prayuktamātrāṇāṃ vyutpādyatve---ūṣa, tera, cakra, peca, ityādivyutpādanavaiyarthyaṃ teṣāmaprayogāditi vācyam | asmadādibhistasya durgamatvāt | yadbhāṣyam--- saptadvīpā vasumatī, trayo lokāḥ, catvāro vedāḥ sāṅgāḥ sarahasyā bahudhā bhinnāḥ, ekaśatamadhvaryuśākhāḥ, sahasravartmā sāmavedaḥ, ekaviṃśatidhā bāh‌vṛcyam, navadhā'tharvaṇo vedaḥ, vākovākyam, itihāsaḥ, purāṇam, vaidyakam, ityetāvān prayogasya viṣaya iti | asti caiṣāṃ vede prayogaḥ--- saptāsye revatīrevadūṣa, yanmenaraḥ śrutyaṃ brahma cakra, yatrānaścakrā jarasaṃ tanūnāmiti | na ca vyutpāditatvamātreṇa prayuktatvānumāne vacantītyādīnāmapi sādhutvāpattiḥ | na hi vacirantiparaḥ prayujyataiti avigītaśiṣṭavyavahāreṇa tatra vyutpattyapravṛtteḥ | tathā cāprayuktatvapramityaviṣayatve sati vyutpādyatvaṃ hetuḥ | tadāhayathālakṣaṇamaprayukte--- iti | syādetat | aprāptāṃśapūraṇaphalako niyamavidhiḥ | vrīhīnavahantītyādau vaituṣyasādhanatvena nakhavidalanāderapi prāptipakṣe'vaghātasya prāptyabhāvāt | avaghātenaiva vaituṣyaṃ sādhyamiti bodhāt | itaravyāvṛttiphalakastu parisaṅ‌khyāvidhiḥ | "imāmagṛbhṇan raśanāmṛtasyetyaśvābhidhānīmādatte" ityatra raśanāgrahaṇai liṅ‌gabalādeva mantraprāptyā garddabharaśanāvyāvṛttāveva tātparyāt | yadyapi liṅgātpūrvameveyaṃ śrutiḥ pravṛttā, tasyānupapattipratisaṃdhānāpekṣatayā caramapravṛttikatvāt, tathā'pyuktavyāvṛttireva phalam | taduktam--- aprāptavidhirevāyamato mantrasya niścitaḥ | prayojanaṃ vidheḥ kiṃ syādasyeti tu nirūpaṇe || na garddabhābhidhānītaḥ phalamanyannivarttaṃnāt | evaṃ ca liṅgenobhayasādhāraṇaraśanāgrahaṇe mantravidhikalpanayā yāvadgarddabharaśanāyā mantraprāptiḥ saṃbhavati tāvadeva pratyakṣavidhinā'śvaraśanāyāmeva mantravidhānālliṅgasya nirākāṅkṣatayobhayasādhāraṇavidhyakalpakatvād garddabharaśanāyāṃ mantrasya prāpakapramāṇābhāvādaprāptireva vyāvṛttirityucyate | yatra tu pramāṇāntaraprāpta evārtho vyāvarttyate, yathā pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyā ityatra pañcātiriktabhakṣaṇasyāpi rāgaprāptatayā pañcātiriktabhakṣaṇavyāvṛttau tātparyaṃ sā prāptaparisaṃkhyā | nanvayaṃ niyama evāstviti cet, avijñāneśvaraḥ--- niyamapakṣe śaśādyabhakṣaṇe doṣaprasaṅgaḥ, śvādibhakṣaṇe cādoṣaprasaṅga iti prāyaścittasmṛtivirodha iti parisaṃkhyaiveti | ādyāyāṃ ca prāptabādharūpadoṣābhāvāttadapekṣayā dvitīyā'bhyarhiteti siddhāntaḥ | tathā ca pañca pañcanakhā ityasya niyamodāharaṇatvaṃ bhāṣyakṛto'nupapannamiti | atrāhuḥ--- parisaṅkhyā'pyatra niyamaśabdena vyavahriyate iti | na caivamapabhraṃśebhyo bodho na syāditi vācyam | niyamaphalasyādṛṣṭasyābhāve'pi dṛṣṭasya kāryasyotpatteḥ | nakha vidalanādinā vaituṣyavat, digantarābhimukhabhojane tṛptivacca | nanvapabhraṃśānāmarthāvabodhahetutvasyāklṛptatvāt kāraṇābhāvaprayukta evārthabodhābhāvaḥ syāt | maivam | paryāyavadvinigamanāvirahādapabhraṃśānāmapi śaktisadbhāvāt | asmātpadādayamartho bodhya itīśvarecchāyāḥ śaktitvapakṣe bhagavadicchāyāḥ sanmātraviṣayakatvāt | padārthāntaratvapakṣe'pi kalpakasya tulyatvāt | asādhusmaraṇadvārā sādhorbodhakatvaprasaṅgācca | tibādismāritānāṃ lādīnāṃ bodhakatvasya vārttikairabhyupagamāt | nacātpatvabahutvābhyāṃ vinigamaḥ, alpīyāṃso hi śabdā bhūyāṃsaścāpaśabdā iti mahābhāṣyokteriti vācyam | ghaṭabodhakatvarūpāyāḥ śaktestadbhramādbodhaṃ vatatā'pyaṅgīkārāt | śaktibhramasya bhramatvakalpanasya punaruktitvāt | nacaivaṃ sarve sarvārthavācakā iti paryavasānād gauṇamukhyavibhāgoccheda iti vācyam | tvatpakṣe'pīśvarecchāyā gauṇādāvatiprasaṅgāt | prayogaprācuryatadvirahābhyāṃ vibhāgācca | atra naiyāyikāḥ | neśvarecchāmātraṃ śaktiḥ, kiṃ tūktaviṣayaviśeṣavaiśiṣṭyena | tathā ca sanmātraviṣayakatvamakiṃcitkaram | pramāṇānurodhenaiva yathoktaviśeṣakalpanāt | miśrāstu uktecchayā īśvareṇa svātantryeṇoccaritatvameva śaktiḥ | na ca caitrādāvavyāptiḥ | dvādaśe'hni pitā nāmetyādito nāmatvena teṣāmapīśvaroccaritatvāt | na ca niṣedhapratiyogitvenāpabhraṃśānāmapyapabhraṃśatvarūpeṇa tathātvam | tadicchayoccaritatvābhāvāt | nāmapadārthaparyālocanayā nāmnāṃ tathā tātparyakoccāraṇasattvāt | na ca gāvīśabdasya bodhakatayā svajñāpyasambandhasattvāllakṣaṇayā gavi sādhutvāpattiḥ | gabhīrāyāṃ nadyāmityādyanurodhācchakyasaṃbandhasya lakṣaṇātvābhāvāditi vācyam | śakyasaṃbandhasyaiva tattvāt | tasya ca jñaptiprayojakasaṃbandhāśrayasaṃbandhaparyavasannasya sākṣātparamparāsādhāraṇaśaktiviṣayasaṃbandhaparyavasannatvād gāvyādipade'nupapatterityāhuḥ | etena padārthāntaratvapakṣe'pi vaiṣamyaṃ vyākhyātam | uktalāghavasyobhayatra vinigamakatvāt | na ca prākṛtasyāpi saṃskṛtavadanugatatvācchaktyāpattiḥ | "tadbhavastatsamo deśītyanekaḥ prākṛtakramaḥ" iti daṇḍyukteḥ | yattu kāvyaprakāśādau śabdaśaktimūladhvanyādau prākṛtagāthodāharaṇaṃ tat tadbodhyasaṃskṛtābhiprāyam | śaktibhramādbodhoktau tatra śaktisvīkāra iti tvasaṃgatam | vyāptibhramaviṣaye vyāpterapyāpatteḥ | tathā ca "na ca śaktisādhyaṃ śaktyāropādbhavitumarhati, āropitadahanādapi dāhāpatteḥ" ityāśaṅ‌kya maṇikṛtoktam--- "jñāyamānakaraṇe prayojakarūpavattayā jñāyamānādeva phalaṃ bāṣpe dhūmāropād vanhyanumitivat" iti | na ca janakajñānabhramatve śābdabuddherayathārthatvam | śaktijñānayathārthatvasya śābdapramāyāmaprayojakatvāt | anāptokte vyabhicārāt | nāpi janakajñānabhramatvenāyathārthatvam | bhramānuvyavasāye vyabhicārāt | apabhraṃśasya śābdapramājanakatvaṃ tu tatprayojakād yogyatādeḥ yathārthatadbodhādvā | abādhitasaṃsargajñānajagakapadārthopasthāpakatvādvā | saṃsargabādhakapramāvirahādveti | prayogapratyayayoraviśeṣe'pi vyākaraṇasya sādhutvaniyamārthatvavat kośādīnāṃ śaktiniyāmakatvācca | uktaṃ ca vākyapadīye--- te sādhuṣvanumānena pratyayotpattihetavaḥ | tādātmyamupagamyaiva śabdasyārthaprakāśakāḥ || na śiṣṭairanugamyante paryāyā iva sādhavaḥ | na yataḥ smṛtiśāstreṇa tasmātsākṣādavācakāḥ || ambāmbeti yadā bālaḥ śikṣamāṇaḥ prabhāṣate | avyaktaṃ tadvidāṃ tena vyakte bhavati nirṇayaḥ || evaṃ sādhau prayoktavye yo'pabhraṃśaḥ prayujyate | tena sādhuvyavahitaḥ kaścidartho'bhīdhīyate || iti | na ca saṃskṛtajñānavirahiṇāṃ mlecchādīnāṃ kathaṃ śaktyāropa iti vācyam | prathamaṃ kenacid gāvīśabde prayukte tatra vyutpanno gośabdādarthaṃ pratītya vyavahṛtavān ambāmbotinyāyāt, pārśvasthaiśca gāvīśabdādeva svārthaḥ prabodhyataiti bhrameṇa gāvīpadaṃ gavi śaktamiti anyeṣāṃ vyutpādanāditi bhramaparamparayā nirvāhāt | nanvevaṃ saṃskṛtatvābhāve śaktyabhāvavyāpyatvajñānavatāṃ tadvācakasaṃskṛtaviśeṣajñānavatāṃ ca--- smārayantaśca te sādhūnarthāvagatihetavaḥ | iti rītyā tatsmaraṇādbodhopapattau api saṃskṛtaviśeṣajñānavirahiṇāmapabhraṃśācchabdabodho na syāt, viśeṣadarśanasattve bhramānavakāśācca iti cet, atra kaṇkoddhārakṛtaḥ, ayamarthaḥ kiñcitpadavācya iti sāmānyajñānādeva āhāryaṃ śaktijñānaṃ tatretyapi kalpanīyam | yadvā tadbodhyārthasaṃbaddhapadārthāntaravācakasya smṛtyā tato lakṣaṇayā bodha iti | na ca yatra sarve'pyapabhraṃśāstatsamārthakasaṃskṛtamātrasya cānupasthitistatroktarītyā śābdabodhānupapattiḥ lākṣaṇikasyānanubhāvakatvāditi vācyam | savibhaktikasyaivoktapadasya smaraṇāt | vibhaktereva tatrānubhāvakatvāt | gaṅgāyāṃ dvirekta ityādivat | evaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvārthavācakatve aśvaśabdo'svaśabdaśca krameṇa vājini daridre ca sādhuḥ, vyutkrameṇa tvasādhuḥ, paratra paraśabdaprayogaḥ taddharmapratipattyartha iti siddhāntavirodhaḥ | gatibuddhipratyavasānārthetyādyarthaviśeṣaghaṭitānuśāsanānupapatyatiprasaktyādiḥ | prayogabāhulyālpatvayorasarvajñāparicchedyatvāt | koṣādeśca śaktimātrabodhakatvena tadatātparyakatvāt | ata eva duścyavanādipadānāmalpaprayogatetyālaṃkārikāḥ | niyataviṣayā api śabdā dṛśyante śavatirgatikarmā kambojeṣveva bhāṣyate vikāraevainamāryā bhāṣante ityādibhāṣyaniruktādidarśanānniyataprayogāṇāṃ tasminnarthe gauṇatvaṃ syāt | yattu sarvatra śaktisvīkāre lakṣaṇānaṅgīkārāllāghavam | anyatā kāryakāraṇabhāvadvayasya śābdadhīdvaye parasparavyabhicāravāraṇāya kāryatāvacchedakakoṭāvavyavahitottaratvaniveśasya cāpatteriti | tattuccham | śaktijñānīyakāryakāraṇabhāveṣu tavāpi tatsāmyāt | na ca tādṛśasthale śaktibhramād yatra bodhastatra śaktijñānatvena kāraṇatāyāstvayā'pi kalpanānnaitadādhikyamiti vācyam | tathā'pi lākṣaṇikapadānāmananubhāvakatvapakṣe tīratvaprakārakatīraviśeṣyakaśābdatvaṃ tīrapadaśaktijñānasya kāryatāvacchedakam | gaṅgāpadalakṣaṇājñānasya tu tādṛśasmṛtitvamiti kāryatāvacchedakabhedena vyabhicārānavakāśāt | navyamate'pi lakṣyatāvacchedake lakṣaṇānabhyupagamāt | kiṃ ca śataṃ śabdānarthāṃścodāhṛtya vicāryate | ekaikasya śataśatārthavācakatve'yutaśaktikalpanaṃ tāvatkāryakāraṇabhāvakalpanaṃ tāvadavyavahitottaratvaniveśanaṃ ca syāt | mama tu śatameva śaktayaḥ kalpyante | na hi mamāpi tāvatīnāṃ lakṣaṇānāṃ svīkāra āvaśyakaḥ | tāvacchabdebhyolakṣaṇayā tāvadarthabodhaḥ kasya cijjāta evetyatra mānābhāvāt | etena śaktibhramo'pi vyākhyātaḥ | tvayā tvajanitānyārthabodhasya tacchaktatvakalpane mānābhāvāt tāvadbhyastāvadarthabodho jāta eveti kalpyam | evaṃ tajjanyavyavahārādayo'pīti mahāgauravamityāstāṃ vistaraḥ | kecittu śaktilakṣaṇājñānayoreka eva kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ | śaktitvāvacchinnasāṃsargikaviṣayatānirūpitapadaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitārthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatāśālijñānatvaṃ kāraṇatāvacchedakaṃ, śābdabodhatvaṃ ca kāryatāvacchedakaṃ, ghaṭo ghaṭapadavānityatrārtho viśeṣyaḥ, padaṃ prakāraḥ, śaktiḥ saṃsargaḥ | nacaivaṃ śakyasambandhasya lakṣaṇāsthale saṃsargatvāttadasaṃgrahaḥ | tasyāpi śaktighaṭitatvāt | śaktitvaniṣṭhāvacchedakatāyāṃ paryāpteraniveśāt | nacaivaṃ tīraṃ gaṅgāpadavaditi śaktirūpasambandhāvacchinnapratiyogitākapadābhāvaprakārakanirṇayasattve lakṣaṇājñānādapi lakṣyārthabodho na syād, bādhakasattvāditi vācyam | padaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitaśaktiniṣṭhasāṃsargikaviṣayatāyāmarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitatvānabhyupagamāttaddharmāvacchinnaviśeṣyatānirūpitā yasya sāṃsargikaviṣayatā taddharmāvacchinnaviśeṣyatākatatsaṃsargāvacchinnapratiyogitākābhāvaprakārakajñānasyaiva pratibandhakatvāditi | tadasat | uktabādhadaśāyāṃ śakyārthabodhasyāpi prasaṅgāt | śakyasambandhapratiyogitāvacchedakakoktajñānadaśāyāmapi lakṣyārthabodhaprasaṅgācca | uktarītyā bādhakābhāvāt | śaktiniṣṭhasāṃsargikaviṣayatāyāḥ padaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitatvānabhyupagame padaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatāyāḥ śaktiniṣṭhasāṃsargikaviṣayatānirūpitatvasyāpi durvacatvācca | yanniṣṭhā yā viṣayatā yanniṣṭhayadviṣayatānirūpitā tanniṣṭhā tadviṣayatā tanniṣṭhatadviṣayatānirūpiteti klṛptatvāt | anyathā śaktiniṣṭhasāṃsargikaviṣayatāyāṃ padaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitatvasya padaniṣṭhaprakāratāyāṃ vā śaktiniṣṭhasāṃsargikaviṣayatānirūpitatvasyābhāvamabhyupagamyoktabādhadraśāyāṃ lakṣyārthabodha ityasya durvāratvāt | tanniṣṭhaviṣayatānirūpakasya kathaṃ tanniṣṭhaviṣayatānirūpitatvaṃ nāstīti yuktestvadukte'pi jāgarūpakatvāt | evaṃ padaniṣṭhaprakāratāyāmarthaviśeṣyatānirūpitatvābhāvaḥ svīkriyatāmuta śaktiniṣṭhasāṃsargikaviṣayatāyāmityapyāpādanīyam | yaddharmāvacchinnaviśeṣyatānirūpitā yā prakāratā taddharmāvacchinnaviśeṣyatākataddharmāvacchinnapratiyogitākābhāvajñānameva pratibandhakamityasyāpi suvacatvāt | atredaṃ bodhyam | bhāṣyamate kratāvevāpaśabdaprayoganiṣedhaḥ | na mlecchitavāityasya tatprakaraṇasthatvāt | śrutyantaramapi yarvāṇastarvāṇo nāma ṛṣayo babhūvuḥ pratyakṣadharmāṇaḥ parāvarajñā ityādi | yogajadharmeṇa dharmasākṣātkāravantaḥ | ayamarthaḥ | viṣayodāsīnatayā yadvānastadvāna iti vaktavye yarvāṇastarvāṇa iti prayogāttannāmakateti | evaṃ ca kratorbahirapaśabdaprayogastaiḥ kṛtaḥ iti tasyāvigītatvonnayanamiti | bhaṭṭairapyuktam--- stryupāyamāṃsabhaktādipuruṣārthamapi śritaḥ | pratiṣedhaḥ kratoraṅgamiṣṭaḥ prakaraṇāśrayāt || vārtikamate tu ubhayatra niṣedhaḥ | nānṛtaṃ vadedityanārabhyādhītapuruṣārthaniṣedhena sarvasiddhenārthānṛtavacchabdānṛtasyāpi niṣedhopapatteḥ | evaṃ ca kratāvapabhāṣaṇe tadvaiguṇyaṃ pratyavāyaśca | tadbahistu pratyavāyamātramiti viśeṣaḥ | atra mīmāṃsākaustubhakṛtaḥ | anṛtapadasyobhayaparatve vadedityasyoccāraṇapratipādanobhayaparatve vairūpyam | evaṃ sakṛcchrutānṛtapadasyāpi | na ca śabdānṛtasyaiva tarhi niṣedho'yaṃ vinigamakābhāvāditi vācyam | "prātaḥ prātaranṛtaṃ te vadanti purodayājjuhvati ye'gnihotram" ityādiśrautaprayogavaśādarthānṛtaevānṛtapadaśaktyavadhāraṇāt | bhāṣyasmṛteranavakāśatayā tadanurodhenātratyānṛtapadasyārthāsatyatvaparatvavasya kalpayitumucitatvācca | ata eva nānṛtaṃ vadediti śrutereva vivāhārthānṛtavadanābhyanujñāpakasmṛtyā saṅkocaḥ | na ca na mlecchitavāiti mlecchabhāṣāyā eva niṣedhaḥ | helaya ityupakramavirodhāt | mleccho havā eṣa yadapaśabda ityupasaṃhāravirodhācca | nanu "vāgyogavid duṣyapi cāpaśabdaiḥ" ityatra vācā caiva hi manasā ca yajñaḥ pravartataitidarśanena vāgyogavicchabdasya yajamānaparatvāt sādhubhāṣaṇaniyamasya yājñe karmaṇi niyamo'nyatrāniyama iti mahābhāṣyoktyā yajñamātraparatvāt tadbalādeva jyotiṣṭome'pi niṣedhasiddhau tatra pṛthaṅ‌niṣedhavaiyarthyam iti cenna | avaghātāsambhave dalanavatpratinidhitvena prasaktānāmasādhūnāṃ prayoganiṣedhārthatvāt | ayajñiyā vai māṣā ityādivat | evaṃ jyotiṣṭome sādhuprayogāsambhave pratinidhitvenāpyasādhavo na vācyāḥ | kiṃ tvakṣisaṃketādibhireva vyavahartavyam | yajñāntare tvapabhraṃśā api pratinidheyā iti phalitam | ata evāhitāgnirapaśabdaṃ prayujyetyatrāhitāgnipadaṃ saṃgacchate | anyathā niṣedhasya jyotiṣṭomamātraparatve naimittikaprāyaścittasyāpi tanmātraviṣayakatvasya svata eva siddheḥ | na ceyamiṣṭiranārabhyādhatitvane hiraṇyanāśeṣṭyādivat puruṣārtheva syāditi vācyam | prāyaścittīyā mā bhūmetyādibhāṣyadarśanena doṣanirghātārthatvāddoṣasya ca bhāṣyānusāreṇa yajñe'paśabdabhāṣaṇādeva prasakterdoṣanirghātadvārā kratvaṅgatvapratīteḥ | na caivamapyāhitāgnigrahaṇavaiyarthyam, yajñamātraeva tadadhikārāditi vācyam | yājñe karmaṇīti bhāṣyasmṛtāvasādhubhāṣaṇaniṣedhasya smārttayajñādibhyo vyāvṛttyarthatvāt | vastutaḥ prāyaścitte'paśabdabhāṣaṇasya nimittatayā tadviśeṣaṇamāhitāgnipadamavivakṣitamevetyanuvāda eva | na ca naimittikokteṣṭikartṛtvena tadvivakṣā | iṣṭerapi svata evāhitāgnisādhyatvāt | ato na tadvaiyarthyabhayena svatantrapuruṣārthaniṣedhakalpanaṃ yuktam | na ca vāgyogaviditi kātyāyanavacanātpuruṣārtho'pi niṣedha iti vācyam | yathottaraṃ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyamiti nyāyena patañjaliproktasyaiva grāhyatvādityāhuḥ | atha kimidaṃ sādhutvam | na tāvad bodhakatvam | apaśabdasādhāraṇyāt | na ca śaktimattvam | śabādivikaraṇaānāmasādhutvāpatteḥ | teṣāṃ kartrādivācakatāyāstṛtīye parastatvāt | apaśabde vyabhicārācca | sādhutvasyaiva śaktyavacchedakatvenānyonyāśrayatvācca | gauṇalākṣaṇikayoravyāpteśca | tayorapi kvacicchaktirastyeveti cedgāvīśabdasya gaṃ gaṇapatimavituṃ prīṇayituṃ śīlamasyeti miśroktarītyā guṅ‌ śabdaityatoṇini vā kkacidarthe śaktisattvād gavyapi tadāpatteḥ | etena vṛttimattvaṃ tadityapi parāstam | etena yasya śabdasya yatrārthe'nādiprayogaḥ sa tatra sādhurityapi nirastam | helaya iti vedaprayukte aliśabde'tivyāpteśca | tasyāpaśabdatvāt | na ca vedasya tadaṃśe|ñanuvādarūpatvānna tatrānādiprayogaḥ | saṃjñā śabdedaṣvavyāpteḥ | na ca nāmadheyatvena tadapi vedasthameveti vācyam | nāpabhāṣitavai ityādāvapabhraṃśatvenāpaśabdānāmapi tathātvāt | na ca niṣedhāpratiyogitvena taditi vācyam | mleccho ha vā eṣa yadapaśabda ityādau tasyāpi sattvāt | etena vedasthaśabdatvaṃ tadityapi nirastam | "bhāṣāyāṃ sadavasaśruvaḥ" "prathamāyāśca dvivacane bhāṣāyām" iti bhāṣāpuruskāreṇa vyutpāditānāṃ niṣedivān yuvāmityādīnāṃ sādhutvānāpatteśca | bhāṣāpadopādānasāmarthyena teṣaāṃ vede prayogo nāstīti nirṇayāt | nāpi yajñaprayogārhatvam | sādhūnāmeva tathātvāt | tadavacchedakarūpāntarāparicayāt | etenābhyudayajanakatvamapi parāstam | nāpyanapabhraṣṭatvam | taddhyapabhraṃśabhinnatvameva | tacca na sāditvam | saṃjñāśabdātivyāpteḥ | nāpi sādhubhinnatvam | anyonyāśrayāt | sādhutvasya tadbhedaghaṭitatvāt | nāpi pratyavāyayogyatvam | tadavacchedakarūpānirukteḥ | nānṛtaṃ vadedityādinā visaṃvādisaṃskṛtasyāpi pratyavāyajanakatvāt | na ca jātiviśeṣe eva sādhutvam | katvādinā saṅkarāt | sādhugakāre asādhukakāre ca parasparātyantābhāvalasamānādhikaraṇayoḥ sādhutvakatvayoḥ sādhukakāre samāveśāt | kaśabdādācārakkibantātkartari kvipi paryāptyā sāmānādhikaraṇyasambhavāt | ātrāhuḥ | anapabhraṣṭatā'nādiḥ yadvā'bhyudayayogyatā | prakriyāvyañjanīyā vā jātiḥ kā'papīha sādhutā || ityabhiyuktoktyā jātiviśeṣa eva sādhutvam | na ca saṅkarastadbādhakaḥ | guṇagatajātau tasyādauṣatvāt | tathā hi | santi tāvacchabdeṣu tattajjanyatāvacchedikā jātayaḥ | yataḥ strīpuṃsādyuccaritamanumīyate | santi ca devadattādijanyatāvacchedikā api jātayaḥ | yato'yaṃ devadattīya ityādyanumīyate iti nirvivādam | tatra devadattīyatvābhivyañjikā jātiḥ tadīyakakārādivṛttirekā svīkartavyā | yatra devadattīyā anoṣṭhyā eva varṇāḥ pūrvaṃ śrutāḥ, tatra cākṣuṣādyaviṣayadevadattoccāritauṣṭhyaśravaṇe devadattīyatvānumānasyānubhavikatvāt | katvādivyāpyatādṛśanānājātisvīkāre oṣṭhyavarṇavṛttijāteḥ pūrvamagrahādanumānānupapatteḥ | tathā ca devadattoccaritagakāre caitrīyakakāre ca parasparātyantābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇayordevadattīyatvābhivyañjakajātikatvajātyordevadattoccāritakakāre samāveśāt saṃkara āvaśyaka iti | taccintyam | dravyagatajātito vaiṣamyābhāvāt | "guṇagatajātau sāṃkaryaṃ na doṣa iti mataṃ nirbījameva" ityupāyakṛtā "bījasāmyena guṇe'pi tasya doṣatvam" iti maṇikṛtā cābhihitatvāt | na coktānupapattiḥ | tatra smaryamāṇāyāḥ kakārādivṛttijāterāropeṇaivānumānopapatteḥ | viṣayasattvenānumiterbhramatvānāpatteḥ | ata evoktaṃ śabdamaṇau | śukakakārādiṣu katvādivyāpyajātirbhinnā | tayā pratyekaṃ śukakakārādiṣu śukādiprabhavatvamanumāya tadvyavahāraḥ | na tu śukakakārādiṣvekā jātirasti śukaprabhavatvānumāpikā tadvyavahārikā vā | gatvādinā saṃkaraprasaṅgāditi | miśrāstu sādhutvajātervarṇavṛttitve varṇaṣu sādhutvapratyayāpattiḥ | vākye tathātvapratyayānupapattiḥ | devadattīyatvādyanumāpakajātisaṃkarāpattiścetyāhuḥ | kiṃ ca ghaṭādipadeṣu jātyanupapattiḥ | padasya varṇasamudāyātmakasya avyavahitottaratvasaṃbandhena ghaviśiṣṭaṭakārādirūpatayā sādhutvaparyāptyadhikaraṇasya yugapadanavasthānāt | "anārabdhe tu gośabde gośabdatvaṃ kathaṃ bhavet" itinyāyena padatvavat sādhutvasyāpi jātitvāsaṃbhavāt | jātervyāsajyavṛttitvānupapattiśceti | atrocyate--- ayaṃ vṛddhānāmāśayaḥ | nityatve satyanekasamavetatvaṃ jātisvarūpam | tacca vyāsajyavṛttitve'pyaviruddham | samavāyāvacchinnavṛtterekamātrāśrayanirūpyatvaniyamābhāvāt | ghaṭādāveva vyabhicārāt | saṃyogādīnāṃ ca janyatvādeva jātitvābhāvo na tu vyāsajyavṛttitvāt | darśanamātrasya cāprayojakatvāt | padavṛttitvābhyupagamādeva saṃkaro'pyanavakāśaḥ | ekajātiparyāptyadhikaraṇe yathoktānyajātiparyāptāveva tadullāsāt | na ca "akāro vāsudevaḥ syāt" ityādyanuśāsanāt tatsambuddhau a ityādau saṅkaro durvāraḥ | tathā'pi vākyaniṣṭhasādhutvābhyupagame doṣābhāvāt | nacaivaṃ vyākaraṇasya sādhvanuśānatvabhaṅgāpattiḥ | padadvārā vākyasyaiva saṃskārāt | vākyādapod‌dhṛtya padāni saṃskriyante iti pakṣasyāpi "na padānta" iti sūtre ākarārūḍhatvāt | padamātrasya kayācid vyutpattyā sādhutvādvā | vākyaviśeṣāntarbhāveṇaiva sādhutvāsādhutvayorvyavasthitatvāt | na ca paryāptyadhikaraṇasamudāyaghaṭakavarṇānāmekakālānavasthānāt kathaṃ tatra sādhutvam | padavākyapratyakṣasya sarvasaṃmatatayā tatra yādṛśī viṣayatā yasya varṇasya tadviṣayatvāpannavarṇasamudāye tad‌vṛttisaṃbhavāt | pratyakṣaviṣayavarṇamātravṛttitvānabhyupagamāt | vyavahāreṇa tathaiva siddhatvācca | viruddhadharmasamasaṃkhyākā nityā eva akārādayo varṇā itipakṣasya pāṇinyādyabhimatatvena aiuṇ‌sūtre vakṣyamāṇatvāt | maṇikṛtastu vyākaraṇavyutpādyatvaṃ sādhutvam | vyākaraṇaparigṛhītatvatadabhāvābhyāmeva prāmāṇikānāṃ sādhvasādhuvyavahārāt | ata eva yaḥ śabdo vyākaraṇena yasminnarthe vyutpāditaḥ tatra sādhurasādhuranyatra | nāmnāmapi "uṇādayo bahulam" iti vyutpāditatvāt | kevalaprakṛtipratyayayorbādhayati grāmagādeśca na tadvyutpādyatvam | anabhidhānena teṣāṃ prayogānarhatvāt | gauṇalākṣaṇikayośca yathā pratipādakatvaṃ tadvyutpādanamapi tatra tatheti tayorapi sādhutvam | na ca sādhuśabdavyutpādakatvameva vyākaraṇatvamityātmāśrayaḥ | śabdaguṇadoṣavidbhirabhiyuktaiḥ prakṛtipratyayādiparikalpanayā śabdānvākhyāyakavākyasya vyākaraṇatvāt | na ca guṇadoṣayorapi sādhutvātmakatvād doṣatādavasthyam | dharmajanakatvādharmajanakatvayoreva tattvāt | na ca sādhutve siddhe vyākaraṇavyutpādyatvaṃ tadvyutpādyatve ca sādhutvamityanyonyāśrayaḥ | pūrvapūrvavyākaraṇataḥ sādhutvamavagamyottarottaravyākaraṇena tad‌vyutpādanāt | sādhutvasya jātitve niṣpratiyogikatvāpattau sarvatra sarvasādhutvāpattiḥ | na ca gośabdaḥ aśve prayuktaḥ sādhureva, jñāpakaśca na bhavati, tacchaktatvenājñānāditi vācyam | gāvīśabdasyāpi kayācid vyutpattyā kvacit sādhutvamiti tajjātiyogena gavyapi sādhutvāpatteḥ | pratiśabdaṃ bhinnatadviṣayajātisvīkāre cānanugamāt | na ca jāteḥ pratiyoginirūpaṇanirūpyatvābhāvaniyame tāratvādijātirapi mandādinirūpaṇanirūpyā na syāditi vācyam | tatrāpi jātrirnetaranirūpaṇanirūpyā, kintu tadutkarṣatvamevetyabhyupagamādityāhuḥ | mīmāṃsakāstu vṛttipramayā'rthapratipādakatvaṃ sādhutvam | vṛttitvaṃ ca śaktilakṣaṇāgauṇyanyatamatvarūpam | gāvyādiṣu ca prayogāderanyathaivopapattervṛttitrayābhāvānnātivyāptiḥ | saṃjñānāṃ tu dvādaśe'hanītyādisāmānyavidhinā putratvādyupādhinā saṃketakaraṇena śakteḥ pramitatvānnāvyāptiḥ | putrādināmakaraṇe gṛhyeṣu niyamaśruteḥ | anādiśaktitā saṃjñāsvapi naiva virudhyate || iti vākyapadīyāt | ṭighubhādīnāṃ cālakṣyatvādeva | "naiva tāḥ sādhavo matāḥ" itinyāyāt | vastuto vṛttigrahābhāve teṣāmarthabodhakatvānupapatteḥ svayaṃ saṃpāditasaṃketatvena gāvyādivacchabdāntaropasthāpakatayā'pi tadayogānmukhyārthābhāve tanmūlakalakṣaṇāgauṇyorapyanupapatteḥ sāṃpratikaśaktisvīkāreṇaiva ṭighubhādiśabdānāmarthabodhakatvaṃ vācyam | ata eva pūrvoktasādhutve'pi na kṣatiḥ | ata eva pāṇinyādeḥ "ṭeḥ" ityādau ṣaṣṭhyādiprayogo'pyupapadyataityāhuḥ | kecittu "ṭeḥ" ityādīnāṃ ṭiśabdānukaraṇatvameva | anukaraṇottaramitiśabdaprayoganiyame mānābhāvāt | "anukaraṇaṃ cānitiparam" itisūtravirodhāt | nacaivaṃ ṭītiśabdasyaiva lopāṭikāryaṃ syānna tvantyasvarādivarṇasyeti vācyam | lakṣaṇayā tatparatvāṅgīkārādityāhuḥ | asādhutvaṃ tu tadbhinnatvameva, na tu jātiviśeṣaḥ | pramāṇābhāvāt | tadanubhavasya sādhutvābhāvāviṣayatvasyānubhavikatvācca | yogyānupalabdhibādhitatvācca | sādhutvaṃ tu vyākaraṇasaṃskārasahakṛtaśrotrendriyagrāhyam | taduktam | prakriyāvyañjanīyeti | taduktam--- tatra tattvamabhiyogāt syāditi | tathā--- abhiyuktāśca ye tatra yannibaddhaprayojanāḥ | tatratyaguṇadoṣaṇāṃ jñāne cādhikṛtā matāḥ || sādhvanuśāsanābhyāsasyāsādhuviṣayakasaṃskārajanakatvoktaucātiprasaṅgāditi | saṃjñāśabde tvayaṃ viśeṣaḥ--- yāstvetāḥ svecchayā saṃjñāḥ kriyante ṭighubhādayaḥ | kathaṃ nu tāsāṃ sādhutvaṃ naiva tāḥ sādhavo matāḥ || anapabhraṃśarūpatvānnāpyāsāmapaśabdatā | hastaceṣṭā yathā loke tathā saṅketitā imāḥ || tāsāṃ prayoge'bhyudayaḥ pratyavāyo'pi vā bhavet | lāghavenārthabodhārthaṃ prayujyante tu kevalam || iti ubhayabahirbhāvaḥ | vyavahārāya niyamaḥ saṃjñāyāḥ saṃjñini kvacit | nitya eva tu sambandho ḍitthādiṣu gavādivat || vṛddhyādīnāṃ ca śāstre'smin śaktyavacchedalakṣaṇaḥ | akṛtrimo'bhisambandho viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavat || itirītyā teṣāmapyanāditā itipakṣe tu sādhutvameva | nāmakaraṇe tu "kṛtaṃ kuryānna taddhitam " iti gṛhyasūtrānugatānāmeva sādhutvam | dvādaśe'hani pitā vanāma kuryāditi śruterviśeṣaviṣayakasmṛtyā bādhāt | deśabhāṣānusāriṇīnāṃ tu saṃjñānāṃ na tat | tathā ca śabdakaṇṭakoddhāre--- anāditā cet sādhutvaṃ saṃjñāśabdeṣu kā gatiḥ | ucyate nāmakaraṇe gṛhyeṣu niyamaśruteḥ || yathākāmaṃ na saṃjñānāṃ viniyogaḥ samasti naḥ | tasmādanāditā saṃjñāsvapi naiva vidhīyate || yāstu taddeśabhāṣābhiḥ saṃjñāstāsāṃ na sādhutā | ata eva nyāyyabhāvāt kalpanaṃ saṃjñādiṣviti tṛtīyavārttike anādiśabdānāṃ sādhutvamityuktam | tṛtīyatvābhidhānaṃ tu viparītagaṇanayetyavadheyam | vārttikaṃ tu ṛlṛk‌sūtre spaṣṭam | tasmāt prakṛtipratyayavibhāgakalpanayā sādhuśabdā atra vyutpādyantaiti siddham || iti sādhutvavicāraḥ || athaivaṃ varṇopadeśavaiyarthyam | aiuṇ‌ ityādinā kasyacit sādhutvānavagamāt | na ca doṣarahitavarṇasvarūpapratītiḥ tadarthaḥ | lokata eva tatsiddheḥ | anyathodāttādipāṭhasyāpyāpatteḥ | taduktam--- iṣṭabuddhyarthaśceti cedudāttānudāttasvaritānunāsikadīrghaplutānāmapyupadeśa iti | karttavyaḥ syāditi śeṣaḥ | traisvaryeṇa sūtrapāṭhe ekasyoccāraṇādeva siddho dvayoreva karttavyatāyā āpādyatve'pi ekaśrutyā pāṭhābhiprāyeṇodāttāditrayapāṭha āpāditaḥ | na ca nirdeśasya jātiparatvād udāttādisaṃgrahaḥ | saṃvṛtakalādīnāmapi tattajjātyavacchinnatayā saṃgrahāpatteḥ | taduktam--- ākṛtyupadeśātsiddham iticet saṃvṛtādīnāṃ pratiṣedha iti | vidheyaḥ syāditi śeṣaḥ | hasvākārasya saṃvṛtatve'pi tadanyeṣāmacāṃ saṃvṛtatvaṃ doṣaḥ | ādipadasaṃgrāhyānāha bhāṣyam--- saṃvṛtaḥ, kalaḥ, dhmātaḥ, eṇīkṛtaḥ, arddhakaḥ, grastaḥ, nirastaḥ, pragītaḥ, upagītaḥ, kṣviṇṇaḥ, romaśaḥ, avalambitaḥ, nirhataḥ, saṃdaṣṭaḥ, vikīrṇaḥ, iti | apara āha--- grastaṃ nirastamavalambitaṃ nirhatamambūkṛtaṃ dhmātamatho vikampitam | saṃdaṣṭameṇīkṛtamarddhakaṃ drutaṃ vikīrṇametāḥ svaradoṣabhāvanāḥ || vyākhyātaṃ ca kaiyaṭena | kalaḥ sthānāntaraniṣpannaḥ kākalītvena prasiddhaḥ | dhmātaḥ śvāsabhūyiṣṭhatayā hrasvo'pi dīrgha iva lakṣyate | eṇīkṛto'viśiṣṭaḥ kimayamokāra uta aukāra iti yatra saṃdehaḥ | ambūkṛto yo vyakto'pyantarmukha iva śrūyate | arddhako dīrgho'pi hrasva iva | grasto jihvāmūle nigṛhītaḥ, avyakta ityapare | nirasto niṣṭhuraḥ | pragītaḥ sāmavaduccāritaḥ | upagītaḥ samīpavarṇāntaragītyā'nuraktaḥ | kṣviṇṇaḥ kampamāna iva | romaśo gambhīraḥ | avalambito varṇāntarasaṃbhinnaḥ | nirhato rūkṣaḥ | saṃdaṣṭo varddhita iva | vikīrṇo varṇāntare prasṛtaḥ, eko'pyanekanirbhāsītyapare | svaradoṣabhāvanāḥ svaradoṣagotrāṇi | anantā hi doṣāḥ śaktipramādakṛtā iti | na ca doṣaviśiṣyānāmapi nirdeśe tādṛśānāmeva prayogāpattiḥ | śāstrānte sarvāsāmeva varṇavyaktīnāṃ śuddhānāṃ pāṭhyatvāt | siddhānte sarvāsāmeva varṇavyaktīnāṃ vivṛtatvapratijñāyāmapi "aa" itisūtreṇa saṃvṛtatvavat | śāstrāntapāṭhena ca sarvatrāsiddhatvalābhaḥ | evaṃ cānubandhānāmitsaṃjñālopayośca tyāgāllāghavam | tathā hi | śī dhātau īkāraḥ eva kalaḥ pāṭhyaḥ | kalādātmanepadam | dhmātātkartrabhiprāye | ādyantau kaladhmātau ityādikaṃ tatra tatra paṭhanīyam | iḍānugādayaḥ kaladhmātāśca krameṇa pāṭhyāḥ | ḍukṛñ‌ ityatra kṛ iti dvidoṣaṃ pāṭhyam | anubandhāstu sarvatra heyāḥ | ādirantyena sahetā ityatra ādikalau saheti vācyam | kalenetipāṭhe tu siddhānte caramasya ṇakārāderivātrāpyantyavarṇasya saṃjñā na syāt | ḍhralopa ityādau aṇa ityasya sthāne aoriti | asaṃdehārtho'sandhiḥ | siddhyatyevam, apāṇinīyaṃ tu bhavati | atra siddhāntavārttikam--- āgamāśca vikārāśca pratyayāḥ saha dhātubhiḥ | uccāryante tatasteṣu neme prāptāḥ kalādayaḥ || jātiparanirdeśe'pi śāstre āgamādīnāṃ viśiṣya pāṭhena doṣanivṛttirityarthaḥ | na cāpaṭhiteṣu prātipadikeṣu doṣaḥ | tvayā'pi pratipadapāṭhasyāvaśyāśrayaṇīyatvāt | anyathā śaśo, mañcakaḥ, palāśaḥ, ityādau ṣaṣo, mañcakaḥ, palāṣaḥ, ityādeḥ prasaṅgāt | nanu svarādinirṇayāya pratipadapāṭhe doṣanivṛttirapi tato'stu, uṇāditvāt pṛṣodarāditvādvā sādhutvābhyanujñānam---viśeṣāvadhāraṇaṃ tu koṣādinā ityuktau tu doṣanivṛttirapi śikṣāderastu iti cet | satyam | doṣanivṛtterānuṣaṅgikatvāt | pratyāhāraniṣpattereva prayojanatvāt | te ca aṇādayaḥ | pratāyahiyante saṃkṣipyante varṇā atretivyutpatteḥ | na ca grahaṇakavākyādakārādibhiraṣyanekeṣāmupasthāpanādatiprasaṅgaḥ | rūḍhereva niyāmakatvāt | bhāṣyavārttikavyavahārasya ca tatra mānatvāt | na ca rūḍhyavacchedakābhāvaḥ | paṅkajapade padmatvasyevātrāpi ādirantyenetyetatsūtra vihitasaṃjñātvasya tathātvāt | tena suptiṅādisādhāraṇyam | yadi tu tatpadajanyabodhaprakārasyaiva rūḍhyavacchedakatvamiti niyamaḥṣa śaktyupādheḥ śābdaviṣayatvaniyamāditi granthadarśanāt | tadā'stu prayogopādhirevoktadharmaḥ | tatprayogajanyayogārthajñānavirodhivirahapratiyogitvasya tathātvāt | yadvā---uktasaṃjñātvameva pratyāhāratvam | ādirantyenetisūtreṇa kṛtāḥ saṃjñāḥ pratyāhāraśabdena vyavahviyantaiti darśanāditi sarvaṃ śivam || iti śrīkūrmācalacakravarttiguruṇā viśveśvareṇa viracite siddhāntasudhānidhau prathamādhyāyasya prathame pāde prathamamānhikam || aiuṇ‌ 1 ādirantyenetivakṣyamāṇasūtrasaṅketavaśādaṇādisaṃjñāsaṃgrāhyavarṇānupūrvīparāṇi caturdaśa sūtrāṇi | spaṣṭapratipattyarthaṃ guṇādīnāmabhāvaḥ | yattu a ityatra vibhakterutvayatvayalopeṣu lopasyāsiddhatvāt ikāre iko'savarṇaiti ṛkāre ṛtyaka iti prakṛtibhāvāñca samādhānād edaitorayāyau durvārāviti | tanna | prakṛtibhāve padāntādhikārāt | chāndasatvādvibhaktilopakalpanamapekṣyāsandhikalpanasyaiva yuktatvāt | kaiyaṭastu varṇopadeśakāle'jādisaṃjñānāmaniṣpādānna sandhiriti | tasyāyamāśayaḥ | aniṣpādāt svanimittakavidheratra pravṛttyaupayikarūpavaikalyāt, varṇopadeśavyāvṛttaṃ yaduddeśyatāvacchedakaṃ tadavacchinnatvāditi yāvat | sādhuśabdānāmeva vyutpādyatvāt | eṣāṃ ca laukikavaidikaśabdānantarbhāvāt | saṃjñāśūbdatve "aiuṇ‌" ityādīnāṃ mānābhāvāt | etena pāṭhapaurvāparyaṃ na śāstrapravṛttau tantram | uttarasūtraprayuktakāryanirddeśasya pūrvasūtreṣu bahulamupalabhyamānasyānupapatteḥ | "tulyāsyaprayatnam" ityādau tadvidheyasavarṇādisaṃjñopajīvakasavarṇadīrghādyapravṛttyāpatteḥ | vidhisūtre uddeśyatāvacchedakatayā gṛhyamāṇo yo dharmastadavacchinne kāryapravṛtterāvaśyakatvāt | ata eva neha nānā'sti kiṃcanetyādīnāṃ niṣedhyatāvacchedakībhūtadṛśyatvādidharmāvacchinnatayā svasyāpi mithyātvabodhakatvaṃ saṅgacchate | na caivaṃ grahaṇakaśāstrasyāpi svasmin pravṛttyāpattau dīrghāṇāmanaṇtvena savarṇagrāhakatvaṃ nāstītisiddhāntabhaṅgāpattiḥ iti vācyam | tatra tacchāstrāt pūrvamakārādīnāṃ dīrghānupasthāpakatvāt dīrghāṇaāmuddeśyatvagrāhābhāvāt iti dūṣaṇamalagnakaṃ veditavyam | tulyāsyādipadānāṃ sādhutvena tatra śāstrapravṛtteḥ | tadvākyārthabodhe tulyāsyādipadārthopasthitereva tantratayā savarṇadīrghatvaprakārakabodhasyānapekṣitatvācca | yattu saṃhitāvirahānna tatkāryam--- saṃhitaikapade nityā nityā dhātūpasargayoḥ | nityā samāse vākye tu sā vivakṣāmapekṣate || iti vākye saṃhitāyā anityatvāditi | taccintyam | akārekārādīnāṃ parasparārthānvayapratiyogyarthānupasthāpakatvena vākyatvābhāvāt | na caitatsūtroktānāmakārādīnām "aṇuditsavarṇasya ca" ityādāvanvayapratiyogitvāttaditi vācyam | tasya vākyatve'pyasya tadanupapatteḥ | anyathā'tiprasaṅ‌gāt | kecittu cādiṣu pāṭhānnipātatve "nipāta ekāj‌" iti pragṛhyasaṃjñayā prakṛtibhāvaḥ | nacaivaṃ dākṣirityādau "ataiñ‌" ityādīnāṃ pravṛttirna syāt, taparatvasāmarthyādākṣarasamāmnāyikasyaivākārasya tatra grahaṇād anyasya sarvaṇagrāhakatvāprasaktyā tannivṛttyarthaṃ taparatvānupayogāditi vācyam | sarvavyaktīnāṃ nirdeśānarhatayā yatkiṃcid‌vyaktinirddeśadhrauvye saṃhitākāryaviraheṇa sphuṭapratipattyarthaṃ nipātavyaktīnāmeva nirddeśe'pi sādṛśyena sarvākāravyaktīnāmupasthityā tatsiddherityāhuḥ | tadapyasat | svavṛttivarṇatvavyāpyadharmeṇa sādṛśyavivakṣāyāṃ dīrghāṇāmapi grahāpatteḥ | na ca nipātānyavyaktinirddeśe'pyayaṃ doṣaḥ | avivakṣitavāntaradharmakavyaktimātrasya nirdeśopagamāt | na ca nipātatvatadbhinnatvobhayābhāvavadavarṇavyaktimātramalīkamiti vācyam | taddharmayoravivakṣāmātrasyoktatvāt | nipātatvasya ca pragṛhyasaṃjñārthamavaśyaṃ vivakṣaṇīyatvāt | kārapratyayastu na bhavati | "rogākhyāyāṃ ṇvulbahulam" ityatra tadupasaṃkhyānāt tadvidhau bahulagrahaṇānvayāt | syādetat | akāraḥ saṃvṛta iti śikṣāvākyāt saṃvṛtaprayatnasya hvasvākārasya vivṛtaprayatnairdīrghaplutākāraiḥ saha sāvarṇyābhāvāt katham "asya ccau" ityādau dīrghagrahaḥ | "aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyaya" iti savarṇānāmeva grahaṇokteḥ | bhinnaprayatnānāṃ ca sāvarṇyābhāvāt | evamihāgnidattetyatra "guroranṛta" iti plutākāreṇa saha savarṇadīrgho na syāt iticet satyam | ata evātrākāro vivṛta evopadiṣṭaḥ | yadvārttikam--- akārasya vivṛtopadeśa ākāragrahaṇārtha iti | atra ca śāstrānte " a a" iti pratyāpattisūtraṃ jñāpakam | tatra hi a iti vivṛtatvaviśiṣṭam a iti ca saṃvṛtatvaviśiṣṭam akāramuccārya vivṛtoddeśena saṃvṛtākāro vidhīyate | saviśeṣaṇe hīti nyāyena saṃvṛtatvasyaiva vidheyatvaparyavasānam | akārasya ca saṃvṛtatve śāstrīyaprakriyādaśāyāmāśrīyamāṇe saṃvṛtatvavidhivaiyarthyāpatteḥ | tataḥ pūrvamakāro vivṛtaḥ pratijñāyataiti prakriyādaśāyāṃ prayogadaśāyāṃ vā na doṣaḥ | śāstrānte vihitasya saṃvṛtatvasya saṃpūrṇaśāstraṃ pratyasiddhatvāt | ākārasya vivṛtatvaṃ ca pāṇinīyaśikṣāyāmuktam--- svarāṇāmūṣmaṇāṃ caiva vivṛtaṃ karaṇaṃ smṛtam | tebhyo'pi vivṛtāveṅau tābhyāmaicau tathaiva ca || iti | svarapadamejbhinnaparam hvasvākārānyaparaṃ ca | saṃvṛto'kāra iti śikṣāntarokteḥ | evaṃ ca hvasvānyākārasya iuṛlṛvarṇānāṃ ca vivṛtatvam | tato'pyekāre okāre ca tadutkarṣaḥ | tato'pyaikāre aukāre cetyarthaḥ | ke cittu uktavārttikasthaṃ vivṛtapadaṃ vivṛtataraparam | dīrghādyakārasya vivṛtataratvena tatsāvarṇyasya vivṛtatvamātreṇāsiddheḥ | tathā ca śikṣāntare--- vivṛtakaraṇāḥ svarāstebhya eo vivṛtatarau tābhyāmaiau tābhyāmapyākāra iti | na ca vyāpyadharmāvacchinnasya vyāpakadharmāvacchinnatvaniyamāt vivṛtatarasyāpi vivṛtatvānapāyāt tata eva sāvarṇyanirvāhe vārttikasthaṃ vivṛtapadaṃ yathāśrutamevāstviti vācyam | vyāpyadharmapuraskāreṇaiva sāvarṇyasya vācyatvāt | ata evoṣmaṇāmīṣadvivṛtatvamāśritya vivṛtaprayatnairikārādibhiḥ sāvarṇyaṃ nāstīti "nājjñalau" iti sūtraṃ bhāṣyakṛdbhiḥ pratyādekṣyate | atha vā sāmārthyādvivṛtatarasyāpi vivṛtatvamātreṇa sāvarṇyam | anyathā vivṛtatvapratijñānavaiyarthyādityāhuḥ | anye tu vivṛtatareṇāpi vivṛtatvamātreṇa sāvarṇyaṃ, sūtrakṛtā "nājjhalau" ityasyārambhāt | ataeva--- "catvāra ābhyantarāḥ prayatnāḥ savarṇasaṃjñāyāmāśrīyante" iti vṛttiḥ | nanvevamekāraukārābhyāṃ saha aidautoḥ sāvarṇyaṃ syāt | tayorvivṛtataratve'pi vivṛtatvānapāyāt | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ | nāvaṃ nāva ityādau "auto'mśasoḥ" ityātvasya karavāvahai atretyatredūdediti pragṛhyatvasya kasmai adāt viṣṇau astītyādau pūrvarūpasya cāpatteḥ | maivam | atra pṛthaṅ‌nirddeśasāmarthyādanubandhadvayasāmarthyādvā tatra sāvarṇyāpravṛtteḥ | anyathā hyekānubandhenaiva vyavaharet, aidautau vā na nirdiśet | grahaṇakaśāstreṇaiva siddherityāhuḥ | atredaṃ cintyam | "eco'yavāyāvaḥ" ityatrādeśaniyamārthamaikāraukārayoḥ pṛthagupadeśaḥ | anyathā''deśasaṅkārāpatteḥ | athāntaratamaparibhāṣayaiva tatra nirvāhaḥ | ecāṃ sandhyakṣaratayā saṃvṛtākāratālavyasya ekārasya tādṛśo'y‌, saṃvṛtākārauṣṭhyasya okārasya tādṛśo'v‌, aicoścottarabhūyastvasya vakṣyamāṇatayā akārasyārddhamātratvādikārokārayoścādhyarddhamātratvādvivṛtākāratālavyasya aikārasya tādṛśa āy, vivṛtākārauṣṭhyasya aukārasya tādṛśa āv, iti vyavasthāsambhavāt | maivam | prakriyādaśāyāmakārasya vivṛtatvapratijñānāt | yattu pṛthaganubandhāditi | tanna | guṇavṛddhisaṃjñayoruddeśyasaṃjñiniyamārthamanubandhadvayasyāpyāvaśyakatvāt | na ca tatra svarūpeṇaiva saṃjñinirdeśānnirvāhaḥ | tathā sati tatrāṣṭamātrāgauravāt | yathānyāse tu sārddhamātrādvayaṃ pratyekaṃ guṇavṛddhisaṃjñayoḥ, arddhamātrā ca varṇasamāmnāye iti sārddhāḥ pañcaiva mātrā iti lāghavāt | na ca guṇasaṃjñāyāmeva svarūpeṇa saṃjñinirdeśaḥ, vṛddhisaṃjñāyāṃ tvanubandhenaiveti vācyam | tathā'pi guṇasaṃjñāyāṃ mātrācatuṣṭayam, vṛddhisaṃjñāyāṃ sārdhamātrādvayamiti militvā sārddhaṣaṇmātrāsaṃpattyā ekamātrādikyāt | nanu "eṅaḥ padāntād‌" ityādau eca ityapahāya paṅgrahaṇasāmarthyādeva aicornātiprasaṅgaḥ | sāvarṇyāpravṛttirityasya tatprayuktakāryāpravṛttirityartha iti cenna | tathā 'pi "auto'mūśasoḥ" ityādau atiprasaṅgāt | na hi taparatvādisthale'ṇaḥ savarṇagrāhakatvaṃ nāstīti sthalāntare'pi tathaiva syāditi dik | atra caikaśeṣeṇa ṣaṇṇāṃ hrasvavyaktīnāmupādānam | sautratvādvibhaktilopaḥ | evamuttarasūtre'pi | ata eva dīrghāṇāmanaṇtvamityapi saṃgacchate | evam "asyacvau" ityādāvanuvāde "tyadādīnāmaḥ" ityādividhau ca hvasvanirdeśe sarvatra hrasvānāmaṇtvamastyeva | tataścānuvāde dīrghādigraho vidhau tu neti iṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ grahaṇakaśāstrārambhaḥ | tena vinā sadvyavasthānupapatteḥ | evaṃ ca viruddhadharmasamasaṃkhyākā nityā ekākārādivyaktayaḥ iti mate naivātra sūtrapravṛttiḥ | ṣaṇṇāmeva hvasvākāravyaktīnāṃ jagati sattvena tāsāṃ vivṛtatvapratijñāne dhātuprātipadikapratyayanipātasthānāmakārāṇāṃ pratyāhāranirdiṣṭaṣaḍakāravyaktibhedakūṭānāśrayatayā sarveṣāmanāyāsena tattadac‌kāryasiddheḥ | nacaivaṃ sarve varṇāḥ sakṛdupadiṣṭā iti hayavaraṭ‌sūtrasthabhāṣyavirodhāpattiḥ, akāraṣaṭ‌kanirdeśasya tvayā'bhyupagamāditi vācyam | eva prayatnoccāryatvasyaiva tadarthatvāt | uccāryavarṇānāha upadiṣṭā ime varṇā iti bhāṣyadarśanāt | nanvaṣṭādaśaiva bhinnā nityāścākārā iti na kasyacit tāntrikasya matam iti cet satyam | yuktisahatvenāsyāpyabhyupagamyatvāt | tathā hi--- bhaṭṭamate tāvadekaikā eva akārādivyaktayo nityāḥ | sa evāyamakāra iti pratyabhijñānāt | nacedaṃ tajjātīyatvāvagāhi vaktuṃ śakyam | bādhakabalādeva jvālādipratyabhijñānasya tajjātīyaviṣayakatvokteḥ | prakṛte ca tadabhāvāt | na ca gakāra utpanno vinaṣṭa ityādirutpattivināśapratyayaḥ tathā | vyañjakadhvanigatasyotpattyādestatrāropāt | na ca svādhikaraṇakṣaṇadhvaṃsānadhikaraṇasamayasambandharūpāyā utpatteḥ svatvaghaṭitatvena dharmibhedabhinnatvāt katham anyotpatteranyatrāropa iti vācyam | utpattighaṭakapadārthānāṃ pratyekamupanaye akārāderadhikaraṇe tasya kṣaṇe tasya dhvaṃse tasyādhikaraṇe ityādirītyā sakhaṇḍotpattibhramasaṃbhavāt | ata eva indhanasamānādhikaraṇātyantābhāvapratiyogitānavacchedakavahnitvāvacchinnavahnisamānādhikaraṇarūpāyā akhaṇḍavyāptervanhitve indhanasamānādhikaraṇātyantābhāvapratiyogitānavacchedakatvābhāvādaprasiddhāvapi taddhaṭakapadārthānāṃ parasparopaśleṣaviṣayatvenaiva vyāptibhramaḥ | na ca pratyabhijñāyā eva bhramatvam pratyayānurodhāditi vācyam | tathā'pi vinigamakābhāvāt | anantaśabdataddhvaṃsaprāgabhāvādikalpanāgauravasya nityatvapakṣapātitvācca | na caikasmin dharmiṇi ekakālāvacchedena viruddhadharmānupapattyā tāratvamandatvādibhedāt tadbheda iti vācyam | tāratvādīnāṃ vāyudharmatvāt | mukhamālinyāderdarpaṇadharmatvavat | anyathā varṇagatatvābhimatagatvādijātibhirvyāpyavyāpakabhāvānupapatteḥ | na hi tāratvavyāpyaṃ gatvam | mandagakāre'pi tatsattvāt | nāpi gatvavyāyaṃ tāratvam | kakārādāvapi tatsattvāt | tāragakāre ca tayoḥ sāṃkaryāt | nacaivaṃ tāratvādeḥ śrotragrāhyatvaṃ na syāt | tasya vāyugrāhakatvābhāvenaiva vāyudharmagrāhakatvābhāvāditi vācyam | keṣāṃcid vāyudharmāṇāṃ tena grahe'pi bādhakābhāvāt | pṛthivījalākāśānāṃ ghrāṇarasanaśrotrāgrāhyatve'pi gandharasaśabdānāṃ tadgrāhyatvopagamāt | tāramandavarṇajanakavāyūnāmutkarṣāpakarṣod‌bhūtasparśānāṃ naiyāyikābhyupagatatvena sparśapuraskāreṇa karṇaśaṣkulyavacchinnatvagindriyagṛhītānāṃ tāratvādīnāṃ śrotreṇa grahasaṃbhavādvā | ata eva ghajñānānantaragrahaviṣayatvādirūpānupūrvyāḥ mānasopanītāyāḥ ṭakārādau śrotreṇaiva graha iti siddhāntaḥ | ata eva taśakṛtvo gakāramuccārayatītyāvṛttiviṣayaka eva pratyaya; na tu vyaktibhedāvagāhī daśa gakārānutpādayatīti | taduktam--- tena yat prārthyate jātestadvarṇādeva lapsyate | vyaktilabhyaṃ tu nādebhya iti gatvādidhīrvṛthā || iti | pratyabhijñānasya varṇaikyādviruddhadharmavattāyāśca dhvanigatatvādupapattirityarthaḥ | atra caivaṃ sūtropapattiḥ | dhātvādisthānāmakārāṇāmaikyena sarveṣāmapyaṇtvāt "asyacvau" ityādisthe akāre grahaṇakaśāstrapravṛttiḥ | śāmyatītyādau "śamāmaṣṭānām" iti dīrghaḥ | dṛṣadityatra phiṭ‌sūtreṇa prātipadikāntyasyākārasya udāttatvam | aṇādisthasya pratyayasvareṇādyudāttatvam | avanamatītyādau "upasargāścābhivarjam" ityādyudāttatvam | anyathā akārāṇāṃ bhinnatve varṇopadeśasthākārasya vivṛtatvapratijñāne'pyanyatra gatānāṃ vivṛtatvābhāvāduktānāmackāryāṇāmapravṛttiprasaṅgāt | hvasvatvādīnām udāttatvādīnāṃ cājekadharmatvāt | varṇasamāmnāyāntargatasyaivāctvāt | tataśca varṇasamāmnāyopadiṣṭāvarṇamātroddeśena kasyacit kāryasyāvidhānāduktavacanasāmarthyamātreṇa tatkāryapravṛttirityādi kalpyaṃ syāt | na caivaṃ kapratyaye'pyaṇpratyayakāryāṇām aṇpratyaye ca kapratyayakāryāṇāṃ pravṛttiḥ syāt, anubandhasaṅkarāpatteriti vācyam | niyatānubandhakaraṇasāmarthyena tattaddeśapuraskāreṇaiva tattadanubandhakāryaniyamopapatteḥ loke'pi iha muṇḍo bhava, iha jaṭilo bhava, iha nagno bhava, ityādirītyā'syānekadharmopadeśe'pi yaddharmāvacchinno yatropadiśyate tatraiva taddharmavyavasthādarśanāt | evaṃ " karmaṇyaṇ‌" ityādāvevaṇittvam | "careṣṭaḥ" itiyādāveva ṭittvam | "gāpoṣṭak" ityatra kittvaṭittve | ata eva "prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌" ṭhasivādibhyo'ṇ‌" ityādau punarṇitkaraṇasārthakyam | nanu tathā'pi ghaṭena taratīti ghaṭika ityatra "naudvyacaṣṭhan‌" iti ṭhanpratyayaḥ, dhanasya nimittaṃ saṃyoga utpāto vā dhanya ityatra "tasya nimittaṃ saṃyogotpātau" ityādhikṛtya vihito "godvyaco'saṃkhyāparimāṇāśvāderyat" iti yatpratyayaśca na syāt, akārasyaikatvena dvyac‌tvābhāvāt, sūtraṃ tu bāhubhyāṃ tarati bāhuka ityādau yatra vijātīyamajdvayaṃ tatra sāvakāśam iti cenna | āvṛttyā ghaṭādipadasyāpi dvyactvāt | na ca gauṇamukhyayoritinyāyāvatāraḥ | "godvyaca" ityatra asaṃkhyāparimāṇāśvāderyadityaśvādiparyudāsena tadabhāvasyāpi jñāpitatvāt | anyathā aśvaśabde mukhyadvyactvābhāvena yatpratyayāprāptau paryudāsavaiyarthyāt | ata eva kiriṇā giriṇetyādau "sāvekāca" iti vibhakterudātatvaṃ nāsti | gauṇenāpi dvyaj‌vyapadeśena ekāj‌vyapadeśasya bādhitatvāt | etadrītyaiva sṛṣṭisamayotpannā tatpralayaparyantasthāyinī ekaivākārādivyaktiriti vedāntamate'pi prakṛterupapattiravadheyeti | etaccāyuktam | tāratvādīnāṃ vāyudharmatve katvādīnāmapi tathātvāpatteḥ | uktaṃ hi tātparyaśuddhāvudayanācāryaiḥ--- varṇātmako'pi nityaḥ kalpyamāna ekaḥ kalpanīyaḥ | pratyabhijñānāt | bhede pramāṇābhāvācca | tāratvādayastvaupādhikāstatrāva bhāsante | tathā ca tīvratvādivat katvādayo'pi tasyaupādhikāḥ santu, kṛtam aprāmāṇikabahutarakalpanājālena | upādhayaśca bahava iti tadgatamekatvasāmānyaṃ kalpanīyamiti ghaṭṭakuṭhyāṃ prabhātam | athoktadoṣabhiyā svābhāvikā eva tīvratvādaya ityabhyupagamaḥ tathā sati tāvanta eva dhvanivat kādayo'pīti katvasāmānyamāvartataiti | na cotpattivināśapratītyorbhramatvaṃ kalpyam | vinigamakābhāvāt | dhvaṃsaprāgabhāvādikalpanasya ca phalamukhatvāt | tanmate kaṇṭhatālvādyabhighātasya kasākṣātkāratvaṃ janyatāvacchedakam manmate tu katvameveti lāghavācca | na ca tanmate'pi laukikaviṣayitāsambandhena katvameva kāryatāvacchedakamiti vācyam | laukikatvasyānanugatatvāt | kolāhala pratyakṣānupapatteśca | tatra katvādīnāmanavabodhāt | teṣvetatpratyakṣe katvādilaukikaviṣayakatvābhāvāt | agṛhyamāṇakaśabdatvādivyāpyajātikanānāśabdānāṃ kolāhalapadārthatvāt | na ca tatra katvādikameva nāstīti vācyam | bubhutsāyāṃ katvādiśrāvaṇasya sarvānubhavasiddhatvāt | na ca pratyabhijñānamātreṇaikyasiddhiḥ | saiveyaṃ gurjarītyādipratyabhijñānena dhvanīnāmapi nityatvāpatteḥ | sa evāyaṃ gakāra iti pratyabhijñāyāśca vyaktyabhedaviṣayakatvaeva bhramatvam | gatvādyavachinnapratiyogitākabhedābhāvaparatve tu pramātvameva | na ca jātipratyabhijñāyāstajjātīyo'yamityevākāra iti vācyam | tadevedam auṣadhaṃ bahubhirbhuktaṃ mayā'pi bhujyate ityādau tajjātīyābhedapratyabhijñāyā api tadākāratvādarśanāt | ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ | yadā gatve jātitvamapi bhāsate tadā tajjātīyo'yamiti | tadabhāve tu so'yamitipratyabhijñāsvarūpamiti | tasmāttattatsvarūpajanyā anantā eva varṇāḥ | nanvevaṃ śabdasyārthabodhakatvaṃ na syāt, yasminpade śaktigrahastasya naṣṭatvāditi cet | maivam | yathā śaktigrahaviṣayasya ghaṭādernāśe'pi ghaṭapadād ghaṭāntarasya bodhaḥ tathā śaktimattvena jñātapadanāśe'pi tajjātīyapadāntarād bodhopapatteḥ | yattu vyaktyaikye sāmānyameva nāsti tat kathaṃ padāntarād bodha iti | tanna | vyaktibhedasyāpi sādhitatvāt | iti naiyāyikāḥ | atrāpi vyaktyabhedapratyabhijñāyā bhramatvamastyeva | evam etanmatasyātrānusāre pratyuccāraṇaṃ varṇānāṃ bhedāt "asya cvau" ityādāvakārasya aṇ‌tvābhāvāt savarṇagrāhakatvaṃ na syāt | atastatra kaṇ‌ṭhādijanyatāvacchedakajātivyāpyā hrasvamātravṛttirapi jātirasti | saiva varṇasamāmnāye vivṛtatvenopadiṣṭā | ata eva sarveṣāmapi hrasvānāmaṇ‌tvamastyebeti na kutrāpyanupapattiḥ | atrāpīdaṃ cintyam | hrasvākāramātravṛttijātau mānābhāvaḥ | na ca hrasveṣu dīrghādivyāvṛttānugatapratyayādeva tatsiddhiḥ | tasya hrasvatvenaivopapatteḥ | na ca hrasvatvameva sā jātiḥ na tvatirikteti vācyam | tasyā atvādivyāpyatvānupapatteḥ | atvahrasvatvayordīrghākāre saṅkarāpatteḥ | na cātvādivyāpyatvaṃ hrasvatvaṃ nānaiveti vācyam | hrasvākārekārādiṣvanugatapratyayānupapatteḥ | "ūkālo'j‌ jhrasvadīrghaplutaḥ" iti hrasvatvasya jātitvābhāvācca | uccāraṇagarbhasya hrasvatvasyopādheranugatatvācca | tasmādaṣṭādaśaiva akāravyaktayo nityāḥ | evaṃ hri pratyabhijñānasya pramātvam viruddhadharmāṇāṃ ca nāropasvīkāra iti matadvayādviśeṣaḥ | tadanugatasya atvādisāmānyasya svīkārācca kolāhalapratyakṣopapattiḥ | na ca laukikaviṣayatāsambandhena katvādīnāṃ kāryatāvacchedakatve kathaṃ kolāhalapratyakṣam, tatra katvādīnāmagrahāditi vācyam | tathā'pi svāśrayaviṣayatāyā eva kāryatāvacchedakasambandhatvāt | katvādyāśrayakakārādīnāṃ kolāhalapratyakṣe viṣayatāyā nirvivādatvāt | vijātīyapavanasaṃyogasya yathā tanmate avacchedakatāsambandhena akārādau hetutvaṃ, samavāyaśca kāraṇatāvacchedakaḥ, tathaivātra tatsākṣātkāre samavāyena pavanasaṃyogavati śravaṇe avacchedakatayā śabdaśrāvaṇotpatteḥ atvādipratyakṣe ca śrāvaṇasamavāyo niyāmakaḥ | śrāvaṇe akāre atvasya samavāyāt | akāraniṣṭhakatvābhāvaśrāvaṇe ca śrāvaṇaviśeṣaṇatā niyāmikā | śrotrasamavāyāderetatpakṣe'nabhyupagamāt | nanu śrāvaṇasamavāyasannikarṣe śrāvaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇamupalakṣaṇaṃ vā | nādyaḥ | anabhivyaktadaśāyāmapyakārasya śrāvaṇopalakṣitatvena tadā'pyatvapratyakṣāpatteḥ | nāntyaḥ | akārasya tatkāle śrāvaṇotpattiṃ vinā śrāvaṇaviśiṣṭatvāsambhavāt | atvapratyakṣotpattipūrvaṃ kevalāvarṇapratyakṣasvīkārāpatteḥ | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ | svāśrayalaukikaviṣayitāsambandhasya kāryatāvacchedakatayā kevalaśabdapratyakṣāsambhavāt, nirvikalpakelaukikaviṣayatā'nabhyupagamāt iticet | maivam | śabdatvādiprakārakapratyakṣasyaiva pūrvaṃ svīkārāt | nanvatrāpyudāttākārādanudattākārābhedāvagāhipratyabhijñāyā bhramatvameveti cet, satyam | tathā'pi bahvīnāṃ tāsāṃ pramātvarakṣaṇādityādikamūhanīyam | ayaṃ ca pakṣaḥ tāramandādidharmabhedabhinnā gakārādivyaktayo nityā eva santviti varṇānityatāvāde bhaṭṭamataikadeśatayā nyāyagrantheṣu śaṅkitaprāya eva aṣṭādaśāvarṇavyaktaya iti śabdakaustubhe'pyatropanyastaḥ | anusṛtaśca bhagavadbhyāṃ vārttikabhāṣyakārābhyām--- tathā hi | "aa" iti sūtre anuvādyapareṇa pūrvākāreṇa grahaṇakaśāstravaśād dīrghadīnāmapyupasthāpane teṣāmapiprayogadaśāyāṃ saṃvṛtatvavidhānaṃ syādityāsaṅkya dvedhā samāhitam--- siddhantu taparanirdeśāt, ekaśeṣanirdeśaādvā svarānunāsikabhinnānāṃ bhagavataḥ pāṇineḥ siddhamiti | at iti pāṭhaḥ kartavyaḥ "tataśca taparastatkālasya" iti dīrghādigrahaṇaṃ netyādyaṃ samādhānam | sūtrasvārasyābhāvādatrāparituṣya ṣaṇṇāṃ hrasvānāmekaśeṣeṇa a iti nirdeśaḥ, tatsāmarthyācca na grahaṇakaśāstrapravṛttiriti dvitīyam | ataśca ṣaḍeva hrasvākāravyaktaya iti tātparyāt arthāttāvatāṃ dīrghāṇāṃ plutānāṃ ca lābhenityatvam | vinā ca ṣaṇṇāmekaśeṣeṇa sarvahrasvākārasaṃgrahābhāvād‌ hrasvamātravṛttyatvāvyāpyajātisattve ca tatparatvenaivopapattau ekaśeṣānuvādānupapattestannityatvaparyavasānāt | nanvevaṃ sarvatra savarṇagrahaṇābhāvasthale ekaśeṣeṇaiva nirvāhe "taparastatkālasya" iti sūtraṃ vyarthaṃ syāditi cet | maivam | sūtranirdeśasvārasyena atraikaśeṣasvīkāre'pi taparatvāpekṣayā tatra gauravāt | "upasargādṛti dhātau" ityādau ṛvarṇena lṛvarṇagrahaṇasyaikaśeṣeṇa sādhayitumaśakyatvācca | tatra dīrghagrahaṇavāraṇārthaṃ taparatvasyāvaśyakatayā'nyatrāpi tasyaiva yuktatvācca | etena ghaṭena taratītyādau gauṇe'pi kāryanirvāhārthaṃ jñāpakānusaraṇaṃ parāstam | sukhyatayaiva nirvāhāt | dvyac‌sthale'nyatarasyodāttatve śeṣanighātenānyatarasyānudāttatvadhrauvyeṇa bhedasattvāt | evaṃ bhaṭṭamate kiriṇetyādau saptamībahuvacane sau ya ekāc tataḥ parā tṛtīyādirvibhaktirudāttā syādityarthakena "sāvekācastṛtīyādirvibhaktiḥ" iti sūtreṇodāttatvaṃ syāt | kiriṣu ityatraikāckasattvāt | yattvāvṛttikṛtena dvyajvyapadeśena svāśrayasyaikāckatvasya nivṛttiriti | tanna | gauṇenāgnitvena māṇavakatvasya nivṛttya bhāvāt | triputre dviputravyapadeśābhāvastu triputratvasyāpyanāropitatvāt | dvitvānyavyāsajyavṛttisaṃkhyāparyāptyanāśrayapuruṣaniṣṭhajanyatvanirūpyajanakatvābhāvavatpuruṣatātparyakasyaiva dviputra iti prayogasya tasminnapramāṇatvāt | saṃbhāvabhiprāye tu pramāṇatvāt | dviputratvavyatirekeṇa triputratvasyāpyanupapatteḥ | ata eva "na vānyasaṃkhyāvyavacchedo navaiva dravyāṇītyasya nārthaḥ tatpūrvasaṃkhyotpattiṃ vinā navatvāyogād" iti dravyopāyādāvuktam | ata evādyānāṃ trayāṇāṃ padārthānāṃ sāmānyavattvamityādayaḥ prayogāḥ | aśvādiparyudāsasya sāmānyāpekṣajñāpakatvoktāvapi gauṇe kāryapravṛttereva nirvāho na tu mukhyavyāvṛtteḥ | tanmātreṇa sāmarthyasyopakṣīṇatvāt | nanu rājñetyādau vibhakterudāttatvavāraṇārthaṃ sāvityuktam | svāśrayaikāc‌tvābhyupagame tu rājasvityatrāpyekāc‌tvasattvāt tadvāraṇaṃ na syāt, ato'tra svāśrayaikāc‌tvanivṛttau sāvityeva jñāpakam iti cet | na | bāhunetyādivāraṇena tasya sārthakyasaṃbhavāt | na caikāca ityanena tadvyāvṛttiḥ | saptamyekavacane tasyāpyekāc‌tavāt | "aukārādeśo ḍitkartavya" iti saptame bhāṣyakṛtoktatvāt | na ca vibhaktimātre ekāc‌tvaṃ vivakṣaṇīyam | sāvityasya vaiyarthyāt | kiṃ ca "ūḍidampadādyappuṃraidyubhyaḥ" iti sūtre ekāj‌grahaṇānuvṛttyā "paddannomās‌" iti sūtre nirdiṣṭāḥ padādayo niś‌śabdaparyantā gṛhyante, tataḥ pareṣāmasannādīnāmanekāc‌tvāt iti sthitam padādiṣu niśantāni prayojayantīti vārttike bhāṣye ca | gauṇena dvyactvena svāśrayaikāc‌tvānivṛttau ca asan yakan śakan āsan ityeteṣāmapyanekāc‌tvena grahaṇaṃ syāditi tadvirodho durvāraḥ | ato vārttikādikameva tannivṛttijñāpakam iti cet, satyam | evaṃvidhakaṣṭasṛṣṭimapekṣyoktarītereva yuktatvāt | uktasarvagranthānāmakāravyaktibhedapakṣābhiprāyeṇaivopapannatvācceti dik | vārttikamate tu atvādijātiparo nirdeśaḥ | na caivaṃ dīrghāṇāmapi savarṇagrāhakatvāpattiḥ | dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyāt | sarveṣāṃ sañjighṛkṣitatve lāghavārthaṃ hrasvasyaiva nirdeśaprasaṅgāt | na caivamapi dīrghasya plutagrāhakatvaṃ syādeva, plutanirdeśe gauravāpattyā tannivṛttau dīrghoccāraṇasya sāmarthyābhāvāditi vācyam | hrasvavyāvṛttatatsādhāraṇadharmābhāvāt | grahaṇakaśāstre'ṇagrahaṇaṃ ca na kāryam | taduktam--- savarṇe'ṇgrahaṇamaparibhāṣyamākṛtigrahaṇāt | taparasūtraṃ tu sthalaviśeṣe jātiparatvavyāvarttanāyaiva | nacaivaṃ vidheyasthale'pi savarṇagrāhakatvāpattau "tyadādīnāmaḥ" "sanāśaṃsabhikṣa uḥ" ityādau dīrghādīnāmapi vidhānaṃ syāditi vācyam | tatra vidheyaviśeṣaṇatayā ekatvasyāpi paśvekatvavat vivakṣitatvāt | na ca tathā'pyatvāvacchinnavidhānasya dīrgheṇāpi caritārthatayā dīrgha evaiko'stviti vācyam | anupasthitadīrghakalpanāpekṣayā upasthitahrasvasyaiva vidheyatvāt | na ca hrasvatvaṃ na padārthatayopasthitamiti vācyam | svarūpeṇaiva hrasvasyoccāraṇāt | "asya cvau" ityādau tvanuvādyaviśeṣaṇatvādgrahaikatvavanna tadvivakṣeti sarvaparatvam | yattu vaiyākaraṇamate vidheyānuvādyaviśeṣaṇānāṃ vivakṣitāvikṣitatvaniyamābhāvaḥ | "upeyivānanāśvānanūcānaśca" ityādau upetyādeḥ nañādeśca vidheyaviśeṣaṇatvāviśeṣe'pi vivakṣāvaiṣamyadarśanāt | "ārddhadhātukasyeḍ‌ valādeḥ" ityatra valāditvasyānuvādyaviśeṣaṇasyāpi vivakṣitatvācca | ata eva "ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ" itisūtre ekagrahaṇamam | anyathā ād‌guṇa ityekatvavivakṣayaivopapatteriti | tat tuccham | mīmāṃsakādīnāmapyavivakṣādeḥ kuladharmatvābhāvāt | śabdopāttārthe vivakṣāyā dhrauvye'pi vidhyanvayānupapattyā nyāyabalāt tatparityāgāt | nyāyasya vacanavirodhe satyakiñcitkaratayā'nuvādyaviśeṣaṇasyāpi kvacit vivakṣitatvāt | ata eva--- parvaṇyaudayike kuryuḥ śrāvaṇīṃ taittirīyakāḥ | ityatra audayikatvaviśiṣṭaparvaviśiṣṭopākarmoddeśena taittirīyakā eveti kartṛniyamavidhāne uddeśyaviśeṣaṇavivakṣādhīnavākyabhedāpatyā taittirīyapadaṃ yājuṣamātropalakṣaṇīkṛtya parvaviśiṣṭopākarmoddeśena audayikatvamātravidhiḥ | parvaṇo'pyavivakṣāyām "bah‌vṛcāḥ śravaṇe kuryuḥ" iti vākyavaiyarthyāpatteriti svīkārāt | ata eva ca " yasyobhayaṃ havirārttimārched" ityatra ārtimātrasya pratiyogiviśeṣānavacchinnasya sārvadikatvānnimittatvāparyavasānāt tadviśeṣaṇamapi havirvivakṣitameva | taduktam--- mṛṣyāmahe haviṣā viśeṣaṇaṃ paryavasitasya hi viśeṣaṇaṃ vākyabhedamāvakṣyatīti | tadviśeṣaṇamubhayatvaṃ tvavivakṣitamiti siddhāntaḥ | vastutaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ śaiṣikatvāt kriyānvayānāvaśyakatvāt pūrvamevārddhadhātuke viśeṣaṇasaṃbhavānna vākyabhedaḥ, aśvābhidhānīmityādivat | "īyivāṃsamatistridhaḥ" ityādeḥ kevalasyopasargāntarapūrvakasya ca prayogadarśanād upetyasyāvivakṣitatvāt | urityekatvavivakṣayā udvayasthāne ekasyokārādeśasya manoramākaustubhayoruktatvācca ekagrahaṇasya bhāṣyakṛtā pratyākhyātatvāt | tathā ca tatra kaiyaṭenoktam--- "tadevamekagrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātam | "ād‌ guṇaḥ" ityādau saṃkhyāyāḥ śabdopāttāyā vivakṣaṇāt | yatra tu saṃkhyā na vivakṣyate tatra lakṣyasiddhiravivakṣitatve hetuḥ" iti | saṃkhyeti prakṛtābhiprāyam, vidheyaviśeṣaṇāntarāṇāmapyupalakṣaṇam | abhyupetyāpi brūmaḥ | taparapratyayau tatkālasya iti sūtrayitvā'pi "tyadādīnāmaḥ" ityādau atiprasaṅgavāraṇasya spaṣṭaprakāreṇaiva saṃbhavād grahaṇakasūtre'ṇ‌grahaṇamanāvaśyakameva | avaśyaṃ cāṇ‌bhinnasthale varṇanirdeśasya jātiparatvaṃ vaktavyam | anyathā avāt s tāmityatra sicaḥ pūrvottarayostakārayormadhye ekasyaiva jhal‌tvaṃ syānna tu dvayoḥ | akṣarasamāmnāye dvayoranirddeśāt | tataśca "jhalo jhāli" iti sico lopo na syāt | na ca vacanasāmarthyaṃ gatiḥ | abhitthā ityādau vijātīyavarṇaparatve sāvakāśatvāt | evaṃ "nāj‌jhalau" itisūtraṃ prayatnasāmyapakṣe'pyanārabhyamiti lāghavam | ubhayasādhāraṇaikajātyabhāvenaivākārādibhirhakārādīnāmagrahaṇasiddheḥ | na ca daṇḍahasta ityādau savarṇadīrghavāraṇaṃ sāvarṇyaniṣedhaṃ vinā durupapādamiti vācyam | tadvidhāvacītyanuvṛttyaiva tatsambhavāt | sūtrārambhapakṣe'pi tadanuvṛtteḥ kumārī śete ityādau doṣavāraṇāyāvaśyakatvāt | agṛhītasavarṇānāmeva "nāj‌jhalau" itiniṣedha iti siddhāntāditi dik | yattu pratyāhārasūtropadiṣṭo'kārādiḥ sādṛśyasambandhena svasadṛśīḥ ṣaṭ‌ vyaktīrupasthāpayati | na ca vṛttyā'nupasthitānāṃ śābdānvayānupapattiḥ | gurumatena tatsaṃbhavāditi | taccintyam | hrasvatvena sādṛśyavivakṣāyāmikārāderapyupasthāpanāpatteḥ | atvahrasvatvābhyāṃ tathātve tu atvamātreṇa sādṛśyaṃ vivakṣitvā'ṣṭādaśavyaktīnāmevopasthitisambhavāt | akāropari prakārībhūya bhāsamānāyāmatvajātau tātparyamupekṣya taddhaṭitagurutaradharmeṇākārāntaropasthitikalpanasyānuktisambhavagrastatvācca | ṛlṛk 2 | nanu vidhipradeśeṣu ṛkāreṇāṣṭādaśasvabhedānāmiva dvādaśalṛvarṇabhedānāmapi grahasambhavād iha lṛkāropadeśo vyarthaḥ | na ca mūrddhadantarūpasthānabhedena sāvarṇyābhāvāt kathaṃ grahaṇakaśāstrapravṛttiriti vācyam | "ṛlṛvarṇayormithaḥ sāvarṇyaṃ vācyam" iti vācanikasāvarṇyena tatsiddheḥ | na ca tadeva nārabhyamiti vācyam | "upasargādṛti dhātau" itisūtrāt "vā supyāpiśaleḥ" ityatra ṛtītyanuvṛcyā prālkārīyatītyatra vṛddhivikalpapravṛttyarthaṃ tadāvaśyakatvāt | yadvā vācyaṃ vyākhyeyam | "ṛkāralṛkārāvatha ṣaṣṭha ūṣmā jihvāmūlīyā" iti bah‌vṛcaprātiśākhyoktarītyā tulyasthānatvāt sūtreṇaiva sāvarṇyaṃ siddhamityarthaḥ | ata eva "ṛduṣadhāccāklṛpicṛteḥ" ityatra klṛpiparyudāsaḥ saṅgacchate | kiṃ ca klṛpisthalṛkārasyaiva lṛkāramātramanukaraṇam | svātantryeṇa tadbhinnalṛkārasya lokavedayorabhāvāt | klṛperlṛkāraśca latvasyāsiddhatvāt svarakāryeṣu ṛkārarūpa eveti vṛddhyādīnāṃ siddhiriti lṛkāropadeśaḥ sāvarṇyavārttikaṃ ca vyarthameva | na ca "kṛpo ro laḥ" iti vihitasya lṛkārasyaivāsiddhatvam, na tu lṛkārīyatītyādisthatadanukaraṇasyeti vācyam | prakṛtivadanukaraṇam ityatideśena tasyāpyasiddhatvāt | anyathā dviḥ pacantvityāhetyatra pacantuśabdasya "tiṅ‌ṅatiṅaḥ" iti nighāto na syāt | tiṅantaśabdānukaraṇatvena svarūpatistiṅantatvābhāvāt | na ca taittirīyavākye ādyudāttapāṭhāt tatra nighāto neṣyataeveti vācyam | bhāṣyodāharaṇasāmarthyena śākhāntare nighātapāṭhasyāpyanumānāt | evam agnīityāhetyādau "īdūded‌ dvivacanaṃ" iti pragṛhyasaṃjñā na syāt | na caivam ṛkārabuddhyā kāryapravṛttau tatsthānīyaguṇāde raparatvameva syāt, na tu laparatvamiti vācyam | "uraṇ‌ raparaḥ" ityatra pratyāhāragrahaṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ, prakṛtau kutrāpyanupayogāt | na ca calkṛpe ityādau abhyāsasya atve prakṛtāveva laparatvasārthakyam | tatra halādiśeṣasyāvaśyakatayā raparatve'pi doṣābhāvāt | na ca klṛptasyāyaṃ kāl‌pta ityādau tasyopayogaḥ | "taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ" iti vṛddhau latvasyāsiddhatayā ṛkāraeva vṛddhipravṛttau raparatve ca "kṛpo ro laḥ" ityanenaiva siddheḥ | na ca tadrephasya svatantratayā ṛkārānantargatatvāt kathaṃ latvamiti vācyam | kṛperyo rephastasyāpi latvamityuttarasūtrayorvyavasthāpanīyatvāt | na ca tathā'pi gamlṛ gatāvityādisthasya lṛkārasyānukaraṇe kathaṃ nirvāhaḥ, tatrāsiddhatvātideśayorapravṛtteriti vācyam | puṣādidyutādy‌lṛditaḥ" iti sūtre lṛkāre parato yaṇādeśaprayogeṇa itsaṃjñānuvādena ca jñāpakena tasyāpyac‌kāryasiddheḥ | vastuta itsaṃjñānuvādasya hal‌kāryasiddhaṃ jñāpayitvā'pi paryavasānasambhavādyaṇ‌nirdeśa eva jñāpakaḥ | yattvevam "idito num" ityādyanuvādānām "ṛtyakaḥ" ityādijñāpakānāṃ ca sattvāt ikārādayo'pi na nirdiśyeranniti | tanna | tannirdeśaṃ vinā ac‌kāryatvādereva durgrahatvāt | lṛkārasyātyalpaviṣayakatvenoktasthalānupapattiparihāramātrārthamanuvādānusārāt | tat kimarthaṃ lṛkāropadeśa iti prāpte abhidhīyate--- lṛkāropadeśo yadṛcchā'śaktijānukaraṇaplutyādyartha iti | dadhy‌lṛtakāya dehīti yadṛcchāśabdaḥ | ṛkāroccāraṇapravṛttau karaṇāpāṭavāt lṛjuityuktasya kumārīlṛjuityāhetyaśaktijānukaraṇam | plutadvirvacanasvaritāśca plutyādayaḥ | klṛptaśikhetyatra "guroranṛto'nantyasyāpyekaikasya prācām" iti plutaḥ | anyathā anṛta iti niṣedhaḥ syāt | klṛptetyatra "anaci ca" iti dvitvam | anatarbhāvitaṇyarthāt karmaṇi ktapratyayānte praklṛpta ityatra karmārthakaktapratyayānte pare'vyavahitagatiḥ prakṛtyā syādityarthakena "gatiranantaraḥ" iti sūtreṇa pūrvapade prakṛtisvaravidhānāt praśabda udāttaḥ | śeṣanighātena lṛkārapratyayākārayoranudāttatvam | tata "udāttādanudāttasya" iti lṛkārasya svaritatvam | na hyetad asiddhatvena sādhayituṃ śakyam | "kṛpo ro laḥ" ityasyaitadapekṣayā pūrvatvāt | pūrvasya ca paraṃ pratyasiddhatvābhāvāt | na ca svaritapūrvabhāvino'nudāttatvasyāpi ajmātradharmatvāt tadapi prayojanaṃ śaṅkyam | śeṣanighātasya ṣāṣṭhatvena taṃ pratyasiddhatayā ṛkāratvenaiva tatpravṛtteḥ | tatrādyaprayojananirāsaparaṃ vārttikam--- nyāyyabhāvāt kalpanaṃ saṃjñādiṣu iti | ayamarthaḥ | ṛterīyāṅiti nirddiṣṭātsautrādṛtidhātoḥ "kvun śilpisaṃjñayorapūrvasyāpi" ityanena śilpinyabhidheye saṃjñāyāṃ ca sopapadānnirupapadācca dhātoḥ kvun syādityarthakena uṇādisūtreṇa kvun‌pratyaye saṃjñāyāṃ vyutpannatayā śāstrānugatatvāt "kṛtaṃ kuryānna taddhitam" iti gṛhyasmṛtyānuguṇyācca ṛtakaśabda eva saṃjñā na tu lṛtakaḥ | yadṛcchāśabdānāṃ sādhutvānabhyupagamāt | etena deśabhāṣānusāreṇa kriyamāṇānāṃ śāstrānanugatānāṃ kūcī mañcītyādināmnāmapyasādhutvaṃ vyākhyātam | ādiśabdādanukaraṇeṣvapi śiṣṭānurodhadarśanāt | lṛvarṇasya dīrghā na santīti maryādāmatikramya kriyamāṇasya dīrghalṛvarṇānukaraṇasyāpyasādhutvameva | mātṛkānyāsādau dīrghalṛvarṇasya mantraśāstrādau prasiddhatve'pyanyatra tadabhāvāt | ata eva dadhi lṛtakāya dehītyāhetyanukaraṇamapyasādhveveti | na ca ṛtakaśabdasya śāstrānugatatvena lṛtakaśabdasyāsaṃjñātve'pi lṛphiḍalṛphiḍḍeti yadṛcchāśabdau durvārāviti vācyam | tatrāpi ṛdhātoroṇādikaphiḍaphiḍḍapratyayāntayoḥ ṛphiḍa ṛphiḍḍa ityetayornivartakatvāt | bhāṣye tu "pakṣāntarairapi parihārā bhavanti" ityuktam | tena yadṛcchāśabdānāmapi sādhutvameva | na ca gṛhyasmṛtivirodhaḥ | aupagavādivadasyāpi sādhutvopapatteḥ | tatra nāmakartuḥ pratyavāyastu uktaśāstrollaṅghanādeva | na tvasādhuprayogāt | ata eva kātyāyanādiśabdānāṃ saṃjñātvaṃ nirbādham | yattu dvitīyaprayojananirāsāya vārtikam- anukaraṇaṃ śiṣṭāśiṣṭāpratiṣiddheṣu iti | tasyārthaḥ | śiṣṭasya vihitasya aśiṣṭāpratiṣiddhasya vihitaniṣiddhānyasya vā'nukaraṇaṃ sādhu | tataścāpaśabdaprayogasya niṣiddhatvāttadanukaraṇamapyasādhveveti | bhāṣyakṛtastu tatprayojanaṃ samarthayante | na hyapaśabdavācakatvamātreṇāsādhutvam | apaśabdapadasyāpi gāvyādyapabhraṃśavācakatvenāsādhutvāpatteḥ | ata eva "te'surā helayo helaya iti kurvantaḥ" ityādīnāmanukaraṇānāṃ sādhutvaṃ sarvasiddham | na ca prakṛtivadanukaraṇam ityasādhutvātideśaḥ | apaśabdasyānupadiṣṭatvena śāstrīyaprakṛtitvābhāvāt | asādhutvasya śāstrīyakāryatvābhāvācca | yadapi tṛtīyaprayojananirāsāya vārttikam--- ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvātplutyādaya iti | tasyāpyayamarthaḥ | vakṣyamāṇarītyā ṛkāraikadeśasya rephasya latve ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvātplutyādayaḥ | na ca anṛta iti plutaniṣedhāpattiḥ | anṛta ityapahāya aravata iti paṭhanīyatvāt | chinnapucchasya śvatvādyanapāye'pi pucchavāttvaprayuktakāryāṇāmapravṛttivat ṛkāre'pi rephāpagamadaśāyāṃ rephavattvaprayuktaniṣedhāpravṛtteḥ | na caivaṃ hotṛ3kāretyāderdīrghasyāpi plutaniṣedhāpattiḥ, rephavattvāditi vācyam | hrasvasya ravato neti vaktavyatvāt | atra bhāṣyam--- sa eṣa sūtrabhedena lṛkāropadeśaḥ plutyādyarthaḥ sanmatyākhyāyate saiṣā mahato vaṃśastambāllaṭ‌vā anukṛṣyataiti | asyārthaḥ | ekasya lṛvarṇasya pratyākhyānāya anṛta ityasya laghoḥ sthāne hasvasya ravato netigurutaranyāsāśrayeṇa viparītameva gauravamiti | laṭ‌vā karañjabhede syātphale'vadye khagāntare | iti viśvaḥ | syādetat | "kṛpo ro laḥ" itisūtram "aa" ityasmātpūrvamastu | tataścāsiddhatvādeva plutyādayaḥ setsyantīti "anṛta" iti yathānyāsamevāstviti | atrāhuḥ | tathā sati rola ityasyānuvṛttyarthaṃ "gro yaṅi" ityasyāpi tatraiva pāṭhāpattau nijegilyataityatra latvasyāsiddhatayā dhātorephāntatvāt "halica" iti dīrghaḥ syāditi | idaṃ punarihāvadheyam | "guroranṝta" iti dīrghapāṭha evāstu anṛlṛta iticchedaḥ | takārasya dvandvottaravartitvena sāmarthyena ṛkāre'pyanvayaḥ | dīrghalṛkārasyāprasiddhyā vyāvṛttyanarhatvāt | plutavidhau ca plutasyānuvādānupapattestaparatvasya ṛkāraevopayuktatvāt | ato na dīrghaṛkārasya plutaniṣedhāpattiḥ | ṛkāralṛkārayoḥ savarṇadīrghe dīrghaṛkāraḥ | anṛta ityetacca gurorityasya viśeṣaṇam | hrasvaṛkārabhinnasya lṛkārasya ca guroḥ pluto bhavatīti sūtrārthaḥ | na ca lṛkārasyaiva plutaḥ syānna tu varṇāntarasya, lṛkārasāmānādhikaraṇyāditi vācyam | hrasvaṛkārabhinnasyeti viśeṣaṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ | nacātrāpyanṛta iti lṛkārasyāpi paryudāsāpattiḥ | viśiṣya lṛkāragrahaṇasāmarthyāt | naca dīrgharkāramātrasya paryudāsāpattiḥ | ṛkāralṛkārayorvyākhyānavaśena savarṇadīrghanirṇayāt | na ca tathā'pyekamātrāvṛddhyā varṇopadeśe lṛkārapāṭhāpekṣayā lāghavābhāvā iti vācyam | plutamātrasiddhyarthasya yatnasya tadvidhāveva yuktatvāt | kiṃ ca "rvorupadhāyā dīrgha" ityatra rephadvayapraśleṣādrepha eva yo rephastasminnevopadhābhūte dīrgho na tvasiddhatvaprayuktarephe'pīti vyākhyāya nijegilyate ityatra "hali ca" iti dīrghasya vāraṇasambhavāt "kṛpo ro la" ityasya śāstropāntapāṭhenāpi plutyādisiddhiḥ | na caivaṃ pipaṭhīrityādāvapi dīrgho na syāt, ṣatvasyāsiddhatayā sasya rutvapravṛtteriti vācyam | tatrāsiddhatvasya tatvamātropajīvyatvāttaduttaraṃ rutvapravṛtteriti dik | eoṅ‌ 3 aiauc‌ 4 | nanvatra taparatvaṃ vaktavyam et ot ṅ‌ ityādi | anyathā eco hrasvavidhau sthānata āntaratamyena hrasvayoreva edotoḥ prasaṅgāt | taparatve tu "acaśca" ityatra dvimātrāṇāmevopasthitvā ekamātrayorhrasvasaṃjñāviraheṇa tadaprasaṅgāt | na ca hrasvo nāstīti siddhāntādāpādyāprasiddhiḥ | chāndogye sātyamugrirāṇāyanīyānām--- "sujāteeśvasūnṛteadhvaryoodribhiḥ sutam | śukraṃ teenyad‌" iti ekamātrayoredotoḥ prasiddheḥ | antaḥ pādasthasya avyaparasya tatprātiśākhye hrasvayoredotorvidhānācca | na caitadartham " eca igghrasvādeśe " iti sūtrārambhāt tata eva tannivṛttiḥ | tatsūtrārambhaprayuktasyaiva gauravasyāpatteḥ | atha gītivaśāttatra tathātve'pi tadanyatra vede loke ca hrasvayoredotorna prasiddhiḥ | prayojanābhāvena taduktayorapyatrānabhimatatvāt | anyathā akārādivat lāghavāt tayorevātropadeśaḥ syāt | grahaṇakaśāstreṇaiva dīrghaplutasaṃgrahasiddheḥ | na ca guṇasaṃjñāyāṃ dvimātrasaṃjñilābhārthamatra dvimātropadeśaḥ | tatra svarūpeṇaiva dīrghanirdeśasambhavāt "adeo guṇaḥ" iti | yathānyāse hi varṇopadeśe mātrācatuṣṭayam guṇasaṃjñāyāmeṅiti sārddhamātraādvayamityubhayatra sārddhaṣaṇmātrāḥ | uktarītyā tu varṇopadeśe dve mātre guṇasaṃjñāyāṃ catasra iti ṣaḍeva | varṇopadeśe ṅakārānubandhastu pakṣadvaye'pi samānaḥ | "eca igghrasvādeśe" iti sūtraṃ tu na hrasvayoredotorvyāvṛttyartham, kiṃ tvedaitoḥ kaṇṭhyatālavyayorodautośca kaṇṭhyauṣṭhyayorubhayāntaratamasya hrasvasyābhāvāt kaṇṭhasthānatayā pūrvabhāgasādṛśyena caturṇāṃ sthāne'kārasya, oṣṭhasthānatayā ca odautoḥ sthāne ukārasyaca, prāptyā akārasyāpi pākṣikaprāptiprasaṅgāt tannivṛttyarthameva | ata eva sandhīyamānavarṇadvayasadṛśāvayavatvena sandhyakṣareti ecām pūrvācāryasaṃjñā | tadabhiprāyeṇaiva--- akārekārayoryogādekāro varṇa ucyate | iti mantraśāstre vyavahāraḥ | ecāṃ śuddhatālavyaśuddhauṣṭhyatvamāśritya tatsūtraṃ pratyākhyāsyata iti tvanyadetat | atastaparatvaṃ kimartham iticet | maivam | tathā'pi gaṅgodakam, rameśaḥ, khaṭ‌vailakā, khaṭ‌vaudanaḥ, ityādau pūrvottaravarṇayormilitvā trimātracaturmātratvāt pramāṇata āntaratamyena tādṛśānāmevādeśānāṃ prasaṅgāt | na ca caturmātramaprasiddham | chāndogye prasiddheḥ | "iṣyate eva caturmātraḥ plutaḥ" itibhāṣyācca | taparatve tu "taparastatkālasya" iti ejbhistrimātrādīnāmagrahaṇe teṣāṃ guṇādisaṃjñāviraheṇa doṣābhāvāt | "plutaśca viṣaye smṛtaḥ" iti tu plutāplutaprasaṅge eva pravartataiti siddhāntaḥ | na ca "akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ" ityatra dīrgha itiyogaṃ vibhajya "ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ" ityadhikāre yo vihitaḥ sa dīrgho bhavatīti vyākhyānānna doṣa iti vācyam | "ami pūrvaḥ" "samprasāraṇācca" iti pūrvarūpasya "ato guṇe" iti pararūpasya ca dīrghatvaprasaṅgāt | atha "prathamayoḥ" itisūtrāt pūrvasavarṇadīrghasyādhikārācca pūrvaparayorityasyopasthityā amītyeva nirvāhe pūrvagrahaṇaṃ yādṛśaḥ pūrvaḥ tathaiva na tu tadvilakṣaṇa iti vyākhyānāt gaurīmityādau dīrghaḥ, pathumityādau ca hrasvaḥ | "samprasāraṇācca" ityatrāpi tasyaiva pūrvaśabdasyānuvṛtteḥ "hala" iti haluttarasamprasāraṇasya dīrghatvavidhānāt jñāpakācca viddhamityatra na dīrghaḥ | "ato guṇe" ityatrāpi paragrahaṇādeva siddheḥ rūpagrahaṇasāmarthyāt parasajātīya evādeśaḥ | vastutastu akāraparatve savarṇadīrgheṇa eṅ‌paratve ca vṛddhyaiva dīrghasiddhau "ato guṇe" itisūtrameva vyarthaṃ syāt | na ca vṛddhiṃ vinā'pyakārasya eṅ‌rūpavidhānena dīrghavidhinirvāhād‌ vṛddhipratiṣedhārthameva taditi vācyam | tathā'pyakāraparatve phalābhāvena "ata eṅi" ityeva sūtrāpatteḥ | evaṃ satyekamātrālāghavācca | ataśca hrasvākārapare pararūpavidhānasāmarthyādeva pacantītyatra na doṣaḥ | ato yogavibhāgo nirdoṣa eveti kalpyate | tathā'pi kṛṣṇarddhiḥ tavalkāraḥ ityādau guṇo na syāt | akārasya dīrghavidhānāt eṅaścāntaratamyābhāvādeva nivṛtteḥ | guṇavidhānasya ikārokārayoḥ parataḥ sāvakāśatvāt | "uraṇ raparaḥ" ityasya ca vṛddhiviṣaye cāritārthyāt | evaṃ ca vigṛhītasyaiva śravaṇaṃ syāt | nanu "ṛtyakaḥ" iti prakṛtibhāvavidhānasāmarthyānna tathā | na ca yaṇādinivṛttyarthatayā tatsārthakyam | ika ityeva nirvāhe aka ityakārasaṅ‌grahasya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ | satyam | tathā'pyakārasyāṃśataḥ sthānasāmyamādāya edotoreva prasaṅgāt | "karttari carṣidevatayoḥ" ityādinirddeśānusaraṇe ca gauravāt | tasmādyogavibhāgoduṣṭa eveti trimātrādivāraṇārthaṃ taparatvamāvaśyakamiti prāpte--- ucyate guṇavṛddhisaṃjñayorecāṃ tātparatvena dīrghāṇāmeva tatra saṃjñitvānna doṣaḥ | plutasya guṇavṛddhisajjñāvirahāt | "sahivahorodavarṇasya" iti varṇagrahaṇena tātparasyāpi tatkālagrāhakatvajñāpanāt | na caiṅaicchabdayostātparatayā dīrghamātropasthāpakatve'pi tadupasthitānāṃ dīrghāṇāmanuccāritatvena taparatvābhāvāt savarṇopasthāpakatvaṃ syādeveti vācyam | tātparatvasya saṃjñāyāmanu payujyamānatvena sāmarthyāttadupasthāpyasañjñiṣu tatkālāvadhāraṇārthatvāt | na ca ākārasya savarṇagrāhakatvābhāvena tatratyatakārasya aicāṃ tatkālagrāhakatvasāmarthye'pi guṇasañjñāyāṃ na tathā, akārasya grāhakatāniṣedhārthameva tatra tadupayogena vaiyarthyābhāvāditi vācyam | "aṇudit savarṇasya" iti sūtre "svaṃ rūpam" itisūtrād aśabdasañjñetyanuvṛttyā sañjñāvidhau aṇ‌ savarṇānna gṛhṇātīti tvākārapraśleṣābhāvasandehaśca syāt | mālā prastha ityatra "mālādīnāṃ ca" iti punarādyudāttavidhānagamyāyāḥ "prasthe'vṛddhamakarkyādīnām" ityatra "aṅgasya" itisūtraṃ pratyākhyātuṃ bhāṣye kaṇṭhata evaitatparibhāṣopanyāsāt | na ca tatra śryarthaṃ bhvartham ityādau iyaṅ‌ṅuvaṅādīnāṃ pratyagrahaṇārthavad‌grahaṇaparibhāṣābhyāṃ vāraṇe'pi nirutaṃ sūtre pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣā bhāṣyavārtikakārābhyāṃ na kva cidāśriteti kaiyaṭenāpyuktamiti haradattābhiprāyamiti vācyam | tathā'pi "diva ut‌" ityādau svaritatvaprasakterevābhāvāt |
