taccintyam | yathāśrute aṭ‌prayojanoktyaiva kroḍīkṛtatvāt | tasmādami prayojanaṃ durvāramiti dik | syādetat | rephasya yarantarbhāvāt tatkāryāṇi prasajyante | tathā hi | madrahradaḥ bhadrahrada ityatra "aco rahābhyām" iti acaḥ parābhyāṃ rephahakārābhyāṃ parasya yaro vidhīyamānaṃ dvitvaṃ syāt | na ca "ro ri" iti lopānnervāhaḥ | taṃ prati dvitvasyāsiddhatvāt | "halo yamāṃ yami" itilopasya tu vaikalpikatayā pakṣe rephadvayaśravaṇāpatteḥ | kuṇḍaṃ rathena vanaṃ rathenetyatra "anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ" syāt | na ca rephoṣmaṇāṃ savarṇābhāvānna doṣaḥ | vijātīyatadabhāve'pi rephasyaivāpatteḥ | prātarnayatītyādau "yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā" iti sthānasāmyena pakṣe ṇakāraḥ syāt | na ca "harayavaṭ‌" iti yakāravakārābhyāṃ pūrvaṃ repho nirdeśya iti vācyam | devitvā dideviṣatītyatra "ralo vyupadhād‌" iti pakṣe kittvaprasaṅgāt | vakārasyāpyuktarītyā ralantarbhāvāt | na ca tatra avyupadhād iticchitvā vakāradvayaṃ ca praśliṣya avakārāntād iuvarṇopadhāt itivyākhyānādvakārānte na doṣa iti vācyam | tathā 'pi gaudhera ityādau "godhāyā ḍhrak‌" iti ḍhrak‌pratyaye ḍhasya eyityādeśe ādivṛddhau "yasyeti ca" ityākāralope ca "lopo vyorvali" iti yakāralopānupapatteḥ | pacerannityatra sīyuṭi salope paca īy‌ ran ityatra tadasiddheśca | rephasya valyanantarbhāvāt | na ca "rali" ityeva tatra vaktavyamiti vācyam | haya gatau hayyādityatra yakārasyāpi lopāpatteḥ | na ca yathānyāsaeva rvali iti sarephaṃ padaṃ chittvā rephe vali ca parato lopavidhānānna doṣa iti vācyam | tathā'pi yaṇ‌sthale sarvatra raṇiti nyāsāpatteḥ | yathāsaṃkhyaparibhāṣayā ikārokāraṛkārāṇāṃ sthāne rephayakāravakārādeśāpatteśca | na ca "sthāne'ntaratama" paribhāṣayā nirvāhaḥ | paratvādyathāsaṃkhyasyaivāpatteriti vadanti | vastutastu "vyupadhāt " ityatra ikārokārayoḥ sthāne yakāravakārayoḥ "arvaṇastrasau" ityatra ṛkārasthāne rephādeśasya ca darśanādantaratamaparibhāṣaivātra pravarttate | yadvā "aṛiṇ‌" "ulṛk" iti pūrvatrāpi nyāsaḥ karttavyaḥ | ik‌sthāne ṛk iti iṇ‌sthāne ca ṛṇ‌ iti pradeśeṣu vyavahartavyam | iṇ‌grahaṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ siddhānte'pi dvitīyaṇakāreṇaiva vācyatvāt | ic‌pratyāhārasthale'pi ṛc‌padameva vaktavyam | "isusuktāntāt " ityatrāpi uk‌sthāne ṛk‌padameva deyam | na ca ikārasyādhikasya saṃgrahāpattiḥ | iṣṭāpatteḥ | "yasyeti ca" ikāralopamikādeśaṃ ca kṛtvā siddhānte yathārūpaṃ tathaiva kādeśe'pi | "yasyeti ca" ityasyāpravṛttimātraṃ tu na doṣāya | "śryuka" ityatrāpi ṛk‌padopādāne ikārasyādhikasya saṃgrahe'pi śrigrahaṇasya niyamārthatvāt | vastuta ṛk‌pratyāhāre ikārasya kutrāpi grahaṇaṃ neti jñāpanārthatvāt | tena "ugidacāṃ sarvanāmasthāne" "ugitaśca" ityādau na doṣaḥ | evaṃ ca hastinīnāṃ samūho hāstikamiti ṭhak‌pratyaye ikādeśābhāve bhasaṃjñāvirahe "bhasyāḍhe taddhite" iti puṃvadbhāvo na syād itidoṣaviraho'pi nirbādhaḥ | "aṇudit savarṇasya" ityatra tu na ko'pi viśeṣaḥ | pareṇaiva tatra pratyāhārāt | tadanyatra tu aṇ‌pratyāhārasya pūrveṇaiva grāhyatvāt ukārasya tadbahirbhāva ṛkārasya tadantarbhāvacca syāditi doṣaḥ | paraṃ tu vya iti tatsthale sarvatra nirdeśyam | u i a ityeṣāṃ tena saṃgrahāt | vyākhyānavaśācca vakārādīnāṃ na grahaṇam | siddhānte'pi pūrveṇa pareṇa vā ṇakāreṇa pratyāhāra iti nirṇayārthaṃ vyākhyānasyaivādaraṇīyatvāt | pūrvatra ṇakāranubandhaśca parityājyaḥ | na caivaṃ vyākhyānato viśeṣapratipattiriti paribhāṣāyāṃ liṅgābhāvaḥ | liṅgāntarasya saṃbhavāt | bastutastu "aṛiuṇ‌" "lṛk‌" iti nyāsaḥ kāryaḥ | ata ukārasya na bahirbhāvaḥ | pariśiṣyate tu ṛkārasyādhikasyāntarbhāvāpattiḥ | sā'pyevaṃ parihāryā | tṛtīyetinirdeśena aṇ‌grahaṇeṣu ṛkāro na gṛhyate iti jñāpyate | tathā hi | "halaḥ" itisūtre aṇa ityasya nānuvṛttiriti laṇ‌=sūtre sthāpayiṣyate | tathā'pi tat siddhāntadṛṣṭyaiva | etatpakṣe tu tatrāpyaṇa ityanuvartyameva | "ikaḥ kāśe" ityatrāpi tadanuvṛttau igrūpasyāṇa ityabhedānvayena samādhānasya bhāṣyaeva spaṣṭatvāt | yadi ca "ḍhralope" itisūtre aṇ‌grahaṇena ṛkāro'pi gṛhyeta, tadā "halaḥ" ityatrāpi tathātvaprasaktyā tṛtīyetyatra trestīyapratyaye rephasya saṃprasāraṇe ṛkāre ca kṛte ṛkārasyāpi dīrghāpattyā tṛtīyeti nirdeśo'saṃgata eva syāt | ata iṣṭānurodhātpūrveṇāṇ‌grahaṇasthale ṛkārastanmadhye na gṛhyate itijñāpanena sakaleṣṭasiddheḥ | syādetat | ṛkārasya yathānyāsapakṣe pūrveṇa aṇpratyāhāre gṛhyamāṇe tadbahirbhūtatayā tadvyāvṛttayarthaṃ tatra pūrveṇāṇ‌grahaṇaṃ svīkriyate | uktanyāse tu pūrveṇāṇ‌grahaṇe'pi tadbrahirbhāvānupapattyā uktātiprasaṅgasya ca tṛtīyeti nirdeśenaiva vāraṇasambhavāt tatra aṇ‌grahaṇaṃ pūrveṇaivetyatra mānābhāvaḥ | pareṇāṇ‌grahaṇe'pi ṛkārasyāṇ‌bahirbhāva iti svīkāre tu "aṇudit sarvaṇasya" ityatrāpi tad‌grahaṇānupapattiḥ iticet | satyam | ṛlṛvarṇayormithaḥ sāvarṇyārambhasāmarthyāt tasya grāhakatvasiddheḥ | na ca savarṇadīrghādividhāne cāritārthyamiti vācyam | tathā'pi "ṛdupadhāccālkṛpicṛteḥ" ityatra bhedapratiyogitvena lkṛpiniveśena paryudāsavyatireke ṛdupadhatvaprayuktakāryāpatterapekṣitatvāt | ṛkārasya lṛkāragrāhakatvābhāve ca sāmānyaśāstrasya tadviṣayakatvaprasaktyabhāve tadvyāvṛttitātparyakasya lkṛpiparyudāsasya vaiyarthyāpātāt | vastuto halāṃ dīrghatvabādhād ecāṃ ca viśeṣābhāvāttatra pareṇāṇ‌grahaṇavaiyarthyāt | tathā ca yathāsaṅkhyaparibhāṣayaiva nirvāha iti bhāgavato bhāṣyakārasya bhāvaḥ | rvalīti vyākhyānena ca paceran gaudherādisiddhyanantaraṃ doṣāntarānupanyāsena taddoṣaparihāre tatsammatinirṇayāt | ata eva "atha vā punarastu paropadeśa" iti rephāpakarṣasamakakṣatayaiva yathānyāse doṣoddhārābhidhānāt | tadyathā brāhmaṇā bhojyantāṃ māṭharakauṇḍinyau pariveviṣṭāmityatra sāmānyataḥ prāptaṃ bhojanaṃ viśeṣaśiṣṭena pariveṣaṇeneva kāryapratiyogiyarniṣṭhaparatvanirūpyapūrvatvarūpeṇa dvitvanimittatvaśrutyā kāryapratiyogitvaṃ bādhyataiti madrahrada ityādau na dvitvam | sāmānyasya viśeṣaparyavasānaparyantaṃ sākṣāc‌śrutakāryāntarasyaiva prathamopasthityā tadviśeṣe'nvayāt | tadetaduktam--- nemau rahau kāryiṇau dvirvacanasya, kiṃ tarhi nimittamiti | hakārasya yarbahirbhūtasya yathā na dvitvaṃ, tathā tadantarbhūtasyāpi rephasya | kāryopadhāyakasāmagrīvaikalyasāmye tadantarbhāvamātrasyākiṃcitkaratvāt | tacca dṛṣṭānte yartvābhāvāt dārṣṭāntike coddeśyatāvacchedakaghaṭakabhedapratiyogitvāt | repha bhinnayartvasyaiva nyāyavaśāddvitvavidhāvuddeśyatāvacchedakatvāt | evam "anaci ca" ityanena haryanubhava ityādāvapi rephasya na dvitvam | arthādhikāreṇa tatrāpi yara ityasya rephabhinnaparatvāt | athaivam "iko yaṇaci" ityādikaṃ dadhyudakamityādau na pravartteta | viśeṣataḥ śrutena sthānitvena iko nimittatvabādhāpatteḥ iticet, atra kaiyaṭaḥ--- tasmādityuttarasya ityādinirdeśānna tatroktanyāyapravṛttiriti | yattu kaustubhe vyaktipakṣe pratilakṣyamasakṛllakṣaṇapravṛtteḥ sa eva tatrāśrayaṇīyaḥ | yadvā pratilakṣyaṃ bhinnānāṃ sarveṣāṃ lakṣaṇānāṃ tantreṇoccāraṇam "iko yaṇaci" iti | tathā ca sarvāsāmikāravyaktīnāṃ yaṇ‌vidhāne'rthādik‌paratve'pi yaṇ‌siddhiḥ | anyathā sarveṣāmikārāṇāmigbhinnacparatvānniyamābhāvena vidhyarthāniṣpatteḥ | na cātiprasaṅgaḥ, apavādavidhiparyālocanayā tadvyaktāvetattātparyākalpanāditi | taccintyam | vyaktipakṣe'pi nimittasamarpakasyāc‌padasya nyāyavaśādigbhinnaparatve siddhe igrūpācpūrvavarttinyā igvyakteruddeśyatvaeva mānābhāvād dadhyudakādau tatpravṛtterdurghaṭatvāt | śrūyamāṇavākye uddeśyatāvidheyatāvacchedakatvābhyāṃ niścitā ye dharmāḥ tadavacchinnavyaktiṣveva nyāyasāmyena tatsamānākārakavākyāntarāṇāṃ pravṛtteḥ | anyathā halparatve'pi yaṇādipravṛttyāpatteḥ | na ca acupadopādānasāmarthyam | igbhinnamātrasaṃgrāhakaprakārāntarābhāvāt | ecītyukte evamātrādhikyādakārānupagrahācca iti dik | atra vārttikam--- ayogavāhānāmaṭ‌su ṇatvam, śarṣu jaśbhāvaṣatve, aviśeṣeṇa saṃyogopadhāsaṃjñā'lo'ntyadvirvacanasthānivattvapratiṣedhā iti | prayojanaviśeṣapuraskāreṇaiva yeṣāṃ pratyāhāraviśeṣāntarbhāva iṣṭaḥ teṣāṃ pratyāhārāntareṣu praveśāpattyā varṇasamāmnāye'nupadeśādanena saprayojanaḥ pratyāhāraviśeṣāntarbhāvaḥ pratipādyate | ayogāḥ svarūpato dvārato vā pratyāhārānantarbhūtāḥ vāhāḥ prayoge śrūyamāṇāḥ te ca visarjanīyajihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyānusvārayamā iti bhāṣyam | yadyapyatra "ṛti ṛ vā" "lṛti lṛ vā" iti ṣaṣṭhe vakṣyamāṇau īṣatspṛṣṭau noktau | tathā'pi tayorac‌tvaṃ vakṣyāmīti tulyāsyasūtrabhāṣye darśanāttāvapyatropalakṣaṇīyau | eṣāmaṭ‌su pāṭhaḥ kāryaḥ | uraḥ kāyati uraḥ pātīti kapratyayaḥ | uraḥ keṇa uraḥ---peṇa ityatra ṇatvaṃ yathā syāt | anyathā aṭ‌tvābhāve'ḍ‌vyavāye'pīti na pravartteta | śarṣu copadeśaḥ kāryaḥ | ubja ārjave ityupadhmānīyopadhasya dhātorupadhmānīyasthāne "jhalāṃ jaś‌ jhaśi" iti jaśtvenāntaratamyād‌ bakārādeśe ubjitetyādi yathā syāt | śartvasiddhau tannāntarīyakatayā jhaltvasyāpi siddheḥ | sarpiḥ ṣu dhanuḥ ṣu ityādau "num visarjanīyaśarvyavāye'pi" iti ṣatvaṃ ca yathā syāt | na ca tatra visarjanīyasya pṛthagupādānādeveṣṭasiddhiḥ | tasyaivoktarītyā pratyākhyeyatvāt | aviśeṣeṇa prayojanapañcakopayuktapratyāhārapuruskāreṇa ityarthaḥ | tena u3bjaketyatra ukārasya plutopayuktagurusaṃjñāprayojakasaṃyogasaṃjñāprayojakaṃ haltvam, niṣkṛtaṃ duṣkṛtamityatra "idudupadhasya" iti ṣatvopayuktopadhāsañjñāyā viśeṣyabhūtavarṇaniṣṭhāvyavahitapūrvatvanirūpakāntyatvapratiyogitāvacchedakatvaṃ, vṛkṣastaratītyatra visarjanīyāntasya padasya sa iti pakṣe sarvādeśatvavāraṇāya alo'ntyasūtravihitāntādeśasthānitāvacchedakam, vyūḍhoraskenetyatra sakārasya sthānivadbhāvenāḍ‌vyavāya iti ṇatvaprāptau "analvidhau" iti paryudāsaghaṭakabhedapratiyogitāvacchedakaṃ cāltvam, uraḥka uraḥpa ityādau "anaci ca" iti dvitvapratiyogitāvacchedakaṃ yartvaṃ ca visargādīnāṃ sidhyatīti vārttikārthaḥ | atrāyaṃ vivekaḥ | jaśbhāvo na prayojanam | ubjadhātorupadhmānīyopadhatve pramāṇābhāvāt | ubjijiṣatītyasiddhyāpatteśca | tathā hi | bakārasahitasyaiva dvitve "halādiḥ śeṣaḥ" iti jakāranivṛttāvabhyāse bakāramātraṃ śrūyate | na ca jaśtvāsiddhatayā bakārasahitasya na dvitvamiti vācyam | pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvitve ityukteḥ | atha prāṇiṇiṣatītyatra "ubhau sābhyāsasya" iti nakāradvayasya ṇatvavidhānāduktaparibhāṣā'nityā | anyathā ṇakāraviśiṣṭasyaiva dvitve abhyāse svata eva ṇakārasiddhau tadvaiyarthyāt | ata eva aujaḍhadityatrābhyāse jakārasiddhirityāśrīyate | tathā'pi neṣṭasiddhiḥ | abhyāsasyopadhmānīyamātraśeṣatāpattau "abhyāse carca" iti jaśtvena bakārasyaiva śravaṇāpatteḥ | ubibjiṣatīti rūpasāmyena doṣāviśeṣāditi kaiyaṭādayaḥ | yattu "prakṛticarāṃ prakṛticaraḥ" iti siddhāntād upadhmānīyamātrasyābhyāse śravaṇāpattiriti sthāpitam | taccintyam | pratiniyataviṣayapuraskāreṇa pratyāhāraviśeṣāntarbhāvavacanasāmarthyena cartvāsiddheḥ | na caivaṃ jhalsaṃjñā'pi na syāditi vācyam | jaśtvasya prayojanatvoktyā tadekavākyatāpannasaṃjñāyā apyākṣepeṇa vaiṣamyāt | na hi "jhalāñjaśaḥ" iti jaśtvameva tatropāttamiti vaktuṃ śakyam | bījābhāvāditi vṛddhābhiprāyāt | tasmādubjijiṣatīti rūpāsiddhistadavastheti | evamasmādeva ghañi "cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ" iti kutvena jakārasya gakārādeśe upadhmānīyasya jaśtvena batve kṛte abhyubga samubgaḥ iti rūpāpattau "so'padādau" ityadhikāre "upadhmānīyasya ca" iti vārttikāntareṇa kavarge parata upadhmānīyasya sakārādeśaṃ tatsthāne jaśtvena dantasthānasāmyāddakārādeśaṃ kṛtvā abhyudgaḥ samudgaḥ iti rūpaṃ sādhanīyamiti satvavidhāyakavacanāntarārambhe'pi gauravam | yadi tu bakāropadho'yamiti vṛttimatamāśrīyate tathā'pi sanibakārasya dvitvaniṣedho'bhyudga ityatra basya datvaṃ ca sādhayituṃ vacanadvayānumāne gauravameva syāt | tasmāddakāropadha evāyam | abhyud‌ga ityādeḥ svarasataḥ siddheḥ | na caivamubjitetyādi kathamiti vācyam | "bhujanyubjau" iti kutvābhāvanipātanārthe sūtre bakāroccāraṇena "bha ud‌jeḥ" iti "ba ud‌jeḥ" iti vā vacanasyānumānāt | akutvaviṣaye ud‌jerdakārasya bhakāro bakāro vā syāt | "stoścunā ścuḥ" ityetaduttaraṃ tatkalpanācca tavargāpasthitadakārasya sthānitvalābhaḥ | evaṃ ca " ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ" iti dakārasya dvitvaniṣedhājjiśabdasyaiva dvitve dakārasya coktavacanena batve kṛte ubjijiṣatītyapi siddham | na ca dvitvātpūrvaṃ paratvād‌batvāpattiḥ | "pūrvatrāsiddhe nāsti vipratiṣedhaḥ" iti siddhāntāt | nāpyantaraṅgatvāt | asiddhatvādeva | nāpi "pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane"iti tanniṣedhaḥ | dvitvavidhāveva tatpravṛtteḥ | atra ca dvitvaniṣedhena vaiṣamyāt | atredamavadheyam | "na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ " ityatra "lopo vyorvali" iti lopena dakārādrephādvā pūrvaṃ bakāro'pi praśliṣyate | tena vārttikamate vṛttimate ca ubjerbakārasya dvitvani ṣedhārthaṃ na vacanāntarānusāraḥ | vārttikamate'pi pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacana ityāśritya bakārasya dvitvaniṣedhasiddheḥ | ato bhāṣyamate na lāghavāvakāśaḥ | atiriktaikavacanakalpanaṃ tu trayāṇāmapi samānam | etāvānparaṃ viśeṣaḥ | vārttikamate upadhmānīyasya sakārādeśavidhāyakaṃ vacanaṃ kalpyam | bhāṣyamate dakārasya batvavidhāyakam | vṛttimate tu bakārasya dakāravidhāyakamiti | yadi tu "bhujanyubjau" iti nipātanādeva dasya bādeśo na tūktavacanamanumeyamiti bhāṣyamate lāghavamiti kalpyate, tadā bakārasyaiva dvitvāpattiḥ | asiddhatvābhāvāt | dakāropadhanirdeśasāmarthyājjiśabdasya dvitvānantarameva dakārasya dvitvamiti kalpane'pi abhyud‌ga ityādāvapi tadāpatteḥ | akutvaviṣaye eva batvaṃ nipātyata itikalpane'pi kutvaviṣaye śravaṇārthatayā dakāropadeśasya caritārthatvāt dvitvānantarameva batvamiti na syāt | athāviśeṣeṇa batvanipātamabhyupetya upasargāntarapūrvakātkevalādvā ubjerna ghañādiḥ anabhidhānāt | abhyudgaḥ samudga iti tūpasargadvayapūrvakādgamerḍapratyaye rūpamiti kalpyate | tato vārttikavṛttyormate'pi abhyudga ityāderuktagatyaiva sādhayituṃ śakyatayā upadhmānīyasya satvavidhāyakaṃ bakārasya datvavidhāyakaṃ ca vacanaṃ na kalpyamiti kutastatrāpi gauravam | paraṃ tūpadhmānīyasya śarṣūpadeśa evātiriktaḥ kalpya iti gauravam | vṛttimate tūktarītyā bakārapraśleṣakṛtaṃ gauravam vārttikasādhāraṇaṃ bodhyam | kiṃ ca bhāṣyavṛttyormate saṃyogasaṃjñārthaṃ yatnāntaraṃ nāstheyam | vārttikamate tu pūrvoktarītyā tadāvaśyakamiti gauravam | nanu ṣatvasiddhyarthaṃ śarṣūpadeśasyāvaśyakatayā tad‌gauravamapi neti cet | maivam | tadarthaṃ visargasyaiva tadantarbhāvānapekṣaṇāt | vastutastasyāpyaprayojanatvāt | "num‌visarjanīya" iti sūtre visarjanīyapadasya sattvena tadvyavāye ṣatvasiddherapratyūhatvāt | na ca tatra tanna karttavyameveti vācyam | siddhaṃ pratyākhyāya yatnāntarakalpanasyaiva vaiyarthyāt | yattu śarṣūpadeśena jhaltvamiva haltvayartvakhartvānyapi sidhyanti | khartvasya phalaṃ tu "kupvoḥ ḥkaḥpau ca" iti visargaḥ | ataḥ śarṣūpadeśāvaśyakatve tata eva nirvāhe sūtre visarjanīyagrahaṇaṃ na kāryameveti | taccintyam | jaśtvasya prayojanatvoktyā tadbralājjhal‌tvasiddhāvapi haltvādīnāṃ tenānākṣepāt | haltvayartvāltvānāṃ prātisvikarūpeṇaiva vidhānāt | visargasya ca sautratvādeva siddheḥ | loke'pi tasyeṣṭatve tu aviśeṣeṇetyatra tasyāpi prakṣeptumucitatvāt | astu vā tata eva jñāpakādatiriktakharttvasyāpi svātantryeṇa siddhiḥ | na tu tāvatā haltvayartvādeḥ śartvākṣepyatvaṃ mānābhāvāt | astu vā śartvākṣiptānāmapyeṣāṃ kāryaviśeṣapuraskāreṇa niyamārtham | aviśeṣeṇetyādivārttikaṃ sarvathā'pyuktakāryātirikte naiṣāṃ kutrāpi pratyāhāraupādānam | ata eva "kupvoḥ ḥkaḥpau" ityatra "kharpare śari" iti visarga eva | yadvā "vā śari" iti vikalpa iti nirastam | ata evāṭ‌śarorupadeśena saṃjñāntarāṇāṃ siddhisambhave'pi upāyasyopāyāntarādūṣakatvādityāśayena pratyāhāraviśeṣān pṛthak puruskṛtya vārttikākṣaravinyāsa ityapyapāstam | niyamārthamuktaprakāreṇaiva vārttikākṣaravinyāsa ityapyapāstam | niyamārthamuktaprakāreṇaiva vārttikaracanāyā ucitatvāt | etena hariḥ karoti hariṃ paśya ityatra yaṇvāraṇāya visargānusvārayorasiddhatvānusaraṇakleśo'pyapāstaḥ | etenaiva aṭ‌su kriyamāṇa upadeśo'kārāvyavahitottarameva karttavyaḥ, anyathā iṇ‌pratyāhārāntarbhāve saṃskarttetyatrānusvārātparasya sasya ṣatvāpatterityapyapāstam | dhvanitaṃ cedaṃ saṃskarttetyatrānusvārādacaḥ parasya sasya dvitvaṃ vadatā, uktarītyā ubibjiṣatītyabhyāse bakāraṃ cāpādayatā kaiyaṭenaiveti dik | tasmājjaśtvaṣatve nātra prayojane iti siddham | āvaśyakaṃ cedaṃ bhāṣyakṛto'pi | anyathā ṣatvārthaṃ śarṣūpadeśasyāvaśyakatve tata eva jaśtvasyāpi tata eva jhaltvena siddhau vārttikamate'pi tata eva jhaltvena siddhau vārttikamate'pi śarṣūpadeśarūpagauravānāpatteḥ | "bhujanyubjau" iti nipātanasya batvāṃśe'pi tātparyasya bhāṣyakṛto'pyadhikasya kalpyatvāt | gauravāntarasya ca parihṛtatvāt | na ca bārttikamate saṃyogasaṃjñāsiddhyarthayatnanibandhanaṃ gauravam | "bhujanyubjau" ityatra gurūccāraṇasāmarthyena jaśtvasyāsiddhatvābhāvaṃ kalpayitvā bakāramādāyaiva tatsiddhaḥ | saṃyogasaṃjñāyāḥ prayojanatvābhidhānasya ca yathāśrutaparatvāt | tasmājjaśtvarūpaprayojanapratyākhyānaparabhāṣyaprāmāṇyāt ṣatvasyāpi prakṛtaprayojanatvapratyākhyāne tatsammatirūnnīyate | jihvāmūlī yaparatve visargasiddhistu "kupvoḥ ḥkaḥpau ca" iti nipātasāmarthyādeva | tena "khayāṃ yamāḥ khayaḥ ḥkaḥpau" ityādau nānupapattiriti sūkṣmamavadheyam | upadhāsaṃjñā'pi na prayojanam | idudupadhasthāniko yo visarga itivyākhyānāt | idud‌bhyāṃ parasya visargasyetyata eva siddhāvupadhāgrahaṇapratyākhyānādvā | alo'ntyavidhirapi na prayojanam | padasya yo visarjanīyastasya sakāra itivyākhyānādeva siddheḥ | sthānivattvapratiṣedho'pi na prayojanam | pūrvatrāsiddhīye na sthānivaditi siddheḥ | na ca tasya "acaḥ parasmin" ityetanmātraviṣayakatvam | sthānikadbhāvaṃ prati tripādīsthasyāsiddhatayā nyāyamūlakatvāt sthānivadbhāvamātraviṣayakatvāt | tasmādaṭ‌su ṇatvam "anaci ca" iti dvitvaṃ ceti prayojanadvayameva siddham | laṇ‌ 6 | hakārādāvakārasya sukhoccāraṇamātrārthatve'pyatrānunāsikatvāditsaṃjñā | pratijñā''nunāsikyāḥ pāṇinīyā itisiddhāntāt | tena repheṇa sahākāroccāraṇe "uraṇ‌ raparaḥ" ityatra rapratyāhāreṇa rephalakārayorupādānam | ṛkāralṛkārayoḥ sāvarṇyamiti vārttikanirdeśaścātra mānam | nanu "ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ" ityādāvaṇ‌grahaṇaṃ pūrveṇa pareṇa vā ṇakāreṇetisaṃdehaḥ prāpnoti iticenna | grahaṇakaśāstre pareṇaiva tadanyatra pūrveṇaivetivyākhyānavaśāttannivṛtteḥ | tathā hi | aca ityeva siddhatvād ecāṃ dīrghatve viśeṣābhāvād aka ityeva vā siddhatvād dīrghatvasyāj‌mātradharmatayā hakārādīnāṃ tadasambhavādvinā'pyaj‌grahaṇaṃ siddhatvāccāṇ‌grahaṇasāmarthyādeva "ḍhralope" ityatra pūrveṇāṇ‌grahaṇam | na ca vṛhū udyamānaityasmāttṛci ūdittvāt "svaratisūti" iti iḍabhāvaṛkārasya guṇe "hoḍhaḥ" iti ḍhatve "jhaṣastathoḥ" iti pratyayatakārasya dhatve ṣṭutvena dhasya ḍhatve "ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ" iti pūrvaḍhakāralope rephasya sthānasāmyena ṛkāre dīrghe ḍhalopasyāsiddhatayā tatpūrvaṛkārasyopadhāsaṃjñāyām "upadhāyāśca" iti itve raparatve ikārasya laghūpadhaguṇe ca verḍhetirūpārthaṃ pareṇāṇ‌grahaṇaṃ syāditi vācyam | "acaśca" itiparibhāṣāvirodhāt rephasya dīrghāsambhavāt | na ca pareṇāṇ‌grahaṇasāmarthyām | anyo'nyāśrayāt | aṇ‌grahaṇasāmarthyapradarśakabhāṣyavirodhād aṭiti ṭakāreṇa saha pratyāhārapāṭhenāpi tadupapatteśca | yattu tṛtīyeti nirdeśātpūrveṇaivātrāṇ‌ | anyathā "halaḥ" ityatrāpyatratyasyaivāṇo'nuvṛttyā treḥ saṃprasāraṇe rephasthānīyaṛkārarūpasyāṇo'pi dīrghaprasaṅgāditi | taccintyam | aṅgāvayavāddhalaḥ paraṃ yat saṃprasāraṇaṃ tadantāṅgasya dīrghaḥ syādityeva tadarthāt | "ikaḥ kāśe" ityādau vicchinnasyāṇ‌grahaṇasyānuvṛttau mānābhāvāt | tathā ca tatra bhāṣye uktasūtrādaṇ‌grahaṇānuvṛttyā pūrvaṃ samādhānaṃ kṛtvā siddhāntitam--- atha vā ubhayaṃ nivṛttaṃ, kasmānna bhavati tṛtīya iti, dvitīyatṛtīyanipātanādetatsiddhamiti | tasmādaṇ‌grahaṇameva jñāpakamiti bhāṣyasammatam | yattu prācām aṇaḥ kiṃ dṛḍha iti pratyudāharaṇam, taccintyam | "dṛḍhaḥ sthūlabalayoḥ" ityatra iḍabhāvo nakārahakārayorlopo niṣṭhātakārasya ḍhatvaṃ ca nipātyate | na tvasiddhakāṇḍasthaḍhatvādeḥ pravṛttiḥ | paridraḍhayyetyatra "lyapi laghupūrvād‌" ityayādeśasya pāridṛḍhīkanyetyādau gurūpottamatvābhāvaprayuktaṣyaṅabhāvasya cāsiddhyāpatteḥ iti bhāṣyādāvuktatvāditi bahavaḥ | prāsādakārastu nakāralopanipātanoktyā dṛṃherevedaṃ nipātanamiti vṛha vṛddhāvityasya pratyudāharaṇatvaṃ yuktamevetyāha | yuktaṃ caitat | ādṛḍhaḥ āvṛḍhaḥ ityatra bhāṣyasvārasyāt | ata eva "dāderdhātorghaḥ" ityasya pravṛttyabhāva iḍabhāvaścetyādikalpanamapi na doṣāvaham | balavat‌pramāṇānugṛhītatvāt | etena dṛherapīdaṃ nipātanamiti kāśikoktaṃ parāstam | uktiliṅgavirodhena kalpanocchedācca | etenāsmātparidraḍhayya pāridṛḍhītyatrāyādeśābhāvaṣyaṅ‌pratyayayorāpādanamapīṣṭāpādanameva | rūpabhedasvīkāre bādhakābhāvāt | pramāṇasya ca darśitatvāt | etena prakriyāyāṃ tṛḍha iti pāṭhakalpanamapyapāstam | "ke'ṇaḥ" ityapi pūrveṇaiva | gokā naukā ityādau upānatkā catuṣkamityādau ca dhatvavisarjanīyayorasiddhatvātpareṣāmacāṃ halāṃ ca saṃbhave'pi hrasvavidhyupasthitasya "acaḥ" ityasyānurodhāditi kaustubhe | kaiyaṭe tu "na mu ne" ityatra netiyogavibhāgāddhatvādīnāmasiddhatvaṃ nāstīti hakārādīnāṃ kapratyaye pare'sambhava eveti vyākhyātam | na ca gokā ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ | aca ityeva vaktavyatvāpatteḥ | "aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsikaḥ" ityatra pareṇa pratyāhāre yadyapi ṛkārādīnāṃ svarūpataḥ saṃbhavo'styeva, karttṛ, agne, vāyo, pacai, mālāmācakṣāṇo māla, vṛkṣavayaterapratyaye vṛkṣav, ityādau sānunāsikānanunāsikabhedena yavalānāṃ dvaividhyāt, tathā'pyapragṛhyasyeti paryudāsena bhedapratiyogivṛttibhedapratiyogitāvacchedakasākṣādvyāpakadharmāvacchinnasyaivānuyogino vyutpattibalātpratītyā pragṛhyabhinnatvenāca evopasthitisiddhau aṇ‌grahaṇasāmarthyātpūrveṇaiva pratyāhāraḥ | vṛkṣav‌śabdastu kaiyaṭena vyākhyātaḥ | vṛkṣaṃ vṛścatīti kvivantād vṛkṣavṛścamācaṣṭaiti ṇici ṇāviṣṭavatprātipadikasyeti ṭilopena ṛkāraśakāracakārāṇāṃ nivṛttau vṛkṣavayatīti siddhe tato vic | na tu kvip | kittvena samprasāraṇāpatteḥ | vakāralopāpavādasya "cchvoḥ śūḍ‌" ityūṭhaḥ prasaṅgācca | na ca ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvaḥ | kvau luptaṃ na sthānivaditi kvau vidhiṃ prati na sthānivad iti ca niṣedhāt | vici tu sthānivattvena valopābhāvādinirvāhaḥ | na ca tathā'pi "hali sarveṣām" iti lopāpattiḥ, pūrvatrāsiddhīye sthānivattvābhāvāditi vācyam | tatra "bhobhago" ityato'śītyanuvarttanāt | na ca ṇic‌prāgbhāvinaṃ kvipamevāśritya ūṭh‌prasaṅgaḥ | antarbhūtakvibāśrayatayā'ntaraṅge tatra karttavye bahirbhūtaṇijapekṣayā bahiraṅgasya ṭilopasyāsiddhatvāditi | yattu kaustubhe ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatayā "vraśca" iti ṣatvaṃ durvāram | na ca ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvaḥ | padāntavidhau neti niṣedhāt | pūrvatrāsiddhe tadabhāvācca | tasmād‌ vṛkṣaṃ vetīti vṛkṣavīḥ vātīti vṛkṣavāḥ | vṛkṣavyaṃ vṛkṣavāṃ vā''caṣṭe iti ṇyantādvic | na ca "lopo vyoḥ" iti valopāpattiḥ | ṇilopasya sthānivattvāt| lopasyānavayavatvena padāntaścedvidhīyata ityarthakasya "na padānta" iti niṣedhasyāpravṛtteriti | taccintyam | vraścādisūtrecchaśāmityatra chakārātpūrvaṃ cakāradvayapraśleṣeṇa ekena svābhāvikasyāpareṇa jakārasthāne vartvena prayuktasya cakārasya nirdeśādvraścādīnāṃ cakārajakārayoreva ṣatvavidhānāt | upāyasya copāyāntarādūṣakatvāt | syādetat | "cchvoḥ" itisūtre kid‌grahaṇamanuvarttate na veti vicārya bhāṣye uktam--- anuvarttamāne kidgrahaṇe chaḥ ṣatvaṃ vaktavyamiti | asyārthaḥ | tadanuvṛttyabhāve "cchvoḥ" iti chasya śatve śakārasya ca ṣatvavidhānādeva siddhau vraścādisūtre chagrahaṇaṃna kāryamiti | evaṃ ca lāghavādatraiva bhāṣyatātparye chakāraparityāge kathamuktaḥ praśleṣa iti | satyam | tathā'pi alo'ntyaparibhāṣayā cakārajakārayoreva ṣatvavidhānādvakārasya tadanāpatteḥ | vraścādyaṃśe ṣatvasya kutvāpavādatvāt | haradattastu vṛkṣav karoti ityevaṃrūpaḥ prayogo nāstyeva | "na padāntā halo'ṇaḥ santi" iti bhāṣyoktyā'nabhidhānaniścayāditi " hali sarveṣām" itisūtre vyavasthāpitavān | atra kaustubhakṛtaḥ | laṇ‌sūtrabhāṣye "na padāntāḥ pare'ṇaḥ santi" ityeva pāṭhaḥ | anyathā apragṛhyasyetiparyudāsenācāmeva kāryabhāktvāditare kāryiṇo na santīti kaiyaṭavirodhāditi | taccintyam | karttṛ ityādīnāṃ sattvapradarśanapareṇa bhāṣyeṇācāmpradarśane'pi halāṃ sattve mānābhāvāt | yathāśrutakaiyaṭokteśca yuktiviruddhatvāt | svarūpeṇa ṛkārādīnāmaṇāṃ sattvena tanniṣedhe bādhābhāvāt | viśiṣṭābhāva ṛkārādiṣu viśeṣaṇābhāvenaiva halsādhāraṇyena varttiṣyataityabhiprāyeṇa tvaduktarītyā kāryiṇo na santīti vyākhyānāvatārāt | na caitad yuktam | aṇ‌grahaṇasya pūrveṇa saha vyavasthāpanātprāk ṛkārādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇābhāvaprayuktaviśiṣṭābhāvāśrayatvāsiddheḥ | anyathā pūrvapakṣasyaivānupasthānāt | "nanu cāyamasti kartṛ " ityādibhāṣyānupapatteśca | ṛkārādeḥ kāryabhāktvābhāvaśaṅkāyāṃ svarūpamātrasattokteraprayojakatvāt | ataḥ svarūpeṇa padāntānāmṛkārādīnāmasattvaśaṅkāyāmṛkārasya taduttarājmātropalakṣaṇatayā tatsattve ukte padāntaṛkārādyabhāvāvabodhakasya "na padāntāḥ pare'ṇaḥ santi" itivākyasya ajaṃśe aprāmāṇyavyavasthityā hakārādyabhāvabodhakatvāṃśe bādhakābhāvātprāmāṇyaṃ paryavasyatīti phalitārthamādāya na halo'ṇaḥ santītivākyasya miśraiḥ samullikhitatvāt | na ca ṛkārapradarśanasyopalakṣaṇatve halo'pyupalakṣyantāmiti vācyam | pramāṇābhāvāt | "hrasvasya guṇaḥ" "eta ai" "āta au ṇalaḥ" ityādīnāmajaṃśe upalakṣaṇatāyāṃ tātparyagrāhakatvāt | na ca halaṃśe "hali sarveṣām" itisūtrehali aśi yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt, vṛkṣavayaterapratyayaḥ vṛkṣav karoti iti bhāṣyaṃ tātparyagrāhakamastyeveti vācyam | tasyaitadbhāṣyavirodhena prauḍhivādatvāt | na ca vaiparītyam | prāthamyasyaiva tāvadvinigamakatvāt | vikalpasya ca vastunyasambhavāt | tadāhuḥ prāmāṇikāḥ--- anuṣṭhānaṃ hi vikalpyate na vastviti | na ca vṛkṣav karotīti spaṣṭārthakabhāṣyavirodhena pūrvabhāṣyasya tathātātparyaṃ na kalpyamiti vācyam | tasyāpyanyathā'nupapannatvāt | na ca tasya pūrvapakṣagatatvena sarvāṃśāprāmāṇye'pi na kṣatiḥ, ajabhāvabodhakatvāṃśavaduktabādhakasya halabhāvabodhakatvāṃśe'pyaprāmāṇyakalpakasya sattvāditi vācyam | nanu cāyamastīti niṣedhātyantāyogavyabacchedaparottarabhāṣyādapyetadarthasya pratīteḥ | hakārādeḥ kasyacid ubhayābhyupagatapadāntatvābhāvakatvāt | vipratipannaniṣedhasyāṃśato bhāṣyasaṃmatatvāt | anyathā pūrveṇāṇ‌grahaṇāsiddheśca | tathā hi | apragṛhyasyetyuktavyutpattivaśādacāṃ lābhena hayādīnāṃ kāryitvāsambhavādevājviṣayakatvasiddhau aṇ‌padasāmarthyātpūrveṇeti na śakyate vaktum | aṇ‌padasāmarthyena vādīnāṃ kāryitve siddhe nyāyasyākiñcitkaratvāt | "arthavadadhāturapratyayaḥ" ityarthavad‌grahaṇena "oṣadheśca vibhaktāvaprathamāyām" ityādau bibhaktyādyupādānena ca tannyāyasyāpyasārvatrikaṃtvāt | "avarṇastrasāvanañaḥ" itisūtre bhedapratiyogivṛttitattvāvacchedakadharmasākṣādvyāpakadharmāvacchinnānuyogitākabhedabhāne vibhaktitvasyaiva tathātvāt tadanavacchinne aṇādau tadapravṛttau ārvatamityādyasiddhyāpatteśca | niṣedhasvīkāre ca "vāhairalupyata sahasradṛgarvagarvaḥ " ityādivirodhāt | bhedapratiyogitāvacchedakānyapratiyogivṛttidharmamātreṇa sādṛśyavivakṣāyāṃ ca tatra pratyayatvasyevātrāpyaltvasya tādṛśatvāttadavacchinnānāṃ vādīnāṃ vāraṇānupapatteḥ | etenāṇ‌grahaṇasya pūrveṇāpyupapannatvān nañivayuktanyāyabādha ityapyapāstam | ubhayorapyanyathopapattau nyāyasaṅkocasyaiva nyāyyatvāt | "ke'ṇaḥ" ityādau tu hrasvaśrutyaivāca upasthāpanāttadanurodha iti vaiṣamyam | uktarītyā tu bādhābhāvasya pramāṇamātropajīvyatayā halāmaṇāṃ padānte'nupapatteḥ tatsaṃgrahārthatvāyogāt | ac‌padaṃ parityajyāṇ‌grahaṇasāmarthyādeva pūrveṇāṇ‌grahaṇasiddhiḥ | tasmādatratyabhāṣyasya haradattokta evārtho yuktaḥ | kaiyaṭasyāpyatraiva tātparyāt | tathā hi | vṛkṣav karotītyaś‌padānuvṛtteḥ prayojanaṃ vakṣyatīti yathāśrutāṣṭamikabhāṣyavirodhamāśaṅkya uktaparyudāsāditare kāryabhājo na santīti samādhānasya na padāntā halo'ṇaḥ santītyatraiva tātparyam | ṛkārādīnāṃ svarūpataḥ sattvena kāryabhātkaṃ viśeṣaṇam | sa ca viśiṣṭābhāva ṛkārādiṣu viśeṣaṇābhāvena hakārādiṣu ca viśeṣyābhāvenāviśiṣṭaḥ | ubhayatrāpi viśeṣaṇābhāvaparatve viśeṣyabhāgavaiyarthyāt | yadyapi cedaṃ prathamamasiddham ṛkārādiṣvanunāsikavidhyapravṛttestadvelāyāmasiddheḥ, tathā'pyapragṛhyasyeti paryudāsenāca evānunāsikena bhāvyam, na tu hala iti phakkikāyāṃ halāmaṇāmasambhave satīti śeṣaḥ | anyathā uktarītyā nyāyasyāpravṛttau vādīnāmapyanunāsikāpatteḥ ityukte padāntā halo'ṇo na santītyuktaprāyam | tathā cāṣṭamikabhāṣyaṃ prauḍhimātramiti bhāvaḥ | na hi padāntā ityasyārthamāha | "kāryabhāja ityarthaḥ" iti | tathā ca gūḍhābhiprāya uktaviśiṣṭābhāvaṃ darśayatīti siddhānta evāyaṃ na tu pūrvapakṣa iti bhāvaḥ | itarastu yathāśrute dūṣaṇamāha | nanu cāyamiti bhāṣye ācāryaḥ pūrvākṣiptaṃ svābhiprāyaṃ prakāśayati---evaṃ tarhīti | padānte halāmaṇāmasambhavāt paryudāsenācāmeva grahaṇe siddhe aṇ‌grahaṇasāmarthyātpūrveṇaiveti bhāvaḥ | ata evāca eva pragṛhyā bhavantīti paryudāsamātraṃ sādhakatvenoktam | taccoktarītyā padānte halāmaṇāṃ sattve'sādhakameveti sarvathā'pyatratyabhāṣyasya na padāntāḥ pare'ṇaḥ santīti bhāṣyasya ca siddhāntatve kaiyaṭasya tātparyam | pūrvapakṣatve granthadvayasyāpyalagnakatvāpatteḥ | vṛkṣav hasatītyatrātiprasaṅgasya aśītyanuvṛttyā'pi durvāratayā tvayā'pi tatrānabhidhānasyāvaśyamāśrayaṇīyatvāt | anabhidhānasya ca padaviśeṣagarbhatayā vṛkṣav itiprayogābhāvamātraparyavasitatvād ityāstāṃ vistaraḥ | "uraṇ‌ raparaḥ" ityapi pūrveṇa | pareṇa prayojanābhāvāt | na ca hotṝkāraḥ mātṝṇāmityādau ṛkārasya savarṇadīrghe "nāmi" iti dīrghe ca raparatvārthaṃ pareṇa syāditi vācyam | "ṛta iddhātoḥ" iti dhātugrahaṇāt jñāpakāt | taddhi ṛkārāntamātrasya itvavidhāne mātṝṇāmityādāvapi itvaṃ syādityatiprasaṅganiṣedhārtham | tatrāpi raparatve tu rephāntatvāpattyā ṛkārāntatvābhāvādeva tadaprasaktyā kiṃ tena | na ca cikīrṣatītyādau "ajjhanagamāṃ sani" iti ṛkārasya dīrghe raparatve ca "upadhāyāṃ ca" itisūtreṇa yathā ṛkārasya ikārādeśo bhavati, tathā mātṝṇāmityādāvapi raparatve kṛte syāt, ataḥ "upadhāyāṃ ca' ityatrānuvṛttyarthameva dhātugrahaṇamiti vācyam | tathā'pi tatraiva tadupādānāpattyā pūrvatra nirdeśasya jñāpanārthatvāt | aṇ‌grahaṇasyaiva jñāpakatvasaṃbhavācca | anyathā "urajraparaḥ" ityeva brūyāt | tatra tatra ṛkārasthānīyānām udāttānudāttasvaritānunāsikadīrgharūpāṇāmādeśānāṃ raparatvāpattestenaiva nirvāhasambhavāt | atha kartrarthamityādau yaṇādeśena ṛkārasya rephe tasya raparatvasiddhyarthamaṇ‌grahaṇam | na ca "halo yamāṃ yami" ityādyarephasya lopāvaśyakatvāttatraraparatvaṃ vyarthamiti vācyam | "jhayo ho'nyatarasyām" ityatastatra vikalpānuvṛtteruktatvāt iti cenna | "rori" iti lopasya durvāratvāt | na ca tasya padāntamātraviṣayakatvam | ajarghā ityāderasiddhyāpatteḥ | gṛdhu abhikāṅkṣāyām ityasya hi yaṅ‌luki dvitve uradatve jaśtve "rugrikau ca luki" ityabhyāsasya rugāgame ca kṛte laṅi aḍāgame sipi śabluki guṇe raparatve silope bhaṣbhāvena gasya ghatve jaśtvena dhasya datve dasya rutve ghakārottararaphesya lope " ḍhralopa" iti ghakārākārasya dīrghatve "kharavasānayoḥ" iti rorvisarge cāsya siddheḥ | etacca sarvamabhyupagamyavādaḥ | vastutastu ṛkārasthānīyānāmaṇāṃ raparatve vidheye ṛkāralṛkārayoḥ sthānitvena rephalakārayośca vidheyatvenopasthitau pariśeṣādādeśasamarpakamaṇ‌padaṃ sthānibhinneṣu rephalakārabhinneṣu cāṇ‌su paryavasyati | tathā ca mātṝṇāmityādau kutrāpi nātiprasaṅgaḥ | nāpi kartrarthamityādau rephadvayāpattiḥ | evaṃ ca pareṇa grahaṇe vaiyarthyāpattirevāṇ‌grahaṇasāmarthyāditi bhāṣyasyārthaḥ | yathā śrute lākṛtirityatra laparatvasyaiva tatphalatvasambhavāditi kaustubhoktadoṣāpatteḥ | nāpi dhātugrahaṇena nistāraḥ | tasyottarārthatvasyāpi sambhavāt | yattu nuḍ‌vācya uttarārthaṃ tu iha kiñcittrapo itinyāyenātra karaṇaṃ jñāpakameveti, tanna | "nāmi" iti sūtre nuḍ‌viśiṣṭaghaṇasya kevalottarārthatvasyāpi sthāpitatvena tathāniyamābhāvāt | na ca vacanena takrakauṇ‌ḍinyanyāyabādhaḥ | pūrveṇāpyupapatteḥ | anyathā arttrarthamityādau "ro ri" iti lopasyāpi bādhāpatteḥ | na ca vacanasāmarthyānnyāyabādhaḥ śreyān | tatra rephalopasvīkāre rephasya raparatvavaiyarthyāt | tadbodhakavacanabādhasya tatrāpyaviśeṣāt | kutrāpi tacchravaṇābhāve pravṛttimātreṇa caritārthatvānupapatteḥ | anyathā "śaro'ci" ityasya vikalpānuvṛttijñāpakatvatadvighaṭanobhayaparasya bhāṣyāderanupapatteriti dik | "aṇudit savarṇasya ca" ityatra tu pareṇaiva | "urṛt" ikārokārayoḥ svarūpeṇa nirddeśāt | anyathā iṇa ityevāvakṣyat | saṃhitāyāṃ yathānyāse halorarddhamātrādvayam mātrādvayaṃ caukārasyeti mātrātrayam | iṇa ityukte tu sārdhamātrādvayam | padacchede'pi hrasvavidhānasāmarthyātkapratyaye pare bhasaṃjñā na bhavatīti kalpayituṃ śakyatvāt | akārekārayoḥ yasyetilopāvaśyakatve ukārasyaiva tadvidhānaprasaṅgāt | vastutastatrāpyorguṇapraṅgena viśeṣābhāvāt | samādhānāntaramāha---apradhānatvāditi | saṃjñāsvarūpatvapratipattimātrārthamanubandhopādānātsaṃjñināmeva prādhānyādgrahaṇam pradhānāpradhānayoritinyāyāt | na caivamakārāderapi tadanāpattiḥ | svaṃ rūpamityanuvṛttyā āderapi saṃjñitvāt | na ca svaśabdenānubandho'pi gṛhyatāmiti vācyam | iteti tṛtīyayā ito'prādhānyalābhāt | sarvanāmnāṃ ca pradhānaparāmarśitvasyautsargikatvāt | idaṃ tvabyuccayamātram | prādhānyaṃ yadi saṃjñitvameva, tadā parasparāśrayaḥ | atha saṃketagrahaṇakaśāstrajanyabodhe viśeṣyatvam | tanna | tasyākiñcitkaratvāt | ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭo ghaṭo ghaṭaśabdavācya ityādau viśeṣaṇe'pi śaktigrahācca | mīmāṃsakānāṃ nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇetinyāyena viśeṣaṇe eva śaktigrahācca | madhyagatānubandhānāṃ grahaṇasyoktarītyā'pi durvāratvācca | samādhānāntaramāha---lopaśceti | balavattara iti svārthe tarap | itsaṃjñāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ ṇakārādīnāmacsaṃjñālopayoḥ prāptau lopavidherbalavattvāt lope kṛte saṃjñāpravṛttikāle teṣāmabhāvānna saṃjñā | bhūtapūrvanyāyenāntyasahitasyādeḥ saṃjñāptambhavāt | anyatā vacanavaiyarthyāt | idamapi na vāstavam | saṃjñāpravṛttikālasattvasya śaktigrahe'nupayuktatvāt | ata eva vṛddhisūtre kaiyaṭaḥ--- satyasati vā saṃjñini buddhyā viṣayīkṛte śabdena pūrvaṃ nirddiṣṭe saṃjñā pravarttataiti | ata eva "halantyam" itisūtre "lasyetsaṃjñā" itibhāṣyādayaḥ | tasmāt pūrvokta eva tātparyamiti dik || iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau prathamasyādhyāyasya prathame pāde dvitīyamāhnikam | vṛddhirādaic‌ | ātāka aikāra aukāraśca ādeśānādeśasādhāraṇyena vṛddhisaṃjñaḥ syāt | pradeśā vidhau "vṛddhireci" ityādayaḥ | anuvāde tu "vṛddhiryasyācām" ityādayaḥ | atra chandovatsūtrāṇi bhavantītyatideśād "ayasmayādīnicchandasi" iti bhasaṃjñatvātpadāntanimittakakutvābhāvaḥ | jaśtvopayoginī tu padasaṃjñā'styeveti "vṛddhirādaijadeṅ‌guṇaḥ" iti saṃhitayā pāṭhe jaśtvaṃ bhavatyeva | yathā sasuṣṭubhā sa ṛkvatā gaṇenetyatreti bhāṣyam | dṛṣṭānte kutvopayoginī padasaṃjñā'sti, na tu jaśtvopayoginīti tu viśeṣaḥ | iha taparatvamaijartham | tena trimātrādīnāṃ na saṃjñeti pūrvamuktam | nacaivaṃ padāntatvābhāvāddatvaṃ na syāditi vācyam | asandehārthatayā pūrvaśeṣatvasyāpi sambhavāt | dakārasya tatkālagrāhakatvamapi pūrvaṃ nirṇītam | syādetat | kṛtamanayoḥ sādhutvamitibhāṣyasvarasād ādaic‌ iti samastameva | anayoḥ padayoriti tadarthāt | yadyapi vṛddhiḥ āt aijiti paspaśāyāṃ pṛthak‌padatvamapyuktam, tathā'pi tadabhyuccayamātram | anayoḥ sūtrakhaṇḍayoriti vyākhyānāpatteḥ | tasya ca "vṛdhirasmai aviśeṣeṇopadiṣṭaḥ prakṛtipāṭhe tasmātstriyāṃ ktinpratyayaḥ, ādaico'pyakṣarasamāmnāye upadiṣṭāḥ" itibhāṣyaviruddhatvāt | cakārādhyāhāraprasaṅgācca | tathā ca samāhāre "dvandvāccudaṣahāntād" iti samāsāntasya, itaretarayogadvandve tu dvivacanasyāpattiriti, satyam | samāsāntavidheranityatvāt samāhāradvandvasyaiva nirdoṣatvāt | tatra jñāpakaṃ tu "prateraṃśvādayastatpuruṣe" itisūtre aṃśvādigaṇe rājan‌śabdapāṭhaḥ | prateḥ pare aṃśvādayo'ntodāttā iti tadarthaḥ | "rājāhaḥ sakhibhyaḥ" iti ṭaco nityatve tu cittvādevāntodāttatvaṃ syāt | evamapāccetyanuvartamāne "sphigapūtavīṇāñjodhvakukṣisīranāmanāma ca" ityantodāttavidhau adhvaśabdopādānamapi liṅgam | "upasargādadhvanaḥ" iti samāsāntasya nityatve acaiva siddheḥ | kecittu "dvitribhyāṃ pāddanmūrddhasu bahuvrīhau" itisūtre samā sāntarahitamūrddhagrahaṇamiha liṅgam | dvimūrddhā trimūrddhā ityatrāntodāttatvavikalpārthaṃ hi tat | "dvitribhyāṃ ṣa mūd‌rdhnaḥ" itisamāsāntasya nityatve tu nānta uktabahuvrīhiraprasiddha eva syāt | dvimūrddha ityāderakārāntatvāt | samāsāntānāṃ samudāyāvayavatvāt | na ca samāsāntānānuttarapadāntāvayavatvadvārā samāsāntatvamityasyāpi bhāṣyarūḍhatvāt ṣapratyayaviśiṣṭasyāpi mūrddhan‌śabdena grahaṇaṃ sambhavatyeveti dvimūrddhāstrimūrddha iti akārāntaeva bahuvrīhau vikalpārthaṃ taditi vācyam | tatpakṣasyābhyuccayamātratvāt | mūrddheṣvityapahāya bahubrīhigarbhagurunyāsārambhātsūtrakṛt‌saṃmatatvābhāvācca | na ca dvau pādayati dvipāt dvayordantān dvidataḥ paśyeti tatpuruṣavāraṇāya brahuvrīhigrahaṇāvaśyakatve mūrddheṣu itinyāsa eva gauravamiti kathaṃ jñāpakatvamiti vācyam | samāsāntaviśiṣṭamūrddhaśabdasāhacaryeṇa pāddacchabdayoripa bahuvrīhyavayavayoreva grahaṇasambhave bahuvrīhigrahaṇasyānāvaśyakatvāt | etena "dvitribhyāṃ pāddan" itisūtre bahuvrīhigrahaṇamevoktaparibhāṣājñāpakam | anyathā pāddanmūrddheṣvityeva nirddeśet | kṛtasamāsāntaśabdaprakramācca | bahuvrīhibhinnaṃ ca samāsāntavirahādeva vārayiṣyate, iti kaustubhoktirnirastā | yathānyāse'pi ṣapratyayānte uktasūtrasyāpravṛtteruktatayā tasya lakṣyatvamaṅgīkṛtya bahuvrīhigrahaṇasya jñāpakatvokteraṅgatatvāt | lakṣyabhedābhyupagamena jñāpakatvokterasāmpradāyikatvāt | yadapi dvidataḥ paśyetyatra kathaṃ dadbhāvaḥ, "paddannomās" iti sūtre tadantavidhyabhāvādityāśaṅkya ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇasūtrasthapūrvapakṣanyāyena "siddhaṃ tvavayavānanyatvād" ityāṣṭamikabhāṣyavārttikanyāyena cāvayavasya kāryalābhāditi tatroktam | tadapicintyam | śasādiṣu parataḥ pūrveṣāṃ pādādīnāṃ padādyādeśavidhānācchaṅkottarayorasaṅgatatvāt | etena "dvitribhyāṃ ṣa mūd‌rdhnaḥ" iti ṣacaṃ vihāya ṣapratyayavidhānamapi jñāpakam | taddhi ṣacaścittvasāmarthyalabhyamantodāttatvam "bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā" iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaravat "dvitribhyāṃ pāddan‌mūrddhasu" iti antodāttavikalpamapi mā bādhiṣṭetyetadarthaṃ vikalpasya kvacit sāvakāśatve satyeva saṅgacchate | avakāśaśca samāsāntānāmanityatvaeva labhyate | trimūrddhānaṃ saptaraśmiṃ gṛṇīṣe itiyathā ityapi parāstam | dvimūrddha ityādau kṛtasamāsānte tatsūtrasya na pravṛttirityuktatvāt | cittvasāmarthyalabhyāntodāttatvasya tadvikalpabādhakatvaśaṅkānupapatteḥ | astu vā tatra vikalpapravṛttiḥ, tathā'pi noktajñāpakatvam | citsvarasya "bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ" itipūrvasūtraviṣaye phalakasaktho viśālākṣa ityādau caritārthatvādvikalpabādhakatvānupapatteḥ | na ca "dvitribhyām" iti ṣaco yaccittvaṃ tadacaritārthameveti vācyam | pūrvasūtrīyasyaivātrānuvṛtteḥ | anyathā pratyāhārāhnike "āta" iti kapratyayakittvamākāraikadeśasyāto lopo na bhavatītyatra na jñāpakam, "tundaśokayoḥ parimṛjāpanudoḥ" ityuttarasūtre caritārthatvād itibhāṣyoktyanupapatteḥ | na caivaṃ ṣapratyayavidhānavaiyarthyameva syāditi vācyam | uktāntodāttavikalpasya samāsāntābhāvapakṣaeva pravṛttervyavasthāpitatvāt | "dvitribhyām" ityatrāpi ṣaṭ‌pratyayavidhāne cittvabalalabhyāntodāttatvasya nirapavādatvāt dvimūrddha ityādau tadeva syāt | ṣapratyaye tu pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eveti vaiṣamyena tatsārthakyādityāhuḥ | tatredaṃ cintyam | samāsāntābhāvapakṣaevoktāntodāttavikalpa iti tāvadākaraviruddham | yadyatra ṣac‌ syāttadā nityamantodāttatvaṃ syāt | "dvitribhyām" iti vibhāṣā'ntodāttatvaṃ tu yadā samāsāntavidheranityatvāt dvimūrddheti samāsāntābhāvaḥ, tadā sāvakāśam | ṣe tu sati samāsāntapakṣe'pi pakṣe'ntodāttatvam pakṣe pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyudāttatvamiti svaradvayasiddhiriti tatratyabhāṣyakaiyaṭayoruktatvāt | tathā coktakalpanaṃ nirmūlatvādeva heyam | mūrddhasviti nirdeśasyoktajñāpakatvaṃ tu bhāṣyādāveva spaṣṭam | ata eva mūrddheṣviti nyāsānārambhāduttarapadāvayavāḥ samāsāntā itipakṣasya sūtrānabhimatatvamiti nirastam | samāsāntābhāvapakṣe'pi vikalpapravṛttyarthatayā tādṛśanyāsaparityāgopapatteḥ | ata eva ṣapratyayavidhānādapi tatpakṣasya sūtrānabhimatatvamityapāstam | samāsāntapakṣe'pyantodāttavikalpārthatvāt | yadapyuktam---"samāsāntāḥ" itisūtre samāsāntānāṃ sākṣādeva samāsāntatvamitipakṣasya bhāṣye vyavasthāpitatvāt dvidhurī tridhurītyatra "akārāntottarapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate" itivārttikānurodhena samāsārthāduttarapadātsamāsāntaḥ kriyataitipakṣasya likhitatve'pi "samāsāntāḥ" itisūtre akārāntād dvigorityuttarapadaśabdarahitavārttikapāṭhena dvidhurītyādeḥ sākṣātsamāsāntatvapakṣe'pi sādhitatvāt | vārttikagatottarapadaśabdamātramūlakasya samāsāntānāmuttarapadāvayavatvapakṣasyāśrayeṇa dvimūrddha ityādāvantodāttavikalpapravṛttikalpanamapekṣya sākṣātsamāsāntatvapakṣamāśritya dvimūrddha ityādau kṛtasamāsānte tadvikalpapravṛttirnetyeva kalpayitumucitatvāduktarītyaiva gurusūtranyāsaṣavidhānayoḥ sārthakyamiti | tadapyasat | tatpakṣāvalambanena kṛtasamāsānte'pi vikalpapravṛttyaiva bhāṣyādyuktayā gurunyāsasārthakyāt | "sarūpāṇām" itisūtre uttarapadāntāḥ samāsāntā itipakṣasyāpi bhāṣyasaṃmatatvena kaiyaṭoktatvācca | "gostriyo" itisūtre "kapi pratiṣedhaḥ" itivārttikapratyākhyānāya bhāṣyakṛtā uktapakṣasya sākṣādeva likhitatvācca | yadapyuktaṃ "dvitribhyāṃ pāddan‌" itisūtrabhāṣyaparyālocanayā tatpakṣasya dvimūrddha ityudāharaṇasya ca bhāṣyānabhimatatvaṃ spaṣṭameva | tathā hi | akārāntasya grahaṇe nakārāntasyopasaṃkhyānam, nakārāntagrahaṇe tvakārāntasya | uttarapadasya kāryitve samāsānte kṛte uttarapade vidhīyamānasyāntodāttatvasya pratyaye prāptyabhāvādityuktvā dvitīyapakṣe uttarapadāntodāttatve śeṣanighātena pratyayasyānudāttatve ṭilope udāttanivṛttisvareṇa pratyayodāttatvam | na cottarapadāntodāttatvātpūrvameva paratvāṭṭilopa iti vācyam | samāsāntārtpūmeva paratvādantodāttapravṛtteḥ | tadā ca ṭilopaprāptyabhāvāt | na ca kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitayā nityatvātpūrvaṃ samāsāntaḥ | antodāttasyāpi tathātvāt | na ca kṛte samāsānte uttarapadāntodāttatvaṃ na prāpnoti, paratvāt ṭilopena bādhāditi vācyam | lopena tannimittavighāte'pi samāsāntena tadavighātāt | yasya ca lakṣaṇāntareṇa nimittaṃ vihanyate na tadanityatvamiti svīkārāditi | tadapi cintyam | kimatra uttarapadāntāḥ samāsāntā itipakṣo nāstītyabhimatam, kiṃ vā dvimūrddha ityādau noktavikalpa iti | nādyaḥ | yadā kṛte samāse samāsānta itipakṣaḥ, tadeyaṃ sampradhāraṇā, yadā tu samāsārthāduttarapadātsamāsāntaḥ kriyate itipakṣaḥ tadā sampradhāraṇaiva nāstīti kaiyaṭenaivoktatvāt | nāntyaḥ | taduttarameva hi kaiyaṭena vyākhyātam--- yadi nityaḥ samāsāntaḥ syāttadā kāryiviśeṣasandehavyāvṛttaye prakramābhedāya vā samāsānta evoccāryeta | tadanuccāraṇāttu samāsāntasyānityatvaṃ jñāpyate | tatra yadā samāsānto nāsti tadā samāsasyottarapadasya vā kāryitve viśeṣābhāvaḥ | yadā tu samāsāntaḥ kriyate tadā samāsasya kāryitve samāsāntasyodāttatvam | yadā'pyuttarapadasya kāryitvam, tadā paratvādantodāttatve kṛte samāsāntaḥ | tatra ṭilope udāttanivṛttisvareṇāpi siddham | nanu pratyayasvareṇa samāsāntasya bhāvyam, naitadasti | bahuvrīhisvareṇa tasya bādhāt | bahuvrīhisvarasyāpyaneneti | anena ca dvirmūrddha ityādau pākṣikodāharaṇatvasyāpi lābhāt | ata eva ṣapratyaye pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara evetyapi kalpanaṃ nirastam | yadapyuktam | mūrddhasu bahuvrīhau" iti gurunirdeśasyoktapakṣāvalambanena kathaṃcit sārthakye'pi ṣapratyayavidhānasya tadasambhavaḥ | ṣaciścittvasāmarthyalabhyāntodāttasya pūrvasūtraviṣaye caritārthasya dvimūrddha ityādau pareṇāntodāttavikalpena bādhasambhavāt | na ca cittvaprayuktamāntodāttatvaṃ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarameva bādhate na tūktavikalpamityatra vinigamakābhāvaḥ | kakṣayā kakṣā nimātavyetibhāṣyoktanyāyena tatsiddheḥ | pūrvakakṣāprāptānāmuttarakakṣāprāptā bādhakā iti tadarthāt | ata eva prathamakakṣāprāptayoryaṇ‌guṇayoḥ savarṇadīrghaḥ, tasya ca "ato guṇe" iti tṛtīyakakṣāprāptaṃ pararūpaṃ bādhakam | prakṛte'pi prathamakakṣāyāṃ "samāsasya" ityantodāttatvam, dvitīyāyāṃ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam, tasya ca ṣacaścittvasāmarthyalabhyamantodāttatvam uktavikalpaśceti tṛtīyakakṣāgataṃ bādhakadvayam | tatrāpavādavipratiṣedhe paratvādattodāttavikalpa eva bhaviṣyatīti prakṛtena ṣacaiva siddheriti | tadapi cintyam | ṣaco vidhāne tasya ca nityatve vikalpasya citsvaranirmuktaviṣayābhāvena vipratiṣedhāyogāt | samāsāntābhāvapakṣe vikalpasya sāvakāśatvamityuktau tu tasya samāsāntapakṣaviṣayakatve pramāṇābhāvātsamānaviṣayakatvābhāvena tadayogāt | nityavidhervaikalpikavidhiviṣaye pravṛttyasambhavāt | tathā ca niravakāśatvādeva vikalpasiddhau ṣapratyayavidhānaṃ vikalpasya sāvakāśatvamākṣipat tatprayojakatayā samāsāntavidheranityatvaṃ jñāpayatīti dik | nanvatra kutvaprāptireva nāsti | laukikavaidikaśabdānāmeva vyutpādyatvād iti cet atrāhuḥ--- anekaśakteḥ śabdasya śaktyavacchedena saṃjñini viniyogānnityatvācca sarvasaṃjñānāṃ laukikatvādādaicchabdasyānukaraṇaśabdatvājjātiśabdatvādvā śāstraprāptirastīti | laukikatvādādaicchabdasya śāstraprāptirastīti sambandhaḥ | tatra nityatvāditi hetuḥ | ādaicchabdasya ākārādau tadbhinne ca sāṅketikaśakteḥ sattvāt | nanvevaṃ saṃjñāvidhānavaiyarthyam | ataḥ śaktyavacchadeneti | sa ca śaktisaṅkocaḥ | idaṃ padametadarthaṃ bodhayatvitivyaktiviśeṣabodhakatvaprakārakecchāviśeṣyatvamiti yāvat | saṃjñini uktecchāyāṃ viśeṣyatāsambandhena viśeṣaṇībhūte bodhe viśeṣyatāsambandhena viśeṣaṇībhūtāyāṃ vyaktau viniyogāt | uktasaṅketajñānasahakāreṇa tadviṣayakaśābdadhījanakatvavyavasthāpanāt | uktaṃ ca--- vyavahārāya niyamaḥ saṃjñāyāḥ saṃjñini kvacit | nitya eva tu sambandho ḍitthādiṣu gavādivat || vṛddhyādīnāṃ ca śāstre'smin śaktyavacchedalakṣaṇaḥ | akṛtrimo'bhisambandho viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavat || tathā cātra śāstre vṛddhiśabdenādaica eva bodhyā itiniyamārthaṃ saṃjñāvidhanamityarthaḥ | nityatvādityupapādayati---anekaśakteriti | anekasminnanekā vā śaktiryasya arthagatapravṛttinimittaviśeṣānapekṣatayā vaktṛtātparyaviṣayayatkiñcidvyaktibodhanasamarthasya | na ca "na kopadhāyāḥ" iti puṃvadbhāvaniṣedhaḥ | taddhitavugrahaṇasya tatra vakṣyamāṇatvāt | anekaviṣayā śaktiryasyeti vivaraṇavākyaṃ tu saptamyartho viṣayatvamityabhiprāyakam | avacchedakabhede'pi lāghavādekaiva śaktiḥ | aupādhikabhedasyopādhibhedamātre paryavasānādityādyaḥ pakṣaḥ | śaktibhedapakṣe dvitīyaḥ | nanu na santi yadṛcchāśabdā iti ṛla़k‌sūtre vārttike vyavasthitatvātkathametat--- ataḥ anukaraṇeti | nanvanukāryānukaraṇayorabhedavivakṣāyāṃ suvanutpattau padatvābhāvātkutvāprāptiḥ | bhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu pradeśāntaraprayuktasyaibādaicchabdasyātra pratyayādākārādīnāmagrahaṇātsaṃjñitvānupapattiḥ---ataḥ jātiśabdatvāditi | aikārādivyaktidvaye aijityanugatapratyayādaic‌tvam aikārādiniṣṭhaprātisvikajātidvayavyāpakaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣaḥ | dravyatvādivadetatsvīkāre'pi bādhakābhāvāditi | tanna | devadattīyatvādyanumāpakajātiviśeṣaiḥ saha sāṅkaryāt | guṇagatajātau tanna doṣa ityasya nirmūlatvāt | anugatapratyayasya "ādirantyena" ityetat‌sūtravihitasaṃjñaupādhikatvenātiriktaviṣayakatvābhāvācca | yadapi siddhānte vyaktiviśeṣopahitasattāyā eva jātitvasvīkārādihāpi sā'stu | vyaktiviśeṣāśca svarūpasattā'tadbhedenānugatīkṛtāḥ | sattopadhāyakāstasyāṃ sarve śabdā vyavasthitāḥ | iti harivacanāditi, tadapi tathaiva | tanmate'pi jātibādhakānāmanusaraṇīyatvāt | kalpakasyāpekṣaṇīyatvācca | na hi tārkikāṇāmeva sa kuladharmaḥ | saugatairapyupagamāt | taduktaṃ kusumāñjalau--- jātyoratadvyāvṛttyorvā samāviṣṭayoḥ parāparabhāva eveti | na cānumāpakajātīnāṃ nānātvasvīkārapakṣe saṅkaro'navakāśa iti vācyam | tathā'pyatiriktajātikalpane mānābhāvāt | tasmādanukāryaniṣṭhāmaitvādijātimevādāya jātiśabdatvam | aitvādisāmānyamastīti vivaraṇasyāpyatraiva tātparyam | kutvaśabde'pi kuśabdasya tadvargīyavarṇamātre saṃketitatvena taduttaratvapratyayasya katvādijātipañcakaṃ vācyam | prakṛtyarthaprakārasya tvaśabdārthatvāt | tathā ca prakṛte ketarāsamavetatve sati sakalakakārasamavetatvarūpakatvatvena katvopasthitau bādhabalāccakāre katvajāterāpādayitumaśakyatvāt svāśrayavyaktidvāraivā''pattiparyavasānāt cakārasya kakāra ādeśaḥ kuto na bhavatīti bhāṣyārthaḥ | evaṃ sarvatrāvapteyam | syādetat | śābdabodhe prathamanirdiṣṭamuddeśyam paranirdiṣṭaṃ vidheyamiti sarvasiddham | yacchabdayogaḥ prāthamyamityādyuddeśyalakṣaṇam | tacchabdayogaḥ paścāttvaṃ sādhyatvaṃ ca vidheyatā || ityabhiyuktokteḥ | tatkathamatra ādaijuddeśena vṛddhisaṃjñā vidhīyataiti cet, ucyate | ādaic‌śabdena pradeśeṣu vyavahārābhāvāt tasya nirjñātārthatvāt vṛddhiśabdasya ca vaiparītyāt uddeśyatvāsambhavāt vṛddhereva saṃjñātve nirṇīte viparītānupūrvīkalpanena vṛddhisaṃjñāvidhānam | na caivaṃ pauruṣeyatvena tasyāprāmāṇyāpattiḥ | śāstratātparyaviṣayatvasyaiva tatprayojakatvāt | anyathā'śvābhidhānīmādattaityādergardabhābhidhānyādivyāvṛttau prāmāṇyānāpatteḥ | "ḍaḥ si dhuṭa" ityādāvubhayanirddeśe pañcamīnirdeśo balīyāniti pañcamyā kalpitasya saptamyante sītiśabde ṣaṣṭhyantatvasya tathātvāpatteśca | maṅgalārthaṃ cātra vṛddhiśabdasya prāk‌prayogāt | na cācāryasya mithyājñānavāsanārāhityena duritasāmānyaśūnyatvāttadviśeṣavighnasandehasyāpyabhāvācca kimarthaṃ taditi vācyam | tathā'pi paramakāruṇikatayā sarvasiddhaśiṣṭatvakasvācāraviṣayatvena hetunā śiṣyāṇāmabhimatakarmārambhasamaye maṅgalasyāvaśyakarttavyatvānumitisiddhyarthaṃ teṣāmevā''nuṣaṅgikamaṅgalasampattinibandhanasvagranthāghyayanasiddhimūlakavaiduṣyavaśāt pūrvoktarītyā'nekakarmādhikāre yajamānasya ṛtvik‌prayuktadṛṣṭādṛṣṭānekaphalasampattyarthaṃ niṣkāmakṛtaiśca taireva karmabhirantaḥ karaṇaśuddhidvārā paramapuruṣārthāpavargasiddhyarthaṃ ca tadupapatteḥ | yattu "vyavahārāya niyamaḥ" itipakṣe atra śāstre vṛddhiśabdenādaica eva bodhyā iti yathāśrutameva samyagiti | tanna | vidhisāmānānupūrvīkatvasya niyame'pyapekṣitatvāt | prāptārthatvena taditaravyāvṛttau tātparyamityetāvataiva tatra bhedāt | anyathā "adeṅguṇaḥ" ityādau viparītānupūrvīkalpanāpatteḥ | vrīhīnavahantītyādāvapi vrīhyuddeśenaivāvaghātasya vidheyatvāt | yadapi "yāstvetāḥ svecchayā saṃjñāḥ kriyante" itipakṣe'pi kāryakālapakṣamāśritya "mṛjervṛddhiḥ" ādaico bhavantītyarthād yathāśrutameva sādhu | tatra ca taparatvamanupayuktameva | bhāvyamānatvena savarṇagrāhakatvāprasakteḥ | yathā jyotiṣṭomarājasūyādiśabdānāṃ yāgavidhāveva sāmānādikaraṇyānnāmadheyatvāvagatiḥ na tu vākyāntareṇa, tathā asmin pakṣe vṛddhyādiśabdānāmapi | "vṛddhirādaic‌" iti tu "iko guṇavṛddhī" itivat padopasthāpakam | upasthāpyasya saṃjñitayā tu saṃjñāsūtratvavyavahāraḥ | na ca "vṛddhiryasyācām" ityādāvanuvāde ādaicāṃ savarṇagrāhakatvaṃ syāditi vācyam | tādṛśalakṣyābhāvāt | anekaśaktikalpanāpatteśca | vidhivākyasya prādhānyāttatra nirṇītasyaivārthasyānyatra grahaṇāccetyādi | tadapi cintyam | ṛkārasthāne trayāṇāmādeśānāṃ prasaṅgāt | anyathā vidhyarthāniṣpatteḥ | ata eva "bhāvyamānatvādaico grāhakā na bhaviṣyanti, naitadasti, nahyatra saṃjñāvidhāvaico bhāvyante" iti kaiyaṭaḥ | "kāryakālapakṣāśrayeṇa śaṅkā, yathoddeśapakṣeṇa parihāraḥ" iti vivaraṇakṛtaḥ | tasmādatra yathoddeśapakṣa eva grāhyaḥ | atredamavadheyam | vṛddhiśabdo vṛddhiśabdavācye lākṣaṇikaḥ | na ca tasya prathamamanupasthitiḥ | vṛddhipadaṃ kiñcidarthavācakamitijñāne kaścidartho vṛddhiśabdavācyo'stīti sāmānyatastadupasthitisattvāt | tasyābhedaḥ saṃsargaḥ | tathā ca ādaico vṛddhiśabdavācyābhinnā itidhīḥ | tataścāsyāṃ buddhau vācyatvaṃ yatra viśeṣaṇaṃ sa saṃjñī | vācyatve yadviśeṣaṇaṃ sā saṃjñā | "indro marutvānmaghavā" ityādāvapyayameva prakāraḥ | ekapadaśaktigrahasya prakārāntareṇāvaśyamapekṣitatvāt | tatparyāyamātraśaktijñānaśūnyasya kośādito'pi śaktigrahābhāvāt | yattu ākārādayo vṛddhiṃ pratyabhedasaṃsargeṇa viśeṣyā iti | tanna | vṛddhiṃ pratītyasya hi ko'rthaḥ | vṛddhiśabdaṃ prati vṛddhiśabdārthaṃ prati iti vā | nādyaḥ | lakṣaṇāṃ vinā tadalābhāt | lakṣaṇāṃ vinaivopapatterityuttaragranthāsaṅgateśca | na ca vṛddhiśabdavācyaṃ kiñcidastītijñāne śabdasya viśeṣaṇatvenopasthityā tasya lakṣaṇāṃ vinā'pi lābha iti vācyam | svatantropasthitaye tadāvaśyakatvāt | abhyupetyāpi brūmaḥ | vṛddhiśabdasya viśeṣaṇatāyāmabhedasya ca saṃsargatve ādaico vṛddhiśabdābhinnā itibodhaḥ syāt | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ | ayogyatvāt | na ca vācyatvaṃ saṃsargaḥ | samavibhaktikapadopasthāpyayorbhedānvayāsambhavāt | ata eva na dvitīyaḥ | na ca vṛddhiśabdavācyatvasyāpyuktarītyopasthitisattvāttasyaivābhedena viśeṣaṇamastviti vācyam | tasyāpyarthaviśeṣaṃ prati viśeṣaṇībhūtatvāt | vastutastu śābdikamate'pi padasyaiva prakāratā'bhyupagamād‌ vācyatvasya ca saṃsargatvāt vṛddhipadajanyaḥ sāmānyaśaktigrahamūlako bodho vācyatvasaṃsargaka eva | tathā ca vṛddhipadajanyāyāmupasthitau saṃsargatāpanne vācyatve padārthānāmākārādīnāṃ kathamanvayaḥ | vācyatvasya padajanyopasthityaviṣayatvāt | anyathā parvato vahnimānguṇa ityapi syāt | saṃsargatāpanne saṃyoge guṇasyābhedānvayasambhavāt | nanu vṛddhiśabdasya ādaijvācakatāyā anekaśakteritinyāyena sattvād ghaṭo nīla ityādivattadarthasyaivābhedasambandhenādaicoranvaya ityuktagranthābhiprāya iticen, maivam | tathā satyuddeśyatāvacchedakavidheyayorabhedāpattyā nirākāṅkṣatvād ghaṭo ghaṭa itivākyavat | ata eva śabdāśraya ākāśamityādivākye ākāśapadaṃ tadvācyaparam | vyutpannaṃ prati tadvākyānupayogādityupāyādāvuktam | yadapyuktam | lakṣaṇā'ṅgīkāre viśiṣṭavidhipakṣe matvarthalakṣaṇādoṣam uktvā nāmadheyatvamudbhidādipadānāṃ vyavasthāpitam | tanna syāt | nāmadheyatve'pi lakṣaṇāyāstulyatvāditi | tadapi mandam | guṇavidhipakṣe matvarthalakṣaṇāyāṃ guṇāṃśasya tadgataliṅgasaṃkhyākārakādeśca pramāṇāntarānavagatatvāt tatsiddhyarthaṃ viśeṣaṇavidhikalpanaprasaṅgāt | nāmadheyasya tu śrotropasthitasyaiva nāmārthatvābhāvādvācyatvasambandhena dhātvarthayāgānvaya iti na tadaṃśe vidhikalpanamitipakṣe śaṅkāyā evānavakāśāt | nāmalakṣaṇāpakṣe'pi udbhicchabdasya tṛtīyārthe vācyatve tasya dhātvarthe yāge'nvayakalpane'pi viśeṣaṇavidhikalpakatvābhāvena lāghavāt | anyathā tvatpakṣe somena yajetetyādāvapi matvarthalakṣaṇā'pekṣayā lakṣaṇāṃ vinaiva nāmatvasiddhiriti somādipadamapi nāmadheyameva syāditi guṇavidhimātroccheda ityalam pallabitena | vṛddhipadaśaktijñānasya caitattritayavṛttitattaddharmānyataraprakārakajñānatvaṃ kāryatāvacchedakam | na tu tadanyataraprakārakatvābhāvavadavṛttitadanyatamaprakārakatvavajjñānatvam puṣpavantapadasyeva sūryatvaprakārakatvābhāvāvadavṛtticandratvaprakārakatvavajjñānatvam | tatra--- ekayoktyā puṣpavantau divākaraniśākarau | iti pramāṇasattvādatra ca tadabhāvāt | pratyuta "vṛddhireci" ityādau "ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ" ityekasyaiva vidheyatvāvagamāt | "vṛddhiryasyācāmādiḥ" ityādeśca | nahyuktavarṇatrayamavyavadhānena kasyacit padasyādau varttate | "mālādīnāṃ ca" iti virodhācca | anyathā'vṛddhatvāt pūrvasūtreṇaiva pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasiddheḥ | evamuttaratrāpi | idameva "pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptiḥ" ityucyate | yatra tu samudāyaparyāptaśaktipramāṇam, yathā "ubhe abhyastam" iti, tatra nāvayavamātrasya vācyatvam | kiṃ tvekavarṇaviṣayakatvābhāvavadavṛttyanyavarṇaviṣayakatvavajjñānatvameva kāryatāvacchedakam | ata eva tatra ubhegrahaṇam | anyathautsargikatvena mitho'napekṣayordvayoreva tatsaṃjñāprasaṅgāt | atastātparyagrāhakapramāṇāntarasattvaeva samudāye vākyaparisamāptiriti siddham | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ | nanu ādaicāṃ svarūpeṇa vṛddhisaṃjñā, uta tantrāvṛttyekaśeṣāmāmanyatamena vṛddhiśabdena ye vihitāsteṣāmeva | nādyaḥ | sarvabhāsa ityādau "uttarapadavṛddhau sarvaṃ ca" iti pūrvapadāntodāttatvāpattyā samāsāntodāttatvasyāsiddheḥ | tāvatī bhāryā'sya tāvadbhārya ityādau" vṛddhinimittasya ca taddhitasya" iti puṃvadbhāvaniṣedhāpatteśca | "ā sarvanāmnaḥ" ityātvaṃ prativatupo nimittatvāt | nāntyaḥ | śālīyo mālīya ityādau "vṛddhād‌" iticchapratyayāsiddheḥ | āmramayaṃ śālamayamityādau "nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhya" iti mayaṭ‌pratyayānupapatteśca | kiṃ ca āmraguptāyaniḥ śālaguptāyaniḥ ityatra "udīcāṃ vṛddhādagotrād‌" iti vṛddhalakṣaṇaḥ phiñ‌ na syāt | yadyapi "prācāmavṛddhāt phin‌ bahulam" iti phinā'pīṣṭasiddhiḥ | "ñnityādirnityam" iti svare'pi bhedābhāvāt | āmraguptāyanībhārya ityatra prāguktasūtreṇa puṃdbhāvaniṣedhastu nāvaśyakaḥ | "jāteśca" ityato'pi siddheḥ | "gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha" iti pāribhāṣitajātestatra sattvāt | āmraguptāyaneśchātrā iti vṛddhācchapratyayavivakṣāyāṃ "phak‌phiñoranyatarasyām" iti lugvikalpena āmraguptīyāḥ āmraguptāyanīyāḥ iti dvairūpyaṃ tu siddhānte'pi neṣṭam | "phak‌phiñoḥ" ityatra yūnītyanuvṛtteḥ | "śivādibhyaḥ" ityaṇṇantādyāskaśabdād "aṇo dvyacaḥ" iti phiñ‌, yāskasyāpatyaṃ yuvā yāskāyaniḥ, tasyacchātrā yāskīyā yāskāyanīyāḥ ityeva tatrodāhṛtatvāditi phiño na kaścidviśeṣaḥ | tathā'pi prācāmudīcāmiti ācāryaviśeṣamatagarbhasūtrasvārasyabhaṅgāt | "ṛto bhāradvājasya" itisūtre prakārāntareṇa samādhāne ayaṃ tu bhāradvājaḥ svasmānmatātpracyāvito bhavatītibhāṣyoktermatapracyavasyāpi dūṣaṇatvāt | kiṃ ca phinpakṣe āmraguptāyanerapatyaṃ kutsitamityarthe phiñantātsauvīragotrādapatye'rthe chaṭhakau kutsane gamye ityarthakena "pheścha ca" itisūtreṇa chaṭhakorapravṛttau āmraguptāyanīyaḥ āmraguptāyanikaḥ itirūpadvayaṃ na syāt | vṛddhādatyadhikāreṇa phiña eva tatropādānāt | yamundaśca suṣāmā ca vārṣyāyaṇi phiñaḥ smṛtāḥ | itiparigaṇanasya pauruṣeyatvāt | anyathā sauvīragotratapadapratyudāharaṇatvena taikāyaniḥ itigranthalekhanavirodhāt | uktatrayamadhye taikāyaniśabdasya tatrāparigaṇitatvāt | api ca āmraguptāyanerapatyaṃ yuvā "prāg‌ dīvyato'ṇ‌" tasya "ṇyakṣatriyārṣañito yūni lugaṇiñoḥ" iti luki āmraguptāyaniḥ pitā āmraguptāyaniḥ putra itirūpadvayaṃ phinā na syāt | ñittvābhāvenoktalugapravṛtteḥ | abrāhyaṇagotramātrādyuvapratyayopasaṃkhyānasya ca brāhmaṇagotre pravṛttyabhāvāt | evametatpakṣe "mālādīnāṃ ca" iti vyarthaṃ syāt | avṛddhamityeva siddheḥ | evaṃ vṛddhiśabde tantrādyāśrayaṇe'pi gauravam | saṃjñāyā vidhānaṃ vihitānāṃ ca saṃjñetiparasparāśrayavāraṇāya sūtraśāṭakavadbhāvisaṃjñāvijñāne'pi gauravamiti prāpte ucyate--- ādaicāmaviśeṣeṇa vṛddhisaṃjñā | uktadoṣāpravṛtteḥ | "uttarapadavṛddhau sarvaṃ ca" ityatrottarapadādhikāravihitāyā eva vṛddhergrāhyatvāt sarvabhāsādau doṣābhāvāt | anyathā sarvaḥ kārakaḥ sarvakāraka ityādau vṛddhiśabdena vihitā yā vṛddhistadvata uttarapadasya sattvāduktasvarāpatteḥ | uttarapadagrahaṇameva ca tadadhikāravihitavṛddhigra he liṅgam | anyathā ādaijmātrasyottarapadatvābhāvātsāmarthyādeva vṛddhimaduttarapadalābhe tadvaiyarthyāpatteḥ | tasmātsarvapāñcāla ityādāveva tatpravṛttiḥ | "susarvārddhājjanapadasya" iti vṛddheḥ | tāvadbhārye'pi nātiprasaṅgaḥ | vṛddhyātmakataddhitasyābhāvenābhedānvayānāpattyā vṛddhitaddhitasyetyetāvanmātreṇāpi vṛddhestaddhita iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsena vṛddhinimittatvalābhe'pi nimittaśabdopādānasāmarthyādvṛddhernimittaṃ yasminniti vyadhikaraṇabahuvrīhimāśritya ñakāraṇakārakakārarūpetsaṃjñāpratiyogitvasambandhena vṛddhernimittaṃ yatrāsti aṇ‌ añ‌ phak‌ ityādau tasyaiva taddhitasya tatra puṃvadbhāvaniṣedha itivyākhyānāt | ākārasya ca svarūpato vidhāne'pivatupratyayasyoktavṛddinimittatvābhāvāt | na ca arśasā bhāryā'syetyatra matvarthāc‌pratyayottaraṭābante arśasāśabde taddhitastrīpratyayayorekādeśasya paraṃ pratyādivadbhāvāttaddhitagrahaṇenāpi grahaṇāt tatra vṛddhyātmakastaddhitaḥ sambavatyeveti kathaṃ nimittaśabdopādānasāmarthyamiti vācyam | tathā'pyaraktetiparyudāsasāmarthyātkarmadhārayaśaṅkā'nupapatteḥ | raktavikārārthakapratyayasya vṛddhyātmakatvābhāvena tatra prasaktyabhāvāt | anye tu vṛddhiśabdena vihitāyā vṛddheryannimittamiti tsayārthaḥ | vṛddhiśabde tantrādyāśrayaṇāt | tādṛśī ca ñiṇṇitkinnimittā sarvaiva vṛddhiḥ | na ca vaiyākaraṇabhāryaḥ sauvaśvabhārya ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ, aṇo yathoktavṛddhinimittatvāditi vācyam | phalopahitatvasya nimittaśabdārthatvāt | tatra ca "na yvābhyām" iti vṛddhiniṣedhāt | na ca ecau ādāyātrāpi phalopadhānam | svarūpeṇaiva tayorvihitatvādityāhuḥ | apare tu yāvadvṛddhijananayogyatve sati kiñcitphalopahitastaddhito nimittaśabdena vivakṣaṇīyaḥ | vaiyākaraṇabhārya ityādau tu aij‌bhyāmaṇo na phalopadhānam | vṛddhiniṣedhasanniyogaśiṣṭayostayoraṇ‌nimittakatve mānābhāvāt | niṣedhapratiyogivṛddhinimittakatve'pi aijāgamaṃ pratyaṇo nimittatvāyogādityāhuḥ | tadubhayamapi cintyam | yogyatvaṃ hi yogyatāvacchedakarūpavattvameva | taccātra śāstramātragamyatayā ñittvaṇittvakittvarūpameva | phalopadhānamapi tadrūpeṇaiva vācyam | phalopahitaniṣṭhānyathāsiddhyanirūpakadharmāvacchedena yogyatāgrahaniyamāt | tathā ca vaiyākaraṇabhārya ityatra kathaṃ nātiprasaṅgaḥ | aṇo ṇittvena prakṛtyantare vṛddhirūpaphalopahitatvāt | na ca yatprakṛtyuttaraṃ yā aṇādivyaktiḥ prayujyate, tatra taphalopadhānaṃ vivakṣitamiti vācyam | yāvadvṛddhijananayogyatvasya durgrahatvāpatteḥ | na hi dākṣirityādrau iñādivyakteḥ svaprakṛtipuraskāreṇa tadvyaktitvena phalopadhānavivakṣāyāmaupagavādiśabdagatavṛddhau tatsvarūpayogyatvaṃ grahītuṃ śakyam | adantabhinnānāṃ tatprakṛtitvābhāvāt | dharmāntareṇa yoyatvaṃ dharmāntareṇa ca phalopadhānamityasya vaktumaśakyatvāt | ata eva viśeṣyabhāgavaiyarthyam | kvacitphalānupadhāne yogyatāyā evābhāvātad | evaṃ ca kvāpi puṃvadbhāvaniṣedho na syāt | ñidādipratyayatrayamadhye sarveṣāmanyatamaprakṛtikatvaniyamābhāvāt | ata eva vṛddhiśabdavihitāyā vṛddhernimittamityapi prāguktamataṃ parāstam | phalopadhānasya yogyatāvacchedakadharmāvacchedyatvaniyamena tatrāpyuktadoṣāvatārāditi | tasmādidamatra tattvam | aniṣiddhavṛddhiprakṛtikatve sati vṛddhiyogyatvaṃ vṛddhinimittatvam | tena viśeṣyabhāgena tāvadbhārye viśeṣaṇabhāgena ca vaiyākaraṇabhārye'tiprasaṅgābhāvaḥ | idaṃ ca viśeṣaṇāṃśānurodhena prakṛtiviśeṣottaratādṛśataddhitamātrasādhāraṇamiti dik | idamapyatrāvadheyam | "vyaktiḥ padārtho bhedakāśca guṇāḥ" itidarśane yadguṇaviśiṣṭasyoccāraṇaṃ tadanyaguṇabhājāṃ saṃjñā | nanvayaṃ prasaṅgādguṇāntarayutānāmapi saṃjñārthaṃ taparatvamiti vārtikamatam | taparasūtrasyātra pakṣe'naṇāmapi grāhakatvamati vidhyarthatvāt | vede hyudātte karttavye'nudāttoccāraṇe dṛṣṭādṛṣṭadoṣadarśanāt niyamato guṇānāṃ bhedakatvāt | bhāṣye tu "eko'yamātmā udakaṃ nāma tasya guṇabhedādanyatvaṃ bhavati, anyadidaṃ śatimanyadidamuṣṇam" ityuktam | tatra jalatvajātyabhiprāyeṇaikyaṃ na vivakṣitam | vyaktibhedādevānyatvasaṃbhave guṇabhedaprayuktabhedodāharaṇatvānupapatteḥ | anyo ghaṭa ityukte ghaṭāntarapratiyogikasyaiva bhedasya bodhāt | kiṃ tvekabhājanasthatvena tattadupādhyavacchinnaeva tatra guṇāntarayogādbhedavyavahāra ityartha iti kaiyaṭaḥ | kvacidabhedakatvapi | muṇḍena caurye kṛte kuntalitvāvasthāyāmapi cauro'yamiti vyavahārāt | etacchāstre tu kiṃ nyāyyamityākāṅkṣāyāṃ siddhāntamāha bhāṣyakāraḥ--- abhedakā eva guṇā iti | ata evānaṅudātta ityādi saṅgacchate | guṇarahitasyoccārayitumaśakyatvānnāntarīyakatayoccāryamāṇo'pi guṇaḥ prabhatnaviśeṣaṃ vinā na vivakṣyate | anyathā hyudāttamevoccārayet iti vākye ca na tūdāttagrahaṇaṃ kuryāditi śeṣa evakārasyārtha iti kecit | anye tu ekaśrutyā sūtrapāṭhaḥ | avacchedakatvenānupāttaśca svarūpamātreṇa sannapi guṇo na bhedakaḥ | aruṇayā krīṇātītyādāveva tasya avacchedakatvam, na tu gāṃ dadyādityetāvanmātroktā viti nirvivādatvāt | bhāṣye ca evakārasya "na tvekaśrutimuccāryodāttagrahaṇaṃ kuryāt" iti śeṣe tātparyam | anyathā spaṣṭārthamudāttagrahaṇaṃ na kuryādityeva brūyāt | hantyadeśasya vadheḥ sthānivadbhāvādanudāttatvādiṭ‌pratiṣedhe prāpte vadhyādeśe udāttanipātanaṃ kariṣyate | "ekāca upadeśe" iti sūtre ekāj‌grahaṇaṃ ca na karttavyamiti bhāṣyāsaṅgateśca | catasaryādyudāttanipātanaṃ kariṣyataiti bhāṣyavirodhācca | etena "sthāne'ntaratamaḥ" itivacanādādeśasya yaḥ svaraḥ prāptastasminnevoccāraṇīye udāttoccāraṇaṃ yatnādhikyādvivakṣārthamiti kaiyaṭakalpanamapāstam | catur‌śabdasya avyutpattipakṣe "traḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ" iti vyutpattipakṣe tu uran‌pratyayāntatayā "ñnityādirnityam " ityubhayathā'pyādyudāttatvāt | asthyādīnāmapyādyudāttatvāccheṣanighātena ikārasyānudāttatayā tadādeśasyānaṅo'pyanudāttatvasyaiva prāptyā udāttoccāraṇaṃ vivakṣārthaṃ syādityudāttagrahaṇavaiyarthyañca | pratyuta yatnādhikye'pyavivakṣājñāpakatvāpattiḥ | ekaśrutyā sūtrapāṭhe tu svaraviśeṣopādānaṃ vivakṣārthamevetyadoṣaḥ | yattu kaustubhe udāttagrahaṇasya svaśabdānupātto guṇo na bhedaka iti trāpyam uta yatnaviśeṣaviraheṇa tatheti | nādyaḥ | nipātanasvarasya vivakṣāpatteḥ | nāntyaḥ | udāttoccāraṇasyaiva vivakṣāhetau yatnaviśeṣe sthite mūlaśaithilyena jñāpakānunthānāt | svopādānavaiyarthyaprayojakasyārthasya jñāpyatvāt | upāttaguṇānāṃ bhedakatvasya lokasiddhatvāt | bhāṣye tathaivoktatvācca | upādānaṃ cātra dvedhā | svarūpeṇa śabdaviśeṣāvacchedakatayā udātta ityādiśabdaiśca | etena vaikalpikamaikaśrutyamaṅgīkṛtya "pakṣāntarairapi parihārā bhavanti" itinyāyena tatrādyudāttanipātanaṃ kariṣyate ityuktam | iha tu traiśvaryeṇa sūtrāṇāṃ pāṭhamāśritya svarūpeṇopāttasya guṇasya nāntarīyakatvādavivakṣāprasaṅgādudāttagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakamityuktam | ato na pūrvottarabhāṣyayorvirodha ityapāstam guṇānāṃ bhedakatvasyāpyavaśyāśrayaṇīyatvāt | ekaśrutyā sūtrapāṭhenaiva prakṛtabhāṣyasya yojyatvāt | ata eva guṇabhinnānāṃ yavalānāṃ saṃgrahāya grahaṇakaśāstre'ṇ‌grahaṇaṃ saṅgacchate | ata evāṣṭana ātve idamastyadādyatve ca nānunāsikaḥ | idaṃ ca sarvamekaśrutyā pāṭhapakṣaṃ paścādupanyasyatā kaiyaṭenaiva dhvanitamityāstāṃ vistaraḥ | adeṅ‌ guṇaḥ 2 | akāra ekāra okāraścāviśeṣeṇa guṇasaṃjñaḥ syāt | pradeśā vidhau "ādguṇaḥ" ityādayaḥ | anuvāde "ato guṇe" ityādayaḥ | anyatpūrvavadūhyam | iko guṇavṛddhī 3 | guṇavṛddhiśabdayoryatra vidheyasamarppakatvaṃ tatra sthāniviśeṣānabhidhāne ika iti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ padaṃ sthānisamarpakamupasthitaṃ bodhyam | idaṃ ca guṇavṛddhiśabdayoḥ prakṛtatve'pi punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇāt‌ śabdavyāpārāśrayeṇa labhyate | anyathā ika ityeva brūyāt | yattu tathā'pi "ikastau" ityeva vaktavyam | vastuta ika ityeva | saṃpūrṇaṃ pūrvasūtradvayamanuvarttya vṛddhirityādaicau yatra vidhīyete guṇa iti ca adeṅau tatra ika iti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ padamupatiṣṭhate iti vyākhyānāt | tatra ca liṅgam "ito'tsarvanāmasthāne" ityatra idgrahaṇam | akārasya svarūpeṇa vidhāne'pi ik‌padopasthitau tadvaiyarthyāditi, taccintyam | sarvanāmnāmutsargataḥ pradhānaparāmarśitayā tacchabdena guṇavṛddhyorgrahaṇānupapatteḥ | autsargikavyutpattyanusāreṇaivāpatteḥ kalpyatvāt | uktaliṅgasya ca ṛbhukṣiśabdagataṛkārokāravyāvṛttyarthatayā'nyathāsiddhatvāt | vākyānuvṛttau ca tasya viśiṣṭārthāntaraparatvena prakṛtārthānvayānupapatteḥ | na ca śabdādhikāreṇa nirvāhaḥ | padamātre tadaṅgīkārāt | vākyārthasya paramatātparyaviṣayatayā tadbhaṅgasyānucitatvāt | padārthasya tu svātantryeṇa tadaviṣayatayā vākyāntarānvaye'pi tadbhaṅgābhāvāt | tadvākyārthabuddhāvetatsamabhivyāhārasya pratibandhakatve gauravāt | tattat‌padārthāntaranirūpitākāṅkṣādijñānāntarakalpane gauravācca | iggrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti bhāṣyādikaṃ tu avayavadvārā sūtrākṣepaparam | pradhānākṣepe guṇākṣepasyārthasiddhatvāt | ata eva "prāk kaḍārātsamāsaḥ" ityatra prāgvacanaṃ kimarthamitibhāṣye avadhitvadyotakākṣepadvāreṇāvadherapyayamākṣepa iti kaiyaṭaḥ | guṇavṛddhyadhikāre punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇasāmarthyāditibhāṣyādisvarasācca | etena sampūrṇasūtradvayānuvṛttisāmarthyaparatayā uktagranthaṃ vyākhyāya pūrvoktavyākhyāne śabdasvārasyānanuguṇatvadoṣodbhāvanamapāstam | viparītatvātsvarasasyeti dik | idaṃ ca sūtraṃ na vidhyātmakam | punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇavaiyarthyāt | nāpyadhikāraḥ | tathā sati naño'pyatraiva pāṭhāpatteḥ | pratiyogibhūtayorguṇavṛddhyoratropādānaṃ niṣedhasya tūttaratretivaiṣamye bījābhāvāt | ik‌sthānikaguṇavṛddhiniṣedhasyottaratra vidheyatayopasthitisiddhyarthatve viśiṣṭasyaivādhikarttumucitatvāt "sarvasya dve" ityādivat | "pratyayaḥ" "paraśca" ityādau vibhajya pāṭhastu vidheyabhedādupapannaḥ | ādyena pratyayasaṃjñā vidhīyate pareṇa tu prakṛtyapekṣayā paratvamiti | tasmātparibhāṣaiveyam | etadupasthitau liṅgaṃ ca guṇavṛddhiśabdābhyāṃ tadvidhānaṃ sthānyantaranirdeśābhāvaviśiṣṭam na tu guṇavṛddhipadamātram | "acoñṇiti" ityādāvatiprasaṅgādityagre nirūpayiṣyāmaḥ | udāharaṇaṃ cetā stotā karttā acaiṣīt astauṣīt ahārṣīt iti | pratyudāharaṇaṃ tu yātā glāyati umbhitā iti atra ākārasya akāraḥ aikārasya ekāraḥ makārasya sthānasāmyādokāraśca guṇo mā bhūt | yadvārttikam--- iggrahaṇamātsandhyakṣaravyañjananivṛttyartham iti | syādetat | pacatītyādau dhātvakārasya śapamāśritya "pugantalaghūpadhasya" iti, pratyayākārasya ca "sārvadhātukārddhadhātukayoḥ" iti tipamāśritya guṇe kṛte'pi viśeṣābhāvaḥ | na ca cikīrṣa aka itisthite akārasya vṛddhyāpattiḥ | "ṇyallopāviyaṅ‌yaṇ‌guṇavṛddhidīrghebhyaḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhena" iti vārttikoktyā ato lopasya bālavattvāt | siddhānte'pi" aco ñṇiti" iti vṛddhernirdiṣṭasthānikatvena uktaparibhāṣāyā apravṛttyā uktarītyaiva samādheyatvāt | ayāsīdityādau tu ākārasya "saci vṛddhiḥ" iti vṛddhāvapi na doṣaḥ | "yamaramanamātāṃ sak ca" iti sagiḍ‌bhyāṃ paratvena tadbādhācceti kecit | yenanāprāptinyāyenāpavādatvāttadbādha ityanye | yātā vātetyādau guṇastu gāpoṣṭakaḥ kittvena jñāpakenaiva varṇaikadeśānāṃ varṇagrahaṇena grahaṇamitipakṣaprastāvoktarītyā nirasta eva | anyathā dvayorakārayoḥ pararūpeṇaiva siddhau ātolopapravṛttyarthakittvasya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ | ato lopena tu na tatra nirvāhaḥ | "anudāttopadeśa" ityata upadeśapadānuvṛttyā ārddhadhātukopadeśakāle yadadantaṃ tasyaiva lopavidhānāt | gādhātostu ṭapratyayotpattivelāyāmādantatvāt | anyathā gata ityādau makāralope kṛte'dantatvena lopāpatteḥ | athātra ābhīyatvena malopāderasiddhatvamāśrīyeta, tathā'pi aya paya gatāvityābhyāṃ kvipi at pat itirūpaṃ mādhavādisaṃmataṃ na siddhyet | "lopo vyoḥ" ityasya ābhīyatvābhāvāt | nacaivaṃ dhivi prīṇane kṛvi hiṃsākaraṇayoścetyetayoridittvānnumāgame "dhinvikṛṇvyora ca" iti vakārasyākārādeśe upratyaye ca kṛte ato lopo na syāt, upratyayotpattivelāyāmadantatvābhāvāditi vācyam | upratyayavelāyāmeva tatsaṃniyogaśiṣṭatayā asyāpi buddhyārohāt iti kecit | yaugapadye'pi upratyayopadeśavelāyāmadantatvaṃ nāstyevetyetadasvarasena nirdeśakramātprathamamatvaṃ tataścaśabdākṛṣṭa upratyaya ityanye | tasmādākāranivṛttyarthaṃ naitatsūtramārabhyam | nāpi aij‌nivṛttyartham | aikāropadeśasāmarthyādeva tadvāraṇāt | anyathā ekāramevoccārayet | na caivamāyādeśo'pi na syāditi vācyam | guṇaṃ prati hyaikāropadeśaḥ svavaiyarthyāpattyā bādhakaḥ āyādeśe tu aikāra eva nimittamiti vaiṣamyāt | tadāhuḥ--- yaṃ vidhiṃ pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ sa vidhirbādhyate, yasya tu vidhernimittameva nāsau bādhyate iti | na ca glāy ityeva paṭhituṃ śakyam | tvayā glāyate ityādau yakāradvayāpatteḥ | ādantatvābhāve jaglāvityāderasiddheśca | nanvevam "ādeca upadeśe'śiti" ityātvamapi bādhyeta | eṅantatvopadeśe'pi ātvasambhavena aijupadeśasya tannimittatvābhāvāt | śiti pratyaye guṇasya śidbhinne tvātvasya aijvirodhitve tulye aijupadeśena guṇa eva bādhyate na tvātvamiti vinigantumaśakyatvāt | dheṭ pānaityādyeṅanteṣu ātvavidherapi sāvakāśatvāt | ātvavidhābejgrahaṇasya tu "mīnātiminotidīṅāṃ lyapi ca" ityuttarārthatvāt | vārttikamate ejantānāṃ dīṅādīnāmātvavidhānasya ghusaṃjñāsūtre vakṣyamāṇatvāt | atra kaiyaṭādayaḥ | "na dhyākhyā" itisūtre kṛtātvasya dhyāyaternirdeśa eva ātvaṃ na bādhyataityatra vinigamaka iti | yattu ejgrahaṇasāmarthyādapyātvaṃ bhavati | na hi tasyottarārthatvaṃ śaṅkyam | bhāṣyamate "mīnāti" itisūtreṇa guṇavṛddhinimitte pratyaye vivakṣite satyupadeśāvasthāyāmevātvaṃ vidhīyate na tu guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṛtayoritisiddhāntāt | anyathā dāya ityatra ikārāntatvāddhañaṃ bādhitvā ac‌ syād, īṣadavadāna ityādau " āto yuc" na syāt, avadāya iti "śyādvyadha" iti ādantatvalakṣaṇo ṇaśca na syāt | idaṃ ca eṅ‌nimittapratyayavivakṣāyāṃ dīṅādīnāmātvavidhānenāpi sidhyati | na ca ñitāṃ ṇitāṃ ca pratyayānāṃ vṛddhinimittatayā eṅ‌nimittatvaṃ nāstīti ghañ‌ṇijādi vivakṣāyāmātvaṃ na syāditi vācyam | vṛddhyā guṇabādhe'pi teṣāṃ guṇaṃ prati svarūpayogyatvānapāyāt | ejviṣaye prāgevātvābhyupagame phalopadhānavivakṣāyāmasaṃbhavāditi | tanna | apavādaviṣayaparihāreṇaivotsargapravṛttyā ṇijāderecaṃ prati svarūpayorayatve mānābhāvāt | tasmādaico na guṇa iti siddham | nāpi vyañjananivṛttyartham | "saptamyāṃ janerḍaḥ" iti ḍapratyayasya ḍitkaraṇena vyañjanasya guṇo na bhavatītijñāpitatvāt | anyathā'rddhamātrikavyañjanasthāne akāre guṇe mātṛke kṛte pararūpeṇa siddhau tadvaiyarthyāt | na ca nakārasya sānunāsika evākāro guṇaḥ syāditi vācyam | para ityeva siddhe rūpagrahaṇasya yadguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ parasya rūpaṃ tādṛgeva yathā syādityetadarthatvāt | atra bhāṣyam--- ḍitkaraṇaṃ na jñāpakam | "anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate" ityanena "gamaśca" "antātyantādhvadūrapāra" itiprakaraṇādhītena vārttikena gamerapi ḍapratyayasya vācyatvāt | tatra ca guṇasvīkāre makārasya sthāne oṣṭhasthānatayā okārasya guṇasyāpattau nago'ga ityādīnāmasiddheḥ | yadyapi "saptamyāṃ janerḍaḥ" itiprakaraṇādanyatraivāyaṃ ḍapratyayaḥ, tathā'pi "janerḍaḥ" itiprakaraṇe "anyeṣvapi dṛśyate itisūtrasthāpiśabdagarbhita evārtho vārttikenokto na tvapūrvaḥ | astu vā tadvārttikameva vyarthamiti bhāṣyābhiprāyaḥ iti kecit | nanu "gamerḍoḥ" iti ḍopratyayavidhānaṃ makārasya okāro guṇo na bhavatīti jñāpakam, anyathā vicaiva guṇe kṛte gorūpasiddheḥ, yadvā idameva vyañjanasya guṇābhāvajñāpakaṃ syāditicen, maivam | makārasthāne sānunāsikasya akārasya vyāvṛttaye ḍopratyayavidheḥ sārthakyāt | atha tathā'pi "tanoterḍauḥ sanvacca" iti ḍitkaraṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ vyañjanasya guṇo na bhavatīti | anyathā nakārasya guṇena pratyayākāreṇa saha pararūpeṇa ca siddhau tasya vaiyarthyāt | kiṃ ca sthānaprayatnābhyāmantaratame cetā acaiṣīdityādau caritārthā guṇavṛddhividhayaḥ kevalasthānakṛtāntaryeṇa vyañjanādiṣu na pravarttiṣyante | na caivaṃ netā anaiṣīdityādau sthānaguṇapramāṇaistribhirāntaratamyāttatra cāritārthye, hrasve tatpravṛttirna syāditi vācyam | "sṛghasyadaḥ kmarac" iti kitkaraṇena pramāṇata āntaryasyāvivakṣitatvajñāpanāt | na ca īhitā īśitetyatra kaṇṭhyatālavyayorvivṛtayośca hakāraśakārayoḥ sthānaguṇābhyāmāntaratamyādadetau syātāmiti vācyam | ūṣmaṇāmīṣadvivṛtatvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | ikārādīnāṃ vivṛtatvameva | ekārādīnāṃ vivṛtataratvasya śikṣāntaroktatve'pi sūtrabhāṣyādyasaṃmatatvāt | uktakittvena ikārādiṣu guṇapravṛttyanumānādvā | tasmādātsaṃdhyakṣaravyañjanānāṃ guṇavṛddhyorabhāvasyoktarītyaiva siddhau sūtrametadvyarthamiti pūrvapakṣaḥ | siddhāntastu "ṅkiti ca" itisūtre niṣedhyāyā vṛddheriglakṣaṇatvasaṃpādanāyedam | na hyetatparibhāṣāṃ vinā iglakṣaṇaguṇavṛddhiniṣedhaḥ śakyaḥ | pratiyogitāvacchedakāprasiddheḥ | sati tvasmin ika itiśabdamuccārya vihitatvalakṣaṇamiglakṣaṇatvaṃ prasiddhyati | tatratyacakārasya itiśabdārthakatayā tadarthalābhāt | na ca tadaviśeṣitayoreva tayoḥ sa niṣedho'stviti vācyam | "naḍādibhyaḥ" phaki laigavāyana ityatra orguṇasyāpi niṣedhāpatteḥ | na ca vidhānasāmarthyam | aupagava ityādau tasya caritārthatvāt | paurohityamityādau tu yaki pare "kiti ca" iti ādivṛddhirbhaviṣyatyeva | vidhānasāmarthyāt | niṣedhasya taddhitabhinne kiti caritārthatvāt | ata eva ik‌sthānikaguṇaniṣedhenāpi na nirvāhaḥ | uktaguṇasya ukārasthānīyatāsattvāt | tasmānniṣedhe pratiyogitāvacchedakībhūtamig‌lakṣaṇatvaṃ tatprasiddhyarthamidam | guṇavṛddhī punaḥ sarvatraiva tadvyatirekeṇāpi ikasthānike eva paryavasyataḥ | tathā hi | "sārvadhātukārddhadhātukayoḥ" "jusi ca" iti guṇaśca alo'ntyaparibhāṣayā antyavarṇe prāptau pūrvoktajñāpakavaśādikṣveva viśrāmyataḥ | "miderguṇaḥ" "pugantalaghūpadhasya ca" ityādiṣu tu sthānyapi nirdiṣṭa eva | mida irmidistasya guṇaḥ | puki antaḥ pugantaḥ | pukīti viṣayasaptamī | puki vivakṣite sati yo'nta ityarthaḥ | tena pugavyavahitapūrvavarttina iti paryavasitam | laghvī cāsāvupadhā ceti karmadhārayaḥ | tataḥ pugantaśca lagūpadhā ceti samāhāradvandve klībatvam | vāpayatītyādau tvādantasannipātakṛtasya pukastadvighātakaguṇāpravarttakatvāt | "ṛcchatyṝtām" ityatrāpi ṛśabdaṛcchabdayordvandvaḥ, ṛcchatiśabdasya ṛkāreṇa ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaṃ kṛtvā pūrvapade tatpuruṣagarbha uttarapade dvandvagarbho dvandvaḥ | yadvā uktarītyā pūrvapade tatpuruṣagarbha ṛkāreṇa ṛcchaśabdena ca tripado dvandvaḥ | tena ṛcchaterṛkārasya sthānitvalābhaḥ | ārivānityādau guṇasiddhyarthamṛdhātoḥ saṃgrahāya madhye caturtho'pi ṛkāraḥ praśleṣyaḥ | anyathā kvasoḥ kittvasāmarthyād guṇo na syāt | praśleṣe tu viśiṣya vidhānasāmarthyād guṇasiddhiḥ | "ṛdṛśo'ṅi" ityatra "uraṅi guṇaḥ" tato "dṛśaḥ" iti pṛthagyogaḥ | urityanuvṛttyā vyadhikaraṇaṣaṣṭhyā ca dṛśisaṃbandhina ṛkārasya guṇa ityarthaḥ | "sthūladūrayuvahrasvakṣiprakṣudrāṇāṃ yaṇādiparaṃ pūrvasya ca guṇaḥ " ityatra yogavibhāgaḥ | "sthūladūrayuvahrasvānāṃ yaṇādiparam" ityeko yogaḥ | "kṣiprakṣudrayoḥ pūrvasya ca guṇaḥ" iti dvitīyaḥ | yuvaparyantānāṃ lakārarephavakārāṇāṃ svottaravarttyakāreṇa saha lope "orguṇaḥ" ityukārasya guṇe avādeśe ca sthavīyān davīyān ityādi siddham | yaṇa ādiryaṇādiḥ tataḥ paramiti samāsaḥ | tena kṣiprakṣudrayoryaṇa ādīrephapūrvau pakāradakārau, tataḥ parasya raśabdasya lopastābhyāṃ pūrvasya ikārasya lakārasya ca guṇa ityarthaḥ | evaṃ guṇamātramikṣu viśrāntam | "mṛjervṛddhiḥ" ityatra tu acaḥ ityapakṛṣya mṛjeḥ saṃbandhinaḥ aco vṛddhiḥ syāt | tato "ñṇiti" iti | aca ityanuvṛttyā yathānyāsavadevāsya yogasyārthaḥ | amarṭ‌ ityādau aṭo vṛddhistu na bhavati | lādeśottaramaḍitipakṣe paratvādvṛddheḥ pravṛtteḥ | sakṛdeva śāstrasya caritārthatvāt | yadā tu lāvasthāyāmevāṭ, na caivamadhyaiyātāmityatra adhi ā i ātāmitisthite "aci śnudhātubhruvām" iti iyaṅaṃ bādhitvā "eranekācaḥ" iti yaṇ‌ syāt, āṭo dhātvādyavayavatvenānekāc‌tvāditi vācyam, "eranekācaḥ" iti vibhajya "iṇo yaṇ‌" ityanuvarttya anekācaścedyaṇ‌ tarhi iṇa evetiniyamena tadvāraṇāditipakṣa āśrīyate, tadā "ṅkiti ca" iti niṣedhād vṛddherlāvasthāyāṃ durlabhatvenāntaraṅgatvādaḍāgamasyaivotpattyā tasya vṛddhiprasaṅge'pi "antyabādhe'ntyasadeśasya" iti paribhāṣayā samādhānasaṃbhavāt | tatpratyākhyānapakṣe tu aṅgākṣiptena pratyayenājviśeṣaṇātpratyaye pare tadvidhānāt | avyavahitapratyayābhāvenaikavarṇavyavadhāne'pi ṛkārasyaiva vṛddhirna tvaṭaḥ | anekavyavadhāne pravṛttau mānābhāvāt | "yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt" itinyāyāt | "sici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu" ityatrāpi acikīrṣīdityakāravṛddhiniṣedhārtham̐ naitatsūtram | allopasya vipratiṣedhena balavattvasya uktatvāt | ākāre'pyuktaḥ samādhiḥ | ejantaṃ tu nāstyeva | anaimittikasya ātvasya prāgeva pravṛtteḥ | rainauglauśabdānāmācārakvibantānāṃ vṛddhisattvāsattvayorna viśeṣaḥ | na ca udaboḍhāmityatra pūrvaṃ ḍhalope tatra odantatvād vṛddhiprasaṅgaḥ | tasyāsiddhatvātpūrvaṃ halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ, tato ḍhalopaḥ, "asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge" ityasiddhatvānna odantatvamitisamādhānāt | na ca gośabdātkvipi agavīdityatra vṛddhiniṣedhārthaḥ | "ṛta iddhātoḥ" ityato'nuvṛttena dhātunā sijākṣiptasya dhātorabhedena viśeṣaṇāddhātureva yo dhāturna tu kathaṃcitprātipadikamitivyākhyānāditi kaustubhe | mādhavastu kavividhupitṛśabdānāṃ kvipi luṅi akavāyīt avidhāvīt apitārīdityāha | tasyāyamāśayaḥ---dhāturevetyasya ko'rthaḥ, pratyayāntare'pi dhātusaṃjñaka eva, dhātutvānibandhanapratyayaprakṛtitvābhāvavānvā | nādyaḥ | tatra hi bhedapratiyogitāvacchedakatayā pratyayatvasākṣādvyāpyo dharmo niveśyate uta kathañcitpratyayatvavyāpyaḥ | na prathamaḥ | tiṅ‌tvādyavacchinnabhedavati kṛtpratyayādau kvibantasyāpi dhātutvāt | nāntyaḥ | tiptvāvacchinnabhinne tasādāvapi tasya dhātutvāttadvyāvṛtterabhāvāt | na dvitīyaḥ | kvibantānāṃ haratikarotyādīnāṃ svādiprakṛtitvena vyāvṛttyāpatteḥ | na ca tugviśiṣṭānāmeva svādiprakṛtitvamiti vācyam | tāvatā'pi dharmibhedānupapādanāt | lū ityādikvibantasamānākārāṇāṃ śuddhalvādīnāmapyalāvīdityādau vṛddhyanāpatteśca | na ca prātipadikatvānuttaradhātusaṃjñākaiti vācyam | "upadeśe evānubandhalope kṛte tato dhātusaṃjñā" itigranthadarśanāddhātupratyayabhinnatve satyarthavattvottarameva hṛprabhṛtīnāmapi dhātusaṃjñatvāt | anubandhasattvāsattvayostvakiñcitkaratvāt | athaupadeśikadhātugrahaṇārthaṃ dvitīyadhātugrahaṇamiti nāmadhātuvyāvṛttiritikaiyaṭoktyanusāreṇocyate, tathā'pi igante kvibantadhātau sici vṛddhirvārayituṃ na yuktā | ik‌paribhāṣāramye tasyā iṣṭatayā tadanārambhe'pi tathātvāt | tādṛśasyaivārthasya prakārāntareṇa sādhanīyatvāt | tasmādokārāntavyāvṛttyarthameva yatanīyamitisthite kecittāvadāhuḥ--- dhātoritivad "otaḥ" ityapyanuvarttya odantasya dhātośced‌ vṛddhirbhavati tarhi dhātoreva dhātorna tu nāmadhātoriti vyākhyeyamiti | taccintyam | nāmadhātvanyasya odantasya dhātoraprasiddheḥ | teṣāmātvasya prāgeva pravṛtteḥ | odantatvopalakṣitasya ākārāntatvadaśāyāṃ vṛddhau satyāmasatyāṃ vā viśeṣābhāvasyoktatvāt | tasmād‌ "neṭi" ityatra netiyogaṃ vibhajya "otaḥ" ityanuvartya okārāntasya vṛddhiniṣedhaḥ | yadvā bahulagrahaṇamanuvarttya odantasya vṛddhyabhāvo bāhulakena sādhanīya ityeva tāvadramaṇīyam | evaṃ halāmapi na sici vṛddhiprasaṅgaḥ | yenanāprāptinyāyena halantalakṣaṇavṛddhestāvadbādhakatvasambhavāt | na caivamakoṣīdamoṣīdityādau "vad‌vrajahalantasyācaḥ" iti vṛddheḥ "neṭi" iti niṣedhena nirapavādatvāt "sicivṛddhiḥ" itisūtreṇa halo vṛddhiprasaṅga iti vācyam | vṛddhimātrasya "neṭi" iti neṣedha ityabhyupagamāt | tasmāt "kṅiti ca" iti niṣedhe iglakṣaṇatvasya vṛddhiviśeṣaṇatvalābhārthamiyaṃ paribhāṣeti siddham | atha tathā'pi kṛtaṃ chinnamityādau "sārvadhātukārddhadhātukayoḥ" iti pugantetiguṇasya ca niṣedhāya guṇagrahaṇamevāstu, na tu vṛddhigrahaṇam | na ca mṛṣṭa ityādau vṛddhiniṣedhāya tasyā iglakṣaṇatāṃ sampādayituṃ taditi vācyam | "mṛjerajādau saṃkrame vibhāṣā vṛddhimārabhante" iti bhāṣyoktyā "ajādau kṅiti vā' itivacanasya "mṛjervṛddhiḥ" ityetaduttaramāvaśyakatayā tatra "adājau ṅkiti" itiyogaṃ vibhajya ṅkiti cedbhavatyajādāvevetiniyamena tadvāyavṛtteḥ sādhyatvāditicet, atrāhuḥ--- ṇū stutau dhū vidhūnane iti kuṭādipaṭhitayorluṅi anuvīt adhuvīditirūpamiṣṭam | tatra "gāṅkuṭādibhyaḥ" iti | ṅittvātideśena "ṅkiti ca" iti sicivṛddherniṣedhārthaṃ tasyā iglakṣaṇatvasaṃpādanāya vṛddhigrahaṇamiti | syādetat | antarbhūtasijmātrāpekṣatvātsic‌parasmaipadetyubhayasāpekṣabahiraṅgavṛddhyapekṣayā'ntaraṅgasyovaṅo vṛddheḥ prāgeva pravṛttau halantatvād "neṭi" iti vṛddhiniṣedhassiddha eva | na ca "sicyantaraṅgaṃ nāsti" itisiddhāntānnaivamiti vācyam | tasya niryuktikatvāt | na caivamacaiṣīdityādau antaraṅgatvātsici vṛddhiṃ bādhitvā guṇa eva syāditi vācyam | tasyaiva vṛddisaṃbhaveneṣṭāpatteḥ | pūrvapakṣe vṛddherik‌sthānikatve niyamābhāvāt | uktaparibhāṣāyāṃ vṛddhigrahaṇānupādānasyaiva prakrāntatvāt | nanvastauṣīdityādau guṇasya na vṛddhisaṃbhavaḥ | okārānte vṛddhainiṣedhasya sthāpitatvāt | bāhulakenānigantasya vṛddhirnetipakṣe tu pūrvīkte'pi tathaiveticed, maivam | oto dhātoreva dhātorna tu nāmadhātoritipakṣe doṣābhāvāditi kecit | taccintyam | tasya dūṣitatvāt | na ca vṛddhyavasthāyāmodanto nāmadhātvanyadhāturatraiva prasiddha iti vācyam | pratyayotpattivelāyāṃ hyodantatvamapekṣitaṃ na tu yākadācit, avidhāvīdityādāvapi niṣedhāpatteḥ | tasyāpi vidhavatītyādau odantatvāt | sicyantaraṅgasvīkāre tatraiva odantatvācca | naceṣṭāpattiḥ | pūrvoktadoṣagrastatvāt | anyathā tatkṛtasya kaiyaṭamādhavayoravirodhasyāpyanupapannatvāt | tasmādeva vyākhyeyam | "sici" itiyogaṃ vibhajya "ota" iti "bahulam" iti cānuvarttya vyavasthitabāhulakaṃ cāśritya sici odantasya vṛddhiḥ syāt vyavasthitatvācca bāhulakasya nāmadhātau na bhavatīti | evaṃ cākavayīt akavāyīt iti matadvayapuraskāreṇa rūpadvayadarśanaṃ siddhāntakaumudyāṃ niryuktikameva | tadaṃśe ubhayorapyaikamatyasyaiva vyavasthāpitatvāt | na caivam avidhāvīdityanupapattitādavasthyam etatpakṣe tatrāpi prāgeva gumasya vācyatvāditi vācyam | svābhāvikaudantasyaiva niṣedhopagamāditi | akārṣīdityādau guṇe kṛte " vadavrajahalantasya" iti vṛddhiḥ | na caivamatārīdityādau guṇe kṛte "neṭi" iti halantalakṣaṇavṛddhiniṣedhāt "ato halāderlaghoḥ " iti vṛddhivikalpāpattiriti vācyam | tadapavādabhūtāyā "ato lrāntasya" itinityavṛddhaḥ sambhavāt | na ca tathā'pi alāvīdityatra vikalpāpattireveti
