vācyam | "lrāntasya " ityatra "lopo vyoḥ" iti vakāraṃ praśliṣya tadantasyāpi nityavṛddhividhānasya vācyatvāt | na caivaṃ mā bhavānavīdamavīdityādāvapi nityavṛddhyāpattiriti vācyam | "h‌myantakṣaṇa" itisūtre ṇiśvigrahaṇamapahāya tatsthāne avimavyoḥ prakṣepeṇa niṣedhasiddheḥ | etatpakṣe aunayīdaśvayīdityādāvantaraṅgatvād guṇāyādeśayoḥ kṛtayoḥ yāntatvādeva niṣedhāpattyā tatreṣṭavikalpāsiddhiriti vācyam | vakārapraśleṣanibandhananityavṛddhereva avimavyoḥ prakṣepeṇa niṣedhāt | "ato halādeḥ" iti vikalpasya maveḥ saṃbhavāt | "madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvānvidhīnbādhante nottarān" itinyāyāt | na caivamajāgarīdityatrāpi vikalpāpattiḥ, ekasūtropāttatayā tadaṃśe'pi "ato halādeḥ" ityasya bādhāyogāditi vācyam | tatra bādhyasāmānyacintayā svaviṣayaprāptasya vṛddhimātrasya bādhāt | agatyā vaiṣamyasya sahyatvāt | yadvā "ato lrāntasya" iti vṛddherevāstu niṣedhaḥ | na caivamajāgarīdamavīdityubhayatrāpi "ato halādeḥ" ityasyāpattiḥ | tadapavādanityavṛddhiniṣedhe'pi mavatau utsargabhūtavikalpapravṛttiḥ jāgarttau tu neti svīkārāt | apavādaniṣedhe punarutsargapravṛttarlakṣyānurodhena vaikalpikatvāt | tasmātsicyapyantaraṅgaparibhāṣāpravṛttisvīkārāduvaṅeva | anuvīdityādau "ṅkiti ca" itiniṣedhapravṛttyarthaṃ sicivṛddheriglakṣaṇatvasaṃpādakatvenāpi nātra vṛddhigrahaṇasārthakyamiticet atrāhuḥ--- ato lrāntasya ityatra vakārasya praśleṣe śavadhātorapi nityaṃ vṛddhiprasaṃgaḥ | na ca tatra mānābhāvaḥ | śavatirgatikarmā kambojeṣu bhāṣyate, vikāraenamāryā bhāṣante iti bhāṣyaniruktakṛd‌bhyāmuktatvāt | na ca avimavivattasyāpi tatra pāṭhaḥ kārya iti vācyam | ṇiśvītidvayaṃ tyaktvā trayaprakṣepe gauravāpatteriti dik | atredaṃ bodhyam | naitadanurodhena "sicyantaraṅgaṃ nāsti" iti svīkāro nyāyyaḥ | vakārapraśleṣānabhyupagamāt | na cālāvīdityatra vikalpāpattiḥ | "vadavraja" ityatra vadaav‌vrajeti praśliṣya avādeśasyāpi vṛddhividhānasya vyākhyātuṃ śakyatvāt | na ca dhātusāhacaryāddhātoreva aco grahaṇaṃ syāditi vācyam | "dvistricatur" itisūtre kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇena sāhacaryasya sarvatrāniyāmakatvasya jñāpitatvāt | "neṭi" itiniṣedhasya ca halantalakṣaṇavṛddhimātrapratiyogikatvasya sarvasiddhatvāt | etena avidhāvīdityādāvapi nityavṛddhyā prāguktagranthamatavirodho'pi nirasituṃ śakyaḥ | evaṃ ca "h‌myantakṣaṇa" iti sūtre ṇiśvigrahaṇaṃ na karttavyameva | sutarāṃ tat‌sthāne avimavyoḥ prakṣepaḥ | prāgeva tu śavateḥ, prayojanābhāvāt | guṇe kṛte yāntatvenaiva ṇiśavyorniṣedhasiddheḥ | avyādiprakṣepasya ca vakārapraśleṣakṛtātiprasaṅgavāraṇamātramūlakatvena tatparityāge mūlocchedenaiva chinnatvāt | evaṃ ca tatratyam aṃśabhedena bādhyasāmānyaviśeṣacintāśrayaṇavaiṣamyamapi nāpadyate | yadapi kaiyaṭādayaḥ | ciri jiri iti hiṃsāyāṃ svādau paṭhyete | tābhyāṃ sici acirāyīdajirāyīditīṣṭam | evaṃ cinoternayateśca yaṅ‌lugantātsici acecāyīdanenāyīditi | sicyantaraṅgasvīkāre tu guṇāyādeśābhyāṃ yāntatvāpattyā "h‌myantakṣaṇa" iti vṛddhiniṣedhe acirayīdityādikameva syādataḥ sijviṣaye'ntaraṅgaparibhāṣā na pravarttataityāvaśyakamiti | tadapi cintyam | hakāramakārasāhacaryeṇa yakārasyāpyaupadaśikasyaiva grahaṇena ayādeśe tanniṣedho na pravarttataiti kalpayituṃ śakyatvāt | ṇiśvigrahaṇaṃ ca tatsūtre sthāpyataeva | tadeva ca aupadeśikayakārāntasyaiva niṣedha ityatra jñāpakam | anyathā guṇāyādeśayoḥ kṛtayoḥ yāntatvādeva niṣedhasiddhau tadvaiyarthyāpatteḥ | evaṃ caḥ sāhacaryasya niyāmakatvaṃ na sārvatrikamityādi kucodyamapyanavakāśam | evaṃ ca ṇiśvigrahaṇasya "sicyantaraṅgaṃ nāsti" ityatra jñāpakatvenopanyāso'pyanupapannaḥ | asmadrītyā'pi tadvaiyarthyābhāvāt | etenoktaliṅgopaṣṭambhenaiva "satyapi saṃbhave bādhanaṃ bhavati" itinyāyamāśritya antaraṅgaṃ vṛddhyā bādhyate | anyathā takreṇa dadhi na bādhyeta | śramakajādibhiśca śap‌kapratyayādayo na bādhyeran | "midaco'ntyātparaḥ" iti śramo dhātorantyādacaḥ śapaśca prakṛtyavayavamātrātparatra saṃbhavāt | akacaśca ṭimadhyagatatvena kapratyayasya ca tadbahirbhāvena deśabhedasattvāt | na ca madhye'pavādanyāyena uvaṅeva vṛddhyā bādhyeta na tu guṇaḥ tasya paścātpaṭhitatvāditi vācyam | bādhyasāmānyacintāyāṃ svaviṣayaprāptasyāpavādabhinnasya sarvasya bādhābhyupagamāt | anyathā "aci ra ṛtaḥ" iti tisṛcatasṛ ityanayorṛkārasya rephādeśaḥ prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrghamutvaṃ ca bādheta, na tu "ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ" itiguṇam | parapaṭhitatvāt | bādhyasāmānyaviśeṣacinte ca lakṣyānurodhādvyavatiṣṭhete ityādikamapyapāstam | prakṛte kalpakasyānyathaivopapāditatvātkalpanāyā mūlocchedalakṣaṇabādhagrahastatvāt | yadapi bhavadadbhirbhāṣyakāracaraṇairuktam | yacca karotyakāragrahaṇaṃ laghoriti kṛte'pi iti | tasyāyamāśayaḥ | "ato halāderlaghoḥ" ityatra adgrahaṇaṃ tāvanna saṃdhyakṣaravyāvṛttyartham, laghorityata eva siddheḥ | ikārokāraṛkārāstvavaśiṣyante acetīt amoṣīt anarttī dityādau | yadi tu sicyantaraṅgaṃ syāttarhi antaraṅgatvenaiva guṇasiddhau tatra vṛddhyapravṛttyartham "ata " iti vyarthaṃ syāt | pāriśeṣyādeva tasyākāramātraviṣayakatvasiddheḥ | tatrāpīdaṃ cintyam akuṭīdapuṭīdityādau "gāṅ‌kuṭādibhyaḥ" iti ṅittvena guṇasyāpravṛttyā tatra vṛddhirmā bhūditi adgrahaṇaṃ sārthakameva | na ca tatra vṛddhirapi ṅittvenaiva na bhaviṣyatīti vācyam | "laghoḥ" iti nirdiṣṭasthānikatayā iglakṣaṇatvābhāvena tadapravṛtteḥ | yattu vṛddhāvantaraṅgeṇa guṇena bādhitāyāṃ ṅittvena guṇabādhe'pi na vṛddheḥ pravṛttiḥ | na hi devadattasya hantari hate devadattasya punarunmajjanaṃ bhavatīti nyāyāditi | tanna | yadi akārasārthakye āgrahastarhi apavādaniṣedhe punarutsargasya pravṛttirityāśrayatām | anyathā tu tatparityāge'pi kṣativirahāt | ata eva "vadavraja" ityatrāsmatpakṣe vakārapraśleṣādhikyamapi na doṣāvaham | vṛddhigrahaṇasya tyāgena lāghavāt | "nāntaḥ pādam" ityatra tu sujāteeśvasūnṛte ityetatsiddhyarthaṃ pūrvarūpe niṣedve ayādīnāmapravṛttirityuktam | atra tvacirāyīdityādīnāṃ phalānāmanyathaiva sādhitatvena vaiṣamyāt | phalavyatirekeṇāpi śabdasārthakyamātrāya yatkiñcidarthajñāpanokteścānucitatvādityalamatiprasaṅgena | tasmādiha vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ nopayujyataevetisthitam | idaṃ tu guṇagrahaṇasādhāraṇyena | vastutastu siddhānte yatā tathā'stu | ik‌paribhāṣāyāṃ vṛddhigrahaṇānupādānapakṣe tu iglakṣaṇavṛddheraprasiddhyā akuṭīdityādau vṛddhivāraṇāyaivāta ityasya sārthakyam | pūrvapakṣe vṛddhimātrasyaiva niṣedhyatvāt | halāderityasya ca kuṭādibhinnasthale sāvakāśatvādityalamatiprasaṅgena | idaṃ tu guṇagrahaṇasādhāraṇyena vācyam | uktarītyā'nekakusṛṣṭikalpanayā guṇavṛddhyorik‌sthānikatvasiddhāvapi tadapekṣayā "iko guṇavṛddhī" ityevāśrayitumarham | "seyaṃ mahato vaṃśastambāllaṭ‌vā'nukṛṣyate" itinyāyasāmyāditi sūtrādyabhiprāyaḥ | paramaprakṛtamanusarāmaḥ | śabdavyāpārāśrayaṇaṃ kim | dyoḥ panthāḥ imamityādau "diva aut" pathimathyṛbhukṣāmāt" "tyadādīnāmaḥ" ityautvamātvamatvaṃ ca alo'ntyaparibhāṣayā antyasyaiva yathā syāditi | yattu bhāṣye sa imamityudāhṛtam, tatra sa imaṃ mantramaphasyaditibrāhmaṇavākyāvayavatvena sa ityaṃśaḥ saṃpātāyātaḥ | na tūdāharaṇapraviṣṭaḥ | tacchabde iko'saṃbhavānniyamapravṛttiśaṅkā'nutthānāditi kecit | anye tu "tyadādīnāmaḥ" ityatra ika ityasyopasthitau dviśabde idaṃśabde ca atvaṃ syānna tvanyeṣām | gaṇanirdeśasya "tadoḥ saḥ sau" ityatrānuvṛttyarthatvasaṃbhavātsa ityapyudāharaṇamevetyāhuḥ | vastutastu tathā sati "idamo maḥ" itisūtraṃ vyarthaṃ syāt | tasya makārasthāne tyadādyatvabādhamātrārthatvāt | uktarītyā ca makāre'tvaprasaktivirahāt | evam "ido'y‌ puṃsi" ityapi vyartham | ikārasya tyadāditvādatve do y‌ puṃsi iti vidhānādeva siddheḥ | dviśabdamātrārthatve tu alo'ntyaparibhāṣayaiva gatārthatvam | asyāṃ ca paribhāṣāyāṃ taccheṣatadapavādapakṣau pūrvapakṣatayā saṃbhāvyete padopasthitipakṣastu siddhānta iti | tatrādyo yathā "sārvadātukārddhadātukayoḥ" ityatra aṅgaguṇaśabdayoranuvṛttyā aṅgasyeti ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśālliṅgādalo'ntyaparibhāṣā guṇapadācca ik‌paribhāṣopatiṣṭhate | tatra ik‌padamaṅgasya viśeṣaṇam igantasyāṅgasya guṇo bhavatīti | sa ca bhavan "alo'ntyasya" ityanayā'ntyasya bhavatīti | tadā'lo'ntyaparibhāṣā asyāḥ śeṣaḥ | atha tvaṅgasyetiṣaṣṭhī alo'ntyaparibhāṣayā antye ali sthāpitā, aṅgāntyasya guṇa iti, paścādikā antyo viśeṣyate aṅgāntyasya iko guṇaḥ syāditi, tadā iyameva tasyāḥ śeṣaḥ | so'yaṃ taccheṣapakṣaḥ | tatpadam alo'ntyaparibhāṣāparamiti pakṣadvayasaṃgrahaḥ | bahuvrīhitatpuruṣābhyāmubhayaparatvāt | tatpravṛttyuttarapravṛttikatvaṃ taccheṣatvamubhayasādhāraṇaṃ bodhyam | etenoktaparibhāṣādvayaikavākyatvasya taccheṣaśabdārthatve rājakīyamityādau alo'ntyaparibhāṣāpravṛttyanāpattiḥ, bhinnadeśayoḥ parasparanirākāṅkṣayorvidhyupakārakayorekavākyatā'nupapattiścetyapāstam | dvayorekavidhau pravṛttisaṃbhave taditarapariṣ‌kṛtavidhipariṣkārakatvasya vivakṣitatvāt | atha guṇavṛddhividhau aṅgasyeti na sthānaṣaṣṭhī, kiṃ tvika ityapekṣayā'vayavaṣaṣṭhī, aṅgāvayavasya ika iti, tadā sthānaṣaṣṭhīrūpaliṅgābhāvādalo'ntyaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate | tataścāṅgāvayavasya yatra tatra sthitasya iko guṇavṛddhī sta iti tadapavādapakṣaḥ | na hi vastutaḥ śāstreṇa prāptasya bādhasaṃbhavaḥ, kiṃ tu bādhakatvābhimataśāstreṇa bādhyatvābhimataśāstrasya svaviṣaye prāptyabhāva eva grāhyate asatyasminnatrāpi tatpravartteteti | utsargasya svaviṣayāviṣayakatvakalpanameva bādha iti sarvasiddhāntaḥ | samuccayastu na saṃbhavati, antyasya ikaśca dvayorapi guṇaḥ paribhāṣādvayaprāmāṇyāt, tathā ca "miderguṇaḥ" ityatra antyasya ikaśca dvayorapi guṇa iti | aṅgasyeti sakṛduccaritaṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthāneyogāvayavayogarūpārthadvayabodhanāsaṃbhavāt | sthāneyogavyatirekeṇa ca liṅgābhāvādalo'ntyaparibhāṣā'nusthānāt | āvṛttyādau ca pramāṇābhāvāt | ata eva miderantyasya iko vā guṇa iti vikalpo'pyanupapanna ityāśayena bhāṣye naitāvāśaṅkitau | tatrādye "miderguṇaḥ" ityādau doṣaḥ | antyasya ik‌tvābhāvāt ikhaścāntyatvābhāvāt | tataśca bhavatītyādau paribhaāṣādvayasya sāvakāśatvādatra vinigamakābhāvādubhayaparityāge guṇasya sarvādeśatvāpattiḥ | yadvārttikam--- vṛddhiguṇāvalo'ntyasyeticen‌midimṛjipugantalaghūpadharcchidṛśikṣiprakṣudreṣviggrahaṇaṃ karttavyam | sarvādeśaprasaṅgaścānigantasyeti | uktasthaleṣu sarvādeśaprasaṅgāttattat‌sthaleṣu iggrahaṇaṃ karttavyam | cakārasya hetvarthakatvāt | yadi tvatrapūrvoktakukalpanā'nusāreṇa sarvatra ikāṃ sthānitvaṃ pariśeṣyeta, tadā pratipattāvatyantaṃ gauravam | bhinnamityādau ig‌lakṣaṇatvābhāvādguṇaniṣedhānāpattiśca | yadi tu knoḥ kittvājjñāpakādiglakṣaṇatvābhāve'pi laghūpadhalakṣaṇasya niṣedhaḥ, na tu guṇamātrasya, ato laigavāyana ityādau guṇasya na niṣedha iti kalpyate, tarhi tadapekṣayā lāghavātpadopasthitipakṣa eva svīkriyatām | tadapavādapakṣe'pi ajuhavurityādivat anenijuḥ paryaveviṣurityādāvapi "jusi ca" iti guṇaḥ syāt | bhavatītyādivadīhitetyādāvapi "sārvadhātukārddhadhātukayoḥ" iti guṇaḥ syāt | agne itivadagnicidityādāvapi "hrasvasya guṇaḥ" iti saṃbuddhiguṇaḥ syāt | agnaya itivadagnicita ityādāvapi "jasi ca" iti guṇaḥ syāt | karttarītivatsukṛtītyādāvapi "ṛko ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ" iti guṇaḥ syāt | agnaye itivadagnicite ityādāvapi "gherṅiti" iti guṇaḥ syāt | bābhravya itivatsauśruta ityādāvapi "orguṇaḥ" iti guṇaśca syāt | tathā ca vārttikam--- iṅ‌mātrasyeticejjusisārvadhātukārddhadhātukahrasvādyorguṇeṣu anantyapratiṣedha iti | hrasvādīti tadguṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiḥ | ādipadaṃ "jasi ca" ityādiguṇatrayaparam | tathā ca tadapavādapakṣe uktātiprasaṅgavāraṇāyānantyasyeko guṇo na bhavatīti vacanāntaraṃ kalpyaṃ syāditi gauravamityarthaḥ | nanu sambuddhijasiguṇayoḥ "ṛto ṅi" iti guṇasya ca hrasvasyeti ṛta iti ca nirdiṣṭasthānikatvātkathāmik‌pari bhāṣopasthitiḥ | agnicite ityatra ca cicchabdasya ghisaṃjñāvirahādeva nātiprasaṅga iticet atrāhuḥ--- ādyayorhrasvenegviśeṣaṇāt | ca cātra paribhāṣopasthānameva durlabham, tasyā aniyamaprasaṅge niyamārthatvāt, akārasya guṇapravṛttāvapi varṇāntarāpattyabhāvena kṣativirahāditi vācyam | hrasvasyāṅge viśeṣaṇatayā tasya cāvayavāvayavibhāvasambandhena igviśeṣaṇatayā hrasvāntaṃ yadaṅgaṃ tadavayavasya iko guṇaḥ syāditi tadā sūtrārthaḥ syāt | tataścāgnicidityādau hrasvāntatvābhāvāt | atiprasaṅgābhāve'pi upagorityādau ukārāderapi guṇaḥ syāt | yadvā hrasvāṅgayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvanirāsārthamaṅgapadottaraṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthāneyogatvābādhanāyānantyasyāpi guṇasiddhyarthamik‌paribhāṣopasthitiḥ syāt | tathā ca aṅgaṃ hrasvaṃ ca ika eva viśeṣaṇam | ādyasyāvayavatvamantyasyābhedaḥ saṃsarga itiviśeṣaḥ | tataścāṅgāvayavasya hrasvābhinnasya iko guṇaḥ syādityarthaḥ | tathā ca "hrasvasya" "jasi ca" ityubhayoratiprasaṅgaḥ sughaṭaḥ | evam "ṛto ṅi" ityatra aṅgāvayavasya ṛdabhinnasyeti | "orguṇaḥ" ityatra aṅgāvayavasya ukārābhinnasya ika ityarthaḥ | agnicite ityādau tu varṇaniṣṭhaiva ghisaṃjñā na tu padaniṣṭhetipakṣe "gherṅiti" ityasyātiprasaṅga iti | nanvaṅgāvayavasya iko guṇa itipakṣe bhettetyādāvapi guṇe siddhe "pugantalaghūpadhasya" iti niyamārtham, tathā ca īhitetyādau na doṣa iti cet, atrāhuḥ--- yadi sārvadhātukārddhadātukayorlaghūpadhasyaivetiniyamaḥ, tarhi "hrasvasya guṇaḥ" orguṇaḥ" ityatra atiprasaṅgadoṣa eva | na hi tatra guṇaḥ sārvadhātukādinimittaḥ | atha laghūpadhasya sārvadhātukārddhadhātukayoreveti, tarhi īhitetyādau doṣa eva | na hyatra guṇo laghūpadhasya | na ca niyamadvayena nistāraḥ | ekasminvākye tadalābhāt | athāvṛttyādikamāśrīyate, tathā'pyanenijurityatrātiprasaṅkaḥ | laghūpadhāṅgasya sārvadātukasya ca tatra sattvāt | he buddhe buddhayaḥ picavya buddhaye ityādīnāṃ laṅūpadhatvābhāvāt tatrātiprasaṅgasya sarvathaiva durvāratvācceti kaiyaṭaḥ | tasmāttadapavādapakṣo duṣṭa eveti sthitam | atra vadanti---aṅgākṣiptena pratyayena aṅgameva viśeṣyataiti uktadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ | yadi tu pratyayena śrūyamāṇena jusādinā ca igviśeṣyate yathāśruti pratyayaparasya jusādiparasya ca iko guṇaḥ syāditi, evaṃ ṅisarvanāmasthānaparasya ṛtadantāṅgāvayavasyeka ityādi, tadā na ko'pi doṣa iti, taccintyam | aṅgapratyayayoḥ parasparamutthitākāṅkṣatvāt | na ca aṅgasya igviśeṣaṇatāpannatvena tadanvayāpekṣayā pratyayasya viśeṣye ikyevānvaya ucita iti vācyam | viśiṣṭasya vaiśiṣṭyamityanvayāt, sarvanāmasthānaparaṃ yadṛdantamaṅgaṃ tadavayavasya ika iti | anyathā raktatvāderapi daṇḍādyanvayānāpatteḥ | svasamavāyisaṃyogena puruṣaevānvayāpatteḥ | atha lakṣyānurodhena ākāṅkṣāṃ kalpayitvā iganvayaḥ kalpyeta, tathā'pi padopasthitipakṣeṇa saha tāratamyavicāradaśāyāṃ gauravasya durvāratvāt | kathaṃcidupapattimātrasyākiñcitkaratvāt | pratipakṣāpekṣalāghavasyaiva pakṣavyavasthāpakatvācca | etena mida iḥ midirityādikalpanābhiprāyeṇa taccheṣapakṣopapattikathanamapyapāstam | athāstu pūrvavipratiṣedhenālo'ntyaparibhāṣābādhikeyamikparibhāṣeti kroṣṭrīyācāryasaṃmataḥ pakṣaḥ | na ca viṣayāntare labdhāvakāśayoreva dvayorvipratiṣedhaḥ, ik‌paribhāṣā tvanavakāśā, alo'ntyaparibhāṣānirmuktaviṣayābhāvāditi na tatsambhava iti vācyam | rāmebhya ityatra ekasya sthānina ādeśadvayasyeva medyata ityatra dvayoḥ sthāninorekasyādeśasyāpyasambhavādasambhavamātrasyāpi vipratiṣedhapadārthatvāditi, tanna | paribhāṣādvayena ikāradakārayorbhinnaviṣayāvacchedena prāptyā asti ca sambhavo yadubhayaṃ syāditipakṣe taccheṣādipakṣāviśeṣāt | satyapi sambhave bādhanaṃ bhavatītipakṣe tu etatparibhāṣā'nārambhe "alo'ntyasya" iti dakārasyaiva guṇaḥ syād | ato yenanāprāptinyāyena tadapavādatvameveti utsargāpavādayoḥ vipratiṣedhāsambhavāt | aprasiddhavipratiṣedhapadārthakalpanāyā anucitatvācceti | tasmātpadopasthitipakṣa eva śreyān | ika itipadasya "jusi ca" ityādāvupasthāne padaikyavākyatayā tadanvayo'ntaraṅgaḥ | alo'ntyaparibhāṣā tu vidhāvavāntaravākyārthabodhottaraṃ vākyaivavākyatayā tatra sambadhyataiti tadanvayo bahiraṅgaḥ | avāntaravākyārthabodhaṃ vinā sthānaṣaṣṭhītvanirṇayābhāvādityāhuḥ | taccintyam | vidhivākyeṣvavāntaravākyārthabodhābhāve ik‌paribhāṣopasthiterapi durghaṭatvāt | guṇādipadamātrasya tadupasthāpakatve sthāniviśeṣanirdeśasthale'pi pravṛttyāpatteḥ | aṅgasya guṇaḥ syādityavāntaravākyārthabodhe'ṅgaguṇayoruddeśyavidheyabhāvāvagatau satyāmeva tatpravṛtteḥ | na ca tathā'pi taddoṣatādavasthyam | sthāniviśeṣasyopalakṣitatvāt | na caivaṃ "sārvadhātukārddhadhātukayo" ityādāvaṅgasyetisthāninirdeśādikparibhāṣopasthityanupapattiḥ | sthānyantarajijñāsānutthāpakasthāninirdeśābhāvasya vivakṣitatvāt | nacaivaṃ guṇapadādikparibhāṣopasthitiritigranthavirodhaḥ | viśiṣṭasyaiva tenābhimatatvāt | ata eva guṇavṛddhipadābhyāṃ yatra guṇavṛddhī vidhīyete iti vyācakhyuḥ | etenānuvāde paribhāṣā'nupasthānādeva "vṛddhiryasya" ityādāvanuvāde ikpadānupasthitisambhavāt phalitārthakathanamātraṃ tadityapāstam | vidheyatvākṣiptasya uktābhāvasya liṅgatā'vacchedakatayā liṅgakoṭau praveśa iti tadabhiprāyāt | tasmātprathamamavāntaravākyārthabodhaḥ | tata ikparibhāṣopasthitiḥ | tata ikpadaikavākyatayā mahāvākyārthabodhaḥ | tatra tu prathamaṃ vidhivākyārthabodhaḥ | tataḥ sthānaṣaṣṭhyā alo'ntyaparibhāṣopasthitiḥ | tato vidhivākye śrutāyāḥ sthānaṣaṣṭhyā antye ali upasaṃhāraḥ | na tu śābdamekavākyatvam | tathā cāvāntaravākyārthabodha ubhayorapyupajīvyaḥ | nanvevam "miderguṇaḥ" ityādau ik‌paribhāṣāyā eva bahiraṅgatvāpattyā alo'ntyaparibhāṣāyā evopasthitiḥ syāt, satyam | sthānatvasyādeśanirūpitatayā tatrāpi vidheyaviśeṣasya liṅgāntarbhāvāvaśyakatvāt | ādeśaviśeṣānavagāhinaḥ sthānatvupratyayasyānupapatteḥ tatparibhāṣāpravṛttyanupayogitvācca | na caivamapi ik‌paribhāṣāmātrasya tatra pravṛttau niyāmakābhāva iti vācyam | uktarītyā antaraṅgabahiraṅgabhāvābhāve'pi alo'ntyaparibhāṣā'pavādasya vācyatvāt tāvadapavādaparihārapūrvakapravṛttikatayā tāvadapavādapravṛttiniścayaṃ vinā tadviṣayaparihārajñānasyānupapattyā tadadhīnatvādalo'ntyaparibhāṣāpravṛttiniścayasya tasyā bahiraṅgatvānapāyāt | etena "alo'ntyasya" ityatrāpi padopasthitipakṣasvīkāre ubhayoḥ sāmyamiti nirastam | tatpakṣasya bhāṣyādyanārūḍhatvācca | kecittu tatpakṣe "ādeḥ parasya" ityatrālpadasyārthaparatvaṃ na syāt | tathā cāsamāsanirdeśavaiyarthyam, dvīpamityatra samastāp‌śabdasya ītvāpattiśca, "ādeḥ parasya" ityatrāpi padopasthitipakṣasyaiva tena vācyatvāt alpasyārthaparatvānupayogāt na ko'pi doṣa iti vācyam | tathā'pi padadvayānvayasya vācyatayā bahiraṅgatvānapāyādityāhuḥ | tatra iko'ṅgasyetisāmānādhikaraṇyānvayasya nyāyyatvādikpadārthasyāṅgaviśeṣaṇatve igantasyāṅgasyetivākyārthe sthāneyogārthakaṣaṣṭhīrūpaliṅgasya tādavasthyādalo'ntyaparibhāṣopatiṣṭhataeva | "miderguṇaḥ" ityādau tu halantatvāt iko mida itisāmānādhikaraṇyāyogāt mideravayavasya ika iti vaiyadhikaraṇyenānvaye sthāneyogaṣaṣṭhīrūpaliṅgābhāvādalo'ntyaparibhāṣopasthityabhāvāt anantyasyaiva guṇasiddhiḥ | na cātrāpi ika iti sthānaṣaṣṭhyaivālo'ntyaparibhaāṣopasthitiḥ syāditi vācyam | tatra ika ityasyopasthityanantaramalo'ntyaparibhāṣopasthāne antyasya ika ityasya igavayavasyāntyasyetyasya cārthasya bādhitatvāt | miderantyasya ik‌tvābhāvāt | antyasya dakārasya igavayavatvāsambhavācca | ikaḥ sthānitvabodhe svātantryeṇāntyasya guṇavidhāne copajīvyavirodhāt | aṅgasyetyādau tvavayavadvārā aṅgasya sthānitvanirvāhānnopajīvyavirodha iti vaiṣamyam | tasmātprakṛtyarthaniṣṭhasthānitvāvirodhinyeva ṣaṣṭhī alo'ntyaparibhāṣāyāṃ liṅgamiti siddham || iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau prathamādhyāyasya prathame pāde tṛtīyamāhnikam || na dhātulopaārddhadhātuke 4 | dhātvavayavalopaprayojakamārddhadhātukaṃ nimittīkṛtya prāpte iko guṇavṛddhī na staḥ | loluvaḥ popuvaḥ marīmṛjaḥ | lolūyādibhyo yaṅantebhyaḥ pacādyac | "yaṅo'ci ca" iti yaṅo luk | tatra "sanādyantā dhātavaḥ" iti yaṅantasya dhātusaṃjñatayā tadavayavayakāralopanimittamacpratyayaṃ nimittīkṛtya "sārvadhātukārddhadhātukayoḥ" iti guṇaḥ prāptaḥ sa etadvacanena niṣidhyate | aikyaṃcātra nimittībhūtavyaktereva, na tu nimittatāvacchedakasyāpi | anyathā dhātvavayavalope'c‌tvaṃ guṇe tvārddhadhātukatvamacpratyayasya nimittatāvacchedakamiti niṣedhāpravṛttiprasaṅgāt | iha dhātupadaṃ tadavayave lākṣaṇikam | yadyapi duḥ khena īyate gamyate iti "durīṇo lopaśca" iti duḥ śabde upapade iṇ‌ gatāvityasmādrak‌pratyayaḥ, dhātośca lopaḥ, tataḥ "ro ri" iti upasargāntyarephalope "ḍhralope" iti dīrghe ca dūramityatra samastasyāpi dhātorlopo'sti, tathā'pi tatra guṇādiprāptiviraheṇa tanniṣedhavaiyarthyāt | dhātulopa ityatra ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣapakṣe trayaḥ kalpāḥ sambhavanti | ārddhadhātukagrahaṇasya lopaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ niṣedhyaviśeṣaṇatvamubhayaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ veti | tatrādye ārddhadhātukanimitte dhātvavayavasya lope guṇavṛddhī na sta ityarthaḥ | tatrānyanimittayorapi guṇavṛddhyorniṣedhāpattyā prapūrvādindheḥ ktapratyaye "aniditām" iti nalopasya ktapratyayarūpārddhadhātukanimittakatvena pra iddha iti ādguṇo na syāt | tasyobhayasthānikatve'pi ik‌sthānikatvānapāyāt | na cekaitiśabdamuccārya vihitatvābhāvānna niṣedhaḥ | uttaratra caśabdabalāttathātve'pi iha śabdasvarūpaparatve mānābhāvāt | ika ityasyārthamātraparatvāt | anyathā tu tṛtīyapakṣīyameva dūṣaṇaṃ yojyam | nanvatra "pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate paścādupasargeṇa" itipakṣe prathamopanataktapratyayāpekṣo nalopa evāntaraṅgaḥ, pūrvamupasargeṇa paścātsādhanenetipakṣe tu guṇa eva tathā, sarvathā'pi guṇo nirapavādaḥ, "asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge" itinyāyena guṇasyāsiddhatayā niṣedhānarhatvāt, bahiraṅgatayā niṣedhasyāsiddhatve guṇasya nirapavādatvāt, satyam | nāstyevāyaṃ prakṛte doṣaḥ kiṃ tu bhedyate ityādi tṛtīyapakṣe vakṣyamāṇameva dūṣaṇamatrāpi bodhyam iti kaiyaṭānusāriṇaḥ | haradattānuyāyinastu "nājānantarye bahiṣṭvapraklṛptiḥ" iti niṣedhād "asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgam" ityasya neha pravṛttiḥ | dvayormadhye ekatra ajānantaryāpekṣāyām "asiddham" iti na pravarttataiti tadarthāt | atra ca ād‌guṇe paurvāparyasya ajghaṭitatvena ajānantaryāpekṣaṇāt | ataḥ preddhamityasyāsiddhirapyatra dūṣaṇamityāhuḥ | idaṃ ca "acaḥ parasmin" itisūtre vivecayiṣyāmaḥ | ārddhadhātukasya niṣedhyaviśeṣaṇatve tu yatkiñcinnimittake dhātulope sati ārddhadhātukanimittake guṇavṛddhī na sta iti syāt | tataśca knūyī śabde ityasmāṇṇici puki "lopo vyoḥ" iti yalope ca pugantalakṣaṇo guṇo'pi na syāt | "cele knopeḥ" ityādijñāpakena niṣedhavāraṇe tu gauravam, vakṣyamāṇadoṣaśca | tantrādinobhayaviśeṣaṇatve tu tadeva gauravam | ārddhadhātukanimitte dhātulope ārddhadhātukanimitte guṇa vṛddhī na sta ityarthe kṛte'pi yatrārddhadhātukasaṃjñaṃ vyaktidvayaṃ lopasya guṇādeśca nimittaṃ tatrāpi niṣedhaḥ syāt | tataśca bhiderṇyantātkarmaṇi yaki bhid‌ i ya iti sthite nityatvād "ṇeraniṭi" iti yakaṃ nimittīkṛtya ṇilope kṛte pratyayalakṣaṇena luptaṃ ṇicamāśritya kriyamāṇo laghūpadhaguṇo'pi na pravartteteti bhedyataiti na syāt | ṇeryakaścobhayorārddhadhātukatvāt | na ca pratyayamātrasāpekṣasya guṇasya tadviśeṣārddhadhātukasāpekṣaṇilopāpekṣayā'ntaraṅgatvātprāgeva guṇaḥ syāditi vācyam | akṛtavyūhaparibhāṣayā tadapravṛtteḥ | ṇilopasya janiṣyamāṇatayā guṇānimittasyārddhadātukasya vināśonmukhatvāt | "upasaṃjātanimitto'pyutsarga upasaṃjaniṣyamāṇanimittenāpyapavādena bādhyate" itinyāyācca | ṇilope sati dhātvavayavalopasampattyā etanniṣedhasya pravarttiṣyamāṇatvāt | kecittu uktanyāyo'pyakṛtavyūhanyāyaevāntarbhūtaḥ | apavādaviṣayābhāvasyāpi nimittakoṭipraveśādityāhuḥ | tasmāddhātorlopo yasminnarddhadhātuke tannimitte guṇavṛddhī na sta ityevārthaḥ | lopaguṇādyorekārddhadhātukavyaktinimittakatvalābhāditi siddhamiṣṭam | atra yadyapi padopasthiteḥ pūrvavākyārthatvenātra niṣedhapratiyogyākāṅkṣāyāṃ tasyā evānvayāpattyā uktasthale ikpadaṃ nopatiṣṭhataiti sūtrārthaḥ syāt, tathā ca loluvādau guṇaniṣedho na syāt, pratyuta bhedyata ityādau vyañjanasya guṇa eva prasajyeta, tathā'pi "dīdhīvevīṭām" itisūtrasya tatra ikpadopasthitiniṣedhakatve ikparibhāṣā'lo'ntyaparibhāṣayoḥ phale viśeṣābhāvena padopasthitiniṣedhasya vaiyarthyāpattyā'trāpi padopasthiterna niṣedhyatvam | kiṃ tvautsargikatayā bhavata ityasyopasthitau guṇavṛddhī na bhavata iti vākyārthaḥ | dhātulopaiti kim | ārddhadhātukaeva vihitapratiṣiddhatvādagatyā vikalpo mā bhūt | ārddhadhātukaiti kim | totortti momorttītyādau sārvadhātukasaṃjñe tipi pare "rāllopaḥ" iti ch‌vorlopāttatra tibāśrayasya laghūpadhaguṇasya niṣedho mā bhūt | rephātparayośchakāravakārayorlopaḥ syātkvau jhalādāvanunāsikādau ca pratyaye pare ityarthe idamudāharaṇam | yadā tu tatra jhalādāvanunāsikādau ca pratyaye pare ityarthe idamudāharaṇam | yadā tu tatra jhalādāvityasya kṅitīti viśeṣaṇamitipakṣaḥ, tadā totormītyādi | tatrānunāsikādipratyayaparatvena tatpravṛtteḥ | ika iti sthāniviśeṣanirdeśaḥ kim | abhāji rāgaḥ ityatra bhañjirañjibhyāṃ ciṇ‌ghañoḥ kṛtayoḥ "bhañjeśca ciṇi" "ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ" iti ca nakāralope kṛte "ata upadhāyāḥ' iti vṛddhiniṣedho mā bhūt | idantvavadheyam | yaṅantātpacateḥ pāpacya ityasmād‌ ṇvuli "yasya halaḥ" ityanena halaḥ parasya yasya lopavidhāne "ādeḥ parasya" itiparibhāṣayā parasya yadvihitaṃ tattasyāderbodhyamityarthikayā vyañjanamātrasya lope "ato lopaḥ" ityakārasya pṛthaglope "acaḥ parasmin" iti akāralopasya sthānivadbhāve dhātvakārasyopadhātvavyāghātād vṛddhyabhāve pāpacaka itirūpam | yaṅ‌luki tu samudāyalopasvīkāreṇa ajjhalādeśasya sthānivattvābhāvādbhavatyeva vṛddhiḥ pāpācaka iti | iglakṣaṇatvābhāvātprakṛtaniṣedhasyāpi tatrāpravṛtteḥ | yathā nonāvetyatreti | atra bhāṣyakṛtaḥ---idaṃ sūtraṃ nārabhyameva | yaṅ‌lukyapi pṛthagallopaṃ svīkṛtya sthānivadbhāve aṅgasya igantatvābhāvādeva guṇavṛddhivirahasiddheḥ | na ca "yaṅo'ci ca" iti luk yenanāprāptinyāyena atolopasya bādhakaḥ syāditi vācyam | "yasya halaḥ" ityatra yasyetiyogaṃ vibhajya atolopa iti cānuvarttya yaśabdākārasya lopavidhānena vyañjanamātralopasya "yaṅo'ci ca" ityetadvidheyatvāt | tataśca akārasya lopaḥ yakārasya lugiti viṣayabhedena yenanāprāptinyāyābhāvāt | evaṃ cāllopasya sthānivattvenaiva nirvāha iti sūtraṃ vyarthameva | na caivaṃ kṛṣṇo nonāva vṛṣabhamityatra nonāvetyasya vṛddhirna syāt, evaṃ pāpācaka ityapi na syāt, allopasya sthānivadbhāvāditi vācyam | ajnimittakasyaiva luko vyañjanamātrapratiyogikatvasvīkārāt | yasyu cakārādbahulagrahaṇena ac‌pratyayavyatirekeṇāpi yaṅo luk sa tvanaimikatvātpratyayotpatteḥ prāgeva pravarttate | pratyayāpekṣapravṛttikebhyo bahiraṅgebhyo'tolopādibhyo'ntaraṅgatvāt | sa tu samudāyapratiyogika eva | tasya ca na sthānivadbhāvaḥ | ajjhalādeśatvāt | ajmātrasthānikasyaivādeśasya sthānivadbhāvavidhānāt | athaivaṃ guṇavaduvaṅādayo'pina syuḥ | akārasya sthānivattve ac‌pratyayasyāvyavahitaparatvābhāvāditi cet, atra kaiyaṭādayaḥ--- sthānivad‌bhūtamakāramevāśritya tatra uvaṅādayaḥ, na tu pacādyacaṃ nimittīkṛtyā | uktayukteḥ | na ca yaṅavayavasya kevalākārasya pratyayatvaṃ nāstīti vācyam | yakāralopottaraṃ tasyāpi pratyayatvāt | na ca yakārasthitikāle akārasya pratyayatvābhāvādyakārāpekṣayā prāgeva luptatayā yakāralopottaramapi pratyayatvānanvayāt kathaṃ tasya pratyayatvam, sthāniniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogino dharmasyātideśenāpyalābhāditi vācyam | sambhavamātreṇāpyatideśasvīkārāt | yakāralopottaraṃ yadyakārasya lopo na syāttadā tasya syādeva pratyayatvamiti yogyatayā lupte'pi tatra sambhāvitasya pratyayatvasyātideśe bādhakābhāvāt | vare niṣedhaśceha liṅgam | yaṅantādyātervaraci "ato lopaḥ" iti "lopo vyorvali" iti allopayalopayoḥ kṛtayorallopasya sthānivadbhāvenākāraṃ nimittīkṛtya prāptaḥ "āto lopa iṭi ca" ityākāralopo mā bhūdityatastatra sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhārambhāt | sthānini dṛṣṭasyaivātideśe tu akārasya sthānivadbhāve'pi pratyayatvābhāve sutarāmārddhadhātukatvābhāvāt varapratyayasya cānajāditvādakāreṇa vyavadhānācca ātolopasyaivāprasaktyā tadvaiyarthyāpatteḥ | atra haradattādayaḥ | hrasvadīrghānteṣu iyaṅuvaṅoḥ kṛtayorlaghūpadhaguṇo durvāraḥ | na cāllopasya sthānivadbhāvena ukārasyopadhātvavyāghāta iti vācyam | ukārasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvābhāvāt | allopānantaramevovaṅaḥ pravṛtteḥ | tathā jaṅgama ityatra "gamahana" ityupadhālopaḥ syāt | yadi tvanaṅīti niṣedhaḥ, tarhi darīdṛśa ityatra "ṛdṛśo'ṅi" iti guṇaḥ syāt | dedya ityatra "dīṅo yuḍaci" iti yuṭ syāt | sanīsraṃso danīdhvaṃsaḥ | "aniditām" iti lopaḥ syāt | yāyā vāvā ityādau "āto lopa" ityākāralopaḥ syāt | tasmātsamudāyalopasvīkārasyāvaśyakatayā loluvādisiddhaye sūtramārabhyamiti | yattu sthānidvārakasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvasya sattvātsthānivadbhāvānna guṇaprasaṅga iti, tanna | sthānidvārā uvaṅo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatve'pyukārasyātathātvāt | lolūya ityasyāmavasthāyāmukāre dṛṣṭasya akārātpūrvatvasyovaṅi sambhave'pi tasyātra kasyacidvidherapravarttanīyatvāt | ukāramātrasya tvādeśatvaparyāptyanadhikaraṇatayā ūkāraniṣṭhasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvasya tasminnatideśāyogāt | yadapyuktam---"sarve sarvapadādeśāḥ" itinyāyenārthavatyeva sthānyādeśabhāvaviśrāmāduvaṅ‌dvārā lolū ityasya sthāne loluv‌ ityādeśaḥ, sa ca sthānivadbhāvādanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvaḥ, tasya guṇadvārā lolov ityādeśe karttavye allopaḥ sthānivaditi yuktameveti, tadapyasat | tathā sati lolūya ityasya sthāne yalopāllopadvārā lolū ityādeśaparyavasāne viśiṣṭasyaiva sthānikoṭipraveśād‌ akārāpekṣayā sthānidvārakasyāpi pūrvatvasya durlabhatvāt | vastutastu sthānidvārakamanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvamāśritya sthānivadbhāvo nirbīja iti tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ | yadapyāhuḥ---"ahgavṛtte punarvṛttāvavidhiḥ" itiparibhāṣayā uvaṅi kṛte na guṇapravṛttiriti, tadapyasat | cekṣiyaḥ toṣṭuvaḥ ityādestathā'pyasiddheḥ | tathā hi "antaraṅgānapi" itinyāyena "akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ" iti dīrghaṃ bādhitvā yaṅo luk | tato'llopasya sthānivattve'pi cekṣi a a toṣṭu a a iti sthānyakāramantyaṃ kṛtvā laghūpadhamaṅgamac‌pratyayaparaṃ jātamiti laghūpadhaguṇaḥ syādityāśaṅkya antaraṅgatvena iyaṅuvaṅoḥ pravṛttiriti svayamapyuktam | yasminnaṅgakārye satyevāṅgakāryamanyat prāpnoti tatra kṛte tanna bhavatīti coktaparibhāṣā'rthaḥ | na cātra laghūpadhaguṇa uvaṅi satyeva prāpnoti | pūrvamapi tatprāpteḥ | yadapi jaṅgama ityatropadhālopo nāpādanīyaḥ | anaṅītiparyudāsenāṅ‌sadṛśe śrūyamāṇājādau tadvidhānāditi, tanna | tatra prasajyapratiṣedhasyaivāvaśyakatvāt | na tvaṅīti svayameva vyākhyātatvācca | anyathā śrūyamāṇatvasyovānarthakatvasyāpi tattvāvacchinnapratiyogitākabhedānuyogitāvacchedakatvasvīkārāpattyā jagmetyādau madhyamapuruṣabahuvacanādāvapyupadhālopānāpatteḥ | svābhāvikājāditvasyāpi tathātvāpattyā jagmuṣa ityādāvapi tadanāpatteśca | bhedapratiyogivṛttīnāntatpratiyogitāvacchedakātiriktānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ madhye śrūyamāṇatvasyaiva bhedānuyogitāvacchedakatvamityatra niyāmakābhāvāt | yadapyuktam---dedya ityatra "dīṅaḥ" ityanubandhanirdeśānna yuḍāgamāpattiḥ, taduktam--- śtipā śapā'nubandhena nirdiṣṭaṃ yad gaṇena ca | yatraikājgrahaṇaṃ caiva pañcaitāni na yaṅ‌luki || iti | tadapyasat | atra yaho lopapratiyogitvena nirdeśāt tadbhinnasya kāryaṃ na bhavatītyarthapratīteḥ | nimittakoṭipraviṣṭasya kāryānanvayāt | praveśaśca sākṣādanyathā vetyanyadetat | ata eva "suptiṅantam" itisūtre kṛttaddhitetyatra tadantagrahaṇābhāve "kevalānāmeva kṛttaddhitānāṃ saṃjñāpattyā bhidityādīnāṃ saṃjñā na syāt, adhāturiti niṣedhād arthavatsūtrāpravṛtteḥ | nāpi kvibādīnām, aśrūyamāṇatvāt" ityanantaraṃ kaiyaṭanoktam---"nāpi pratyayalakṣaṇena prāpnoti, pratyayanimittamanyasya yat kāryaṃ vidhīyate tat pratyayalope bhavati, na tu pratyayasyaiva yat kāryaṃ tadapi, na hyasat kāryitvena vacanaśatenāpi śakyamāśrayitumiti | tatra vidhiratra niṣedha iti paraṃ viśeṣaḥ | śtipetyādijñāpakasyāpi yaṅ‌bhinnakāryaviṣayakatvāt | tacca "ekācaḥ" ityekagrahaṇaṃ tattadaṃśe tattannirderśo vetyanyadetat | etena "dīṅaḥ" ityanubandhanirdeśo yaṅ‌luṅgivṛttyartha iti tatratyaharadattokteratratyataduktivirodhodbhāvanamapyapāstam | pratyayāntarasambandhiyuḍāgamavāraṇārthatāyāstatroktatvāt | yaṅavayavamakāramāśrityātra tadāpādanasyāviruddhatvāt | nanvevamapi yaṅakāramāśritya yuḍāpattirasaṅgaitava, dīṅaḥ parasyājādeḥ ṅkita ārddhadhātukasya yuṭo vidhānādasyāpi yaṅ‌kāryatvānapāyāt, svavidhau sthānivattvābhāvācca iti cet, satyam bhavadīyasya "śtipāśapā" ityādivacanopanyāsasyāpyasaṅgatitādavasthyāt | miśrāṇāṃ tvayamāśayaḥ---allopānantaraṃ yalopa ityatra mānābhāvaḥ | lukaḥ sarvāpekṣayā balavattvamitisvīkārāt | ata eva gomatpriya ityādau "supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ"iti sorlugeva, na tu hal‌ṅyādilopaḥ | pratyayalakṣaṇena numādiprasaṅgāditi siddhāntaḥ | na ca acpratyayasya yaṅakāreṇa vyavadhānātkathaṃ pūrvaṃ yasya lugiti vācyam | nirdeśyatāvacchedakayaṅ‌tvāvacchinnāpekṣasyā vyavadhānasya sattvāt | yogavibhāgasāmarthyāttu yalopo vyañjanamātre paryavasyatītyanyadetat | vastugatyā yatra kāryaviśrāmastadapekṣasyaivāvyavadhānasyopādāne tu "k‌ṅiti ca" itisūtrasthakaiyaṭagranthavirodhāt | sthānivad‌bhūtenākāreṇa vyavadhānātpaścādapi kathamiti tulyatvācca | śrutikṛtamevāvyavadhānaṃ vacanaprāmāṇyādāśrīyataiti cet, tarhi yalopasya parinimittakatvaṃ kuto nirṇītam | acītisaptamyāḥ satisaptamītvenaivopapatteḥ | allopasya tu sthānivadbhāvārthaṃ paranimittakatvasvīkāra iti vaiṣamyam | prayojanaṃ vinā'pi parasaptamītvasvīkāre pramāṇābhāvāt | lolūyataityādāvapi yakāralopāpattivāraṇārthamacaḥ sattāmātrasvīkārāt | na ca tathā'pi nirdiṣṭaparibhāṣopasthānaṃ durvāramiti vācyam | "śnānnalopaḥ" itisūtre kṅitītyanuvṛttipakṣe hinastītyatra nalopo na syādityāpatteḥ satisaptamyā bhāṣye samādhānāt | nanu tat pūrvapakṣābhiprāyavarṇanamātram, paratvābhimatasaptamīsthale'pi saptamyā bhāvalakṣaṇatvāt, paratvārthakasaptamyā viśiṣya vidhyabhāvāt "iko yaṇaci" ityādāvapi nirdiṣṭaparibhāṣā'nupasthānaprasaṅgāt | satyam | tathā'pi viṣayasaptamītvasvīkārāt tatra tadanupasthānasya siddhāntasiddhatvāt | tathā ca śrūyamāṇatādaśāyāmeva yuḍāpattiḥ | na ca tadapekṣayā lopasyaiva pūrvaṃ pravṛttiriti vācyam | ṅiduddeśena vihitasya yuḍāgamasyānavakāśatayā balavattvāt | dīṅaḥ parasyājāderṅita ārddhadhātukasyānyasya durlabhatvāt | na ca ṅidityaṃśa uttarārtha eveti vācyam | sati sambhave kevalottarārthatvasya durvacatvāt | ata evākṛtavyūhaparibhāṣāyā api nāvatāraḥ | kāryiṇo ninittatvābhāvācca | nanvevaṃ cekṣiya ityādau guṇo'pi śrūyamāṇatādaśāyāmevāpādyatām, kiṃ sthānivad‌bhūtamakāramāśritya tadāpādaneneticet, satyam | sārvadhātuketyādiguṇasya "kṅiti ca" iti niṣedhāt, laghūpadhaguṇasya ca tamāśrityāpādayitumaśakyatvāt | tamādāyaiva laghūpadhatvasampatteḥ | anayoranyatra caritārthatayā tatra lopasyaiva prāthamyācceti vaiṣamyāt | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ | yattu vadanti---"yasya halaḥ" iti lopasya tvayā'pyavayavamātrapratiyogikatvaṃ svīkṛtam | tatra yadyapi dedyaka ityatra yuṭ‌ syāditi nāpādanārham, halaḥ paratvābhāvena yalopānupapattyā dedīyaka iti rūpābhyupagamāt, sanīsrasaka ityādau nalopo'pi sarvasaṃmatatvādeva nāpādyaḥ, yāyāyakaḥ, vāvāyakaḥ, ityādāvāto lopo'pi nāpādyaḥ | yalopaviraheṇājādikṅidārddhadātukaparatvābhāvāt, tathā'pi gameryaṅantāt ṇvuli jaṅgamaka ityatrāllopasya sthānivadbhāvād vṛddhyabhāvo yathā tathā upadhālopo'pi syāt | athātra "anaṅi" iti pratiṣedhaḥ, tarhi tarīdṛśaka ityatra "ṛdṛśo'ṅi" iti guṇaḥ syāt | athātrāṅgavṛttaparibhāṣayā "saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ" iti vā samādhānam, tarhi yaṅ‌lukyapi sanīsrasa ityatra nalopo yāyā vāvā ityādāvāto lopaśca na śaṅkyaḥ | samādhānasya tulyatvāditi | tadapi cintyam | "yasya halaḥ" iti lope'pi saṅghātapratiyogikatvasyaiva svīkartavyatvāt | na ca halaḥ parasya yasya lopaḥ syādārddhadhātuke ityasya "ādeḥ parasya" itiparibhāṣayā vyañjanamātre vyavasthāpitatvāt kathaṃ samudāyalopa iti vācyam | yenanāprāptinyāyena "yaṅo'cica" iti lopasyātolopāpavādatvāttavāpi tatra kathamavayavalopa ityasya tulyatvāt | na coktayogavibhāgena nirvāhaḥ | atrāpi "ato lopaḥ" ityasmādata ityanuvartya akārāntasya yasyetivyākhyāne viśeṣaṇasāmarthyād "ādeḥ parasya" iti na pravarttataiti samādheruktatvāt | vyañjanākārayoḥ samāhāradvandvaṃ kṛtvā dvayorlopavidhānasāmarthyāttadapravṛtterapi ca suvacatvāt | yasyetisaṅghātagrahaṇamitivāmanagranthadarśanācca | bebhiditā marīmṛjitā ityetatsūtrodāharaṇatayā prācīnalekhanasvārasyācca | prakṛtaniṣedhe ika ityanuvṛttyā pāpācaka ityatra "ata upadhāyāḥ" iti vṛddhernāyaṃ niṣedha ityuktatvācca | yaṅ‌lopasya saṅghātapratiyogikatvaṃ vinā tatroktavṛddhiprasaṅgasya durupapādatvāt | yattu yakārākārasamudāyāntargatasyaiva yakārasya lopo na tu aharyīd amavyīdityādau kevalasyāpīti vāmanavākyavyākhyānam, taccintyam | nirdeśe tādṛśatvasya vāraṇīyatvābhimate'pi sattvāt | lopapravṛttivelāyāṃ tathātvasya saṃgrāhye'pyabhāvāt | tanmate'pyatolopasya prāgevopagamāt | haradattīyatathāvyākhyānasya ca parakīyavyākhyānānuvādamātratayā tatsammatatvābhāvāt | ata eva prakāśakāraiḥ "yasya" iti lopasaryāvayavalopatve yaṅ‌luko'vayavalopapakṣe haradattoktadoṣānatidiśyopasaṃhṛtam | tasmātsūtraṃ sthāpayituṃ pravṛttairlukīva lope'pi samudāyanivṛttirevaiṣṭavyā | uktayuktīrvāmanavākyaṃ copaṣṭabhya haradattādigranthopamardārthameva pravṛttatvāditi | teṣāṃ hyayamabhiprāyaḥ---haradattāṃśe granthopamardo "yasya " iti lopasyāvayavalopatve tātparyābhāva iti vyākhyānam, ubhayatrāpyavayavalopavādināṃ tu dūṣaṇamevopamarda iti | etena pāpācaka iti yaṅantāṇṇvuli vṛddhirbhāṣyaviruddhetyapāstam | etatsūtrapratyākhyāne bhāṣyatātparyavirahe "yasya" iti saṃghātalope ajjhalādeśasya sthānivattvavirahād "ata upadhāyā" iti vṛddheḥ susthatvāt | etanniṣedhastu iglakṣaṇatvābhāvānna pravarttataityuktam | kiṃ ca "acaḥ parasmin‌" itisūtre'nāśrīyamāṇāyāṃ prakṛtau sthānivadrāva iti pakṣe napadāntasūtre dvirvacanavareyalopānāṃ grahaṇaṃ karttavyamiti bhāṣye vakṣyate | āśrīyamāṇāyāṃ prakṛtāvitila pakṣe hi dvirvacane'nacītiparyudāsena tatsadṛśasya hala evāśrayaṇam, na tvacaḥ | vare tvākāralope vidhīyamāne prakṛtirāśritaivāci kṅitīti, tat kathaṃ vareśabdagrahaṇamāpādyate ityāśaṅkya kaiyaṭenoktam--- yaṅa eva samudāyasya pratyayatvaṃ na tadavayavasyākārasyeti | ajādau pratyaye pare ākāralopasya vidhānādatrāprasaṅga eveti | tathā cātra kathaṃ tadāśraya uvaṅ‌, kathaṃ vā sambhāvitasyāpyatideśa ityatra bhāṣyakārādīnāṃ tātparyam | api ca jaṅgama ityādāvupadhālopādīnāṃ ṅittvopajīvināmāpādanamubhayeṣāmapyanupapannam | ṅakārasya yaṅi samudāyānubandhatvāt | akāramātrasya sthānivadbhāve'pi tasya yaṅ‌rūpatāyā durlabhatvāt | ata eva ramāyai ityādau "vṛddhireci" ityeva vṛddhirna tu "āṭaśca" iti dīkṣitairevoktamityavihitairvibhāvanīyamiti dik | kṅiti ca 5 | ighlakṣaṇe guṇavṛddhīyaṃ pratyayamāśrityate tasya gittve kittve ṅittveca sati na staḥ | kakārātpūrvaṃ cartvena tataśca kittvādyavacchinnakāraṇatānirūpyakāryatvasya guṇavṛddhyoḥ śabdaviṣayatve vṛtterapramāṇatvāpatteḥ | tatra śāstrasyāpi tātparye tu ṣoḍaśigrahaṇāgrahaṇavadvikalpāpatterityāstāntāvat | git | ik‌padānupasthityā phakaḥ kittve'pi tannimittako guṇo yathā syāt | ata eva kāmayataityatra kamerṇiṅo ṅittve'pi tamāśritya "ata upadhāyāḥ" iti vṛddhirdhātvakārasya bhavatyeva | āśrityeti kim | chinnam bhinnam ityādau laghūpadhaguṇo'pi yathā na syāt | atra ika ityanuvarttate guṇavṛddhī iti ca | tatra kṅitītyanena iko viśeṣaṇe kṅiti parato ya igityarthe "tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya" itiparibhāṣopasthitau nirdiṣṭaśabdasyāvyavahitoccāritārthakatayā citam stutam ityādau kidādyavyavahitapūrvavarttina eva iko guṇaniṣedhaḥ syāt, na tu bhinnimityādau | dakāreṇa vyavahitatvāt | tasmātkṅitīti guṇavṛddhiviśeṣaṇameva | tataśca neyaṃ parasaptamī, kṅiti pare guṇavṛddhyoravihitatvāt, anyathā vikalpāpatteḥ, kiṃ tu nimittatāmātre | tacca igante'vyavadhānena laghūpadhe vyavadhāneneti yathāprāptaṃ gṛhyate | anuvādasya yathāprāptaparatvaniyamāt | nimittatvamapi sārvadhātukatvādinā tattadvidhau śrūyamāṇena dharmeṇa | kṅidādau niṣedhasāmarthyādvidhivākyeṃṣu tadanullekhācca | yadyapi nimittatvaṃ saptamyartho viśiṣya noktaḥ, tathā'pi kṅiti sati prāpte ye guṇavṛddhī iti sambandhe arthāttatpratyayasya nimittatvaṃ paryavasyatītyāhuḥ | ralo vyupadhād ityādinā kittvātideśaścātra mānam | anyathā vyavadhānena guṇaniṣedhā pravṛttau tadarthakittvasya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ | vastutaḥ kṅitītyatra viśeṣyākāṅkṣāyāṃ pūrvasūtrasthārddhadhātukapadena tiṅ‌śidbhinnatve sati dhātvadhikāroktapratyayatvena rūpeṇa tatsamarpaṇe'pi viśiṣṭasyātra viśeṣyatvasvīkāre "sārvadhātukamapit" ityādīnāṃ vyarthatvāpattyā satyantamparityajya dhātvadhikāroktapratyayatvameva viśeṣyatāvacchedakam viśiṣṭavācakapadānāṃ sati bādhake viśeṣyamātraparatvasya lakṣaṇāṃ vinaiva svīkārāt | "śrotavyaḥ śrutivākyebhyaḥ" ityatra śrutiśabdasya pramāṇaśabdamātraparatvasvīkārāt | tataśca pratyayenāṅgasyopasthityā laghūpadhasyāṅgasyāvyavadhānādubhayatrāpi niṣedhasiddhiḥ | aṅgāpekṣasyaivāvyavadhānasya svīkārāt | idañcātraiva kaiyaṭe spaṣṭam | ihānye vaiyākaraṇā mṛjerajādau saṃkrame vibhāṣā vṛddhimārabhante kṅityaci vā iti pūrvasūtre bhāṣyam | saṃkramo guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhahetubhūtaḥ kṅitpratyayaḥ | pūrvācāryasaṅketāt | ajādau kṅiti pratyaye pare mṛjervikalpena vṛddhirbhavatīti tasyārthaḥ | mṛjanti mārjanti | atra haradattaḥ---"yasminvidhistadādāval‌grahaṇe" itiparibhāṣayaiva siddhau ajādāviti vacanaṃ mukhyājādigrahārtham | tena vyapadeśivadbhāvenājādau na bhavati | yathā yūyaṃ mamṛja tvayā mamṛje iti | atra kecit | tathā'pi mamṛjetyatra vikalpo durvāraḥ | "liṭi madhyamapuruṣabahuvacanasya thasya sthāne vidhīyamāno'kārādeśo'ntyasya prāpnoti | na caivaṃ vidhivaiyarthyam, thakārottarākārasya tatra svata eva sattvāditi vācyam | ṇalādīnāṃ yathāsaṅkhyasampādanena sārthakyādityāśaṅkya akāradvayātmako'yamādeśo'nekāl‌tvātsarvasya, yadvā---dhātorityadhikārāddhātoḥ parasya thasyākāravidhāne "ādeḥ parasya" iti paribhāṣayā thakārasyaivākāraḥ, ubhayathā'pi "ato guṇe" iti pararūpamiti bhāṣye spaṣṭam | tasya sthānivadbhāvena mukhyājāditvamastyeveti | anye tvāhuḥ---vyapadeśivadbhāvanibandhanājātitvasyeva sthānivattvanibandhanasyāpi tasya gauṇatāyā vaktuṃ śakyatvānnedaṃ sādhīyaḥ | kiṃ tu ajādāviti na vidhivākyaśarīram, yenoktamarthaṃ jñāpayet | kiṃ tu "kṅityaci vā" iti taduttarabhāṣyapaṭhitameva | pūrvabhāṣyasthāmajādipadaṃ tu acītyasya "yasmin" itiparibhāṣāsiddhārthānuvādamātram | ato na haradattoktaṃ yuktam | ata eva mamṛjetyatra gaṇapāṭhādeva vṛddhyabhāva iti ātreyaḥ | dhātuvṛttiṣvapi yūyaṃ mamṛja mamārja ityudāhṛtamiti | idaṃ cānyadavadheyam | kṅityeva viklapārambhāt dhātvaṃśalopanimittatvena vṛddhiniṣedhahetāvac‌pratyaye nāyaṃ vikalpa ityatroktam | tatsūtrapratyākhyānaprastāve tu atolopasya sthānivadbhāvamāśritya yathottaraṃ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyena vṛddhivikalpo bhavatyevetyuktam, taccintyam | sūtrārambhapakṣe yathārūpaṃ tathaiva tatpratyākhyāne'pīti tatra bhāṣyābhiprāyasyāvaśyakatvāt | tasya cātra haradattoktābhiprāyeṇaiva siddheriti dik | nanvacinot amārṭ‌ ityādau sthānivadbhāvena tibāderṅittvād guṇavṛddhiniṣedhāpattiḥ | na cānalvidhāviti tanniṣedhaḥ śaṅkyaḥ | anubandhakāryeṣu tadapravṛtteḥ | yuktaṃ caitat | anubandhānāmitsaṃjñakatvena ādeśātpūrvameva lopena sthāninyasaṃnidhānāt | ādeśaprayojyanivṛttipratiyogina eva sthānitvāt | lakārānubandhanivṛttyośca bhāvābhāvarūpādeśaprayojyatvāt | "anekāntā anubandhā" iti pakṣe tu teṣāṃ sthānikoṭipraveśasya dūrāpāstatvāt | jñāpakaṃ cātra "na lyapi" iti ītvaniṣedhaḥ | ktvāniṣṭhakittvasya sthānivadbhāvena lyapyapravṛttau kittvābhāvādeva ītvāprasaktyā tadvaiyarthyāpatteriti cet atra vārttikaṃ tāvat--- lakārasya ṅittvādādeśeṣu sthānivadbhāvaprasaṅga iti cet, yāsuṭo ṅidvayanātsiddhamiti | anyathā liṅ‌vadbhāvaprayuktaṅittvena tadādeśānāṃ ṅittve tadavayavasya yāsuṭo'pi tattvāt "yāsuṭ parasmaipadeṣūdātto ṅicca" iti ṅidvacanaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt | na ca stuyādityādau "uto vṛddhirluki hali" ityasyā uta iti nirdiṣṭasthānikatvenāniglakṣaṇāyāvṛddheḥ, cinuyurityādau "kṅiti ca" itiniṣedhāpavādasya "jusi ca" iti guṇasya ca pratiṣedhārthaṃ ṅidvacanamastu, punarṅittvasāmarthyaṃ vinā sthānivattvaprayuktaṅittvamātreṇa tanniṣedhasyānupapatteriti kathaṃ tasya jñāpakatvamiti vācyam | uta audityeva siddhe vṛddhigrahaṇena "saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ" iti vṛddhiniṣedhasiddheḥ | " ksasyāci" itiyasmādacītyanuvarttya ajādau jusi guṇavidhānāt yāsuṭi kṛte ca juso halāditvasaṃpatteḥ |
