brūtādityatra vārttikamate'pi na īḍāgamāpattiriti | dīdhīvevīṭām 6 | dīdhīveṣyoriṭaśca guṇavṛddhī na staḥ | ādīdhyanam ādīdhyakaḥ āvevyanam āvevyakaḥ akaṇiṣam araṇiṣam kaṇitā śvaḥ raṇitā śvaḥ aṅgasaṃjñāyāṃ tadādigrahaṇena mibādeśamamaṃ prati sijantamaṅgaṃ tibādeśaṃ ḍāśabdaṃ prati ca kaṇit ityaṅgam | tatroktādeśadvayasārvadhātukaṃ nimittīkṛtya prasaktasya laghūpadhaguṇasyāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ | tṛjantādau iṭaḥ pratyayāvayavatvena taduttarapratyayāntarābhāvādaṅgānantargatatvena ca guṇāprasaktyā luḍantatvādyotanāya śva ityuktam | ḍādeśaṃ prati tāsyantasyāṅgatayā tāsyavayavasya iṭo guṇaprasiktisaṃbhavāt | na ca dīṅ‌ kṣaye dhīṅ‌ anādare veñ‌ tantusantāne vī gatyādiṣu eṣāmeva grahaṇaṃ syāditi vācyam | "avayavaprasiddheḥ samudāyaprasiddhirbalīyasī" itinyāyāt | tanmātratātparyagrāhakānupūrvyantaraparityāgasāmarthyācca | iṭ‌ cāgama eva | na tu iṭa gatāviti dhātuḥ | kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇena sāhacaryasya niyāmakatvaniyamabhgasya jñāpitatvāt | atra vadanti | dīdhyako vevyaka iti śuddhayoreva dīdhīvevyo rūpam, na tu ṇyantayoḥ | ādīdhakaḥ āvevakaḥ ityeva rūpayostatra svīkārāt | yattu haradattenoktam---varṇagrahaṇasāmarthyāt śrūyamāṇaeva ivarṇe lopo na lupte, tena ṇyantābhyāṃ ṇvuli ṇilopasya pūrvavidhau sthānivattve'pi śrūyamāṇatvābhāvāllopābhāve yaṇi kṛte dīdhyako vevyaka iti śuddhasamānākārakameva rūpamiti, taccintyam | "nāglopi" itisūtragatabhāṣyavirodhāt | tatra varṇagrahaṇa lupte'pīvarṇe yathā syādityevamarthamityāśaṅkya sthānivadbhāvena siddherantaraṅgatvāṇṇilopātprāg "yīvarṇayoḥ" iti lopasiddheśca varṇagrahaṇasya pratyākhyātatvāt | bhāṣyakārānurodhena ca sādhutvasvīkārāditi | bhāṣyavārttikayostvetatsūtraṃ pratyākhyātam | dīdhīvevyośchāndasatvena loke prayogānarhatvāt | chandasi ca guṇadarśanāt | tathā ca---prajāpatirvai manasā yatkiñcinnādīdhet, hautrāya vṛtaḥ kṛpayannadīdhet, adīdhayurdāsarājñe vṛtāsa ityādi | chāndasattvenaitatsamādhānāpekṣayā ca kvacicch‌rūyamāṇaguṇābhāvasyaiva tena sādhayituṃ yuktatvāt | iṭo'pi grahaṇaṃ vyartham | iḍvidhau "neḍaśi kṛti" itisūtrādiḍ‌grahaṇamanuvarttya ekasya iṭ‌padasya vikārābhāvavatparatvena iṭ‌ vikārābhāvavāneveti vyākhyānena guṇābhāvasya siddhatvāt | na caivaṃ pipaṭhīrityādau "rvorupadhāyā dīrgha ikaḥ" iti dīrgho'pi na syāditi vācyam | tasya niyamaṃ pratyasiddhatvāt | yadvā niyamasyāṅgādhikārīyatvāttatratyasyaiva vikārasya niyamena vyāvṛttirityuktadīrghadvayaṃ nirbādhamiti bhāṣyakṛtaḥ | apāṭhīdityatrāpi "sijlopa ekādeśe siddho vaktavyaḥ" iti jñāpakātsavarṇadīrghaḥ | na ca "graho liṭi" ityasyāpyāṅgatvānniṣedhāpattiḥ | ārambhasāmarthyāditi kaiyaṭādayaḥ | vastutastu vikārapadasya ikāravṛttibhedapratiyogitāvacchedakajātimatparatayā tādṛśavikārasya ekārādirūpasyaiva niṣedho na tu dīrghasya | itvāvacchinnatvāttasyāpīti rahasyam | syādetat | pipaṭhīṃṣi brāhmaṇakulānītyatra "sānta mahataḥ saṃyogasya" iti dīrgho na syāt | siddhatvāt, āṅgatvāt, anyatra caritārthatvād, vaijātyānavacchinnatvācceti | atrāhuḥ---asādhurevoktaprayogaḥ | atolopasya sthānivadbhāvena jhalantatvābhāvāttallakṣaṇasya numo durlabhatvāt | na ca tarhyajantatvādeva num syāditi vācyam | ajantatvaprayuktasya numaḥ sakārottarameva prasakteḥ | sāntasaṃyogābhāvena tasya sthānivattvāsambhavāt | pipaṭhiṣa ityajantasya lopapūrvadaśāyāmakārāpekṣayā pūrvatvābhāvāt | na hyakāraviśiṣṭasyākārātpūrvatvam | bādhāt | na ca "kkau luptaṃ na sthānivad‌" itiatolopasya sthānivattvābhāvājjhalantalakṣaṇo num syādeveti vācyam | kkau vidhiṃ prati na sthānivadityasyaivārthasya vyavasthitatvāt | lavamācakṣāṇa ityarthe tatkarotīti ṇyantāt lavaśabdāt kvipi "ṇeraniṭi" iti ṇilope kṛte vakārasya ūṭhi karttavye ṇinimittakasyātolopasya sthānivadbhāvo mā bhūdityarthakatvāt | sukhīyatisutīyatibhyāṃ kvipi allopayalopayoḥ kṛtayoḥ allopasya sthānivattvena yaṇādeśo mā bhūdityetadarthaṃ kvau luptamityasyāśrayaṇe'pi tasyāsārvatrikatvāt iti napadāntasūtre vakṣyamāṇatvāt | prakṛte ca numaḥ kvimnimittakatvābhāvena kvau vidhimityasyāpravṛtteḥ | halo'nantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ 7 | ajbhiravyavahitā halaḥ saṃyogasaṃjñāḥ syuḥ | pradeśāḥ "saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ" ityādayaḥ | halaḥ kim | titaupade saṃyogāntalopo mā bhūt | na ca "tanoterḍauḥ sanvacca" ityatra ukāroccāraṇasāmarthyādeva tadabhāvasiddhiriti vācyam | bhasaṃjñāsthale saṃyogāntalopaprasaktyabhāvena tatra tatsārthakyāt | nanu antaraśabdena sahāyaṃ bahuvrīhirantarāśabdena vā | ādye antaraśabdasyādheyavācitayā halapekṣayā vijātīyavarṇaśūnyasya saṃjñāyāmavagrahe'pi saṃyogasaṃjñāsiddhiḥ | tatra hi matadvayam | mātrākālavyavadhānena varṇāntaramuccāryate ityekam, arddhamātrākālavyavadhānenetyaparam, ubhayathā'pi kālavyavadhāne'pi varṇāntaravyavadhānābhāvāt | dvitīye tu ādhārasya kālasyāpi vyavadhānaniṣedhāt avagrahe saṃyogasaṃjñā na syāt, haluccāraṇasamayadhvaṃsādhikaraṇasamayadhvaṃsānadhikaraṇasamayavṛttyuccāraṇapratiyogitvasya aj‌vyavadhāne iva kālavyavadhāne'pi virahāt iti viśeṣasattvāditi cet--- atra bhāṣyakārāḥ naiva doṣo naiva prayojanamiti | pakṣadvayamapyado tapamiti tasyārthaḥ | na cāpsu ityādau saṃyogasattve gurutvād "guroranṛtaḥ" iti pluto na tvanyatheti kathamubhayābhāva iti vācyam | adhikaraṇavṛtteḥ tasya dūraddhūtasaṃbandhābhāvāt | vicāryamāṇānā mityādau tu vākyasya ṭereva plutavidhānena gurusaṃjñāyā anapekṣitatvāt | na cāpsu bhavo'psavyaḥ digāditvādyat "apo yoniyanmatuṣu" iti saptamyā aluk, tatsaṃbuddhau dūrāddhūtasaṃbandhātphalabhedāpattiriti vācyam | evaṃvidhe viṣaye avagrahasya padakārairakaraṇāttathaiva saṃpradāyāt | na cāsu yonirvā'śva ityatra viśeṣaḥ syāditi vācyam | samāsapadānāmanto'vagṛhyataiti padakārasaṃpradāyāttatrāpi suśabdātpūrvamavagrahābhāvāditi kaiyaṭādayaḥ | iyaṃ ca saṃjñā samudāyasya, nāvayavamātrasya, saṃyujyante'sminsamudāye varṇā ityanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānāt | anyathā niryāyādityādau rephayakārayoḥ pratyekaṃ saṃyogasaṃjñāyāṃ yakārasyāpi saṃyogāditvād "vā'nyasya saṃyogādeḥ" ityetvaṃ syāt, gleyādityādivat | na ca siddhānte'pi "aco rahābhyām" iti dvitvena yakāradvayasampattyā syādevoktadoṣa iti vācyam | tasyāsiddhatvena saṃyogasaṃjñāyā aniṣpatteḥ | kiṃ ca pratyekasaṃjñāpakṣe saṃhṛṣīṣṭetyatra "ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ" iti iṭ‌, saṃhriyataityatra "guṇo'rttisaṃyogādyoḥ " iti guṇaśca syāt | caramavarṇasya saṃyogatayā ṛkārekārayoḥ saṃyogāditvasaṃmpatteḥ | dṛṣatkarotītyatra kakārasya saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ syāt | dakārasya saṃyogatve tadantatvasya sattvāt | śaktā vastā ityatra "skoḥ" iti saṃyogādyoḥ sakārakakārayorlopaḥ syāt | takārasya jhalaḥ parataḥ sattvāt | niryātaḥ ityādau "saṃyogāderāto dhātoryaṇvataḥ " iti niṣṭhānatvaṃ ca syāt | yadi tu "vā'nyasya saṃyogādeḥ " ityatra saṃyogādityetāvataika saṃyogātparo ya ākārastadantasyāṅgasya etvamityarthalābhādādigrahaṇasāmarthyādabhedaikatvasaṃkhyaiva vṛttau bhāsataiti niyamaṃ tiraskṛtyaṃ saṃyogāvādī syetyupasarjanārthasyāpi dvitvāvagatiriti saṃyogadvayādereva etvamiti sūtrārthānniryāyādityatra nātivyāptiḥ | evam "ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ" "guṇo'rtisaṃyogādyoḥ" ityatrāpi vyākhyeyam | "saṃyogāntasya" ityatrāpi pūrvanyāyena saṃyogadvayāntasya lopavidhānānna dṛṣatkarotītyatra doṣāpattiḥ | "skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ" ityatrāpi sakārakakāragatadvitvāpekṣayā saṃyogayorityeva siddhe ādigrahaṇabalād jhali parato yaḥ saṃyogaḥ padānte ca yaḥ saṃyogaḥ tasyādiḥ samīpo yaḥ kakāraḥ sakāraśca tayorlopavidhānam | tena śaktā vastā ityatra nātiprasaṅgaḥ | "saṃyogāderātaḥ" ityatrāpi saṃyogādāta ityeva saṃyogātparo ya ākārastadantāddhātoḥ parasya niṣṭhātakārasya natvamityarthena siddhe ādigrahaṇavaśātsaṃyogadvayādilābhānniryāta ityatra noktadoṣa iti kalpyate | tathā'pi pratipattigauravam, pratyekaṃ saṃyogasaṃjñāyāḥ kvacidapyanupayoge tatsvīkāravaiyarthyaṃ cetyavadheyam | hala iti bahutvaṃ cāvivakṣitam | anyathā śikṣetyādau "gurośca halaḥ" ityapratyayānupapatteḥ | na caivamajavyavahitasyaikasyāpi saṃyogasaṃjñāpattiḥ | avayavārthānurodhena dvayoravaśyamapekṣitatvāt | yatra tu bahūnāṃ halāmavyavadhānaṃ tatrāviśeṣeṇa dvayorbahūnāṃ ca saṃjñā | na caikājdirvacananyāyaḥ samudāyakāryeṇāvayavānāṃ kāryasaṃpattereva tadbrījatvāt | nij ityasya dviruktau tadantargatānāṃ sarveṣāmekācāṃ dvirvacananirvāhāt | iha ca bahūnāṃ saṃjñaya dvayostatkāryāsiddhiriti vaiṣamyāt | tathā hi | saṃsvaryataityatra "guṇo'rti" iti na syāt | gomānkarotītyatra gomān t s karoti iti sthite takārasya saṃyogāntalopo na syāt | maṅktetyatra "masjinaśorjhali" iti numāgame man s j iti sthite sakārasya saṃyogāditvābhāvāt "skoḥ" iti lopo na syāt | nirgleyādityādau rephaghaṭitasaṃyogasyāṅgāditvābhāvāt aṅgādeśca gakāralakārasamudāyasya saṃyogasaṃjñatvābhāvādetvaṃ na syāt | evaṃ nirglāna ityatra natvaṃ na syāt | athaivam indidrīyiṣatīti na sidhyati | tathā hi---tatra nakāradakāraghaṭita ekaḥ dakārarephaghaṭitaścānya iti dvau saṃyogau uktarītyā ca nakārasyeva dakārasyāpi saṃyogāditvād "nandrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ" iti dvitvaniṣedhe rīśabdasyaiva dvitve indrirīyiṣatīti rūpaṃ syāditi cet, satyam | tatra hi karmadhārayottarapañcamyantamajāderitipadam "ajāderdvitīyasya" iti sūtrādanuvarttate | ādibhūtādacaḥ pare saṃyogādayo nadarā dvirnocyantaiti sūtrārthaḥ | tataśca dakārasya saṃyogāditve'pyādibhūtādacaḥ paratvābhāvānniṣedhāpravṛttau drīśabdasya dvitve halādiḥ śeṣe'bhyāsasya hrasve ca siddhamiṣṭam | evaṃ ca āderacaḥ parasyaikāco dvitīyatvavyāpyatvāttatsūtre dvitīyapadaṃ nopādeyameveti niṣkarṣaḥ | mukhanāsikāvacano'nunāsikaḥ 8 | mukhayutanāsikayoccāryamāṇo varṇo'nunāsikasaṃjñaḥ syāt | abhra ām̐ apaḥ | "āṅo'nunāsikaścandasi" iti ā ityasyānunāsikaḥ | prāṇyaṅgatvena samāhāradvandve klībatvena nāsikavacana ityāpattivāraṇāya madhyamapadalopisamāsāśrayaṇam | nipātanādyathāśrutasya sādhutve tu mukhanāsikavacana ityasādhu | "abādhakānyapi nipātanāni' iti pakṣe tu tadapi sādhu | yadvā---mukhanāsikapadaṃ kṛtvā īṣadarthakanañsamāsavyutpannena tādṛśāṅ‌pūrveṇa vā vacanapadena samāsaḥ | bhāgasya mukhena bhāgasya nāsikayā coccāraṇādīṣattvam | idaṃ ca pūrvaparayorbhāgayormadhye eko bhāgo mukhenoccāryate dvitīyastu nāsikayā | tatra nāsikāvacanabhāgoparāgavaśānmukhavacanabhāgasyāpi nāsikāvacanavadbhānam | yathā sam̐yyantetyādau anunāsikayakārādyuparāgādakārasyāpyanunāsikatvena pratītiriti matamāśrityoktam | yadā tu mukhasya nāsikāyāścāntarālavarttisthānāntaramevaitaduccāraṇe nimittam, tadā mukhopasaṃhitā nāsiketi samāsaḥ | padadvayasya svārthāntarāladeśe lakṣaṇāt | arddhamantarvedi minotyarddham̐ bahirvedītyasyeva tadantarāle | tatrādyapakṣe prāsādavāsinyāyaḥ | yathā prāsādavāsinastadgrahaṇena bhūmivāsinastadgrahaṇena kevalaṃ gṛhyante | ubhayavāsinastu prāsādabāsigrahaṇena bhūmivāsigrahaṇena ca gṛhyante | grāhakatāvacchedakadharmadvayāvacchinnatvāt | uttaramatadvaye tu na tadavatāra iti spaṣṭameva | atha padasaṃskārapakṣe vacanapadaṃ karaṇalyuḍantam | ucyate'neneti vyutpādya paścānmukhanāsikāpadena sambadhyate | antaraṅgatvātpravṛttaśca padasaṃskāro bahiraṅgeṇa padāntarānvayadaśāyāṃ pratīyamānena strītvena na bādhyataiti ṅīppratyayo na bhavati | prathamameva strītvavivakṣāyāṃ tu mukhanāsikāvacanīka ityapi nirbādham | evaṃ ca mukhanāsikā vacanaṃ yasya mukhanāsikamavacanaṃ yasyeti vā bahuvrīhiriti bhāṣyamatam | kecittu rājabhojanāḥ śālaya itivat karmaṇi lyupratyayaṃ bāhulakāt svīkṛtya karmaṣaṣṭhyā samāsa ityāhuḥ | atra mukhagrahaṇaṃ kim yamānusvārāṇāmeva mā bhūditi bhāṣyam | asyārthaḥ---madhyamadarśane nāsikāvacanapadena ubhayasthānako varṇo na gṛhyeta, kiṃ tu yamānusvārā eva | teṣāṃ mataviśeṣe eva kevalanāsikāsthānatvāt | tathā ca taittirīyaprātiśākhyam---"nāsikyā nāsikāsthānā mukhanāsikyā vā" iti | tathā ca "āṅo'nunāsikaḥ" ityādau vidhisthale taeva vidhīyeran | "viḍ‌vanoranunāsikasyād‌" ityādyanuvādasthale tu anuvādasya yathāprāptaviṣayakatvaniyamāt yamānusvāraparasya ca viḍādipratyayasyāsiddherapratipattireva syāt | atastaddarśane mukhapadaṃ sārthakam | ādyamate tu nāsikāvacanapadenaiva prāsādavāsinyāyena mukhavacanānāmapi grahaṇasabhavāttadvyarthameva | na ca yamānusvārānādāyātiprasaṅgaḥ | anuvāde yamānusvārāṇāmasaṃbhavāt, vidhau ca sthānino mukhanāsikāvacanatvāt tadantaratamatvena mukhanāsikāvacanasyaivādeśatvātkevalanāsikāvacanānāṃ yamādīnāmāntaratamyābhāvādevātiprasaṅgabhaṅgāt | taduktaṃ bhāṣyakṛtā--- naiva doṣo naiva prayojanam iti | tathā ca teṣāmapi saṃjñāvidhāne doṣābhāvāt mukhapadaṃ na deyameveti sthitam | nāsikāpadatyāge tu kacaṭatapānāmapi syāt | tataśca śakta ityatra kakārasya pakva ityatra cakārasya taptamityatra pakārasya ca lopaḥ syāt | odanapagityādau "anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ" iti dīrghaśca syāt | atra vadanti | vargeṣvāditaścaturṇāṃ pañcame pare madhye pūrvavarṇasamānākāraṃ varṇāntaraṃ prātiśākhye svāgamatvena vihitaṃ yamasaṃjñam | yamalajātayoḥ prāyeṇa sārūpyadarśanādyama iva yama iti gauṇyeyaṃ saṃjñā | yathā pilik‌knī cakh‌vnatuḥ ag‌gniḥ agh‌ghnan ityatra kakhagaghebhyaḥ parabhāge tattatsadṛśo'yamāgamaḥ | iyantu yamotpattirakhaṇḍapade eveti tu pramāṇābhāvādupekṣyam | parabhāge iti mūlagranthena pūrvāvayavatvasyaiva lābhāt | ata eva chāndogyalakṣaṇapraṇeturaudavrajisaṃjñasyācāryasya sūtram "anantyāntyasaṃyoge madhye yamaḥ pūrvasya guṇaḥ" iti | anantyā ādyāścatvāraḥ | antyā ṅakārādayaḥ | guṇaḥ pūrvasya bhaktaḥ, tadavayava iti yāvat | yattu vivaraṇakārairuktam---vargapañcamayuktāḥ prathamādayo yamā iti, taccintyam | ayogavāhatvapratipādakahayavaraṭ‌sūtrīyabhāṣyavirodhāt | kevalanāsikāsthānatvaparoktabhāṣyavirodhācceti | atradaṃ vicāraṇīyam | caturṇāmādyavarttināmevānunāsikaguṇatvena bhedāttajjātīyatve'pi sānunāsikayakārādivadaṇ‌sūpadiṣṭaiḥ svasavarṇairagṛhītatvādyuktamevāyogavāhatvam | na hi niranunāsikāḥ kādayo'ṇ‌madhye paṭhyante, yenaiṣāmapi grahaṇakaśāstreṇaiva saṃgrahasiddhau ayogavāhatvapratipādanavirodhaḥ syāt | tasmātsānunāsikaniranunāsikabhedena kādīnāṃ dvaividhyamityeva bhāṣyāditātparyam, na tu kādivṛttivarṇatvasākṣādvyāpyajātyabhāvavattāyām | mānābhāvāt | ata eva kum̐ khum̐ gum̐ ghum̐ iti nyāsādigranthāḥ saṅgacchante | kum̐ ityasya tattadvargādyakṣaraparatvāt | khum̐ ityādeśca vargadvitīyādyakṣaraparatvāt | anunāsikatvamātrasya cādhikasyopādānāt | nāpi dvitīyo virodhaḥ | am̐ ityādīnāṃ bhāgamātraṃ nāsikyam | yamānusvārāṇāṃ tu mukhanāsikyatve'pi prāsādavāsinyāyenānunāsikatvamapyasti, na tu tadīyaṃ bhāgamātraṃ tathā, ityevaṃ paratvasya bhavadbhirevoktatvāt | etenāditaścaturṇāṃ tadasambhava evetyapāstam | pramāṇasattve bādhakābhāvāt | nanu guṇānāmabhedakatvādeva teṣāṃ pratyāhārāntarbhāvasambhavādayogavāhānāmaṭ‌sūpadeśaparabhāṣyavārttikavirodha eveti cet, maivam | ayogavāhapadena teṣaāṃ saṃgrahe'pi visarjanīyajihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyānusvārāṇāmeva tatropadeśaprayojanasyoktatvena yamānāṃ prayojanasya tatra kutrāpyanuktatvāt tathā'pi pratyāhāraviśeṣapuraskāreṇaiva tanniyamasampādanārthakatvena tadavirodhācca yamānāṃ tatropadeśe tātparyābhāvanirṇayāt | yattūktam---naiva doṣo naiva prayojanamiti bhāṣyavirodhaḥ, tvanmate yad‌ ghnantītyādau "yaro'nunāsike" ityasya pravṛttyā doṣasyodbhaṭatvāditi, tadapyasat | dvirvacanavidhyekavākyatāpannayartvasyaiva teṣu niyatatvena satyapi yamānāṃ yarantarbhāve anunāsikatvādividhyekavākyatāpannayartvasya bādhābhyupagamāt | evaṃ ca yamānāṃ vyañjanaparatvaniyamena "anaci ca" ityasya tatra kadācidapyapravṛttyā phalato yamāṃśe yartvādibādha eva paryavasyatīti siddham | guṇānāmabhedakatve'pi yamānāṃ na tattatkāryapravṛttiriti | tasmādyamānāmayogavāhatvapratipādakabhāṣyasya teṣāṃ tattatpratyāhāraviśeṣāntarbhāvaprayuktakāryānudāharaṇavyājena tattatpratyāhārānantarbhāvavidhānaeva tātparyam | anyathā antarbhāvaprayuktakāryābhāve tadvidhānavaiyarthyāt | aprasaktasya ca niṣedhānarhatvāt | prasakteśca varṇāntaratvapakṣe varṇasamāmnāyamadhyānupadeśenānupapannatvāt | kakārādimadhyaevāntarbhāvaḥ saṃmataḥ | tathā sati hi guṇānāmabhedakatvena khaphachaṭhetyādibhistatsaṃgrahe prasakte bhavati niṣedhopapattiḥ | tasmādanyathā'nupapannamuktabhāṣyagranthameva paruskṛtya vakṣyamāṇavākyānāṃ varṇāntaratvatātparyeṇa vyākhyānaṃ pratyādeśyam | ekaṃ brahmāstramādāya nānyaṃ gaṇayataḥ kvacit | āste na dhīravīrasya bhaṅgaḥ saṅgarakeliṣu || iti nyāyāt | tathā hi---sparśā yamā anunāsikāḥ svātpareṣu sparśeṣvanāsikeṣu iti prātiśākhye svapadasya vargādyakṣaracatuṣṭayaparatvāt tatpareṣvanunāsikasparśe vargāntyavarṇeṣu anunāsikatvaviśiṣṭāḥ sparśāḥ prathamādyāḥ yamasaṃjñā bhavantītyarthasya spaṣṭatayā sparśasaṃjñayā ca kutra varṇāntaratve tātparyam | etena "pradodhruvacch‌vaśuṣu" ityatroṣmasaṃjñakaśakārā diṣūpasthānīyasya chakārāderyamavāraṇāya pravṛttena " sparśasyoṣmaprakuteḥ parastādyamāpattiḥ" itisūtre parastācchabdadarśanādvarṇāntaratvamityapāstam | parastācchabdenāgamatvamātralābhe'pi varṇāntaratvasya lābhe uktisambhavābhāvāt | yadapi nāradīyaśikṣāyām--- anantyaśca bhavetpūrvo hyantyasya parato yadi | tatra madhye yamastiṣṭhetsavarṇaḥ pūrvavarṇayoḥ || savarṇaḥ sadṛśaḥ | dvitvamapi vivakṣitam | yajña ityādau jakāradvayasattve'pi "jmayā atra vasavo rantidevā" ityādau jakāradvayābhāvāditi tadvyākhyātāra iti, tadapyakiñcitkaram | āgame āgamivṛttivarṇatvavyāpyajātyabhāvavattvarūpasya varṇāntaratvasya tato'navagamāt sāvarṇyasya guṇabhedenaiva nirvāhāt | audavrajisūtre'pi guṇatvasyaiva lābhāt | "aśarīraṃ yamaṃ prāhuḥ" iti gautamaśikṣāyāścārthastairevoktaḥ | aśarīraṃ svarabhaktyādivad vyañjakalipiviśeṣaśūnyam | lakṣaṇavaśenaiva tadīyasthalaviśeṣaniścayasambhavāllipisampradāyapravarttakācāryaiḥ svarabhakteriva yamasyāpi vyañjakībhūtā lipirna kalpiteti yāvat | "ralayorūṣmaṇi pare madhye svarabhaktiḥ" iti śikṣādiprasiddheḥ | yatra tu naivaṃvidhalakṣaṇena sthalāvadhāraṇaṃ karttuṃ śakyate, tatrāgatyā lipyantaraṃ pravarttitam, yathā visargādāviti | na tvetāvatā varṇāntaratvasiddhiḥ | anvayadṛṣṭānte varṇāntaratve'pi vyatirekadṛṣṭānte tadabhāvāt | anyathā tadanuktyā śikṣādau vibhāgasya nyūnatvāpatteḥ | yadapi pāṇinīyaśikṣāyām--- triṣaṣṭiścatuḥ ṣaṣṭirvā varṇāḥ sambhavato matāḥ | prākṛte saṃskṛte cāpi svayaṃ proktāḥ svayambhuvā || svarā viṃśatirekaśca sparśāḥ syuḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ | yādayaśca smṛtā hyaṣṭau catvāraśca yamāḥ smṛtāḥ || anusvāravisargau ca ḥkaḥpau cāpi rarāśrayau | duspaṣṭaśceti vijñeyā lṛkāraḥ pluta eva ca || tatra aiuṛvarṇānāṃ hrasvadīrghaplutabhedāt dvādaśa, lṛkārasya hrasva eva, ecāṃ dīrghaplutabhedādaṣṭāviti acāmekaviṃśatiḥ | sparśāḥ kādayo māvasānāḥ | yaralavaśaṣasahetyaṣṭau | yamāścatvāraḥ | prathamatvadvitīyatvatṛtīyatvacaturthatvopādhibhedāt | anusvārādayaścatvāraḥ spaṣṭāḥ | duspṛṣṭastu bāh‌vṛcye prasiddhaḥ | evaṃ triṣaṣṭiḥ, lṛkārasya plutatvasambhavāttena saha catuḥ ṣaṣṭiriti | atra yamānāṃ pṛthaggaṇanāt spaṣṭameva varṇāntaratvamiti, tadapyasat | na hyatra ekasaṃkhyeyavṛttivarṇatvavyāpyajātyabhāvavattvaṃ saṃkhyeyāntarasya niyatam | hrasvādyakārādau tādṛśyā atvādijāteḥ sattvāt | tathā ca kutracijjātibhedena kutracid guṇabhedena gaṇanasyātra darśanāt yamāṃśe'pi kādivṛttijātyabhāve prāmāṇyamastyeveti vaktumaśakyatvāt | na caivaṃ yādīnāmaṣṭatvānupapattiḥ, yavalānāṃ guṇabhedena dvaividhyāditi vācyam | tatrobhayasādhāraṇajātereva vibhājakatvenābhimatatvāt | svatantrecchasya maharṣerniyogapratyanuyogānarhatvāt | tātparyasya coktarītyā vighaṭitatvāt | tasmādvivaraṇamatameva ramaṇīyamiti sūkṣmamīkṣaṇīyam | tulyāsyaprayatnaṃ savarṇam 9 | tālvādisthānamābhyantaraprayatnaścetyubhayaṃ yayorvarṇayostulyaṃ tayoḥ parasparaṃ savarṇasaṃjñā syāt | pradeśāḥ "akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ" ityādayaḥ | uttarapade dvandvagarbhaḥ, tatpuruṣagarbhaḥ, pūrvapade tatpuruṣagarbhaḥ, tripado vā bahuvrīhiriti catvāro'tra pakṣāḥ | tatrādyo vyākhyātaḥ | āsyaṃ ca prayatnaśca āsyaprayatnau tau tulyāvasyetyarthasyokteḥ | āsye prayatna āsyaprayatnaḥ | na ca "amūrddhamastakātsvāṅgādakāme" iti saptamyā alugāpattiḥ | taddhitāntasyāsyaśabdasya svāṅgamātravācitvābhāvāt | sa tulyo'syeti dvitīyaḥ | tulya āsye tulyāsyaḥ, mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsādhuḥ | tādṛśaḥ prayatno yasyeti tṛtīyaḥ | tulya āsye prayatno yasyeti caturthaḥ | anekapadopādānasāmarthyena tripadasyāpi bahuvrīheraṅgīkārāt | tulyaśabdasya tulayā saṃmita iti vyutpattāvapi sadṛśamātre rūḍhiḥ, pravīṇādivat | āsyaśabde ca nānāvidhā vyutpattiḥ | asyante uccāryante varṇā anenetyāsyam | bāhulakātkaraṇe ṇyat | yadvā---āsyandate'nnaṃ prāpya dravībhavatītyāsyam | "anyeṣvapi" iti ḍaḥ | atha vā annena dravīkriyate ityāsyam | antarbhāvitaṇyarthātkarmaṇi ḍaḥ | syādetat | evamaniyatāvayavārthapradarśanapareṇa bhāṣyeṇāsyaśabdasya mukhe rūḍhirvivakṣitā | tathā ca rūḍherbalavattvād‌ avayavārthamātreṇa tālvādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ na sambhavati | "laukikamāsyam oṣṭhātprabhṛti prākkākalakāt" iti bhāṣyokteḥ | evaṃ ca tadupādānaṃ vyartham | sarvavarṇānāmāsyaeva niṣpatteḥ | na ca nāsikyeṣu vyabhicāraḥ | nāsikā hi na bāhyā varṇotpattau nimittam, tatra jihvāgrādisaṃyogābhāvāt, kiṃ tarhi āsyāntaścarma vitatamasti, tatsambaddhā rekhā nāsikā, tasyāṃ vāyvabhighātādvarṇotpattiriti siddhāntāt | visargasya kaiściduraḥ sthānasvīkāre'pi tasya sāvarṇyābhāve'pi doṣābhāvāt | prayatnamātrasāmyavivakṣāyāṃ ca jabagaḍadānāṃ spṛṣṭaprayatnasāmyātsāvarṇyāpattiḥ | bhāṣye śakārasyāpyupādānaṃ tu saṃpātāyātam | vivṛtatvena prayatnabhedāt | tataśca ūrgja ityādau "jharo jhari savarṇe" iti lopaḥ syāt | ūrgannam | "pañcamyāmajātau" iti ḍaḥ | evaṃ prāpte nyāsabhedena siddhāntamāha vārttikakāraḥ--- siddhantvāsye tulyadeśaprayatnaṃ savarṇam iti | asyārthaḥ---āsye yeṣāṃ tulyo deśaḥ prayatnaśca te savarṇasaṃjñāḥ | uktasthale tu deśabhedānnātivyāptiḥ | āsyeti prayatnaviśeṣaṇārtham | tena bāhyaprayatnavyāvṛttiḥ | tathā ca deśāṃśe tasya vaiyarthye'pi na kṣatiḥ | bāhyaprayatnāśca vivārādayo mahāprāṇāntā aṣṭau bhāṣye kaṇṭhoktāḥ | nanvevamapyakārasya savarṇasaṃjñā na syāt, kākalakasyādhastādupajatrusthānamavarṇasyeti kaiścidaṅgīkārāt, tasya coktāsyabahirbhāvāt | maivam | sarvameva mukhamavarṇaniṣpattau vyāpriyataityabhyupagamāt | na ca tathā'pi tasyāsyameva deśo na tvāsye deśa ityuktānupapattisāmyam | vyapadeśivadbhāvena siddheḥ | āsyaśabdasya sarvāvasthāviśiṣṭāsyaparatvāt | deśaśabdasya tu avarṇotpattihetvavasthāviśiṣṭatatparatvāditi | bhāṣyakārāstvāhuḥ---āsye bhavamāsyam, śarīrāvayavādyat | "halo yamām" iti yalopaḥ | na cāllopasya sthānivattvam | yalope tanniṣedhāt | tathā cāsyapadādeva sthānalābhe sūtrabhaṅgo na yuktaḥ | na ca bāhyaprayatnabhede sāvarṇyānāpattiḥ | prārambho yatnasya prayatna iti vyutpattyaiva tadvyāvṛtteḥ | bāhyānāṃ varṇotpattipaścādbhāvitvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | astu vā prayatnapadaṃ yathāśrutameva | bāhyabhede'pyābhyantarasāmyena sāvarṇyasiddheḥ | yāvatprayatnasāmyavivakṣāyāṃ prayojanābhāvāt | sthānaikye sati yatkiñcit‌prayatnasāmyasyaivānatiprasaktatvāt | na caivamapi avarṇasya eṅośca sāvarṇyāpattiḥ, tatra bhāgavivekasya susthatvāditi vācyam | tayoravarṇasya vivṛtataratvāt eṅāmaicāṃ ca sthānabhedādeva tadanāpatteḥ | "eoṅ‌" ityādisūtre pṛthaganubandhasāmarthyādaicoḥ pṛthaṅ‌nirdeśācceti tatraivoktam | etena aicāvapi vyākhyātau sthānabhedācca | na ca tathā'pyudāttānudāttānāṃ sāvarṇyaṃ na syāt, prayatnabhedāditi vācyam | svarūpamātrasatāṃ guṇānāmabhedakatvamiti svīkārāt | yattu bhāṣyakārasya prauḍhimātrametat | tathā hi---ejavayavāvarṇena saha sāvarṇyamāpādyatauta ejbhireva | nādyaḥ | gavyaṃ nāvyamityatra "yasyeti ca" iti lopāpattiritikaiyaṭavivaraṇādigranthavirodhāt | uttarabhāgena vyavadhānāt | karttṝṇāmityādau ṇatvārthaṃ "vyavāye'pi" iti yogavibhāgasya bhāṣyakārairevoktatvāt | na cottarabhāga evāvarṇasadṛśa iti vācyam | agne ehītyādau pūrvarūpasya bhāṣyaevāpāditatvāt tadvirodhāt | jātyantaratvasyaiva tatra siddhāntitatvācca | nāntyaḥ | praśliṣṭāvarṇāvityādihetvanupapatteḥ | hetvantarasyaiva vācyatvāt | ata eva ivarṇovarṇayorecaśca na sāvarṇyamiti | tatredaṃ vācyam---kimavayavasya sāvarṇyamiti śaṅkaivātrānavakāśā | avarṇasya eṅośca savarṇasaṃjñā prāpnotīti spaṣṭameva bhāṣye uktatvāt | nanu sandhyakṣareṣu prathamabhāgasyākāreṇa sādṛśyatsavarṇasaṃjñāprāptiriti kaiyaṭoktāyāmāpātanikāyāṃ tathā pratīyataiti cenna | tad‌dvārā'pyavarṇasya sādṛśyamastīti tadbhāvamuktvā nāvyamityatra yasyetilopāpatteḥ taduktādyavivaraṇaeva saṅgamitatvāt | tathā ca kaiyaṭādyuktayasyetilopaprasaṅgavirodhena bhāṣyasya prauḍhivādatvamupapādayatā kaiyaṭoktāpātanikāyā avarṇaparatvasya śaṅkitumapyaśakyatvāt | praśliṣṭāvarṇāviti hetvanupapattistu eṅaṃśe vivṛtatarāvarṇāvetāviti hetvantarasyaivoktatvāt | nādyaḥ | tatrāvayavasya pṛthakatvena graho nāstīti hetoḥ susthatvāt | aicostu sphuṭo'kārasya pratibhāso'stīti pratyāhārāhnike bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoreva sthitatvāt | etena tadavayavākārasyāpi sāvarṇyāpattirnirastā | evamikārokārayorapīti bodhyam | tathā ca tatra bhāṣyam--- yadatrāvarṇaṃ vivṛtataraṃ tadanyasmādavarṇāt ye apīvarṇovarṇe vivṛtatare te anyābhyāmivarṇovarṇābhyāmiti | kaiyaṭenāpyuktam---tadevamākārādisthasyāvayavasya bhedenāgrahaṇādagrahaṇam, sandhyakṣarasthasya tvasāvarṇyāt, ṛkārasthastu bhedena pratibhāsād gṛhyataiti nuḍādisiddhiriti | ākārādītyādipadameṅ‌param | sandhyakṣarapadamaic‌param | gṛhyate rephagrahaṇenetyarthaḥ | nanvevamavayavībhūtākārasya sāvarṇyāpattiparihāre'pi ecāṃ tadāpattau samādhānānuktitādavasthyameveti ced, maivam | tarhi ecām akāreṇa sāvarṇyāpattireva nāstītyucyatām, kṛtaṃ samādhānānuktyudbhāvanena | avayavasāvarṇyadvārā teṣāṃ sāvarṇyāpattirastīti cet, tarhi tatparihāradvārā teṣāṃ tatparihāra iti sustham | tadevaṃ dvandvagarbhabahuvrīhipakṣo vyākhyātaḥ | nanūttarasminpakṣatraye tulyapadasya āsyapadena samanvayābhāvādbhinnasthānānāmapi prayatnasāmyātsāvarṇyaṃ syāt, maivam | taddhitāntāsyapadopādānasāmarthyādāsyaityekatvavivakṣāyāmekasminneva sthāne yayostulyaḥ prayatna ityarthalābhāt | anyathā sthānānāmāsyavṛttitvaniyamādāsyapadenaiva sarvasthānalābhe sthānabhede'pi prayatnaikyamityarthasya siddheḥ | nanvevamapi anyena saha tulyasthānaprayatnasyānyena sāvarṇyaṃ syāt, pratiyogiviśeṣasyānupāttatvāt, tadvāraṇāya "tasya" iti vaktavyam, yo yasya tulyasthānaprayatnaḥ sa tasya savarṇa ityarthalābhāduktātiprasaṅgasamādhānāt, maivam | tathā sati savarṇasaṃjñāvidhānavaiyarthyāt | sarveṇa saha sarvasya sāvarṇyaprasaṅge ca vyāvarttyālābhāt | na ca rephoṣmaṇāṃ kiñcinnirūpitasāvarṇyābhāvāttannivṛttyarthatayā sārthakyam | svanirūpitasāvarṇyasya tatrāpi svīkārāt | rephoṣmaṇāṃ savarṇā na santīti pravādasya vijātīyasavarṇābhāvaparatvāt | vastutastu tulyaśabdasya sasambandhikatvādevoktārthasiddhiḥ | "pitā śuśrūṣitavyaḥ" ityādau yannirūpitaṃ pitṛtvaṃ tasyaiva śuśrūyakatvalābhāt | ata eva "tulyāya kanyā deyā" ityādau yajjātyavacchinnanirūpitakanyātvaṃ tajjātyā tulyatvaṃ sampradānasya labhyate | sthānagrahaṇaṃ kim, kacaṭatapānāṃ mā bhūt | spṛṣṭaprayatnasya tulyatvāt | anyathā tarptatyatra "jharo jhari savarṇe" iti palopaḥ syāt | prayatnagrahaṇaṃ kim, cakāraśakārayormā bhūt | tālusthānasya tulyatvāt | spṛṣṭavivṛtaprayatnabhedāttu nātivyāptiḥ | anyathā vāk‌ścyotatītyatra pūrvasūtreṇa śakāralopaḥ syāt | ata evābhyantaratvaviśeṣaṇasyāpi sārthakyam | anyathā śvāsāghoṣavivārākhyabāhyaprayatnatrayasādṛśyasattvādativyāptitādavasthyāt | sarvaprayatnasāmyavivakṣāyāṃ kaṅayorapi bāhyaprayatnabhedādaṅkita ityādau parasavarṇādyabhāvāpattyā tasyāśrayitumaśakyatvāt | cakāraśakārayoralpaprāṇamahāprāṇarūpabāhyaprayatnabhedasyākiñcitkaratvāt | kiṃ ca "jharo jhari" ityevokte "halo yamāṃ yami" itivat yathāsaṃkhyāpattau śiṇḍhītyādau ḍalopo na syāditi tatra savarṇapadagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam | yāvatprayatnasāmyavivakṣāyāṃ ca ḍaḍhayorapyalpaprāṇamahāprāṇarūpaprayatnabhedena sāvarṇyānupapattyā ḍalopābhāvatādavasthye sarṇapadamapi vyarthaṃ syāt | vastutastu abhitthā ityādau sakāralopārthatayā tatra savarṇapadaṃ sārthakameva | sakārathakārayormahāprāṇatvenāpi sāmyāt | kintu niśchajham niṣṭhuram nissthānam madhuliṭ sthānam ityādāvapi lopaḥ syāditi bodhyam | atha tathā'pi taddhitāntāsyaśabdabalādeva sthānaprayatnobhayalābhasambhavāt prayatnapadaṃ vyartham, tālvādisthānavat prayatnasyāpyāsyabhavatvāditi cenna | pratyekavyāpāranirāsārthamubhayorupādānāt | tenobhayasāmye satyeva sāvarṇyam | na tvanyataramātrasāmye'pīti na doṣaḥ | atha sthānaprayatnavivekaḥ---akuhavisarjanīyānāṃ kaṇṭhaḥ | icuyaśānāṃ tālu | ṛṭuraṣāṇāṃ mūrddhā | lṛtulasānāṃ dantāḥ | upūpadhmānīyānāmoṣṭhau | edaitoḥ kaṇṭhatālu | odautoḥ kaṇṭhoṣṭham | vakārasya dantoṣṭham | jihvāmūlīyasya jihvāmūlam | nāsikā'nusvārasya | kecittu vargapañcamānāṃ svasvavargāpekṣayā nāsikāsthānamadhikamityāhuḥ | anye tu--- anusvārayamānāṃ ca nāsikāsthānamiṣyate | iti pāṇinīyaśikṣāyāṃ pañcamānāṃ nāsikāsthānānukterna tathetyāhuḥ | tadagre vicāryam | yatno dvidhā---ābhyantaro bāhyaśca | ādyaścaturddhā | spṛṣṭeṣatspṛṣṭavivṛtasaṃvṛtabhedāt | spṛṣṭaṃ prayatanaṃ sparśānām | īṣatspṛṣṭamantasthānām | vivṛtamūṣmaṇāṃ svarāṇāṃ ca | hrasvasyāvarṇasya prayogadaśāyāṃ saṃvṛtatvam, prakriyādaśāyāṃ tu vivṛtatvaṃ pratijñāyataiti prāguktam | ābhyantaratvaṃ caiṣāṃ varṇotpattipūrvabhāvitvāt | tathā hi---nābhipradeśāt prayatnapreritaḥ prāṇavāyurūrddhamākramānnuraṃḥ prabhṛtīnāmanyatame sthāne prayatnena vidhāryamāṇaḥ sthānamāhanti, tato varṇasya tadvyañjakadhvanervotpattiḥ | tatra varṇotpatteḥ pūrvaṃ jihvāgropāgramadhyamūlānāṃ tattatsthānaistālvādibhiḥ saha yadā samyak sparśaḥ tadā spṛṣṭatvam, īṣatsparśe īṣatspṛṣṭatvam, sāmīpyamātre saṃvṛtatvam, dūratve tu vivṛtatvamiti | idaṃ cātra tattvam--- aṣṭau sthānāni varṇānāmuraḥ kaṇṭhaḥ śirastathā | jihvāmūlaṃ ca dantāśca nāsikauṣṭhau ca tālu ca || sodīrṇo mūrd‌dhnyabhihato vaktramāpadya mārutaḥ | varṇāñjanayate, ityādiśāstraparyālocanayā avacchedakatāsambandhena varṇaṃ prati tādātmyasambandhena hetutvaṃ sthānatvamiti labhyate | avacchedakatā ca kaṇṭhe akāra ityādyabhiyuktapratītiniyāmakaḥ svarūpasambandhaviśeṣaḥ, bheryāṃ śabda ityādivat | na hi tiṣṭhantyasminsthānamiti vyutpattyā tadatiriktaḥ sambandho vaktuṃ śakyaḥ | utpattipakṣe varṇānāmākāśasamavetatvāt, abhivyaktipakṣe ca vibhutvādavṛttitvāt | etena "āsye tulyadeśaprayatnam" ityadhikaraṇatvabodhakadeśapadagarbhaṃ vārttikamapi vyākhyātam | karaṇapadaṃ ca kiṃ punarāsye bhavaṃ sthānaṃ karaṇaṃ ceti bhāṣyamupādāya spṛṣṭatādijihvāgramadhyamūlāni veti kaiyaṭena vyākhyātam | tatrādyaṃ spṛṣṭaprayatnetyādi vyavahārābhiprāyam | na tu tāttvikam | tathāhi---jihvāgradipratiyogikatālvādisaṃyogasya spṛṣṭādipadātpratīyamānasya karaṇatvamanupannam | vyāpārahitatvāt | na hyuktasaṃyogena kiñcit janayitvā varṇā janyante | mānābhāvāt | etena tadabhivyañjako dhvanirapi vyākhyātaḥ | jihvāgrādīnāṃ tu yathoktasaṃyogaṃ vyāpāramāśritya yuktameva karaṇatvam | ātmamanaḥ sayogenātmano jñānakaraṇatvasya, cakṣurghaṭādisaṃyogena cakṣurādīnāṃ cākṣuṣādikaraṇatvasya ca prasiddhatvāt | ata eva kaṇṭhādyabhighātasya katvaṃ kasākṣātkāratvaṃ vā kāryatāvacchedakamiti tāntrikāṇāmud‌ghoṣaḥ | atrāvacchedakatā kāryatāvacchedakaḥ sambandhaḥ, samavāyastu kāraṇatāvacchedakaḥ | bhavati cāvacchedakatayā varṇavati tālvādau samavāyena jihvāgrādisaṃyogaḥ | evaṃ saṃyogasambandhena jihvāgrādīnāṃ hetutvam | na caivaṃ karaṇaikyāpattiḥ | yadvarṇotpattau yat sthānamavacchedakaṃ tadanuyonikajihvāgradisaṃyogasya tatra vyāpāratayā tadbhedena karaṇatānāṃ bhedāt | evaṃ ca yadyevaṃ prayatnagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam, tasyāpyāsyabhavatvāt, satyametat, pratyekaṃ tu vyāpāranirāsārthamubhayorūpādānam, tena dvayostulyatve savarṇasaṃjñā bhavatītigranthotthānamapi saṅgacchate | na hyuktasaṃyogasyāsyabhavatvam | āsyasamavāyanirūpakatvarūpasya tasya tadavayave tālvādābeva sambhavāt | uktasaṃyogasya tvāsyāvayave eva samavetatvāt | yadyapi jihvāgrādīnāmapi na sākṣādāsyasamavāyanirūpakatvam, jihvayaiva saha teṣāmavayavāvayavibhāvāt, tathā'pyāsyanirūpitasamavāyanirūpakatvamubhayasādhāraṇaṃ vācyam | āsyapratiyogiko yaḥ samavāyastadanuyogitvaṃ tālvādau, tadanuyogijihvāpratiyogikasamavāyānuyogitvaṃ ca jihvāgrādāviti | na caitatpūrvoktasaṃyoge | jihvāgrapratiyogikasaṃyogasya adhikasya dānaṃ vinā tatsaṅgrahābhāvāt | yadi tu dantānāṃ śarīrānavayavatvāttadasaṅgraha iti vibhāvyate, tadā''syapratiyogiketyatra samavāyasthāne sākṣātsambandheti vācyam | saṃyogasamavāyayoreva tathātvāt | pakṣāntare'pyevameva vācyatvācca | tasmādyathoktamāsyabhavatvaṃ taddhitāntasya āsyapadasya lakṣyatāvacchedakamiti śaṅkā'rthaḥ | pratyekasāmye savarṇatvavāraṇāya pṛthak‌prayatnagrahaṇāvaśyakatve ca āsyapadasya na yathoktaṃ lakṣyatāvacchekam, mānābhāvāt, kiṃ tu sthānamātrasādhāraṇam | saṃgrāhyānurodhenaiva vṛttisvīkārāt | vastutastu āsyasamavāyanirūpakatvaṃ lakṣyatāvacchedakasambandhaḥ | lakṣyatāvacchedakaṃ tu avacchedakatāsaṃbandhāvacchinnavarṇaniṣṭhakāryatvapratiyogikakāraṇatāśālitvameva | anyathā āsyarūpādau tadavayavāntare ca tasyātiprasaktatvāt | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ | bāhyaprayatnāstvekādaśa---vivāraḥ saṃvāraḥ śvāso nādo ghoṣaḥ aghoṣaḥ alpaprāṇo mahāprāṇa udāttaḥ anudāttaḥ svaritaśceti | ete ca varṇotpattyanantaraṃ mūrd‌dhni pratighātānnivṛtte prāṇe jāyanta iti bāhyā ucyante | vāyunā kaṇṭhe abhihanyamāne galabilasya vikāsādvikāraḥ | tatsaṃkocāt saṃvāraḥ | ata eva dūrasamīpāvasthānātmakābhyāmābhyantaravivṛtasaṃvṛtābhyāmanayorbhedaḥ | anyeṣāṃ svarūpamāha nyāsakāraḥ--- saṃvṛte galabile'vyaktaḥ śabdo nādaḥ, vivṛte śvāsaḥ | uparivarttinau śvāsanādāvanupradānamiti kecidācakṣate | varṇaniṣpatteranu paścātpradīyate ityanupradānam | anye tu bruvate---anupradānamanusvānam | ghaṇṭānirhrādavatsthānābhighātaje dhvanau nādo'nupratīyate, tadā nādadhvanisaṅgād ghoṣo jāyate | yadā śvāso'nupradīyate, tadā śvāsadhvanisaṅgādaghoṣaḥ | mahati vāyau mahāprāṇaḥ | alpe vāyāvalpaprāṇaḥ | yadā sarvāṅgānusārī prayatnastīvro bhavati, tadā gātrasya nigrahaḥ, kaṇṭhavivarasya cāṇutvam, svarasya ca vāyostīvragatitvādraukṣyaṃ bhavati, tamudāttamācakṣate | yadā tu mandaḥ prayatno bhavati tadā gātrasya sraṃsanam, kaṇṭhabilasya mahattvam, svarasya vāyormandagatitvāt snigdhatā bhavati, tamanudāttamācakṣate | udāttānudāttasaṃnikarṣātsvaritaguṇa iti | eṣāñca savarṇasaṃjñāyāmanupayoge'pi ābhyantaratvaviśeṣaṇavyāvartyatayopasthitatvādāntaratamyaparīkṣāyāmupayogācchātra vyutpādanamiti na doṣaḥ | tadayaṃ saṃgrahaḥ--- kharaḥ ḥkaḥpau visargaśca śvāsāghoṣavivārakaḥ | hānusvārajhaśantasthā ghoṣavannādasaṃvṛtāḥ || jaścayo'lpāsavo'ntasthā mahāprāṇāḥ pare'khilāḥ | pañcamā jaś‌vadeva syuranunāsikatā'dhikāḥ || ayamarthaḥ---vargāṇāṃ prathamā dvitīyāḥ śaṣasāśca kharaḥ, jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyā visargāśca śvāsāghoṣavivāraprayatnāḥ | hakārānusvārau vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthā yaralavāśca ghoṣanādasaṃvāraprayatnāḥ | vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyaprathamā yaralavāścālpaprāṇāḥ | anye sarve mahāprāṇāḥ | vargapañcamāstu tattadvargatṛtīyatulyaprayatnāḥ | anunāsikatvaṃ punareṣāmadhiko guṇa iti | syādetat | udāttādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ kathaṃ bāhyatvam | tatra vivārādīnāmaṣṭānāmeva bhāṣye paṭhitatvāt | udāttādīnāṃ sāvarṇyaprāptyabhāvamāśaṅkya guṇānāmabhedakatvena parihṛtatvācca | udāttādīnāṃ bāhyante ca tatsāmyābhāvena sāvarṇyābhāvasyāpādayitumaśakyatvāt | abhedakatvapakṣānusāravaiyarthyācceti cenna | yadyapyudāttādīnāṃ bāhyatvamuktam, tathā'pyabhyupetyābhyantaratvaśaṅketi vivaraṇakārairevoktatvat |"vivārādaya ekādaśa prayatnāḥ" iti kaiyaṭokteśceti dik | atra kecit---ābhyantaratvamabhyupagamyāpi sāvarṇyābhāvaśaṅkāparabhāṣyamanupapannameva | udāttādirūpaprayatnabhede'pi vivṛtarūpa tadaikyātsāvarṇyopapatteḥ | yāvatprayatnaikyavivakṣāyāṃ ca bāhyaprayatnasāmye'pyābhyantaraprayatnabhede sāvarṇyaṃ mā bhūdityetadarthamābhyantaragrahaṇamityākaravirodhāt | āpattisthale yāvatprayatnaikyavirahāttadanupapatteḥ | tadarthakapraśabdavaiyarthyācca | sthāne'ntaratamasūtrasthabhāṣyādibalāt | śakārādivadvargadvitīyacaturthānāmapyūṣmatvapratītyā vivṛtamūṣmaṇaāmiti vākye'pi tadgrahaṇasya turvāratayā sparśavivṛtobhayaprayatnānāṃ vargadvitīyacaturthānāṃ kevalaspṛṣṭaprayatnān vargaprathamatṛtīyān apekṣya prayatnādhikyena sāvarṇyābhāve "coḥ kuḥ" ityādau tadgrahaṇānupapatteśca | kakārādyapekṣayā ṅakārādīnāṃ nāsikāsthānādhikyātsāvarṇyānāpatteśca | prayatnavat sthāne'pi yāvattvasya vivakṣaṇīyatvāpatteḥ | vaiṣamye bījābhāvāt | asmanmate tu yāvattvavivakṣāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvānnāsikāsthānasāmyena ñamaṅaṇanānāṃ parasparaṃ sāvarṇye tvannayasītyādau paryāyeṇa pakṣe "vā padāntasya" iti ñādayaḥ pravarttante iti | atredaṃ vaktavyam---ayaṃ hyākarābhiprāyaḥ | ābhyantaratvamanantarbhāvya prayatnasāmyavivakṣāyāṃ yo varṇo yadvarṇasamānasthānakatve sati yadvarṇasamānaprayatnakaḥ sa tasya savarṇa iti phalitam | tatra prayatne yāvattvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ na vā | nādyaḥ | prathamatṛtīyānāṃ dvitīyacaturthānāṃ ca sāvarṇyānupapatteḥ | alpaprāṇamahāprāṇatvābhyāṃ bhedāt | nāntyaḥ | khakārahakārādeḥ sāvarṇyaprasaṅgāt | kaṇṭhyatvānmahāprāṇatvācca | evamanyatrāpyāpādyam | yadi tvābhyantaraprayatnasāmyamapi niveśyam, tatastenaivānatiprasaṅge bāhyaprayatnasāmyaniveśa eva vyartho'prasaṅgasampādakaśceti | evaṃ cāsyabhavatvamātreṇa bāhyavyāvṛttivirahādābhyantaramātralābhāya praśabdaviśiṣṭayatnapadopādānamāvaśyakamiti | āsyapadaṃ sthānamātraparam | prayatnaparatve prayojanābhāvāt | tathā ca bāhyaprayatnasāmyasya sāvarṇyaprayojakatvaṃ vikalpya dūṣayata ākarasya prayatne yāvattvavivakṣāyāṃ tadvirahe vā tātparyābhāvāt | udāttādīnāmābhyantaratve tadbhedena sāvarṇyābhāvaśaṅkāyāstadviruddhatvāt | nanu tathā'pi siddhānte ābhyantaraprayatnasyaiva savarṇasaṃjñopayoge'pi tatra yāvattvavivakṣaṇaṃ kimartham, yenodāttānudāttādīnāṃ sāvarṇyābhāvaśaṅkā syāt, tadvarṇasamānasthānatve tadvarṇavṛttyābhyantaraprayatnavattve ca sati tadvarṇavṛttyābhyantaraprayatnāntaravato vyāvartyavarṇasyābhāvāt, udāttānudāttādīnāṃ tu sāvarṇyasyeṣṭatayā vyāvartyavarṇasyābhāvāt, udāttānudāttādīnāṃ tu sāvarṇyasyeṣṭatayā vyāvartyatvāyogāt, iti cenna | devadattayajñadattau tulyadhanāvityādāvasati bādhake'nyūnānatiriktatvasyaiva dhanādau pratītyā tasyautsargikatayā vivakṣānadhīnatvāt | rājamintriṇau tulyāvityādau tu pratyakṣāderbādhakatvāt | ata evoktaṃ bhāṣye--- kiṃ sati bhede, satītyāha | satyeva hi bhede savarṇasaṃjñayā bhavitavyam | kuta etat, bhedādhiṣṭhānā hi savarṇasaṃjñā | yadi hi yatra sarvaṃ samānaṃ tatra syāt savarṇasaṃjñāvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt iti | asya hyayamarthaḥ---āsyapadena bāhyaprayatnasyāpi saṃgrahe yāvad‌bāhyābhyantaraprayatnasāmyaṃ savarṇasaṃjñānimittam iti labhyeta, tataśca svasyaiva svasāvarṇyaṃ syānna tu varṇāntarasyeti saṃjñāvaiyarthyam | tatparihārāya vidhānasāmarthyādautsargikārthatyāga iti | ata eva sati saṅkoce kiñcin‌mātrasāmye'pi syādityāsaṅkāparaḥ "yadi tarhi sati bhede kiñcit samānamiti kṛtvā savarṇasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati śakāracchakārayoḥ ṣakāraṭhakārayoḥ sakārathakārayoḥ savarṇasaṃjñā prāpnoti, eteṣāṃ hi sarvamanyat samānaṃ karaṇavarjam " iti granthaḥ saṅgacchate | śvāsāghoṣavivāramahāprāṇarūpabāhyaprayatnacatuṣṭayasya tālvādisthānasya ca tulyatvāt | ābhyantaraprayatnastu śarāṃ vivṛtatvam, chādīnāṃ tu spṛṣṭatvamiti bhedaḥ | evaṃ ca prayatnapadenābhyantarasya tasyāsyapadena ca sthānamātrasyopādāne tu noktadoṣaḥ | autsargikarītyā pratnapadasya yāvadābhyantaraparatvaṃ tu durvāram | bādhakasya durvacatvāditi | udāttādīnāṃ tarhi savarṇasaṃjñā na prāpnotīti śaṅkā'bhiprāyaḥ | ata eva guṇānāmabhedakatvenaiva nirvāhe yatkiñcit‌prayatnaparatvakalpanayautsargikārthabādho na yukta itiparihāropapattiḥ | etena "anudāttāderañ‌" ityādāviva bhedakatvapakṣasyaiva yuktatvādityapāstam | vṛddhyādisūtrasthasarvagranthavirodhāt | "āmudāttaḥ" ityādisūtravirodhācca | "anudāttādeḥ " ityādau tvanantānudāttādivyaktiparicāyakatvena tadvivakṣā | tāvadvyaktīnāṃ viśiṣya nirdeśāsaṃbhavādanudāttagrahaṇavaiyarthyāpatteśca | yattu "sthāne'ntaratame" ityādi, tanna | vivṛtamūṣmaṇāmityatra hi kiṃ pade juhotītyanena āhavanīye juhotītyasyeva sāmānyaviśeṣanyāyena vargadvitīyacaturthānāṃ spaṣṭatvaṃ bādhitvā vivṛtatvaṃ vidhīyate uta sāvakāśaniravakāśanyāyena spṛṣṭaṃ prayatnaṃ sparśānāmityasya prathamādiṣu sāvakāśatvāt dvitīyacaturthayorvivṛtatva vidhīyate sa yāvatyā vācā kāmayīta tāvatyā dīkṣaṇīyāyāmanubrūyādityādineva yatkiñcit prācīnamagnīṣomīyāttenopāṃśu caratītyādeḥ | nādyaḥ | sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvo hi na vidheyāṃśe | spṛṣṭatvavivṛtatvayorvirodhāt | nāpyanuvādyāṃśe | śakārādiṣu vargaprathamatṛtīyeṣu ca sparśatvoṣmatvayoḥ parasparātyantābhāvasamānādhikaraṇatvāt | na dvitīyaḥ | spṛṣṭatvavidhervargaviṣamavarṇeṣviva vivṛtatvavidherapi ūṣmasu sāvakāśatvāt | na ca dvitīyacaturthānāṃ sparśatvameva nāstīti vācyam | "sparśeṣu yatṣoḍaśamekaviṃśam " itibhāgavatādivirodhāt | "sparśāḥ syuḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ" itiśikṣāvirodhācca | prathamatṛtīyapañcamānāṃ tatsāvarṇyānāpatteśca | na ca spṛṣṭatvamabādhitvaiva vivṛtatvaṃ vidhīyataiti vācyam | tayorviruddhatvena samuccayānarhatvāt | "na hi bādhitamarthamāgamo'pi bodhayati" iti nyāyāt iti na kiñcidetat | yadapyuktam---kaṅādīnāṃ sāvarṇyaṃ na syāditi | tatra kecit tāvadāhuḥ---vargapañcamānāṃ nāsikā sthānaṃ na bhavati, śikṣāyāṃ yamānusvārāṇāmeva tadukteḥ, kiṃ tu karaṇam | tadvyāpāreṇa taduccāraṇāt | tāvanmātreṇa sthānatve akārādīnāmapi nāsikāsthānatvāpatteḥ | tadakathanena nyūnatāpatteśca | yattu karaṇarūpāyā api nāsikāyāstaddhitāntāsyapadena grahaṇāttadbhede sāvarṇyamanupapannameva | āsyapadasya sthānamātraparatayā saṃkoce bījābhāvāditi, tanna | āsyapadasya karaṇaparatve mānābhāvāt | saṃkocasya dūrāpāstatvāt | vṛttiviṣayatāvacchedakadharmāvacchinnakiñcidvyaktiviṣayakatātparyābhāvakalpanasyaiva saṃkocatvāt | etena kiṃ punarāsye bhavaṃ sthānaṃ karaṇaṃ ceti bhāṣyavirodha ityapi nirastam | na hi karaṇamāsyabhavaṃ neti brūmaḥ | kiṃ tu āsyapadārthatāvacchedakaṃ prakṛte sthānatvameveti | yadapyuktam---etena tulyaśabdasaṃkocāpekṣayā paścādupasthitāsyaśabdasaṃkoca eva nyāyya ityapāstam | kakhagaghaṅādīnāṃ svarūpato bhedārthaṃ sthānādāvavāntarabhedasyāvaśyakatvena sarvasthānasāmye savarṇasaṃjñeti pakṣe'pi tulyaśabdasaṃkocāvaśyakatvācceti | tadapyasat | āsyaśabdasya saṃkocaḥ karaṇavyāvṛttalakṣyatāvacchedakatvavasthāpanameva | tasya ca nyāyyatvam | tatsādhāraṇye pramāṇābhāvāt | tulyaśabdasaṃkocastu yatkiñcitparatvam | tatra cānyāyyatvam | bhāṣyādibhiranuktatvāt | kakhetyādikaṃ tu vyarthameva | sthānatāvacchedakarūpeṇa sthānasāmyavivakṣāyāṃ vastusato'pyavāntarabhedasya sthānatānavacchedakatayā doṣābhāvāt | tvanmate ubhayatra saṃkoca iti vaiṣamyasattvācca | yadapyuktam---tulyaśabdasyānyūnānadhikaparatve'nyataraikye yāvadāsyabhavaikyābhāvādaprāptau prayatnagrahaṇavaiyarthyāpattiḥ | etena prayatnasya pṛthagupādānāttaddhitāntāsyaśabdena nāsikārūpaṃ karaṇaṃ na gṛhyate ityapāstam | ubhayatrāpi tulyatvasya vaktuṃ śakyatvenā''numānikavacanakalpanāpattyā saṃkocasyānyāyyatvena ca vinigamanāvirahātsarvatra pravṛttau tātparyagrāhakatayā prayatnapadasya vyākhyātuṃ yuktatvācceti, tadapyasat | āsyapadasya sthānamātraparatve'yaṃ doṣaḥ utāsyabhavaparatve | nādyaḥ | prayatnapadavaiyarthyānāpatteḥ | nāntyaḥ | tatparatvasyānaṅgīkārāt | na ca padāntaropādānāpekṣayā''syaśabdasya tadubhayaparatvameva samyagiti vācyam | pratyekasāmye saṃjñāyā apravṛttyarthaṃ prayatnapadasārthakyāvaśyakatve āsyapadasyobhayaparatvakalpanāyā eva gurutvāt | sthānakaraṇobhayasādhāraṇasya lakṣyatāvacchedakasya durvacatvācca | yattu tvannayasītyādau ṅādayo'pi bhavantīti, tat sāhasamātram | śābdikamātrānabimatatvāt | ata eva kaustubhe'pi yāvatsthānasāmyavivakṣāyāṃ ñamaṅaṇanānāṃ svavargyaiḥ sāvarṇyānāpattirityevoktam | anyathā teṣāṃ parasparaṃ sāvarṇyābhāvo'pyāpāditaḥ syāt | kiṃ bahunā nāsikāyāḥ sthānatvavādibhirapi yāvatsthānasāmyameva vivakṣitvā nāsikāsthānaṃ savarṇasaṃjñāyāmanupayuktamityeva svīkriyate | tathā ca tadgranthārthaḥ--- nanu "śād‌" iti sūtre śakārātparasya tavargasya ścutvaniṣedho vyarthaḥ "stoḥ" ityatra tuśabdena nakārasyānupādānāt, nāsikāsthānādhikyena tasya savarṇatvābhāvādgrahaṇakaśāstrapravṛttyaviṣayatvāt | maivam | nāsikāsthānasāmyaṃ savarṇasaṃjñāyāṃ nādriyate ityatredaṃ jñāpakam | na ca yatkiñcitsthānasāmyaṃ sāvarṇyaprayojakamiti na tadvaiyarthyamiti vācyam | tathā sati tvannayasītyādau ṅādīnāṃ paryāyeṇa pravṛttyāpatteḥ | anye tu anyūnasthānatvameva tulyasthānatvam, pañcamānāṃ parasparaṃ nāsikāsthānasāmye'pi tālvādisāmyābhāvāt | svavargyaiḥ samaṃ tvadhikasthānatve'pi nyūnasthānakatvābhāvātsāvarṇyam | tena tvaṅkaroṣītyādau ṅakārādisiddhiḥ | na cādyānāṃ pañcamasāvarṇyaṃ tathā'pyasiddhamiti vācyam | prayojanābhāvādiṣṭāpatteḥ | na ca gauri ehītyādau savarṇadīrghaḥ syāt, prakṛtibhāvaśca na syāditi vācyam | ekārasya vivṛtataratvamāśritya prayatnabhedopagamāt | na ca "torli" ityatra lakāreṇāṇtvādvakāropasthāpane tadvastu ityādau dakārasya vatvāpattiriti vācyam | dvitīyakārapraśleṣeṇa lakārasvarūpasyaivopādānāt | nāpi "ralo vyupadhād" ityatra ralantargatalakāreṇa vakārasyāpi grahaṇe devitvā dideviṣatītyādau pākṣikakittvāpattiḥ | hayavaraṭ‌sūtre rephasya yātpūrvamapakarṣaprastāve bhāṣyoktarītyā avakārāditi padacchedena samādhānasambhavāt | yadvā---sthānatāvacchedakaparyāptyāśrayatvaṃ sthānatvam | vakārasya dantoṣṭhamityatra ca dvandvanirdeśādubhayatvaṃ sthānatāvacchedakam, tacca na pratyekaviśrāntamiti na vakārasya lakārasāvarṇyam | "lugvā duha" iti sūtre "udoṣṭhyapūrvasya" iti sūtre ca dantyatvamoṣṭhyatvaṃ ca dantādibhavatvamātraṃ niveśyate, na tu tatsthānatvam | tatra yogārthenaivobhayaparatayā grahaṇakaśāstrānupayogena sāvarṇyasyānapekṣyatvāt | tena adugdhāmityādāviva aduhvahītyādāvapi ksalopaḥ, pupūrṣatītyādāviva susvūrṣatītyādāvapyutvaṃ ca siddham | tena yallom̐kamityādau anusvārasya parasavarṇe sānunāsikavakārāpattirapyanāsaṅkyā ityāhuḥ | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ | sarvathā'pi vargapañcamānāṃ parasparaṃ sāvaṇyai neti siddham | yadapyuktam---"varṇotpattau nāsikāyāḥ pāke kāṣṭhādivatsthālyādivadvā karaṇatvam | nādyaḥ | "āsye tulyadeśaprayatnaṃ savarṇam" ityadhikaraṇatvabodhakadeśaśabdasahitavārttikena tadbhāṣyeṇa ca virodhāt | adhikaraṇarūpaprāsādavāsinyāyapratipādakabhāṣyeṇa mukhanāsikayoradhikaraṇatvabodhanācca | nāntyaḥ | karaṇatve'pi sthānatvasya durvāratvāt" iti, tadapyasat | kaṇṭhādereva ṅakārādideśatvena tadvirodhābhāvāt | na hi tena nāsikāyā ṅakārādideśatvamapi bodhyate | pramāṇaprayojanayorabhāvāt | nāsikāyāḥ savarṇasaṃjñāyāmanupayogāt | prāsādavāsinyāyasya samasta eva ca varṇo dvābhyāmuccāryataityādyapakṣe'vatāre'pi eko bhāgo mukenoccāryate dvitīyastu nāsikayā, yadvā---tadubhayāntarālavarttisthānāntarameva taduccāraṇe nimittamityuttarapakṣadvaye tadanavakāśāt | idaṃ ca kaustubhe'pi spaṣṭam | yadapyuktam---"yathā--- ayugmā vargayamagā yaṇaścālpāsavaḥ smṛtāḥ | ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādajādigrahaṇam | "supāṃ sulug" itisūtrasthabhāṣyādiprāmāṇyādacāmalpaprāṇatvapratīteḥ | yathā vā---"kvinpratyayasya" itisūtrasthakaiyaṭādiprāmāṇyādvargacaturthānāmalpaprāṇatā'pi dantyoṣṭhyavakārasya mahāprāṇatā'pi | tathoktasikṣāyāṃ cakāreṇa ñādīnāmakārādīnāṃ ca grahaṇaṃ vyākhyeyam | ata eva kaustubhe ñakārādīnāṃ nāsikāsthānatvaṃ sākṣāduktam" iti | tadapyasat | prakṛte kalpakābhāvena vaiṣamyāt | ñādīnāṃ parasparaṃ sāvarṇyasyāpi kaustubhānabhimatatvācceti dik | vastutastu teṣāṃ sāvarṇye laṇ‌sūtrātpūrvaṃ ñamaṅaṇaneṣvanyatamameva makārānubaddhaṃ paṭhet | anyeṣāṃ tenaiva grahaṇasiddheḥ | na ca svavargyāṇāmapi grahaṇāpattiḥ | teṣāṃ pṛthak‌pāṭhasāmarthyāt | na caivaṃ tacchlokenetyatra chatvaṃ na syāt, lasya am‌bahirbhāvāpatteriti vācyam | chatvamaṇīti vācyatvāt amītyasmādadhikasyāntarbhāvānāpatteḥ | grahaṇakaśāstrādanyatra pūrveṇaivāṇ‌grahaṇamityasya yathāśrutaparatvāt | na ca yaṇi doṣaḥ | āntaratamyena vyavasthopapatteḥ | bhavadabhimatatvācca | etena rapratyāhāro'pi vyākhyātaḥ | na ca nasya iṇantarbhāve suhinsu ityādau ṣatvāpattiḥ | siddhānte'pi tatra "num‌visarjanīya" iti ṣatvaprasaktyā num‌grahaṇaṃ tatsthānīyānusvāropalakṣaṇārthamityatra vyākhyānātiriktasya bījasya durvacatayā tasya ca sākṣānnumaḥ parasya sasya ṣatvaṃ nāstītyetanniścayaṃ vinā'nupapannatayā'trāpi tenaiva saṃkocopapatteḥ | numaḥ sākṣādupādāne tadādeśalakṣaṇayā saṃkocaḥ | pratyāhārāntarbhāve tu tadatiriktaparatvenetyanyadetat | yadvā---varṇopadeśe "laṇ‌" ityasmādanantarameva ñādiṣvanyatamo mānubaddhaḥ paṭhanīyaḥ | grahaṇakasūtre tu aṇ‌padasthāne amityevāstu, lāghavasya bhūyastvāt | na cātra "aco ñṇiti" "ñnityādirnityam" ityādermidādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ | ubhayopādānasāmarthyāt | evam "ṅ‌ṇoḥ kuk‌ṭuk śari" ityatra yojyam | nāpi "k‌ṅiti ca" ityasya | ṇalādau vṛddhyarthaṇittvasya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ | na ca "midaco'ntyātparaḥ" ityasya ṇalādau | "ata upadhāyāḥ" ityasya vaiyarthyāt | nanu "midaco'ntyātparaḥ" ityasya nityatiprasaṅgaḥ, evaṃ mo'nusvārasya ṇāntādau, "ṇo naḥ" ityasya nakārādyādau, "nodāttopadeśasya māntasya" ityasya nāntādau, "raṣābhyām" iti mādīnāmapi ṇatvaṃ syāt, iti yathāyogamāpādyamiti cet, satyam | ṅakārasyaiva pāṭhyatvāt ñaṇanamānāṃ savarṇagrāhakatvāpattyabhāvāt | athaivamapi grahijyādisūtreṇa jagrāha grāhyamityādau saṃprasāraṇaṃ syāt, ṅitīti ṅakāreṇa ṇakārasyāpi grahaṇāt | maivam | bhṛjjatīnāṃ ṅiti ceti saṃhitayā ṅakārapraśleṣeṇa svarūpatoṅakārasyaiva grahaṇāt | na ca tathā'pi "halo yamāṃ yami lopaḥ" ityatra ñakārādyaṃśe yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na syāt iti vācyam | tatrātiprasaṅgasthalābhāvena kṣativirahāt | na ca "ṅamo hrasvādaci ṅamuṇnityam" ityatra ṅamuṭo'pyāpattiriti vācyam | ṅaṇanānāmiti svarūpeṇaiva paṭhitavyatvāt | ṅamuḍityatra dve ityeva pāṭhyam | yadvā---varṇopadeśe na ṅam iti pāṭhyam | tena ṅakāramakārau parasparaṃ grāhakau neti phalitam | tena "ṅamo hrasvād‌" ityatra na doṣaḥ | nāpi "midaco'ntyāt" ityasya aṇ‌phin‌phiñādiṣvatiprasaṅgaḥ | ṅittvasyānanyārthakaṅittvasthalaeva pravṛttisvīkārāt | svaravṛddhyarthatayā nittvādīnāmupakṣīṇatayā teṣāṃ pratyayatvāt paratvopapatteḥ | na ca tātaṅ‌nyāyena pravṛttyāpattiḥ | tatra ṅakārasya śrūyamāṇatvāt prakṛte savarṇagrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā'pavādabādhakalpane mānābhāvāt | yathānyāsamapekṣya lāghavasya bhūyastvāt | may‌pratyāhārasthale ṅayityeva paṭhanīyam | "tubhyamahyauṅayi" ityatra tatprakṛtikaghañādipratyayabādhādvibhaktiprakaraṇāccānatiprasaṅgāt | vahūrñji ityādau "aco rahābhyām" iti dvitvasya siddhānte'pīṣṭatayā "yaṇo mayaḥ" ityasya pravṛttāvapyadoṣāt | na ca ñakārasyādhikasya saṃgrahāpattiḥ | padānte ñakārasyāprasiddhatayā "maya uñaḥ" ityatrāpyadoṣāt | tasmāt ñādīnāṃ mithaḥ sāvarṇyaṃ neti siddham | anyathā sānunāsikayavalānāmapi mithastadāpattau sayyam̐ntā ityādau sthalatraye'pi paryāyeṇa teṣāmāpatteḥ | kiṃ ca vivaraṇakārādimate sānunāsikakakārādīnāmapi yamatvātteṣāṃ sāvarṇyaprasaṅge tvannayasītyādau kakārādirūpayamānāmapyādeśatvaṃ prasajyeva | yāvatsthānasāmye sāvarṇyasvīkārapakṣe teṣāṃ kevalanāsikāsthānatvamāśritya samādhāne'pi mukhanāsikobhayasthānatvamādāya tattadvargīyayamāpatterduṣpariharatvāt "nāsikyā nāsikāsthānā mukhanāsikyā vā" iti vacanānmukhapadena tadvargasthānasyaivopādeyatvāt | varṇāntaratvamate'pi sthānāntarānuktyā svavṛttisādṛśyapratiyogivarṇasamānasthānaprayatnatvasyaiva vācyatvāt | tathā ca "pañcame pare yamotpattiḥ" ityādikamapi vyākulaṃ syāt | nanu tathā'pi uktavacanānnāsikāyāḥ sthānatvaṃ sidhyatyeveti cet, satyam | atratyasthānapadasya taduccāryatvamātraparatvāt | mukhanāsikyā iti vākye tu mukhāvayavakaṇṭhādīnāṃ pramāṇāntareṇa sthānatvanirvāhāt | "mukhanāsikāvacana" ityatra vacanapadasvārasyānmukhanāsikoccāryatvasyaiva pratīteḥ | ata eva bāhyaprayatnābhidhānottaraṃ "yathā tṛtīyāḥ tathā pañcamā ānunāsikyavarjam ānunāsikyaṃ teṣāmadhiko guṇaḥ" iti bhāṣyaṃ saṃgacchate | anyathā bāhyaprayatnasāmyakathanaprastāve sthānavaiṣamyābhidhānasyānarhatvāt | uktarītyā tu āntaratamyamātraparīkṣopayogitvena tadaucityāt | na cānunāsikatvanirmuktaṅakārādīnāmamanupalambhātkathaṃ guṇatvamiti vācyam | jalaparamāṇurūpādīnāṃ tadguṇatvānupapattiprasaṅgāt | tanniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitvasya guṇalakṣaṇānupayogāt | "sattve niviśate'paiti" ityāderanyathaiva vyākhyāsyamānatvāt | api ca anunāsikasaṃjñāsūtre mukhasya nāsikāyāśca taduccāraṇe karaṇatvaṃ sarvagranthasiddham | sthānatvaṃ ca karaṇapratiyogikasaṃyogānuyogitvam | tatra karaṇapratiyogikatvamupalakṣaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vā | nādyaḥ | jihvāgrādīnāmapi sthānatvāpatteḥ | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ | tatsāmyamādāya samānaprayatnānāṃ sāvarṇyāpatteḥ | yatkiñcitsthānasāmyasyaiva bhavanmate'pekṣyatvāt | nāntyaḥ | svapratiyogikatvaviśiṣṭasaṃyogānuyogitvasya svasminnanaṅgīkārāt nāsikāyāḥ sthānatvānupapatteḥ sthiratvāt | ityāstāmativistaraḥ | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ | ṛlṛvarṇayoḥ sthānabhedādaprāptāṃ savarṇasaṃjñāṃ vidhātuṃ vārttikamārabhyate--- ṛlṛvarṇayormithaḥ sāvarṇyaṃ vācyamiti | atra vyācakṣate---ā ca ā ca ralau, tau ca tau varṇau ceti vigrahaḥ, uśca ul‌ ca ṛlostayoriti vā | prathamāntena pariniṣṭhitavibhaktyā vā vigraha iti siddhāntāditi | tatrādye ṛ lṛ au iti sthite "ṛtyakaḥ" iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ | "ṛto ṅi" iti lṛkārasya guṇaḥ, tata ṛkārasya yaṇādeśaḥ | na cākṛtavyūhanyāyātprakṛtibhāvānupapattiḥ | guṇe satyapi sthānivadbhāvasaṃbhavānnimittavighātābhāvāt | na caivaṃ yaṇo'pi daurlabhyam | "ṛtyakaḥ" ityatra "pluptapragṛhyāḥ " ityato'cītyanuvartya ṛkārarūpamacamāśritya yatkāryaṃ tasyaiva vāraṇāt | yaṇādeśastu acsāmānyamupajīvatīti tadvyāvṛttivirahāt | na ca "acaḥ parasmin" ityanenābhāvo'pyatidiśyataiti siddhāntāt ṛkārakālīnasya yaṇabhāvasya guṇe'pyatideśa iti vācyam | "na padānta" iti tanniṣedhāt | antarvartivibhaktyā pūrvapadasya subantatayā padasaṃjñatvāt | dvitīye tu osi guṇasya daurlabhyādakārottaramuccāraṇārthamakāraṃ tannimittakayaṇaṃ ca svīkṛtya yojyam | ṛloriti vā pāṭha iti | atredaṃ bodhyam---ṛkārarūpāj‌nimittakatvaṃ na tāvadṛtvāvacchainnanimittatākatvam | savarṇadīrghayaṇorayādīnāṃ ca vāraṇānupapatteḥ | tatra ṛtvena nimittatvavirahāt | "upasargādṛti dhātau" ityatraiva prakṛtibhāvasya kathaṃcitpravṛttyāpattyā dhātugrahaṇaṃ pākṣikaprakṛtibhāvanivṛttyarthamityādisakalavyākopaprasaṅgāt | nāpi ṛkāraviśrāntanimittatākatvaṃ yaṇādeśasādhāraṇyāt | atha yasyāṃ lakṣyavyaktau ṛkāraparatvābhāvaprayukto yatkāryābhāvastadeva kāryaṃ prakṛtibhāvena vyāvartyate, iti cenna | guṇātpūrvaṃ prakṛte yaṇādeśasyāpyetādṛśatvātpravṛttyāpatteḥ | tadvyaktau ṛkāraparatvābhāvasyāprasiddhyā yadyatra ṛkāraparatvaṃ na syāttadā yaṇādeśo na syādityevaṃrūpasyaiva prayuktatvasya vācyatvāt | tasya cānyatra ṛkāraparatvābhāve'pi dadhyatretyādau yaṇādeśābhāvasyādarśanādāpādakatvānupapatteḥ | evaṃ brahmaṛṣirityādau guṇasyāci durvāratvaṃ yojyam | evaṃ ca prakṛte guṇottaram ṛkāraṣaratvavyatirekaprayukto na yaṇādeśābhāvaḥ, ākāraparatvenāpi tadupapatteriti kathañcit āśaṅkā'pi niravakāśā | ādeśābhāvasthale savarṇadīrghavyāvṛttāvapi yathāyogamādeśāntarasya durvāratvaprasaṅgāt | tasmādacītyanuvṛttāvapi yaṇādeśavyāvṛttasya nivartyatāvacchedakasya durvacatvāduparañjakatvamātraṃ tasya, na tūpayuktatvamapīti na kiñcidetat | yadapyuktam---prakṛtibhāvābhāvapakṣe "vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ" iti guṇe kṛte yaṇādeśasaulabhyamiti, tadapi na | tayoryugapatpravṛttau samānanimittatāyāṃ ca tannyāyapravṛtteṛ kaustubhādau spaṣṭatvāt | etena tathātve na kiñcinmānamiti nirastam | vyāśrayatve lakṣyānurodhāttatpravṛttisvīkāre'pi prakṛte lakṣyaniścayābhāvena autsargikīṃ samānāśrayapravṛttimāśritya tadapravṛttereva svīkarttumucitatvāt, kvau luptaṃ kvau vidhiṃ prati vā na sthānivadityādivat | tasmātprakṛtibhāvapakṣe ṛalāviti ṛloriti ca, tadabhāve tu rāviti roriti ca rūpaṃ yathāyogaṃ bodhyamityalaṃ bahunā | sāvarṇyaprayojanaṃ tu hotṛ lṛkāra iti sthite savarṇadīrghau yathā syāt, hotṝkāraḥ | ubhayāntaratamasya lṛkārāntaratamasya ca dīrghasyāsambhavādṛkārāntaratamo dīrghaṛkāraḥ | atha "akaḥ savarṇe" iti sūtre "ṛti ṛ vā" "lṛti lṛ vā" iti paṭhyate | akaḥ savarṇe ṛti pare pūrvaparayoḥ sthāne ṛ ityayamādeśo vā syāt | īṣatspṛṣṭo dvimātraścāyam | madhye dvau rophau tayorekā mātrā, ubhayato'j‌bhakterdvitīyā | evaṃ dvitīyavacanavidheye lṛkāre'pi bodhyam | tatra madhye dvau lakārāviti viśeṣaḥ | ubhayorapi prayatnabhedādṛlṛvarṇābhyāmagṛhītatvenāc‌tvābhāvādaprāptayoreva vidhānam | tatra vāśabdasya samuccayārthatvamaṅgīkṛtyāprāpta eva dīrgho vidhīyatām, kiṃ sāvarṇyena | na ca dvitīye savarṇapadasyānuvṛttau tatsaṃjñāyā apyāvaśyakatvam, ananuvṛttau tu dadhylṛkāra ityādāvatiprasaṅga iti vācyam | prathamavārttike ṛtītyapanīya "ṛtaḥ" prati plutasyāsiddhatvābhāvādanunāsikapravṛttiḥ syāt | nanu saṃjñāparibhāṣasya kāryārthatvāt kāryakālapakṣa eva nyāyya iti cet, atrāhuḥ---"prayojanaviśeṣānavagame'pi sāmānyataḥ kiñcitprayojanavattājñānamātreṇa yathoddeśapakṣopapattiḥ | yathā---viśiṣyāśrūyamāṇabhāvyakeṣu vidhiṣu iṣṭasāmānyasya bhāvyatvamādāyāṃśatrayavaiśiṣṭyaṃ bhāvanāyāḥ sampādya taduttaramārthavādikaḥ kalpito vā iṣṭaviśeṣo vyavasthāpyate tadvat, mahāvākyārthaparyālocanayā tu kāryakālapakṣa" iti | atra haradattaḥ---saṃjñāṃ prati plutasyāsiddhatve'pi anunāsikaparyudāsaṃ prati na tathā | tataśca yasyānena saṃjñā kṛtā dvimātrasya na so'nunāsikavidhau sthānī, kiṃ tu trimātraḥ | na ca sthānivadbhāvena trimātrasyāpi pragṛhyatvam | al‌vidhau tadayogāt | īkārāntadvivacanasya pragṛhyasaṃjñatayā viśeṣaṇatayā īkārādirūpālsāpekṣatvāt | kiṃ cāvaśyaṃ "siddhaḥ plutaḥ svarasaṃdhiṣu" ityāśrayaṇīyam, daṇaaḍa āḍhakamiti plutasya dīrgheṇa nivṛttiryathā syāt | ata eva suślokā 3 iti suśloketi ityatra guṇo bhavan plutameva nivarttayati, na sthāninam | ādeśe plutaśravaṇaprasaṅgāt | tatkathaṃ yathoddeśapakṣe'pīṣṭasiddhiriti | atra kaiyaṭaḥ--- "śāstrāsiddhatvāśrayaṇācca plutabuddhāvasatyāṃ pragṛhyatve vidhīyamāne dvimātraviṣayā buddhiḥ pravarttate" iti | ayamarthaḥ---dvimātrasya trimātreṇāpahāre'pi "pūrvatrāsiddham" ityanena śāstrāsiddhatvabodhanāt trimātraeva dvimātratvabuddhyā pragṛhyasaṃjñā kriyate, na tu dvimātre kṛtāṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñāṃ trimātre atidiśāmaḥ, yenālvidhitvāttadabhāvaśaṅkā syāt | evaṃ ca trimātraeva pragṛhyasaṃjñāpravṛttiḥ | dvimātratvabuddhyā saṃjñāpravṛttāvapi vastuto dharmiṇastrimātratayā tatraiva viśrāmāt, rajatabhramajanyapravṛtteḥ śuktiviṣayakatvavat | na cāhāryāropeṇa kathaṃ śāstrapravṛttiḥ | śāstreṇaiva tasya śāstrapravṛttiprayojakatvokteḥ | śāstrasya vastuto'siddhatvāsambhavāt | etena suśloketītyādāvādeśa plutaḥ śrūyetetyapyapāstam | dvimātrabuddhyaiva kriyamāṇena guṇena tad‌buddhiviśeṣyaplutasyaiva nivṛtterarthasiddhatvāditi dik | catvāro'tra pakṣāḥ sambhavanti | īdādīnāṃ viśeṣyatvaṃ dvivacanasya ca viśeṣaṇatvam, dvivacanasaṃjñaṃ yadīdādi tat pragṛhyamityartha ityādyaḥ | pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā dvivacanapadaṃ dvivacanāntaparam, īdādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇatvāttadantavidhiḥ, īdādyantaṃ dvivacanāntamiti dvitīyaḥ | īdādyantaṃ yad‌ dvivacanaṃ tadantamiti tṛtīyaḥ | dvivacanameva saṃjñi vakṣyamāṇayukteḥ, īdādyantaṃ dvivacanaṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñamiti vākyārtha iti caturthaḥ | tatrādye pacete ityādau saṃjñā na syāt, ekārasya dvivacanāvayavatve'pi dvivacanatvābhāvāt | na ca mukhyānupapattyā śāstraprāṇāṇyādgauṇe pravṛttiḥ | gaṅge ityādau "antādivacca" ityādivadbhāvena ekārasya mukhyadvivacanatvena tatra cāritārthyāt | dvitīye'pi kumāryoragāraṃ kumāryagāram vadhvoragāram vadhvagāramityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ | pratyayalakṣaṇena dvivacanāntatvāt | svarūpata īdūdantatvācca | tṛtīye'pi aśukle śukle samapadyetāṃ śuklyāstāṃ vastre ityatra prathamādvivacanasya "napuṃsakācca" iti śībhāve cvipratyaye "supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ" iti śīlope "asyacvau" iti śuklaśabdāntyākārasya ītve taddhitāntatvādutpannasya supratyayasyāvyayatvālluki kṛte śīśabda īkārāntaṃ dvivacanaṃ pratyayalakṣaṇena ca padaṃ tadantamityatiprasaṅgaḥ | nanu pakṣadvaye'pi na doṣaḥ | "īdūtau ca saptamyarthe" ityatra saptamītyevokte'pi pratyayalakṣaṇena "somogaurī adhiśrita" ityatra pragṛhyasaṃjñāsiddhau arthagrahaṇena pragṛhyasaṃjñāprakaraṇe pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ nāstīti jñāpayituṃ śakyatvāt | śuklāstāmityatra "antaraṅgānapi vidhīn bahiraṅgo lugbādhate" iti nyāyādaukārasyaiva lopena śībhāvāpravṛtteḥ pratyayalakṣaṇe satyapi doṣābhāvācca | īdādyantatvasya tāvatā'pyalābhād iti cet, maivam | tathā'pi tadantagrahaṇadaurlabhyādeva pakṣadvayasya duṣṭatvāt | "saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnāsti" iti "suptiṅantaṃ padam" ityantagrahaṇena jñāpitatvāt | tasmādīdūdedantaṃ yaddvivacanamityeva yuktam | sannidhānena dvivacanasyaiva saṃjñitvapratīteḥ | na caivaṃ yathoktodāharaṇeṣu īdādisvarūpeṣu tadantatvaṃ nāstīti vācyam | vyapadeśivadbhāvena tadantatvasambhavāt | atra "maṇīvādīnāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ" iti paṭhitvā maṇīva rodasīva dampatīveti vṛttikṛtaḥ | keyaṭādayastu bhāṣyavārttikakārābhyāmapaṭhitatvādapramāṇametat | maṇīvoṣṭrasyeti tu prayogo vāśabdasyopamānārthasya | rodasītvetyādistu chāndasaḥ prayoga ityāhuḥ | evaṃ ca nyāyasāmyānmunitrayānuktānāṃ "turīyasyeṣṭiḥ" "śaṃsiduhiguhibhyo vā" "knameke chandasi bhāṣāyāṃ ca" ityādīnāṃ vṛttikṛnmātroktānāmiyameva gatiḥ | nanvevam--- sphuṭotpalābhyāmalidampatīva tadvilocanābhyāṃ kuṭakuḍ‌malāśayā | nipatya bindū hṛdi kajjalāvilau maṇīva nīlau taralau virejatuḥ || iti naiṣadhasya kā gatiḥ, vāśabdasyātrāsaṅgateḥ pauruṣeyatvācceti cet, atrāhuḥ---ivārthasya vāśabdasyāyaṃ prayogaḥ | na ca tatra mānābhāvaḥ | vaṃ prayetasi jānīyādivārthe ca tadavyayam | itiviśvadarśanāt | "kādambakhaṇḍitadalāni va paṅkajāni" ityādiprayogāt | "va vā yathā tathaivaivam" ityamaravyākhyāyām "śātravaṃ va papuryaśaḥ " iti kālidāsaprayogasya tadvyākhyātṛbhirudāhṛtatvācca | yattu amare ayameva pāṭho yuktaḥ, na tu vadveti kṣīrasvāmyuktaḥ | prātipadikaprakrame taddhitasya vaterananuguṇatvāt | apatyasamūhādiparyāyamadhye aṇ‌phañ‌vuñādīnāmanukteśceti | taccintyam | taddhitatvamātreṇa prakramavirodhe yathetyādīnāmapyanupādānaprasaṅgāt | prakṛtinirmuktasya tathātve tu prakṛtiviśeṣasya niyatatvasyopādhitvāt | thādīnāṃ prakṛtiviśeṣottarameva vihitatvāt | vatestu tadabhāvāt | ata eva aṇādīnāmityādikamapāstam | teṣāmapatyasamūhādyarthaviśeṣāsādhāraṇarūpābhāvāt | prakṛtiviśeṣagarbhatayā tu "gārbhiṇaṃ gaṇe" ityādinā tattatprakaraṇe bahuśo darśitatvāt | vateśca sādṛśyaeva vidhānāt | adaso māt 12 | asmātparāvīdūtau pragṛhyau staḥ | amī īśāḥ | rāmakṛṣṇāvamū āsāte | mātkim | amuke'tra | na cātra ekārasyānanuvṛttereva nātiprasaṅga iti vācyam | mād‌grahaṇasāmarthyādevaikārānanuvṛttilābhāt | adaśśabdasambandhimakārāvyavahitottarasya tasyāsambhavāt | na ca amū āsāte ityatra pūrveṇaiva siddhiriti vācyam | tat prati mutvasyāsiddhatayā aukārāntatvāt | na caivamanenāpyanirvāhaḥ | ārambhasāmarthyādatra mutvasyāsiddhatvābhāvāt | yadvārttikam--- āśrayātsiddhatvaṃ yathā rorutve iti | kiṃ ca strīnapuṃsakayordvivacane mutvasyāsiddhatve'pyekārāntatvamevāśritya pūrveṇa pragṛhyatvasiddhiḥ | tata eva prakṛtibhāvānunāsikaparyudāsāvapi siddhau | kāryakālapakṣe tu "aṇo'pragṛhyasya" ityatropasthitena sūtreṇa saṃjñāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ mutvasya siddhatvālliṅgatraye'pi dvivacane'nunāsikaparyudāsaḥ | pūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ | etatsūtram̐ tu bahuvacanārthaṃ puṃsi dvivacane prakṛtibhāvārthaṃ ceti vivekaḥ | śe 13 | ayaṃ pragṛhyaḥ | asme indrābṛhaspatī | na yuṣme vājabandhavaḥ | ādye caturthībahuvacanasya dvitīye dvitīyābahuvacanasya ca sthāne "supāṃ sulug" ityādisūtreṇa śe ādeśaḥ | śittvātsarvādeśatvam | "śeṣe lopaḥ" iti ṭilopaḥ | na cāntye saṃjñāvaiyarthyam | padapāṭhakāle itiśabdaprayoge sārthakyāt | evam "asme dhatta vasavo vasūni" ityādikamapi bodhyam | kāśe kuśe vaṃśe ityādau lomāditvāt śapratyayānte hariśe babhruśe ityādau ca lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā na doṣaḥ | nipāta ekājanāṅ‌ 14 | āṅ‌bhinna ekāc‌ svarūpo nipātaḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñaḥ | a avadya | i indraḥ | u umeśaḥ | a niṣedhākṣepayoḥ | i vismaye | u jugupsādiṣu | atraikāc‌śabde karmadhārayaḥ, lāghavāt | "vyāharati mṛgaḥ" ityādinirdeśācca | tena predaṃ brahmetyādau nātiprasaṅgaḥ | nanvevaṃ ekagraho vyarthaḥ | nipātasyācaḥ saṃjñayaiva siddheḥ | na cājantasya nipātasyetyarthavāraṇāya taditi vācyam | viśeṣaṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ | halantasya pragṛhyatve satyapi kṣatyabhāvāt | na ca puro'stītyādau sakārāntasya prakṛtibhāve rorutvaṃ na syāditi vācyam | saṃjñāṃ prati rutvasyāsiddhatvāt | na caikadeśavikṛtanyāyena rephāntasya saṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ | prakṛtibhāvaṃ pratyapi rutvasyāsiddhatvāt | siddhakāṇḍasthakāryātparasya ca sakārānte prasaktyabhāvāt | na cājantasyaiva saṃjñā, na tvajmātrasyetyarthalābhāya viśeṣaṇaṃ syāditi vācyam | "ādyantavadekasmin" iti ajmātrasyāpyajantatvāt | na ca viśeṣaṇasāmarthyādvyapadeśivadbhāvaparityāgaḥ | tadantavidhiparityāgenāpi tasya cāritārthyasambhavāt | na ca vinigamakābhāvaḥ | "anāṅ‌" ityasyaiva tattvāt | vyapadeśivadbhāvamātrabādhe hi tadvyarthaṃ syāt | āṅaḥ kevalācsvarūpatvena prāpterevābhāvāt | aco viśeṣyatve tu tadantavidhiśaṅkā'pi neti kimekapadeneti prāpte | bhāṣyakṛtaḥ--- ac‌samudāyagrahaṇaśaṅkānirāsāyaikagrahaṇaṃ kurvannācāryo jñāpayati---varṇagrahaṇeṣu vyaktisaṃkhyā na vivakṣyate, kiṃ tu jātireva nirdeśyataiti | tena "halantācca" iti sūtre yadvakṣyati vārttikakāraḥ--- dambherhalgrahaṇasya jātivācakatvātsiddhamiti, tat sūtreṇaiva saṃgṛhītaṃ bhavati | tasyārtho hi dambheḥ siddhamityanvayaḥ | kittvamiti śeṣaḥ | tatra hetuḥ halgrahaṇasya jātivācakatvāditi | dambheḥ san | "sanīvanta" ityādivikalpādiḍabhāvaḥ | "dambha icca" iti itvam | pakṣeītvañca | "atra lopa" ityabhyāsalopaḥ | dinbhsati dīn‌bhsati iti sthite---"halantācca" iti sanaḥ kittvamiṣyate | ikaḥ samīpo yo hal tataḥ paraḥ san‌ kitsyāditi tasyārthaḥ | prakṛte ca ikaḥ paratvaṃ nakāre, na tu tataḥ paraḥ san | bhakāreṇa vyavadhānāt | bhaśabdāttu paraḥ san, na tu bhaśabda ikaḥ paraḥ | nakāreṇa vyavadhānāditi kittvaṃ na syāt | jātivācakatve tu nakārabhakārayorhal‌tvarūpaikadharmāvacchinnatayā iṣṭasiddhiḥ | tataḥ kittvānnalopaḥ | bhaṣūbhāvena dasya dhatvam | bhakārasya cartvena pakāra iti dhipsati dhīpsatīti siddham | nanu ac‌samudāyanivṛttyarthamevaikapadaṃ syāt | aiu apehītyatra hi samudāyasyaiva saṃjñā syāt, na tu pūrvayoriti tatra guṇādikaṃ syāditi cet, atrāhuḥ--- saṃjñāyā vidheyatvāt prādhānyam, saṃjñinastu guṇatvamiti paśunā yajetetivadekatvasya vivakṣayaiva samudāyanirāsa iti | yadyapi samudāyakāryeṇāvayavānāṃ kāryanirvāha ekāj‌dvirvacananyāye bījam, na cātra tathā, samudāyasaṃjñayā'vayavānāṃ prakṛtibhāvānirvāhāditi na tasyātra viṣayaḥ, tathā'pi samudāyagrahaṇaśaṅkānirāsāyaiva kṛtamekagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakamiti bodhyam | nipāta iti kim | cakārātra | ṇalo'kārasya prakṛtibhāvo mā bhūt | na cārthavadgrahaṇanyāyena nirvāhaḥ | anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ pratyayasyāpyarthavattvāt | kevalayoḥ nipātapratyayayoraprayogasyāpi tulyatvāt | evam ata sātatyagamane "anyebhyo'pi" iti ḍapratyayaḥ, ṭilopaḥ, a āgacchetyetadapi pratyudāharaṇam | yadyapi nañivayuktanpāyenāpi āṅ‌bhinno nipāta eva gṛhyate, tathā'pi tannyāyasya vyabhicāritvānna doṣaḥ | bhedapratiyogitāvacchedakatayā ṅakāraniveśastu ṅitaḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñā yathā syādityetadarthaḥ | tadvivekastu bhāṣye--- īṣadarthe kriyāyoge maryādā'bhividhau ca yaḥ | etamātaṃ ṅitaṃ vidyādvākyasmaraṇayoraṅit || ā uṣṇam, oṣṇam | āṅīṣadarthaiti ṅinnirdiṣṭaḥ | ā itaḥ, etaḥ | prādau ṅitpaṭhitaḥ | ā udakāntāt, odakāntāt | ā ahicchatrāt, āhicchatrāt | "āṅ‌ maryādā'bhividhyoḥ" vinā teneti maryādā | saha tenetyabhividhiḥ | paricchedyamadhye avadheranantarbhāve antarbhāve cobhayam | tathā cāvadhitvārthakapadasamabhivyāhṛtapadasya svārthataduttarobhavyavacchedaparatve maryādā, svārthottaramātravyavacchedaparatve'bhividhiriti bodhyam | atra ṅittvāt na prakṛtibhāvaḥ | aṅittu yathā---ā evaṃ nu manyase | pūrvaprakrāntavākyārthasyānyathātvādyotanārtha ākāraḥ | pūrvamevaṃ nāmaṃsthāḥ, samprati tvevaṃ manyase ityarthaḥ | vākyārambhasūcanāyākāraḥ ityapare | ā evaṃ kila tat | smṛteḥ sūcaka ākāraḥ | tataḥ smṛto'rtho nirdiśyate | atra ca vākyasmaraṇayoraṅittve eva tātparyam | tena īṣadarthādicatuṣṭayānantarbhāve'pi ubhayabhinne ṅittvameva | tena abhra ām̐ apa ityatra saptamyarthavṛtterapyākārasya "āṅo'nunāsikaḥ" iti sidhyatīti granthakṛtaḥ | ata evaitacchabdena pūrvārddhoktārthacatuṣṭayaparākāraparāmarśāt ṅidvidhāvuddeśyaparāmarśakatvābhāvānnānvādeśatvamityenādeśavirahaḥ saṅgacchate | ubhayabhinnārthe ṅittvasyaiva caturthacaraṇānusāreṇārthasiddhatvāt | kecittu pūrvametacchabdenānupādānānnānvādeśatvamityāhuḥ | tanna | śabdāntareṇāpyanvādeśatvasya bhāṣyakṛtā vakṣyamāṇatvāt | tasmādīṣadarthādiṣu vartataiti vṛttirna vidheyā, kintu paricāyakatāmātreṇopātteti na tatheti dīkṣitāḥ ityanyatra vistaraḥ | atra vadanti---"anāṅ‌" ityasya paryudāsatvaṃ na yuktam | tathā hi | aśabdo vāsudevārthakaḥ | "āṅ‌ maryādā'bhividhyoḥ" ityavyayībhāvaḥ | ā āt aṃ "hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya" iti hrasvaḥ | aśabdasya svābhāvikamāṅ‌bhinnatvaṃ sthānivadbhāvakṛtaṃ nipātatvaṃ cāśritya a itaḥ eta ityatra pragṛhyasaṃjñāprasaṅgāt | "āsamudrakṣitīśānām" itivatsamāsaḥ | na ca āṅ‌bhāvātideśe āṅ‌bhinnatvavyapadeśanivṛttiḥ | guruvad guruputre vartitavyamityatra gurutvasyeva āṅ‌vadbhāvena āṅ‌tvasyānatideśāt | atideśe vā "āṅayamakāraḥ" ityāhāryabuddherāṅ‌bhinno'yamiti buddhāvavirodhāt | atideśānāṃ ca svāśrayānivarttakatvāt | brāhmaṇavadasminkṣatriye vartitavyamityatra kṣatriyatvavyapadeśanivṛttyabhāvāt | astu vā ekādeśe'pi sthānivadbhāvenaiva parāvarṇagatasyāṅ‌bhinnatvasyāśrayaṇam | kaiyaṭādāvapi parādivadbhāvenaikādeśasyāṅ‌bhinnatvāśrayaṇāt | tasmātprasajyapratiṣedha eva yuktaḥ | vākyabhedāsamarthasamāsāśrayaṇasya kāryānurodhenādoṣatvāt, "anaci" "aśiti" ityādivat | ata evottarasūtre pratiṣiddhārtho'yamārambha iti bhāṣyaṃ saṅgacchate iti | idaṃ tvavadheyam | paryudāsapakṣe nañivayuktanyāyabalādeva nipātalābhasambhave'pi nipātapadopādānaṃ svayameva yo nipātastasyaiva pragṛhyatvam, na tu sthānivadbhāvaprayuktanipātatvakasyetyetadarthakam | tena noktadoṣaḥ | atideśenaiva tatra nipātatvasyānīyamānatvāt | nipātagrahaṇasya cottarārthatve'pi "ihakiñcittrapo iti" iti nyāyenātropādānasyāpi prayojanasambhave sati tyāgāyogāt | evam ekagrahaṇasyāpyatra pūrvoktarītyā prayojanābhāvānmukhyārthakamevaikapadaṃ vyākhyāyatām | "eke mukhyānyakevalāḥ" ityamarokteḥ | taccaupadeśikatvarūpamatra grāhyam | tena mukhyatvasya sāmānādhikaraṇyena nipātatvalābhādātideśikanipātatvamāśritya noktadoṣaḥ | na caivaṃ "varṇagrahaṇe jātigrahaṇam" ityatra jñāpakānupapattiḥ | apṛktasaṃjñāsūtre ekagrahaṇasyāpi bhāṣyaeva tajjñāpakatvokteḥ | etena tata eva siddhāvatratyamekagrahaṇaṃ vyarthamityapi śaṅkā'ntaraṃ parāstam | vinigamakābhāvācca | vakṣyati tatra tathaiva kaiyaṭaḥ | nanvevamapi "pratiṣiddhārtham" iti bhāṣyavirodho durvāra iti vācyam | ado'bhavadityatrātiprasaṅgasaṅkāyā lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā samādhānasya ca taduktasyānupapattyā tadgranthasya prauḍhivādatvāt | na cottaragrantha eva prauḍhivādo lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣāyā varṇagrahaṇeṣvapravṛtteriti vācyam | tathā'pi go'bhavadityatrātiprasaṅgasaṅkāderanupapatteḥ | "anāṅ‌" ityatra prasajyapratiṣedhapakṣe vākyabhedāsamarthasamāsāśrayaṇāpatteśca | āṅ‌bhāvātideśena tadbhinnatvavyapadeśānivṛttāvapi tatkāryāṇāṃ nivṛtteśca | gurau gurubhinnatvavyapadeśasattve'pi gurutvaprayuktakāryapravṛtteḥ | āhāryabuddherapi śāstraprāmāṇyena kāryaniyāmakatvāt | asiddhasthale tathaiva klṛptatvāt | ot 15 | okārānto nipātaḥ pragṛhyaḥ | āho iti | utāho iti | nipāta iti kim | "niyutvānvāyavāyāhi" "viṣṇaurugāyeva te somaḥ" ityādau mā bhūt | vṛttikṛtastu gavityayamāhetyapi pratyudāharanti | atra vadanti---"tatra pragṛhyasaṃjñāsattve'pi na kṣatiḥ | prakṛtibhāvavidhau padāntādhikārādeva tadaprasakteḥ | gavityayamāhetyatra ca vibhaktiśravaṇābhāvādanukāryānukaraṇayorabhedavivakṣayā'rthavattvābhāvena prātipadikatvābhāvādvibhakteranutpattyā padāntatvābhāvāt | "apadaṃ na prayuñjīta" ityasya cāpariniṣṭhitaprayoganiṣedhārthatvāt | prakṛte ca go iti svarūpasyaiva pariniṣṭhitatvāt | ata eveha "lopaḥ śākalyasya" iti na pravartataiti | na caivaṃ "he'layo he'laya iti kurvanta" ityatra kathaṃ rutvayatvayalopā iti vācyam | tatra bhedavivakṣayā supratyayaṃ kṛtvā "hal‌ṅyāb‌bhyaḥ" iti vibhaktilopena "prakṛtivadanukaraṇam" ityatideśena vā padāntatvāt | tasmātprakṛtibhāvavidhau padāntagrahaṇānuvṛttirnāstītyabhiprāyeṇa vṛttigrantho yojyaḥ" iti | nanvāho ityādayo nipātasamudāyāḥ, āha u āho, uta āha u utāho ityādi, tataḥ pūrveṇaiva saṃjñā siddhā ādivadbhāvena | na ca āho itītyādau "uña ūm̐" ityasyāpattiḥ | ñakārānubandhasyaiva tatra grahaṇāt | na ca niranubandhaukāre mānābhāvaḥ | tatraiva bhāṣye vakṣyamāṇatvāt | na ca ā u ityanayorekādeśe o ityatrāntavadbhāvena āṅgrahaṇena tadgrahaṇena "anāṅ‌" iti pratiṣedhaḥ syādatastannirāsāyedam | anyathā "oṣu yātaṃ marutaḥ" "oṣu yātaṃ bṛhatī śakvarī ca" "ocitsakhāyaṃ sakhyāvavṛtyām" ityādau pragṛhyasaṃjñā'nāpatteḥ | na cāc‌paratvābhāvāttatsattve'pi na viśeṣa iti vācyam | kasyāñcicchākhāyām o ayātamiti pāṭhe viśeṣasambhavāt | pratiṣedhārtho'yamārambha iti bhāṣyasyaiva ca tatra pramāṇatvāt | na ca naitadbhāṣyakṛto vivakṣitam, ado'bhavadityādāvatiprasaṅgasyāgre śaṅkitatvāt, pratiṣiddhārthatve tatra prasakterevābhāvāditi vācyam | ubhayārthatve'pyavirodhāt | vidhyarthatvātparatvād "anāṅ‌" iti pratiṣedhabādhakatvasya ca sambhavāditi samāhitatvāt | astu vā "anāṅ‌" iti paryudāsa eva, tathā'pi āṅanāṅorekādeśasyādivadbhāvena anāṅ‌grahaṇena grahaṇāt | tatkimarthamidaṃ sūtramiti cet, atra bhāṣyam--- ekanipātā ime iti | akhaṇḍā eva, na tu nipātasamudāyāḥ | ato'pūrvavidhirevāyamam | ata eva "oṣu yātaṃ marutaḥ" ityādau padapāṭhakāle aikapadyenaiva pāṭhaḥ | evam ām āho devadattetītyatra "āma ekāntaramāmantritam" iti nighātapratiṣedho'pi | atha tathā'pi adaśśabdāt cvipratyaye "ūryādicviḍācaśca" iti gatisaṃjñāyāṃ lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā nirvāhaḥ | varṇagrahaṇeṣu tadapravṛtteḥ | anyathā haraye ityādau "eco'yavāyāvaḥ" ityasyāpravṛttyāpatteḥ | cakre idam ityādau cāritārthyāt | kiñca tathā'pi agaurgaurabhavat go'bhavad ityādau doṣo durvāraḥ | "gamerḍoḥ" iti okārasya svarūpata uccāraṇena pratipadoktatvāt iti cet, atra bhāṣyam--- gauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasampratyaya iti | tadyathā---"gauranubandhyo'jo'gnīṣomīyaḥ" iti na vāhīko'nubadhyataiti | ayamarthaḥ | "svaṃ rūpam" ityatra rūpagrahaṇenārthagrahaṇasyāpi jñāpitatvāt arthavataḥ kāryeṇa bhavitavyam | arthaśca dvedhā, mukhyo gauṇaśca | tatpadaśaktiviṣaya ādyaḥ | gauṇastu sādṛśyanimittakavṛttiviṣayaḥ | guṇanimittakavṛttisambandhitvena śabdavadarthe'pi svārasikagauṇapadaprayogāt | tatra prāthamyānmukhyārthasyaiva grahaṇam | vṛttyantarasya tad‌bādhaeva samullāsāt | śakyārthabhānasyāpi tatrābhyupagamena tatpūrvakatvācca | śakyasamavetaguṇaprakārakabodhatvasyaiva svaśakyaguṇavattārūpavṛttijñānakāryatāvacchedakatvopagamāt | tataśca go'bhavadityatra prakṛtereva kartṛtvam | "saṅghībhavanti brāhmaṇāḥ" "paṭībhavanti tantavaḥ" ityādau vacanavyavasthāyāḥ "tvadbhavati devadattaḥ" "madbhavasi tvam" "tvadbhavāmyaham" ityādau puruṣavyavasthāyāśca tata evopapatteḥ | prakṛtitvamatrāropaviṣayatvaṃ bodhyam | tatra ca gotvādikamāropitameva, na mukhyamiti | na ca gauṇe'pi guṇānāmeva pravṛttinimittatvābhyupagamātkathaṃ vāhīkādau gotvāropa iti vācyam | svotprekṣāprabhavāropaviṣayībhūtārthavṛttitvaṃ gauṇatvamiti matena tadukteḥ | atra hi śabdasya svābhidheyaṃ vinā'nyatra guṇayogamātreṇa pravṛttyabhāvāt | āropaviṣaye viṣayitāvacchedakadharmasyaivāropaḥ | na ca viviktatvena tadanupapattiḥ | śuktikādau cākacakyādisādṛśyena rajatatvādyāropavat "yoṣā vāva gautamāgniḥ" iti pañcāgnividyāyāṃ retomayahaviḥ prakṣeparūpahomādhikaraṇatvasādṛśyena yoṣāyāmagnitvāropavat jāḍyakrūratvādisādṛśyena vāhīkamāṇavakādau gotvasiṃhatvādyāropa ityāstāṃ prāsaṅgikam | tasmānna gauṇe parasparāvacchedaḥ | śābdānvayastu kriyāyāmeveti bhāṭṭasiddhāntaḥ | evaṃ gāṃ vāhīkamānayeti pūrvaṃ kriyāsambandhāpekṣayā vibhaktāvutpannāyāṃ paścātsāmānādhikaraṇyād‌ gauṇārthaprādurbhāvo bhavatīti | tadetaduktaṃ bhāṣyakṛdbhiḥ--- yattu śabdāśrayaṃ tacchabdamātre bhavati, śabdāśraye ca vṛddhyātve iti | yattu vākyasaṃskārapakṣe vṛddhyātvapravṛttitaḥ prāgeva gauṇārthāvagateḥ ādyamayuktamiti, tadasat | gauṇārthāvagatimātrasyākiñcitkaratvāt | tasya kāryapravṛttāvanupayuktatvāt | anyathā gāmānayeti mukhyārthe vṛddhyāderapravṛttiprasaṅgāt | yadapi "kiñcetyādikaṃ na yuktam, brūte pāṭhayetyādikriyānvayāyaiva gauṇatāyā āśrayaṇīyatvāt" iti, tadapyasat | "aruṇayaikahāyanyā piṅgākṣyā somaṃ krīṇāti" ityādāvapi aruṇayā krīṇātīti vākye guṇamātrasya krayasādhanatvānupapattyā tadarthaṃ prāgeva krayasādhanadravyasambandhena krayānvayāpattau tatsiddhāntabhaṅgaprasaṅgāt | ayogyatājñānasya śābdadhīpratibandhakatayā tadabhāvena svarūpasataivāruṇyasya krayabhāvanāyāmanvaye jñāte paścādeva yogyatākāṅkṣāyāmamūrtatvena sākṣādayogyatve'pi dravyaparicchedarūpavyāpāradvārā karaṇatvayogyatānirṇayaḥ | prathamaṃ tu kārakāntaravadeva bhāvanāyāmāruṇyasya sambandha ityādestatra nirūpitatvāt | prakṛte'pi tadrītyā pūrvaṃ gauṇatvapratyaye bījābhāvāt | yadapyuktam, "kaṭo'pi karma bhīṣmādayo'pi" iti pakṣe uktisambhave'pi sāmānādhikaraṇyādbhīṣmāderdvitīyeti bhāṣyoktapakṣāntare cintyam | akārādīnāmaikyapakṣe bāhuka ityādau caritārthānāṃ "naudvyacaḥ" ityādīnāṃ ghaṭika ityādau pravṛttirna syādityāśaṅkāparāṇām aiuṇ‌sūtrasthabhāṣyādigranthānāṃ virodhāt | śakyam, śabdasvarūpaṃ ca śakyatāvacchedakam | ādyaṃ prasiddhivaśācchīghropasthitikam, na tvantyamiti viśeṣaḥ | śvaśuraśabdasya svarūpeṇopādānasthale śīghropasthityarthavācake caritārthaṃ śāstraṃ dvitīye na pravartate | "ata iñ‌" ityatra tvakārāntasya saṃjñāśvaśure'pi sattvātkathaṃ na iñ‌ pratyayaḥ pravartteta | tadupasthitau prathamaśvaśurapadārthabodhasyānapekṣitatvena tacchabdasya tūddeśyatāvacchekatāvacchedakam | taddhaṭakasambandho yadi sāmānādhikaraṇyamātraṃ tarhi "athopayantrā sadṛśena yuktām" ityatraikādeśaśya pūrvāntatvena grahaṇādokārāntatvaṃ nipātatvaṃ cāstīti "athāto brahmajijñāsā" ityādāvapyathaśabdasya pragṛhyasaṃjñā syāt | tathā ca yasyāṃ vyaktau odantatvanipātatvayoḥ samaniyatatvaṃ tatroktavidhipravṛttiriti vaktavyam | gośabde ca nipātatvābhāvadaśāyāmapyodantatvamastyeveti na pravṛttiḥ | aho ityādau ubhayamapyastīti nāvyāptiḥ | etena nipātasaṃjñā tasyāpi mukhyaivetyapāstam | uktarītyā uddeśyatāvacchedakarūpavaikalyāt | itau kim | viṣṇo'tra | uña ūm̐ 17 | iha trairūpyamiṣṭam | ādeśavikalpe pragṛhyatvavikalpe ca ūm̐ iti | u iti | viti | ubhayābhāvapakṣe yaṇādeśaḥ | taccaikasminsūtre na sidhyati | uña ityasya śrutenādeśena sambandhe śākalyapadānuvṛttyā ādeśavikalpe tadabhāvapakṣe "nipāta ekājanāṅ‌" iti pragṛhyasaṃjñāyā nityatayā rūpadvayasyaivāpatteḥ | ato yogavibhāgaṃ kṛtvā vyākhyeyam | "uñaḥ" śākalyasyeti itau pragṛhyamiti cānuvartate | asya itiśabde pare pragṛhyasaṃjñā vā syāt | u iti | viti | tataḥ "ūm̐" iti dvitīyo yogaḥ | atra yadi pragṛhyasya śākalyasyetyubhayamapi nānuvarttata, tadā tvaniṣṭamapi rūpaṃ syāt | yadi tu pragṛhyasya uña ityevānuvartteta, tadā pragṛhyasya uño nityamādeśavidhāne ūm̐ iti viti iti ca dve eva rūpe syātām | yadi tu śākalyagrahaṇamātramanuvartteta, tadā pragṛhyāpragṛhyayorādeśavikalpe ūm̐ iti u iti dve pragṛhyasya | apragṛhyatvapakṣe ca ādeśasya yaṇādeśesānunāsikavakārayuktaṃ śuddhasya yaṇādeśe ca niranunāsikavakārayuktaṃ ceti dve rūpe iti militvā rūpacatuṣṭaye sānunāsikavakārayuktaṃ rūpamaniṣṭaṃ syāt | ata ubhayānuvṛttyā pragṛhyasyādeśavikalpe sati iṣṭarūpatrayasiddhiḥ | tena pragṛhyasya ūña ūm̐ ādeśo vā syādityarthaḥ | nanu śākalyasyaiva mate yogavibhāgāśrayaṇāt | ata eva "ūm̐vāśākalyasya" "śākalyasyācāryasya mate vā ūm̐ ayamādeśaḥ" iti bhāṣyaṃ śākalyaśrutereva phalaṃ vāgrahaṇena pratipādayatīti vyākhyātam | kecittu śākalyagrahaṇasya yathāśrutatve'pi "nipāta ekāj‌" ityeva siddhe "uñaḥ" iti sūtraṃ niyamārtham, śākalyabhinnamate uñaḥ pragṛhyatvaṃ neti tadarthaḥ | "ūm̐" iti sūtre ca pragṛhyasya uña ityetāvataiva śākalyalābhe punaḥ
