iti saptamyā luk | padapāṭhakāle itiśabdasya taduttaraṃ prayogādudāharaṇatvam | "somogaurī adhiśritaḥ" iti | saṃhitāyāmapyudāharaṇatvam | īdūtāviti kim | priyaḥ sūrye priyo agnā bhavāti | agniśabdātsaptamyā ḍādeśaḥ | saptamyarthe kim | dhītī | matī | suṣṭutī | tṛtīyāyā īkārarūpaḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ | atra vārttikam--- īdūtau saptamītyeva lupte'rthagrahaṇādbhavet | pūrvasya cetsavarṇā'sāvāḍām‌bhāvaḥ prasajyate || vacanādyatra dīrghatvaṃ tatrāpi sarasī yadi | jñāpakaṃ syāttadantatve mā vā pūrvapadasya bhūt || ayamarthaḥ | īdūtau saptamyādityevāstu kimarthamarthagrahaṇam, saptamīsahacaritaṃ yadīdūdantam, yadvā---saptamyāṃ paratastat pragṛhyasaṃjñamityarthe "somogaurī adhiśritaḥ" ityādau luptāyāmapi saptamyāṃ pratyayalakṣaṇena pragṛhyatvasiddheriti praśnaḥ | saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantagrahaṇābhāvādarthagrahaṇaṃ vinā saptamyā evaṃ saṃjñinītvālluptāyāśca kāryābhāvāt pratyayaṃ nimittīkṛtyānyasya kāryavidhānaevapratyayalakṣaṇānuśāsanātsvakārye tadabhāvācca gaurī ityatra pragṛhyasaṃ jñā na syādato'rthagrahaṇam | tena ca saṃjñāyā arthanibandhanatvena pratyayaśravaṇānapekṣatvālluptāyāmapi saptamyāṃ pkṛtibhāvasya saṃjñetyabhiprāyeṇottaraṃ luptaiti | nanu gaurī ityatra na saptamyā lopaḥ, kintu dhītī matī suṣṭutītyādāviva "akaḥ sarvaṇe" iti ekādeśaḥ | tasya cādivadbhāvādbhavatyeva īkāraḥ saptamīti nedaṃ prayojanamityāha---pūrvasyacedityādi | dūṣayati---āḍām‌bhāva iti | ekādeśaṃ bādhitvā paratvādāṅgatvācca "āṇ‌nadyāḥ" itiyāṭ‌ | "ṅerām‌nadyāmnībhyaḥ" iti saptamyā āmityādeśaśca syādityarthaḥ | nanu saptamīlopaṃ vinā īdūdantatvābhāvādanyatra ca saṃjñāyāḥ prayojanābhāvādetādṛśasthale tallopasya sārvatrikatvāttatra pravṛttiṃ vinā saṃjñāyā vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāttatsāmarthyādeva luptāyāmapi saptamyāṃ saṃjñā bhaviṣyatyevetyāha---vacanāditi | yatra saptamyāśchandasa īkārādeśaḥ, tatraiva saṃjñāvidhānasya caritārthatvāpattyā sāmarthyasyopakṣīṇatvātsaptamīlopasthale saṃjñā na syādevetyāha---yatra dīrghatvamiti | yathā---"dṛtiṃ na śuṣkaṃ sarasī śayānam" ityatra saraḥ śabdātparasya saptamyekavacanasya "iyāḍiyā jīkārāṇāmupasaṃkhyānam" iti ī ityādeśaḥ | tatra saptamyāḥ śrūyamāṇatvena saṃjñāvidhānasya cāritārthyāditi | nanu tatrāpi na saptamyā īkārādeśaḥ | prayojanābhāvāt | kintu sarasīśabdottarasaptamyā lopa eveti saṃjñāvidheḥ sāmarthyamastyevetyāha---tatrāpīti | yadi ityasaṃdehe sandehaḥ, "śāstrāṇi cetpramāṇaṃ syuḥ" ityādivat | "sarasī tu mahāsaraḥ" iti śabdārṇavāt | "dakṣiṇāpathe mahānti sarāṃsi tu mahāsaraḥ" iti śabdārṇavāt | "dakṣiṇāpathe mahānti sarāṃsi sarasya ityucyante" iti bhagavadukteḥ | "sādharmyaṃ dadhati girāṃ mahāsarasya_" ityādidarśanācca | nanu tathaā'pi sarasīśabdasyaiva luptasaptamīkasyāyaṃ prayogo, na tu saraḥ śabdasyetyatra kiṃ mānam, tanmātrārthamarthapadopādānasya sandarbhaviruddhatvāditi cet, atrāhuḥ--- sarasīśayānamityatrāntodāttapāṭha eva mānam | gaurādimadhye "pippalyādayaśca" iti pāṭhāttadantaḥ pātino ṅīṣantasarasīśabdasyaiva antodāttatvāt | asunpratyayāntasya saraḥ śabdasya nitsvareṇādyudāttattavāpatteriti | tasmādarthagrahaṇaṃ mā'stviti siddham | nanu pragṛhyasaṃjñāprakaraṇe pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ nāstīti jñāpanārthametatsyādityāha---jñāpakaṃ syāditi | uktārthasyeti śeṣaḥ | tasya prayojanamāha---tadantatve iti | "īdūded‌ dvivacanaṃ pragṛhyam" iti sūtre īdūdedantaṃ dvivacanāntamiti, īdūdedantaṃ yat dvivacanaṃ tadantamiti pakṣaśca siddho bhavatītyarthaḥ | nanu tatra tadantavidhyabhāvādeva tat pakṣadvayaṃnirastam | ata etadarthajñāpanamanupayuktamevetyata āha---māveti | pūrvapadasyeti | vāpyāmaśvo vāpyaśvaḥ nadyāmātirnadyātiritisamāse luptasaptamīkayoḥ vāpīnadīśabdayoḥ pratyayalakṣaṇena saptamyantatvātpragṛhyatvaṃ mā bhūdityarthaṃ sārthakamevārthagrahaṇamityarthaḥ | nanvarthagrahaṇe'pi tatrātivyāptirdurvārā | saptamyarthasya pratīyamānatvāt iti cet, maivam | jahatsvārthavṛttipakṣe samāse viśiṣṭaśaktisvīkāreṇa pūrvapadasyānarthakatvāt | ajahatsvārthā vṛttiritipakṣe'pi pūrvapade saptamyarthe lakṣaṇaiva | arthapadopādāne tu viśeṣyatāsambandhena saptamīpadajanyopasthitimattvasya lābhāt | samāse pratīyamānasyādhikaraṇatvādestathātvābhāvādeva tadvāraṇaṃ bodhyam | atredamavadheyam | ayaṃ yogaśchāndasa eva | tena yayīpapīvātapramīśabdānāṃ paptamyekavacane īkārāntānāmapi na pragṛhyasaṃjñā | anyathā eṣāmeva śrūyamāṇasaptamīkānāmīdantatvasambhavena "tatrāpi sarasī yadi" ityetatparyantānudhāvanavaiyaparthyāpatteḥ | etena ukārāntasya bhāṣāyāmasambhavāttadanusāra ityapi nirastam | ihadatto'pyevam | ata evana prasādakāreṇa vaidikaprakriyāyāmevedaṃ sūtramupanyastam | dādhā ghvadāp 19 | dārūpā dhārūpāśca dhātavo ghusaṃjñāḥ syuḥ dāb‌daipau vinā | pradeśāḥ "nergadanada" ityādayaḥ | dārūpāścatvāraḥ | ḍudāñ‌ dāne | dāṇ‌ | do avakhaṇḍane | deṅ‌ pālane | dhārūpau dvau | ḍudhāñ‌ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ | dheṭ‌ pāne | ejantānām "ādeca upadeśe" ityātvena dārūpatvam | anaimittikamātvaṃ śiti tu pratiṣedha iti siddhāntāt | na cānukaraṇasya dhātutvaṃ nāstīti vācyam | "prakṛtivadanukaraṇam" ityatideśena tatsambhavāt | na ca prakṛtāveva kṛtāttvānāmanukaraṇamastu kimatideśeneti vācyam | teṣāmātvābhāvasthale praṇidyati praṇidayataityādau ghusaṃjñā'nāpatteḥ | tataścaturṇāṃ dārūpāṇāṃ dvayośca dhārūpayorekaśeṣottaraṃ dvandvaḥ | prātipadikasaṃjñāṃ prati atideśāpravṛttyāśrayeṇa vibhaktyantatvāt | "niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya" ityasyā lakṣaṇapratipodaktaparibhāṣāyāśca neha pravṛttiḥ | viśiṣyaiva sarveṣāmupādānāt | adābiti kim | dāp lavane | dātaṃ barhiḥ | chinnamityarthaḥ | "do dad ghoḥ" iti dadādeśābhāvaḥ | daip śaudhane | avadātaṃ mukham | ghutvābhāvād "aca upasargāttaḥ" ityasya na pravṛttiḥ | uddeśyasamarpake dā ityatra anayorapyanukaraṇaśaṅkānirāsārthañcedam | tenānayoranukṛtatvābhāve'pi na kṣatiḥ | na ca dīṅo'pi kathamatra nopādānam, "mīnātiminotidīṅāṃ lyapi ca" iti tasyāpyādantatvāditi vācyam | tatsvarūpānukaraṇe ātvānupapatteḥ | tena hi guṇottaramātvaṃ vidhīyataiti vārttikamatam | guṇādinimitte pratyaye pare iti tu bhāṣyamatam | ubhayathā'pi naimittikatayā anukaraṇe pravṛttyabhāvāt | "ādecaḥ" ityātvaṃ tu anaimittikatvādanukaraṇe'pi pravartataiti vaiṣamyam | vārtikakṛtastu ejantānukaraṇatve pramāṇābhāvādgauravācca prayogaeva ye ākārāntāḥ prayujyante tadanukaraṇānāmevāyamekaśeṣeṇa nirdeśaḥ, "dādhā" iti pṛthak‌padaṃ vā sāmānyānukaraṇam | nanvevaṃ praṇidyati praṇidayate ityādau ghusaṃjñā'bhāve ṇatvaṃ na syāt | śiti ātvaniṣedhāt kṛtātvānāmeva ca tvayā ghusaṃjñāsvīkārāt iti cet, satyam | vacanenaiva samādheyatvāt | tathā ca kātyāyanavārttikam--- ghusaṃjñāyāṃ prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ śidarthamiti | bhāradvājīyāstu śidvikṛtārthamiti paṭhanti | ayamarthaḥ---"dādhāprakṛtayo ghusaṃjñāḥ" iti sūtraṃ kāryam | dādhā ityaṃśena prayoge ādantānāṃ ghusaṃjñā | prakṛtipadaṃ ca sannidhānāt dādhāprakṛtiparam | tathā ca tatsthale ātvābhāve'pi yeṣāmātvaṃ yatra kvacidvihitaṃ teṣāmapi ghusaṃjñā | ātvānupadhāne'pi tatprakṛtitvasya ātvādeśasthānitāvacchedakarūpavattvasya sattvāt | tena praṇidyati ityādi siddham | bhāṣyakṛtastvāhuḥ---"nergada" iti sūtre ghumāsyatītyatra ghuśabdāvyavahitottaraprakṛtipadamavaśyaṃ paṭhanīyam, ghuprakṛtimeti | anyathā praṇimayataityatra ṇatvānupapatteḥ | lākṣaṇikatvena meṅo māśabdena grahītumaśakyatvāt | prakṛtigrahaṇe tu prakṛtipadasya sannidhānānmāprakṛtyarthakatvena meṅ‌grahaṇasiddheḥ | na caivaṃ mīnātiminotyorapi "mīnātiminoti" ityādinā kutracidātvavidhānena tayorapi māprakṛtitvāṇṇatvāpattiḥ | māṅiti ṅakārānubandhasyāpi pāṭhyatvāt | anyathā mā māne ityasyāpi grahaṇāpatteḥ | evaṃ ghumāṅ‌prakṛtīti pāṭhamapahāya "ghuprakṛtimāṅ‌" ityādi paṭhanīyam | ghuśca prakṛtiśca māṅ‌ ceti dvandve prakṛtipadaṃ sanni hitatvātpūrvottarobhayaprakṛtiparam | evaṃ ca ghuprakṛtītyukte ghuśabdena dādhārūpāṇāmupasthitau tatprakṛtitvena dhātusvarūpalābhāt praṇidyati praṇidayataityādau ghusaṃjñaāṃ vinā'pi ṇatvaṃ siddhamiti ghusaṃjñāyāṃ prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ vyartham | yattu bhāradvājīyairuktam, "vikṛtārtham" iti, tadapi na | "gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ" iti paribhāṣayā lākṣaṇikasyāpi dārūpasya ghusaṃjñāsiddheḥ | asyāṃ ca daipaḥ pittvameva liṅgam | taddhi adābityatra paryudāsapratiyogikukṣau daipo'pi niveśo'stu ityartham | lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā dāgrahaṇe'pravṛttau tu daipa ātvasya lākṣaṇikatayā tasya pratiyogibahirbhāvastadavastha eva syāditi tadvaiyarthyameva syāt | nanu tathā'pi dheṭo ghusaṃjñā na syāt | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ | prakṛtiśabdena ṇatvasiddhāvapi ghusaṃjñāprayuktakāryāntarāṇāmasiddhiprasaṅgāt, satyam | "do dad ghoḥ" ityatra dheṭo nivṛttyarthaṃ kṛtena da ityanena tasyāpi ghusaṃjñājñāpanāt | ghutvābhāve sthānitāvacchedakānākrāntatvādeva tasya tadbhāvāprasaktau tannivṛttyarthayatnānaucityāt | na ca dadhāti nivṛttyarthatvena sārthakyam | "dadhāterhiḥ" iti tasya hyādeśavidhānātsāmānyaviśeṣanyāyenaiva ghuśabdasya dadhātyanyaparatvopapatteḥ | na ca dṛṅ‌dhṛṅorṇici dārayati dhārayatītyatra dādhārūpatvāt tatrātiprasaṅgaḥ, vṛddhyā ākāre kṛte dādhā ityetayorarthavattvāt, raparatvasya paścādeva pravṛttyā tadaṅgabhūtatvena tadanyatvāpravartakatvāt iti vācyam | "siddhaṃ tu prasaṅge raparatvād‌" iti vārttikarītyā ār‌ ityādeśasyaiva vṛddhyā vidhānāt dār dhār‌ ityanayorevārthavattvāt tadavayavayordādhā ityanayoratrāgrahaṇāt | "arthavadgrahaṇe nānarthakasya" iti nyāyāt | dāpayati dhāpayatītyādau tu pugāgamātpūrvameva ghusaṃjñāpravṛttau pugviśiṣṭasyāpi ghugrahaṇena grahaṇam | abhyupetyāpi brūmaḥ---dār‌ dhār‌ ityetadavayavayordādhārūpayorghusaṃjñāyāmapi pranidārayatītyādau na ṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ | ghusaṃjñānirūpitaṃ yasyopasargatvaṃ tataḥ parasya nerṇatvavidhānāt | tatra ca rephaviśiṣṭaṃ pratyevopasargatvam, na tu tannirmuktapūrvabhāganirūpitam | yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ pratyeva gatyupasargasaṃjñā iti niyamāt | nanvevaṃ dāpayatidhāpayatyorapi tanna syāditi cet, na | pūrvapravṛttasaṃjñāyā āgamopajane'pi tadavasthatvāt | yadā tu upasargasya ṇyarthaviśeṣakatvam, tadādādhārūpaṃ pratyupasargatvābhāvānnityaṃ ṇatvaṃ na bhavatyeva, kintu "śeṣe vibhāṣā" iti vaikalpikameveti | tadevaṃ matatrayaṃ paryavasannam | "pūrvoktāstraya ādantāstrayaśca eṅantā viśiṣya ghusaṃjñāḥ" iti sūtrakārasya, "prayoge ākārāntānāṃ dādhārūpāṇāṃ tatprakṛtīnāṃ ca" iti vārttikakārasya, "prayoge ākārāntānāmeva saṃjñā, tatprakṛtīnāṃ tu ṇatvavidhau prakṛtigrahaṇāṇṇatvamātram, na tu ghusaṃjñā" iti bhāṣyakārasya matamiti | evaṃ sthite upadidīṣataityatra dīṅassanpratyaye "sani mīmāghurabha" ityādinā is‌bhāvaḥ syāt | "mīnātiminotidīṅāṃ lyapi ca" iti dīṅa ātvavidhānena tasya dāprakṛtitvāt vārtikamate ghusaṃjñatvāt | anyamatadvaye tu nāyaṃ doṣa iti spaṣṭameveti cet, ucyate--- yadi īkārāntasyaiva dīṅa ātvavidhānam, tadā'yaṃ doṣaḥ syāt, na tvevam, kintu guṇe kṛte ekārāntasyaiva ātvaṃ vidhīyate | tataśca dāprakṛtitvaṃ de ityasyaiva na tu dī ityasya | upadidīṣataityatra ca ejantatvābhāvena dāprakṛtitvaṃ nāstīti ghusaṃjñāvirahāt | dābhāvanirūpitasthānitvasya tatprayojyanivṛttipratiyogitvarūpasya ejantaeva viśrānteḥ | na caivas ādantatvanimittakayuc‌pratyayādyasiddhiḥ |" ākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ pratyayavidhiḥ" iti viśiṣyaiva vārttikakṛtā tasya vihitatvāt | nanvevamapi vārttikabhāṣyakārayormate upādāstetyatra "sthāghvoricca" iti itvaṃ syāt, prayoge ādantatvasyātra sattvena bhāṣyamate'pi ghusaṃjñatvāt, iti cet, atra vārttikaṃ tāvat--- dīṅaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ sthāghvorittve iti | tathā ca vācanika eva tadabhāvaḥ | bhāṣyakṛtā tu saṃnipātalakṣaṇanyāyena samāhitam | tathā hi---pūrvoktarītyā ejantānāmātvavidhānābhyupagame yuc‌pratyayādisiddhyarthaṃ vārtikāntarakaraṇe gauravāt ejviṣaye ātvaṃ vidhīyate | guṇavṛddhinimittakapratyaye vivakṣite iti yāvat | tathā ca pratyayotpattipūrvameva dīṅādīnāmādantatvātsiddhastallakṣaṇapratyaya iti lāghavam | evaṃ sati ātve akittvasannipāto nimittam | kittve sati guṇavṛddhiniṣedhena ejviyānupapatteḥ | tataścākittvasaṃnipātakṛtamātvaṃ sicaḥ kittvapravartikāṃ ghusaṃjñāṃ na pravartayati | kittvena ejviṣayāpahāre ghusaṃjñānimittasya ātvasya nimittavighātāpatteḥ | syādetat | sūtramate praṇidātetyādau dīṅa ātve kṛte ṇatvaṃ na bhavati, ghusaṃjñāvirahāt | bhāṣyavārttikamate tu ṇatvāpattiḥ, prayoge ādantatvāt dāprakṛtitvācca ghusaṃjñāsattvāditi dvayoḥ sūtrakṛtā saha virodhaḥ | evaṃ praṇidīyate praṇidīna ityādau bhāṣyamate "nergada" iti nityaṃ ṇatvam, tatra prakṛtigrahaṇena ghusaṃjñāyā anapekṣitatvāt | vārttikamate tu "śeṣe vibhāṣā" iti vaikalpikam | ejantānāmeva dāprakṛtitvopagamena īdantasyāprakṛtitvāditi dvayoḥ parasparavirodho durvāra iti cet, atrāhuḥ--- bhāṣyarītyā sarvatra dīṅo nityaṃ ṇatvamiti sthite sūtravārtikamate'pi "śeṣe vibhāṣā" ityasya dīṅaśe vyavasthitavikalpatvamāśritya nityaṇatvameva svīkāryam | "yathottaraṃ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyam" iti siddhāntāt iti | nanvadābiti paryudāsapratiyogitvaṃ dāp lavanaityasyaiva syānna tu daiṣaḥ, pakāraviśiṣṭasyātvāyegāditi cet, maivam | anubandhānāmanekāntatvapakṣe pakārasyānavayavatvena dhātorejantatvānapāyāt | ekāntatvapakṣe'pi "udīcāṃ māṅo vyatīhāre" iti kṛtātvasya meṅo nirdeśena "nānubandhakṛtamanejantatvam" ityasya jñāpitatvāt | ubhayathā'pyātvapravṛttau bādhakābhāvāt | na cāyaṃ māṅ‌ māne ityasyaiva nirdeśaḥ syāditi vācyam | tasya karmavyatīhāravivakṣāyāmeva vyatīhāre vṛtteḥ | meṅastu svabhāvādeva tadvṛttitvāt | tasmādeva vyatīhāre tkāpratyayasyānena vidhānāt | praṇidānavyatīhāraśabdayorekārthatvāt | bhāṣyabalātpūrvakālānyārthatkāpratyayasya meṅo'nabhidhānanirṇayācca | evaṃ ca meṅa iti paṭhanīye māṅa iti pāṭhasya jñāpakatvamavyāhatam | vastutastu daipaḥ pittvamevātra jñāpakam | taddhi paryudāse daipo grahaṇārthameva | ātvāpravṛttyā tatparyudāsābhāve tu tadvaiyarthyāpatteḥ | lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣāyā apravṛttijñāpanenaiva taccaritārthamiti cenna | uddeśyāsiddhitādavasthye tāvanmātrasya vyarthatvāt | bhāṣyakṛtastu dābevāyaṃ na daibastītyāhuḥ | na caivaṃ dāyatīti rūpaṃ na syāditi vācyam | divādiṣu pāṭhāt śyanpratyayena tatsaṃbhavāt | na hyatra svare bhedaḥ | dāyatītyādau ubhayathā'pyādyudāttatvāt | "tāsyanudāttenṅidadupadeśāllasārvadhātukamanudāttamah‌nviṅoḥ" iti sūtreṇa adupadeśābhyāṃ śap‌śyan‌bhyāṃ parasya tibāderanudāttatvavidhānāt | na ca tācchīlike cānaśi dāyamāna ityatra svarabhedaḥ syāt, cānaśo lādeśasārvadhātukatvābhāvena anudāttatvābhāvāt, śyani nitsvareṇa dhātorādyudāttatvam, śapi tu pittvāttasyānudāttatvam, cānaśastu citsvareṇāntodāttatvamiti vācyam | śyansvarasya satiśiṣṭatve'pi "anyatra vikaraṇebhyaḥ" iti paryudāsena tatrāpyantodāttatvāt | "satiśiṣṭo'pivikaraṇasvaraḥ sārvadhātukasvaraṃ na bādhate, yadayaṃ tāseḥ parasya lasārvadhātukasyānudāttatvaṃ śāsti, lasārvadhātuka eva tajjñāpakaṃ syānnetyāha, aviśeṣeṇa jñāpakam" iti "ātmamāne khaśca" iti sūtre bhāṣyadarśanāt | tataśca yathā tatra khaś‌svareṇa śyansvarasya bādhaḥ, evamiha cānaś‌svareṇāpi ityarthapratīterityāhuḥ | na caivamapi dāpayatītyasyāpi paryudāsāpattiḥ | yathoddeśapakṣe antaraṅgatvātpugāgamātpūrvameva ghusaṃjñāpravṛtteḥ | nanu kāryakālapakṣe ṇatvaghusaṃjñayoḥ samānadeśatvātpukaṃ prati tayorasiddhatvena "antaraṅgabahiraṅgayoḥ" itinyāyānavatārāt prāgeva puk, tato ghusaṃjñā na syāditi cet, atra bhāṣyam--- dādhā ghvapiditi vakṣyāmīti | tathā ca bhedapratiyogitāvacchedakapittvasya dāpayatītyatrābhāvānna doṣaḥ | yadvā---uktadhātū bakārāntāveva | sūtramapi bakārāntam | cartvena tu pakāraśravaṇam | ato na doṣa iti | ādyantavadekasmin 20 | asahāye'pi ādāvivāntaiva ca kāryaṃ syāt, ekasminnityupameye saptamīdarśanādādyantavaditi saptamīsamarthādvatiḥ | mathurāvat pāṭaliputre prākāra ityādau tathādarśanāt | ekaśabdaścāsahāyavācī, na tu saṅkhyāvācī | ekatvasya vastumātre sattvenāvyāvarttakatvāt | asahāyatvaṃ cātra tat‌kāryoddeśyatāvacchedakadharmaparyāptyāśrayatve satyekatvarūpaṃ grāhyam | na saṃkhyāvācītyasya coktaviśeṣaṇāṃśavinirmuktasaṃkhyāyā vācyatvavyavacchede tātparyam | bhavati hi ādyudāttavidhāvuddeśyatāvacchedakasya pratyayatvasya paryāptyāśrayaḥ aupagava ityādau akārādiḥ | tavyadādau tu tāvadvarṇā iti viśeṣyadalena tadvāraṇam | tatrādivattve prayojanāni | pratyayādyudāttatvam, taittirīya ityādau iva aupagava ityādāvapi yathā syāt | "ñnityādirnityam" āhicumbakāyaniḥ āgniveśya ityādāviva gārgyaḥ kṛtirityādāvapi syāt | "ārddhadhātukasyeḍ‌ valādeḥ" itīṭ‌ kariṣyatītyādāviva joṣiṣadityādāvapi syāt | "yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe" iti ajādau vidhīyamānau iyaṅuvaṅau śriyo bhruva ityādāviva śriyau bhruvau ityādāvapi syātām | "āḍajādīnām" aikṣiṣṭetyādāviva adhyaiṣṭetyādāvapi yathā syāt | athāntavattve prayojanāni | "īdūded dvicanam" iti pragṛhyatvaṃ pacete ityādāviva khaṭ‌ve ityādāvapi yathā syāt | "napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ" iti num "midaco'ntyātparaḥ" ityanena kuṇḍānītyādāviva yānītyādāvapi ante yathā syāt | "aco'ntyādi ṭi" iti saṃjñayā "ṭita ātmanepānāṃ ṭere" ityetvaṃ kurvāte ityādāviva kurve ityādāvapi syāt | "supi ca" ityakārāntasyāṅgasya dīrghatvaṃ ghaṭābhyāmityādāviva ābhyāmityādāvapi yathā syāt | "yena vidhiḥ" ityajantasya vidhīyamāno yat jeyamityādāviva adhyeyamityādāvapi yathā syāt | tathā hi---"parasmin sati yasmātpūrvaṃ nāsti sa ādiḥ" "pūrvasminsati yasmātparaṃ nāsti so'nyaḥ" iti nirūḍhau vyavahāraḥ | etadanusāreṇa varṇānāmādyantatvayornirūpyamāṇayoḥ svavṛttidharmāśrayaprāgabhāvādhikaraṇakālavṛttitve sati taddharmāśrayadhvaṃsānadhikaraṇakālavṛttitvam āditvam | svavṛttidharmāśrayadhvaṃsādhikaraṇakālavṛttitve sati taddharmāśrayaprāgabhāvānadhikaraṇakālavṛttitvaṃ cāntatvaṃ phalati | svapadaṃ lakṣyatvābhimatatattadvyaktiparam | tad‌vṛttidharmaśca tadvidhāvuddeśyatāvacchedakībhūto grāhyaḥ | taddharmāśrayaśca tattatpratyayavyaktyantargata eva grāhyaḥ | anyathā tadaprasiddhyāpatteḥ | madhyasthe'tivyāptivāraṇāya ubhayatra viśeṣyam | tacca iyādāvasti na tvakāramātre | ato mukhye caritārthaṃ śāstram anuttaratvāpūrvarūpaṃ gauṇamāditvamantatvaṃ cādāyakevale na pravartteta | ata idaṃ sūtram | yastu vārttikam--- apūrvānuttaralakṣaṇatvādādyantayoḥ siddhamekasminniti | apūrvatvamevāditvam, anuttaratvamevāntatvām, tena sarvatrāpi mukhyatvādeva siddheḥ sūtrametadvyarthamiti, tatra bhāṣyam--- gonardīyastvāha--- satyametat, sati tvanyasminniti | tathā ca svārasikapratītyanurodhāduktaviśiṣṭadharma eva ādyantapadaśakyatāvacchedaka ityuktavārttikamayuktamityarthaḥ | ekasminniti kim | sabhāsaṃnayane bhavaḥ sābhāsaṃnayanaḥ | atra bhaśabdottaramākāramāśritya "vṛddhiryasyācāmādiḥ" iti vṛddhasaṃjñā mā bhūt | atha "vṛddhiryasyācāmādiḥ" itivṛddhasaṃjñāsūtrasthenaiva ādipadenātra doṣo nāstīti cenna | tatratyādiśabdasya mukhyādiparatvābhāvāt | anyathā jānātīti jñā brāhmaṇī ityādau jñāpadasyāpi vṛddhatvānāpattyā jñīya ityatra chapratyayānāpatteḥ | ihaikagrahaṇe tu madhyāvasānasthānāṃ āditvātideśavirahāt tadvyāvarttakatayā tatratyasya ādiśabdasya sārthakyāt | atra nyāsakāraḥ---atideśasūtre ekagrahaṇābhāve vṛddhasaṃjñāsūjñagatamādigrahaṇamanātideśikapratipatyarthaṃ sat asahāyānāṃ jñādīnāmeva vṛddhasaṃjñāṃ vārayet | sabhāsannayane tu syādeva, svottaragatānāmacāṃ catuṣṭayamapekṣya anātideśikasya āditvasya tatra sattvāditi | tatra vadanti---atraikagrahaṇābhāve yatra mukhyamāditvaṃ nāsti sa sarvo'pyatideśaviṣayaḥ syāt | tataśca yathā jñādīnāṃ na vṛddhatvaṃ tathā sabhāsannayanasyāpi na syāt | asahāyavanmadhyagate'pi mukhyāditvavyavahārābhāvāt, tat kathamuktavaiṣamyamiti | nyāsakṛtastvayamabhiprāyaḥ---vyavahārānurodhena lakṣaṇakaraṇam | taduktamācāryaiḥ-- siddhānugamamātraṃ hi kartavyaṃ tu parīkṣakaiḥ | na sarvalokasiddhasya lakṣaṇena nivartanam || iti | tataścāyamādirityukte taduttarasya anta ityukte ca pūrvasya niyamata ākāṅkṣā, na tu pūrvābhāvasyottarābhāvasya ceti sarvasiddham | pūrvatvāntatvayoruttarapūrvatvamātranirūpyatvāt, kādāci tkāpekṣāyāśca śabdaśaktyavyavasthāpakatvāt | etacca nyāse'pi spaṣṭamevoktam---"dvitīyādikaṃ sahāyamapekṣyādyantaśabdau pravartete | tathā hi---laukikaḥ sati parasminsahāye pūrvamādiriti vyavaharati" ityādinā | ata eva "daiśikayoḥ paratvāparatvayoḥ tṛtīyāpekṣatvam, kālikayostu parasparāśrayāpekṣatvam" iti dīdhitikārādayaḥ | na hi bharato lakṣmaṇātpūrvaḥ lakṣmaṇo bharatātkaniṣṭha ityanayorgauṇatvam | na caivamādyudāttatvaṃ madhyamasyāpi syāditi vācyam | pratyayādipadasamabhivyāhārādeva pratyayatvādyupādhyavacchinnādipratīteḥ, daśarathasyādyaputra ityādau tadanyatatputratvāvacchinnāpekṣayā tatpratyayavat | ityāstāṃ prāsaṅgikam | nanu "vyapadeśivadekasmin" ityeva yuktam | iyāya āretyādau iṇ‌ṛdhātośca dhātvavayavatvaṃ prāthamyaṃ ekāc‌tvaṃ cāśritya ikāraṛkārayordvitvaṃ yathā syāt | "ekācaḥ" iti hi bahuvrīhiḥ | evaṃ "sa devānyakṣad‌" ityādau yajeḥ pañcamalakāre "sibbahulaṃ leṭi" iti sip, tasya ṣatvaṃ ca yathā syāt | pratyayasyāvayavo yaḥ sakārastasya ṣatvavidhānāt, "ādyantavad‌" ityuktyā ca āditvāntatvaprayuktakāryasiddhāvapyuktakāryāṇāmasiddheḥ | vyapadeśastu mukhyo vyavahāraḥ, sa yasya nimittavaśādasti sa vyapadeśī, yastu vyapadeśahetvabhāve'pi kāryaṃ prati tadvadvartate sa vyapadeśivat | tathā ca ekasminnapi mukhyaiva kāryaṃ syāditi vacanārthaḥ iti cet, atra bhāṣyakārāḥ--- avacanāllokavijñānātsiddhamiti | vacananirapekṣāllokavyavahārātsiddhyā "ādyantavad‌" iti "vyapadeśivad‌" iti cobhayamapi nārambhaṇīyam | iṇ‌dhāturhi prayogabhedādbahurūpaḥ, eti itaḥ yantītyādiḥ | iyāyetyatratya ikārastadavayava iva bhāsate | yadvā---arthavato dhātorvarṇarūpo'yameko'c‌ iti kriyāvācakatāvacchedakatadanyadharmābhyāṃ bhedavyapadeśaḥ | evaṃ sipratyayo joṣiṣadityādāviṭ‌sahitaḥ, vakṣadityādau kevalo'pīti pratyayasyāyaṃ sakāra iti | loke'pi bahuputravadekaputre'pi ayaṃ me jyeṣṭhaḥ putro'yaṃ madhyamo'yaṃ kaniṣṭha iti | asūtāyāmasoṣyamāṇāyāṃ ca prathamagarbheṇa hateti vyavaharanti | nanvime gauṇā vyavahārāḥ | ādyasya putrāntaravyāvṛttitātparyakatvāt, dvitīyasya ca tadgarbhadhvaṃsāsamānakālīnagarbheṇetyarthāt | śāstraṃ ca mukhye caritārthaṃ kathaṃ gauṇe pravartteteti cenna | nirūḍhatayā mukhyatulyakakṣatvāt | "ṛdorap‌" iti anudāttārthapittvācca | ādyudāttatvāprasaktau tadbādhanārthasya tasya vaiyarthāt | "iṭa īṭi" iti jñāpakācca | anyathā sicaḥ sakāramātrasya val‌rūpatvena valāditvābhāvādiṭo'nupapatteḥ | taraptamapau ghaḥ 21 | etau ghasaṃjñau staḥ | racayati ruciḥ śeṇīmetāṃ kumāritarā raveḥ | gharūpetyanena "tasilādiṣu" iti prāptaṃ puṃvadbhāvaṃ bādhitvā hrasvaḥ | nadyāstaro nadītara ityatra tu na | tamappratyayasāhacaryāt | tamaśabdasyāpi prātipadikasya sambhave tu pakārānubandhasāmarthyāt | vastutastu ghasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāmapi na kṣatiḥ | samānādhikaraṇe strīliṅge pare hrasvavidhānāt | sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca svārthikasyaiva, na tu taratīti vyutpannasya tarādeḥ | bhāṣye tu "yadā saiva nadī sa eva tarastadā prāpnoti" ityuktam | tatra bhāve striyāṃ ktinpratyaye tīrṇiriti bhāvyamityāśaṅkya kaiyaṭaḥ---"tīryate tara iti sāmānyena padaṃ vyutpādya paścānnadyā viśeṣyate" iti | tatra parihāraḥ---"strīliṅgeṣu gādiṣvityevaṃ tad‌" iti | taraśabdasya ca strītvābhāvāt | anyathā mahīṣīva rūpaṃ mahiṣīrūpamityatrāpi hrasvāpatteḥ | "supsupā" iti samāsaḥ | mahiṣīveyamākṛtirityarthaḥ | atra vadanti---ātiśāyanikapratyayaprakaraṇaeva "tādī ghaḥ" "pitau ghaḥ" iti vā sūtramapahāya prakaraṇaparityāgenoktasūtrārambhaḥ svārthiko'pi tarapratyayo'stīti jñāpanārthaḥ | tena "alpāc‌taram" ityādi sidhyatīti | kecittu sāmānyāpekṣajñāpakamāśritya īyasuno'pi svārthikatvam | tena "aho mahīyastava sāhasikyam" ityādi siddhamityāhuḥ | vāmanastu kāvyālaṅkāre śabdaśuddhiprakaraṇe mahattvapratiyogyapekṣāyāmapyātiśāyanikā ityāha | yadapekṣayā'tiśayaḥ pratyāyyate tadaprayoge'pi tasya gamyamānatvamātreṇa bhavantītyarthaḥ | "devo vaḥ savitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇe" ityatra "chāndasastamap‌" iti bhāṣyaṃ tasyānukūlam | anyathā svārthikatvenaivopapatteḥ | bahugaṇavatuḍati saṃkhyā 22 | ete saṃkhyāsaṃjñāḥ syuḥ | bahukṛtvaḥ | saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyā'bhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc | bahudhā | saṃkhyāyā vidhārthe dhā | bahubhiḥ krīto bahukaḥ | saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan | bahuśaḥ | "saṃkhyaikavacanācca vīpsāyām" iti śas | evamuttareṣu "yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup‌" "ā sarvanāmnaḥ" ityātvam | yāvatkṛtva ityādi | kimaḥ saṃkhyāparimāṇe ḍati ca | katikṛtva ityādi | nanu ekādiśabdānāmapi saṃjñeyaṃ vidheyā | anyathā pradeśeṣu "kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrime kāryasampratyayaḥ" iti nyāyena pāribhāṣikasaṃkhyaiva gṛhyeta, na tu lokasiddhā | sarvārthapratyāyanaśaktimataḥ śabdasyārthaviśeṣe vyavahārāya niyame tanmātraparatvāt | anyathā saṃjñāvidhānavaiyarthyāpatteḥ | na caivaṃ "nadīpaurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇībhyaḥ" ityatrāpi tathāpattiḥ | paurṇamāsyādiśabdopādānasāmarthyena tatra kṛtrimanadyā anupādānāt | maivam | saṃkhyākāryātideśārthatvādasya sūtrasya saṃjñāvidhāyakatvābhāvāt | vatimantareṇāpi bahuśastadarthapratyayāt | yadvā---atrāpi tathāniyamābhāvāt | "kartari karmavyatihāre" "śabdavairakalahābhrakaṇvameghebhyaḥ karaṇe" ityādau vyabhicārāt | na ca tatra sāmarthyāttathātvam | atrāpi yatnaviśeṣasadbhāvāt | "saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan" ityatra tiśabdāntāyāḥ śacchabdāntāyāśca saṃkhyāyāḥ paryudāsena laukikasaṃkhyāgrahaṇasya jñāpyatvāt | viṃśatītyādeḥ triṃśadityādeścāpāribhāṣikatvāt | pāribhāṣikyāstasyāstadantatvavirahāt | na ca katīti pāribhāṣikyeva saṃkhyā tiśabdāntā'stīti vācyam | arthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā ḍatipratyayaikadeśatiśabdasya bhedapratiyogitvenānupādānāt | taduktam--- ubhayagatiriha śāstre bhavatīti | atha eva bahugaṇaśabdayorvaipulyasaṅghārthayorneha grahaṇam, kintu saṃkhyārthayoreva | sa ca niyamārthaḥ---aniyatabahutvāvācakānāṃ madhye'nayoreva saṃkhyāsaṃjñā, na tu bhūryādīnām | tena bahutvavācakatvābhāvavatorekadviśabdayorniyatabahutvavācināṃ tryādīnāṃ ca na vyāvṛttiḥ | viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvābhyāṃ teṣāṃ nirdhāraṇapratiyogitāvacchedakānākrāntatvāt | bhāṣyakṛtastvāhuḥ---"bahupūgagaṇasaṅghasya tithuk‌" "vatorithuk‌" "ṣaṭ‌katikatipayacaturāṃ thuk‌" iti sūtraiḥ ḍaṭi pare āgamānāṃ vidhānasāmarthyātteṣāṃ saṃkhyātvaṃ jñāpayate | anyathā saṃkhyātvaṃ vinā ḍaṭa evānupapatteḥ | tathā cedaṃ sūtraṃ ca kartavyameveti | na caivaṃ pūgādīnāmapi kṛtvasujādikamapi saṃkhyākāryaṃ syāt, bahugaṇaśabdayoḥ kāryasāmānye saṃkhyātvaṃ jñāpyate, pūgādīnāṃ tu viśeṣāpekṣameveti vaiṣamye mānābhāvāditi vācyam | lakṣyānurodena tadaṅgīkārāt | etadanurodhātsūtrametadāvaśyakamiti kaustubhakṛtaḥ | atra śabdāntarāṇāmapi saṃkhyākāryaviśeṣasiddhyarthāni vārtikāni | adhyarddhagrahaṇaṃ ca samāsakan‌vidhyartham | arddhenādhikamadhyarddham | ekadeśārthakārddhaśabdasyādhiśabdena samāse yaugikārthapratyayena saṃkhyāpratyayābhāvāttribhāgādiśabdavatsaṃkhyāvācitvābhāvādidaṃ vidhyartham | adhyarddhena śūrpeṇa krītam adhyarddhaśūrpam | "dīk‌saṃkhye" ityanuvartamāne " taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca" iti krītārthakataddhitavivakṣāyāṃ śūrpaśabdena saha samāsaḥ | tataḥ "śūrpādañanyatarasyām" iti añ‌ ṭhañ‌ vā | "adhyarddhapūrva" iti tasya luk | adhyarddhena krītamadhyarddhakam | "saṃkhyāyā atiśantāyāḥ" iti kan | samāsavidhyarthamiti, sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī | tena samāsasya samāsanimittakakāryasya vā vidheyatve ityarthaḥ | tena dvigunimitto lugapi siddhaḥ | evaṃ ca "adhyarddhapūrvācca dvigoḥ" ityatrādhyarddhagrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyeyam | dvigutvādeva siddheḥ | taduktam--- luki cāgrahaṇamiti | anye tu ekaḥ adhyarddhaḥ dvau ityādirītyā loke gaṇanadarśanādadhyarddhaśabdo'pi saṃkhyārtha ityāhuḥ | tadrītyā sārddhādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ saṃkhyātvavyāvṛttyarthatayā "adhyarddha" iti vārtikaṃ niyamārtham | vākyabhedena ca dvitīyo niyamaḥ---uktakāryadvayaeva saṃkhyātvaṃ na tu kāryāntareṣu | tena kṛtvasujādayo neti kaiyaṭaḥ | arddhapūrvapadaśca pūraṇapratyayāntaḥ | saṃkhyāpadaṃ samāsakanvidhyarthamiti cānuvartate | pūraṇapratyayānte uttarapade arddheśabde ca pūrvapade yatra tādṛśasamāsarūpapūrvapadasya śabdāntareṇa samāse kani ca kārye saṃkhyā saṃjñā ityarthaḥ | arddhapañcamaiḥ śūrpaiḥ krītam arddhapañcamaśūrpam | arddhapañcamena krītam arddhapañcamakam, pūrvavatsamāsādi | adhikagrahaṇañcāluki samāsottarapadavṛddhyartham | adhikapadasya saṃkhyāviśeṣaṇatve'pi saṃkhyātvābhāvādayamapyapūrvavidhiḥ | adhaikayā ṣaṣṭhyā krīto'dhikaṣāṣṭikaḥ | adhikasāptatikaḥ | "taddhitārtha" iti samāsaḥ | prāgvateṣṭhañ‌ | alukīti vacanāt‌ luki karttavye saṃkhyāsaṃjñā nāstīti "saṃkhyāpūrvo dviguḥ" iti na dvigusaṃjñā | tenādhyarddhapūrveti ṭhaño na luk | "saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca" ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ | anyathā ṣaṣṭiśabdasya saṃkhyāparatvābhāvāttadapravṛtteḥ | nanu uttarapadavṛddhyarthamityata eva lugabhāvasyākṣepasambhavātpṛthak tadgrahaṇaṃ vyarthamiti cet, atrāhuḥ--- arhatyarthātpareṣvartheṣu ye pratyayāsteṣāṃ lugaprasaṅgena tatraivottarapadavṛddheḥ sāvakāśatayā tanmātreṇāluka ākṣeptumaśakyatvāditi | ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ‌ 23 | ṣāntā nāntā ca saṅkhyā ṣaṭ‌saṃjñā syāt | ṣaṭ‌ tiṣṭhanti | ṣaṭ‌ paśya | pañca saptetyādi | "ṣaḍ‌bhyo luk" iti jaśśasorluk | saṅkhyeti kim | vipruṣaḥ | pāmānaḥ | nanvatra saṃkhyāpadaṃ nāsti | na ca pūrvasūtrāttadanuvṛttiḥ | tasya saṃjñātvena laukikasaṃṅkhyāvācakatvābhāvāt | ucyate--- atideśapakṣe saṃkhyāpadānuvṛtteḥ susthatvāt | saṃjñāpakṣe'pi "ṣṇāntā" ityatra strīliṅgaviśeṣyasyākāṅkṣitatvādasvaritasyāpi saṅkhyāpadasyānuvṛttyā śabdādhikāreṇātra tasyābhimatārthaparatvasiddheḥ | etacca pūrvasūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam | nanvatra "upadeśa" iti vaktavyam | pratyayotpattikāle iti tadarthaḥ | anyathā śatāni sahasrāṇītyādau numaḥ pūrvāvayavatvena saṃkhyāyā nāntatvasampattyā ṣaṭ‌saṃjñāyāṃ jasāderluk‌prasaṅgāditi cenna | sarvanāmasthānasaṃnipātakṛtasya numastallopapravartakaṣaṭ‌saṃjñāṃ prati nimittatvānupapatteḥ | atha tathā'pi aṣṭan ām iti sthite paratvānnityatvācca "aṣṭana ā vibhaktau" ityātve kṛte nāntatvābhāvāt ṣaṭ‌saṃjñā'nupapattyā "ṣaṭ‌caturbhyaśca" iti nuḍāgamo na syāditi tadarthamevopadeśagrahaṇamāvaśyakamiti cenna | yathoddeśapakṣe antaraṅgatayā bhibhaktyutpatteḥ prāgeva ṣaṭ‌saṃjñāpravṛttau tasyā eva sthānivadbhāvenākārānte sulabhatvāt | atha kāryakālapakṣe nuḍ‌vidhyekavākyatāpannāyāḥ ṣaṭ‌saṃjñāyā api vibhaktisāpekṣatayā'ntaraṅgatvābhāvādātvasyaiva prathamaṃ pravṛtterdoṣatādavasthyam, yathoddeśapakṣe'pi ṣaṭ‌saṃjñāyāṃ nakārasyopajīvyatvādal‌vidhitvādatideśadaurlabhyamiti cet, satyam | "aṣṭano dīrghāt" iti svarasūtre dīrghagrahaṇena kṛtātvasyāpi ṣaṭ‌saṃjñājñāpanāt | tathā hi---aṣṭan‌śabdasya "traḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ" ityādyudāttaprasaṅge'pi ghṛtādipāṭhādantodāttatvam | tasya aṣṭabhiriti madhyodāttam, aṣṭābhirityantodāttaṃ ceti rūpadvayamiṣṭam | tatra ca "ṣaṭ‌tricaturbhyo halādiḥ" iti vibhakterudāttatvaṃ prāptam, tadbādhetvā ca"jhalyupottamam" iti madhyodāttatvaṃ prāptam, ṣaṭ‌tricaturbhyaḥ parā yā jhalādirvibhaktistadante pade upottamamudāttaṃ bhavatīti tasyārthaḥ | tadbādhanārtham "aṣṭano dīrghād‌" iti sūtram | dīrghāntādaṣṭanaḥ parā sarvanāmasthānabhinnā vibhaktirudāttā syāditi tadarthaḥ | ātvābhāvapakṣe tatpravṛttirmā bhūditi dīrghapatopādānam | yadi tvātvapakṣe ṣaṭ‌saṃjñā na syāttadā "aṣṭanaḥ" iti vibhaktyudāttasya tatraiva sāvakāśatayā ātvābhāvapakṣe "jhalyupottamam" ityanena paratvādeva vibhaktyudāttabādhopapattau dīrghādityasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt | ātvapakṣe'pi ṣaṭ‌saṃjñāyāṃ tu vibhaktyudāttasya "jhalyupottamam" ityetannirmuktaviṣayābhāvād yenanāprāptinyāyena tadapavādatvādātvābhāvapakṣe'pi madhyodāttabādhaḥ syāt, ato "dīrghād‌" ityuktam | tathā cāṣṭabhirityatra vibhaktyudāttasya prāptyabhāvāt "jhalyupottamam" iti madhyodāttasiddhiḥ | na cāṣṭāvityatrāntodāttatvaṃ sāvakāśam, tatra vibhakterjhalāditvābhāvena madhyodāttaprasaktyabhāvāditi vācyam | "ekā deśa udāttenodāttaḥ" ityanenaiva gatārthatvāt | aṣṭan‌śabdo'ntodātta ityuktatvāt | "aṣṭanaḥ" iti sūtre antodāttāduttarapadādityato'ntodāttapadānuvṛtterākarasaṃmatatvāt | etena "kadaṣṭannityasyāvyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyudāttatvātkadaṣṭādhiti śasi vibhaktyudāttatvaṃ sāvakāśam" iti śaṅkā'pyapāstā | tatrāntodāttatvābhāvena "aṣṭanaḥ" iti vibhaktyudāttasya pravṛttyanupapatteḥ | yadyapi manoramādau "aṣṭano dīrghād‌" iti sūtre antodāttapadaṃ nānuvartate, uttaratra maṇḍūkaplutyā tadanuvṛttyupapatteḥ" ityapyuktam, tathā'pi tadabhyupetyavādamātraṃ bodhyam | etena ṣaṭ‌saṃjñāpekṣayā lāghavātkṛtātvasyāṣṭanaḥ ṣaṭ‌svarasattaiva jñāpyatām, jñāpakasya svaraprakaraṇasthatvāt, tatra ṣaṭ‌saṃjñāyā anupasthitatvāt, bādhakaṣaṭ‌svaranimittatayā tadupasthitau tu ṣaṭ‌svarasyaiva prathamopasthitatvācca | arthāpatteḥ sākṣādupapādakaviṣayatātā autsargikatvāt, ityapi nirastam | yadvyatirekeṇānupapattipratisandhānaṃ tasyaivārthāpattyā kalpyatvāt | taduktam--- aniyamyasya nāyuktirnāniyantopapādakaḥ | iti | ātvapakṣe yadi ṣaṭ‌saṃjñā na syāttadā dīrghāditi vyarthaṃ syāt ityevopapatteḥ | na ca yadi ṣaṭ‌svaro na syādityevāpādakamastviti vācyam | ṣaṭ‌saṃjñānimittakasvarābhāvasya ṣaṭ‌saṃjñāvyatirekaprayuktatayā tasyā eva prathamopasthitatvāt | ṣaṭ‌svarābhāvasyāpādakatve tu tadabhāvasyaiva sādhyatvaṃ syāt | anyathā viparyayaparyavasānāt | āpādakavyatirekasādhyakapramāṇaeva tarkasya sahakāritvāt | tacca pramāṇamanumānamarthāpattirvetyanyadetat | tathā ca yadi ṣaṭ‌svara eva arthāpattiviṣayastadā "dīrghād‌" ityasya vaiyarthyameva syāt | ātvapakṣe madhyodāttarūpasya ṣaṭ‌svarasyāniṣṭatvāt | iṣṭatve "aṣṭanaḥ" iti sakalasyaiva sūtrasya vaiyarthyāpatteśca | tasmātṣaṭ‌saṃjñaiva jñāpyate | tannibandhanasvaraprasakteḥ "aṣṭanaḥ" itisūtropayuktāyāstata eva nirvāhāt | nuṭ‌pravartakatayā tadvaiyarthyābhāvācceti sarvanirvāhāt | ata eva "bhavatyātve kṛte ṣaṭ‌saṃjñā" ityeva bhāṣkārairuktam | ata eva ca pūrvasūtre "ḍaṭi pare vidhīyamānā āgamā ḍaṭo nirvāhakaṃ saṃkhyātvaṃ jñāpayanti" ityevoktam | anyathā tatra ḍaṭa eva jñāpanāpatteḥ | ākārānte ṣaṭ‌svarasattājñāpane prayojanābhāvācca | aṣṭābhirityādau "aṣṭanaḥ" iti vibhaktyudāttasyaiva pravṛtteḥ | priyāṣṭābhirityādau ca gauṇatvātṣaṭ‌svarānupapatteḥ | "ṣaṭ‌tricaturbhyaḥ" iti bahuvacananirdeśāt | anyathā samāhāre dvandvaṃ kṛtvaikavacanameva brūyāt | "jhalyupottamam" ityatrāpyarthādhikāreṇa ṣaḍarthaprādhānyaeva pravṛtterucitvāt | ata eva "caturaḥ śasi" iti sūtre "ṣaḍ‌bhyaḥ parayorjaśśasorlopavidhānād bahuvacanāntarāṇāṃ ca halāditvaniyamāt tadarthaṃ "ṣaṭ‌tricaturbhyaḥ" itisūtrasthasya halādirityasya nopayogaḥ" ityuktaṃ bhāṣyakṛdbhiḥ | gauṇe'pi tatpravṛttau tvajādivacanāntaravyāvṛttyarthatvasambhavāttadasaṅgatyāpatteḥ | paramāṣṭābhirityādāvapi ṣaḍādibhyo vihitatvābhāvādapravṛtteḥ | "ṣaṭ‌tricaturbhyaḥ" ityatra vihitaviśeṣaṇasya haradattenoktatvāt ityādeḥ svayamevoktatvāt | vastutastu dīrghagrahaṇena kṛtātvasthale ṣaṭ‌svarasattājñāpanapakṣe priyāṣṭābhirityādi prayojanaṃ syādeva | etajjñāpyasvarapravṛttau ṣaḍarthaprādhānyāderanapekṣitatvāt | "jhalyupottamam" ityanena svaravidhānaeva tasyāpekṣitatvāt | atha ṣaṭ‌saṃjñaivānena jñāpyate, tato "jhalyupottamam" ityanenaiva svarapravṛttirāśaṅkyate iti cettarhi siddhamasmadiṣṭam | tasmāduktayuktyaiva ṣaṭ‌svarapravṛttirna jñāpyataiti bodhyam | yattu ātvapakṣe ṣaṭ‌svarasyeva tadabhāve tadabhāvajñāpanenāpi "dīrghād‌" ityasya sārthakyādvinigamanābirahādubhayajñāpanāpattiriti, taccintyam | "svaratisūtisūyati" ityatra lugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇayoralugvikaraṇasyaiva grahaṇam" ityasyeva "lugvikaraṇasyaiva grahaṇam" ityasyāpi jñāpanāpatteḥ | tenāpyubhayanirdeśavaiyarthyoddhārāt | iṣṭa evārtho jñāpyate ityasyāpyubhayasādhāraṇatvāt | yatkiñcidarthajñāpanena sarvajñāpakānāmapi sārthakyasambhavāt | sarvatrāpi jñāpakānāṃ tattadarthaviśeṣaviṣayakatvocchedāpatteśca | yadapyuktam | "dīrghād‌" ityasya yogavibhāgārthatayā sārthakyam | tatra hi dīrgheti luptapañcamyantam | āditi prathamāntam | dīrghādityanuvṛttasyāṣṭano viśeṣaṇam | ata eva "dīrghādaṣṭanaḥ" iti na sūtritam | āditi prathamāntana viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayordīrghāṣṭanorvyavadhānāpatteḥ | "dīrghād‌" iti sūtre'ṣṭano 'nuvṛtterasambhavācca | dīrghāntādaṣṭan‌śabdātparasya asarvanāmasthānavibhakterākāra udātta ityarthaḥ | idañcāṣṭānāmityatrāntodāttārthamiti | tadatyantamasat | idaṃ hi " aṣṭana ā vibhaktau" ityatra halītyapakarṣapakṣe tadabhāve vā | nādyaḥ | nāntatvasannipātakṛtasya nuṭastadvighātakamātvaṃ prati nimittatvānupapatteḥ | na ca tasyā anityatvānna doṣaḥ | akṛtavyūhaparibhāṣayā nuṭo durlabhatvāt | bhāvinā ātvena nimittasya vināśonmukhatvāt | "nopadhāyāḥ" iti dīrgheṇa nakāralopena ca pañcānāmityādivadaṣṭānāmityasyāpi siddhyā saṃnipātanyāyāpravṛttisvīkāravaiyarthyācceti tasya dūṣyatvāt | etenoktayogavibhāgo'pi nirastaḥ | "ṣaṭ‌tricaturbhyo halādiḥ" ityanenaiva vibhaktyākārasyodāttatvasiddheḥ | yattu uktayogavibhāgaādityanena "aṣṭana ā vibhaktau" ityātvasya grahaṇam, pratipadauktatvāt, na tu "nopādhāyāḥ" ityasya, vilambitapratītikatvāt | tacca saṃnipātaparibhāṣāyāḥ pravṛttau durlabhamiti nātra sannipātaparibhāṣāyāḥ pravṛttiriti, tadasat | "aṣṭanaḥ" ityātvaparatvānurodhena sannipātanyāyo bādhyatām uta "nopadhāyāḥ" iti dīrghe'pyetatpravṛttyā'siddhatvaṃ bādhyatāmityatra vinigamakābhāvāt | na caivaṃ lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣāyā asiddhatvasya cetyubhayorbādhāpattiḥ | tvanmate'pyakṛtavyūhasannipātaparibhāṣayorbādhāt | yadapyuktam | nalopasyāsiddhatvenāṣṭano dīrghāntatvābhāvāt "nopadhāyāḥ" iti dīrghapakṣe noktayogapravṛttiriti, tadapyasat | "nalopaḥ supsvara" ityādiniyamāt | na cāyaṃ svaravidhirbhavatyeveti vācyam | nakārāntasya svare vidheyaeva tadaṅgīkārāt | pañcārmamityādau tathaiva dṛṣṭatvāt | kāryāntarāṇāmapi tatrāṅgasambandhitvāt | atra ca vibhaktyākārasya svaravidhānena vaiṣamyāt | nāpi dvitīyaḥ | tatra "nopadhāyāḥ" iti dīrghasyaiva vācyatayā pratipadoktasya ātvasya durlabhatvāt | svecchayā yogavibhāge chāndasatvakalpane bījābhāvāt | asarvanāmasthānavibhaktipadayoḥ prathamāntayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīkalpane'pi pramāṇābhāvāt | idaṃ cābhyupetyoktam | aṣṭānāmityatra vibhaktyākārodāttasyoktarītyaiva siddhatvāduktayogavibhāgaeva bījābhāvāt | tatpravṛttivicārasya niravakāśatvāt | yattu āmparāṣṭan‌śabde ṣaṭ‌svarāpravṛttijñāpanamasya phalam | tasyāpyātvābhāvapakṣe'ntodāttatvābhāva iti | tadasat | aprāmāṇikaphalānurodhena kalpanā'nullāsāt | anyathā svecchayā yogavibhāgaṃ kṛtvā'nekeṣāṃ phalānāṃ jñāpayituṃ śakyatvāt | tasmātkṛtātvasya ṣaṭ‌saṃjñaiva jñāpyate iti siddham | nanvevaṃ dīrghagrahaṇena ātvavikalpajñāpanānupapattiḥ | uktarītyā caritārthatvāt | maivam | svavaiyarthyaprayojakavyatirekapratiyogina ekasyānekasya vā jñāpyatvāt | ubhyajñāpanaṃ vinā dīrghagrahaṇavaiyarthyānuddhārādātvābhāvapakṣe madhyodāttabādho mā bhūdityetadarthasya dīrghagrahaṇasya ātvābhāvapakṣaṃ vinā vaiyarthyatādavasthyāditi dik | yadvā ākārapraśleṣo'pyatra bodhyaḥ | ṣakāro nakāra ākāraścānte yasya ityarthaḥ | nanvevaṃ dvābhyāmityādau "jhalyupottamam" ityasya dvyaci pade pravṛttyabhāvāt "ṣaṭ‌tricaturbhyaḥ" iti vibhaktyudāttenāntodāttatvaṃ syāt | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ | "ā dvābhyāṃ haribhyāmindra yāhi" ityādāvādyudāttasyaiva paṭhyamānatvāt | maivam | nakārasthānikasyaivākārasya saṃjñāyāmupādānāt | na cātra pramāṇābhāvaḥ | sanidhānasyaiva tathātvāt | ata eva ghusaṃjñāsūtre "nergada" ityatra "ghuprakṛtimāṅ‌" iti pāṭhe prakṛtipadena pūrvottaraprakṛtiparāmarśa iti siddhāntaḥ | vastutastu "halo yamāṃ yami lopaḥ" iti dvitīyanakārapraśleṣeṇa nakārasthānika ākāro'tra vyākhyeyaḥ | uktasvaradoṣopanyāsaparabhāṣyaṃ tvabhyupetyavādamātram | etenaikādeśe'tiprasaṅgaśaṅkāparagrantho'pi vyākhyātaḥ | athavā saptame yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ | "ṣaḍ‌bhyo luk" ityatra "ṣaḍ‌bhyo yaduktaṃ tatkṛtākārādaṣṭano'pi bhavatīti tadarthaḥ | tena nuṭ siddhaḥ | na ca yaduktamityadhyāhāre mānābhāvaḥ | bhāṣyasyaiva mānatvāt | na caivaṃ jaśśasorlugapyatidiśyeteti vācyam | auśtvavidhānavaiyarthyāpatteḥ | etenānumānikavacanakalpanāpekṣayā ākārānte ṣaṭ‌saṃjñāvirahakalpanameva yuktamiti nirastam | atideśasya lugviṣayakatvaṃ nāstītyasyaiva kalpyatvāt | nāntatvāvasthāyāmeva lugvāraṇārthaṃ tvanmate'pi vidhisāmarthyasyāvaśyāśraṇīyatvāt | na cāṣṭano yaduktaṃ tatṣaḍ‌bhyo'pi syāditi viparītārthāpattiḥ | yogavibhāgasyeṣṭasiddhyarthatvaniyamāt | anyathā yogavibhāgamātrocchedāpatteḥ | yadvā "aṣṭana ā vibhaktau" ityanantaraṃ "rāyaḥ" iti yogaṃ vibhajya "hali" ityubhayaśeṣatayā vyākhyeyam | tena halādāveva vibhaktau parata ātvavidhānāt nuṭa eva prāthamyam | na caivaṃ jaśśasorātvaṃ na syāditi vācyam | "aṣṭābhyaḥ" ityātvaviśiṣṭanirdeśena tatra tadanumānāt | anyathā aṣṭā iti aṣṭa iti vā brūyāt | na caivaṃ prayāṣṭau priyāṣṭā ityatrānupapattiḥ | priyāṣṭānau priyāṣṭāna ityādereva sādhutvādiṣṭāpatteḥ | yadbhāṣyam--- yathālakṣaṇamaprayukte iti | tadatra mā bhūdātvamityartha iti kaiyaṭaḥ | kecittu bhavatyevātrātvamiti bhāṣyārtha ityāhuḥ, taccintyam | śaṅkāyā apakarṣapakṣaviṣayakatvena tatraiva samādhānasya yuktatvāt | tatra ca halāditvābhāvena ātvaprāptiviraheṇa kaiyaṭavyākhyāyā eva yuktatvāt | tadayaṃ phalitārthaḥ | prathamaṃ tu yathoddeśāddīrghādākārato vibhāgābhyām aṣṭānāmitiśabde samādhayaḥ pañca paryavasyanti | ayaṃ cātra viśeṣaḥ | auṅaṣṭānteṣvām‌ṅidoṣṣu nātvaṃ gauṇe mate'ntime | bhavatyeva tu tatrātvamādye pakṣacatuṣṭaye || tathā hi---halādivibhaktāvātvavidhānamiti pakṣe priyāṣṭā iti bahuvrīhau auṅamārabhya ṭāparyantam āmi ṅeṅasiṅas‌ṅiṣu os‌dvaye ca ātvaṃ na prāpnoti | eṣāmajāditvāt | na ca "grahaṇavatā prātipadikena" tadantavidhiniṣedhādatrātvaprasaktireva neti vācyam | "padāṅgādhikāre tasya ca taduttarapadasya ca" ityanena tatsattvāt | na ca luṅ‌luṭorivātvasyāpi gauṇe na pravṛttiriti vācyam | tadvidhau bahuvacananirdeśādarthaprādhānyalābhaḥ, ātvavidhau tu ekavacananirdeśānneti vaiṣamyāt | tadiha kutra bhāṣyatātparyamiti cet, maivam | ātvavidhāvekavacananirdeśātsvarūpasya grahaṇaṃ nārthasya, tenopasarjane'pyaṣṭani bhavati | "tatrāpi vikalpitatvātpriyāṣṭā piyāṣṭānau priyāṣṭāna ityapi bhavati" iti vadatā haradattena halītyapakarṣe bhāṣyasya tātparyaṃ nāstīti spaṣṭamevoktatvāt | yattu "aṣṭābhyaḥ" iti sūtre "tadantagrahaṇātparamāṣṭau ityuktvā priyāṣṭāna ityatrātvasyābhāvādauś‌ na bhavatītivṛttigranthavirodhādyathā punargauṇatāyāmātvaṃ na bhavati | tathā tadvidhāveva vakṣyata iti tatratyaharadattagranthavirodhāccoktaharadattagrantho na yukta iti | taccintyam | vakṣyate ityatra vṛttikāreṇetyasya vivakṣitatvāt | ātvābhāvaprayojakaśca halītyapakarṣastatra spaṣṭa eva | yathāśrutavṛttigranthasya cānupapannatvāt | "aṣṭābhyaḥ" ityarthaprādhānyanirdeśena bahuvrīhau gauṇatvamevauśtvābhāvaprayojakam, na tvātvābhāva mūrddhanyagrahaṇānuvṛttyā tatratyaṇagrahaṇasya bhāṣye pratyākhyātatvāt | na caivaṃ pūṣṇa ityādāvapi ṇatvānupapattiḥ | "aṭ‌kupvāṅ‌" ityanenaiva tatra ṇatvasiddheriti | taccintyam | tasyāḥ ṣṭutvavidhāvapravṛtteḥ | ṣṭutvasya tāṃ pratyasiddhatvāt | yattu phalaikyāya kāryakālapakṣa eveha nyāyya iti | tanna | phalaikyaṃ hi "raṣābhyām' ityatra ṇagrahaṇatatpratyākhyānayovo | "tasya doṣaḥ" ityatra ṇatvagrahaṇatatpratyākhyānayorvā | "acaḥ parasmin" ityatra pañcamīsamāsatatpratyākhyānayorvā | nādyaḥ | ṇagrahaṇena lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā tadabhāveca "tasya doṣaḥ" iti ṇatvapratyākhyānena ṣṭutvasya sulabhatvāt | na dvitīyaḥ | ṇatvagrahaṇe pratipadoktaparibhāṣayā tadabhāve ca bādhakābhāvādeva ṣṭutvasya niścitatvāt | na tṛtīyaḥ | pañcamīsamāsapakṣe pratipadoktanyāyena tadabhāve ca tata eva ṣṭutvasya pramitatvāt | tadaikyasaṃpādakatayā yathoddeśapakṣasyaivātra yuktatvāt | vastutastu "na padānta" iti sūtre "dvirvacanādīni vareyalopasvaravarjam" iti vārttikabhāṣyābhyāṃ vakṣyate | tathā ca ṇakārādisādhāraṇadharmo yatra vidheyatāvacchedakastasyāpi "tasya doṣaḥ" ityatra ṇatvapadenopādāne śiṇḍhītyādāvapi tatpravṛttyāpattyā "pūrvatrāsiddhe na saṃkhyāsāhacaryeṇa taddhitasyaiva ḍatergrahaṇāt | yatānyāse 'pyevameva vācyatvāt | ktaktavatū niṣṭhā 25 | etau niṣṭhāsaṃjñau staḥ | kṛtaḥ | kṛtavān | "niṣṭhā" ityubhayorvidhānam | vihitayoḥ saṃjñā, saṃjñopasarjanānāṃ vyāvṛttiḥ | teṣāṃ dharmiviśeṣamātrabodhakatvāt | nanu kimidaṃ sarvanāmatvam | na yāvadarthabodhakatvam | pūrvādipadānāṃ ghaṭādyavācakatvāt | na ca pūrvatvādirūpeṇa tadbodhajanakatvāttadarthakatvam, kenacidrūpeṇa yāvadarthabodhajanakatvasya vivakṣitatvāditi vācyam | vibhudravyāṇāṃ guṇādīnāṃ ca pūrvatvādirūpeṇāpyabodhanāt | ātmapareṣu svayuṣmadasmatpadeṣvavyāpteśca | ata eva kaiyaṭena "sarveṣāṃ nāmāni" iti bhāṣyavyākhyāyāṃ "svaviṣayāpekṣayā sarvanāmatvam, yathā jātyādeḥ svaviṣayāpekṣayā sarvagatatvam" ityuktam | nāpyanekārthabodhakatvam | sarvapadasyāpi saṃjñābhūtasya tathātvāt | tadvācyavyaktīnāmavasthābhedena bhinnatvāt | nāpi vijātīyānekabodhakatvam | svādipadeṣvavyāpteḥ | ātmatvena teṣāṃ sājātyāt | priyasarvau caitramaitrāvityupasarjanasarvapadasyāpi tathātvādativyāpteśca | tasmātsaṃjñopasarjanavyāvṛttamavayavārthatāvacchedakaṃ durvacamiti cet, satyam | anvarthasaṃjñayaivobhayavyāvṛttiriti upasarjanatvamityubhayasaṃmatatvāt | ata evāgre kaiyaṭo vakṣyati--- upasarjanapratiṣedho vārttikakārasya, na sūtrakārasya | "na bahuvrīhau" ityasyārambhāditi | saṃjñāyāstvanvarthatvāśrayaṇādapi | viśeṣaśāstreṇa sāmānyaśāstrasaṅkocasya tulyatvāt | satyam | saṇatvasyāsādhutvameva | uktanyāyāt | na ca "kriyāsātatye" ityanena santataśabdabādhāpattiḥ | ekadeśānumatidvārā "lumpedavaśyamaḥ kṛtye" iti pūrvācāryaślokasyaiva jñāpyatvāt | na ca "purāṇaprokteṣu " iti nuḍāgamābhāvanipātanātpurātanaśabdasyāsādhutvāpattiḥ | iṣṭatvāditi kecit | pṛṣodarādiṣu tasya pāṭhyatvāditi kaiyaṭaḥ | kaustubhakārāstu purāṇeti nirdeśena āgamaśāsanasya avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ" ityasya cānityatvāmātraṃ jāpyata ityāhuḥ | tena "purātanaṃ tvāṃ puruṣaṃ purāvidaḥ" ityādi siddham | saṃjñopasarjanayoḥ saṃjñāpratiṣedhaprakāramāha vārttikakāraḥ | pāṭhātparyudāsaḥ paṭhitānāṃ saṃjñākaraṇamiti | ayamarthaḥ---saṃjñopasarjanānāṃ sarvādimadhye pāṭho nāstīti vacanamārabhyate | teṣāṃ pāṭhabahirbhāvaṃ kṛtvā gotrādigaṇe paṭhyante, na tvānyādṛśānīti | tena "canacidīvagotrāditaddhitāmreḍiteṣvagateḥ" "kutsane ca supyagotrādau" ityatra tādṛśānāmeva grahaṇam, na tvarthāntaravṛttīnām | evamihāpi yāni sarvādivācakāni tānyeva sarvādigaṇe paṭhitāni, na tu saṃjñopasarjanībhūtāni | teṣāṃ viśeṣavṛttīnām | evamihāpi yāni sarvādivācakāni tānyeva sarvādigaṇe paṭhitāni, na tu saṃjñopasarjanībhūtāni | teṣāṃ viśeṣavṛttitvāt | tathā ca teṣāṃ gaṇapāṭhābhāvādeva na saṃjñāprasaktirityarthaḥ | na caivaṃ saṃjñāprayuktakāryāsiddhiḥ | sarvanāmna ityādau yaugikārthasyaiva grahaṇāt | vastuta evaṃ | bhāṣyakṛtā tvanenaiva prakāreṇeti viśeṣaḥ | yāni sarvādīni tāni sarvanāmasaṃjñānīti saṃjñārthaṃ dvitīyamiti na ko'pi doṣaḥ | na caivaṃ sahavivakṣāvirahādekaśeṣānupapattiḥ,
