tasmai sarvāya | atikrāntaḥ sarvamatisarvaḥ tasmai atisarvāya | antargaṇakāryaṃ yathā---tad‌ nāma kaścit "tyadādīnāmaḥ" ityatvaṃ na | tamatikrānto'titat "ad‌ḍḍatarādibhyaḥ" ityad‌ḍādeśo na | na ca saṃjñāyāṃ gauṇamukhyanyāyādeva vāraṇātparyudāsavaiyarthyam | iṣṭāpatteriti haradattādayaḥ | tasya padakāryamātraviṣayakatvāditi kaiyaṭaḥ | "yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ ṅaso'ś‌" ityādikaṃ tvatiyuṣmadityādau bhavatyeva | śabdasvarūpamātrāśrayatayā gaṇapāṭhānapekṣatvāt | na ca "yuṣmadyupapade" ityādāvapyāpattiḥ | "abhivyaktapadārthāye" iti nyāyātprasiddhārthaparatāyāmeva tatpravṛtteḥ | tatra ca śabdaparatvāt | atra bhāṣyam--- saṃjñāpratiṣedho vyarthaḥ, pūrvaparāvaretyatrāsaṃjñāyāmiti yogaṃ vibhajya tasya pūrvottaraśeṣatayā vyākhyānāt | evamupasarjanasyāpi "anupasarjanāt" iti sūtrasya pratyākhyānāt, tadadhikāre prayojanābhāvāt | tacca tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ | kintu tadanyathā vyākhyeyam | "anupasarjana" iti ṣaṣṭhyantam, chāndasatvāttalopaḥ | aśca acca āt uktādeśau anupasarjanasya bhavata ityarthaḥ | na caivam, atiyuṣmadityasyāsiddhiḥ | akārāntaraṃ praśliṣya tena pūrvoktādeśayorviśeṣaṇāt | akārātparau yau akārātkārau iti vyākhyānāt tyadādyatvamad‌ḍādeśaścākārātparato vidhīyete iti tatra paribhāṣopasthānam, na tvatiyuṣmadityatra "pañcamyā at‌" ityad‌bhāvasya | yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ parasya ṅasyādervidhānāt | tayoścākārāntatvābhāvāt | nanvevaṃ priyau dvāvasyeti bahuvrīhau priyadvirityatra tyadādyatvaṃ syāt | ikārasthānikasyākārādeśasya vakārātparatvādakārātparato vidhānābhāvāduktaparibhāṣāyā apravṛtteḥ | evam "tadoḥ saḥ sāvanantyayoḥ" iti satvamapyupasarjane syāt | uktaparibhāṣāyāṃ sakārasyānupādānāt | maivam | "tyadādīnāmaḥ" ityatroktaparibhāṣayā'nupasarjanagrahaṇe siddhe sāhacaryāttathābhūtasyaiva dviśabdasyopādānāt | satvavidhāvapyarthādhikāreṇa tathāvidhānāmeva tyadādīnāṃ grāhyatvāt | yadvā---aṅgādhikāreṣvarthadvārakaviśeṣaṇamāśrayaṇīyam | taduktam--- aṅgādhikāre yaducyate gṛhyamāṇavibhaktestadbhavatīti | gṛhyamāṇādvihitā vibhaktirityarthe tu paramapañcetyādau luk‌ na syāt | tathā ca sarvanāmārthavṛttisaṃkhyākārakābhidhāyino ṅeḥ smai syādityādirarthaḥ | priyaviśvāyetyādau tvanyapadārthavṛttaya evaṃ saṃkhyādayo vibhaktyocyante, na tu sarvaśabdārthavṛttaya ityadoṣaḥ | paramasarva ityādau tu sarvaśabdārthavṛttaya eveti nāvyāptiḥ | nanu "dvandve ca" iti jñāpakātsarvanāmasaṃjñāyāṃ tadantavidhirasti | tathā ca tadantasyāpi priyaviśvādeḥ sarvanāmatvātsarvanāmārthavṛttisaṃkhyādyabhidhāyitvaṃ vibhakterakṣatamiti cet, satyam | sarvādigaṇapaṭhitatve sati sarvanāmatvasyātra niveśāt | tadantasya ca satyāmapi saṃjñāyāṃ tadabhāvāt | na caivaṃ vihitaviśeṣaṇenaiva tatsiddhiriti vācyam | upāyasyopāyāntarānapavādakatvāt | anye tvetadaparitoṣādevānvarthasaṃjñāśrayaṇamityāhuḥ | vastutastu anvarthasaṃjñāpakṣe upasarjanavyāvṛttasyāvayavārthasya durvacatvāt | tatra bhāṣyasya na tātparyam | "dvandve ca" ityanena jñāpyamānastadantavidhistu yatra sarvanāmnaḥ prādhānyaṃ tatraiva | lakṣyānurodhāt | dharmigrāhakapramāṇānurodhācca | tenātisarva ityādau nātivyāptiḥ | "na bahuvrīhau" iti sūtraṃ tu alaukikavākye saṃjñāniṣedhārthaṃ pratyākhyeyaṃ vetyanyadetat | yastvaṅgādhikāralabhyatadantavidhiprayukto'tiprasaṅgaḥ sa tatraiva vihitaviśeṣaṇena parihariṣyate | anyathā tenāpi tatparihārānupapatteḥ | tatra vihitaviśeṣaṇena taddoṣaparihārasya ca sarvābhimatatvāt | anyathā'vayavasaṃjñāniṣedhārthatayaiva vacanopapattyā tadantavidhijñāpakatvānupapatteḥ | kaiyaṭasyāpyayamevābhiprāyaḥ | atisarvāyetyādau tvaviśeṣakāryamaparihṛtameveti doṣasya "anupasarjanād" iti pūrvoktapakṣameva prakramya tena likhitatvāt | arthadvārakavibhaktiviśeṣaṇapakṣe taddoṣābhāvasya tadabhimatatvāt | aviśeṣakāryaṃ sarvanāmasaṃjñāprayuktamityarthaḥ | tasmādarthadvārakavibhaktiveśeṣaṇaeva bhāṣyasya tātparyam | nanu pañcakāḥ śakunaya ityatra pratyayasya svārthikatvāt ṣaḍarthaprādhānyāt paṅ‌bhyo luk syāditi cenna | pratyayaviśiṣṭasya śabdāntaratvānnāntatvābhāvācca ṣaṭ‌saṃjñāvirahāt | nanu "yuṣmadaspadbhyāṃ ṅaso'ś‌" ityādikamapyupasarjane na syāt, yuṣmadādyarthaniṣṭhasaṃkhyādyanabhidhāyakatvāttatratyavibhakteriti cenna | tatprakaraṇe aṅgasyārthadvārā yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ ca paratvamātreṇa vibhakterviśeṣaṇīyatvāt | aṅganiṣṭhasaṃkhyābhidhāyinyā yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ parasyā ṅasādivibhakteraśādayo bhavantītyarthaḥ | "ad‌ḍ‌ḍatarādibhyaḥ" ityatra tvaṅgādhikārābhāvād ḍatarādibhyo yo vihita ityarthadvārakaṃ vidhānamāśrayaṇīyam | tena paramakataradityādau atikataramityādau ca nāvyāptyativyāptī | "asthidadhisakthyakṣṇāmanuṅudāttaḥ" "tyadādīnāmaḥ" ityādau tu "aṅgasya" iti ṣaṣṭhyā api sattvādasthyādibhiraṅgena vā vibhaktirviśeṣyata ityubhayasambhavāt | asthītyādau aṅgasya vibhaktāvasthyādīnāmanaṅ‌ syāditi vākyārthaḥ | tena priyasakthnetyādau nāvyāptiḥ | atra śakaṭāvayavavācī sakthiśabdaḥ | anyathā "bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ" iti ṣaṭ‌prasaṅgāt | "tyadādīnāmaḥ" ityādau tu tyadādikaṃ vibhakterviśeṣaṇam, aṅgasyetyakārasya | tyadādyarthaniṣṭhasaṃkhyādyabhidhāyinyāṃ vibhaktāvaṅgasyākāro'ntādeśaḥ syādityarthaḥ | tena atisa atitad‌ ityādau nāvyāptyativyāpti | lakṣyānurodhenaiva vyākhyānapravṛtterityāstāṃ vistaraḥ | ubhaśabdaḥ paryāptyā dvitvaviśiṣṭasya vācakaḥ | ata eva nityaṃ dvivacanāntaḥ | nanvevaṃ sarvādipāṭho'sya vyarthaḥ | ekabahuvacanayoreva sarvanāmasaṃjñāprayuktakāryaviśeṣadarśanāt | ubhyābhyāṃ hetubhyāmiti tṛtīyayośca "nimittakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ prāyadarśanam" iti hetāviti sūtrasthasarvanāmasaṃjñānapekṣavārttikādeva siddheḥ | kākacośca viśeṣābhāvāditi cet, satyam | ubhakāvityakajartho'tra pāṭhaḥ | na hyetatkapratyayeneṣṭaṃ siddhyati | ayacā ubhayakāvityāpatteḥ | dvivacanātiriktasthale ubhaśabdādayajutpattiniyamāt | tathā hi---"ubhādudātto nityam" ityatra ubhāditi yogo vibhajyate | avayavavṛtteḥ saṅkhyāvācinaḥ ubhaśabdādavayavinyarthe'yacsyāt | ubhayo maṇiḥ | śyāmalohitābhyāṃ bhāgābhyāmārabdha ityarthaḥ | tato nityam | ubhaśabdānnityamayacsyāt, arthaviśeṣānirdeśātsvārthe | ubhau putrau yasyāsāvubhayaputraḥ | na caivaṃ dvidaṇḍyādiṣūbhāhastītyasyānupapattiḥ | tatra pākṣikāyajabhāvanipātanena tatsiddheḥ | naduktaṃ vārttikakṛtā--- anyābhāvo dvivacanaṭābviṣayatvād‌, ubhayo'nyatreti | anyatra dvivacanaparatvābhāve ityarthaḥ | tathā ca kapratyayena vyavadhānāddvivacanaparatvābhāvāt ayac‌ syāt | akaci tu tasya madhyapātitvādubhaśabdasya dvivacanaparatvamastyeveti na tatprasaṅgaḥ | bhāṣyakṛtastvāhuḥ---svārthikatvādu bhaśabdatulyārthakatvāttadrūpadvivacanaparatvamastyeveti avaśyaṃ vaktavyam | evaṃ ca kapratyayasyāpi dvitvārthakaprakṛtikasya dvitvābhidhāyakapratyayatvarūpadvivacanatvasadbhāvāt tasminpare ayaco na prasaṅgaḥ | pāribhāṣikadvivacanamātrasyoktavārttike'nupādānāt | ata eva "ṇeraṇau" ityatra karmaśabdena kriyāgrahaṇam | ata ubhayaśabdo'tra na paṭhanīya eveti | evaṃ ca "nityam" itiyogavibhāgasya vyākhyāne vṛttimātre ityasya prakṣepo nirmūla iti bodhyam | yastvevam---ubhayata ubhayatretyādāvapyayaco'nupapattiḥ | na ca tatra taso vibhaktyantādvidhānādvibhaktyarthasyāpyadhikasyābhidhānāt dvitvamātravācakatvaṃ nāstīti vācyam | kapratyayasyāpyajñātādyarthabodhakatvāt | pañcakaṃ prātipadikārtha iti pakṣe'dhikavācakatvācca iti | taccintyam | dvitvamātravācakatvaṃ hi na dvivacanatvam | karmatvāderapi tato bodhāt | atha dvitvavācakatāvacchedakarūpeṇa dvitvānyāvācakatvaṃ dvitvamātravācakatvam | tatra tu dvitīyātvādinā karmatvādivācakatvam, autvādinā tu dvitvavācakatvamiti cet kapratyayasyāpi dvitvārthakaprakṛtikatvena dvitvavācakatvaṃ tadarthavihitatvenājñātādyarthavācakatvamiti sāmyāt | vastutastu tratasoravyayatvāddvitvābhidhānasāmarthyaṃ nāstīti kaiyaṭokterna tayordvivacanatvam | svārthikatve'pi svasvabhāvavirodhino'rthasyābhidhānānarhatvāt | tatprakṛtyarthabodhasya svārthikatāyāmanupayogātpramāṇābhāvāt | prakṛtabhāṣyasya bādhakatvācca | ubhayaśabdastu vyākhyātaḥ | sa cāvayavadvayārabdhe'vayavini varttate | tasya mitrāṇyamitrāste ye ca ye cobhaye nṛpāḥ | mitratvāmitratvārūpadharmāvacchinnā ityarthaḥ | dharmadvayaṃ ca viśeṣyatāvacchedakāvacchinnavyaktibhedasāmānādhikaraṇyena bhāsate, na tu parasparasāmānādhikaraṇyeneti viśeṣaḥ | "ubhayameva vadanti manīṣiṇaḥ" ityādau tu indradaśaratharūpamavayavadvayamādāya tadubhayasamudāya ubhayaśabdena vivakṣitaḥ | yadā tu ubhayo maṇiriti vyutpādya tādṛśaṃ maṇidvayaṃ saha vivakṣyate, tadā ekaśeṣeṇa dvivacanaṃ prāptamanabhidhānānnivāraṇīyam | "taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ " iti sūtre ubhayaśabdasya dvivacanānutpādādasarvavibhaktitvamiti kaiyaṭokteḥ | tathā ca tasyāvyayatvavāraṇāya parigaṇanaṃ karttavyamiti tadarthaḥ | haradattastu pacatikalpamityādivārakatvena parigaṇanasāmarthyasyopakṣīṇatvāt ubhayaśabdāddvivacanaṃ bhavatyevetyūce | nanu ayacastayapapratyayādeśatvena prathamacarametyādisūtreṇa jasi sarvanāmasaṃjñāpattiriti cet, maivam | vyavasthitavikalpāt pūrvavipratiṣedhādvā tatra nityaiva saṃjñeti kecit | vibhaktinirapekṣatvādantaraṅgayā nityasaṃjñayā vibhaktisāpekṣatvādbahiraṅgā vibhāṣā bādhyataityanye | bhāṣyakṛtastvāhuḥ---ayac‌ svatantra eva pratyayaḥ | tadvidhau tayapo'nuvṛttau mānābhāvāt | na caivamubhayītyatra "ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañ‌" iti sūtreṇa tayabantatvaprayukto ṅīb‌ na syāditi vācyam | tatratye mātrac‌pade mātraśabdamārabhya ayaṭaścakāraparyyantaṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇe tadantarbhāvādayaco'pi svātantryeṇa ṅīp‌siddheḥ | evaṃ ca tayagrahaṇamapi tatra na karttavyam | uktapratyāhārāntarbhāvādeva siddheḥ | yadvā---dvayasajiti pratyāhārastena daghnañ‌mātracorgrahaṇamapi na kāryam | "pramāṇe mātraj‌dvayasaj‌daghnacaḥ" iti sūtrapāṭhe tu mātra jityeva pratyāhāraḥ | na caivaṃ kati striya ityādau ṅībāpattiḥ, ḍaterapi tadantaḥ pātāditi vācyam | "na ṣaṭ‌svasrādibhyaḥ" iti niṣedhāt | "ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañ‌" ityatra ata ityanuvṛtteśca | na caivamapi tailamātretyādau atiprasaṅgaḥ, pratyāhārapakṣe cakārasya mātraśabdaṃ pratyaviśeṣaṇatvāt cakārāntamātrapadagrahaṇe pramāṇābhāvena "huyāmāśruvasibhasibhyastran‌" ityasya tranpratyayāntamātrapadasyāpi grahāpatteriti vācyam | sadṛśasyāpi pratyāhāre'nantarbhāvāt | pramāṇe varttamānādvihitasya prameyavṛttereva mātraśabdasya grahaṇāt | pratyayānukaraṇatayā mātraśabdasya yathoktaprātipadikaparatvābhāvāt | nanu "vyathāṃ dvayeṣāmapi medinībhṛtām" ityatra kathaṃ sarvanāmasaṃjñeti cet, satyam | ubhayetyarthaparo nirdeśa iti kecit | gurudvayāya guruṇoḥ ityādivirodhānnedaṃ yuktam, kintu dvayaṃ dvaidhamiṣṇanti gacchantīti dvayeṣasteṣāṃ dvayeṣāmiti kathaṃcitsamādheyamityapare | cākravarmaṇavyākaraṇe dvayaśabdasyāpi sarvanāmatā'bhyupagamāttaditi tvanye | yuktaṃ caitadeva | "kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti" "gatikārakopapadād‌" iti ca sūtre dhātorhi dvaye pratyayā vidhīyante iti mahābhāṣyasvārasyāt | ata eva--- yavādiśabdāḥ kiṃ dvyarthā no vā''ryamlecchasāmyataḥ | dīrghaśūkapriyaṅ‌gvādyā dvaye'pyarthā vikalpitāḥ || iti yavavarāhādhikaraṇe mādhavācāryaprayogaḥ | na ca tayādeśatvāt "prathamacarama" iti tatsiddhiḥ | ayac‌ pratyayāntarameveti bhāṣyasiddhāntāt | ḍataraḍatamau pratyayau | tataśca tadantāḥ śabdāḥ grāhyāḥ | saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhyabhāve'pi kevalayoḥ saṃjñāvidhānavaiyarthyāt | anyapadamanyo'nyābhāvavadarthakam | tadekadeśe samabhivyāhṛtapadārthasya ghaṭāderanvayād‌ ghaṭādanya ityādau bodhaḥ | anyatarānyatamaśabdāvavyutpannau svabhāvād dvibahuviṣaye nirdhāraṇe varttete iti paspaśāyāṃ kaiyaṭaḥ | tatra dvitīyasya sarvanāmasaṃjñāvirahānna tatkāryam | ata eva "na tāvatsāmānyādiṣvanyatamaṃ tamaḥ" ityādiprayogaḥ | śākaṭāyanena "ḍataraḍatamāntatvena tayorvyutpādane'pi anyataraśabdapāṭhasya niyāmakatvādanyatamaśabdasya gaṇakāryādyabhāvaḥ" iti vyākhyānāt | itarastvanyanīcayoḥ ityamaraḥ | atha kathaṃ "pakṣetare'tivyāpteśca" iti upādhivāde naiyāyikā iti cet, satyam | pakṣamitarayatīti kṛdantamitarapadamiti tatra prāñcaḥ | pakṣa itaro yasmāditi bahuvrīhau na sarvanāmatvamityanye | pakṣetarapadaṃ pakṣetaratve pāribhāṣikam | tataśca ādhunikyā itarasaṃjñāyā ivāsyāpi na sarvanāmatvamiti miśrāḥ | etena "vanyetarā jānapadopadābhiḥ" ityādi vyākhyātam | tva tva iti dvāvapyakārāntau anyaparyāyau | "etaṃ tvamanye daśayantramutsam" ityudāttasya "uta tvaḥ paśyan‌" ityādiranudāttasyeti kecit | prathamastakārāntaḥ | "tarīruta tvadbhavati sūta uta tvad‌" iti mantre tvaditi sarvanāmasu paṭhito'nudātto'nyaparyāyaḥ" iti vedabhāṣyokteḥ | "tvadadharamadhuramadhūni pibantam" iti jayadevaprayogācca | tvatto'nyasyā adhara ityeva tadarthāt | "paśyati diśi diśi rahasi bhavantam" iti pūrvavākyālocanayā tavādharastvadadhara itivigrahāyogādityanye | evameṣāṃ prāmāṇye'pi "uto tvasmai tanvaṃ visasre" ityanudāttasya smāyādidarśanāttasya sarvāditvanirṇayaḥ | udāttākārāntasya takārāntasya vā'tra pāṭhe tu sandehaḥ | ādyasya smāyādikaṃ uttarasya tvakajādikaṃ kvacicchākhyāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu nirṇeyam | vastuto bhinnasvarayorapyakārāntayorekaśrutyā tantreṇaiva pāṭhasambhavādubhayapāṭhasāmarthyena prathamasya takārāntatvameva yuktamiti kecit | nema ityarddhārthaḥ | "pranemasmin dadṛśe soma" iti darśanāt | samasimaśabdau sarvaparyayau | "mā naḥ samasya dravyaḥ" "uruṣyāṇo aghāyataḥ samasmād‌" ityādidarśanāt | "ādrātrīvāsastanute simasmai" iti darśanācca | "tvattvasamasimetyanuccāni" iti phaṭ‌sūtrādanudāttatve prāpte "simasyātharvaṇa udāttaḥ" iti vacanādudāttatvam | ātharvaṇapadasyopalakṣaṇārthatayā vyākhyātatvāt | tulyaparyāyasamaśabdasya tu nayaṃ saṃjñā | "yathāsaṃkhyamanudeśaḥ samānām" iti jñāpakāt | pūrvaparāvaradakṣiṇottarāparādharāṇi vyavasthāyāmasaṃjñāyām | svamajñātidhanākhyāyām | antaraṃ bahiryogopasaṃbyānayoḥ | pūrvādayaḥ pañca dikkālayoḥ tadavacchinne ca | pūrvasyāṃ diśi pūrvasyāṃ vāpyāṃ pūrvasminkāle pūrvasmingurāvityādi | dakṣiṇādharaśabdau diśi tadavacchinne ca | "diśaḥ sapatnī bhava dakṣiṇasyāḥ" | na cārthaniyame mānābhāvaḥ | vyavasthāyāmityasyaiva mānatvāt | svābhidheyāpekṣo'vadhiniyamo hi vyavasthā | pūrvādīnāṃ coktārthasya niyamenāvadhisākāṅkṣatvāt | pūrva ityādāvukte kasmādityākāṅkṣāyā utpatteḥ | dakṣiṇasyā ityatrāpi vastuto'vadhirastyeva, prasiddhestu tadaprayogaḥ | na ca saṃjñāyāmiti niṣedhaḥ | ādhunikasaṅketa eva hi saṃjñā, na ca dikṣu sā'statīti pañcame vyākhyātāraḥ | vyavasthāyāṃ kim | dakṣiṇāḥ gāthakāḥ | pravīṇāḥ | adhare tāmbūlarāgaḥ | oṣṭhe | uttare śaktaḥ | prativākye ityādirarthaḥ | atha katham "tathā pareṣāṃ yudhi ca" iti kālidāsādayaiti cet, satyam | vyavasthāviṣayasyaiva parādhiśabdasya lakṣaṇayā vairyādau prayogaḥ | na caivamupasarjanatā | svārthaviśiṣṭārthāntaraparatvasyaivopasarjanatvāt | atra ca lakṣaṇayā vairitvādiprakārakabodhe'pi śakyārthasya tatrānanvayāt | ata eva pakṣetare ityatretarapadasya bhāvapradhānatve'pi sarvanāmakāryāpātād "bahuvrīhiṃ kṛtvaiva bhāvaprādhānyamāśrayaṇīyam" iti dīdhitivyākhyātāraḥ | yattu tasmādvahnimānityādau jñānalakṣaṇāpakṣe'pi sarvanāmakāryamiti, taccintyam | dhūmāditihetughaṭakadhūmapadeṣu lakṣaṇāsvīkāre'pi tasmāditi sarvanāmnā śaktyaiva dhūmajñānasya bodhayituṃ śakyatayā tatra lakṣaṇāyāṃ mānābhāvāt | "tat tvamasi" ityatra tatpadena pūrvopakrāntasyātmana eva parāmarśāttatsadṛśe lakṣaṇā naiyāyikairucyata ityavirodhaḥ | yattu śatrutvādiprakārakabodho mānasa eva, śābdastu deśāntaraniṣṭhatvādiprakāraka eveti | taccintyam | taduttaraṃ mānasasāmagrīniyamābhāvāt | asaṃjñāyāṃ kim | uttarāḥ kuravaḥ | sumerumavadhīkṛtyottaraśabdasya kuruṣu vṛttāvapi saṃjñātvānna sarvanāmatvam | na ca dikṣu saṃjñā nāsti kuruṣvastītyatra mānābhāvaḥ | avicchinnasampadāyamūlakavyākhyātṛvacanasyaiva mānatvāt | svo jñātāvātmani svaṃ triṣvātmīye svo'striyāṃ dhane | ityamaraḥ | ātmanītyasya puṃlliṅgaśabdenānvayaḥ | jñātidhanayoḥ saṃjñāniṣedhādātmanyātmīye ca vācye sarvanāmatvam | ākhyāgrahaṇasāmarthyādātmīyatvena jñātidhanayorbodhatātparye sarvanāmatvameva | yathā sve putrāḥ | sve gāvaḥ | viśeṣyatāsambandhena jñātidhanayoḥ svapadajanyabodhavattvaṃ yatra tatraiva tanniṣedhāt | yattu "nirākṛtaḥ svasyāṃ satatamitarasyāṃ praṇayavān" iti kaiścitprayuktam, tadapi tanāvityādistrīliṅgaviśeṣyapadādhyāhāreṇa ātmīyārthakatayaiva kathañcidvyākhyeyam | kecittu "svamātmātmīyayoḥ" ityeva paṭhanīyam | na ca "svāminnaiśvarye" iti sūtre aiśvaryyasyāpi tadarthatvāttadasaṃgrahāpattiḥ | tasya tanmātraviṣayakatvāttadarthe matvarthīyamāminpratyayaṃ vinā prayogānarhatvādityāhuḥ | antaramavakāśāvadhiparidhānātnarddhibhedatādarthye | chidrātmīyavinābahiravasaramadhye'ntarātmani ca || tasyārthadvaye saṃjñā | tatra bahirityanāvṛto deśa ucyate | tena saha yogo bāhyasya bhavati | antare antarā vā gṛhāḥ | nagarabāhyāścaṇḍālādigṛhā ityarthaḥ | bahi śabdasya taddeśavṛttiparatve tu bahirvarttinā sahābhyantarasya yogāt nagarābhyantarā gṛhā ityarthaḥ | ubhayasyāpyatra grahaṇam | upasaṃvyānaśabdo'pi karaṇavyutpattyā uttarīyaṃ karmavyutpattyā tvantarīyamabhidhatte | apurīti vaktavyam | antarāyāṃ puri | atra sarvanāmatvābhāvānna tatkāryam | liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā ekādeśasya pūrvāntatvena grahaṇādvā'tra prasaktiḥ | na caitadvārttikaṃ jasivibhāṣāvidhereva śeṣaḥ, tatraiva paṭhitatvāditi vācyam | adantatvābhāvādeva ṭābantājjasaḥ śībhāvāprasaṅgāt | prakārādabhyantare bahiśca deśabhedāt punaḥ kriyamāṇatvādubhayopapattiḥ | upasaṃvyānagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ bahiryogeṇa kṛtatvāt | uttarīyaparatve bahiryogaśabdasyādyamartham | antarīyaparatve tu dvitīyamarthamādāya siddhamityarthaḥ | na vā śāṭakayugādyartham | samānapramāṇe śāṭakayuge aparihite kimuttarīyaṃ kimantarīyamityanavabodhādaparidhānadaśāyāṃ bahiryogeṇa anirvāhādupasaṃvyānagrahaṇamiti vārtikābhiprāyaḥ | bhāṣyakārāstu upasaṃvyānatvamapyaparidhānadaśāyāṃ nāsti, buddhyā vyavasthāpanaṃ tu bahiryogasyāpi tulyamityupasaṃvyānagrahaṇaṃ vyarthamityāhuḥ | kecittu śāṭakānāṃ traye śarīre sākṣātsaṃyuktasya svasaṃyuktasaṃyuktena bāhyena tṛtīyena saha yogo nāsti | na ca madhyavarttino'pi tadapekṣayā bāhyatvāt tadyogenopapattiḥ | yāvānsamudāyo yatra buddhisthaḥ tadapekṣayā bāhyatvasya grāhyatvāt | evaṃ bāhyasya śarīrasaṃyuktenābhyantareṇāpi yogo nāsti | madhyavarttina uktanyāyenābhyantaratvābhāvāt | evaṃ catuṣṭaye'pi yojyam | śāṭakayugādyarthamiti ādiśabdopādānena vārttikasyaitādṛśābhiprāyalābhādityāhuḥ | bhāṣyasya tvayamāśayaḥ---bahiryogetyasya svaritatvāt tena ca gauṇārthasyāpi grahaṇātparamparāsambandhamādāya tatrāpi bāhyābhyantarayogopapattiriti antaraśabdasyārthadvaye sarvanāmatvam | tyad tad‌ etau pūrvoktaparāmarśakau | ādyaśchāndasaḥ "eṣasya vāji" ityādiprayogālloke cādarśanāditi kecit | "syaśchandasi" iti sūtre chandograhaṇasāmarthyālloke'pītyanye | yatpadam uddeśyārthakam | etadidamau pratyakṣopasthite | adas vyavahite | eko'nyārthe pradhāne ca prathame kevale tathā | sādhāraṇe samāne ca saṃkhyāyāṃ ca prayujyate || "prajāmekā rakṣatyurjamekā" ityatrānyārthaḥ | "ekavīraḥ" ityādau pradhānārthaḥ | "eke|ñalpaprāṇāḥ" ityādau prathamārthaḥ | "ata ekahalmadhye" ityādau asahāyarūpakevalārthaḥ | "etāvekadhanau dvau" ityādau sādhāraṇārthaḥ | "tenaikadik" ityādau samānārthaḥ | "eko dvau " ityādau saṃkhyārtha iti | "ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ‌" iti sūtre saṃkhyāyāmasahāyatve anyatve cetyarthatrayamasya bhāṣye uktam | "eke mukhyānyakevalāḥ" ityamare mukhyatvamapyuktam | tadanyatra lakṣaṇayā prayogaḥ | śaktau mānābhāvāt | ata evādvaitacandrikāyām "ekamevādvitīyaṃ brahma" ityasya vyākhyāyāṃ samānādyarthavācakatvaṃ nirastam | "tenaikadik" iti sūtre ekajātīyatvena samāne gauṇapadaprayogaḥ | sudāmnā ekadik saudāmanī, sudāmākhyaparvatayuktadik | sadṛśadigyukteti yāvat | caitramaitrāvekadhanau ityatrāpi yatheṣṭaviniyogārhatvarūpasādṛśyena caitro maitrīyayatheṣṭaviniyogārhadhane yatheṣṭaṃ viniyokteti yāvat | ityuktatvāt | sambodhanaviṣayo yuṣmadarthaḥ | uccārayitrarthastu asmacchadaḥ | aliṅgatvantūbhayatra samānam | uccārakatvaṃ ca yatra vākyamananyavaktṛtātparyakam tatraiva | tena "vācyastvayā madvacanātsa rājā" ityādau macchabdena kālidāsaparāmarśābhāve'pi na kṣatiḥ | sītābhiprāyeṇa tadvākyasamullekhāt | ata eva kusumāñjalau--- tadaikṣata bahu syām ityādau uttamapuruṣasyāsmadarthasāmānādhikaraṇyaniyamāttadākṣepe'haṃ bahu syāmityananyatātparyakāsmacchabdatvena hetunā tasya vaktṛparatvaṃ sādhayitvā īśvaraḥ sādhitaḥ | "gṛbhṇāmi te saubhagatvāya hastam" ityādau vyabhicāravāraṇāyānanyatātparyakatvapraveśa iti varddhamānādau spaṣṭam | bhavacchabdastu yuṣmacchabdasamānārthaḥ | parantu liṅgayogī | atrabhavacchabdādau sambodhanavyabhicārī ceti viśeṣaḥ | "bhāterḍavatuḥ" iti vyutpāditaḥ | nanvasya halantatvena smāyādīnāmabhāvaḥ, tṛtīyā tu "nimittakāraṇa" ityādinaiva gatārtheti cet | atrāhuḥ--- phiñadrimayaṭaḥ pūrvanipātaḥ ṭhak‌chasau tathā ātvaśeṣaṣyañ‌virahāḥ akacca bhavataḥ phalam | atrākajātvaikaśeṣā bhāṣye kaṇṭhoktāḥ | anye upalakṣaṇatayā saṃgṛhītā iti | vato'patyaṃ bhāvatāyaniḥ | tyadāditvena vṛddhasaṃjñāyām "udīcāṃ vṛddhād‌" iti phiñ‌ | bhavantamañcatīti bhavadyraṅ‌ | "viṣvag‌devayośca ṭeradryañcatāvapratyaye" iti cakāreṇa sarvanāmagrahaṇāṭṭeradryādeśaḥ | bhavanmaya ityatra "nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ" iti mayaṭ | bhavanmitraḥ | "sarvanāmasaṃkhyayoḥ" iti pūrvanipātaḥ | "bhavataṣṭhak‌chasau" ityatra śatṛpratyayāntabhavacchabdanivṛttyarthaṃ vṛddhād ityanuvarttanāt | bhavatoriti pāṭhenāpi nirvāhānnedaṃ niyatamiti tu bodhyam | bhavāniva dṛśyate bhavādṛk | "ā sarvanāmnaḥ" ityātvam | devadattaśca bhavām̐śca bhavantau | "tyadādīni sarvaiḥ" ityekaśeṣaḥ | bhavato bhāvo bhavattetyatra sarvanāmasaṃjñayā guṇavacanasaṃjñābādhāt "guṇavacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ" iti ṣyañabhāvaḥ | "guṇavacanasaṃjñā 'sarvanāmasaṃjñā" ityekasaṃjñādhikāre vārttikakṛtā paṭhitatvāt | bhavakānityatra "avyayasarvanāmnām" ityakac | kapratyaye bhavatka ityeva syāt | "sarvanāmno vṛttimātre" iti bhāṣyavacanātpuṃvadbhāvo'pi phalam | "bhavanmayo dhyāyati nāvanīpatiḥ" iti śrīharṣaḥ | kiṃśabdaḥ praśnākṣepayoḥ | praśno dvividhaḥ, jijñāsāmūlako vipratipattimūlakaśca | ādyo yathā--- kimekaṃ daivataṃ loke kiṃ vā'pyekaṃ parāyaṇam | iti | dvitīyo yathā---īśvarasadbhāve kiṃ pramāṇamiti | ayameva kathāpravṛttihetuḥ | ādyasyopadeśamātreṇa jijñāsānivṛttau viśrāmāt | ākṣepo yathā---"ko nāmāyaṃ saviturudayaḥ" iti | dvidaivākṣepaḥ | "khaṭ‌vā''kṣepe" ityādau darśanāt | khaṇḍane tu kiṃ pramāṇamityupanyasya kiṃśabdo'yamākṣepārtho vā kutsitārtho vā vitarkārtho vā praśnārtho vā syāditi vikalpacatuṣṭayamuktam | abhāvapratipādanārthatvaṃ duṣṭatvapratipādanārthatvaṃ sandehārthatvaṃ jijñāsāviṣayatvapratipādanārthatvamiti ca krameṇa tadvyākhyātam | īśvarasadbhāve pramāṇaṃ nāstītyādye, kutsitaṃ pramāṇamiti dvitīye, pramāṇamanyadveti tṛtīye, pramāṇaṃ jijñāsāviṣaya iti caturthe arthaparyavasānaṃ tatphalitārthamādāyeti bodhyam | vṛt sarvādigaṇo vṛttaḥ, samāpta ityarthaḥ | gaṇapāṭhe vṛcchabdasya samāptau paribhāṣitatvāt | yattu "yadindrāgnī avamasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ, madhyamasyāṃ, paramasyāmutastha" ityādāvavamādipadānāmapi sarvanāmakāryaṃ dṛśyate tacchāndasatvādeveti kaiyaṭādayaḥ | itaretarasmāt anyo'nyeṣāmityādau tu dviḥ prayogo dvirvacanamiti pakṣe tadantavidhinā siddham | "dvandve ca" iti jñāpakena sarvanāmasaṃjñāyāṃ tadantavidheraṅgīkārāt | sthānedvirvacanapakṣe tu sthānivadbhāvena sarvanāmatvam | sanniyogaśiṣṭatvenāntaraṅgamapi dvitvaṃ bādhitvā "antaraṅgānapi" iti nyāyena "samāsavacca bahulam" iti samāsattvaprayuktasya lukaḥ pūrvaṃ pravṛtteḥ | anyathā subantasya dvitve sthāninaḥ sarvanāmatvābhāvena tadādeśe'pi tadanupapatteḥ | na caivaṃ padatvābhāvāttadadhikārīyadvitvānupapattiḥ | pratyayalakṣaṇena tathātvāt | aṅgādhikārīyatvābhāvād "na lumatā" iti niṣedhāpravṛtteḥ | anyo'nyeṣāmityatra tu samāsavattvābhāve'pi pūrvapadasya "prathamaikavacanāntatvam dvitīyādayastu parapadasya" iti vacanabalātprakṛti pratyayavibhāgasiddheḥ | atredamadhikamanusaṃdheyam | tadādisarvanāmnāṃ buddhisthatvarūpeṇa śaktiḥ | na caivaṃ buddhisthatvaprakāraka eva bodhaḥ syāt, na tu ghaṭatvaprakārakaḥ, śābdabodhasya śakyatāvacchedakaprakārakatvaniyamāditi vācyam | atra tatparityāgāt | alpanāyāḥ phalānurodhitvāt | ata eva sarvanāmni na lakṣaṇeti pravādaḥ | śaktyaiva tatprakārakabodhāditi prāñcaḥ | anye tu ghaṭatvādayo dharmā eva śakyatāvacchedakāḥ, nānārthatvasyeṣṭatvāt | na ca laghusamaniyatagurudharmaprakārakaśābdasthale lakṣaṇāpattāvuktapravādavirodhaḥ, kambugrīvādimattvasya ghaṭatvādyapekṣayā gurutvena svaśakyatānavacchedakatvāt, tatra niṣprakārakavyaktibodhopagame ca padānnirvikalpakānaṅgīkāraniyamavirodhāditi vācyam | padānnirvikalpakasvīkārapakṣaeva tadavatārāt | tadbhaṅge'pi kṣativirahāccetyāhuḥ | miśrāstu haripadavannānārthatve pramāṇābhāvād buddhisthatvamupalakṣaṇībhūya śakyatāvacchedakānāmanugamakam | buddhiviṣayatāvacchedakāvacchinnameṣāṃ śakyamityeva śaktigrahāt | evaṃ ca yaddharme yadā yatpuruṣīyabuddhiviṣayatāvacchedakatvaṃ gṛhyate, tadā yathoktaśaktigrahajanyasaṃskārasya taddharmāṃśaudbodhāttaddharmaprakārakāveva padārthasmṛtiśābdabodhau | evaṃ ca ghaṭatvādiniṣṭhaprakāratānāṃ buddhiviṣayatvarūpaprakāratāvacchedakaikyādanugamaḥ | viśiṣya ghaṭatvādīnāṃ śakyatāvacchedakatve tu tanniṣṭhaprakāratānāmānantyena gauraṃva syāt | śakyatāvacchedakaikyavat śakyatāvacchedakatāvacchedakasyāpi śaktyaikyasampādakatvādityāhuḥ | anye tu evamapi kadācid ghaṭatvaprakārako bodhaḥ kadācittu paṭatvaprakāraka ityetadupapattyarthaṃ ghaṭatvaprakārakabodhaṃ prati buddhisthatvāvacchinnaghaṭatvaprakārakaśaktijñānasya hetutā vācyā | evamanyatrāpītyuktahetutākoṭau buddhisthatvāvacchinnatvaniveśe gauravam | tadapekṣayā nānārthatvameva svīkṛtya buddhisthatvasya prayogopādhitvakalpanameva yuktamityāhuḥ | nanvevamapi sarveṣāṃ sarvanāmnāṃ paryāyatvaṃ syāditi cenna | buddhiviśeṣeṇa tadabhāvāt | sarvapadasya uddeśtatāvacchedakatve sati yāvatāṃ prikārāṇāṃ buddhiviṣayatvam teṣu śaktiḥ | na coddeśyetyasya vaiyarthyam | vidheyānāṃ tadarthatvābhāvāt | na caivamapi yatpadaparyāyatvāpattiḥ | tatra tatpadaghaṭitavākyasākāṅkṣāyā avāntaravākyoddeśyabuddhervivakṣitatvāt | atra prakārasyānekatvena viśeṣaṇādvā | ya ākāśaḥ sa śabdāśraya ityādau yatpadajanyabuddhiprakārasyānekatvavyabhicārāt | etena tatpadasādhāraṇyamapi nirastam | atra padāntarasamabhivyāhārasyāpi nāpekṣā | sarve brāhmaṇā ityatra brāhmaṇatvāvacchinnaparatvasya sarve ityādau prameyatvāvacchinnaparatvasya ca darśanāt | praśnapratyekabuddhiviṣayāvacchinne kiṃpadasya śaktiḥ | na nvajñāte icchānudayāt jñāte ca jijñāsānutpatteḥ kathaṃ praśna iti cenna | "kimekaṃ daivataṃ loke" ityādau praśrajanakajñāne uttaravākyajanyajñāne ca viṣayatāvacchedakadharma eka eva tathā'pyekadaivatātvavyāpyadharmaprikārakaṃ jñānaṃ mamecchāviṣaya iti praśnavākyārthaḥ | atra viṣṇutvaniṣṭhā prakāratā ekadaivatatvāvacchinnā, viṣṇurdaivatamityatra tvanavacchinnā | tathā ca taddharmāṃśe niravacchinnaprikāratākajñānecchayā praśnavākyaṃ tadaṃśe kiñcidavacchinnaprakāratākajñānajanyamiti na doṣaḥ | kimayaṃ sthāṇuḥ puruṣo veti saṃśayābhilāpe ko'yamityākṣepe ca yadyapi yathoktamavyāptam, tathā'pi tatra śaktyantaraṃ kalpyam | tatpadaghaṭitavākyasākāṅkṣāvāntaravākyoddeśyabuddhiviṣayaprakārāvacchinne yatpadasya, yatpadaghaṭitavākyasākāṅkṣāvāntaravākyoddeśyabuddhiviṣaye tatpadasya śaktiḥ | na ca yo gataḥ sa āgata ityādāvavyāptiḥ | tacchabdasamānārthakapadasya vivakṣitatvāt | ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ | prakrāntaprasiddhānubhūtārthakastacchabdo na yacchabdasākāṅkṣaḥ | krameṇa yathā--- kātaryaṃ kevalā nītiḥ śauryyaṃ śvāpadaceṣṭhitam | ataḥ siddhiṃ sametābhyāmubhābhyāmanviyeṣa saḥ || atrātithisaṃjño rājā prakrāntaḥ | dvayaṃ gataṃ saṃprati śocanīyatāṃ samāgamaprārthanayā kapālinaḥ | kalā ca sā kāntimatī kalāvataḥ tvamasya lokasya ca netrakaumudī || atra candrakalā prasiddhā | utkampinī bhayapariskhalitāṃśukāntā te locane pratidiśaṃ tarale kṣipantī | krūreṇa dāruṇatayā sahasaiva dagdhā dhūmākulena dahanena na vīkṣitā'si || sāgarikānetre vatsarājena pūrvamanubhūte | iti kāvyaprakāśe | kiṃ ca uttaravākyāntargato yacchabdo niyamena pūrvavākye tacchabdopādānaṃ nāpekṣate | udayati sma tadad‌bhutamālibhirdharaṇibhṛd‌bhuvi tatra vimṛśya yad | ityādau tatsattve'pi--- sādhu candramasi puṣkaraiḥ kṛtaṃ mīlitaṃ yadabhirāmatā'dhike | ityādau tadabhāvāt | atra keciduktasthale'pi tacchabdākṣepa ityāhuḥ | anye tu atra pṛthageva śaktiḥ | avāntaravākyoddeśyaviṣaye tatpadamityeva miśrairuktam | "sādhu candramasi" ityādau yatpadenoddeśyabodhe taduttarameva prathamapādajanyabodhānmahāvākyārthabodhaḥ | tatpadākṣepeṇa punaḥ prathamapādajanyabodhakalpane gauravāt | evam --- utpattirindorapi niṣphalaiva dṛṣṭā vinidrā nalinī na yena | ityādāvapi tatpadādhyāhāre indutvaviśiṣṭopasthitau paunaruktyāpatteḥ | na ca vinidranalinīdarśanābhāvaviśiṣṭatvena tatpadād‌ bodhaḥ | yatpadārthasyaiva darśanaviśeṣaṇatvāt | yanmīlitamityatra yatpadenāpi mīlitasyaivokteḥ | sambhede cānyataravaiyarthyābhāvāt | na ca yatpadavaiyarthyam | "yacchabdayogaḥ prāthamyam" iti rityoddeśyatvalābhārthatvādityāhuḥ | samīpavarttini pratyakṣaviṣayatāvacchedakāvacchinne idametatpadayoḥ śaktiḥ | ata eva "pratyañjali vākyāvṛttiḥ | upādāsyamānapayasa idamā nirddaśānupapatteḥ "iti varddhamānopādhyāyaḥ | tādṛśapratyakṣayogyadharmāvacchinne śaktiḥ | upādāsyamānāñjalīnāmapyetaditi nirddeśa iti nibandhakārokterekameva vākyamityanye | mānasapratyakṣaviṣaye'pīdānīṃ ghaṭa ityādau kāle idampadaprayogādupādāsyamānapayasa idamā nirddeśaḥ sambhavatyeva | paraṃ tu tadātanatyāgena tatra svatvadhvaṃso na bhavati | upādānapūrvakāle tatra svatvānutpattyā'nutpannasya dhvaṃsāyogāt ityapare | vyavahitavarttini pratyakṣaviṣayatāvacchedakāvacchinne adas‌padasya śaktiḥ | vyavadhānaṃ tu deśakālābhyām | idamādinā yo bodhyate tato viprakṛṣṭe tatprayogāt | prāthamikapratyakṣaviṣaye ayamiti prayogāt | dvitīyapratyakṣaviṣaye'sāviti prayogāccha | ubhayatra yathāyogaṃ prāthamikatvaṃ dvitīyatvaṃ ca pratyakṣe viśeṣaṇa miti kecit | yaddharmāvacchinne sambodhyatvabuddhiḥ taddharmāvacchinne yuṣmatpadasya yaddharmavacchinne yadvākyoccārayitṛtvabuddhiḥ taddharmāvacchinne asmatpadasya śaktiḥ | abhimukhīkaraṇānamukūlajñānaviśeṣaviṣayatvaṃ sambodhyatvam | tattatpadottaratvena tattatpadānusandhānamuccāraṇam | tadanukūlavyāpāravattvamuccārayitṛtvam | maunisādhāraṇyāt | uccāraṇaṃ ca ananyatātparyakatvagarbhamiti prāgevoktam | athaivaṃ kāvyādāvacetane tvatpadaprayogo na syāt | evaṃ vayaṃ gacchāma ityādāvapīti cet, satyam | uccārayitṛtvaviṣayakaṃ yaduccārayitṛtātparyaṃ tadviṣayatāvacchedakadharmavattvasya vivakṣitatvāt | uccārayitṛtvāropasya tatrāpi sambhavāt | anye tu sambodhyatāvacchedakāvacchinne uccārayitṛtāvacchedakāvacchinne ca yuṣmadasmadoḥ śaktiḥ | tadavacchedakatvaṃ ca caitrā diśarīrāvacchinnātmatvam | asambodhyādestadbhramācchābdabodhastu śaktibhrameṇa samarthanīyaḥ | ata eva tasyāprāmāṇyam | kastvambhoḥ kathayāmi daivahatakaṃ māṃ viddhi śākhoṭakam | ityādau bhramāsambhave lakṣaṇā, mukhyārthānvayānupapatteḥ | "sarvo'pyahaṃ guṇīti vetti" ityādāvapi tathā | sambodhyatvoccārayitṛtvapratipatteryathāyogaṃ prayojanatvāt | vayaṃ gacchāma ityādau mahārṇavokto virūpaikaśeṣa ityāhuḥ | nanu caitratvādinā bodhe "anayorātmamātraśaktatvam" itigranthavirodhaḥ | "tat tvamasi" "ahamātmā guḍākeśa" iti śrutismṛtyorātmanyeva prayogāccha caitratvādeḥ śarīravṛttijātitvāt | jātasya nāma karma karotīti śarīrasyaiva nāmakaraṇavidhānāt | caitraḥ paṇḍita ityādeśca bhāktatvāt | ata eva mṛtasyāpi caitrādipadena nirdeśaḥ | gotrānvayārthamuktaprakārasyāvaśyakatvāt | satyam | śarīraghaṭitaparamparāsambandhena caitratvāderātmavṛttitvopapatteriti dik | sarvādigaṇavyākhyānaṃ sampūrṇam | vibhāṣā diksamāse bahuvīhau 27 | atra sarvanāmasaṃjñā vā syāt | uttarasyāḥ pūrvasyāśca diśo'ntarālam uttarapūrvā | "diṅ‌nāmānyantarāle" iti bahuvrīhiḥ" tasyai uttarapūrvasyai uttarapūrvāyai | pratipadoktadiksamāsagrahaṇānneha | yā pūrvā sottarā syonmugdhasya sa uttarapūrvaḥ | tasmai uttarapūrvāya dehi | yattu yottarā sā pūrvā yasyetyeva vigraho yukto'nyathā pūrvanipātavaiparītyāpattiriti | tanna | vastuto yā pūrvā sā yasyottaratvaprakārakajñānaviṣaya ityatra uttaretyasyaiva viśeṣaṇatvāt | uttaraviśeṣyakapūrvatvaprakārabhramāvivakṣāyāṃ tu pūrvottaretyasyāpi iṣṭatvāt | evaṃ ca bahuvrīhāviti na kāryam | dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇāmiti dvandvasya pratipedāktaparibhāṣayaiva vāritatvāt | nanūttarasūtre bahuvrīhireva yo bahuvrīhistatraiva nidhedho yathā syānna tvatidiṣṭabahuvrīhāvityetadarthaṃ tat | anyathā ekaikasmaidehītyādau "ekaṃ bahuvrīhivat" "ābādhe ca" iti dvirvacane'pi niṣedhaprasaṅgāt | maivam | samāsapadānuvṛttyaiva samāsa eva yo bahuvrīhirityarthalābhāt | na bahuvrīhau 28 | bahuvrīhisaṃjñāpravṛttiviṣayībhūte pade sarvāderuktasaṃjñā na syāt | na ca tasya bahuvrīhipadārthatvābhāvaḥ | tādarthyāttacchabdopapatteḥ | na caivaṃ laukikavigrahe'pi niṣedhāpattiḥ | tasya bahuvrīhyarthapradarśanaparatve'pi tādarthyābhāvāt | ekārthībhāve vṛttireva, vyapekṣāyāṃ tu vākyameveti siddhāntāt | alaukikavākya eva samāsapravṛttisvīkārāt | tathā ca kaiyaṭenoktam--- aprayogasamavāyi yatprakriyāvākyaṃ tatrāyaṃ pratiṣedho na laukikavākye prayogārhe tasya pṛthageva prayogāditi | nanvevam alaukikavigrahe'pi pratiṣedhavaiyarthyam | upasarjanatvādeva prāptyabhāvāt | na ca tasyānvayabodhājanakatvāttadarthakasya kathamupasarjanatvamiti vācyam | samāse upasarjanatvadarśanena tatrāpi tadanumānāt | anyathā sāmarthyasyābhāvāttatra samāsapravṛttyanupapatteriti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | na ca sāmarthyameva tatrānumīyate "anekamanyapadārthe" ityādiśāstrīyānuvādasāmarthyāt, na tūpasarjanatvamapi, tasya samāsapravṛttyanupayogitayā'rthāpattyaviṣayatvāditi vācyam | ekārthībhāvātiriktasya sāmarthyasya durvacatvāt | tadākṣepādevopasarjanatvasyāpyākṣepasiddheḥ | samāsottaraṃ sāmarthyasvīkāre prayojanābhāvāt satyam | samāsānyathā'nupapattyā'laukikavākye'pi samudāyaeva sāmarthyamanumīyate na tu padeṣu pratyekaprayojanakalpakayoḥ | anyatarasyāpyanavatārāt | tathā cāvayavamātrasyānupasarjanatvātsaṃjñāprasaktau pratiṣedhopapatteḥ | mukhyaeva bahuvrīhāvayaṃ niṣedha iti pakṣo'pi bhāṣye prathamamupanyastaḥ | tvakaṃ pitā yasya tvatkapitṛkaḥ | ahakaṃ pitā yasya matkapitṛkaḥ | atra sarvanāmasaṃjñāyām "avyayasarvanāmnāmakac‌ prāk‌ ṭeḥ" ityakac‌ syāt | tasya kapratyayāpavādatvāt | evaṃ dvakau putrau yasya sa dvikaputra ityapyudāhāryam | vyañjanānteṣu kākacorviśeṣa iti bhāṣye akārāntabhinnatvasyopalakṣitatvāditi kaiyaṭaḥ | tathā ca tvakatpitṛko makatpitṛko dvakiputra ityādikaṃ prasajyeteti pratiṣedho'samārabhyate | nanvevamapi akaṭ‌prasaṅgaḥ | saṃjñānimittakatvena tasyāntaraṅgatvāt | padāntarasaṃnidhāne varttipadārthaviśeṣaṇānyapadārthavivakṣāyāṃ pravarttamānasya bahuvrīherbahiraṅgatvāt | tathā ca samāsātprāgeva pravṛttasyākacaḥ samāsānantarapravṛttikenoktaniṣedhena bādhitumaśakyatvāt | na ca yathā "pratyayottarapadayośca" iti liṅgād bahiraṅgo'pi samāsāśrayo luk antaraṅgānāmapi bādhakaḥ, evamuktaniṣedhasāmarthyātsamāso'pyakacaṃ bādhitvā pravarttataiti vācyam | priyaviśvāyetyetadarthamapyetadupapatteḥ | "vā priyasya" iti priyasya pūrvanipātaḥ | evaṃ dvyanyāya tryanyāya | "sarvanāmasaṃkhyayoḥ sannipāte paratvātsaṃkhyāyāḥ pūrvanipātaḥ" iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | atra hi kāryakālapakṣe sarvanāmasaṃjñāyāḥ smāyādyādeśavidhibhirekavākyatvāt viśvaśabdasya sarvanāmasaṃjñāmupajīvya tadantavidhinā priyaviśvaśabdasya saṃjñā syāt, sā mā bhūditi viśvaśabdasyaiva saṃjñā niṣidhyate | atra bahuvrīhisaṃjñottarakālaṃ prasaktasaṃjñāniṣedhenoktavacanasya caritārthatvāt uktārthajñāpanānupapatteḥ | maivam | upasarjanapratiṣedhenāpyetāvanmātrasiddheḥ yathoktajñāpanasya susthatvāt | imameva pakṣamāśritya prāñco vyācakhyuḥ--- bahuvrīhau sarvādeḥ sarvanāmatā na syāt | priyasarvāya | sūtrakāramate bahuvrīhau na sarvanāmatā, bhāṣyakāramate gauṇatvamātre | tvatkapitṛko matkapitṛka ityatra samāsāvayavayoryuṣmadasmadoḥ sarvanāmatvādanaṅgakāryatvenākac‌ syāt sa mā bhūt kapratyaya eva syādityetadarthamidaṃ sūtramiti nyāsakṛnmatamiti | avayavasya saṃjñāniṣedho'tra vivakṣitaḥ | tena kiṃ samudāyasyāyaṃ niṣedha iti vikalpakoṭirnirastā | sarvādeḥ sarvanāmatā na syāditi granthaṃ prakṛtya tattacchaṅkā'navatārāt | nanvavayavasyāpi kathaṃ saṃjñāprasaktiḥ, upasarjanānāṃ pāṭhātparyudāsasya vārttikakṛtoktatvāt | satyam | sūtrakāreṇa tadanaṅgīkārāt | tadāha---sūtrakāramataiti | atra caitatsūtrārambhasyaiva jñāpakatvāt | jahatsvārthavṛttipakṣe'pi svārthavācakatvasya saṃjñopayogino vṛttāvapi sattvāt | etena tvatkapitṛka ityasya vyākhyāyām "samāsāntaḥ pātinoryuṣmadasmadoḥ sarvārthavākacakatvena" iti prasādagranthaḥ, "samudāyo hi viśeṣe varttate, pūrvapadaṃ tu sarvārthatāyā anapetameva " iti nyāsagranthaśca vyākhyātaḥ | etena "anvarthasaṃjñābalādeva sūtrākṣarairevopasarjanaparyudāsalābha" ityapi nirastam | "nanu cātrānvarthasaṃjñākaraṇādeva saṃjñānirāse kṛte'kac‌ na bhaviṣyati, viśeṣaviṣayatvād" ityāśaṅkya naitadasti samudāyo hītyādigranthāvatārāt | uktarītyā tu nāvayavavyāvṛttiriti tadabhiprāyāt | tathā hi---kimidaṃ viśeṣaviṣayatvam | na tāvacchakyatāvacchedakayāvaddharmaprakārakabodhānupadhāyakatvam, tvakaṃ pitā yasyetyādāvapi tathātvāt | yugapattāvatprakārakabodhābhāvāt | buddhiviṣayatāvacchedakībhūtakiñciddharmaprakārakabodhasyāpyubhayatraiva jāyamānatvāt | ata eva śakyatāvacchedakayatkiñciddharmāvacchinnayāvadvyaktibodhājanakatvamapyanāśaṅkyam | sarve ghaṭā ānītā ityādāvabhāvāt | sarvatvamādhikārikamiti nyāyāt | nāpi viśeṣadharmāvacchinnaśakyatākatvam | sarvanāmnāṃ sarveṣāmeva tathātvāt | nāpyanyadharmānavacchinnaśakyatākatve sati tat | avayavasādhāraṇyāt | nāpi saṃjñopasarjanobhayabhinnatvam | pāribhāṣikatvāpattyā'nvarthasaṃjñālabhyatvānirvāhāt | nanvekārthībhāvarūpāyāṃ vṛttau avāntarapadavibhāgānabhyupagamātkathamevamiti cet, maivam | prakriyādaśāyāmeva vyutpattikāryāṇāṃ pravṛttisvīkārāt pariniṣṭhitapade tadapravṛtteḥ | anyathā pariniṣṭhitatvavyāghātāt | "taddhi apravṛttanityavidhyuddeśyatāvacchedakadharmānākrāntatvam | nihate tiṅantādāvavyāptivāraṇāya apravṛtteti | vaikalpikeḍāgamoddeśyatāvacchedakākrānte seddhetyādāvavyāptivāraṇāya nityeti" iti svayameva nirūpitatvāt | ata eva "dvandvatatpuruṣayoruttarapade nityasamāsavacanam" iti vārtikaṃ saṅgacchate | anyathā avāntaratatpuruṣasya mahāvibhāṣayā vaikalpikatvāpatteḥ | tadaṃśe vārttikaṃ nyāyasiddhārthānuvādamātramiti tu tatraiva nirākariṣyāmaḥ | "etena jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau samāsāvayavayorartha eva nāsti | ajahatsvārthāyāmapi svārthaviśiṣṭārthāntaravṛttitvenopasarjanatvaṃ spaṣṭameva" iti nirastam | prakriyopayogino'rthasya jahatsvārthāyāmapi sattvāt | kṛtaddhitetyādau tathaiva bhāṣyādibhiḥ siddhāntitatvāt | anyathā "dvandve ca" ityasyānupapatteḥ | vṛttyantargatasyānarthakatvādeva sarvanāmatvābhāve tadantavidhinā samāse tatprasaṅgasya durghaṭatvāt | tasyāpyalaukikavigrahaparatāyā durvacatvāt | samudāyasyāyaṃ pratiṣedha iti siddhāntāt | kathaṃ vā paramasarva ityādau sarvanāmatvam | dvandvakarmadhārayayoravayavasyāpyarthavattvam, na tu bahuvrīhyādāviti vaiṣamye bījābhāvāt | vṛtterubhayatra sādhāraṇyāt | pūrvottarapadatvabhedasya tvakiñcitkaratāyāḥ svayamevoktatvāt | evaṃ "tyadādipradhānāpyetat siddham" iti pratibhāṣyasyāpyayamevābhiprāyaḥ | anyathā'narthakatvādeva nātra saṃjñāyā akacprasaktirityeva brūyāt | apiśabdasya tvayamarthaḥ---priyaviśvāyetyatraitatpratiṣedhasya caritārthatvāttvatkapitṛka ityādau kathamakaco nivṛttiḥ | samāsātprāgevāntaraṅgatvāttadāpatteḥ uktatvāt | yadi tu pratiṣedhasāmarthyātpūrvamapyakaco na pravṛttirityasya rakṣārthaṃ priyaviśvāyetyatra upasarjanapratiṣedha āśrīyate, tadā tvatkapitṛka ityatrākajapi tenaiva na bhaviṣyatītyuktaniṣedhavaiyarthyam | alaukikavākyaeva akaco niṣedhārthamārambha iti svīkāre tu dvitīyapakṣaeva paryavasānam | ajahatsvārthāyāmapītyādāvapi praṣṭavyam---kiṃ svārthasyānyaviśeṣaṇatāpannatvādupasarjanatvamiti vivakṣitam, uta svasyārthāntare lākṣaṇikatvāditi | nādyaḥ | sarvasmai ityādāvapi tadāpatteḥ | vibhaktyarthaviśeṣaṇatāpannatvāt | nāntyaḥ | na hi lākṣaṇikatvamupasarjanatvamiti svaparagranthavirodhāt | bahuvrīhau pūrvapadasyaivānyapadārthe lakṣaṇeti pakṣe prakṛtopayogasyāpyabhāvācca | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ | nanūpasarjanaparyudāsānabhyupagame'tisarvāyetyādāvatiprasaṅga ityata āha---bhāṣyakāreti | vṛttipraveśasāmye'pi yatra sarvanāmārthasya viśeṣaṇatvaṃ na tatra saṃjñā, yatra tu viśeṣyatvaṃ tatrāstyeva | yathā paramasarve ityādāviti bhāvaḥ | tataśca tvatkapitṛka ityudāharaṇānupapattyā'laukikavigrahe pratiṣedhaparametatsūtramiti bhāṣyābhiprāya iti prācāmāśayaḥ | nyāsakārastvāha---priyaviśvāyeti nodāharaṇam | samudāyasyāsarvanāmatvāt | saṃjñāyāṃ jñāpakalabhyasya tadantavidheśca sarvanāmārthaprādhānyaviṣayakatvāt | tadavayavānāṃ ca viśvādīnāṃ sarvanāmakārthaprādhānyaviṣayakatvāt | tadavayavānāṃ ca viśvādīnāṃ sarvanāmakāryaprasaktyabhāvāt | smaiprabhṛtīnāmaṅgādhikārīyatvāt | na ca "aṅgādhikāre tasya ca taduttarapadasya ca" iti siddhāntātsarvanāmāntādaṅgātparatvamāśritya tadāpattiḥ | vihitaviśeṣaṇāśrayaṇāt | sarvanāmno'ṅgādvihitasya ṅeprabhṛterityarthāt | "dvandve ca" ityatra dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇāmiti bhāṣyaprayogasya tatra pramāṇatvāt | ekavākyasyaikarūpeṇaiva sarvatra pravṛtteḥ | na ca sarvanāmāntādaṅgādvihitasyetyarthaprasaṅgādatiprasaṅgatādavasthyam | vihitaviśeṣaṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ | aṅgātsarvanāmna ityeva sarvanāmno viseṣyatvasvīkārāt | tena ca tadantavidherapravṛtteḥ | ata evoktaṃ prakāśakāraiḥ--- avayavamātrasya satyapi sarvanāmatve doṣābhāvāditi | evaṃ ca "na bahuvrīhau" iti niṣedhasya priyaviśvāyetyatrānapekṣitatvāttatsāmarthyādantaraṅgo'pyakac‌ samāsātpūrvaṃ na pravarttate iti tvatkapitṛka ityādyudāhaṇaṃ susthameva | tatsiddhaṃ kṛte bahuvrīhāvavayavasaṃjñāniṣedhārthamevaitatsūtramiti | tadetadupanyasyati, tvatkapitṛka ityādinā | tathā ca sūtrakāramataityanenopasarjanapratiṣedhānaṅgīkārādetatsūtrārambha ityuktam | vārttikamate tūpasarjanapratiṣedhādeva siddhamityarthaḥ | viṣayajijñāsāyāṃ tu bhāṣyamate'laukikavigrahe'yaṃ niṣedhaḥ | nyāsakṛnmate tu bahuvrīhāvavayavānāmiti viveka uktaḥ | na cāsya bhāṣye'pi prathamaṃ likhitatvātkathaṃ nyāsakārīyatvenopanyāsa iti vācyam | ādye upasarjanapratiṣedhena priyaviśvāyetyādīnāmanyathāsiddhiruktā | dvitīye tu saṃjñāmabhyupagamya prakārāntareṇeti viśeṣāt | evaṃ sūtre vyākhyāte pratyākhyānābhiprāyeṇāha bhāṣyakāraḥ | gonarddīyastvāha--- akacsvarau tu karttavyau pratyaṅgaṃ muktasaṃśayau | tvakatpitṛko makatpitṛka ityeva bhavitavyamiti | svaraḥ "svāṅgaśiṭāmadantām" ityādyudāttatvam | yathottaraṃ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyādbhāṣyānusārādeva sādhutvavyavasthā | tṛtīyāsamāse 29 | sarvanāmasaṃjñā na syāt | māsapūrvāya dehi | punaḥ samāsagrahaṇaṃ vākyabhedena samāsārthakavākye'pi niṣedhalābhārtham | māsena pūrvāya | na ca tvayakā kṛtam tvakatkṛtamityādāvapyāpattiḥ | pratipadoktasya "pūrvasadṛśa" itisamāsasyaivopādānāt | yadvā asamāse ityanyo yogaḥ | paryudāsena samāsasadṛśasya laukikavākyasya grahaṇam | na ca pūrvasūtravadasyāpyalaukikavākyaparatvamevāstviti vācyam | adanteṣu kākacoraviśeṣāt | takārāntānāṃ ca pratipadoktatṛtīyāsamāsābhāvādvaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt | dvandve ca 30 | sarvanāmasaṃjñā na syāt | pūrvāparādharāṇām | samudāyasyāyaṃ niṣedho na tvavayavānām | na ca samudāye saṃjñāprasaktyabhāvaḥ | uktaniṣedhenaiva tadanumānāt | prayojanaṃ sarvanāmāvyavasaṃjñāyāmiti vārttikācca | nanvayamavayavasyaiva saṃjñāniṣedhaḥ kuto na syāditi ced, maivam | phalābhāvāt | tyadādibhyaḥ pūrveṣāmakārāntatvena kākacorviśeṣābhāvāt | tyadādīnāṃ caikaśeṣavidhānena dvandvasyaivāprasiddheḥ | svarādau pāṭha iti kathaṃ jñāpakateti vācyam | jñāpakatvopanyāsakabhāṣyaprāmāṇyena tasmāt kvinpratyayo'nabhidhānānna bhavatīti nirṇayāt | na ca gaurglaurnaurityeteṣāmapyavyayasaṃjñā syāditi vācyam | atra vārtikam--- anikārokāraprakṛtiriti vaktavyam | atra tvikārokāraprakṛtikatvānna doṣa iti | yadi tvevamapi kumbhakārebhyo nagarakārebhya ityādāvativyāptiḥ, tarhi ananyaprakṛtiriti vaktavyam | tena ādeśamātrasya vyāvṛttiḥ | bhāṣyakṛtastvāhuḥ---"sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasya" iti paribhāṣāyā āvaśyakatvāt tata eva nātiprasaṅgaḥ | sup‌sannipātakṛtasya ejantatvasya tadvighātakāvyayasaṃjñāyāmanimittatvāt | satyāṃ hi tasyāṃ sulopāpattyā ejantatvanimittasya vighātaḥ syāditi | ayamarthaḥ---sannipātaḥ saṃbandhaḥ lakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ yasya tādṛśo vidhiḥ tadvighātakasya svanimittasaṃbandhavighātakasya kāryasya nimittaṃ na bhavatīti | nyāyasiddhaṃ caitat | upajīvyāvirodhenaiva upajīvakasya pravṛtteḥ | na caivaṃ vahnyādestṛṇādivighātakatvaṃ na syāditi vācyam | kalpanāviṣayatvāduktanyāyasya anyatra yathāpramāṇameva vyavasthāpanāt | ata evānubhavasya smṛtikāraṇatve saṃskārasya kāraṇatvaṃ na siddhyati | kāryāvyavahitapūrvavarttitvābhāvenānubhavasya smṛtiṃ prati kāraṇatvānirvāhāt tannirvāhārthameva saṃskārakalpanayā'nubhavakāraṇatāyāstadupajīvyatvāt | ata eva "kaṣṭāya kramaṇe" ityādinā hrasvāṃśe sannipātaparibhāṣābādha iti siddhāntaḥ | "kṛnmejantaḥ" ityādestu svābhāvikaejantasthale sāvakāśatvāt noktasthale etatparibhāṣābādhakatvamiti | idaṃ punaravadheyam | yatropajīvyatāvacchedakadharmo rūpāntarāpattāvapi nānyathā bhavati, na tatroktanyāyapravṛttiḥ | yathā kariṣyasītyatra valāditvaviśiṣṭamārddhadhātukamiḍāgamasyopajīvyamiti tadrūpādiṇaḥ parasya sasya ṣatvaṃ bhavatyeva | ṣatve kṛte'pi tasya valāditvāvighātāt | evaṃ sarveṣāmityādāvapi | sakārasya etvanimittatve'pi ekārātparatvena ṣatve kṛte'pi jhalāditvāvigātād | "hali sarveṣām" iti nirdeśānnātra sannipātanyāyapravṛttiriti pravādastu abhyupetyaiva bodhyaḥ | yadrūpāvacchinnāyāṃ yasyāṃ vyaktau nimittatvaṃ paryavasyati tadvyakterapi vighāto na bhavatītyarthaṃ kalpayitvā'nityatvamāśritya samādheḥ saṃdarbhaviruddhatvāt | prasaṅgādasyāḥ prayojanāntarāṇyapyupanyasyante | amunetyatrāsiddhatvena mutvasyākārāntatve'pi ghisaṃjñānimittaṃ nābhāvamāśritya "supi ca" iti dīrgho na | ghisaṃjñāvyāghātāpatteḥ | "na mu ne" ityatra nābhāve karttavye kṛte ca sati mubhāvo nāsiddhaḥ iti vyākhyānaṃ tu saṃbhavamātreṇa | uktarītyaiva susthatvāt | śakaṭipaddhatyādibhyaḥ saptamyekavacanasya ṅeraukārādeśe tatsanniyogenekārasyākārādeśe ca kṛte adantalakṣaṇaṣṭāp na bhavati | tayorānantaryasya vighātāpatteḥ | nanvaukārādeśasyānantaryaprayuktatve'pi tatsanniyogaśiṣṭe atve'pi tathātve mānābhāva iti cetsatyam | ata evāparitoṣātsaptame bhāṣyakāreṇa "aukārādeśo ḍitkarttavya" ityuktatvānna doṣaḥ | ḍittvena ṭilope halantatvena ṭāpaḥ prāpterevābhāvāt | evam "ijādeśca gurumata" iti sūtre iyeṣetyādāvapi āmprāptimāśaṅkya "upadeśavacanāt siddham" iti vārtikaṃ pratyākhyātuṃ bhāṣye liṭ‌sannipātakṛtasya guṇasya liṭ‌sannipātavighātakamāmaṃ prati na nimittatvamityuktam | "āma" iti lerluk‌prasaṅgāt | evam "acaḥ parasmin" iti sūtre pañcamīsamāsānāśrayaṇapakṣe mathitaṃ paṇyamasyetyarthe "tadasya paṇyam" iti ṭhaki tasya ikādeśe" yasyeti ca" iti akāralope ca kṛte tāntatvātkādeśo na | tasya hi tāntatvaṃ nimittam | tatra ca ikapratyayaḥ | tasminpare akāralopotpatteḥ | tasya kādeśe ca tadvighātāpatteḥ | evamanyadapyūhyam | dākṣirityādau iñ‌pratyayasyopajīvyākāralopanimittatvaṃ tu uktaparibhāṣāyā anityatvādeva | tatra ca pramāṇaṃ prāgevoktam | evaṃ "na yāsayoḥ" iti sūtramapi tatra pramāṇam | anyathā akārasannipātakṛtasya ṭāpastadvighātakamitvaṃ prati nimittatvānupapattyaiva siddhau itvaniṣedhavaiyarthyāt | syādetat | agniśabdo'pyutpattipakṣe phiṭ‌svareṇa vyutpattipakṣe tu pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ | tato matup | tasyāntodāttatvāt hrasvānnuṭaśca parasya matupa udāttatvaṃ syādityarthakena "hrasvanuḍ‌bhyāṃ madub‌" iti sūtreṇa udāttatve kṛte "anudāttaṃ padamekavarjjam' iti śeṣanighātena prakṛtibhāgasyānudāttatvaṃ na syāt | tadīyāntodāttatvasya matubudāttopajīvyatvāt | "hrasvanuḍ‌bhyāṃ matub‌" iti sūtre "antodāttāduttarapadād‌" ityato'ntodāttādityasyānuvṛtteriti | ucyate----anityatvādevātra na doṣaḥ | ata eva paramavācā ityatra "antodāttāduttarapadādanyatarasyāmanityasamāse" iti sūtreṇa antodāttātparasyā vibhaktervidhīyamānamudāttatvaṃ prakṛtibhāgasya śeṣanighāte nimittaṃ bhavatyeva | yattu svaravidhau sannipātaparibhāṣā na pravarttate iti | taccintyam | pramāṇābhāvāt | tathā hi | gopāyatamityatra gup‌ iti dhātusvareṇāntodāttaḥ | āyapratyaya ādyudāttaḥ | "sanādyantā dhātavaḥ" iti punardhātusaṃjñāyāmantodāttatayā yakārākāra udāttaḥ, na tu ukāra ākāro vā | "satiśiṣṭasvarabalīyastvam" iti nyāyāt | tataḥ śappratyayaḥ | "anudāttau suppitau" ityanudāttaḥ | "ato guṇe" iti pararūpam | "ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ" iti akāra udāttaḥ | tamādeśo lasārvadhātukasvareṇānudāttaḥ | "udāttādanudāttasya" iti svaritaḥ | tamāśritya pūrvasya śeṣanighātaḥ prāpnoti | sannipātaparibhāṣayā tu na bhavati | udāttopajīvakasya svastisya tadvighātakanighātāpravarttakatvāt | yattu vadanti---yathoddeśapakṣe śeṣanighātaparibhāṣā tripādyāṃ na pravarttate | ataḥ śeṣanighāte kriyamāṇe svaritasyāsiddhatvādeva na śeṣanighāta iti tatra sannipātaparibhāṣāyāḥ prayojanābhāvaḥ | na ca tasyā yathoddeśameva pravṛttau mānābhāvaḥ | "tavyattavyānīyaraḥ" iti tavyatastitkaraṇasya pramāṇatvāt | tathā hi---tavyamātrasyāpi pratyayasvareṇādyudāttatve śeṣanighāte ca kṛte "udāttādanudāttasya" iti svaritatvāviśeṣāt, śeṣanighātaparibhāṣāyāśca kāryakālamapi pravṛttau tasyā "udāttādanudāttasya" ityetatsamānadeśatayā svaritasya śeṣanighātaṃ pratyasiddhatvābhāvāt nighāte ca kṛte ubhayatrāpi svarasāmyāttavyatastittvaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt | tasyā yathoddeśameva pravṛttau tu "udāttād" iti svaritasya śeṣanighātaṃ pratyasiddhatvāt tavyapratyaye śeṣanighāto na bhavati | tavyatpratyaye tu "titsvaritam" ityasya pāṣṭhatvāttasya nighātaṃ pratyasiddhatvaṃ nāstīti bhavatyeva śeṣanighāta iti tittvasya sārthakyameveti | tadapi cintyam | udāttīpajīvakasya svaritasya saṃnipātanyāyena tadvighātakaśeṣanighātāpravarttakatvādeva tavyapratyaye tadapravṛtteḥ | "titsvaritam" ityasya tu udāttopajīvakatvābhāvena śeṣanighātanimittatvamavyāhatamiti phalabhedasya spaṣṭatayā titkaraṇasya veyarthyābhāvena yathoktajñāpakatvānupapatteḥ | sannipātaparibhāṣāyāḥ svaravidhāvapravṛttisiddhirityanyo'nyāśrayāt | etena "yato'nāvaḥ" iti sūtrasya śeṣanighātaparibhāṣāyā yathoddeśameva pravṛttirityatra jñāpakatvam | tasya hi yatpratyayāntasya nauśabdabhinnasya dvyaca ādirudātta ityarthaḥ | anyathā yatastittvena svaritatvāt tamāśritya śeṣanighāte pūrvasyānudāttatvamuktasūtraṃ vinaiva syāt | ādyudātte kṛte'pi śeṣanighātenānudāttatve "udāttādanudāttasya" iti svaritatve ca kṛte śeṣanighātena pūrvasyānudāttatvameva bhavatīti viśeṣābhāvāt "yato'nāva" iti sūtraṃ vyarthameva syāt | śeṣanighātaparibhāṣāyā yathoddeśameva pravṛttau tu "udāttādanudāttasya" ityasya śeṣanighātaṃ pratyasiddhatvāccheṣanighāto na bhavatīti sūtrasārthakyamityapi parāstam | traipādikasya svaritasya udāttopajīvakatvena tadvighātakaśeṣanighātaṃ pratyapravartakatayā sūtrārambhe phalabhedasya sattvāt | "anāvaḥ" iti paryudāsasya vidheyaṃ vinā'nupapattyā tadarthatayaiva sūtrasārthakyācca | tasmātsannipātaparibhāṣāyā anityatvenaiva sarveṣṭasiddhau śeṣanighātaparibhāṣāyā yathoddeśameva pravṛttiriti niyamakalpanamaprāmāṇikameva | ata eva śabdakaustubhe'pyatraiva sūtre agnimānityatra sannipātaparibhāṣāyā anityatvādeva śeṣanighāta ityuktam | tasmāduktamanoramādigranthā niryuktikā eveti dik | katvātosankasunaḥ 39 | etadantamavyayasaṃjñam | kṛtvā | purā sūryasyodetoḥ | purā vatsānāmapākarttoḥ | udayādapākaṇāccetyarthaḥ | "bhāvalakṣaṇe stheṇ‌kṛñ‌vadicarihutamijanibhyastosun‌" | "purā krūrasya visṛpo virap‌śin‌" "purā jatrubhya ātṛdaḥ" | "sṛpitṛdoḥ kasun" iti kasun | dvāvetau chāndasau | avyayībhāvaśca 40 | avyayasaṃjñaḥ syāt | parigaṇanaṃ kartavyam | luki mukhasvaropacārayornivṛttau ceti | luki yathā---upāgni | pratyagni | "avyayādāp‌supaḥ" iti supo luk | mukhasvaranivṛttau yathā---upāgnimukhaḥ | pratyagnimukhaḥ | "mukhaṃ svāṅgam" iti uttarapadasyādyudāttatve prāpte "nāvyayadik‌śabdagomahatsthūlamuṣṭipṛthuvatsebhyaḥ" iti niṣedhaḥ | tataśca upāgni agnisamīpe mukhaṃ yasyeti upāgnimukha ityatra "bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā" iti pūrvapade prakṛtisvara eva | sa ca samāsatvādantodāttaḥ | visargādeśasya sakārasya upacāreti pūrvācāryasaṃjñā | tannivṛttau yathā---upapayaḥ kāraḥ | upapayaḥ kāmaḥ | "ataḥ kṛkami" iti satve prāpte "anavyayasya" iti paryudāsaḥ | parigaṇanaṃ kim | upagnyadhīyāna | parāṅgavadbhāvena ṣāṣṭham "āmantritasya ca" ityādyudāttatvam | anyathā'vyayānāṃ parāṅgavadbhāvapratiṣedhāttanna syāt | upāgnikamityādau "avyayasarvanāmnām" ityakaj‌ na | upakumbhammanya ityatra "arurdviṣad‌" iti mum | anyathā "anavyayasya" iti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt | upakumbhībhūtaḥ "asya cvau" ityatrāvyayānāmupasaṃkhyānapratiṣedho na | idamavadheyam | nāvyayībhāvāditi viśeṣaniṣedhādeva luk‌ siddhaḥ | "ataḥ kṛkami" ityatra "anuttarapadasthasya" ityanuvṛttyaiva na satvam | ato mukhasvaranivṛttireva prayojanam | tatra kecit | mukhasvara iṣṭa eva | yadyetāvatprayojanaṃ syāttatraivāyaṃ brūyād "nāvyayādavyayībhāvācca" iti bhāṣyasvārasyāt | anye tu anavyayamavyayaṃ bhavatītyanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānādeva mukhasvaranivṛttirbhaviṣyatīti sarvathā'pi sūtramidamanārabhyam | evaṃ "taddhitaśca" ityādisūtracatuṣṭayamapi | svarādau hi tasilādistaddhita edhāc‌paryanta ityādicvyarthāccetyantena auṇaādikamāsiṃ vihāya "taddhitaśca" iti sūtrasyārthaḥ saṃgṛhītaḥ, kṛnmakārasandhyakṣarā ityanena 'kṛnmejantaḥ" ityasya | śi sarvanāmasthānam 41 | jaśśasorādeśaḥ śītyetaduktasaṃjñam | vārīṇi | "sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau" iti dīrghaḥ | pradeśeṣveva śisuṭorityuktau tu napuṃsake'pi syāt | na ca śigrahaṇasāmarthyam | śasarthatvenopakṣayāt | tasmātsaṃjñā''rambha āvaśyakaḥ | tasyā mahattvaṃ tu pūrvācāryasaṃpradāyāt | suḍanapuṃsakasya 42 | napuṃsakabhinnaprakṛtikāni svādipañcavacanānyuktasaṃjñāni | rājā | rājānau | rājānaḥ | rājānam | rājānau | prāgvaddīrghaḥ | anapuṃsakasya kim | sāmanī "vibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ" ityallopābhāve saṃjñāvirahānna dīrghaḥ | paryudāsaḥ kim | napuṃsake vidhipratiṣedhābhāvābyāṃ pūrvasūtreṇa prāptāṃ saṃjñā yathā syāt | tena vanānītyādi siddham | na ca tadārambhasāmarthyam | śasādeśe caritārthatvāt | yadvā pratiṣedha evāyam | na coktadoṣaḥ | "anantarasya vidhirvā niṣedho vā" iti tadabhāvāt | anyathā "suṭ‌ strīpuṃsayoḥ" iti pratipattilāghavārthaṃ brūyāt | "anapuṃsakasya" iti vacaneṣu keṣāñcinnañsamāsānāmasāmarthye'pi sādhutvaṃ jñāpyate | tenāśrāddhabhojītyādi siddham | asamarthasamāso vākyabhedaśceti gauravaṃ tu na doṣaḥ | phalamukhatvāt | naveti vibhāṣā 43 | niṣedhavikalpayorvibhāṣā saṃjñā syāt | itiśabdasyobhayānvitatvāt | sa ca padārthaviparyāsakṛt | loke hi gavādiśabdā arthaparā itikaraṇena gaurityāhetyādau śabdaparāḥ | sampadyante | vyākaraṇe tu "svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya" iti paribhāṣaṇāt svarūpaparatvamutsargaḥ, itikaraṇena tu arthaparatvamiti viśeṣaḥ | tasmādartha evātra saṃjñā saṃjñī ca | na ca navetyakhaṇḍanipātārthasya niṣedhamātrasya saṃjñitvāpattiḥ | "vibhaāṣā dik‌samāse" iti jñāpakāt | anyathā "na bahuvrīhau" ityeva siddheḥ | itiśabdābhāve tu "vibhāṣā śveḥ" ityādau navetiśabda evādeśaḥ syāt | arthasya saṃjñātvād anyatarasyām ityādisthale'pi vakṣyamāṇarītyā vairūpyoddhāraḥ | tathā hi---ubhayatra vibhāṣāyāmevāsyopayogo nānyatra | "vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne" iti prāptavibhāṣāyām "svaritañita" ityādinā nityamātmanepade prāpte pakṣe tannivṛttimātrasya vidheyatvātpakṣe bhavatītyasyānuvādatvāt | "vibhāṣorṇoḥ" iti nityaṅittvābhyupagamāt praurṇavitetyādau tadabhāvāṃśasya sthitatvādbhāvāṃśamātrasya vidheyatvāt | "vibhāṣā śveḥ " ityubhayatra vibhāṣāyāṃ tu vidhimukhena pravṛttau pitsveva vikalpaḥ syāt | kitsu tu yajāditvānnityameva samprasāraṇaṃ syāt | niṣedhamukhena pravṛttau tu kit‌sveva vikalpaḥ syāt, na tu pitsu | tatra prasaktivirahāt | ubhayathā pravṛttau tu vairūpyalakṣaṇo vākyabhedaḥ syāt | saṃjñārambhe tu śrutakramavaśānneti niṣedhasya prathamaṃ kitsu pravṛttiḥ | tataḥ kidakiti sarvasmin liṭi aikarūpyāpanne sati pakṣe bhavatīti vidhimukhenaiva vikalpaḥ pravarttataiti na vairūpyam | ākṛtau padārthe samudāye sakṛllakṣaṇapravṛttyā sūtrametat | vyaktipakṣe tu "vibhāṣā śveḥ" ityādeḥ pratilakṣyaṃ bhinnatvāt kvacidvidhimukhena kvacicca niṣedhamukhena pravṛttiḥ | lakṣaṇabhedena vairūpyābhāvādityanārabhyam | tathā ca vārttikam--- aśiṣyo vā viditatvāditi | atravadanti | ākṛtipakṣe'pi pradeśeṣveva 'na vā śveḥ" ityādi paṭhanīyam | anyathā anyārthamapyārabdhā saṃjñā "vibhāṣorṇoḥ" ityatra pravartteta | pratiṣedhānāṃ ca balīyastvāt | praurṇuvītyatrāpi prathamaṃ ṅittvaniṣedhaḥ, tataśca vikalpaḥ syāt iti | vastutastu | "vibhāṣā" ityeva pradeśeṣu paṭhanīyam | saṃjñāpakṣe'pi prathamaṃ niṣedhastato vikalpaḥ pravarttataityāvṛttilakṣaṇavākyabhedasattvāt | atra bhāṣyakṛtā "gro yaṅi" "aci vibhāṣā" iti vacanamaprāptavibhāṣāsu paṭhitam | tatra pratyavatiṣṭhante---trisaṃśayā ityupakramāt prāpte'prāpte ubhayatra veti saṃśayaviṣayībhūtavibhāṣāṇāmeva vyutpādyatvād atra koṭitrayasyoktisambhavābhāvaḥ | tathā hi--nijegilyataityatra nityaṃ latvam, na tu vibhāṣāprasaktiriti na prāptavibhāṣā'vasaraḥ | na ca yaṅītyanuvartanādyaṅ‌nimittasya rephasyāci pare latvamiti vyākhyānāttatsambhava iti vācyam | nijegir‌ ya ac‌ iti sthite "gro yaṅi" ityasya prāptisamaye acparatvābhāvena vibhāṣāprāptyabhāvāt | na ca vibhāṣārambhasāmarthyāt yaṅ‌lukaḥ pūrvam "gro yaṅi" iti na pravarttataiti kalpyam | tathā'pi ubhayatra vibhāṣātvasya durlabhatvāt | vibhāṣāyā girati gilatītyādau caritārthatayā "gro yaṅi" ityasya yaṅ‌lukaḥ prāgeva pravṛtterubhayorasamānakālīnatvāt | na ca latvasyāsiddhatayā durbalatvāttatpūrvameva lugiti vācyam | antarbhūtayaṅapekṣatvenāntaraṅgalatvaṃ prati bahirbhūtapratyayāpekṣasya luko'siddhatvāt | pūrvābhāvena "pūrvatrā siddham" ityasyāpravṛtteḥ | atrāhuḥ---prāptavibhāṣātvapuktarītyaiva | aprāptavibhāṣātvaṃ tvittham--"antaraṅgānapi" iti nyāyena latvātpūrvaṃ luk | na ca lug‌nimittādacpratyayātpūrvameva latvaṃ syāt, tasya kartṛrūpārthāpekṣatvena bahiraṅgatayā'siddhatvāt pūrvābhāve pūrvatrāsiddhatvasyāpravṛtteriti vācyam | kṛtitugvidhigrahaṇena bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanāt | dharmigrāhakamānena luka iva tadupajīvyānāṃ samāsapratyayādīnāmapi prābalyasiddheśca | nanu tathā'pi nijegir ac ityatra latvaṃ durlabham | yaṅ‌paratvābhāvāt | pratyayalakṣaṇasya ca " na lumatā" iti niṣedhāt | na ca latvasyāṅgādhikārabahirbhāvānna tatpravṛttiriti vācyam | aṅgādhikārabahirbhūtaṃ tadantarbhūtaṃ vā vastugatyā aṅgasya yatkāryaṃ prāpnoti tanna bhavatīti tadarthāt | tat kathamubhayatra vibhāṣāsambhava iti cenna | pṛthagallopāśrayeṇa "acaḥ parasmin" iti sthānivadbhāvasambhavāt | pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthāni vadityasya "tasya doṣaḥ saṃyogādilopalatvaṇatveṣu" iti niṣedhāt | na ca tathā'pi ubhayatra vibhāṣā'nupapattiḥ, "groyaṅi" ityetat prati "aci vibhāṣā" ityasyāsiddhatvāt na vipratiṣedha iti vāghyam | "na mu ne" ityatra netiyogavibhāgāt | yadvā---yoge yogo nāsiddhaḥ, kiṃ tu "prakaraṇe prakaraṇam" ityāśrayaṇāt | samudāyalopapakṣe tu ajapekṣayā'ntaraṅgatvānnityaṃ latvamiti bodhyam | uktisambhavasamarthanamātraṃ caitat | siddhānte tu vibhāṣāyā asiddhatvādeva nityaṃ latvam | iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau prathamādhyāyasya prathame pāde ṣaṣṭhamāhnikam | ig‌ yaṇaḥ saṃprasāraṇam 44 | yaṇaḥ sthāne igbhavatītyevaṃrūpo vākyārtho, yaṇ‌sthānika igrūpo varṇaścetyubhayaṃ samprasāraṇasaṃjñam | "ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam" ityādividhisthale vākyārthasya grahaṇam, "samprasāraṇācca" ityādyanuvādasthaletu varṇasyeti bhedaḥ | itiśabdānuvṛttervākyārthasya saṃjñitvam | tadanārambhe tu vākyasyaiva saṃjñā | na ca tasyaiva vidheyatvāpattiḥ | "vāha ūṭh‌" saṃprasāraṇamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyena tadarthasyaiva vidheyatvāt | "ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam" ityādau ca uktajñāpakasya sāmānyāpekṣatvakalpanāt | na caikavākye vākyasya tadarthasya vā saṃjñā'stu, varṇasya tu kathamiti vācyam | tantrāvṛttyekaśeṣāṇāmanyatamāśrayaṇāt | na ca tatra mānābhāvaḥ | vidheyānuvādyasamarpakavibhaktyā sūtranirddeśasya tathātvāt | taduktam--- vibhaktiviśeṣanirdeśastu jñāpaka ubhayasaṃjñātvasyeti | hariṇā'pyuktam--- saṃprasāraṇasaṃjñāyāṃ liṅgābhyāṃ varṇavākyayoḥ | pravibhāgastathā sūtraekasminneva jāyate || tathā "dvirvacane'ci" iti tantrāvṛttyādilakṣaṇaḥ ekaśeṣeṇa nirdeśo bhāṣya eva samarthitaḥ | tantraṃ dvidhā---śabdatantramarthatantraṃ ca | arthabhedācchabdabhede ādyam | śabdaikye dvitīyam | yadvā---vākyārtha eva saṃjñī, anuvāde tu tannirvartye varṇe lakṣaṇā | atha vā "varṇa eva saṃjñī | vidhipradeśe sūtraśāṭakavad bhāvisaṃjñā''śrayaṇīyā" iti bhāṣyam | atha aduhitarāmityatra lakārasthāne uttamapuruṣasyaikavacanamiṭ‌, tasya yaṇ‌sthānikatvena saṃprasāraṇasaṃjñāyāṃ "halaḥ" iti dīrghāttiḥ | tarapaṃ prati tiṅantasyāṅgatvāt | atrāhuḥ--- yathāsaṃkhyāśrayaṇādyakārasthānikasyaiva ikārasya saṃprasāraṇasaṃjñeti | tathā hi---vākyārthaḥ saṃjñīti pakṣe tasyoddeśyavidheyoḥ saṃsargarūpatayā yathāsaṃkhyaparibhāṣopasthitau yaṇaḥ sthāne ik‌ syādyathāsaṃkhyamityavāntaravākyārthaḥ | sa saṃprasāraṇasaṃjñaḥ syāditi mahāvākyārthaḥ | na cāvāntaravākyārthaṃ gṛhītvā yāti vātītyādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ | tasya saṃjñāsaṃbandhamātre tātparyāt | anyathā "ṣyaṅaḥ saṃprasāraṇam" ityādivaiyarthyāt | aduhītyādestajjatvābhāvācca | ubhayasaṃjñāpakṣe'pi upasthitatvādyathāsaṃkhyapravṛttavarṇasyaiva saṃjñitvāt | idaṃ ca karmakarttari śuddhe karttari vā rūpam | varṇasaṃjñāpakṣe tu na yathāsaṃkhyam | anuvāde paribhāṣā'nupasthānāt | na caivaṃ sthāneyogo'pi na syāditi vācyam | "ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā" ityatrānuvartyāsya vyākhyeyatvāt | taduktam--- siddhaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyadhikāre vacanādati | yadvā---siṃhāvalokitanyāyenātraiva sthānagrahaṇamapakṛṣyatām, saṃprasāraṇasyetyatra tantrādinā tadbhāvitagrahaṇāt | atha vā kāryakālapakṣe yaṇaḥ saṃprasāraṇamigbhavatīti vākyārthānnānuvādatvamiti | yathāsaṃkhyaparibhāṣopasthitau tatpravṛtta eva varṇaḥ saṃjñī, sa eva "saṃprasāraṇasya" ityādāvupatiṣṭhate | atha vā laukikanyāyasiddha eva sthānakrameṇa saṃbandho'nuvāde'pi sulabha iti dyubhyāmityatra "halaḥ" iti dīrgho na | "diva ut‌" iti taparakaraṇāt | evaṃ dyuloka ityatra "saṃprasāraṇasya' iti dīrgho na | na ca dīrghāpravṛttyā caritārthasya taparatvasya "bhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇagrāhakaḥ" ityatra kathaṃ jñāpakatvamiti vācyam | vākyārthaḥ saṃjñīti pakṣeṇa tadukteḥ | "saṃprasāraṇasya" ityatra tadbhāvitagrahaṇādvā | pakṣāntare tu "ṛta ud‌" iti jñāpakam | na cākṣadyuvau akṣadyuva ityādau ūṭhaḥ saṃprasāraṇasaṃjñāyāṃ "saṃprasāraṇācca" iti aukārādeḥ pūrvarūpāpattiḥ | "saṃprasāraṇapūrvatve samānāṅgagrahaṇam " iti vārttikoktoḥ kvinbirūpitāyā aṅgasaṃjñāyā dhātumātre vibhaktinirūpitāyāstu samāsarūpe samudāye viśrāntatvāt | vārṇādāṅgasya balavattvācca | vākyārthaḥ saṃjñīti pakṣe tu pūrvarūpaprasaktereva virahāt | hūto jīna ityādau tu "halaḥ" itisūtrasāmarthyātsaṃprasāraṇanirvṛttasyādeśe'pi dīrghaḥ | varṇaḥ saṃjñīti pakṣe'pi alvidhau sthānivad‌bhāvāsaṃbhavādārambhasāmarthyātsaṃprasāraṇādeśe kāryapravṛttervācyatvāt | ādyantau ṭakitau 45 | ṭitkitau yasya vihitau tasya kramādādyantāvayavau staḥ | bhavitā | pāyayati | na ca "careṣṭaḥ" "gāpoṣṭak‌" "vrīhiśālyorḍhak‌" ityādāvatiprasaṅga iti vācyam | purastādapavādanyāyena sthāneyogāpavādasyāsya "pratyayaḥ" "paraśca" ityanena pareṇa bādhāt | paribhāṣeyam | pareṇa paribhāṣāprakaraṇena sāhacaryāt | yadvā--- saṃjñaiveti bhāṣyam | tathā hi---ṭakitāviti karmadhārayaḥ | itsaṃjñakau ṭakārakakārāvādyantayoḥ saṃjñe staḥ | tena "ārddhadhātukasyeḍ‌ valādeḥ" ityatra ikārādiśabdasyopasthitiḥ | ikārādiriti bahuvrīhau ikāra ādiryasyeti vigrahaḥ | sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣayā tavyasya itavyādeśe siddham | tadāhuḥ--- anāgamakānāṃ sāgamakā ādeśā bhavantīti | evaṃ yāpayatītyatra yā ityasya yāp ityādeśaḥ | na ca "ādyantau ṭakau" ityevāstu saṃjñāyāḥ saṃjñipratyāyakatvamātreṇa svayaṃ kāryānanvayāditi vācyam | "ālajāṭacau" "ṭhasyekaḥ" ityādāvatiprasaṅgāt | itsaṃjñayā tu deśaviśeṣasyopalakṣaṇam | tena itsaṃjñakasya yo deśastatrāvasthitau ṭakārakakārau saṃjñe | āṭacaṣṭakāraḥ ikādeśasya kakāraśca na tatheti na doṣaḥ | na ca aḍāgamasthale bhū ityasya abhū ityādeśaḥ sa codātta ityarthe alo'ntyaṣaribhāṣayā aṅgasya antodāttatvaṃ syāditi vācyam | a ṭ udāttaśca yasyeti tripadabahuvrīhiṇā udāttākārādirabhū ityādeśa iti vyākhyānāt | udāttapadasya viśeṣaṇatve'pi sautraḥ paranipātaḥ | na ca tathā'pi "āḍajādīnām" ityatra doṣaḥ | udāttapadānuvṛttāvapi tena saha śrūyamāṇasyāṭo bahuvrīhyayogāditi vācyam | tatsūtrasya pratyākhyānāt | vakṣyati ca vārtikakṛt--- ajādīnāmaṭā siddhamityādi | midaco'ntyātparaḥ 46 | acāṃ madhye yo'ntyādacaḥ paro mit syāt | sthāneyogasya "paraśca" ityasya cāpavādaḥ | vanāni | yaśāṃsi | "rudhādibhyaḥ śanam" | ruṇaddhi | na ca pūrvavadasya "paraśca" ityetad‌bādhakatvānāpattiḥ | bādhyasāmānyacintāyāṃ svaviṣaye prāptaṃ sarvaṃ bādhyataityabhyupagamāt | anyathā śnamo mittvavaiyarthyāt | "tṛṇahaḥ" iti nirddeśena makārasya śravaṇārthatvānupapatteḥ | aca iti nirddhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī | jātāvekavacanam | na cāca iti pañcamyeva, antyāditi pañcamyantasāmānādhikaraṇyāditi vācyam | "śe mucādīnām" ityādāvantyasyāco'sambhavena etadapravṛttau alo'ntyaparibhāṣāyāḥ pravṛttyāpattyā mittvavaiyarthyāt | evaṃ cāntyādacaḥ paro mitsyāditi prācāṃ vṛttirapyevameva vyākhyeyā | anye tu tatrāca iti astu pañcamyeva | kiṃ tathā sati sarvathaiva num na syāditi vivakṣitam uteṣṭadeśe na syāditi | nādyaḥ | vacanavaiyarthyāt | nāntyaḥ | antyabādhe'pyacaḥ paratvasaṃbhavāt | pradhānabādhāpekṣayā guṇabādhasyaiva kalpayitumucitatvādiṣṭasiddheriti | etena ajaṃśavaikalye'pi pravṛttiḥ syādityapi nirastam | aco viśeṣyatvāttadvaikalye pravṛttyanāpatterityāhuḥ | pūrvasūtre dvandvanirddiṣṭasyāpi antagrahaṇasyātrānuvṛttermit pūrvāntaḥ | abhaktatve tu "tā tā piṇḍānām" ityādau "śeśchandasi bahulam" iti śilope nalopo na syāt | prātipadikāntatvābhāvāt | vahaṃliha ityatra mumo makārasyānusvāro na syāt | apadāntatvāt | ādigrahaṇānuvṛttyā parādiriti vyākhyānetu vāriṇe ityādau "gherṅiti" iti guṇaḥ syāt, vahaṃliha ityanusvāro na syāt | atiśayitaḥ sakhā yeṣāṃ tāni atisakhīni brāhmaṇakulāni | atra "sakhyurasaṃbuddhau" iti ṇittvādvṛddhiḥ syāt | na ca gauṇatvāttadabhāvaḥ | gauṇatve'pi tatpravṛtteḥ | "asthidadhi" ityādivat | evaṃ trapūṇītyādau aṅgasya nāntitvābhāvāt "sarvanāmasthāne ca" iti dīrgho na syāt | tasmātpūrvāntapakṣaḥ sādhuḥ | atra vārtikam--- antyātpūrvo masjeranuṣaṅgasaṃyogādilopārtham | magnaḥ magnavān | "oditaśca" iti niṣṭhānatvaṃ tasyāsiddhatvātkutvam | "masjinaśorjhali" iti num, tasya tdyantyādacaḥ paratve "aniditām" iti anuṣaṅgalopo na syāt | anuṣaṅga iti nakārasyopadhāyāḥ prācāṃ saṃjñā | na ca "skoḥ" iti salope nakārasyopadhātvāllopa iti vācyam | taṃ prati salopasyāsiddhatvāt | bahūnāṃ samavāye samudāyasyaiva saṃyogasaṃjñeti pakṣe sakārasya saṃyogāditvābhāvācca | evaṃ maṅ‌k‌tā maṅ‌ktavyamityādi bodhyam | "bharjimarcyośca" antyātpūrvo midityanuvarttate | bhṛjī bharjane | auṇādike aci kṛte umāgamaḥ | bharujā | marca śabde curādiḥ | auṇādika ipratyayaḥ | īmāgamaḥ | marīciḥ | nipātanāt siddham | uktavārttikapratyākhyānamidam | aṅgulyādiṣu bharujāśabdasya bāhvādiṣu ca marīciśabdasya pāṭhāt | "mṛkaṇibhyāmīciḥ" marīciḥ iti tūpāyāntaram | eca ig‌ hrasvādeśe 47 | ādiśyataityādeśaḥ | hrasvena karmadhārayaḥ | nirddhāraṇe saptamī | jātāvekavacanam | ādiśyamāneṣu hrasveṣu madhye eca igeva syāt | heśabdamatikrāntaṃ atihi kulam | citraguḥ | atiri | atinu | saṃdhyakṣarāntaratamasya hrasvasyābhāve ekadeśasādṛśyena prasaktayorivarṇovarṇayornirāsārthametat | vārttikakārastvāha--- siddhameṅaḥ sasthānatvād, aicoścottarabhūyastvāditi | ayamarthaḥ---śabdaparavipratiṣedhādeṅa uttarabhāgāntaratamau iuvarṇāveva | tathā ca ṣaṣṭhe kaiyaṭaḥ--- vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryamiti nāyaṃ niyamo lakṣaṇayorvipratiṣedhe paraṃ bhavatīti kiṃ tarhi ekalakṣaṇavihitayorapi kāryayorvipratiṣedhe paraśabdaviṣayatvātparaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatītyeṣo'pyartha āśrīyate iti | yadvā---ekāraḥ śuddhatālavya okārastu śuddhauṣṭhyaḥ iti mate siddham | tathā ca bah‌vṛcaprātiśākhyam--- tālavyāvekāracavargāvikāraikārau yakāraḥ śakāra iti, śeṣa oṣṭhopapādya iti ca | pūrvoktabhinno varṇarāśiroṣṭhābhyāmupapādyaḥ | ukāraḥ pavarga odautau upadhmānīyaśca oṣṭhyā iti vṛttikṛt | "śeṣa oṣṭhyo'pavādya" iti tadbhāṣye pāṭhaḥ | uttarasūtre vakṣyamāṇānvihāyetyarthaḥ | spaṣṭārthañcedam | aikṣu samādhānāntaramapyāha vārtikakāraḥ---aicośceti | uttarabhūyastvāccetyanvayaḥ | arddhamātrā avarṇasya sārddhamātrā tvivarṇovarṇayoriti pakṣe mallagrāmādivad bhūyasā vyapadeśādapīkārokārāvādeśau iti prakṛtasūtramanārabhyamiti | samapravibhāgapakṣo'pyaṣṭame sthitaḥ, tatra pūrvoktasamādhānadvayameva | ṣaṣṭhī sthāne yogā 48 | yogo'styasyā ityarśa āditvādac‌ bhūmārthe | anekasambandhaparatayā sambhāvyamāneti yāvat | ayogeti chede tvanirddhāritasambandhaviśeṣā ṣaṣṭhī sthānaprayuktasambandhaparā bodhyā | sthānaṃ prasaṅgaḥ | darbhāṇāṃ sthāne śaraiḥ prastaritavyamitivat | asterbhūḥ samīpo'nantaro veti saṃśaye tatsthāne uccāraṇīya ityarthātsāmīpyādinivṛttiḥ | yogeti kim | "ūdupadhāyā gohaḥ" "śāsa idaṅ‌haloḥ" ityādau mā bhūt | anyathā gohiśāsoḥ sthāne dhātumātrasyopadhāyā ūditau syātām | yadvā---sthāneyogetyekaṃ padam | pūrvapade saptamyā tṛtīyayā vā bahuvrīhiḥ | nipātanādalugetvaṃ vā | na ca gohaḥ śāsa ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ | aniyamaprasaktau niyamārthameva paribhāṣāpravṛtteḥ | upadhāsannidhānena avayavaṣaṣṭhītvanirṇayādākāṅkṣāvirahāt | mārgapraśne vāmadakṣiṇapuraskāreṇa mārgopadeśe'pi mārgadvaidhasthalaeva tadupasthiteḥ | bhāṣyakṛtastvāhuḥ---lakṣyānurodhādantaraṅgatvāt sthānivadādeśa iti jñāpakācca iṣṭasthale sthāneyogatvavyākhyānasambhavānnāyametadvākyārthaḥ, kiṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyantamuccāryyamāṇameva sthānena yujyeta, na tu pratīyamānamityeva | taducyate--- nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti iti | tena "jarāyā jaras" ityādau jarāśabdāntaṃ yadaṅgaṃ tadavayavasya jarāśabdasya jarasādeśo na tu nirityasyāpīti | yattu jarāśabdottaraṣaṣṭhyā svaprakṛtyarthabhūtajarāśabdaniṣṭhameva sthānitvaṃ bodhyate, na tu nirjarādiśabdaniṣṭham | tasya prakṛtyarthatvābhāvāt | na ca tadantaparibhāṣayā so'pi prakṛtyartha iti vācyam | jarāśabdarūpasyāṅgasya sthāne ityarthamupajīvya tatpravṛttyā tadavirodhena avayavadvāraiva nirjarādiśabdānāṃ sthānitvasya bodhyatvāt | ata eva "udoṣṭhyapūrvasya" ityādāvoṣṭhyetyādikaṃ padārthaikadeśe ṛkārādau viśeṣaṇam | ata eva sāgamakasya nādeśaḥ | prakriyādaśāyām 'anāgamakānāṃ sāgamakā ādeśo bhavanti" ityasyānucitatvāt | sthānivadbhāve tu sthānibuddhyaiva kāryapravṛttyā na nirdiśyamānasyetinyāyabādhaḥ | astu vā bhāṣyoktarītyoktasūtraniṣpannā vācanikī "nirddiśyamānasya" iti paribhāṣā | sā ca bahiraṅgapadāṅgādhikāretyādīnāṃ bādhiketi | taccintyam | tadantasya sthānitvabodhane'pi jarārūpasyāṅgasya sthānitvabādhāvaśyakatvād upajīvyavirodhasya durvāratvāt | vārttikamate jarāśabdāntasyaivāṅgasya sthānitvaṃ vyapadeśivadbhāvena kevalajarāśabdasyāpyādeśasiddheriti siddhāntācca | evaṃ nirjarādiśabdāntargatajarāśabdasyāṅgatvābhāve'pi tasya sthānitvāṃśamādāyopajīvyavirodhābhāvasya suvacatvāt | "udoṣṭhya" ityādau tu viśeṣaṇānvayānantarameva tadantavidhiriti siddhāntāt | " alo'ntyasya" "ādeḥ parasya" iti tu dvayamārambhasāmarthyādasya bādhakam | "anekāl śit sarvasya" ityanena saha tvavirodhātsamuccayaḥ | evaṃ ca tantrādinā sphuṭapratipattyarthaṃ prāguktārtho'pi bodhyaḥ | atra vadanti | "iko guṇavṛddhī" itivadayaṃ yogaḥ padopasthāpaka evāstu | iha śāstre anirddhāritasambandhaviśeṣā ṣaṣṭhī sthāneśabdena yujyate | sthāne iti saptamyantaṃ padaṃ tatropatiṣṭhate iti | sthāneyogā'syā iti vigrahaḥ | evam "alo'ntyasya" "ṅicca" ityādāvapi | sthāne'ntaratamaḥ 49 | prasaktānāṃ madhye sadṛśatama ādeśaḥ syāt | yadi tvayaṃ svatantro vidhiḥ syāttadā uttarapadānimittakasyānaṅo'ntaraṅgasaṃyogāntalope karttavye'siddhatvāt nakārarephayoḥ śravaṇaṃ syāditi doṣaeva bhāṣyasya tātparyamityāhuḥ | tanna | saṃyogāntalopasya saṃyogapadobhayasaṃjñāpekṣatvāt | na cottarapadāpekṣāyāṃ padasaṃjñāpekṣatvamānaṅo'pīti vācyam | tasya samāsāvayavamātrasyāpekṣitatvāt | samāsacaramabhāgasyājādau supi kutrāpi padasaṃjñānaṅgīkārāt | kaustubhe'pi tathaiva nirṇī tatvāt | evam udāttādīnāmapi ṛkārāṇāṃ raparatvaṃ syāditi dik | syādetat | khaṭ‌varśya ityādau raparatvaṃ na syāt | ṛmātrasthānikatvābhāvāt | samudāyasyaiva tatra sthānitvenāśrayaṇāt | na ca "ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ" ityanenod‌bhūtāvayavabhedasya samudāyasya nirddeśāt parasparāpekṣayoravayavayoreva samudāyatvādṛkārasthānīyatvamakṣatamiti vācyam | ānaṅo'pi raparatvaprasaṅgāt | avayavasya tatrāpyaṇ‌tvāt | ṛkāratadanyobhayasthānikasyaiva aṇanaṇ‌svarūpasyāpi raparatvasya durvāratvāt | taduktam--- avayavagrahaṇāttaditi cedādeśe rāntapratiṣedha iti | na ca urityṛvarṇagrahaṇāt varṇagrahaṇe tadantagrahaṇād‌ ṛvarṇāntasya sthāne yo'ṇ‌ tasya raparatvaṃ na tvatreti vācyam | karttā ityādau tadasiddheḥ | aṅgasyeti ṣaṣṭhyā antye'li upasaṃhārāt | ṛvarṇasyaiva guṇavidhānāt | tasya ca ṛdantatvābhāvāt | na ca vyapadeśivadbhāvaḥ | arthavattvābhāvāt | tasmādekādeśasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyam | māturityādau "ṛta ud‌" ityasya ca pratiṣedha iti cenna | ekādeśe'vayavayoreva sthānitvāt ṛsthānitvasya sattvāt | ata eva sthānibhedādādeśabhedo mā bhūditi tatraikagrahaṇam | ata eva loke devadattasya putro devadattāyāḥ putra ityubhābhyāṃ vyapadeśaḥ | māturityatra raparatve'pi doṣābhāvāt | "rātsasya" iti salope rephasya visarjanīye ca rūpasiddheḥ | na caivaṃ mātuḥ karotītyatra "idudupadhasya cāpratyayasya" iti ṣatvāpattiḥ | kaskādiṣu bhrātuṣputraśabdapāṭhena ekādeśaśāstraṃ nimittaṃ yasya tataḥ parasya visargasya ṣatvaṃ na bhavatīti jñāpitatvāt | idamapyatrāvadheyam | pūrvasūtrādanta ityanuvṛttau ayaṃ pūrvāntaḥ | ādirityanuvṛttau parādiḥ | ubhayānuvṛttau tvabhakta iti sambhavati | yadyapi rapara ityatrānyapadārthaprādhānyam, tathā'pi vidheyatayā rephasya prādhānyāttasyaivāntatvaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti bodhyam | na ca prasajyamānasyaivāṇo raparatvavidhānāt rephamātrasya kathaṃ pakṣatrayaśaṅketi vācyam | tṛtīyapakṣamāśrityaitadupapatteḥ | tatrāntyaṃ prakṛtya vārttikam--- abhakte dīrghalatvayagabhyastasvarahalādiśeṣavisarjanīyapratiṣedhaḥ pratyayāvyavasthā ceti | gīḥ pūrityatra dīrgho na syāt | dhātoḥ rephāntatvābhāvāt | rephavakārāntasya padasyeti vyākhyāne agniḥ vāyurityādāvatiprasaṅgāt | na ca ऱepavakārāntasya padasyeko dhātorityarthaḥ | priyagrāmaṇiḥ priyasenānirityādāvatiprasaṅgāt | nijegilyataityatra "gro yaṅi" iti latvaṃ na syāt | graityasyāvayavaṣaṣṭhyāntatvāt | na ceyamānantarye ṣaṣṭhī | svarjegilyataityatrāpyāpatteḥ | yadi yaṅā''nantaryaṃ viśeṣyate, yadvā---gra iti pañcamītyucyate, tadā na doṣaḥ | gīryate pūryate svayamevetyatra "acaḥ karttṛyaki" iti svaro na syāt | repheṇa vyavadhānāt | svaravidhau vyañjanamavidyamānavadbhavatītyayamapi na doṣaḥ | etena "mā hi sma te piparuḥ" ityatra " abhyastānāmādiḥ" udāttaḥ syādajādau lasārvadhātuke iti svaro'pi vyākhyātaḥ | vavṛte ityādau halādiḥ śeṣeṇa rephanivṛttirna syāt | abhyāsāvayavasthānāderhalastadvidhānāt | nārkuṭo nārpatya ityādau yasmāt suptiṅ‌vidhistadādisubante ca rephāntasya padatvādvisargaḥ syāt | kirato girata iti ca na syāt | kiratītyekavacane hi nityatvātpūrvaṃ vikaraṇaḥ | āṅgantvanityam, akṛte vikaraṇe guṇasya prāptiḥ, kṛte tvitvasyeti | dvivacane tu dvayorapi nityatvātparatvāditve rephasyābhaktatayā dhātvavayavatvābhāvādvikaraṇo na syāt | dhātoḥ pare tāvataiva tadvidhānāt | na ca vikaraṇātparo rephaḥ | tathā'pi ṛkārasthānikādaṇaḥ paratvānupapatteḥ | na ca paratvaṃ vyavahitasādhāraṇam | iṣṭāsiddhitādavasthyāt | pūrvāditve tu "roḥ supi" ityavadhāraṇaṃ kāryam | roreva supi nānyasya | sarpiḥ ṣu dhanuḥ ṣu ityādau yathā syāt, gīrṣu pūrṣu ityādau mā bhūt | abhaktatve'pyayaṃ doṣaḥ | tadādivacanāt pratyayāvadhikapūrvabhāgasyāpi padāntatvāt | parāditvapakṣe tu subbhaktatvānna padāntatvam, kiṃ tu nārkalpirityatra visargāpattiḥ | taduktaṃ bhāṣye--- kalpipadasaṃghātabhakto'sau notsahate'vayavasya padāntatāṃ bādhitumiti | nṛkalpaśabdādiñi vṛddhiḥ | rephastu pratyayasamudāyasya kalpiśabdasyāvayavo na tu kalpamātrasya | tathā ca kalpaśabde pare vidhīyamānā padasaṃjñā tadādivacanādrephāntasya bhavatīti visargaḥ syāt | padyate'rtho'neneti vyutpattyā bhāṣye padeti pratyayasyokteḥ | kalpaśabde pare vyavasthitasyāpi rephasya tadavayavatvābhāvāttayoḥ paurvāparyasadbhāvādātmana evāvayavabhūtasya padāntatvavighātakatvānupapatteḥ | kalpapadasaṃghāteti pāṭhe tu kalpapadasaṃbandhi yatpadaṃ nārkalpiriti tasya padasya yo'vayavaḥ pratyayasaṃghātaḥ kalpiśabdastadbhakta iti vyākhyeyam | tasmādetadarthamapyuktaniyama ārabhyaḥ | gīryataityatra "acaḥ karttṛyaki" iti svarastu upadeśe'jantatvavyākhyānānnirbādhaḥ | parāditvapakṣe tu doṣānāha vārttikakāraḥ--- parādāvakāralopa autvaṃ puk‌pratiṣedhaḥ caṅ‌yupadāhrasvatvamiṭo'vyavasthā'bhyāsalopo'bhyastatādisvaro dīrghatvaṃ ceti | tathā hi---kartā hartā ityatrāto lopaḥ syāt | na copadeśagrahaṇānuvṛttiḥ | dhinotītyekavacane akāralopābhāve'pi ād‌guṇena yadvā ukārasya guṇe pararūpeṇa siddhāvapi dhinutaḥ kṛṇuta ityanupapatteḥ | ārddhadhātukopadeśe yadakārāntamityarthe tu na doṣaḥ | cakāra jahāretyatra ṇala autvaṃ syāt | "nirddiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti" ityayaṃ na doṣaḥ | na ca "ādeḥ parasya" iti vacanādrephasya autvāpattiḥ | ṇala ityanena prayogasamavāyyakāravyaktiviśeṣasya ākārāntādaṅgātparasyādeśapravṛtteḥ | sarephasya tvanumīyamānasya nādeśaḥ | bhāṣye tu pratyāyyapratyāyakayorabhedavivakṣayā ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasyetyuktatvāt akāramātrasya ca repheṇa vyavadhānāt | yadi tu pratyayasyeti liṭīti vocyeta tadā syādāpattiḥ | kārayatītyatra ādantatvātpuk syāt | acīkaradityatra "ṇau caṅ‌yupadhāyāḥ" iti hrasvo na syāt | rephasya parāditvādākārasyopadhāsaṃjñā'nupapatteḥ | āstaritetyādau nityatvād‌ guṇe raparatve ca kṛte "neḍvaśi kṛti" itīṭo niṣedhaḥ syāt, iṭ‌pravṛttau vā rephātpūrvamiṭ‌ syāt iti iṣṭavyavasthādaurlabhyam | ubhayorapi parāditvāt | vavṛte ityādau halādiḥ śeṣo na syāt | abhyāsānavayavatvāt | "mā hi sma te piparuḥ" ityatra lasārvadhātukasya uso rephāditve'jāditvābhāvādabhyastādyudāttatvaṃ na syāt | prakartā prakarttumityādau " tādau ca niti" iti svaro na syāt | upadeśe takārādau kṛtīti vyākhyānādayaṃ na doṣaḥ | gīḥ pūrityādau antaraṅgatvādvalopaitve raparatve subādyavayavo repha iti svīkāre "rātsasya" iti salope kṛte tasyāsiddhatvāddīrgho na syāt | tasmātpūrvāntapakṣa eva sthitaḥ | "roḥ supi" iti niyamasyārabdhatayā'nāpādyatvāt | alo'ntyasya 51 | śthānaṣaṣṭhīnirddiṣṭaṃ yaducyate tat tadantyasyālo bodhyam | tyadādīnāmaḥ | saḥ | yaḥ | "ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā" iti sūtrasyānuvṛttyā sthānaṣaṣṭhīlābhaḥ | nanvala iti prathamābahuvacanāntaṃ vyākhyāya ādeśaviśeṣaṇamal‌grahaṇamastu, tathā ca alātmaka ādeśo'ntyasya bhavatītyarthād "anekāl‌śit sarvasya" iti sūtre'nekāl‌grahaṇaṃ na karttavyamiti lāghavam | maivam | antyaviśeṣaṇamalgrahaṇamiti pakṣe'pi ṅicca ṅidevānekālantyasya bhavati, na tvaṅiditi niyamamāśritya tatpratyākhyānasaṃbhavāt | virajīkarotītyādau "arurmanaścakṣuścetorahorajasām" iti paramānaḍudbhyāmityatra sarvasyāpyanuḍucchabdasya syāt | anekālgrahaṇaṃ ca pakṣadvaye'pyāvaśyakam | anyathā "ato bhisaḥ" iti pañcamīnirddeśe'nekālapyādeśaḥ "ādeḥ parasya" iti vacanādādereva syāt | na ca "ādeḥ parasya" ityatrāla iti prathamāntamanuvartya parasya vihito'l‌ ādeḥ syāditi vyākhyāya aisi doṣo nivāryaḥ, tasyānaltvāditi vācyam | bahorbhāvo bhūmetyatra imanica ikārasya lopānupapatteḥ | tatsattve ca apavādapratiṣedhena paratvātsarvādeśasiddheḥ | ayaṃ cātrārthaḥ---sthāneyogatvena nirṇītā yā ṣaṣṭhī sā'nena antye'li anusaṃhriyate | yadvā---niścito ya ādeśaḥ so'ntyasyālaḥ sthāne iti | ṣaṣṭhīmātrasyānusaṃhāre ṭitkinmitāmapyantyāvayavatvaprasaṅgāt | tataśca "ārddhadhātukasya" iti vihita iṭ‌ tṛca ṛkārātpūrvam, dāpayatīti puk ca ākārāntyāvayavaḥ syāt | tataśca "arthavato hyāgama" sthāneyogatvameva bādhyeta | tulyajātīyatayā saṃbandhasyaiva bādhyatvāt | ṣaṣṭhīsvarūpaṃ tu antye'li vyavasthitameveti | anusaṃhārastu "ādeḥ parasya" "anekālśit sarvasya" ityanusaṃhārāntareṇa caritārthasyāsya tātaṅi paratvād "anekāl‌śit sarvasya" ityanena bādhāt | na cotsargāpavādayoḥ kathaṃ vipratiṣedha iti vācyam | guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthatvena ṅittvopapattyā tatraitasya pravṛttyanavadhāraṇāt | na ca sarvādeśatvaṃ vinā pratyayatvābhāvāt guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthatvameva durlabham, tathā cānyonyāśraya iti vācyam | "eruḥ" ityanantaraṃ tādityādeśe karttavye ṅitkaraṇasya guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthatvanirṇayāt | ādeḥ parasya 53 | pañcamīnirdeśena yadvihitaṃ tadāderalo bodhyam | īdāsaḥ | "tasmādityuttarasya" ityupatiṣṭhate | tena ākārasyekāraḥ | āsīnaḥ | dvirgatā | anuvāde parabhāṣā'nupasthāne'pi sthāne ityasyānuvṛttyā'nyatra phalābhāvādvā tallābhāt | tathā ca pañcamīnirddeśena yatkāryaṃ taduttarasya sambandhi uttarasya sthāne vidhīyamānamāderbodhyamityubhayaikavākyatayā'rthaḥ | vākyabhedasāmarthyācca "gāṅ‌kuṭādibhyaḥ" ityādau dvitīyāṃśavaikalye'pi prathamavākyārthamātrasya pravṛttiḥ | na ca vākyabhede mānābhāvaḥ | "uttarasyādeḥ" ityasamāsanirddeśasya mānatvāt | anyathā uttarāderityevāvakṣyat | na caivam prathamāṃśavikalasya dvitīyāṃśasyāpi svātantryeṇa pravṛttyāpattau "nityaṃ ṅitaḥ" ityatra sakārāntasya ṅiduttamasya lopaḥ syāditi vidhāne bhaveva bhavema bhūyāsva bhūyāsmetyādau uttamapuruṣekāravakārāderlopaḥ syāt, na tu alo'ntyaparibhāṣayā'ntyasya sakārasyeti vācyam | dvitīyavākyārthabodhakāle pratamavākyārthabodhasyotpattyā tattyāge mānābhāvena prathamāṃśavikalasya pravṛttyanupapatteḥ | pratyāsattyā pūrvavākyaprāpitasyaivādeśasya grahaṇācca | tathā ca "tasmādityuttarasya" iti sūtraeva āderiti padamadhikaṃ pāṭhyam | "ādeḥ parasya" iti ca tyājyamityarthaḥ | na ca "anekāl‌śit sarvasya" iti sūtrātpūrvamevoktanyāso'stviti vācyam | nirdiṣṭagrahaṇānuvṛttyanāpatteḥ | uktarītyā tu " tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya" iti sūtrāttadanuvṛttiriti vaiṣamyam | na ca tasyāpyatraivāpakarṣo'stviti vācyam | tathā'pi "ṅicca" ityādisāhacaryeṇa saptamīpañcamīnirdeśe ṣaṣṭhīnirddiṣṭayoḥ pūrvaparayoḥ bādhaḥ syāt, paratvāt | tataśca brāhmaṇā aṣṭāvityatra aṣṭan‌śabdāt pūrvayorjaśśasorauśādeśāpattiriti vadanti | apare tu nedaṃ yuktam | jaśśasbhyāmākṣiptaprakṛteraṅgasya ca saṃnidhānādaṣṭannityasyaiva
