maivam | anabhidhānāt iha cānaśeva nāstīti | yadvā---ādyudāttatvameveṣṭam | "yathottaraṃ munīnāṃ prāmāṇyam" iti svīkārāt | uktabhaddiprayogādvāśabdo dhātvantarbhūta iti mate tu tasyādyudāttaviṣayakatayā spaṣṭameva caritārthatvam | na hi cānaśi ādyudāttatvaṃ labhyate | paryudāsasya vikaraṇaprayuktasvaramātraviṣayakatvamiti "ātmamāne khaśca" itisūtrasthabhāṣyakaiyaṭasiddhatvāt | khaśantaiva cānaśante'pyantodāttatvasya durlabhatvāt | yattvatra sūtre kaiyaṭenoktam---dāyamāna iti cānaśi pravṛterādyudāttārthaṃ nittvamiti, tad abhyuccayamātram | tasmānniyamārthaṃ śittvaṃ pittvanivṛttyarthamiti kathaṃ tasyāpavāde utsargakṛtaṃ neti jñāpakatvamiti pūrvapakṣaḥ | atra kaiyaṭaḥ---lakṣyānurodhātsāmānyāpekṣajñāpakameva śittvamāśrīyate, na tu niyamārthamiti | yadvā---kāpavādasya ṭakaḥ kittvamukte'rthe pramāṇam | analvidāviti kim | tena tasmāttasyata smiṃśca vidhau mā bhūt | alā vidhau yathā---mahoraskena | sakārasya sthānivadbhāvena visarjanīyasyāṭ‌sūpadeśāṇṇatvaṃ syāt | alaḥ parasya vidhau yathā---dyauḥ panthāḥ saḥ | aut āt akāraścetyeteṣāṃ hal‌sthānīyatvena "halṅyāb‌" iti sulopaḥ syāt | alo vidhau yathā---dyukāmaḥ | "diva ud‌" iti lopaḥ syāt | na cotvavidhānasāmarthyam | aharvimaladyu ityāhau val‌paratvābhāve caritārthatvāt | ali parato vidhau yathā---ka iṣṭaḥ | ikārasya sthānivadbhāvena sorhaś‌paratvāt "haśi ca" ityutvaṃ syāt | sa ityatra tvakārasya sthānivattve halparatvātsorlopaḥ syāt | uktānekasamāsalābhārthaṃ ca vidhigrahaṇam | na cānal ityevocyatāṃ sādhutvārthaṃ prathamāprayoge'pi tadarthasyāvivakṣitatvāt | yadvā---ala ityucyatām | anuvādatayā sthāneyogābhāvātṣaṣṭhyāḥ sambandhasāmānyārthakatayā uktavibhaktyarthopasaṃgrahasiddheriti vācyam | aprādhānyena alāśrayaṇe sthānivattvaniṣedhārthaṃ vidhipadopādānāt | tena pradīvyetyādau valāderityārddhadhātukānyapadārthaviśeṣaṇatayā'lāśrayaṇe'pi na sthānivattvam | anyathā "haśi ca" ityādau prādhānyena yatrālupāttastatraiva tanniṣedhāt | vidhigrahaṇe tvalāśrayo vidhiral‌vidhiriti uttarapadalopāśrayaṇāt viśeṣyatayā viśeṣaṇatayā vā'lāśraye niṣedhapravṛttiḥ | āśrīyataityāśrayaḥ, erac | "alamāśrayate" iti bhāṣyaṃ tvarthapradarśanārthaṃ, karmaṇyaṇaḥ prasaṅgāt | alāśrayaparatvādāśrayaśabdasya gatārthatvādaprayoga eva lopa iti kaiyacaḥ | nanvevaṃ sthānyanubandhakāryāṇāmapi niṣedhāpattyā pradīvyetyādau kittvaṃ na labhyeteti cenmaivam | anekāntatvapakṣe teṣāṃ sthānyaltvābhāvāt | ekāntatvapakṣe'pi pūrvameva lopāt | "na lyapi" iti liṅgācca | anyat prāguktam | syādetat | tasthānāpannastaddharmaṃ labhataiti nyāye naiva gatārthatvādidaṃ sūtramanārabhyam | ata eva nīvāreṣu vrīhidharmā avaghātādayaḥ pravartante | maivam | vrīhīnavahantītyādau vrīhyādipadānāmapūrvasādhane lākṣaṇikatayā tadapūrvasādhanatvānnīvārādau tatpravṛttāvapi "āṅo yamahanaḥ" ityātmanepadasya hantisvarūpamātraviṣayakatayā vadhādeśe pravṛttyayogāt | "svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya" iti paribhāṣitatvāt | anyathā ātṛṇeḍhītyādāvapi prasaṅgāt | syādetat | astu jñāpakādeva gatārthaṃ sūtram | "yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe" ityatrānādeśagrahaṇenādeśaḥ sthānivadityasya "ado jagdhiḥ" iti sūtre kitītyanenaiva siddhe lyab‌grahaṇena cānalbidhāvityaṃśasya jñāpayituṃ śakyatvāt | ata eva viśeṣaṇatayā'pyalāśrayaṇe na sthānivadityasyāpi siddhiriti | satyam | uttarasūtre sthānivadādeśa ityasyāvaśyakatayā yogavibhāgena tadārambhaḥ, arthāpattyanusāre gauravāt | analvidhāvityapi spaṣṭārtham, uttarasūtre dvitīyavidhigrahaṇānuvṛttyarthaṃ ca | phalasya tatraiva vakṣyamāṇatvāt | syādetat | nimittaśāstravyapadeśarūpatādātmyakāryāṇyatideśabhedāḥ syuḥ | pūrvavatkarmavadādivat‌tṛjvat‌parāṅgavad‌ṇidvaditi kramātvaṭ‌ | "pūrvavatsanaḥ" iti nimittātideśaḥ | yadyapi brāhmaṇāderagrabhojananimittasya brāhmaṇatvādeḥ kṣatriyādāvatideśo'śakyaḥ, tathā'pi "pūrvavat" iti prakṛtigaṃta ṅittvaṃ hi na sannante'tidiśyate, kiṃ tu prakṛtigatameva san‌vyavadhāne'pyātmanepadaṃ pravarttayatītyetāvatā nimittātideśavyavahāraḥ | na cāyaṃ kāryātideśa eveti vācyam | cikraṃsate pracikraṃsate ityādāviṭ‌prasaṅgāt | nimittātideśe tu kramireva sanā vyavahito'pyātmanepadaprayojaka iti "snukramoranātmanepadanimitte" iti niyamānneṭ | phalopahitanimittasyaiva tatra grāhyatvāt | śāstrātideśaḥ "karmavatkarmaṇā" ityatra pākṣikaḥ | vyapadeśa "ādyantavad" iti | ekasminnāditvāntatvaprakārakavyavahāre'tidiṣṭe tattatsūtraireva kāryasiddheḥ | tathā ca prāñcaḥ---ādyantavadvyapadeśo, nimittam "pūrvavatsana" iti | rūpātideśastṛjvat iti | kroṣṭuśabdasthāne kroṣṭṛśabdasya vidhānāt | tādātmyātideśaḥ "subāmantrite parāṅgavatsvare" iti | "yatte divo duhitarmartabhojanam' ityatra divoduhitariti samudāye āmantritanighātapravṛtteḥ | kāryātideśo "goto ṇit" ityādi | tadevaṃ ṣoḍhā'tideśe kāryātideśo'yamityatra kiṃ niyāmakamiti | maivam | "siddhantvātmanepadena samānapadasthasyeṭ‌pratiṣedhād" itivārttikarītyā pūrvavadityayamapi kāryātideśaḥ | kramerātmanepadasya ca samānapadasthalauktaniyamapravṛttiḥ | ātmanepadaṃ tu prakraṃsyataityādau "propābhyāṃ samarthābhyām" ityanena pracikraṃsataityādau "pūrvavatsanaḥ" ityanena iti viśeṣe'pyekapadasthatvasya tulyatvāduktaniyamapravṛtteḥ | ādyantavadityayamapi tathā | haradattādisvārasyāt | kurute kurve ityādau "ādyantavyapadeśe'pi antyo'c‌ ādiryasyeti bahuvrīhyarthasyābhāvāt ṭisaṃjñāvirahe etvānupapatteḥ | kurvātityādisthalīyasya ṭeretvākhyakāryasyātideśādeva tatreṣṭasiddheḥ | śāstrātideśo'pi pākṣika eva | tādātmyātideśastu ādeśena sthānino'pahārād bādhitaḥ | tādātmyapratiyoginoḥ samānakāla eva tatpravṛtteḥ | rūpātideśe tvādeśavidhivaiyarthyam | vikalpasya pūrvoktarītyā'sambhavāt | tasmātprādhānyātkāryātideśa evāyamiti sthitam | nyāsakārastu vyapadeśātideśaḥ saṃjñāpakṣe paryavasannaḥ | sa ca vatkaraṇasāmarthyādeva netyāha | atra haradattaḥ--- "saṃjñāpakṣe vadherevātmanepadaṃ syānna tu hanteḥ | śabdasaṃjñātvāt "svaṃ rūpam" ityasyāpravṛtteḥ | evaṃ kena kasmādityādāvaṅgakāryādīni na syāriti doṣadvayam | vyapadeśātideśe tu " svaṃ rūpam" iti hantigrahaṇam, tadvyapadeśātideśācca vadherapi | evaṃ sthāniniṣṭhānāṃ dhātvaṅgādivyapadeśānāṃ kādyādeśe'tideśāttatkāryasiddhiriti vaiṣamyāt na tathā' iti | atra vārtikāni--- tasya doṣaḥ---tayādeśaubhayapratiṣedhaḥ | jātyāravyāyāṃ vacanādeśasthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ | ṅyāb‌grahaṇe'dīrghaḥ | āhibhuvorīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ vadhyādeśe vṛddhitatvapratiṣedhaḥ iḍ‌vidhiśca | ākārāntānnuk‌ṣuk‌pratiṣedhaḥ | loḍādeśaśābhāvajabhāvadhitvahilopaitvapratiṣedhaḥ | trayādeśe srantasya pratiṣedhaḥ | ām‌vidhau ca svare vasvādeśe pratiṣedhaḥ | goḥ pūrvatvaṇittvātvasvareṣu | karotipibatyoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | tasya sthaānivadādeśa iti lakṣaṇasya | tatra prathamavārtike yadvaktavyaṃ tatsarvādisūtraevoktam | dvitīyamapi vyartham | na ca vrīhibhya ityatraikavacanasthāne bahuvacanādeśavidhānātsthānivadbhāvāt "gherṅiti" iti guṇāpattiḥ | arthātideśasyaiva tatroktatvāt | tṛtīyasya tvayamarthaḥ---niṣkauśāṃviḥ atikhaṭ‌va ityatra ṅyāb‌grahaṇātsulopaḥ prāpto niṣedhyaḥ syāt | tasmānṅī ī ā āp‌ iti praśliṣya dīrgheti pratyākhyeyam | atikhaṭ‌venetyādāvapi nātiprasaṅgaḥ | āpo grahaṇe sarvatrākārapraśleṣāt | na caivamapyatikhaṭ‌vāyetyatra yāṭaḥ prasaṅgaḥ | svāśrayasyātvasya sthānivadbhāvena cāptvasya sattvāditi vācyam | ābantaṃ yadaṅgaṃ tataḥ parasya yāḍiti vyākhyānāt | pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa vihitastadādereva grahaṇāt | upasarjanastrīpratyaye tadādiniyamasattvāt | atikhaṭ‌vetyetatsamudāyasya ābantatvābhāvāt | khaṭ‌vāityasyāṅgatvābhāvāt | atikhaṭ‌vaśabdādeva tatra subutpatteḥ | tathā cāṅgatvābantatvayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvānna doṣa iti siddham | ata evātikārīṣagandhyāputra ityādau samprasāraṇaṃ na | halṅyādisūtre tu vihitaviśeṣaṇāśrayaṇe setyādāvavyāptiḥ | yaḥ sa ityādāvativyāptiśceti na praśleṣavaiyarthyam | vārtikamate'pi "yāḍāpaḥ" ityādāvākārapraśleṣāvaśyakatvāt | anyathā'tikhaṭ‌vāyetyādāvaṅgādhikākārātsamādhāne'pi jarasā nase pṛte ityādau doṣasya durvāratvāt | sutāmicchansutīrityādau sulopāpatteśca | yadvā---ākāramapi praśliṣya tatsāmarthyānmadhye hrasvatāmāpannasya vāraṇamiti bodhyam | caturthavārtikamapi vyartham | na cātthetyatrā''hādeśasya sthānivadbhāvena "bruva īṭ‌" abhūdityatra astyādeśabhuvaḥ "astisico'pṛkte" itīṭ‌ ca syāditi vācyam | "āhasthaḥ" iti jhali pare thatvavidhānājjñāpakāt | na ca īṭi kṛte'pi bhūtapūrvagatyā jhalāditvāt thādeśa iti vācyam | āthādeśasyaiva vidhānāpatterlāghavāt | tibādyādeśānāṃ ṇalādīnāmapi bhūtapūrvagatyā jhalāditvāt tatrāpi thādeśasya durvāratvāt | dvitīyadoṣasyāpi "astisico'pṛkte" ityatra dvisakārakanirddeśena sakārāntādevāsteḥ parasyāpṛktasārvadhātukasya īḍāgamavidhānamiti vāraṇāt | syādetat | as‌ityanantaraṃ sakārapraśleṣe dhātutvābhāvāttib‌ na syāditi mādhavoktadoṣāpattiḥ | dhātvantaḥ pātinā sāreṇa sico'nvayānarhatayā sijnimittakasya īṭaḥ prasaṅgaśca | na caivāmasteḥ sakārāntatvena viśeṣaṇavaiyarthyam | tathā'pi svatantre bhavatau doṣasya tāvadasthyāt | etena sicca as ca sicas samāhāradvandve sautraḥ pañcamīlopaḥ | bhatvānna kutvajatve | asti vidyamānaṃ ca ta tsicas ceti karmadhārayaḥ | tena luptātsico bhūbhāvenāpahṛtādasteśca parasya neti kalpanaṃ pratyuktam | rūpasiddhāvapi bhāṣyokteranirvāhāt | ata eva sico'lpāc‌katvādbahuviṣayatayā'bhyarhitatvācca pūrvanipātapāptāvapi tadakaraṇaṃ tantrādinā vidyamānasica ityarthalābhārtham | tiprayogasvārasyācca | anyathā sicasbhyāmityeva brūyāt | na cāstayasyatyoratiprasaṅgaḥ | vikaraṇavyavadhānena tābhyāṃ parasyāpṛktasārvadhātukasyāsaṃbhavāditi mādhavoktamapyapāstam | atra vadanti | astisicas‌s iticchedaḥ | sāntādasteḥ na tu kṛtabhūbhāvāt sāntātsicaḥ śrūyamāṇāditi yāvat | na caivaṃ "sico'pṛkte" iti saṃhitānupapattiḥ | dvitīyasya saṃyogāntalopāt saṃyogāntaṃ yatpadantasyeti pakṣe tadabhāve'pi saṃyogāntasya padāntasyeti pakṣe saulabhyāt | tasyāpyākarārūḍhatvāt | na ca tasyāsiddhatvādrorutvānāpattiḥ | "saṃyogāntalopo rorutve" iti siddhakāṇḍe pāṭhāt | etannirddeśasyaiva ca tadvārttikārthe mūlatvāt | yadvā---mā'stu saṃyogāntalopaḥ dvayoreva sakārayo rutve kṛte "ato roḥ' ityanena dvayorapyeka eva ukāraḥ, paśvekatvavadvidheyaviśeṣaṇasyaikatvasya vivakṣitatvāt | na cokāradvaye'pi savarṇadīrghānantaramād‌guṇo vyākhyeya iti vācyam | ekapadāśrayatvenāntaraṅgatvāt sica u ityatra guṇasyaiva savarṇadīrghaṃ bādhitvā prasaṅgāt | na ca sakāradvayasyāpyeka eva rurbhavatviti vācyam | tadvidhau padasyetyanuvṛtterekapadāntatvābhāvāt | dvitīyasakārasya pṛthak‌padatvāt | na ca pūrvarukārātparo nākāro dvitīyāttu na pūrva iti kasyāpyutvaṃ na syāditi vācyam | roriti jātinirdeśopagamāt | tatra coktanirddeśasyaiva mānatvāt | na ca paratvād‌ "haśi ca" iti pūrvasyaiva utvāpattiḥ | rutvasyāsiddhatayā paratvābhāvāt | na cāśrayātsiddhatvam | sthānyaṃśe tathātve'pi nimittāṃśe tadabhāvāt | takārabhinnasyāpi haśaḥ sambhavenānyathā'nupapattyabhāvāditi | atredaṃ vaktavyam---dvitīyaḥ sakāraḥ prathamāntaḥ pañcamyanto vā nirvibhaktiko vā | nādyaḥ | sica iti pañcamyantaviśeṣaṇatvānupapatteḥ | na dvitīyaḥ | chāndasatvāpatteḥ | nāntyaḥ | padatvābhāve rutvānupapatteḥ | etena saṃyogāntalopo'pi nirastaḥ | evaṃ sicaḥ sakārāntatvena viśeṣaṇamapi vyartham | "astisico'pṛkte" iti dvisakārako nirdeśaḥ | asteḥ sakārāntāditi bhāṣyakārairastereva tadviśeṣaṇasyoktatvāt | vārtike'pi bhvādeśasyaiva īṭ‌prasaktipratiṣedhayoruktatvāt | śtipaḥ pūrvaṃ sakārapraśleṣaeva bhāṣyatātparyāt | śtipaḥ sautratvādupapatteḥ | na caivaṃ sicaḥ paratvamāśritya īḍāgamāpattiḥ | "gātisthā' iti sūtre bahulagrahaṇamanuvartya tasya evakārasamānārthatvaṃ cāśritya sico lugeva bhavati iti vyākhyānāt sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhopapatteḥ | etena pūrvoktarītyā sicas iti samāhāre tadupari s iti chedamāśritya astigrahaṇapratyākhyānaparatayā'pīdaṃ bhāṣyaṃ yojayituṃ śakyamityapi parāstam | bhatvapañcamīlopayorubhayatra chāndasatvakalpane gauravācca | etena jātinirddeśe idameva pramāṇamiti nirastam | tādṛśanirdeśaeva mānābhāvāt | varṇagrahaṇe jātigrahaṇamityasya tu nāyaṃ viṣayaḥ | roḥ iti samudāyāśrayaṇād | dvayorutvamapyanupapannam | rutvasyāsiddhatvāt | na cāśrayātsiddhatvam | eka eva yatra rustatra caritārthatvāt | utvasya siddhatvaṃ vinā tadanuvādenotvavidhivaiyarthyāpattereva siddhatvakalpanāt | dvitīyāṃśe'siddhatvabādhe pramāṇavirahāt | yadvā---śtipaṃ vinaiva sūtraṃ pāṭhyamiti bhāṣyābhiprāyaḥ | "assico'pṛkte" iti tatraiva sakārāntaraṃ vyākhyeyam | asteḥ sakārāntāditi bhāṣyaṃ tu as ityaṃśavyākhyāparam | asatyādāvatiprasaṅgasya mādhavoktarītyā nirastatvāt | bhāṣyasya samādhānopalakṣaṇatāmātratve tu as iti luptapañcamīkaṃ sti iti apṛktaviśeṣaṇam | asaḥ sicaśca parasya sakāratakarāderapṛktasārvadhātukasya īṭ‌ syāt | ābhyāṃ parasyāpṛktasārvadhātukasya sakāratakāratvarūpaniyamāt viśeṣaṇānupayoge yena rūpeṇātra nirddeśastadrūpāvachinnāpekṣayā paratvalābhāya tat | tena sthānivadbhāvavyāvṛttirita dik | pañcamasya tvayamarthaḥ | "hano ṇbulbahulaṃ taṇi" iti vārttikena saṃjñāchandasorvadhādeśaḥ | tasya halantatvād‌ "ata upadhāyāḥ" iti vṛddhiḥ | "hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ" iti takārādeśaśca syāt, tayoḥ sthānivadbhāvo niṣedhyaḥ | āvadhiṣīṣṭetyatra sthānivadbhāvenāṅgatayā "ekāca upadeśe'nudāttād‌" itīṇniṣedhaśca syāt | atra sthānivadbhāvenāṅgasaṃjñā na bhavatīti vaktavyam | idamapi bhāṣye pratyākhyātam---avadhīdityatra "ato halādeḥ" iti vṛddhiprasaṅgādvadhādeśasyādantatvasvīkārāt | vadhaka iti tu "hano vadhaśca" ityauṇādikaḥ kvun | tathā ca vṛddhitatvayorna prasaṅgo ṇittvābhāvāt | iṭo niṣedho'pi nāsti | vadhādeśaādyudāttanipātanasāmarthyāprakṛtisvarāpravṛtteḥ | na ca yadā vadhiṣīṣṭetyatra "nipātairyadyapi" iti nighātapratiṣedhāt iṣṭaḥ pratyayasvaro na syāt, satiśiṣṭenādyudāttena bādhāpatteriti vācyam | ārddhadhātukīyāḥ sāmānyena bhavantīti pratyayotpatteḥ pūrvameva vadhādeśāt taduttaraṃ pratyayotpattyā tatsvarasyaiva satiśiṣṭatvāt | atredamavadheyam | vārttikarītyā "ārddhadhātuke" ityasya viṣayasaptamītve'pi liṅītyādīnāṃ parasaptamītvābhyupagamāt syasicsūtre "vadhabhāvātsīyuṭi ciṇvadbhāvo vipratiṣedhena " ityuktam | ubhayorapi paranimittakatvāt | bhāṣyamate tu vadhādeśasya pratyayotpatteḥ pūrvameva pravṛttyā paranimittakatvābhāvāt antaraṅgatvāt ciṇvadbhāvasya tu paranimittakatayā bahiraṅgatvādantaraṅgabahiraṅgayośca vipratiṣedhāyogātkathañciṇ‌vadbhāva iti śaṅkāyāṃ pratipadavidhitvācciṇvadbhāva iti kaiyaṭaḥ | syādetat | pratipadavidhitvaṃ kimanavakāśatvam uta sākṣādupāttatvam | nādyaḥ | syasicsūtre hanagrahaṇasya ghāniṣyataityādau sīyuṭo grahaṇasya tu kāriṣīṣṭetyādau sāvakāśatvāt | na ca syādīnāṃ caturṇām ajantādibhiścaturbhiranvayātsvaritatvābhāvena ca yathāsaṃkhyavirahāt pratyekaṃ syādibhiranvayāddhanaḥ sīyuṭi ciṇvad‌bhāvavidhānam | tanniravakāśameva | antaraṅgatvādvadhabhāve tasya sthānivadbhāvena hantinā grahaṇātsīyuṭi ciṇvadiṭi kṛte "ṇyallopau" iti pūrvavipratiṣedhena ato lope vadhiṣīṣṭetyeva rūpāpatteriti vācyam | antaraṅgatvātpūrvaṃ vadhabhāvapravṛttau hanaḥ sīyuḍanvayaeva mānābhāvāt | nāntyaḥ | "hano vadha liṅi" iti sākṣādupādānasya vadhādeśe'pyaviśiṣṭatvāt | antaraṅgatvasyādhikyācca | atrāhuḥ---"ciṇvadiṭ‌ ca" iti cakāreṇa hanteḥ sīyuṭi ciṇvadbhāvavidhānāttasyānarthakyameva pratipadavidhitvam | na ca tasyānuktasamuccayārthatve mānābhāvaḥ | bhāṣyakṛtaiva ca bhagavān kṛtavāṃstu tadarthamityuktatvāt | yadvā---liṅīti sāmānyaṃ sīyuṭīti viśeṣaḥ | hanterityubhayatrāpyaviśiṣṭam | tathā cāpavādatvādeva ciṇvadiṭa asaṃbhave cakāreṇāpi tadvidhānasyāśakyatvāt | yadvā---asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamityanena "antaraṅgaṃ balavat" ityetapratyākhyānasya vakṣyamāṇatvāttasya ca kṛtituggrahaṇenānityatvajñāpanāt lakṣyānurodheneha tyāgād yukto vipratiṣedhaḥ | atha vā liṅīti parasaptamyevāstu | paratvācciṇvadiṭ | ādyudāttanipātanaṃ tu mā'stu | na ca karttetyādivadvadhiṣīṣṭetyatra iḍanāpattiḥ | hantyupadeśe ekāctve'pi vadhyupadeśe'nekāc‌tvāt | vadherdvāvupadeśāviti bhāṣyaevoktatvāt | eketi viśeṣaṇasyānekāv‌kopadeśavyāvṛttyarthatvāt | na cāca ityukte tadantasyaiva syāditi vācyam | pacādīnāmanudāttetvavaiyarthyāpatteḥ | ekatvavivakṣāmatvarthalakṣaṇābhyāmaca ityetāvataiva ekājvato lābhe ekagrahaṇasyoktārthaparatvāt | uktārthaparatayā'pi "yatraikāj‌grahaṇaṃ caiva" iti paribhāṣāpravṛttisiddheḥ | na caikapadasyoktarītyā sārthakye "śtipā śāpā" ityādiparibhāṣājñāpakatvānupapattiḥ | śīṅ‌dīṅādīnāṃ guṇayuḍāvidhāvanubandhanirdeśasyaiva tajjñāpakatvāt | tasmādvayeḥ parasya iṭ‌ siddhaḥ | ata eva vyāghrabhūtinā'niṭ‌kārikāsu adantaparyudāsaḥ kṛta iti | yattu prasādakṛtā ghāniṣīṣṭetyeva rūpaṃ na tu vadhidhiṣīṣṭetyapi | taduktaṃ bhāṣye--- athedānīṃ ciṇvadbhāve kṛte punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānādvadhabhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavati sakṛdgatau vipratiṣedhe yadbādhitaṃ tadbādhitameveti, haniṇiṅādeśapratiṣedhaśceti | tanna | ciṇvad‌bhāvapakṣe vadhādeśavirahe'pi tadabhāvapakṣe vadhādeśapravṛttau bādhakābhāvāt | haniṇiṅādeśaniṣedhasya tu syādiṣu ciṇvadityatideśena yatprāptaṃ tatparatvāt | liṅiprāptasya tadaviṣayatvāt | ata evāṅgakāryāṇāmevātideśamāśritya tad‌ bhāṣye pratyākhyātam | pramādakāreṇāpi prathamaṃ tathaivānūditamiti | ata eva "ekāca" iti sūtre vadhiṣīṣṭeti rūpaṃ bhāṣyaevodāhṛtam | ākārāntādityādipañca vārtikānyapi anārabhyāṇi | tathā hi---vilāpayati bhāpayati ityatra nuk‌ṣukau lī ī bhī ī itīkārapraśleṣādeva na bhavataḥ | śiṣṭāt hatāt bhintāt kurutāt stāt ityatra paratvāttātaṅi kṛte "śāhau" "hanterjaḥ" "hujhalbhyo herdhiḥ" "utaśca pratyayādasaṃyogapūrvāt" "ghvasoreddhau" iti śābhāvo jabhāvo dhitvaṃ hilopa etvaṃ ceti sthānivadbhāvena prasaktāḥ, sakṛdgatāviti nyāyānna | etena puṣṇītādityatra "halaḥ śnaḥ śānaj‌" ityasyāpyapravṛttirvyākhyātā | tisṛbhāve kṛte "trestrayaḥ" ityapinādeśaḥ | uktanyāyāt | etena catasrastiṣṭhantītyatra catasṛbhāve kṛte "caturanaḍuhoḥ" ityāmneti vyākhyātam | viduṣaḥ paśyetyatra vasvādeśasya śatṛgrahaṇena grahaṇāt "śaturanumo nadyajādī" iti sūtreṇāntodāttātparatvamupajīvya vibhakternodāttatvam | "anuma" ityatra "tanādikṛñbhya uḥ" ityukārādārabhya numo makāraparyantamumpratyāhāramāśritya tadrahitasyeti vyākhyānāt | vasośca tatrāntarbhāvāt | na caivaṃ lunatā punatetyādāvapi na syāt, śnāpratyayasyāpi tadantargatatvāditi vācyam | anum‌grahaṇaṃ śaturviśeṣaṇaṃ na tu tadantasyetyāśrayaṇāt | śatari pare śnāpravṛttāvapi tasya śatṛprakṛtikatvābhāvāt | numityāgamagrahaṇe'pi tadrahitasya śataryeva viśeṣaṇatvāt | tadantaviśeṣaṇatve muñcatītyādāvapi niṣedhāpatteḥ | tadantasya "śe mucādīnām" iti sanumkatvāt | apatyavārttikasya tvayamarthaḥ---citragvagramityatra "sarvatra vibhāṣā goḥ" iti pūrvarūpaṃ syāt | "nāntaḥ pādam" iti pāṭhasya bhāṣyārūḍhatayā sarvatreti sūtrasyāpi pūrvarūpavidhāyakatvaucityāt | kaiyaṭastu prakṛtibhāvo'nena vidhīyate, na pūrvarūpam | tasmād‌ "eṅaḥ padāntādati" iti pūrvarūpaṃ prāpnotīti bhāṣyārtha ityāha | śākalasūtre hrasvaśceti cakāreṇa prakṛtyetyanukṛṣyataiti bhāṣyadarśanāt "prakṛtyā'ntaḥ pādam" iti pāṭha iti tasyāśayaḥ | eṅa iti tatra varttate iti bhāṣyasyāpyatrānuguṇyam | pūrvamataṃ tu sarvatretyatra tadanuvṛttiparatayā neyam | na caiṅa ityalāśrayaṇānna sthānivattvamiti vācyam | he citrago agramityatra tathā'pi durvāratvāt | svata eṅantatayā sthānyalo'nāśrayaṇāt | evaṃ citragurityatra "goto ṇit" iti ṇittvādvṛddhiḥ syāt | citragūnityatra "ā goto'mśasoḥ" iti ṣāṣṭhavārttikapāṭhādātvaṃ syāt | atra ṇittvagrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṇ | taparatvenaiva tayorapravṛtteḥ | "auto'mśasoḥ" iti pāṭhasyaiva sthitatvāt | na ca acinavamityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ | śasā sāhacaryātsupa evāmo grahaṇāt | bahugumānityatra "hrasvanuḍ‌bhyāṃ matup" ityudāttasya "na gośvantsāvavarṇa" iti niṣedhaḥ syāt | tataḥ goḥ pūrvasvarayoriti vārtikaṃ sthitam | bahugunā ityādau "antodāttāduttarapadādanyatarasyām" iti prāptasya "na gośvan" iti niṣedhaḥ iti vṛttigrahanthastu bhāṣyādivirodhāccintyaḥ | dvādaśavārtikamapyanārabhyam | na ca kurupibetyādau sthānivattvāllaghūpadhaguṇāpattiḥ | karotau taparanirdeśādakārasya mātrikattvādukāra eva nyāyya iti taparatvasya śāstrāntaraprāptadvimātranivṛttyarthatvāt pibeścādantatvāt | acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau 56 | paranimittako'ca ādeśaḥ sthānivatsyāt tasmātpūrvatvena dṛṣṭasya dṛṣṭād vā nimittāt vidhau karttavye | alvidhyarthamidam | vavraśca | uradatvasya sthānivadbhāvād "na saṃprasāraṇe" iti vakārasya saṃprasāraṇaniṣedhaḥ | uradatvasyāṅgādhikārīyatayā'ṅgākṣipte pratyape pare tadvidhānāt | na ca prāgabhyāsavikārebhyo'ṅgādhikāra iti vācyam | āsaptamasamāpterityasya siddhāntitatvāt | "guṇo yaṅ‌lukoḥ" ityatra lugagrahaṇasya kṛtatvāt | atra sthānibhūtādaca ṛkārātpūrvatvena dṛṣṭasya vakārasya saṃprasāraṇe karttavye sthānivadbhāvaḥ | evamacitīkaḥ sucitīkaḥ bahucitīka ityatra "citeḥ kapi" iti dīrghaḥ | "hrasvānte'ntyātpūrvam" iti sthānyalāśrayaḥ svaraḥ siddhaḥ | svaravidhau sthānivad‌bhāvaniṣedhasya lopājādeśamātraviṣayakatvāt | akhaṭvako bahukhaṭvaka ityādau "āpo'nyatarasyām" iti hrasvasya sthānivadbhāvānnoktaḥ svaraḥ kiṃ tu "kapi pūrvam" ityuttarapadāntodāttatvamevetyavadheyam | tasmādvidhau yathā---tanvanti tanvate | yaṇādeśasya sthānivadbhāvānneṭ | anyathā ukārasyārddhadhātukatayā yaṇi kṛte valāditvāt sa syāt | tannityaṃ tatra nimittaṃ taccokārātpūrvam | aca iti kim | viśnaḥ dyūtvā syūtvā abhigatya ādyayośchakārasya śakāraḥ | tasya paranimittakatvātsthānivad‌bhāve "che ca" iti tuk mā bhūt | nanvantaraṅgatvātpūrvameva tukā bhāvyam | "vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīya" ityasya yugapatprāptike samānāśrayaeva pravṛtteḥ | karoterṇali kṛ a iti sthite "aco ñṇiti" iti vṛddheḥ gaurityādau sāvakāśatvāttadbādhitvā'ntaraṅgatvātprāptasya yaṇo bādhena vṛddhereva pravṛttiḥ | praśna ityatra tu śatvasya pratyayotpattyanantaraṃ tukastu prāgeveti prāptikāle vaiṣamyāt | śasya naṅ‌ nimittam, tukastu cha iti samānāśrayatvābhāvācca | atrāyaṃ prācāmabhiprāyaḥ | "abhyāsasyāsavarṇe" ityatrāsavarṇagrahaṇaṃ tāvadasya jñāpakamiti ṣaṣṭhe prathamāhnikānte bhāṣye spaṣṭam | tathā hi---īyatuḥ ūṣaturityatrātiprasaṅgavāraṇaṃ na tadarthaḥ | antaraṅgabalavattayaiva gatatvāt | savarṇadīrghasyāvayavamātrāpekṣatvāt | iyaṅuvaṅorabhyāsasaṃjñā'ṅgasaṃjñā cetyubhayāpekṣatvāt | na ceyaṅuvaṅostadapavādatvam | yenanāprāptinyāyena yaṇaṃ pratyeva tayorapavādatvāt | nanu icchatyetibhyāṃ ṇali iṣ a i a ityatra guṇavṛddhyoḥ satyoḥ "dvirvacane'ci" iti rūpātideśād‌ ikāre dvitvapravṛttiḥ | tatra savarṇadīrghaprāptāvapyetadārambhāttannirūpitāpavādatvaṃ durvāram | ninyaturityādyanurodhena pūrvapravṛttakāryasya dvitvānantaramavasthānaniyamasya vaktumaśakyatvāt | anyathā pūrvamiyaṅ‌pravṛttyā dvitvānantaram "eranekācaḥ" iti yaṇ‌ na syāt | maivam | kṛte'pyasavarṇagrahaṇe tasya nirviṣayakatvāpatteḥ | na ca tatsāmarthyātsavarṇadīrghaṃ bādhitvā punarguṇavṛddhipravṛttiḥ | iyartītyādau cāritārthyāt | na ca asavarṇagrahaṇābhāve'pi yenanāprāptinyāyena iyartītyatra yaṇ‌bādhe siddhe tadanupādānāpattiḥ | sāmarthyāt iyeṣetyādau guṇādipravṛttisvīkāre'savarṇagrahaṇavaiyarthyatādavasthyāt | "artteśca" ityeva sūtrayitvā yvorityanuvartya artterikārasya iyaṅi vidheye "abhyāsasya" ityuktisāmarthyenāpi iyeṣetyādisiddheḥ | na cārtteriti pāṭhe ariyarti iti yaṅ‌luki tadasiddhiḥ | urityeva vācyatvāt | iṇ‌sāhacaryāddhātugrahaṇasiddheḥ | ṛkārasyāṅgena viśeṣaṇādvā | tena attragnirityādau na doṣaḥ | na caivamiyeṣetyādivadīṣaturityādāvapi iyaṅāpattiḥ | savarṇadīrghasyāntaraṅgatvāt | iyeṣetyatra tu guṇasaṃbhāvanayā akṛtavyūhaparibhāṣayā dīrghāpravṛtteḥ | etena ninyaturityādau iyaṅāderapravṛttirapi vyākhyātā | tatra ca jñāpakaṃ "samarthānāṃ prathamādvā" iti sūtre samarthagrahaṇam | taddhi sautthitirvaikṣamāṇirityādau bhāvinyā ādivṛddhyā antaraṅgasyāpi savarṇadīrghasya nimittavighātādapravṛttiḥ syāditi sāvutthitirvāyīkṣamāṇirityaniṣṭarūpavāraṇārtham | kṛtasandhikāryatvarūpaṃ pariniṣṭhitatvaṃ ca tatra samarthaśabdārthaḥ | nimittaṃ vināśonmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatprayuktaṃ kāryaṃ na kurvantīti tatparibhāṣā'rthaḥ | kṛtamapi nivarttayantītyasya jñāpyatve tu phalasāmye'pi gauravādhikyaṃ bodhyam | tasmādiyeṣetyādau guṇe kṛte savarṇadīrghānavakāśādyaṇi prāpte tasyaiva iyaṅapavādaḥ ityasavarṇagrahaṇavaiyarthye prasakte tatra guṇāpravṛttyupapādakatvena vārṇaādāṅgasya balavattvasya jñāpakatayā tatsārthakyam | na ca guṇasya sthānivad‌bhāvād "asavarṇe" iti nimittasyāvighātātkatham akṛtavyūhanyāyapravṛttiḥ syāditi vācyam | "na padānta" iti savarṇavidhau tanniṣedhāt | tatratyasavarṇādigrahaṇapratyākhyānapakṣe tu pūrvasyaiva vidhau sthānivadbhāvo na tu svapūrvaikādeśavidhāviti vakṣyamāṇatvātsavarṇadīrghanimittavighāto bodhyaḥ | tasmātsamānāśraye yugapatprāptau coktaparibhāṣājñāpanāttādṛśaviśeṣaviṣayakatvamapyāsthīyate | lakṣyānurodhāt | syādetat | samānāśrayetyatra kāryiṇoraikyaṃ vivakṣitam, nimittayorvā | nādyaḥ | syona ityatra si ū na iti sthite ikārasyaiva guṇayaṇoḥ prāptyā samānāśrayatvasattvāt tadabhāvānnoktaparibhāṣāpravṛttiriti kaiyaṭādigranthavirodhaāt | āhva ityatra āhu ā a iti sthite ālopapūrvatvayorapyākāroddeśyakatvena vyāśrayatvāttadapravṛttikathanavirodhācca | na dvitīyaḥ | i i atus ityatra savarṇadīrghasya ikāro nimittam, yaṇastu pratyayākāra iti samānāśrayatvānupapatteḥ | śvanśabdasya bhatve saṃprasāraṇe ca śu an as ityatra allopasya bhanimittatvātpūrvatvasya ca tadabhāvācca | tathā hi---siverbādulakādauṇādike napratyaye guṇo valopa ūṭh‌ ca prāpnoti | tatrāpavādatvādvalopaṃ bādhitvā ūṭh‌ | na caivamapi guṇabādhe vinigamakābhāvaḥ | guṇasyāṅgasambandhinīṃ laghvīmiglakṣaṇāmupadhāmārddhadhātukaṃ cāpekṣamāṇasya bahiraṅgatvāt | ūṭhastu vakārāntamaṅgamanunāsikādiṃ ca pratyayamapekṣamāṇasyāntaraṅgatvāt | si ū na iti sthite laghūpadhaguṇayaṇoḥ prāptau varṇāmātrāpekṣatvenāntaraṅgatvādyaṇ‌ | tataḥ "sārvadhātukārddhadhātukayoḥ" iti ūkārasya guṇa iti syonetyasya siddhiḥ | evaṃ "kavidhau sarvatra saṃprasāraṇibhyo ḍa" ityuktvā''hvaḥ prahva ityudāhṛtya kapratyayena siddhimāśaṅkya kapratyayasaṃprasāraṇayoruvaṅi kṛte āhuvaiti syāt | na ca ālopasya sthānivadbhāvānnovaṅ‌ | pūrvatve kṛte tatprāpteḥ | paratvādākāralopa eva syādityuktvā antaraṅgatvātpūrvatvamityāśaṅkya "vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīya" ityākāralopa ityuttkā evaṃ tarhīdamiha sapradhāryam ākāralopaḥ kriyatāṃ saṃprasāraṇamityuttkā paratvādāto lopaḥ | tataḥ saṃprasāraṇe yaṇādeśe āhvaḥ prahva ityādi siddham, iti bhāṣyam | evaṃ tarhītyādibhāṣyasyāvataraṇikāyām "vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīya ityasya" samānāśrayaevāṅgīkārādālopapūrvatvayośca bhinnāśrayatvāttadapravṛttiriti kaiyaṭaḥ | tadanantaraṃ ca pūrvatvasyāntaraṅgatvamiti bhāṣyavyākhyāyāṃ "vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīya" ityetattu samānāśrayaviṣayamevetyuktamiti tenoktam | evam aśabdādācārakvibantālliṭi a a atus ityatrā'tolopasya vyāśrayatvāt "ato guṇe" iti pararūpameveti manoramādivirodhaḥ | tathā hi---"upeyivān" iti sūtre iṇo dvirvacane'bhyāsadīrghatve ca kṛte iyādeśo nipātyataityuttkā "dīrgha iṇa" iti dīrgheṇa bādhādekādeśo na syādityāśaṅkya dīrghatvaṃ naikādeśabādhakam, kiṃ tu "iṇo yaṇ" iti vidhīyamāno yaṇ‌ | sa ca svaprāptāveva bādhako'tra tu yaṇaḥ prāptyabhāvādekādeśa evetyuktaṃ bhāṣye | tatra kaiyaṭena īyaturityatrābhyāsadīrghatve ekādeśātpūrvam "vārṇādāṅgam" iti yaṇi kṛte sthānivattvādekādeśaḥ prāpnotītyuktatvenābhyāsadīrghatvamekādeśabādhakaṃ syādityāśaṅkya sthānivadbhāvena rūpānatideśāt rūpāśrayasyaikādeśasya yakāre'bhāvaḥ | "vārṇādāṅgam" iti yaṇādeśena bādhitasyaikādeśasya sthānivadbhāve kṛte prāptyabhāva iti vyākhyātam | i i atus ityasyāmavasthāyāṃ yathā iṇo yaṇaādeśa ekādeśasya bādhakaḥ tathā sthānivadbhāvānantaramapyekādeśaprāptāviti tadarthaḥ | tathā "saṃprasāraṇācca" iti sūtre "aṭo vṛddheriyaṅ‌" iti vārttike'dhyaiyātāmityatra "vṛddhirantaraṅgā" iti bhāṣyavyākhyāyāṃ "vārṇādāṅgaṃ balavad" ityanāśrityedamucyataiti kaiyaṭavirodhaḥ | evam "ādeca" iti sūtre āyādeśe alo'ntyasyātve glānīyamityādisiddhiriti pakṣe vivaraṇaprastāve glai atusityatrāyādeśe yakārasya ātve glā ā atusityatra ekādeśa ātolopaśca prāptaḥ | tatraikādeśasya varṇāśrayatvādantaraṅgatve'pi "vārṇādāṅgam" ityāto lopaḥ | tasyābhīyatvenāsiddhatvā tsthānivadbhāvācca pūrvasyātolopo na syāditi doṣamupanyasya "vārṇādāṅgam" ityanāśrityedamuktamiti kaiyaṭo'pyasaṅgataḥ syāt | syādetat | ekaniṣṭhakāraṇatānirūpitaikavarṇaniṣṭhoddeśyatānirūpitobhayavidheyatākatvaṃ tat | yathā kṛ aityādau | uktaṃ ca kausktabhe---yatra hyekameva nimittīkṛtya yugapadāṅgavārṇayoḥ prāptistatraiva "vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīya" iti vicch‌na ityatra tuk‌śatvayoḥ chakāranakārarūpanimittabhedasya spaṣṭatvāt | ataḥ syona ityādau na doṣaḥ | tatra guṇasyārddhadhātukaṃ nimittaṃ yaṇastvajiti kāraṇabhedāt | āhva ityādāvapi ālopapūrvatvayorekoddeśyakatve'pi lopasya ajādiṅkidārddhadhātukaṃ nimittaṃ pūrvatvasya tu neti nimittaikyābhāvāt | śuna ityatrāpi na doṣaḥ | saṃprasāraṇasya bhasaṃjñānimittakatvāt | saṃprasāraṇanibandhanapūrvatvasyāpi bhasaṃjñānimittakatve bādhakābhāvāt | prayojakasādhāraṇasyaiva nimittatāyā vivakṣitatvāt | vastutastu śuna ityatra pūrvatvameveṣṭaṃ vipratiṣedhasūtrīyākaragranthaprāmāṇyāt | allope udāttanivṛttisvarādyāpattiriti tatra nirūpayiṣyamāṇatvāt | allopaparāsiddhavatsūtrasalthakaiyaṭādigranthasya prauḍhimātratvāt | tena dyavatītyatrāpi nātivyāptiḥ | yaṇguṇayorekoddeśyakatve'pi ūkārasārvadhātukarūpanimittabhedāt | maivam | īyaturityatra tadabhāvāt | savarṇadīrghe prathama ikāra uddeśyo yaṇi tu dvitīya iti kāryibhedāt | na ca "ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ" iti dvitīya ikāro'pi savarṇadīrghe kāryīti vācyam | tathā'pi yaṇi atuso'kāro nimittam, savarṇadīrghe tu abhyāsottara ikāra iti bhedāt | nanu sthānedvirvacanapakṣe'tuso'kārasyāpi dvitvanimittatvāt | cakraturityatra yaṇaḥ sthānivadbhāvārthaṃ sākṣaādvā samudāyaghaṭakatayā vā dvitvaprayojakasyaiva dvitvanimittatvasvīkārāt | lakṣyānurodhādihāpi tathāśrayaṇe bādhakābhāvāt | tathā ca akārasya dvitīyekāraprayojakatayā savarṇadīrghanimittatvamapyasti | yaṇ‌nimittatvaṃ tu tasya spaṣṭameveti cet | maivam | syona ityatra yaṇ‌nimitte ūkāre tasya nimittatayā guṇe'pyārddhadhātukatayā tasya nimitattvāt | āhva ityatra saṃprasāraṇaṃ pūrvatve nimittam, tatra ca kittvamiti kidārdhadhātukanimittakamātolopaṃ pratyapi tasya nimittatayā samānāśrayatvāpatteśca | na caikanimittetyasyaikadharmāvacchinnaniṣṭhanimittatvamarthaḥ | īyaturityatra savarṇadīrghayaṇ‌nimittayorikārākārayorac‌tvarūpaikadharmāvacchinnatvāditi vācyam | viśna ityatra śatvatugāgamanimittayornakāracchakārayorapi iltvarūpaikadharmāvacchinnatvāt | kiṃ ca pūrvoktarītyā yaṇ‌savarṇadīrghayoḥ sthānaikyasaṃpādane "ijādeśca" iti sūtre ṛ ṛ atusa ityatra savarṇadīrghayaṇoḥ prāptau paratvātsavarṇadīrghe ṛ atusiti sthite ekādeśasyāntādivadbhāve ṛkārasya dhātugrahaṇenopādāne "ṛcchatyṝtām" iti guṇe raparatve ca araturiti, abhyāsatvena grahe tu "urat" iti atve raparatve halādiḥ śeṣa "ata ādeḥ" iti dīrghe āto lope'turiti rūpaṃ syāditi bhāṣyakārāśaṅkāyām ṛ ṛ atusityavavasthāyāmāṅgatvāduradatvameva syādityāśaṅkya "vārṇādāṅgam" ityetatsamānāśrayaviṣayakaṃ varṇadvayāśrayaṃ tu savarṇadīrghatvamiti bhinnāśrayatvamiti kaiyaṭavirodhaḥ | api ca "ekāco dve" ityanena prathamasya "ajādeḥ" iti ca dvitīyasya dvirvacanaṃ virodhābhāvātsamuccīyataiti pakṣe dvitīyadvirvacanasyānarthakyam | tathā hi---aṭeḥ sani iṭi ca aṭisa iti sthite---prathamadvirvacanam | aṭ‌ aṭ‌ halādiśeṣeṇa ṭakāranivṛttau dvitīyadvirvacanam, halādiśeṣaḥ | a a aṭ‌ iti trayāṇāmakārāṇāṃ dvayorakārayorvā pararūpe viśeṣābhāvaḥ | tatra halādiśeṣātpūrvameva dvitīyaṃ dvirvacanaṃ syādityāśaṅkya kaiyaṭenoktam--- nityatvātpūrvaṃ halādiḥ śeṣaḥ | kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt | dvitīyadvirvacanaṃ tu śabdāntaraprāptyā'nityam | taddhi kṛte halādiśeṣe'ṭaḥ prāpnoti akṛte tu ṭaśabdasya | antaraṅgatvācca "ato guṇe" iti pararūpaṃ "sanyataḥ" itītvasya bādhakam | "sanyata" itītvaṃ hi sanamabhyāsaṃ cāpekṣamāṇaṃ bahiraṅgam | "prāgabhyāsavikārebhyo'ṅgādhikāra" iti pakṣe itvamāṅgaṃ na bhavati iti | vārṇādāṅgaṃ balavat ityapi nāsti satyapi vā itvasyāṅgatvenānāśrayatvādāṅgavārṇayoratra paribhāṣā'nupasthānamitiuktarītyā ca sano dvitvanimittatayā dvitīyākārasampādanadvārā pūrvākārapararūpe nimittatvamastīti itvapararūpayorekanimittakatvaṃ syāditi dik | atrocyate | samānanimittaprayuktatvameva samānāśrayatvamiha vivakṣitam | sanabhyāsāśrayatvāditvasya pararūpasya varṇamātrāpekṣatvācca bhinnāśrayatvamiti kaiyaṭokteḥ | na caivam īyaturityatra abhyāsottarasya īkārasya dīrghayaṇau prati sthānitvena samānāśrayatvamityādigranthaviśeṣalekhanamasaṅgataṃ syāditi vācyam | tathā satyakārasyaiva pararūpamitvaṃ ca prati sthānitvātsamānaśrayatvāpatteḥ | na coktasthale'tivyāptiparihāraḥ kathamiti vācyam | vivakṣitasya tatra sattvāt | tathā hi---aṅgakāryapratiyogikoddeśyatvādhikaraṇaṃ sat yadvārṇakāryanimittatvādhikaraṇaṃ tadaparyāptavārṇakāryoddeśyatākatvam | uddeśyatvaparyāptyadhikaraṇaikye sati ekadharmiparyāptatvaṃ cetyanyataravannimittatākatvaṃ tad | vyāśrayatvenodāhṛteṣu āṅgakāryoddeśyatvādhikaraṇasya vārṇakāryanimittatvādhikaraṇatvābhāvānnātivyāptiḥ | vicch‌na ityatrāṅgakāryaśatvoddeśyasya chakārasya vārṇakārye tukinimittatvāt ativyāptiriti tadaparyāptavārṇakāryoddeśyatvaniveśaḥ | i i atus ityatra āṅgakāryānuddeśyasya dvitīyasya ikārasya vārṇakārye savarṇadīrghe nimittatvāttaduddeśyatvāccāvyāptivāraṇāyāvṛttitvamapahāya aparyāptatvaniveśaḥ | pūrvaparobhayaparyāptatvānna doṣaḥ | āṅgakāryanimittatvavārṇakāryoddeśyatvayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyasya samānāśrayatvenodāhṛteṣvabhāvādasambhavavāraṇāya āṅgakāryoddeśyatvavārṇakāryanimittatvayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ niveśitam | āṅgakāryapratiyogikoddeśyatvādhikaraṇaṃ yattadaparyāptavārṇakāryoddeśyatākatvamityukte yadyapi si ū naḥ pṛcchatī tyādau cātivyāptiḥ | guṇoddeśye ikāre ūkāre ca yaṇtukoruddeśya tāyāḥ paryāpteḥ, tathā'pi ṛ ṛ atus aṭiṭiṣatītyatra uradattvaṃ "sanyata" itītvaṃ cetyubhayarūpāṅgakāryapratiyogikoddeśyatvādhikaraṇayorabhyāsaṛkārākārayoḥ savarṇadīrgharūpavārṇakāryapratiyogikoddeśyatvaparyāptyadhikaraṇatvābhāvādativyāptiḥ syādataḥ varṇakāryanimittatvādhikaraṇetyuktam | tayostu na vārṇakāryanimittatvam | dvitīyayoreva tathātvāt | tathā cāṅgakāryoddeśyatvasamānādhikaraṇaṃ yadvārṇakāryanimittatvādhikaraṇaṃ tasyāprasiddhatvāttatra na doṣaḥ | dvitīyayorāṅgakāryānuddeśyatvādādyayośca vārṇakāryaṃ pratyanimittattāvāt | vārṇakāryanimittatvādhikaraṇaṃ yad‌ tadaparyāptavārṇakāryoddeśyatākatvamityukteḥ tatraivātivyāptiḥ | dvitīyayoḥ savarṇadīrghoddeśyatvaparyāptyadhiraṇatvāt | tannimittatvācca | evaṃ pṛcchatītyādau tathā tuko nimittasya chakārasya tuguddeśyatvābhāvāt hrasvasyaiva tathātvāt | ata āṅgakāryapratiyogikoddeśyatvādhikaraṇaṃ sadityuktam | uktasthale tvāṅgakāryaṃ prati teṣāmanuddeśyatvānna doṣaḥ | kṛ a ityatrāvyāptivāraṇāya uddeśyatvaparyāptītyādi | tatra ṛkāramātre yaṇ‌vṛd‌dhyubhayoddeśyatvasyākāramātre tadubhayanimittatvasya paryāptyā nātivyāptiḥ ityeṣā dik | atra vadanti | uktaparibhāṣāyāssamānāśrayamātraviṣayakatvamākarānurodhādvā kalpyate dharmigrāhakapramāṇabalādvā | nādyaḥ | "ajādeḥ" iti sūtre pūrvapakṣe iyaṭiṣatītirūpārthaṃ kaiyaṭena sāmānyena "vārṇādāṅgaṃ balavat" ityāśrīyate, na tu samānāśrayāṅgavārṇaviṣayamevetītvameva pravartate na pararūpamiti ityabhihitatvāt | nāntyaḥ | asavarṇagrahaṇasārthakyānyathā'nupapatteḥ vārṇādāṅgasya balavattvajñāpanamātreṇopakṣīṇatayā sāmānāśrayamātraviṣayakatvaparyantaṃ tadasāmarthyāt | vidheyadvayasyaikoddeśyakatvarūpasamānāśrayatvasyaiva tadviṣayatayā yathoktasamānāśrayatvāsiddheśca | kiṃ caivaṃ sautthitirityādau samānāśraye jñāpitatvādakṛtavyūhaparibhāṣāyā api tadviṣayaeva pravṛttiḥ syāt | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ | seduṣīmityādau tadapravṛttiprasaṅgāt | na ca tatra samānāśrayatvaṃ nāstīti vācyam | samānaśrayatvena 'vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīya" iti vṛddhiprasaṅgāditi kaiyaṭenoktatvāt | etena yugapatprāptisthalamātraviṣayakatvamasyā ityapi nirastam | vṛddheḥ pratyayanimittakatayā pūrvaṃ prāptyabhāvāt | kiñca viśvavāh‌ as ityatra samprasāraṇaṃ bahiraṅgaṃ guṇe kārye'siddhamiti yasyāntaraṅgaṃ kāryaṃ prasajyate tasyaiva bahiraṅgasyāsiddhatvaṃ syāt | tataścākṣadyūrityādau bahiraṅgasyāpyūṭho yaṇ‌prāptyabhāvādasiddhatvaṃ na prāpnotīti "nājānantarye" iti tanniṣedho bhāṣyakārerupanyasto'narthakaḥ syāt | adhītya pretyetyatra bahiraṅgasyaikādeśasyāsiddhatvapratiyoginaḥ tuk‌prasaktyabhāvādevāsiddhaparibhāṣāpravṛttivirahe "ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ" ityatra tuggrahaṇena "nājānantarye" iti paribhāṣājñāpanasyāpyanupapatteśca | na caivaṃ yathoddeśapakṣavilayāpattiḥ, jñāpakasamānadeśatvasyānupapattyaviṣayatayā tadasiddheriti vācyam | lakṣyānurodhena tatkalpanāt | anyathā jñāpakasamānadeśatvaniyame tavāpi kāryikālapakṣavilayāpatteḥ | vyāśraye'pyetatpravṛttau "yajayācca" ityatra naṅo ṅitkaraṇaṃ jñāpakamiti sīradevādibhiruktatvācca | anyathā tuko'ntaraṅgatvātpravṛttau laghūpadhatvābhāvādeva guṇaprasaktyabhāvāttanniṣedhārthaṅittvasya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ | cyavante plavantaityādau guṇe kṛte ekādeśa iti nyāsakārokteśca | suna ityatrāllopasya kaiyaṭenoktatvācca | na ca tatra samānāśrayatvameva, āṅgakārye'llope uddeśyasya akārasyaiva vārṇakārye "saṃprasāraṇācca" iti pūrvarūpe nimittatvāt saṃprasāraṇādaci pare pūrvarūpamekādeśaḥ syāditi vyākhyānāt tadaparyāptoddeśyatākatvasya ca sattvāditi vācyam | tatra nimittatāvacchedakadharmānavacchinnatvenāpyuddeśyatāyā viśeṣaṇīyatvāt | uktapūrvarūpe cāc‌tvasyaiva nimittatvoddeśyatvobhayāvacchedakatvāt | anyathā āhva ityādau ālopapūrvatvayorvyāśrayatvābhidhānasyāsaṅgatyāpatteḥ | nanvevaṃ viśra ityatra vyāśrayasyāpi śādeśasya siddhau pūrvoktavyāśrayeṣu doṣāpattiriti cet, satyam | "vārṇādāṅgam" ityasya anityatvāt na tatra pravṛttiḥ | tatra ca mānam "cch‌voḥ" iti satukkanirdeśaḥ | na cāca ityasyānupādāne sthānivattvena tuko niṣedhārthaṃ tadati vācyam | aca ityasyānyārthamāvaśyakatvāt | na ca tatra mānābhāvaḥ | ṣāṣṭhabhāṣyasyaiva tathātvāt | anyathā āṅgatvāt śatve kṛte tuk‌prasaktyabhāvāttadasaṅgatyāpatteḥ | tena pūrvoktavyāśrayeṣu na doṣaḥ | na ca satukkanirdeśasya prakṛtaparibhāṣāyāḥ samānāśrayamātraviṣayakatvajñāpakatvamevāstu iti vācyam | viṣayaviśeṣāvacchedena saṅkoce gauravāt | niruktasamānāśrayatvasya gurutvācca | nanvatra tuk‌prasaktireva nāsti, "akṛtavyūha" iti nyāyāt | maivam | tasyāpyanityatve satukkanirddeśasya mānatvāt | evaṃ ca naṅo ṅittvaṃ guṇaniṣedhārtameva | sīradevādyuktistu yathāśrutārthābhiprāyā | etena naṅo ṅittvamevākṛtavyūhaparibhāṣājñāpakam | "samarthānām" iti tu mā'stu | "samarthasūtraṃ karttavyam, kriyate ca samarthānāṃ prathamādvā" iti bhāṣyasvārasyādityapi vyākhyātam | atha "rāllopaḥ" ityatrāpi satukkasyānuvṛttyāpattau hūḥ hurau ityādau vitukkasya chasya lopo na syāt | na cānuvṛttisāmarthyācchuddhaśakārasyaiva tatropādānam, rephottaracchakārasya tugabhāvanaiyatyāditi vācyam | vakāramātrānuvṛtteḥ sambhavāt chakārasyānuvṛttāveva mānābhāvāt | atrāhuḥ---satukkavitukkau dvāvapi nirdiśyete | na ca samāhāradvandve ekavacanasya itaretarayoge tu bahuvacanasyāpattiriti vācyam | chakārayossamāhāradvandvaṃ kṛtvā vakāreṇa saha itaretarayoge dvandva iti vyākhyānāt | ādeśe'pi dvitīyaśakārapraśleṣaḥ | yadvā "na dhyākhyā" iti mūrccheḥ parasyā niṣṭhāyā natvaniṣedhālliṅgācchuddhasya chakārasya "rāllopa" ityatrānvayaḥ | chalopaṃ vinā rephātparatvābhāvena natvaprasaktivirahāt iti dik | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ | aca ityasya pratyudāharaṇaṃ tu dyūtvā syūtveti | anyathā ūṭhaḥ sthānivattvādyaṇ‌ na syāt | na cātideśānāṃ svāśrayānivarttakatvātsvāśrayamatrāc‌tvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti vācyam | vidhigrahaṇasāmarthyātsvāśrayanivṛtteḥ vatinirddeśādabhāvasyāpyatideśa ityasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | nanu ādeśatvaparyāptyāśrayasya ūṭho na yaṇ‌nimittasya ūkārasya ca nādeśatvaparyāptyāśrayatvam, tasya samudāye paryāpteriti cenna | anubandhānāmanekāntatvād | ekāntatve'pi pūrvapradhvaṃsitvādūkārasyaivādeśatvaparyāptyāśrayatvāt | evamabhigatyetyatrāpi makāralopasya paranimittakatvāt tasya sthānivadbhāve "hrasvasya piti kṛti" iti tuk na syāt | nanu akrāṣṭāmityatra sico lopasya paranimittakatvāttasya sthānivadbhāve "ṣaḍhoḥ ka si" iti katvaṃ syāditi kuto na pratyudāhṛtamiti cenna | "pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat" ityanenaiva niṣedhāt | parasminniti kim | yuvajāniḥ | jāyāyā niṅa ākārādeśatvātpūrvasya yakārasya "lopo vyoḥ" iti lope karttavye sthānivadbhāvo mā bhūt | vyāghrasyeva pādāvasya vyāghrapāt | "pādasya lopo'hastyādibhya" ityaparanimittako lopaḥ | tato gargāditvādyañ‌ | vaiyāghrapadyaḥ | "pādaḥ pad" iti padādeśe kārye'kāralopasya na sthānivattvam | na ca vacanasāmarthyam | ekādeśasyādivadbhāvena pādenetyādāvapyāpatteḥ | dvipadikā ityatra padbhāvasya cāritārthyācca | tatra "pādaśatasya saṃkhyādervīpsāyāṃ vun lopaśca" iti vun akāralopaśca | na ca tatrāpi sthānivadbhāvaḥ | "yasyeti ca" iti lope siddhe'pi punarlopavacanasāmarthyāttasya paranimittakatvābhāvāt | "pādasya lopaḥ" ityasya tu na sāmarthyam | vyāghrapādityādau bhasaṃjñāvirahe sāvakāśatvāt | "parasmin" ityukte tu pādenetyādau na padbhāvaḥ | vaiyāghrapadya ityādau padbhāvasya sāvakāśatvāt | tatraikādeśasya sthānivadbhāvāt | varṇagrahaṇe jātigrahaṇādacorādeśe'pi tatpravṛtteḥ | ata eva śrāyasau gaumatau cāturau ānuḍuhau ityādāvekādeśasyādivadbhāvena prasaktau numāmau na | evaṃ "parasmin" ityanuktau audavāhau ityatra ekādeśasyādivattvāt bhasaṃjñāyāṃ vāh ityasya ūṭh‌ syāt | udakaṃ vahatīti udavāhaḥ | karmaṇyaṇ | udakasyodaḥ saṃjñāyām | bāhvāditvādiñ‌ | ādīdhye āvevye ityatra ikārasya ṭeretvam aparanimittakam, tasya sthānivattvād "yīvarṇayordīdhīvevyoḥ" iti lopaḥ syāt | pūrvavidhāviti kim | naidheyaḥ | nipūrvāddhāñaḥ kiḥ | āto lopaḥ | "dvyacaḥ" "itaścāniñaḥ" iti ḍhak | āllopasya sthānivattvāt tryac‌katvāt uktavidhyapravṛttirmā bhūt | tryac‌ke dvyackāryāṇāmapravṛtteḥ | na ca pūrvasyeti pāṭhe'pi kārye karttavye ityarthasyākṣepasambhavādvidhigrahaṇavaiyarthyam | pūrvasya pūrvasmāditi samāsadvayalābhārthatvāt | pañcamīsamāsodāharaṇaṃ tu tanvantīti prāgevoktam | nanu "asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge" ityata evaitad gatārtham | na ca "nājānantarye" iti niṣedhaḥ | yatrānataraṅge aca ānantaryam, tatraiva taditi kaiyaṭasiddhāntāt | atra tu bahiraṅge yaṇi ajānantaryasyāpekṣitatvāt | maivam | yatrāntaraṅgabahiraṅgayormadhye'nyataratrājānantaryaṃ tatra tanniṣedhapravṛtterharadattena svīkārāt | atretthaṃ pratyavatiṣṭhante | yatrottarakālapravṛttike'jānantaryāpekṣā tatra "asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgam" iti paribhāṣā na pravarttataiti kaiyaṭamatameva yuktam, na tu dvayormadhye'nyataratreti haradattamatam | pacāvedamityatra "eta ai" ityapravṛttimāśaṅkya bahiraṅgatvena guṇasyāsiddhatvāditi bhāṣyaharadattādyuktasyāsaṅgatiprasaṅgāt | pūrvapravṛttike guṇe'jānantaryasattve niṣedhāpatteḥ | kaiyaṭarītyā tu guṇottarapravṛttikaaitve ajānantaryānapekṣaṇena niṣedhāpravṛttyā bahiraṅgatvenāsiddhatvopapatteḥ | "na dhātulopa" iti sūtre preddha ityatra bahiraṅgatvenāsiddhatvamāśritya samādadhatā bhāṣye ṇa virodhācca | kiṃ ca "na padānta" iti sūtre daddhyatreti vṛttigranthamupādāya sthānivattvaniṣedhasāmarthyānna bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāpravṛttiriti haradattoktivirodhaḥ | tadrītyā bahiraṅge yaṇi ajānantaryasattvena "nājānantarye" iti niṣedhādeva tadapravṛttisiddhau sāmarthyānudhāvanavaiyarthyāt | kiṃ ca "saṃyogāntalope yaṇaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ" ityasya bahiraṅgaparibhāṣayā pratyākhyānaparabhāṣyavārttikavirodhaḥ | bahiraṅge yaṇyajānantaryasattvena bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyā apravṛttyāpatteḥ | tasmāddharadattamataṃ pūrvāparasvagranthavirodhāt bhāṣyavirodhāccopekṣyamiti | atredaṃ vicāraṇīyam | yatrā kāryavidhāvānantaryeṇācorāśrayaṇaṃ tatra niṣedhādanupasthānaṃ paribhāṣāyāḥ, yathā'kṣadyūriti | tatra hi "iko yaṇaci" iti vacanādacorāśrayaṇamiti | asmiṃstu pratiṣedhasūtre nāstyacorāśrayaṇamiti tāvad nadhātulopasūtre kaiyaṭa granthaḥ | tatra "acoḥ" iti dvitvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ na vā | nādyaḥ | dharmigrāhakamānavirodhāt | "ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ" ityatrāntaraṅge'jdvayānantaryasyānapekṣitatvāt | iṇaḥ parasya yasya ṣatvavidhānāt | hrasvasya tugvidhānācca | na dvitīyaḥ | daddhyatretyatrāpyacaḥ parasya yaro dvitvavidhānādajānantaryasattvāduktaniṣedhāpattyā sthānivattvaniṣedhasāmarthyānusārasyāvaśyakatvāt | na ca yatra paravarttino'co nimittatvaṃ tatraiva "nājānantarye" iti niṣedhapravṛttiḥ, yathā'kṣadyūrityādau, daddhyatretyatra tu pūrvavarttina eva tatheti na tatpravṛttiriti vācyam | dharmigrāhakavirodhaāt | bahiraṅge acorānantaryasthale jñāpitāyāḥ paribhāṣāyā yatrāntaraṅge'corānantaryaṃ tatraiva pravṛttirityasya durghaṭatvāt | tasmādayamatra haradattābhiprāyaḥ--- acoriti dvitvaṃ vivakṣitameva | tadāśrayaṇaṃ cāntaraṅge bahiraṅge vetyatra nāgrahaḥ | jñāpake bahiraṅgaevācorānantaryāpekṣāyāmapi lakṣyānurodhena tanniyamasya paribhāṣāyāmanantarbhāvāt | ata eva dhinvanti kṛṣvanti yaṇādeśe kṛte valādilakṣaṇa iṭ‌ prāpnoti, sthānivadbhāvānna bhavatīti bhāṣyakṛdbhiruktam | "nājānantarye" iti niṣedhāpravṛttau bahiraṅgaparibhāṣayaiva gatārthatvāpatteḥ | kiṃ ca kartrarthamityatra rephadvayaśravaṇārtham upaṇ‌raparasūtre pareṇāṇ‌grahaṇamastu ityāśaṅkya rephādeśasya kṛte'pi raparatve "ro ri" iti lopasyāvaśyakatayā rephadvayaśravaṇaṃ nāstīti bhāṣyaevoktam | tatrāsiddhaparibhāṣāpravṛttau tu lopānupapattyā rephadvayaśravaṇārthatvasya nirbādhatvāpatteḥ | pūrvapravṛttatayā yaṇādeśe ajānantaryasattvena "nājānantarye" iti niṣedhapravṛttāveva tadbhāṣyasya sāmañjasyād | uttarakālapravṛtte lope ekasyāpyaco'napekṣitatvena uktaniṣedhasya yojayitumaśakyatvāt | etena tatratyoktapūrvapakṣavirodhodbhāvanena haradattamatadūṣaṇamapyapāstam | siddhāntavirodhasya kaiyaṭamataevodbhāvyatvāt | "na padānta" itisūtrasthagranthasya ca nājānantaryaparibhāṣā vyatirekeṇāpi tatra nānupapattirityāśayena pravṛttatvāt | kaiyaṭamate'pi ajiti dvitvasyāvivakṣitatayā vṛtrahabhyāmityādau etatpratiṣedhapravṛttyāpattyā "hrasvasya piti kṛti" iti tugāgamāpattyā asiddho nalopa iti bhāṣyoktyā "nalopaḥ supsvara" iti "asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgam" iti veti kaiyaṭoktyā ca virodhāt | anityatvokteśca "eta ai" ityatra haradattamate'pi sāmyāt | yattu "eta ai" ityasyācaḥ sthāne jāyamānatve'pi aca ānantaryābhāvānna doṣa iti | tadasat | ānantaryaṃ hyavyavahitapūrvāparībhāvo vā nimittakāryiṇoranyatarasyāc‌tvaṃ vā | nādyaḥ | ajiti dvitvavivakṣāyāmeva paryavasānāt | nāntyaḥ | pacāvedamityatrāpi sattvāt | "yaṇaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ" itivārttikapratyākhyānasya ca "jhalo lopād‌" ityetadabhiprāyakatvād, etatpratiṣedhānityatvābhiprāyakatvādvā, asiddhaparibhāṣāyāḥ kāryakālatve'pyetatparibhāṣāyā yathoddeśaparatvādveti dik | atrāyaṃ siddhāntaḥ---antaraṅgaṃ balavad" iti paribhāṣā nirapavādā | "asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgam" iti tūktāpavādā | yattu vipratiṣedhasūtre pūrvaparibhāṣā gatārtheti bhāṣyam | tadabhyuccayamātramiti bhāgavṛttikaiyaṭalaghuvivaraṇakārādayaḥ | vṛhadvivaraṇakārāstu--"nājānantarye" iti paribhāṣā mā'stu | tajjñāpakenāsiddhaparibhāṣā'nityatvasyaiva jñāpyatvādityāhuḥ | "nājānantarye" iti bhāṣyamapyasiddhaparibhāṣāyā anityatvaparatayaiva neyamiti dīkṣitāḥ | bastutastu viṣayaviśeṣāvaccinnamanityatvaṃ samarpayituṃ nājānantaryaparibhāṣādhrauvyamiti bhāṣyāśayaḥ | ata eva vṛttikārasīradevābhyāmuktam---"nalopaḥ supsvara" iti sūtre kṛtituggrahaṇenāsiddhaparibhāṣāyā anityatvaṃ jñāpyate | tenām ityatra bahiraṅgasyaikādeśasyāsiddhatvenāntaraṅgamutvaṃ sidhyati | papuṣaḥ paśyetyatra bahiraṅgasya saṃprasāraṇasyāsiddhatvāt "vasvekājād‌ghasām" itīṭ‌ ca na bhavatīti | ata eva bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyā anityatvād yā setyatra bahiraṅgamapi tyadādyatvamantaraṅge ṭāpi nāsiddhamiti haradattaḥ | kecittu yathoddeśapakṣe'siddhaparibhaāṣāyāstatrāpravṛttyā kāryakālapakṣe ca "nājānantarye" iti niṣedhāt tuggrahaṇaṃ sārthakamevetyāhuḥ | "na yāsayoḥ" iti jñāpakādeva tatra bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyā apravṛtteḥ ityāstāṃ tāvat | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ | nanu pūrvasyeti ṣaṣṭhyā kāryitvanimittatvarūpasaṃbandhadvayasyopasaṃgrahasiddhe vidhigrahaṇaṃ mā'stu | tatrāpi pūrvasmānnimittatvenāśritāditi vyākhyeyatvāt | anyathā hegaurityatra gakārātparasya vidhau vṛddheḥ sthānivattvād "eṅ‌hrasvād‌" iti saṃbuddhilopāpatteḥ | satyam | yogavibhāgārthaṃ tat, tena pūrvasya vidhau sthānivadeva na tu svāśrayam | yadvā---vidhigrahaṇasāmarthyācchāstrīye'śāstrīye ca vidhimātre sthānivattvam | tena paṭayatītyādau ṭilopābhāvavelāyām "ata upadhāyā" iti vṛddhernimittābhāvādevābhāvāt ṭilope kṛte'pi na pravṛttiḥ | aśāstrīyasyāpi vṛddhyabhāvasyātideśāt | nanu pūrvasūtrādvidhigrahaṇānuvṛttyaiva siddhiḥ | yadvā---sthānivaditi vatibalenābhāvo'pyatidiśyate, uśīnaravanmadreṣu yavāḥ santītivat | taduktam-- kāmamatidiśyatāṃ vā saccāsaccāpi neha bhāro'sti iti | iti cet, satyam | tathā'pi pūrvasyaiva vidhau sthānivattvam, na tu pūrvaparayorvidhāviti niyamārthatvāt | tena īyaturiti siddham | anyathā iṇo'tusi yaṇaādeśe "dvirvacane'ci" iti sthānirūpātideśādikārasya dvitve tatkāle yaṇo'pahārāt antaraṅgatvātsavarṇadīrghaḥ syāt | vyāśrayatvena "vārṇādāṅgam" ityapravṛtteḥ | na ca savarṇadīrghānantaraṃ yaṇi bādhakābhāvānnimittasya vināśonmukhatvānna savarṇadīrghaḥ | kṛte'pi yaṇi sthānivadbhāvena nimittavighātābhāvāt | i atus iti sthite "antādivacca" ityabhyāsagrahaṇena grahaṇādabhyāsahrasve "dīrgha iṇaḥ kiti" iti dīrghe tatsāmarthyādyaṇabhāve i aturiti syāt | uktarītyā tu savarṇadīrghasya pūrvaparobhayavidhitvādyaṇādeśasya sthānivadbhāvānupapattyā savarṇadīrghasya nimittavighātāpattyā akṛtavyūparibhāṣayā tadapravṛttau dvitīyasya ikārasya yaṇādeśe pūrvasya dīrghe ca siddhamiṣṭam | iha sannidhisāmye'pi sthānyapekṣameva pūrvatvaṃ gṛhyate, na tvādeśād nimittādvā | tena vaiyākaraṇaḥ sauvaśva ityatra yaṇādeśasya sthānivadbhāvamāśritya prāptau "eco'yavāyāva" iti āyāvādeśau na staḥ | eco yaṇādeśottarakāle pravṛttyā anādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvasya virahāt | taduktam--- acaḥ pūrvatvavijñānādaicoḥ siddhamiti | na ca sthānina ādeśenāpahṛtatvātkathaṃ tadapekṣapūrvatvopādānam | pūrvatve tasyopalakṣaṇatvāt | athaivaṃ nirādyetyatra jagdhyādeśaḥ ghātyādityatra vadhādeśaśca syāt | tatra hi---ṇyallopau" iti pūrvavipratiṣedhena pūrvaṃ ṇilopastataḥ pratyayalakṣaṇena vṛddhiḥ | tathā cānādiṣṭādaco ṇica ikārād ād ghāt ityanayoḥ pūrvatvaṃ nāsti | ekadeśavikṛtanyāyena ca adihangrahaṇābhyāṃ tadgrahaṇamiti cenna | sthānidvārā tayorapyanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt | na ca sthānini tasyārthasiddhatve'pi śāstrīyatvābhāvādati deśānarhatvāt kathamādeśasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvalābha iti vācyam | "acaḥ parismin" ityatideśasyaiva śāstrīyakāryatvātsthānivatsūtreṇa tasyaivātideśasaṃbhavāt | "na padānta" iti sūtre savarṇagrahaṇañceha liṅgam | anyathā'llopānantarapravṛttasyānusvārasya svarūpato'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvābhāvādeva sthānivadbhāvāprasaktyā tanniṣedhavaiyarthyāt | nanvevam brāhmaṇakaṇḍūtiriti na siddhyet, kaṇḍūyateḥ ktici allopayalopau, allopasya sthānivattvāduvaṅ‌ tasya sthānidvārā'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvād‌ "acaḥ parasmin" iti sthānivadbhāvādakāreṇa vyavadhānānnoṭh‌, nāpi "lopo vyoḥ" iti valopaḥ | "hali ca" iti dīrghe kaṇḍūv‌tirityasyāpatteḥ | na covaṅaḥ sthānidvārā'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatve'pi na tasyātra kāryam, kiṃ tu vakāramātrasya, sa ca nādeśatvaparyāptyāśraya iti tasyāpi sthānidvārakamanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvaṃ nāstīti vācyam | "sarve sarvapadādeśā" iti nyāyena kaṇḍū ityasya kaṇḍuv ityādeśaḥ | tasya kaṇḍū ityādeśe kārye'llopasya sthānivattvasaulabhyāt | atrāhuḥ---sthānidvārakamanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvamanityam | kaṇḍūtiriti bhāṣyodāharaṇasāmarthyāt | titaumācaṣṭe titāpayatīti haradattagranthācca | anyathā ṇau ṭilope ca tasya sthānivattvād "aco ñṇiti" iti vṛddhyabhāve'pi "ata upadhāyā" iti vṛddhyā''kāre tasya sthānidvārā ukārātpūrvatvena ukāralopasya sthānivadbhāvātpuko durlabhatvāt | na ca puka ākārāntasamudāyāvayavatvādākāramātrasya ca pūrvatvānna pugvidhāvukāralopasya sthānivadbhāva iti vācyam | uktanyāyena ākārāntasyāpi pūrvatvāditi | yattu titau ṇic‌ iti sthite vṛddhiṭilopayornityatve paratvād "ata upadhāyā" iti vṛddhiḥ, tataṣṭilope ādantasya svata evānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatayā sthānivadbhāvasya durvāratayā puko durlabhatvam | tasmāt śapi ṇico guṇe tasya vṛddhau āyādeśe titāyatītyeva rūpam | na ca titā ṇic‌ iti sthite'ntaraṅgatvād ād‌guṇe śapyayādeśe titayatītyasyāpattiḥ | akṛtavyūhaparibhāṣayā pūrvamādguṇasyāpravṛtteḥ | vṛddhyā tannimittavighātasyotpatsyamānatvāt | akṛtavyūhaparibhāṣāyā antaraṅgaparibhāṣā'pavādatvāt | na ca śapi guṇasya "acaḥ parismin" iti sthānivattvādād‌guṇasya nimittasya vighāto na bhavatīti vācyam | pūrvaparayorvidhau sthānivattvābhāvāt | luṅi tu titā ṇic caṅ‌ tip‌ iti sthite "tanoterḍauḥ sanvacca" iti vyutpattipakṣe "anabhyāsasya" iti dvitvaniṣedhe "caṅ‌paranirhrāse" iti ṭilopasya sthānivattvaniṣedhena hrasvābhāve ṇilopasya sthānivattvādasiddhatvādvā'tolopābhāve dīrghavidhau sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhātsavarṇadīrghe'titādityeva na tvatitāpaditi | taccintyam | ṭilopasya nityatvāt | "acaḥ parasmin" iti kāryātideśena vṛddhiprāptāvapi "lakṣaṇāntareṇa prāpnuvannanityaḥ" ityanityatvāt | kiṃ tvanityamapi anādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvamiha neṣyataityatra pramāṇaṃ cintyamiti | vastutastu sthānidvārakamanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvamityatra mānābhāvaḥ | aśāstrīyatayā'tideśānarhatvāt | ata eva āhvā a ityatra saṃprasāraṇe ātolopasya sthānivadbhāvāttannimitte yaṇādeśe ca āhva iti siddhamityāśaṅkya ātolopasya sthānivadbhāvo na bhavati ukārasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvābhāvāditi bhāṣyam | vyākhyātaṃ ca kaiyaṭena--- nanvanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvo vakāra iti tadādeśasyāpi sthānivadbhāvādanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvaṃ bhaviṣyati, naitadasti, śāstrīyakāryasiddhaye sthānivadbhāvo vidhīyate, na tvanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatve laukike iti | yattu "acaḥ parasmin" ityatideśa eva śāstrīyaṃ kāryamityādi, tadasat | atideśasya śāstrīyatvavirahānuddhārāt | atideśaniṣṭhaśāstrīyatāyā akiñcitkaratvāt | yadrūpavaikalyādupadeśāpravṛttau satyāmatideśo mṛgyate tadrūpaniṣṭhaśāstrīyatvasyaivāpekṣitatvāt | anyathā'paśabdānukaraṇasyāpyasādhutvaṃ syāt | asādhutvamāśrityāsādhuprayoganiṣedhe pravarttayitavye'sādhutvasyāpekṣitatayā tasyāpi śāstrīyatvāpatteḥ | "prakṛtivadanukaraṇam" iti hi tatrātideśaśāstram | brāhmaṇena nāpabhāṣitavai iti niṣedho'tideśyaḥ | taddhaṭakaṃ cāsādhutvam | prakṛte'pi "sthānivadādeśaḥ" iti atideśaśāstram | "acaḥ parismin" iti sthānivadbhāvo'tideśyaḥ | taddhaṭakaṃ cānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvamiti sāmyāt | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ | ṛlṛk‌śūtrasthabhāṣyādisvaparagranthavirodhāt | ata evadyūtvetyatra yaṇādeśānupapattireva bhāṣye upanyastā, na tu ūṭhaḥ sthānivattvāt "lopo vyoḥ" iti yakāralopāpattirapi, anādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvābhāvāditi kaiyaṭenoktam | "khyatyāt" iti sūtre'pi ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvātsakhīyateḥ kvau allopasya na sthānivattvamiti śaṅkāyāṃ tatroktam | kvau lupkaṃ na sthānivaditi ca samāhitam | "lopo vyoḥ" iti sūtre'pi kaṇḍūrityatrātolopasya sthānivattvāduvaṅ‌ syādityāśaṅkyoktam--- tatraiva kvibāśraya ūṭh‌ kariṣyate ūṭhi ca karttavye nāsti sthānivadbhāvaḥ | ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt | ata eva kaṇḍuvau kaṇḍuva ityādāvūṭh‌ | avaṅi karttavye nāstyallopasya sthānivadbhāva iti | sthānidvārake tvanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatve gṛhyamāṇe tadanityatvaparatayā bahūnāṃ granthānāṃ kadarthanaṃ syāt | yattu sthavīyānityatra guṇalopayostulyakālatvāt guṇasya kathamanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvamityāśaṅkya sthānino'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāttad‌dvāreṇa guṇasyāpi bhaviṣyati, tatra sthānivadbhāve sati tvakāreṇa vyavadhānādavādeśāprasaṅga iti kaiyaṭenoktam | tadabhyupetyavādamātram | uktayukteḥ | ajjhalādeśe'pi sthānivaditi pakṣamupakramya likhitatvācca | iyeṣetyādau "abhyāsasyāsavarṇe" iti iyaṅuvaṅornimittavighātakatvaṃ guṇasyopapādayituṃ savarṇagrahaṇasārthakyasya svayamevoktatvāt | tasya pratyākhyeyatvācca | nirādyetyādau cāsiddhaparibhāṣayā samādhānāt | āśrīyamāṇāyāmeva prakṛtau sthānivadbhāva iti pakṣe jagdhyādeśe ṇernimittatvenānāśrayaṇātsthānivattvānupapattyoktarītyaiva samādheyatvād | atra ca pakṣe vidhīyate iti vidhiḥ | karmaṇi kipratyayaḥ | pūrvasyeti śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī | sā ca na sthāneyogā | anuvāde paribhāṣā'nupasthānāt | etenā''yannāsanniti vyākhyātam | "iṇoyaṇ‌" "śrasorallopaḥ" ityanayoḥ sthānivadbhāvena ajāditvādāṭ‌pravṛtteḥ | pūrvasya tadavayavasya tadvikārasya vā vidhāvityarthādāgamādividhāvapi sthānivattvapravṛtteḥ | "acaḥ" ityatra tvādeśapadasamabhivyāhārātsthānaṣaṣṭhī | ihāpi yatra vidheyatvaṃ tatra na sthānivattvamiti vyākhyāyeta, tarhi ṣaḍika iti na sidhyet | tathā hi---anukampitaḥ ṣaḍaṅgulidattaḥ ṣaḍikaḥ | "bahuco manuṣyanāmna" iti ṭhac‌ | "ṭhājādāvūrdhvam" iti jaś‌bhāvasādhi kāyā akārāntaniṣṭhabhasaṃjñāyāḥ sādhako'yaṃ sthānivadbhāvaḥ | tadvyatireke bhasaṃjñāyā api ṣakarāntaniṣṭhatvāpartau tayā padasaṃjñābādhe jaśbhāvānupapatterityapāstam |
