sthānivadbhāvo netyarthe jaś‌saṃbandhina eva grahaṇena jaś‌bhāvena saha bādhyabādhakabhāvo niṣpādyaniṣpādakabhāvo vā yasya saṃbandhastasyaiva sthānivattvaniṣedhāt | bhāvasādhanapakṣe'pi ṣaḍika ityasya siddheśca | jaś‌bhāvasya vidheyasya padāntatvasattvāt | na ca jaś‌bhāvasya pūrvameva nirvṛttyā padāntasya vidheyatvaṃ nāstīti vācyam | bhasaṃjñāyā api saṃbhāvitatvādakṛtavyūhaparibhāṣayā "antaraṅgānapi vidhīnbahiraṅgo lugbādhate" iti nyāyācca tadapravṛtteḥ | karmasādhanapakṣe'pi padāntasthānikavidheyābhāvācca | na ca padāntatvena siddhasya bhatvātṣakārarūpāpattirvidheyeti vācyam | dvirvacanādisāhacaryeṇa śāstrīyasyaiva vidheyasyopādānāditi | tadatyantamasat | anādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvena dṛṣṭasya padacaramāvayavasya sthāne vidhau kārye paranimitto'jādeśo na sthānivaditi vākyārthaḥ | tathā ca "dadhyatretyatra saṃyogāntalopaprasaṅge padāntavidhiṃ prati netyayamapi pratiṣedho nāsti, padānte vidheye sa pratiṣedho na ca lopo'bhāvātmakatvātpadānta" iti kaiyaṭagranthavirodhaḥ | evaṃ vṛkṣav ityatra vidheyasya valopasyāvayavatvābhāvāt "na padānta" iti ṇilopasya sthānivattvaniṣedho neti kaustubhamanoramāgranthavirodhaḥ | tvadrītyā lopapratiyogino vakārādeḥ padāntatvasattvānniṣedhasya durvāratvāt | evaṃ vetasvānityatra karmasādhanapakṣedhanapakṣe na doṣa ityetatparabhāṣyavirodhaḥ | tadasminnastītyarthe kumudanaḍavetasebhyo ḍ‌matup | ḍittvādakāralopaḥ | "tasau matvarthe" iti bhasaṃjñāyāṃ rutvābhāvaḥ | na ca tasya cāturarthikatvānnirvṛttādyarthakatve tathā'pi doṣa iti vācyam | tatrānabhidhānamityabhiprāyeṇoktatvāt | tatra sāntasya bhasaṃjñāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāmallopasya sthānivadbhāvātsāntatvaṃ nāstīti bhasaṃjñā na syāt | na ca "na padānta" iti niṣedhaḥ | bhasaṃjñāyāḥ padāntasthānikatvābhāvāt | tathā ca padāntasthānike vidhau yadvirodhī tadvidhiṃ pratyapi na sthānivadbhāva ityartho'vaśyaṃ vācyaḥ | asti ca padāntasthāniko rutvavidhiḥ | tadvirodhī bhasaṃjñāvidhiḥ | taṃ prati allopasya sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhe sati tasya bhasaṃjñā siddhā | tathā cādhikārthaparatve mānābhāva ityasaṃbaddhamevābhidhānam | ata eva sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhavyatirekeṇaiva yasya padāntatvaṃ siddham, tasya vidhau "na padānta" iti niṣedhaḥ karmasādhanavidhiśabdapakṣe pravarttataiti bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoreva spaṣṭam | vetasvānityatra hi sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhaṃ vinā sakāro na padāntatvena siddhaḥ | sthānivadbhāvasattve'kārāntaeva padasaṃjñāviśrāmāt | kāni santītyatra ca "na padānta" iti niṣedhaṃ vinā'pi ikārasya padānatatvasattvādyaṇādeśe kartavye'llopasya sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhasaulabhyam | bhāvasādhanapakṣe'pi tatsidhyatīti tvanyadetat | evaṃ ṣaḍika ityatra "na padānta" iti niṣedhapravṛttiṃ vinā ṣakāro na padāntatvena siddhaḥ ato durlabhaiva tatraitanniṣedhapravṛttiḥ | na cāntarvarttivibhaktyā tasya padāntatvaṃ siddhameveti vācyam | stānivadbhāvaniṣedhābhāve tulyāvadhikayā bhasaṃjñayā tad‌bādhāpatteruktatvāt | etanniṣedhasyaiva tatpadasaṃjñāyāmupajīvyatvāt vetasvānityato viśeṣābhāvāt | yattu kāni santītyatraiva niṣedhopapattiriti tanna | padāntasthānike vidhau yasya bādhyabādhakabhāvo niṣpādyaniṣpādakabhāvo vā sambandhastasya sthānivattvaniṣedha ityavaśyaṃ vācyam | jaśtvavidhito vaiṣamyābhāvāt | niṣpādyaniṣpādakabhāva ādeśasya vivakṣitaḥ sthānino vā ? | nādyaḥ | allopasya yaṇādeśena tadabhāvāt | nāntyaḥ | ṣaḍika ityatrākārasyāpi svāntaniṣṭhabhasaṃjñādvārā jaśtvarūpe padāntasthānikavidhāvanuguṇatvāt niṣedhasya durvāratvāt | nanu sākṣādanuguṇatvaṃ niveśyamiticenna | sākṣāttvapraveśe gauravāt | kiṃ ca, sākṣāttvam hi kiṃ saṃjñāmātrānapekṣatvam, uta svabhinnavṛttisaṃjñā'napekṣatvam, uta svamātravṛttisaṃjñā'napekṣatvam ? | nādyaḥ akārasyāpyactvena rūpeṇa yaṇyanuguṇatvāt | na dvitīyaḥ | actvasyāpi akārabhinnavṛttitvāt | nāntyaḥ | aprasiddheḥ | atha yasyāṃ vyaktau yatra nimittatvaparyavasānaṃ tatparyyāptasañjñātiriktasañjñānapekṣatvaṃ tadartha iti ced | aṇāditañjñāyā apyakāraparyāptatayā tadatiriktāyā acsañjñāyā evāpekṣitatvāt | atha bhedapratiyoginyāṃ sañjñāyāṃ prakṛtakāryanimittatvamapi vācyam aṇaādisañjñāstu na tathā iti cenna | tathāpi yathoddeśe aci parato yatkāryaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yad‌ ādeśe'pi bhavatīti kāryātideśena lope satyapi "acaḥ parasmin" ityanenaiva yaṇādīnāṃ prasaktyā akāre nimittatvaparyavasānābhāvāt | naca kāryakālapakṣe śāstrīyatvāviśeṣāt akāraniṣṭhāyā evācsaṃjñāyā lopottaramatideśaḥ, yaṇādeśastu "ikoyaṇaci" ityanenaiveti ced | tathāpi akāre nimittatvasyānanvayāt | acsañjñāyā lope'tideśe'pi nimittatvasya phale eva viśrāmāt | evaṃ paryavasānaṃ phalopadhāyakatvaṃ sambhāvanāmātraṃ vā ? | nādyaḥ | niṣedhātprakṛte phalānupadhānāt | nāntyaḥ | actvena ikārādīnāmapi tathātvāt | atra sthānivadbhāvena phalānupadhānaṃ tatrākaḥ savarṇe dīrgha ityapavādeneti tu viśeṣaḥ | na ca kāni santītyatra ikāre na nimittatvasambhāvanā, akāralope'pi tadabhāvāt iti vācyam | lope sati akāre'pi tadabhāvāt | sthānivadbhāvaprayuktā sambhāvanā vivakṣiteti cet | tarhi sā pakṣadvaye'pi lopasyaiva natvakārasyetyuktameva | nanu atideśyatāvacchedakadharmo yādṛśaḥ prakṛte nimittatāvacchedakatvena nirṇītastadavacchinnāyāṃ yasyāṃ vyaktau padāntasthānikavidhinirūpitanimittatvaṃ sambhāvitaṃ tad‌vṛttitadatiriktadharmānapekṣatvaṃ vivakṣitam, prakṛte'tideśyatāvacchedako nimittatāvacchedakatvena nirṇīto dharmo'ctvaṃ tadavacchinnāyāṃ lopavyaktau kāni santītyatra yaṇādeśanimittatvaṃ sambhāvitaṃ tādṛśalopavṛttiryo'ctvātirikto dharmastadanapekṣatvaṃ yaṇādeśe prasañjanīye lopasyāstyeveti ced | satyam | actvasya kevalasya yaṇādeśānāpādakatvāt | kāryāntaraviśiṣṭasyaiva tasya tadāpādakatvāt | nahi yadyatra parato'c‌ syāt tadā yaṇādeśaḥ syādityāpādayituṃ śakyam | pūrvasya ik‌tvābhāve pragṛhyatve vā satyapi tasmiṃstadanutpatteḥ | tasmāttadabhāvaprayojakābhāvapratiyogitvamevānuguṇatvam vācyam | yathā cāc‌tvasya kāni santītyatra tathātvam tathā ṣaḍika ityatra akārasyāpi | tadabhāve ṣakārānta eva bhasañjñāprasaṅgāt jaśtvābhāva prayojakatvāt iti sthānivattvaniṣedho durvāraḥ syāt iti dik | siddhānte tu padāntasya yatra vidhīyamānatvaṃ tatra sthānivattvaniṣedhaḥ | ṣaḍika ityatra tu jaśtvasya pūrvasiddhatvānna niṣedha iti sati sthānivadbhāve bhapadasañjñayorbhinnābadhikatayā ṣāntasya padasañjñāsiddhiḥ | tena na padasañjñāvirahaprayuktaṣakārarūpatāpattiḥ | na ca ṣakārarūpatāvidhānamādāyaiva niṣedhāpattiḥ | tasyāpadāntatvāt | anyathā jaśtvāpatteḥ | anukampito vāgāśīrdatto vācikaityatra tu "ekākṣarapūrvapadānāmuttarapadalopo vaktavya" iti samastasyaivottarapadasya lopasvīkāraḥ | yattu akṛtavyūhaparibhāṣayā antaraṅgānapītiparibhāṣayā vā ṣaḍika ityatrāpi na pūrvaṃ jaśtvamiti | tatra nādyaḥ | uktarītyā nimittasya vināśonmukhatvābhāvāt | śaṅkāmātrasyāprayojakatvāt | na dvitīyaḥ | svādiṣvitipadasañjñāyā aṅgamātraviśrāntatayā luki durlabhatve'pi subantatvaprayuktāyāstasyā atathātvena lukyapi pratyayalakṣaṇena sulabhatvāt | anyathā pañca saptetyādau nalopo na syāt | rājapuruṣa ityādāvapi tathā | tatrāpi luka eva svīkārāt | anyathā 'trāllopāpatteḥ | gomatpriya ityādau numādyāpatteśca | padasañjñā tvantarvartivibhaktyāśrayeṇa ṣakārāntasveti kaiyaṭokteśca vibhakteraśrūyamāṇatayā subantasya padasañjñāyāmapi ṣakārānta eva paryavasānamityevaṃparatvāt | atha bhāvasādhanapakṣe brahmabandhūrityatra dhakārasya jaśtvaṃ syāt ūṅā sahaikādeśasya parādivadbhāvenoṅ‌grahaṇena grahaṇāt | tasminpare svādiṣvitipadasañjñāyā dhakārānte prasaṅgāt | naca bhasañjñayā bādhaḥ | tatra sthānivadbhāvapravṛttyā tasyā ukārānta eva viśrāmāt | evaṃ vetasvānityatra sakārasya rutvāpattiḥ, padāntatve vidhīyamāne sthānivattvaniṣedhāt padasañjñāyāḥ sakārānte susthatvāt | atra bhāṣyam "pade antaḥ padāntaḥ" pade parato'nta iti yāvat | tasya vidhau na sthānivat | ḍ‌matuptu na padamiti sasya rutve kartavye bhavatyeva sthānivadbhāvaniṣedha iti bhatvasyāpi sakārānta eva vidhānāt avadhibhedābhāvādbhasañjñayā padasañjñābādhaḥ | "yadvā yathā'nyāni padakāryāṇi upaplavante rutvaṃ jaśtvaṃ, evamidamapi padakāryamupaploṣyate | kim ? bhasañjñā nāmeti" | asyārthaḥ | bhasañjñāyāṃ padamityanuvartate padaṃ sadbhasañjñaṃ bhavatīti padatvasadbhāve tannimittakaṃ rutvaṃ mābhūditi bhasañjñāyāmapi padaviṣayakatvātpadāntavidhitvamastīti sthānivattvaniṣedhātsāntasyaiva bhasañjñeti tayā padatvabādhānna rutvam | pūrvaṃ padasañjñaiva bhasañjñopajīvyā, paścāttu bhasañjñayā tad‌bādha ityanyadetad | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ | dvirvacane sud‌dhyupāsyaḥ |" anaci ca" iti dvitve kartavye yaṇādeśo na sthānivat | na ca asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamiti dvitvānupapattitādavasthyam | haradattamate nājānantarye iti tanniṣedhāt | sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhasāmarthyācca | vare iti nipātanānna vibhakterluk | tannimitto'jādeśo na sthānivat | yāyāvaraḥ | yāteryaṅantāt "yaśca yaṅaḥ" iti varac | ato lopaḥ | tasya "ātolopa iṭi ca" ityākāralope kartavye na sthānivattvam | syādetat | ato lopasya paranimittakatvameva nāsti ārddhadhātuke iti viṣayasaptamyā ārddhadhātukotpatteḥ pūrvamevāto lopapravṛtteḥ | ata eva "aco yat" ityatra vṛttau vakṣyate `ac‌ grahaṇaṃ kim ? yāvatā halantāṇṇyataṃ vakṣyati | ajantabhūtapūrvasyāpi yathā syāt ditsyaṃ dhitsyam' iti | atra haradattādayaḥ---`varegrahaṇasāmarthyātparasaptamīpakṣo'pyasti | ata eva "anudāttetaśca halādeḥ" ityatra ādigrahaṇam | asati hi tasminhalantāditi vijñāyeta | tataśca jugupsano mīmāṃsana ityatra yujna syād iti | yadi ca viṣayasaptamī syāt prāgeva pratyayotpatterato lope sati halantatvādeva tatrāpi yuc siddhyediti ādigrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syād' iti | evaṃ yāteryaṅantāt ktici ato lope yalopavidhau sthānivattvaniṣedhādyalope tasya sthānivadbhāvādākāralope punaryakāralope yātiriti rūpam | na ca punarākārayakārayorlope pratyayamātraśravaṇāpattiriti vācyam | ālopasya sthānivattvāt ābhīyatvenāsiddhatvādvā | na ca svasya svaṃ pratyeva kathamasiddhatvamiti vācyam | ciṇoluṅ‌nyāyena tatsambhavāt | vakṣyati ca vārttikam--- "ciṇo luki tagrahaṇānarthakyaṃ saṃghātasyāpratyayatvāttalopasya cāsiddhatvād" iti | asyārthaḥ---ciṇo lugvidhau akāritarāmityādau tarabāderlopo mā bhūdityetadarthakaṃ tagrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ taṅ‌tarasamudāyasya pratyayatvābhāvāt | na ca takāralopottaraṃ tarapo lopāpattiḥ | talopasyāsiddhatvāt | na cābhede tadanupapattiḥ | viṣayabhedena lakṣaṇabhedāśrayaṇāditi | bhāṣye tu kaṇḍūyateḥ ktici kaṇḍūtiriti yalopodāharaṇ | vṛttau tu ktinnityuktam | tatra yadyapi apratyayena bādhitatvātkaṇḍūyetyeva bhavitavyamiti bhāṣyoktyā ca ktino daurlabhyam | tathā'pi `ktinnābādibhya' iti ktin | `kticītyeva yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ' iti haradattaḥ | allopayalopau | na ca allopasya sthānivattvāduvaṅ‌prasaṅgaḥ yalopaṃ pratyeva sthānivattvaniṣedhāditi vācyam | iṣṭāpatteḥ | "ch‌voḥ" iti tasya ūṭhaḥ sambhavāt | na ca taṃ pratyuvaṅādeśasya sthānivattvāpattiḥ | ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt | ata eva ūṭhaḥ punaruvaṅ neti haradattādayaḥ | evaṃ teṣṭhīyateḥ ktici allopayalopayorallopasya sthānivattvādiyaṅi "lopo vyoḥ" iti yalope teṣṭhitiriti rūpam, pepīyatestu eranekāca iti yaṇi yalope ca peptiḥ, śo tanūkaraṇe ityasmād yaṅantāt ktijādiṣu kṛteṣu "pūrvatrāsiddhe na--" iti sthānivattvaniṣedhācchasya ṣatve ṣṭutve ca śāṣṭiriti viśeṣaḥ | ākarṣikaḥ | caratītyarthe "ākarṣād‌" iti ṣṭhal‌ | "liti" iti kakārākārasyodāttatve kārye "yasyeti ca" iti akāralopo na sthānivat | na ca vacanasāmarthyaṃ gatiḥ | kāraka ityādau caritārthatvāt | "svaravidhau vyañjanamavidyamāvad" iti rephādervyavadhāyakatvānupapatteḥ | ānantaryasambhave vyavahitānāśrayaṇāt | na ca ṣṭhalo litkaraṇasāmarthyādakāreṇa vyavadhāne svarasiddhiḥ | ākārasyāpi pakṣe udāttatvāpatteriti kaiyaṭaḥ | anye tu tu śrutikṛtamevānantaryaṃ litkaraṇasāmarthyādāśrīyate | ghnantītyādau kutvavaditi, tanna yuktamityāhuḥ | tatra cikīrṣaka ityādau īkārasyodāttatve karttavye'to lopo na sthānivaditi udāharaṇam bodhyam | śiṇḍhi ityatra savarṇānusvārayoḥ karttavyayoḥ śnasorallopo na sthānivat | nanu śnasorallope kṛte anusvārapravṛtteḥ anusvārasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvābhāvāt sthānivattvaprasaktireva nāsti | naca sthānidvārakamanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvamiti vācyam | aśāstrīyatvena tasyātideśānarhatvāt | yattu haradattādibhiruktam | anādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāpekṣe "acaḥ parasmin" ityatideśe karttavye "sthānivadādeśa" ityatideśaḥ pravarttata iti | tanna | pūrvasūtre nirākṛtatvāt | tathā hi | anādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvamatidiśyate "acaḥ parasmin" ityatideśo vā | nādyaḥ | aśāstrīyatvāt | nāntyaḥ | "acaḥ parasmin" ityatideśasya prakṛte'pi sthāninyapravṛttatayā tadādeśe'tideṣṭumaśakyatvāt | sthāninyadṛṣṭasyātideśānarhatvāt | āvaśyakaṃ ca haradattasya tat | anyathā loluva ityādau iyaṅuvaṅoḥ kṛtayorlaghūpadhaguṇaprāptyā tadvāraṇārthaṃ "na dhātulopa---" iti sūtrārambha iti tatsiddhāntānupapatteḥ | sthānidvārakamanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvamāśrityāllopasya sthānivadbhāvādeva guṇaprasaktestatra vārayituṃ śakyatvāt | na ca tatsūtrapratyākhyānād bhāṣyakārasya sthānidvārakamaṣyanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvamiti abhiprāya āvaśyaka iti vācyam | tatsūtrapratyākhyāne bhāṣyakṛtastātparyavirahāt | "āto'nupasarga" iti sūtrasthabāṣyavirodhasya pūrvameva darśitatvācca | na ca tadbhāṣyādikaṃ sthānidvārakasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvasyānityatvābhiprāyakameveti vācyam | sthānidvārakasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvasya yuktiśāstrobhayaviruddhatvena `sa hyādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvaḥ' ityādibhāṣyasyaiva balavattvāt | ata eva "akṣayyaṃ hi vai cāturmāsyayājinaḥ sukṛtaṃ bhavati" ityetadapekṣayā kṛtakatvaliṅgakavināśitvānumānasahakṛtāyāḥ "tadyatheha karmacito lokaḥ kṣīyata evamevāmutra puṇyacito lokaḥ kṣīyate" iti śruteḥ prābalyamiti bhāmatyādāvuktam | ata eva kaṇḍūtirityatrādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvāt punaruvaṅ‌netyuktam | satyam | ādeśāpekṣaṃ nimittāpekṣaṃ vā pūrvatvamiti pakṣadvaye sthānivattvaprasaktyā niṣedhopapattiḥ | etenoktaniṣedhādeva sthānidvārakasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvasya grahaṇamityapāstam | kecittu haritaśabdādākhyānaṇyantādvici harillunātītyatra "torli" iti latve karttavye'to lopasya ṇilopasya vā sthānivattvaniṣedhārthaṃ savarṇagrahaṇam | na ca pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivadityata eva siddhiḥ | "tasya doṣaḥ saṃyogādilopalatvaṇatveṣu" iti tanniṣedhādityāhuḥ | anye tu pratipadoktameva latvaṃ tatra gṛhyate na tu parasavarṇavidhiprayojyaṃ vyavahitapratītikatvādityāhuḥ | apare tu rephottaraṃ vidheyalakārapraśleṣāt "torli" iti latvamapi pratipadoktameva, parasavarṇasyānuvṛttau gauravaprasaṅgāt | vastutastu "pūrvatrāsiddhīye na sthānivad‌" ityāśritya savarṇagrahaṇasya siddhānte'pi pratyākhyeyatvānnāyaṃ doṣaḥ ityādyavadheyam | yadyapi parasavarṇavidhau sthānivattvaniṣedhasya tatsthānino'nusvārasyāpi vidhau sthānivattvapratiṣedhamantareṇānupapannatayā'nusvāravidhāvapi tanniṣedha iti pṛthaganusvāragrahaṇavaiyarthyam, tathāpi yatra parasavarṇaprasaktirnāsti śiṃṣantītyādau tatrānusvāro na syāditi śaṅkāvāraṇārthaṃ tat | pratidīvnetyatra "hali ca" iti dīrghe kārye bhasaṃjñānimittako'llopo na sthānivat | pratipūrvād‌ divaḥ "kanin yuvṛṣitakṣirājidhanvidyupratidivaḥ" iti kanin | vṛttau tu "upadhāyāṃ ca" iti dīrgha iti paṭhyate, tad lekhakaiḥ pramādāllikhitam, divervakārasyānupadhātvāt | "upadhāyāṃ ca" iti sūtre pratidīvnetyatra "hali ca" iti dīrgha iti vṛttāveva likhitatvāditi haradattādayaḥ | dīkṣitāstu `ācārakvibantātkvipi samādheyam | tatra pratidivan iti nāntam, tasyaiva dhātusaṃjñā tayā vakārasyopadhātvasambhavāt | nac, allopātpūrvamakārasyaiva "anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ" iti dīrghāpattiḥ | akṛtavyūhaparibhāṣayā bhāvinamallopamālocyāntaraṅgasyāpi dīrghasyāpravṛtteḥ | na ca sthānivattvābhāve'pi "asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgam" iti paribhāṣayā'llopasyāsiddhatvāddīrghānupapattiḥ | kṛti tuggrahaṇena tasyā anityatvajñāpanāt | yathoddeśapakṣe tatparibhāṣāyāstatrāpravṛtteśca | etasyobhayapakṣe'pi vācyatvād' iti āhuḥ | "sagdhiśca me" "babdhāṃ te harī" | adeḥ ktin "bahulaṃ chandasi" iti ghaslādeśaḥ | "ghasibhasorhali ca" ityupadhālopaḥ | "jhalo jhali" iti salopaḥ | dhi pare sico lopa ityasya bhāṣyakṛtā'naṅgīkārāt | vārtikamate tu chāndasatvātsalopa iti kaiyaṭaharadattādayaḥ | "jhaṣastathoḥ" iti pratyayatakārasya dhatvam | tat prati pūrvasmādvidhāviti upadhālopasya na sthānivattvam | tasyānityatvāt | ghakārasya "jhalāṃ jaś‌ jhaśi" iti jaśtvena gakāre kartavye upadhālopo na sthānivat | samānā gdhiḥ sagdhiḥ "samānalasya chandasyamūrddhaprabhṛtyudarkeṣu" iti samānasya sādeśaḥ | dvitīye bhaserloṭ‌, tasastām, śapaḥ śluḥ | antaraṅgatvād dvitvam | abhyāsakāryam | tata upadhālopādi prāgvat | jakṣatuḥ | ghaserliṭ atus | "gamahana" ityupadhālopaḥ "kharica" iti cartvena ghasya katve karttavye na sthānivat | atra vārtikam--- "svaradīrghayalopeṣu lopājādeśo na sthānivat" | bhāvarūpastvādeśaḥ sthānivadevetyarthaḥ | tena pañcārantyaḥ, daśāratnyaḥ | jasādiṣu "chandasi vā vacanaṃ prāṅ‌ ṇau caṅ‌yupadhāyāḥ" iti guṇābhāve yaṇ‌ | tasya sthānivadbhāvād "igantakālakapāla---" ityādinā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara iti bhāṣyam | na cedamasiddhaparibhāṣayā gatārthamiti vācyam | akṛtavyūhaparibhāṣayā pūrvaṃ yaṇo'pravṛtteḥ | bahukhaṭvaka ityatra sthānivadbhāvāt "hvasvānte'ntyātpūrvam" iti khakārākārasya udāttatvaṃ na bhavati, kiṃ tu "kapi pūrvam" ityeva | prācitīka ityatra tu `hvasvānta' ityasya pravṛttiriti kaiyaṭaharadattādayaḥ | kiryoḥ giryoḥ, vyutpattipakṣe "hali ca" iti dīrghaḥ prāpto yaṇaḥ sthānivadbhāvānnāsti | aca ityadhikāre "bhujeḥ kicca" "kṝgṝśṝdṝkuṭibhidicchidibhyaśca" iti iḥ | sa ca kit | "kṝgro ricca" iti haradatanyāsakārābhyāmupanyastaṃ tu kvaciduṇādivṛttāvanveṣaṇīyamiti dīkṣitāḥ | (anye) iha "upadhāyāṃ ca" iti sūtre vṛttikāroktarītyā kiryorityādikamavyutpattipakṣāśrayeṇāpi siddham | vāyvorityatra "lopo vyoḥ" iti vakāralopastu asiddhaparibhāṣayā niṣeddhuṃ śakyaḥ | ata uktavārttike svaretyevāvaśyakamityāhuḥ | "kvilugupadhātvacaṅ‌paranirhrāseṣūpasaṃkhyānam" | pūrvatrāsiddhe ca "tasya doṣaḥ saṃyogādilopalatvaṇatveṣu" | ayamarthaḥ---kvau vidhiṃ prati na sthānivat | lavamācakṣāṇo lauḥ | ṇici ṭilopaḥ, kvau ṇilopaścetyubhayaṃ vakārasya kvibnimitte ūṭhi kārye na sthānivat | "etyedhatyūṭh‌su" iti vṛddhiḥ | ye tu "kvau luptaṃ na sthānivat" iti paṭhanti teṣāmetanna syāt | tathā pipaṭhiṣateḥ kvau ato lope napuṃsake bahuvacane jhalaclakṣaṇe numi karttavye ato lopasya sthānivattvaniṣedhaḥ syāt | kvau pare kṛtatvāt iti numprasaṅgāt | `kvau vidhim" iti pakṣe tu numaḥ kvinimittatvābhāvādbhavatyeva sthānivattvam | pūrvatrāpi kvinimittakasya ṇilopasya sthānivattvaniṣedhe'pi ṇinimittakasya ṭilopasya sthānivattvaprasaṅgādūṭho'nupapatteḥ | idaṃ ca haradattagranthe spaṣṭam | kaiyaṭenāpi "kvau vidhiṃ prati" ityartho vyavasthito na tu "kvau luptam" itītyuktam | kvacit "kvau luptam" ityapyāśrīyate eveti tadarthaḥ | ata eva "khyatyātparasya" iti sūtre `sakhīyateḥ sakhīḥ lūnīyaterlūnīḥ' iti bhāṣyam | sakhīyādibhyaḥ kvipi kṛte 'llopayalopayoścāllopasya sthānivattvādikārasya yaṇā bhāvyam | tato yalope sthānivattvaniṣedhād, ādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvātsthānivattvāprasaṅgādvā yalopaḥ syādityāśaṅkya kvau luptaṃ na sthānivaditi samādhatta kaiyaṭaḥ | atra "lopājādeśa eva na sthānivad" iti pakṣamāśritya ādiṣṭādaca ityādyuktam | devayaterdayūriti tūbhayathā'pi sidhyatīti haradattaḥ | nanu "kvau vidhiṃ prati" iti pakṣe ūṭh‌ siddhyati tathā'pi tasya sthānidvārā'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvād ṇilopasya sthānivattvād "aco ñṇiti" iti vṛddhiḥ syāt, tasmāt "kvau luptam" ityavaśyāśrayaṇīyam | ata eva idaṃ tu kvauluptasyodāharaṇaṃ devayaterdayūriti kaiyaṭenoktam | tatkathamubhayathā'pīti cenna | sthānidvārakapūrvatve mānābhāvasyoktatvāt | na ca pakṣadvaye'pi pratyayalakṣaṇena dayūrityatra vṛddhirdurvāreti vācyam | bahiraṅgasya ūṭho vṛddhiṃ pratyasiddhatvāt | tathā ca sthānivadbhāve satyapi na kṣatiḥ | na caikadeśavikṛtanyāyena "diva aud‌" ityasyāpattiḥ | niranubandhaparibhāṣayā adhātugrahaṇānuvṛttervā tatsamādhānasya bhāṣye vakṣyamāṇatvāt | idaṃ ca sarvamārddhadhātuke iti parasaptamīpakṣe | viṣayasaptamītve tvato lopasya paranimittakatvābhāvāt na sthānivattvaprasaktiriti bodhyam | dhvanitaṃ cedaṃ "lopo vyoḥ" iti sūtre yalopakvilopayorvipratiṣedhaṃ vadatā bhāṣyakṛtā tadupapādayatā kaiyaṭena ceti spaṣṭamākaravidām | lukā lupte na sthānivat | āmalakyāḥ phalamāmalakam | "nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ" iti mayaṭ | "phale luk", "luk‌taddhitaluki" iti ṅīṣo luk | paranimittako "yasyeti ca" ityallopo na sthānivat | anyathā sthānivadbhāvādīkārasya paratvamastītyakāralopaḥ syāt | phaleluk‌pratyākhyānapakṣe tu pañcabhiḥ paṭvībhiḥ krītaḥ pañcapaṭuḥ pañca indrāṇyo agnāyyaśca devatā asya pañcendraḥ, pañcāgniḥ | ādye "ārhād‌" iti ṭhak | tasya "adyarddhapūrva" iti luk‌ | "antaraṅgānapi" iti nyāyena yaṇaḥ pūrvaṃ tatpravṛttāvapi sthānivattvādyaṇ‌prasaṅgaḥ | aviravikanyāyena paṭuśabdādeva tatra ṭhak na tu paṭvīśabdāditi kalpane ca pratipattigauravam | na ca "bhasyāḍhe taddhite" iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ | bhatve bhāvinyeva tadvidhānād atra tu luki tadabhāvāt | "ṭhak‌chasośca" ityasyāpi lumatā lupte pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvena durlabhatvāt | dvitīye puṃvadbhāvavirahātspaṣṭamudāharaṇam | "sāsya devatā" ityaṇ | "dvigorluganapatye" iti luk | tato ṅībṅīṣoḥ luk | tatsanniyukta aikāraḥ ānuk‌ca śrūyeta | na ca sanniyogaśiṣṭanyāyena tannivṛttiḥ | taddhitaluki pare strīpratyayaluko vihitatayā tannimittāyā ṅīpoṅīṣaśca nivṛtteḥ svapūrvayoraikārānugāgamayornivṛttau kāryāyām "acaḥ parasmin" iti sthānivattvapravṛtteḥ | kecittu vare ityatra vara ī iti praśleṣāt īkāre parato vidhau na sthānivaditi vyākhyāya prakṛtavārtike luggrahaṇaṃ nārabhyamiti vadanti | spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ padamañcaryyām | kecittu evaṃ sati pañca gārgyāyaṇyo devatā asya pañcagārgyaḥ ityatra ṅīṣo luki ṣphapratyayasya luk na siddhyet ṅīṣ‌lukaḥ sthānivadbhāvena taddhitalukaḥ paratvābhāvāt | īkāre parato yo vidhistatraiva tvayā sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhopagamāt | asya ca tathātvābhāvāt | evaṃ pañcabhiḥ śvaśrūbhiḥ krītaḥ pañcaśvaśura ityatrākārokāralopaḥ syāt | aineyaḥ śyaineya ityādau "yasyeti ca" iti ṅīpo lope nakārasyāpi nivṛttiḥ syāt | nakārasya pūrvameva niṣpannatayā kāryatvābhāvāt sthānivadādeśa ityasyāpravṛtteḥ | nivṛttyabhāvarūpakāryasyāśāstrīyatvāt | na ca ṅīb‌nakārayoḥ saha vidhānena īkāraparividhyabhāvānnoktaniṣedha iti vācyam | ānugaikārayorṅīṣā ṅīpā ca saha vidhānena pañcendra ityāderasiddheḥ ityāhuḥ | tanna | ṣphapratyayena sahaiva ṅīṣo luk‌pravṛtteḥ | tatra hi "prācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ" iti strītvaṃ ṣphapratyayasyaivārtho ṅīṣ‌ tu ṣittvasāmarthyādbhavatīti siddhāntaḥ | upadhātve karttavye na sthānivat | pārikhīyaḥ | anyathā parikhāśabdāccāturarthike'ṇi kṛte tannimittakasya ālopasya sthānivadbhāvāt khakāropadhatvābhāvād "vṛddhādakekāntakhopadhād" iti cho na syāt | upadhāsaṃjñāyāḥ pūrvavidhitvāt | na ca paṭayatītyādau ṭilopasya sthānivad‌bhāvaniṣedhāt pakārākārasya upadhāsaṃjñāyāṃ satyām "ata upadhāyāḥ" iti vṛddhyāpattiriti vācyam | upadhāsaṃjñānibandhanapratyayavidhāvevoktaniṣedhapravṛtteriti siddhāntāt | na caivaṃ saurī balākā iti yalopodāharaṇe upadhāvidhau sthānivattvaniṣedhādeva tadanyathāsiddhyabhidhānaṃ bhāṣye kathamiti vācyam | anāsthāvādamātratvāt | tatra hi "tenaikadik" ityaṇantāt ṅīp | ekasyāṇ‌nimittako dvitīyasya cākārasya ṅīb‌nimittako lopaḥ | taddvayasyāpi yakāralope sthānivattvaniṣedhaḥ | dvitīyalopasya tvābhīyatvātsamānāśrayatvāccāsiddhatayā yakārasyopadhāsaṃjñāyāṃ tallopasiddheḥ | tathā copadhātvaṃ yalopa evoktam, na tu pratyayavidhāviti | yalopasyaiva saurītyudāharaṇamiti spaṣṭam | caṅ‌paranirhrāsaścaṅ‌nimittako hrasvaḥ | vāditavantaṃ prayojitavān avīvadadvīṇāṃ parivādakena | prathamaṇico lopasya sthānivattve satyākārasyānupadhātvāt "ṇau caṅ‌yupadhāyāḥ" iti hrasvo na syāt | yastu caṅ‌paro dvitīyo ṇic tadaṅgasaṃbandhitvasyākārarūpāyāmupadhāyāmabhāvāt | prathamaṇijaṅgasaṃbandhitvasya sattve'pi prathamaṇicaścaṅ‌paratvābhāvāt | evaṃ vāriśabdād‌ "tatkaroti" ṇyantāccaṅ‌ avīvarat | ikāralopo na sthānivat | na ca "nāglopi" iti niṣedhaḥ | paratvāt vṛddhau satyāṃ ṭilopa ityabhyupagamāt | ata eva halakalayoradantatvaṃ nipātayiṣyate | kutve'pi na sthānivat | arcayaterauṇādikaḥ kapratyayaḥ arkaḥ, pācayateḥ ktic‌ pāktiḥ | "coḥ kuḥ " iti kutvaṃ prati ṇilopo na sthānivat | kutvamupalakṣaṇam | ateva lehayaterleḍhiḥ dohayaterdogdhiḥ, yājayateryāṣṭiḥ, veśayaterveṣṭiriti sidhyatīti bodhyam | kutvopādānasya pūrvatrāsiddhīye na sthānivadityetanmūlakatvāt | tadapi nyāyasiddham | "acaḥ parasmin" ityatideśaṃ prati traipādikasyāsiddhatayā tadvidhau tadapravṛtteḥ | na ca rāma ityādau visargo na syāt | nyāyasāmyena sthānivatsūtrasyāpyapravṛttau subantatvābhāvātpadatvānupapatteriti vācyam | "pratyaya" ityādijñāpakena tatpravṛtteḥ | na caivaṃ dvirvacanasavarṇānusvāradīrghajaścaro'pi sūtre nopādeyā iti vācyam | iṣṭāpatteḥ | tathā ca vārttikam--- "dvirvacanādīni ca vareyalopasvaravarjam" iti | syādetat | dīrghagrahaṇaparityāge sthalāntarīye dīrghavidhau sthānivattvāpattyā "ciṇ‌ṇamuloḥ" iti sūtre yaṅantāṇṇijantādvā ṇici ciṇi aśaṃśāmi aśāmi iti sarvairudāhṛtam na siddhyet | na ca dīrghagrahaṇasamārthyāt | ahīḍītyetadarthatvāt | aheḍītyetannivṛttyarthatvācca | tathā hi--"heḍṭa anādare" ghaṭādiḥ, hrasvaḥ | hiḍayati | atra ciṇ‌ṇamuloḥ kṛtayoḥ hrasvavikalpasyaiva vidhāne ahiḍi aheḍīti syāt | dīrghe tu ahiḍi ahīḍīti rūpamiti kaiyaṭādau spaṣṭam | atrāhuḥ---ṇitvajātyaikyaṃ gṛhītvā aśāmīti, yaṅ‌lugantāt tvaśaṃśāmīti sidadham | yaṅi talluki vā arthasvarayoraviśeṣāt | grāhitamityādyapi pūrvasyādvidhau sthānivadbhāvena ṇicā vyavadhāne "graho 'liṭi" iti dīrghasyāpravṛtteḥ | na ca sūtramate dīrghavidhau sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhāt dīrgho durvāraḥ | vihitaviśeṣaṇāśrayaṇāt | etena jarīgṛhitetyapi vyākhyātam | mādhavācāryāstu yaṅ‌lugantādgrahestṛjādāviṭo dīrghaḥ jāgrahītetyādi ityāhuḥ | tatrāhuḥ---dviḥ prayogo dvirvacanaṃ ṣāṣṭhamiti siddhāntād‌ grahervihitatvam | yaṅ‌luko'naimitikatayā'jjñalādeśatayā luko luptatvācca sthānivadbhāvo'pi neti tasyāśayaḥ | etacca bhāṣyakaiyaṭaviruddham | "ekāco dve " iti sūtre hi "graheraṅgād" iti bhāṣyavyākhyāyāṃ kaiyaṭenoktam---`jarīgṛhitetyatra grahervihitaṃ yad‌ ārddhadhātukamiti vihitaviśeṣaṇānna dīrghaḥ | tṛco `jarīgṛh' ityaṅgaṃ na tu grahiḥ, viśeṣaṇasāmarthyāddhi yathāśrutarūpāśrayaṇam' iti | idaṃ ca yadyapi yaṅ‌prakrameṇoktam tathā'pi yaṅ‌lukyapi na dīrgha iti tadabhiprāyo'nyasāmyāditi | atredaṃ vaktavyam---yaṅ‌lukaḥ kiṃcinnimittakatvābhāvena taduttaraṃ pratyayotpattau bādhakābhāvāt yathāśrutarūpāśrayaṇe grahervihitatvānapāyāt | na ca dvitvādipravṛttyanantaramevārddhadhātukotpattiḥ | antaraṅgatayā ārddhadhātukasyaivotpatteḥ | yaṅante tu grahyaśabdottaramevārddhadhātukotpattyā yathāśrutarūpapracyava iti vaiṣamyam | na ca jarīgṛhityaṅgamiti kaiyaṭavirodhaḥ | śuddhasya graheraṅgavyāvṛttāveva tattātparyāt | yaṅ‌lopasya paranimittakatvādyathāśrute vādhāt | tatpūrvaṃ jarīgrahyaśabdāt tṛjiti tenaivoktatvācca | astu vā tatra yaṅaḥ śrūyamāṇatayā tannimittaṃ dvitvādi pūrvameva, luki tu pratyayalakṣaṇādyapekṣasya dvitvādeḥ paścādeva pravṛttiriti mādhavāśayaḥ | "graho' liṭi" iti sūtre ekāc‌grahaṇasya haradattenānuvartitatve'pi yathā yaṅ‌luṅante dīrghapravṛttistathoktā tatreti dik | "tasya doṣaḥ saṃyogādilopalatvaṇatveṣu" | tasya pūrvoktaniṣedhasya | tena sthalatraye pūrvatrāsiddhe'pi sthānivattvapravṛttirityarthaḥ | tena, kākyartham, vāsyartham, ityatra padānte yaḥ saṃyogastadādyavayavayoḥ sakārakakārayoḥ "skoḥ" iti kalopo na | nanu "skoḥ" ityatra ityanuvṛttyā tasya ca "skoḥ" ityatra vyabhicārāvārakatvena vaiyarthyāt upasarjane'pi saṃyoge viśeṣaṇatayā jhalanto yaḥ saṃyogaḥ tadādyoḥ skorlopa ityarthād bahiraṅgatayā yaṇo'siddhatvādvā nāyamatiprasaṅga iti cenna | kusmayateḥ kvipi kūriti mādhavādyudāhṛtasyānupapattiprasaṅgāt | saṃyogādītyasyānupādāne saṃyogāntalope ṇilopasthānivadbhāvaniṣedhāpatteḥ | dadhyatra iti bhāṣyavyākhyāyāṃ "pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat iti nāsti, saṃyogādipadasya saṃyogopalakṣitalopopalakṣaṇatvāt" iti kaiyaṭokteḥ pūrvapakṣyabhiprāyavarṇanamātraparatvāt | napadāntasūtraśeṣe skandayateḥ skan takṣayatestagiti tenaivoktatvāt | "yattu siddhakāṇḍe ścutvakatve " iti vārtikavyākhyāne madhupūrvāt ścotateḥ kvibantāṇṇijantāt kvipi madhugitīṣyate madhuḍiti prāpnotīti tenoktam, tatra sakāropadeśasāmarthyānna saṃyogādilopa iti bhāvaḥ | na ca san ścotatītyatra "śi tuk" ityapravṛttyā caritārthatvamiti vācyam | "kvau luptaṃ na sthānivat" iti samādheyatvāt | kusmayatau tu sāmarthyābhāvāt saṃyogāntalopasyaiva pravṛtteḥ | takṣirakṣibhyāṃ ṇyantābhyāṃ kvipi tak rak ityādyasiddheśca | saṃyogasya tatra jhalantatvāt | saṃyogādilope karttavye ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāve tu tadaparvṛttyā saṃyogāntalope ca sthānivattvaniṣedhena tatpravṛttyā uktasiddheḥ | na ca "kāṣṭhaśageva nāsti" iti bhāṣyādayaṃ prayogo nāstīti vācyam | kāṣṭhaśak‌sthātetyatra jhalparasaṃyogādeḥ kakārasya lopamāśaṅkya tathoktatvāt yatra kakārasya saṃyogādilopaprasaktistatraivānabhidhānasyoktatvāt | atra ca ṇilopasya sthānivattvena tadaprasaṅgāt | ata eva kāntebhyaḥ kvib‌ nāstīti vyākhyātāraḥ | latve yathā---nigāryate, nigālyate | ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvād "aci vibhāṣā" iti latvavikalpaḥ | atha pratyayalakṣaṇenaiva latvam | na ca varṇāśrayatvām, dhātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇame tatpratyaye kāryavijñānāt | etacca bhrūṇahatyeti takāranipātanena jñāpayiṣyate | yadvā, antaraṅgatayā ṇilopāt pūrvameva latvamiti cet, maivam | `pratyayalakṣaṇasūtramitaravyāvṛttimātraphalakam, sthānivadbhāvastu sthānivatsūtreṇaiva' iti bhāṣye vakṣyamāṇatvāt ajādipratyayanimittake latve ca viśeṣaṇatayā alāśrayaṇād "analvidhau" iti niṣedāt | nāpyantaraṅgatvena siddhiḥ | akṛtavyūhaparibhāṣāvirodhāt | kiṃ ca "upasargasyāyatau" iti sūtre ayatiparatvam upasargasya viśeṣaṇaṃ rephasya veti pakṣadvayam | ādye plāyata iti latvārthaṃ sthānivadbhāvopayoga āvaśyakaḥ, anyathā ekādeśe kṛte paurvāparyarūpavyapavargābhāvaḥ | ayatiniṣṭhaparatvanirūpitapūrvatvaśālina upasargasyeti tadarthāt | ubhayata āśraye ca antādivadbhāvaniṣedhāt | dvitīye ekādeśasya parāditvena grahaṇādrephāpekṣayā'yateḥ paratvena plāyate ityasya siddhāvapi palyayate ityatra latvaṃ na syāt, yakāreṇa vyavadhānāt | na ca vacanasāmarthyam | plāyate ityatra sāvakāśatvāt | na ca tatrāpi sthānivadbhāvāt akāreṇa vyavadhānam | pūrvatrāsiddhe tanniṣedhāt | latvavidhau sthānivadbhāvapratiprasave tu yenanāvyavadhānanyāyenobhayatra latvasiddhiriti dik | "ṇatve māṣavapanī" iti bhāṣyam | "prātipadikānta---" iti sūtreṇa samāsāntasya nakārasya ṇatvaṃ vidhīyamānam allopasya sthānivattvaniṣedhāt ṅībutpatteḥ prāk‌ samāsavidhānātprāpnotīti kaiyaṭaḥ | atra pratyavatiṣṭhante---bahiraṅgatayā'llopasyāsiddhatayā nakārasya prātipadikāntatvābhāvaḥ | prahiṇoti pramīṇātītyādaucaikadeśavikṛtanyāyenaiva "hinumīnā" ityasya pravṛtteḥ | na ca priyāṣṭ‌na ityatra ṇatvanivṛttisiddhyarthamidam | kāryakālapakṣe bahiraṅgatayaiva siddheḥ | etena priyāṣṭ‌ṇa iti ṇatvasvīkāraparaḥ padamañjarīgrantho'pāsta iti | tadasat | tatra ṇatvasya pūrvamupapāditatvāt | yattu "aniterantaḥ" iti sūtre he prāṇ‌ iti ṇatvārtham "padāntasya" iti niṣedhabādhāya "antaḥ" iti yogaṃ vibhajya padāntasyāniterṇatvaṃ vidhīyate | yadvā, samīpārtamantaśabdamādāya nimittasamīpavarttino'nitinakārasya tādṛśasya vā aniternakārasya ṇatvaṃ yogavibhāgaṃ vinā'pi siddham | ādye prāṇiti ityādāvekenā''kāreṇa vyavadhāne'pyārambhasāmarthyāt ṇatvam | dvitīye tu ekādeśasya ādivadbhāvāt rephādavyavahitasyāniteḥ saṃbhavātsiddham | paryanitītyatra tu dvayenaikena vā vyavadhānānna ṇatvamityaṣṭame vyākhyātam | iha ṇatvagrahaṇe tu paryanitītyatreva prāṇiti ityatrāpi dvābhyāmekena vā varṇena vyavadhānāt ṇatvaṃ na syāt | na ca vacanasāmarthyam | niraṇiti duraṇitītyatra cāritārthyāt | na caivaṃ "nirduroraniteḥ" ityeva brūyāt iti vācyam | anitiṃ pratyupasargatvābhāve'pi ṇatvāpatteḥ | nirānayatītyatra niro ṇyarthaviśeṣakatvena ṇatvasyāniṣṭatvāt | kiṃ ca, anitervijantānniṣpannān śabdasya niśśabdena "nirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe" iti samāse bhasaṃjñāyāmallope nirna ityatra ṇatvaṃ syāt | he prāṇityatra ṇitvapratiprasavāyāvṛttyartham akṣaralāghavācca "antaḥ" ityasyaiva yuktatvāt | tasmādāṣṭamikabhāṣyādyālocanayā atra ṇatvagrahaṇaṃ na kāryamiti | tadapyasat | tanmātraparatve "rādaniteḥ" ityasyaivāpatteḥ | rāntādupasargātparasyāniterṇa iti vyākhyānasaṃbhavāt | "aniteḥ" ityasya prayojanāntarābhāvāt "padāntasya" iti niṣedhasyāpavādasaṃbhavācceti dik | yadyapi "na mu ne" ityatra yogavibhāgādasiddhatāyā anityatvamāśritya sthalatraye sthānivattvaṃ susādham, tathā'pi tādṛśaviśeṣasya durgrahatayā vārtikārambha eva śreyān | dvirvacane'ci 58 | dvitvanimittamacamāśritya kṛto'jādeśaḥ sthānivat syāt dvitve karttavye | "acaḥ parasmin" ityasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvasya vidhāveva pravṛtteḥ sāc‌kasya dvitve karttavye aprāptaḥ sthānivadbhāvo vidhīyate | nimittāpekṣayā pūrvasya vidhāviti pakṣe'pi dvircanasya vidhau sthānivattvaniṣedhāditi kaiyaṭaḥ | rūpātideśaścāyam | cakratuḥ, cakruḥ | kṛ atusa kṛ us, iti sthite yaṇaḥ paścāt uktātideśena kṛ ityasya "liṭi dhātoḥ" iti dvitvam | kāryātideśasvīkāre tu yaṇādeśe sati prakṛteranac‌katvāt ekāco vihitaṃ dvirvacanaṃ na prāpnotīti sthānivadbhāvādanena sūtreṇa yaṇ‌sahitasyaiva dvirvacanaṃ syāt | rūpātideśatve ca pramāṇaṃ vakṣyate | atra pañca pakṣāḥ saṃbhavanti | tathā hi--acītyādeśopalakṣaṇam | dvirvacane iti viṣayanirddeśaḥ | aci yo'jādeśaḥ sadvitve sthānivaditi prathamaḥ |, dvirvacana iti viṣayanirddeśaḥ tasmintakartavye sthānivadbhavatyaci pare iti dvitīyaḥ |, dvirvacanapadamarśaādyajantam adhikaraṇalyuḍantaṃ vā | dvitvanimittatvaviśeṣitaṃ ca aj‌grahaṇam ādeśopalakṣaṇam | dvirvacananimitte'ci yo'jādeśaḥ sa sthānivaditi tṛtīyaḥ |, uktavidhamevā'j‌grahaṇaṃ sthānivadbhāvaviśeṣaṇam | ajādeśaḥ sthānivat dvirvacananimitte'ci pare iti caturthaḥ |, dvirvacanagrahaṇamāvarttate | etenājviśeṣyate tena ca sthānivadbhāvo viśeṣyate | apareṇa viṣayo nirdiśyate | dvitve karttavye ajādeśaḥ sthānivat dvitvanimitte aci pare iti pañcamaḥ | atra nādyaḥ | dvitvanimittatvarahitamacamāśritya kṛtasyāpyajādeśasya sthānivattvaprasaṅgāt, aco dvitvanimittatvenāviśeṣitatvāt | tataścācikīrttadityatra ṇici pare kṛtasya "upadhāyāṃ ca" iti ṛkārasthānikasya ikārādeśasyāpi sthānivattve "caṅi" iti kṝ ityasya dvitve "urad‌" ityattve ca acakīrttaditi syāt | dudyūṣati ūṭhamāśritya kṛtayaṇādeśasya sthānivattve div‌śabdasya dvitve didyūṣatīti syāt | bhavanamicchatīti kyajantātsani lyuṭi kṛtayorguṇāvādeśayoḥ sthānivattve bubhavanīyiṣatīti syāt | na dvitīyaḥ | dudyūṣati ityādidoṣadvayatādavasthyāt | acikīrtadityatra tu itvasya takāravyavadhānānna doṣaḥ | sthānivadbhāvabhājo hyādeśasya sthānivattvavidhānavelāyām aci anantare sthānivattvena bhāvyam, tathaivāci parataḥ tadvidhinirvāhāt | evaṃ papāvityatra "āta au ṇalaḥ" ityaukāreṇa saha pāśabdasya vṛddhau samprati ādeśātparo'j‌ nāstīti sthānivattvaṃ na syāt | jagmaturityādau "gamahana" ityupadhālopo vyavahitatvānna syāt | na tṛtīyaḥ | kālāvadhāraṇavirahe dvitvottaramapi sthānirūpāvasthānaprasaṅgāt | na caturthaḥ | papāvityādidoṣasāmyāt | kālāvadhāraṇābhāvācca | na pañcamaḥ | jagmaturityādyanupapatteḥ | lopapratiyogyapekṣayā'tusādeḥ avyavahitaparatvābhāvāt | tasmāduktarītyā pūrvavyākhyānameva yuktam | tathā hi---dvirvacananimittatvena ajviśeṣaṇāt acikīrtadityādau nātivyāptiḥ | ittve ṇico dvitve ca caṅo nimittatvāt | ādeśopalakṣaṇācca papāvityādau nāvyāptiḥ | punardvirvacanopādānācca kālāvadhāraṇalābhāt dvitvottaramādeśāvasthānam | atha dvirvacananimitte'ci pare vidhīyamānaṃ sthānivattvaṃ cakraturityādau na syāt | atuso dvitvanimittatve'pi tadavayavasyākāramātrasya tannimittatvavirahāt | na cārambhasāmarthyam | cakāra cakre ityādau dvitvayaṇ‌nimittayorekamātraparyāptatayā tatra caritārthatvāt | yadi tu, parasminnityanuvartya tatrācīti viśeṣaṇam | vyākhyeyam "yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe" iti ajādau parasminniti, cakre ityādau tu vyapadeśivadbhāvādajāditvamiti kalpyate | evamapi na nirvāhaḥ | ajāderdvirvacananimittatve'pi yaṇaṃ pratyaca eva nimittatvāt | vastuto "vidhau paribhāṣopatiṣṭhate nānuvāde" iti nyāyena "yasminvidhiḥ" iti paribhāṣāpravṛttireva durllabhā | aciyo'jādeśa ityasyānuvādatvāt | tatrā''deśasyānuvādyatayā tadviśeṣaṇatvāt acītyasya tadādigrahaṇaparibhāṣāyā apravṛtteḥ | atrocyate | aci parato dvirvacanaṃ dṛṣṭamityetāvataivāco dvirvacananimittatvam atra | tadāhuḥ--- `tadbhāvabhāvitāmātreṇeha nimittatvam' iti | tathā ca sākṣādvā samudāyaghaṭakatayā (vā) dvitvopayogitvamātraṃ vivakṣitamiti | yattu dvirvacanenākṣiptaḥ pratyayo'trācītyanena viśeṣyate, parasminnityanuvarttate | amīṣāṃ madhye devadattātparamānayetyukte yathā sajātīyena manuṣyāntareṇāvyavahitapara ānīyate tathehāpi pratyayāntareṇāvyavahitaparo gṛhyate | tena dvitvanimitte ajadau pratyaye pratyayāntareṇāvyavahite sati yo'jādeśaḥ sa sthānivaditi sūtrārthaḥ | vakṣyamāṇajñāpakabalena ṇicā vyavahite pravṛttāvapi didavanīyiṣatītyādāvanekapratyayavyavadhānannātiprasaṅgaḥ | apīpyadityatra varṇavyavadhāne'pi pratyayāntarābhāvātpravṛttiḥ | anuvāde paribhāṣā'nupasthāne'pi nirddiṣṭaparibhāṣālabhyārthasiddhiśca | ata eveha parasminnityanuvarttate iti nyāsakāraḥ | dvirvacanena pratyayākṣepaṃ ṇijbhinnapratyayavyavahite jñāpakasyāpravṛttiṃ ca vadataḥ kaiyaṭasyāpyayamevāśaya iti | tanna | "yasminvidhiḥ" iti paribhāṣāpravṛtterdurlabhatvāt | nirddiṣṭaparibhāṣāpravṛttiṃ vinā tadarthasyānupapatteśca | tathā hi---amīṣāmiti nirdhāraṇe manuṣyatvasya pratiyogitāvacchedakatayā tadviṣayasyāpi manuṣyatvalābhāt, paraśabdasya cāvyavahitaparārthakatvāt tathā (artha---) lābhāt | prakṛte ca yadapekṣamavyavadhānaṃ tasya pratyayatvagrāhakābhāvāt | ūrṇunaviṣatītyarthaṃ tadbhāvabhāvitāmātreṇetyasyāvaśyamāśrayaṇīyatvācca | tathā hi---ūrṇoteḥ sani "sanivanta---" iti iṭi ca ūrṇu is iti sthite "vibhāṣorṇoḥ" iti ṅittvaviraheṇa guṇāvādeśau | "sanyaṅoḥ" iti sannantasya dvitvavidhāne'pi sano dvitvaprayojakatayā tasminkṛtayoḥ sthānivattvāt nuśabdasya dvitve abhyāse ukāraśravaṇam | atra hi iḍabhāve "iko jhal" iti sanaḥ kittvāpattyā guṇavirahāt iṭaḥ sanniṣṭhajhalāditvavighaṭakatvena guṇanimittatvam, avādeśe tu spaṣṭameva | dvitvanimittaṃ tu saneva, tatra viśeṣaṇāntarānupādānāt | tathā ca nimittakoṭāvapraviṣṭasyāpyacastatra vidyamānatvamātreṇa nimittatvamāśrityaiva tatra guṇādeḥ sthānivattvamiti | nanvevam aririṣatīti na syāt | ṛdhātoḥ sani "smipūṅ‌rañjvaśāṃ sani" iti iṭi guṇe ca tasya is‌śabdanimittakasya sthānivattve "ajāderdvitīyasya" iti iso dvitvaprasaktyā arīṣatītirūpaprasaṅgāt | ris ityasya dvitvaṃ tu tatreṣṭamiti cet | maivam | is‌śabdasya kāryitvena dvitvanimittatvābhāvāt | na hi kāryī nimittatayā''śrīyate | śayitarīti jñāpakāt | anyathā śīṅoṅittvena guṇaniṣedhāpatteḥ | na caivam ūrṇunaviṣatītyapi na syāt | sannantasya dvitvavidhyaviśeṣeṇa tatrāpi is ityasya dvitvanimittatvāsaṃbhavāditi vācyam | matvarthīyena ininā kāryopahitasyaiva nimittatvaniṣedhāt | ūrṇotau nuśabda eva pravṛttyā sano dvitvānupadhānāt | aririṣatītyatra tu riśabdasya dvitvabhāgitayā sano dvitvopahitatvamiti vaiṣamyāt | nanvevaṃ jeghrīyate dedhmīyate ityādāvapi ghrīy dhmīy ityāderdvitvabhāgitayā yaṅo dvitvanimittatvābhāvādevānatiprasaṅge tadvāraṇārthamacītyuktamiti bhāṣyavṛttyādigranthāḥ kathaṃ saṃgacchantāmiti cenna | 'anusvāro vyañjanaṃ ca akṣarāṅgam" ityasmādanantaraṃ "svarāntare vyañjanānyuttarasya" iti prātiśākhye sūtritatvāt ghrīya iti samudāye yakārasyottarāvayavatayā ghrī ityādereva dviruktiriti tadabhiprāyāt | yadi tu ṣāṣṭhavārttikabhāṣyarītyā "naṭabhāryāvadvyañjanāni" ityāśritya dvitīyaikājavadhikasya dvirvacanamāśrīyate tadā tu adhijage iti ajgrahaṇasya vyāvarttyaṃ bodhyam | "gāṅ‌ lliṭi" iti dvilakārakanirdeśamāśritya "lāvasthāyāmeva gāṅādeśavidhānam" iti bhāṣye uktatvāt | nanu vārtikamate liṭītyādīnāṃ parasaptamītvābhyupagamāt gāṅādeśasya paranimittakatve'pi bhāṣyakṛtā viṣayasaptamītvābhyupagamānnedamapi prayojanamiti cet, tarhi jagle ityādyudāharaṇam | aśiti pratyaye pare ātvavidhānāt | athānaimittikamātvaṃ śiti tu pratiṣedha iti vakṣyamāṇarītirāśrīyate tadā acīti nopādeyameva | atha bhaseḥ kvasau "ghasibhasorhali ca" ityupadhālope kṛte tasya sthānivattvaniṣedhārthamastu iti cet | atra kaiyaṭaharadattādayaḥ--- "tatra satyasati vā sthānivadbhāve na kaścidviśeṣaḥ psvānitirūpasāmyāt | na ca sati dvitve pakāradvayamiti vācyam | "dṛṣṭānuvidhiścandasi bhavati" iti siddhāntāt | bhāṣāyāṃ kvasurdurlabha eva upadhālopaśca chāndasa eva" iti | acītyetadeva rūpātideśe pramāṇam | kāryātideśe tu ghrī, gā, glā ityeṣāmeva dvitvena bhāvyamiti tatra sthānivadbhāvaniṣedhārthasya acītyasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt | rūpātideśasvīkāre tu ghrā, iṅ‌, glai ityeṣāṃ dvitvāpattau iṣṭarūpaṃ na sidhyatīti tatra sthānivadbhāvo mā pravarttiṣṭetyetadarthakatayā tatsārthakyam | taduktam---"ajgrahaṇaṃ tu jñāpakaṃ rūpasthānivadbhāvasya" iti | ajgrahaṇapratyākhyānapakṣe tu sthānivaditi śabdādhikāramāśritya sthānivatsūtre kāryātideśaparatvena niścitasthānivacchabdasya atra lakṣyānurodhāt rūpātideśaparatvaṃ kalpyam | pūrvasūtrādaca iti ṣaṣṭhyantamanuvartya tenādeśo viśeṣaṇīyaḥ | nanu aca ityādeśaviśeṣaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet na | śuśāvetyatra vṛddhyāvādeśayoriva samprasāraṇasyāpi sthānivattve śviśabdadvitve śiśāveti rūpaṃ mā bhūt | na ca "samprasāraṇaṃ tadāśrayaṃ ca kāryaṃ balīyaḥ" iti lāvasthāyāmeva tatpravṛttyā dvitvena saha samānanimittakatvameva neti vācyam | vyatiśuśuvāte ityādau doṣasya durvāratvāt | "vibhāṣā śveḥ" ityasya lāvasthāyāṃ pravṛttāvapi ījāte ījāthe ityādāvatiprasaṅgāt kittvasyādeśavidhyanantarapravṛttikatvāt | na ca tasyāpi lāvasthāyāmeva vidhirastviti vācyam | antaraṅgairādeśairbādhitatvāt | "svāpeścaṅi" iti samprasāraṇasya sthānivadbhāve "na samprasāraṇe samprasāraṇam" iti niṣedhāt aśūṣupat ityatrābhyāse uvarṇānupapatteśca | aca ityukte tu sup ityasyaiva
