| asyārthaḥ---"oḥ puyaṇ‌jyapare" iti sūtreṇa abhyāsokārasya ittvaṃ vidhīyate pavargayaṇ‌jakāreṣvavarṇapareṣu parataḥ | tatra yadyapi pipaviṣate yiyaviṣati ityatra pūṅo yauteśca sani "smipūṅ‌rañjvaśām---" iti, "sanīvante" iti ca iṭ‌ guṇāvādeśau dvitve karttavye "dvirvacane'ci" ityasya pravṛttyā abhyāse ukārasambhavāt tasya ittvavidhānena pakārayakārāṃśaḥ sārthaka eva, tathā'pi vargapratyāhārajakārāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ ṇau kṛtasyādeśasya sthānivattvaṃ jñāpayati | ādeśaviśiṣṭānāmeva dvitve'bhyāse uvarṇasyāprasiddheḥ | abhyāsākārasya "sanyataḥ" iti ittvasya siddheśca | tadvyatirekeṇa pavargayaṇ‌jakārāṇāmavarṇaparāṇāṃ durlabhatvāt | sani caiṣāmiṭo durlabhatvāt | abībhavat, amīmavat, alīlavat, arīravat, bibhāvayiṣatītyādi | tathā ca dvitvanimittasyāco ṇicā vyavadhāne'pi ṇijnimittakasyāpyajādeśasya sthānivadbhāve siddhe cukṣaāvayiṣatītyādikaṃ nirābādham | yenanāvyavadhānanyāyena dvitvanimittasyāco ṇijmātreṇa vyavadhānamāśrīyate na tu ninavanīyiṣatītyādau lyuṭ‌kyajādibhiriti nātiprasaṅgaḥ | ata eva `ṇau kṛtaṃ sthānivad‌' iti paṭhanti | nanvevamapyacikīrttadityatra ṇici kṛtasya ittvasyāpi sthānivattvaṃ syāt | maivam | avarṇapara eva hali sthānivattvānumānāt | tathā ca bhāṣyam---"tulyajātīyasya jñāpakam | kaśca tulyajātīyaḥ ? yathājātīyakāḥ puyaṇ‌jayaḥ | kathañjātīyakāścaite ? avarṇaparāḥ" iti | vārttikakārastu sūtrametatpratyācakhyau | tathāhi---ṣaṣṭhe dvitvaprakaraṇānte paṭhyate--- "dvirvacanaṃ yaṇāyavāyāvādeśāllopaṇilopopadhālopakikinoruttvebhyaḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhena" iti | asyārthaḥ---dadhyatretyādau sāvakāśo yaṇ‌, cayanaṃ cāyako lavanaṃ lāvaka ityādau āyādeśādayaścatvāraḥ, godaḥ kambalada ityādāvāllopaḥ, śleṣmaghna ityādāvupadhālopaḥ, kāraṇā hāraṇā ityādau ṇilopaḥ, nipūrttā ityādāvuttvaṃ ca | kiratītyādau "ṛta iddhātoḥ" itīttvasyāpyetadupalakṣaṇam | tena taturirityādikamapi setsyati | dvitvaṃ tu bibhidaturityādau sāvakāśam | tathā cobhayaprasaṅge pūrvavipratiṣedhāt dvitvaṃ teṣāṃ bādhakam | tena cakratuḥ, vivāya, lulāva, vivayitha, lulavitha, papatuḥ, jaghnuḥ, jagmatuḥ, āṭiṭat, taturirityādi siddham | na caivam iyaṅo'trānupādānānninyaturiti na syāditi vācyam | "prakalpya ca" iti nyāyena bhāvinaṃ yaṇamālocya pūrvamiyaṅ‌ na pravarttata ityuktatvāt | tasmānnārambhaṇīyametadvacanamiti | bhāṣyakārāstvāhuḥ--- vipratiṣedho'yamayuktaḥ, āllopādīnāṃ nityatvāt dvitvasyānityatvena tulyabalatvābhāvāt | athāpūrvo'yaṃ vācaniko vipratiṣedhastadā tadeva gauravam | api ca nityānāmivāntaraṅgāṇāmapi vacanena bādhāpattau ninavanīyiṣatītyādāvabhyāse ukāraśravaṇaṃ syāt | atha nityānāmevoktavacanaṃ vārakaṃ na tvantaraṅgāṇāmapi, tathā'pi cukṣāvayiṣatītyādau vṛddhyāderantaraṅgatvātpūrvaṃ pravṛttau tato dvitve abhyāsahrasve "sanyata" iti ittve ca ikārasya śravaṇaṃ syāt | tathā ca tad‌bādhanāya "utparasyātaḥ" "ti ca" ityuttaraṃ "odaudādeśasya cuṭutuśarādeḥ" iti vacanaṃ kalpyam | abhyāsasyetyanuvarttate | asyārthaḥ---ādautorādeśo yasminnaṅge tatsambandhī cuṭutuśarādiśca yo'bhyāsastasya yo'kārastasya utsyāditi | cukṣāvayiṣati, uḍuḍāvayiṣati, nunāvayiṣati, ūrṇunāvayiṣati, śuśāvayiṣati, pusphārayiṣati | yadyapyantye "śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ" iti pakāraśeṣe śarāditvaṃ nāsti tathā'pi abhyāsasañjñāpravṛttikāle tad‌ bodhyam | odaudādeśasya kim ? "cāyṛ pūjāyām" cicāyayiṣati | "khada sthairye" cikhādayiṣati | cuṭutuśarādeḥ kim ? bibhāvayiṣati | ataḥ kim ? ṛjum, ṛṇam, ṛtum, aṃśuṃ, vā, ākhyat ārjijat, ārṇiṇat, ārtitat, āṃśiśat | atra paratvād‌ vṛddhau ṭilope saṇic‌kasya dvitvaṃ mā bhūt | "abhyāsasya" ityanuktau tu cuṭutuśarāderiti aṅgasya ato vā viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt | tathā ca śītaṃ lunāti śītalūḥ sūryaḥ tamākhyātumicchati śiśītalayiṣatītyatra takārottarasyākārasya uttvaṃ syāt | tasmādvacanadvayamapi vārttikakṛtā paṭhanīyam | "oḥ puyaṇ‌jyapare" ityapi tathaiva | pipaviṣate yiyaviṣati jijāvayiṣatītyādau ittvaṃ yathā syāt | pū yu ityanayoḥ sani iṭi paratvād‌ guṇe pūrvavipratiṣedhenāvādeśātpūrvaṃ dvitvasya tanmate pravṛtteḥ | "jucaṅ‌kramya" ityatra nirdiṣṭaḥ sautro judhātuḥ | tasmāṇṇyantātsan | tatra cuṭutuśarāderityuttve prāpte tad‌bādhanāya ittvasya vaktavyatvāt | na ca ṭuṭutuśarāderityatra cuśabdasthāne cakāramātraṃ paṭhanīyam | tathāca nātrātiprasaṅga iti vācyam | guṅ‌ ghuṅ‌ dhvanau | ṇici caṅi tābhyāṃ, sani ca ajūgavat, ajūghavat, jugāvayiṣati, jughāvayiṣatītyāderasiddheḥ | evaṃ didavanīyiṣatītyatrāpi tavargāditvāduttvavāraṇāya vacanāntaramārambhaṇīyam | athavā "sanyata" ityasmānmaṇḍūkaplutyā sangrahaṇamanuvavartya yenanāvyavadhānanyāyena ṇijbhinnavyavadhāne uttvaṃ neti vyākhyeyam | nanvevamapi tanuśabdādācārakvibantāddhetumaṇṇau satyasati vā san titanāvayiṣati titanaviṣatītyatrāpyuttvaṃ syāt | maivam | abhyasasyāvayavaḥ odaudādeśasya tu yathāsambhavamavayava ādeśo vā yo'kārastasya utvamiti vārttikārthaḥ | cukṣāvayiṣatītyavayavaḥ | pusphārayiṣatītyādeśaḥ | titanāvayiṣatītyatra tu tadubhayābhāvānna doṣaḥ | evaṃ ca ata ityapi sārthakam | anyathā āṭiṭadityādau caṅ‌pare ṇau yadaṅgaṃ tadavayave laghau sanvadatideśāt ārjijadityādāvapi prasaṅgābhāvena tadvaiyarthyaṃ syāditi sūtrāpekṣayā vārttikamate mahāgauravamiti | syādetat | prakṛtasūtraṃ vārtikaṃ cetyubhayamapi māstu | "oḥ puyaṇ‌" ityeva jñāpakam | antaraṅgaṃ nityaṃ ca bādhitvā dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti dvitvānantaraṃ ca yathāsambhavaṃ yaṇādipravṛttiriti | atra kaiyaṭaḥ---jñāpakaṃ sāmānyāpekṣaṃ viśeṣāpekṣaṃ vā | nādyaḥ | acikīrtadityādau ittvaṃ bādhitvā pūrvaṃ dvitvapravṛttāvabhyāse akāraśravaṇāpatteḥ | nāntyaḥ | cakraturityāderasiddheḥ | tasmātsūtramāvaśyakam | tad‌viṣaye ca iṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ bhāṣyoktarītyā jñāpakamāśrayaṇīyamiti dik | atra vopadevena kāvyakāmadhenāvitthaṃ vyavasthāpitam---aṅkayateścaṅi ṇicamāśritya kṛtasya ato lopasya sthānivadbhāvāt kaśabdasya dvitve āñcakaditi rūpameke svīkurvanti tacca munitrayaviruddham | tathāhi---kiṃ "dvirvacane'ci" iti sthānivattvaṃ, jñāpakena vā | nādyaḥ | ṇico dvitvanimittatvābhāvāt | dvirvacanāvṛttyā dvitvanimittamacamāśritya kṛtasyaivājādeśasya sthānivattvamiti bhāṣyavārttikayoruktatvāt | nāntyaḥ---jñāpakasya sajātīyaviṣayakatvamāśritya avarṇapara eva hali sthānivattvamiti bhāṣya eva sthāpitatvāt | pūrvavipratiṣedhavārtikadūṣaṇaparabhāṣyaprāmāṇyādeva tathā lābhāt | āñcakadityādāvabhyāse akārasya bhāṣyasaṃmatatve hi tadarthamapi vārtikakṛtā yatnāntaraṃ kalpanīyamiti gauravamapyāpādayet | tadabhāvāttu jñāyate'bhyāse ikāra eva bhāṣyābhimata ityallopasya sthānivattvamanibhimatam iti | tasmādukārādeśa eva sthānivat | abhyāsātparasya avarṇaparahalastatraiva sambhavāditi siddham | yattu kāśikāyām "pūrvatrāsiddham" iti sūtre ūḍhaśabdāt ṇici caṅi aujaḍhadityudāhṛtya ktyantasya tu aujiḍhadityuktam | nyāsakṛtā ca ṇau kṛtasya ṭilopasya sthānivadbhāva iti vyākhyātam | sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇakāreṇa ca "ṇicyanit" iti sūtritam | tatsarvaṃ mahābhāṣyavisaṃvādānnirmūlam | itthameva durgaguptena durgaṭīkāyām, trilocanadāsena kātantrapañjikāyām, varddhamānamiśreṇa kātantravistare, hemasūriṇā haimavyākaraṇe, pradarśitam | etacca jñāpakamajantasyāpavargaparasyāvarṇa eveti vedi tavyamiti pradarśitam | abhinavaśākaṭāyanena ca śabdānuśāsane ṇinimittādapi prāgdviḥ taccāvarṇapare iti pradarśitam | tasmādāñcikat aujiḍhat ityeva sādhīyaḥ | tathaiva nandikṣīrasvāmyādibhirdhātupārāyaṇeṣūdāhṛtam--- śuṣkikā śuṣkajaṅghā ca kṣāmimānaujiḍhattathā | iti vaiyāghrapadyavārtike'pi ikārapāṭha eva sāṃpradāyikaḥ | śrotriyāstu pramādājjisthāne jaṃ paṭhanti | kṣemendreṇāpi jainendranyāse spaṣṭamevoktamiti | vaiyāghrapadyavārttikaṃ ca pūrvatrāsiddhamityasya prayojanābhidhānaparam | tathā hi---śuṣkiketyatra "udīcāmātaḥ sthāne yakapūrvāyāḥ" iti ittvavikalpo na bhavati "śuṣaḥ kaḥ" iti niṣṭhākatvasyāsiddhatayā kakārasyākārāt pūrvatvābhāvāt | evaṃ śuṣkajaṅghetyatra "na kopadhāyāḥ" iti puṃvadbhāvaniṣedhasya na pravṛttiḥ | kṣāmimānityatra "mādupadhāyāśca" iti vattvaṃ na bhavati, "kṣāyo maḥ" iti matvasyāsiddhatayā makārasyānupadhātvāt | aujiḍhadityatra ḍhatvasyāsiddhatvāt h‌ti ityasya dvitvam | atra vadanti | vopadevamahāgrāhagrasto vāmanadiggajaḥ | kīrtereva prasaṅgena mādhavena vimocitaḥ || tathā hi---kiṃ vāmanoktau vārttikadūṣaṇaparabhāṣyavirodhaḥ, kiṃ vā jñāpakasya sajātīyaviṣayakatvavarṇanaparabhāṣyavirodhaḥ ? | nādyaḥ | "nityānityayorvipratiṣedhānupapattiḥ, didavanīyiṣati ityādyasiddhiśca" iti dūṣaṇayorbhāṣye 'nuktatvāt dūṣaṇāntaropalakṣaṇaṃ bhāṣyamiti sthite aujaḍhat ityabhyāse akāraśravaṇārthaṃ so'pi vidheyaḥ syāt iti dūṣaṇāntarasyāpi vārttikopari deyatvāt | tadevaṃ vārttikaṃ racanīyam---"odaudādeśasya cuṭutuśarāderabhyāsasyotsani" tataḥ "allopavato ṇico't‌" | allopavato'ṅgasyābhyāsasya ṇico't syāt aujaḍhat āñcakat iti | na dvitīyaḥ | yatra dviruktau abhyāsottarakhaṇḍasya ādyo'javarṇastatra sthānivaditi bhāṣyasya phalitārthaḥ | asti ca h‌taśabdasya dviruktau prakriyādaśāyānuttaratrāvarṇaḥ | na ca punaḥ pravṛttena ṭilopenāpahārāt na tasya prayogasamavāya iti vācyam | prayogasamavāyitvasya bhāṣye'nuktatvāt | evaṃ ca nunāvayiṣatītyādau dvitvapravṛttivelāyāmavarṇābhāve'pi paścādbhāvinaṃ tamāśritya yathā sthānivadbhāvastathā h‌taśabdasya paścāttadvirahe'pi | tathā hi---avarṇaparatvaṃ dvitvapravṛttivelāyāṃ vivakṣitam uta pariniṣṭhite rūpe ? | nādyaḥ | cukṣāvayiṣati ityādāvabhāvāt | nāntyaḥ | āñcakat ityādau tadabhāvāt | tasmātprakriyādaśāyāmeva tadityavaśyamaṅgīkāryam | etena vopadevanyastā api granthā vyākhyātāḥ prakriyādaśāyāmavarṇaparatvasya vivakṣitatvāt, vāmanoktau tadvirodhābhāvāt | adyajīgapat ityatra tu sthānivattvapravṛttāvajāditvāt ṇica eva dvitvāpattyā ubhayatrāpyavarṇaparatvābhāvāt na sthānivattvam acikīrttat ityādivat | evaṃ satyuvarṇasthānikasyaivādeśasya sthānivattvamiti durāgraho nirmūla eva | ata eva "lopaḥ pibaterīccābhyāsasya" iti sūtre apīpyat ityatra pibaterṇau yuki caṅi upadhālope ca tasya sthānivattvāt pāy‌śabdasya dvitvamiti vṛttiḥ saṅgacchate | atredaṃ vaktavyam---sthānivadbhāvapravṛttivelāyām avarṇaparatvaṃ yatra halo'sti tatratya ādeśaḥ sthānivat iti bhāṣyābhiprāyo na tu tvaduktānyataratra gauravāt pramāṇābhāvācca | etena bhāṣyasya dūṣaṇopalakṣaṇatvāt "allopavato ṇico't‌" iti vacanārambho'pyāpādyatvenābhimata ityapāstam | vācanikavipratiṣedhaparatvena pravṛtte vārttike bhāṣyasya dūṣaṇopalakṣaṇatve pramāṇābhāvāt | nityānityayorvipratiṣedhānupapattiriti dūṣaṇasya prasiddhavipratiṣedhaparatvamātraviṣayakatvāt | yattu ukārādeśasyaiva sthānivattve acikīrttat ityatrātiprasaṅgaśahkābhāṣyamasaṅgataṃ syāt iti | tat tuccham | ṇici kṛtaṃ sthānivadbhavatīti yathāśrutārthabodhadaśāyāmeva tatpravṛtteḥ | siddhāntavirodhena śaṅkāyā asaṅgatyuktau śaṅkāmātrocchedāpatteḥ | anyatānyataratrāvarṇaparatvavādinastavāpi tadasaṅgaterduruddharatvāt | tatra prakriyādaśāyāmapyavarṇaparatvābhāvāt | etena prayogasamavāyitvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ bhāṣyānuktamiti nirastam | ūrṇunāvayiṣati ityādāvapi sthānivattvapravṛttidaśāyām avarṇasya halapekṣayā paratvāt | "kathaṃ jātīyakāścaite avarṇaparāḥ" iti bhāṣyokteśca | yuktaṃ caitat | avarṇaparapavargayaṇ‌jakāreṣu parato vidhīyamānamabhyāsokārasya ikārādeśavidhānaṃ hi sthānivadbhāvaṃ jñāpayati ityubhayasiddham | asti cātra sthānivattvapravṛttivelāyāṃ pavargādīnāmavarṇaparatvamiti yathoktārthalābhāt | ata eva "tulyajātīyasya jñāpakam" iti bhāṣyam | tena tulyajātīyasya sthānivattvamityarthāt tatpravṛttivelāyāmavarṇaparatvasya spaṣṭamevoktatvāt | prathamopasthitaṃ sthānivadbhāvamupekṣya dviruktāvabhyāsottarakhaṇḍasyādyo'javarṇa ityarthaparatve mānābhāvāt | evaṃ ca "allopavato ṇico't" iti vacanāpādanamapi dūrāpāstam | abhyāse'kārasya pramāṇasiddhatvābhāvena tadarthaṃ vacanārambhasya niṣphalatvāt | prakriyādaśāyām avarṇaparatvamityasya nyāsādyanabhimatatvācca | ata eva "stautiṇyoḥ" iti sūtre siṣecayiṣati ityatra sicerhetumaṇṇau guṇe sani iṭi guṇāyādeśayoḥ kṛtayoḥ guṇasya sthānivadbhāvāt sic‌śabdasya dvitvamiti nyāsakāreṇoktam | tatrottarakhaṇḍe akārābhāvena tvaduktarītyā aujaḍhat ityatratyatadgranthasya vyākhyātumaśakyatvāt | etena sico dvitvamiti nyāsasya bhāṣyavirodhādupekṣyatvamiti parāstam | aujaḍhat ityatrāpyallopasthānivattvasya bhāṣyaviruddhatayā svayameva prakriyādaśāyāmavarṇaparatvābhiprāyaṃ kalpayitvā vacanānarhatvāt | ata eva aujaḍhat ityādisiddhaye sāmānyāpekṣaṃ jñāpakamuktvā acikīrttat ityādyanurodhena tadanityatvaṃ sīradevena svīkṛtam | tasmātsāmānyāpekṣaṃ jñāpakamityeva vāmananyāsakārādīnāmabhiprāyaḥ na tu tvaduktaḥ | paraṃ tu "viśeṣāpekṣaṃ jñāpakam" iti bhāṣyavirodhādeva teṣāmanupādeyatvamityanyadetaditi rahasyam | ata eva adanteṣu ūna dhātormādhavīyadhātuvṛttau, "nonayatidhvanayati" iti sūtre kāśikāpadamañjaryyośca auninat ityabhyāse ikārapāṭhaḥ saṃgacchate | etena tatsarvaṃ lipipramādaprayuktameva | sthalāntarasthavāmanamādhavagranthaviruddhatvāt ityapi nirastam | bhāṣyasaṃmatārthasaṃvādina ikārapāṭhasyaiva vāmanāditātparyaviṣayatvāvaśyakatvena vaiparītyāt | nanvevam akārāntatvavaiyarthyamiti cenna | tad‌balena vṛddhau satyām ahkāpayati āñcīkapat ityādirūpābhyupagamāt | yadi tu citi ityādāviditkaraṇasya ṇijvikalpajñāpakatāyāḥ klṛptatvāt ihāpi tathaivetyāgrahastathāpi na kṣatiḥ | ṇijabhāvapakṣe anekāc‌tvāt ām, aṅkyāt ityādau "aniditām" iti upadhālopāpravṛttirityato'pi sārthakatānirvāhāt | yattu abhyāse akāraśravaṇārthatayā adantatvasārthakyamiti | taccintyam | ikārasyaiva tatra vyavasthāpitatvāt | atha sarvamate'pyabhyāse jakāraśravaṇānupapattiḥ "pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane" iti ḍhakārasyaiva siddhatvāt iti cenna | tasyānityatayā hratiśabda eva tatpravṛtterityāstāmativistaraḥ || iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau prathamasyādhyāyasya prathame pāde aṣṭamāhnikam | adarśanaṃ lopaḥ 54 | prasaktasyādarśanaṃ lopasaṃjñaṃ syāt | sthāne ityanuvṛtteḥ | na cādarśanaśabdasyaiveyaṃ saṃjñā syāt iti "lopo vyoḥ" ityādau sa evādeśaḥ prasajyetiti vācyam | mahāsañjñāsāmarthyāt arthasyaiva saṃjñitvāt | na ca pradeśeṣveva laukikalopaśabdārtho vijñāsyate paśurapatyam ityādāviveti saṃjñāsūtramanārabhyamiti vācyam | prasaktasyeti pratiyogiviśeṣalābhārthaṃ tadārambhāt | anyathā dadhi madhu ityādau kvipaḥ svābhāvikādarśanasattvena lopasaṃjñāyāṃ pratyayalakṣaṇena tuk syāt | tathā ca vārttikam | "siddhaṃ tu prasaktādarśanasya lopasaṃjñitvāt" iti | nanu vārttikamate tatsūtrasya vidhyarthatvāt astvevam | bhāṣyamate tu tanniyamārthaṃ sthānivatsūtreṇaiva kāryapravṛttiriti vakṣyate | na cātra tukastena prasaktiḥ | ṣaṣṭhīgrahaṇasya tatrānuvartitatvāt | ata eva grāmaṇīḥ ityādau arthopapadadhātusannidhānāt arthataḥ śāstrataśca aṇ‌prasaṅge kvipo vidhāne'pi vṛddhyādikaṃ na bhavati | tasmādidaṃ sūtraṃ nirrathakamiti cet | maivam | "cāhalopa evetyavadhāraṇam" "cādilope vibhāṣā" iti sūtrayoścādīnāmaprayogasyaiva lopapadārthatvātṣaṣṭhīnirddeśena lopavidhyabhāvāllopasaṃjñā'nupapattau `ayamevāraṇyaṃ gacchatu' `ayameva grāmaṃ gacchatu' ityādau tiṅantanighātaniṣedhasya `śuklā vrīhayo bhavanti' `śvetā gā ājyā duhanti' ityādau nighātaniṣedhavikalpasya cānupapatteḥ | sūtrārambhe tu tatra śāstratolokato vā tadaprasakterna doṣaḥ | na ca vārtikamate grāmaṇīrityatra vṛddhiḥ syāditi vācyam | kvipā aṇaḥ prasaṅgāpahārāt | viśeṣaśāstranirmukte eva sāmānyaśāstrasya pravṛtteḥ | "satsūdviṣa" iti kvipo viṣaye "karmaṇyaṇ‌" ityasya prasakterevābhāvāt | pratyayasya luk‌ślulupaḥ 60 | tantrāvṛttyādinā tadbhāvitānāmimāḥ saṃjñāḥ anekasaṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyāt | luk‌ślulup etaiḥ śabdaiḥ kṛtaṃ pratyayādarśanaṃ krameṇa tatsaṃjñaṃ syāt | na caivaṃ vidhipradeśeṣu itaretarāśrayāpattiḥ adarśanasya nityatve'pi lugādisaṃjñayā bhāvitatvasya tadabhāvena pūrvavat parihārāsambhavāt iti vācyam | bhāvisaṃjñāvijñānāt | pradeśāśca "luk taddhita" "juhotyādibhyaḥ śluḥ" "janapade lup‌" ityādayaḥ | lopasaṃjñāyāśca naitābhirbādhaḥ | ekasaṃjñādhikārāt | anyatra saṃjñānāṃ samāveśadarśanāt | ata eva "na lumatāṅgasya' iti niṣedhaḥ saṅgacchate | anyatā "pratyayalope" ityasya lugādiviṣaye prasakterevābhāvāt | syādetat | pratyayasyeti kimartham | `na tāvadapratyayanivṛttyartham | lugādividhau sarvatra pratyayasyaiva sthānivattvādaprasiddheḥ | anuvāde ca tadbhāvitasyaiva grahaṇāt | nanu "luk taddhitaluki" ityatra "gostriyoḥ" ityanuvṛttyā gośabdasyāpi lugāpattiḥ | yogavibhāgāt | "gorupasarjanasya" tataḥ "striyāḥ" | "luktaddhita" ityatra "striyāḥ" ityanuvarttate goḥ iti nivṛttam | anyathā pratyayagrahaṇe kṛte'pi gamerḍos‌pratyayasya luk syāt | "kaṃsīyaparaśavyayoḥ" ityatrāpi kaṃsīyaparaśavyayoḥ prātipadikātparasya luk vidhīyate | "ṅyāpprātipadikāt" ityadhikṛtatvāt | ataḥ prakṛtibhāgasya na lopaḥ | anyathā "kameḥ saḥ" kaṃsaḥ parān śṛṇāti paraśuḥ ityukārasakārayorlugāpatteḥ | na ca "atribhṛgukutsa" ityādau pratiyogiviśeṣasamarpaṇārtham | tatra "yaskādibhyo gotre" ityato gotrapadānuvṛtteratryādigotre yo vihitastasya lug‌vidhānāt | "janapade lup‌" ityatra prātipadikādhikārātpratyayānuvṛtteśca janapade vihitasya cāturarthikapratyayasya luk | "lavaṇālluk" ityatrāpi ṭhaka eva, prakṛtatvāt "tasmādityuttarasya" iti pañcamyā pratyaya ityetasya ṣaṣṭhyantatvakalpanāt | nanu "yañañośca" "supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ" ityādau lopapratiyogipratyayasyānekāc‌tvena "alo'ntyasya", "lavaṇālluk‌" ityādau ca "ādeḥ parasya" iti ādimātrasya lopo mā bhūditi sarvādeśārthaṃ pratyayagrahaṇam | maivam | lope prakṛte 'pi "lugvāduha" iti lugvacanasya sāmānyāpekṣajñāpakatayā lumatāṃ sarvādeśatvasiddheḥ | na ca lopa eva sarvādeśo lugādayastu "alo'ntyasya" iti vaiparītyaṃ syāditi vācyam | asañjātavirodhitayā lopasyāntyādeśatvasiddhau lugādīnāmeva sarvādeśatvakalpanāt | maivam | "āgastyakauṇḍinyayoragastikuṇḍinac‌" ityatra "lugaṇiñoḥ" ityato luggrahaṇamanuvarttate na vā ? | nādyaḥ | sthāninau dvau ādeśāstu lukā saha traya iti yathāsaṃkhyavirahe ekaikasyādeśatrayaprasaṅgāt | tataścāgastayo'ri kuṇḍināḥ syuḥ kuṇḍināścāgastayaḥ | luk ca jñāpakātsarvādeśastadā ubhayatrāpi vibhaktimātraṃ śrūyeta | nāntyaḥ | prakṛte siddhe'pi agastīnāṃ chātrā āgastīyā iti prāgdīvyatīye ajādau pratyaye vivakṣite'pyagastyādeśasya niṣedhābhāvāt pravṛttāvavṛddhatvāt chapratyayānupapatteḥ | iha pratyayagrahaṇe tu āgastyakauṇḍinyayoḥ pratyayāṃśasya luki pariśiṣṭabhāgayoryathāsaṃkhyamagastikuṇḍinacau ādeśāvityāgastayaḥ kuṇḍinā iti ca siddham | prāgdīvyatīyavivakṣāyāṃ tu gotre 'lugacīti luk‌pratiṣedhe tatsaṃniyogaśiṣṭāgastibhāvasyāpi nivṛttāvāgastyetyasya vṛddhatvāt che "sūryatiṣyāgastya" iti yalope āgastīyā iti siddham | kauṇḍinye tūbhayathā'pi na viśeṣa iti tatraiva vakṣyate | tasmāllugityasya tatrāvaśyamanuvarttyatayā pūrvadoṣaparihārāya pratyayagrahaṇamatrāvaśyakam | bhāṣyakṛtastu "pratyayalope" ityatra viśeṣaṇārtham, dvitīyagrahaṇamuttarārtham | tena samastapratyayalope eva pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ na tvekadeśalope | anyatā āghnīya, saṃrāyaspoṣeṇa mīya ityatra paratvādupadhālope punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānādanunāsikalopaḥ syādityāhuḥ haradattastu sarvādeśārthamapīdam, sāmānyena jñāpanasyāgatikagatitvāt ityāha iti dik | pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇam 61 | pratyaye lupte'pi tannimittakaṃ kāryaṃ syāt | tena atṛṇeṭ‌ ityatra tipo luptatve'pi "tṛṇaha im" iti halādipitsārvadhātukaṃ nimittīkṛtya imāgamaḥ | na cātra "sthānivat" ityanena gatārthatvam | viśeṣaṇatvenāpyalāśrayaṇe "anal‌vidhau" iti niṣedhasyā svīkārāt | varṇāśraye pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ nāsti ityasya tu nāyaṃ viṣayaḥ varṇaprādhānyamātre tatpravṛtteḥ | tathā hi prakṛtasūtre pratyayalope tallakṣaṇam ityevāstu, yadvā dvitīyabhāga eva mā'stu, sthānivat ityanuvṛttyā siddheḥ | tadupādānasāmarthyācca pratyayamātravṛttidharmo yatra nimittatāvacchedakastadeva kāryaṃ pratyayalope bhavati na tu gave hitam gohitam ityādāvavādeśaḥ, ac‌tvasya tatra nimittatāvacchedakasya pratyayāpratyayasādhāraṇyāt | yadyatra "nalumatā" iti niṣedhaḥ, tathā'pi suyaśā ityatra nisargasulopasya sthānivattve "vā śari" iti sakārādeśavikalpasya, suvṛḍ‌ ityatra "khari ca" iti cartvasya durvāratvam | imāgamavidhau tu sārvadhātukasya viśeṣyatayā tattvasya pratyayatvavyāpyatayā tatpravṛttau bādhakābhāvāt | halādāviti viśeṣaṇatayaiva varṇasya tatrāśrayaṇāt | etadarthasyaiva `varṇāśraye nāsti' ityatropanibaddhatvāt | ata eva dhinvikṛṇvyorvici "lopo vyoḥ" iti valope tasyānimittatvāt vastuto nimittatvasya pratyayavṛttitve'pi "na dhātulope" iti guṇaniṣedho na pravartate, ārddhadhātukatvasya tatra nimittatāyāmanavacchedakatvāt, val‌tvasya ca pratyayatvāvyāpyatvavirahāt | tena sudhe, sudhenau, sudhenaḥ, sukaḥ, sukarṇau, suvarṇa ityādi siddham | "hal‌ṅyābhya" iti sulope padatvāt "nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya" iti nalopaḥ | etena--- sudhe sudhevārivadhātsurāṇāṃ sukāraṇe lāghavataśca rāmaḥ | viśeṣaṇe dve ya ihādikarturvadedadhītī sa hi kaiyaṭīye || iti vyākhyātam | dhātorlopo yasminniti bahuvrīhiṇaiva siddhe ārddhadhātukagrahaṇasāmarthyāttatvena nimittatvalābhāt | na ca `totorti ityādivyāvṛttyā cāritārthyam, yaṅ‌lukaścāndasatvāt | bhāṣāviṣayatve'pi ārddhadhātukagrahaṇasyāvṛttyā dvitīyasya sāmarthyamiti bodhyam | "pūrvasminyoge yadārddhadhātukagrahaṇam tadanavakāśam" iti "ṅkiti ca" ityetatsūtrīyabhāṣyokteśca anāsthāmūlakatvād iti | idaṃ tu cintyam---ārddhadhātukagrahaṇāllopaguṇayorekavyaktinimittakatvamātramiṣyate na tvārddhadhātukatvāvacchinnanimittatvanirūpitakāryatvaparyantam | loluva ityādāvapi guṇaniṣedhānupapatteḥ | "yaṅo'ci ca" iti lope ac‌pratyayasya vastuta ārddhadhātukatve'pi ārddhadhātukatvasya nimittatānavacchedakatvāt | tasmādārddhadhātukatvavyāpyadharmāvacchinnanimittatvanirūpitakāryatvavivakṣaṇam | vyāpyaṃtvaṃ ca bhedābhedasādhāraṇam | ārddhadhātukānatiriktavṛttitvasyaiva dharme'bhimatatvāt | prakṛte tu val‌tvasya ārddhadhātukātiriktavṛttitvānna niṣedhapravṛttiriti sustham | uktabhāṣyasvārasyādatra vijeva na bhavati | kvipi tu ūṭhi kṛte dhinūḥ, dhinvau, dhinvaḥ, kṛṇūḥ kṛṇvau, kṛṇva ityādi | sudhī, sudhinau, sudhinaḥ, sukīḥ, sukṛṇau, sukṛṇaḥ ityādi tu na bhavati ityāhuḥ | `yaṅ‌luko bhāṣāviṣayatve ārddhadhākagrahaṇasyatotorti ityādau cāritārthyādāvṛttau ca mānābhāvāt guṇaniṣedhe sudhī, sudhinau, sudhinaḥ, sukīḥ, sukīrṇau, sukīrṇa ityapi bhavati' iti dīkṣitāḥ | nanu parivīrityatra kvipo lope tugdīrghayoranenaiva vidhānādekalakṣaṇatvādvipratiṣedhānupapattyā paratvāddīrghatvaṃ na syāt | maivam | vyapadeśātideśo hyayam, tataśca `kṛtpratyayaḥ' ityādivyapadeśo lope'tidiśyate, kāryaṃ tu tannibandhanaṃ tattacchāstraireva bhavati iti vipratiṣedhasiddheḥ | taduktam--- "sindhantu sthānisaṃjñā'nudeśādānyabhāvyasya" iti | svārthe ṣyaṅ‌ | ādeśasya sthānisaṃjñayā yo vyapadeśastasyānena vidhānādityarthaḥ | tasmādal‌vidhyarthamidam iti vārtikamatam | bhāṣyakṛtastvāhuḥ atṛṇeṭ‌ ityarthaṃ nedam | tatra halītyetasya nivṛtteḥ | na ca tṛṇahāni ityādāvativyāptiḥ | "nābhyastasyāci" ityasmād `aci na' ityanuvṛtteḥ | na cāśīrityatra "śāsa idaṅ‌haloḥ" ityetadartham | āśāsaḥ kvāvupasaṃkhyānātsiddheḥ | taddhi tavāpyāvaśyakam | tatra śāsimātragrahaṇe āśāsta ityādau mābhūditi niyamārtham, aṅ‌prakṛtibhūtasyaiva śāsaḥ sāhacaryādittvavidhau grahaṇe tu āśāste ityādāviva kvipyapi tasyāprasaktyā vidhyarthamiti paraṃ viśeṣaḥ | tasmātpratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇameva kāryaṃ na tu pratyayāpratyayasādhāraṇadharmāvacchinnanimittatvanirūpyakāryatvavadapi kāryamiti niyamārthamidam | tena śobhanā dṛṣado'sya sudṛṣatprāsāda ityatra suśabdātparasya mannantasyāsantasya cottarapadasya bahuvrīhāvādyudāttatvaṃ bhavatītyarthakena "sormanasī alomoṣasī" iti sūtreṇādyudāttatvaṃ na pravartate | kiṃ tu "nañ‌subhyam" ityantodāttatvameva | anyathā "supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ" iti jaso luki sthānivadbhāvenottarasyā'santatvānapāyāt | uktarītyā tu astvasya pratyayavyattiriktavṛttitvānna doṣaḥ | aninasmangrahaṇeṣu arthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣāyā apravṛtteḥ | evaṃ "atvasantasya" iti dīrgho 'pi na bhavatītyavadheyam | vārttikamate tūktadoṣavyāvṛttyarthaṃ yatnāntarārambhe gauravamiti | syādetat | niyamavidheritaravyāvṛttireva phalam | `vrīhīnavahanti' ityādau hyetavyatirekeṇāpi tuṣataṇḍulavibhāgarūpavaituṣyasādhanatvena dalanādivikalpitāvaghātasya prāptyā tatsādhāraṇaprāptāveva tātparye pākṣikaprāptipratiyoginaḥ sādhanāntarasya nivṛttiḥ | na cedameva niyamaphalam | aprāptāṃśaprapaṇarūpaniyamābhāve tadanupapatteḥ | tatsattve cārthādeva tatsiddheḥ | prakṛtavidhyabhāve ca sthānivadbhāvasya na pākṣikī prāptiriti cet | atrāhuḥ---parisaṃkhyāpyatra niyamapadena vyavahriyate | `pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyā' ityasya niyamatvena bhāṣye likhitatvāt | sā ca yadyapi doṣatrayavatī yathāśrutārthatyāgāt, pañcātiriktā na bhakṣyā iti parārthakalpanāt, prāptapañcanakhānyabhakṣaṇabādhācca | tathā'pyatra sāmānyaśāstrasyāpi pratyayalopasthalatātparyakatve śāstraprāptasyātyantabādhāsambhavātpratyayatvavyāpyadharmāvacchinnanimittatākasyāpi kāryasya vacanadvayaprāmāṇyādvikalpa eva syāt | pañcātiriktabhakṣaṇaṃ tu prāpakapramāṇasya rāgasya daurbalyādbādhyate iti vaiṣamyam | ataḥ sāmānyaśāstrasyoktakāryātiriktaviṣayakatvamavaśyaṃ kalpyam | ataḥ prāptabādharūpo doṣo nāsti | tena pratyayalakṣaṇasya tadbhinne, bhavatītyasya ca na bhavatītyatra tātparyātpratyayalakṣaṇātiriktaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ | na ca sthānivadityasyānenopasaṃhārāpattiḥ | tacchāstravaiyarthyāpatteḥ | "taṃ ca turddhā kṛtvā puroḍāśaṃ barhiṣadaṃ karoti" "āgneyaṃ caturddhā karoti" ityanayostu parasparopasaṃhārādvaiṣamyam | āgneyapadaṃ havirantarātpuroḍāśapadaṃ cānyadaivatyapuroḍāśādvyāvartyata iti | smṛtipurāṇādau tvavāntaravaktṛbhedānna sāmānyaśāstravaiyarthyam | ata eva `na aṅgulyā dantadhāvanaṃ kuryānna tarjanyā' ityādāvekavaktṛkavākye nopasaṃhāraḥ kiṃ tudoṣādhikyakalpanameveti dik | atha tathā'pi pañcetyatra pratyayalakṣaṇena padatvaṃ samāsatvātprātipadikatvam, "snukramoḥ" iti iṭ‌, "ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi" iti ṣaṣṭhī ityādigranthānāṃ kā gatiḥ, itaravyāvṛttāveda tātparyāt sāmānyaśāstrasyaiva tadvidhāyakatvāt iti cet | atrāhuḥ--- ubhayaprāptāviti pariśeṣitā ṣaṣṭhī ityādi vyākhyeyam na tu vihiteti | ata eva "ubhayaprāptau karmaṇīti pratiṣedhe 'kādiprayoge'pratiṣedhaḥ" iti vārttikakṛtā tatsūtrasya pratiṣedhatvamevoktam na tu vidhitvam | yadvā, sāmānyaśāstrasya viśeṣe tātparyābhāvasyobhayakalpyatvāt pratyayalakṣaṇetyādikaṃ yathāśrutamevāstu | asya ca prayojanāpekṣāyāṃ pratyayalakṣaṇātiriktakāryavyāvṛttiḥ phalataḥ siddhyati | yathā "imāmagṛbhṇan raśanāmṛtasyetyaśvābhidhānīmādatte" iti pratyakṣavidhiḥ liṅgakalpyavidhyapekṣayā pūrvapravṛttikatvāt apūrvavidhireva | tāvanmātrasya ca laiṅgikavidhinaiva siddhatvādetadvaiyarthyāpattyā gardabhābhidhānīvyāvṛttiḥ phalaṃ kalpyate | taduktam--- aprāptavidhirevāyamato mantrasya niścitaḥ prayojanaṃ vidheḥ kiṃ syādasyeti tu nirūpaṇe || na gardabhābhidhānītaḥ phalamanyannivarttanāt | na cātra viṣayāntarārthaṃ sthānivatsūtrasyāvaśyakatvānna pratyayalopasūtrasya tadapekṣayā prathamapravṛttiḥ pratyakṣatvāviśeṣāditi vācyam | tathā'pi sthānitvādeśatvābhyāṃ tattatsthānyādeśānāmanugame'pi vastutasteṣāṃ bhinnatvāt yāvat pratyayatallopayorupasthityā sāmānyaśāstrasya pratyayalopaparatvaṃ labhyate tāvat pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇamityanena viśeṣadharmaprakārakabodhajananātprathamapravṛttau bādhakābhāvāt | etāvānparam viśeṣaḥ---tatra laiṅgikavidhikalpanameva pratibadhyate prakṛte tu sāmānyaśāstrasya pratyayalopaviṣayakatvamātramiti | asmiṃstu pakṣe pūrvoktagranthā yathāśrutā eva yojyāḥ | etena niyamasūtrāṇāṃ niṣedhamukhena vidhimukhena vā pravṛttiriti pakṣadvayaṃ vyākhyātam | na lumatā'ṅgasya 63 | lumatā luk‌ślulupāmanyatamena śabdena kṛte pratyayādarśane tannimittamaṅgakāryaṃ na syāt | gargāḥ, mṛṣṭaḥ, juhutaḥ | yañ‌śaporlumatā lopāttannimittau vṛddhiguṇau na | lumatā kim | kāryate, hāryate | "ṇeraniṭi" iti ṇilope ṇyapekṣā, amārṭ‌, nityatvāddhalṅ‌yādilope'pi mṛjervṛddhiśca yathā syāt | aṅgasyeti kim | pañca, sapta | atra pratyayalakṣaṇena subantātvātpadasaṃjñā yathā syāt | atrāṅgaśabdasya svaritatvādaṅgādhikāravihitameva kāryaṃ niṣidhyata iti vārttikakṛt | bhāṣyakṛtasttvāhuḥ---evaṃ sati ut‌krāmetyatra "ato heḥ" iti herluki "kramaḥ parasmaipadeṣu" iti dīrghaḥ, jigamiṣa ityatra "gameriṭ parakmaipadeṣu" itīṭ‌, vivṛtsetyatra "na vṛdbhyaścaturbhyaḥ" itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaśca na syāt | eṣāmaṅgādhikārīyatvāt | ato'ṅgādhikārīyaṃ tadbahirbhūtaṃ vā bastuto'ṅgasya yat kāryaṃ tatrāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ | nacāṅgakāryamātraniṣedhe'pyuktadoṣatādavasthyam | lopapratiyogiparasmaipadanirūpitāṅgasaṃjñāyāḥ krametiśabantamātravṛttitvāt dīrghasya ca śabnirūpitāṅgatvaśālinaḥ kramereva vidhānāt | evamuttaradvaye'pi | tathā ca yatpratyayanirūpitaṃ yasyāṅgatvaṃ tatpratyayasya sthānivattvamāśritya tannimittaṃ kāryaṃ tasya na bhavatītyarthaḥ phalitaḥ | atha pakṣadvaye'pi "ñnityādirnityam" "kitaḥ" "pathimathoḥ sarvanāmasthāne" iti vihitāḥ svarā luki kṛte'pi durvārāḥ | tathā ca gargāḥ, vidāḥ | yañañorluk" | uṣṭragrīvā | "ive pratikṛtau" iti kano "devapathādibhyaśca" iti lup | tatra "ñniti" ityādyudāttaṃ syāt | asaṃjñāyāṃ cedam | saṃjñāyāṃ tu "saṃjñāyāṃ tu "saṃjñāyāmupamānam" ityādyudāttasyeṣṭatvāditi kaiyaṭaḥ | atrerapatyānyatrayaḥ | "itaścāniña" iti ḍhak‌ | tasya "atribhṛgukutsa" iti luk | tatra kitastaddhitasyetyantodāttatvaṃ syāt | pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā taddhitāntasya tadvidhānāt | na ca phiṭ‌svareṇa tatrāntodāttatvaṃ durvāram | "rāśadibhyāṃ trip‌" "adestriniśca" ityuṇādisūtreṇātriḥ atrī iti ca rūpadvayasiddheḥ | tatra pratyayasya pittvādanudāttatve śeṣanighātena ikārāntasyātriśabdasyādyudātatvam | nāntasya nitsvareṇāntodāttatvamityabhyupagamāt | "atreriva śṛṇutam" ityatra, "atrīṇāṃ stomamadrivaḥ" iti luki cādyudāttaprayogācca | panthāḥ priyo yasya sa pathipriyaḥ | "supodhātu" iti luki pathimathorityādyudāttatvaṃ ca syāt | eṣāmaṅgādhikārīyatvābhāvāt | vastuto'ṅgakāryatvābhāvācca "suptiṅantam" iti padasaṃjñāyā iva uktasvarāṇāṃ pratyayāntakāryatvābhāvāt | aṅgatvasya tu pratyayāntāvadhikapūrvabhāgamātravṛttitvāt | nanu "kita" iti mā'stvaṅgakāryam, itarad dvayaṃ tu saptamīnirdeśādvastuto'ṅgasya kāryaṃ bhavatyeveti bhāṣyamate kathaṃ tatprasaktiriti cenna | sauvaryaḥ saptamyastadantasaptamya iti svīkārāt ñnidantasyāderudātta ityarthāt | tatra ca jñāpakaṃ "bhīhrībhṛhumadajanadhanaharidrājāgarāṃ pratyayātpūrvaṃ piti' iti pūrvagrahaṇam | anyathā piti pare vidhīyamānasya pūrvakāryatvasiddhyā tadvaiyarthyāt | ata eva "upottamaṃ riti"iti udāttatvam `āhavanīya' ityādau ridantasyopottame pratyayasyaiva īkāre pravarttate natu prakṛtibhāgasyopottame ikārākāre | evaṃ "caṅyanyatarasyām" ityapi caṅanta | eveti siddhāntaḥ | na caivaṃ "caturaḥ śasi" ityudāttatvaṃ śasantasyaiva syāt | tathā ca "ṣaṭ‌triṃśāṃśca caturaḥ kalpayanta" iti madhyodāttapāṭhavirodha iti vācyam | śas‌grahaṇasāmarthyāttadantabādhāt | anyathā "ūḍidampadādi" iti sūtra eva catur‌śabdaṃ brūyāt | tatrāsarvanāmasthānagrahaṇānuvṛttyā'natiprasaṅgāt | na ca ābhyāmityādau taddoṣaḥ | "ṣaṭ‌tricaturbhyo halādiḥ" iti tatrodāttatvasyaiva siddhānte'pīṣṭatvāt | na caivaṃ svāravidhau ṣaṣṭhīnirddeśasyaivāpattiḥ, rita ityādāvarddhamātrādhikyāditi prāpte vārtikam--- "lumati pratiṣedhe ekasvarasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ, sarvāmantritasij‌luk‌svaravarjaṃ, prayojanaṃ ñnitikilluk‌svarāḥ, pathimathoḥ sarvanāmasthāne luk" iti | ayamarthaḥ---pratyayalakṣaṇena prāpto'pyekapadasvaro na bhavati | "sarvāmantritasijluk‌svaravarjam" iti vacanamārabhyamityarthaḥ | padadvayāśrayastu bhavatyeva | yathā dadhi tiṣṭhatītyatra "padasya" "padād" ityadhikārīyaḥ "tiṅ‌ṅatiṅaḥ" iti nighātaḥ | dadhītyasya padasaṃjñārthaṃ pratyayalakṣaṇasyāpekṣyatvāt | evam `iha tiṣṭha' ityādi bodhyam | sarvādiparyudāsaḥ kim | `sarvastomo'tirātraḥ' ityatra "sarvasya supi" ityādyudāttatvam, `sarpirāgaccha' `sapta āgacchata' ityatra "āmantritasya ca" iti ṣāṣṭhādyudāttatvam, `mā hi dātām' ityatra "ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām" ityādyudāttatvaṃ ca yathā syāt | nacādye 'bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā" ityata eva siddham "svāṅgaśiṭāmadantānām" iti sarvaśabdasyādyudāttatvāditi vācyam | "sarvasya supi" ityasya pravṛttiṃ vinā "bahuvrīhau" prakṛtyā" ityanena vyavasthāpyatvāt | sarpiḥ śabdasyāpi vyutpattipakṣe pratyayasvareṇa, avyutpattipakṣe'pi phiṭ‌svareṇāntodāttatvāt | "nabviṣayasya" ityādyudāttasya na pravṛttiḥ | "anisantasya" iti paryudāsāt | `ghṛtādipāṭhādantodāntatvam' iti kaiyaṭaḥ | tattu avyutpattipakṣābhiprāyam | nanu saptaśabdaḥ "sapyaśūbhyāṃ tuṭ‌ ca" iti kaninantatvāt ādyudāttaḥ, avyutpattipakṣe'pi "nraḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ" iti tathaiveti cenna | ghṛtāditvāt antodāttatvāt | sapta yuñjati rathamekacakramiti tatprayogācca | tasmātsvaratrayanivṛttiḥ prayojanamityarthaḥ | "gātisthā" ityatra sijgrahaṇasāmarthyāt talluki svarasiddhiḥ | anyathā clereva lukaṃ vidadhyāt abhūt, apāt ityādisiddhaye | "astisico" ityatra sakārāntarapraśleṣasyāpyevaṃ parityāgasambhavāt | na caivam "ātaḥ" iti sūtraṃ vidhyarthameva syāt na tu niyamārtham, tathā ca laṭo nivṛttaye clilukīti vaktavyatvāpattyā gauravaṃ viparītamiti vācyam | "ṅitaḥ" ityanuvṛttyaiva laṭonivṛtteḥ | tasmātsij‌luk‌svarasyoktarpayudāse bhedapratiyogitvena niveśo na kārya iti | ṣaṣṭhe tu jñāpakena samāhitam | tathā ca "saṃjñāyāmupamānam' iti sūtre vārtikam--- "upamānasyādyudāttatvavacanaṃ jñāpakamanubandhalakṣaṇe svare pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhasya" iti | anyathā cañceva cañcā, vardhrikeva vardhrikā | saṃjñārthasya kano "lummanuṣye" iti lub | tatra pratyayalakṣaṇena nitsvareṇaiva tatsiddherityādyudāttavacanamuktārthajñāpakameva | na ca "na lumatā'ṅgasya" iti pratiṣedhaḥ | aṅgādhikārabahirbhāvāt | nidantasyāderityarthād, vastuto'ṅgakāryatvābhāvācca | "pathimathoḥ" iti svarapratiṣedhavacanaṃ tu karttavyameva | tasyānubandhalakṣaṇatvābhāvāt uktajñāpakena durvāratvāt | na ca jñāpakasya svaramātraviṣayakatvaṃ kalpyam | āmantritasijluk‌svarayorasiddhiprasaṅgāt | na ca saptamīnirddiṣṭe svare pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedho jñāpyaḥ | `sarvastomaḥ' ityādyudāttānupapatteḥ | yadvā saptamīnirddiṣṭasvare pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ na bhavatīti jñāpyam | "sarvasya supi" ityatra saptamīmapanīya supa iti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ pāṭhyam | atra vadanti | jñāpakaṃ dvedhā sāmānyāpekṣaṃ viśeṣāpekṣaṃ ca | yadi "bhahrī" ityatra pūrvagrahaṇena saptamyarthapakṣe tadantagrahaṇapakṣe ca yatra phalabhedastatraiva "sauvaryaḥ saptamyastadantasaptamya" iti jñāpyate | tatra hi pūrvagrahaṇābhāve tadanta evodāttaḥ syāt | saptamyāśrayaṇe tu pitaṃ vihāya bhīprabhṛtīnāmevodātta iti phale bhedaḥ | evaṃ "upottamaṃ riti" "caṅyanyatarasyām" ityādau bodhyam | "ñnityodirnityam" "pathimathoḥ sarvanāmasthāne" ityādau tūbhayathā'pi prakṛtyāderevodāttatvamiti na kaścidbhedaḥ | ato nātra tadantasaptamītvam | ato vastuto'ṅgasya kāryaṃ bhavatyeveti "na lumatā'ṅgasya" iti pratiṣedhapravṛttyā na citsvarādyāpattiriti | prakṛtasūtrasthabhāṣyakaiyaṭasvaraso'pyevam | ṣāṣṭhatadgranthāstu sāmānyāpekṣajñāpakābhiprāyā iti dik | `atraya' ityatrāpi noktasvarāpattiḥ, taddhitasyaiva kito'ntodāttavidhānāt | atra ca tasya luptatvāt | pratyayalakṣaṇasyānyadīyakāryasyaiva pratyayalope'pi vidhānāt | pratyayasya tu yatkāryaṃ tasya tallope'nupapatteḥ | ekanirūpitayornimittatvakāryitvayorekasminnasambhavāt | na ca tadapi pratyayāntasyaiva kāryamiti vācyam | na hi pratyayagrahaṇe tadantasyeti svatantraṃ vacanam kiṃ tu viśeṣaṇaṃ tadantasya saṃjñetyetadarthamūlakam | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve ca kāmacārāt tatra pratyayasya viśeṣaṇatvānaṅgīkārāt | lopasyābhāvarūpatayā antasya tadudāttasya ca bādhātsthānivatsūtrasyāpyapravṛtteḥ | `rājapuruṣa' ityādāvapi nāllopaḥ | vastuto yadaṅgamiti vyākhyānādbhasaṃjñāniṣedhāt subantatvapravṛttapadasaṃjñayā ca nakārasya lopāt | `ahardadāti' ityatra repho'pi siddhaḥ | "asupi" iti niṣedhasya vastuto'ṅgakāryatvena sublukyapravṛtteḥ | na ca vārttikamate doṣo durvāraḥ | `ahno ravidhau' iti vacanārambhāt | na ca "asupi" iti vacanasya sāmarthyātpratyayalakṣaṇaṃ nāstīti vācyam | `dīrghāhā nidāghaḥ' iti halṅyādilope'pi rephāpatteḥ | etena "asupi" iti paryudāsaḥ, `ahardadāti' ityatra dādhātoḥ subbhinnasya sattvāt repha iti parāstam | na ca rūtvaratvayorasiddhatayā durbalatvātpūrvaṃ nalopāt akārasyaiva rutvaratvayorāpattiḥ | tadubhayāramyasāmarthyāt tadviṣaye nalopavirahāt | akārasya rephe rutve vā viśeṣābhāvāt | na ca `ahargaccha' `he dīrghāho nidādha' ityatra tadārambhaḥ caritārthaḥ, tatra nalopaniṣedhāditi vācyam | tathā 'pi "rūparātri" iti rutvavaiyarthyāt | na caitadapi sambuddhau caritārtham | "ahan" ityāvartya ekena nalopābhāvo nirūpyate, dvitīyena ca rutvaṃ vidhīyate iti vyākhyānāt | syādetat | paramavācā, paramagoduhā, paramalihā, paramadaṇḍinā, paramadivā, paramakumāryā, ityatrāntarvartivibhaktinibandhanāyām uttarapadasya padasaṃjñāyāṃ "coḥ kuḥ" "dāderdhātatorghaḥ" "hoḍha" "na lopaḥ prātipadikāntasya" "diva ut‌" "iko'savarṇe śākalyasya hrasvaśca" ityeteṣāṃ pravṛttiḥ syāt | na ca bhasaṃjñayā bādhaḥ | bhinnāvadhikatvāt | samastapadasya bhasaṃjñā uttarapadamātrasya tu padasaṃjñeti | atra bhāṣyam---bhasaṃjñāyāṃ subantamityanuvartyam | tathā ca yajñādāvasarvanāmasthāne pare yasmātpratyayavidhistathābhūtaḥ pūrvasamudāyo bhasaṃjñaḥ, tadavayavasubantasadbhāve tu tadapi bhasaṃjñaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | pradhānaśiṣṭā ca bhasaṃjñā rājña ityādau subantāvayavābhāve'pi pravarttata eva, "kurttuḥ kyaṅ‌ salopaśca" iti haṃsāyate ityādāviva | nacaivamapi sarvanāmasthāne doṣo durvāraḥ tatra "asarvanāmasthāne" iti padatvaniṣedhāt | tatrāpi subantamityanuvṛtteḥ pratiṣedhasāmarthyācca "anantarasya vidhirvā" ityasya na pravṛttiḥ | "sarvanāmasthāne pare pūrvasamudāyastadavayavabhūtaṃ subantaṃ ca padasaṃjñaṃ neti tadarthaḥ | samudāyasya "svādiṣu" iti, avayavasya tu subantamiti prāptāyāḥ padasaṃjñāyā niṣedhāt `paramavācau' ityādi siddham | na caivaṃ `suvāk' `surājā' ityādau kutvanalopādikaṃ na syāt, samudāyāvayayordvayorapyuktarītyā padasaṃjñāniṣedhāt iti vācyam | "asarvanāmasthāne" ityatra "yaci bham" iti sūtrāt yacītyapakṛṣya ajādau sarvanāmasthāne padatvaniṣedhāt sau padasaṃjñāsadbhāvāt | na caivaṃ śrūyamāṇe'pi sau pūrvasya padasaṃjñāpattiḥ | iṣṭatvāt | tasmātsamāsacaramabhāgasyājādau supi na kvacitpadasaṃjñeti siddhaṇ | na caivaṃ `dūrānmuktaḥ' ityādāvaluk, `hotāpotārau' ityādāvanaṅ‌ ca na syāt uttarapade tadvidhānāditi vācyam | uttarapadaśabdasya samāsacaramāvayave rūḍhatayā tatra padasaṃjñā'napekṣaṇāt | na caivamapi `dadhisecau' ityādau "sātpadādyoḥ" iti ṣatvaniṣedho na syāditi vācyam | padādādiḥ padādiriti vyākyānāt | padottaratve sati śabdāntarasyādiriti yāvat | na ca rāmeṣu ityādāvapi niṣedhāpattiḥ | "svādiṣu" iti yā padasaṃjñā tāmādāyoktaniṣedhasyāpravṛtteḥ | tatra ca sātigrahaṇasyaiva jñāpakatvāt | yuktaṃ cedam | padasyādiriti vyākhyāne `dadhisecau' ityādau ṣatvasya durvāratvāt | "gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpatteḥ" iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | na ca bahusecau ityādau ṣatvāpattiḥ bahucaḥ pratyayatvenāpadatvāditi vācyam | bahucaḥ parasya neti vacanasyārabhyatvāt | tathā hi padāt ityeva vācyam | padātparasya sasya ṣatvaṃ na syādityarthaḥ | ādipadasthāne ca bahuc prakṣepyaḥ bahucaḥ parasya sasya na ṣatvamiti | vārtikakṛtā tu "paramavācā' ityādisādhanāya bahuvacanamevārabdham | tadāha--- "uttarapadatve cāpadādividhau" iti | uttaretyanenottarapadaṃ gṛhyate | tasya padatve iti samāsaḥ | samāsacaramāvayavasya padasaṃjñāyāṃ karttavyāyāṃ lumatā lupte pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ na bhavati | `dadhisecau' ityādāvapi padasaṃjñāniṣedhavāraṇāya apadādividhāviti | padādividhau tu karttavye bhavatyeva pratyayalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca prāk subutpatteḥ samāso'tra nābhidheyaḥ | `dhanakrītā' ityādisiddhaye tadanityatvasvīkārāt | kaiyaṭastu nāyamupapadasamāsaḥ kiṃ tu `dadhnaḥ secau' iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, anabhidhānācca sopapadānna vic, ato `dadhiṣecau' ityādeḥ nāpattirityāha | evamapi "bahucpūrvasya ca" iti vacanaṃ kāryameva, bahuci kṛte viśiṣṭasyārthavattvātprātipadikatvātsupo luki punarviśiṣṭātsubantarotpattervakṣyamāṇatvāt antarvartivibhaktyā padasaṃjñāmāśritya kutvaṃ mā bhūt iti | atra vadanti---"pratyayalopa" iti sūtra eva `uttarapadatve ca padādividhau' `bahucpūrvasya' iti paṭhanīyam | padādividhāveva pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ na tu padāntavidhau iti niyamārthaṃ cedaṃ vākyadvayam | evaṃ ca nañ‌parityāgāllāghavam | evaṃ ca sāvapi padam ityapi nāsti | pūrvoktaprakārasyānādaraṇāt | ata eva halṅyādisūtre bhāṣyam--- `atha sāvapi padaṃ bhavati | evamapyubhayataḥ spāśā rajjuḥ' iti | `abhūvan' ityatra jus na bhavati | āta ityasya niyamārthatvāt | na ca devadattaṃ yājayāñcakāra ityatra lukaṃ bādhitvā paratvāt tibādiṣu "āmaḥ" iti teṣāṃ luki pratyayalakṣaṇena tiṅantatvāt āmantasya nighātastataḥ parasya nighātaniṣedhaśca syāditi vācyam | yenanāprāptinyāyena lāvasthāyāmeva tibādīn bādhitvā luk‌pravṛtteḥ | taduktam--- `āmi lilopāt tasya cānighātastasmācca nighāt' iti | na ca devadatto yuṣmatputra ityādau ṣaṣṭhyantasya vihitā yuṣmadasmadorādeśāḥ syuriti vācyam | sthagrahaṇena śrūyamāṇāyāṃ vibhaktāveva tadvidhānāt | "samaye tiṣṭha sugrīva" ityādau samayaṃ mā hāsīrityarthāvagamāt tiṣṭhaterahānau vṛtteḥ | na ca vibhaktiviśiṣṭayoreva vasnasādi na tu prakṛtibhāgamātrasyetyarthaṃ sthagrahaṇamiti vācyam | ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyānāmiti nirdeśenāpi tatsiddheḥ | atha "ciṇo luk" iti talope kṛte `avadhi bhavatā dasyuḥ' `agāyi bhavatā grāmaḥ' `adhyagāyi bhavatā anuvākaḥ,' ityādau "hano vadha liṅi" "luṅi ca", "iṇo gā luṅi", "iṅaśca" | "vibhāṣā luṅ‌lṛṅoḥ" iti haniṇiṅgādeśā na syuriti cenna | luṅi yadārddhadhātukaṃ tasminviṣaye teṣāṃ vidhānāt lādeśātprāgeva teṣaāṃ pravṛtteḥ | tasmādvastuto'ṅgasya kāryaṃ na bhavatīti siddhāntaḥ | aco'ntyādi ṭi 64 | nirddhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī | jātāvekavacanam | acāṃ madhye yo'ntyo'c‌ tadādi śabdasvarūpaṃ ṭisaṃjñam | pradeśāḥ "ṭita ātmanepadānām" ityādayaḥ | antya ādiryasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ | nityasāpekṣatvātsamāsaḥ | yatra tu halantastatra tadviśiṣṭasyaiva saṃjñā | tena kurute ityādāvakārasya, kurvāte ityādau ca ākāramakārayoretvam | alo'ntyātpūrva upadhā 65 | antyādalaḥ pūrvo varṇa upadhāsaṃjñaḥ | "pugantalaghūpadhasya ca" iti ikārasya guṇaḥ | nanu pūrvasyāvadhyanavacchinnasyaivopādānāt śāsa ityatra śakārākārasamudāyasyaivopadhāsaṃjñā syāt | samudāyāvayavasannidhau ekājdvirvacananyāyena samudāyasyaiva kāryitvāt | tathā ca "śāsa idaṅ‌haloḥ" itīttvaṃ samudāyasyaiva syāt iti cenna | pūrvapadasyotsargato'vyavahitapūrvaparatvāt | samudāyasaṃjñāyāmapi "alo'ntyasya" iti paribhāṣayā 'natiprasaṅgācca | atha "nānarthake'lontyavidhiranabhyāsavikāre" iti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, śabdasyāvṛttirna tu arthasyetyabhyāsasyānarthakatvāt "bhṛñāmit" ityādeḥ sarvādeśatvavāraṇāya anabhyāsetyuktam | vikāraśca bhāvātmaka eva, tena dehi ityatra abhyāsalopaḥ sarvādeśa eveti | maivam | "tasya lopa" iti sūtre ñiṭuḍūnāṃ sarvalopārthaṃ "tasya" iti padopādānādetasyāḥ sūtrānabhimatatvāt | bhāṣyakṛtā'pi tatprayojanānāmanyathopapāditatvāt | tathā hi "avyaktānukāraṇasya" iti pararūpaṃ tāvadantyasya na bhavati | "nāmeḍitasyāntyasya tu vā" iti jñāpakāt | anyathā''mreḍitasya vetyeva brūyāt | "ghvasoreddhau" ityatrāpi lopagrahaṇānuvṛttāvapi punarlopagrahaṇasāmarthyāt sarvādeśaḥ | tathācaivaṃ sūtraracanā "ghorabhyāsasya lopohau" | vyākhyātam | "aseścait" asterghośca edbhavati hau pare ityarthaḥ | yadvā lopas‌ś‌ iti chedaḥ | saṃjñāyāṃ śakārānubandhasya prayojanābhāvādādeśe saṃjñini sarvādeśatvapravṛttiḥ | "dviśakārako nirddeśa" iti bhāṣyam | tatra lopa iti bhinnaṃ padam | lopaśabdasya kṛdantasya saṃjñinā'rthenārthavattvādvibhaktau kṛtayāṃ śakāraḥ pratinirddiśyate | tasya copadeśa eva itsajñāyāṃ sarvādeśo lopaḥ sampadyate | na ca jhali pare yaḥ saṃyogastadāditvātsorlope ekaśakārakapāṭhenaiva jhali pare yaḥ saṃyogastadāditvātsorlope ekaśakārakapāṭhenaiva nirvāha iti vācyam | spaṣṭārthaṃ na tallopa iti bhāvāt | ata eva "ana upadhālopinaḥ" ityādāvallopo na kṛtaḥ | yadvā "jhalo jhali" itivat nimittikāryiṇorekapadasthatva eva "skoḥ" ityasya pravṛttiḥ | na ca `ābhyām' ityādau "hali lopa" iti akakārasya idama ido vihitasya lopasyāntyapratiyogikatvāpattirdurvāreti vācyam | "anāpyakaḥ" ityasmāt `an‌' ityanuvṛttyā halīti saptamyā an ityatra ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpya ana eva lopavidhānāt, alo'ntyaparibhāṣayā nakāramātrasya lope "ato guṇe" iti pararūpe ca `ābhyām' iti siddheḥ | na ca tathāpi "atra lopo 'bhyāsasya" ityatrāntyādeśatvaprasaṅgatādavasthyam | atrābhyāsatvāśraye lopo, na tu tadekadeśe iti vyākhyānāt | nanu dadau, dadhau ityādivāraṇāya sanītyasya, jijñapayiṣati ityādivāraṇāya sādāviti sanviśeṣaṇasya, yiyakṣati iti vāraṇāya mīmetyādiprakṛtiviśeṣāṇām, "muco'karmakasya guṇo vā" iti mumukṣati gām ityādivāraṇāya viṣayaviśeṣasya ca lābhārthamevātragrahaṇamiti cenna | anuvṛttyaivaiṣāṃ siddheḥ | na ca tathā'pi "vibhāṣā bhavadbhagavadaghavatāmoccāvasya" iti vārtikena vihita okāro vakāramātrasya syāt iti vācyam | vasyetyapahāya avasyeti nirdeśasāmarthyātsarvādeśatvasiddheḥ | tasmātsamudāyasaṃjñāyāmapi na doṣaḥ | saṃyogopadhatvādivyavahāro'pyatra saṅgacchate | pakṣāntare tvavayavadharmasya samudāye samāropo bodhyaḥ | yadvā, ala iti jasantam | na ca pūrva ityekavacanāntenā sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattiḥ | pūrve iti jasantasyaiva chedāt | antyasyāl‌tvalābhastvārthaḥ | yadvā, ala iti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī | jātāvekavacanam | alāṃ madhye'ntyātpūrvo'l‌ ityarthaḥ || tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya 66 | saptamīnirdeśe pūrvasyaiva kāryaṃ syāttacca nirddiṣṭe avyavahitoccārite | niśśabdena nairantaryasya diśinā coccāraṇasya lābhāt | niyamārthaṃ cedam | "iko yaṇaci" ityādīnāmaniyatapravṛttiprasañcako yastarkito'bhāvastatpratiyogitvāt | yadīdaṃ vacanaṃ na syāt tarhi pūrvasya parasya samīpasyānantarasya vyavahitasyāvyavahitasya vā iko vinigamakābhāvāt yaṇādeśaḥ syāt | sati tvasminpūrva eva viśrāmyatīti | "iko yaṇaci" ityatra hi bhāvalakṣaṇā saptamī | aci satītyarthaḥ | sattvaṃ ca pūrvaparobhayasādhāraṇam | evamupaśleṣo'pi | tathāca kāryapratiyogitvanimittatvayorekatra yugapadasambhavāt `dudhyudakam' ityādau paryāyeṇa dvayoryaṇ‌ syāt ataḥ pūrvasyaiveti niyamyate `agnicit' ityatra vyavahitapūrve'pi prāptastvavyavahitasyaiveti | yattu sat‌saptamyāṃ "tasmin‌" iti paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate iti "śnānnalopaḥ" iti sūtre bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoruktam | tat pūrvapakṣiṇaḥ prauḍhivādamātram | nanu tasminniti śabdo yatra nirddiśyate yathā---"tasminnaṇi ca yuṣmākāsmākau", tatraivāyaṃ pravartteta | `gavityayamāha' ityādau itiśabdena śabdasvarūpasyaiva bodhāt | na ca tatra prayojanābhāvaḥ | he yauṣmākīṇa asmabhyaṃ dehi, he āsmāka yuṣmabhyaṃ dadāmi' ityādau khañaṇ‌bhyāṃ parasyādeśavyāvṛtteḥ phalatvāt | maivam | loke śabdasyārthaparatvāt itinā śabdaparatvakalpanāt, vyākaraṇe tu śabdaparatvāt itinā'rthaparatvasiddheḥ | itikaraṇasya padārthaviparyāsakaratvāt | tatraiva pūrvaśabdoccāraṇāpatteśca | etatsūtrārambhāpekṣayā lāghavāt | tasmātsaptamyantānukaraṇameva tasminniti | sarvanāmnā aci halīti viśeṣāṇāṃ saṃgrahāt, "tasyāpatyam" ityādivat || tasmādityuttarasya 67 | pañcamīnirddeśe uttarasyaiva kāryaṃ syāt taccāvyavahitasya | tena "tiṅ‌ṅatiṅaḥ" iti nighātaḥ `agnimīle' ityatraiva na tvīle'gnimityatrāpi | digyogalakṣaṇā ceyam | kārakavibhakterasambhavāt | tathācottaraśabdavatpūrvaśabdasyāpyadhyāhārāpatteḥ vyavahitasyāpyuttarasya kāryaprasaṅgācca niyamārthamidam | tena `utthānam' ityatra "udaḥ sthāstambhoḥ" ityasya na prasaṅgaḥ | yadvārttikam--- "tasmiṃstasmāditi pūrvottarayoryogayoraviśeṣānniyamārthaṃ vacanaṃ tadhyudakaṃ, pacatyodanam" iti | ihāpi tasmāditi pañcamyantānāmanukaraṇam na tu yatra tasmāditi śabdastatraitadupasthityartham, pūrvoktayukteḥ | nanvatra prayojanābhāvādeva śaṅkā'nudayaḥ | "tasmānnuḍa़dvihalaḥ" "ata ādeḥ" iti dīrghādakārātpūrvasyāṅgasyāsambhavāt | "tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi" ityatrāpi vṛkṣān‌ ityādau pūrvasavarṇadīrghāt pūrvasya ṣakārasya natvāpatteḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirddiṣṭasya śaso natvamiti vyākhyānena vāraṇāt | atrāhuḥ---uccarata ānupalabhata iti prayojanam, dīrghībhūtādākārātpūrvasyoccaracchabdaprakṛtikasya śaso natvaṃ mā bhūdityuktisambhavasattvāt | evam "tasmānnuḍaci" ityatrāpi anaśva ityādau luptanakārānnañaḥ pūrvaṃ nuḍāgamo mā bhūditi yojanīyam | iha sūtradvaye ṣaṣṭhīpraklṛptipakṣo'pi bhāṣye uktaḥ | sa yathā---"ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā" iti sūtrādiha ṣaṣṭhītyanuvṛttyā satyapyarthanirdeśe 'vyavahitasya pūrvasya ṣaṣṭhī, pañcamyarthanirdeśe tādṛśasyottarasya ṣaṣṭhī syādityarthaḥ | ika ityādau ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sattvāttadanuvādena pūrvasyaiṣā, na tūttarasya na vā pūrvasyāpi vyavahitasyetyetadeva bodhyate | "āne muk" ityādau tu ṣaṣṭhyapi prakalpyate | anyatpūrvaṃvat | sā cāniyatayogātsthānaṣaṣṭhī | yaduttaraṃ sthānaṣaṣṭhī tasyaiva ca kāryaniyamo'rthātsiddhaḥ | yatra tūbhayanirddeśastatrobhayorna prakalpakatvam | kāryitvanimittatvayoryugapadekasminnasambhavāt | "ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ" iti jñāpakācca | anyathā "ād‌guṇaḥ" ityādau āditi pañcamyā'cīti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ kalpyata ityubhayorguṇādeśasiddhau tadvaiyarthyāt | tathā ca tatra kaiyaṭaḥ--- sūtradvayapramāṇatvāt dve bhavetāṃ prakalpike | ṣaṣṭhyā vibhaktī tenātra jñāpanārthatvamāśritam || dve pañcamīsaptamīrūpavibhaktī | ṣaṣṭhyāḥ parasparottaraṣaṣṭhyā ityarthaḥ | kiṃ tu paratvānavakāśatvābhyāṃ niyamapakṣavatṣaṣṭhīprakalpanapakṣe'pi vyavasthā | tathā hi---"āne muk" ityatra saptamyanavakāśā "ato yeyaḥ" iti pūrvatra caritārthāyā ata iti pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayati | evam "īdāsaḥ" ityāsa iti pañcamī niravakāśā "āne" iti saptamyāḥ pūrvatra sāvakāśāyāḥ | "tāsyanudāted‌" iti sūtre'pi "sārvadhātuke" iti saptamī abhyastasijarthatvāduttaratra sāvakāśeti tāserityādipañcamyeva ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayatī---lasārvadhātukasya syatāsyādibhya anudāttatvamiti | ca na tatra lasārvadhātukamiti prathamāntapāṭhānna saptamīti vācyam | "tasyādibhyo'nudāttatve saptamīnirdeśo'bhyastasijarthaḥ" iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | evam "bahorlopaḥ" ityatra bahoriti pañcamyanavakāśā iṣṭhemeyassu iti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayati---bahoḥ pareṣāmeṣāṃ lopaḥ syādityarthaḥ | ata eva "bhūca bahoḥ" iti ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśaḥ | "gato ṇit" iti pañcamī sarvanāmasthāne iti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpati | gośabdasya ṇittve prayojanābhāvācca | na ca `tiṣṭhati gauḥ' ityatra pūrvasya vṛddhiḥ phalam | gośabdaṃ prati tiṣṭhateranaṅgatvāt | "āmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ‌" ityatrāpi pañcamyanavakāśā āmīti saptamyā uttaratra sāvakāśāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayati | na ca ādityanuvṛttayā pañcamyā sāmānādhikaraṇyādadantātsarvanāmna iti pañcamyapi kṛtārtheti vācyam | tathā'pi yathoddeśapakṣe paratvāt "tasmādityuttarasya" ityetatpravṛtteḥ | taduktam--- "ubhayanirddeśe vipratiṣedhātpañcamīnirddeśa" iti | idaṃ cābhyupetyoktam | varṇāśrametarāṇām ityādivāraṇāya sarvanāmno vihitasyāma iti, yeṣām ityādyartham akārātparasyeti vyākhyānāt | akārāntātsarvanāmno vihitasyāma iti vyākhyāne tu yeṣām ityādau na syāt | dīrghādityatra tu ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthāne pañcamī, chāndasavyatyayāt | tena dīrghasyaiva tuk na tu chasya, "vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyā" iti liṅgācca | anyathā chakārottaraṃ tuk‌prasaṅge ścutve "khari ca" iti cartve cakāradvayaṃ syāt | nanu pratyayavidhāvapi "guptij‌kid‌bhyaḥ" iti pañcamyāḥ san iti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīprakalpakatvaṃ syāt | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ ādeśāntarapratinirdeśābhāvātsanaḥ sanādeśe doṣābhāvāditi vācyam | sthānina evātra nirdiṣṭatvādādeśasyopadeśābhāvāditsaṃjñā'nupapatteḥ | sthānino'pyutpattikāla eva nivṛttyabhimukhatayā pratipannasya itsaṃjñā'nanvayāt | atrāhuḥ--- paratvaviśiṣṭasya sana utpādanenopakṣīṇāyāḥ pañcamyā nāsti prakalpakatvamiti | ṣaṣṭhī hyanuvādavibhaktiḥ | sa ca yathāprāptasya | pratyayavidhau ca tasya pūrvamaprasiddhyā'nuvādānupapatteḥ | aniyame niyamakāriṇyāḥ paribhāṣāyā aniyamaprasaktyabhāve pravṛttyanarhatvācca | tasmātpratyayavidhau pañcamyo na prakalpikā iti || svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyāśabdasaṃjñā 68 | śabdasya svakīyaṃ rūpaṃ saṃjñi śabdaśāstre yā saṃjñā tāṃ vinā iti dīkṣitāḥ | navyāstu "aṇuditsavarṇasya" ityādiṣu prathamāntānāṃ saṃjñāsamarpakatvena ṣaṣṭhyantānāṃ saṃjñisamarpakatvena dṛṣṭatvāt svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya saṃjñā syādityarthaḥ | tathā ca pratyayalopasūtre bhāṣyam--- "svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya saṃjñā bhavatīti hanterapi hantiḥ saṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti atrāpi rūpaṃ śabdasaṃya saṃjñeti" ityāha | haradattastu--`grāhyamityadhyāhāryam | śabdasyeti "kṛtyānāṃ karttari vā" iti ṣaṣṭhī | tena śabdaḥ svameva rūpaṃ grāhayatītyarthaḥ | rūpapadaṃ cāgnyādipadavṛttijātiparam | vyaktidvārā ca kāryayoga, iti vyācakhyau | tena "agnerḍhak" iti agniśabdādeva ḍhak‌ na tu vahniśabdāt | aśabdeti kim | "upasarge ghoḥ" ityādau ghuśabdasvarūpaṃ mā grāhi, kiṃ tu dādhārūpā dhātava eva gṛhyeranniti | tena ghudhātoḥ śabdārthānna kipratyayaḥ | svapadaṃ ca yatra yaḥ śabda upāttastatparam | śabde śāstre saṃjñeti saptamīsamāsaḥ | ṣaṣṭhīsamāse karmādiṣvarthasaṃjñāsu svarūpagrahaṇāpatteḥ | nanu rūpagrahaṇaṃ vinā'pi svaśabdena tadeva grāhyam | pratītāvupadeśānapekṣādasādhāraṇatvādantaraṅgatvānniyatopasthitikatvācca, arthasya pratītau śaktigrahāpekṣatvāt paryāyāntarabodhyatvena sādhāraṇatvātpadadhījanyajñānaviṣayatvena bahiraṅgatvāt anukaraṇadaśāyāmarthānavagamādaniyatopasthitikatvācceti | atrāhuḥ---ihārthe'pi vivakṣito rūpavaditi jñāpanārthaṃ rūpagrahaṇam | tena "arthavad‌grahaṇe nānarthakasya" siddham | jñāpakavaśādarthasya, rūpaṃ rūpamiti vacanācca śabdasyeti, siddhamarthavad‌grahaṇam | tena `kāśe' ityādau "śe" iti pragṛhyatvaṃ netyādi | yatra tvarthavadrūpeṇa śabdo nāśrīyate tatra nedamupatiṣṭhate | yathā---varṇagrahaṇeṣu,---ṭeretvaṃ, tenānarthakasyāpi ṭeretvaṃ bhavati | atra bhāṣyakṛtaḥ---naitatsamārabhyam | loke hi yogyatālakṣaṇena sambandhena śabdo'rthaṃ bodhayati | vyākāraṇe'pi paśurapatyaṃ devatā prāñca udañco bharatā ityādāvartha eva gṛhyate | "agnerḍhak‌" ityādau tvarthena saha pratyayasya paurvāparyāsaṃbhavāt śabdasyaiva grahaṇam | "ṅyāpprātipadikāt" ityadhikārācca | na cāśabdasaṃjñetyetadarthamārambhaḥ | ghusaṃjñārambhādeva ghudhātoragrahaṇāt | "vyavahārāya niyamaḥ" ityuktatvāt | etena `kumārīgha' ityatra "gharūpa" iti hrasvo 'bhāvapratiyogīti vyākhyātaḥ | "ī halyaghoḥ" ityatra tu ghuśabdasyākārantatvābhāvādeva nopādānam | paryudāsābhāve yadgrahaṇaprasaktistasyaiva paryudāsābhyupagamāt | na cārthavadgrahaṇaparibhaāṣājñāpanārtham | tasyā nyāyasiddhatvāt | śabdaviśiṣṭasyaivārthasyopasthiterautsargikatvāt viśeṣye kāryabādhādviśeṣaṇībhūtaśabde kāryapravṛttervācyatvāt arthasya parityāgāpekṣayā śabdaviśeṣaṇatvena kāryiniyāmakatāyā eva yuktatvāt | pratyāsattyā ca sa eva śabdo gṛhyate, na tu tatparyāyaḥ, anupasthitatvāt | ata eva āgneyam ityādau agnipadenaivopādāne devatātvam, na tu paryāyāntareṇeti "vidhiśabdasya mantratve" ityadhikaraṇe siddhāntaḥ | etena "abhivyaktapadārthā ye" iti nyāyo, gauṇamukhyāyo'pi vyākhyātaḥ | gauṇārthasya prathamamanupasthitatvāt | na cottarasūtracatuṣṭaye "svaṃ rūpam" ityasyānuvṛttyartham | tāṃ vinā'pi nirvāhāt | grahaṇakasūtre svasyāpi svasāvarṇyāt grahaṇasiddheḥ | anyathā `avāttām' ityādau "jhalo jhali" iti lopānupapatteḥ | vyaktibhedasyātrāpi sulabhatvāt | evaṃ taparasūtre'pi | "ādirantyena" ityatrādipadāvṛttyā siddham | tatra liṅgaṃ "nādici" iti niṣedhaḥ | anyathā "prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ" ityatra "akaḥ" ityanuvṛtterakārasya saṃgrahaṇābhāve tadaprasaktyā niṣedhavaiyarthyāt | "yena vidhiḥ---" ityatrāpi "tasya ca" iti vārttikakṛtaiva vācyatvāt | tasmātsūtramidaṃ pratyākhyātam | "sittadviśeṣāṇāṃ vṛkṣādyartham" | sidityupalakṣaṇam | kiñcilliṅgāsaṅgena viśeṣāṇāṃ saṃjñeti vaktavyam | tena "vibhāṣāvṛkṣamṛga---" iti sūtre vṛkṣas mṛgas ityādi pāṭhyam | viśeṣāṇāmeva dvandva ekavat | plakṣanyagrodham, plakṣanyagrodhāḥ | idaṃ ca nyāyasiddham | paryāyāṇāṃ sahaprayogābhāvāt sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāṃ cārthābhāvātsāmānyena viśeṣāṇāmākṣepāt dvandvsayaivānupapatteḥ | "pitparyāyavacanasya ca svādyartham" | cakārātsvarūpasya viśeṣāṇāṃ ca grahaṇam | "sve puṣaḥ" | raipoṣaṃ puṣṭaḥ, aśvapoṣam, svapoṣam | idaṃ vācanikameva | "jitparyāyasyaiva rājādyartham" | "sabhā rājāmanuṣyapūrvā" | inasabham, īśvarasabham | neha rājasabhā, hariścāndrasabhā | idamapi nyāyasiddham | nañ‌praśleṣeṇa arājeti paryudāsāśrayaṇāt rājasadṛśānāṃ tatparyāyāṇāmeva grahaṇāt | na ca svasyāpi svaparyāyatvam | svabhinnatve satyabhinnapavṛttinimittakatvaṃ paryāyatvamiti svīkārāt | viśeṣaṇena svasya, viśeṣyeṇa ca viśeṣavācakapadasya vāraṇāt | inaśabdo rājaśabdaparyāya ityasya rājaśabdabhinnatve sati rājaśabdaśakyatāvacchedakadharmāvacchinnaśakyatāka ityarthaḥ | "jhittasya ca tadviśeṣāṇāṃ ca matsyādyartham" | "pakṣimatsyamṛgānhanti" | mātsyikaḥ, śāpharikaḥ | na tu paryāyavacanānām animiṣānhanti | `mīnasyeṣyata' iti bhāṣyam | mainikaḥ | `mṛgapakṣiṇostu pinnirdeśaḥ karttavyaḥ | tena svarūpasya paryāyāṇāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ ca grahaṇam' iti vyākhyātāraḥ | idamapivācanikam | aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ 69 | avidhīyamāno'ṇ‌ udicca savarṇasya cakārātsvasya ca saṃjñā syāt | atrāṇ‌ pareṇa ṇakāreṇeti prāguktam | "asya cvau" | śuklīsyāt mālīsyāt | erac | jayaḥ, layaḥ | "ṛdorap" stavaḥ, pavaḥ | "uraṇ‌raparaḥ" | kārtā, kirati | "ṛdorap" ityatra hrasvaṛkārasya tu na grahaṇam dīghārṇāmanaṇ‌tvena savarṇagrāhakatvaṃ nāsti iti siddhāntāt | etena "aṣṭana ā vibhaktau" ityādikaṃ vyākhyātam | "apratyayaḥ" iti paryudāsācca | dīrghāṇāmanaṇ‌tvaṃ ca grahaṇakaśāstra eva vākyāparisamāptinyāyāt | "uraṇ‌" ityādau tu teṣāmapyupādānam | tena kāraka ityādau raparatvam | tasmāddīrghāṇāṃ grāhakatvaṃ nāsti grāhyatvaṃ tvastyeveti phalitārthaḥ | apratyaya ityudito na viśeṣaṇam | "kuhoścuḥ"| cakāra, jagāda | ata eva "bhāvyamāno'ṇ‌ savarṇānna gṛhṇāti" ityāhuḥ | tuknuḍādayastu noditaḥ, "pratijñānunāsikyāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ" ityabhyupagamāt | apratyayaḥ kim | vidhīyamānānāṃ pratyayādeśāgamānāṃ grāhakatvaṃ mā bhūt | tena "ata iñ‌", "idama iś‌", "bhuvo vuk" ityādau na dīrghādi | na ca iñādīnāṃ anaṇ‌tvādeva na grāhakatvamiti vācyam | upadeśa ityanuvṛttyā sūtrāntaragatānāmeva halāmitsaṃjñāpravṛttau ikārādīnāmeva vidheyatvaparyavasānāt | syādetat | "akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ" ityatrākāro'ṣṭādaśānāṃ grāhako'stu aṇ‌tvāt | astu ca ikārādīnāmapi "ādirantyena---" ityukteḥ | īkārādayo dīrghāstu kathaṃ grāhyāḥ | tadvācakasya ikārādeḥ sūtre'nupādānāt | ak‌śabdena tadupasthitiriti cet, tarhi vākyārthe te'nuyantu | padārthasaṃsargasya vākyārthatvāt | na tu te'pi svārthopasthāpakāḥ | anuccaritatvāt | ata eva `ṛcaṃ vetti' ityādau śabdaviśeṣaṃ vetti ityevārtho na tu `tadarthaṃ vetti' iti | tathā ca vārttikam--- "tatra pratyāhāragrahaṇe savarṇāgrahaṇamanupadeśāt", "hrasvasaṃpratyayāditi ceduccāryamāṇasaṃpratyāyakatvācchabdasyāvacanam" iti | śabdasyāpratīyamānasyāvacanam arthāpratipādakatvamityarthaḥ | atrāhuḥ---pratyāhāragrahaṇe sarvatra tadvācyavācye nirūḍhalakṣaṇā, "dīrghājjasi ca" iti jñāpakāt | taddhi "prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrghasya niṣedhaḥ | na cāk‌śabdavācyo dīrgho 'sti | tathā ca niṣedhasya nirviṣayatvāpattiḥ | ākārasya sattve'pi tatra "nādici" ityeva siddheḥ | "pvādīnām" ityādinirdeśāśceha liṅgamiti | atretthaṃ pratyavatiṣṭhante---`ṛcaṃ vetti' ityatra arthatvenārthasya karmatayā vedanānvaya āpādyate agnitvādinā vā ? | nādyaḥ | tādṛśabodhe'rthapadottaradvitīyājñānasya hetutvāt | nāntyaḥ | tatrāpyagnimiti dhiyo hetutvāt | na ca yatra kaiyaṭoktarītyā ṛk‌śabdena prakaraṇādivaśāt `agnimīle' ityādirūpā ṛk pratīyate tatra `arthaṃ vetti' itibodha āpādyata iti vācyam | arthatvaviśiṣṭavācakasya taduttaradvitīyāyāścājñānāt | ṛk‌śabdottaraṃ dvitīyāyāstvānupūrvīviśeṣāvacchinnāyā ṛca eva karmatābodhakatvāt | arthasya ṛk‌śabdārthatvābhāvāt | na ca īḍanādikarmakabodha āpādyaḥ | taduttarakarmavibhaktijñānavirahāt | na ca `agnimīla' ityādyṛgarthasya karmatāsaṃsargeṇa vedanānvayastathā `agnimīle vetti' ityādijanya iveti vācyam | ṛcam ityanena saha vedanasya janitānvayabodhatayā nirākāṅkṣatvāt | etenāgnikarmakavedanabodhāpattirapi nirastā | uccāritatvasya tu śābdabodhakāraṇatāvacchedake na niveśaḥ | pustakadarśanādinā śabdasmaraṇādapi tadutpatteḥ | śabdopasthitaśabdasya nārthabodhakatvam, lipyādyupasthitasya tvastyeveti vaiṣamye ca mānābhāvāt | etena devadattapadasya `ghaṭam' iti dvitīyaikavacanāntapade gṛhītasaṅketasya `devadattaṃ vetti' iti vākyāt ghaṭakarmakavedanabodhāpattirapi nirastā | ghaṭamiti padakarmakavedanānvayabodhena nirākāṅkṣatvāt | agādisaṃjñānāṃ ṣaṣṭhyādiviśiṣṭe ikārādau saṅketajñānābhāvācca | vārttikasya tvayamabhiprāyaḥ---"akaḥ savarṇe---"iti vākyāt dīrghoddeśyatvarūpaṃ sthānitvam ākṣarasamāmnāyikānāmikārādīnāmeva syāt na tu dīrghāṇām | ikāropasthāpake ak‌pade sthānitvabodhakaṣaṣṭhyāḥ sattve'pi dīrghopasthāpakāt ikārāduttaraṃ tadabhāvāt, ataḥ śrīśādyasiddhiriti | anuccaritānāmarthopasthāpakataiva nāstītyartha uktadoṣāt | vārttikapadaṃ tvevaṃ vyākhyeyam---pratyāhāre, uccārite sati iti śeṣaḥ, savarṇānāmagrahaṇamanvayabodharāhityaṃ prāpnoti anupadeśātsaṃjñiṣvanuccāraṇāt | evaṃ ca madhyagatvābhāvāt ādyantarūpayā saṃjñayā saha teṣāmasati saṅketaparicchede uktapratijñāsiddhiḥ | hrasvasaṃpratyayāt---hrasvairupasthāpanāt | uccāryamāṇasaṃpratyayāt---uccāryamāṇasya tattadbodhānukūlayogyavibhaktyantatvādinā jñātasya samyaguddeśyavidheyabhāvavivekena pratyāyakatvāt anvayabodhakatvāt śabdasyāvacanam | iṣṭānvayabodhājanakatvamiti | "ṛk ityukte saṃpāṭhamātraṃ gamyate" iti bhāṣyamapi adhyayanādirmatvādividheyoddeśyatayeti śeṣeṇa śābdaparatayaiva neyam | "ṛk‌chabdena prakaraṇādivaśāt viśiṣṭasaṃniveśā ṛk pratīyamānā'pi svārtaṃ na pratyāyayati" iti kaiyaṭo'pyuktarītyaiva vyākhyeya iti | `uccāryamāṇaireva pratyāyakairbhavitavyamiti nāsti niyamaḥ | bud‌dhyupārūḍhāstu pratyāyakāḥ | asti ca madhyavarttiṃnāṃ buddhāvārohaḥ | tataśca saṃjñitvena pratyāyyamānasyāpi pratyāyakatvaṃ bhaviṣyati | atra ca jñāpakaṃ "dīrghājjasi ca" iti pratiṣedha' ityādipadamañjarīgranthasyāpyatra svārasyam | atrāyaṃ niṣkarṣaḥ | śabdopasthitasya śabdasya nārthabodhakatvam | anukaraṇasthale śabdasyopasthitasyāpyarthānavabodhakatvāt | etacca "svaṃ rūpam--" iti sūtre kaiyaṭaharadattādigranyeṣveva spaṣṭam | vārttikasya tu noktaṃ vyākhyānam | aka ityanayaiva ṣaṣṭhyā teṣāmapi sthānitvabodhanasambhavāt | ata eva "dvirephamānaya", "hiraṇyapūrvaṃ kaśipuṃ pracakṣate" ityādisthale bramarādivṛttikarmatvabodhaḥ saṅgacchate | aka iti hi aiuṛlṛityeṣāṃ saṃjñā | anukāryānukaraṇayośca bheda evātra vivakṣitaḥ, anyathā vibhaktyanupapatteḥ | tathā ca akāropasthāpyasya akārasya tadupasthāpyānāṃ dīrghāṇāṃ yathā sthānitvaṃ tathā'k‌padopasthāpyasya ikārādestadupasthāpyānāṃ dīrghāṇāṃ ca tat | akārādito vailakṣaṇyābhāvāt | tsamādanuccāritasya kathaṃ grāhakatvamityeva pūrvapakṣābhiprāyaḥ | siddhāntastu---anyatra tathātve'pi prakṛte śabdopasthitaśabdasyāpi grāhakatvam anyatā grahaṇakaśāstraṃ vyarthaṃ syāt | "asyacvau" "eranekācaḥ" ityādāvapi akārasyoccāryamāṇasya grāhakāt akārād bhinnatvāt | etena dīrghasya sambhave'pi "nādici" ityasya vaiyarthyam iti nirastam | aka ityatrākāreṇāpi dīrghagrahaṇasya yuktisāmyāt anupapattyā "dīrghajjasi ca" ityasya jñāpakatāyāḥ susthatvāt | ata eva yatra svarūpeṇoccāryante "asyacvau" ityādau tatraivaiṣāṃ grāhakatvaṃ syāt ityapi kaiyaṭena pūrvapakṣa uktaḥ | aka ityādāvapyakārasya savarṇagrāhakatvaṃ na syāt ityāpatterapi tadabhimatatvāt | tadayamarthaḥ---gavityayamāhetyādāvanukaraṇasya tanmātrabodhakatvam | aṇaāṃ tu anukāryavṛttidharmāvacchinnayāvadvyaktiparatvam | "asya" ityādiṣu akārasyaivānukāryatvāt tadbhedānāmeva grahaṇam | aka ityādau tu "ādirantyena" iti vacanāt yāvatāmanukāryatvaṃ tadbhedānāmeva grahaṇam | "ādirantyena" ityanena akārādiṣviva "aṇudit" ityanena tadbhedeṣvapi saṅketitatvāt | na ca tatra pratyekamakārādīnāmapi savarṇagrahakatvasya bodhyatayā tata eva siddhau agityādīnāṃ tadvilakṣaṇaṃ grāhakatvaṃ na bodhyate gauravāditi vācyam | "dīrghājjasi ca" ityādīnāṃ tadvācyavācye nirūḍhalakṣaṇākalpakatvamapekṣya agādiśabdānām uktaparatvakalpakatvasyaiva yuktatvāt | na ca aṇityatra aṇ‌ ak‌ aṅ‌ ac‌ aṭ‌ ityādibodhābhāvāt kathaṃ teṣāṃ yāvadvyaktiparatvabodha iti vācyam | tadā'pi tadupasthiterāvaśyakatvāt śabdavyapadeśādeva jhaltvamapyāyātīti bhavadabhyupagamāt | na ca pratyāhāragrahaṇābhāve "asya cvau" ityādau grāhakatvānupapattiḥ | aṇ‌pade tantrāvṛttyekaśeṣāṇāmanyatamāṅgīkārāt | api ca bhavanmate varṇagrahaṇe grahaṇakaśāstreṇa grāhakatvam, pratyāhārasthaletu uktajñāpakalabhyanirūḍhalakṣaṇayeti paryavasitam | tathā ca aka ityādīnāṃ grāhakatve grahaṇakaśāstrasyānupayogāt akpadārthabodhe ca "ādirantyena " ityasyaivāpekṣitatvāt, grahaṇakasūtre'pi aṇ‌padena dīrghāṇāmupasthitau bādhakābhāvāt teṣāmapi savarṇagrāhakatvāpattyā `dīrghāṇāmanaṇ‌tvena savarṇagrāhakatvaṃ nāsti' iti siddhāntabhaṅgaprasaṅgaḥ | tathā ca kaiyaṭaḥ---`atra hi sūtre pratyāhārasaṃniviṣṭā eva gṛhyante | svātmani kriyāvirodhāt aniṣpādād, grahaṇakaśāstrāntarābhāvācca atra sūtre akārādibhirākārādīnāṃ grahaṇāsaṃbhavaḥ | anyeṣu tu pradeśeṣu anena sūtreṇa akārādibhirākārādayo gṛhyamāṇāḥ kāryāṇi labhante" iti | kaustubhe'pyuktam---`padārthasaṃsargo hi vākyārthaḥ | tadbodhaśca padārthabodhottarabhāvī | tataścāṇ‌sūtreṇa ye upasthitāsteṣāṃ savarṇagrāhakatvaṃ sūtrārthaḥ | aṇ‌śabdaścākṣarasamāmnāyapaṭhiteṣu saṅketita iti tānevātropasthāpayati' ityādi | kiṃ caivaṃ grahaṇakasūtrasyaiva vaiyarthyam | ubhayasādhāraṇyena grāhakatvasya "dīrghād‌---" ityādinaiva jñāpayituṃ śakyatvāt | tasmāduktarītireva yuktā | ata eva kaiyaṭena spaṣṭamuktam---`tatrākāra uccārita "ādirantyena sahetā" iti madhyapatitānāṃ svarūpasya ca grāhakaḥ, asmācca vacanātsavarṇānāmapītyartha' iti | na ca tatpratyāhārādyakṣaramātraparam | akārasyopalakṣaṇatvāt yukteścoktatvāt iti dik | vārttikakārastvāha--- "savarṇe'ṇ‌grahaṇamaparibhāṣyamākṛtigrahaṇād‌" iti | akārādinirdeśānāṃ jātiparatvāt tadavacchinnayāvadvyaktilābhāt aṇ‌grahaṇaṃ na kāryam | hrasvatvaṃ tu vidheyasthale tadviśeṣaṇatayā vivakṣitamiti nātiprasaṅgaḥ | anuvādyasthale tu tadavivakṣaṇātsarvagrahaṇam | "aṣṭana ā" ityādau tu dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyān dīrghavyaktisamavetameva sāmānyaṃ gṛhyate | pūrvavayā brāhmaṇaḥ pratyupastheya ityatra viśiṣṭavyaktiniṣṭhabrāhmaṇatvavat | yadvā, vyaktireva śabdārthaḥ | jātistvaśabdārtho'pi abhedapratyayaheturasti iti sarvavyaktīnāmabhedenāśrayaṇaāt ekavyaktinirdeśe sarvavyaktigrahaṇasiddhiḥ | ākṛtigrahaṇāt ityasya tu ayamarthaḥ--ākṛterekākārapratyayanimittatvena pratipattiriti | na cātra ṛkariṇa lṛkāragrahaṇaṃ na syāt | ekajātyanākrāntatvāditi vācyam | atrāṇ‌padasthāne ṛkāraprakṣepeṇa tatsiddheḥ | taparastatkālasya 70 | nanu tatchabdastaparaparaḥ | tasya kālānātmakatvāttaparaḥ kālo yasyeti sāmānādhikaraṇyamanupapannam | tathā coktam--- ādityagrahanakṣatraparispandamathāpare | bhinnamāvṛttibhedena kālaṃ kālavido viduḥ || maivam | tatkāla iva kālo yasyetyuttarapadalopābhyupagamāt | taḥ paro yasmātsa tātparo vā svasamakālasya uccāryatāvacchedakadharmāvacchinnasyaiva grāhakaḥ | tena at it ityādau hrasvatvāvavacchinnaṣaṭ‌vyaktīnāmeva grahaṇam | ṛdityādau ṛlṛityubhayasambandhināṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ militvā dvādaśānām | tātparasyodāharaṇam | "vṛddhirādaic‌" iti | tena trimātrādīnāṃ ecāṃ guṇavṛddhisaṃjñāvirahāt gaṅgodakam, khaṭvailakam ityādau na trimātrādyādeśa iti eoṅityādisūtrayoḥ prapañcitam | kāryakālapakṣe bhāvyamānatvādeva savarṇagrahaṇavāraṇe tu vṛddhisūtre taparakaraṇaṃ spaṣṭārthamityapi vṛddhisūtra eva vicāritam | guṇānāṃ bhedakatvapakṣe tu tatra taparatvam ākārārthamapi guṇāntarayuktasya tasya grahaṇasya phalavatvāt | idaṃ ca sūtraṃ vidhyarthaṃ niyamārthaṃ veti pakṣadvayamākarasiddham | tathā hi---aṇityasyānanuvṛttyā ākārādāvaṇbhinne tatkālānāṃ savarṇānāṃ bhinnaguṇatve'pi anena grahaṇaṃ vidhīyate | nanvevamasyānaṇ‌su caritārthatvāt "ato bhisa ais‌" ityādāvaṇ‌grahaṇe akāreṇa dīrghādīnāmapi pūrvasūtreṇa grahaṇaṃ syāditi cenna | tasyāpi "asya cvau" ityādau hrasve caritārthatayā vipratiṣedhe paratvāt asyaiva pravṛtteḥ | anyatra saṃjñānāṃ bādhyabādhakabhāvavirahe'pi atra phalabhedena virodhāt---savarṇasaṃgrāhakatve hyaṣṭādaśānāṃ prasaṅgo'nyathā tu ṣaṇṇāmiti | na ca taparatvasāmarthyādeva na grahaṇam | "ṛta iddhātoḥ" ityādau mukhasukhārthatvasyāpi darśanāt | etenoktasaṃkhyānupādānāt virodhābāve'pi taparatvasāmarthyāt bādhyabādhakabhāvānupādānamitya pāstam | asyeti nirdeśe'pi lāghavācca phalato virodhasyāpi bādhakatve tantratayā śābdasaṃkhyānupādānasyākiṃcitkaratvāt | yadapi takāraviśiṣṭeyaṃ saṃjñā na tvaṇ‌mātram | tatkālasyeti tacchabdastu viśeṣyamātraṃ parāmṛśati na tu viśiṣṭam | taduccāraṇakālasadṛśe lakṣaṇā tu prācāṃ mate'pyastyeva | sarvanāmapade'pi "etasyaiva revatīṣu vāravantīyam", "tattvamasi" ityādau lakṣaṇāyāḥ pūrvottaratantrayoḥ sthitatvāt | tathā ca ṭighubhādyantargatāṇ‌vat ihaikadeśatvenānarthakyādgrāhakatāprasaṅga eva nāsti | vibhaktyutpattirepyevaṃ saṃgacchate | vṛddhisūtre `atrākāraḥ prayogasthairākārairarthavān' iti haradattagranthastu prācāṃ rītyā netavya iti | tadapi cintyam | takārasyopalakṣaṇatayā tadviśiṣṭasya saṃjñātvābhāvāt | na ca viśeṣaṇatvasya mukhyatvāttad‌guṇāvijñānāt viśiṣṭe tat | at‌ityasya aityasya ca saṃjñātve gauravāt | at, it‌ityānupūrvyāḥ śaktatāvacchedakatve gauravācca | etena pañcamīsamāsānāśrayaṇe'pi na nirvāhaḥ | ata evāsya niyamārthatvaṃ vipratiṣedhaśceti bhāṣyoktaṃ saṅgacchate | viśiṣṭasya saṃjñātve tasyānaṇ‌tvātpūrveṇa prāptyabhāvāt, samānaviṣayakatvābhāvāccobhayamapyanupapannaṃ syāt | vibhaktistu akaityādivat | tatrānubandhanirmuktasyaiva vācakatāyāstvayā'pi svīkārāt | "divaaut" ityatra vidhīyamāne taparakaraṇaṃ svarārtham | "dyauḥ pitaḥ pṛthivi mātaradhruk" | udāttaprayogastu dyośabdasya | "pṛthivī uta dyauḥ" iti | "aut" "acca gheḥ" ityādau tu mukhasukhārtham | vyākhyānāt | "samidhāne agnau" ityādau titsvarābhāvād' iti vṛttyādayaḥ | yattu tairuktam---"iṭo't" ityatra "na vibhaktau" iti na niṣedhaḥ | "idamasthamuḥ" iti ukārānubandhanādanityatvāt' iti | tadabhyupagamyavādamātram | titsvarāpatteḥ | "bhakṣīya tava rādhasaḥ" ityantodāttaprayogāt | tasmānmukhasukhārthameva' iti dīkṣitāḥ | syādetat--- abhyāsārthe drutā vṛttiḥ prayogārthe tu madhyamā | śiṣyāṇāmupadeśārthe vṛttiriṣṭā vilambitā || iti tisro vṛttayaḥ | tāśca krameṇa tṛtīyabhāgādhikāḥ---drutaṃ ślokamṛcaṃ coccārayato yasyā nāḍikāyā nava palāni sravanti tasyā eva madhyamāyāṃ dvādaśa, vilambitāyāṃ tu ṣoḍaśeti | tathā ca prakṛte vilambitāyāṃ taparakaraṇe drutamadhyayoḥ, madhyamāyāṃ taparakaraṇe drutavilambitayoḥ, drutāyāṃ taparakaraṇe madhyamavilamvitayorupasaṃkhyānaṃ kāryaṃ syāt, kālabhedāt | atra vārttikam--- "siddhantvavasthitā varṇā vaktuścirāciravacanād vṛttayo viśiṣyante" iti | asyārthaḥ---vyañjako dhvanirmātrākālāvacchinna eva varṇamabhivyañjayati, svarūpeṇa tu taduttarakālamapyanuvarttate | yadvā hrasvavyañjako dhvanirvṛttitraye'pi mātrākāla eva | kiṃ tu madhyamavilambitayoḥ pūrvadhvanyanuniṣpādādinā nyūnakālena dhvanyantareṇa pūrvābhivyaktavarṇasyaiva vyaktyantaraṃ janyate | abhivyañjakabhede'pi abhivyaṅgyabhedābhāvāt | evaṃ dīrghaplutavyañjakayorapi vṛttitraye'pi yathākramaṃ dvimātratrimātratve | tadanuniṣpādī tu tato nyūna iti na doṣaḥ | hrasvadīrghaplutāstu svata eva bhinnāḥ | varṇotpattipakṣe tu tadanuniṣpādī dūrādapi grāhyaḥ kaścit dhvanirāvaśyakaḥ | tasyaiva kālabhedād vṛttitraividhyaṃ
