ṅittvātideśe 'pyaupadeśikakittvasattvena niṣedhapravṛttyā dhūtvā, nūtvā ityeva, sādhutvāt virodhābhāvāt svāśrayakittvasyānivarttanāt | na ca "yenanāprāptinyāyena ṅittvena kittvabādhāpattiḥ | `kuṭitā' ityādau kittvābhāvena nāprāpte kittve ṅittvātideśānārambhāt ityāhuḥ . indhibhavatibhyāñca 6 | `ñiindhī dīptau' `bhū sattāyām' | ābhyāṃ paro 'pilliṭ kitsyāt | indheḥ saṃyogārthaṃ grahaṇam, bhavateḥ pidartham | nanu babhūveti prathamaṇali na kittvavidhānārtham | "acoñṇiti" iti vṛddhernirdiṣṭasthānikatayā tatra "kṅiti ca" iti niṣedhāpravṛtteḥ | na ca kittvasāmarthyādaniglakṣaṇavṛddherapi niṣedhaḥ syāditi vācyam | babhūvitheti thali, `ahaṃ babhūva' iti uttamaṇali ca ṇittvābhāvapakṣe guṇaniṣedhena caritārthatvāt | atra vārttikam--- "indheśchandoviṣayatvād bhuvo vuko nityatvāt tābhyāṃ liṭaḥ kidvacanānarthakyam" iti | uktasūtrapratyākhyānametat | indherhi anantaro liṭ nāstyeva | "ijādeśca gurumataḥ" ityāmā vyavadhānāt | chandasi tu "amantre" iti paryudāsādām‌virahe'pi samīdhe ityatra "chandasyubhayathā" iti liṭaḥ sārbadhātukatvāt "sārvadhātukamapid‌" iti ṅittvānnalopaḥ | ārddhadhātukatvācca śnamabhāvaḥ | tathāca mantraḥ--- "tvāmagne dadhyaṅ‌ṅṛṣiḥ putra īdhe atharvaṇaḥ" iti, "samīdhedasyuhantamam" iti ca | evañca liḍavyavahitapūrvasya bhāṣāyāṃ saṃmbhavo nāstītyatra tātparyaṃ na tu sāmānyata indherbhāṣāyāmaprayoge 'pīti kaiyaṭādayaḥ | etena indhigrahaṇasāmarthyāt ām‌virahe bhāṣāyāmapyuktaprayogasya sādhutvakalpanamapāstam, bhāṣyavārttikaviruddhatvāt | bhū a iti sthite ca vuko nityatvāt | na ca śabdāntaraprāptyā vuganityaḥ | ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt | kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena nityatvānapāyācca | "oḥ supi" ityata orityasyānanuvṛtteḥ | vuki kṛte ca guṇasya prāptyabhāvāt | mṛḍamṛdagudhakuṣakliśavadavasaḥ ktvā 7 | kitsyāt | "na ktvā seḍ‌" iti vakṣyamāṇakittvaniṣedhasyāpavādaḥ | `mṛḍa sukhane', `mṛda kṣode', `gudha pariveṣṭane,' `gudha roṣeca', `kuṣa niṣkarṣe', kliśa hiṃsāyām', `kliśū hiṃsāyām' | divādikrādyordvayorapyupādānam | `vada vyaktāyāṃ vāci', `vasa nivāse' | uṣitvā | "vasati kṣudhoriṭ‌" | yajāditvātsamprasāraṇam | atra bhāṣyam---"na katvā seṭ‌" iti sūtraṃ na karttavyam, idaṃ sūtraṃ mṛḍādibhya eva parasya ktvaḥ kittvaṃ nānyebhya iti niyamārthamastu | na ca mṛḍādibhyaḥ paraḥ ktvaiva kidbhavati na tu niṣṭhādiriti viparītaniyamāpattiḥ | prayogamūlatvād vyākaraṇasmṛteraniṣṭaniyamānupapatteḥ | na ca lūtvā, pūtvā ityādāvapi kittvānupapattiḥ kttvāmātrasya niyamāpatteḥ, "kttvātosunkasunaḥ" ityatra viśeṣaṇārthatvena kakārasārthakyāditi vācyam | seṭa eva ktvo niyamārambhāt | na ca "kliśaḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ" iti pakṣe kliśeraniṭ‌tvāt tataḥ parasya ktvaḥ kittvavidhānamaniṭ‌ktvākittvavyāvṛttyarthaṃ syāditi vācyam | gudhakuṣakliśāṃ 'ralo vyupadhād" iti kittvavikalpānnityakittvavidhyarthatvāt niyamārthatvāyogāt | rudavidamuṣagrahisvapipracchaḥ saṃśca 8 | cakārāt ktvāgrahaṇam | `rudir‌ aśruvimocane,' `vida jñāne,' `muṣa steye,' `graha upādāne,' `ñiṣvap‌ saye' `praccha jñīpsāyām | rurudiṣati ruditvā | "svapipracchyoḥ sannarthaṃ grahaṇaṃ kideva hi ktvā" iti bhāṣyam | "na ktvā seḍ‌" itiniṣedhasya suptvā pṛṣṭvetyatrāpravṛtteḥ | aniṭ‌katvāt | ata eva aniṭaḥ ktvaḥ kittvaniyamārthatvamasya na iti kaiyaṭaḥ | iko jhal 9 | igantātparo jhalādiḥ san kitsyāt | ktvāgrahaṇaṃ tvatra nivṛttam | aniṭ‌kasya tasya svayameva jhalāditvāt | bubhūṣati, didīṣate | kittvena guṇaniṣedhaḥ | ata eva ejviṣayatvābhāvāt dīṅo "mīnātiminotidīṅām" ityātvaṃ na | na ca jhalantaḥ sannityartho'stu | tataśca `cicīṣitā' ityādau atolopasthala eva kittvaṃ syāt na tu `cicīṣati' ityādau | sañśabakārayorekādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvāditi vācyam | ādigrahaṇānuvṛttyā vyākhyānāt | iggrahaṇe ik‌ smaraṇe ityeva tu na gṛhyate, gargādiṣu jigīṣuśabdapāṭhasya jñāpakatvāt | jayateḥ parasyaca sanaḥ kittvānupapattiprasaṅgāt, jhalitipratyāhārasāhacaryācca | tatsamīpasya halo'sambhavāddhalantāccetyasyānanvayaprasaṅgācca iti nyāsakāraḥ | atra vārttikam--- "ikaḥ kittvaṃ guṇo mā bhūt dīrghārambhāt kṛte bhavet | anarthakaṃ tu hrasvārthaṃ dīrghāṇāṃ tu prasajyate || sāmarthyāddhi punarbhāvyamṝdittvaṃ dīrghasaṃśrayam | dīrghāṇāṃ nākṛte dīrghe ṇilopastu prayojanam" || asyārthaḥ---"iko jhal halantācca" ityeka eva yogo 'stu kimartho yogavibhāga ityākṣepābhiprāyaḥ | yathāśrute tuttaramāha---"guṇo mā bhūd‌" iti | "sārvadhātukārddhadhātukayoḥ" ityanenetyarthaḥ | nanvatra "ajjñanagamāṃ sani" iti dīrgho yenanāprāptinyāyena guṇasya bādhako bhaviṣyatītyāha---"dīrghārambhād‌" iti | dīrghottaraṃ guṇaprasaktestanniṣedhārthaṃ kittvamityuttaramāha---"kṛte bhaved" iti | rūpaviśeṣābhāve 'pi mantrajapādivadāvarttamānasyaiva śāstrasya phalasādhanatvāditi bhāvaḥ | nanvevaṃ dīrghavidhivaiyarthyaṃ śāstrapūrvakaprayogasyaiva dharmanimittatayā śāstrapravṛttimātrasyāprayojakatvādityāha---"anarthakantu" iti | uttaramāha---"hrasvārtham" iti | hasvānāṃ dīrghavidhisāmarthād guṇābhāve'pi dīrghāntānāṃ prayojanavirahāddīrghavidhyapravṛttyā guṇaḥ syāditi tanniṣedhārthaṃ kittvamiti bhāvaḥ | "dīrghāṇāṃ tu" iti guṇaniṣedhārthaṃ dīrgheṣvapi dīrghaśāstraṃ pravarttata eva | adagdhadahananyāyasya phalābhāvamūlakatvāt | phalañca hrasveṣu rūpāntarasampattiḥ | dīrgheṣu tu rūpāntarānāpattirityanyadetat | ata eva "mo rāji samaḥ kvau" iti makārasya makārādeśavidhiḥ | tadetaduktam---"sāmarthyāddhi punarbhāvyam" iti | nanu dīrghavidhinā guṇasyeva ikārasyāpi bādhāpattiḥ | cikīrṣati, jihīrṣati | "añjhana" iti dīrghaḥ | "ṛta iddhātoḥ" itītvaṃ hi tatreṣyata ityāśaṅkyāha---"ṛdittvam" ityādi | dīrghatvavyatirekaprayuktavyatirekapratiyogitvādidādeśasya na bādha ityarthaḥ | uktaṃ hi---`yaṃ vidhiṃ pratyupadeśo 'narthakaḥ savidhirbādhyate, yasya tu vidhernimittameva nāsau bādhyate" iti | nanu hrasvāntānāṃ dīrghābhāve ittvaprāptyabhāve 'pi dīrghāṇāṃ dīrghavyatirekeṇaiva ittvaprāptirastyevetyāśaṅkyāha---"dīrghāṇāṃ nākṛte dīrghe" iti | tatrāpi guṇabādhārthaṃ dīrghavidhiravaśyaṃ pravarttayitavyaḥ | anyathā "ittvottvābhyāṃ guṇavṛddhī vipratiṣedhena" iti guṇa prasaṅgādityarthaḥ | tadevaṃ kittvavaiyarthye prāpte siddhāntamāha "ṇilopastu" iti | jñapi+sa+ti itisthite ṇerguṇo lopo dīrghatvaṃ ceti trayaṃ prāpnoti | tatrā'sati kittve niravakāśatvādviśeṣābhāvācca guṇa iva lopo 'pi dīrgheṇa bādhyeta | pācayateḥ pāktiḥ ityādau ṇilopasyāpi sāvakāśatvāt | "purastādapavādā anantarānvidhīnbādhante nottarān" iti nyāyena lopa eva bādhyeta | guṇastu syādeva | kittvavidhāne tu `cicīṣati' ityādiṣu guṇaprasaktyabhāvāttatra labdhāvakāśaṃ dīrghatvaṃ paratvāṇṇilopena bādhyate iti siddham | syādetat | asatyapi kittve yenanāprāptinyāyena guṇasyaiva dīrgho bādhako bhaviṣyati na tu ṇilopasya, guṇabādhena ca sāvakāśaṃ dīrghatvaṃ paratvādeva ṇilopena bādhiṣyata ityanārabhyameva kittvam | atrāhuḥ---bādhyaviśeṣacintāyāṃ tathātve'pi bādhyasāmānyacintāyāṃ svaviṣaye prāptasya sarvasya bādhābhyupagamāt | syādetat | asatyapi kittve `nimitsati' `pramitsati' ityatra mīnātiminotyoḥ sani niravakāśatvād guṇaṃ bādhitvā dīrghaḥ | tataḥ minoterapi mīgrahaṇena grahaṇātpratipadavidhānādis‌bhāvena guṇabādhaḥ | taduttaraṃ "halantācca" iti kittvena laghṛpadhaguṇabādhaḥ | tathā ca "sanimī" ityatra `mī' itisāmānyagrahaṇārthatvāddīrghavidheścaritārthatāyāṃ `jñīpsati' ityatra dīrghaṃ bādhitvā paratvādeva ṇilopo bādhiṣyate iti kṛtaṃ kittvena | maivam | uktarītyā dīrghasya sāvakāśatvāt dvābhyāmapi guṇalopābhyāṃ dīrghabādhāpatteḥ kittvārambhasyāvaśyakatvāt | na ca dīrghasya kuṅ‌dhāturavakāśaḥ, `cukūṣati' ityatra kuṭādittvenaiva ṅittvāṅ‌ guṇaniṣedhasiddheriti vācyam | uktabhāṣyānurodhena dīrghāntatvanirṇayāt iti kaiyaṭādayaḥ | na ca `gu purīṣotsarge' `dhu gatisthairyayoḥ' iti sannantāvavakāśa iti vācyam | tathā sati uhanagamāmityeva pāṭhāpattyā ajitipratyāhāragrahaṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ | evaṃ kuṅo hrasvāntatve 'pi bādhakābhāva iti nyāsakārābhiprāyaḥ | halantācca 10 | antapadasyāvayavārthatve 'nanvayaḥ | iko halavayavatvābhāvāt | igvato halantāditi nyāse `pipakṣati' ityatra samprāsāraṇāpattiḥ | igupadhāddhalantāditi nyāse dambheḥ sanyavyāptiḥ | sūtrabhedaśca | tathāpi samīpārtho 'ntaśabdaḥ | ik‌samīpāddhalaḥ paro jhalādiḥ san‌ kitsyāt | `guhū saṃvaraṇe'| jughukṣati | `bhidir‌ vidāraṇe'| vibhitsati | atha dambheḥ sani dhipsati ityatra nakārasya sanparatvābhāvāt bhakārasya ca ik‌samīpatvābhāvātkittvābhāve nalopo na syāt | ucyate | haltvajātyobhayoraikyamāśritya ik‌paratvānapāyāt | taduktam---"dambherhal‌grahaṇasya jātivācakatvātsiddham" iti | idaṃ ca "nipāta ekāj‌" ityekagrahaṇena jñāpitam | hakārādiṣu cābhinnapratyayābhidhānāt hal‌tvajāteḥ sadbhāvaḥ | tyaktabhedā vyaktaya eva jātiriti pakṣe 'pi bhedavyudāsādabhedāśrayaṇādiṣṭasiddhiriti kaiyaṭaḥ | yadyapi vṛddhisūtroktanyāyena haltvajātāvatiriktāyāṃ mānābhāvaḥ, tathāpi halpadajanyāyāmupasthitau yāvatīnāṃ jātīnāṃ hakārādau pratyekaṃ prakāratvaṃ tadatiriktavarṇatvasākṣādvyāpyajātyanavacchinnatvamevātra vivakṣaṇīyam | liṅ‌sicāvātmanepadeṣu 11 | ik‌samīpāddhalaḥ parau jhalādī liṅ ātmanepadaparaḥ sicca kitau staḥ | klṛpsīṣṭa, klṛpsīyāstām, klṛpsīran, aklṛpta, aklṛpsātām, aklṛpsata | ūditvādveṭ‌ | jhalādī kim | kalpiṣīṣṭa akalpiṣṭa iti iṭ‌pakṣe mā bhūt | syādetat | ātmanepadeṣviti nirddhāraṇasaptamī parasaptamīvā | nādyaḥ | nirddhāraṇasya sajātīyaviṣayatayā liṅ‌mātrasya viśeṣaṇāpatteḥ | liṅiti tadādeśagrahaṇāt | na dvitīyaḥ | sico viśeṣaṇe 'pi liṅastadayogāt | sīyuḍ‌viśiṣṭasya liṅ‌padārthatve tadapekṣayā liṅ‌paratvānupapatteḥ | nāpyarthadvayaparatvam | sakṛcchrutatvāt | nāpyekaśeṣaḥ | arthabhedātsahavivakṣāvirahāt | atra bhāṣyam---"ubhayathā 'pyadoṣaḥ" iti | tathāhi---ātmanepadaṃ yau liṅ‌sicāvityarthaḥ | naca sicastaṅānobhayabhinnatvādātmanepadatvānupapattiḥ | tatparatvena ātmanepadasya sici aupacārikatvāt | gauṇamukhyārthayorātmanepadaśabdayoḥ sārūpyamātrapratibaddhaikaśeṣāśrayaṇāt | dvitīye'pyadoṣaḥ | avayavagatapaurvāparyasya samudāye āropāt | tantreṇārthadvayalābhādvā | parantu sambhavavyabhicārābhyāṃ sijevātmanepadena viśeṣyate na tu liṅ | parasmaipadeṣu liṅo jhalāditvābhāvena tata evātmanepadagrahaṇasiddhāvātmanepadaviśeṣaṇasya vaiyarthyāt | atha sico'pyātmanepadaviśeṣaṇaṃ kimartham ayākṣīt ityādau ika ityeva vyāvṛtteḥ | acaiṣīd ityādau ac‌paratvābhāvādeva tathātvāt | `akoṣīt' ityādau iḍāgame kṛte jhalāditvābhāvāt | abhaitsīt ityādau "vadavraja" iti vṛddheriglakṣaṇatvābhāvādeva "viṅatica" iti niṣedhavirahātsatyapi kittve kṣativirahāt | maivam | asrākṣīt, adrākṣīt ityādau "sṛjidṛśoḥ" ityakillakṣaṇasyāmāgamasyānupapattiprasaṅgāt | uśca 12 | ṛvarmātparau jhalādī pūrvoktau kitau staḥ | bhṛṣīṣṭa, bhṛṣīyāstām, bhṛṣīran, abhṛta, abhṛṣātām, abhṛṣata | vā gamaḥ 13 | gamaḥ parau jhalādī pūrvoktau kitau vā staḥ | saṅgasīṣṭa, saṃgaṃsīṣṭa, samagata, samagaṃsta | kittvapakṣe 'nunāsikalopaḥ | hanaḥ sic 14 | hanteḥ paraḥ sic kitsyāt ātmanepade pare | āhata, āhasātām, āhasata | punaḥ sijgrahaṇaṃ "ekayoganirdiṣṭānāṃ saha vā pravṛttiḥ saha vā nivṛttiḥ" iti jñāpanārtham | tena pūrvasūtradvaye "liṅ‌sicāvātmanepadeṣu" itisaṃpūrṇasūtrānuvṛttiḥ | yamo gandhane 15 | sic kitsyāt | gandhanaṃ paradoṣāviṣkaraṇam | `udāyata'| gandhane kim | `udāyaṃsta padām'| ākṛṣṭavānityarthaḥ | vibhāṣopayamena 16 | prāgvat | rāmaḥ sītāmupāyata, upāyaṃsta mahāstrāṇi | sthāghvoricca 17 | sic kit, iccāntādeśaḥ | samasthita, samasthiṣātām, sāmasthiṣata, adita, ādiṣātām, adiṣata | atra vārttikam--- "icca kasya takārettvaṃ dīrgho mā bhūdṛte 'pi saḥ | anantare pluto mā bhūtplutaśca viṣaye smṛtaḥ" | nacātra hetupadaprayogavirahāt "ṣaṣṭhī hetuprayoge" ityasyāprasaktyā kasyetyatra hetutṛtīyāpattiḥ | atra sambandhitvanaiva vivakṣitatvāt | `madīyāḥ putrāḥ' ityatra apatyatvaprakārakavivakṣāviraheṇa sambandhisāmānyārthe chapratyayotpatteḥ | "takārettvam" ityatra karmadhārayottaraṃ tvapratyayaḥ | "dīrgho mābhūd‌" iti | ākārasthāne āntaratamyāttasyaiva prasaṅgāt | "bhāvyamāno 'ṇ‌ savarṇānna gṛhṇāti" iti parihāro noktaḥ | `amūbhyām' ityādau bhāvyamānasyāpyukārasya grāhakatvadarśanāt, samādhānāntarasadbhāvācceti bhāvaḥ | "ṛte'pi saḥ" iti | "ghumāsthā" ityādinaiva ītvasya siddhatvāt ikāravidhaisāmarthyādeva dīrgho na bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ | kittvantu vidheyameva | anyathā "ghumāsthā" ityasyāpyapravṛtteḥ | prayojanāntaramāha "anantare pluto mā bhūd‌" iti | asadṛśe ādeśe kriyamāṇe pluto vihitastatrāpyanena vidhīyeta | asminkartavye "pūrvatrāsiddham" ityāṣṭamikaplutasyāsiddhatvāt | tataśca pakṣe 'nuvādadoṣaḥ syāditi hrasva eva bhavatītyarthaḥ | kecittu taparatvasamarthanamatet | asadṛśādeśe kriyamāṇe dīrgha eva syāt | naca tasyoktarītyā 'nyathāsiddhiḥ | plutanivṛttyarthatayā siddhasyāpi vidhānopapatteḥ | mā bhūtlutaiti cenna | "plutaśca viṣaye smṛtaḥ" | sa cāsati taparatve na prāpnotīti dīrghanivṛtyarthaṃ taparatvaṃ sthitamiti vyācakhyuḥ | plutavidhautu "vākyasya ṭeḥ" ityadhikārātkathamekasya plutaḥ syāditi cintyametaditi kaiyaṭaḥ | na ktvā seṭ‌ 18 | seṭ ktvā kinna syāt | atra vārttikam--- "na seḍiti kṛte 'kittve niṣṭhāyāmavadhāraṇāt | jñāpakānna parokṣāyāṃ sani jhalgrahaṇaṃ viduḥ | ittvaṃ kitsanniyogena reṇa tulyaṃ sudhīvani | vasvarthaṃ kidatideśāt gṛhītiḥ ktvā ca vigrahāt" | ayamarthaḥ---akittve iti chedaḥ | `na seḍ‌' iti sūtraṇīyam | ktvāgrahaṇe phalābhāvāt | naca gudhito, gudhitavān iti niṣṭhāyāmapi kittvaniṣedhāpattiḥ | "niṣṭhā śīṅ‌svidimidi" ityādiniyamādeva tadabhāvāt | ebhya eva parā niṣṭhā na kidityarthāt | ebhyaḥ parā niṣṭhaiva kinna bhavatīti viparītaniyamasya vyākhyānādeva parityāgāt | nanu tathāpi, parokṣāpadaṃ pūrvācāryaprasiddhyā liṭ‌param, tatra kittvaniṣedhe papiva, papimetyādau "āto lopa iṭi ca" ityākāralopo na syāditi cenna | kṅidārddhadātukaṃ nimittīkṛtya tadabhāve 'pi iṭamevāśritya tatsiddheḥ | naca tathāpi jagmiva, jaghniva ityādau "gamahana" ityupadhālopaḥ kittvābhāvānna syāditi vācyam | aupadeśikakittvasyaivāyaṃ niṣadho na tvātideśikasyeti vyākhyānāt`asaṃyogālliṭ kit' iti ātideśikakittvasya susthatvāt | nacātra pramāṇābhāvaḥ | "iko jhal‌" ityatra jhalgrahaṇasyaiva mānatvāt | taddhi `śiśayiṣate' ityatra kittvaṃ mā bhūdityetadartham | ātideśikasyāpi kittvasya niṣedhe tu tatra "ika" iti kittvaprasaktāvapi "na seḍ‌" ityanena tanniṣedhasambhavāt anūpaśabdasya "anorapradhānakanīyasi" ityanudāttāditve ekādeśasya ca "svarito vā 'nudātte padātau" iti svaritatve varṇāntaratvāt | nāpyudāttatvānudāttatvayoreva samāhāro grāhyaḥ | acprastāvāt | tathāpi guṇinoḥ samāhārānupapattau guṇayostadāśrayaṇam | na ca samāhārasya saṃjñitvānupapattiḥ, svaritasaṃjñayā yogyatayā aca eva saṃjñitvenākṣepāditi vācyam | upacārātsamāhāravato'ca eva saṃjñitvāt | nacaivaṃ traisvaryeṇādhīmahe ityādiśiṣṭavyavahāravirodhaḥ | kaiścidudāttaguṇaiḥ kaiścidanudāttaguṇaiḥ kaiścidubhayaguṇairiti tadarthāt | svaratraividhyaparatvābhāvāt | tasyādita udāttamarddhahrasvam || 32 || sthite guṇadvayasamāhāre vibhāgapradarśanārthamārambhaḥ | nanu hrasvagrahaṇāddīrghaplutasvaritayorayaṃ vibhāgo na syāt | kanyā, śaktike3 śaktike iti "kanyārājamanuṣyāṇām" ityantaḥ svaritaḥ | "svaritamāmreḍhite'sūyā" | iti svaritaḥ plutaḥ | maivam | arddhahrasvaśabdaḥ pramāṇe rūḍhaḥ | vyutpattyarthaṃ hrasvasyopādānam | arddhamātrā tvanenābhidhīyate tataḥ prameye mātrapratyayaḥ | "pramāṇe laḥ" iti tasya luk | tataśca hrasvadīrghaplutayorapi buddhyā'rddhamātrāvibhāgasambhavānna doṣa iti bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ sthitam | ata eva `"yenavidhiḥ" iti sūtre hrasvaśabdamamukhyayā vṛttyā mātrārddhe varttamānamaṅgīkṛtya dīrghapvalutayorudāttavibhāgaḥ kṛta' iti bṛhadvivaraṇakārairuktam | atra dīkṣitāḥ---hrasvagrahaṇamavayutyānuvādamātram | arddhamityeva vivakṣitam | tena dīrghaplutayorapi pūrvārddhamudāttam | tacca na samāṃśarūpaṃ kintu leśarūpam | tatra prātiśākhyaviśeṣānurodhena kasyāṃ cicchākhāyāṃ samāṃśaḥ, kasyāṃcidarddhamātreti viśeṣaḥ | ekaśrutyādīnāṃ prātiśākhyānurodhenaiva vyavasthādarśanāt | na ca dīrgasvaritasamārddhsayodāttatve pramāṇābhāvaḥ | ye1'rā ityatra ekārasya, tanūnapācchacīpatimityatraca padapāṭhe ūdītorarddhodāttatayā bah‌vṛcaiḥ paṭhyamānatvāt | tanūnapācchacīpatiśabdayoḥ "ubhe vanaspatyādiṣu yugapat" iti pūrvottarapadayorādyudāttatve śeṣanighātaḥ | pūrvapadayośca tanūśacīpadayorantyasya pākṣikaṃ svaritatvaṃ prātiśākhye uktam--- jātyavadvā tathā vā'ntyau tanūśacīti pūrvayoḥ | iti | svaritārddhasyodāttatve prātiśākhyamapi--- ekākṣarasamāveśe pūrvayoḥ svaritaḥ svaraḥ | tasyodāttatarodāttādarddhamātrārddhameva vā || anudāttaḥ paraḥ śeṣaḥ sa udāttaśrutirna cet | udāttaṃ vocyate siñcitsvaritaṃ vā'kṣaraṃ param | iti | svara ityantaṃ svaritalakṣaṇam | pūrvetipadasyodāttānudāttatvapatvāt | tasya svaritasya svatantrodāttāpekṣayā udāttatarā'rddhamātrā bodhyeti | arddhamātreti `kva3vo'śvāḥ' ityādyabhiprāyam | na caivaṃ svatantrodāttāpekṣayā udāttatarā'rddhamātrā bodhyā ityasya nīcasthānatvādanudāttatvāpattiḥ | atyantanīcasyaiva sthānasya tatropādānāt | arddhaṃveti dīrghābhiprāyam | anenaiva trayāṇāmupasaṃgrahādidamevādarttavyamiti sūcayitumevakāraḥ | arddhamātrāpekṣayā samāṃśasya bahutvena tadupakārakatvāt | caramopanyāsācca | prātiśākhyasamākhyayā tacchākhāparatvalābhe tacchākhāyāṃ svaritasya samānodāttapāṭhācca | anudātta ityādi pariseṣasiddhārthānuvādaḥ | sa śeṣa udāttaśrutiḥ | kimaviśeṣeṇa ? netyāha--nacetyādi | udāttasvaritaparaṃ vihāyetyarthaḥ | śākalyo'pyāha--- aprākṛtastu yaḥ svāraḥ svaritodāttapūrvagaḥ | udādāyārddhamasyātha śiṣṭaṃ nighnanti kampitam || udādāya udāttaṃ kṛtvetyāhuḥ | atra vadanti---nedaṃ yuktam | uktākaragranthavirodhāt | śākhāviśeṣe tathā pāṭhe'pi sarvaśākhāsādhāraṇasyāsya tadekavākyatayā saṃkocānarhatvāt | laukikaprayoge viśeṣavacanābhāve'rddhamātraivodāttetyatra tātparyāt | uktaprātiśākhyaṃ ca na sādhakam | arddhamātrā, arddhameva veti pakṣayoḥ pāṇiniśākalyayoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣalakṣaṇābhiprāyeṇa vyavasthitatvāt | evakāro viśeṣalakṣaṇena kṛtāyāḥ sāmānyalakṣaṇavyāvṛtteranuvādārthaḥ | vāśabdo vyavasthitavikalpārtha iti | apica samāṃśagrahame'rddhagrahaṇavaiyarthyaṃ "samaṃ syādaśrutatvād" ityeva siddheḥ | na cārddhamātrāyā api lābhārthaṃ tat | ubhayasādhāraṇarūpābhāvāt, leśatvasyaikasyābhāvāt, ekaśeṣādikalpane'pi gauravāt | etenārddhahrasvaśabdenārddhamātrā lakṣyata iti haradattādigranthāstu matāntaraparatayā kathaṃcinneyā iti parāstam | haradattoktasyaiva prakṛtasūtrārthatvāt | yattu---ākare arddhamātrāyāmarddhahrasvaśabdasya rūḍheruktatvāt samudāyasya śaktyabhāvena lakṣaṇāyā ayogāccāyukta eva iti | tanna | arddhamātrāyāṃ rūḍhāvapi kaiyaṭoktarītyā tadavacchinnadharmiṇo lakṣaṇayaiva lābhāt | mātracpratyayalopaṃ na jānatāmapi bodhodayāt | tadanuśāsanasya "guṇavacanebhya" ityādivallakṣaṇātātparyagrāhakatvādityāstāṃ vistaraḥ | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ--- atra vārttikaṃ--"svaritasyārddhahrasvodāttādodāttasvaritaparasya sannatarādūrddhvamudāttādanudāttasya svaritātkāryaṃ svaritāditi siddhyartham" asyārthaḥ---ā arddhahvasvodāttāditi ākāracchedaḥ | iyaṃ navasūtrī "udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ" ityateduttaramaṣṭame paṭhanīyā | tena `imaṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvati' ityatra me---śabdātsvaritātpareṣāṃ gaṅgetyādīnām āmantritanighātādanudāttānāṃ "svaritātsaṃhitāyāmanudāttānām" iti vacanādekaśrutirbhavati | anyathā "udāttādanudāttasya" iti traipādikasvaritasya "svaritāt" ityatrāsiddhatvātsvaritātparatvamanudāttānāṃ nāsti iti ekaśrutirna syāt | na cāśrayātsiddhatvaṃ śaṅkyam | `kāryam' ityādau ṣāṣṭhasvarite sāvakāśatvāt | "svaritodāttārthaṃ ca" | tathāhi---subrahmaṇi sādhuriti yatpratyayaḥ tittvātsvaritaḥ, tataṣṭāp‌ pittvādanudāttaḥ, ekādeśa āntaratamyātsvaritaḥ | tatrānudāttabhāgasyāpi vidyamānatvāt | omityudāttaḥ | "omāṅośca" ityudāttasvaritayorekādeśaḥ svarita eva | ekadeśāntaratamyāt | indraśabdaścāmantritatvādanudāttaḥ | `subrahmaṇyomindra āgaccha' ityatra "na subrahmaṇyāyāṃ svaritasya tūdāttaḥ" ityokārasya svaritasyodāttavidhānaṃ sāvakāśamiti traipādikasya svaritasyodātto na syāt | `indra āgaccha' iti yathā | "svaritodāttācca svaritārtham" | `indra āgaccha, hariva āgaccha'| āśabda udāttaḥ | gaccheti śeṣanigātādanudāttaḥ | "udāttādanudāttasya" iti svaritaḥ | tasyāsiddhatvāduktasūtreṇodāttatvaṃ na syāt | "svaritaparasannatarārthaṃ ca" māṇavakajaṭilakādhyāpaka nyaṅ‌ | "nyadhīca" iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ | tata "udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ" ityakāraḥ svaritaḥ | tasyāsiddhatvāt "udāttasvaritaparasya sannaparaḥ" iti pūrvasyānudāttataro na syāt | na cāśrayātsiddhatvam | māṇavakajaṭilakābhirūpaṃ kva ityatra sāvakāśatvāt | "titsvaritam" ityasya siddhatvāt | tasmānnavasūtrī śāstrānte paṭhanīyeti siddham | tacca sūtrakṛtaiva jñāpitam | taduktam---"devabrāhmaṇayoranudāttavacanaṃ jñāpakaṃ `svaritād‌' iti siddhatvasya" iti | anyathā svaritasyāsiddhatvādanudāttatvamastyevetyanudāttatvavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt | nahi svaritasya siddhatvamanena jñāpyate svaritasya ya udāttastasmātparasyānudāttasya svaritatā''patteriti bhāṣyavārttikayoḥ sthitam | atra dīkṣitāḥ---"svaritasyatūdātta" iti prakaraṇotkarṣe jñāpakam | naca bhāṣyakaiyaṭādirītyā `subrahmaṇyom' ityatra tadavakāśaḥ | "ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ" ityasya pravṛtterāvaśyakatvāt | naca tatra "anudāttasya" ityanuvṛttervṛttikṛtoktatvāt udāttasvaritayorekādeśe na tatpravṛttiriti vācyam | tadanuvṛttau mānābhāvāt | `kvāvaram' ityatra bah‌vṛcairudāttasyaiva paṭhyamānatvāt | kvaśabdasya svaritatvāt | taittirīyāṇāmapi "yājyayaivainametayā''pyāyayati" ityatrāṅ‌praśleṣeṇa dvitīyākṣarasyodāttatvācca | ata eva bah‌vṛcaprātiśākhye--- udāttavatyekībhāva udāttaṃ sandhyamakṣaram | anudāttodaye punaḥ svaritaṃ svaritopadhe'|| iti--- śloke uttarārddha evānudāttapadaṃ prayuktam, pūrvānvayabhramavāraṇāya punaḥ padaṃ prayuktam | śaunakīye svarāṣṭake'pi---`ekādiṣṭamudāttena taṃ tameva nayetsvaram' ityuktam | ekādeśe pratiyogitvenānudāttasyānupādānād' ityāhuḥ | tanna | śākhāviśeṣe tathā pāṭhasya prātiśākhyavidhinaiva siddhe tadanurodhena sarvabhāṣādarśibhāṣyakārādivyākhyānasyollaṅghayitumaśakyatvāt | ekaśruti dūrātsambuddhau 33 | dūrātsaṃbodhane vākyamekaśruti syāt | `āgaccha māṇavaka'| pakṣe māṇavakaśabdaṭeḥ pluta udāttaḥ | ekaśrutiplutābhyāmavayavabhedena vākye samuccitābhyāṃ dūrātsambodhanaṃ dyotyate | sambuddhipadaṃ sambodhanaparam | ekavacanaparatve `devo brāhmaṇā' ityādāvavyāpteḥ | taduktam---"ubhayagatiriha śāstre bhavati" iti | kvacidakṛtrimasyāpi grahaṇamityarthaḥ | ekavacanasya dūrāditi viśeṣaṇānupapatteḥ | sambodhanasya tu kriyārūpatvādapādānatayā tatsambhavāt | ekaśrutiśca nodāttā, "uccaistarāṃ vā vaṣaṭ‌kāra" ityudāttavidhānāt | anyathā "yajñakarmaṇi" ityekaśrutyaiva siddheḥ | nāpyanudāttā | "udāttasvaritaparasya sannapara" ityanudāttatvavidhānāt | ekaśrutyanuvṛttyaiva siddhāvanudāttavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt | tasmātkṣīrodakavadudāttānudāttayorbhedatirodhānamekaśrutirityarthaḥ siddhaḥ | atraiva pracayavyavahāro vaidikānām | svarite tu vibhāgena tayorupalabdhiḥ | anye tu vyācakṣate---ubhayatrāpi taranirdeśastantram | "somasyāgnevīhi3vau3ṣaḍ‌" ityatra "yajñakarmaṇi" ityekaśrutirvihitā, tadapekṣayā vauṣaṭ‌śabdasyodāttataratvaṃ vidhīyate | taccaikaśruterudāttānurāgaṃ vinā'nupapannam | utkarṣasya sapratiyogikatvāt | evaṃ "sannatara" ityatrāpi | tathā ca saptasvarāḥ---udāttaḥ, udāttataraḥ, anudāttaḥ, anudāttaraḥ, svaritaḥ, svaritodāttaḥ, svarita evānudāttenoparakta ekaśrutiḥ | kasyacittu svaritasyodāttabhāgo nānudāttenānurajyata iti pṛthak svaritanirdeśa iti siddham | yajñakarmaṇyajapanyūṅ‌khasāmasu 34 | mantro yajñakarmaṇyekaśrutiḥ syāt japādīnvarjayitvā | "agnirmūrddhā divaḥ" | yajñeti kim | svādhyāyakāle traisvaryameva yathā syāt | ajapeti kim | "mamāgne varco vihaveṣvastu" | japo nāmopāṃśuprayogo yathā jale nimagnasya | nyūṅkhāstu ṣoḍaśa okārāḥ | teṣu prathamasaptamatrayodaśāstraya udāttāstrimātrāḥ, itare trayodaśānudāttā arddhaukārāḥ | evaṃ cāśvalāyanenoktamudāhṛtaṃ ceti prasādakāraḥ | "gītiṣu sāmā''khyā" iti jaiminisūtram | ajapetiparyudāsāttatsadṛśamantre idamaikaśrutyam | ata eva "indraśatruśabde ūhyamāne naitatpravṛttiḥ" iti paspaśāyāṃ prapañcitam | uccaistarāṃ vā vaṣaṭ‌kāraḥ 35 | yajñakarmaṇi vauṣaṭ‌śabda uccaistarāṃ vā syādekaśrutirvā | 'somasyāgne vīhi3vau3ṣaṭ‌" | vaṣaṭ‌śabdopādānaṃ vaicitryārtham | vauṣaṭ‌śabdasyaiva vivakṣitatvāt iti saṃpradāyaḥ | etasmānnirdeśādeva varṇanirdeśābhāve'pi kārapratyayaḥ | tena svāhākāro hantakāra ityādisiddham | vibhāṣā chadansi 36 | chandasi ekaśrutirvā | vyavasthayā ca vikalpaḥ | yathā---vah‌vṛcānāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ traisvaryam, brāhmaṇe tvekaśrutirityādi | vikalpasya prakṛtatve'pi "yajñakarmaṇi" ityasya nivṛttisūcanārthaṃ punarvibhāṣāgrahaṇam | nanu yajñakarmaṇyeva nityāyā vaikalpikyāścaikaśrutervirodhādvidhātumaśakyatvātsāmarthyādeva `yajñakarmaṇi" ityasya nivṛttisambhavātpunarvibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ vyarthamiti cenna | ajapetyādiparyudāsānnityaikaśrutermantraviṣayakatvam, vaikalpikyāstu brāhmaṇaparatvamiti vyavasthāsambhavāt | pratiṣedhapakṣe'pi nityaikaśrutereva ūhādiviṣayatvam, vaikalpikyāstu chandoviṣayatvamiti sambhavāttannivṛttyarthatayā sārthakyāt | atra vyācakṣate---tantreṇāvṛttyā vā "acchandasi" iti nañpraśleṣādbhāṣāyāmapyaicchiko vikalpaḥ | dāṇḍināyanādi--sūtre "aikṣvākasya svarabhedārtham̐ pṛthak nipātanam" ityuktvā "aikaśrutyanirdeśātsiddham | ekaśrutirhi svarasarvanāma | yathā---napuṃsakaṃ liṅgasarvanāma" iti bhāṣyokteḥ | ata eva viruddhasvarakasamāsadvayasyaikaśrutyā saṅgrahādabhiyuktānāṃ śleṣakāvyanirmāṇaṃ saṅgacchate | ata eva indraśatruśabde bahuvrīhisvareṇa doṣapravṛttiruktā paspaśāyām, tadante "śveto dhāvati alambusānāṃ yātā" iti bhāṣyaṃ ca | "veda iva loke svaro na viśeṣādhyavasāyahetuḥ" iti kāvyaprakāśasya tvekaśrutyā pāṭhādityāśayaḥ | nacaivaṃ "jhalyupottamam" iti prakramya "vibhāṣā bhāṣāyām" ityuktervaiyarthyam | traisvaryeṇa prakrame pākṣikānudāttalābhārthatvāt | veti prakṛte vibhāṣāgrahaṇātsūtrakṛtāṃ tantrāderanabhimatatvāt | svaravidhau chando'dhikārābhāvācceti tiṣṭhatu vistaraḥ | na subrahmaṇyāyāṃ svaritasya tūdāttaḥ 37 | subrahmaṇyākhye nigade pūrveṇa prāptā ekaśrutirna bhavati kintu vacanāntaravihitasya svaritasyodāttaḥ syāt | "subrahmaṇyom" | "indra āgaccha" | oṃkārasyodāttatvaṃ vyākhyātam | "omabyādāne" iti plutodāttatvaṃ tu nāsti, tasyā'yajñakarmaviṣayatvāditi saṃpradāyaḥ | indraśabda āmantritādyudāttaḥ, śeṣanighātenākāro'nudāttaḥ | "udāttādanudāttasya" iti tasya svaritaḥ, tasyānena udāttaḥ | "nipātā ādyudāttā" ityākāra udāttaḥ | gaccha ityasya "tiṅ‌ṅatiṅaḥ" iti nighātaḥ | "udāttād" iti gakārākārasya svaritaḥ | tasyāpyudāttaḥ | tathāca chakārabhinnā ādyāścatvāra udāttāḥ | naca "udāttād‌" iti chakārasyāpyudāttatvāpattiḥ | taduttarametatprakaraṇapāṭhasya pūrvamuktatvātsvaritodāttasyāsiddhatvāt | "hariva āgaccha" ityatra āmantritādyudāttaḥ ikārasyaśeṣanighātaḥ, tasya svaritaḥ, tasyodāttatvam iti `hariva' ityatra dvāvudāttāvantyo'nudāttaḥ | `āgaccha' ityapi pūrvavat | "āgaccha maghavan" ityatra "āmantritasya" iti maghavacchabdo'nudāttaḥ | "medhātitheḥ" iti ṣaṣṭhyantasya "meṣa" ityāmantreta parāṅgavadbhāvāt āmantritasvareṇa medhātitiśabdāvayavo me ityudāttaḥ, dhā ityasyoktarītyā svaritasyānenodāttaḥ | medhā iti dvyamudāttam | itaradanudāttam | evaṃ "vṛṣaṇaśvasya mene kaurāvaskandinnahalyāyai jāra" ityādiṣu parāṅgavadbhāvādi yojyam | "kauśikabrāhmaṇa gotamabruvāṇa" ityatrāpi dvau dvāvudāttāvanye'nudāttāḥ | naca tṛtīyasyāpi "udāttādanudāttasya" iti svaritatvādanenodāttatvāpattiḥ, evaṃ pareṣāmapīti vācyam | svaritagrahaṇasāmarthyāt sarveṣāmudāttatve iṣṭe "na" ityapahāya "subrahmaṇyāyāmudātta" ityeva brūyāt | tasmādubhayagrahaṇasāmarthyānna sarveṣāmudāttatvam | "śvaḥ sutyāmāgaccha maghavan" | śva iti nipātasvareṇādyudāttaḥ | sutyāśabdaḥ | "saṃjñāyāṃ samajaniṣadanipatamanavidaṣuñ‌śīṅ‌bhṛñiṇaḥ" iti sunoteḥ kyapi tatrodāttānuvṛtterantodāttaḥ, śeṣanighātena `su' ityanudāttaḥ | "udāttasvaritaparasya" ityanudāttataraḥ | āgaccha iti dvāvudāttau paro'nudātta iti pūrvavat | "dvyahe sutyām, tryahe sutyām" dvyaha iti ṭajantatvādantodāttam | tathā ca sāmabrāhmaṇam---"tasmādutkare tiṣṭhansubrahmaṇyaḥ subrahmaṇyāyāhvayati---subrahmaṇyo3m, subrahmaṇyo3m, subrahmaṇyo3m iti | striyamiva trirāha triṣatyā hi devāḥ | `indrāgaccha' iti yadāha `indrāgaccha' ityetadvā asya pratyatraṃ nāma tenaivainaṃ trirāhvayati | `hariva āgaccha' iti, pūrvapakṣāparapakṣau vā indrasya harī tābhyāṃ hīdaṃ sarvaṃ harati | `medhātithermeṣa' iti, medhātithiṃ ha kāṇvāyaniṃ meṣo bhūtvā jahāra | `vṛṣaṇaśvasya mene'| vṛṣaṇaśvasya ha menakā nāma duhitā''satāṃ hendraścakame | `gaurāvaskandin' iti | gauramṛgo ha bhūtvā'vaskadyāraṇyādrājānaṃ pibati |`ahalyāyai jāra' iti | ahalyāyā ha maitreyyā jāra āsa | `kauśikabrāhmaṇa' iti | kauśiko ha smainaṃ brāhmaṇa upanyeti | `gotamabruvāṇa' iti | devāsurā ha saṃyattā āsaṃstānantareṇa gotamaḥ śaśrāma, tamindra etyovāca---iha no bhavānspaśaścaratviti, nāhamutsaha iti, athāhaṃ bhavota rūpeṇa carāṇīti, yathā manyasa iti | sa yattad gotamo abruvāṇaścacāra gotamarūpeṇa vā tadetadāha gotamāsīti | ahe sutyāmāgaccha maghavanniti, tadyathā'rhato brūyāditi ahe vaḥ paktā'smi tadāgacchatetyevamevaitaddevebhyaḥ sutyāṃ prāha | `devā brāhmaṇāḥ' iti, devā ha vai devā atha haite manuṣyadevā ye brāhmaṇāḥ śuśruvāṃso'nūcānāste manuṣyadevāḥ | āhutaya eta devānāṃ dakṣiṇā manuṣyadevānām, āhutibhirha devānprīṇāti dakṣiṇābhirmanuṣyadevāñchuśruvuṣo'nūcānānbrāhmaṇānprīṇāti" iti | "asāvityantaḥ" | vācanikamidam | prathamāntasyānta udāttaḥ | `gārgyo yajate, vātsyo yajate | ñittvādādyudātvaṃ prāptam | tathā ca drāhyāyaṇisūtram "arthanirvacanamuccāntam" | `artho nirucyate bodhyate prādhānyena pratipādyate'nenetyarthanirvacanam | padamiti yāvat | padamityeva tu noktam | samāse pūrvapadānāmantodāttatā mā bhūd' iti vyākhyātāraḥ | yajate ityasya nihatasya "udāttād‌" iti svaritatve udāttaḥ | "amuṣyetyantaḥ" | ṣaṣṭhyantopalakṣaṇamidam | `dākṣeḥ pitā yajate' | pūrvavat | "syāntasyopottamaṃ ca" adantasya ṣaṣṭhyantasya upāntyaṃ cakārādantaścetyubhayamudāttaṃ syāt | gārgyasya pitā yajate, vātsyasya pitā yajate | "vā nāmadheyasya" | syāntasya nāmadheyasyopottamaṃ vā udāttaṃ syād, antyastu syādeva | devadattasya pitā yajate | `janiṣyamāṇānām' ityatra pratyayasvareṇa syaśabda udāttaḥ, "tāsyanudātted‌" iti lasārvadhātukasvareṇa śānajanudāttaḥ | "udāttād‌" iti svaritaḥ | tasyānenodāttatvamiti ṣyamau udāttau | anyaccheṣanighātenānudāttam | `pitāpitāmaha' ityatra tu pitāmahapratitāmahayoḥ "asau" ityantodāttatve `udāttād" iti svaritatve prakṛtasūtreṇa pipraśabdayorevodāttatvaṃ natu tatparato'pi | devabrahmaṇoranudāttaḥ 38 | atra vārttikam---"devabrahmaṇoranudāttatvameke" iti | devā brahmāṇa āgacchata | ayamarthaḥ---devā brahmāṇa iti padayorvaiyadhikaraṇyapakṣe pūrvasyāmantritasyāvidyamānavadbhāvādubhayorapi āmantritādyudāttatve śeṣanighāte svaritatve ca kṛte'nudāttavidhirarthavān | yadi tu tayoḥ samānādhikaraṇyaṃ tadā "vibhāṣitaṃ viśeṣavacane bahuvacanam" iti pakṣe vidyamānatvād "āmantritasya" iti nighātenaiva siddhyā prayojanābhāvāt | svaritātsaṃhitāyāmanudāttānām 39 | svaritātpareṣāmanudāttānāṃ saṃhitāyāmekaśrutiḥ syāt | "imaṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvati" | imamityantodāttam | me ityanudāttam | "anudāttaṃ sarvam" ityadhikārāt | "udāttādanudāttasya" iti tasya svaritaḥ | tataḥ pareṣāṃ gaṅge ityādīnāmekaśrutiḥ | saṃhitāyāṃ kim | padapāṭhe āmantritanighātenānudāttatvameva yathā syāt | syādetat | `anudāttānām' iti bahutvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ na vā | nādyaḥ | `āgniveśyaḥ', `pacati' ityatra dvitvaikatvayoravyāpteḥ | āgniveśyaśabdo hi gargādiyañantatvādādyudāttaḥ | śeṣanighāte dvitīyaḥ "udāttād‌" iti svaritaḥ | veśyeti varṇadvayamanudāttam | pacati ityatra dhāturudāttaḥ | śaptipau pittvādanudāttau | śavakāraḥ svaritaḥ | tataḥ para eva evānudātta ityekaśrutirna syāt | nāntyaḥ | 'imaṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvati" ityatra meśabdasya svaritatvāttataḥ parasyaikasyaivekaśrutiḥ syāt, na `yamune' ityādīnām, vyavahitatvāt | "tasmādityuttarasya" itivacanāt | atra bhāṣyam---vacanatrayāntānāmanudāttapadānāmekaśeṣo'yamiti | sarūpasūtrārambhapakṣe cedam | jātipakṣe tu "jātyākhyāyām" iti bahuvacanam | tataścaikadvibahuṣu svaritātparasyā jāterānantaryeṇopalambhātsarveṣāmaikaśrutyasiddhiḥ | nanvādye ṣaṭ‌prabhṛtīnāmeva kāryaṃ syātsahavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣavidhānāt samuditānāmeva kāryānvayāditi cenna | nirdeśasahavivakṣāyāmapi pratyekaṃ kāryapravṛtteḥ, devadattayajñadattaviṣṇumitrā bhojyantāmitivat | udāttasvaritaparasya sannataraḥ 40 | udāttaḥ svarito vā paro yasmāttasyānudāttasyānudāttataraḥ | "sarasvati śutudri" | "vyacakṣayatsvaḥ" | iti vṛttikārādayaḥ | kecittu---ekaśrutisvarasyānudāttataraḥ syādityevārthaḥ | anyathā 'ekaśruti dūrād‌" itisūtragatabhāṣyakaiyaṭavirodhāt | kiñca asyāsiddhatvātsarasvatīśabdāvayavekārasyāpi pūrveṇaikaśrutiḥ syāt | nacāyaṃ tadapavādaḥ | agnim, kanyā ityādau sāvakāśatvāt | naca "na mu ne" ityatra `na' iti yogavibhāgānnāsiddhatvamiti haradattādirītyā nirvāhaḥ | tadarthaṃ yogavibhāgasya bhāṣyādāvanukteḥ | anyathā śāstrāntapāṭhakalpanasyāpi vaiyarthyāt | ekaśruteriva svaritasyāpi paratvādbādhopapattau "nodāttasvarītodayam" iti sūtravaiyarthyācceti prāhuḥ | apṛkta ekālpratyayaḥ 41 | eko'l yatra sa pratyayo'pṛktasaṃjñaḥ | pradeśāḥ--"sutisyapṛktaṃ hal‌" ityādayaḥ | syādetat | ekahalityeva vaktavyam | `apṛktaṃ hal' ityatra halpadaparityāge lāghavāt | algrahaṇe tu bibhedetyādau ṇalo lopavāraṇāya tadāvaśyakatvāt | maivam | "yūni lugaṇiñoḥ" iti padadvayoccāraṇe gauravāt | halgrahaṇetu apṛktasyetyeva tatra vaktavyatvāt | nacaivaṃ phāṇṭāhṛterapatyaṃ phāṇṭāhṛtaḥ | "phāṇṭāhṛtimimatābhyām" itiṇapratyayasyāpi lugāpattiḥ | aṇa eva lukā siddhau ṇavidhānānarthakyāpattyā tadvāraṇāt | naca "yañiñośca" itiphagbādhanārthatayā tatsārthakyam | pailādipāṭhaṃ kṛtvā'pi phako vārayituṃ śakyatvāt | maivam | yathānyāse'pṛktasaṃjñāyāṃ halgrahaṇam, halṅyādisūtre dvitīyahalgrahaṇam, "aṇiñoḥ" ityatrāpṛktagrahaṇaṃ ceti trayamaḥ uktarītyā'pyapṛktasaṃjñāyāṃ halgrahaṇam, "aṇiñoḥ" ityatrāṇiñ‌padayorgrahaṇaṃ ceti padatrayameveti na lāghavam | evaṃ ca tathā'pyekagrahaṇaṃ māstu | naca darviḥ, jāgṛvirityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ | aleva yaḥ pratyaya iti vyākyānāt | anyathā'lpadavaiyarthyāt | alantasyetyarthe kevalasyādyantavadbhāvena tathātvāśrayaṇe tadvyāvartyābhāvāt | nacaivaṃ halgrahaṇe'pi samānam iti vācyam | ajantavyāvṛttyā tadantavidheścaritārthatvāpatteḥ | tasmād‌ "ekagrahaṇaṃ varṇagrahaṇe jātigrahaṇam iti jñāpanārtham" iti bhāṣyam | "nipāta ekāj" ityatra jñāpitasyāpi punarjñāpanaṃ mandabuddhyanugrahārthamiti kaiyaṭaḥ | tatpuruṣaḥ samānādhikaraṇaḥ karmadhārayaḥ 42 | sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dvedhā śābdamārthaṃ ca | ādyaṃ yathā---nīlamutpalamiti padadvayasya, samānavibhaktikatvāt | dvitīyamapi tatraiva tadarthayorabhedena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāt | tatrādyaṃ bādhitasādhāraṇaṃ `matā vandhyā' ityādidarśanāt | dvitīyaṃ tvabādhitamātravṛttīti vivekaḥ | śabdānuśāsanaprastāvādādyamevātra niviṣṭam | kāñcanamayavahnimānityādyabhiyuktaprayogadarśanāt | varttipadayorekavibhaktikayoryastatpuruṣaḥ karmadhārayasaṃjñaḥ sa syāt | tatpuruṣaprakaraṇādanyatraitadārambhastu karmadhārayasaṃjñāyāstatpuruṣasaṃjñābādhakatvaṃ mā bhūditi | tatraikasaṃjñādhikārāt | nīlañca tadutpalaṃ ca nīlotpalam | citrā gāvo yasyetyādibahuvrīherapi samānādhikaraṇatvādvyabhicāravāraṇāya tatpuruṣa iti | rājapuruṣa ityādivāraṇāya samānādhikaraṇa iti | naca tatpuruṣasya samudāyasyaikyātsāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattistasya bhedaniyatatvāditi vācyam | tatparuṣapadasya tad‌ghaṭakapadalakṣakatvāt | nanu mukhyatatpuruṣasyāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ sambhavati--- rājapuruṣaḥ śobhana ityādau, tatra caritārthatvātkuto lakṣaṇā | atra kaiyaṭaḥ---tatpuruṣasya padāntareṇa sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ barihaṅgaṃ varttipadānāṃ tu tadantaraṅgamiti | nacaivaṃ pratyekaṃ padānāmeva kramadhārayasaṃjñā''pattiḥ | ekājdvirvacananyāyena padasamudāyasyaiva saṃjñāvidhānāt | prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ samāsa upasarjanam 43 | samāsavidhau prathamāntaṃ padamuktasaṃjñam | kṛṣṇaṃ śritaḥ kṛṣṇaśritaḥ | kṛṣṇādiśabdānāṃ prathamāntatvābhāve'pi "dvitīyāśrita---" ityādau tatsamarpakadvitīyādipadānāṃ prathamāntatvāt | tathāca samāsapadaṃ tadvidhāyakaśāstraparamiti phalitam | samāsaghaṭakapadāpekṣayā samāsavidherlaghutayā tatparatvasyaiva nyāyyatvāt | syādetat | nirdeśāpekṣayā samāsasyādhāratvāt ekatra prathamānirdiṣṭasya sarvatropasarjanasaṃjñā syāt | taduktam---"yasya vidhau prathamānirdeśastato'nyatropasarjanasaṃjñāprasaṅga" iti | tataśca rājakumārīśrita ityatra śritādisamāse kumārīśabdasya prathamānirdiṣṭatvāduktasaṃjñāyām upasarjanatvanimitto hrasvaḥ, pūrvanipātaśca pūrvapade ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣe'pi syāt | atra vārttikam--- "siddhantu yasya vidhau taṃ pratīti vacanād‌" iti | yasya śritādeḥ samāsavidhau prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ taṃ pratyevopasarjanasaṃjñetyarthāt | upasarjanamityanvarthasaṃjñayā yatpratiyogikaṃ yasyāpradhānatvaṃ tatpratiyogikaivoktasaṃjñeti lābhāt | nanvevamarddapippalī, puruṣavyāghra ityādau pūrvapadārthapradhāne'rddhādiśabdānāmuktasaṃjñā na syāt | maivam | arthasambhave satyevānvarthasaṃjñānāṃ pravṛttinimittamapekṣya pravṛtteḥ | anyatra tu tadanapekṣyaiva, vidhānasāmarthyād | ata eva svādīnāṃ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñeti vakṣyate | etena rājñaḥ puruṣasyetyādikamapi vyākhyātam | bhāṣye tu parihārāntaramapyuktam | pūrvanipātaprakaraṇe hi "na vā'niṣṭadarśanād‌" iti pūrvānipātaṃ pratyākhyāyoktam---"ṣaṣṭhyantayoḥ samāse'rthābhedātpradhānasyāpūrvanipātaḥ" iti | vākyasamāsayorekārthatvānurodhādrājña eva pūrvanipāto na puruṣasya, anyathā'rthabhedaprasaṅgāt | na ca rājñaḥ kumāryā ityatropasarjanahrasvāpattiḥ | punarṅīpsambhavādiṣṭāpatteḥ | vakṣyate hi---"paravalliṅgam" iti, "śabdaśabdārthau" iti | yadyapyetattatraiva dūṣaṇīyaṃ tathāpyanvarthasaṃjñāyāmeva tātparyam | ekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte 44 | samāse yanniyatavibhaktikaṃ tadapyuktasaṃjñaṃ na tu tasya pūrvanipātaḥ | tattatprayogavyaktau sarvasyāpyekavibhaktitvāt sāmarthyāt yasya paryāyeṇāpi na sarvavibhaktitvaṃ tasyeyaṃ saṃjñā | `niṣkauśāmbiḥ' ityatra hi kauśāmbīśabdo niṣkramaṇakriyā'pekṣayā'pādānaśaktisanbandhātpañcamyanta eva | kriyāntarāpekṣayā śaktyantarānāveśāt | syādetat | śritādisamāse dvitīyādyantānāṃ kṛṣṇādiśabdānāmapyanena pūrvanipātaniṣedhaḥ syāt, pūrvasūtrasya nīlotpalādisamānādhikaraṇasamāse sāvakāśatvāt | maivam | atra paryudāsāśrayaṇāt pūrveṇa tatra siddheḥ | yadvā "ekavibhakti---" ityanena vihitopasarjanasaṃjñānibandhanasyaiva pūrvanipātasya pratiṣedhaḥ | "anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā" itinyāyāt | "ekavibhaktāvaṣaṣṭhyantavacanam" iha mā bhūt arddhaṃ pippalyā arddhapippalī | ekadeśisamāsamātraviṣayakaścāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ | tena pañcānāṃ kumārīṇāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcakumāri ityādau upasarjanatvameveti dvitīye vistaraḥ | "prayojanaṃ dviguprāptāpannālaṃpūrvopasargakrāntādyarthe" | krameṇodāharaṇam | pañcabhirgobhiḥ krītaḥ pañcaguḥ, prāpto jīvikāṃ prāptajīvikaḥ, āpanno jīvikāmāpannajīvikaḥ, alaṅkumāryai alaṅkumāriḥ, niṣkrāntaḥ kauśāmbyā niṣkauśāmbiḥ | iti siddhāntasudhānidhau prathamādhyāyasya dvitīye pāde prathamāhnikam || arthavadadhāturapratyayaḥ pratipadikam 45 | dhātupratyayabhinnamarthavacchabdarūpaṃ prātipadikasaṃjñaṃ syāt | mahāsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ "ko dhātuḥ, kaḥ pratyayaḥ, kiṃ prātipadikam" ityārthavaṇaśrutyanurodhāt | arthapadamabhideyaparam | saṃjñiviśeṣalābhārthamidam | taduktam---"arthavaditivyapadeśo varṇānāṃ mā bhūd" iti | nacādhāturityādiparyudāsāttad‌bhinnasyārthavata eva lābhaḥ | dharmāntaraprayuktasādṛśyavato vāraṇīyatvāt | tena varṇeṣu pratyekaṃ na vyabhicāraḥ | "varṇānāṃ ca mā bhūd‌" itipāṭhe daśadāḍimādyanarthakapadasamudāyasya cakāreṇa samuccayaḥ | syādetat---astu varṇānāṃ saṃjñā | na ca svāderāpattiḥ | ekavākyatayā saṃkhyākarmādiṣu teṣāṃ vidhānāt | maivam | aviśeṣeṇa svādīnāmutpatteḥ | tato'rthaniyamaḥ prakṛtārthāpekṣo vā pratyayaniyama iti avyayādivatsupāṃ durvāratvāt | tataśca dhanaṃ vanamityādau samudāyasya pṛthak prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ tadantarbhāvāt vibhaktilope'pi nalopāpattiḥ | na cādhāturiti niṣedhaḥ | pratyekasmādvibhakterāpādyatvāt | tatra ca dhātutvābhāvāt | arthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣāyā viśiṣṭarūpopādānaviṣayakatvāt | "prādūhoḍha" ityādivat | yattūktam---"saṃghātasyaikārthyāt subabhāvo varṇād‌" iti, tad‌ varṇānāmarthavattvapakṣe tantreṇaikayaiva vibhaktyā samudāyāvayavārthagataikatvapratītisiddheḥ | anarthakasya tu saṃjñāyāṃ prakāśanīyārthavirahāt pratyekavarṇādapi syād | anyad vicāritaṃ paspaśāyām | nanu "supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ" ityatra dhātoḥ pārthakyena grahaṇāt dhātoḥ prātipadikasañjñāviraho jñāpayiṣyate | anyathā putrīyatītyādau prātipadikatvādeva luk‌siddheḥ tena "ahan‌ vṛtram" ityādau na nalopāpattirityadhātugrahaṇaṃ vyartham | maivam | tatra "apratyaya" iti prātipadikasaṃjñāniṣedhāt tadarthatayā dhātugrahaṇopapatteḥ | naca pratyayalakṣaṇena "apratyaya" iti saṃjñāniṣedhaḥ | "naṅisambuddhyoḥ" ityanena lope kārye pratyayalakṣaṇamāśrityoktaparyudāso na pravartate iti jñāpitatvāt | apratyaya iti kim | kāṇḍe, kuḍye | atra vibhaktyantasya sañjñāyāṃ 'hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya" iti mā bhūt | atra bhāṣye chid‌ bhid‌ ityādau `adhātuḥ' iti niṣedhātprātipadikasaṃjñāvidhāyakatvena kṛdgrahaṇasya caritārthatve'pi taddhitagrahaṇasya niyamārthatvaṃ bhaviṣyati---etadantasyaiva pratyayāntasya saṃjñeti | syādetad---padānāṃ pratyekaṃ pratyayāntatve'pi vākyasya prātipadikasaṃjñā syāt | naca tatra pratyayāntaparyudāsena nirvāhaḥ | `pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa vihitastadādestadantasya ca' iti prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasyaiva grahaṇāt | nanu arthavattvābhāvādeva tadvāraṇam | anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ padānāmevārthavattvāt, vākyasya cākāṅkṣādilabhyatvāt | maivam | dhvanivyaṅgya nityaṃ vākyaṃ padārthasaṃsargarūpaviśiṣṭavākyārthavācakam | anyathā vākyārthasyāśābdatvaṃ syāt | tathāca vākyameva mukhyaḥ śabdaḥ, vākyārtha eva mukhyaḥ śabdārthaḥ | padapadārthāvasthāpanaṃ tu lāghavārthaṃ sādṛśyātkalpitānvayavyatirekāvāśritya kalpitam | prativākyaṃ vyutpattyasambhavāt iti siddhāntāt | atra vārtikam--- "arthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārtham" iti | nanvevaṃ bahupaṭavaḥ, uccakaiḥ, nīcakaiḥ ityādikānāmapi saṃjñā na syāt | dyotyavācyābhyāmarthābhyāṃ pratyayasya prakṛteścārthavattvāt arthavatsamudāyatvarūpapratiyogitāvacchedakadharmāvacchinnatvāt | naca saṃjñāvirahe yathā svādyutpattirna bhavati, tathā pūrvotpannavibhaktilopo'pi na bhaviṣyati iti tayaiva siddhiriti vācyam | svare doṣaprasaṅgāt | tathāhi--"cita" iti sūtre "citaḥ saprakṛteḥ bahvakajartham" itivacanātprakṛtimantarbhāvya citsvaro vidhīyate | tathāca `paṭava' iti jasantasya bahucaṃ prati prakṛtitvāt jasakārasyodāttatvaṃ syāt | pūrvopannasupo lope tu punarutpannavibhakteḥ prakṛtāvanantarbhāvāṭṭākārasyodāttatvamiti siddhamiṣṭam | uccakairityādāvapi akajvataḥ samudāyādvibhaktyabhāve padatvābhāvād `uccakaiḥ paṭhati' ityādau "tiṅ‌ṅatiṅa" iti nighātānupapattiḥ, padādityadhikārāt | tanmadhyapatitanyāyasyānāśrayaṇenedam | tasmātprakṛtipratyayasamudāyasya prātipadikasaṃjñā bhavatyeveti jñāpanārtham apratyaya iti vaktavyam | nacaivaṃ bahupaṭava ityāderapi niṣedhāpattiḥ | pratyayāntasyaiva pratiṣedhāt | na ca `saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantagrahaṇābhāvaḥ' | yatra saṃjñā vidheyā tatraiva tanniṣedhāt | atra tu saṃjñāpratiṣedha iti vaiṣamyāt | na ca jasantaṃ bahupaṭava ityetadapi pratyayāntameveti vācyam | paṭuśabdādeva jasutpatteḥ, samudāyasya tadantatvābhāvāt | na ca na vidyate pratyayo yasmin iti bahuvrīhiṇā pratyayāderapi bahupaṭava ityasya niṣedhaḥ syāditi vācyam | varttipadārthaprādhānyena tatpuruṣasyāntaraṅgatvāt | atra bhāṣyam---tulyajātīyasyaiva samāsagrahaṇena niyamaḥ kriyate subantānāmeva samāsavidhānāt | na cāśvakrītītyādau "gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpatteḥ" itivacanādasubantenāpi subantasya samāso'stīti vācyam | bhedasaṃsargadvārakārthavattvayuktānāmityarthāditi kaiyaṭaḥ | tathāca prakṛtipratyayabhāvānāpannasamudāyasya samāsabhinnasyoktaniyamena vyāvṛttiriti phalitam | etenoktadoṣabhiyā pratyayāntapratiṣedhasāmarthyātprakṛtipratyayasamudāyasya saṃjñā bhavatyeveti nyāsagrantho yathāśrutaparatvena vyākhyātaḥ | kecittu---yatra saṃghāte pūrvo bhāgaḥ padam uttarastu na pratyayastasya vyāvṛttiḥ | bahupaṭava ityatra pūrvabhāgasya padatvābhāvānna doṣaḥ | janmavānityādau tūttarabhāgasya pratyayatvāt | na ca taddhitagrahaṇasāmarthyam | aupagava ityādau pūrvasya bhasaṃjñayā tatra caritārthatvāt | na cāntarvarttivibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñā | tulyāvadhikayā bhasaṃjñayā tadbādhāt | na ca `ayamiyān' ityādisamudāyasya saṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ pūrvabhāgasya padatve'pyuttarasya pratyayatvāduktaniyamena tatra pravṛttyabhāvāditi vācyam | tadvihitatvasyāpi pratyayaviśeṣaṇatvāt | tadvihitatvābhāvāprayuktaviśiṣṭābhāvasya tatrāpyanapāyādityāhuḥ | na ca suptiṅ‌samudāyasya saṃjñāpattiḥ | "jahikarmaṇā bahulamābhīkṣṇye karttāraṃ cābhidadhāti" ityasya niyamārthatvāt | yadyapi samāsasaṃjñā samāsāntodāttārthā tathāpi samāsatvādeva prātipadikatvamiti tattulyajātīyatāpratipādanārthametaduktamiti kaiyaṭaḥ | na ca `paśya dhāvati' ityādestiṅ‌samudāyasya tadāpattiḥ | "ākhyātamākhyātena kriyāsātatye" ityasya niyamārthatvāt | tasmātsamāsagrahaṇena tulyajātīyānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vākyānāṃ niyamānnivṛttiriti siddham | atra vadanti---naiyāyikamate samāsasya śaktilakṣaṇobhayarahitatvādarthavattvābhāvādaprāptasaṃjñāvidhāyakatve bahupaṭava ityāderasiddhiḥ, taddhitāntatvābhāvātsamāsatvābhāvāt | na ca taddhitagrahaṇaṃ tadviśiṣṭaparamiti vācyam | pacatakītyādāvativyāpteriti | tanna | padārthadvayasya viśeṣyatvaprakāratvābhyāmanvayāt yatra viśiṣṭārthalābhastādṛśasamudāyasyaiva tairanarthakatvopagamāt | bahucastu svārthikapratyayatvena paṭuśabdasyaiva tādṛśārthakatvāt | tathāca ayaṃ viśeṣaḥ---vaiyākaraṇānāṃ vākyasamāsayorapi bahupaṭava ityādivadarthavattvātsamāsagrahaṇasya niyamārthatvād vākyavadbahupaṭava ityāderapi vyāvṛttiprasaktau tadvyāvṛttaṃ niyamapratiyogitāvacchedakaṃ rūpamāśritya vākyasya saṃjñā vāryate | naiyāyikānāṃ tu samāsasya viśeṣavidhānātsaṃjñā na tu vākyasya, viśeṣavidhyabhāvād | arthavattvābhāvena sāmānyavidherapravṛtteśca | bahupaṭava ityādestu ubhayamate'pyarthavattvādeva prātipadikasaṃjñeti | yadapyuktam---samāsagrahaṇasya niyamārthatvābhāve `mūlakenopadaṃśam' ityādau samudāyasya prasaṅgaḥ | kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇāt | vaiyākaraṇamate tu samāsagrahaṇakṛtaniyamena paratvāttadbādhāt | evañca "kṛtaddhita" iti sūtre kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate eva phalābhāvāditi | tadapyasat | vidhimukhena niyamapravṛttau niṣedhasyākṣepyatvāt pratyakṣavidhināṃ samaṃ vipratiṣedhāyogāt | ākṣepyāpekṣayā pratyakṣasya balavattvāt | niṣedhasya samāsabhinnaparatāyā iva kṛdbhinnaparatāyā apyavaśyaṃ kalpanīyatvāt | niṣedhamukhena pravṛttiriti pakṣe'pi kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā kārakapūrvasyāpi prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ siddhāyāṃ pareṇāpi niyamena vyavacchedo na syāt | kārakapūrvasya prātipadikasaṃjñāvidheranyatra sāvakāśatvābhāvāt sāvakāśaniravakāśayorvipratiṣedhānupapatteḥ | na ca niyamānurodhāttadapravṛttiḥ | niyamasya kṛdbhinnaparatvam, kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣāsaṅkoco vā kalpyate ityatra niyāmākābhāvāt | paribhāṣāyā apravṛttau niyamasya kṛtsādhāraṇyam, tatsiddhau tatparibhāṣāyā apravṛttirityanyo'nyāśrayāpatteśca | pratyuta tasyāḥ prathamopasthitikatayā kārakapūrvasya saṃjñāsiddhau niyamasya tadbhinnaparatāyā eva yuktatvāt | atha eva "kṛttaddhita" ityatra kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣopasthāne `mūlakenopadaṃśam' ityatra samāsābhāvapakṣe'pi tṛtīyāyā luk syāt | na ca samāsavikalpavidhivaiyarthyam | `dadhiupadaṃśam' ityatra śākalaprakṛtibhāvārthatayā tadupapatteḥ | anyathā "amaivāvyayena" iti nityasamāsāpattyā "sinnityasamāsayoḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ" iti śākalaprakṛtibhāvaniṣedhāpatteriti kaiyaṭena caturthe uktam | "gatikārakopapadātkṛt" iti uttarapadaprakṛtisvaravirahārthaṃ tayā tadupapattiriti ca sīradevenoktam | paratvānniyamena tatsaṃjñābādhamanabhidhāya kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣāyā apravṛttereva tena prathamamuktatvāt | tathāhi praṣṭhītyādau samāsātprāgeva "puṃyogād" ityādivacanairṅyādipratyayaḥ syādityāśaṅkya praṣṭhādisamudāyasya prātipadikatvābhāvātstrīpratyayānupapattirityuktvā kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā samudāyasya kṛdantatvātsaṃjñā syādityāśaṅkya apratyaya iti paryudāsātpratyayāntasya prātipadikasaṃjñāyā aprāptāvapi kṛdgrahaṇena kṛdantasya saṃjñā na tu gatikārakapūrvasyāpītyuktam | tasmātsamāse kṛte tannibandhanaprātipadikasaṃjñayā strīmatyaya iti tadgranthārthaḥ | atastatra kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate ityubhābhyāmuktam | tasmādevaṃ samādheyam--- "kṛttaddhita" ityatra saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhyabhāve'pi arthavadityasyānuvṛttyā prakriyādaśāyāmanvayavyatirekābhyāṅkalpitāmarthavattāmāśritya prakṛtipratyayayormilitvā yadarthabodhakatvaṃ tadarthabodhakasamudāyasya prātipadikasaṃjñeti tāvadbhāṣyādāveva spaṣṭam | tataśca naiyāyikamate'pi arthavadgrahaṇānuvṛttyā prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasyaiva vidhānasāmarthyātsaṃjñā na tu kārakapūrvasyāpi | adhikagrahaṇe pramāṇābhāvāt | tadbalātparibhāṣāyā eva pravṛttyabhāvāt | vastuto nātra tatparibhāṣā'vakāśaḥ | "gatiranantara" ityatra tasyā jñāpayiṣyamāṇatvāt | pratyekapūrvasyaiva grahaṇamiti tadarthāt | ubhayapūrvasya yugapadanupādānāt | avataptenakulastitam, udakeviśīrṇamityādau tathaiva darśanācceti dik | nanvetatsūtraṃ vyartham, vyutpattipakṣe kṛdantatvādeva sarvatra siddheriti cenna | avyutpattipakṣe sārthakyāt | tatra cedameva jñāpakamiti prāñcaḥ | nirukte'pyuktam---"nāmānyākhyātajānīti śākaṭāyanaḥ, nairuktasamayaśca, na sarvāṇīti gārgyo vaiyākaraṇānāñcaike" iti | vyutpattipakṣe'pi nipātārthamanukaraṇārthañceti haradattoktaṃ tu cintyam | tatrāpi prakṛtyādikalpanasambhavāt | vastutastu vyutpattipakṣe'pi bahupaṭava ityādyarthaṃ sūtram | na caivaṃ bahucpūrva ityeva sūtryatāmiti vācyam | mūlakenopadaṃśamityādau kṛdantatvenātiprasaṅgāt | arthavatsūtraṃ vinā samāsagrahaṇasya niyamārthatvāyogāditi dīkṣitāḥ | tadasat | bhedavivakṣāyāmanukaraṇānāṃ prakṛtyādikalpena mānābhāvāt | ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ | bhedavivakṣāpakṣe'nukāryeṇārthavattvātprātipadikasaṃjñā "bhuvo vug‌" ityādivat | abhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu na, gavityayamāhetyādivat | mūlaketyādāvatiprasaṅgasya ca nirastatvāt | kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca 46 | kṛdantataddhitāntasamāsāḥ prātipadikasaṃjñāḥ | pratyayāntapratiṣedhasya pūrvamuktatvāttadapavādasyāsya pratyayānta eva pravṛtteḥ, "saṃjñāvidhau" ityasya nātra pravṛttiriti nyāsakāraḥ | liṭ‌ dhuk ityādau adhāturiti, kartetyādau pratyayāntamiti paryudāse prāpte'yamārambhaḥ | samāsagrahaṇaṃ ca niyamārthamiti vyākhyātam | nanu samāsasya pratyayāntatvādaprāptavidhirayaṃ syāt | maivam | pratyayagrahaṇe yasmātsa vihitastadādereva grahaṇāt | na ca "strīpratyaye cānupasarjanena" ityanupasarjanastrīpratyaye tadādiniyamābhāvād `rājakumārī' ityādyarthaṃ syāditi vācyam | antaraṅgasyāpi hal‌ṅyādilopasya ligviṣaye pravṛttyabhāvāt, śrūyamāṇe eva supi samāsapravṛtteḥ, `parihṛtyāpavādaviṣayam' itinyāyāt | tatrāpratyayāntatvena samāsavākye pravṛttāyāḥ saṃjñāyā ekadeśavikṛtanyāyena vibhaktilukyapi sulabhatvāt | ata eva gomatpriyaḥ ityādau na numādayaḥ | lukā lope pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvāt | nanu tathā'pyasamarthasamāse vidhyarthaṃ syāt | maivam | arthavadityanuvṛtteḥ, tasya cānarthakatvāt | na caivaṃ tatra saṃjñā''nāpattiḥ | dharmigrāhakamānena tatsiddheḥ | "asūryalalāṭayoḥ" ityanena hyasūryaśabde upapade khaś‌ | vibhaktyantaṃ vinā ca upoccāritapadarūpopapadatvānupapatteḥ | syādetat | śaśaviṣāṇādisamāsārthamayamapūrvavidhiḥ | teṣāmanarthakatvāt | nanu śaśapadaṃ śaśasabandhābhāvavatparam | tasyābhedena viṣāṇānvayaḥ | tathā ca śaśasambandhābhāvavadabhinnaṃ viṣāṇamityarthavadeva taditi vācyam | śaśaviṣāṇaṃ nāstītyasyāyogyatvāpatteḥ | ataeva viṣāṇe śaśasambandhābhāvaniścayadaśāyāṃ śaśaviṣāṇanirmitaṃ kārmukamiti vākyānna śābdadhīrityabhiyuktaḥ | ata eva--- eṣa vandhyāsuto yāti khapuṣpakṛtaśekharaḥ | mṛgatṛṣṇā'mbhasi snātaḥ śaśaśṛṅgadhanurddharaḥ || ityāderapārthakatvamiti kṣīrasvāmyādibhiruktam | ata eva `saṅgatigrahaṇaābhāvācchaśaśṛṅgādipadānāmabodhakatā' iti bauddhādhikāradīdhitāvuktam | maivam | "śabdajñānānupātī vastuśūnyo vikalpaḥ" iti pātañjalasūtrāt śaśaviṣāṇāderalīkasyāpi śabdabodhyatvāt | anena padenālīkaṃ bodhyamiti vṛttestatra svīkārācca | ata eva `gaganakamalasyāpi śabdābhāsapratipannatvād' iti līlāvatyāmuktam | atyantāsatyapi jñānamarthe śabdaḥ karoti hi | iti--- khaṇaaḍanakārokteśca | vastutastu tanniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogini śaśapadasya lakṣaṇā | tataśca tadarthenārthavatvātprātipadikasaṃjñā | `śaśasambandhaviśeṣavadviṣāṇam' itidhīstu bhramādeva | etena śaśaviṣāṇaṃ nāstītyapi vyākhyātam | śaśasambandhaviśeṣasyaiva tatra pratiyogitāvacchedakatāyā bhramaviṣayatvāt | ata eva `śaśādipratyekapadārthavyutpannasya śaśaviṣāṇādipadāttadarthapratyayaprasaṅgād' iti dīdhitāvuktaṃ viśiṣṭasyārthavattvaṃ nāstītyabhiprāyāt | ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ---tādṛśārthaviśeṣaśaktasya śaśaviṣāṇādisamāsasya kadācicchaktibhramādanyathābodhakatvamiti | prāñcastu khapuṣpaśaśaśṛṅgādiśabdānāmabhāvavacanatvādarthavattvam | tathāhi---khe puṣpaṃ nāstīti vigrahe nañarthāntarbhāvaḥ | vigrahe nāstīti kathanaṃ samāsārthavivaraṇārtham | samāsottaraṃ nāstīti padajātaṃ tvanuvādamātram | spaṣṭaṃ caitanmīmāṃsāvārttikādāvityāhuriti dik | hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya 47 | ajantasya prātipadikasya napuṃsake hrasvaḥ | śrīpam | hrasvaśrutyā "aca" ityupasthitau tadantavidhiḥ | prātipadikasambandhino'ca ityanvaye tu vaiyadhikaraṇyam, suvāk kulamityādāvativyāptiśca syāt | na ca napuṃsakapadenaiva prātipadikākṣepasambhavāttadupādānavaiyarthyam | kāṇḍe kuḍye ramate brāhmaṇakulamityādivyāvṛttyarthatvāt | sādhanāśrayasaṃkhyāvattalliṅgasyāpyupādānasaṃbhavāt | nacoktanyāyena `doṣā brāhmaṇakulam' ityādau sahacaritatvāddoṣāśabdasyaupacārikatve'vyayasyāpi hrasvāpattiḥ prātipadikatvāditi vācyam | `doṣā divā' iti śabdau hi rātrāvahanīti saptamyartaviśiṣṭārthau | brāhmaṇakulasādhānānāṃ kriyāṇāṃ adhikaraṇaṃ kālo bhavan brāhmaṇakulasyādhikaraṇam---`doṣā dṛśyate caratyadhīte vā' iti | ādheyavyavadhānenādhikaraṇasya kriyādhāratvāt | tataścāvyayaṃ napuṃsakasyādhikaraṇameva na tu napuṃsakamiti | nanu kāṇḍībhūtaṃ brāhmaṇakulamityādau prakṛtivikṛtyorabhedavivakṣāyāṃ cvipratyayāntasyāpi napuṃsakatvādativyāptiriti | naca kṛte hrasve "cvauca" iti dīrgho bhaviṣyatīti vācyam | antaraṅge dīrghe bahiraṅgasya hrasvatvasyāsiddhatvāt | evaṃ ramate ityatrāpi hrasvatve ṭeretvaṃ neti yojyamiti cenna | asattvavācitvādavyayasya napuṃsakatvābhāvāt | etena tibantamapi vyākhyātam | śaktyāśrayadravyaniṣṭhasaṃkhyāpratipādakasyāpyākhyātasya tadīyaliṅgapratipādane sāmarthyavirahāt | śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt | `kāṇḍe tiṣṭhataḥ' ityatrāpi napuṃsakatvābhāvaḥ, saṃkhyāyāḥ prādhānyāt | avayavadharmaṇa samudāyasya napuṃsakatvavyapadeśe tu kāṇḍe kuḍye ityatra syāt | prātipadikavibhaktyorekādeśasya prātipadikagrahaṇena grahaṇāt `hrasvo napuṃsake yattasya' iti karttavyaṃ syāt | sākṣāttasyaiva yadā napuṃsakatvaṃ tadā hrasvo na tvavayavadvārake tasminniti tadarthaḥ | athavā tasyaivānupajātavyatirekasyetyarthaḥ | vibhaktyantaṃ copajātavyatirekamiti nātiprasaṅgaḥ | sūtrakārasya tvayamabhiprāyaḥ---mukhyamevātra napuṃsakavṛtti prātipadikaṃ gṛhyate | antavadbhāvātideśāttu prātipadikatvaṃ na mukhyamiti | yugavaratrāya, yugavaratrārtham, yugavaratrebhya ityādau tu na hrasvaḥ | bahiraṅgatvāddīrghādīnāmasiddhatvāt | evamatikhaṭvāyetyādau uttarasūtreṇa hrasvo'pi neti vyākhyeyam | gostriyorupasarjanasya 48 | upasarjaneti gostriyoḥ, teca prātipadikasya viśeṣaṇam | tena tadantavidhiḥ | "grahaṇavatā prātipadikena" iti niṣedhasya pratyayavidhimātraviṣayakatvāt | tathā copasarjanabhūte ye gostriyau tadantaṃ yatprātipadikaṃ tasya hrasvaḥ syāt | "alo'ntyasya" | niṣkauśāmbiḥ, atikhaṭ‌vaḥ | "ekavibhakti ca" ityupasarjanatvam | citraguḥ | prathamānirdiṣṭatvāt | syādetat | atiśrīḥ, atilakṣmīrityādau hrasvatvaṃ syāt | maivam | atra vārttikam--- "goṭāṅgrahaṇaṃ kṛnnivṛttyartham" | kṛtstrīṇāṃ dhātustrīṇāṃ cetyarthaḥ | ṭāṅiti ṭāpamārabhya ṣyaṅo ṅakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ | tathā ca kṛdantastrīṇāṃ tadbahirbhāvānna doṣaḥ | bhāṣyakārāstvāhuḥ---strīgrahaṇaṃ svaritamāśritya "striyām" ityadhikāre vihitā eva pratyayā gṛhyante |"svaritamāśritya" iti sūtrasya yatra svaritatvaṃ tatra tadadhikāropādānamiti, asyāpivyākhyāsyamānatvāt | nanvevaṃ rājakumārīmatikrānto'tirājakumārirityādau hrasvo na syāt | pratyayagrahaṇe yasmātsa
