pūrvārddhena ca sahito divaso'dyatanaḥ, viśeṣaṇamupasarganamityādi pūrvācāryāṇāṃ vacanam | tatrāpyaśiṣyatvaṃ samānaṃ lokasiddhatvāt | yadvā lokasiddhatvākhyo hetustulyaḥ | tathā cāśiṣyatvasiddhiriti yojyam | jātyākhyāyāmekasminbahuvacanamanyatarasyām 58 | spaṣṭorthaḥ | yadyapi jātirupalakṣaṇaṃ vyaktistu padārtha iti pakṣe bahuṣvekavacanamityeva yuktam, "jāterupalakṣaṇatvenākhyāyām" iti vyākhyānāt, tathā'pi jātau padārtha etat | taduktam---"jātyākhyāyāṃ sāmānyābhidhānādaikārthyam" iti | bhāṣye tu "yad‌ gārgye gārgyatvaṃ tadekam" ityapyuktaṃ tad‌ gotrasya paribhāṣikajātitvābhyupagamāt, bahuṣu gargeṣu gārgyatvasyaikasya bhāvāditi kaiyaṭaḥ | jātiśceha samānakālīnānekavṛttireva gṛhyate na tu bhinnakālīnānekavṛttirḍitthatvādiḥ | jātipadārthapakṣe sarveṣāṃ jātiśabdatve'pi "jātyākhyāyām" ityuktisāmarthyāt | nanvatra pakṣe vrīhibhya āgata ityatra "rgheṅiti" iti guṇaḥ syāt sthānivadbhāvena ṅayādeśasya bhyaso ṅittvāt | maivam | ekasminnarthe bahutvasyaivānenātideśāt sthānyādeśabhāvavirahāt | taduktam---"arthātideśātsiddham" iti | evaṃ "tiṣyapunarvasvoḥ" ityatrāpi dvivacanabahuvacanaśabdābhyāṃ dvitvabahutvayorabhidhānamiti bodhyam | "saṅkhyāprayoge pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ" | ekasminbahutvātideśasyaikaśabdaprayoge'pi prāptau pratiṣedhārambhaḥ | eko vrīhiḥ saṃpannaḥ subhikṣaṃ karoti | vikalpaḥ kim | vrīhirityapi yathā syāt | tatra sampanno vrīhirityādau bhinnavyaktiparatve'pi ekatvaṃ vrīhitvajātāvevānveti kvacitpadārthatāvacchedakapadārthayorapyanvayasvīkārāditi kecit | anye tu vrīhyādipadaśakyatāvacchedakatayā vrīhitvādeḥ svarūpata evopasthityā anvayitāvacchedakavrīhitvatvarūpeṇānupasthitestatra padārthāntarānvayānupapattyā svāśrayaprakṛtyarthatāvacchedakavattvasambandhena prakṛtyarthe vrīhyādāvevaikatvānvaya ityāhuḥ | navyāstu nedaṃ yuktam | nahyekatvamātramekavacanasyārthaḥ vastumātrasādhāraṇyādarthavata eva lābhādanupayogācca, kintu sajātīyāntararāhityaviśiṣṭam | tacca sajātīyaniṣṭhabhedapratiyogitānavacchedakaikatvarūpam | sājātyaṃ ca samabhivyāhṛtapadārthasambandhitvaviśiṣṭaprakṛtyarthatāvacchedakarūpeṇa | tenātra ghaṭo'stītyādau etaddhaṭaniṣṭhasyaikatvasya ghaṭāntaraniṣṭhabhedapratiyogitāyāṃ vastvantaraniṣṭhaikatvasya caitad‌ghaṭaniṣṭhabhedapratiyogitāyāmavacchedakatayā ghaṭaniṣṭhabhedapratiyogitānavacchedakaikatvāprasiddhāvapi na kṣatiḥ | etaddeśavidyamānatvaviśiṣṭaghaṭaniṣṭhabhedapratiyogitānavacchedakatvasya taddhaṭaniṣṭhaikatve eva prasiddheḥ | tatra ghaṭāntarasattvavivakṣāyāṃ tu tadaprasiddhameva syāt | ata eva "paśunā yajeta" ityādāvekatvasya vivakṣitatvāt tadyāgavyaktau paśvantaravyāvṛttiḥ | bahughaṭasattve `ghaṭo'sti' iti prayogastu jātyabhiprāyeṇa samarthanīyaḥ | yattu bhāvākhyātavadatrāpyekatvamavivakṣitameva sādhutvārthatvāditi | tanna | tatra gatyantarābhāve'pyatra tadabhāvāt ityāhuḥ | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ--- atra vārttikaṃ "aśiṣyaṃ vā bahuvatpṛthaktvābhidhānād" iti | jātiprādhānyavivakṣāyāmekavacanasya dravyaprādhānyavivakṣāyāṃ tu bahuvacanasya siddhatvāt sūtraṃ nārabhyamityarthaḥ | "asmadaḥ saviśeṣaṇaprayoge neti vācyam"| devadattaḥ gārgyāyaṇaḥ paṇḍito vā ahaṃ bramīmi | tvaṃ rājā vayamapyupāsitaguruprajñābhimānonnatā ityādau bhavatyeva | niṣedhasyānuvādyaviśeṣaṇaviṣayatvāditi haradattādayaḥ | asmado dvayośca 59 | ekatve dvitve vā vivakṣite'smado bahuvacanaṃ vā syāt | vayaṃ brūmaḥ | ahaṃ bravīmi, āvāṃ brūva iti vā | idamapi bhāṣye pratyākhyātam | idaṃ me akṣi suṣṭhu paśyati, anenākṣṇā'haṃ suṣṭhu paśyāmītyubhayathā loke prayogadarśanāt | ādye ākhyātasya saṃyogādivyāpāraparatvāt, antye cāśrayatvāparatvāt | tathā ca vayaṃ paśyāmaḥ ityādau vayamityanenendriyāṇāmabhidhānāt śarīravattatrāpyahaṃkārotpādāt | ekendriyapravṛttāvindriyāntarāṇāmaudāsīnyena saṃvidhātṛtvātkartṛtvasya vivakṣitatvāt | pāratantryavivakṣāyāṃ tvahamityekavacanam | yuṣmadasmadoścaikaśeṣe'smada evārthadvayābhidhāyitvāt dvivacanam | phalgunīproṣṭhapadānāṃ ca na kṣatre 60 | dvitve bahutvaprayuktaṃ kāryaṃ vā syāt nakṣatrerthe | udite pūrve phalgunyau proṣṭhapade vā | uditāḥ pūrvāḥ phalgunyaḥ proṣṭhapadā vā | nakṣatre kim | phalgunyau māṇavike | idaprapi pratyākyātam | tadyuktaṃ candramasāmādāya bahutvasaṃbhavāt chatriṇo gacchantītyādivat | amāvāsyāyāmapyādityamaṇḍalapraviṣṭena candreṇa nakṣatrāṇāṃ yogāt | ekasyāṃ tūttarāyāṃ phalgunīśabdasyāvṛtteḥ puṣpavantāvityādivannaikavacanam | śiṣṭaprayogasya niyāmakatvācca nātiprasaṅgaḥ | chandasi punarvasvorekavacanam 61 | viśākhayośca 62 | dvitve ekavacanaṃ vā | punarvasu, viśākhā vā nakṣatram | pakṣe punarvasū, viśākhe | ime api pratyākhyāte | tathā ca vārtikam--- "punarvasu viśākhyoḥ supāṃ suluk pūrvasavarṇeti siddham" iti || tiṣyapunarvasvornakṣatradvandve bahuvacanasya dvivacanaṃ nityam 63 | bahutvaṃ dvitvavadbhavati | tiṣyaśca punarvasūca tiṣyapunarvasū | tiṣyeti kim | kṛttikārohiṇyaḥ | nakṣatreti kim | tiṣyaśca punarvasūca māṇavakāḥ tiṣyapunarvasavaḥ | na cātra gauṇatvādeva vyāvṛttiriti vācyam | tiṣyapunarvasuyuktakālabhavatvena māṇavakeṣu tiṣyapunarvasuśabdasya mukhyatvāt | na ca tathāpi pūrvasūtrādeva nakṣatrapadalābha iti vācyam | kālārthakatiṣyapunarvasuśabdasya vāraṇārthatvāt | vahavaḥ tiṣyapunarvasavo gatāḥ katareṇa tiṣyeṇa gataḥ | yadvā anayoḥ pradeśāntarasthamapi kāryaṃ nakṣatratve eva syādityetadartham | tena "tiṣyapunarvasvornakṣatrāṇi yalopa" ityatra nakṣatrapadaṃ nopādeyam | nanu tatra vā'tra vā tadupādāne na kaścidviśeṣa iti cettarhi paryāyasyāpi grahaṇārtham siddhapunarvasū iti siddham | dvandveti kim | yastiṣyaḥ sa eva punarvasū yeṣāṃ bhrāntānāṃ te tiṣyapunarvasavaḥ | bahviti kim | samāhāre mā bhūt | uditaṃ tiṣyapunarvasu | na cāprāṇināmiti paryudāsājjātiprayuktaikavadbhāvānupapattiḥ | sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣaikavadbhavatītyasya jñāpyatvāt | tena bābhravaśālaṅkāyanaṃ bābhravaśālaṅkāyanā ityādi siddham | tathāhi---aprāṇijātidvandve nityamekavadbhāvaḥ prāṇidvandve tu vikalpena, ekavadbhāvaprakaraṇaṃ prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra eva dvandva iti viṣayavibhāgārthamiti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | tathā ca tatprakaraṇānupāttānāṃ "cārtha dvandva" ityanenaiva itaretarayogadvandve dvivacanādi, samāhāradvandve tvekavadbhāva iti nyāyasiddhe'rthe bahuvacanagrahaṇamapi liṅgamiti siddham | tathā ca samāhāre prāṇyaṅgādīnāmeva dvandva iti tatra viparītaniyamavāraṇārthametaditi tātparyam | iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau prathamasya dvitīye dvitīyamānhikam | atha tṛtīyamāhnikam | sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣaekavibhaktau 64 | svādyanyatamayāvatpratyayaprakṛtikānāṃ yeṣāṃ śabdānāṃ sārūpyaṃ teṣāṃ madhye eka eva śiṣyate | vṛkṣau vṛkṣāḥ | yadyapi samānānāmityuktau rūḍhatvātsamānapadasya tulyārthatvāvagame lāghavam, sarūpāṇāmityatra tu padadvayārthāvagamapūrvakānyapadārthāvagamātpratipattigauravam, tathā'pi śabdārthobhayakṛtasāmvivakṣāpattyā vṛkṣā ityādāvevaikaśeṣaḥ syānna tvākṣāḥ pādā ityādau arthabhedāt | "svaṃ rūpam" ityatra rūpagrahaṇena vyākaraṇe'rthāṅgīkārasyāpi jñāpitatvāt | rūpagrahaṇe tu śabdasvarūpamātragataṃ tulyatvaṃ gṛhyate iti na doṣaḥ | nanvekagrahaṇaṃ vyartham | śeṣaśabdasya bhāvasādhanatvapakṣe prāthamyādekasyaiva śeṣasiddheḥ | śiṣyate iti śeṣa iti karmasādhanatve'pyekatvasya vivakṣitatvādekasyaiva śeṣasiddheḥ | maivam | ādye vyāptinyāyādanekasyāpi śeṣāpatteḥ | dvitīye'pi "grahaṃ samārṣṭi" itivatsaṃskāryasaṃkhyāyā avivaśritatvāt | atha śeṣagrahaṇaṃ vyartham | sarūpāṇāmekaḥ sādhurbhavatīti vākyaśeṣādhyāhāreṇāntaratamasyaikasyodaśasyopapatteḥ | maivam | ekasyādeśatvāprasaṅgāt | "ṣaṣṭhīsthāne yogā" iti niyamāt | tataścāśvaśca aśvaścāśvau | samudāyaghaṭakayordvayordvayoraśvaśabdayorādāvudāttatvādantye cānudāttatvātsarvodāttasya sarvānudāttasya vā'śvaśabdasya prasaṅgāt | udāttadvayānudāttadvayavataḥ samudāyasya sthāne tadanyataravata evādeśasyāntaratamatvāt | athaikavibhaktāviti kimartham | na ca payaḥ payo jarayati, vāso vāsaḥ chādayati, brāhmaṇābhyāṃ ca kṛtaṃ brāhmaṇābhyāṃ ca dehītyādāvekaśeṣavāraṇārthamiti vācyam | sahavivakṣāyāmityasyāvaśyakatvāt | ata eva "idito numdhātoḥ" ityekaśeṣābhāvaḥ saṅgacchate | parasparaviśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvānāpannānāmeva tatsaṃbhavāt | bahūvrīhau tu varttipadārthānāṃ viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvasattvāt | vakṣyati hi vārttikakāraḥ "na vā'rthavipratiṣedhādyugapadvacanābhāva" iti | yugapadvacanaṃ sahavivakṣā | yatra śiṣyamāṇo lupyamānārthābhidhānasamarthastatra hyekaśeṣaḥ | kartṛtvakarmatvasampradānatvādayaśca ekena yugadbodhayitumaśakyāḥ | yugapadekasmādvibhaktidvayānutpatteḥ | caturthyantasya śeṣe ca brāhmaṇebhya ityukte vartṛtvasya, tṛtīyāntasya śeṣe brāhmaṇairityukte sampradānatvasyānavagamāt | ekena bhinnena vā padenopasthitānāmaikarūpyeṇaiva pratyayārthānvayādityarthaḥ | maivam | tasya sārūpyopalakṣaṇārthatāyā vakṣyamāṇatvāt | syādetat | anekavyaktibubodhayiṣāyāmanekaśabdaprayoge prāpte tannivṛtyarthaṃ tāvadayamārambhaḥ | tataśca virūpānekaśabdaprayogasya dhavakhadirau ityādau darśanāt sarūpaikaśeṣārambhavat vṛkṣā ityādau sarūpaikaśeṣadarśanādvirūpāṇāmanekaśeṣa ityevā''rabhyatām dṛṣṭāntamātrasya hetvabhāvasya cobhayatra sāmyāt | prayogānusaraṇe tu kiñcidārabdhavyam | vyaktipakṣe'pi ekasyāpi śabdasya bahvarthabodhakatvasambhavādanyathaikaśeṣārambhe'pyanirvāhāt | śabdaśaktervacanamūlakatvābhāvāt | kiñca sarūpaikaśeṣe gauravaṃ dvayorekaśeṣe ekasya, yadā trayāṇāmekaḥ śiṣyate tadā dvayoścaturādīnāmekaśeṣe trayādīnāṃ nivṛttirekasya ca pravṛttirvyākhyeye iti pravṛttinivṛttilakṣaṇaviṣayabhedādbuddhigauravāparteḥ | śeṣaśabdasya nivṛttiviśiṣṭāvasthānavācitvāt virūpānekaśeṣārambhe tu pravṛttiviṣayā buddhirekarūpaiveti lāghavam | ucyate | "vṛddhoyūnā" tyādāvekaśeṣasyaiva vidheyatvāt iha tvanekaśeṣavidhāne prasthānadvayāpattyā lāghavādekaśeṣasyaiva yuktatvāt | idaṃ tvavadheyam---ekapadasya pūrvoktarītyā sajātīyāntararāhityārthakatayā śabdāntaranivṛttireva vidhīyate, āvasthānaṃ tu siddhatvādanūdyate | ata eva kaiyaṭena pravṛttinivṛttilakṣaṇaviṣayabhedādityuktam | āpātato "dadhnā juhoti" ityādivadavasthānasyāpi vidheyatvapratīteḥ | nivṛtteravasthāne vaiśiṣṭyañca nivarttamānapadasamabhivyāhārābhāvarūpam | pratiyogiprasiddhiśca śrūyamāṇatatpadasamabhivyāhṛtaśabdāntarasthale eva alaukikaprakriyāvākya eva vā sulabhā | syādetat | ṣaḍatra pakṣāḥ sambhavanti | tathāhi---samudāyādekavibhaktau parata ekaśeṣo vidhīyate ekaśabdasya saṃkhyāvācitvena prasiddhatvāt | nanu "ṅyāpprātipadikād‌" ityatraikavacanāntānāmeva dvandvaḥ kriyate vṛttipadārthānāṃ sarvatraikatvabhānasyautsargikatvāt | yauṣmākīna ityādau ādeśādibalādeva bahutvādikātsvādayo na tu samudāyāt | "kartturīpsitamam" ityādau tu dvayorbahūnāṃ vā īpsitasya karmasaṃjñādarśanāllakṣyānurodhānna saṃkhyāvivakṣeti vaiṣamyam | tathā ca samudāyādekasyā vibhakteḥ paratvābhāvādasaṃbhava eva | taduktaṃ "ekavibhaktāviti cennābhāvādvibhakteḥ" iti | maivam | svārthamādāyāvayavayoriva parasparāpekṣāyāṃ satyāṃ samudāyārthasyāpyavayavārthātiriktasyānubhūyamānatvāt tamādāya samudāyasyāpyekaprātipadikatvādvibhaktyupapatteḥ | nacārthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti vācyam | tasya sajātīyaviṣayakatvāt subantānāmeva vyāvṛtteḥ | rājadarśītyādāvupapadādisamāse'pi pūrvapadasya nalopādipadakāryānurodhena subantatvāt | tathā caikājdvirvacananyāyena samudāyādeva dvivacanādyutpattiḥ | tenaivāvayavārthānāṃ saṃkhyānvayātmakānugrahasaṃpatteḥ | na ca rājan rājan au ityatra paratvānnityatvāccopadhādīrghe kṛte vairūpyādekaśeṣo na syāt itiṃ vācyam | "virūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām" iti tatsambhavāt | yadvā antaraṅgatvādekaśeṣaḥ | saṃbuddhibhinnasarvanāmasthānarūpavibhaktiviśeṣam, upadhāṃ cāpekṣamāṇasya dīrghasya bahiraṅgatvāt | na ca dvandve'pi dvandvaṃ vinaiva samudāyādvibhaktiprasaṅga iti vācyam | tadvidhāvanekaṃ subantamityanuvṛttyā uktanyāyabādhāt | tathā ca vṛkṣa vṛkṣa au iti sthite ekaśeṣapravṛttirityekaḥ pakṣaḥ | yadvā pṛthag‌vibhaktau parata ekaśeṣaḥ | nanu vṛkṣa s‌ vṛkṣa s‌ iti sthite vibhaktau parataḥ sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣasya vibhaktinimittakatvāt prakṛtinivṛttau taduttaravibhakteḥ kevalāyāḥ prayogaḥ syāt | na ca kevalayoḥ prakṛtipratyayayoḥ prayoga iti niṣedha iti vācyam | tayoḥ parasparalopaprayojanakatve `agnicid' `iyatī' ityādau paraspararāhinye'pi prayogadarśanāt | na cānyeṣāṃ sakārāṇāṃ saṃyogāntalopena nistāraḥ | saṃyogāntaṃ yat padaṃ tadantasya tadvidhānāt | vṛkṣas‌s‌s‌ iti sthite ca vṛkṣam ityekam, s‌ iti dvitīyam, s‌ iti tṛtīyaṃ tadamiti kasyāpi padasya saṃyogāntatvābhāvāt | etena saṃyogādilopo'pi parāstaḥ | maivam | "saṃyogāntalopa" iti bhāṣyasya saṃyogāntasyāntaḥ sakārastasya lopaḥ | sa ca halṅyādisūtreṇetivyākhyeyatvāt | iti dvitīyaḥ | athavā samāsādekavibhaktau parata ekaśeṣo'stu | prathamasūtrād‌ dvandve ityanuvṛtteḥ | tathā ca vṛkṣaśca vṛkṣaśceti dvandve vṛkṣavṛkṣaau atraikaśeṣa iti | taduttaravibhakteḥ "sapo dhātu---" itilopānna śravaṇāpattiriti tṛtīyaḥ | yadvā pṛthak sarveṣāṃ viktyantānāmekaśeṣaḥ ekavibhaktīnāmiti nyāsāśrayaṇāt | saptamīnirdeśe hi prakṛtimātranivṛttau pratyayaśravaṇaprasaṅgaḥ, uktarītyā tu vibhaktyantānāmeva nivṛttyā neti caturthaḥ | athavā prātipadikānāmevaikaśeṣaḥ | tathāhi---ekavibhaktāviti na kriyate | "hrasvo napuṃsake" iti sūtrātprātipadikagrahaṇamanuvarttyānutpannāyāmeva vibhaktau sarūpāṇāṃ prātipadikānāmekaśeṣo vidhīyate | tiṅanteṣvapi pac‌l pac‌l iti sthite kṛdantatvātprātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ tadupapatteḥ | tathā ca lupyamānaprakṛtikavibhaktiśravaṇasya nāpattiḥ | na ca prātipadikamātrasārūpyavivakṣāyāṃ jananīparicchettṛvācinorapi mātṛśabdayorekaśeṣāpattiḥ | vibhaktyantānāmekaśeṣapakṣe'pi tulyatvāt | kvacidvibhaktau sārūpyasattvāt | na ca prātipadikāvasthāyāṃ sārūpyasya sārvadikatvātsarvatraikaśeṣāpattiḥ | vibhaktyantānāṃ sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣe tu yasyāṃ tṛtīyādivibhaktau sārūpyaṃ tatraikaśeṣo natvanyatreti vācyam | arthavipratiṣedhādatrāpyekaśeṣānāpatteḥ | mātṛśabdadvayaikaśeṣe tābhirityanuprayukte pumarthasya, tairityukte ca stryarthasyānavabodhāt iti pañcamaḥ | yadvā dvivacanabahuvacanāntānamekaśeṣaḥ | yugapadadhikaraṇavivakṣāyāṃ caikaikasya padasyārthadvayabodhakatvāt vṛkṣāvityādau dvivacanādisiddhiḥ | na caivaṃ ekaśeṣeṇa nityena vṛkṣaśca vṛkṣaśceti vākyabādhāpattiḥ | tatra sahavivakṣāvirahāt bhinnārthatvādekaśeṣavṛttyā vākyabādhābhāvāt | idaṃ ca dvandve ityanuvartya dvandve prasakte satīti vyākhyānāllabhyate iti ṣaṣṭhaḥ | tatra---nādyaḥ | bhikṣāṇāṃ samūho bhaikṣamityāderasiddheḥ | tathāhi---bhikṣā bikṣā bhikṣā ām a iti sthite sarvavidhibhyo lugvidherbalavattvādāmo luki kṛte ekaśeṣo na syāt | vibhaktiparatvābhāvāt | na ca pratyayalakṣaṇam | "na lumatā'ṅgasya" iti tanniṣedhāt | rāma rāma au ityatrāpi paratvādvṛddhau hetvabhāvādekaśeṣo na syāt | na cāntādivadbhāvena vibhakteḥ paratvamiti vācyam | ubhayata āśraye tanniṣedhāt | na dvitīyaḥ | dvivacanabahuvacanārthaṃ dvandvapratiṣedhārthaṃ ca vacanāntarārambhāpatteḥ | na cānavakāśa ekaśeṣo dvandvabādhakaḥ | tiṅanteṣu ekaśeṣasya sāvakāśatvāt | kārakabhedena kriyābhedādanekatiṅantaprasaṅgāt | tataśca paratvāt dvandvaḥ syāt | na ca taduttaram ekaśeṣaḥ | sakṛdgatāviti nyāyāt | punaḥ prasaṅgavijñāne'pi vakṣyamāṇarītyā svarasamāsānteṣu doṣaprasaṅgāt | vṛkṣas vṛkṣas‌ityatra pūrvasyāpi vṛkṣaśabdasya pākṣikanivṛttiprasaṅge s‌vṛkṣāvityāpatteḥ | parasyaiva nivṛttau niyāmakābhāvāt | evaṃ bahutve'piyojyam | na ca saṃyogādilopena siddhiḥ | ekapadasambandhīyaḥ saṃyogastadāderhalo'trābhāvāt | s‌ s ityanayoḥ pratyekaṃ padatvāt | idaṃ copalakṣaṇaṃ paranivṛttāvapi pūrvoktasya halṅyādilopasyānupapatteḥ | sutisītipratyayaiḥ prakṛtyākṣepāt halantāyāḥ prakṛteḥ pareṣāmeva svādīnāṃ lopavidhānāt | evaṃ godau dārāḥ sikatā ityādīnāṃ niyatavacanānāṃ yatraikaśeṣastatra halṅyādilopādeḥ śaṅkitumapyaśakyatvācca | etena saṃyogāntasya padāntasyeti pakṣāśrayeṇāpi nirvāho na sambhavatīti dik | evaṃ śiṣyamāṇaprātipadikottaravibhakteḥ śravaṇaprasaṅgaścetyavadheyam | nāpi tṛtīyaḥ | taduktam---"samāsa iti cetsvarasamāsānteṣu doṣaḥ" iti | tathāhi aśvaśvāśvaśceti dvandve samāsāntodāttatve śeṣanighāte ca yadi pūrvaśeṣastadā sarvānudāttatvāpattiḥ, atha paraśeṣastadā'ntodāttatvaprasaṅgaḥ paratvādekaśeṣaṃ bādhitvā samāsāntodāttatvapravṛtteḥ | na ca yenanāprāptinyāyenaikaśeṣaḥ samāsāntodāttatvāpavāda iti vācyam | taduttaramapyekaśeṣapravṛttisambhavādvirodhābhāvācca | evaṃ ṛc‌ ṛc‌ a iti sthaite'ntarvartinyā vibhakterlukā luptatvāt pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhācca vibhaktiparatvābhāvādekaśeṣārthaṃ samudāyādanyā vibhaktirutpādyā, tasyāṃ ca nāsti sārūpyam | eko hi ṛc‌śabdaḥ, apara ṛcaśabdaḥ | na ca samāsāntaḥ samāsasyaivāvayavo natūttarapadasyeti vācyam | samāsāntakṛtavyavadhānena vibhaktiparatvābhāvādekaśeṣānāpatteḥ | na cāyameva doṣo vaktavyo natvasārūpyamiti vācyam | samāsārthasyottarapadasyāvayavaḥ samāsānta iti pakṣamāśritya tathoktatvāt | evaṃ svasā ca svasārau cetyatra paratvād guṇadīrghayoḥ kṛtayoḥ sārūpyābhāvādekaśeṣo na syāt | evaṃ nauśca nāvau cetyādāvanaṅgakārye āvādeśādāvapi bodhyam | tathā hi yadyantarvarttinyāṃ vibhaktau lukā luptāyāmapi vacanasāmarthyātpratyayalakṣaṇamāśrīyate tadā'tra vairūpyam, atha samāsavibhaktyaikavibhaktiparatvaṃ tathā'pi vairūpyatādavasthyam | evam "ākhyātamākhyātena " ityatra prakaraṇe dvandvaśca sarūpāṇāmiti kalpanīyam | anyathā tiṅantānāmekaśeṣānāpatteḥ | nāpi caturthaḥ | lupyamānānāṃ pratyayena sahaiva nivṛttāvapi śiṣyamāṇaprakṛtikapratyayasya śravaṇāpattyā tallopavidhānasya dvibahuvacanavidhānasya dvandvapratiṣedhavacanasya cārambhaṇīyatvāt | nāpi pañcamaḥ | bhaikṣamityasyāsiddheḥ | samarthasya yad‌ ṅyāpprātipadikaṃ tasmāttaddhitā ityābantādaṇi kṛte paratvādādivṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ vairūpyādekaśeṣānāpatteḥ | haritasya strī hariṇī, eva hariṇasyāpi | hariṇī ca hariṇī ca hariṇyāvityekaśeṣānupapatteśca | prātipadikāvasthāyāṃ vairūpyāt | evaṃ śyenyau rohiṇyāvityatrāpi | yadyapi haritaśabdātpuṃyoge ṅīṣā haritīti rūpaṃ tathā'pi haritaśabdasya strī hariṇī strīpratyayānto haritaśabda iti yāvaditi kaiyaṭaḥ | prātipadikagrahaṇasya vicchinnatvācca prātipadikānāṃ loke prayogābhāvātsārūpyasya padāntarbhāveṇaiva grahaṇāt | taduktam---"na vā padasyārthe prayogād" iti | nāpi ṣaṣṭhaḥ | jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau padadvayasyāpyanarthakatvāt ekaikasyānekārthābhidhāyitvānupapatteḥ | ajahatsvārthāvṛttipakṣe'pi prathamapravṛttasyaikavacanasya tyāgāyogāt | anyathā ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādyayogāt tatrāpi pūrvapadasyottarapadārthe upasaṃkrameṇa ṣaṣṭhyādyayogāt | tathā ca bhāṣyam---"seyaṃ yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatā duḥ khā ca durupapādāca" iti | etacca dvitīyaṃ prapañcayiṣyāmaḥ | tasmātṣaḍapi pakṣā duṣṭā eveti prāpte siddhāntamāha bhāṣyakāraḥ--- "prātipadikānāṃ caikaśeṣesiddham" iti | tathāhi---ekaśeṣe na ekavibhaktirnimittaṃ kiṃ tarhi sārūpye upalakṣaṇam | ekavibhaktau laukikaprayoge yāni sarūpāṇi dṛṣṭāni teṣāmekaśeṣaḥ | sa cānaimitikatvādvibhaktiṃ nāpekṣate ityantaraṅgatvātsubutpatteḥ | prāgeva pravarttate | bhāṣye prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ copalakṣaṇam | tena hariṇyādīnāmapi tatsiddhiḥ | "svarabhinnānāṃ yat paraṃ tacchiṣyate" iti vacanānṅībantasya hariṇīśabdasya śeṣaḥ | kecittu haritahariṇaśabdayorevaikaśeṣe ubhayavācitve'pyanyatarasya varṇavācitvaṃ cāśritya strīpratyaya ityāhuḥ, teṣāṃ pakṣe svarabhedaprasaṅga iti kaiyaṭaḥ | bhaikṣyamityādāvapyanaimittikatvenāntaraṅgatvātpūrvamekaśeṣastato vṛddhiḥ | yadvaikaśeṣottarameva taddhitotpattiriti na doṣaḥ | tasmādayamatrārthaḥ---vibhaktipadamatra svādimātraparam, satyapyāśrayabhedena kriyābhede nivṛttabhedāyā eva tasyāstiṅantena bodhāt | prakarṣābhyāvṛttyādīnāṃ ca svāśrayābhyāvṛttyādinimittakatvāt | pacata ityādidvivacanādīnāṃ ca kartrādiniṣṭhasaṃkhyāpratipādakatvāt | naca kartṛkarmaṇorvihitasya lakārasya tadbhedādbheda eva yukta iti vācyam | iṣṭāpatteḥ | "lasya" ityatra latvajāterāśrayaṇādanekeṣāmapi lakārāṇāṃ sthāne'rthata āntaryāt dvivacanabahuvacanayoḥ pravṛtteḥ | ekapadaṃ ca samānārthakaṃ satsajātīyārthakam | sājātyaṃ ca na vibhaktitvena vibhaktipadādeva siddheḥ, tadupādānasyāpi vaiyarthyāpatteśca | vibhaktitvāvacchedena sārūpyasyāsambhavādevāvivakṣaṇīyatvāt | tatsāmānādhikaraṇyamātreṇa sārūpyasya ca sarūpapadopādānādeva lābhāt, kintu vibhaktitvavyāpyena sutvādinā | na tu prathamātvādinā | vṛkṣaḥ vṛkṣau vṛkṣā ityādāvapi sārūpyābhāvāt | tātparyavaśācca prakṛtyarthatāvacchedakasutvādidharmāṇāṃ yāvattvaṃ gamyate | tādṛśyatkiñciddhārmāvacchedena sārūpyasya tadvyatirekeṇaiva siddheḥ | avacchinnatvaṃ ca saptamyarthaḥ | tathā ca vibhaktitvavyāpyā yāvantaḥ sutvādidharmāḥ pratyekaṃ tadavacchinnayāvatpratyayavyaktiṣu sārūpyamityarthaḥ | sutvādiyāvaddharmāvacchinnāyā ekasyāḥ pratyayavyakteraprasiddhatvātpratyekamityuktam, sutvādyavacchinnayatkiñcadvyaktau sārūpyavāraṇāya yāvadityuktam | tena jananīparicchettṛvācinormātṛśabdayornaikaśeṣaḥ | au ityārabhya śas‌paryantaṃ sārūpyābhāvāt | etenottarasūtrasthasyaivakārasyehānukarṣaṇātsarūpāṇyevetyartho labhyate ityapāstam | uktarītyaiva tallābhāt | nanvevaṃ niyatavacanānāṃ dārāśca dārāścetyādīnāmekaśeṣo na syāt | maivam | yāvatyaḥ pratyayavyaktayo yasmātsambhavanti tadavacchedena sārūpyasya vivakṣitatvād iti dik | syādetat | gārgā iti na siddhyati | apatyabahutve hi yaño'pi bahava utpādyāḥ pratyarthaśabdaniveśād, anyathaikaśeṣavaiyarthyāt | na ca dvitīyādīnāṃ yañāṃ prakṛteḥ paratvaṃ na syāditi vācyam | yañākṛterekatvādvyavadhānābhāvāt | garga ya ya ya iti sthite prathamayañaḥ prakṛtisannipātakṛtavairūpyādekaśeṣo na syāt | evaṃ vibhaktinimittakatvapakṣe'pi samudāyasya taddhitāntatvātprātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ ekavibhaktyutpattau bodhyam | sahavivakṣāyāṃ vibhaktyantānāmekaśeṣa iti pakṣe'pi garga ya as‌ ya as‌ iti sthite'pyevam | na ca prakṛtyaṃśaṃ vihāya yaśabdānāṃ sārūpyāttadupattiḥ | prakṛtiviśiṣṭasamudāyādeva vibhaktyutpattyā tallakṣitasārūpyāśraye ekaśeṣe vibhaktibahirbhāvasyānucitatvāt | yañā prakṛtyarthānapekṣasamudāyānabhidhāyitvācca | na caikaikasya pratyayārthasya prakṛtyarthena yogātpradhānāvṛttyā ca guṇāvṛtternyāyyatayā gargaśabdānāmapi bahutvādgārgyaśabdānāmevaikaśeṣa iti vācyam | "tadrājasya bahuṣu" iti yalopānupapatteḥ | bahuṣu vṛtteryañādereva taddhidhānāt | tasya ca yañāmekaśeṣa eva śiṣyamāṇayaño bahvarthakatvādupapatteḥ | uktarītyā tu yañantasyaiva bahvarthakatvāt | maivam | tatkṛte bahutve ityasyāpi tadantakṛte bahutve ityeva vyākhyānāt | na caikasminkaśyapāpatye'ñi kṛte tasmād "ive pratikṛtau" kan | "jīvikārthe cāpaṇye" iti tasya luk | pratikṛtivahutvavivakṣāyāṃ kāśyapā ityatrāpi luk syāt, añantasya bahurthakatvāditi vācyam | apatyabahutvavācina eva lopavidhānāt asya ca pratikṛtibahutvavācitvāt | yadvā ekasmādeva gargaśabdātpareṣāṃ bahūnāṃ yañāṃ satyapi prakṛtisannipātakṛtavairūpye sarveṣāṃ prakṛtyarthaviśiṣṭāpatyābhidhāyitvād‌ "virūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām" ityekaśeṣa iti siddham | yadyetatsūtraṃ na syāttarhi pratyekaṃ vibhaktyutpattau dvandvaḥ syāt, sati tvanekasubantābhāvānna tatpasaktiḥ | etena dvandvāpavāda ekaśeṣa iti vyākyātam | nanu padārthatāvacchedakabhede dvandva iti pakṣe ghaṭaśca ghaṭaśceti dvandvasya na prasaṅga iti cenna | padārthabhede dvandvapakṣe sambhavāt | payasī ityatra jalatvadugdhatvarūpapadārthatāvacchedakabhedasattvācca | syādetat | ekaśca, ekaśca dvau ca dvau cetyekaśeṣaḥ syāt | atra vārttikam---"saṃkhyāyā arthāsaṃpratyayādanyapadārthatvāccānekaśeṣaḥ" iti | yatraikaḥ śabdo'nekārthābhidhānasamarthaḥ tatraivaikaśeṣaḥ | prayuktānāmevānvākhyānāt | ekānityukte ca sahāyāderevārthasyā pratītyā dvitvapratītyabhāvāt | anyapadārthatvāccetyasyāsaṃdigdhena padāntareṇa dvāvityādinaiva tadarthaḥ pratyāyyate ityarthaḥ | etena tatra dvandvo'pi nāstyanabhidhānāt | nanu gārgyāvityatra gārgyaśca gārgyaśceti sarūpaikaśeṣasyāpi sambhavātsandehādarthāsaṃpratyaye'pi ekaśeṣo dṛśyate uttarakālaṃ prakaraṇādinā sandehanivṛtteḥ | na ca tatra "vṛddho yūnā" ityārambhasāmarthyāt tathā, atra tvasandigdhaviṣayasambhavānneti vācyam | akṣā ityādāvapyapravṛttyāpatteḥ | maivam | arthāsampratyaye satyanyapadārthatvāditi viśiṣṭasya hetutvāt | atredaṃ tātparyam---yatpadārthatāvacchedakāvacchinnaṃ dvitvādiparyāptyadhikaraṇaṃ tatpadayorekaśeṣaḥ | ekatvāvacchinnaṃ tu na dvitvādiparyyāptyadhikaraṇam | nanu ghaṭatvādyavaccinnamapi pratyekaṃ na tathā, militaṃ tvekatvāvacchinnamapi tatheti tulyam | na ca tatra padārthatā'vacchedakaṃ ghaṭatvādikamubhayatrāpyabhinnam, ekatvaṃ tu prativyakti bhinnamiti vācyam | payasī ityādāvapi jalatvadugdhatvarūpapadārthatāvacchedakayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt | maivam | yatpadārthatāvacchedakaṃ pratyayārthasaṃkhyāniṣṭhapratiyogitāvacchedakatākabhedaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣyatāvacchedakaṃ na bhavati, tatpadayorekaśeṣaḥ | ekatvaṃ tu eko dvitvavadbhinna iti pratītau viśeṣyatāvacchedakamave | paryāptisambandhasya pratiyogitāvacchedakatvalābhāya pratyayārthetyuktam | ekaghaṭe ghaṭāviti prayogābhāvena vibhaktyarthadvitvādeḥ paryāptyaivānvayasya vyutpannatvāt | eko dvitvavānityatra tu dvitvamāśrayatvamātreṇa viśeṣaṇaṃ na tu paryāptyeti nadoṣaḥ | ghaṭo dvitvavadbhinna ityatrāpi ekatvameva yathoktabhedaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣyatāyāmavacchedakaṃ na tu ghaṭatvaṃ na dvāviti prayogābhāvāt | ata eva caitro maitraśca gacchataḥ ityatra pratyekamekatvānvaye'pi caitratvamaitratve dharmitāvacchedakīkṛtyaivākhyātārthadvitvānvayadhīrna tvekatvamapītyadoṣaḥ | evaṃ dviśabdādāvapi yojyam | prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ---ekārthānāmapi virūpāṇāmekaśeṣo vaktavyaḥ | vakradaṇḍaśca kuṭiladaṇḍaśca vakradaṇḍau kuṭiladaṇḍau vā | sarūpāṇāmityanena samānārthakatvasyāpi saṅgrahāt | "svarabhinnānāṃ yasyottarasvaravidhistasyaikaśeṣo vaktavyaḥ" | svareṇa bhinnānāṃ bhinnasvarāṇāmiti yāvat | akṣaścākṣaśca akṣau | eko'kṣaśabdo'śerdevane iti sapratyayāntatvādantodāttaḥ | dvitīyastu ghañantatvādādādyudātta iti tasyaikaśeṣaḥ | mīmāṃsakau | eko mīmāṃsakaśabdoṇvulantatvānmadhyodāttaḥ aparastu mīmāṃsāmadhīte iti "kramādibhyo vun" iti ādyudāttastasyaikaśeṣaḥ | idamapyavadheyam---ghaṭāvityādau padārthatāvacchedakasāmānādhikaraṇyena dvitvaṃ pratīyate, akṣāvityādāvapi padārthatāvacchedakayorbibhītakatvadevanatvayoḥ parasparasāmānādhikaraṇyābhāve'pi pratyekaṃ tadadhikaraṇayordvayordvitvānvaye dvitvena saha tayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamavyāhatam, padārthatāvacchedakayoḥ parasparasāmānādhikaraṇyapratyayasyānubhavasiddhatvābhāvāt prayojanābhāvāt ghaṭāvityādāvasambhavācca | ekaśeṣasthale ca akṣapadameva ekapadārthatāvacchedakaprakārakatvaviśiṣṭāparapadārthatāvacchedakaprakārakajñānajanakam | anubhavānurodhāt | tathācānārabhya evaikaśeṣaḥ | ekenaiva tādṛśārthabodhasiddheḥ, anyathā tadārambhe'pyanistārāt | nahi svato'satī śaktirācāryeṇa kartuṃ śakyate | śabdaśakterlokaprayogamātrakalpyatvāt | nacaivamagnicit somasudityādau kvib‌lopāderapi vaiyarthyāpattiḥ | pratyayalakṣaṇādestatprayojanatvāt | ekaśeṣasya ca prakriyāyāmupayogavirahāt | nacaikena śabdena kathamanekārthābhidhānamiti vācyam | tulyatvāt vṛttiviṣayatāvacchedakāvaccinnabodhyatvāt | ekadvibahūnāmarthānāṃ ghaṭo godau dārā ityādiśabdavṛttiviṣayatvasyāviśeṣāt | nacaivaṃ plakṣanyagraudhāvityādāvapi sahavivakṣāyāṃ samudāyārthaprārdubhāvādekenaivārthadvayabodhāt dvitīyaprayogo na syāditi vācyam | plakṣāvityukte plakṣāntareṇaiva sahatvapratīteḥ | kvacit dvirūpeṇāpyarthadvayābhidānadarśanācca | yathā---dyāvākṣāmā | dyāvā cidasmai pṛthivīnamete iti | dyośabdenātra dyāvāpṛthivyorabhidhānam | aukārasya "supāṃ sulug‌" ityākārādeśaḥ | pṛthivīiti dvivacanāntam | "vā chandasi" iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ | pṛthivīpadena divaspṛthivyorabhidhānam | tathāca prakaraṇādivaśādyatrārthaviśeṣanirṇayastatra pravṛttinimittabhede'pi virūpasyāpyanekārthābidāyitvadarśanātsarūpasya sutarāṃ tadupapatteḥ | etena nānārthānurodhādekaśeṣārambha ityapāstam | uktarītyā ekenaiva śakyatāvacchedakadvayaprakārakadhīsambhavāt | naca dvandvavāraṇārthamayamārambhaḥ | anabhidānādeva tatsiddheḥ | tadevaṃ pakṣadvaye'pi sūtraṃ pratyākhyātam | ata eva "sarūpāṇām" iti "jātyākhyāyām" iti ca sūtrayorbhāṣyakṛtā pratyākhyāsyamānatve'pi lakṣyānurodha eva pakṣadvayāśraye bījamityuktaṃ kaustubhe paspaśāyām | padārthatāvacchedakaikyasthalābhiprāyeṇa tu prāha vārttikakāraḥ---'ākṛtyabhidhānādvaikaṃ vibhaktau vājapyāyanaḥ" iti | sūtrābhiprāyavarṇanamātrārthaṃ vārttikāntaraṃ "dravyābhidhānaṃ vyāḍiḥ" iti | jātivyaktyoḥ padārthatve tāratamyaṃ vipratiṣedhasūtre nirūpayiṣyāmaḥ | jātisadbhāve pramāṇamāha---"prakhyā'viśeṣād" iti | prakhyāyā buddheraviśeṣādekarūpatvāt | bhinnavyaktiviśeṣyakayorapi saurityākārakayordvayorbodhayoḥ samānaprakārakatvānubhavāt | evaṃ caikatvamapi jāterdharmigrāhakamānasiddham | lāghavena nityatvakalpanācca nāśrayanāśanāśayatvam | nacaikasyā jāteryugapadanekavyaktiṣu kathaṃ vṛttiriti vācyam | tasyā api dharmigrāhakātsiddheḥ | yattu "eka indro'nekasminkratuśate āhūto yugapatsarvatra bhavati" iti bhāṣyaṃ tad‌ abhuyaccayamātram | kāyavyūhena tadupapatteruttaramīmāṃsāyāṃ nirūpitatvāt | acetanadevatāpakṣe tu sannidhānasyaivānaṅgīkārāt | nanu gotvaṃ vyāpakamavaśyaṃ vācyam, anyathā utpanne gopiṇḍe tatpratyayo na syāt | taduktaṃ bāhyaiḥ--- na yāti na ca tatrāsīdasti paścānnacāṃśavat | jahāti pūrvaṃ nādhāramaho vyasanasantatiḥ || tataśca ghaṭādāvapi gotvaprakārakapratyayaḥ | taduktam--- vyaktau caikatra sā vyaktyā'bhedātsarvatraga yadi | jātirdṛśyeta sarvatreti | maivam | samavāyākyasambandhaviśeṣasya govyaktibhireva samaṃsvīkārāt | tatra svabhāvasyaiva niyāmakatvāt | ata eva jīvānāṃ vyāpakatve'pyakacchedakatvākhyaḥ sambandhaḥ śarīraviśeṣa eva svīkriyate | anyathā sarvaśarīrāvacchedena sarveṣāṃ sukhādisākṣātkārāpatteḥ | yattu bauddhāḥ---apoha eva atad‌vyāvṛttirūpo jātiḥ | gobhinnabhedasya momātre sattvādatiriktagotve mānābhāvāditi | tadasat | gobhinnamityatra yatkiñcidgopratiyogiko bhedo niveśyate, gotvāvacchinnapratiyogitākovā | nādyaḥ gorapi yatkiñcidgavāpekṣayā bhinnatvāt | tadbhedasya ghaṭe'pi vṛttyā tatrāpi gauriti pratyayāpatteḥ | nāntyaḥ | atiriktagotvasiddheḥ | tadāhuḥ--- siddhaścāgaurapodyeta goniṣedhātmakaśca saḥ | tatra gaureva vaktavyo nañā yaḥ prātiṣidhyate || iti | kriyāśabdānāmapi jātivācitvameva | guḍataṇḍulādipākavyaktiṣvavāntaravailakṣaṇyasattve'pi pākatvasya pratyabhijñābalātsiddheḥ | bhinnaḍitthaśabdagataṃ yathā ḍitthaśabdatvaṃ nāma teṣvabhinnapratyayābhidānahetu tathā so'yamiti śabdārthayorabhedādhyavasāyādadhyastaḍitthaśabdeṣu saṃjñiṣvapi sambandhādabhinnapratyayābhidhānanimittam | tathāca svāśrayavācyatvasambandhena vyaktiniṣṭhaṃ ḍitthaśabdatvaṃ tadartheṣu pravṛttinimittam | vahnimānityādau svasamavāyisaṃyogasambandhena vahnitvamivetyāśayaḥ | tau etau ityādau ca parokṣatvapratyakṣatvādikam | abhāvāścatvāra ityatrāpi nirupākhyatvaṃ nāma sāmānyamāśrayaṇīyam | gotvāśvatve sāmānye iti vyāvṛtteṣvanuvṛttapratyayahetutvaṃ sāmānyānāmapi sāmānyamasti | athavā niḥ sāmānyāni sāmānyānīti tārkikadarśanaṃ vaiyākaraṇairna niyamata āstheyam | kāryonnīyamānā hi teṣāṃ padārthā iti sāmānyeṣvapi sāmānyamasti iti kaiyaṭaḥ | nacaivaṃ sāmānyeṣvapi sāmānyasvīkāre'navasthāpattiriti vācyam | ekavyaktitvarūpabādhakasattvena tatra jāterasvīkārāt | yattu ghaṭatvādijātimādāya tasyāpyanekavyaktikatvamastyeveti | tanna | tatsādhāraṇajātyantarasvīkāre prayojanābhāvāt | sāmānyatvajātyaiva tatrānuvṛttapratītyupapatteriti dik | nanu jātau padārthe dvitvādīnāṃ kathamanvayaḥ tasyā ekatvāt | maivam | ekāśrayasambandhavivakṣāyāmākṛterekavacanam | yathā "paśuna | yajeta" iti | anekāśrayasambandhavivakṣāyāṃ tu dvivacanabahuvacane | nahi jātipadārthavādinā vyakteranabhidheyatvaṃ svīkriyate, kintu guṇabhāvamātram | tatra pacati pacataḥ pacantītyādau kriyāprādhānye'pi sādhanasaṃkhyākṛto vacanabhedaḥ, evamākṛtiprādhānye'pi dravyasaṃkhyākṛtaḥ ityādoṣāt | nanvevamapi liṅgabhedo na syāt brāhmaṇī brāhmaṇa iti | uktaṃ hi "viśeṣaṇānāṃ cājāteḥ" ityatra "āviṣṭaliṅgā jātiḥ" iti | sarvadā'pyekamevāśrayagataṃ liṅgamupādatte ityarthaḥ | maivam | stanakeśādisambandharūpasya strītvāderlaukikasyātra liṅgatvenānupādānāt | tathā sati liṅgāntarasambandhāyogāt | kintu svasiddhāntavyavasthā śābdikairāśrīyate | tathāhi sattvarajastamaḥ pariṇāmarūpāṇaāṃ śabdādīnāṃ vṛddhihrāsamadhyasthā'vasthāḥ śabdaikagocarā liṅgatvena parigṛhyante | guṇānāṃ vṛddhiḥ puṃstvam, apacayaḥ strītvam, sthitimātraṃ napuṃsakatvam | ata evotkarṣāpakarṣasattve'pi tadavivakṣayā stitimātrābhiprāyeṇa "sāmānye napuṃsakam" iti śāstraṃ saṅgacchate | etacca "striyām" iti sūtre prapañcayiṣyāmaḥ | vṛddho yūnā tallakṣaṇaścedeva viśeṣaḥ 65 | apatyamantarhitaṃ vṛddamiti pūrvācāryaparibhāṣayā vṛddhapadaṃ gotraparaṃ pāribhāṣikayuvapadasāhacaryāt | yuvapratyayāntena sahoktau kotrapratyayāntaḥ śiṣyate uktapratyayamātrakṛtaṃ cettayoḥ kṛtsnaṃ vairūpyam | gārgyaśca gārgyāyaṇaśca gārgyau | vṛddheti kim | gargaśca gārgyāyaṇaśca gargagārgyāyaṇau | yūneti kim | gargaśca gārgyaśca gargagārgyau | tallakṣaṇeti kim | gārgyaśca vātsyāyanaśca gārgyavātsyāyanau | kṛtsnaṃ kim | bhāgavittibhāgavittikau | bhāgavittaśabdādgotrāpatye "ata iñ‌" tasmādyūnyapatye "vṛddhāṭhṭhak sauvīreṣu bahulam" iti ṭhak | atra na kevalaṃ pratyayamātrakṛtaṃ vairūpyaṃ kintu kutsāsauvīragotratvakṛtamapi | "gotrastriyāḥ sutsane" ityataḥ "kutsane" ityasyānuvṛtteḥ | kṛtsnaṃ kim | gārgyaśca vātsyāyanaśca gārgyavātsyāyanau | strī puṃvacca 66 | yūnā sahoktauvṛddhā strī śiṣyate tadarthaśca puṃvat | strītvaprayuktavairūpyādhikyādaprāptāvārambhaḥ | gārgī ca gārgyāyaṇau ca gargāḥ | "astriyām" ityanuvṛttau "yañañośca" iti luk‌dākṣī ca dākṣāyaṇaśca dākṣī | iha strīśabdasya svaritatve tadadhikārīyapratyayopādāne puṃvat strīpratyaya iti abhāvātideśo vā, svaritatvābhāve śabdasyagrahaṇaṃ vā, arthagrahaṇaṃ vā | nādyaḥ | uktasthale gargā ityatra yañaḥ śravaṇāpatteḥ | "astriyām" iti tallopaniṣedhāt | prasajyapratiṣedhe cāyaṃ doṣaḥ | paryudāse tu strīsadṛśārthasattvāt śiṣyamāṇasya lupyamānārthābhidhāyitvāt | na dvitīyaḥ | strītvasyānivṛttyā gargānpaśyetyatra "tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi" iti natvānupapatteḥ | tasmāt tṛtīyaḥ sādhuḥ | pumarthātideśe tatprayuktakāryapravṛtteḥ | evamanyatrāpi bodhyam | pumānstriyā 67 | sarūpāṇāṃ madhye striyā sahoktau pumān śiṣyate sa ca puṃvadeva tallakṣaṇa eva cedviśeṣaḥ | haṃsaśca haṃsī ca haṃsau | śiṣyamāṇasya lupyamānārthābhidhāyitvena strītvasyāpi sattvena ṭāpprāptaḥ puṃvadevetyanuvṛtterna bhavati | padāntaragamye'pi tallakṣaṇaviśeṣe'yamekaśeṣaḥ | yathā gauścāyaṃ gauśceyamityetau gāvau carata iti kaiyaṭaḥ | taditarakṛtaviśeṣaviraharūpe viśiṣṭābhāve'sya tātparyam | sa cātrāpi viśeṣyābhāvādastyeveti dīkṣitāḥ | pumāniti yogavibhāgādviśeṣābhāve'pyekaśeṣaḥ śiṣṭaprayogasya niyāmakatvācca nātiprasaṅga iti nyāsakāraḥ | haṃsatvajāteḥ śakyatāvacchedakatvasāmyācchabdabhedasya strītvamātralakṣaṇatve'pi haṃsaśca varaṭā ca ityādau naikaśeṣaḥ | sarūpānuvṛttyā prakṛtisāmyalābhāt | bhātṛputrau svasṛduhitṛbhyām 68 | bhrātā ca svasā ca bhrātarau | putraśca duhitāca putrau | pūrvasūtre sarūpapadānuvṛttau caitadeva sūtraṃ mānam | anyathā'trāpi tenaiva syāt | "tyadādīni sarvaiḥ" ityatra tu na tadanuvṛttirbādhitatvāt | atra bhāṣyam gārgyaśca gārgyāṇaścetyatra vṛddhayūnoryadekaṃ gargāpatyatvarūpaṃ sāmānyaṃ tasyaiva vivakṣitatvāt siddhaṃ gārgyāviti | vṛddhayūnoratropādānaṃ kiṃ vā vṛddhayoreveti viśeṣāvadhāraṇārtham ekaśeṣārambhapakṣe'pi prakaraṇāderevāpekṣaṇīyatvāt sāmānyopādāne'pi tenaiva viśeṣanirṇayasaṃbhavāt | na ca dvandvavāraṇārthamekaśeṣārambhaḥ | anabhidhānādeva tannivṛtteḥ | strīpuṃsayorapi mṛgakṣīrādivajjātimātravivakṣāyāṃ brāhmaṇāvityādi siddham | syādetat | brāhmaṇavatsā ca brāhmaṇīvatsaścetyatra "pumānstriyā" ityekaśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ | yatraikā pratyayaprakṛtiranyattu vairūpyam, tādṛśaviṣayasya sattvāt | naca "ekavibhaktau" ityanuvṛttyā ekaśeṣanimitte vibhaktau parato yatra strīpuṃsakṛto viśeṣastatraikaśeṣaḥ iha tu pūrvapadavibhaktāvapi strīpuṃsakṛtaviśeṣasattvānneti vācyam | kārakaśca kārikāca kārakāvityekaśeṣānāpatteḥ | ittvaṃ hyatra strītvakṛto viśeṣastasya caikaśeṣanimittavibhaktipekṣya pūrvatvābhāvāt | naca ittvasya strīpratyayakṛtaviśeṣarūpatve'pi strītvarūpārthakṛtaviśeṣatvaṃ nāstīti vācyam | tathā sati gomāṃśca gomatī ca gomantāvityasiddheḥ | strīpratyayenātra viśeṣāntarānādhānāt | strītvarūpārthena tu pratyayarūpasyaiva viśeṣasyoktatvāt | tathāca kvacidarthāhitasya kvacicca strīpratyayāhitasya viśeṣasyāvaśyaṃ grāhyatvāt | naca pakṣadvaye'pi paṭuśca paṭvīca paṭū ityādāvekaśeṣo na syāt, yaṇādeśe strītvastrīpratyayānyatarasyāpi nimittatvābhāvāt, ajrūpatvamevāśritya yaṇo vihitatvāditi vācyam | tadbhāvabhāvitāmātreṇa strīpratyayasya paraṃparayā ca strītvasya yaṇādeśe nimittatvāt, evaṃ itve'pīti brāhmaṇavatsā cetyādāvekaśeṣo durvāra iti | maivam | tatpadasyānuvṛttyā pradhānayoreva strīpuṃsayorgrahaṇāt | sahavivakṣāyāṃ caikaśeṣavidhānāt | tasyāśca pradhānamātraviṣayakatvāt yatra pradhānastrīpuṃsakṛto viśeṣastatraikaśeṣaḥ atra tvapradhānastrīpuṃsakṛtasyāpi viśeṣasya sattvāditi | napuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccāsyānyatarasyām 69 | aklībena sahoktau klībaṃ śiṣyate taccaikavadvā tallakṣaṇa eva cedviśeṣaḥ | śuklaśca kaṃbalaḥ śuklaṃ ca vastraṃ tadidaṃ śuklaṃ te ime śukle | śuklaḥ kaṃbalaḥ śuklā bṛhatikā śuklaṃ vastraṃ ca tadidaṃ śuklaṃ tānīmāni śuklāni | atra bhāṣyaṃ sthitimātravivakṣāyāṃ autsargikaṃ napuṃsakameva siddhaṇ | na ca pākṣikaikavadbhāvārthaṃ sūtram | jātiprādhānyavivakṣayaiva siddheḥ | pitā mātrā 70 | spaṣṭam | vetyanuvartate | pitā ca mātā ca pitarau mātāpitarau | dauhitrābhāve pitarau dhanabhājāvityetadvyākhyāne----yadyapi yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatāyāṃ dvandvasmaraṇāttadapavādatvādekaśeṣasya dhanagrahaṇe pitroḥ kramo na pratīyate tathāpi vigrahavākye pūrvanipātādekaśeṣābhāvapakṣe ca mātāpitarāviti mātṛśabdasya pūrvaṃ śravaṇātpāṭhakrameṇārthakramāvagamāddhanasambandhe'pi kramāpekṣāyāṃ pratītakramānurodhenaiva prathamaṃ mātā dhanabhāk, tadabhāve piteti gamyate iti vijñāneśvaraḥ | etena jagataḥ pitarau vande ityapi vyākhyāttam | yogyatādipramāṇāntaravaśānnirṇaya iti paryavasānāt | etena bhavānapi tvaddayitāca śeṣe sāyujyamāsādayataṃ śivābhyāmiti viṣayāntaramapi vyākhyātam | strīliṅgasya vigrahavākye pūrvaprayoganiyame mānābhāvāt | "uṣṭrī ca karabhaśca, haṃsaśca varaṭā cetyādau kasmānna bhavati" iti bhāṣyadarśanāt | śvaśuraḥ śvaśvrā 71 | spaṣṭam | śvaśurau śvaśrūśvaśurau | sūtratrayamadhikṛtya bhāṣyam---vṛttiviṣaye bhrātrādiśabdānāṃ svasrādibodhakatvaṃ tāvadekaśeṣārambhe'pi svīkāryam, śiṣyamāṇaṃ lupyamānārthābhidhāyīti siddhāntāt, tadvaram ekaśeṣaṃ vinā'pi śabdārthasambandhasya nityatvātsahavivakṣāyāmeva tathātvaṃ svīkriyatām; anabhidhānācca bhrātṛsvasṛśabdayorna dvandvaḥ; mātāpitarau śvaśrūśvaśurāvityatra ca dvandvasya vāśabdāmuvṛttyā tvayā'pi svīkārāt; kimayaṃ sarūpayorekaśeṣa uta virūpayorityavadhāraṇārthaṃ prakaraṇāderniyāmakatvasya vācyatvācceti | `śyālaḥ svāsrorathāgrahīd' iti bhāgavate tu svasṛpadaṃ "prāṇabhṛdupadadhāti" itivalliṅgasamavāyena svasṛtatpatyorlākṣaṇikam | nacobhayoḥ sāmyādalpatvānupapattiḥ, tatra prāṇapadagarbhamantrasya tadrahitamantrāpekṣayā'lpatvāt iti vācyam | lakṣyāpekṣayā śakyānāṃ bahutvābhāvamātrasya tatra vivakṣitatvāt iti śrīdharaḥ | tyadādīni sarvairnityam 72 | svabhinnaiḥ sarvaiḥ sahoktau tyadādīni nityaṃ śiṣyante | sa ca devadattaśca tau | "tyadāditaḥ śeṣe punnapuṃsakato liṅgavacanānīti vaktavyam" | sā ca devadattaśca tau | sā ca kuṇḍeca tāni | śiṣyamāṇatvāttyadādiliṅge prāpte ārambhaḥ | puṃnapuṃsakayostvekaśeṣe śabdaparavipratiṣedhānnapuṃsakaśeṣaḥ | tacca devadattaśca te | "advandvatatpuruṣaviśeṣaṇānāmiti ca vaktavyam" | sa ca kukkuṭaḥ sā ca mayūrī kukkuṭamayūryau te | tacca sāca arddhapippalyau te | nyāyasiddhaṃ cedam | "paravalliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ" iti samāsārthasya liṅgātideśāttadviśeṣaṇasya sarvanāmnastalliṅgatvasiddheriti kaiyaṭaḥ | tyadādīnāṃ sarvanāmatayā vastumātraparāmarśakatvātpadāntareṇa sahoktau teṣāmeva śeṣo nyāyasiddha iti nedamārabhyam | naca tyadādīnāṃ yatparaṃ tacchiṣyate ityetadarthaṃ sūtram, tadvinā śabdaparavipratiṣedhālābhāditi vācyam | saca yaśca tāvānaya yāvānayeti pūrvaśeṣasyāpīṣṭatvāt | sūtrārambhapakṣe ca tadasiddheḥ | nāpi taddevadattāviti prayogavāraṇārtham | "sāmānyaviśeṣavācinorna dvandvaḥ" iti vacanasyāvaśyakatvāt | nacaivaṃ śūdrabhīram, gobalīvardam, tṛṇolapam, iti na syāditi vācyam | ābhīrāṇāṃ jātyantaratvāt | brāhmaṇādugrakanyāyāmābhīro nāma jāyate | māhiṣyograu prajāyate viṭ‌śūdrāṅganayornṛpād || iti--- smṛteḥ | gośabdasya ca strīgavīmātravācakatvāt vṛṣabhe śaktyantarasvīkārāt | na ca sāmānyapadena viśeṣārthasyāpi pratītisiddheḥ na dvandvaprasaktiriti vācyam | taṃ brāhmaṇamānaya gārgyamiti prayogadarśanāt | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavad viśeṣyasannidhau sāmānyaśabdasya taditaraviśeṣaparatvasyāpi brāhmaṇā āgatā vasiṣṭho'pyāgata ityādau darśanāt | tasmātsāmānyaviśeṣayordvandvavacanasyāvaśyakatvāttata eva siddhau naitatsūtramārabhyamiti bhāṣyam | grāmyapaśusaṅgheṣvataruṇeṣu strī 73 | pumānstriyetyasyāpavādaḥ | eṣu sahavivakṣāyāṃ strī śiṣyate | gāva imāḥ | ajā imāḥ | grāmyeti kim | nyaṅkava ime | sūkarā ime | paśviti kim | brāhmaṇā ime | saṅ‌gheti kim | etau gāvau | saṃghe guṇatvānupapattyā tad‌ghaṭakaniṣṭhaṃ tadgrāhyam, dvyavayavasaṅghasambhave'pi saṅghapadagrahaṇasāmarthyādanekaghaṭitasyaiva vivakṣitatvāt | ataruṇeti kim | taruṇakā ime | varkarā ime | saṃghe taruṇatvatadabhāvayoranvayānupayogātsaṃghaghaṭakapaśuvyaktiniṣṭhayostayorupādānaṃ sāmarthyāt | "anekaśapheṣviti vācyam" | neha aśvā ime | uṣṭrā ime | vikalpānuvṛttyā vyavśitatvāccedamiti nyāsakṛt | atrāpi bhāṣyam---naitadārabhyam | saṅgheṣu strīgavīnāmeva bāhulyānmallagrāmādivad bhūyastvena vyapadeśādeva strīśeṣasiddheḥ, agrāmyeṣu tu puṃsāmeva prādhānyāt, uṣṭrāṇāṃ tu āraṇyakatvena sūtrārambhe'pi strīśeṣatvābhāvāt | brāhmaṇā ityādāvapi puṃsāmeva prādhānyāt | etāvityādauca nirjñāte liṅgaviśeṣe puṃsa eva śeṣāt, vatsā ime ityādāvapi puṃsāmeva prādhānyāditi | iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau prathamasya dvitīye tṛtīyamāhnikam pādaścāyaṃ samāptaḥ || <1.3> atha prathamādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ | bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ 1 | kriyāvācino bhvādayo dhātusaṃjñāḥ syuḥ | bhavati | dhātutvāllaḍādayaḥ | yāḥ paśyasītyādau dhātusaṃjñāyāṃ yā ityāderāto lopasya vāraṇāya kriyāvacanā iti | hiruk‌ ityādau varjayitvetyādyarthake nipāte, śiśye ityādau bhāvatiṅante cātivyāptivāraṇāya bhvādaya iti gaṇapaṭhitā ityarthakam | naca lākṣaṇikatvādeva yāśabdasya gaṇe'nupādānamiti vācyam | sthalāntare pratipadoktatvasya tatrāpekṣitatvāt | nacāntaraṅge lope'rthanimittakatayā bahiraṅgasya ṭāpo'siddhatvam | liṅgasya kārakāpekṣayā prathamapratītikatvena ajādipratyayanimittakasya lopasyaiva bahiraṅgatvāt | `nājānantarye' iti niṣedha ityapi kecit | nacārthanirddeśo niyāmakaḥ | tasyābhiyuktāntarakṛtatvenāpāṇinīyatvāt | kriyāvācitvamākhyātumekaiko'rthaḥ pradarśitaḥ | prayogato'nusarttavyā anekārthā hi dhātavaḥ || ityarthāntaravyāvṛttau tātparyābhāvācca | atha eva "kurda khurda gurda guda krīḍāyāmeva" ityevakāraḥ | "śliṣa āliṅgane" ityādikaṃ ca saṅgacchate | nacaivaṃ "ṭuvam udgiraṇe" iti nipātanādittvamityasyānupapattiḥ | etadaparitoṣādeva pṛṣodarāditvasyānyairuktatvāt | bhūvādaya iti nipātanādvakārāgamaḥ | nacāsādhutvam | vaiyākaraṇanikāye prasiddhatvāt | naca kriyāvacanatvasya sūtrādalābhaḥ | bhavanaṃ bhūḥ kriyāsāmānyaṃ tad‌ vadantīti bhūvādaya ityarthāt | "vasivapiyajirājivrajisahihanivāsivādivāribhya iñ‌" ityatra iña o vādayatervidhāne'pi bāhulakādvaderapi tatsambhavāditi kecit | vādayaterevātra iñ‌ nivṛttapreṣaṇatayā'rthabhedābhāvāt | vadantītibhāṣyasya cārthakathanaparatvādityanye | nacaivaṃ gaṇapaṭhitatvasya daurlabhyam | "sānādyantā dhātavaḥ" ityasyārambheṇa paṭhitānāmeva saṃjñā'numānāt | sautrāṇaāṃ tu stambhvādīnāmuditkaraṇena dhātvadhikārīyakāryavidhānena ca dhātutvasiddheḥ | culumpādīnāṃ ca bhvāderākṛtigaṇatvāt | vṛtkaraṇasya yajādisamāptyarthatvāt | etena divādyante vṛtkaraṇaṃ puṣādisamāptyartham, tena mṛgyatītyādikamapi vyākhyātam | vastuto "bahulametannidarśanam" iti curādyante gaṇasūtreṇa sarvasiddhiḥ | bhvādibhyo'pi svārthe ṇic | yadvā daśagaṇīpāṭho diṅ‌mātram, śiṣyaprayogādanye'pi dhātavo jñeyā iti dvedhā tasya granthakṛdbhirvyākhyānāt | yadvā bhūśca vāśceti dvandvaḥ | ādiśabdayorvyavasthāprakāravācinorekaśeṣaḥ | bhūvau ādī yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ | sādṛśyaṃ ca kriyāvācitveneti yathoktaviśeṣaṇadvayalābhaḥ | naca vāterdhātutvānāpattiḥ | bhedāghaṭitasādṛśyasya tatra sattvāt | yadvā vādaya ityatra bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayorekaśeṣaḥ | "svara bhinnānāṃ yatparaṃ tacchiṣyate" iti bahuvrīheḥ śeṣaḥ | bhuvo vādaya iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | vācyavācakabhāvaśca ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | yadvā tantrāvṛttyādinā ubhayalābhaḥ, "dvirvacane'ci" ityādivat | atra bhūprabhṛtayo vāsadṛśā ityeva sāram | etena--- bhūvādīnāṃ vakāro'yaṃ maṅgalārthaḥ prayujyate | bhuvo vārtham̐ vadantīti bhvarthā vā vādayaḥ smṛtāḥ || iti--- vārttikaṃ vyākhyātam | vastutastvabhiyuktānāṃ paribhāṣāviśeṣasambandhena dhātupadavattvameva dhātutvam | tatparicāyakaṃ coktasūtram | natu bhvādyanyatamatvam, gauravāt | anukaraṇeṣu tattadrūpāṇāmatiprasaṅgācca | tadvyāvṛttasya bhūtvāderanyatamatvaghaṭakasya prakārāntareṇa durvacatvāt | ata eva sautrāṇām, culumpādīnāṃ ca saṅgrahaḥ | ata eva ca dhātvarthatvaṃ kriyātvamiti tāntrikāṇāmuddhoṣaḥ saṅgacchate | atha keyaṃ kriyānāma ? yattvāhuḥ phalāvyavahitapūrvakālavartī vyāpāraviśeṣastathā | adhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ tu kriyātvamaupacārikam | taduktam--- anantaraṃ phalaṃ yasyāḥ kalpate tāṃ kriyāṃ viduḥ | pradhānabhūtāṃ tādarthyādanyāsāṃ tu tadākhyayā || iti | naca kāṣṭhādivyāpārasya tathātvādvyabhicāraḥ | janakāntarānanukūlatvasya vācyatvāt | nāpi pākārambhepi kriyāyā bhāvitvātpakṣyatītyasyāpattiḥ | gauṇamukhyasādhāraṇatakriyāsamūhasyātītatve'pakṣīditi, prāgabhāve pakṣyatīti, yatkiñcitsattveca pacatīti prayoga iti vyavasthā'bhyupagamāt | idaṃca yaṅivadhau bhāṣye spaṣṭam | tanna | mukhyatvasambhave gauṇatvasyānucitatvāt | atha pacitvaṃ jātiḥ, pacatītyanugatavyavahārāt, saiva kriyā | nacaivamasādhyatvāpattiḥ | tadāśrayavyaktīnāmeva tathātvāt | taduktam--- jātimanye kiyāmāhuranekavyaktivarttinīm | asādhyā vyaktirūpeṇa sā sādhyevāvabhāsate || iti | tanna | daṇḍādivyāpārasyāpi phalānukūlatvena tadāśrayasya daṇḍasya kartṛtve tiṅā tadabhidhānāpattyā daṇḍena devadattaḥ pacatītyatra daṇḍe'pi prathamāpatteḥ | naca karaṇārtheyaṃ tṛtīyā | kartṛtve karaṇatvasyānupapatteḥ | "ākaḍārādekā saṃjñā" iti niyamāt | na ca tadā daṇḍādivyāpārasya dhātvarthatvenāvivakṣitatvānna doṣa iti vācyam | tathā'pi kriyāyāḥ sādhyatvapratyayasyānyaviṣayakatve mānābhāvāt | atha sādhyatvenābhidhīyamāno vyāpāraviśeṣaḥ kriyā | taduktam--- yāvatsiddhamasiddhaṃ vā sādhyatvenābhidhīyate | āśritakramarūpatvātsā kriyetyabhidhīyate || iti | naca sādhyatvenābhidhāne mānābhāvaḥ, pacati, pākaḥ, karoti, kṛtirityādau dhātvarthapratītyaviśeṣe'pi kriyāntarākāṅkṣānākāṅkṣayodarśanasya mānatvāt | tathāca kriyāntarākāṅaakṣānutthāpakatāvacchedakatvaṃ sādhyatvam | tadevāsattvabhūtatvam | kriyāyāḥ pratyayārthatāvāde'pi pacati pākabhavanetyādau tathā darśanāttathātvāvaśyakatvāditi | tanna | sādhyatvaprakārakaśābdabodhasya sarvānubhavaviruddhatvāt | bhoktumityādāvasattvabhūtā kriyā bhāsate iti siddhāntavirodhācca | kriyāntarākāṅkṣāyāstatra sattvāt iti tṛtīye vakṣyate iti cet | atrocyate | phalānukūlo vyāpārasamūha eva kriyā | taduktaṃ bhāṣye "kriyā nāmeyamatyantāparidṛṣṭā pūrvāparībhūtāvayavā na śakyā piṇḍībhūtā nidarśayitum" iti | vyāpārasamūhaghaṭakānāmavayavānāmekakṣaṇānavacchinnatayā pratyakṣāsambhavādityarthaḥ | tathā ca vākyapadīye--- guṇabhūtairavayavaiḥ samūhaḥ kramajanmanām | buddhyāprakalpitābhedaḥ kriyeti vyapadiśyate || yugapadanavasthāne hetuḥ kramajanmanāmiti | buddhyā tāvadviṣayakasamūhālambanajñānena | prakalpitaḥ abhedo yasya | tathā cānekavarṇasamudāye ekajñānāvacchinnatayā yathaikaṃ padamiti vyavahārastathoktasthale kriyāyā apītyarthaḥ | piṇḍībhūteti | yathā paramāṇavaḥ piṇḍībhūtā upalabhyante na kevalāḥ evaṃ piṇḍībhāvāt kriyā na pratyakṣeti kaiyaṭaḥ | kāvyaprakāśakāreṇāpyuktam--- sādhyaḥ pūrvāparībhūtāvayavaḥ kriyārūpa iti | tadvyākhyātāro'pi---sādhyaḥ sādhyatvena vivakṣitaḥ pūrvāparībhūtatvena pratīyamānā avayavāḥ pracayāntargatāḥ pracayino'dhiśrayaṇādayo yasya pākādidhātvarthasya saḥ | akramasya kramāprāptiścvyarthaḥ | pracayasya tattatpratyekātiriktasyābhāvādvyāpārāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ pākatvena krameṇa pāka iti bhrama eveti | ata evoktamāśrityakramarūpatvāt iti | yadvā adhiśrayaṇādirapi tattadāśrayaviśiṣṭaḥ kriyārūpaḥ, kriyāyā viśeṣyasya caikatvād akramatve'pi āśrayībhūtaviśeṣaṇakramātkramopacāraḥ | anye tu sthālīndhanataṇḍulādiviśiṣṭakriyā pacādidhātvarthaḥ, tadavayavāśca svaniṣṭhaśaktyavacchedakatve sati svāśrayāḥ sthālyādayaḥṣa teṣāṃ vāstavapaurvāparyābhāvāccvipratyaya ityāhuḥ | naca yatra cullyuparidhāraṇādayo'vatāraṇaparyantā vyāpārāḥ puruṣabhedena nānāpākakriyāsu yugapadbhavanti tadā pākakriyāpratyakṣaṃ syāditi vācyam | tadvyaktīnāṃ parasparasahakāritvābhāvāt | nanu pākatvaṃ pratyekavyāpāraparyāptam, natu saṃyogādivadvyāsajyavṛtti bhinnakālīneṣu ekasya vyāsaktyanupapatteḥ, uktagranthāntarebhyo'pi tathāpratīteśca | śabdakaṇṭakoddhāre'pyuktam---cullījvālanamārabhyāvatāraṇaparyantavyāpārakalāpe ghaṭatvādivat pratyekaparyāptameva pākatvaṃ bhāvanātvaṃ vā ākhyātārtho vā, phalāvacchinnavyāpārasamudāyasya tadarthatvāt | uktaṃ ca bhāṣye---"nānā caikārthā kriyā pacatīti sthālyadhiśrayaṇamudakāvasecanaṃ taṇḍulāvapanamedho'pakarṣaṇamagnijvālanaṃ darvīghaṭṭanamavatāraṇam" iti, tathāca pākapratyakṣaṃ syādeveti cenna | pākatvasya vastutastathātve'pi tatsamūhasyaiva kriyāvyavahāraviṣayatvāt | tasya ca pratyakṣāyogāt | ata eva paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyādāvekadeśasyaiva varttamānasya darśanakarmatvamiti tṛtīye vaśryate | taduktaṃ hariṇā--- kramātsadasatāṃ teṣāmātmāno na samūhinām | sadvastuviṣayairyānti sabandhaṃ cakṣurādibhiḥ || na yāntītvanvayaḥ | kramikavyāpārasamudāyasya kriyātvāttasya varttamānatvāsambhavānna cakṣurādigrahyatvam | varttamānasya tadekadeśabhūtasya vyāpārasya cākṣuṣatvaṃ tūpapannamevetyarthaḥ | tatsiddhaṃ kriyā dhātvartha iti | athoktarūpakriyāyā dhātvarthatve kiṃ mānam ? | na tāvad‌ "bhāvapradhānamākhyātam" iti niruktam | ākhyātaśabdasya dhātāvaśaktatvāt | nanu `sarvamākhyātajaṃ nāma' iti niruktakṛtā'bhidhānāttasya dhātuvācakatvam | pratyayajanyatvasya nāmatvasambhavāt | "nāma ca dhātujamāha nirukte, vyākaraṇe śakaṭasya ca tokam" iti bhāṣyokteśca | śakaṭasya ṛṣestokamapatyamiti kaiyaṭaḥ | śākaṭāyana iti yāvat | tathāca niruktam---tatra "nāmānyākhyātajānīti śākaṭāyano nairuktasamayaśca" itīti cet | maivam | kṛdante dhātāvākhyātapadaprayogābhāvāt | tatra lakṣaṇayā tadupapatteḥ | ata eva "yeṣāṃ tūtpattāvarthe sve prayogo na vidyate tānyākhyātāni" itijaiminisūtre'pi lakṣaṇayaivākhyātapadaṃ dhātuparam | utpattāvuccāraṇakāle sve'rthe prayogo na vidyate, svārthasiddho na vidyate iti yāvat | ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ---jaiminisūtre tena tiṅantasyaiva dhātorgrahaṇam, nirukte tu ākhyātapadasyopalakṣaṇatayā dhātusvarūpamātrasyeti | nāpi bhāvapadasya bhāvanāparatvam | dhātvarthaḥ kevalaḥ śuddho bhāva ityabhidhīyate | iti--- vaiyākaraṇaiḥ paribhāṣitatve'pi niruktasmṛtau ākhyātārthabhāvanāyā eva grahaṇāt | tasya vyākaraṇamātraparatvāt | tatrāpi "napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ" ityādāveva tathā, natu "tasya bhāvastvatalau" ityādāviti spaṣṭam | kiñca bhāvanāyā dhātvarthatve mukhyaviśeṣyatvaṃ na syāt, pratyayārthaprādhānyabhaṅgāpatteḥ | kvacittatparityāge'pi utsarge pakṣapātasya yuktatvāt | naca bhāvanāyāstiṅarthatve kṛdanteṣu tatpratītirna syāditi vācyam | dhātvarthakārakaistatsiddheḥ | taduktam--- dhātvarthakārakaireva guṇabhūto'vagamyate | bhāvanātmā kṛdanteṣu tasmānnavābhidhīyate || ata eva bhāvanāpradhānatvādākhyāteṣu tatsambandhādeva guṇabhūtakārakapratītisiddherna kartṛkarmaṇorabhidhānam | naca svārthaphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācitvarūpasakarmakatvānirvacanānupapattiḥ | tatra hi vastutaḥ phalavyadhikaraṇo yo vyāpārastadvācitvaṃ sakarmakatvam, uta phalavyadhikaraṇatvena vyāpāravācakatvam | nādyaḥ | pacyāderapi phalāvivakṣāyāmakarmakatvāṅgīkārāt | tatra vastutaḥ phalavyadhikaraṇatvasyābhāvāt | nāntyaḥ | anubhavavirodhāt | naca sarvadā'karmakasyaiva vāraṇīyatvānna pūrvoktātivyāptiriti | tādṛśākarmakādilakṣaṇasyānupayuktatvāt | "laḥ karmaṇi bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ" ityakarmakagrahaṇenāvivakṣitakarmakāṇāmapi grahaṇasyeṣṭatvāt | `neha pacyate' ityādau bhāvalakāra iti haradattādibhiruktatvāt | `pītā gāvo' `bhuktā brāhmaṇāḥ' `kṛtapūrvī kaṭam' `gataṃ tiraścīnam' ityādau granthakārairbhāve ktapratyayavyākhyānācca | nanu gatibuddhyādisūtre gatyarthākarmaketi sūtreca avidyamānakarmakāṇāmeva grahaṇaṃ devadattena pācayatīti tṛtīyānurodhāt, dattavānpakvavānityarthe dattaḥ pakva ityāderāpatteśceti cet | tarhi tadananugamatādavasthyam, tasmādavivakṣāvirahaviśiṣṭakarmasākāṅkṣadhātutvameva sakarmakatvaṃ tadabhāvaścākarmakatvam | pacyādīnāṃ svarūpeṇa karmasākāṅkṣatve'pyavivakṣādaśāyāmakarmakatvādavivakṣāviraheti | etena kṛño yatnārthakatveyativadakarmakatvāpattiriti nirastam | tathāhi---ākāṅkṣā samabhivyāhārātmikā śabdadharmaḥ | tenārthyaikye'pi ghaṭaḥ karmatvamityādāvanākāṅkṣatvam | ghaṭamityādau ca sākāṅkṣatvam, tadvadeva yateḥ karmānākāṅkṣā kṛñaśca tadākāṅkṣetyupapatteḥ | āsyādidhātūnāṃ ca svarūpeṇa akarmakatve'pi māsādikālayoge tadākāṅkṣatvātsakarmakatvam | ata evaikasyaiva granthadātoścaitraniṣṭhavyāpāramādāya sakarmakatvaṃ puṣpaniṣṭhavyāpāramādāyatvakarmakatvamityabhyupagamaḥ | atha bhāvayati ghaṭamitivadbhavati ghaṭamityapi syāt | dṛṣṭānte ṇicā dārṣṭāntike cākhyātena vyāpārabodhāviśeṣāt | naca prayojakavyāpāro ṇijarthaḥ, kartṛvyāpārastvākhyātārtha iti viśeṣa iti vācyam | tvadrītyā kārakacakraprayoktureva kartṛtvena ghaṭasyātathātvāt | naca yasyaivānyāpekṣayā''khyātopāttavyāpārasamavāyaḥ sa kartā iti bādhādhyāye vyavasthitatvādadoṣa iti vācyam | karotiḥ kriyamāṇena na kaścitkarmaṇā vinā | bhavatyarthasya kartā ca karoteḥ karma jāyate || karotyarthasya yaḥ kartā bhavituḥ sa prayojakaḥ | bhavitā tamapekṣyā'tha prayojyatvaṃ prapadyate || tena bhūtiṣu kartṛtvaṃ pratipannasya vastunaḥ | prayojakakriyāmāhurbhāvanāṃ bhāvanāvidaḥ || iti | bhāvārthādhikaraṇe bhaṭṭapādairbhāvanāyā nirūpitatvāt tadanāśrayasya kartṛtvānupapatteḥ | naca dhātūpāttavyāpārāśrayatvameva kartṛtvamiti vācyam | vyāpārasya dhātvarthatvasiddhau bhāvanāyāstiṅarthatvānupapatteriti cenna | anukūlavyāpāre śaktipakṣe hi anukūlatvaṃ janakatvam prayojakasādhāraṇaṃ vā | nādyaḥ | phalajanakaśarīragatakriyāviśeṣopakṣīṇasyātmaniṣṭhaprayatnāderanyathāsiddhasyā'saṅgrahāpatteḥ | nāntyaḥ | kṛṣyādisādhāraṇyāt | naca yatnatvādhaḥ santāpanatvādīnāṃ tattadrūpeṇa śakyatāvacchedakatvāṅgīkārānnātiprasaṅgaḥ | tathāpi pacati pāke yatate ityādivivaraṇādyatnādīnāṃ dhātvarthabahirbhāvasya durvāratvāt | naca ghañādiyoge dhātoḥ phalamātramarthaḥ | sāmānyasāmagrīmaryādayā tadbodhāpatteḥ | ghañādisamabhivyāhārasya tatpratibandhakatve gauravāt | tibādisamabhivyāhṛtadhātutvasya śaktatāvacchedakatve gauravāt | tibādisamabhivyāhṛtadhātutvasya tatpratibandhakatve gauravāt | tibādisamabhivyāhṛtadhātutvasya śaktatāvacchedakatve kāryakāraṇabhāvadvayamavaccedakagauravaṃ tatra vyāpārabodhānubhavavirodhaśca | stokaṃ pāka ityasyopapādanavirodhaśca | naca tatra vivakṣāvirahādeva yatnabarhibhāvaḥ | devadattaḥ pacatītyatra vivakṣādhrauvyāt | anyatā tasya kartṛtvānupapatteḥ | dhātūpāttavyāpāravata eva tvanmate tattvāt | ata pacatītyatra bhāsamāno yatno'vaśyaṃ pacyarthādbahiḥ kāryaḥ | sa evākhyātārthaḥ | vivaraṇavelāyāṃ bhāsamānasya tasya pariśeṣādākhyātavācyatvakalpanāt | tatrāpi ratho gacchatītyāderanurodhādanukūlavyāpāravāciṇijantabhūdhātunā vivaraṇāt, saṅgrāhakalāghavāccānukūlavyāpāre eva śaktiḥ, yatnasyāpi tadrūpeṇa saṅgrahāditi mīmāṃsakāḥ | maṇḍanamiśrānuyāyinastu---phalamātraṃ dhātvarthaḥ, anakūlavyāpāro vyāpāramātraṃ vā''khyātārthaḥ | janyajanakabhāvaḥ saṃsargalabhyaḥ | laḍādyartho varttamānatvādi liṅarthaśceṣṭasādhanatvādi vyāpāra evānveti | ākhyātajanyavarttamānatvaprakārakabodhe tajjanyavyāpāropasthiterhetutvakalpanāt | naca vyāpāravigame phalasattve pāko vidyate iti syāditi vācyam | bhāvārthaghañāderanukūlavyāpārārthatvāt | ata eva vyāpārasattve phalānutpattidaśāyāṃ pāko bhaviṣyatīti na prayogaḥ | nāpi ghaṭabhūtalayormithaḥ saṃyoga itivanmitho gamanamityādi | saṃyoga ityādau tu ghañādeḥ prayogasādhutāmātram, dhātvarthamātrapratīteḥ | vyāpārarahite'pi vṛkṣādau saṃyujyate ityādivyavahārāttatra tiṅo'pi na vyāpāro'rtha iti na sakarmatvam, āśrayatvasyaiva tatra tiṅarthatvāt | nacaivaṃ dhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalaśālitvarūpaṃ karmatvaṃ grāmāderanupapannam | pratyayopanītaparasamavetavyāpārajanyadhātvarthaphalaśālitvasya karmatvāt | pratyayopanīte parasamavete ca vyāpārasya viśeṣaṇam | bhūmiṃ prayāti vihaga ityatra vihagāderapi svāpekṣayā bhinno yaḥ svāvayavaḥ tatsamatevyāpārajanyadhātvarthaphalasaṃyogavattvātsvātmānaṃ prayātītyādivāraṇāya pratyayopanīteti | tādṛśasvārthavyāpārastu na parasamavetaḥ | gamanātmakavyāpārasyaiva pratyayopanītatvāt, tasya ca parasamavetatvābhāvāt | gamanajanyavibhāgaśālipūrvadeśe'tivyāptivāraṇāya dhātvartheti | taṇḍulaṃ pacatītyatra ādheyatvaṃ dvitīyārthaḥ, phale dhātvarthe tadanvayaḥ | phalasya janakatvasaṃbandhenākhyātārthavyāpāre tasyāśrayatvena caitre'nvayaḥ | taṇḍulavṛttiviklittijanakavyāpāravāṃścaiva iti dhīḥ | caitreṇa pacyate taṇḍula ityatra tṛtīyārthavṛttitvasya tiṅarthe vyāpāre, tasya janyatvasambandhe dhātvarthe phale, tasyāśrayatvena taṇḍulādāvanvayaḥ | caitravṛttiparasamavetavyāpārajanyaphalavāṃstaṇḍula iti dhīḥ | phalavyāpārayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhedena kartṛkarmavyavahāraḥ | atha subarthasya dhātvarthe'nvayaḥ klṛpta iti tasyākhyātānvayakalpanamayuktam, evam ākhyātārthavyāpārasya dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇatvamapi iti vibhāvyate, tarhi tṛtīyāyā vyāpāra evārthaḥ, tatra vṛttitvaṃ prakṛtyarthasya saṃsargaḥ, vyāpārasya janyatvena dhātvarthaphale'nvayaḥ, tasya nirūpitatvasambandhena tiṅarthe'dhikaraṇatve tasya taṇḍule'nvayaḥ | karmakṛtaḥ phalāśrayaḥ, kartṛkṛtaśca vyāpārāśrayo'rthaḥ, taṇḍulaḥ pakvaḥ caitro gantā ityādisāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhāt | karmapratyaye subartha eva vyāpāre varttamānatvānvayaḥ | naca bhinnapadopāttānvaye'tiprasaṅgaḥ | phalabodhakadhātusamabhivyāhṛtakarmākhyātajanyavarttamānatvabodhe tṛtīyājanyavyāpāropasthiterhetutvāt | pakvavānityādau kartṛpratyaye tu ekadeśe vyāpāra eva tadanvayaḥ | yadvā vyāpāre āśraye ca khaṇḍaśaktiḥ viśiṣṭamanvayalabhyam | ata eva evakārasya anyayoge vyavacchede ca śaktiḥ | anyayogapratiyogikavyavacchedaśaktau pārtha eva manuṣya ityādeḥ prasaṅgāt | pārthānyayogo ghaṭaścetyubhayābhāvasya manuṣyatve sattvāt | nacānyayogatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākavyavacchedaḥ śakyaḥ | vastumātrasya yatkiñjidapekṣayā'nyatvāt aprasiddheḥ | nacānyasaṃyuktātvāvacchinnapratiyogitāvyavacchedo'nyasamavetatvāvacchinnavyavaccedaśca dhvaṃsādau prasiddha iti vācyam | pārtha eva dhānurdhara ityādau bādhitatvāt | pārthasyāpi kutaścidanyatvena tatsamatetatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākavyavacchedasya dhaturdharatve virahāt | pārthānyayogatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākavyavacchedasya anyayogatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākavyavacchedādbhinnatayā tadapratyayaprasaṅgāccā evaṃ ca nīlo ghaṭo nāstītyatra nīlānvitasya ghaṭasyābhāve'nvayāt nīlaghaṭatvāvacchinnapratiyogitvaṃ saṃsargaḥ tathā pārthādyanvitasyānyayogasya vyavacchede'nvayātpārthānyayogatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvaṃ saṃsarga iti bodhyam | naca pratiyogitāmātreṇānyayogaviśiṣṭo vyavaccheda evārtho'stu vyutpattibalāduktavyavacchedalābhasambhavāditi vācyam | vākyārthalābha eva vyutpattestantratayā padārthasya tadalabhyatvāt | nacaikapadārthayoḥ kathaṃ mitho'nvaya yati vācyam | ākhyātārthakṛtau kālānvayasya parairabhyupagamādityāhuḥ | kecittu vyāpāramātraṃ dhātvarthaḥ | gato gamyate grāma ityādau phalasya kṛdātmanepadābhyāmeva lābhāt, grāmaṅgacchati, grāmasya gantetyādāvapi dvitīyādeḥ phalajanakatvamarthaḥ | ādeśaśaktyanaṅgīkāre tu tatsmāritadvitīyāyā eva so'rthaḥ | yadvā ṣaṣṭhyāḥ karmatve lakṣaṇā phalaṃ cādhikaraṇatvasaṃsargeṇanāmārthe'nveti | yadvā phalamātramartho janakatvaṃ saṃsargaḥ | nacaivaṃ grāmaṃ gacchati tyajatītyādau phalasāmānyasya dvitīyādinā lābhe'pi niyatasaṃyogavibhāgādilābho na syāt | tataśca gṛhādgrāmaṃ gacchati caitre grāmasyedaṃ gamanaṃ na tu gṛhasyeti na syāt‌ gṛhavṛttiphalajanakatvasāmānyābhāvasya tatrāsattvāditi vācyam | gamyate grāma ityatra phalamātmanepadārtha iti vadatāmapi phalaviśeṣapratyayānupapattiprasaṅgāt | naca tadavacchinnavyāpāravācidhātusamabhivyāhārātphalaviśeṣo labhyate yatheṣṭasādhakatvavācakādvidhereva svargādipadasamabhivyāhārātsvargajanakatvam | pratītistviṣṭatvaphalatvābhyāṃ svargatvasaṃyogatvābhyāṃ vetyanyadetaditi vācyam | gamisamabhivyāhāre dvitīyāyāḥ saṃyogaḥ, tyajisamabhivyāhāre ca vibhāga evārtha ityatra tayostāparyagrāhakatvasambhavādityāhuḥ | naiyāyikāstu phalāvacchinnavyāpāravācitvameva dhātoḥ sakarmakatvam | tyajervibhāgāvacchinne, gameśca saṃyogāvacchinne spande śaktatvāt | dhātvarthajanyaphalaśālitvamātrasya karmatve pūrvadeśe gameḥ karmatvam, uttarasmin tyajeḥ, spandeśca pūrvāparadeśayoḥ syāt | uktarītyā tu spandervyāpāramātre śaktirnatu phalāvacchinne iti na sakarmakatvam | nacaivaṃ jānātyādeḥ sakarmakatvaṃ na syāditi vācyam | tatra tadvyavahārasya bhāktatvāt | nacaivaṃ tatra dvitīyādikaṃ na syāditi vācyam | "karmaṇi dvitīyā" ityanuśāsanaṃ hi tatsamabhivyāhāramapekṣya pravarttate "tena raktaṃ rāgād" itivat, tathā ca pacyādiyoge dhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalaśālini taṇḍulādau dvitīyādikaṃ vidadhāti, jānātyādiyoge dhātvarthaviṣaye ghaṭādau, spandādiyoge tūktānyataraprakārābhāvānna kutraciditi vyavasthopapatteḥ | "sakarmakadhātuyoge dvitīyā" ityetādṛśānuśābhāvāt | tadevaṃ vivāde kathaṃ viśiṣṭā bhāvanā dhātvartha iti prāpte siddhāntamāha bhāṣyakāraḥ--- `kiṃ karoti' iti kriyāsāmānyaviṣayakapraśne pacatītyāderuttarasya prayogāt dhātvartha eva vyāpāraḥ | nanu kiṃ viṣayakayatnavānityeva praśnārthaḥ, kṛño yatnārthatvāt | taduktaṃ kusumāñjalau--- kṛtākṛtavibhāgena kartṛrūpavyavasthayā | yatna eva kṛtiḥ pūrvā parasminsaiva bhāvanā | kriyājanyatvāviśeṣe'pi yatnajanyājanyatvapratisandhānātpaṭāṅkurayoḥ kṛtākṛtavyavahārāt, jñātrādivadāśrayaparatṛjantakartṛpadasya yatnāśrayabodhakatvācca | kriyāyāstadanukūlavyāpārasya vā kartṛpadārthatve tadāśrayaṃ karaṇamātraṃ vā karttṛpadārthaḥ syāt | ata eva pacatītyasya pākaṃ karotīti kṛñā tiṅarthasyaiva vivaraṇam | taduktam--- bhāvanaiva hi yatnātmā sarvākhyātasya gocaraḥ | tayā vivaraṇadhrauvyādākṣepānupapattitaḥ || iti | iti cet | maivam | kṛño yatnamātrārthakatve 'kriyate ghaṭaḥ svayameva' iti karmavadbhāvānupapatteḥ | karmasthakriyeṣveva tadvidhānamiti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | anyathā `jñāyate ghaṭaḥ svayameva' ityasyāpi prasaṅgāt | taduktam--- nirvartye ca vikārye ca karmavadbhāva iṣyate | natu prāpye karmaṇīti siddhānto hi vyavasthitaḥ || prāpyatvaṃ ca kriyākṛtaviśeṣavattayā'nupalabhyamānatvamiti vakṣyate | tasmādutpādanaiva kṛñarthaḥ | utpāttimattayāca ghaṭa upalabhyate eva `ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ kenacitkṛtaḥ' iti ghaṭadarśane jñānodayāt | naca ghaṭopādānaviṣayakakṛtau sādhyatayā ghaṭasyāpi viṣayatvāt tadvyatirekeṇa ca ghaṭānutpatteryatnavattayā'pi ghaṭa upalabhyate eva, sākṣātkārasya tvayā'pyabhidānādutpatteratīndriyatvāt iti vācyam | tadapekṣayā utpattereva tadviṣayatvaucityāt | anyathā phalajñānasyāpi pravṛttiprayojakatayā tadviṣayatvasyāpyutpattyā ākṣepāt `jñāyate ghaṭaḥ svayameva' ityādikamapi syāt | naca tatrotpattau kṛño lakṣaṇā | utpādanāyā upādhirūpatayā śakyatāvacchedakatvagauravād | ata evotpādanā tiṅartha iti ratnakoṣamatamapi maṇikṛtaivameva nirastam | naca lakṣyatāvacchedaka iva śakyatāvacchedake'pi gauravaṃ na doṣa iti śaṅkyam | lakṣaṇāyāḥ śaktikalpanottarakalpyatayā tatra lāghavānādaraṇāt | anyathā niṣādasthapatyadhikaraṇavirodha iti cet | na | uktaprayogarūpasādhakena utpādanāyāmeva śaktiparicchedāt | evaṃ kiṅkarotītyatra kṛño yatnārthakatve praśnavākye tirṅyayatnānanvayasya vācyatayā pacatīti uttarānupapattiḥ | dhātoḥ praśnaviṣayārthānavabodhāt | tathāhi---`kimekaṃ daivataṃ loke' ityādau `ekadaivatatvavyāpyadharmaprakārakajñānaṃ mameṣṭasādhanam' iti jñānāt `tādṛśajñānaṃ mama jāyatām' itīcchayā uktavākyaprayogaḥ | tasya ca `ekadaivatatvavyāpyadharmo mama jijñāsānivṛttiḥ, viṣṇutvaprakārakajñānodayāt | tasyaiva viṣṇutvāṃśe ekadevatatvavyāpyadharmaprakārakajñānatvarūpeṇecchāviṣayatvāt | anyajñānādanyecchānutpatteḥ | siddhe'pi tadanutpatteśca | utpādanārthatve tu vyāpārasāmānyaviṣayakapraśne tadviśeṣaviṣayakottaropapattiriti | nanvevaṃ asti bhavatītyādiṣu ubhayāṃśaviraha iti cet | maivam | tatrāpi kriyāsadbhāvāt | taduktam | astyādāvapi dharmyaṃśe bhāvye'styeva hi bhāvanā | anyatrāśeṣabhāvāttu sā tathā na pratīyate | dharmyaṃśe dharmibhāge, bhāvye bhāvyatayā vivakṣāyām | bhūdhātorutpattisthityubhayārthakatvāt | "tatra bhavaḥ" "tatra jātaḥ" iti bhedanirdeśāt ata eva tatra laḍādiprayogaḥ, kālasya kriyātmakatvāt | kriyābhedāya kālastu saṃkhyā sarvasya bhedikā | iti, kālānupāti yadrūpaṃ tadastīti pratīyate | iti--- vākyapadīyokteḥ | nacaivaṃ `ghaṭaṃ karoti' ityatreva `ghaṭo bhavati' ityādāvapitatpratītiḥ syāditi vācyam | aśeṣabhāvādbhāvanāphalayorekaniṣṭhatvādbhāvanā spaṣṭaṃ na pratīyate ityuttarārddhārthāt | nacaivaṃ `kiṅkaroti' iti praśne `pacati' ityādivad `asti' ityādikamapi uttaraṃ syāditi vācyam | susthatayā niścite praśnasya viśeṣaviṣayakatvajñānāt tadabhāve'pi āsannavināśadharmikayathoktapraśne astītyuttarasya sarvābhimatatvāt | nanu `digasti' `ātmā bhavati' ityādo utpatterbādhitatayā kathaṃ bhāvanā vācyeti cenna | tattatkṣaṇaviśiṣṭatvena teṣāmapyutpatteḥ | yadvā svarūpadhāraṇameva phalaṃ tadāśrayataiva sādhyatvenābhidhīyamānā vyāpāraḥ | tathācātmā''diḥ svarūpadhāranaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | astītyutpannasyātmadhāraṇamucyate iti niruktakārokteḥ | ātmānamātmanā vibhradastīti vyapadiśyate | iti--- vākyapadīyokteśca | nacaivaṃ sakarmakatvāpattiḥ | jīvatyādivadantarbhūtakarmakatvāt | yadvā astitvameva vyāpāraḥ, avacchedakatārūpa vyāptiḥ phalam | ata eva `māsamāste ityādau dhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalaśālitvarūpaṃ mukhyameva karmatvamiti bhāṣye dvitīye vakṣyate | athavā kriyāvācitvāvaśyakatve'pi phalavācitvānāvaśyaktavātsattā''direva kriyā | ata eva `paśyati bhavaḥ svayameva' `darśayate bhavaḥ' ityādau nivṛttapreṣaṇe viṣayatārūpaphalasyaiva dhātvarthatvaṃ kriyātvaṃ ceti svīkāraḥ | evaṃ pacyate odanaḥ svayamevetyādau | ekadeśe samūhe vā vyāpārāṇāṃ pacādayaḥ | svabhāvataḥ pravarttante tulyarūpaṃ samāśritāḥ || iti--- vākyapadīyānusāreṇa viklittimātraṃ dhātvarthaḥ | tadrūpakriyāśrayatvāt odanādīnāṃ kartṛtvamiti vyācakṣate | bhāṣyetu niruktamapyudāhṛtam---"ṣaḍ‌ prakārāḥ teṣu cāstiḥ paṭhita iti tasyāpi kriyātvam | athavā bhāvasya sattāyā ete prakārāḥ | sattaivānekakriyātmikā sādhanasambandhādhyavasīyamānasādhyarūpā janmādirūpatayā bhāsate iti | tathāca jātisamuddeśe hariṇoktam--- sambandhibhedātsattaiva bhidyamānā gavādiṣu || ityupakramya, prāptakramaviśeṣeṣu kriyā saivābhidhīyate | kramarūpasya saṃhāre tatsattvamiti kathyate || iti | vyāpāraviśeṣāṇāṃ sādhyatvātkramikatvācca tadupahitasattāyāstadyoga ityarthaḥ | syādetat | jānāti, icchati, yatate, dveṣṭi, ityādau avacchedakaṃ phalaṃ nāstyeva, tathāca tatra kathaṃ sakarmakatvam, vaiyākaraṇānāṃ svārthaphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācitvasyaiva tattvāt | naca jñānajanyaṃ viṣayatākhyameva phalaṃ ghaṭaniṣṭhamiti vācyam | jñānajanyaviṣayatāyāṃ mānābhāvāt | atītādau tadutpatteraśakyavacanatvāt | taduktaṃ kusumāñjalau--- svabhāvaniyamābhāvādupakāro'tidurghaṭaḥ | sughaṭatve'pi satyarthe'sati kā gatiranyathā || pūrvārddhasyāyamarthaḥ---viṣayasya jñānena saha pūrvamasambandhe ghaṭajñānaṃ paṭe'pi jñātatāṃ janayet asambaddhatvāviśeṣāt | svabhāvādeva tajjñānaṃ paṭīyamiti cenna | jñātatāsvīkāravaiyarthyāt | naca kriyātvātkarmaniṣṭhaphalajanakatvānumānam | icchati naśyati ityādau vyabhicārāt | na ca `ghaṭo jñātaḥ' iti pratyakṣaṃ mānam | jñānavaiśiṣṭyasyaiva tadviṣayatvāt | taduktam--- anekāntādasiddhervā naca liṅgamiha kriyā | tadvaiśiṣṭyaprakāśatvānnādhyakṣānubhavo'dhike || iti | iṣṭatādīnāmapi siddhiprasaṅgādityarthaḥ | atra vadanti---āvaraṇabhaṅgajanakajñānaṃ jñānānukūlavyāpārovā jānāteḥ, icchādveṣānukūlavyāpāra icchatidviṣyādīnāmartha iti sakarmatvamupapannamiti | advaitacandrikākṛtastu---naitadyuktam | āvaraṇabhaṅgarūpaphalasya parokṣajñānaviṣayaniṣṭhatvābhāvāt | parokṣavṛttyā'sattvāpādakasyaivāvaraṇasya nivṛtteḥ | tatra vṛtterviṣayasambandhābhāvena viṣayaniṣṭhābhānāvaraṇabhaṅgābhāvāt | pramātṛmātraniṣṭhavṛttyā pramātṛniṣṭhāvaraṇabhaṅgasyaiva sampādanāt | paraṃparayā phalasambandhamādāya sakarmakatvoktāvakarmakasyāpi tadāpatteḥ | tasyāpi phalavyāpārayordhāturityādinā tvayā svavācchavyāpārasamānādhikaraṇaphalavācakatvokteḥ | sukhādisthale āvaraṇasyaivāprasiddhatvācca | ata eva jñānamapi na phalam | caitanyasya nityatayā phalatvāyogāt | vṛttijñānasya parokṣasya viṣayaniṣṭhatvābhāvāt | viṣayatāsambadhasya vṛttyaniyāmakatvāt | sukhādisthale tadasambhavācca | yadapi viṣayatājanakajñānādikaṃ jānātyāderartha iti | tadapi na | viṣayatāyā jñānādyatiriktatve'pi jñānādijanyatve mānābhāvāt | jñānādipūrvaṃ viṣayatāsattve'pi jñānādyabhāvādevopapatteḥ | jñānādipūrvaṃ ca svotpattidvitīyakṣaṇe svakāryopadhānāsambhavātsvotpattikṣaṇe saviṣayakatvābhāvāt | tasmādevaṃ vācyam---asattvāpādakājñānanirūpakatvābhāvasya yadadhikaraṇatvaṃ tatprayojakacideva jānātyarthaḥ | uktādhikaraṇatvarūpaphalavattvena ghaṭāderjñānādikarmatā | sukhādiniṣṭhe tādṛśādhikaraṇatve'pi sukhādyupahitarūpeṇa cit prayojikā | sukhāderasattvadaśāyāṃ tādṛśacidabhāve uktādhikaraṇatvābhāvāttadbhāve tadbhāvācca | na ca yathoktanirūpakatvābhāvaprayojakacideva jñādhātvartho'stviti vācyam | ghaṭākāravṛttidaśāyāṃ pramātāraṃ jānātīti prasaṅgāt | tādṛśavṛttiprayuktasyoktanirūpakatvābhāvasya pramātari sattvāt | karteti tṛtīyaṃ vākyam aṇau karmaṇo ṇau kartṛtvapratipādanaparam | eṣāmekavākyatve mahāvākyam---lakṣyasya saṃskārakaṃ mahāvākyaṃ sampadyate | nacaivaṃ darśayate bhṛtyānrājeti bhāṣyodāharaṇavirodhaḥ | aṇyantāvasthāyāṃ kartṝṇāṃ bhṛtyānāmeva ṇau karmatvamiti bhavatyevātmanepadam | ata eva smarayatyenaṃ vanagulmaḥ svayameveti pratyudāharaṇaṃ saṅgacchate iti kaiyaṭānusāryarthaḥ | naca yadityanena kartṛtve ca karmakartṛtvādevātmanepadaṃ siddham | tathā hi---lunāti kedāraṃ devadatto lūyate kedāraḥ svayameveti | yathā kedāraḥ karmakartā tathā lāvayate kedāraḥ svayameveti ṇyante'pi | lunātirhi tulyakriyaḥ" iti karmakāryāṇāmatideśāt lūyate kedāraḥ svayameveti prayogaḥ | svayamiti vacanaṃ kartrantaravyudāsārtham | ātmanetyarthe tu tadapekṣayā karmatvamastyeveti karmaṇi lakāreṇaiva siddhaṃ syāt | yadvā tenātmanaḥ karaṇatvamātraṃ pratipādyaṃ prakṛte tu dvidhābhavanamātravṛtterlunāteryadā devadattādiprayojakavyāpāre ṇijutpadyate tadā lunāti kedāraṃ devadattaḥ lāvayati kedāraṃ devadatta
