prathamatṛtīye dvitīyaturye ca tulyārthe iti vivekaḥ | athādhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣaḥ lunāti kedāraṃ devadattaḥ lunantaṃ devadattaṃ saukaryātiśayātkedāraḥ prayuṅkte iti kedāravyāpāre ṇic‌---lāvayati kedāro devadatteneti devadattaniṣṭho yo lavanānukūlo vyāpārastadanukūlavyāpāravānityarthaḥ | sa ca vyāpāro lavanasaukaryaprayojakaḥ śālipākādiḥ | punaḥ prayojyaprayojakabhāvāvivakṣāyāṃ prakṛtyā ṇicā yopāttayoḥ preṣaṇayoryugapattyāge lāvayate kedāraḥ svayameveti tisro bhavanti kakṣāḥ | pakṣe'dhyāropitapreṣaṇe'tra nivṛttapreṣaṇasamakakṣātulya evārtaḥ | evaṃ sthite nivṛttapreṣaṇakriyāyāṃ "karmavatkarmaṇā" ityātmanepadaṃ siddham | lāvayati kedāraṃ devadatta iti lāvayatau yādṛśī karmāvasthāyāṃ kedārasya dvidhābhavanakaraṇā kriyā tādṛśyeva tasmin dhātau kartravasthāyāmiti 'ṇeraṇau" iti sūtramanārabhyam | nacādhyāropitapakṣe ārohayatītyatra hastinaḥ karmatvābhāvātsamānadhātau karmatvaṃ nāstīti pacatyodanaṃ devadatto rādhyatyodanaḥ svayamevetivatkarmavadbhāvo na syāditi vācyam | adhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣaparityāge'pi na syāditi vācyam | adhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣaparityāge'pi kṣativirahāt | nivṛttameṣaṇakriyayaiva sarveṣṭasiddheḥ | naca yak‌ciṇornivṛttyarthamidam | aṇau yat karma ṇau cetsa kartā tadā ṇerātmanepadameva nānyaditi niyamārthatvāditi vācyam | "yak‌ciṇoḥ pratiṣedhe hetumaṇṇiśribrūñāmupasaṃkhyānam" itivārttikasyāvaśyakatayā tata eva tatsiddheḥ | nanu udapupucchata pucchaṃ svayamevetyadetumaṇṇau yak‌ciṇoḥ pratiṣedhārthaṃ sūtram | naca pucchaśabdasya dravyavācakatayā aṇyantāvasthāyāṃ karmaṇa evābhāvātprakṛtasūtreṇāpi tad durvāram | pucchaśabdasya pucchakarmikāyāmudasanakriyāyāṃ vṛtteḥ | tasmātsvārtheṇiṅ‌ | yadā bhrāmyamāṇaṃ pucchaṃ saṃskāravaśāccakramiva bhramaṇakriyāyāṃ bhūtāyāṃ svātantryeṇa vivakṣyate tadā udapupucchatetyātmanepadameva ṇiṅatādyathā syāditi niyama iti cet | na ihahetumatpadamapahāyaiva vārttikasya bhāvadvājīyaiḥ paṭhyamānatvām | anyathā gaṇayati gaṇaṃ gopālakaḥ | gaṇayati gaṇaḥ svayamevetyatra yak‌ciṇoḥ pratiṣedhārthaṃ vacanāntaramārabhyaṃ syāt | gaṇasya ṇāveva karmatvātprakṛtaniyamena tatra yak‌ciṇordurvāratvāt | nanvatra karmabadbhāvasyaiva daurlabhyam | tathāhi---karmasthabhāvakānāṃ karmasthakriyāṇāṃ ca karmavadbhāvaḥ kriyābhāvayośca parispandatadvirahānyataraviśiṣṭasādhanasādhyatvādbhedavyavahāraḥ | gaṇanaṃ ca saṃkhyānimittaḥ paricchedo jñānaviśeṣātmakaḥ kartari vartate na tu karmaṇīti cet na | bhāgaśo vyavasthāpane'pi gaṇayatirvartate | bhāgaśo'vatiṣṭhamānaṅgaṇaṃ gopālako'vasthāpayati | tatrānukūlatvādgaṇasyaiva kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ karmasthabhāvakatvātkarmavadbhāvaprasakteḥ | atra vivaraṇakārāḥ---pucchaśabdasyāṇau karmatve'pyetatsūtrasya na tatra pravṛttiriti bhāṣyakaiyaṭagranthāvabhyupagamyavādamātraṃ vastugatyā pucchaśabdasya tatkarmakakriyāyāmavṛtteranubhavavirodhāt | ata eva ṇeriti sāmānyagrahaṇe'pi pucchabhāṇḍādiṇiṅo na grahaṇam | aṇau karmaṇo'sambhavāditi haradattenāpyuktamityāhuḥ| athāṇau karmaṇo ṇau karmatve ātmanepadaṃ yathā syāt ṇau tu karmaṇo ṇau kartṛtve mā bhūdityetadarthamidaṃ sūtramiti cet na| atrāpyātmanepadasyeṣṭatvāt | nityatvāṇṇicaḥ kevalānāṃ curādīnāṃ prayogābhāvādaṇau karmaṇo'sambhavāpatteriti hetumaṇṇico grahaṇam | aṇāviti pratiṣedho'pi tasyaiva pratyāsattyā nyāyyaḥ ityahetumaṇṇau gaṇasya karmatvaṃ hetumaṇṇau kartṛtvamiti prakṛtasūtreṇāpyātmanepadasya durvāratvāt | nanvanirdiṣṭaviṣayasya pratiṣedhasya vidhātumaśakyatvāt anādhyāne iti pratiṣedhārtham̐ sarvaṃ sūtramārabhyate | smarati vanagulmaṃ kokilaḥ smarayatyenaṃ vanagulmaḥ svayamevetyatrātmanepadaṃ mā bhūditi cet | na | kartṛsthabhāvakatvādatra karmavadbhāvasya prasaktyabhāvāt iti prāpte siddhāntaḥ--- karmasthabhāvakeṣūktarītyā karmavadbhāvena siddhāvapi kartṛsthabhāvakeṣvātmanepadavidhānārthaṃ sūtram | tathāhi---ruhirgativiśeṣavacana iti "yaddhituparaṃ chandasi" ityatra vakṣyati bhāṣyakṛt | naca nyagbhāvarūpasya phalasyātrāpi karmasthatvamastyeveti vācyam | tasya phalatvābhāvāt | taduktaṃ vākyapadīye--- viśeṣadarśanaṃ yatra kriyā tatra vyavasthitā | kriyāvyavasthā tvanyeṣāṃ śabdaireva prakalpitā || iti | ataḥ kriyākṛtaviśeṣadarśanena śabdārthānusāreṇa vā kriyāyāstātsthyaṃ vyavatiṣṭhate | ataḥ pacyādidhātūnāṃ kriyā karmasthā viklittyādimattayā taṇḍulāderupalambhāt | kriyānivṛttāvapi yatra tatkṛto viśeṣaḥ karmaṇyupalabhyate tatraiva kriyāyāḥ karmasthatvam | jānātītyādau tu na tatheti spaṣṭameva | ārohatītyatrāpyuparigamanānukūlavyāpāra eva dhātvartho na tu hastyādinbhagbhāvānukūlaḥ | upari gaccheyamityeva hyupadeśo na tu hastino nyagbhāvo bhavatviti | ata eva bhūmiṣṭhe śākhāṃ namayatyārohatīti na prayogaḥ | tasmādārohatyādīnāṃ karmasthabhāvakatvābhāvāttatrātmanepadamanena vidhīyate | tathāhi ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ | nyag‌ bhāvayantītyarthaḥ | tato hastipakavyāpāraparityāge ārohati hastī | nyag‌ bhavatītyarthaḥ | taduktaṃ hariṇā--- nivṛttapreṣaṇaṃ karma svakriyāvayave sthitam | nivarttamāne karmatve sve kartṛtve'vatiṣṭhate || iti | nivṛttapreṣaṇaṃ kartṛvyāpārajanyaphalāśrayatvenāvivakṣitam | svaniṣṭhe viśiṣṭakriyāvacchedakatayā kriyāvayave phalātmakesthitaṃ svātantryeṇa vivakṣitam | tādṛśasamabhivyāhāre phalasyaiva kriyātvāt tadāśrayasya kartṛtvaṃ viśiṣṭavyāpārasyātrākriyātvāttadāśrayasya na kartṛtvam | viśiṣṭaparatve tu vyāpārasyaiva kriyātvātphalāśrayasya karmatvamevetyarthaḥ | tato nivṛttapreṣaṇaṇici ārohayanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ | ārohayantītyarthaḥ | punarṇyarthatyāge ārohayate hastī | nyagbhavatītyarthaḥ | taduktam--- nyagbhāvanaṃ nyagbhavanaṃ ruhau śuddhe pratīyate | nyagbhāvanaṃ nyagbhavanaṃ ṇyante'pi pratipadyate || avasthāṃ pañcamīmāha ṇyantaṃ tatkarmakarttari | nivṛttapreṣaṇāddhātoḥ prākṛte'rthe ṇijucyate || yadyapi prathamakakṣāyāṃ phalāvacchinnavyāpārapratītyā nyagbhavanamapi pratīyate eva, tathā'pi viśeṣyatvaṃ nyagbhāvanasyaivetyarthaḥ | tataḥ śuddha eva vyāpārāṃśaparityāge nyagbhavanameva pratīyate iti dvitīyakakṣā | tato ṇyante prathamakakṣāvadeva nyagbhāvanaṃ budhyate iti tṛtīyakakṣā, ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ---śuddhe ubhayamapi ruherarthaḥ, ṇyante tu ruhernyagbhavanaṃ ṇicaśca vyāpāro'rtha iti | tato ṇijarthavyāpāravivakṣāyāṃ dvitīyakakṣāvadeva caturthakakṣā | atra śuddhaṇyante nyagbhāvanaṃ śaktyā pratīyate nyagbhavanaṃ tu lakṣaṇayeti vivekaḥ | prākṛte'rtha ityasya śakyalakṣyobhayasādhāraṇe prakṛtisambandhinītyartha iti kecit | nivṛttapreṣaṇātprayojyamātrābhidhāyinaḥ prākṛte prakṛtivācye iti tu vivaraṇakārāḥ | teṣāmayambhāvaḥ---phalāvacchinnavyāpāre dhātuśaktisvīkāre phalamātrabodho lakṣaṇayaiva | viśiṣṭavācakānāṃ viśeṣaṇamātraparatve lakṣaṇāyā eva svīkārāt | phale vyāpāre ca khaṇḍaśaktisvīkāre tu tātparyavirahāt vyāpārānavabodhe phalapratītiḥ śaktyaiveti | yadi tu ekoccāraṇāntarbhāvenaiva khaṇḍaśaktervācyatayā pratyekarūpeṇa bodhane lakṣaṇaiva, ata eva puṣpavantādipadāccandratvasūryatvānyataramātraprakārako bodho lakṣaṇayaiveti siddhāntaḥ iti navyarītirāśrīyate, tadā nyagbhavanabodho lakṣaṇayaiveti bodhyam | syādetat | kakṣācatuṣṭayasyaivoktatvātpañcamī avasthā kathamiti cet | atrāhuḥ---uktarītyā catuṣṭayabodhe tataḥ prakṛtasūtreṇātmanepadaṃ pratipādyate iti vyutpattikramāpekṣayā pañcamatvam, prayogārhaṃ tu kakṣācatuṣṭayameveti kecit | kaustubhakṛtastu viśiṣṭavācakayoḥ śuddhaṇyantayorvācyāvaṃśau vācakabhedād dvedhā gaṇayitvā tṛtīyakakṣāyāmavasthācatuṣṭayaṃ caturthakakṣāyāṃ pañcamyavastheti vivakṣitamityāhuḥ | evaṃ viṣayatvāpattyupasarjanaviṣayatvāpādanārtho dṛśiḥ | paśyanti bhavaṃ bhaktāḥ | cākṣuṣaviṣayaṃ kurvantītyarthaḥ | bhaktavyāpāratyāge paśyati bhavaḥ | cākṣuṣaviṣayo bhavatītyarthaḥ | ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ lunātyādernivṛttapreṣaṇādvitīyakakṣāyāṃ karmasthabhāvakriyatvātkarmavadbhāva pravṛttiḥ, na tvatrobhayatreti | tathā ca vṛttiḥ---ruhiḥ kartṛsthakriyaḥ dṛśiḥ kartṛsthabhāva iti | tacca prāgeva vyākhyātam | tataḥ paśyantaṃ prerayatīti ṇici darśayanti bhavaṃ bhaktāḥ | prathamakakṣāvadarthaḥ | punarṇyarthasyāvivakṣāyāṃ darśayate bhavaḥ | dvitīyakakṣāvadarthaḥ | prakṛtasūtreṇa tvātmanepadamiti dik | atra dīkṣitāḥ---evaṃ varṇayatāṃ kaiyaṭādīnāṃ prakṛtasūtrabhāṣyavārttikagranthavirodhaḥ ārohayamāṇo hastī sthalamārohayati manuṣyānityatrātivyāptiśaṅkāyāṃ manuṣyāniti karmāntarasadbhāvānneti hi prathame praghaṭṭake "karmakartṛtvātsiddham" iti śaṅkāyāṃ "yak‌ciṇornivṛttyartham" iti dvitīye " kartṛsthabhāvakārtham" iti tṛtīye sthitam | tatrādyo viruddhaḥ | manuṣyāṇāmaṇau kartṛtvāt | manuṣyasthalayoraṇau kartṛkarmaṇoreveha karmatayā yadatiriktakarmābhāvādātmanepadasya durvāratvāt | dvitīyo'pi viruddhaḥ | taduktarītyā karmavadbhāvasyaivābhāvāt | "karmavadakarmakāṇām" iti hi vārttikam | ata eva na tṛtīyo'pi | tathā coddeśyavismṛtirevāpatatīti mahānayaṃ mahatāmapi pramādaḥ | kiñca karmāntaranivṛttiparavākyasya niṣphalatvameva syāt udāharaṇadaurlabhyāt | nahyaṇau ye kartṛkarmaṇī tadbhinnaṃ karmaṇau sambhavati yadanena vyāvartyeteti | tatra kecidāhuḥ---pratamapraghaṭṭake tāvanmanuṣyāniti karmaṇaḥ sattvānnātivyāptirityasya haradattādibhiruktatve'pi kaiyaṭenānuktatvāt | sthalarūpasya karmaṇaḥ sattvānnātivyāptirityeva tadabhiprāyāt | vārttikakārābhimataṃ niyamārthatvaṃ dūṣayitvā sūtrasya vidhyarthatvavyavasthāpanaparabhāṣyānusāriṇaḥ kaiyaṭasya dvitīyapraghaṭṭakavārttikavirodhasyākiñciratvāt | kartṛsthabhāvakriyeṣu sūtrasya vidhyarthatāyāstvayā'pi svīkārācca | na tṛtīyaḥ | tṛtīyapraghaṭṭakabhāṣyānusāreṇaiva kaiyaṭena tathā'rthasya varṇitatvāt evaṃ vadataḥ svasyaivoddeśyavismaraṇāt | tadayaṃ niṣkarṣaḥ---kartṛsthakriyārthaṃ sūtrārambha ityeva hi bhāṣyakārābhiprāyo na tu yādṛśasthale karma kartā kartṛsthakriyaśca dhātustatraivaitatsūtrapravṛttirityetatparyantamapi | mānābhāvāt | kaiyaṭavyākhyāne tu `darśayate bhṛtyānrājā' ityudāharaṇasya tātparyagrāhakatvāt | naca karmakartṛtvātsiddhamiti śaṅkitatvādakarmakamevodāharaṇamiti vācyam | tasya lāvayate kedāra ityetanmātraviṣayakatvāt | anyathā smarayatyenaṃ vanagulmaḥ svayameveti pratyudāharaṇamasaṅgataṃ syāt | yattu kaiyaṭādibhiruktaṃ karmeha na vivakṣitam | atra hyenamiti karmaṇaḥ sattvāt karmavadakarmakāṇāmiti vacanāt karmavadbhāvasya prāptirnnāsti | na tvetatsūtreṇātmanepadasya karmāntarasadbhāvāt | tasmātsmarayati vanagulmaḥ svayameveti pradarśanīyam | smṛ ādhyāne ghaṭādiḥ | utkaṇṭhāpūrvakasmūtau viṣayo bhavatītyarthaḥ | yacca vyākhyātaṃ gabhīrāyāṃ nadyāṃ ghoṣa ityatra gabhīranadīpadārthayorabhedabodhānantaraṃ tīralakṣaṇāyāmapi prāthamikabodhamādāya gabhīrapadasārthakyavadihāpyadhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe dvitīyakakṣāyāṃ karmaṇyanvite tato ṇijarthasyeva karmaṇo'pi parityāge ṇicaḥ karmapadasya ca prāthamikabodhamādāya kathañcitsārthakyaṃ svajñāpyasambandho lakṣaṇetyabhyupagamāt | jñāpyasya ceha viśiṣṭavākyārtharūpatvāt | eṣaiva cārthavādaiḥ prāśastyala7ṇāyā gatiḥ | sa eṣa siddhānāṃ vyākhyopāyaḥ | svādhīne tu śabdaprayoge karmavinirmuktameva prayoktumucitam | tadabhyupagamya vādamātram vārttikamatānusāreṇoktatvāt | sūtraśeṣe kaiyaṭenoktarītyā karmavivakṣāyāṃ svayameva pratipāditatvāt | etena karmakartari mūlodāharaṇāni karmavadbhāvastu kartṛsthabhāvakriyatvānneti siddhāntaśarīraṃ bhāṣyavṛttyādiniṣkarṣe sthitamiti nirastam | akarmakamātraparatve mānābhāvasyoktatvāt | karmavadbhāvāviṣaye kartṛsthabhāvādāviva tathāvidhe sakarmake'pi pravṛttau bādhakābhāvāt | etena gabhīrāyām ityādikamapyapāstam | tadvākye gabīrapadasya janitānvayabodhatayā prakṛtavākye ca tvadrītyā karmaṇo'nvayabodhānupadhānena vaiṣamyāt | yattvadhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe dvitīyakakṣāyāṃ karmānvaya iti | tadasat | vākyāntare'nvitatve'pi tadvākye'nvitatvaṃ vinā sārthakyābhāvāt | ṇicastu svārthikatvenāpyupapattyā na vaiyarthyamiti vaiṣamyam | vākyāntareṣu sarvavākyānāmanvitatvādvākyaviśeṣe'nanvitapadopādānāpattyā'tiprasañjakatvācca | arthavādasthale tu "vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā" ityādau arthasyābādhitatvena śakyārthajñānajanyaśābdaviṣayībhūtakṣepiṣṭhatvaguṇako vāyuḥ svadaivatyakarmajanyaphalaṃ śīghraṃ prayacchatītyevaṃrūpavākyārthasambandhādeva stutirūpaṃ prāśastyaṃ lakṣyate | yajamānaḥ prastara ityādau tu yathāśrutasya bādhāt gauṇyā yajamānakāryakāritvasajātīyakāryakārī prastara iti śābde jāte tadantaraṃ svakāryakartṛrūpavākyārthasambandhātprāśastyaṃ lakṣyate | na tvananvitaśrūyamāṇapadārthakasyaiva vākyārthasya taditi na kiñcidetat | syādetat | evaṃ satyadhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣadvitīyakakṣāyāmapyātmanepadameva bhavatīti paryavasāne lāvayati kedāro devadattenetyatra parasmaipadaṃ kaiyaṭenaiva prayujyamānamasaṅgataṃ syāditi | atrāhuḥ lekhakapramādādeva tathā pāṭha iti | yattu vivaraṇakārairuktaṃ ṇauced‌grahaṇaṃ samānakriyārtham | nacāṇyantena samānakriyatvaṃ ṇyantasyetyātmanepadaṃ na kṛtamiti, tadvakṣyamāṇaharadattagranthaśraddhājāḍyamātraprayuktatvādupekṣyamiti | adhikamagre vakṣyāmaḥ | yattūktaṃ karmāntaranivṛttiparavākyasya vyāvartyaṃ nāstīti | tadasat | ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ | ārohayamāṇo hastī sthalamārohayati manuṣyānityasya vārttikabhāṣyakārābhyāmeva vyāvartyatvoktyā tadabhāvakathanasya sāhasamātratvāt | ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ---vārttikakṛtā yathāśrutasūtrārthamādāya "ṇerātmanepadavidhāne amyantasya karmaṇastatropalabdhiritarathā hi sarvaprasaṅgaḥ" iti hi vacanamārabdham | amyantasya yatkarma yadāṇyante tadeva karma bhavati tadā''tmanepadamiti tadarthaḥ | bhāṣyakṛtā tu pūrvopanyastakaiyaṭoktarītyā'vāntaravākyabhedamāśritya sūtrākṣaraireva tatrātivyāptirvāriteti | naca ṇau ye kartṛkarmaṇī tadanyakarmavyavacchede tātparyasya kaiyaṭenoktatvād‌, atra ca ārohantisthalaṃ manuṣyā ityaṇau kratṛkarmaṇoreva manuṣyasthalayorṇyante karmatvātsyādevātmanepadamiti cet | na | ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā ityatrā'ṇau kartṛkarmabhyāṃ hastihastipakābhyām anyasya sthalamitikarmaṇaḥ sattvāt | nacārohanti sthalaṃ manuṣyā ityaṇyantāvasthāmādāyā'tiprasaḍga eveti vācyam | tasyāmavasthāyāṃ yatkarmasthalarūpaṃ tasyoktaṇyantāvasthāyāṃ kartṛtvavirahāttṛtīyavākyārthenaiva tadvāraṇāt | ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā ityaṇyantāvasthāyāṃ ye kartṛkarmaṇī tadatiriktakarmābhāvaṃ cādāyātiprasaṅgasyāpādayitumaśakyatvāt | tathā ca yasyāmaṇyantāvasthāyāṃ karmaṇo ṇyante kartṛtvaṃ tasyāmeva ye kartṛkarmaṇī tadatiriktakarmavyavacchede tātparyamiti paryavasannam | ārohayamāṇo hastītyatra tu bhavatyevātmanepadam | adhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣatṛtīyakakṣāyāṃ viśeṣyābhāvādeva tadatiriktakarmābhāvasattvāt | `dīrśayate bhṛtyā n‌ rājā' ityatra tadīyadvitīyakakṣāyāṃ tu paśyanti bhṛtyā rājānamityaṇyantāvasthāyāṃ kartṝṇāmeva bhṛtyānāṃ karmatvātkartṛkarmātiriktatvābhāvaprayuktaviśiṣṭābhāvāditi nako'pi doṣaḥ | etena sa santataṃ darśayate gatasmayaḥ kṛtādhipatyāmiva sādhu bandhutāmiti bhāraviprayogo'pi vyākhyātaḥ | ata eva "hṛkroranyatarasyām" ityatra "abhivādidṛśorātmanepade upasaṃkhyānam' iti vārttikavyākhyāyāṃ paśyanti bhṛtyā rājānam, darśayate bhṛtyān rājā, darsayate bhṛtyairājā ityatra "ṇeraṇau" iti ātmanepadamiti bhāṣyakṛdbhirvyākhyātam | na ca karmasañjñāvirahaparameva tadbhāṣyatiti vācyam | saṅkoce mānābhāvāt | etena dvitīyavākyārthaḥ pratyāsattyaiva gatārthaḥ | ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ syādaṇau yatkarma ṇau cetsa karttetyukte pratyāsatteretadgamyate yena ṇicā ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ vidhitsitam aṇyante tatprakṛtau yatkarma tadeva cettasminneva ṇyante karteti | iha tu yatrāyamupādhiḥ kṛtameva tatrātmanepadam ārohayamāṇa iti | sthalamārohayatītyatra tvaṇau karmaṇaḥ sthalasya ṇau kartṛtvābhāvādayamupādhireva nāstīti nātmanepadaprasaṅga iti | tadapyasat | ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā ityatra śānacprakṛtyantargatasyeva tiṅ‌prakṛtyantargatasyāpi ṇerabhāvasattvāt tatra karmaṇo hastinaḥ sthalamārohayati manuṣyāniti ṇyante kartṛtvasadbhāvādatiprasaḍgasya durvāratvāt | nanu manuṣyāḥ sthalamārohantītyaṇyante karmaṇaḥ sthalasya tatra kartṛtvaṃ nāstīti cetkiṃ yāvatāmaṇau karmatvaṃ tāvatāṃ ṇau kartṛtvamityamabhimataṃ pratyāsattivādinaḥ | omiti cenna | ārohayamāṇo hastīti adhyāropitapreṣaṇatṛtīyakakṣāyāmapi ātmanepadābhāvaprasaṅgāt | manuṣyāḥ sthalamārohantītyaṇyantāvasthāyāṃ karmaṇaḥ sthalasya tṛtīyakakṣāyāṃ kartṛtvābhāvāt | etena ṇitvenaikyaṃ gṛhītvā śānacprakṛtyantargatasya ṇerabhāve karmaṇo hastina eva tiṅ‌prakṛtibhūtaṇyantārthe kartṛtvāduktasthale'tiprasaṅgaśaṅkopapattirityapi nirastam | tiṅ‌prakṛtyantargataṇijabhāvasyāpi tatra sattvenoktarītyaivātiprasaṅgopapattau ṇitvenaikyavivakṣāyāṃ prayojanābhāvāditi kecit | syādetat | yena ṇicā ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ vidhitsitaṃ tatra ye kartṛkarmaṇī tasya ṇerabhāve yatra tayoḥ karmatvaṃ kartṛtvaṃ ca tādṛśaṇyantādātmanepadamiti pratyāsattyartha iti cet na | adhyāropitapreṣaṇatṛtīyakakṣāyāṃ nivṛttapreṣaṇasya ca caturthakakṣāyāmavyāpteḥ | 9tatra karmaṇo'prasiddhatvāt | atha yathāsambhavaṃ ṇyante karturaṇau karmatvaṃ ṇyante karmaṇo'ṇau kartṛtvaṃ ceti cenna | uktasthale'tiprasaṅgatādavasthyāt | ṇyante karmaṇo manuṣyāṇāmaṇau kartṛtvasattvāt, nivṛttapreṣaṇatṛtīyakṣāyāmapyatiprasaṅgācca | ṇyante karmaṇo hastina ārohati hastī iti dvitīyakakṣāyāṃ kartṛtvasadbhāvāt | syādetat | yena ṇicā ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ vidhitsitaṃ tasya ṇerabhāve dhātvarthatā'vacchedakaṃ yat phalaṃ tadeva yasmin ṇyante dhātvarthatā'vacchedakaṃ dhātvartho vā bhavati tasmādātmanepadam | ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā ityatra hi dhātvarthatvāvacchedakaṃ nyagbhavanam, stalamārohayati manuṣyānityatra tu nyagbhavanānukūlo yo manuṣyaniṣṭhavyāpārastadanukūlavyāpāraśca ṇijarthaḥ | tathā ca nyagbhavane sthalasya tadanukūlavyāpāravānhastīti dhīḥ | tatra nyagbhavanaṃ ṇyantadhātvarthatāvacchedakatāvacchedakameva bhavati natu dhātvarthatāvacchedakaṃ dhātvartho vā | vyāpāradvayasyaiva krameṇa tathātvāditi nātiprasaṅgaḥ | caramakakṣāyāmakarmakatayā dhātvarthatāvacchedakamaprasiddhamiti dhātvartho vetyuktam | naca darsayate rājā bhṛtyānityetatsaṃgraho na syāddhātvarthatāvacchedakatvābhāvādviṣayatvāpattyupasarjanaviṣayatvāpādanaṃ hi paśyanti bhṛtyā rājānamityatra dṛśerarthaḥ | preṣaṇāntarāropa tu viṣayatvāpattyanukūlo yo bhṛtyaniṣṭho vyāpāraścakṣuḥ saṃyogādistanukūlo yo vyāpāraścakṣuḥ saṃyogāderanukūladeśāvasthānādistadāśrayo rājetyanvayabodhaḥ | viṣayatvāpattau rājaniṣṭhatvamarthād‌ gṛhyate, tatra ca cakṣuḥ saṃyogādireva ṇyantatvarthatāvacchedako na tu viṣayatvāpattiriti vācyam | ṇyantatvābhāvadaśāyāṃ dhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalāśrayo yastadanyavṛttitvenānavagamyamānatve sati dhātvarthe prakāratvamātrasya sākṣātparamparāsādhāraṇasya dhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalāśrayo yastadanyavṛttitvenānavagamyamānatve sati dhātvarthe prakāratvamātrasya sākṣātparamparāsādhāraṇasya dhātvarthatāvacchedakapadena vivakṣitatvāt | atra ca viṣayatvāpatte rājānyāvṛttitvenānavagamyamānatvasattvānātivyāptiḥ | ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā ityatra dhātvarthatāvacchedakanyagbhavanāśrayāddhastino'nyasminsthale vṛttitvena nyagbhavanasya sthalamārohayati manuṣyānityatra pratīyamānatvānnātiprasaṅga iti cet | na | pratyāsattyāhi yadantādātmanepadaṃ yatpratiyogikābhāvāśca karmopalakṣaṇam | yadantatvaṃ ca kartṛviśeṣaṇam| sā ṇijvyaktirekā grāhyā ityetāvanmātre siddhe ṇyantatvābhāvadaśāyāṃ dhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalāśrayo yatra ṇyantāvasthāyāṃ ṇijarthavyāpārāśrayastatra ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ syād ityeva sūtrārtho yathoktasthale'pi prasakte eva siddhyati, natūktatadanyavṛttitvenāpratīyamānaparyantamiti tādṛśārthalābhāyoktarītyā dvitīyavākyārthāśrayaṇamāvaśyakamiti tata evoktārthaḥ sidhyati iti bhagavadabhiprāyāt | tasmād‌ dvitīyavākyārthabalādyāvānartho vivakṣitaḥ vākyaikye'pi sa labhyate pratyāsattyeti sāhasam | tadayaṃ bhāṣyamataniṣkarṣaḥ---aṇyante sati yatra yau kila phalavyāpārayorāśrayau ṇyante tatra tadanyakarmavirahastatkarmaṇaḥ kartṛtā dhātoḥ syāttata ātmanepadamanādhyānārthakāditi | asau panthā vārttikabhaāṣyakaiyaṭamukhagranthāśayagranthigaḥ | vṛttikāramate tvayamarthaḥ---ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ syādanādhyāne aṇau yatkarmetyasya karmāntaranivṛttirarthaḥ | vyākhyānaṃ kaiyaṭoktarītyaiva | etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ---tatra ṇau cedityantena karmāntaranivṛttilābhaḥ, atra tu aṇau yatkarmetyetāvataiva | sāmarthyāṇṇeriti sannihitatvācca ṇyantāvasthāyāmeva aṇau karmaṇo ṇau kartṛtvavidhānasiddhiḥ | aṇau yatkarmetyanuvādasāmarthyādevāṇau karmatvasiddhestatraiva tadvidhānasyānupayogāt | karmapadaṃ karmamātraparaṃ natu kartṛkarmobhayaparamiti | "ṇau ced" iti tṛtīyaṃ vākyam | aṇau yadityanuvṛttyā aṇau yat pratipādyaṃ vastu ṇau cettadeva pratipādyamityarthaḥ | ṇaucedgrahaṇaṃ samānakriyārthamiti vṛttigranthasvarasāt | sa karteti---caturtham | aṇau yatkarma ṇau cetsa karteti tadarthaḥ | anādhyāna ityapi prasajyapratiṣedhapakṣe pañcamaṃ vākyam | ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ | ārohayate hastīsvayameva | siñcanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ | secayate hastī svayameva | paśyanti bhṛtyā rājānam, darśayate rājā svayameva | ṇeriti kim | ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ, ārohayamāṇo hastī sādhvārohati | aṇāviti kim | gaṇayati gaṇaṃ gopālaḥ, gaṇayati gaṇaḥ svayameva | gaṇasaṃkhyāne curādāvadantaḥ | ato lopasya sthānivattvānna vṛddhiḥ | gaṇyamāno gaṇo yadā gaṇanakriyāyāmānulobhyaṃ pratipadyate tadā tadvyāpāramātravṛtterhetumaṇṇic | punarnivṛttapreṣaṇadaśāyāṃ pratyudāharaṇam | ṇāveva gaṇaḥ karma tatraiva ca karteti nātmanepadam| nāpi karmavadbhāvena, kartṛsthakriyatvāt | saṃkhyānimittakajñānaviśeṣātmakasya gaṇanasya kartaryeva vṛtteḥ | karmagrahaṇaṃ kim | lunāti dātreṇa, lāvayati dātraṃ svayameva | aṇyantāvasthāyāṃ dātrasya karaṇatvāt | ṇaucedgrahaṇaṃ samānakriyārtham | ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ | ārohayamāṇo hastī bhītān secayati mūtreṇa | prayojyaprayojakabhāvalakṣaṇe'pi kriyābhede mā bhūṇṇic | prakṛtyupāttakriyāyāmeva yathā syādityarthāt | yadyapi prayojyaprayojakabhāvakriyābhede'pyanenātmanepadaṃ vāryata eva, tathā'pi atyantabhedapradarśanārthaṃ secayatīti dhātubhedaḥ pratyudāhṛtaḥ | bhītāścātrārohayateḥ karma na secayateḥ | ārohayamāṇa iti ṇicaścetyātmanepadam, cānaś vā | bhītā hyārohayamāṇā bhītyā mūtrayanti | tena hastī sicyate | karmaṇo'vivakṣitatvātsecayaterakarmakatvam | yatsagrahaṇamananyakarmārtham | tathāhi--- uddeśapratinirdeśāllabdhe yatsaṃgrahe punaḥ | tadgraho vākyabhedena karmāntaranivṛttaye || tenārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ | ārohayamāṇo hastī sthalamārohayati manuṣyān ityatra nātmanepadam, manuṣyarūpasya karmāntarasya sattvāt | yadyapi bhāvakarmaṇorātmanepadasya siddhatvātkartaryevānena bhavitavyam, tathā'pyaṇau yat karma tasminneva kartari yathā syāt, kartrantare mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kartetyuktam | tena ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ | tānārohayati mahāmātra ityatra na | ruhergatyarthatvāddhastipakānāṃ karmasaṃjñā | yadyevaṃ karmāntarasadbhāvādevātra na bhaviṣyati | naitadasti | asti hyatrāṇau karmaṇo hastino ṇāvapi karmatvenānvayaḥ | nacāsati kartṛtvavidhau karmāntaravyāvṛttirlabhyate | yadvā prayojakavyāpāre tātparyād yadā hastipakāḥ karmatvenāvivakṣitāstadedaṃ pratyudāharaṇam | anādhyāne kim | smarati vanagulmaṃ kokilaḥ | smarayatyenaṃ kokilaṃ vanagulmaḥ | vṛttau vanagulmasyeti ṣaṣṭhī tu karmatvopalakṣaṇārthā | vanagulmasya ramaṇīyatvapratipādanāya prayojakatvavivakṣāyāṃ ṇic | enamiti buddhisthārthatvātkokilasya karmasaṃjñā | etadapyupalakṣaṇaṃ karmāntarasattvādeva prāptyabhāvāt | tasmāt karmāvivakṣāyāṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ draṣṭavyamiti haradattānusārī tadarthaḥ | adhikamagre vakṣyāmaḥ | kaustubhakārāstu vyācakhyuḥ---ṇerityekaṃ vākyam | arthaḥ pūrvavat | aṇau yatkarma ṇau cediti dvitīyam | aṇau yā kriyā saiva ceṇṇyantenocyate iti tadarthaḥ | "kartari karmavyatihāre" ityādivat karmaśabdasya kriyāparatvāśrayaṇāt | sa karteti tṛtīyam | aṇāvityāderanuvṛttyā ṇic‌prakṛtyarthaṃ prati yat karmakārakaṃ sa eva ceṇṇyante kartetyarthaḥ | śabdādhikārāśrayaṇena karmapadasyātra kārakaviśeṣaparatayā vyākhyānāt | bhāṣyavārttikayorapi dvitīyavākyagataṃ karmapadaṃ kriyāparatayaiva vyākhyeyam | dvitīyavākyaprayojanaṃ tu adhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe dvitīyakakṣāyāṃ mā bhūt | tatra preṣaṇādhikyānnātivyāptiḥ | tṛtīyavākyaprayojanaṃ tu nivṛttapreṣaṇapakṣe tṛtīyakakṣāyāṃ mā bhūt | tatrāṇau karmatvameva na tu kartṛtvamiti nātivyāptiḥ | nivṛttapreṣaṇapakṣe caturthakakṣāyāṃ prathamakakṣāmādāya tṛtīyavākyārthasya dvitīyakakṣāmādāya ca dvitīyavākyārthasya samanvayānnātivyāptiriti | atredaṃ vaktavyam---adhyāropitapreṣaṇadvitīyakakṣāyāmapyātmanepadasya bhāṣyakārairabhyupagamena tadvāraṇamanupapannam | evaṃ tṛtīyakakṣāyāmapyavyāptiḥ | ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā ityatra nyagbhavanāvaccinnavyāpārasya ārohayate hastītyatra ca nyagbhavanamātrasya pratītyā samānakriyatvābhāvāt | yattu kriyāyā ādhikyamātraṃ vyavacchidyate natu nyūnatvamapīti | tanna | prakṛtyupāttā yā kriyā saiva ceṇṇyantenocyeta ityato nyūnādhikyavyavacchedasyaiva pratīyamānatvāt | prakṛtyupāttakriyātvaṃ viśeṣyatāvacchedakīkṛtya tadavacchinnānyasmiṇ‌ṇyantavācyatvavyavacchedasyeva tadavacchinne ṇyantavācyatvasyāpi pratīteḥ | evakārārthānyonyābhāvapratiyogitāvacchedakadharmasya vyavacchedyadharmaprakārakabodho viśeṣyatāvacchedakatayā ca bhānamiti niyamāt | ata eva `pārtha eva dhanurdharaḥ' ityādau pārthānyasmindhanurddharatvavyavaccedaḥ, pārthe dhanurddharatvaṃ ca pratīyate | anyathā "pārtho dhanurddharo na vā" iti saṃśayasya tadvākyārthabodhādanivṛttiprasaḍga iti sampradāyaḥ | syādetat | ārohati hastī ityatra nivṛttapreṣaṇadvitīyakakṣāyāṃ nyagbhavanamātrasya prakṛtyupāttakriyātvāt tadrūpaviśeṣyatāvacchedakasāmānādhikaraṇyamātreṇa ṇyantavācyatvapratītāvapi caramakakṣāyāmātmanepadaṃ sulabhameveti uktaviśeṣyatāvacchedakāvacchinnayāvatkriyāsāmyasyāsambhavādeva vivakṣānupapatteriti cenna | adhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe dvitīyakakṣāyāmapyātmanepadasya durvāratvāt | ārohatītyatrāpi ṇyarthasyāntarbhāvayituṃ śakyatayā ārohati hastipakān hastī ityatra nyagbhavanānukūlahastipakaniṣṭhavyāpārānukūlavyāpāravān hastīti bodhasya ārohayati hastipakān hastītyetadvākyajanyabodhasya ca tulyatayā ṇyantāṇyantayoḥ samānakriyatvasāmyāt | adhyāropitapreṣaṇatṛtīyakakṣāyāmapi nivṛttapreṣaṇadvitīyakakṣāmādāyaiva kriyāsāmyokteḥ | aṇau karmaṇo ṇau kartṛtvaṃ nāsti prathamakakṣākarmaṇo hastina eva tatra karmatvāt | hastipakānāmevobhayatra kartṛtvāditi nātivyāptiriti vaiṣamyam | iyaṃ kakṣā na granthakārairukteti cenna | nyāyāviśeṣe tasyākiñcitkaratvāt | ṇyantasamānārthakatvamātrasya bahirbhāvabījatve nivṛttapreṣaṇaprathamadvitīyapakṣayorapyucchedāpatteḥ | apica granthakārairnoktetyasiddham, śuddhe'pi ṇijarthamantarbhāvya bahuṣu vyākhyāyamānatvāt | avasthāṃ pañcamīmāha ṇyantaṃ tatkarmakartari | iti--- vākyapadīye ārohayate hastītyavasthāyāḥ pañcamītvasya sākṣādevoktatvācca | pūrvoktakusṛṣṭivyākhyānasyānupādeyatvāt | tathā--- nyagbhāvanaṃ nyagbhavanaṃ ruhau śuddhe pratīyate | ityatra nyagbhāvanapadena nyagbhavanānukūlavyāpāro nyagbhavanānukūlavyāpārānukūlavyāpāraścetyubhayamādāya kakṣādvayamabhimatam | ṇyantasya punarṇyantasya ca nyagbhāvanapade vyākhyānāt | tathā cārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ | hastiniṣṭhaṃ yannyagbhavanaṃ tadanukūlavyāpāravanta ityartaḥ iti prathamakakṣā | tato'ntarbāvitaṇyarthatāyām ārohati hastipakān hastī | nyagbhavanānukūlo yo hastipakaniṣṭho vyāpārastadanukūlavyāpāravānityartha iti dvitīyā | tato vyāpāradvayasyāpyavivakṣāyām ārohati hastī ityādikaṃ pūrvavaditi bhavati ārohayate hastī ityātmanepadārhā kakṣā pañcamāti dvitīyakakṣāyāmeva preṣaṇanivṛttirityasyāprayojakatvāt | nanvatrāṇau karmaṇo ṇau kartṛtvābhāvādeva nātiprasaṅgaḥ | ārohati hastipakān hastī ārohayati hastipakān hastītyubhayatrāpi sattvāt | naca yāmavasthāmādāya kriyāsāmyaṃ tatkarmaṇa eva ṇau kartṛtvaṃ vivakṣitamiti vācyam | adhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣatṛtīyakakṣāyāmavyāpteḥ | dvitīyakakṣāmādāya hi tatra kriyāsāmyam tatra tvakarmaṇo'prasiddhatvāt | nivṛttapreṣaṇatṛtīyakakṣāyāṃ tu prathamakakṣāmādāya kriyāsāmye'pi uktatṛtīyavākyārthānanvayānnātivyāptiriti spaṣṭameva vaiṣamyāt | vṛttikārasyāpyayamevābhiprāyaḥ | ārohayamāṇo hastīsthalamārohayati hastī manuṣyānityetadvyāvṛttyarthaṃ karmāntaranivṛttestena vyākhyātatvāt | anyathā ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā ityetadapekṣayā tatra preṣaṇāntarapratītyā kriyāsāmyābhāvādevātiprasaṅgānupapatteḥ | ṇaucedgrahaṇaṃ samānakriyārthamiti tanmate'pi svīkārāt | ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ---tvanmate aṇau yatkarma ṇau cedityetena samānakriyatvalābhaḥ | tanmate tu ṇaucedityanena pūrvānuvṛttisahiteneti | etena karmapadaṃ kriyāparamiti kvāpyākaragranthe noktamiti parāstam | uktarītyā tu nyagbhavānānukūlavyāpārasya ārohati hastipakān hastītyatreva sthalamārohayati manuṣyānityatrāpi sattvena kriyāsāmyasattvādatiprasaṅgāpattau karmāntaranivṛttivākyena tadvāraṇaṃ sambhavatīti | sthalamityādikarmāntirābhāve tu arthādeva nyagbhavanaṃ hastiniṣṭhatayaiva gamyate iti | etena samānakriyatvābhāvādadhyāropitapreṣaṇadvitīyakakṣāyāṃ nātmanepadamiti vivaraṇagrantho'pi cintyaḥ | etenārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ, tānārohayati hastītyatra mā bhūditi haradatto'pi vyākhyātaḥ | adhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe dvitīyakakṣāyāmapi yathāvyākhyātanivṛttapreṣaṇadvitīyakakṣāmādāya kriyāsāmyasya sattvāt | etena nivṛttapreṣaṇapakṣe ādyakakṣādvayasya ṇyantatvābhāvāt tṛtīyasyāṃ tu hastinaḥ kartṛtvābhāvāt, caturthyāṃ tu karmānvayāt adhyāropitapreṣaṇapakṣe ca dvitīyakakṣāyāṃ samānakriyatvābhāvāt, prathamāyāṃ ca ṇyantatvābhāvāt, tṛtīyasyāṃ ca karmānanvayāt haradattoktiranuktasambhavagrasteti kaustubhoktamapyapāstam | tasmātsamānakriyatvāvivakṣāyāmapi adhyāropitapreṣaṇadvitīyakakṣāyāmātmanepadaṃ durvārameveti siddham | kecittu kaustabhoktārthasya sūtrakārābhimatatve "karmavatkarmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ" iti sūtrādanantaraṃ "ṇeraṇāvanādhyāne" ityeva sūtraṃ kuryāt | anādhyāne samānadhātāvaṇau karmaṇā tulyakriyo ṇyantasya kartā karmavaditi vyākhyāne tadabhimatārthalābhāt | tvadrītyā kāryātideśāśrayaṇenaiva sidhyā tadabhimatapūrvavipratiṣedhajñāpanakleśābhāvācca | kartṛsthabhāvakriyārthaṃ sūtrārambha ityasya tulyatvāt | yak‌ciṇośca karmasthabhāvakriyeṣviva kartṛsthabhāvakriyeṣvapi viśeṣavacanenaiva vāraṇīyatvāt | kiñca ārohayamāṇo hastī parvatamārohayati iti nivṛttapreṣaṇatṛtīyakakṣāyāmapyātmanepadaṃ syāt prathamakakṣāmādāya kriyāsāmyasya, ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā ityaṇau karmaṇo hastinaḥ kartṛtvasya ca sattvāt | karmāntaranivṛttivākyasya tvayā'nabhyupagamāt | naca yāṃ kakṣāmādāya kriyāsāmyaṃ tatkakṣāyameva yat karma tasya ṇau kartṛtvaṃ vivakṣitamiti vācyam | asambhavāpatteḥ | nivṛttapreṣaṇapakṣe dvitīyakakṣāmādāya kriyāsāmyasya prathamakakṣāmādāya cāṇau karmaṇo ṇau kartṛtvasya svayameva vyākhyānāt | dvitīyakakṣāyāṃ karmaṇo ṇau kartṛtvasya svayameva vyākhyānāt | dvitīyakakṣāyāṃ karmaṇa evāprasiddhatvāt | naceṣṭāpattiḥ | bhāṣyakārādimataviruddhatvāt | yasyāmaṇyantāvasthāyāṃ karmaṇo ṇyante kartṛtvaṃ tasyāmeva ye kartṛkarmaṇī tadanyakarmavyavacchede karmāntaranivṛttivākyasya tātparyamiti vyavasthitatvāt | vṛttikaustubhobhayamate'pyakarmakāṇāmevodāharaṇatvasvīkārāt ityāhuḥ | syādetat | ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā ityetatsamānārthikāyām ārohayanti hastinaṃ hastipakā ityasyāmapi nivṛttapreṣaṇapakakṣāyāmātmanepadaṃ syāt | ārohati hastipakānhastītyaṇau karmaṇāṃ hastipakānāṃ ṇau kartṛtvāt | tatra ye kartṛkarmaṇī tadatiriktakarmābhāvācca adhyāropitapreṣaṇadvitīyakakṣāviśeṣasya durvacatvāt iti cet | na | kriyāsāmyasya bhāṣyamate'pi vivakṣitatvāt | uktaṇyantanivṛttapreṣaṇakakṣāyāṃ ca kriyāyāṃ nyūnatvena tadabhāvāt | adhyāropitapreṣaṇadvitīyakakṣāyāṃ coktopādhiviśiṣṭakriyāsāmyasattvādātmanepadopapatteḥ | pakṣadvayasyāpi caramakakṣāyāṃ pūrvoktaviśiṣṭābhāvasahitasya `ārohati hastī' ityetadavasthāmādāya kriyāsāmyasya sattvādātmanepadamupannam | kriyāsāmyaṃ ca haradattoktarītyaiva vyākhyeyam | kaiyaṭasyāpyatraiva tātparyam | samānakriyatvaṃ bhāṣyakaiyaṭasaṃmatamityasya kaustubhakāreraṅgīkārācca | ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ---tanmate'dhyāropitapreṣaṇadvitīyakakṣāyāmativyāptivāraṇāya tathoktam | asmābhistu yathoktanivṛttapreṣaṇatṛtīyakakṣāyāmiti | ata eva vivaraṇakāraiḥ ṇaucedgrahaṇaṃ samānakriyāpratipattyarthamiti tatropanyastam | etena tadvivaraṇaṃ padamañjarīśraddhājāḍyamātraprayuktamityapi nirastam | uktarītyā bhāṣyādisaṃmatatvāt, paraṃ tvadhyāropitapreṣaṇadvitīyakakṣāyām aṇyantadhātvarthakriyāsāmyaṃ nāstītyaṃśe eva vivaraṇasya cintyatvamiti rahasyam | ata eva bhāṣyamate "karmavatkarmaṇā" ityanantaraṃ pūrvoktarītyā naitatsūtrārambhāpattiḥ | adhyāropitapreṣaṇadvitīyakakṣāyāmātmanepadānupapattiprasaṅgāt | kaustubhamate tu tasyā alakṣyatayā taddoṣaḥ kaiścidukta iti vaiṣamyam | etādṛśabhāṣyābhiprāyavyavasthāpanārthameva vṛttikṛtā caturthavākyārtho vyākhamyātaḥ `darśayate rājā bhṛtyān' ityatra | tenāpyātmanepadoktyā bhāṣyavṛttyormataikyanirṇayāt | `darśayate rājā bhṛtyān svayameva' iti caturthakakṣāyā bhāṣyamate'pi lakṣyatayā tadudāharaṇenādhyāropitapreṣaṇadvitīyakakṣāyā vṛttimate'pyalakṣyatvāsiddheḥ | nanu `karmakartari' ityādivṛttigranthastu vārttikamatānusāreṇa, `kartṛsthakriyārtham' ityāditadgrantho bhāṣyavadatyantāyogavyacchedārthako na tvanyayogavyavaccedārthako nyāyasāmyāt | `gaṇayati gaṇaḥ svayameva' iti grantho'pi vārttikamatānusāreṇaiva | bhāṣyakārairṇigrahaṇena hetumaṇṇica eva grahaṇāt | tatrāpyātmanepadasyodāhṛtatvāt | ata eva helārājenoktaṃ gaṇayati gaṇaḥ svayamevetyatra tvātmanepadanivṛttyarthaṃ niyamārthatayā "ṇeraṇau" iti sūtraṃ vārttikakṛtā vyavasthāpitamiti | ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ, ārohayamāṇo hastī bhītānsecayati mūtreṇeti pratyudāharaṇasya tvayamarthaḥ---bhītā mūtreṇa hastinaṃ siñcanti iti prathamakakṣā | saṃyogānukūladravadravyaniṣṭhakriyānukūlavyāpāraśca sekapadārthaḥ | hastiniṣṭhasaṃyogānukūlā yā mūtrarūpadravadravyaniṣṭhakriyā tadanukūlavyāpāravanta ityarthaḥ | tato ṇyarthāntarbhāve hastī bhītairmūtreṇa siñcati | saṃyogānukūladravadravyakriyānukūlavyāpārānukūlavyāpāravānityarthaḥ | etatsamānārthāyām adhyāropitapreṣaṇadvitīyakakṣāyāṃ hastī bhītaiḥ secayate mūtreṇeti | tatrātmanepadaṃ bhavatyeva | gatibuddyādisūtrasyānavakāśādbhītānāṃ karmatvābhāvātkartari tṛtīyā || bhīsmyorhetubhaye 68 | bhayeti vismaraṇasyāpyupalakṣaṇam | ābhyāṃ ṇyantābhyāmātmanepadaṃ prayojakasyaiva tajjanakatve | muṇḍo bhīṣayate | "bhiyo hetubhaye" iti ṣuk | "bibhataḥ" iti vaikalpikātvapakṣe bhāpayate | ṣugvidhāvīkārapraśleṣādatra tadabhāvaḥ | jaṭilo vismāpayate | hetubhaye kim kuñcikayā bhāyayati, rūpeṇa vismāyayati | atra "nityaṃ smayateḥ" iti ātvaṃ na bhavati | uktārthakahetubhayapadasya tatrānuvṛtteḥ | yadyapi hetuvyāpāre ṇijvidhānaṃ tasyāpi bhayahetutvaṃ tathā'pi viśeṣaṇasāmarthyāddhātusvarūpamevānyanirapekṣandhātvarthaprayojakaṃ cetyarthaḥ | etena manuṣyavācā manuvaṃśaketuṃ vismāyayanniti vyākhyātam | vismāpayanniti pāṭhaḥ prāmādikaḥ | ṇijantareṇa vācetyasya karaṇārthatvamapahāya prayojyakartṛparatayā vā samādheyaḥ | gṛdhivañcyoḥ pralambhane 69 | ṇyantābhyāmābhyāṃ vañcanārthābhyāmātmanepadam | māṇavakaṃ garddhayate vañcayate vā | pralambhane kim | śvānaṃ garddhayati | kutracittasyecchāmutpādayatītyarthaḥ | ahiṃ vañcayati varjayatītyarthaḥ | liyaḥ saṃmānanaśālīnīkaraṇayośca 70 | cakārāt pralambhanagrahaṇam | līṅ‌ praśleṣaṇe | divādiḥ | aṅit krayādiḥ | dvayorapyupādānam | niranubandhakaparibhāṣāyā "vāmadevāḍ‌ ḍyaḍ‌ḍyau" iti ḍitkaraṇajñāpyatayā pratyayaviṣayakatvāt | jaṭābhirālāpayate | pūjāṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ | śyeno vrtikāmullāpayate | nyakkarotītyarthaḥ | bālamullāpayate | vañcayatītyarthaḥ | "vibhāṣālīyateḥ" ityātvam etadviṣaye nityaṃ vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāt | naca "līyateḥ" iti śyanā nirdeśāt līnāterātvaṃ na syāditi vācyam | ubhayārthako nirdeśo'yamiti siddhāntāt | saṃmānanādiṣviti kim | bālamullāpayati | āśleṣayatītyarthaḥ | mithyopapadāt kṛño'bhyāse 71 | ṇyantātkṛño mithyopapadādātmanepadaṃ syātpaunaḥ punye | padaṃ mithyā kārayate | sāpacāraṃ svarādiduṣṭamasakṛduccārayatītyarthaḥ | kṛñ‌ atrākarmaka uccāraṇārthaḥ | ṇyantastu uccāraṇārthaḥ sakarmakaśca | mithyeti kim | padaṃ suṣṭhu kārayati | kṛñaḥ kim | padaṃ mithyā vācayati | abyāse kim | sakṛtpadaṃ mithyā kārayati | svaritañitaḥ kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale 72 | svariteto ñitaśca dhātorātmanepadaṃ syāt kartṛgāmini kriyāphale | kriyāphalamatra yaduddeśena tatkriyāpravṛttistat | natvavāntaraphalaṃ yattad | taduktam--- yasyārthasya prasiddhyarthamārabhyante pacādayaḥ | tat pradhānaṃ phalaṃ teṣāṃ na lābhādi prayojanam || tena dakṣiṇāvetanādikamādāya nātmanepadam | atra kriyāphalasyātiriktagāmitvavivakṣāyāmātmanepadamasādhu, na tu kartṛgāmitvāvivakṣāyām | ata eva kartrabhiprāye iti kim kartṛbhinnagāmitve mā bhūditi vyākhyātaṃ natu kartṛgāmitvābhāva iti | tena bhallīnāmiva pānakarma kurute kāmaṃ kuraṅgekṣaṇetyatrātmanepadamanarthakamiti kāvyaprakāśaḥ saṅgacchate | anyathā cyutasaṃskṛtāvevāntarbhāvaḥ syāditi pradīpakārādayaḥ | yadgataphalakāmanayā karma kriyate tadgatameva phalamiti niyamāt gayāśrāddhaṃ pitari, jāteṣṭiḥ putre svargapūtatve janayataḥ | mātāpitrādisvargakāmanākṛtaṃ ca puṣkaraṇīyāgādikaṃ mātāpitrādisvargajanakam | "svargakāmaḥ" ityādau svaparasādhāraṇasvargasya phalatvakalpanāt | yajetetyātmanepadaṃ ca kriyāphalasya kartraniṣṭhatve'pi kartrabhipretatvamātreṇa sādhviti maṇikṛtaḥ | miśrāstu puruṣaviśeṣasya phalārthaṃ viśiṣya yat karmoktaṃ tat tanniṣṭhaphalecchayā kṛtaṃ puruṣāntare phalajanakamastu itthaṃ ca paraputrādipūtatvārtamapi jāteṣṭhyādikamastu yadgataṃ phalaṃ śāstradeśitaṃ tadgatatvenaiva phalakāmanā prayojiketyarthe "svarmakāma" iti śrutau svatvasyautsargikatvānmātāpitrādisvargārthaṃ puṣkaraṇīyāgādikaraṇavirodhaḥ | dadyādaharahaḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ pratimāvahannityādau parapitrādilābhāpattiḥ | ātmanepadamapi phalasya kartṛgatatve eva sādhu | kartāraṃ cet kriyāphalamabhipraiti abhisaṃbadhnātīti vyākhyānāt | ata eva kartrabhiprāyakriyāphalayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ sūtre saṅgacchate | abhiprāyapadasya viṣayalakṣaṇāyāṃ gauravāt | ata eva yajanti yājakā iti pratyudāharaṇam | naca teṣāṃ vetanamātre'bhiprāyaḥ | sāṅge phale satyeva vetanamiti vetanoparāgeṇa phalābhiprāyasyāpi sattvāt | tasmātparārthaṃ puṣkariṇīyāgamahādānādeḥ śiṣṭairavigānenācaraṇātsvaparasādhāraṇasvargādikāmaḥ puṣkaraṇīyāgādikaṃ kuryāditi viśiṣyaiva śrutiḥ kalpyate ityāhuḥ | kecittu tadapekṣayā pratyakṣavidhereva śiṣṭācārabalātsāmānyaparatvāvadhāraṇādautsargikasvaparatābādho yuktaḥ | pitṛbhya ityādau tu svapitṛbhya ityādivacanāntaraikavākyatayā śiṣṭācāreṇa ca saṃbandhitvenautsargikasvapitṛparatvameveti maṇikṛduktaṃ yuktam | ātmanepadamapi kartṛbhiprete kriyāphale eva | viṣayasaptamyā kriyāphalaviṣayake kartrabhiprāye, abhipreyate iti karma vyutpattyāvā uktārthalābhāt | ata eva dakṣiṇādyuparāgeṇāpi yajamānasvargādeḥ kāmatve yajante yājakā iti | dakṣiṇādereva tathātve tu yajanti yājakā ityeveti granthakārairuktam | na vimuñcanti sāmarthyaṃ vākyārtheṣu padāni vaḥ | yajjvalanti hi kāṣṭhāni tat kiṃ pākaṃ na kurvate || iti kartranabhiprāye'pyātmanepadasya bhaṭṭācairyaiḥ prayuktatvāccetyāhuḥ | kecittu idamātmanepadaṃ saṃvidhānavṛttibhyo bhavati | pacate pācayatītyarthaḥ | evaṃ yajate ityādi | dhātūnāmanekārthatvātprakṛtireva yadā saṃvidhāne varttate tadā tasya dyotakamātmanepadaṃ bhavati, yadā tu prakṛtyā na vihitaṃ saṃvidhānaṃ tadā tadabhidhānāya ṇijutpadyate pācayatīti | yadā tu "ṇicaśca" iti ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ bhavati tadā dvitīye saṃvidhāne ṇyantasya vṛttiḥ | yathā rājā pācayate iti | kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale ityanena saṃvidhānātmaka eva kriyāviśeṣa upalakṣyate | taduktaṃ vākyapadīye--- kriyāpravṛttāvākhyātā kaiścitsvārthaparārthatā | asatī vā'satī vā'pi vivakṣitanibandhanā || keṣāṃcitkartrabhiprāye ṇicā saha vikalpyate | ātmanepadamanyeṣāṃ tadarthā prakṛtiryathā || krīṇīṣva pacate dhatte cinoti cinute'pi ca | āptaprayogā dṛśyante yeṣu ṇyartho'bhidhīyate || asatīvetyanena kamalavanod‌ghāṭanaṃ kurvate ye ityādayaḥ samarthitāḥ | tatrāpi svārthatāvivakṣāyāḥ sambhavāt | keṣāñciditi ślokena ṇyarthasya vācakaṃ dyotakaṃ vā''tmanepadamiti matadvayaṃ saṃgṛhītam | cinoti cinute iti cinoti cāyayatīti krameṇārtha ityāhuḥ | atrāyaṃ vivekaḥ---ṇyarthe ātmanepadamiti mate'pi saṃvidhāne śabdaśaktisvābhāvyātsvaritañita eva varttante nānye dhātava itisvaritañidgrahaṇaṃ bhāṣye pratyākhyātam | ye'pi svārthaṃ kriyārambhe ātmanepadaṃ parārthakriyārambhe parasmaipadam | sā ca svārthaparārthatā vivakṣānimittā laukikaprayoge svaritañidviṣayaiva natu yātītyādi viṣayetyāhuḥ, tanmate'pi svaritañidgrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyātam | idaṃ mataṃ kriyāpravṛttāviti kārikayoktam | pañcabhirhalaiḥ kṛṣatītyatra "vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne" iti pākṣika ātmanepadābhāvaḥ | svāmidāsau pacata ityatra kriyāmātravivakṣāyāṃ parasmaipadam | svāmigatadharmasya dāse ārope tvātmanepadaṃ bhavatyeveti kaiyaṭaḥ | apādvadaḥ 73 | pūrvaviṣaye ātmanepadam | nyāyamapavadate | kartrabhiprāye kim | apavadati | ṇicaśca 74 | pūrvaviṣaye ṇyantādātmanepadam | kaṭaṃ kārayate | "kṛtaśmaśrurapi śmaśrūṇi kārayati" iti bhāṣyaṃ tu saṃvidhānapakṣe, kartṛgāmitvāvivakṣāyāṃ vā | atra kaścid‌ idaṃ curādiṇyante na pravarttate lakṣeḥ svaritettvakaraṇāt | tadāha--- svaritetsyādgrahiḥ kartrādau lakṣiścaikaścurādiṣu | iti---vyācaṣṭa | ṇijabhāvapakṣe svaritettvaṃ sārthakamiti noktārthajñāpakamiti candraḥ | lakṣeḥ svaritettvaṃ nirmūlamiti maitreyaḥ | tadetatsarvaṃ haradattenoktam | eṣa vidhirna curādiṇijantātsyāditi kaścana niścanute sma | āptavaco'tra na kiñcana dṛṣṭam | lakṣayateḥ svaritettvamanārṣam | samudāṅ‌bhyo yamo'granthe 75 | sarvaṃ prāgvat | natu granthaviṣaye | āṅ‌pūrvakasya vidhānaṃ sakarmakārtham | akarmakatve "āṅo yamahanaḥ" ityeva siddheḥ | vrīhīnsaṃyacchate | bhāramudyacchate | vastramāyacchate | agranthe kim | udyacchati cikitsāyāṃ vaidyaḥ | adhigamanapūrvakamudyamanaṃ dhātvarthaḥ | cikitsāmadhigantumudyamaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | kartrabhiprāye ityeva | saṃyacchati,ta udyacchati, āyacchati | anupasargājjñaḥ 76 | prāgvat | "akarmakācca" iti siddhe sakarmakārthamārambhaḥ | gāṃ jānīte | anupasargātkim | svargaṃ na prajānāti | itthaṃ nṛpaḥ pūrvamavāluloce tato'nujajñe gamanaṃ sutasyetyatra nṛpeṇeti vipariṇāmātkarmaṇi lakāro bodhyaḥ | vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne 77 | upapadamatra samīpe śrūyamāṇaṃ padam | tena kriyāphalasya kartṛgāmitvapratītau svaritetprabhṛtibhyo vā''tmanepadam | upapadena kartṛgatve pratīte uktārthānāmaprayogādātmanepadasyāprāptau aprāptavibhāṣeyam | svaṃ yajñaṃ yajati yajate vā | evamanyat | śeṣātkartari parasmaipadam 78 | ātmanepadanimittahīnāddhātoḥ kartari parasmaipadaṃ syāt | karmakartaryapi parasmepadaṃ syāt, sati tu kartṛgrahaṇe uttaratra śeṣagrahaṇasya kartṛgrahaṇasya cānuvṛttau satyāṃ śeṣe kartari parasmaipadavidhānātkarmakartari na bhavatīti cet | atra bhāṣyaṃ "kartari karmavyatihāre" ityatra `kartari' ityasya pratyākhyānāt tasyehānuvṛttyā kartaiva yaḥ kartā tatra parasmaipadaṃ na tu karmakartarīti na doṣa iti | anuparābhyāṃ kṛñaḥ 79 | yatrārthe ātmanepadamuktaṃ tatrāpīdam | anukaroti | parākaroti | abhipratyatibhyaḥ kṣipaḥ 80 | "kṣi preraṇe" svarited | abhikṣipatītyādi | ebhyaḥ kim | ākṣipate | kartarītyeva | atikṣipyate sūkṣam | karmakartaryapi evam | prādvahaḥ 81 | vaha prāpaṇe | svaritet | pravahati | prātkim | āvahate | parermṛṣaḥ 82 | mṛṣa titikṣāyām | svaritet | parimṛṣyati | pareḥ kim | āmṛṣyate | "pareḥ" iti yogavibhāgādvaherapīdamiti kecit | vyāṅ‌paribhyo ramaḥ 83 | ramu krīḍāyām | anudāttet | viramatītyādi | upācca 84 | yadyapyupapūrvo ramirnivṛttivināśārthatvādakarmakaḥ, tatra ca vibhāṣāyā vakṣyamāṇatvāt sakarmakārthaṃ kathamayamārambhaḥ, tathā'pyantarbhāvitaṇyarthatvātsakarmakatvaṃ bodhyam | yajñadattamuparamiti | uparamayatītyarthaḥ | vibhāṣā'karmakāt 85 | uparamati uparamate vā | nivartate ityarthaḥ | budhayudhanaśajaneṅ‌prudrusrubhyo ṇeḥ 86 | ebhyo ṇyantebhyaḥ parasmaipadam | "ṇicaśca" ityasyāpavādaḥ | bodhayati padmam | yodhayati kāṣṭhāni | nāśayati duḥ kham | janayati sukham | acittavatkartṛkatvād "aṇāvakarmakād" ityanena neha siddhiḥ | adhyāpayati | prāvayati, drāvayati, srāvayati | krameṇa prāvayatyādīnāṃ prāpayati vilāpayati syandayatītyarthaḥ | calanārthatvābhāve idaṃ vacanam | naca syandayatītyarthe "nigaraṇacalanārthebhyaḥ" iti siddham dravatvajanaycalanasya syandanapadārthatvāditi vācyam | dravatvajanyatāvacchedakacalanatvavyāpyajātiviśeṣaśaktatayā'sya viśeṣaśabdatve'pyaparyāyatvādityāhuḥ | nigaraṇacalanārthebhyaśca 87 | bhakṣaṇakampanārthebhyo ṇyantebhyaḥ parasmaipadaṃ syāt | nigārayati āśayati bhojayati calayati copayati kampayati | sakarmakārtho'cittavatkartṛkārthaścārambhaḥ | "ādeḥ pratiṣedho vācyaḥ" | ādayate devadattena | nijāsyalakṣmīmukuraṃ cakoraiḥ svakaumudīmādayamānamindumiti śrīharṣaḥ | gatibudvyādisūtreṇa prāptāyā devadattasya karmasaṃjñāyā "ādikhādyoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ" iti vaktavyādabhāvaḥ | kathaṃ tarhi--- imā kimācāmayase na cakṣuṣī ciraṃ cakorasya bhavanmukhaspṛśī | iti śrīharṣaḥ | na pīyatāṃ nāma cakorajihvayā kathaṃcidetanmukhacandrikā sadā---iti pūrvārddhānusāreṇa pānārthatvoktāvapi tasya bhakṣaṇaviśeṣatayā sāmānyagrahaṇena grahaṇasya durvāratvāt | anyathā'traiva sūtre copayatītyasaṅgataṃ syāt | copayatermandagatyarthatvāt | pratyavasānārthatvaṃ vinā gatibuddhyādisūtreṇa imāmityatra karmatvāsaṅgatiprasaṅgācca | ata eva "na pādami" iti sūtre pāgrahaṇam dheṭa upasaṃkhyānaṃ ca saṅgacchate | anyathā pādheṭorapi ācamivatpānārthatvena niṣedhavaiyarthyaṃ syāt | atra dīkṣitāḥ---ācāmayeti loṅantam | `se' iti saṃbodhanaṃ damayantyāḥ | ī lakṣmīḥ tayā saha varttamāne iti vyākhyānāt | kecittu cakorasya cakṣuṣī bhavanmukhaspṛśī varttete | ata eva imāṃ kiṃ nācāyamase cakṣurbhyāmityāhuḥ | yadvā iḥ kāmaḥ tasya mā lakṣmīḥ tasyā aṅkimā dṛśyatāṃ tvayeti śeṣaḥ | cakāraḥ pūrvoktaniṣedhasamuccayārthaḥ | etadvṛttiśobhāyāṃ kāmaśobhāsādṛśyādetaddarśane taddarśanamapi prasaktam, taccātra tvadanurāgābhāvātkāmasādṛśyaviṣayadarśanecchāvirahānmā'stu, sāmānyato ramaṇīyatvena darśanaṃ tu kriyatāmiti bhāvaḥ | āmayase yojayasi bodhayasi vā | amerbudhyarthatvād "gatibuddhiḥ---" iti karmatvamiti naiṣadhabhāvapradīpe vistaraḥ | aṇāvakarmakāccittavatkartṛkāt 88 | ṇeḥ pūrvamakarmakāt cittavat‌kartṛkād ṇyantātparasmaipadaṃ syāt | śete kṛṣṇaḥ taṃ śāyayati gopī | aṇāviti kim | ārohayamāṇaṃ prayuṅkte ārohayate ityatra ṇāvakarmake mā bhūt | "ṇeraṇau" iti sūtre nivṛttapreṣaṇādhyāropitapreṣaṇayoścaramakakṣāyāmakarmakatvavyavasthāpanāt | akarmakāt kim | kaṭaṃ kurvāṇaṃ prayuṅkte kārayate | cittavat‌kartṛkātkim | vrīhīnśoṣayate | kecittu aṇāviti ṇimātrasya paryudāsāccurādiṇyantāddhetumaṇṇau aṇāvityasya pratyudāharaṇamāhuḥ | atra bhāṣyam---budhādisūtrādiha ṇerityanuvarttate, sa ca hetumaṇṇijeva, budhādibhyastasyaiva sambhavāt | tenāyamarthaḥ---ahetumaṇṇyanto yo'karmakaścittavatkartṛkaśca tasmāddhetumaṇṇyantātparasmaipadaṃ bhavatīti | tena cetayamānaṃ prayuṅkte cetayatītyādi siddhyatīti | etena "aṇāvakarmakād" iti curādiṇico ṇyantātparasmaipadavacanamiti vārttikaṃ vyākhyātam | tasmātkeṣāṃ cinmatam etadubhayaviruddham | yattu rūpayantaṃ prayojayati rūpayate iti keṣāṃ citpratyudāharaṇaṃ tat prayojayatīti vigrahasvārasyāt curādiṇyantāddhetumaṇṇici | saukaryavivakṣāyāṃ prayojyavyāpāramātravṛttāvakarmakatvād, dvitīyo hetumaṇṇijiti bodhyam | etena cetayamānaṃ prayuṅkte cetayate ityapi vyākhyātam | na pādamyāṅ‌yamāṅ‌yasaparimuharucinṛtivadavasaḥ 89 | ebhyo ṇyantebhyaḥ parasmaipadaṃ na syāt | atra pivatirnigaraṇārthaḥ, itare cittavatkartṛkāḥ | nṛtiścalanārtho'pi | ato "nigaraṇacalana---" iti "aṇaāvakarmakād" iti ca prāptaṃ parasmaipadaṃ niṣidhyate | pāyayate | pā rakṣaṇe ityasya na grahaṇaṃ lugvikaraṇatvāt | tenāṇāvakarmakatvavivakṣāyāṃ pālayatītyeva | damu upaśame | damayate | āṅ‌pūrvo yama uparame | āyāmayate | "yamo'pariveṣaṇe" iti mittvaniṣedhaḥ | ṅakāraviśiṣṭopādānam upasargapratipattyartham | tenānyānvitādākārātparasya na | āṅ‌pūrvo yasuḥ prayatne | āyāsayate | paripūrvo muh vaicitye | pratyekameṣa parimohayamāṇabāṇaḥ | rocayate | nartayate | sarasvatī vādayate vipañcīm | cirādanadhyāyamavāṅ‌mukhī mukhe tataḥ sma sā vāsayate damasvasā | "vasa ācchādane" ityasya na grahaṇaṃ lugvikaraṇatvāt | dheṭa upasaṃkhyānam | dhāpayete śiśumekaṃ samīcī | prathamādvivacanena "vā cchandasi" iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ | ayaṃ ca kartṛge phale prāptasyātmanepadasyāpavādatayā vihitasya parasmaipadasyaiva niṣedhaḥ | yattvakartrabhiprāye "śeṣād" iti parasmaipadaṃ tad‌ bhavatyeva | tena vatsān pāyayati payaḥ, damayantī kamanīyatāmadam avīvadadvīṇāṃ parivādakena, bhikṣā vāsayatītyādi siddhamiti granthakṛtaḥ | vā kyaṣaḥ 90 | kyaṣantātparasmaipadaṃ vā | lohitāyati lohitāyate | paṭapaṭāyati paṭapaṭāyate | prakṛtyarthaniyamapakṣe ekavākyatayā vidhiriti pakṣe ca parasmaipadasyāyaṃ vikalpaḥ | bhinnavākyatayā niyamapakṣe tu pūrvasūtre pratiṣedhenāpavādamapanīyātmanepadasyāpravartanāt | tatpratiṣedhasyaivātrānuvṛttyā tatsāmarthyādātmanepadavikalpaḥ | ātmanepadapravṛttiṃ vinā tanniṣedhāyogād, ātmanepadasya lakṣaṇayopasthitau tasyaiva vikalpasiddheḥ | dyud‌bhyo luṅi 91 | dyutādibhyaḥ parasmaipadaṃ vā syālluṅi | adyutat adyotiṣṭa | aluṭhat aloṭhiṣṭa | luṅi kim | anyatrānudāttettvānnityaṃ taṅ‌ yathā syāt | nanvatra vāgrahaṇānuvṛttirvyarthā | anudāttettvānniṣiddhasya parasmaipadasyānena pratiprasave kṛte "lasya" ityutsargeṇaiva pākṣikasyātmanepadasya siddheriti ced | atrānuparābhyāmiti sūtravārttikam- "na vā dyutādibhyo vā vacanād" iti || asyārthaḥ---aśeṣatvātkṛñaḥ "svaritañitaḥ" iti pūrveṇa niyamādaprāptasya parasmaipadasya "anuparābhyām" ityanena vidhāne'pi anuparāpūrvātkarotermaulena vidhivākyenātmanepadamapisyāt | niyamāṃśakaraṇena parasmaipadasya pratiprasave'pi ātmanepadasya niṣedhābhāvād ityāśaṅkāyāṃ samādhānaṃ naveti | "dyud‌bhyo luṅi" ityatrāntareṇāpi vāvacanānuvṛttiṃ parasmaipadapratiprasavādubhayasminsiddhe svaritatve navāvacanānuvṛttirliṅgaṃ parasmaipadapratiprasave ātmanepadābhāvasyeti | yadvā ātmanepadāpavādaḥ parasmaipadaṃ vidhīyate natu pratiprasavadvāreṇa niyamaḥ pratipādyate | evaṃ ca yathā kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale parasmaipadaṃ na bhavati tathā parasmaipadavidhāvātmanepadamapi, yenanāprāptinyāyena bādhakatvāditi | asminnapi pakṣe pākṣikātmanepadapravṛtyarthamiha vāgrahaṇānuvṛttiriti dhyeyam | vṛdbhyaḥ syasanoḥ 92 | vṛtuvṛdhuśṛdhusyandūbhyaḥ padasmaipadaṃ vā lasyātsye sani ca | vartsyati avartsyat vivṛtsati | "na vṛdbhyaḥ ścaturbhyaḥ" iti neṭ | pakṣe varttiṣyate ityādi | syasanoḥ kim | varttate | syādetat | luṅi pūrveṇa vikalpo na siddhyet | dyutādāveva vṛtādīnāṃ pāṭhāt | takrakauṇḍinyanyāyenāsyāḥ prāpteḥ pūrvaprāptibādhakatvāt | ata evottarasūtre cakāraḥ | luṭīti viśeṣavidhināsyasanoriti prāpterbādho yathā na syāt | anyathā klṛperapi vṛtāditvādanenaiva syasanorvikalpasambhave cakāravaiyarthyāditi cet | maivam | dyutādipāṭhasāmarthyād vṛtādibhyo'pi luṅi vikalpasiddheḥ | yadvā luṅītyasya svaritatvādihāpyanuvṛttiḥ | luṭi ca iti| asyārthaḥ--svavyāpāre sarveṣāṃ svātantryāttadanuṣṭhānadvāreṇa pradhānakriyāyāmupayogātkartṛsannidhāvapi svavyāpārasyānivartanāt pāratantryāvasthāyāmapyanivṛtti kārakatvam| tathāhi arthāntarāvagamādapādānavyāpārānavasāyāt| evaṃ brāhmaṇāya dadātītyarthe brāhmaṇo dadātīti na prayogaḥ| śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāccāpādānasmapradānayorvyāpāre dhātorna vṛttiḥ| atrāyaṃ siddhāntaḥ--yadyapi ``jugupsāvirāmapramādārthānāmupasaṃkhyānam| adharmājjugupsate| viṣayatvaṃ pañcamyā nindā dhātorarthaḥ| adharmaṃ nindatītyarthaḥ| adharmādviramati| pañcamyā viṣayatvam| dhātoḥ karaṇānantaraṃ iti vivaraṇāt| adhyayanaviṣayakābhibhavāśakyatvajñānavānityarthaḥ| śatrun parājayate ityatra paratvātkarmasaṃjñā| abhibhavatītyarthaḥ| tenāsoḍhagrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham| vāraṇārthānamīpsitaḥ || 26 || vāraṇārthānāṃ prayoge kriyayā''ptumiṣṭo'rtho'pādānaṃ syāt| kūpādandhaṃ vārayati| nanu kūpasya nivāryanivārakābhyāmubhābhyāmanīpsitatvāt kathamapādānasaṃjñeti cet| atrāhuḥ--pravṛttividhāto vāraṇamiti pakṣe vārakaniṣṭhavyāpārajanyaprakṛtadhātūpāttaphalaśālitvenāndhāderevepsitatve'pi saṃkoce mānābhāvena vāraṇaśabdavācyakoṭau pravṛtterapi praveśāt| vāryamāṇaniṣṭhagamanavyāpārajanyasaṃyogarūpaphalaśālitvena kūpāderapīpsitatvam| vibhāgānukūlavyāpāro vāraṇamiti pakṣe tu vibhāgasyobhayaniṣṭhatvena tacchālitvānnivāryanivārakayordvayorapi spaṣṭamevepsitatvamiti| taccintyam| vāraṇasthale kūpe'ndhasaṃyogasyaivānutpattyā tacchālitvasya vaktumaśakyatvāt| etena vibhāgo'pi pyākhyātaḥ| andhātkūpaṃ vārayatītyasyāpi prasaṅgācca| yattu saṃyogasyaivābhāvāt siddhavibhāgaparipālanamātreṇa phalatvamiti| tadapi na| saṃyogābhāve guṇaviśeṣātmakavibhāgasyāpyanutpatteḥ| pūrvasiddhavibhāgāntarasya phalatvoktau tu yatra tadvyakteḥ pūrvaṃ kūpavibhāgo'pi na jātastatroktaprayogānāpatteśca| naca saṃyogātyantābhāvarūpa evātra vibhāgo vivakṣaṇīyaḥ| satyapi kūpapāte uktaprayogadarśanāt| naca saṃyogasyāvyāpyavṛttitayā kūpasaṃyogasattve'pi tadatyantābhāvasattvānna virodhaiti vācyam| pratiyogisamānādhikaraṇasaṃyogātyantābāvo ddeśena vāraṇānukūlavyāpārasya kenāpyananuṣṭhānāt| tasya svata eva sattvāt| anyathā'ndhakūpasaṃyogānukūlavyāpāravatyapi kūpādandhaṃ vārayatīti prayogaprasaṅgāt iti dik| tasmādandhasya kūpādhaḥsaṃyogo mā bhūditīcchāpūrvakatvādvāraṇasyāndhapratiyogikakūpādhodeśasaṃyogābhāvaviṣayakatvādicchāyāḥ svīyābhāvaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitapratiyogitvasaṃsargāvacchinnasaṃyoganiṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitānuyogitvasaṃsargavacchinnaprakāratāśālitvarūpamevepsitatvaṃ grāhyam| ato'ndhakūpasaṃyogāprasiddhāvapi na kṣatiḥ| uktecchāyāstatrāpi susthatvāt| atra pañcamyā adhaḥsaṃyogānukūlakriyārūpaṃ patanam| dvitīyāyā dhātvarthavyāpārānvitaṃ patanam| dhtorvirodhivyāpāro'rthaḥ| tathācāndhavṛttikūpaniṣṭhādhaḥsaṃyogānukūlakriyāvirodhivyāpāraviṣayakakṛtimāniti bodhaḥ| yatra kūpe patanamaprasiddhaṃ tatroktaprayogo'sādhurevetyeke| anye tu dhātorabhāvānukūlavyāpāro'rthaḥ| pañcamyā vṛttitvam| dvitīyāyā dhātvarthatāvacchedakābhāvānvitaṃ pratiyogitvamanuyogītvaṃ vā| abhāvaśca kūpādipadasabhivyāhārāt patanādijanyādhaḥsaṃyogādinā saṃbandhena| kūpavṛttyandhapratiyogikābhāvānukūlavyāpāraviṣayakayatnavāniti dhīḥ| evaṃ saviṣādannānmitraṃ vārayatītyādau yatra mitrasya viṣānnabhojanamaprasiddhaṃ tatra bhojanādisaṃbandhena saviṣānnavṛttimitrabhojanamaprasiddhaṃ tatra bhojanādisaṃbandhena saviṣānnavṛttimitrapratiyogikābhāvānukūlavyāpāraviṣayakayatnavāniti dhīrityāhuḥ| kecittu patanābhāvaprakārakecchāpūrvakapatanābāvānukūlo vyāpāraḥ prakṛte vāraṇam| pañcamyarthaḥ karmatvam, dvitīyārthaḥ kartṛtvam, patanaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāsambandhenecchāyāmanveti| kūpapatanādeḥ kvacidaprasiddhatve'pi tādṛśecchāsattvānna doṣaḥ| kūpakarmatvenāndhakartṛtvena ca yā patanābhāveccha tatpūrvakapatanābhāvānukūlo yo vyāpārastadviṣayakakṛtimāniti vākyārthaḥ| evaṃ saviṣādannādityādau bhojanābhāvecchāpūrvakabhojanābhāvānukūlo vyāpāro vāraṇam| anyat pūrvavadityāhuḥ| apare tu uktobhayatra ādye dhātoḥ patanaṃ dvitīye bhojanam| ubhayatrābhāvānukūlavyāpāraścārthaḥ| pañcamyā ādye'vacchinnatvaṃ dvitīye karmatvam, ubhayatra dvitvaṃ cārthaḥ| dvitīyāyāḥ kartṛtvamarthaḥ| dhātvarthapatanāderādhikaraṇatvena dhātvarthatāvacchedake'bhāve'nvayaḥ| dvitvāvacchinnasya pañcamyarthatāvacchedake'bhāve'nvayaḥ| dvitvāvacchinnasya pañcamyarthadvitīyārthobhayasyābhāve pratiyogitvenānvayo'pi vyutpattivaicitryāt| tathāca patanasāmānye yaḥ kūpāvacchinnatvāndhakartṛkatvobhayābhāvastadanukūlavyāpāraviṣayakayatnavān, dvitīye bhojanasāmānye yaḥ saviṣānnakarmakatvamitrakartṛkatvobhayābhāvastadanukūlavyāpāraviṣayakayatnavāniti dhīḥ| ākāśaṃ na paśyatī ghaṭaścaitrau vetyādau dvitīyayā viṣayitvaṃ lakṣaṇayā ghaṭādivṛttitvaṃ dvitvaṃ ca bodhyate| dhātorlaukikaviṣayitvāvacchinnapratyakṣam| tathā ca laukikāpratyakṣasāmānye ya ākāśaviṣayakatvāghaṭavṛttitvobhayābhāvastannirūpako ghaṭa ityarthaḥ| ākāśaviṣayakacākṣuṣopanītabhāne'pi laukikaviṣayitvāvacchedena ākāśaviṣayakatvacaitravṛttitvobhayābhāvo'styeva| evamaprasiddhasthale'nyatrāpītyāhuḥ|| antardhauyenādarśanamicchati || 27 || yatsamavetapratyakṣaviṣayatvābhāva ātmana iṣyate tadapādānam| upādhyāyādantardhatte śiṣyaḥ| atra svapratyakṣābhāvecchāpūrvakatadanukūlasaṃnnikarṣābhāvānukūlavyāpāro dhātvartheḥ| pañcamyartho vṛttitvam| tasya svapratyakṣābhāve'nvayaḥ| upādhyāyavṛttiryaḥ svapratyakṣābhāvastadicchāpūrvakaḥ pratyakṣānukūlasannikarṣābhāvānukūlo vyāpāraḥ śiṣyavṛttiriti dhīḥ| icchāniveśātsatyapi cākṣuṣe na kṣatiḥ| ākhyātopayoge|| 28 || upayogo niyamapūrvakamadhyayanam tatra vaktā'pādānam| upādhyāyādadhīte| adhyayanaṃ taduccāritaśabdaprayojyaśabdānusandhānam| pañcamyartho vṛttitvam| upādhyāyavṛtti yaduccāraṇaṃ tajjanyaśabdaprayojyaśabdānusandhānamiti| idamapi bhāṣye pratyākhyātam| dhruvamapāya ityata eva siddheḥ| taduktam-``yadyapakrāmati kiṃ nātyantāyāpakrāmati santatatvāt| athavā jyotirvajjñānāni bhavanti| vyākhyātaṃ ca kaiyaṭena santatatvāditi śabdasya vyañjakā dhvanaya upādhyāyenotpādyamānā bhinnā api sādṛśyāttatvenādhyavasīyamānāḥ śrotuḥ punāḥ punaḥ śrotrapathaṃ gacchanto vyaktisphoṭarūpaṃ jātisphoṭirūpaṃ vā śabdamabhivyañjayantītyarthaḥ| athaveti| yathā jvālārūpaṃ jyotiravicchedenotpadyamānaṃ sadṛśatvenādhyavasīyamānaṃ santataṃ tathaivopādhyāyajñānāni bhinnāni śabdarūpatāmāpadyamānāni saṃtatānyucyante| jñānasya śabdarūpāpattiriti darśanamatra bhāṣyakārasya| tathācoktam- vāyoraṇūnāṃ jñānasya śabdatvāpattiriṣyate| kaiściddarśanabhedo hi pravādeṣvanavasthitaḥ|| iti| janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ || 29 || jāyamānasya heturapādānasaṃjñaḥ| putrātpramodo jāyate| brahmaṇaḥ prajāḥ prajāyante| janītyarthagrahaṇam| aṅgādaṅgātsambhavasi| janeriñ| janighasibhyāmiṇvā| ``jānivadhyoścaiti na vṛddhiḥ śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā samāsaḥ| yadvā ``kartari caiti niṣedhasyāta eva jñāpakādanityatvam| idamapi pratyākhyātam| gomayād vṛściko jāyate| golomāvilomabhyo dūrvā jāyante| atrāpakramaṇaṃ gauṇam| loke hi yadyasmādutpadyate tattasmānnirgacchatītyucyate| vaiśeṣikādimate tu paramāṇvādisamavetaṃ kāraṇebhyo'pṛthagdeśaṃ kāryamutpadyate iti nāstyapakramaḥ| sāṃkhyamate'pyāvirbhāvatirobhāvalakṣaṇajanmanāśarūpapariṇāmābhyupagamānna tathā| ``saṃtatatvānnātyantamapakrāmantiiti bhāṣyam| avicchedādityarthaḥ| yathā bilāddīrghabhogo bhogī niṣkrāmannapyāvicchedāttatropalabhyate tathādūrvā apītyartha iti kaiyaṭaḥ|| atrādvaitacandrikākārāḥ-vibhāgarūpāpakramaṇasyāvadhāvevāpakramato na pratītiḥ| iha tu yuktatvarūpamapakramaṇaṃ tadavadhau prayuktasya pratītiraṅgīkriyate eva| tathaivānubhavāt| nanu prayuktatvaṃ kathamapādānapañcamyartha iti cet| na| vṛkṣātpatatītyādau vṛkṣādyavadhikavibhāgapratītyā vibhāgasyeva kapālādvaṭa ityādau kapālādyavadhikaprayuktatāpratītyā prayuktasyāpyapāyaśabdena vaktuṃ śakyatvāt| tathā cedaṃ bhāṣyatātparyam-avyavahitottarakṣaṇasambandho'pyatrāpāyaśabdārthaḥ| tadekadeśe'vyavahitottaratve nirūpakarūpasyāpyavadherdhruvapadena vācyatvāt| kāraṇasamūhasya tadavadhitve'pi samūhasamūhinorabhedopacārāt karaṇamātre'pi tatsaṃbhavaḥ| yadyapyanyathāsiddhasyāsyāpyuktāvadhitvamsti, tathā'pyananyathāsiddhatvasyāpi niveśyatvād, daṇḍarūpāddhaṭaityādernāpattiḥ| daṇḍāddhaṭo jāyate ityādau ghaṭaṃ pratyananyathāsiddhadaṇḍaghaṭito yaḥ samūhastadavyavahitottarakṣaṇasambandhābhinna yā utpattistadvan ghaṭaḥ| daṇḍāddhaṭa ityādau jāyate ityādikriyādhyāhārāvasyakatve tu tādṛśāvyavahitottaratvameva pañcamyarthaḥ| tathaiva dhātvarthaghaṭakakṣaṇe'nvayādiṣṭārthalābhaḥ| vastutaḥ prayuktatvameva pañcamyarthaḥ, tasyaivāpāyaśabdena dhruvapadena coktisaṃbhavāt| asti ca ghaṭādāviva tadutpattāvapi daṇḍādi prayuktatvamiti daṇḍādvaṭa utpadyate daṇḍāddhaṭa tadutpattāvapi daṇḍādiprayuktatvamiti daṇḍāddhaṭa utpadyate daṇḍāddhaṭa ityasya ca prāmāṇyam| kaiyaṭaidivākyaṃ tu samādhānāntarābhiprāyam| niṣkrāmn vibhāgānukūlavyāpārotpattikālāvaccinnaḥ vibāgapūrvasthūlakālavyāpārotpattikālapradarśanāya dīrghabhoga iti| tathāca vibhāgotpattiḥ, pūrvaṃ bile bhogina ivotpatteḥ prayuktatvasya vā kramaṇasyottarakālameva lomādau dūrvādeḥ pratyakṣam| utpattyādyakāletu tannāstyeva| cakṣurādyasaṃyogāt| utpattikṣaṇe ca lomādau dūrvādyastīti parokṣadhīstu pūrvoktarītyā samādheyā| yattu bhogino'grāvacchedena bilāsaṃyogarūpāpakramaṇasya sattve'pi mūlāvacchedena bilasaṃyogādyathā bile upalabdhistathā dūrvādeḥ svapariṇāmilomādibhāgasambaddhatayā pratīyamānasyāpi lomādibhāgāntarāvacchedena lomādisambandhābhāvarūpāpakramaṇamiti kaiyaṭavākyārtha iti tanna| vṛkṣāvamthitikāle calatyapi patrādau vṛkṣāccalatītyādyaprayogād vṛkṣādisaṃyogādyasamakālikasyaiva vṛkṣādisaṃyogābāvāderapāyapadārthatayā bilādisaṃyogābhāvāderapāyapadārthatvābhāvādityāhuḥ|| bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ || 30 || bhūkartuḥ prabhavaḥ prāgvat| himavato gaṅgā prabhavati| bhavanamatra bahiḥsaṃyogaḥ bahiḥpadārtho himavādbhinnajambūdvīpabhūmiḥ| saṃyogadhvaṃsakālīnatvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ| saca bahiḥsaṃyogatvavyāpakaviśeṣaṇatāsambandhena bahiḥsaṃyoge'nveti| āśrayatvaṃ tiṅarthaḥ| himavatsaṃyogadhvaṃsakālīnahimavadbhinnajambūdvīpīyabhūmisaṃyogāśrayo gaṅgeti dhīḥ| prayāgātprabhavati gaṅgetyaprayogāt bahiḥsaṃyogatvavyāpakasambandhaniveśaḥ| prayāgabhinnambūdvīpabūmigaṅgāsaṃyogatvaṃ gaṅgādvārādibhūmigaṅgāsaṃyoge kalpādikāle'pyasti| natu prayāgagaṅgāsaṃyogadhvaṃsakālīnatvamiti tadvāraṇam| himavadbhinnagaṅgāsaṃyogatvāvacchedena tu himavadgaṅgāsaṃyogadhvaṃsakālīnatvamastyeveti na doṣaḥ| anye tūktaprayogavāraṇāya prāthamikabahiḥsaṃyogaḥ pañcamyarthaḥ| bahiḥpadārtho bhūkhaṇḍam| prāthamyaṃ saṃyogadhvaṃsāvyavahitottarakṣaṇavṛttitvam| himavatsaṃyogadhvaṃsakālīnāvyavahitottarakṣaṇavṛttipṛthivīsaṃyogāśrayatvavatī gaṅgeti dhīrityāhuḥ| idamapi pratyākhyātam| anyānyāḥ prādurbhavantīti bhagavadukteḥ| etenānyānyaśayyāracanāya lūnairityādiśrīharṣaprayogā vyakhyātāḥ| atra vadanti karthaciduktaprayogāṇāṃ samarthane'pi mukhyārthapuraskāreṇa ṣaṣṭhī syāt| naṭasya śṛṇotītivat| kriyānukūlavyāpārāṃśe naṭopādhyāyayoraviśeṣāt| anabhidhānabrahmāstramāśritya pratyākhyānaṃ tu na manoramam| sansūtrabhāṣyaviruddhaṃ ca| evaṃ jugupsetivārtikamapyāvaśyakam| evaṃ ca dhruvaṃ bhayaheturasoḍha ityādisaṃjñinirdeśo'pi sārthekaḥ| paratvāttattatsaṃjñāpravṛttāvapi śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ ``na māṣāṇāmaśnīyādityādivat ṣaṣṭhyā iṣṭatayā tatrāpādānasaṃjñāvāraṇārthatvāditi atra bhāṣyārthavirodhaḥ| upādhyāye ṣaṣṭhī neṣyate bhayahetvādiṣu tviṣyate ityasya vaktumaśakyatvāditi bahuśrutairvicāraṇīyaṃ ca| tadetadabhisaṃdhāyāsmatpitṛcaraṇairuktam| avadhitvavadapādānam| avadhitvaṃca prakṛtadhātvarthaprayuktakartṛkarmānyatarasaṃbandhanivṛttimattvam| aśvātpatati devadatta ityatra prakṛtadhātvarthaḥ patanaṃ tatprayuktā devadattarūpasya kartuḥ saṃyogasya nivṛttiraśve tadvānaśvo'pādānam|| parasparānmeṣāvapasarata ityatrāpi apasaraṇaprayuktā meṣayoḥ saṃyogasya nivṛttiḥ| vṛkādbibhetītyatra vṛkaprayuktā devadattasambandhasya nivṛttirvṛke| caurebhyastrāyate devadattamityatra trāṇaprayuktā karmasaṃjñakadevadattasaṃbandhasya nivṛttiścaureṣu| upādhyāyādadhīte ityatrāpi karmaṇaḥ śabdasya dhvanyātmakasya nivṛttirupādhyāye vartate| kaiyaṭoktavidhātra bodhyā| yenotpādito dhvaniranityatvānnivartate iti kaiyaṭāśayaḥ| māṣebhyo gāṃ vārayatītyatra vāraṇakriyāprayuktā karmabhūtānāṃ gavāṃ sambandhasya nivṛttirmāṣeṣu| gomayādvṛściko jāyate ityādāvapi kartṛbhūtavṛścikatādrūpyasaṃbandhanivṛttirgomayādau| himavato gaṅgā prabhavatītyādāvapi prabhavanakriyākartṛgaṅgājalasaṃbandhasya nivṛttirhimavati| yataḥ kāścidāpo himavato nirgacchanti kāścidanyāstatra tiṣṭhanti| samudraḥ kuṇḍiketyatra kuṇḍikāyāḥ pānīyabāhulyātsamudratvam| samudrasya vā sutāratvātkuṇḍikātvamasadapi vivakṣāvaśāt pratīyate| tathā gauṇamukhyasādhāraṇamevā'pādānatvaṃ sarvatra sambavatīti dik|| karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānam || 32 || tatkriyākarmaṇā karaṇabhūtena tatkriyākartā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānasaṃjñāḥ| karaṇībhūtakarmajanyaphalabhāgitvenoddeśyatvaṃ saṃpradānatvamiti yāvat| upādhyāyāya gāṃ dadāti| grāmaṃ gacchatītyatra gamanakarmagrāmajanyasukhādimattayoddeśyasya caitrādervāraṇāya karaṇībhūteti| grāmo hi na gamane karaṇam| dhanaṃ tu dāne tathaiva| parasvatvahetutyāgaviśeṣātmakadānaghaṭakasvatvahetutvāt| pitṛsvargoddeśena brāhmaṇāya godānasthale dānajanyaphalaśālitvenaiva pitā'bhipreto na tu gojanyaphalaśālitveneti na vyabhicāraḥ| nacādṛṣṭadvārā svargādiphalasyāpi gojanyatvaṃ, dattā gauḥ pitṛsvargaṃ janayiṣyatītyabhisandhānāditi vācyam| adṛṣṭādvārakatvena dhātvarthāvacchedakatvena vā phalasya viśeṣaṇāt| uktasthale viprasvatvoddeśyakatvaṃ tadicchājanyarūpaṃ dānānvitaṃ caturthyāḥ, dvitīyāyāstu svatvamarthaḥ| viprasvatvoddeśyakadhanīyasvatvajanakadānānukūlakṛtimān iti dhīḥ| evaṃ ca dānakriyāmātranirūpitaṃ sampradānatvamityanaṅgīkārāt vṛkṣāyodakaṃ sñcitītyādāvapi udakajanyaphalabhāgitvenoddeśyatvādvṛkṣasya sampradānatvam| vṛkṣīyapatrādyuddeśyakasecanaviṣayakakṛtitimāniti dhīḥ| nacājāṃ grāmaṃ nayatītivadvṛkṣamudakaṃ siñcatīti syāt| saṃyogavattayā vṛkṣasya dravadravyakriyāvattayā ca udakasya karmatvasambhavāditi vācyam| anabhidhānāt| mīmāṃsakāstvanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānāttyajyamānadravyoddeśyatve sati svīkāravattvaṃ saṃpradānatvam| svīkāro yatheṣṭavivaniyogayogyatopadhāyakaḥ pratigrahaḥ| uddeśyatvaṃ caturthyantapadoccāraṇajanyajñānaviṣayatvam| nāmagotre samuccārya samyak śraddhānvito dadet| saṃkīrtya deśakālādi tubhyaṃ sampradade iti|| na mameti svasattāyā nivṛttimapi kīrtayet| dānahomādikaṃ kuryādevaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ|| iti vṛddhavasiṣṭavacanāt|| devatāyāmativyāptivāraṇāya viśeṣyam| tyajyamānadravyoddeśyatvamindrādāvarthe| tyāgakālīnacaturthyantapadoccāryatvaṃ śabde| devatātvaṃ taddhitavācyam vṛddhavyavahārāt| ata eva taddhitāpekṣayā devatālābhe caturtyā daurbalyam| svīkāravattbāṃśatyāgenaiva tyajyamānadravyoddeśyatvarūpadevatātvasya caturthīto lābhāt| taduktaṃ bhaṭṭaiḥ| taddhitena caturthyā vā mantraliṅgena vā punaḥ| devatāsaṅgatistatra durbalaṃ tu paraṃ param|| tatra tyāgādikamanyalabhyam| uddeśyatvamātraṃ caturthyarthaḥ| rajakāya vastraṃ dadātītyādau ca lakṣaṇeti| vṛttikārasyāpyayamevābhiprāyaḥ| kaiyaṭādayastu ``na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyātiti darśanāt ``khaṇḍikāpodyāyastasyai capeṭāṃ dadātiiti bāṣyakārodāharaṇācca parasvattvāpattiparyantasvattvanivṛtterdānatvam| dadātiviṣayaiva ca sampradānasaṃjñetyubhayamapyayuktam| ata eva kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamitivārtikamapi pratyākhyātamityāhuḥ|| nanvetanmate taddhitāpekṣayā caturthyā durbalatvaṃ na syāditi cenmaivam| tanmātrasya daurbalyānupapādakatvāt| tathāhi-guṇādhikaraṇe nirupitaṃ ``tapte payasi dadhyānayati sā vaiśavdevyāmikṣā vājibhyo vājinamiti śrutaṃ, tatra vājinavākyaṃ kiṃ pūrvayāgānuvādena da ravyadevatānyataravidhiḥ, atha karmāntaravidhiḥ| svavākyopāttayordravyadevatayorvākyāntaropāttadravyadevatāpekṣayā prathamopastitikattvāttadavaruddhe yāge nirākāṅkṣatayā vākyāntaropātayorna niveśa iti| vājinavākyasthasya yajeradhikārākhyaprakaraṇasāpekṣasya prakṛtayāgopastāpakatvam| āmikṣāvākyasthasya tu tadanapekṣasyaiveti| yajeḥ dravyadevatāpadānvaye sannikarṣācca| yajikalpakasya dravyadevatāsaṃbandhasyāmikṣāyāṃ vaiśvadevītyakapadopādānātpratītiḥ| vājine tu padāntaropādānāditi viprakarṣācca| vaiśvadevītyatra ``sāsya devatāityānuśāsanāddevatāviśiṣṭadravyaviśeṣasya taddhitārthatvāt| dravyānabhidhāne ābhikṣāpadasā mānādhikaraṇyānupapatteśca| naca tasya vyaktinyāyena dhīḥ| ``saṃmadāne caturthīitivaddevatāyāṃ taddita ityevānuśāsanaprasaṅgāt| naca dravyamātraṃ taddhitārtho, devatātvaṃ tu saṃsarga iti vācyam| padārthānuśāsane saṃsargasyānuśāsanānarhatvāt| ``tasyāpatyamityādau apatyatvasyāpi pratyayārthatvānāpatteśca| naca taddhitasya dravyaviśeṣavācakatve āmikṣāpadavaiyarthyam| buddhisthaprakāravācinastaddhitasya padāntarasamabhivyāhāravirahe āmikṣātvādiviśeṣarūpeṇānupasthāpakatvāt tātparyagrāhakatayā tatsārthakyāt| yadi ca taddhitāntapadamātraśravaṇe'pi dravyaviśeṣasya saṃśayotpādātsāmānyarūpeṇa dravyopasthitastaddhitāt| tathāpi viśeṣasyāmikṣāpadena samarpaṇe'pi anirdhāritadravyaviśeṣadevatāsaṃbandhasya padaśrutimātramamāṇakatvamakṣatam| vājibhya iti caturthī tu svarūpā evaṃ saṃdigdhā| pañcamīsādhāraṇyāt| caturthyapi saṃpradānatvamātravācinī pratigrahītṛtvāṃśatyāgena lakṣaṇayaiva devatātvaṃ vadet, natu dravyasaṃbandham| devatayāpi pratisaṃvandhitayā dravyasyārthāpattividhayākṣepe'pina tasya śādbatvam| nacākṣepo'pi saṃbhavati| pramāmāntarābhāve tasyāvaśyakatvāt| atra ca vājinapadasya sattvāt| tataśca vājibhya iti padasya dravyasākāṅkṣatve'pi dravyasambandhasya padāntaragamyat‌tādāmikṣāsambandhamapekṣya vājinasaṃbandho viprakṛṣṭaḥ| naca saṃkhyāvadabyāsāpādanena niveśaḥ| karmasvarūpe hyekatvāvacchinne sati abhyaste tasminnekādaśatvaniveśaḥ| dvitvādisaṃkhyāyāḥ pūrvāvadāritaikatvasāmānādhikaraṇyaniyatatvāt| vājinasya tvāmikṣāsāmānādikaraṇyenāniveśāt abhyastasyāpi karmaṇaḥ āmikṣāvarodhatādavasthyena niveśāsaṃbhavāt| tasmād dravyadevatāsaṃbandhakalpitaṃ sānnāyyaprakṛtikaṃ yāgāntarameva āmikṣā'nuṣpādivājinapratipattyarthatayā''bhikṣāyāgamātrāṅgatvena vidhīyate| tasmātpūrvakarmaṇyaniviśamāno guṇo bhedakaḥ| aniveśaśca prakṛte saṃnikarṣaviprakarṣādibhiruktanyāyaiḥ| kvacidvākyabhedāpattyādinetyanyatra nirūpitam| atra ca lakṣaṇayā devatātvapratītiriti bījābhāve'pi nyāyāntareṇa yathoktenaiva caturthyā daurvalyasiddheriti| prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ| kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| patye śete| śayanakriyayā īpsitasya patyuktasaṃjñā| bhāṣyakārāstu saṃdarśanādhyavasāyaprārthanādibhirarthyamānatvāt kriyā'pi kṛtrimaṃkarma| tathāca sūtreṇaiva sidadham| aprayujyamānā api yāḥ saṃdarśanādikriyāstatkarmabhūtayā śayanakriyayā patyurabhipreyamāṇatvāt| pūrvaṃ hi śayanakriyāyāḥ jñānaṃ tata icchā tataḥ pravṛttiriti kramaḥ| jñānādikriyānirūpitaṃ ca karmatvaṃ śayanādeḥ spaṣṭamiti| pratīyamānakriyāmapekṣya kārakatvasya praviśa, piṇḍīmityādau darśanāt| ``kriyārthopapadasyaiti sūtrasvārasyācca| nanvevaṃ kaṭaṃ karotityādāvapi sampradānatvāpattiḥ| atrāhuḥ--yadā saṃdarśanādayo dhātvarthādbhedena vivakṣyante tadā saṃpradānasaṃjñā| sā ca vivakṣā prayogadarśanavaśānniyataviṣayaivāśrīyate'to nātiprasaṅgaḥ| tatra bhedasyāvivakṣitatvāt| ata eva gatyarthakarmaṇīti pratyākhyāsyate| uktaṃca vākyapadīye-- bhedasya ca vivakṣāyāṃ pūrvāṃ pūrvāṃ kriyāṃ prati| parasyāṅgasya karmatvānna kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam|| kriyāṇāṃ samudāye tu yadaikatvaṃ vivakṣitam| tadā karma kriyāyogātsvākhyayaivopacaryate|| bhedābhedavivakṣā ca svabhāvena vyavasthitā| tasmādgatyarthakarmatve vyabhicāro na dṛśyate|| viklapenaiva sarvatra saṃjñe syātāmube yadi| ārambheṇa na yogasya pratyākhyānaṃ samaṃ bhavet|| svākhyayāḥ kriyopsitatvarūpakarmasaṃjñayā upacaryate-vyavahiyate, natu sampradānasaṃjñayā| gatyarthakarmaṇi tu bhedābhedobhayaṃ paryāyeṇa vivakṣyate iti saṃjñādvayādvibhaktidvayaṃ siddham| spaṣṭamanyat| mīmāṃsakāstu niyamena jñānādipratītyabhāvānnedaṃ yuktam| ata eva gatyarthakarmaṇīti sūtre ``kriyāgrahaṇamapi tatra codyateiti bhāṣyakṛtoktavārtikaṃ vidhitvenāśritamityāhuriti tatraiva sphuṭīkariṣyāmaḥ| idaṃ ca trividham| anirākaraṇātkartustyāgāṅgaṃ karmaṇepsitam| preraṇānumatibhyāṃ ca labhate saṃpradānatām|| iti vākyapadīyāt| sūryāyārdhyaṃ dadāti| viprāya gāṃdadāti| uprādhyāyāya gāṃ dadāti iti kramādudāharaṇam| naca tādarthyacaturthyaiva siddhau etatsūtravaiyarthyam| dānakriyāyāḥ phalasambandhitayā prādhānyātsaṃpradānasyaina tadarthatvam natu dānākriyāyāḥ sampradānārthatvamiti tadaprasakteriti helārājaḥ| ata eva tyāgāṅgaṃ ``karmaṇepsitamityuktam|| karmasaṃpradānayoḥ karaṇakarmatve vācye| pathunā rudraṃ yajate| pathuṃ rudrāyadadātītyarthaḥ| idaṃ tu chāndasavyatyayātsiddhaṃ| loke tu yajeḥ pūjārthatvātpaśo- karaṇatvam| rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ || 33 || uktasaṃjñaḥ syāt| devadattāya rocate svadate vā modakaḥ pathi| prīyamāṇaḥ kim pathītyadhikaraṇe mā bhūt| ādityo rocate ityatra dīptyarthe na saṃjñā| atra vākyapadīyam| hetutve karmasaṃjñāyāṃ seṣatve vāpi kārakam| rucyarthādiṣu śāstreṇa saṃpradānākhyamucyate|| asyārthaḥ| anyasamavetābhilāṣo rucyarthaḥ| abhilāṣaviṣayo bhavatītyavagamāt| tādṛśaṃ modakaṃ devadattaḥ prayuṅkte| laulyāttadānuguṇyamācaratīti devadattasya hetusaṃjñāyāṃ, rocateḥ prīṇatītyarthe tu karmasaṃjñāyāṃ, devadattasya yo'milā,stadviṣayo bhavatītyarthe tu śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ saṃpradānasaṃjñārambhaḥ| ślāghahnuṅsthāśapāṃ jñīpsyamānaḥ || 34 || eṣāṃ prayoge bodhayitumiṣṭaḥ sampradānam| devadattāya ślāghate| taṃ stautītyarthaḥ| evaṃ hi devadattaḥ śakyate jñāpayituṃ| devadattāya svaṃ paraṃ vā ślāghyaṃ kathayatīti kecit| ślāghamānaḥ parastrībhyastatrāgādrākṣasādhipaḥ|| iti bhaṭṭīprayogāt ātmānaṃ ślāghyaṃ parastrībhyaḥ kathayannityarthaḥ| ādyapakṣe karmatve, dvitīye ca śeṣaṣṭhayāṃ prāptāyāmārambhaḥ| h‌nuṅādayaḥ svārthaviśiṣṭajñāpanārthatvātsakarmakāḥ| tathā ca jñīpsyamāna iti saṃjñiviśeṣaṇam| devadattāya h‌nute devadattamapalapan tadapalāpaṃ devadattaṃ bodhayati| sannihitamapi taṃ dhanikāderapalapatītyarthaḥ| yadvā hnotavyaṃ devadattaṃ bodhayatityarthaḥ| devadattāya tiṣṭhate īdṛśo'hamityavasthānena bodhyate| kastasmai ramaṇaṃ gaṇapraṇayine tiṣṭhenata kaḥ prajvala-- ddambolidyutimaṇḍalojjvalabhujastambāya jambhāraye|| iti murāriḥ| devadattāya śapate| śapathena kiñcitprakāśayatītyarthaḥ| jñīpsyamāna ityukterneha| devadatta| devadattaḥ ślāghate gārgikayā| ślāghate pathītyādau kartrādiviṣaye na saṃjñā| dhāreruttamarṇaḥ || 35 ||9 uttamarṇo dhanasvāmī| utkṛṣṭārthaparāducchabdāttamap| davyaprakarṣatvānnām| artteḥ ktaḥ| ``ṛṣamādhamarṇye ityatra vinimayani rūpakamātrasya vivakṣitatvāduttamarṇe'pi natvam| etannipātanādeva bahuvrīhau niṣṭhāntasyāpi paranipātaḥ| devadattāya śataṃ dhārayati| punardānamaṅgīkṛtya dravyagrahaṇaṃ dhāraṇam| ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāmārambhaḥ| uttamarṇaḥ kim| uktavākye grāme ityādiprayoge mā bhūt| naca paratvādeva siddhiḥ| uttamarṇe'pi hetusaṃjñāpatteḥ| spṛherīpsitaḥ || 36 || spṛha īpsāyām| curādiradantaḥ| asya prayoge īpsita uktasaṃjñaḥ syāt| puṣpebhyaḥ spṛhayati| īpsitatamatve tu paratvātkarmatvam| puṣpāṇi spṛhayati| śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyeva| kumārya iva kāntasya trasyanti spṛhayanti ca|| iti haradattādayaḥ| karmasaṃjñāyāḥ śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāśca bādhikeyaṃ saṃjñeti helārājaḥ| etatpakṣe uktaprayoge kāntāyeti vibhaktivipariṇāmaḥ| ``paraspareṇa spṛhaṇīyaśobham| ityatra dānīyo vipra itivatsaṃpradāne evānīyar iti kalpyam| krudhadruherṣyāsūyārthānāṃ yaṃ prati kopaḥ || 37 || krodhādyarthānāṃ dhātūnāṃ prayoge yaṃ prati kopastatkārakamuktasaṃjñam| devadattāya krudhyatītyādi| krodho roṣaḥ| droho'pakāraḥ| īrṣyā paraguṇāsahanam| asūyā paraguṇabidhvaṃsanam| yadyapyete vittadoṣā eveti vittadoṣārthānāmityeva vaktuṃ yuktaṃ tathāpi yo'smāndveṣṭītyādau dviṣeranabhinandanārthatvena krodhādyavṛttitvāttatrātiprasaṅgaḥ syāt| auṣadhaṃ dveṣṭītpādāvanabhinandane'pi dviṣeḥ prayogāt| yaṃ pratīti kim| bhāryāmirṣyati| parairdṛśyamānāṃ na sahate ityarthaḥ| krudhadruhorakarmakatvāttadyogeśeṣaṣaṣṭhyāṃ, itarayostu sakarmakatvāt dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyāmārambhaḥ| kudhadruhorupasṛṣṭayoḥ karma || 38 || sopasargayoranayoḥ pūrvoktaṃ karmasaṃjñam| pūrvāpavādaḥ| devadattamabhikrudhyati, abhidruhyati| rādhīkṣyoryasya vipraśnaḥ śaśa 39 || etayorvividhapraśnasambandhi kārakaṃ sampradānasaṃjñam| kṛṣṇāya rādhyati, īkṣate vā| pṛṣṭo gargaḥ śubhāśubhaṃ paryālocayatītyarthaḥ| śubhaśubharūpayoḥ karmaṇordhātvarthānatarbhāvādakarmakatvam| ṣaṣṭhīmāptau vacanam| rādhyatīti akarmakatvāt śyan| tathā ca divādyantargaṇasūtram| ``rādho'karmakādvṛddāveva iti| rādho'karmakādeva śyan, evakārasya bhinnakramatvāt| yathā bṛddhāviti| ata eva ``karmavatkarmaṇāiti sūtre rādhyatyodana iti bhāṣyam, sidhyatītyarthakatvāt| etenaitayoḥ karmakārakaṃ sampradānamiti pratyuktam| yasyetyanarthakaṃ, yaṃ pratītyanuvṛttyā siddheriti kecit| tanna| yaṃ pratītyasya yadviṣayārthakatvādan paryālocane śubhāśubhayoreva viṣayatvācchubhāśubhayośca nirviṣayakatvāt| śabdādhikāramāśrityārthāntarakalpane gauravāt| pratyāṅbhyāṃ śruvaḥ pūrvasya kartā || 40 || pratipūrva āṅpūrvaśca śruṇotirabhyupagamārthaḥ| tasya pūrvo vyāpāraḥ pravartanakriyā, tasyāḥ kartā sampradānam| viprāya gāṃ pratiśrṛṇoti āśrṛṇoti vā| vipreṇa mahyaṃ gāṃ dehīti pravartitaḥ pratijānīte ityarthaḥ| hetusaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vipreṇa pratiśrṛṇoti iti prayogavāraṇāya vacanam| vivakṣābhedena devadatto gāṃ pratiśrāvayatīte kecit| evaṃ devadatto rocayati modakamityapi syāt| naceṣṭāpattiḥ| tatratyasvaparagranthavirodhāt| hetutvabādhāṇṇijabhāvasya prakṛte'pi tulyatvādityanye| anupratigṛṇaśca || 41 || anu prati ityanyatarasmād parasya gṛṇāteḥ prāyuktaṃ kārakaṃ tathā| gṛṇā iti śnātasyānukaraṇam| anumatibhyāṃ gṛṇā iti samāsaḥ| āto dhāterityākāralopaḥ| kecittu anupratiti bhinnaṃ padam| prakṛtivaditi avyayatvātsulopa ityāhuḥ|| śaṃsituḥ protsāhanaṃ tadarthaḥ| purvo vyāpāraḥ śaṃsanam| hotre anugṛṇāti, pratigṛṇāti vā| hotā prathamaṃ śasati tamadhvaryuḥ ``ādyāmo devāityādibhiḥ śabdaiḥ protsāhayatītyarthaḥ| sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam || 42 || kriyāyāṃ prakṛṣṭopakārakaṃ kārakaṃ karaṇasaṃjñam| naca kārakādhi kārādeva labdhasya sādhakatvasya punaḥśrutyaiva prakarṣārthasiddhyā kiṃ tamapeti vācyam| sāmarthyāt prakrṣo'na prakaraṇe na gṛhyate ityasya jñāpyatvāt| tena gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādi siddham| tīraniṣṭhādāratvasya pravāhe uvacārāt| gaṅgāpadasya tīralakṣakatve tu nedaṃ prayojanam| rāmeṇa bāṇena hato vālī| atra prāñcaḥ kārakāntare'caritārthatve sati kriyānimittatvaṃ karaṇatvam| kārakāntaraniṣṭhavyāpāradvārā kriyāhetutvābhāvo viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| kartṛkarmaṇoḥ karaṇaniṣṭhavyāpāradvārā kriyāhetutvānna vyabhicāraḥ| adhikaraṇasyāpi kartṛkarmānyataravyāpāradvārā tathātvam| caitro gehe sthālyāmodanaṃ pacatītyādau gṛhasya kartūvyāpāradvārā, stālyāḥ karmavyāpāradvārā upayogāt| sampradānasyāpyanumatiprakāśanadvārā, karturicchotpādanadvārā vā, apādānasya patanapratibandhakasaṃyoganāśakavibhāgadvārā tathātvam| naca kuṭhārādisaṃyogasyāpi kartṛkarmavyāpāre caritārthatvādavyāptiḥ| caramakāraṇasyaiva lakṣyatvāt| ata eva phalāyogavyavacchinnaṃ kāraṇaṃ karaṇamityāhuḥ| anye tu vyāpāravattve sati kāraṇatvaṃ karaṇatvam| na ca kāryamātre jñānādau cā'dṛṣṭasya manoyogasya ca vyāpāratvādātmanaḥ karaṇatvāpattiḥ, 'ṣṭatvāt| ata eva ``ātmānamātmanāvetsiityādiprayogāḥ| kartṛtvakaraṇatvopādhibhedenaikasyobhayātmakatve'pyadoṣāt| śrāvaṇapratyakṣe śrotramanaḥsaṃyogo vyāpāro, na śabdaḥ| śabdātyantābhāvapratyakṣe vyabhicārāt| cākṣuṣādau cakṣurādestatsaṃyogaḥ, anumitau vyāptijñānasya parāmarśo vyāpāra ityāhuḥ| anye tu kartṛvyāpāraviṣayatvaṃ karaṇatvaṃ| tacca phalānukūlakarttṛvyāpāravattvam| asti hi kuṭhārādau chidānukūlakarttṛniṣṭhasaṃyogādimattvam| na cā'dhikaraṇasyā'pi karttṛniṣṭhavyāpāraviṣayavādvyabhicāraḥ, tatkaraṇatvasyeṣṭatvāt| sthālyā'nnaṃ sāvayatītyādiprayogāt| taduktam-- kriyāyāḥ pariniṣpattiryadvyāpārādanantaram| vivakṣyate yadā tatra karaṇaṃ tattadā smṛtam|| vastutastadanirdeśyaṃ na hi vastu vyavasthitam| sthālyā pacyata ityeṣā vivakṣā dṛśyate yataḥ|| etena gavā dānaṃ sādhayati, brāhmaṇena sādhayatītyādivyākhyātam| caitra ātmanā caitra ātmanā caitreṇa vā pacatītyaprayogādantyāvayavi sat yadavacchedakatayā kṛtimattadbhinnatvena vyāpāravān viśeṣyaḥ| antyāvayavītyupādānāddhastena pacatītyādesaṃgrahaḥ| idaṃ ca karaṇatvaṃ nā'numānādisādhāraṇamiti tatra bhinnameva tat| karaṇaśabdaśca nānārtha ityāhuḥ| divaḥ karma ca || 43 || dīvyateḥ sādhakatamaṃ karmasaṃjñam| cātkaraṇasaṃjñam| karaṇaśabdānuvṛttervakṣyamāṇānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇākarṣaṇena vā paryāyalābhātsamāveśārthaścakāraḥ| tatphalaṃ tu ākaḍārāditi sūtre vyākhyātam| parikrayaṇe sampradānamanyatarasyām || 44 || samayaviśeṣāvacchedena vetanādinā svīkaraṇaṃ parikrayaṇaṃ, tasmin sādhakatamaṃ sampradānasaṃjñaṃ vā| śatāya śatena vā parikrītaḥ| ādhāro'dikāraṇam || 45 || ādhriyate kriyā'nenetyādhāraḥ| adhyāyanyāyetyādinā karaṇe ghañ| kriyādhāratbaṃ kartṛkarmaṇordhāraṇāt| sākṣātkriyāśrayayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇoḥ parābhyāṃ kartṛkarmasaṃjñābhyāṃ bādhāt| kartṛkarmānyataravyavadhānena kriyāśrayaḥ kārakamadhikaraṇasaṃjñam| tadāha hariḥ-- kartṛkarmavyavahitāmasākṣāddhārayat kriyām| upakurvatkiyāsiddhau śāstre'dhikaraṇaṃ smṛtam|| kaṭe āste, sthālyāṃ pacati| nanvevamagnau pacatītyādiprayogānupapattiḥ| kartṛkarmānyataradvārakasya kriyāvattvasya virahāt| nacāyaṃ prayogo nāstyeveti kalpyam| yasminnagnau pacedannaṃ tasmin homo vidhīyate| ityādismārtaprayogadarśanāt| nāpi agnyādipadasya sthālyādilakṣaṇayā uktānyataradvārakatvasambhava iti keṣāṃcit kalpanaṃ yuktaṃ, yacchabdasyāpi tatparatvāpattyā tasmin homo vidhīyate ityasyānanvitatvaprasaṅgāt iti cetsatyam| chāndasatvena tadupapatteḥ| nanvadhikaraṇatvaṃ na dharmasambandhitvaṃ saṃyogāderdviṣṭhatayā badarādeḥ kuṇḍādinirūpitādhāratvāpatteḥ| naca svadharmasambandhastat, kuṇḍādikaṃ ca na badarādidharma iti vācyam| dharmatvasyādheyatārūpatayā tasya ca svaniṣṭhādhikaraṇatānirūpakatvarūpatayā'nyonyāśrayaprasaṅgāt| nacotpattisthitijñaptīnāmanyatamāpekṣaṇīyamadhikaraṇaṃ, samavāyikāraṇaṃ ghaṭādeḥ, bhūtalādi jātyādeḥ samavāyi samavāyādeḥ, svarūpasambandhi ceti kramādudāharaṇamiti vācyam| apekṣaṇīyapadena kāraṇoktau asamavāyyādāvativyāpteḥ| ghaṭatvādijñapterghaṭādau samavāyitvānupapatteśca| atra prāñcaḥ| tadbhinnatve sati tatpatanapratibandhakasaṃyogavanmūrtatvaṃ tadadhikaraṇatvam| brahmāṇḍādhārakasaṃyogāśrayeśvaravāraṇāya mūrteti| jātiguṇādināṃ tatsamavāyitvameva tat| samavāyādestatsvarūpasambandhitvamiti nānaivādhikaraṇatvamityāhuḥ| navyāstu evamananugamātsaptamyā nānārthatvāpattyā'tiriktamevādhikaraṇatvam| nacādheyatvamevātiriktaṃ, tannirūpakatvaṃ cādhāratvamiti vācyam| vinigamakābhāvāt| ato dvayamapyatiriktamityāhuḥ|| atra prācīnānusāriṇaḥ| tattatsaṃyogasamavāyādirevādhāratā| ādhāratātvaṃ cātiriktaṃ tatmādhāraṇamato nānanugamaḥ| daṇḍādhāra ityukte ādhāratātvena saṃyogagrahe'pi saṃyogatvena tadagrahād daṇḍasaṃyogī naveti saṃśayasambhavaḥ| saṃyogatvādyavacchinnaprakāratākadhiya eva tadvirodhitvādityāhuḥ| bhūtale ghaṭa ityādhāratvaṃ saptamyarthaḥ| tasya nirūpakatvasambandhena ghaṭe'nvayaḥ| bhūtalaniṣṭhādhikaraṇatvanirūpako ghaṭa iti bodhaḥ niṣṭhatvanirūpakatve saṃsargāviti tārkikaprāñcaḥ| navyāstu bhūtale na ghaṭa ityādau bodho na syāt, nirūpakatvasambandhasya vṛttyaniyāmakatvenābāvapratiyogitānavacchedakatayā nañarthānvayāsambhavāt| ata ādheyatvaṃ saptamyarthaḥ| tatra nirūpitatvasambandhena prakṛtyarthasyānvayaḥ saptamyarthasya cāśrayatvasambandhena ghaṭādāviti bhūtalanirūpitādheyatvāśrayo ghaṭa iti dhīrityāhuḥ| adhiśīṅstāsāṃ karma || 46 || adhipṛrvāṇāmeṣāmādhāraḥ karmasaṃjñaḥ syāt| adhiśete, adhitiṣṭhati, adhyāste vā vaikuṇṭhaṃ hariḥ| abhiniviśaśca || 47 || etatpūrvasya viśaterādhāraḥ prāgvat| grāmamabhiniviśate| abhiniveśa āgrahaḥ| tadāśrayatvātsvārthe'karmako'yam| tatrādhikaraṇasya karmasaṃjñāvidhirayam| pravośanārthatāyāṃ tasyāḥ siddhatvāt| parikrayaṇe sampradānamiti sūtrānmaṇḍūkaplutinyāyena vikalpānuvṛttau vyavastitavibhāṣātvasvīkārāt pāpe'bhiniviśate ityādau saptamī| ata eva samarthasūtre eṣvartheṣvabhiniviṣṭānāmiti bhāṣyam| upasargadvayasya yathoktānupūrvyāvacchinnatvena prayogaścāyam| neḥ paranipātakaraṇālliṅgāt| teneha na| niviśate yadi śūkaśikhā pade| karmatvavibakṣāyāṃ tu tatrāpi dvitīyaiva| upānvadhyāṅvasaḥ || 48 || upavasati, anuvasati, adhivasati, āvasati vā grāmaṃ senā| vaseraśyarthasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| arthaśadbo nivṛttivācī| vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| aśyarthasya bhojananiṣṭattervācako yo vasistasyetyarthaḥ| yadvā śiṅo'rthaḥ śyarthaḥ| na śyarthoṃ'śyarthaḥ| asthānārthasyetyarthaḥ| jalāśaya ityādau śeteḥ sthityarthatvadarśanāt| grāme upavasati| grāme
