tiṣṭhatītyarthe tu grāmamupavasatīti| upoṣya rajanīmekāmiti kālādhvanoriti dvitīyā| ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīteti kālikādhikaraṇatve saptamī| kārakavibhakterbalavattvāt| karturīpsitatamaṃ karma || 49 || kartṛniṣṭhā yā ātyantikī prāptīcchā tadviṣayaḥ kārakaṃ karmasaṃjñam| yadvyāpāravattvaprayuktaṃ kartṛtvaṃ tenaiva prāptumiṣṭamiti sannidhilabhyam, tena kriyājanyaphalaśālitvalābhaḥ| phalecchāyā upāyecchāvidhayā kriyecchājanakatvāt phalasyaivepsitatamatvāt| naca cautro grāmaṃ gacchatītyādau saṃyogaśālinaścaitrasyāpi karmatvāpattiḥ| parasamavetatvena kriyāyā viśeṣaṇāt| atra khaṇḍanakṛtaḥ| vṛkṣātparṇaṃ patatītyādāvapādāne'ti vyāptiḥ| parṇasamavetapatanakriyājanyavibhāgarūpaphalaśālitvāt| naceṣṭāpattiḥ| dvitīyāntatvāpatteḥ| naca ghaṭaḥ kriyate ityādau vyabhicāraḥ | ghaṭaṃ karotītyādau tasyāmeva kriyāyāṃ prayogāntare dvitīyāntatvasattvāt| naca karmatvena vivakṣāviṣayatve dvitīyāprayorajakaṃ natu karmatvamātram, yugapacca kārakāṇāṃ na vivakṣeti vācyam| karmatvasattve vivakṣāyā durvāratvāt| naca vaiyākaraṇasampadāyoniyāmaka iti vācyam| vastumātraṃ karmetyapi lakṣaṇaprasaṅgāt| atiprasaṅgasyoktarītyaiva supariharatvāt| nacāpādānānyatvamapi viśeṣaṇam| nadī bardhate ityādāvakyavopacayarūpāyā vṛddheḥ aprāptatīrabhāgena saṃyogavibhāgau phale iti tacchālini tīre'tivyāpteḥ tathāca vṛdherasaṃyogasyaiva kriyānāśakatvāt, grāmādeśca gantṛsamavetagamanavināśahetusaṃyogaśālitvānnātivyāptirapīti vācyam| vṛddhiphalasaṃyogasya kriyānāśakatvārttārādāvativyāptitādavasthyāt| evamātmānaṃ jānātītyādāvavyāptiriti| atrāhuḥ| kriyāphalaṃ kenaciddhātunā kartratiritiktaniṣṭhatvena pratipādyate| kena cicca na tathā, yadvā kartṛniṣṭhatvena pratipādyate| athavā kasya ciddhātoḥ kartratiriktaniṣṭhatvena phalapratiprattau tārparyaṃ| kasya cittu na tathā, yadvā kartṛniṣṭhatvena phalapratipattau tātparyam| tatra kriyāśrayātiriktaniṣṭhatayā dhātupratipādyaphalaśāli karma| naca vṛkṣatīrayostathātvam| uccāraṇaviśeṣe vibhāgarūpaphalasya patatyarthatvābhāvāt| adhaḥ saṃyogasya tadarthatvāt| vardhatinā ca kartratiriktaniṣṭhatvena kasyāpyanabhidhānāt| nacātmānaṃ jānātītyatrāvyāptiḥ| parasamavetakriyāphalaśālitvena kriyāśrayātiriktavṛtti yat kriyāphalaṃ tajjātīyaphalāśrayatvasya vivakṣitatvāt| ghaṭādivṛttivyavahārasajātīyasya vyavahārāderātmanyapyupapatteḥ| yadvā''tganaḥ paratvābhāve phalānāśrayatve'pi ca kriyāśrayātiriktaniṣṭhatvena phalasya dhātunā'nucyamānatvānna doṣa iti| naiyāyikāstu dhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalaśālitvaṃ tat| saṃyogāvacchinnakriyā gamerthaḥ| vibhāgāvacchinnā tyajeḥ| adhaḥsaṃyogāvacchinnā pateḥ| spandamātrasya tadarthatve paryāyatvaprasaṅgāt| tathāca gamanapatanajanyavibhāgamādāya pūrvadeśe, saṃyogamādāya tyajeruttaradeśe karmatvānāpattiḥ| spandervṛvadhātośca vyāpāramātravācakatayā dhātvarthatāvacchedakatvasya saṃyoge virahānna pūrvaparadeśayostīrasya ca tathātvaprasaṅgaḥ| phalāvacchinnavyāpāravācitvādeva dhātūnāṃ mukhyaṃ sakarmakatvam| jānātyādīnāṃ tu nāmārthānvitoddeśyatvātiriktaviṣayatvarūpavibhaktyarthānvayyarthakatvarūpagauṇaṃ tat| ghaṭaṃ jānātītyādito ghaṭaviṣayatāśālijñānāśraya iti bodhāt| ubhayasādhāraṇasakarmakadhātuyoga eva karmapratyayāḥ ata eva paterna sakarmakatvam| nāmārthānvitasya caturthyarthoddeśyatvasyaiva yatre'nvayāt| abhuñjāne'pi bhojanāya yatate iti prayogāt| parasamavetakriyājanyatvamapi phale niveśyam| bhūrmi prayāti vihago, vijahāti mahīruhaṃ, na tu svātmānamiti prayogāt| saṃyogavibhāgayoruktadhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalatvena tacchālinaḥ| svasya karmatvaprasaṅgāt| naca mallo mallaṃ gacchatītyādau ubhayakarmajasaṃyogasya tādṛśatvāt svasmin svakartṛkakriyākarmatvavyavahārāpattiḥ| parasamavetakriyājanyaphalaśālitvaṃ yatra tattatkriyākarmeti svīkārāt| itthaṃ ca dvitīyādeḥ kriyānvitaṃ parasamavetatvamarthaḥ| paratvaṃ ca supā svaprakṛtyarthāpekṣayā pratyāyyate| karmākhyātena tu svārthaphalānvayyapekṣayeti viśeṣaḥ| tathāca bhūrmi prayāti ityāderbhūmibhinna samaveto bhūmivṛttisaṃyogajanako yaḥ spandastadanukūlakṛtimānitidhīḥ| ataḥ svabhinnasamavetaṃ svavṛttisaṃyogajanakaṃ yanmallāntaravṛtti gamanaṃ tadanukūlakṛteḥ svasminnabhāvānna mallaḥ svaṃ gacchatītyādiḥ prayogaḥ| atra ca dvitīyādyarthaphale yadvyakteranvayastadvyaktitvāvacchinnapratiyogitāsambandhena grāmādeḥ paratve'nvayaḥ| tena pṛthivī prayātītyādau pṛthivītvāvacchinnapratiyogitākabhedasya vihāgādāvasattve'pi na kṣatiḥ na vā svātmanyapyubhayabhedasattvāt svaṃ prayātītyādiprayogāpattirityāhuḥ| anye tu pṛthivyādipadaṃ tattatpṛthivyādivyaktau lākṣaṇikam| anvayitāvacchedakāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvavyutpattyanurodhādityāhuḥ| kecittu kriyānvitaṃ anyonyābhāvapratiyogitāvacchedakatvaṃ dvitīyārtho na parasamavetatvaṃ| tatasca bhumivṛttisaṃyogajanasaṃ bhūminiṣṭhānyonyābhāvapratiyogitācchedakaṃ ca yat prayāṇaṃ tadanukūlakṛtimāniti dhīḥ| svaniṣṭhakriyāyāḥ svaniṣṭhānyonyābhāvapratiyogitāvacchedakatvavirahānna svaṃ prayātītyāpattirityāhuḥ| evaṃ sati yena mallena mallāntaraṃ na gataṃ tasmin mallo mallaṃ gacchatīti prayogaḥ syāt| mallāntariniṣṭhānyonyābhāvapratiyogitāvacchedikāyāstanmallakriyāyāstanmallabhūmivṛttisaṃyogajanakatvāt| phalānvayimallavyaktereva pratiyogitayā bhedānvaya ityuktau tu tadvyaktitvādeḥ prakāratve śaktyānantyam| saṃsargatvakalpanāpekṣayā tu parasamavetatvameva samyak| anyonyābhāvasyāvyāpyavṛttitve'pyakṣaterityapare| atha pateradhaḥsaṃyogāvacchinnaspandārthatayoktasaṃyogaśālino bhūtalādeḥ karmatvāpattau vṛkṣātparṇaṃ bhūtalaṃ patatīti prayogāpattiriti cenna| tathā vivakṣāyāmiṣṭatvāt| ata eva dvitīyā''śritātītapatitetyādisūtreṇa patitayoge dvitīyasamāsavidhiḥ saṃgacchate| anye tvāhuḥ sakarmakākarmakatvavyavasthā na vyāpārasvarūpe kiṃtvavacchedakaphalaviśeṣānādāya śabdaviśeṣe| tathāhi-dhātunā vyāpārāvacchedakatvena phale'bhihite pratiyogyākāṅkṣāyāṃ sannihito dvitīyāntasyaivārthastattvenānvīyate iti grāmaṃ gacchatītyatra grāmapratiyogikasaṃyogajanakavyāpāro vākyārthaḥ| patidhātvarthāvacchedakasaṃyoge ca na pratiyogitvena vṛkṣo'nveti, ayogyatvāt| na bhūtalaṃ, adhaḥ saṃyogāvacchinnavyāpāravācinā dhātunā pratiyogiviśeṣitasyaiva phalasyopasthāpanena pratiyoginirākāṅkṣatvāditi na dvitīyānirdeśaḥ| evaṃ vardhate ityādāvapyūhyam| evacca kaṭaṃ karotītyādau kṛdhātvārthāvacchedakotpattirūpaphalabhāgitvātkaṭādermukhyameva karmatvamiti| kecittu patinā kartṛmātraniṣṭhatvenādhaḥsaṃyogātmakaphalopanayādakarmakatvam| gamyādīnāṃ tu grāmaniṣṭhatvena tadupanayātsakarmakatvamityāhuḥ| etanmate saṃyogāvacchinnavyāpāre lakṣaṇāmaṅgīkṛtya dvitīyāsamāsavidhānaṃ samādheyam| kecittu patiḥ sakarmaka eva kintu gurutvajanyavijātiyakriyaiva tadarthaḥ| tatsamabhivyāhṛtadvitīyāyāstvadhaḥsaṃyogālakṣaṇaṃ karmatvam| evaṃ tyajigamyāderapi vyāpāra evārtho na tu phalāvacchinno gauravāt| dvitīyādistu tatsamabhivyāhārarūpatātparyagrāhakavaśādvibhāsaṃyogādiparaḥ| ato grāmaṃ tyajati gacchati ityetayorna paryāyatvam| tyajervibhāgāvaccinnaspandaśābdatvaṃ, gameḥ saṃyogāvacchinnaspandaśābdatvaṃ kāryatābacchedakamiti svīkārāt| gamanaṃ tyāga itvatrāpi spandaviśeṣaṇakavibāgādiviśeṣyakaśābdānupapattiḥ| vibhāgasaṃyogānyataraspandobhayavaiśiṣṭyāvagāhiśābdanupapattiḥ| vibhāgasaṃyogānyataraspandobhayavaiśiśṭyāvagāhiśābdatvasyaiva vibakṣitatvāt| vibhāgādiviśeṣaṇakaspandaviśeṣyakatvaspandaviśeṣaṇakavibhāgādiviśeṣyakatvetyubhayasya saṃgrāhāt| sakarmakatvavyavahārastvananugatatattannimittakaḥ| parasamavetatattaddhātvarthānvitaphalaśālitvaṃ tattaddhātvarthakarmatvam| tena pūrvadeśādergamyārdauna karmatvamiti vadanti| tannetyapare| kriyānimittatvaṃ vinā karmaṇo'pādanasya ca kārakatvāyogāt| juhotestu devatoddeśyako'gniprakṣepo'rthaḥ| sa cāgnisaṃyogānukūlakripānukūlo ghṛtādiniṣṭhī nodanādivyāpāraḥ| na cāgnau juhotītyādau saptamyarthasyānvaye nirākāṅkṣatvam| saṃyojānukūlakriyānukūlavyāpārasyaiva dhātvarthatvāt| ataḥ kriyāyā dhātvarthatāvacchedakatayā tadvato ghṛtādereva karmatvaṃ na tu saṃyogavato'gneḥ| saṃyogasya dhātbarthatāvacchedakatāvacchedakatayā dhātvarthatānavacchedakatvāt| dhātvarthe sākṣātprakārasyaiva dhātvarthatāvacchedakatvāt| tathā ca ghṛtavṛttyagnisaṃyogāvacchinnakriyānukūlavyāpārānukūlakṛtimāniti dhīḥ| mūlyadānaṃ vinā svasvatvadhvaṃsaparasvatvajanakastyāgo dānam| devatoddeśyakasvasvatvadhvaṃsaphalakasyāgo yāgaḥ| mūlyagrahaṇaprayuktasvasvatvadhvaṃsaparasvatvajanakastyāgo vikrayaḥ| mūlyagrahaṇaprayuktasvasvatvadhvaṃsvatvotpādakasvīkāraḥ krayaḥ| dattadravyasvatvajanakaḥsvīkāraḥ pratigrahaḥ| tathāca viprāya gāṃ dadāti, viṣṇuṃ yajate, gāṃ vikrīṇāti, krīṇāti, pratigṛṇhātītyādau mūlyagrahaṇaṃ vinā viproddeśyakagovṛttisvasvatvadhvaṃsaparasvatvajanakatyāgānukūlakṛtimān, viṣṇūddeśyakasvasvatvadhvaṃsajanakatyāgānukūlatyāgānukūlakṛtimān, govṛddimūlyadānaprayuktasvasvatvānukūlasvīkārānukūlakṛtimān, govṛttidattadravyasvatvajanakasvīkārānukūlakṛtimāniti dhīḥ| viṣṇoruddeśyatāsambandhena svasvatvadhvaṃsarūpaphalavattvena karmatvamiti prāñcaḥ| navyāstu dānasya parasvatvajanakatve tata eva vikrayādivāraṇe mūlyagrahaṇeti vyartham| yadi tu svīkāraviśeṣātmakatayā pratigrahasyaiva svatvajanakatvāt, aupādānikasvatvasthale svīkārasya taddhetutāyāḥ klṛptatvāt, anyatā pratigrahavaiyarthyam| ``ijyādhyāpanapratigrahairbrāhmaṇo dhanamarjayetiti smṛtivirodhaśca| svasvatvadhvaṃsamātrajanakaṃ dānaṃ tu parasvatvamayojakamityucyate| tathāpi vaiyarthyatādavasthyaṃ tathāpyupekṣāyāmativyāptiśca| tasyā apa svasvatvadhvaṃsadvārā parasvatvaprayojakatvāt| kiñca dūrasthapātroddeśenatyaktasya pratigrahātprāgasvāmikasya dravyasyānuddeśyena puruṣeṇa pratigrahātsvatvaṃ syāt| anyoddeśyakatyāgasya tadvirodhitve gauravam| vaiyarthyatādavasthyaṃ| tathāpyupekṣāyāmativyāptiśca| tasyā api svasvatvadhvaṃsadvārā parasvatvaprayojakatvāt| kiñca dūrasthapātroddeśena tyaktasya pratigrahātprāgasvāmikasya dravyasyānuddeśyena puruṣeṇa pratigrahātsvatvaṃ syāt| anyoddeśyakatyāgasya tadvirodhitve gauravam| na ca saṃpradānasyānumatiprakāśanadvārā dānahetutvādasampradānakatyāgo dānābhāsa eveti vācyam| tīrthasaṅkalpitadravyaṃ yadanyatra pradīyate| dātā tatphalamāpnoti pratigrāhī na doṣabhāk|| manasā pātramuddiśya bhūmau toyaṃ viniḥkṣipet| vidyate sāgarasyānto dānasyānto na vidyate|| dravyapātravikarṣaścetparokṣaṃ dātumudyataḥ| taṃ dhyāyedvaibhavaṃ pātraṃ dravyamādityadaivatam|| parokṣe kalpitaṃ dānaṃ pātrābhāve kathaṃ bhavet| gotrajebhyastathā dadyāt tadabhāve svabandhuṣu|| ityādi nāradīyaṣaṭ‌triśanmatādismṛtivirodhāpatteḥ| evaṃ svasvatvadhvaṃsajanaketyapi vyartham| avyāvartakatvāt| agniprekṣepo homa ityapyayuktam| devatoddeśyakasvasvatvadhvaṃsajanakatyāgo yāgaḥ| sa eva prakṣepāvacchinno homa iti vācaspati miśrokteḥ| yāga eva viśiṣṭadeśaprakṣepopahito homa evaṃ vivekokteśca| asti ca ṛtvijāṃ tyāgādyajamānasvatvadhvaṃsaḥ| anumatadāsatyāgaviśeṣātsvamitvadhvaṃsavat| vastuto dānatvayāgatvahomatvādayo mānasapratyakṣagamyā jātiviśeṣāḥ| naca śrāddhasya pitropakṣayā yāgatvaṃ brāhmaṇāpekṣayā ca dānatvamiti vivekoktestatra sāṃkaryam| śrāddhasya gauṇatadubayarūpatvāt| viṣṇuṃ yajata ityādau dvitīyārtha uddeśyatvaṃ tacca tasyedamityāropajñānaviṣayatvam| devatācaitanyapakṣe tu devatāyāḥ svatvopagamāt dānatvavyāpyaṃ yāgatvaṃ, tadvyāpyaṃ homatvamiti bodyam. devapūjādikamapi yāga eva| ata evaṃ saṃsṛṣṭisthale'sādhāraṇasvatvanāśottaraṃ sādhāraṇasvatvotpādāttatra dānalakṣaṇasya nātivyāptiḥ| dānatvajātestatrānaṅgīkārāt| paramātrasvatvānukūlatvena viśeṣaṇānna tatheti kecit| satyeva pūrvasvatve tatra parasvatvoptattimātram| naca svatvavati kathaṃ parasvatvotpattiḥ| icchāyā uttejakatvādityanye| adṛṣṭajanakatvaviśeṣaṇārttannirāsa ityapare| miśrāstu devatoddeśyakadravyatyāgarūpaṃ yāgalakṣaṇaṃ devatāyai dāne'tivyāptam| tathāpi dāne devatāsvatvamuddeśyaṃ na tu yāge| ata eva pūjārūpayāgadravyaṃ gandhapuṣpādi sarvadeśīyāḥ śiṣṭā upayuñjate, na tu devatāyai dattaṃ gṛhālaṅkāraṇādikāmityāhuḥ| uddhārakṛtastu saṃpradānatvam| tadabhāve ca kathaṃ dānaṃ, tadvinā ca kathaṃ svatvaṃ, anyathā yāge'pi svatvotpattyāpatteḥ| nacānutpannameva svatvamuddeśyatvamātreṇa vyāvartakam| taduddeśyatve mānābhāvāt| naca dadātiprayogo mānam| śrāddhe'pi śrāddhaṃ dadyāditi bahuśaḥ prayogāt| naca śrāddhamapi dānam| sakalasaṃpradāyavirodhāt| devasvavyavahārasta uddeśyatāmātreṇa| gṛhālaṅkaraṇādīnāmanupayogaḥ| hṛdi rūpaṃ mukhe nāma naivedyamudare hareḥ| pādodakaṃ ca nirmālyaṃ mastake yasya so'cyutaḥ|| naca- api dīpāvalokaṃ me noyayuñjyānniveditam| iti bhagavadvacanavirodhaḥ| tasyāsādhāraṇasthāvaraviṣayatayā rāgaprāptabhojanaviṣayatayā vyavasthāpanāt| athavā'nyasmai niveditaṃ tasmai nopayujyānna nivedayet ityarthaḥ| pitranyadevatocchiṣṭaṃ viṣṇave yaḥ prayacchati| ityādinindāvalāt| vastuto dāne mantrābhāvānna devaddhādau mantraḥ, sa eva yāgo nānya iti| ataeva svīkāraḥ sa ṛtvikle dāne kāraṇaṃ, nānṛtvikle| atha evotsarge dadāidaṃ ca saptavidhamityuktaṃ vākyapadīye| nirvarttyaṃ ca vikāryaṃ ca prāpyaṃ ceti tridhā matam| taccopsitatamaṃ karma caturdhā'nyattu kalpitam|| audāsīnpena yatprāpyaṃ yacca karturanīpsitam| sajñāntarairanākhyātaṃ yadyaccāpyananyapūrvakam|| iti| ādyānāṃ trayāṇāṃ lakṣaṇamapyuktam| satī vā vidyamānā vā prakṛtiḥ pariṇāmini| yasya nāśrīyate tasya nirvarttyatvaṃ pracakṣate|| prakṛtestu vivakṣāyā vikāryaṃ kauścidanyathā| nirvarttya ca vikāryaṃ ca karma śāstre pradarśitam|| yadasajjāyate sadvā janmanā yatprakāśate| tatrirvarttya vikāryaṃ tu dvedhā karma vyavasthitam|| kiñcid guṇāntarotpattyā suvarṇādevikāravat| darśanādanumānādvā tatprāpyamiti kathyate|| ayamarthaḥ| ghaṭaṃ karotītyatra satyapi ghaṭasya prakṛtirna pariṇāmitvena vivakṣiteti nirvartyam| bhasma karotīttyatrāpi kāṣṭhādirupaprakṛteravidyamānāyā avivakṣāyāṃ, tathaivoktaprakṛteḥ pariṇāmitvavivakṣāyāṃ tu vikāryataiveti kecit| saditi tu sāṃkhyādayaḥ| taduktaṃ tatraivaḥ| utpatteḥ prāmasadbhādo buddhyavasthānibandhanaḥ| aviśiṣṭaḥ satā'nyena kartrā bhavati janmanaḥ|| kāraṇaṃ kāryabhāvena yadā vā vyavatiṣṭhate| kāryaśabdaṃ tadā labdhvā kāryarūpeṇa jāyate|| yathā'heḥ kuṇḍalībhāvo vyagrāṇāṃ vā samagratā| tathaiva janyarūpatvaṃ satāmeke pracakṣate|| ādyaśloko'satkāryavāde ghaṭādīnāṃ kathaṃ janmakartṛtvamiti śaṅkāsamādhānārthaḥ| buddhikalpitasattāmādāya śabdaprayogopayuktaṃ kartṛtvam| tatra kāryāvyavahitaprākkāle vṛttitvasyānupayuktatvāt| kāraṇatvaṃ tu svasya svaṃ prati nāṅgīkriyate eva| yatroktāpekṣāsyāt| utpattāvapi ghaṭaprāgabhāvasyaiva nimittatvāt| satkāryavāde'pi vedāntādyabhimate yena rūpeṇotpattistadrūpeṇa pūrvamasattvāt, kāraṇarūpeṇa satvasya tvaprayojakatvāditi tadedaṃ tarhyavyākṛtamāsīditi vākyavyākhyāyāṃ tarkakautūhale vistaraḥ| antyadvayaṃ tu satkāryavādābhiprāyam ghaṭo nāśyatvamāpannaḥ, kaṭakameva mukuṭaṃ jātamityādipratītyā pūrvāvasthāyā uttarāvasthātādātmyānubhavāt pūrvottarāvasthayorabhedaḥ| bhinnakālīnayorapyanubhavasāmyāt pratīyogitvānuyogitvattādātmayasyāpi sambhavāt| idameva vedāntibhiḥ saṃskāraśabdenābhidhīyate| parantu mithyātvātsāṃkhyāpekṣayā viśeṣaḥ| prakṛtamanumarāmaḥ| vikāryaṃ dvedhā| prakṛtibhūtasyātmana ucchaṃde saṃbhūtaṃ prāptam| kāṣṭhaṃ bhasma karotīti| guṇāntarotpattyā suvarṇaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ karotīti| bhasmadaśāyāṃ na kāṣṭhatvapratyayaḥ, kuṇḍaladaśāyāṃ tu suvarṇatvamatyayo'stīti viśeṣaḥ| atra kāṣṭhasuvarṇayoḥ pariṇāmitvavivakṣāvivakṣayorapi bodhyam| naca kriyājanyaphalānāśrayaspakāṣṭhasya kathaṃ karmatvīmati vācyama| prakṛtivikṛtyernirūḍhayā'bhedavivakṣayā tathātvāt| kāṣṭhāni vikurvan bhasma karotītyarthādvā| taṇḍulān vikledayannodanaṃ nirvartayatītivat| vyutpāditaṃ cedaṃ paśyatīti| āvaraṇabhaṅgasya viṣayatvasya vā kriyākṛtaviśeṣasya pratipattṛgamyatve'pi tadatiriktāgamyatvam| audāsīnyena grāmaṃ gacchan tṛṇaṃ spṛśati| anīpsitaṃ viṣaṃ bhuṅ‌ke| saṃjñāntarairanākhyātamakathitaṃ gāṃ dogvi payaḥ| anyapūrvakaṃ saṃjñāntaraprasaṅge vihitakarmasaṃjñākam| krūrabhabhikrudhyatītyādi| naiyāyikāstu saṃyogādikriyāphalaśāli prāpyaṃ grāmadiyallabdhasattākamevāvasthāntaramāpadyate tadvikāryam| yathā prāgudāhṛtam| tatra hi kāṣṭhapadaṃ tadavayavaparam| tasya sata eva bhasmādibhavanarūpāvasthāntaraprāpteḥ| na ca kriyā yatkarmanāśakaṃ phalaṃ janayati tadvikāryam| kāṣṭhaṃ lunātītyatra kāṣṭhamiti vācyam| tatra lakṣaṇayā kāṣṭhāvayavasya karmatayā kriyāyāstannāśakatvābhāvāt| tatra hi kāṣṭhapadasya tadavayavaḥ, lunāterārambhakasaṃyogavirodhivibhāgahetukriyānukūlavyāpāro'rthe iti kāṣṭhāvayavṛttitādṛśavibhāgahetukriyānukūlavyāpārānukūlakṛtimāniti śābdāt kāṣṭhāvayavasya prāpyakarmataiva| avasthāntaraprāptyabhāvātā taṇḍūlaṃ pacatītyatra taṇḍulapadaṃ tadavayavalakṣakam| pacyartho rūpādiparāvṛttyavacchinnatejaḥsaṃyogaḥ| tena kriyājanyaphalaśālitvāt sato'vasthāntaragāpteścobhayavidhaṃ karmatvam| ghaṭaṃ karotītyādi nirvartyam| atra kṛñaḥ phalāvacchinnavyāpārabodhakatayā gauṇaṃ karmatvam| kriyānimittatvābhāvānna mukhyaṃ kārakatvamapi, kintu sādhyatvākhyakṛtiviśayatayā gauṇam| kṛñsamabhivyāhṛtadvitīyāderuktaviṣayataivārthaḥ| ata eva kapālaṃ karotīti na śaktyā prayogaḥ| upādāntvākhyaviṣayatāyā eva tatra sattvāt| prāñcastu ghaṭapadaṃ kapāle lākṣaṇikam| tena kriyājanyaghaṭātmakaphalaśālitvāt mukhyameva karmatvādi| śaktyā tu kapālaṃ karotīti na prayogaḥ kṛñsamabhivyāhṛtaghaṭādestadavayave nirūḍhalākṣaṇikatvādityāhuḥ| yattu kartṛkaraṇakarmādhikaraṇavibhaktīnāṃ āśraya evārthaḥ| phalāśrayaḥ karma, vyāpārāśrayaḥ kartā, kartṛkarmānyatarāśrayo'dhikaraṇam| tatra phalāderanyalabhyatayā āśrayamātramarthaḥ| tatvamevākhaṇḍaśaktirūpamavacchedakam| naca cautro grāmaṃ gacchatītyādau caitrāderapi karmatve dvitīyāpattiḥ| saṃjñāntaravirahaviśiṣṭakarmasaṃjñāyā eva dvitīyāprayojakatvāt| parayā kartṛsaṃjñayā karmasaṃjñāvādhāt| ekasaṃjñāvikāreṇa samāveśasyāpyasambhavāditi taccintyam| āśrayamātrasya vācyatve kartṛsaṃjñāparyavasānānupapattyā tasyāḥ karmasaṃjñābādhakatvānupapatteḥ| naca phalasyāśrayopariviśeṣaṇatvavivakṣāyāṃ karmasaṃjñā, vyāpārasya tathātve tu kartṛsaṃjñeti vācyam| phalāśrayatvādeḥ śābdabodhaviṣayatve'pi kartṛkarmānyatarāśrayatvasyādhikaraṇasthale śābdabodhāviṣayatvāt tatra niyāmakābhāvāt| tathāyuktaṃ cānīpsitam || 50 || īpsitatamavatkriyayā yuktamanīpsitamapi karmasaṃjñam| caurān paśyati| anīpsitānāmapi caurāṇāṃ cakṣuḥsaṃyogabalāddarśanaviṣayatvam| akathitaṃ ca || 51 || apādānadiviśeṣairavivakṣitaṃ kārakaṃ karmasaṃjñam| parigaṇanaṃ kartavyam| naṭasya śrṛṇotītyādāvatiprasaṅganivāraṇārtham| tathā ca bhāṣyam| duhiyācirudhiprachibhikṣiciñāmupayoganimittamapūrvavidhau| bruviśāsiguṇena ca yatsacate tadakīrtitamācaritaṃ kavinā|| nīvahyorharateścāpi gatyathīnāṃ tathaiva ca| dvikarmakeṣu grahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti niścayaḥ|| prachityatrānityamāgamaśāsanamiti tugabhāvaḥ| iko yaṇacisanādyantā dhātava ityādau nuḍādyabhāvavat| upayujyate ityupayogo mukhyaṃ karma kṣīraphalādi tasya nimittaṃ gavādi| gāṃ dogdhi paya ityatra hi payasa īpsitatamatvamupayujyamānatvānna tu goḥ| naca tathāyuktatvena siddhiḥ| tathāyuktatvābhāvāt| bruviśāsyorguṇena karmaṇā ca yatsacate sambadhyate, kriyāyāḥ sādhyatvātprādhānyaṃ, kārakāṇāṃ guṇatvam| ṣaca samavāye svaritet| parasmaipadeṣvevaitatpāṭhapakṣe ṣaca sevane ityasyānudātteto rūpam| dhātūnāmanekārthatvāt| kavinā krāntadarśinā medhāvinā''cāryeṇeti yāvat| akīrtitamakathitamityācaritaṃ vyavahṛtamityarthaḥ| apādānādyavivakṣāyāṃ caitadityāha-apūrvavidhāviti| pūrvoktānāmapādānādisaṃjñānamaviṣaye ityarthaḥ| nacaivaṃ vakṣyamāṇayorhetukartṛsaṃjñayorviṣaye'tiprasaṅgaḥ| pūrvatyanyamātrasyopalakṣaṇāt| nacākathitamiti niṣṭhārthabhūtatvasya vakṣyamāṇo bādhaḥ| tasyāvivakṣitatvāt| ata eva parājerasoḍha ityādau parājeṣyamāṇasyāpyapādānatvamiti sampradāyaḥ| paratvāddhetukartṛsaṃjñābhyāmetad‌bādhaḥ ekasaṃjñādhikārāditi navyāḥ| gatyarthanāmiti gatibuddhyādisūtropāttānāmupalakṣaṇam| cakāreṇa jayatyādisaṅagraha iti kaiyaṭaḥ| te ca mādhavenoktāḥ| jayateḥ karṣatermanthermuṣerdaṇḍayateḥ paceḥ| tārergrāhestathā mocestyājerdīpeśca saṅgrahaḥ|| kārikāyāṃ caśabdena sudhākaramukhaiḥ kṛtaḥ| atha bhikṣeḥ prathagupādānaṃ vyartham| duhādinirdeśasyārthaparatvāt| yācigrahaṇenaiva saṃgrahāt| nacārthaparatve mānābhāvaḥ| ahamapīdamacodyaṃ co dya iti tadrājasūtre bhāṣyanirdeśāt| pṛchiparyāyatayaiva cudordvikarmakatvasambhavāt| ata eva- ``śiloccayo'pi kṣitipālamuccaiḥ prītyā tamevārthamabhāṣateva-iti kālidāsādiprayogāḥ saṅgacchante| ata eva tyājerapi duhyarthatvādeva saṅgrahaḥ iti cedatrāhuḥ| anunayārtho'tra yāciḥ| avinītaṃ vinayāyānunayatīti pratyayāt| naca yācereva tarhi grahaṇamastviti vācyam| arthabhedācchabdabheda iti prārthanārthasya yācerihānupādānāt| pakṣāntare tu spaṣṭārthaṃ bhikṣigrahaṇamiti| udāharaṇāni| gāndogdhi payaḥ| pauravaṃ gāṃ yācate| avinītaṃ vinayaṃ yācate| anvavaruṇaddhi gāṃ vrajam| māmavakaṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchati| pauravaṃ gāṃ bhikṣate| vṛkṣamavacinoti phalāni| putraṃ brūte dharmaṃ, anuśāsti vā| ajāṃ nayati grāmam| vahati bhāraṃ grāmam, harati vā| rāmayati devadattaṃ grāmamityādi| śataṃ jayati devadattam| karṣati śākhāṃ grāmam| śataṃ daṇḍayati| taṇḍulānodanaṃ pacati| tārayati kapīn samudram| grāhayati baṭuṃ vedam| tyājayati kopaṃ devadattam| dīpayati śāstrārthaṃ śiṣyān| nacājāṃ gṛhītvā grāmaṃ nayatītyarthādaprayujyamānagrahaṇakriyāpekṣameva karmatvamiti vācyam| ajā nīyate grāmamityatra nayatyuttarakarmapratyayena grahaṇakarmaṇo'jāyā anabhidhānaprasaṅgāt| ``anyakarmeti ced brūyād lādīnāmavidhirbhaveiti bhāṣyokteḥ| iha graherdikarmakatvaṃ vahūnāmanabhimataṃ, uktasthale budhyarthatvādeva tatsaṃbhavāt| ata evavahūnāmanabhimataṃ, uktasthale budhyarthatvādeva tatsaṃbhavāt| ata eva- ``ajigrahattaṃ janako dhanustat| iti bhaṭṭiprayogaṃ anena bhagavatā tripuradāhaḥ kṛta iti bodhitavāt| ``ayācitāraṃ nahi devadevamadriḥ sutāṃ grāhayituṃ śaśāka iti kālidāmaprayogamudvāhyatvena bodhayitum| tamādau kulavidyānāmarthamarthavidāṃ varaḥ| paścātpārthivakanyānāṃ pāṇimagrāhayatpitā|| iti tatprayogaṃ ca uttarārdhe teneti vibhaktivipariṇāmena vyācakhyuḥ| ana eva| ``patad‌grahaṃ grāhitavānnalena saḥ iti śrīharṣaḥ| pacestu dvikarmakatvaṃ ``duhipacyorbahulaṃ sakarmakayoriti karmavatkarmaṇetisūtragatavārtikavyākhyāyāṃ kaiyaṭena sphuṭīkūtam| mādhavasyāpyatraivānumatiḥ| nanvetatkarmasaṃjñāsūtre dvyarthaḥ paciriti bhāṣyaviruddham| tatra hiviklittirutpattiśva phaladvayaṃ vyāpāraśca pacyarthaḥ| tathā ca viklittiśālinayā taṇḍulānāmutpattimattayā caudanasya karmatvam| tena taṇḍulānāmutpatteścānukūlo devadattaniṣṭho vyāpāra ityarthaḥ| taṇḍupāttāyāṃ pacatītyatra tu vikledayatītyarthaḥ| dhātutvena pacyupāttāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ pacitvarūpeṇa pacyupāttāyā viklitteḥ karmatayānvayāt| odanaṃ pacatīnirūpitam| dvikarmakatve tu uktaprayāsavaiyarthyaṃ syāt| maivam| matabhedābhiprāyatvāt| etenākathitaśabdo yadyapradhānārtho gṛhyeta tadā pāṇinā kāṃsyapātryāṃ dogdhi paya ityatra karaṇādhikaraṇayorapi karmasaṃjñā syāt| naca tayoranavakāśatvaṃ pacyādau sāvakāśatvāt| naca tatrāpi etatprasaṅgaḥ| duhyādiparigaṇanāditi haradattagrantho vyākhyātaḥ| yattu grāherdvikarmakatve jāyāpratigrāhitagandhamālyāmiti na sidhyet| jāyayā gandhamālyaṃ pratigrāhitaṃ yeti vigrahe bahuvrīherdurlabhatvāt| trikataḥ śeṣasya bhāṣye vakṣyamāṇatvāt| naca gandhamālye pratigrāhite yāmiti vigrahaḥ| dhenurūpaprayojyakarmaṇa eva ktenābhidhānāt| ``ṇyante kartuścakarmaṇaiti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| ata eva- ``bhūpālairvigataspṛhā āpa dhanaṃ viprāḥ pratigrāhitā iti prayogaḥ| pratigrāhite gandhamālye yayeti vigrahe tu nānupapattiḥ| uḍharatha ityādivat| nacāpādānādyavivakṣāyāmeva dvikarmakatvaṃ tadvivakṣāyāṃ tūktavigraho bhaviṣyatīti vācyam| harateśceti cakārasamuccitānāṃ jayatyādīnāmakathitasūtraviṣayatve'pi tathaiva ceti samuccitānāmaṇau karturṇau karmatābhyupagamāt gatyarthaiḥ sāhacaryāt| ata eva tāryādayaḥ pṛthageva saṃgṛhītāḥ| grahaṇakartṛtvāvivakṣāyāṃ prayojakasya hetutvābhāve ṇico durlabhatvācca| naca dīpigrahaṇavaiyarthyam| akarmakatvādgatibuddhīti sūtreṇaiva siddheriti vācyam| ṇyantāṇṇici tatsārthakyāditi taccinyam| bharatastatra gandharvān yudhi nirjitya kevalam| ātodyaṃ grāhayāmāsa samatyājayadāyudham| pratigrāhitaśabdasya bodhitārthatvamaṅgīkṛtya svecchayā'nyatarakarmaṇi pratyayotpattyā jāyayā bodhite gandhamālye yāmiti vigrahe tadupapatteḥ| yadvā pratigrāhitaśabde bhāve ktaḥ| jāyāyā iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| arśa āditvādac| jāyāniṣṭho yaḥ dhenukartṛkasvīkaraṇaprayojako vyāpārastadviśiṣṭe gandhamālye yasyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| vaiśiṣṭyaṃ cedaṃ dhenorbhavatvitīcchaviṣayatvam| etena| ``svakrīḍāhaṃsamohagrahilaśiśubhṛśaprārthitonnidracandra iti naiṣadhaṃ vyākhyātam| śiśuniṣṭhaṃ utkaṇṭhaṃ yatprārthanaṃ tadviṣayībhūta unnidracandro yasyā iti tadarthāt| etenāpradhānakarmaṇaḥ ktenābhidānāt, ``kākapakṣadharametya yācitaitivat śiśunā unnadracandraṃ prārthitetyatra vahubrīhidaurlabhyāttaccintyamiti nirastam| idamihāvadheyam| vibhāgānukūlakiyānukūlavyāpāro duheḥ, saṃyogānukūlakriyānukūlavyāpāraśca nayaterarthaḥ| vibhāge gāmityasya, kriyāyāṃ paya ityasyānvayaḥ| govṛttivibhāgānukūlā yā payovṛttiḥ kriyā tadanukūlavyāpārasya stanaviṣpīḍanādeḥ, grāmavṛttisaṃyogānukūlā yā'jāvṛttiḥ kriyā tadanukūlavyāpārasya ca bodhaḥ| sākṣāddhātvarthatāvacchedakayathoktakriyāśālinorajāpayasoḥ karmatvam| dhātvarthatāvacchekatāvacchedakavibhāgasaṃyogarūpaphalānvitayostu gogrāmayostadabhāvādanena karmasaṃjñāvidhānam| ata eva dvyarthaḥ paciriti bhāṣyeṇa viklittirūpaphalānvayitvena taṇḍulānāṃ, utpattirūpaphalānvayitvena caudanasyeti dvikarmakatvamupapāditam| ata eva pacerapi cakāreṇa saṅgrahastatsaṃmataḥ| etena pacerdvikarmakatve tadbhāṣyavirodhaśaṅkā nirastā| yadā tu vibhāgācadhitvaṃ gorvivakṣyate, tadā goḥ payo dogdhītyapādānatvam| gavāvadhikavibhāgānukūlapayovṛttikriyetyādibodhāt| payaḥsambandhitvavivakṣāyāṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyeva, gosambandhi yatpayastanniṣṭhavibhāganulakriyānukūlavyāpārasya bodhāt| sa ca vibhāgo gavāvadhika eva tātparyavaśātpratīyate| idamapyavadheyam| lakṛtyaktakhalarthā dvikarmakebhyo mukhye gauṇe vā karmaṇīti vivavakṣāyāṃ vyāvasthāmāha bhāṣyakāraḥ| pradhānakarmaṇyākhyeye lādīnāhurdvikarmaṇām| apradhāne duhādīnāṃ ṇyante kartuśca karmaṇaḥ|| dvikarmapadenātra nīvahyorharateścaiveti trayaścakārasamuccitaḥ kṛṣiśca gṛhyate| duhādipadena kārikopāttāścakārasamuccitānāṃ madhye'hetumaṇṇyantā jidaṇḍyādayaśca gṛhyante| ṇyantapadena tu gatyādisūtropāttāścaśabdasamuccitāstāryādayaśca| tatra hyaṇau kartāṇau karma, tasyābhidhāne lādaya ityarthaḥ| tatrāpi buddhipratyavasānārthaśadbakarmakeṣu guṇakarmaṇīti matāntaraṃ yadbhāṣyam- kathite'bhihitetvavidhistvamatirguṇakarmaṇi lādividhiḥsaparedhruvacoṣṭitayuktiṣu cāpyaguṇe tadanalpamatervacanaṃ smarateti|| atrādyacaraṇaḥ| pradhānakarmaṇi lādibhirabhihite guṇakarmaṇi ṣaṣṭhītyekīyamatadūṣaṇaparaḥ| taddhi prāguktam| kathite lādayaścetsyuḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ kuryāttadā guṇe| kārakaṃ cedvijānīyādyāṃ yāṃ manyeta sā bhavet|| duhyate gauḥ payaḥ, yācyate pauravātkambala iti pūrvārdhodāharaṇam| kārakatvavivakṣāyāṃ tu yathāsvaṃ vibhaktayaḥ| duhyate goḥ payaḥ, yācyate pauravātkambala iti| tathā ca kathiteti pradhānakarmaparam| tasminnabhihite tvasyā dvitīyāpekṣayā bhinnāyāṛ ṣaṣṭhyā vidhiriti| tvasyānyācāryadeśīyasya matirnatvācārthasya| apradhānakarmaṇi dvitīyādarśanādityarthaḥ| nyāyyaṃ pakṣamāha| guṇakarmaṇīti| sapare ityatra paraśabdo gatyādimūtraparaḥ| tatsahite duhādau guṇakarmaṇi lādayaḥ| dohādipravṛtteḥ payaādyarthatvādgavādīnāmaprādhānyam| tatra pratyayotpattistu dugdhādyarthinaḥ prathamaṃ gavādāveva pravṛtteḥ| taduktam- guṇakarmaṇi lādividhi pūrvaṃ guṇakarmaṇā bhavati yogāt| mukhyaṃ karmaprepsuryasmād dravye'vayatate prāk|| tasmācchuddhasya duherbhavati gavā pūrvameva sambandhaḥ|| gorduhinā payasastu prāk tasmāllādayastasmin| iti| gaurduhyate payaḥ, dogdhavyā, dugdhā, sudohā vetyādi| ṇyante tu prayojakavyāpārasya śābdaṃ prādhānyam| ṇyarthatayā tasya viśeṣyatāpannatvāt| prayojyavyāpārasya tvārtham| prayojakavyāpārasya tadarthatvāt, atastatkarmaṇorapi tathātvam| ata ubhayatrāpi paryāyeṇa pratyayaḥ| bodhyate māṇavakaṃ dharmaḥ, māṇavako dharmamiti vā| dhṛvayuktayo'karmakāḥ| pūrvācāryasaṅketāt| ceṣṭitayuktayo gatyarthāḥ| eṣvaguṇe prayojye karmaṇi lādayaḥ| devadatto grāmaṃ gamyate, gamayitavyaḥ, gamitaḥ, sugama ityādi| analpamaterācāryasya| tad‌ dvitīyatṛtīyacaraṇopanyastam| smaratetyāgamāvicchedoktiḥ svakalpitatvanirāsārthā| na ca buddhipratyavāsānārthaśabdakarmakeṣu guṇakarmaṇyeva lādiprasaṅgaḥ, ṇyante kartuścetyasya paratvātsapara ityanena bādhāditi vācyam| apara āheti prāyeṇa matāntarapratipattyā tatrāpi vikalpasiddheḥ| tadayaṃ saṃgrahaḥ| mukhye hṛnīvahakṛṣāṃ tu guṇe duhādervāśabdakarmakasabuddhyaśanārthakānām| ṇyantāntarasya kila karmaṇi tu prayojya saṃpratyayaṃ dadhati laktakhalarthakṛtyāḥ|| atha kṛdyoge karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī dvikarmakebhyaḥ kutra karmaṇi syādidi cet? atra bhāṣyam| ubhayathā goṇikāputra iti| netā'śvasya srughnaṃ srughnasya vā| atra hyekena śabdena bhinnakakṣayorguṇapradhānayoḥ karmaṇorabhidhānānupapattyā pradhānakarmaṇo'bhidhānaṃ nyāyyam| ṣaṣṭhī tu pṛthageva guṇapradhānābhyāṃ dvitīyāvadvidhīyate iti ovarodhādubhābhyāṃ prāptā pradhāne nityā bhāṣyamāmāṇyāyādguṇakarmaṇi vaikalpikī| ``kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām|| deśaścākarmakāṇām iti vaktavyam| gantavyo'dhyā'dhvagantavyaḥ| nipātanādviseṣaṇasyāpi paranipātaḥ| na ca gantavyapadavaiyarthyam| gantavyatayā loke prasiddhasya niyataparimāṇamya krośayojanādereva grahaṇārthatvāt| māsamāste, godohamāste godohaparyāptakālamabhivyāpya tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ| krośamāste| kurūn svapiti| na ca kālādhvanoriti dvitīyāsiddheḥ karmasaṃjñāvaiyarthaayam| godāhādeḥ kālopādhitve'pi kālatvenāprasiddhatvāt| kālādhvanostu lādividhyarthatvāt| āsyate māsaḥ, āsitavyaḥ, āsitaḥ, svāso vā| evaṃ śayyate krośa ityādi| deśapadaṃ grāmamamudāyaviśeṣātmakakurupañcālādiparam| bhāṣyodāharaṇasāmarthyāt| tenādhiśīṅsthāsāmityāderna veyarthyamiti kaiyaṭaḥ| yadi tu sakarmakadhātvantarārthaviśiṣṭa āsanādau āsyādayo vartante, tadāpūrveṇaiva siddham| māsamāsanena vyāpnotītyarthāt| yadvakṣyati prākṛnamevedaṃ karma, yathā kaṭaṃ karotīti dvitīye vistaraḥ| gatibuddhipratyavasānārthaśabdakarmākarmakāṇāmaṇi kartā sa ṇai || 52 || gativuddhibhakṣaṇārthānāṃ śabdakarmakāṇāmakarmakāṇāṃ ca dhātūnāmaṇau kartā ṇau karma syāt| yadyapi prayojakavyāpāreṇa prayojyavyāpārasyepsitamatvāttatprayuktakarmasaṃjñā siddhaiva, tathāpi niyamārthamidam| ṇijarthenāpyamānasya yadi bhavati tarhi gatyarthādīnāmeva nānyeṣāmiti| tena pācayati devadatto yajñadāttenetyatra guṇakriyākartari prayojye pūrvapravṛttakartṛsaṃjñāyā evāvastānāttṛtīyā| taduktam- guṇakriyāyāṃ svātantryātpreṣaṇe karmatāṃ gataḥ| niyamātkarmasaṃjñāyāḥ svadharmeṇābhidhīyate|| svadharmeṇa kartṛpratyayena tṛtīyayeti yāvat| gamayati devadattaṃ grāmaṃ ityādi| devadatto grāmaṃ gacchatīti aṇyantāvasthāyāṃ devadattasya kartṛtvam| nīvahyoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| prāpaṇārthatayā viśeṣaṇatvena gatipratītiriti saṃjñāprasaktiḥ| nāyayati vāhayati vā bhāraṃ devadattena| vaheraniyantṛkasyaiva pratiṣedhaḥ| vahanti vāhāḥ| vāhayati vāhān rathinaṃ sūtaḥ| niyantṛpadaṃ paśuprerakamātraparam| tena vāhayati balīvardān sasyam| kālaṃ yāpayatītyādāvapyanena karmatvam| yā prāpaṇe ityatra gatereva prāpaṇapadārthatvāt| budhyartheti jñānasāmānyavācināmeva grahaṇam| natu viśeṣārthānāṃ smaratyādīnām, śrudṛśorupasaṃkhyānamya vakṣyamāṇatvāt| bodhayati māṇavakaṃ dharmam| bhojayati, āśayati vā māṇavakamodanam| ādayati, khādayati vānnaṃ baṭunā| bhakṣerahiṃsārthasya pratiṣedhaḥ| naca curādiṇyantatvādaṇau kartetyasyāprasiddhaḥ| hetumaṇṇijante vidhānādaṇāvityatrāpi saṃnidhānāttasyaiva pratiṣedhāt| hetumaṇṇijantatvavirahadaśāyāmityarthādatrāpi prasakteḥ| bhakṣayatyannaṃ baṭunā| ahiṃseti kim| bhakṣayanti balīvardāḥ sasyam| bhakṣayati balīvardān sasyam kṣetrasthānāṃ yavānāṃ caitanyābhyupagamāt| yavabhakṣaṇe tatsvamino vā hiṃsā| hisāṅge bhakṣaṇe bhakṣayatervṛttisvīkārāt| śabdaḥ karmakārakaṃ yeṣāṃ te śabdakarmakāḥ| natu karmapadaṃ kriyāparam| pratyavasānaśabdārthetipāṭhādeva tādṛśārthalābhe karmaśabdasyārtātpṛthagupādānasāmarthyāt| adhyāpayati pāṭhayati vā putraṃ devadattaḥ| dṛśeścopasaṃkhyānam| darśayati hariṃ bhaktān| cākṣuṣaparatvādbudhyarthatvena siddhāvapi tatra jñānasāmānyavācināmeva grahaṇam, natu viśeṣavācināmiti jñāpanārthamupasaṃkhyānam| śrāvayati ślokaṃ devadattamiti tu śadbakriyāṇāmityarthe śrṛṇoterapyupasaṃkhyānāt| anyathā tu śadbakarmakatvātsiddham| ādye hvāyayati krandayati vā devadattenetyatra pratiṣedho vācyaḥ| pakṣadvaye'pi śabdāyateḥ pratiṣedho vācyaḥ| akarmakatvādapi pramaktisattavāt| śabdasya karmaṇo dhātvarthe'ntarbhāvāt| śabdāyayati devadattena| akarmakapadaṃ avidyamānakālādyanyakarmakaparam| tena māsamāsayati caitramityādi siddham| devadattena pācayatītyādau ca na karmatvam|| hṛkroranyatarasyām || 53 || hārayati kārayati vā kaṭaṃ bhṛtyaṃ bhṛtyena vā| naveti vibhāṣeti sūtre ubhayatra vibhāṣeyamiti vārtikam| tathārhi-abhyavaddārayati māṇakamodanaṃ, māṇavakena vetyatra pratyavasānārthatvātprāpte, vikurvate chātrāḥ, vikārayati chātrān, chātrairvetyatra tvaprāpte idamārabhyate| abhivādidṛśorātmanepade ceti vaktavyam| abhivādayateraprāpte dṛśestu buddhyarthatvādupasaṃkhyānādvā prāptevibhāṣeyam| abhivadati guruṃ devadattaḥ| abhivādayate guruṃ devadattaṃ devadattena vā| darśayate rājānaṃ bhṛtyān bhṛtyairvā| parasmaipade tu karmasaṃjñāvirahapakṣe ṇeraṇāvityātmanepadam| tatpakṣe tu ṇicaśceti| svatantraḥ kartā || 54 || kriyāyāṃ svātantreṇa vivakṣito'rthaḥ kartṛsaṃjñaḥ syāt| svātantryaṃ ca dhātūpāttavyāpārāśrayatvam| taduktaṃ hariṇā- dhātunoktakriye nityaṃ kārake kartṛteṣyate| dhātūpāttaphalāśraye karmaṇyativyāptivāraṇāya vyāpāreti| pācayati caitro maitreṇetyādau pākasya ṇijarthasya ca dhātṛpāttavyāpāratvāttayorubhayoḥ kartṛtvam| caitravṛttikartṛtvasyaiva tiṅupāttatvāt tatraiva saṃkhyānvaya iti tu viśeṣaḥ| caitro maitraṃ gamayatītyatra maitrasya kartṛtve'pi na tṛtīyā| karmasaṃjñāvarodhāt| sthālī pacatītyādau sthālīniṣṭhavyāpārasyaiva dhātūpāttatvātkartṛtvam| tena caitro na pacayatītyādau dhātṛpāttavyāpārābhāvāśreya caitrādau nāvyāptiḥ| tadvyāpārasyābhāvapratiyogitve'pi dhātvarthatvānapāyāt| caitravṛttitvena bhāsamānatvasya lakṣaṇāntarbhāvāt| yattu ghaṭaḥ paṭo netyādāvanyonyābhāvapratiyogini ghaṭādau dhātvarthaśrayatvābhāvādavyāptiḥ| naca tatrādhyāhaॉtabhavatipadasyobhayatādātmyabhavanalakṣakatayā tādṛśabhavanamabhāvapratiyogiti śābde'rthādanyonyābhāvabodhopapattestadātmatvena bhavanasya cobhayavṛttitvādubhayoḥ kartṛtvopapattiriti vācyam| dvayorapi tiṅupāttasaṃkhyātvāpattyā ghaṭo na paṭāviti prayogānāpattaiḥ| etena ghaṭo na paṭa ityatra ghaṭapratiyogikānyonyābhāvavallakṣakaṃ, nañapadaṃ tātparyagrāhakaṃ ataścobhayorapi śuklo ghaṭaḥ, aghaṭaḥ paṭa itivat pākṣikābhedasambandhamādāya viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvena vā'dhyāhṛtakriyāyāmevānvaya ityapāstam| ghaṭo naśyatītyādau kathamapi kartṛtvānupapatteśceti| tadasat| anyonyābhāvapratiyoginaḥ kartṛtvavirahāt| sādhutvaprayojakaprathamāyāḥ prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāva eva prayojaka ityasya svayamapyaṅgīkārāt| yadapi yaddhātvarthāvacchinnaliṅgānanvayipadopastāpyārthāśrayatvaṃ yasya tasya tatkartṛtvaṃ, pacyate caitreṇa, pacati caitra ityādau caitrāderdhātvarthāvacchinnakṛtyāśrayatvāt karmaṇi lakāreṇāpi kṛterukteḥ| ghaṭo bhavatītyādau cākhyātenāśrayatvasya, ca pratiyogitvasya lakṣaṇāt avacchinnatvaṃ ca svarūpaviśeṣo na tu janakatvādyena| tena prayiyogitvādernāśādyajanakatve'pi na kṣatiḥ| caitraḥ pācakaḥ, paktetyādau kṛtpratyayena pākānukūlaterliṅgānanvayinyā uktatvāt| caitrasya pāka ityādighañante ghañadyarthasya liṅgānvaye'pi dhātunā lakṣyasya pākāvacchinnavyāpārasya liṅgānanvayānnāvyāptiḥ| yadvā ghañādinā kṛterlakṣaṇayā śaktyā ca pākasyoktiḥ| kṛtau ca caitrasyānvayātkartṛtvam| śeṣe ṣaṣṭhītvādvā kartṛtvābhāve'pi na kṣatirityādi| tadapyasat| kṛduktakṛterlaliṅgānanvayitve pramāṇābhāvāt| caitraḥ paktā, mitrā paktrītyādidarśanāt| naca talliṅgamāśrayavṛttyeva, natu kṛtivṛtti kṛtyādipade eva kṛteḥ strītvādipratyayāditi vācyam| tathāpi kṛteḥ pṛthag‌ghañarthatve kṛterna liṅgānvaya iti durvacatvāt| pākānukūlakṛtisādhyaḥ pāka ityasya ca siddhabhāvāpannabhāvo ghañādyartha iti siddhāntaviruddhatvāt| śeṣaṣaṣṭhayāśca caitrapāka ityādau kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvarānuṣapattyaiva duṣṭatvāt iti dvitīye prapañcayiṣyāmaḥ| yadapi ghaṭo na paṭāvityatrādhyāhṛtabhavatyādeḥ pratiyogitvāśrayatvobhapalakṣakatvama| ghaṭapaṭasanbandhinī pathākramaṃ anyonyābhaviye vidyamānatvasambandhani pratiyogitvāśrayatve iti dhīḥ| anuyogivṛttisaṃkhyāvacanamevākhyāte bhavati, natu prayiyogivṛttisaṃkhyāvacanamapīti niyamo'pyanubhavānusārātkalpyaḥ| yadvā ghaṭo na bhavatī paṭau na bhavata iti kriyādvayādhyāhāraḥ| rañpadaṃ dyotakam| ekaghaṭavṛttibhavanāśrayatvaṃ paṭadvayavṛttibhavānāśrayatvapratiyogikānyonyābhāvaditi bodhaḥ| dvayorākhyātayoḥ paśya mṛgo dhāvatītivatsvapratiyogikānyonyābhāvavattvasaṃsargeṇānvayaḥ| ghaṭapaṭayorbhedānubhavaśca mānasa iti| tadrapyasat| ghaṭo na ghaṭa ityasyāpyāpatteḥ| ghaṭatvāvācchinnatvameva pratiyogitve ghaṭasya sambandha iti cet na| ghaṭasya paṭānyavṛttyanyonyābhāvapratiyogitvaṃ, paṭasya ghaṭatvānyatharmāvacchinnapratiyogitākānyonyābhāvāśrayatvamādāyāpi uktadhīparyavasānasambhavāt| yasyāśrayatvaṃ tadvṛttirevānyonyābhāvo budhyate ityādinimakalpane'pi śābdena ghaṭaḥ paṭo na veti saṃśayanivṛttyādikaṃ na syāt| ekavākyatvānubhavavirodhaśca| etena yadvetyapāstam| ghaṭapaṭayorbhedānubhavasya śābdatvācceti tiṣṭhatu tāvat| tārkikaprāñcastu itarakārakāprayojyatve sati kārakāntaraprayojakatvaṃ kartṛtvam| satyantaṃ kuṭhārādivāraṇāya| puruṣādijanyasaṃyogādivyāpārāviśiṣṭatvena tatprayojyatvādityāhuḥ| taccintyam| īśvaraprayojyānāṃ jīvānāṃ kartṛtvānāpateḥ| daṇḍajanyasaṃyogadiviśiṣṭatvena daṇḍādiprayojyatve kulālādāvyāpteśca| navyāstu tatkriyānukūlakṛtimattvaṃ tatkriyākartṛtvam| kāṣṭhe pākānukūlavyāpāravattvapratisaṃdhāne'pi kartṛpadāprayogāt| kṛtākṛtavibhāgenetyācāryoktarītyā yatnaśaktimatā tṛjantena kṛdhātunā vyutpannakartṛpadasya yatnāśrayabodhakatvācca| acetane tatprayogasya gauṇatvāt| gurutarabhārottolanakriyāviṣayakayatnasattve'pi tadaniṣpattau tatkriyākartṛtvavyāvahāravirahāt viṣayakatvaṃ vihāyānukūlatvamupāttam| yadi tvanyaviṣayāṃ tadanukūlāṃ kṛtimādāyā'pi na tatkartṛtvam, ata eva mattau bhūtaṃ natu mayā kṛtamiti tatra vyavahāra iti nāntarīyakakṛtimādhyapiṣṭamadhyasya śarkarādibhojane caitrasya na kartṛtvama, tadā viṣayakatvamapi niveśyam| tacca sādhyatvena| tena yāgādikṛteruddeśyatvākhyaviṣayatayā svargādau satve'pi na yāgādikartuḥ svargādikartṛtvam‌| īśvaraḥ pacatītīṣṭameva| anyathā tu kāryatvānavacchinnajanyatānirūpitamasādhāraṇamanukūlatvaṃ niveśyamityāhuḥ| tatprayojako hetuśca || 55 || tasya kartuḥ prayojako hetusaṃjñaḥ, cātkartṛsaṃjñaśca| kurvantaṃ prerayati kārayati hariḥ| hetusaṃjñayā tadvyāpāre hetumati ceti ṇic| kartṛtvāt kartari lakāraḥ| na ca prayojyasya svātantryābhāvātkathaṃ kartṛtvamiti vācyam| prayojakasannidhāne'pi svavyāpāre svātantryānapāyāt| ata eva kurvatyapi prayojye prayojyakakārayatīti vyapadeśa iti bhāṣye spaṣṭam| iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau prathamasya caturthe tṛtīyamāhnikam| <2.1> atha dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ| samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ|| 1 || padasambandhī vidhiḥ samarthāśrito vodhyaḥ| samarthapadasya tadāśrite lākṣaṇikatvāt| vidhipadaṃ karmasādhanam| upasarge ghoḥ kiriti kipratyayaḥ| vidha vidhāne ityauṇādike ipratyaye tvādyudātto vidhiśabdaḥ| ayaṃ tvantodātta iti viśeṣaḥ| atra ekārthībhāvaḥ sāmarthyāmadhikāra ityekaḥ pakṣaḥ| vyapekṣāsāmarthyamādhakāra iti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ| dvividhaṃ sāmarthyamadhikāra iti tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ| evaṃ paribhāṣāyāmapi traya iti ṣaṭ pakṣāḥ| tatraikārthībhāvaḥ sāmarthyaṃ paribhāṣeti siddhāntaḥ| itare pūrvapakṣā iti sthitamākare| anyatarasya dvayorvā subantatve yaḥ pravartate sa padavidhiḥ| mīmāṃsakāstu padatvaprayojakasādhāraṇameva padavidhitvaṃ tena vrīhibhiryavairvā yajetetyatra brīhiyavayorna samuccayaḥ| sākāṅkṣatve'sāmarthyena tatastṛtīyānupapatteḥ| vibhaktyutpattau satyāṃ padasaṃjñeti tṛtīyāvidherapi padasaṃjñāprayojakatayā padavidhitvena samarthaparibhāṣāviṣayatvādityāhuḥ| tadasat| śabdāntarānvayākāṅkṣāyāmevāsāmarthyāt anyathā samuccayābhāve'pyavaghātādisākāṅkṣatvena tṛtīyānutpattiprasaṅgāt| nīlaṃ ghaṭamityādāvapi vibhaktyanutpattiprasaṅgāt| nīlasākāṅkṣatayā ṛddhasya rājapuruṣa itibadasāmarthyāt| manmate tu padavidhitvavirahānna paribhāṣopasthānamiti vaiṣamyam| ata eva sansūtre upasargārthāviśiṣṭadhātvarthasya karmatvamiti pakṣe upasargasākāṅkṣatve'pi dhātoḥ sanpratyayaḥ| padavidhitvābhāvena samarthaparibhāṣāyā apravṛtteḥ| mahāntaṃ putramicchatītyatra tu subantāt kyajvidhānena tasya padavidhitvānna doṣa ityuktaṃ bhāṣye| tvadrītyā tu sanpratyayāntāttiṅutpattau padasaṃjñeti tasyāpi padavidhitvamastyeveti samarthaparibhāṣopasthāne tadvirodhāpattirdurvārā| etena viśeṣaṇatvasyānyayogavyāvṛttiṃ vinā'sambhavena dravyāntarasāpekṣatve viśeṣaṇatvasyāpyanupapattau ekārthībhāvalakṣamasāmarthyānupapatterityapi nirastam| anyayogavyāvṛttāveva viśeṣaṇatvasvīkāre daṇḍī puruṣa ityāderanupapatteḥ| svāyogavyāvṛttimātravivakṣāyāṃ tu samuccaye'pyāderanupapatteḥ| svāyogavyāvṛttimātravivakṣāyāṃ tu samuccaye|ñapyadoṣāt| ata eva `yadi rathantarasāmāsomaḥ syādaindravāyavāgrān grahān gṛhṇiyāt, yadi bṛhatsāmā sukrāgrān, yadi jagatsāmā āgrayaṇāgrān' ityatra bṛhadrathantarasādhyapṛṣṭhayorjyotiṣṭome vikalpe'pi svāyogavyāvṛttyā viśeṣaṇatvasambhavādekārthībhāvalakṣaṇasāmarthpānapāyādviśiṣṭasya yāgasyāgratāyāṃ nimittamiti siddhāntaḥ| vrīhibhirityādau tu vrīhijanyatvayāgatvayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamātrasya vidhibodhyatvāt| yavajanyatvasāmānādhikaraṇyasyāpi śāstrāntareṇa bodhe ubhayatra vijātīyayāgatvameva janyatāvacchedakaṃ kalpyate tṛṇāraṇimaṇinyāyāt| sāmārthyaṃ ca na parasparānvayayogyārthakatvaṃ bhāryā rājñaḥ, puruṣo devadattasyetyādāvativyāpteḥ| kintu tadarthānvitārthabodhakatvena tātparyaviṣayatvaṃ| tatra tu rājño bhāryāpadārthena sahaivānvayabodhe tātparyaṃ natu puruṣeṇeti na doṣaḥ| etacca vākye vyapekṣāsāmarthye ca ekārthobāvapakṣe samudāyasyaiva viśiṣṭārthaśaktisvīkāreṇaitādṛśasāmarthyābhāvāt| tatra cetthamupapattimāhuḥ| rājapuruṣa ityādau padadvayasya sbārthaparatve vākyavad vṛttāvapi viśeṣaṇānvayaḥ syāt| evaṃ putrīyati, kumbhakāra, aupagava ityādāvapi bodhyam| na ca saviśeṣaṇānāṃ vṛttirna, vṛttasya vā viśeṣaṇayogo neti vacanānna tadāpattiḥ vacanena tannivāraṇe gauravāpatteḥ| uktarītyā tu samudāyasya visiṣṭārthaśaktatayā tadekadeśe rājadipadārthe viśeṣaṇānvayānupapatteḥ siddhau uktavacanasya nyāyaprāptānuvādakatvamātrasvīkāreṇa lāghavāt| śvaśurapadajanyopasthitau pitṛviśeṣaṇatvenopastitāyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ suśīlāyā ityādiviśeṣaṇānanvayāt| evaṃ dhavaśca khadiraścetyādau iva samāse'pi cakāraprayogāpattiḥ| naca mayāpi tādṛśārthe nirūḍhalakṣaṇāsvīkārānna tadāpattiriti vācyam| śaktereva tāvatā svīkartumucitatvāt| samāse citragurityādau yatpadaprayogāpattiśca, prāptodako grāma ityādau kartṛpratyayāntaprāptapade kartuḥ pratyayārthatayā prādhānyāpattau udakakartṛkaprāptikarmibhūto grāma ityarthāsambhavaśceti| anye tvāhuḥ| rājapuruṣa ityatra rājapadasya rājasambandhini lakṣaṇayā rājñaḥ padārthaikadeśatayā tatrāpi veśeṣaṇānvayasyāpādayitumaśakyatvāt| vastuto viśeṣaṇatvenopasthitasyetarapadārthānanvaye nirākāṅkṣatvaṃ bījam| tataśca raktaḥ paṭo bhavatītyādāviva ṛddhasyetyādisamabhivyāhāre utthāpyākāṅkṣayā'nvayasambhavādasādhutvajñāpanārthaṃ saviśeṣaṇānāmiti vacanamāvaśyakam| ato'luk‌samāsasthale'pi na doṣaḥ| yattu naptā sundaraḥ, ghaṭo nitya ityādau vinā lakṣaṇāṃ sundaranityayoḥ putre ghaṭatve cānvayamādāya sādhutāvāraṇāya padārthaikadeśānvaye vākyasyāsādhutāyāḥ sāmānyata eva nirṇayaḥ| kiñca dṛśaprayogād‌durvāraḥ iti śaktisvīkāra iti| tadasat| caitrasya naptetyāderapi asādhutvāpatteḥ| bodhasya bhrāntyāpi sambhavena śaktisvīkāreṇa tasya durvāratvācca| bhedyabhedakasambandhopādhibhedaniyantritam| sādhutvaṃ tadabhāve'pi bodho neha nivāryate|| ityabhyupagamāt| naca ghaṭo nitya ityādervināpi lakṣaṇāṃ ghaṭatve nityatvānyaye sādhutvaṃ syāditi vācyam| iṣṭāpateḥ| ākāṅkṣāvirahādeva tathānavabodhāt| viśeṣyatayā padārthaprakārakabodhe viśeṣyatayā padajanyopasthiterhetutvāt| kvacittu svārasikānubhāvabalenāgatyā padārthatāvacchedake'pyanvayārthamavacchedakatayā padajanyopasthiterapi hetunvakalpanāt| ata eva ghaṭaḥ karmatvamityādau nāsādhutvavyavahāraḥ| yattu śabdakaustubhe dhruvamapāye iti sūtre uktaṃ ānayanayogāddhaṭasya, kṛtiyogādānayanapadasya ca kṛdyogaṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgasatvādidaṃ vākyamasādhveveti| tadasat| ghaṭānayanayoranvayasyātrānabhimatatvāt| ghaṭasya karmatve tasya vā''nayane'nvayasyāpādyatvāt| cakāraprayogāpādānamapyanarham| samuccayaviśiṣṭaghaṭādhilakṣaṇayaivopapatteḥ| atiriktaśaktisvīkārāpekṣayā lakṣaṇāyā eva yuktatvāt| yatpadaprayogasyāpyanāpattiḥ| vigrahe tathātve'pi samāse gopadasya citragavīsvāmilakṣakatayā svāmiprādhānyasiddhau samāse tatprayoge prayojanābhāvāt| citrā gāvo yasyeti vigrahe gavāmeva viśeṣyatayā samāsārthāvabodhakatvaṃ vigrahasya kathaṃ syāditi yacchabdārthasya svāminastacchabdena viśeṣyatāsaṃpādanārthamevoddeśyavidheyabhāvavidhayā yattatpadayo prayogāt| nanu gopadasya gosvāmilakṣaṇāyāṃ citrāpadārthānanvayaḥ| goḥpadārthaikadeśatvāt| nāpi citrāpadamya citrāsvāmini sā| gopadārthānanvayāditi cet| atra vaṭeśopādhyāyāḥ| vākye eva lakṣaṇā naca citrā gauryasyeti vigraha eva luptasmṛtayatpadārthastatrānayanādikriyānvayī tatra citragosambandhitapaivopasthiteḥ karmatvānvayānupapatteḥ| naca nirvibhaktikameva yatpadam vigrahe| vigrahavākyasyānvayābodhakatvāpātāt| na ca citrā gauryasya tamānayeti vākyārthaḥ| tatā'nanubhavāt| naca yattadornityasambandhāttatpadopasthitiḥ, adhyāhāraprasaṅgādityāhuḥ| ata eva gabhīrāyāṃ nadyāṃ ghoṣa ityādau vākye eva lakṣaṇā| gabhīranadyoḥ parasparamanvayabodāntaraṃ vastugatyā gabhīranadīsambandhitīraṃ tīratvena rūpeṇa tatra lakṣyate| parasparānvayavodhaṃ vinā viśiṣṭārthe vākyajñāpyatvābhāvena svajñāpyasambandharūpalakṣaṇāyāstīre jñātumaśakyatvāt| ata eva satyaṃ vijñānamānandaṃ brahmeti vākye vastugatyā viśiṣṭavākyārthasambandhi śuddhaṃ brahma lakṣyate iti vedāntavidaḥ| evamarthavādādivākye'pi pāśastyādilakṣaṇāstantrāntare spaṣṭāḥ| evamihāpi citrāgavorabhedānvayabodhottaraṃ svajñāpyagosambandhini citragosvāmitvarūpeṇa lakṣaṇā natu svāmitvena devadattatvena vā| viśiṣṭānubhāvānurodhāt| devadattādipadenaiva tallābhācceti bodhyam| maṇikṛtastu gabhīrāyāṃ nadīti bhāge lakṣaṇā, nadyāmityante vā| nādyaḥ| tasya aprakṛtitvena tadarthe subarthānanvayāt| nāntyaḥ| ata eva, subarthe subarthānanvayāccetyāhuḥ| anye tu samudāyasya lakṣyārthavattvena nāmatvānnādyo doṣaḥ| summātrārthayorananvaye'pi samuditavākyārthasyātathātvena na dvitīyo'pi nacātra vākyasyāsubantatvena lakṣyārthabodhakatvānupapattiḥ| arthavattvena tasya nāmatve'pi tīrarūpasya tadarthasya nābhedena kriyānvayo'yogyatvāt, nāpi bhedena avyutpatteriti vācyam| tīravṛttāveva lakṣaṇāsvīkāreṇa vākyasya dvitīyāntatvasambhavenābhedānvayasya kriyāyāṃ sambhavāt| gabhīrayā nadyā vṛkṣā janitā ityādau dvitīyāntatvānupapattāvapi nadītyādyanta eva lakṣaṇāsvīkārānnāsādhutvānavayau| eṣaiva rītirarthavādavākye'pi lakṣake bodhyā| tatrāpi hi kiyāyāmevānyeṣāmiva valavahaniṣṭānanubandhitvarūpaprāśastyasyāpi prathamamanvayaḥ| paścādeva dhātvarthe ityāhuḥ| tatradaṃ cintyam| tathāpi samudāyasya pratyayatvamanupapannaṃ yasmāt pratyayo vihitastasyaiva prakṛtitvāt| samudāyasya lakṣyārthavattave'pi nāmatvamanupapannam| nadīśabdasya pratyayāntatvenāpratyaya iti paryudāsāt| na ca pratyayagrahaṇe yasmātsavihitastadādestadanatasya ca grahaṇamiti paribhāṣayā nadīśabdasyaiva tena paryudāso na ca lakṣaṇāyāḥ padadvayavṛttitvādarthavatsamudāyatvaṃ nāstyekasyaiva samudāyasyārthavattvāditi vācyam| tathāpi dvayorarthavattvānapāyāt| anyathā vākyārthasya lakṣakatvapakṣe viśiṣṭārthasya samudāyapratipādyatayā vākyasya prātipadikasaṃjñāpatteraparihāryatvāt| ata eva dyotyavācyābhyāmarthābhyāṃ prakṛtipratyayavorarthavattvāduktaniyamena saṃjñāniṣedhaḥ syāditi bhāṣyādiśaṅkā saṃgacchate| anyathā gabhīrāyāmityatratyavibhakteḥ prātipadikāvayavatayā lopaprasaṅgācca| etena gabhīrayā nadyetyādikamapi nirastam| ata eva dvitīyo'pyapāstaḥ| nadyāmityatrāpi tatra vibhaktilopaprasaṅgasyādhikyāt| arthavattvasattvena tatrāpi prātipadikasaṃjñāprasakteḥ| tatra kriyāviśeṣaṇatayā dvitīyāntatvasvīkāreṇa bhavatā nāmatvasvīkārācca| āstāmaprakṛtametat| anye tu astu vinigamanāvirahādbahuvrīhau padadvaye'pi lakṣaṇā tathāpi na śaktikalpanaṃ gauravāditi vadanti| navyāstu gopade eva viśiṣṭārthalakṣaṇā| ata evārdhapippalī, upakumbhamityādau pūrvapadārthapradhāne'pi ṣaṣṭhītatparuṣāvyayībhāvādāvuttarapadasyaiva pippalyardhādau lakṣaṇā, pūrvapadaṃ tu tātparyagrāhakaṃ tadarthasyottarapadalakṣyasya viśeṣyatvācca pravādanirvāha ityāsthīyate| etena gopadasya gosvāmilakṣakatāyāṃ ekadeśe gavicitrānvayo na syādityapāstam| na ca citrapade viśiṣṭalakṣaṇāmādāya vinigamanāvirahaḥ| tasya guṇavācakatayā tallakṣaṇāyāḥ paramparāsambandharūpatayā gurutvāt| etena aṣaṣṭhyarthabahuvrīhyantargatānāṃ prāptādipadānāmapi kartrādivācakatvena sākṣātsambandhasattavādvīnigamakābhāva ityapāstam| tathāpi teṣāṃ sāmānyarūpeṇa dravyavācakatvam| udakādipadānāṃ tu viśiṣyeti sambhavāt| śūrādipadānāṃ guṇaviśiṣṭadravyavācitvaniyame'pi prakṛte citrādipadānāmapi tathātvenāviśiṣṭatvāt śūragurityādāvapi vinigamakasya susthatvācca| kevalaguṇavācakatvābhāvamātrasyākiñcitkaratvāt| uttarapade lakṣaṇāyāṃ pratyayasaṃnidhānalābhācca| nacānekeṣāṃ subantānāmanyapadārthaparatve bahubrīhividhānādekamātrapadasyānyapadārthaparatve tadanupapattiriti vācyam| tātparyagrāhakatvādinā tadupayogasya maṇikārādibhiruktatvāt| anyathā samāsasyānekapadatvābhāvātacchaktau tavāpi tadvirodhatādavasthyāt| yattu ghaṭādipade'pi prakṛtipratyayavibāgasambhavātpratyayāṃśasya jātiviśeṣādau lakṣaṇeti kalpayituṃ śakyatayā samudāyaśaktivilayāpattiritiṃ| tanna| yaugikārye samudāyaśaktivilopa āpādyate, rūḍhyarthe vā| nādyaḥ| iṣṭāpatteḥ| nāntyaḥ| tatrāvayavārthasambandābhāvāt| bahubrīherapi yadi devadattatvādi śakyatāvacchedakaṃ tadaiva ghaṭapaṭādisāmyaṃ syāt, natvevamasti vodhayorvai lakṣaṇyasya sarvasaṃmatatvāt| naca citragavisvāmitvaviśiṣṭadevadattatvādikameva śakyatāvacchedakaṃ devadattādipadaṃ ca tātparyagrāhakamiti vācyam| nānārthatvāpatteḥ| anyapadārtha ityanuśāsanavirodhāt| devadattādipadasyaiva sarvamartho bahuvrīhistātparyagrāhakaityāpatteśca| ata eva bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ padārthabhidhāne'nuprayogānupapattirabhihitatvāt| yatā cārthe dvandva ityābhidhānād dvandve cakārasyāprayogastathā devadattapadārthasya samāsenābhihitatvāddevadattādipadaprayogo na syāt| iti pūrvapakṣayitvā navā'nabhihitatvāddevadattādivapadaprayogo na syāt| iti pūrvapakṣāyitvā navā'nabhihitatvādityanena sāmānyārthasya samāsenābhidhāne'pi viśeṣasyānabhidhānāt viśeṣapratipattparthaṃ devadattādipadaprayoga iti siddhāntitam| tathā ca citragavīsvāmitvaprakārabodhatvameva citraguriti samudāyaśaktijñānasya kāryatāvacchedakam| evaṃ ca tārkikādināṃ gopadalakṣaṇājñānasyeti viśeṣaḥ| ata eva mīmāṃsāvārtike| bhavetāṃ yadi vṛkṣasya vājikarṇau kathaṃcana| aklṛptāṃ samudāyasya śaktiṃ ko jātu kalpayet|| ityuktam| arthavadityādisūtrānurodhenāvyutpattipakṣasyāvaśyābhyupeyatayā samudāyaśaktilopāpatteranucitatvācca| kasya śabdasyāvyutpannatvamityapekṣāyāṃ ca yatrāvayavārthamādāya na tatpadajanyabodhopapattistasyeti vinigamakasya spaṣṭatvāt, prakṛtibhāgapratyayabhāgayorghaṃṭate ghaṭa ityādau vyabhicāreṇa ghaṭatvaprakārakaghaṭaviśeṣyakabodhānupapādakatvāt| etena paṅkajapadamatibandirapāstā| tatra padmātvaprakārakabodhārthameva samudāyaśīktisvīkārāt| yattvevamapi tatra vibhaktyarthānvayānāpattiḥ pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvitasvārthabodhakatvavyutpatteḥ uttarapadottaraṃ pratyayavidhānābhāvena tadarthasya prakṛtyarthatvābāvāditi tattuccham| prakṛtitvaṃ hi aṅgatvameva| yasmātpratyayīvadhistadādipratyaye'ṅgamiti vacanāt| tathā ca samāsottaraṃ vibhaktividhānāt| ekasya tātparyagrāhakatvamaparasya lakṣakatvamiti vaiṣamyasattve'pi lakṣyārthe prakṛtyarthatvānapāyāt| etena samāsottaraṃ vibhaktirna syādityapi nirastam| abhyupetyāpi brūmaḥ| samāsagrahaṇādeva pratipadikasaṃjñā| nanvevaṃ tasya niyamārthatvābhāve kṛtaddhitetisūtreṇa mūlakenopadaṃśamiti samudāyasya prātipadikasaṃjñāpattiḥ| kṛd‌grahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇāditi cenmaivam| anena hi kimāpādyate, samudāyottaraṃ vibhaktirvā, samudāyottarama vibhaktilopo vā| nādyaḥ| iṣṭāpatteḥ| avyayatvena lopasya sumalabhatvāt| na dvitīyaḥ| tṛtīyāprabhṛtinyanyatarasyāmiti sūtre tṛtīyāgrahaṇavaiyarthyāpatte| upadaṃśastṛtīyāyāmityasya ṇamul‌mātraviṣayakatvena amaivāvyayeneti sūtreṇaiva samāsasiddheḥ| taddhi pakṣe tṛtīyāśravaṇārtham| tatrāpi lope tu kiṃ vikalpena| vastutastu kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasya kevalasya ca grahaṇam| anyathā kaṣṭaśrita ityādau dvitīyāśriteti samāso na syāt| tathā ca kevalasya kṛdantasya kārakapūrvasya ca prātipadikasaṃjñāvidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt| iti nātra tatparibhāṣopasthānamiti tatraiva vipañcitamityāstāṃ tāvat| etena tryaṅgaiḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajatītyatrāṅgānuvādena tritvāvidhirna sambhavati| samāse ekaprasaratābhaṅgaprasaṅgāt| ekaṃ hi padaṃ uddeśyakaṃ vidhāyakaṃ vā yuktam| natvekoddeśenāparavidānamiti siddhāntavirodha ityapāstam| uttarapadalakṣaṇāyāṃ ekapadārthatvasya sulabhatvāt| vasta bahuvrīhāvevottarapade lakṣaṇā upakumbhamarthāpippalītyādau tu pūrvapadārthasya kumbhasamīpapippalyardhādorvibhaktyarthe prātipadikāntarārthe cānvayo nānupapannaḥ| tādṛśabodhe tādṛśasamastapadapratyayapadayoravyavahitapūrvāparībhāvasya prātipadikāntarārthābhedānvayabodhe samānavibhaktikayostādṛśaśasamastapadapadāntarayoḥ samabhivyāhārasyā pi pṛthagākāṅkṣātvakalpanādityabhinabaḥ panthāḥ| samāsagrahaṇasya vidhyarthatayā taduttaraṃ vibhakteḥ saulabhyāt| na ca tatroddeśyavidheyabhāvena bodhaḥ syāditi vācyam| uddeśyavidheyabhāvāvacchinnaviṣayatayā śābde samāsānantargatapadadvayajanyopastiterhetutvakalpanāt| etena rājapuruṣaḥ sundaraḥ, yadi rathantarasāmā somaḥ syādaindravāyavāgrān grahān gṛṇhīyāt ityādau ca tathānvayo na syādityapāstam| uddeśyavidheyayordvayoḥ samāsānantargatatvasya vivakṣitatvāt| etena vaṣaṭkartuḥ prathamamakṣa ityādiṣu vādhaśaṅkā nirastā| śābde pūrvanirdiṣṭasyoddeśyatvaṃ caramanirdiṣṭasya vidheyatvamiti niyamasya sarvasaṃmatatvācca| vṛddhisūtre ca darśitametadityāstāṃ vistaraḥ| tasmādayamatra bhāṣyabhiprāyaḥ| rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ityatra rājā ṣaṣṭhyarthe sambandhe, sa cāśrayatvena puruṣe viśeṣaṇamiti rājasambandhāśrayaḥ puruṣa iti bodhaḥ| atra prakṛtyartho rājā pratiyogitvasambandhena ṣaṣṭhyarthe'nveti| tathā ca pratiyogitvāśrayatvayoḥ saṃsargatvaṃ, anyeṣāṃ padārthatvamiti vibhāgaḥ| nacāyaṃ bodho rājasambandhilakṣaṇayā rājasamvandhiprakārakābhedasaṃsargakapuruṣaviśeṣyakabodhasvīkāre samāsādupapādayituṃ śakyaḥ| tathā ca rājaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitapratiyogitvaniṣṭhasāṃsargikaviṣayatānirūpitasambandhaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatākhyaprakāratānirūpitāśrayatvaniṣṭhasāṃsargikaviṣayatānirūpitapuruṣaniṣṭhaviseṣyatāśālijñānatvaṃ rājapuruṣapadaśaktijñānakāryatāvacchedakaṃ kalpyate| na ca tādṛśārthe samudāyalakṣaṇayaiva tadupapattiriti vācyam| ubhayostulyakakṣatayā bodhakatve'nādiprayoge ca samāne vṛtterlakṣaṇātvameveti durāgrahamātraparyavasānāt| nacaivaṃ prāptodakādibahuvrīhau vigrahasamānākārakabodhasya kenāpyanaṅgīkārāt tatra śaktirna syāditi vācyam| tathāpi ekatra klṛptāyā tatrāpi tatkalpane bādhakābhāvācca| naca vākye saṃkhyāyā api rājādiviśeṣaṇatvena bhānātkathaṃ samānākārakatvamiti vācyam| yāvatyaṃśe sambhavastāvato'pi tyāgānaucityāt| nacaikatvaviśiṣṭarājasambandhāśrayetyādikameva śakyatāvacchedakaṃ kalpyatāmiti vācyam| tathānubhavābhāvāt| vṛttāvabhedaikatvamaṃkhyaiva bhāsate iti siddhāntāt| saṃkhyāviśeṣāṇāmavibhāgenāvasthaānaṃ abhedaikatvasaṃkhyā| taduktaṃ vākyapadīye- yathauṣadhirasāḥ sarve madhunyāhitaśaktaḥ| avibhāgena vartante tāṃ saṃkhyāṃ tādṛsīṃ viduḥ|| yadvā pariktaviśeṣaṃ saṃkhyāsāmānyamabhedaikatvasaṃkhyeti kaiyaṭaḥ| taduktam- bhedānāṃ vā parityāgātsaṃkhyāsā sa tathāvidhaḥ| vyāpārājjātibhāgasya bhedāpohena vartate|| agṛhītaviśeṣema yathā rūpeṇa rūpavān| prakhyāyate na śuklādirūpabhedastu gamyate|| idaṃ ca matabhedapradarśanamātram| saṃkhyāsāmānye mānābhāvāt| dhvanitaṃ cedaṃ avyayānāṃ liṅgasāmānyayogaṃ dūṣayatā kaiyaṭeneti bodhyam| dviputra ityādau śabdaviśeṣopādānātsaṃkhyāviseṃṣamatyayaḥ| tāvakīno māmakīna ityādāvādeśaviśeṣāt| śaurpikamityatra prātipadikena viśiṣṭasyaiva parimāṇasyopādānāt| māsajāt ityādau viśiṣṭakālāvagame tātparyāt| evamanyadapyanumandheyam| na ca prathamopastitatvātkapiñjalanyāyena rājapuruṣa ityādau rājādīnāmekatvapratyayo'stu iti vācyam| tadvadatra saṃkhyopasthāpakapadābhāvāt| nacaivaṃ saṃkhaayāsāmānyamapi na pratīyeta iti vācyam| saṃkhyāviśeṣānavacchinna eva rājādipadārtho bhāsate ityasya vivikṣitatvāt| etena rājño rājñorvetyāderjijñāsānurodhātsaṃkhyātvamāmānyapratītiḥ kalpyeti nirastam| mānasādisaṃkhyātvajñānādeva tadupapatteḥ| tasya saṃkhyāsaṃśayahetutve mānābhāvācca| ato vibhaktilopādividhānaṃ prakriyāmātram| rītiḥ| viśiṣṭa eva śaktiriti vaiyākaraṇāḥ| evaṃ sati niṣādasthapatiṃ yājayedityatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāse pūrvapadasya sambandhini lakṣaṇā, karmadhāraye tvabhedaḥ saṃsarga eveti lāghavātkarmadhāraya eva| samānaviṣayakatvamātreṇa samānārthakatvaṃ natu viśeṣaṇasāmyenāpīti spaṣṭaṃ śabdālokādau| evaṃ ca bhedābhāvarūpābhedasya vigrahe prakāratvena bhānātkarmadhārayavigrahasyaiva gurutvādviparītāpattiḥ| na niṣādasaṃbandhiprakārakābhedasaṃsargakasthapati viśeṣyakadhījanakatatpuruṣāpekṣayā gauravābhāvāditi| atrocyate| vākye vibhaktyarthābhedaṃ vadadbhirapi yathā samāse'bhedaḥ saṃsarga evetyucyate uktaṃ hi miśraiḥ-nacaivaṃ karmadhāraye'pi vibhaktyarthe'bhede lakṣaṇā? mantavyeti niṣādastapatyadhikaraṇavirodhaḥ| karmadhāraye'bedasya sesargamaryādayā bhānābhyupagamāditi| tathā'trāpi niṣādaprakārakābhedasaṃsargakasthapativiśeṣyakajñānajanakatvameva karmadhārayasya svīkriyate tathāca ṣaṣṭhīsamāse pūrvapadārthaniṣṭhaprakāratāyāṃ karmadhāraye ca pūrvapadārthaniṣṭhaprakāratāyāṃ abhedasya saṃsargatayā praveśena tatra sambandhino'dhikasya śakyatāvacchedakakoṭāvanupraveśā ttadgauravaṃ durvāram| ata eva lakṣaṇāyā aviśeṣe'pi matvarthalakṣaṇāpekṣayā gauṇī durbaleti tadvyapadeśādhikaraṇe nirṇitam| tathāca| parābhīṣṭe viśiṣṭārthe samāse śaktiyogataḥ| sambhave sati dharmasya laghoreva puraskriyā|| 1 || iti tiṣṭhatu vistaraḥ| atha kayaṃ devadattasya gurukulamityādikamiti cet| atrāhuḥ| sambandhiśabdasthale sāpekṣatve'pi bhavatyeva vṛttiḥ| taduktaṃ vākyapadīye- sambandhiśabdaḥ sāpekṣo nityaṃ sarvaḥ samasyate| vākyavatsā vyapekṣā hi vṛttāvapi na hīyate|| iti| tathā-tasmātsamāsasubdhātukṛttaddhitaviśeṣaṇe| na viśeṣema sambandhaḥ sāpekṣe tu bhavedayam|| yadvā svāśrayasambandhitvasambandhena ṣaṣṭhyarthasya sambandhasya kula evānyaḥ| taduktam- samudāyena sambandho yeṣāṃ gurukulādinā| saṃspṛśyāvayavām̐ste tu yujyante tadvatā saha|| 1 || iti| caitrasya naptetyādāvapi ṣaṣṭhyarthasya svāśrayajanyatvasambandhena dharmiṇyanvaya iti śabdāloke| kvacittu sāpekṣatve'pi sa sambāndhakabhinnasthale'pi vṛttirbhāṣyaprāmāṇyāt| tathāhi-kimodanaḥ śālīnāṃ, keṣāṃ śālīnāmityarthaḥ| raktaśvetabhedena śālidvaividhyāt| saktvāḍhakamāpaṇīyānāṃ āpaṇasambandhināṃ saktūnāmāḍhakamityarthaḥ| kuto bhavān pāṭaliputrakaḥ| pāṭaliputrādāgataḥ pāṭaliputrakaḥ| ropadhetoḥ prācāmiti vun| dve pāṭaliputre, kasmāt pāṭaliputrādbhavānāgataḥ ityarthaḥ| akiñcikurvāṇādayastu asamarthasamāsā asādhavaśceti sthitam| tatsiddhaṃ ekārthībhāvasāmarthye samāsādaya iti| vakṣyamāṇavibhāṣāyāṃ ca sāmarthyaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ, na tu samāse| guṇaḥ kṛtātmasaṃskāra iti nyāyāt| tathā ca vikalpenaikārthībhūtaṃ satsamasyate ityādistatra tatra vākyārthaḥ| natvekasminneva viṣaye vikalpena samāsa ityartho'sambhavāt| vyapekṣāyāṃ vākyameva| ekārthībhāve tu samāsa eveti yāvat| yadyapyalaukike prakriyāvākye sāmarthyaṃ nāsti tasya śābdabodhājanakatvāt tathāpi pariniṣṭhite viśeṣaṇasambdādyabhāvanadarśanāt śatrādau dvitīyādisāmānādhikaraṇyadarśanena lakāre tatkalpanavat| evaṃ citragupadasyānyapadārthaparatvādalaukike'pi tatparatvaṃ kalpyate| anyapadārtha ityādisautrānuvādenaiva devatāvigrahavattatsiddheścetyāhuḥ| iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau dvitīyādhyāyasya prathame tasmin pare vidhīyamānasya parāṅgavadbhāvasya padavidhitvātsamarthaparibhāṣopastāne tiṅantasya vāraṇasambhavāt| vyadhikaraṇasya tasya vastuto'sāmarthyāt| samānādhikaraṇasya tu samānādhikaraṇasamarthamiti vācanikāsāmarthyasattvāt| ṣaṣṭhyāmantritakārakavacanamityasyāvyāptivāraṇāyāvaśyakatayā tata eva tiṅantavāraṇācca| pratyuta sub‌grahaṇe kṛte tīkṣṇayā sūcyā sīvyannityatra subantasamudāyasya parāṅgavadbhāvo vana syāt pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā subantatvābhāvāditi cet| satyam| pīḍye pīḍyamāna karoṣyaṭan ityādavatiprasaṅgāt| asti hyatra sāmarthyam| sambodhanapadaṃ kriyānvayīti vakṣyamāṇatvāt| naca sarpiḥ kālakamityādau isusoḥ sāmarthye iti ṣatvavāraṇāya samānādhikaraṇamamarthasityuktatvāt karoṣyaṭan ityatra na doṣa iti vācyam| sarpiḥ pīyate ityādau ṣatvasiddhaye adhātvabhihitamityasyāpyuktatvāt| naca sarvaṃ nāma dhātujamiti darśane kālakādāvapi tadāpattiriti vācyam| kriyāyāḥ pratītāveva paryudāsāt| ṣaṣṭhyāmantritetyapekṣayā ca tannimittagrahaṇameva yuktam| goṣu svāminnityatra paraṅgavadbhāvasyānyathā'nupapatteḥ| nahi goṣviti ṣaṣṭhyantam| nāpi āmantrite dhātubācyā yā kriyā tasyāḥ kārakaṃ svāmīśvarādhipatīti śeṣaviṣaye mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvṛdhā vṛtaspṛśā, kratuṃ bṛhantamāśāthe ityatra ṛtenetyasya, ayamagne jānatetyatra ayamityasya cetyavadheyam| syādetat| mitravaruṇāvityasyāpi parāṅgavadbāvo na syāt| ṛnasya vardhayitārāvityarthe'ntarbhāvitaṇyarthād‌vṛdheḥ kvipi anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate iti dīrghe ca ṛtāvṛdhāvityasya vyutpatteḥ| tatra ca mitrāvaruṇayornimittatvābhāvāt| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ| ṛtāvṛdhāvityasya nighātānāpatteḥ| dvitīyapādāditvenānudāttaṃ sarvamapādādāviti paryudāsaprasaṅgāt| ataṃ eva imaṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvati śutidri stomamiti mantre pūrvapūrvāmantritānāmavidyamāna vadbhāve'pi mitrāvaruṇāvityasya kathaṃ parāṅgavadbhāvaḥ| āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavaditi tasyāvidyamānavadbhāvāditi vācyam| pūrvapadopādānasāmarthyātparasya kārya evāvidyamānavadbāvātideśātsvakārye mitrāvaruṇāviti sāmānyavacanaṃ, tadviśeṣavacanaṃ ṛtāvṛdhāviti parāṅgavanna bhavatītyarthaḥ| tathā ca ṛtenetyasyeva mitrāvaruṇāvityasyāpi parāṅgavadbhāvo durlabha iti| atra mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvṛdhāvityatra kārakāṇāṃ kriyāyāmevānvayādṛtenetyasyottarārdhagatena kratuṃ bṛhantamāśātheityatratyakenāśāthe ityanenānvayānmitrāvarumābhyāmanvayo nāstīti sāmarthyavirahān parāṅgavadbāvaḥ| mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvṛdhāvityanayostu śābde kriyānvaye'pi pārṣṇikaparasparāvacchedanābhedānvayātsāmarthyamastīti parāṅgavadbhāvasiddhiḥ| samānādhikaraṇamasamarthamiti tvadhātvabhihitaparamityuktameveti| nacaivaṃ śutudrītyasyāpi nighātaḥ syāt| sarasvatipadasya parāṅgavadbhāvenāpādāditvāditi vācyam| nacaivamekatvāvaruddhānāṃ kathaṃ bahuvacanāntakriyāyāmanvayaḥ tathācaikavākyatvābhāve nighātasyāpi daurlabhyamiti vācyam| pratyekaṃ tathātve'pi milineṣu bahutvānvayasambhavāt| ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahan saṃyujyāvasanibya ā,| tau gururgurupatnī ca prītyā pratinanandatuḥ| ityādivedalokaprayogadarśanāccetyāhuḥ|| tatredaṃ vaktavyam| ऑtasya vardayitārāvityanena ṛtavardhane mitrāvaruṇayornimittatvasya mpaṣṭameva lābhāttasya tannimittatvaṃ nāstītyayuktam| taddharmāvaccinnakāryatāpratiyogikakāraṇatāvaccedakadharmavattvasyāpi vivakṣitatvāt| divo duhitarityādāvavyāpteḥ| goṣu svāminnityādāvyāpteśca| na ca tannimittagrahaṇaṃ vinaivoktarītyā tanna kartavyamityabhiprāya iti vācyam| ekārthībhāvaḥ sāmarthyamadhikāraśceti siddhāntāt| parāṅgavadbhāve ca tannimittagrahaṇānna doṣa iti bhāṣyakaiyaṭayorvyāvastāpitatvāt| vyapekṣāsāmārathyasyātra grahītumaśakyatvāt| aṅgeti kim| dvayoḥ pṛthagādyudāttatvaṃ mābhūt| vaditi kim| svāśrayamapi yathā syāt| ām kuṇḍanāṭa| āma ekāntaramāmantritamiti nighātaḥ| svara iti kim| kūpe siñcan, carma namn, ityatra ṣatvaṇatve prati parāṅgavadbhāvo mābhūt| sati hi tasminnaikapadyātsakārasya padāditvābhāvātsātpadādyeriti ṣatvaniṣedho na syāt, samānapadasthatvāṇṇatvaṃ ca syāt| atra bhāṣyam| atidesena svāśrayaṃ padāditvaṃ na nivarttyate virodhābhāvāt| pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmeveti niyamācca na ṇatvam| pūrvapadaśabbasya samāsapūrvāvayave ruḍhatve'pi vyāptinyāyena yaugikasyāpi pūrvapadasya grahaṇāt| yadvā āmantritapadagrahaṇāt āmantritatvaprayuktakāryaṃ pratyeva parāṅgavadbhāva iti| samānādhikaraṇasyopasaṃkhyānamanantaratvāt| tīṣṇayā sūcyā sīvyan, tīkṣṇena paraśunā vṛścan| tasminniti nidiṣṭe pūrvasyeti paribhāṣopasthityā āmantrite pare vidhīthamānasya parāṅgavadbhāvasya vyavahite pravṛttivirahādārambhaḥ| naca parasparāṅgavadbhāve kṛte pūrvasyāpi sa bhaviṣyatīti vācyam| svara ityavadhāraṇena parāṅgavadbhāve karttavye parāṅgavadbhāvasya durlabhatvāt| ``chandasi paramapi pūrvasyāṅgavadbhavatīti vaktavyam| ā te pitarmarūtāṃ sumnametu| prati tvā duhitardivaḥ| vṛṇīṣva duhitardivaḥ| pitarityāmantritanighātenānudāttaṃ, tasmātparaṃ marutāmityetadāpi anudāttameva| ``avyayapratiṣedhasca| uccairadhīyāna, nīcairadhīyāna| ``anavyayībhāvasyeti vaktavyam| upāgnyadhīyāna| yadyapi luṅmukhasvaropacārāḥ prayojanamiti pūrvamuktaṃ tathāpi spaṣṭārthamidamuktam| prākkaḍārātsamāsaḥ || 3 || kaḍārāḥ karmadhāraye ityataḥ prāk‌samāsa ityadhikriyate| āvṛttyā pūrvaṃ samāsasaṃjñā, tato'vyayībhāvādisaṃjñeti sajñāntaravyāpakatvasiddhiḥ| anyathā paryāyeṇaiva saṃjñādvayaṃ syāt| upasargakarmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvat| syādetat| samāsasaṃjñāyā anavakāśatvādeva samāveśo bhaviṣyati| naca vispaṣṭapaṭurityādau tadavakāśa iti vācyam| vispaṣṭādīni guṇavacaneṣu iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaravidhānājjñāpakādvṛddhakumārīvaranyāyena samāsasiddheratra saha supetyasya pravṛttyanupayogāt| tatrottarapadārthatāvacchedake pāṭave vyutpattibaladvispaṣṭātvasyānvayātpūrvapadārthatāvacchedakasyottarapadārthatāvacchedakasya caikadharmiparatvābhāvena karmadhārayatvānupapatteḥ| ata eva paṭhanti- kaḥ samāsa iti praśne vispaṣṭapaṭugocare|| samāsamātraṃ ye brūyurvispaṣṭapagaṭavo hi te|| naca kākatālīyaṃ ajākūpāṇīyamityatrāvakāśaḥ| atrāpi samāsācca tadvipayāditīvārthaviṣayakasamāsānuvādena chapratyayavidhānabalādeva samāsasiddhyā saha supetyasyānupayogāt| nacedaṃ bahuvrīhireva kākatālamityatra ivapadārthasya prādhānyāditi vācyam| matvartha eva bahuvrīhervidhānāt| vastuta upamānaśabdasyaivopameyavṛttitayā ivārthaprādhānyābhāvāt| kākatālaśabdayoḥ svasamavetakriyāparatvena kākāgamanasadṛśaṃ caitrāgamanaṃ, tālapatanasadṛśo dasyūpānipāta ityekasminnivārthe samāsaḥ| patatā tālena yathā kākasya vadhastathā dasyunā caitrasyeti dvitīye tatra chamatyayaḥ| tadāha- yaccaurāṇāmasya ca samāgamo yaśca tairvadho'sya kṛtaḥ| upanatametadakasmādāsīdbana kākatālīyam|| na ca punārājaḥ punargava ityatrājitiyogavibhāgena tatpuruṣasaṃjñāṃ vināpi rūpasiddheḥ samāsasaṃjñā sāvakāśeti vācyam| punargavīti ṅībarthaṃ ṭaca eva tatrāpekṣitatvena tatpuruṣasaṃjñāyā avaśyāpekṣaṇīya tayā'vyayaṃ pravṛddhādibhiriti vā mayūkhyaṃsakāditvādvā tatpuruṣasyaiva vācyatvāt| na ca punarādheyamityatra viśeṣakāryādarśanātsāvakāśā samāsasaṃjñeti vācyam| gatikārakopapadātkṛditi svarārthaṃ gatisaṃjñāvaśyakatve vācyam| gatikārakopapadātkṛditi svārārthaṃ gatisaṃjñāvaśyakatve kugatiprādaya iti tatpuruṣasyaiva vācyatvāt| yato'nāva iti dheyaśadbasyādyudāttatvātpunarādheyaśabde ekāra udāttaḥ| anyathā samāsāntodāttatvaṃ syāt| na ca punarutsyūtaṃ vāso deyaṃ, punarniḥkṛto ratha ityavakāśaḥ| punaḥśabdasya gatisaṃjñāyāṃ thāthādisvareṇāntodāttatvam| asatyāṃ tu samāsasvareṇeti viseṣābāvāditi vācyam| gatisaṃjñāyāṃ gatiranantara ityanantaragrahaṇasāmarthyāt thāthādisvaraṃ bādhitvā ucchabdasya prakṛtisvaratvāt| udāttapunaḥśabdasya tu śeṣanighātaṃ bādhitvā paratvādgatirgatāviti nighāto bhavatīti viśeṣasattvāt| na ca punaścanasau cchandasīti tatsiddhiḥ| bhāṣāyāṃ svarasiddhaye gatisaṃjñāpekṣāyā āvaśyakatvāt| naca kāṭhake punarutsyūtaśabdo'ntodātta eva paṭhyate iti vācyam| vyatyayena pravṛddhāderākṛtigaṇatvādvā tatsiddheḥ| tatsiddhaṃ samāsa ityevādhikriyatāmiti cetsatyam| ekasaṃjñādhikāre paryāyāpatterāvaśyakatvāt| yadyapyavihitalakṣaṇaḥ samāsaḥ saha supetyanena vidhīyate iti bhāṣye vakṣyate tathāpyasaṃyuktapāṭhena samāsasaṃjñāyāḥ sarvārthatvaṃ, nyāyavyutpādanāya tvanavakāśavyutpādanamiti kaiyaṭaḥ| saha supā || 4 || saheti yogo vibhajyate| subāmantrite ityataśca sub‌grahaṇānuvṛttiḥ| subantaṃ samarthena saha samasyate| yo jāta eva paryabhūṣat| yaḥ śambaramanvavindat| anuvyacalat| anuprāviśat| sup‌supeti punirvidhānena katipayatiṅantamātraviṣayatvādasya nātipramaṅgaḥ| yogavibhāgasyeṣṭasiddhyarthatvānneha| samprayaccha vṛṣyā indrāya bhāgam| subiti saṃkhyā vivakṣitā| tena pūrvaṃ veḥ samāsaḥ, paścādanoḥ| samāse śākalapratiṣedhādyaṇādeśaḥ| samāsāntodāttatvaṃ tu na bhavati| tiṅ‌ṅatiṅa iti nighātena bādhitatvāditi kecit| anye tu tathā satyanorgatirgatāviti nigātaḥ| viśabda udāttaḥ| udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudāttasyeti svaritaḥ| evaṃ cānuprāviśaditi bhāṣyodāharaṇavaiyarthyam| ataḥ sati śiṣṭatvātsamāsāntodāttatvameva| na ca subutpattiprasaṅgaḥ| tiḍaikatvasyoktatvādityāhuḥ| apare tu vacanagrahaṇasāmarthyādukteṣvapyekatvādiṣu prathamā bhavatyeva| na ca śravaṇāpattiḥ| hal‌ṅyādilopasambhavāt| ata evaikapadyādāmanupraviśa devadattetyatrāma ekāntaramāmantritamiti nighātapratiṣedhaḥ samāsasaṃjñāyāḥ prayojanamiti tiṅantavighātavādina ityāhuḥ| atra dīkṣitāḥ| evaṃ matasvarūpamātraṃ likhadbhyāṃ kaiyaṭaharadattābhyāṃ kiṃ paratvānnighāta uta sati śiṣṭatvātsamāsāntodāttatvamiti nāvadhāritam| kiñca gatikārakopapadāditi uttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ bhavati navetyapi vicārayitumarham| tatra kṛd‌grahaṇasya vārtikakṛtā pratyākhyānāt| kiñca anuvyacaladityādau yathā tathā'stu| yo jāta ityādau tu yadvṛttānnityamiti nighātapratiṣedhātsamāsāntodāttatvaṃ durvāram| kiñca sati śiṣṭatvātsaṃmāsāntodāttatvamiti pakṣe atyāyāhi śaśvato vayaṃ te ityatra āṅaudāttapāṭho na saṅgacchate| api ca niriṇāmi ityatra niśabde, vitanvate ityatra viśabde ca nighātaḥ| samāsāntodāttatvaṃ tu riṇātītyatra nāsti| tanvate ityatra tvastīti vaiṣamyaṃ durupapādam| tasmādidamatra tattvam- vārtikamate tāvadādya eva pakṣaḥ| kṛdgrahaṇapratyākhyānāt| udāttavatā gatimatā ca tiṅā samāso vaktavya iti tatpuruṣādhikāre tiṅ‌samāsavidhānena gatisamāsasya tatpuruṣatvābhyupagamācca| vitanvata ityatra tricakrāditvādantodāttatvaṃ kalpyam| atyāyāhityatra tu tiṅ‌ṅatiṅ‌ iti nighāte āṅā samāsaḥ| uttarapadasyodāttaśūnyatayā gatisvarābhāvādavyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇāṅudāttaḥ| tato'tiśabdena samāse kṛte kṛd‌grahaṇapratyākhyānāduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇeṣṭasiddheḥ| niriṇātītyatra tu yacchabdayoge nighātaniṣedhātpūrvavadeveṣṭaṃ siddham| bhāṣyamate tu saha supetyatra yogavibhāgenoktasamāsavidhānāttatpuruṣasaṃjñāvirahādgatisvarasyāvyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasya cābhāve samāsāntodāttena vitanvate iti siddham| anvavindat, niriṇātītyādau uttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ tu bāhulakātsamādheyamityāhuḥ| idaṃ tu iha vaktavyam| kṛd‌grahaṇapratyākhyāne dhātorhi dvaye pratyayā vidhīyante, tiṅaḥ kṛtaśca, tatra kṛtā saha samāso bhavati, tiṅā ca na bhavati| tatrāntareṇa kṛd‌grahaṇaṃ kṛta eva bhaviṣyatīti bhāṣyakāroktyā tiṅ‌samāse gatikārakopapadāditi svaro na pravartate iti gamyate| tiṅ‌samāsasya svarūpataḥ sattvena uktasvarābhāvaviśiṣṭatayaiva tadabhāvamya vācyatvāt ata eva prapacatitarāmityatra kṛd‌grahaṇasyāvyāptirudbhāvitā| anyathā prapacatītyatraiva tatkathanaprasaṅgāt| apica udāttaktā gatimatā ca tiṅā samāso vaktavya iti vārtikavyākhyāyāṃ yatpariyantīti udāttavata udāharaṇam| nipātairyadyadīti nighātapratiṣedhādyantītyasya pratyayasvareṇādyudāttatvātpariśabdasya yantītyanena samāsaḥ| anuvyacaladiti| pūrvaṃ paratvāttiṅ‌ṅaniṅa iti nighātaḥ| tata udāttatvābhāvādgatimateti pṛthaguktam| tatra trayāṇāṃ padānāṃ samāsāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati| tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyāsaptamyupamānāvyayadvitīyākṛtyā iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ tu na bhavati| gatirgatāvityanoranudāttatvāt| tatra codāttasvaritagrahaṇānuvartanāt| viśabdasya pūrvapadatvābhāvāditi tāvatkaiyaṭenaiva vyākhyātam| tathā ca samāsāntodāttatvaṃ bhavatyeveti spaṣṭamevoktam| idamapyavadheyam| tiṅ‌samāsaḥ chāndasa eva| anyathā paryabhūṣadityādau hal‌ṅayādilopena yatprakarotityādau napuṃsakatvābhyupagamena ca nirbāhe'pi yatprakurute ityādau hvasvasya prakurvīrannityādau na lopasya cāpatteḥ chāndasatvenaiva sulopasya vācyatvāt| tasmātkāvyādau upasargaḥ prathak padameveti siddhāntaḥ| ``ivena saha samāso vibhaktyalopaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca vaktavyam| uktayogābhyāṃ siddhasamāsānuvādena vibhaktyalopasvarau vidhīyete| ayaṃ cānityaḥ| udbāhuriva vāmana ityāderjīmūtasyeva bhavati pratīkamityatra taittirīye pṛthakpadapāṭhasya ca darśanāt| etenevasamāsasya chāndasatvamapyapāstam| ivena samāse śrautyāḥ samāsagatopamāyā ālaṅkārikairudāhṛtatvācceti| advaitamapyanubhavāmi karasthābilvatulyaṃ śarīramahinirlvayinīva vīkṣe|| ityādayaḥ samastaprayogāḥ ``nahyasti prathamāntenaivetyādyanekamanyapadārtha iti sūtrasthabhāṣyasaṃmatā eveti dīkṣitāḥ| avyayībhāvaḥ || 5 || adhikāro'yam| yadyapi pūrvapadārthapradhāno'vyayībhāvaḥ| uttarapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣaḥ| anyapadārthapradhāno bahuvrīhiḥ| ubhayapadārthapradhāno dvandva iti prācāṃ vyavahāra ihāpi mahāsaṃjñākaraṇādāśritastathāpi prāyika eva| unmattagaṅgamityavyayībhāve'nyapadārthasya, ardhapippalīti tatpuruṣe pūrvapadārthasya, dvitrā iti bahuvrīhau ubhayapadārthasya ca prādhaānyadarśanāt| samāhāradvandva ubhayapadārthaprādhānyādarśanācca| ekārthībhāvapakṣe padadvayasyāpyanarthakatvācceti kaiyaṭādayaḥ| avyayaṃ vibhaktisamīpasamṛddhivyṛddhyarthābhāvātyayāsampratiśabdaprādurbhāvapaścādyathānupūrvyayaugapadyasādṛśyasaṃpattisākalyāntavacaneṣu || 6 || atrāvyayamiti yogaṃ vibhajya apadiśamiti sādhanīyam| klībe'ntaraṃ tvapadiśaṃ diśormadhye vidik striyām| ityamara iti kecit| taccintyam| bhāṣyādāvanuktatvāt| vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ| avyayībhāve śaratprabhṛtibhya iti ṭac| avyayībhāvaśceti klībatvamiti kṣīrasvāminā tatra vyākhyātatvāt| diśoridamiti vigrahasya darśitatvācca| sabandhasya cārthavaśānmadhyarūpasyaiva grahaṇāt| nanvatra vibhaktipadamadhikaraṇamātraparam| nacaivaṃ vikṣaktīti sāmānyanirdeśavaiphalyam| pariśiṣṭavadadhikaraṇapadasyaiva grahaṇāpatteriti vācyam| tathā satyeka mātrāyā ādhikyāt| maivam| adhikaraṇamātravivakṣāyāṃ vibhaktipadasthāne ṅigrahaṇasyaiva lāghavātprasaṅgāt| nacaivaṃ ekasyaiva lābhāpattiḥ, tathātve suityevābhidhānāpatteḥ prathamopasthitatvāt| tasmādvibhaktipadopādānasvarasādadhikaraṇādatiriktārtha vṛtterapyavyayasya grahaṇamabhimatamiti na kāpyanupapattiḥ| tataśca kartṛkarmakaraṇasaṃpradānāpādānarūpaśaktivṛtteravyayasyāprasiddhatvāt| adhikaraṇasaṃbandhobhayaparamavyayamatra gṛhyate iti siddham| yattu nārada ityabodhītyādau itiśabdena karmābhidhānasya prasiddhatvāditi nāradamityavyayībhāvo bhavatyeva vibhaktipadasvārasyāditi kaiściduktam| taccintyam| tasya karmatvamātrāvṛttitvāt| tathāhi-nāradaṃ abodhi ityetajjanyabodhāpekṣayā nārada ityabodhi ityetajjanyabodhasya vailakṣaṇyamanubhavasiddham| ādye ullekhyajñānasya nāradaviśeṣyakatvaṃ niyameva gamyate| nāradatvaprakārakatvaṃ tu autsargikam| dharmāntaraprakārakasyāpi nāradaviśeṣyakajñānasya tadullekhyatvāt| dvitīye tu nāradatvaprakārakatvaṃ niyamena gamyate, nāradaviśeṣyakatvaṃ tu na tathā| nāradatvaprakārake bhinnaviśeṣyake'pi bodhe sati tādṛśaprayogadarsanāt| tathāca viśeṣyatvarūpaṃ karmatvaṃ jñānādyarthakadhātuyoge dvitīyārthaḥ| itiśabdasya tu prakāratvamarthaḥ| svasamabhivyāhṛtapadārthatāvacchedakaprakārakatvasya jñāne niyamato'vabhāsanāt| svasamabhivyāhṛtapadārthaviśeṣyakatvaṃ tu pramāsthale labhyate, nanu bhramasthale iti anabhihitasūtre vakṣyāmaḥ| tatrāvyayībhāvasvīkāre tasya nityasamāsatvānnārada ityabodhīti prayogasyāsādhutvaprasaṅgācceti dik| vibhaktistadartharūpā kārakaśaktiradhikaraṇādisvarūpā vacanaśabdaḥ karmavyutyattyā'rthaparaḥ| vibhaktyādibhirabhedena tadarthānvayaḥ| adhikaraṇādyartheṣu vartamānaṃ subantamavyayaṃ samarthena saha samasyate| naca supsupetyane na siddhiḥ| punarvidhānāttasyānityatvadyotanāt| ataeva vibhāṣādhikārātpūrvaṃ paṭhitasyāpi tasya nityasayāsatvābhāvātpūrvaṃ bhūto bhūtapūrva iti svapavigraho vṛttāvuktaḥ| vāpyāmaśvo vāpyaśva ityādau tatsamāse kaiyaṭe'pīti boddhyam| saṃjñāyāmitivatsupsupetyasyāpi nityatve sinnityasamāmayoḥ śākalapratiṣedha itivārtikasthanityagrahaṇapratyākhyānaparasya ``nityagrahaṇena nārthaḥ idamapi siddhaṃ bhavati vāpyāmaśvo vāpyaśvaiti bhāṣyasyānupapatteḥ| yathāśrutavārtikenāpi tanniṣedhasiddheḥ| nacaivaṃ paṅkajādipadeṣvapi nityasamāsatvādavigrahatvaṃ syāditi vācyam| yaugikārthapuraskāreṇa vigrahadarśane'pi samudāyārthasya padmatvasya samāsaikagamyatayā vastutastathātvāditi dīkṣitāḥ| vibhaktau harau ityadhihari| hari ṅi adhi ityalaukikaṃ vākyam| antaraṅganapīti ṅerluka, natu paratvādautyam, gherakārāntādeśe yathoktarūpāsiddheḥ| saṃnidhānātsamasyamānapadāntargataiva vibhaktirgrāhyā| tadarthaścādhiśabdena dyotyaḥ| nacaivaṃ nipātenābhihite vibhaktyanupapattiḥ| subantena samāsavidhānasāmarthyāttadutpatteḥ| ataeva dvijārthaḥ sūpa ityādau uktārthasyāpi prayogo vakṣyate| vibhaktyarthamātravṛtterevāvyayasyeha grahaṇam| vacanagrahaṇasya sāmarthyādvibhaktyādipratyekānvayāt| anyathā tadvaiyarthyāt| gṛhasyopari, grāmasya pura ityādīnāṃ tvadhikaraṇārthatve'pi digdeśakāleṣvadhikeṣu vartamānatvānna samāsaḥ| kecittu| nipātenābhihitatvātprathamāntenāyaṃ samāsaḥ| yadvā ṣaṣṭhyanteneti matadvayamapi pariśiṣṭoktatvādaṅgīcakruḥ| taccintyam| samasyamānapadasya saptamyantaṃ vinā samāse'dhikaraṇārthakādhiśabdaprayogānupapatteḥ| prāñcastu harau adhikṛtyeti vigrahamāhuḥ| tatra nityasamāsatve'pyasvapadavigrahatvamakṣatam| lyabantasya samāsaghaṭakātiriktasya praveśāt| naca samāsārthaleśamapyabodhayatastasya vigrahāntarbāvo na yukta iti vācyam| samāsārthātiriktārthabodhakatvena vigrahavahirbhāve kumbhaṃ karoti kumbhakāra ityapi na syāt| aṇante vartamānatvasaṃkhyādyanavabodhanāt| samāsārthabodhakatvasya adhikaṃ tu(?)praviṣṭamiti nyāyenobhayatra sāmyāt| kiñcaivaṃ vigrahamātrocchedāpattiḥ| tadanyūnānatiriktārthabodhakatvasya kuvāpyabhāvāt| citragurityatra goniṣṭhasaṃkhyānavabodhāt, vigrahe ca tadvodhāt iti dik| samīpe kṛṣṇasya samīpamupakṛṣṇam| anvarthasaṃjñātvātmāmīpyaprādhānye'yaṃ, samīpavarttiprādhānye tu upadaśā iti bahuvrīhirvakṣyate| ato'tra sāmīpyasya bhedenānvayaḥ| tatra tu samīpavartino'bhedeneti viśeṣaḥ| naca samayā, nikaṣā, ārādityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ| teṣāmadhikaraṇatvaviśiṣṭasāmīpyaparatvāt| grāmasya samīpe iti bodhāt| upakumbhamityādau sāmīpyasya ghaṭādiniṣṭhanvena gamyamānatvāt| tathā ca tatra sāmīpyaṃ deśāntare tadvṛttitvaṃ ca ghaṭādau prakāraḥ| upakumbhamityādau tu kumbhasyaiva sāmīpyanirūpakatvaṃ tadviśeṣyatvaṃ ceti viśeṣaḥ| yattu tatra dvitīyāpañcamyorvidhānasāmarthyānna samāsa iti tanna| caitrasya grāmaṃ sagayetyādāvasāmarthyādasamāse tadvidheścaritārthatvāt| naca samāsasya nityatayā vṛttasya viśeṣaṇayogo neti caitrasyetyādernāpattiḥ| saviśeṣaṇānāṃ netyasyāpi sattvāt| nacānityasamāsaparaṃ taditi vācyam| mānābhāvāt| tatprayoge ekārthībhāvena samāsaprāptyabhāvācca| naca sthūlasya kumbhasya kāra ityāpattiḥ| karmayogaṃ vinā'ṇo'sādhutvāt| sthūlaṃ kumbhakāra ityasya cāsāmarthyāt| ata eva mahāntaṃ putrīyati ityāderagamakatvaṃ bhāṣye uktam| vyapekṣāyāṃ vākyameva, ekārthībhāve vṛttirevetyasya tadarthatvāt| samṛddhau madāṇāṃ samṛddhiḥ sumadraṃ, madrāṇāṃ viśeṣyatve tu kugatīti tatpuruṣaḥ| samṛddhā madrāḥ sumadrā iti| vyṛddhau duryavanam| arthābhāve tu abhāvapratiyoginā samāsaḥ| iha tu ṛddherabhāvapratiyogitvaṃ na tu yavanānāmiti viśeṣaḥ| arthābhāve nirmakṣikam| avighnam| saṃsargābhāve'yaṃ samāsastasya samasyamānapadārthavirodhitvāt| bhedasya tu padārthatāvacchedakenaiva saha virodhāt| yattu bhūtale ghaṭo netyatra ghaṭābhāvabodho na bhavati| avyayībhāvasya nityasamāsattvāditi| tanna| abhāvasya viśeṣyatvaevā'vyayībhāvavidhānāt| bhūtalavṛttyabhāvapratiyogī ghaṭa ityabhāvaprakārakapratiyogitvasaṃsargakaghaṭaviśeṣyakabodhatātparye bhūtalavṛtti ralakṣaṇāvaditi maithilasampradāyaḥ| atyaye himasyātyayo'tihimam| tasya dhvaṃsaḥ ityarthaḥ| na cārthābhāvena siddhau pṛthagupādānaṃ vyartham| tatrātyantābhāvasyaivopādānāt| atra cātyayagrahaṇasyaiva pramāṇatvāt| tena prāgabhāvārthe nāvyayībhāvaḥ| yattu dhvaṃsatbamabāvatvavyāpyamakhaṇḍamevetyarthābhāvātpṛthagupādāmiti tanna| dhvaṃsatvasyābāvatvāghaṭinatve'pi dhvaṃsasyābhāvattvānapāyāt| saṃprati ityavyayamadhikaraṇaśaktipradhānam| etarhi saṃpratīdānīmadhunā sāṃprataṃ tathetyamarokteḥ| adhikaraṇakārakākṣiptā yujikriyā nañā niṣidhyate| atinidram| nidrā idānīṃ na yujyate ityarthaḥ| atitaisṛkamācchādanamiti vṛttiḥ| tisṛbhāve saṃjñāyāṃ kanyupasaṃkhyānam| tisṛkā nāma grāmaḥ| tatra bhavaṃ taisṛkamācchādanam| taccātiśīte vā kāle upayojyam| idānīṃ nopabhogārhaṃ taisṛkamācchādanamiti tadarthaḥ| tai sṛkapadasyācchādanapadasāpekṣatve'pi gamakatvātsamāsa ityāhuḥ| prāñcastu asaṃpratīti saṃpratyabhāvaḥ anenopabhogyavastuno yo vartamānakālastasyaiva niṣedhaḥ kriyate ityāhuḥ|| nanu adhikaraṇasya niṣedhaṃ pratiyogitvenānvayo viruddhaḥ| bhūtale na ghaṭa ityādau bhūtalasyābhāvapratiyogitvānavabhāsanāditi cenna| vastuto'dhikaraṇasya nābhāvapratiyogitvaṃ, tajjanyabuddhāvadhikaraṇatvena pratiyamānasya vā nādyaḥ| adhikaraṇasya kevalānvayitayā ghaṭāderapi tatātvānupapatteḥ| nāntyaḥ| kālasya niṣedhapratiyogitvaṃ vadatā tasyādhikaraṇatvānubhavānaṅgīkārāt| nacādhikaraṇaśaktipradhānasyābhāve pratiyogitvenānvayo na syāt, bhūtalasya veti vācyam| tathābhūtasyāpi divāśabdasya divāmanye ityatrādhikaraṇaśaktiprādhānyamapahvāya vṛttisvabhāvena karmatvāṅgīkārāt| tathācātinidramityasya nidrāyogyakālābhāvaityarthaḥ| śabdaprādurbhāve itihari| hariśabdasya prakāśa ityarthaḥ| haripadaṃ śabdasvarūpaparam| tamya prakāśārthena itiśabdena samāsaḥ| paścādarthe anuratham| rathānāṃ paścādityarthaḥ| iha vyṛddhipadasyālpāctvena prasaktasya pūrvanipātasyākaraṇaṃ etatsamāsāni tyatvajñāpanārtham| ato vākyasyāpi sādhutvamiti kecit| samīpādyarthaiḥ śabdairataddhitāntaiḥ sāhacaryāt tathāvidhasyaiveha grahaṇam| acaḥ parasminnityatra tataḥ paścāditi, anekamanyapadārthe iti sūtre sarvapaścāditi ca bhāṣyādityanye| yogyatāvīpsāpadārthānativṛttisādṛśyāni yathārthāḥ| anurūpaṃ rūpasya yogyam| vīpsāyām| arthamarthaṃ pratīti pratyartham| bhāṣyaprāmāṇyādvākyamapi sādhu| yadvā pratiśabdo'tra karmapravacanīyatvāt saṃbandhasyāvacchedakaḥ| vīpsā tu dvirvacanadyotyā| ato'vyayasya vīpsāyāmavṛtterna samāsa iti haradattādayaḥ| kecittu pratiśabdasya vīpsāyāṃ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyāttadgarbhaṃ vākyamapi| naca grāmasya vṛkṣaṃ pratītyatra samāsāprasaktyā tatraiva dvitīyāvidhānaṃ sāvakāśāmiti vācyam| samāsāvaśyakatve viśeṣaṇasyaivānanvayāpatterityāhuḥ| hareḥ sādṛśyaṃ sahari| anupūrvasya bhāva ānūpūrvyam| brāhmaṇāditvātṣyañ| ṣitvānṅīṣ ānupūrvīti| anujyeṣṭham| jyeṣṭhakrameṇetyarthaḥ| yaugapadye sacakram| sahaśabdasya samāsaḥ| avyayībhāve cākāle iti sabhāvaḥ| sadṛśaḥ sakhyā sasakhi| sakikhīti vṛttiḥ| apacitaparimāṇā mṛgālī kikhī| pūrve sādṛśyasya prādhānyaṃ atra tadvata iti
