prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ|| itibhagavadgītoktorityuktam| dvāvimau puruṣauloke kṣaraścākṣaraevaca|| iti tatroktatvāttadarthalābhaiti tadvyākhyātāraḥ| kumumāñjalyupāye tu nirdhāraṇasaptamyā samāsaḥ| nacaivaṃṣaṣṭhīsamāsa niṣedhavaiyarthyam| tatrāntodāttatvaṃ, saptamīsamāse tu tatpuruṣe tulyārtheti pūrvapadaprakṛtitvaraitibhedādityuktam| yattu saṃjñāyāmitisamāsasya nityatvātsvapadavigrahatvamayuktamiti tadakiñcit‌karam| saptamīśauṇḍai rityatra saptamītiyogavibhāgātsamāsasya vācyatvāt| ataeva naraśūra itiprayogasyāpi siddhistatravyākhyātetidik| pratipadīvadhānā ca ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate iti vācyam| sarpiṣo jñānam| jñovidarthasyeti ṣaṣṭhī| ṣaṣṭhīśeṣa ityapahāyānyāsarvā ṣaṣṭhī pratipadavidhānā| naca na nirddhāraṇe iti asya vaiyarthyam| yataśca nirddhāraṇamiti sūtrasya saptamīmātravidhāyakatvādviśeṣavihitasaptamyā sāmānyaprāptaṣaṣṭhyā bādho mābhūditi cakāreṇa tadabhyanu jñāne'pi ṣaṣṭhīśeṣe ityasyaiva tadvidhāyakatvāt| evaṃ svāmīśvaretyādāvapīti gṛhasvāmī sarveśvara ityādisiddham| atrāyaṃ siddhāntaḥ| jño'vidarthasyetyādi caturdaśasṛnryā divastadarthasyetyādiṣaṭ‌mūnryāṃ śeṣa ityanuvartate| tatra ca ṣaṣṭhī śeṣaityeva tatsidhyā tadvidhānaṃ niyamārtham| ṣaṣṭhībhavati śrūyate eva| ṣaṣṭhībhavatītyatyantāyogavyacchedasya śeṣavacanādeva siddheḥ| kriyāsaṃgatasyāpyevakārasyāyogavyavachedārthatvam| jñānamarthaṃgṛṇhātyevetyādau kvacittathā vyutpatteśca| yadvā ṣaṣṭhayeva bhavatīti niyamavyāvartyasya pūrvaprāptasya vibhaktyantarasyābhāvāllopaeva vyāvartyaḥ| tathā ca ṣaṣṭhīlopaprayojakaḥ samāsa eva na bhavatīti phalitārthaḥ| tasya ca tiṅante prāptyabhāvādeva vyāvarttyatvānupapatyā mātuḥ smaraṇamityādau ṣaṣṭhīlopābhāvastadarthaḥ| mātuḥ smaratītyudāharaṇaṃ ca vṛttikārādīnāṃ kṛdantasyaivopalakṣaṇamiti prāmāṇikāḥ| nacaivaṃ harismaraṇamityādīnāmanupapattiḥ| karmaṣaṣṭhyā samāsena tatsaṃbhavāt| naca viśeṣābhāvaḥ| tatra samāsāntodāttatvaṃ, karmaṣaṣṭhayā samāsetu kārakaparatvātkṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvamiti viśeṣāt| taduktaṃ vākyapadīye| kārakairvyapadiṣṭeca śrūyamāṇākriye punaḥ| proktā pratipadaṃ ṣaṣṭhī samāsasya nivṛttaye|| iti| apica mātuḥ smṛtamityatra naloketi karmaṣaṣṭhīniṣedhāt śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāścoktarītyā samāsābhāvādvākyasyaiva sādhutvam| taduktam| niṣṭhāyāṃ karmaviṣayā ṣaṣṭhī ca pratiṣidhyate| śeṣalakṣaṇayā ṣaṣṭhayā samāsastatra neṣyate|| tathāca pratipadavidhāneti niṣedho vyarthaḥ| tadapavādaḥkṛdyogācetyetadapi vyarthameva| katūkarmaṇoḥ kṛnītyatra tu śeṣa ityasya nivṛttyā karmaṇiṣaṣṭhīmaprāptāmevedaṃ vidhatte'ti tadyoge ṣaṣṭhīsamāso bhavatyeveti dik| pūraṇagumasuhitārthasadavyayatavyasamānādhikaraṇena || 11 || pūraṇādyarthaiḥ sadādibhiśca ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate| satāṃṣaṣṭhaḥ| pūraṇārthāḥ pratyayā eva gṛhyante iti prāguktam| guṇotiye kevalaṃ guṇe guṇaviśiṣṭadravye ca vartante teṣāmupādānam| candanasya gandha ityādau hi vaiyadhikaraṇayameva| natu kadāpi candanaṃ gandhaiti sāmānādhikaraṇyam| śuklādīnāṃ tu paṭasya śuklaiti śuklaḥpaṭa iti cobhayaṃ vyutpannam| yadyapi matublopādāśrayalakṣaṇayā vā sāmānādhaikaraṇyaṃ tacca gandhavaccandanamityādāvapi| tadāśrayāṃkṣedapratyayaḥ samānaḥ, tathāpi matupe vinā nāstītyayameva viśeṣaḥ| lakṣaṇāyāśca tatpadeṣu nirūḍhatvābhāvāt| ādhunikalakṣaṇāyāśca niṣedhāt| nanubhedābhedavādimate guṇābhedasyaiva dravye svīkārāttatrarūpādipade'tiprasaṅgaḥ syāditicenna| tairapipaṭorūpamitiprayogapratītyoranaṅgīkārāt| rūpatvādivyāpyadharmāṇāmevābhedapratiyogitāvacchedakatvamiti svīkārāt| tasmādekānupūrvyavacchinnasya yasya śabdasya guṇatadviśiṣṭadravyobhavabodhakatvaṃ teṣāmevāyaṃ nipedha iti candanagandhaḥ paṭarūpamityādau bhavatyeva samāsaḥ| nacapaṭasyaśaukalyamityatra niṣedho na syātsarvadā vyadhikaraṇatvāditi vācyam| yatpratipādyaguṇapratipādakaśabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyavaiyadhikaraṇyābhyāmanvayabodhakatvaṃ tenāpi saha samāsaniṣedhāt| astica śuklaguṇasyaprakṛtyarthāvacchedakadharmavācibhāvapratyayāntaguṇaviśiṣṭadravyavāci prakṛtikaśauklayapadapratipādyatvaṃ tat‌pratipādakaśuklapadasya cobhayathā bodhakatvāt| naca rūpapadapratipādyaguṇapratipādaka śuklapadamādāya tasyāpi niṣedhaḥ syāditi vācyam| samāna prakārakatvenapratipādakatvasyoktatvāt| nacaitāvān viśeṣaḥkuto labhyata iti vācyam| tatsthaiśca guṇaiḥ samāsaiti vārttikasya mānatvāt| guṇināsaha bhadenānvayabodhakatvasya tadarthatvāt| tasyacagumamātrasādhāraṇyena bhedamātreṇānvayabodhakatvalābhāt| naca brāhmaṇasya śukla iti nodāharaṇaṃ dantādinaiva saha sākāṅkṣatvāditi vācyam| prakaraṇādinā viśeṣyasya nirjñātatveśuklenāpi sāmarthyāt| sekhyāyāstu na niṣedhaḥ| śatasahasrāntāccaniṣkāt krośaśatayojanaśatayorupasaṃkhyānaṃ khārīśatamapi dadātīti munitrayokterjñāpakatvāt| anityaścāyaṃ guṇena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaniṣedhaḥ| uttarapadārthaprādhānyamityādimuniprayogāt tena yatnagauravādisiddhiḥ| suhitārthāstṛptyarthāḥ| phalānāṃ suhitāḥ| karaṇasya śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhī| na loketi niṣedhasya kṛdyogalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhīviṣayakatvāt| nanvevaṃ tṛtīyāsamāsena phalatṛpta ityāderāpattiḥ| phalairnānāvidhaiścitraiḥsvāduśītaiśca vāribhiḥ| tṛptāstāṃ bhrājathumatīṃ papracchuḥ kasya pūriyam| itibhaṭṭiprayogeṇa suhitārthayoge śeṣatvavivakṣaiveti niyamasya vaktumaśakyatvāt| naceṣṭāpattiḥ, niṣedhavaiyarthyāditi cenna paṣṭhyā samāse'ntodāttatva syāt| tṛtīyayā tu thāthādisvarāpavādastṛtīyākarmaṇīti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara iti viśeṣāt| pitṝnatārpsītaitiprayogeṇatṛpeḥ sakarmakasyā pisattvātkarmaṇiktapratyayasaṃbhavāt phalatarpaṇamityatra kārakātparatvenakṛduttarapadaprakatisvarācca| ataeva suhitārthayoge karaṇasyaśeṣatvavivakṣaivetyāhuritiharadattena tatrāparitoṣa udbhāvita ityāhuḥ| sat dvijasya kurvan, dvijasya kurvāṇaḥ| śeṣeṣaṣṭhī| corasya dviṣan| dviṣaḥ śaturvāvacanamitipakṣe karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| brāhmaṇasya paśyannityatra tu na prasaṅgo lādeśaprayoge ṣaṣṭhyā niṣedhāt| odanādyapekṣāyāścaśatrādyantena sahāsāmarthyāt| avyayaṃ brāhmaṇasya kṛtvā| tādarthyasya śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃṣaṣṭhī| brāhmaṇasaṃbandhinī kriyetyarthaḥ| evaṃ purā sūryasyodetorādheyaḥ| vakṣyamāṇatvāt| atra vṛkṣasyoparīti avyayatvātsamāsapratiṣedha iti kaiyaṭaharadattau| pūrvottarasāhacaryātkṛdavyayenaiva niṣedha iti rakṣitādayaḥ| ataevāvyayapadena kṛnmejantaḥ ktbātosunkasuna ityuktvāavyayakṛto gṛhyante itimādhevenoktam| tenayatkṛte'rīnnigṛṇhīmaḥ| tatpāṇimātmoparipātukaṃ tu ityādisiddham sarvapaścāditibhāṣyaprayogo'pyatrapramāṇam| tavyeti niranubandhagrahaṇāttavyatāsaha bhavatyeva samāsaḥ| gatikārakopapadāditi kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| tavyatastitvenāntasvaratatvam| tavyasya tvādyudāttatvātmadhyodāttatvaṃ syādirti viśeṣaḥ| samānādhikaraṇena śuklasya māṇavakasya, rājñaḥ pāṭaliputrakasya, pāṇineḥ sūtrakārasyeti bhāṣyam| mārāvi śadbo mākriyatā mityāha mārāvikaḥ| mārāvīti māṅ‌yuktasya rāvīti rudhātorbhāvociṇantasyānukaraṇam| tadāheti māśabdādibhya upasaṃkhyānamitiṭhak| mārāvidasyeti pāṭhe uktaśabdaṃ dadātīti na evārthaḥ| evaṃ takṣakasya sarpasyetyapyudāhāryam| anyadagre vakṣyāmaḥ| ktena ca pūjāyām || 12 || matibuddhītivihitaktāntena ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate| pūjārthānmatyādyarthācca tadvidhānātpūjayā tatsūtravihitaktapratyaya upalakṣpate| tenagatyādyarthaprakṛtikaktāntasyāpi niṣedhaḥ| rājñāṃ mato buddhaḥ pūjito vā| ktasyaca vartamāne itiṣaṣṭhī| kalahaṃsarāmamahitaḥ kṛtavānityādau tu kartuḥ seṣatve ṣaṣṭhī tataḥ samāsaḥ| śeṣa ṣaṣṭhayā samāse'ntodāttatvam| anyathākārakaparatvātkṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraitiviśeṣānna niṣedha iti kecit| anye tu bhūte ktāntātkartāri tṛtīyā| pūjito yaḥsurāsurairiti darśanāt| kṛrtṛkaraṇe kṛtābahulamiti samāsaḥ| tenetyadhikāre uṣajñāta itinirdeśena vartamāktaprayogānurodhena sāmānyāpekṣatvāśrayaṇādityāhuḥ| adhikaraṇavācinā ca || 13 || ktena ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate| idameṣāṃmāsitaṃ gataṃ bhuktaṃ vā| kto'dhikaraṇecotiktaḥ| adhikaraṇavācinaścetikartari ṣaṣṭhī| vācigrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham| kiṃvṛttaṃ yadvṛttaṃ mityādau bhāve ktaḥ vyadhikaraṇe bahubrīhiḥ| tadvākartari ktaḥ| tṛtīyāsamāsa ityāhuḥ| karmaṇi ca || 14 || cakāra itiśabdārthaḥ| karmaṇīti saptamyantānukaraṇam| taṃśabdamuccārya vihitā ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate| ubhayaprāptau karmaṃṇīti sūtravihiteti yāvat| citraṃ gavāṃ doho'gopena| atra tanniyamātkarmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| athaśabdānuśāmanamityatra tu kartṛkarmaṇorityeva ṣaṣṭhī| śabdānāmanuśāsanaṃ natvarthānāmityarthe kartṛviśeṣanivṛttāvatātparyāt| ato nāyaṃ niṣedha ityāhuḥ| etadabhiprāyeṇaiva athātobrahmajijñāsetyatra kalpatarāvuktam-prakṛte tubrahmakarmatvamebopādīyate natu kartṛmato'tiśaya iti ubhayaprāptyabhāvātkartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛtītyeva ṣaṣṭhī| tena brahmajijñāsetyupapannaḥ samāsaiti| kecittu tatrākākārayoḥ strīpratyayayoḥ pratiṣedha ityāśrityobhayaprāptāvityasya bādhāt kartṛkarmaṇoriti ṣaṣṭhī| ataḥ samāsa ityāhuḥ| prasaktimātramubhayorapekṣitaṃ natu śābdamupādānamiti tadabhiprāyaḥ| ataevaśeṣaṣaṣṭhyā samāsaitipakṣo'pi kaiyaṭādibhiruktaḥ| kecityaviśeṣeṇa vibhāṣeti pakṣasyāpi tatravakṣyamāṇatvānniyamāpravṛttipakṣe idamityāhuḥ| tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari || 15 || kartrarthatṛjakābhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyā na samāsaḥ tṛcaḥ kartrarthatvāvyabhicārāt| kartarītyakasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ apāṃ sraṣṭā vajrasyabhartā| nacayājakāditvādbhartṛśabde samāsaḥ śaṅvyaḥ| patyarthasyaiva tatra grahaṇāt| odanasya pācakaḥ kartari kim| ikṣūṇāṃ bhakṣaṇamikṣubhakṣikā| paryāyārharṇotpattiṣu ṇvuc| dhātvarthanirdeśe ṇvul‌vā| atha kathaṃ ghaṭānāṃ nirmātustribhuvanavidhātuśca kalahaḥ nijatninetrāvataratvabodhikāmityādi| atra nyāsakāraḥ| tṛnsamāso'yam| nacatatra naloketi ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhaḥ| prakṛtasūtre'nubandhanirdeśena tadanityatvasiddhorityāha-śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāsamāsa iti kaiyaṭādayaḥ| anyetu janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ, tatprayojako hetuścetyādinirdeśādayaṃ niṣedho'nitya ityāhuḥ| kartari ca || 16 || kartṛṣaṣṭhayā akena saha samāso na syāt| bhavataḥ śāyikā| paryāyārharṇetiṇvuc| tṛco yoge karturabhidhānena kartṛṣaṣṭhayā'nupapattyā nātra tṛco'nuvṛttiḥ| nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ || 17 || arthadvaye ṣaṣṭhī nityaṃ samasyate| nacātra niṣedhasyaiva nityatvānvayaḥ sannihitatvāditi vācyam| tasya pratiṣedhārambhasāmarthyādeva nityatvāt| vidheścavaikalpikatvena tasyaiva nityatvānvaye vacanasārthakyāt| udṛlikapuṣpabhāñjikā| saṃjñāyāmiti bhāve ṇvul| krīḍāviśeṣasyeyaṃ saṃjñākirmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| jīvikāyāṃ dantalekhakaḥ| krīḍāyāṃ vikalpa jīvikāyāṃ tṛjakābhyāṃ mityatra kartarīti ṣaṣṭhayā viśeṣaṇaṃ natu pratyayayoḥ| naca kartrarthakatṛcā yoge kartṛṣaṣṭhayā asaṃbhavāttad‌grahaṇabaiyarthyam| tasyottarārthatvāt kartariceti sūtre hi kartṛgrahaṇaṃ tṛjakayorviśeṣaṇam| kartrarthakābhyāṃ tṛjakābhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate iti| etanmate'pi phalitārthaḥ| prāguktārthena tulya eva| kintu sūtradvaye'rthavyanyaya iti viśeṣaḥ| nityaṃ krīḍetisūtre akapratyayamātramudāharaṇamiti tulyam| vāmanastu ramaṇīyakarteti jīvikāyāmapi tṛcā samāsamāha| akejīvikārthe itisūtre'kaiti kimityuktvā tatpratyudāharaṇāt| krīḍāyāṃ lakṣaṇābhāvena tṛjabhāve'pi jīvikāyāṃ ṇvul‌tṛcāviti tṛco'pisulabhatvāt| ataeva tṛjuttarārtha iti vyākhyātam| anyathā karmaṇiceti sūtre tadvicchede'trāpyananuvṛttiprasaṅgadityāhuḥ| kugatiprādayaḥ || 18 || kuśadvo gatisaṃjñāḥ prādayaśca samarthena nityaṃ samasyante| kuśabdaḥ pāpārtho'tragṛhyate napṛthivyarthaḥ| avyayasāhacaryāt| avyaye nañ‌kunipātānāmiti vārtikoktyā tasyāpyavyayatvāt| kupuruṣaḥ kutsitaḥ puruṣaityarthaḥ| īṣadartheceti koḥ kādeśavidhānāttatrāpi samāsaḥ| ūrīkṛtya| prādigrahaṇamagartyatham| tatra viṣayavibhāgo vārttikairuktaḥ-svatī pūjāyām| subhujā| atirājā napūjanāditi samāsāntaniṣedhaḥ| atisiktameva bhavatetyatikramaṇe'pyatiḥ samasyate iti kaiyaṭaḥ| atiratikramaṇeceti karmapravacanayitvātṣatvābhāvaḥ| suṣṭuvamipyatropasargatvātaṣatvam| dur‌nindāyām| durgavaḥ| samāsāntaṣṭac| āṅīṣadarthe| ākaḍāraḥ| kriyāyoge tu gatitvātsamāsaḥ| āmandrairindraharibhiryāhi mayūraromabhirityatra tu sāmarthye'piindraṃ pratyagatitvāttadgateṣadarthatvābhāvācca na samāsaḥ| prādayo gatādyarthe prathamayā| pragata ācāryaḥ prācāryaḥ| prāntevāmī prapitāmahaḥ| vṛttiviṣaye gatādyarthavṛttīnāṃ prādīnāṃ gatitvābhāve'pi prādigrahaṇasāmarthyātsamāsaḥ| atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyayā| atikrānto mālāmatimālaḥ| avādayaḥ kṛṣṭādyarthe tṛtīyayā| avakṛṣṭaḥ kokilayā'vakokilaḥ| paryādayoglānādyarthe caturthyā| pariglāno'dyayayanāya paryadhyayanaḥ| alaṃ kumāryai alaṃkumāriḥ| ekavibhakticetyupasarjanatvāt hrasvaḥ nityasamāsatve'pi caturthīvidhānasāmarthyātpakṣe vākyam| ataevatatsūtre'laṃkumāryaialakumārirīti bhāṣyam| dīkṣitāstu nāyametadviṣayaḥ| prādisamāsasyāyaṃ prapañca iti siddhāntāt| alaṃśabdasya ca prāditvavirahāt| kintu dviguprāptāpannālaṃpūrvetyanena jñāpyamāno'lapūrvastatpuruṣo'trasūtre pṛthaggatigrahaṇātparyāptyartenāpi tena bhavannabhidhaānānurodhāccaturthyantenaiva bhavati| tasya cānityatvaṃ nirbādhamevetyāhuḥ| nirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe pañcamyā| niṣkāntaḥ kauśambyā niṣkauśāmbiḥ| naca prādigrahaṇasyāgatyarthatvātkarmapravacanīyānāmapi samāsāpattiḥ| karmapravacanīyānāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavya iti vacanena tadvāraṇāt| vṛkṣe prati vidvyotate vidyut| atha kathamadhītyeti| adhiparī anarthakāviti karmapravacanīyatvāditicet atra kecit| adhyāpakadhūrtairiti nirdeśādanityo niṣedhaḥ| ataeva sustutamatistutamiti ṣatvābāve'pi samāsaḥ kaiyaṭādāvuktaḥ ityāhuḥ| adhītya snātveti khaṭvākṣepesūtragatabhāṣyaprāmāṇyāditi tatvam| avyayaṃpravṛddhādibhiḥ samasyata itivaktavyam| punaḥ pravṛddhaṃ bahirbhavati| punargavam| punaḥ sukham| ivena vibhaktyalopa ityādi| avyayamavyayena prapayajñapatimiti| udāttavatā gatimatā ca tiṅā'vyayaṃ samasyate itivaktavyam| anuvyacalat| yatpariyanti| etattatvaṃ sahasupetyatroktam| upapadamatiṅ || 19 || upapadaṃ subantaṃ samarthena nityaṃ samasyate| atiṅantaśca samāsaḥ| kumbhakāraḥ| atiṅiti kim| mā bhavān bhūt| anyathā māṅiluṅiti saptamīnirdiṣṭasya māṅaupapadatvālluṅantena samāsaḥsyāt| yadyapi ihasūtre'tiṅiti nopapadaviśeṣaṇam| kintusamāsasyaiveti spaṣṭatayā bhāṣye noktam| tathāpi anavaklūptyeti sūtre kiṃvṛttasyānadhikārādarkivṛttagrahaṇānarthakyamityuktvā upapadaṃsaṃjñārthamityāśaṅvaya atiṅiti samāsapratiṣedhātsaṃjñānarthakyamiti siddhāntitatvāllabhyate| pūrvasūtre'pi gatītipṛthak‌kṛtyātiṅiti pṛthak‌yojyam| tenaprapatatītyādau na samāsaḥ| nacasupsupetyadhikārādeva tiṅantavyāvṛttiriti vācyam| supsupetyasya nivṛttijñāpanārthatvāt| subiti prathamāntaṃ tvanuvartate eva| anyathā rājadarśītyādau pūrvapadasyāsubantatvānnalopo nasyāt| nirgata itirutvam| saṃyyante tiparasavarmavikalpaśca na syāt| sup‌suṣeti nivṛttamitibhāṣyasya tu ekadeśanivṛttāveva tātparyamiti keyaṭādayaḥ| nanu kārako gata ityatra tumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāṃ iti kartuṃ gata ityarthe gataśabde upapade ṇvul‌vidhānātsamāsa nivṛttyarthaṃ akriyārthabhatiṅgrahaṇamastu| anyathā gatakāraka iti syāt| akriyetyukte tu prakṛtivācyakriyāśrayapratyayoptatyā kriyāvācitvānna samāsa iticennā| atiṅiti subantaviśeṣaṇatayā subantasya dravyavācitvena kriyārthatvābhāvāt| kṛdante prakṛtyarthasya kriyāyāḥ pratyayārthe kartari viśeṣaṇatvāt| ataeva gataśabde samāsyāpyaprasaktiḥ| dhātumātrasyopapadatvāt| dhātośca kriyāvācitvāttadāśrayapratyayotpatteḥ| naca tarhidhātoreva samāsaḥ syāditi vācyam| pratyayārthena saha saṃsṛṣṭasya niḥ kṛṣya samāsasyāśakyatvāt subantatvābhāvācca| nacakārakasya gatirityatra bhāvapratyayasya kriyāvācakatvāttadantena samāsaniṣedhārthaṃ atiṅgrahaṇaṃ syāditi vācyam| tatrāpi pratyayena sattvarūpatāpannākriyābhidhānāt| sādhyarūpakriyāyā dhātumātrabodhyatvāt| subantasya kriyāvācitvābhāvāt| kriyāvācinaśca subantattvābhāvāt| kṛdabhihito bhāvo dravyavatprakāśata itinyāyāt| dravyadharmānliṅga saṃkhyādīn gṛṇhātītyarthāt| anyadagre vakṣyāmaḥ| tasmātsupetyasya nivṛttireva tatprayojanam| tena gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāgsubusatteriti paribhāṣā jñāpyate| ekadeśānumatidvārā samastaparibhāṣāyā lakṣyānurodhena jñāpanasaṃbhavāt| gatīnāṃ yathā| vyājighratīti vyāghrī| āto'nupasarge kaḥ| naca pāghroti śapratyayāpattiḥ| jighrateḥ saṃjñāyāṃ pratiṣedhārambhāt| viāiti upasargadvayasya ghraśabdāt supo'nutpattāveva tena samāsaḥ| anyathāsvārthadravyaliṅgasaṃkhyākārakāṇāṃ krameṇa pratyaya iti prakriyāmāśritya pūrvaṃ liṅgākāṅkṣādhrauvyeṇa tannimittakapratyayo lakṣaṇāntarābhāvāṭṭābeva syāt| ghraśabdamātrasya jātivācakatvābhāvāt| ṅīṣaśca sūkarītyādau sāvakāśatvāt| paścādratisamāse vyāghrāśabdasya jātivācitve'pi adantatvābhāvāt ṅīṣ na syāt subutpatteḥ prāgeva samāse tu vyāghraśabdasya pūrvaṃsiddhau jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ siddhaḥ| naca tatrasāmānyanimittaṭābāpattiḥ| antaraṅgatvātsamāsasyaiva pravṛttaiḥ taduttaraṃ ṅīṣaiva tadbādhāt| evaṃ kārakāṇāṃ alpairabhrailiṃptāabhraliptī kartṛkaraṇekṛtā bahulamiti samāsaḥ| tataḥ karaṇapūrvādityanuvartamāne ktādalpākhyāyāmiti ṅīp| yadi subutpatyanantaraṃ sa syāttadā pūrvaṃṭābutpattau ṅīṣ na syāt| ata ityadhikārāt| naca vacanasāmarthyam| abhraurviliptādyauriti vākyāvasthāyāmapi ṅīṣāpatteḥ| pūrvaśabdasya vyavasthāvacanatvam| ataityasya prātipadikādityasya cādhikārasya vādho veti kalpyatvāt| sāhi tasya dhanakrītetyādyanupapatteḥ| nanutvadrītyāpi uktaprayogo'nupapanna eva| evaṃdadhisecāvityādausātpadādyoriti ṣatvaniṣedhaśca nasyāditi cet| atrāhuḥ| kvacitsubutpattāvapi kārakasamāso bhavatīti supetyasyanivṛttāveva tātparyaṃ natu supaḥ prāgeva samāsa ityatra| tathāca kāryānurodhātkvacidutpanne kvaciccānutpatre supi samāsa iti| dadhimecāvityatra tunirupapadātsecayateḥ kvapi kṛte ṣaṣṭhīsamāse'pi siddhamiti prāguktam| upapadānāṃ yathā kacchena pibati kacchapī| supītiyogavibhāgātkaḥ| ātonupasarge iti kapratyayaḥ| jātinimittatvenāvayavārthabādhasyāvaśyakatvāditi kaiyaṭaḥ| vyāghrīvadvyākhyeyam| yattu atiṅityupapadaviśeṣaṇaṃ tena pradhānahārako vrajatityatra neti tanna| prathamāntamub‌grahaṇasyāpi nivṛttiprasaṅgāt| amaivāvyayena || 20 || ammātravidhāyakasūtre yatsaptabhīnirdiṣṭaṃ tadevopapadaṃ avyayena samasyate iti niyamo'yaṃ| idaṃcāmaivetyasyāvṛttyā nirūpitvasya tṛtīyārthatvāt| tasyacopapadaviśeṣaṇatvāllabhyate| ammātranirūpitaṃ yasyopapadatvaṃ tadavyayena samasyate iti paryavasānāt| tāvanmātrasya ca pūrveṇaiva siddhatvānniyamavidhisvābhāvyāttadeva samasyata ityarthasiddhiḥ| evaṃca tulyavidhānamityadhyāhāro nād‌raṇīyaḥ| svāduṃkāram| saṃpannaṃkāram| lavaṇaṃkāram| syādumiṇamulitisvā dugrahaṇasyārthaṃparatvāt| nipātanātpūrvapade māntatvam| atra pratyayāntaravidhyabhāvātsvāduśadvasyām‌mātranirūpitamupapadatvam| ataevāvyayāntaraṃ pratyupapadatvābhāvādamaiva samāsaḥ| agrebhojam| agrebhuktvā| atra tu vibhāṣāgreprathamapūrvoṣviti ktvāṇamulorvidhānānna tanmātranirūpitaṃ tat iti na samāsaḥ| ubhayanirūpitopapadasaṃjñāyā bhinnatve mānābhāvāt| niyamaphalaṃtu kālasamayavelāsu tumun| kālo bhoktumityādau mābhūt| avyayeneti kim| kum‌bhakāra ityādau kumbhādeḥ samāsanivṛttirmābhūt| anyathā amaṃ pratyeva yasyopapadatvaṃ tadevopapadaṃ samasyate itiniyamaparyavasānaprasaṅgāt| naca pūrvasūtrasyānavaka śatvādavyayaparatvaṃ niyamasya bhiviṣyatīti vācyam| amantena saha ya upapadasamāsaḥ so'maiva tulyavidhānasyeti niyamāpatteḥ| agrebhojamityādau samāsābhāve'pi agrebhuktvā kāle bhoktumityatra durvāratvāt| tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyām|| 21 || upadaṃśastṛtīyāyāmityādau yānyupapadāni tāni avyayena saha vā samasyante| ubhayatra vibhāṣeyam| mūlakopadaṃśaṃ bhuṅkte mūlakenopadaṃśaṃ bhuṅkte ityatramāpte, avyayeyathā bhipretākhyāne kṛñaḥktvāṇamulāvityatrobhayavidhau uccaiḥ kāramācaṣṭe ityatra tvaprāpte vidhānāt| ihasamāse gatikārakopapadāditi kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| asamāse tu uccairityantodāttam| ādirṇamulyanyatarasyāmitikāramityādyudāttam| amā sahaivāyam| nehāparyāpto bhoktum| paryāptivacaneṣvititumun| ktvāca || 22 || tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyupapadāni ttktvāpratyayena vā samasyante| samāsapakṣe lyap| uccaiḥ kṛtya uccaiḥ kṛtvā| avyaye'yathābhipretetittkā| tṛtīyeti kim| alaṃkṛtvetyādi| śeṣo bahuvrīhiḥ || 23 || adhikāro'yam śeṣaḥ kim| unmagaṅgam| yeṣāṃ padānāṃ yasminnarthe saṃjñāntaraṃ noktaṃ teṣāṃ tad‌rthe yaḥ samāsaḥ sa bahuvrīhiḥ| nacākaḍārādekā saṃjñeti ninavakāśatvādabyayībhāvādisaṃjñā bhaviṣyantīti vācyam| prāk‌kaḍārātparaṃkāryamiti pāṭhe paratvādbahuvrīhisaṃjñāprasaṅgāt| ekasaṃjñādhikāre tu trikataḥ śeṣo bhāṣye vyākhyātaḥ| tathāhi| dvitīyāśritetyārabhya dvitīyādīnāṃ trikāṇāṃ ṣaṣṇāṃsamāsauktaḥ| tataśca prathamāyāḥ śeṣatve prathamāntānāṃ padānāṃ bahuvrīhirityarthāsamānādhikaraṇānāmityapi siddham| kaṇṭhekālaityādau tu saptamyāḥ pūrvanipātavidhānājjñāpakādbahuvrīhiḥ| iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau dvitīyasyādhyāyasya dvitīye pāde prathamamāhnikam| śrīḥ | dvitīyapāde dvitīyamāhnikam|| 2 || anekamanyapadārthe || 24 || anekaṃ suvantamanyasya padasyārthe vartamānaṃ vā samasyate sa bahuvrīhiḥ| anyapadaṃ samasyamānapadadvayabhinnaparam| samasyamānapadadvayaṃca prathamāntam| trikataḥ śeṣasyoktatvāt| tadbhinnapadaṃca dvitīyādyantaṃ tadarthaśca karmatvādi tasya prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇatvena pratīyamānatvāt| ataeva paṭhanti aprathamāvibhaktyarthecāyamiti| tathāca dvitīyādyarthaviśiṣṭa eva bahuvrīhyarthaḥ| prāptamudakayaṃ sa prāptodako grāmaḥ| ūḍho ratho yena sa ūḍharatho'naṅvān| upahṛtaḥ paśuryasmaisa upahṛnapaśū rudraḥ| uddhṛta odano yasyāḥ sā ud‌dhṛtādanā sthālī| citrā gāvo yasya sa citragurdevadattaḥ| vīrāḥ puruṣā yasmin sa vīrapuruṣo grāmaḥ| atra sarvatra karmatvādiviśiṣṭasya grāmāderlābhaḥ udakakartṛkaprāptikarma rathakarmakāvahanakartā paśukarmakopaharaṇoddeśyaḥ| odanakarmakoddharaṇāvādhiḥ| citragavīsvāmī| vīrābhinnapuruṣādhikaraṇa ityādivodhāt| ato vṛṣṭe deve gata ityādau padadvayasya bhāvalakṣamasaptamyantasya samayaparicchedadvārā gamanakriyārūpānyapadārthatātparyakatve'pi gamane vṛṣṭidhvasottarakālīnatvasyaiva pratītyā karmatvādibodhābhāvānna bahuvrīhiḥ| etena citrāgāvo yasyeti vigrahe gavāṃ prādhānyam| samāse tu svāminaitivṛttivākyayorviśeṣyabhedaḥ syāt| ataścitrāṇāṃ gabāmayamityādireva vigraha iti mīmāṃsakoktaṃ parāstam| samasyamānapadayoḥ prathamāntatvaṃ vinābahuvrīhereva durlabhatvāt| matvarthe bahuvrīhiriti kātyāyana vacanavirodhācca| tadasyāstīti prathamāntādastyarthe vartamānānmatupo vidhānāt| vṛttivākyayorviśeṣyabhedasyāprayojakatvāt| tathāca kvacidguṇapradhānatvamarthānāmavivakṣitamitiprakramya hariṇoktam| ākhyātaṃ taddhitakṛtoryātkiñcidupadarśakam| guṇapradhānabhāvādau tatra dṛṣṭo viparyaya iti|| akṣairdīvyati ākṣikaḥ| vyākaraṇamadhīte vaiyākaraṇaḥ| pacatīti pācakaḥ| vigrahe kartuḥ kriyāyāṃ guṇībhūtatve'pi vṛttau viśeṣyatvena pratyayāt| bhāvanā ca teṣāṃ tiṅavācyā asmākaṃ tu dhātvartha iti viśeṣaḥ| māsāja ityatra vṛttivākyayoviṃśeṣyabhedaḥ prāgeva vyākhyātaḥ| ataeva sarvatantreṣu citrā gāvo yasyetyeva vigraho darśyate iti dik| anekagrahaṇaṃ bahūnāṃ samāsasiddhyartham| tathācasamarthasūtre bhāṣyam| susūkṣmajaṭakeśena sunatājinavāsasā| samantraśitirandhreṇa dvayorvṛttau na siddhayati|| catuḥpado'yaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ| ḍhayāpoḥ saṃjñāchandasorityatra bahulavacanājjaṭāśabde hrasvaḥ| yadvā tripadabahuvrīrhi kṛtvā paścātkeśa śabdena bahuvrīhiḥ| evaṃ suṣṭu nate vāso yatreti vyākhyeyam| samantrāni śitīti rantdhraṇi yasyeti vigrahaḥ| nanutripade bahuvrīhau pūrvaśālāpriyaḥ pañcagavadhana ityatra śālāśabdasyodāttatvaṃ samāsāntaśca yadyapi uttarapanimitakatatpuruṣasaṃjñayā siddhyati| tathāpi khādirī itarā śamyā yasyeti khādiretaraśamyamityatra khādirīśabdasya puṃvadbhāvo na syāt| uttarapadasya tataḥ paratvābhāvāditicet na| tatretarā cāsau śamyāceti karmadhāraya kṛtvā khādirīitaraśamyā'syeti dvipadasyaiva bahuvrīherbācyatvāt| khādirīpadasya vikārataddhitāntatvāddhṛddhinimittasyeti pratiṣedhasyāpravṛtteḥ| atha pūrvaśālāpriyaityādāvapavādatvādvahuvrīhīsvaro durvāraḥ| naca viṣayabhedādvirodhābhāvaḥ| tasyāvavayavāśrayatayā'ntaraṅgatvenabahuvrīhisvarasyaivāpateḥ naca samucvayena nirvāhaḥ, anudāttaṃpadamekavarjamiti padadvaye udāttadvayānupapatteḥ| nacāntaraṅgatvaṃ na svarabalīyastve hetuḥ bahiraṅgeṇāpi satiśiṣṭena svareṇa bādhāditi vācyam| tathāpi nimittasvarānnimittisvaro balīyāniti bahuvrīhau svāvayavottarapadāśraye pūrvayostatpuruṣe nimittatayā bahuvrīhimvaraṃ bādhitvā tatpuruṣasvarasyavopapatteḥ| naca nimittisvarabalīyastve mānābhāvaḥ| yuktārohyādiṣvekaśitipācchabdapāṭhasya mānatvāt| anyathaikaśabdasya kannantatvāt| yadvā svāṅgaśiṭāmityādyudāttatvāt ekaḥ śitiḥ pādo yasyeti tripade bahuvrīhau taddhitārtheti dvayostatpuruṣe ca tatsvaraṃ bādhitvā bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadādyudāttasiddhau tadarthasya pāṭhasya vaiyarthyāt| nanvekaḥ śitiḥ pādo yasyeti pūrvapade karmadhārayagarbhe bahuvrīhāvigante dvigāviti pūrvapadādyudāttatvam| ekaḥ śitiryeṣāṃ te ekaśitayaḥ pādā yasyeti pūrvapade bahuvrīhigarbhe bahuvrīhāvāpi bahuvrīhau prakṛtyeti vatsiddhamiti yuktyārohyādaṣvekaśitīpācchabdapāṭhapratyākhyānātkathaṃ tasya jñāpakatvamiticetsatyam| tathāpi nimittasvarānnimittisvaro balīyānityasya vācanikatvāṅgīkārāt| naca susūkṣmajaṭakeśenetyādau tripade bahuvrīhau pṛrvapadadvayasya tatpuruṣasaṃjñāyāmantodāttāpatiriti vācyam| nahi bahuvrīhyavayavasya tatpuruṣatvamatra vidheyam| kintu lakṣaṇāntareṇa yasya tatpuruṣasaṃjñāprāptetyanuvādaḥ| dik‌saṃkhyayostu taddhitārthottarapadeti tatpuruṣasaṃjñāvidhānavaiṣamyam| naca tatrāpi viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeti tadvidhānamiti vācyam| samudāyasya vṛtāvavayavasya saṃjñāntaraṃ viśeṣavacanaṃ vinā na pravartate iti bahulavacanātsiddheḥ| anyathāpūrvaśālāpriya ityatrāpi vacanāntareṇa siddheruttarapade pare tatpuruṣavidhānavaiyarthyāt| nanvemapyadhikaṣāṣṭhivarṣa ityatra tripade bahuvrīhau adhikagrahaṇaṃ cālukīti adhikaśabdasya saṃkhyāsaṃjñatvāttaddhitārthottarapadeti padadvayasya tatpuruṣe'ntodāttatā syāt| maivam| igante dvigāviti pūrvapadādyudāttasiddhiḥ| nanvadhikaśatavarṣa ityatra doṣatādavasthyam| adhikaṣaṣṭhiḥ ityatrāpi ḍacprakaraṇe tatpuruṣe saṃkhyāyā upasaṃkhyānāmiti ḍacprasaṅgaḥ| kiñca taddhitārthottarapadeti tatpuruṣaṃ bādhitvā saṃkhyayāvyayeti bahuvrīhau bahuvrīhausaṃkhyeyeiti ḍac‌prasaṅga iti cenna| upasaṃkhyānasya gotriṃśadityādyanurodhenāvyayādimātraparatvāt| adhikaṣaṣṭhirvarṣāṇāmasyeti vigrahe ṣaṣṭhipadasya saṃkhyāparatayā saṃkhyeyaparatvābhāvācca| nacaivaṃ varṣāṇāṃ saṃkhyeyatvādanekamanyapadārthe iti bahuvrīhiprasaṅgaḥ| tasyasaṃkhyeyavṛttitvācca ḍajapi vayasvinyabhidheye bahuvrīhigarbhabahuvrīhiprasaṅgaśceti vācyam| vṛttiviṣaye dvyekayorityādinirdeśena daśādīnāmapi saṃkhyāmātraparatvātsaṃkhyeyasyānyapadārthaṃtvātsaṃkhyottarapadasya bahuvrīheḥ pratyākhyānāt| avyavikanyāyenādhikā ṣaṣṭhirvarṣāṇāmiti vākyameveti svīkārāt| nacaivamapyadhikaśatavarṣaityatra takārākārasyaivodātttvaṃ syānnatvadhikaśabdasyādyudāttatvamiti vācyam| tasya yuktārohyādiṣu draṣṭavyatvāt| syādetat| anekagrahaṇaṃ citragurityādāvuttarapadasyāpyupasarjanasaṃjñārthamevāstviti cenna| ekavibhakticāpūrvanipāta ityevasiddheḥ| citragumānayetyādau samāsārthasya vibhaktyantarayoge'pi citrā gāvo yasyeti vigrahe samasyamānapadayoḥ prathamāntatvaniyamāt| nacaivaṃ rājñaḥ kumārī rājakumārī tāṃ paśyetyādid‌rśanātkumārīśabdasyāpi niyatavibhaktitvādatiprasaṅga iti vācyam| tatra dvitīyādyantenāpi kumārīśabdena vigrahopagamāt| tattatprayogavyaktau sarvasyāpyekavibhaktitvātsamāsatvavyāpyadharmāvacchinnaṃyattatpuruṣādi tannirūpitavigrahatvāvacchedena yasyaikavibhaktitvamityarthaparyavasānāt| atha prathamāntena vigraha ityeva pakṣo yuktaḥ| anyathā karmatvādeḥ samāsenaivābhihitatvādrājakumārīṃ paśyetyādau dvitīyādikaṃ na syāt| ataḥ prātipadikārthamātravivakṣāyāṃ prathamaṃ prathamayā saṃskṛtvā tataḥ paśyetyādisambandhavivakṣāyāṃ dvitīyādikamanupapannam| apicoktavibhaktoḥ samāsabahirbhūtāyāḥ kathaṃ vigrahe praveśaḥ| evaṃ pūraṇaguṇetisūtre samānādhikaraṇena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaniṣedho'pi vyarthaḥ| tathāhi takṣakasya sarpasyetyatra viṣādirūpasamāsabāhyapadārthāpekṣā ṣaṣṭhī tathāca kaṭo'pi karma bhīṣmādayo'pīti pakṣe dvayorapi ṣaṣṭhyanvaye paścātprātipadikārthayoḥ parasparāvacchedaḥ| tataśca ṣaṣṭhyantayormitho'sāmarthyaṃ spaṣṭam| tataśca prathamāntayoreva samāsaprasaṅgastatra bahulavacanānneti prāguktam| evaṃ rājñaḥ kumāryā ityatra dvayoḥ ṣaṣṭhyantātpūrvanipātaniyamo na syādityāśaṅkāpi mandā| kumārīśabde prathamāntatvāvaśyakatvāt| ataḥ prathamāntenaiva vigraho yukta iti prāpte ucyate| samāsottaraśrutasya dvitīyāderapi dvitīyapadottaraṃ vigrahe praveśa upasthitatvāt bādhakābhāvāt| anyathā vigrahe niyatavibhaktitvenopasarjanasaṃjñāyāṃ kumārīśabdāderhasvāpatteḥ| sādhakatvācca| ataeva bahuvrīhiprakṛtikādvitīyādervigrahe vartipadotaraṃ na prayogaḥ| svāmigatakarmatvādyabodhakatvena viruddhārthakatvāt| ataevaca karmatvādernasamāsenābhidhānam| anupraveśamātreṇa vācyatve pacantīti pācakā ityatra bahutvasyāpi kṛdarthatvāpatteḥ| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsakarmadhārayādeḥ sarvavibhaktisādhāraṇyena vibhaktiviśeṣārthānāṃ tattadarthakukṣāvantarbhāvayitumaśakyatayā sarvasādhāraṇasyaivārthasya tadbodhakalpanaucityāt| karmadvādeścānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tattadvibhaktibodhyatvāt| ataeva dvitīyārthe bahuvrīhau karmatvādervartipadārtādeva dharmiviśeṣaṇatvena pratītatvāt| udakakartṛkaprāptikriyānirūpitakarmatvādibodhārthaṃ nadvitīyādiḥkintu kriyāntanirūpitakarmatvādibodhārthaṃ nadvitīyādiḥkintu kriyāntaranirūpitakarmatvādibodhārthameveti niyamaḥ| evaṃ nīlotpalasyetyādau ṣaṣṭhyā vigrahe'pi na saṃbandhasya samāse praveśaḥ| tadaṃśe vivaraṇatvābhāvāt| ata eva niṣedhasārthakyaṃ pārṣṭhikaparasparāvacchede'pi sāmarthyasyānapāyāt| `mitrāvaruṇāvṛttāvṛdhā' mityatra prathamaṃ dvayoḥ kriyānvaye'pi pārṣṭhikābhedamādāyaiva sāmarthyena parāṅgavadbhāvasya pūrvamupapāditatvācca| vastutaḥ kārakavibhaktīnāmeva kriyāyānvayaniyamāt| tadantānāmeva kaṭo'pi karmeti nyāvena kriyānvaye paścānmitho'vacchedaḥ| ṣaṣṭhyāstu kārakavibhaktitvābhāvātprathamameva nāmārthānvayaḥ tasyāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyādvibhaktiriti pakṣasyaiva vyavasthitatvāt| ata eva ṣaṣṭhyāḥ kriyayānvayātpūrvameva nāmārthānvayādaśvābhidhānīmityādau viśiṣṭoddeśe'pi na vākyabhedaḥ| ataeva samānādhikaraṇamasamarthamiti vācanikamitisiddhāntaḥ| ataeva sarpiṣaḥ pīyamānasyeti samānādhikaraṇaṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhodāharaṇaṃ bhāṣyakṛdbhiruktam| adhātvabhihitamiti vācanikān sāmarthyapratiprasavāditi tadabhiprāyaḥ| evaṃca pañcakaṃ prātipadikārtha itipakṣe dvitīyādayo yathā prātipadikottaraṃ dyotakatayaivopayujyaṃte tathā rājakumārīmityādāvapīti kleśo'pyanāśrayaṇīyaḥ| evamalaukikavigrahe'pi laukikavigrahavadeva vibhaktiḥ tasmātpariniṣṭhitavibhaktyā vigrahapakṣo'pyaduṣṭa iti tiṣṭhatu vistaraḥ| anyagrahaṇaṃ kim| vartipadārthapradhānye sāvakāśasya tatpuruṣasyānyapadārthe bahuvrīhiṇā paratvādbādho yathā syāt| anyathā nīle tpalaṃ sara ityādau samānādhikaraṇasthale bahuvrīhereva bādhāpatteḥ| kaṇṭhekālaityādau vyadhikaraṇasthale bahuvrīheḥ sāvakāśatvāt| padagrahaṇa rki vākyārthe mābhūt| grāhavatī nadīti| asya hi mā snāsīriti tātparyagamyo vākyārthaḥ| arthagrahaṇaṃ kim| kṛtsne padārthe yathā syāt| anyathā ṣaṣṭhyarthasaṃbandhamātramarthaḥ syāt tathāca devadattādisāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt nāmārthayorbhedānvayāyogāt| trikataḥ śeṣasyoktatayā samānādhikaraṇānāmeva bahuvrīhiḥ| nehe| pañcabhirbhṛktamasya| pañca bhuktavanto yasyetyatrāpi na bhavatyana bhidhānāt| avyayānāṃ vācyaḥ| uccairmukhaḥ uccaiḥ śabdasyādhikaraṇaśaktipredhānatvādvaiyadhikaraṇyādaprāptau vacanamiti kaiyaṭādayaḥ| anyetu prathamāntatvamātrasyehāpi sattvādakartavyamevedam| ata eva vāk ca dṛṣcca priyā yasyeti tripade bahuvrīhau kṛte'vāntaradvandvo'bhāyupagataḥ| prādibhyo dhātujasya bahuvrīhistaduttarapadalopastuvā vaktavyaḥ| prapatitaparṇaḥ praparṇaḥ| naño'styarthānāṃ bahuvrīhirvā cottarapadalopaḥ| avidyamāno ghaṭo yatra tadaghaṭaṃ bhūtalam| avidyamānaghaṭaṃ vā| astikṣīrādīnāmupasaṃkhyānamasubantatvāt avyayatvātsiddham| tiṅantatvādaprāptau vacanam| tiṅantapatirūpakamavyayamiti pratyākhyānam| yadyapi kiṃsabrahmacārītyatra ke sabrahmacāriṇo yasyeti samāse kaṭha ityuttarānupapattiḥ| praśnasya bahuvacanantitve uttareekavacanāyogāt| keṣāmiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāse'pi sa eva doṣaḥ| ādyudāttatvānupapattiśca| etena supsupeti kaḥ sabrahmacārīti samānādhikaraṇasamāsa ityapāstam| kaḥ sabrahmacārī yasya sa rkisabrahmacārī tvaṃ iti samāse ekatvasvarayorupapattāvapi tadbhinnasya praśnaviṣayatvādahaṃkaṭha iti asmatsāmānādhikaraṇyamanupapannaṃ syāt| tathāpi prathamokta eva bahuvrīhiḥ| svasya kaṭhatvoktyā teṣāmapi kaṭhatvākṣepāt| anyathā sabrahmacāritvāyogāt| ataeva kaṭhāiti bahuvacanasyottare sarvadā nāstitvam| vartipadārthānāṃ upasarjanatvāttaṃdupalakṣitasyānyapadārthasya prādhānyāt rkisabrahmacārīti samāsena teṣāmanabhidhānāt| vākyena praśne tūttare'pi bahuvacanaṃ bhavatyeveti siddhāntaḥ| dvaudroṇau arddhadroṇaścārdhatṛtīyā droṇā ityucyante| ardhastṛtīyo yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| nacānyapadārthasya vartipadārthavyatiriktatvaniyamādatra ca bahutvānyathānupapatyā vṛttau vartipadārthasyāpyantarbhāvātkathaṃ bahuvrīhiriti vācyam| ardhasya dvayośca yaḥ samudāyaḥ sa samāsārthaḥ| tadavayavāśca kadācidbhedena kadācidabhedena vivakṣyante| yathā brahmaṇānāṃ saṃghaḥ| saṃghībhavanti brāhmaṇā iti| tataścodbhūtāvayavabhedaḥ samudāyaḥ samāsārtha iti bahuvacanam| droṇaśabdasya lakṣaṇayā droṇayostadardheca vṛttiriti sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti doṣābhāvāt| nacaivaṃ `asidvitīyo'nusasāra pāṇḍavaṃ `saṃkarṣaṇadvitīyasya balaṃ kuṣṇasya vardhatā'mityādāvapi dvayoḥ pūraṇasya dvitīyasya dvyātmakasamudāyāvayavatvāttadavayavasya samudāyasya samāsārthatvāddvivacanāpattiḥ| dvitīyaśabdasyāvyutpannasya sahāyārthasya tatra prayogāt| sacāyaṃ bahuvrīhidviṃvidhaḥ tad‌guṇasaṃvijñāno'tad‌guṇasaṃvijñānaśca tasyānyapadārthasya yatra kriyānvayaḥ sa ādyaḥ| yathā lambakarṇamānayetyādau| tadabhāve dvitīyaḥ| yathā citragumānayetpādau evaṃ ca viśeṣaṇatvopalakṣaṇātvābhyāṃ tadguṇātadguṇavibhāgaḥ| yattu kaiyaṭaḥ saṃyogasamavāyalakṣaṇe saṃbandhe tad‌guṇasaṃvijñānam| svasvāmibhāvādike tu saṃbandhe bahuvrīhau atad‌guṇasaṃvijñānamiti saṃkṣepeṇa viṣayavibhāga iti| tatsaṃbhavamātrābhidhānam| ataeva saṃkṣepeṇetyuktam| sarvādīni sarvanāmānītyatra samudāyena sarvaśabdasyoktadvayābhāvāt sarvanāmasaṃjñānupapatteḥ| janmādyasya yata iti sūtre janmano brahmalakṣaṇatvānupapatteśca| viśeṣaṇādivibhāgaśca kalpatarāvuktaḥ| kāryānvayitvena vibhedakaṃ hi viśeṣamaṃ nailpamivotpalasya ananvayitvena bhedakānāmupādhitā lakṣaṇatā ca siddhā| yāvatkāryamavasthāyi bhedahetorupādhitā| kādācitkatayā bhedadhīheturupalakṣaṇam|| upalakṣamatvaṃ ca pratyāyyavyāvṛttyanavacchedakatve sati tatsamānādhikaraṇatvaṃ buddheḥ| viśeṣaṇatvaṃ ca tadavacchedakatve satītyādispaṣṭamanyatra| prakṛte tu kāryānvayānanvayābhyāṃmeva tadbodhyam| tatrautsargikastad‌gumasaṃvijñāno viśeṣaṇatvasya mukhyatvāt| bodhakasattve tu dvitīyaḥ| āṣāḍhādicaturmāsānityādau śrāvaṇādimāsacatuṣṭayasya vacanāntaraikavākyatayā grahaṇāt| ataeva dvipadagarbho bahuvrīhistadguṇa evetyapāstam| jakṣityād‌yaḥṣaḍityādau vyabhicārāditi advaitacandrikāyām| saṃkhyayāvyayāsannādūrādhikasaṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeye || 25 || saṃkhyeyārthayā saṃkhyayā avyayādayaḥ samasyante| daśānāṃ samīpe ye santi te upadaśāḥ| uparviśāḥ| bahuvrīho maṃkhyeyeti ḍac| `tiviṃśaterḍitī'ti tilopaḥ| `ayaṃ vīro vārānajayadupaviṃśamavasumatī'miti murāriḥ| sāmīpyamādhānye tvavyayībhāva iti prāguktam| evamāsannaviṃśān viśasitaviṣamakṣatrajātipraroha'iti murāriḥ| adūratriṃśāḥ| adhikacatvāriṃśāḥ| dvau vā trayo vā dvitrāḥ| yadyapi dvau trayo yeṣāmunmugdhānāmiti vigrahe pūrveṇaiva siddham| bahuvrīherasaṃkhyeyavṛttitvātsamāsāntadaurlabhyaṃ ca| dvau vā trayo veti vigrahe pakṣe dvivacanaprasaṅgaḥ| tathāpi saṃkhyāyāmanirjñātāyāṃ bahuvacanaṃ prayoktavyam| kaṃti bhavataḥ putrā iti darśanāt| idaṃ ca vācanikamiti kecit anyetu vāśadvasyātra saṃśayārtatvātsaṃśayasyāniyatasaṃkhyāvimarśitvāttadviṣayabahutvasadbhāvānnyāyasiddhamityāhuḥ| yadvā kāryānvayasyānyataramātravṛttitve'pi bodhe pañcānāṃ viṣayatvāt| taduktaṃ saiṣā pañcādhiṣṭhitā vāgiti| dvidaśā ityatra dvau daśeti na vigrahaḥ| daśasaṃkhyāyā ekatvāt| nāpi dviśabdasya daśatvāvṛttigatasaṃkhyāparatvāt dvirdaśeti sujantadviśabdena tasya śabdāntaratvena saṃkhyārthatvābhāvāt| tathāpi sujantenaiva vigrahaḥ| asvapadavigrahopagamāt| śabdaśaktisvābhāvyena samāsena kriyābhyāvṛttilakṣaṇasujarthasyābhidhānānna tatra tatprayogaḥ| vākye tu sucaṃ vinātadarthānavagamāttatprayoga iti viśeṣaḥ| evaṃca nyāyasāmyāddvau daśatāvityapi vigrahaḥ| taduktam| śabdāntaratvādvākyeṣu viśeṣā yadyapi śrutāḥ| vṛttiśabdonya evāyamarthāntaranibandhanaḥ| iti| itikaiyaṭaḥ sujādīnāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ vākye prayoge'pi vṛttyantargatasya dvyādiśabdasya tadbhinnatayā sujādyarthapratyāyakatvamiti kārikārthaḥ| na ca dvitrāḥ dvidaśāḥ ityatra vārthasujarthayoḥ prādhānyātpūrveṇaiva siddhamiti vācyam| tayoḥ prādhānyābhāvāt| kababhāvārthatvācca| diṅ‌nāmānyantarāle || 26 || diśāṃ saṃjñāḥ samasyante antarāle vācye| dakṣiṇasyāḥ pūrvasyāśca diśo'ntarālaṃ dakṣiṇapūrvā| sarvanāmno vṛttibhāve puṃvadbhāva iti bhāṣyam| nāmeti rūḍhigrahaṇārtham| tenaindrīkauveryādīnāmantarālaprādhānye samāsābhāvaḥ| aprathamāvibhaktyarthe ityuktatvādvaiyadhikaraṇyācca pūrveṇāsiddhau vacanam| vibhāṣādik‌samāse iti sarvanāmasaṃjñāvikalpe asyaiva grahaṇāya pratipadoktatvasaṃpādanārthamapye tat| kababhāvārthaṃ ca| tatra tenedamiti sarūpe || 27 || saptamyante grahaṇaviṣaye tṛtīyānte ca praharaṇaviṣaye sarūpe pade idaṃ yuddhaṃ pravṛttimityarthe karmavyatīhāre samasyete| itiśabdasya laukikavivakṣāparatvena grahaṇapraharaṇakarmavyatīhārayuddhānāṃ lābhaḥ| tatrāpi yuddhaṃ viṣayībhūtaṃ anye vācyā iti viśeṣaḥ| grahaṇapraharaṇaśabdayoryathākramamadhikaraṇe karaṇe ca lyuṭ| keśeṣu keśeṣu gṛhītvā idaṃ yuddhaṃ pravṛttaṃ keśākeśi| muṣṭīmuṣṭi| daṇḍaiśca daṇḍaiśca prahṛtya daṇḍādaṇḍi| ic‌karmavyatīhāre iti samāsānta ic| tasya tiṣṭhad‌guprabhṛtīnicetyavyayībhāvamadhye pāṭhādavyayatvam| anyeṣāmapīti dīrghaḥ| na ca idaṃśabdātpūrvamākāraṃ praśliṣyaivātvaṃ vidhīyatāṃ uttarapade yasyeti lopāvaśyakatvena prayojanābhāvāditi vācyam| yadi niyogatosyānenaiva dīrghatvaṃ syāditi bhāṣyeti asyasītyādāvatiprasaṅgasya bhāṣye darśitatvāt| evaṃ ca muṣṭāmuṣṭīti prāmādikamiti kaiyaṭādayaḥ| sarūpetikim| halaiśca musalaiścedaṃ yuddhaṃ pravṛttam| idaṃ sūtraṃ vaiyadhikaraṇyārtham| prathamāvibhaktyarthe ekaśeṣabādhanārthaṃ kababhāvārthaṃca| anyathā sahavivakṣitatvātsarūpatvādekavibhaktitvāccaikaśeṣaḥ syāt samūhānyathānupapattyā samūhaviṣayiṇyānayā bahuvrīhisaṃjñayā tvārambhasāmarthyāttadbādhāt| nacaparatvātpūrvayogenaivaikaśeṣabādhaḥ syāt| anyapadārthāpekṣayā tasya bahiraṅgatvāt| parādapyantaraṅgasyaikaśeṣasya balavatvāt| naca viśeṣavihitenecā bādhātkababhāvaḥ| śeṣādvibhāṣeti kababhāve pakṣe icaḥ sāvakāśatvāt| tathāhi tatraśeṣapadaṃ tantrāvṛttyādinā ubhayaparam| upayuktādanyaḥ śeṣaḥ| anuktasamāsānta iti yāvat| dvitīyasya tu śeṣādhikāro'rthaḥ| ādyena priyamadhuka ityādau dvitīyena dakṣiṇapūrvādau tadabhāvaḥ| diṅ‌nāmānītyādau śeṣagrahaṇānanuvṛtteḥ śeṣādhikāraeva gṛhyate natūpayuktādanya iti kaiyaṭaphakvikāyāstu evakārasya kriyāsaṃgarti kṛtvā śeṣādhikāro'pi gṛhyate natūpayuktādanyaeveti kevalānupayuktagrahaṇavyavacchede tātparyamityāhuḥ| tena saheti tulyayoge || 28 || tulyayogavṛttiḥ sahaśabdaḥ tṛtīyāntena vā samasyate| putreṇasaha saputra āgataḥ| sahaputraḥ| vopasarjanasyeti sādeśaḥ| pituranyapadārthasya prādhānye'pi vaiyadhikaraṇyārthaṃ prathamārthaṃ kababhāvārtha ca vacanam| tulyayogeti kim| sahaiva daśabhiḥ putrairbhāraṃ vahati gardabhī| teṣu vidyamāneṣvityarthaḥ| ataevāgnā ī patīvatsajūrdevena tvaṣṭrā somaṃ piba svāhetyatraikakriyānvaye vināpi sahayogopapattyā tvaṣṭurdevatātvaṃ neti siddhāntaḥ| tulyayogavacanaṃ prāyikam vibhāṣā sākāṅkṣe vibhāṣāsapūrvasyetyādijñāpakāt| tena sakarma ityādi siddham| cārthe dvandvaḥ || 29 || prāguktasamāsaṃ anekaṃ subantaṃ cārthe vartamānaṃ vā samasyate sa dvandvaḥ| samuccayānvācayetaretarayoga samāhārāścārthāḥ| mitho'napekṣayorekasminnanvayaḥ samuccayaḥ| yathā ``aharaharnayamāno gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ paśum| vaivasvato na tṛpyati surāyā iva durmatiḥ| atragavādīnāṃ nayanānvayaḥ| gamyamānārthatvāt caśabdāprayogaḥ| mukhyānuṣaṅgikoddeśyatvābhyāṃ bhinnakriyānvayitvamanvācayaḥ| bhikṣāmaṭa gāṃcānayeti| atrabhikṣāṭanasyāvaśyakatvaṃ gavānayasya kṛtā kṛtatvam| yadyapi dhavaṃchindhi khadiramapītyanyatarasyāvaśyakatvavivakṣāyāṃ kriyāsāmye'pyanvācaya eva| ghaṭamānaya paṭaṃ cetyādāvubhayaprādhānyavivakṣāyāṃ samuccaya eva| tathāpi kriyaikyabhedau na niyāmakau kintu guṇapradhānabhāvavivakṣaiveti kaiyaṭaḥ| militānāmanvaya itaretarayogaḥ| samūhaḥ samāhāraḥ| tatrādyayorna samāsaḥ| asāmarthyāt| antyayostu dhavakhadirau vāgdṛṣadam| naca cārthe vidhānāt dvandvasyāvyayatvāpattiḥ| tatprakaraṇe pāṭhābhāvāt| śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kim| yājñikaścāyaṃ vaiyākaraṇaścāyaṃ yājñikavaiyākaraṇaḥ, kaṭhabahṛcaḥ, nīlotpalamitpādau mābhūt| viśeṣaṇamityādāvupayuktatvena śeṣatvābhāvaḥ| anyathaikasmin dharmiṇi anekadharmasamuccayena cārthasadbhāvāt| dvandvasaṃjñāpattau abhyarhitatvādvaiyākaraṇādeḥ pūrvanipātaḥ syāt| tatpuruṣetu kāmakhañjādivadaniyatapūrvanipātasiddhiḥ| idaṃca paraṃkāryamiti pakṣe| ekasaṃjñādhikāre tuviśeṣavihitattvādeva tatpuruṣasaṃjñāsiddheḥ| naca śeṣagrahaṇapakṣe| upāsnānaṃ sthūlamikataṃ tūṣṇīṃgaṅgamahāhradam| droṇaṃ cedaśako gantuṃ martvā tāptāṃ kṛtākṛte|| ityatra dvandvo nasyāt ktenanañ‌viśiṣṭeneti samāmavidhānādaśeṣatvāditi vācyam| kṛtākṛtetyatra bhinnayoreva karmaṇorabhimatatvāt| ekasyaikadeśāvacchedena kṛtākṛtatvavivakṣāyāmeva ca ktenetyādisamāsapravṛtteḥ| atra padārthabhede dvandva ityeke| anyetu padārthatāvacchedakabhededvandvaḥ| cārthe ityamyāpi bhedegamye iti nārthaḥ| dhavakhadirāvityatra vibhaktyarthopasthityabhāvena ekasyānyasmin viśeṣaṇatvābhāvena bhedasya saṃsargatayā bhānāyogāt| ata eva naprakāraviśeṣatvābhyāṃ, apadārthatvāt, chindhītyananvayācca| atovāstava evabhedo vivakṣaṇīyaḥ| sacapadārthapratiyogikaścetyatra niyāmakābhāvāt| tenanīlotpalādau vyāptiviśiṣṭapakṣadharmetyādauca padārthaikye'pi samasyamānārthatāvacche dakasya vyāptiviśiṣṭapakṣadharmatvādebhedāttatsambhavaḥ| nacaivamekaśeṣānuśāsanavaiyarthyam| payasī ityatra jaladugdhobhayaparatve jalatvadugdhatvarūpapadārthatāvacchedakabhedena tatsārthakyāt| nacanīlaghaṭayorityatra dvitvānanvayaḥ padārthe bādhāt| tadavacchedakasyaikadeśatvāddravyabhinnatayādvitvānvayānarhatvāccetivāccam| sādhutvamātrārthatvāt| nacanīlaghaṭayorabedaityatra karmadhārayaevāstu| naca dvivacanānupapattiḥ, ekadharmiṇi karmadhārayottaramiva dvindvottaramapi dvivacanānuśāsanābhāvāditi vācyam| karmadhārayādeva nīlābhinnatayā ghaṭopasthitau tasyābhedānākāṅkṣatvādananvayāpatteḥ| tatrābhedasya saṃsargatayā bhāne'pi phalānurodhena nirākāṅkṣatvādityāhuḥ| āre tu padapratipādyabhede dvandvaḥ| ato nobhayatrāpyanupapattiḥ| ekaśevasthale ghaṭadvayasyātra ca nīlatvaghaṭatvayośca bhedāt| nacaivamekasmin ghaṭe ghaṭaścaghaṭaśca ghaṭā ityapi prasaṅgaḥ| tatpratipādyānāṃ ghaṭaghaṭatvasamavāyānāṃ bhedāditivācyam| samasyamānapadayormadhye'nyatarapadabodhyayāvadvyaktibhedasyānyatarapadabodhye vivakṣitatvāt| yadvā viṣayitāsambandhenaikapadasya yatkāryatāvacchedakaṃ tadbhinnaviṣayatāsambandhāvacchinnakāryatākatvasyānyapade'bhimatatvāt| atra tu padadvayasyāpi ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭaitaddhaṭa eva kāryatāvacchedaka ityāhuḥ| prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ| anekagrahaṇaṃ kim| hotṛpotṛneṣṭod‌gātāraḥ| nacāyaṃ dvayordvandva iti vācyam| hotṛpotrorapyānaṅ prasaṅgāt| syādetat| dhavakhadirayoḥ parasparamananvaye sāmarthyābhāvātsamāso na syāt| nacaikakriyānvayitvameva taditi kaiyaṭoktarītyā nirvāhaḥ| kṛtaḥ sarvo mṛttikayetyarthe kṛtaḥ sarvamṛttika ityāpatteḥ| karaṇatvakarmatvābhyāṃ sarvamṛttikāpadārthayoḥ kriyānvayitvāt| naca vacanasāmarthyādasāmarthye'pi samāso yadvā karmatvādyekarūpeṇānvayitvasamāmarthyamitivācyam| anvācaye'haraharityādau cātiprasaṅgāt| uttarapadottaraṃ dvivacanādyanupapattiśca| tadarthasyaikatvāt| tasmāt‌dhavapadaṃ dhavakhadirobhayaparam| evaṃ khadirapadamapi| tathāca padadvayārthayoḥ parasparamabedānvayarūpaṃ sāmarthyaṃ vākye ca tadabhāvaḥ spaṣṭaḥ| dvitīyārthasya pratipattyarthaṃ ca śabdāntaprayogaḥ arthadvayasyaiva padadvayabodhyatvānna bahuvacanaprasaṅgaḥ| ateva dyāvācidasmai pṛthivī namete ityatra pūthivaśibdasya dvivacanāntatvaṃsaṃṅgacchate| vācchandasīti pūrvasavarmaḥ| anyathāsaṃnamete itidvivacanāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ pṛthivīśabdottaraṃ padapāṭhavelāyāmitiśabdaprayogaḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñānibandhanaprakṛtibhāvaśca na syāt| tadetatsarvamabhisaṃdhāya vārtikakāreṇoktam| yugapadadhikaraṇa vacane dvandva iti| adhikaraṇaṃ samasyamānapadayorthau tayoryugapadvacane padadvayasyāpi padadvayārthabodhakatveityarthaḥ| atra bhāṣyakārāḥ| seyaṃ yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatā duḥkhācadurupapādāceti| duḥkheti pratitivirodhāt| dhavapadasya khadirabodhakatvābhāvāt| dhavakhadirāvitivākyāvṛttijanyabodhādatra vailakṣaṇyācca| uddeśyatāvacchedakavidheyayoraikyena ghaṭo ghaṭa ityādivacchābdabodhānupapatteśca| ekapadamukhyārthena samamaparapadamukhyārthasyābhedabodhopagame ca yogyatāvirahāt| ekārthatve'pi tādṛśānvayasaṃbhave padadvayasyāpyarthadvayabodhakatvakalpanaprayāsavaiyarthyācca| pṛthivītyatra ca chāndasavyatyayenaikavacanasthāne dvivacanopapatteḥ| dvandvena samudāyābhidhāyinā dvivacanādyupapatteḥ| naca tasyaikatvādekavacanāpattiḥ| ud‌bhūtāvayavabhedasya samudāyasya samāsārthatvāt| arthagrahaṇasāmarthyāccakāreṇa prakāśito yo'rthasta dvandvaḥ| gāmaśvamityādau tu cakāraprayogavyatirekeṇāpi samuccayāvagamānna tasya camātraprakāśitatvaṃ sāmarthyaṃ tu pūrvoktameva| anyathāyathoktarītyāpi anistārāt| kṛtaḥ sarvamṛttika ityatra vidhāyakābhāvena samāsāpatterabhāvāt| kṛtāsahaiva tasya vihitatvāt| kvacidasāmarthye samāsadarśanamātreṇa tadāpattisaukarye ca asūryaṃpaśyāityasamāsamātreṇa kṛtaḥ sarvamṛttikaiti samāsāpattestenāpi parihartumaśakyatvāt| vacanaprāmāṇyātsamāsaityasya tulyatvāditi yatkiṃcidetat| nyagrodho dṛśyatāṃ plakṣaścetyuktaṃ nyagrodhasya na cārthavṛttitvaṃ kintu plakṣasyaiva| ato'nekapadasyacārthavṛttitvābhāvānna samāsaḥ| yattu vadanti| vigraheyugapadadhikaraṇavācitāyā durupapādatvaṃ bhāṣyārtho natu samāse'pi| tatpūrvaṃ vigrahe khalvapi yugapadadhikaraṇa vacanatā dṛśyate| dhavauca khadiraucetyādidarśanena tathaiva yuktatvāt| prakriyādaśāyāṃ prathamapravṛttaikavacanasya tyāgāyogāt| naca samāse pratyekapadayorubhayārthatve vigrahe'pi tathātvamiti vācyam| rājapuruṣaityādau rājapadasya sabāndhalākṣaṇikatvena vigrahasyāpi rājācāsau puruṣaścetyākārāpatteḥ| naceṣṭāpattiḥ| ṣaṣṭhyāākrośe ityāderalugvidhestatsvaravidheśca virodhāpatteḥ| iti| tadasat| tadviṣayaṃ ceti pūrvagranthe samāse'pi yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatvasya darśitatvena tatsādhāraṇyenaiva dūṣaṇe bhāṣyatātparyāt| anyathā cārthedvandva iti nyāsasamarthanānupapatteḥ| vigrahe tadvāraṇānupapatteśca samāsārthāvabodhakasyaiva tattvāt| naca ṣaṣṭhīsamāsādyucchedaḥ| tatraṣaṣṭhayāsambandhasya baktuṃ śakyatvāt| tāvadāpi sambandhī nokta iti cet kiṃ tataḥ| dharmamātrasyoktatvāt| vigrahe sarvāṃśasāmyasya brahmaṇāpyānetumaśakyatvāt| atra cadhavaśceti vigrahe samāsāntargatadhavaśabdadvitīyārthasya pratyāyayitumaśakyatvāt| ataevālug‌vidhyāderna virodhaḥ| ataeva yuṣmadasmatpratyaya gocarayorityatra yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatvānurodhena dvivacanāntābhyā meva yuṣmadasmabhdyataṃ dvandve vigraha ityāśaṅ‌kyoktabāṣyakaiyaṭānusāreṇobhayathāpi tadabhāva ityuktamaupaniṣadavṛddhaiḥ| nanvevaṃ āṅgaśca vāṅgaśca kāliṅgaśceti aṅgavaṅgakaliṅgā iti nasyāt| tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyāmiti apatyakṛtabahutvavivakṣāyāṃ apatyapatyayasya lugvidhānāt| yugapadadhikaraṇatāṃ vināca tadrājārthasya bahutvānanvayāt| tadrājāttena bahutvoktau lugityarthe priyavāṅgāityatrāpi tatprasaṅgāditi cenna| bahuṣuvartamānasyetyarthamādāya saṃprati pratīyamānaṃ yadbahutvaṃ tadāśrayasya tadrājena pūrvamabhidhānāt, ityasya tvayāpi vācyatvāt| taccasamāsottarasupeti mama viśeṣaḥ| nahiyugapadadhikaraṇavacanapakṣe'pi pratyekasmādapi paratobahuvacanamastyeveti nadoṣaiti bhāpyakārairevoktam| alaukikadvandvavigrahe vartipadānāmekavacanāntatvasya yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatvapakṣe tadabhiprāyaviruddhatvāt| samāhāradvandve pāṇipādaṃ vādayetyatra prakṛtyarthaikadeśe karmatvasya, ekatvasyatu samāhāra evānvayo vyutpattivaicitryāt| yattu samāhārasaṃjñā nadīvṛddhyādivat pāribhāṣikī natu tasya śabdārthatvam| ekatvamananvitameva| naca dvivacanādyāpattirasādhutvāditi| tanna| rathaghoṣādhikaraṇavirodhāt| rathaghoṣeṇamāhendrasya stītramupākarotītyatrobhayapadalākṣaṇikasamāhāradvandvāpekṣayā pūrvapadamātra lākṣaṇikaṣaṣṭhīsamāsasya lākṣaṇikatāyāstatroktatvādeṣā dik| idaṃ ekaviṃśatirityādau samāhāradvandva iti bhāṣyam| naca napuṃsakāpattiḥ| liṅgasya lokāśrayatbāt| tena rājanyavahuvacanadvandva'ndhakavṛṣṇiṣu saṃkhyetipūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| siddhaḥ| śatasahasramityādiṣaṣṭhīsamāsavāraṇāya tasya dvandvaviṣayatvāt| yadi tvekādhikā viṃśatiriti śākapārthivāditvādadhikapadalopastadā samāsāntodāttatvam| upasarjanaṃ pūrvam || 30 || samāse upasarjanaṃ pūrvaṃ prayojyam| adhihari| naca rājñaḥ pūruṣasyetyatra dvayorapi ṣaṣṭhīti samāsaśāstre prathamānirdiṣṭatvādupasarjanatayā paryāyeṇa pūrvanipātāpattiḥ| anvarthasaṃjñayāyaapradhāne eva tatpravṛtteḥ| atra viśeṣyatayā puruṣasyaiva prādhānyāt| rājadantādiṣu param || 31 || eṣu upasarjanaṃ paraṃ syāt| dantānāṃ rājā rājadantaḥ| vanasyāgre'grevaṇam| gaṇe nipātanādaluk| ākṛtigaṇo'yam| dharmādiṣvaniyama iṣyate| arthadharmau dharmārthau| jampatī| dampatī| jāyāpatī| gaṇapāṭhājjāyāyā daṃjambhāvaḥ| dvandve ghi || 32 || hariharau| anekaprāptāvekatra niyamo'niyamaḥ śeṣe hariharaguravaḥ| ajādyadantam || 33 || ajāditvādantatvaviśiṣṭaṃ dvandve pūrvaṃ syāt| bahuṣvaniyamaḥ| aśvarathendrāḥ| indrāśvarathāḥ| dhyantādajādyadantaṃ vipratiṣedhena| indrāgnī| alpāc‌taram || 34 || dvandve'lpāckaṃ pūrvaṃ syāt| naca bahūnāṃ saṃnidhāne dvivacanopapadatvābhāvāttarabanutpattyā tatra niyamo na syāditi vācyam| nipātanātsvārthe tarap kutvacutvābhāvaścetyāśrayaṇāt| dhavakhadirau| prāsāde dhanapatirāmakeśavānām| mṛdaṅgaśaṅkhatūṇavāḥ pṛthak‌danti saṃsadītyādau dvayoḥ pṛthag‌dvandvaṃ kṛtvā pūrveṇa punardvandvaḥ| naca jātiraprāmināmityekavadbhāvāpattiḥ| niyatadravyaparatvāt| nāpi tūryāṅgatvena| śaṅkhasya tad‌bhāvāt| yadvā tūryaśilpopajīvināmeva tūryāṅgatvena grahaṇāt| pūrvābhyāmalpāctaraṃ vipratiṣedhena| vāgagnī| vāgindrau| anityamidaṃ prakaraṇam| lakṣamahetvoḥ, samudrābhrāddhaḥ ityādi nirdeśāt| etena `barhirājyayorasaṃskāre śadbalābhā'diti jaiminisūtram `adhītibodhācaraṇapracāraṇai'rityādi vyākhyātam| ṛtunakṣatrāṇāṃ samākṣarāṇāmānupūrvyeṇa pūrvanipāto vaktavyaḥ| śiśiravasantau kṛtikārohiṇyau| sametikami| grīṣmavasantau| abhyarhitaṃ pūrvam| mātāpitarau, ete mānyā yathāpūrvaṃ tebhyomātāgarīyasīti yājñavalkyaḥ| laghvakṣaraṃ pūrvam| kuśakāśam|| sarvato'bhyarhitaṃ pūrvaṃ ladhvakṣarādapīti vaktavyam|| bhrāturjyāyasaḥ|| yudhiṣṭhirārjunau|| sekhyāyā alpīyasyāḥ|| ekādaśa dvādaśa dvandvādanyatrāpyetat| dvitrāḥ| `dveyekayo'riti sautratvātsiddham|| saptamīviśeṣaṇe bahuvrīhau || 35 || saptamyantaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ ca bahuvrīhau pūrvaṃ prayojyam| kaṇṭhekālaḥ| yadā kaṇṭhe kiñcidastīti sāmānyato jñāte kāla ityucyate tadā kaṇṭhasya viśeṣyatvātsaptamyāḥ pṛthagupādānam| anyadā viśeṣaṇatayaiva siddheḥ| citraguḥ| ||sarvanāmasaṃkhyayorupasaṃkhyānam|| viśvadevaḥ| idamapi viśvaśabdasya viśeṣyatve| divaśuklaḥ| dvoyarviśeṣaṇatvādaniyamaprasaṅgaḥ| dviputra ityādi viśeṣaṇatvādapi siddham| taḥ paro yasmātsa taparaḥ| jahatsvaṃ padāt sa jahatsvaḥ| tādṛgratho yasyāṃ sā jahatsvārthā vṛttiriti tu sūtrabhāṣyaprayogādrājadantāditvādvā siddhamityāhuḥ| uktobhayasannipāte saṃkhyāyāḥ śabdaparavipratiṣedhāśrayaṇāt| ata eva saṃkhyāsarvanāmnoriti noktam| dvyanyāya tryanyāya| vā priyasya| priyaguḍaḥ| guḍapriyaḥ| gaḍvādibhyaḥ parā saptamīti vaktavyam| gaḍukaṇṭhaḥ| gaḍuśirāḥ| kvacinna| vahegaḍuḥ| iha saptamīti jñāpakaṃ sāmānyāpekṣam| tena `manuṣyajanmāpi surāsurān guṇai'rityādi siddham| tathāca vāmanaḥ-`avarjyo bahuvrīhirjanmādyuttarapada'iti| śiṣṭaprayogasya niyāmakatvācca nātiprasaṅgaḥ| yattu śāvarabhāṣye agnihotraṃ juhotītyatra siddhānte'pi agnaye hotramasminniti bahuvrīhiriti| someśvareṇaca agnirhotraṃ yasyetiṣaṣṭhīvahuvrīhirityuktam| tatra yadyapi vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ taittirīyaśākhāyāmantodāttapāṭhavirādhaśca| tathāpi vājasaneyake sarvodāttasvarapāṭhasya tatpuruṣeṇāpyanupapattyā'nyataratra chāndasatvakalpanasyāvaśyakatvāt| vyadhikaraṇabahuvrīherapi kvacidāśrayaṇācca nātīva doṣaityabhiprāyaḥ| navyamīmāṃsakāstu `uṇādayobahula'mityanusārājjuhoterbhāve tran pratyayaḥ| agnerhotro homa iti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ| yadagnayecetyādipramāṇāvagatadevatātvād dravyasambandhaviśeṣo lakṣaṇayā ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ| ato'gnidevatākatvaṃ pravṛttinimittam| naca prātaḥ prayoge'gnidevatākatvābhāvānnaivamiti vācyam| ekamyaiva homasya jyotiṣṭhomavatsāyaṃprātarabhyāse'pi karmabhedābhāvena vijātīyahomatvasāmāsādhikaraṇyena tatsattvādeva tadupapatteḥ| (nahi tadavacchedena sadeva)| tathā vaiśvadevena yajetetyatra viśvedevasambandhasyaikayāgamātravṛttitve'pi tena yāgāṣṭakanāmadheyatvasvīkārādityāhuḥ| yattu hotraśabdamadhikaraṇevyutpādya ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣa ityuktam| tatrāgnisambandhihomādhikaraṇamitibodhe'gneradhikaraṇatvaṃ nāyatiti vibhāvyamiti dik| niṣṭhā || 36 || niṣṭhāntaṃ bahuvrīhau pūrvaṃ syāt| kṛtakṛtyaḥ niṣṭhaśabdenavihitasyaiva grahaṇānnapuṃsake bhāve kta ityasyāgrahaṇāt cārusmitamiti|| jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ parā niṣṭhā vācyā|| sāraṅgajagdhī palāṇḍubhakṣitī māsajātā sukhajātā duḥkhajātā|| nacajātikālasukhādibhyaḥ parāyā niṣṭhāyā uttarapadāntodāttatvavacanādeva jñāpakātsiddhiḥ| akṛtamitapratipannāiti yeṣāntanniṣedhastadarthe parinipātasya vācyatvāt| vastutastu pratiṣedhasyottarapadāntodāttaprasaktipūrvakatvāttasya ca paranipātaṃ vinānupapattesteṣāmapi pratiṣedhādeva jñāpakātsiddhiḥ| kvicinna| kṛtakaṭaḥ pītodakaḥ| vāhitāgnyādiṣu || 37 || āhitāgniḥ| agnyāhitaḥ| praharaṇādibhyaḥ pare niṣṭhāsaptamyau| asyudyataḥ| susalodyataḥ| asipāṇiḥ| daṇḍapāṇiḥ| kvacinna| vivṛtāsiḥ| kaḍārāḥ karmadhārāye || 38 || kaḍārādaya ityarthaḥ| prāṇabhṛta upadadhātītivat| kaḍāragaḍula karaṇa khañja kuṇṭha khoḍa khalati gaura vṛddha bhikṣuka piṅgala tantu jaraṭha vṛt| kaḍārajaiminiḥ| jaiminikaḍāraḥ| gaḍulaśāṇḍilyaḥ śāṇḍilyagaḍulaḥ| karmadhāraye kim| bahuvrīhau mā bhūt| kaḍārapuruṣako grāmaḥ| iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau dvitīyādhyāyasya dvitīye pāde dvitīyamāhnikam|| pādaśca samāptaḥ|| <2.3> atha tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ prathamamāhnikam|| anabhihite || 39 || ardhikāro'yam| dvitīyādayo vibhaktayo'nabhihite karmādaubhavantītyarthaḥ| abhidhānaṃ pratipādanaṃ aśvābhidhānīmādatte| abhihitaśloka iti bandhanoccāraṇārthayoḥ hinotergativṛdhdyarthayorapi prakṛtānupayogāt| taṇḍulaṃ pacati caitraḥ| caitreṇa taṇḍulaḥ pacyate| ādye kartaryākhyātotpattyā kartṛkarmaṇorabhihitatvānābhihitatvābhyāṃ tṛtīyāvirahidvitīye| ante ca karmaṇo'bhihitatvātkartuścānabhihitatvāt dvābhyāṃ dvitīyāvirahatṛtīye| abhidhānaṃca prāyeṇa tiṅkṛttaddhitasamāsaiḥ| devadattaḥ pācakaḥ| kartari ṇvul| devadatena pakvastaṇḍulaḥ| karmaṇi ktaḥ| aurapagavaḥ| citraguḥ| taddhitasamāsābhyāṃ janyajanakabhāvasya svasvāmibhāvasya coktatvānna ṣaṣṭhī| kvacinnipātenāpyabhidhānam| viṣavṛkṣo'pi saṃvardhya svayaṃ cchettumasāmpratam| na yujyate ityarthaḥ| athakathaṃ- `smṛtvā vālibhujau na sāṃpratamavajñātuṃ ca te vānarā' niti murāriḥ| ucyate| avajñānanirūpitaṃ tatra karmatvam| ataevapaktvaudanaṃ bhujyate paktvaudano bhujyate ityubhayaṃ prāmāṇikam| `kramādamuṃ nārada ityabodhi saḥ'| tathāhi| ayaṃ nārada iti śrīkṛṣṇasamavetaṃ jñānaṃ itiśabdaśca tadākāraparāmarśakaḥ adaḥśabdottaradvitīyāyā viśeṣyatvamarthaḥ| tathācapūrvoktavyaktiviśeṣyakanāradatvaprakārakajñānāśrayaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaityarthaḥ| jñānākāraparamarśaketiśabdena svaparāmarśanīyajñāne svāvyavahitapūrvavartipadajanyabodhaprakārakatvalābhāt| idamevakarmābhidhānam| ayantu viśeṣaḥ| dvitīyāyā jñānārthakadhātunā yoge viśeṣyatvamarthaḥ| ghaṭatvena paṭajñāne ghaṭaṃ jānātityāderaprayogāt| iti śabdasya tu uktaprakārabodhakatvaṃ paṭaṃ ghaṭa iti jānātītiprayogāt| ataśca dvitīyāyā prakṛtyarthāvacchedakatadatiriktadharmaprakārakatvasādhāraṇyena prakṛtyarthaviṣayakatvaṃ itiśabdena ca svapūrvapadārthatāvacchedakadharmātiriktadharmaprakārakatvaṃ jñānasya niyameva bodhyate| viśeṣyaṃ ca pūrvapadārtho'nyo veti na niyamaḥ| ataevāmumityatra dvitīyā| viśeṣyatvasya itiśabdenānabhihitatvāt| ghaṭaṃ jānātītyatra tu prakāraviśeṣyayorekapadopāttatayā ghaṭatvāpekṣayā ghaṭapade na dvitīyāprasaṅgāt| nedaṃ prakṛtodāharaṇaṃ yuktam| tathāpi vyadhikaraṇaprakārakasthale tathātve'pi prakṛte jñānasya pramāṇatvāt| nāradaviśeṣyatāyāapi tadbodhyatvamityabhiprāyaḥ| nacaivamamumityatrāpi dvitīyā na syāditi vācyam| ayaṃ nārada ityabodhītyato nāradaviśeṣyakatvasya niyamato'navabhāsanāt| idaṃtvāvacchinnaviṣayatāto nāradatvāvacchinnaviṣayatāyā bhedāditi dik| syādetat| karmādīnāṃ tiṅādibhirabhidhāne uktārthānāmaprayoga iti nyāyena dvitīyādīnāṃ prasaktyabhāvādayamadhikāro vyarthaḥ| nacaiko dvāvityādau vyabhicāraḥ| tatra prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ saṃkhyayorbhedābhyupagamāt| yathā śatamityatra pravṛttinimittaśatasaṃkhyā dravyādiniṣṭhānyā, vibhaktyarthabhūtā prātipadikārthaśatādigataikatvasaṃkhyā cānyā| tathātrāpi pravṛttinimittaṃ vibhaktivācyamcaikatvaṃ bhinnamiti sambhavāt| taduktaṃhariṇā- nimittamakamityatra vibhaktyā nābhidhīyate| tadvatastu yadekatvaṃ vibhaktistatra vartate iti|| atrāhuḥ-guṇaviśiṣṭasya kaṭasya karmatvaṃ pratipādyam| dvitīyotpattiṃ vinā ca kaṭasya tadviśiṣṭatvapratyayābhāvāttasyāpi karmatvaṃ na syāditi sāmānādhikaraṇyāt bhīṣmāderdvitīyā| naca prathamaiva syāditi vācyam| viśeṣyapadottaraṃ dvitīyāyā evopasthitatvāt| pāṭhakramāpekṣayā prathamāyāḥ pramopasthiteretadapekṣayā bahiraṅgatvāt| yadvā viśiṣṭasya vidhitsāyāṃ dharmimātreṇa paritoṣābhāvāddharmāṇāmapipsitatamatvātteṣāmapi karmatvam| tasya cānyavācakapadottaradvitīyayānabhidhānāt| kṛtaḥ kaṭa ityādau tu ktapratyayasya dhātuttaravartitvena prātipadikārthaviśeṣaniṣṭhakarmatvamātrānābhidhāyakatvādaviśeṣāddharmadharmyubhayaniṣṭhatadabhidhānātsarveṣāṃ prathamāntatvamiti vaiṣamyam| ata evāruṇayaikahāyanyetyādau kārakavibhaktīnāṃ kriyayānvayaḥ śābdaḥ| pārṣṭhikastu parasparaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo, guṇasya sākṣātkrayasādhanatvābhāve'pi tatsādhanagorūpadravyaparicchedakatvenaiva krapasādhanatvanirvāhāditi mīmāṃsakāḥ| nīlaṃ ghaṭamityādāvabhedaḥ saṃsargaḥ| bhedasaṃsargakanāmārthaprakārakabuddhāveva pratyayajanyopastitehartutvāt viśeṣaṇavibhaktiḥ sādhutvārthā| evamavyayātiriktatvamapi nāmaviśeṣaṇam| candra iva mukhaṃ, ghaṭo netyādau avyayārthe sādṛśye'bhāve ca pratiyogitayā candraghaṭādeḥ sādṛśyādeścānuyogitayā mukhādāvanvayāt iti naiyāyikāḥ| viśeṣaṇavibhaktirabhedārthā| ato bhedasaṃsargaketi kāryatāvacchedake na deyam| candra ivetyādau candrādipadottarāyā vibhakteḥ pratiyogitvaṃ, ivādipadottarāyāścānuyogitvamartha iti tadekadeśinaḥ| syādetat| sūtrārambhapakṣe'nabhihita iti prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ, paryudāso vā| nādyaḥ| asamarthasamāsavākyabhedayorāpatteḥ| prāsādeāste ityatra prāsādekriyādviyādhikaraṇatvāt| tasya ca sadiprakṛtikena ghañaivābhidhānāttannibandhanasaptamīnīṣedhaprasaṅgāt| etena dvitīyo'pi nirastaḥ| abhihitasyābhihitabhinnatvābhāvāt| naca sadikriyānirūpitādhikaraṇaśakterabhidhāne'pi āsikriyānirūpitādhikaraṇaśakteranabhidhānamāśritya saptamīti vācyam| āmane āste śayane śete ityādau tato'pyanirvāhāt| dravyātirikte kārake pramāṇābhāvena śaktirūpakārakabhedenobhayopādānasyāvaśyakatvāt| dravyasvarūpātirekeṇa śakteḥ pratyakṣānavagāhyatvāt| tatpūrvakānumānasyāpi tasyāmapravṛtteḥ| kāryasya dravyānvayavyatirekamātrānuvidhāyitvena kāryābhāvaprayojakābhāvapratiyogitvenāpi tadasiddheḥ iti cet| ucyate| yadi dravyamātraṃ sādhanaṃ syāt tadātasyaikarūpatvāttannibandhanābādhitapratyabhijñānaviṣayatvānnānārthakriyākaraṇanibandhano vyapadeśabhedo na syāt| dṛśyate cāsau kva devadatta iti praśne asau vṛkṣe ityuttare adhikaraṇatvena pratīyamānasya vṛkṣasya katarasminniti vṛkṣaviśeṣapraśne yastiṣṭhatītyuttare kartṛrūpatayā pratīte| nahyadhikaraṇatayā kartṛrūpatayā ca pratītyorvailakṣaṇyamapalapituṃ śakyam| tacca viṣayabhedāyattaṃ jñānasvarūpattve saugatamatapraveśāpatteḥ| atastadupapādakatvena kartrādirūpāḥ ṣaṭ‌śaktayo'vaśyamaṅgīkaraṇīyāḥ| yatsamāveśādekasminneva tattadvyapadeśabhedāḥ| anyathā karmakaraṇādīnāṃ vyavasthaiva syāt| tadetaduktaṃ vākyapadīye-nityāḥ ṣaṭ‌śaktayo'nyeṣāmiti| tāśca kriyābhedabhinnā eva| anyathāyaṃ gamanasya kartā natu pākasyetyāderayogāt| natu dravyavyaktibhedenāpi tadbhedo mānābhāvāt| evaṃca kartṛtvādikaṃ tāsāmanugamakaṃ śakyatāvacchedakakamityapyāstheyam| anyathā tadaṃśe'nugatavyavahāro'pi na syāt| athaivamāsane āste ityādi kathamiti cet atrāhuḥ-āsanaśayanakaraṇāpādānasaṃpradānādiśabdairāsanādikriyāyogyaṃ vastumātramanud‌bhūtaśaktikamabhidhīyate| tatra śaktyudbhavapratipādanāya vibhaktiravaśyotpādyā| tataścāsisādhanamitibhāṣyasya sādhanāntaranirāse tātparyam| śabdavyutpattayekevalamatrāsikriyopādīya te ityartha iti| udbhavaścāyameva yadādheyakālaviśeṣādirūpanirūpakaviśīṣṭatvena pratītiḥ| āsanamityatra kālaviśeṣasyādheyaviśeṣasya cānavagamāt| kevalasya ca liṅādeḥ prayogānarhatvāt| dhātvantaraprayoge ca kriyāntaranirūpyādhikaraṇānirūpakasyaivādheyāderlābhādāsikriyānirūpyādhikaraṇanirūpakādheyāderanavagamatādavasthyāt| api ca pratyayenādhikaraṇābhidhāne'pi śaktyantarānāviṣṭaṃ śuddhaṃ śaktisvarūpaṃ na pratyāyyate| āsanenetyādau karmādiyogānubhavāt vibhaktīnāmeva śuddhakārakaśaktibodhakatvāt| uktaṃ ca bhaṭṭapādaiḥ| kṛdantena hi dravyaviśiṣṭaṃ kārakamucyate| natu vibhaktyeva niṣkṛṣṭāśaktiḥ| tathā ca kārakaṃ kārakeṇeti syāditi| evaṃ ca niṣkṛṣṭarūpapratipattireva udbhava iti dik| nanvevamapi paktvaudano bhujyate iti na syāt| ktvāpratyayasya karmārthatāyāḥ kenāpyanaṅgīkārāt| ākhyātena bhujikriyāni rūpitaśaktyābhidhāne'pi pacikriyānirūpitakarmaśakteranabhidhānena dvitīyāpatteriticet maivam| pradhānakriyānirūpitaśaktyanurodhenaivābhidhānānābhidhānaprayuktakāryāṇāṃ pravṛtteḥ| etena caitreṇa bhuktvāgacchatīti bhavatyeva| tadvadityatideśena pradhānoktiprayuktakāryātideśe'pi svaniṣṭhānabhidhānaprayuktanaprayuktakāryaniṣedhābhāvādatideśe tathaiva vyutpatteriti nirastam| pradhānānurodhenaiva guṇakāryapravṛtteḥ kaiyaṭādivirodhācca| atideśaviruddhasyaiva svāśrayasya pravṛtteḥ karmavatsūtragatabhāṣyādi siddhatvāt| taduktaṃ hariṇā-- pradhānetarayo ryatra dravyasya kriyayoḥ pṛthak| śaktirguṇāśrayā tatra pradhānamanurudhyate|| pradhānaviṣayā śaktiḥ pratyayenābhidhīyate| yadā guṇe tadā tadvadanuktāpi pratīyate|| iti| ayamarthaḥ| vākyārthe tiṅantavācyaiva kriyā pradhānam| itaratvasya pradhānapratiyogikatvalābhāyājādyacadantasyāpatirapadasya paranipātaḥ| pṛthak iti śaktyanvapi| kriyābhedena kārakaśaktibhedāt| anurudhyate iti vyācaṣce pradhāneti| yadābhidhīyateityanvayaḥ| anuktāpi ākhyātena| svaprakṛtyarthākriyānirūpitaśaktimātrābhidhānāt| ktvāprakṛtyarthakriyānirūpitaśakterabhidhātumaśakyatvāt| tadvad-uktavat| guṇānāṃ pradhānamukhamekṣitayā ekasminneva pade pradhānaśaktyābhidhānaprayuktakāryabodhena svānabhidhānaprayuktatadviruddhakāryaprayojakatvānupapatteḥ| kriyādvārakaścatatsādhanayoḥ śaktyorguṇapradhānabhāva ityarthaḥ| aṅguṇavirodhanyāyo'pyatrānusaṃdheyaḥ| yattu mīmāṃsakairuktam| evaṃ sati odanaṃ bhuktvā śāstraṃ paṭhyate `śrutvāpyarthaṃ nānumatastenaso'rthaḥkubuddhine'tyādiprayogānupapattirato yadvṛttikārakatvaṃ svānvayikriyāpratipādakena padena vṛttyāpratīpādyaṃ tatvaṃ prathamāprayojakam| abhihitatvaṃ anvayaśca prāthamikaḥ| tenauduṃbaro yūpobhavati, svargakāmo yajatetyatra yūpambhāvayoditi karmatvalakṣaṇāyāmāpi śaktijanyabodhe kartṛtvasyoktatvātprathamopapattiḥ| yatra tvanvayānupapattyālakṣaṇājanyabodha eva prāthamikaḥ| yathā'gniḥ pāke yatate caitraḥ ityatrāgneḥ karaṇatve tatrayatatipadenakaraṇatvānabhidhānātprathamāyā asādhutvameva| paktvaudano bhujyate ityādau caudanasya pācakriyāyāṃ nānvayaḥ| kintudvitīyāntaudanapadādhyāhāra eveti| tadasat| tatra guṇapradhānaśaktibhyāṃdharmibhedenasvānabhidhānābhidhānaprayuktakāryārambhe bādhakābhāvāt| yatpadopasthāpyakārakaniṣṭhaśaktyabhidhānaṃ pratyayena tatpadopasthāpyakārakaniṣṭhakriyāntarasādhanaśaktereva viruddhakāryānārambhakatvācca| dvitīye padabhedena taddveṣābhāvāt| nacaivaṃ caitreṇa bhuktvā caitro gacchatīti prayogāpattiḥ| samānakartṛkatvasyavyabhicārābhāvena guṇakriyāyāṃ pṛthak‌kartṛvācakapadaprayogābhāvāt| ataeva caitrobhuvattvā caitro gacchatīti na prayogaḥ| karmaikyasyatvanāvaśyakatvātkvacitkarmaṇaḥ pṛthak‌prayogopīti anenajīvenātmanānupraviśya nāmarūpevyākaravāṇīti vākyavyākhyānaprastāve tarkakautūhale vistaraḥ| prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ| yattu navyamīmāṃsakairuktam| pacatītyukte kīdṛg‌vidhaiti praśnānurodhena tadupapādakadharmijñānārthaṃākhyātasyalakṣaṇayākartrādiparatvāt tādṛśābhidhānādikameva vibhaktivyavastāpakam| nacaivaṃ kṛtpratyayena śaktyā tiṅāca lakṣaṇayā tadabhidhānamiti ubhayasādhāraṇābhidhānānupapattiritivācyam| vṛttyā pratipādyatvasya tadarthatvāditi| tadasat| evaṃsatyubhayāpekṣayā kartrādiśakterevānuśāsanasiddhāyāḥ kalpayitumucitatvāt| yadapi yatratu ṣaṣṭhoktanyāyenāśrayānekatvagrāhakaṃ pramāṇamasti| yathādampatyoḥ| tatrayajetetyādividhivākye evavacanaśravaṇānnākhyātenāśrayalakṣaṇā ekatvānanvayāpatteḥ| dvitvalakṣaṇāyāṃca pramāṇābhāvāt| atastatrākhyātena kartṛtvatvaṃlakṣyatāvacchedakakṛtyakartṛtvaṃlakṣyate natvāśrayo'pi| taspārtādevavodhopapatteḥ| svargakāmādipadasyāpi tatra lakṣaṇayā bhāvyamātraparatvāt| prathamāprayojakaṃ tusarvatrakartṛtvoktireva| sāca yatra kartāri lakṣaṇā tatrakartṛtvaprakārikāyatra kartṛtve lakṣaṇā tatrakartṛtvaviśeṣyaketibhedaḥ| athavā kartṛtvādeḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyasaṃsargeṇa kṛtāvanvayāt taddhaṭakatayā saṃsargamaryādayaivakartrāderbhānam| tadādāyaivānuśāsanam| evaṃ cābhihitatvalakṣaṇe vṛttyetyapi nadeyam| kintusāṃsargikaviṣayatāsādhāraṇyena śādbavidhayāpratipādyatvamātramiti| tadapyamat| laḥ karmaṇītyādyanuśāsanavirodhāt| saṃsargasya śāstratātparyāviṣayakatvāt| guṇādhikaraṇe vaiśvadevītyādau prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ saṃsargabalāddevatātvapratītiriti pakṣadūṣaṇāya saṃsargavidhayā bhāsamānasya padārthānuśāsanapravṛttairanuśāsanānupapatteritibhīmāṃsākaustubhe svayamevābhihitatvāt| kartarikṛdityatra vācye ityarthasya vāpyanumatatvāduttaratrakathaṃ cit pratipādye ityarthānupapatteḥ| śabdādhikārasyāpyanabhyarhitatvāt| tajjanyapratīti viśeṣasyaivābhihitapadārthatvācca| daṇḍītyādiśādbe'bhedasya saṃsargatve'pi tasyadaṇḍipadābhidheyatvavyavahāravirahāt| yajetetyādau tu padārthatāvacchedakakartṛtvānvaye'pi saṃkhyāyā nakṣatiḥ| tadāhuḥ| parasparasāpekṣayorevāgnīṣomayorivadevatātvaṃ kartṛnvam| kartṛrūpaikyāccākhyātopāttasaṃkhyāgnīṣomau devatetivatsaha prayoge'pyaviruddhetidik| naiyāyikāstu anabhihitasaṃkhaayāke iti adhikārārthaḥ| caitraḥ pacatītyatra kartṛsaṃkhyāyāḥ pacyate taṇḍulaityatrakarmasaṃkhyāyā ecākhyātenābhidhānāt| naca kartṛkarmaṇoḥ samānavacanatve ubhayasaṃkhyābhidhānāpattiḥ| sākāṅkṣe eva tadanvayāt| taduktamācāryaiḥ-- ākṣepalabhye saṃkhyeye nābhidhānasya kalpanā| saṃkhyeyamātralābhe'pi sākāṅkṣema vyavasthitiriti| naca supaiva ekatvapratyayāttiṅo na tadarthatvaṃ| caitrośca gacchatityatra dvitvapratītestiṅ‌mātrasādhyatvāt| naca tatra supa eva dvitvelakṣaṇā| subvibhaktau lakṣaṇāṅgīkāre vyatyayānuśāsanavirodhāt| naca vibhaktyantarārtha eva supo na lakṣaṇā, dvitvaṃ tu tadvibhaktyartho'pīti vācyam| tathāpi caitradvayāderevabodhaprasaṅgādubhayaniṣṭhadvitvapratītyanupapatteḥ| prakṛtyarthamātragatasaṃkhyābodhakatvasya tatra vyatpatteḥ| nacaikatvenopasthite kartha dvitvānvayaḥ| tasyāvavivakṣitatvāt| dvayoḥ pratyekamekatvabodhe'pi dvau gamanānukūlakṛtimantāvitibodhopapatteḥ| naca brāhmaṇāḥ paṭhata ityatra bahavo brāhmaṇāḥ dvau paṭhanānukūlakṛtimantāviti bodhāpattiḥ| ākhyātajanyadvitvabodhe brāhmaṇāḥ paṭhata ityādijñānasya pratibandhakatvāt| naca tathāpi ākhyātaikavacanasyaikatve śaktau na mānamiti vācyam| taṇḍulaṃ pacatītyādyanurodhenadvitīyādyekavacanānāmekatveśaktavapiprarthamaikavacanasyaikatvaśaktau vinigamakābhāvāt| tathācākhyātārthasaṃkhyāprakārakabodhe bhāvanāprakāratanirūpitaviśeṣyatāsambandhena prathamāntapadajanyopasthitirhetuḥ| bhāvanāyāścaviśeṣyo'nyāviśeṣaṇatve satiprathamāntapadopasthāpyaḥ| bhāvanāyā āśrayākāṅkṣatvātpuruṣasyāpi kriyākāṅkṣatvāt| taduktamācāryaiḥ| nahyanyatarākāṅkṣānvayahetuḥ, kintūbhayākāṅkṣā| prātipadikārtho hi phalenānvayamalabhamānaḥ kriyāmbandhamapekṣate| bhāvanāpi vyāpārabhūtā satīvyāpārimityubhayākāṅkṣeti| tasmāttiṅi saṃkhaayābhidhānānabhidhānābhyāṃ kṛtpratyayasthaletukartṛkarmaṇorabhidhānānabhidhānābhyāṃ vyavasthā| anabhihitaityasyacakartṛkarmasaṃkhyāyāḥ kartṛkarmaṇo rvānabhidhāne ityarthaḥ| etena kartrekatvatvādinā śaktaugauravamityādikamapāstam| navyāstu pacyate taṇḍulaityatra phalāvacchinnakriyāyādhātvarthatve kartṛkriyāyāścādheyatvārthatve maitravṛttivyāpārajanyaphalaśālī taṇḍulaiti bodho na syāt| śaktiśādbayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaviparyayāpatteḥ tasmādvyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ, phalamātmanepadārthaḥ, janyatvaṃ saṃsargaḥ, maitravṛttikṛtijanyavyāpārajanyaphalaśālītibodhaḥ| evaṃca pacatītyatrakṛteḥ, pacyateityatraphalasyābhidhānānabhidhānābhyaāṃvyavasthā ghaṭo jñāyateityādau viṣayatāyā ghaṭo naśyatītyādaucapratiyogitāyā apibhāktekarmatvakartṛtve tatsādhāraṇasyaivābhidhānam| kṛtpratyayecasāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhena viśiṣṭavācitve'pi viśeṣaṇasyāpyabhidhānasattvena sarvatraikarūpyopapatteḥ| kṛtāmapi kṛtāvevaśaktiḥ pacatītyatrādheyatvaṃ maitreṇapacyate taṇḍulaityatrādhikaraṇatvarūpaṃ karmatvaṃ dvitīyākhyātayo ryathākramamarthaḥ| tathāca taṇḍulavṛttiryāviklattirityādiḥ pūrvavadvodhaḥ| dvitīye tu adhikaraṇaṃ tiṅartaḥ vyāpārasya janyatvena phale'nvayaḥ tataścaitravṛttivyāpārajanyaviklityadhikaraṇaṃ taṇḍula iti satamākhyātadīdhitau parairupanyastamiti vibhāvanīyam| matāntarantu saṃsargā pavaite tato'ṅgīkārāt| nacakāryaviśeṣapuraskāreṇa tatpravṛttyapravṛttibhyāṃ nirvāhaḥ| atideśasyānityatvāditi vācyam| kalpanāyāṃ lāghavānavatārāt| atideśena padatvasyaivānetuṃ yuktatvācca| dvitīyārthaḥ tasyobhayapadārthe'nvayaḥ| kṛṣṇapratiyogikobhayapārśvavartina ityarthaḥ| dhik‌kṛṣṇābhaktamityatra viṣayitvaṃ dvitīyāyāḥ| dhik‌padasya ca nindārthaḥ| kṛṣṇābhaktaviṣayikā nindā| dvitīyā prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇasyaiva nindāyā hetutvaṃ vyutpattilabhyam| kṛṣṇabhaktyabhāvenaiva nindāpravṛtteḥ| saca nindāyāṃ viśeṣyatāvacchedakatvena bhāsate| kṛṣṇabhaktirahitatvācchedena nindāpratīteḥ| kvacittu viśeṣaṇapadārthānāmeva nindānimittatvaṃ dhikkarabhamasatidīrghagrīvamityādau kvacittātparyagamyānāṃ dhik‌tañca tāṃ ca madanaṃ caimāṃ camāṃcetyādau yāṃ cintayāmi satataṃ mayisānaraktāityādi `abhitaḥ paritaḥ samayānikaṣāhāpratiyogepī'ti| `paryabhibhyāṃ ce'ti tasilantāvabhitaḥ paritaḥ śabdau ubhayataḥ sarvata ityanayorarthe vartete| abhimukhyavṛtterapyabhitaḥ śabdasya bubhukṣitavṛttyabhāvapratiyogipratibhāniṣṭhaviṣayatānirūpitam| yadvā kiñcinniṣṭhābhāvapratiyogipratibhāviṣayatvaṃ bubhukṣitavṛttipratibhāniṣṭhaviṣayatānirūpitam| yadvā kiñcinniṣṭhābhāvapratiyogipratibhāviṣayatvaṃ bubhukṣitavṛttipratibhāniṣṭhaviṣayatānirūpitamiti navyamīmāṃsakāḥ| taccintyam| kiñcinniṣṭhapratibhāviṣayatvasya bubhukṣitanṛttyabhāvapratiyoginī yā pratibhā tadviṣayatvasya caikyena nirūpyanirūpakabhāvānupapatteḥ| bubhukṣitavṛttipratibhāsvīkāre pratibhāviṣayatvasya kiñcinniṣṭhābhāvapratiyogitvānupapatteśca| pratibhāyā jñānarūpāyāḥ saviṣayatvaniyamāt| vastutastu bubhukṣitavṛttinirūpitatvaṃ svaviṣayakatvaṃ cetyubhayasambandhena pratibhātyantābhāvavatkiñciditi dhīḥ| yadvā kiñcidviṣayakapratibhāviraho bubhukṣitavṛttiḥ| etena strīratnalābhocitayatnamagnamenaṃ hi na sya pratibhāti kiñciditi naiṣadhaṃ vyākhyātam| dṛśigrahaṇādanye'pi caitraṃ yāvacchītam| tatparyantakālanṛttyabhāvāpratiyogi śītamitidhīḥ| uṣṇatve eva asattvabhūtaphale kālakavibhaktestāvatāpyasiddhau tadviśeṣaṇedūrāpāstatvāt| svargakāmoyajetetyādau tubhāvyasyabhinnapadopāttatayā dhātvarthasya karaṇatvenānvaye tasya siddhaikasvabhāvattvādasiddhasya tadanupapattyā arthādbhāvyatvalābha iti vaiṣamyam| phale pradhānaṃ vyāpārastiṅarthastu viśeṣaṇam|| iti rītyā phalajanakatvasya vyāpāre lābhāt| tacchādbe phalasya bhāvyatvānavagāhanāt| abhyupetyāpi brūmaḥ| pacyate odanaḥ svayamevetyādau viklittimātraṃ dhātvarthaḥ| tadrūpakriyāśratvādodanasya kartṛtvamityākaraḥ| taduktaṃ vākyapadīye- ekadeśe samūhe vā vyāpārāṇāṃ pacādayaḥ| svabhāvataḥ pravartante tulyarūpaṃ samāśritāḥ|| iti| tadviśeṣaṇasya stokādeḥ karmatvaṃ na syāt| vyāpārasya tatsamabhivyāhāre dhātvarthatvābhāve vikletteḥ kriyājanyaphalāśrayatvābhāvāt| evaṃ paśyati bhavaḥ svayameva, darśayate bhava ityādau viṣayatvāpādanāṃśatyāgena viṣayatvāpattimātrasya dhātvarthatvāt| tatra viṣayatvā pādanasyānavagamāt kriyātvābhāvāt viṣayatvāpatteḥ karmatvānupapattyā tatra kriyāviśeṣaṇānāmapi tanna syāt| naca tatra na bhavatyeva viśeṣaṇānvaya iti vācyam| mānābhāvāt| evaṃ stokamodanaḥ pacyate ityāderapyanupapattiḥ| pākaḥ| kriyate iti vivaraṇānurodhena tatra pākavṛttikarmatvasyābhihitatvena tadviśeṣaṇe dvitīyānaucityāt| evaṃ ca dhātvarthāntarbhūtasya karmaṇo lakāreṇa nābhidhānamityapyaśāstrīyaṃ vaidharmyābhidhānam| tathāhi-tatkarmatvaprayuktāyā viśeṣamadvitīyāyā apyanupapatteḥ| sāmānādhikaraṇyādviśeṣaṇe vibhaktiriti pakṣe dvitīyāntasāmānādikaraṇyābhāvāt| kaṭo'pi karmetyaṅgīkāre tu stokādikarmaṇo dhātvarthavahirbhūtatvācadabhidhānasya durvāratvāt| nacaivaṃ jyotiṣṭomenetyatra tṛtīyāpi na syāditi vācyam| tatra tasyaiva prādhānyāt| evamodanaṃ pacatītyasya nirvartyakarmatayā phalaviśaṣṭasyaivaudanapadārthatayā pacati rvyāpāramātrārtho natu phalārvācchannavyāpārārthaḥ| sādhyatvākhyaviṣayatayaivaudanasya karmatvāt| ato noktarītyā prakṛtasiddhiḥ| tasmāttato'nyatrāpi dṛśyate ityevāśrayaṇīyam| kecittu`tatpratyanupūrvamīpalomakūla'miti sūtre taditi napuṃsakadvitīyakaivacanāntena tacchadbena vartate iti prakṛtavartanakriyāviśeṣopādānaṃ jñāpakam| yadyapi tadadhīte ityādau sautraṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ na vivakṣyate tathāpi prakṛte saṅgrāhyaliṅgāntarābhāvāttadvivakṣetyāhuḥ| tṛtīyā ca horachandasi || 3 || juhoteḥ karmaṇi tṛtīyādvitīya staśchandasi| yavāgvāgnihotraṃ juhoti| agnihotramatra haviḥ| homaḥ prakṣepaḥ| vibhakterbhinnatve'pi viruddhārthakatvābhāvāt yavāguhaviṣorabhedānvayaḥ| bhāṣyakṛtastu agnihotraśabdo jyotiṣyapi vartate| agnihotraṃ prajvalitamiti darśanāt| juhotiśca prīṇane| agniṣu hūyamāneṣviti darśanāt| yadā yavāgūśadbātṛtīyā tadā tayā'gniṃ prīṇātītyarthaḥ| yadā tu dvītīyā tadā yavāgvākhyaṃ haviḥ prakṣipatītyarthaḥ| ataḥ sūtraṃ na kāryamityāhuḥ| antarāntareṇa yukte || 4 || antarāśabdo yadyapyantarāyāṃ purīti ṭābanto'pyasti, antareṇa śabdo'pi tṛtīyānto'pi tathāpi pratipadāktatvānnipātayorgrahaṇam| udbhūtādhāraśaktike madhye ityarthe vinārthe caitau| dyāmantarā vasumatīmapi gādhijanmā| mṛṇālamūtrāmalamantareṇa sthitaścalaccāmarayordvayaṃ saḥ, tvāmantarā tāmarasāyatākṣi, antareṇa hariṃ nasukham| sambandhitvamādyayordvitīyārthaḥ| dyāvāpṛthivyoścāmaradvayasyaca madhye ityarthaḥ| vinārthe pratiyogitvaṃ dvitīyārthaḥ| tadādye saṃyogaviśeṣavacchinnaṃ, dvitīye bhaktiviśeṣāvacchinnamityādyavaseyam| kinte bābhravaśālaṅkāyanānāmantareṇa gatenetyatra tu teṣāṃ tāratamyena jñātena kimityarthaḥ| dvayoścaivāntarā, avidyamānā antarā yeṣāmiti bhāṣye tu sambandhamātre ṣaṣṭhī| madhyāpekṣayā avadhitvavivakṣāyāmeva dvitīyāsvīkārāt| sambandhavivakṣāyāṃ hi na jñāyate kiṃ tayorevāvadhitvaṃ utānyasahitayorityāhuḥ| yattu antareṇa puruṣamityādau pratiyogitvavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhī na syāt| tadvivakṣayā dvitīyāsattve'pi tayorevāvadhitvaṃ na tvanyasahitayoriti nirṇayāsambhavācca| mānāntareṇa nirṇayasya tulyatvāditi tanna| dvitīyāprayogasyaiva tādṛśatātpaparye grāhakatvāt| madhyasyāvadhinirūpyatvena sapratiyogikatvābhāvācca| avadhitvasyaiva tena vivakṣāyāṃ tu viśeṣābhāvāt| madhyamyobhayanirūpyatayā tādṛśaprayogābhāvācca| nirūpakapratītyaiva madhyapratītyupapattau tadatiriktāvadhitvanirākāṅkṣatvācca| yadapi tava mamaca madhye kamaṇḍalurityatra ṣaṣṭhyantayoḥ kamaṇḍalāvevānvayaḥ, tannirūpyatvaṃ madhyamasya mānāntarasyamyam| dvitīyāprayoge tu tadapekṣayaiva madhyabodho yuktapadasvārasyāt iti| taccintyam| sambandho hi madhyanirūpakatvaṃ, svasvāmibhāvādirvā?| nādyaḥ| tvanmannirūpyamadhyavṛttiḥ kamaṇḍalurmadhyavṛttiritibodhasya nirākāṅkṣatvāt| nāntyaḥ| anyadīye'pi kamaṇḍalau tava mama cetyādiprayogāt| tava mama ca kamaṇḍalurantareti vākyajanyadhiyo vailakṣaṇyācca|| kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge || 5 || dvitīyā syāt| kālo māsādirūpastadupādhiḥ| adhvā gantavyatvena prasiddhaḥ| krośayojanādiḥ| māsamadhīte| krośaṃ śete| atyanteti kim| amāvāsyāyāṃ yajate| atyanto vyāpakaḥ sambandhaḥ|, tanniṣṭhātyantābhāvāpratiyogitvamiti yāvat| tathā ca kālikasambandhāvacchinnapratiyogitāko yo māsaniṣṭhātyantābhāvastadapratiyogyadhyayanamiti dhīḥ| avacchedakatāsambandhāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvaṃ krośaniṣṭhātyantābhāve niveśya pūrvavadanyadvācyam| nanu dvitīyāmātravidhāne āsyate māsaḥ, śayyate krośa iti āsito māsaḥ āsitavyaḥ māsa ityādau karmaṇi lakārādayo na syuriti cet| atra vārtikakāraḥ| karmavaditi vaktavyam| tena noktadoṣaḥ| vatkaraṇantu svāśrayamapi yathā syāt| āsyate māsam| śayyate krāśam| akarmakatvāt bhāve lakārādaya iti| bhāṣyakṛtastvāhuḥ prākṛtamevedaṃ karmoti| ayamarthaḥ| vyāpanādiviśiṣṭa āsanādirmāsamāste ityādau dhātvarthaḥ| tato viśeṣaṇībhūtavyāpanādikriyāpekṣaṃ svābhāvikametatkarma| tataścāsanādeḥ karaṇatvenānvayaḥ| svargakāmo yajatetyādivat| āsanena māsaṃ vyāpnotītyarthaḥ| prayogasya vyavasthitatvācca kaṭe āste ityādau śuddha evāsanādau vṛttiriti nātiprasaṅgaḥ| tathāca vākyapadīye- kālabhāvādhvadeśānāmantarbhūtakriyāntaraiḥ|| sarvairakarmakairyoge karmatvamupajāyate|| iti| sārvatrikasyāsanāderapekṣayā vyāpanādeḥ kriyāntaratvam| akarmaketyupalakṣaṇam| māsamadhīte iti bhāṣyodāharaṇāt| māsamāste kaṭe ityādau kaṭaśadbāttu na dvitīyā vyāpanakarmatvāditi helārājaḥ| deśakālādhvagantavyā iti niyamāditi kecit| nacaivamapi bhāve lakārādikaṃ na syāditi vācyam| akarmakebhya iti dhātunāmanyapadārthatvātteṣāṃ prayogāntare tadarthānāmeva kālādisambandhadarśanāttairakarmakatvāsambhavātsāmarthyādviśeṣāṅgīkāreṇa dravyarūpeṇa karmaṇā ye'karmakāsteṣāṃ grahaṇāt| athavā'ntaraṅgeṇa dravyakarmaṇā bahiraṅgasya kālādostirobhāvāttadapekṣasakarmakākarmakavyevahārāpravṛtteḥ| antaraṅgakarmaṇo'sannidhāne tu bahiraṅgeṇāpi kālādikarmaṇā sakarmakatvasvīkāreṇa māsaāsyate iti karmaṇyapi lakārādiḥ| uktaṃca vākyapadīye| ādhāratvamiva prāptāste dravyaguṇakarmasu|| atastaiḥ karmabhirdhātu ryukto dravyairakarmakaḥ| lasya karmaṇi bhāve ca nimittatvāya kalpate iti|| etena `sasne māghamaghātighāti yamunāgaṅgaughasaṅge yaye'ti naiṣadhaṃ vyākhyātam| sasnau māghamiti saṅgenayoti ca pāṭhakalpanantu bhrāntinibandhanatvādupekṣyam| sūtraṃ tu krośaṃ kuṭilā nadītyatra guṇenātyantasaṃyoge dvitīyārtham| krośasya kriyāyogābhāve karmatvānupapatteḥ| avacchinnatvaṃ dvitīyārthaḥ| krośāvacchinnakauṭilyāśraya ityarthaḥ| apavarge tṛtīyā || 6 || apavargaḥ kriyāvirahaḥ| saca dvedhā| sādhanavaikalyenaphalaprāptyā ca| tatra sāmarthyātphalaprāptinibandhana evāpavargo'tra grāhyo natvaśaktyādikṛtaḥ| etadabhiprāyeṇaivāpavargaḥ phalaprāptiriti vyākhyātam| tatra tātparye kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge tṛtīyā syāt| ahnā krośena vānuvāko'dhītaḥ| neha| māsamadhīto nāyātaḥ| atraphalopadhānaviśiṣṭe'ghyayane dhātorlakṣaṇā| anyatpūrvavat| dinādivyāpakaṃ phalopadhāyakamadhyayanamiti dhīḥ| pratyudāharaṇe nāyāta iti phalarāhityadyotanārtham| saptamīpa़ñcamyau kārakamadhye || 7 || kārakamadhyavartinoḥ kālādhvanoḥ ete staḥ| ihastho'yaṃ krośe krośādvā lakṣyaṃ nidhyet| devadattādhikaraṇadeśasya lakṣyarūpakarmaṇaśceti dvayoḥ kārakayormadhyavartī krośaḥ| nanu adya devadatto bhuktvā dvyahāna dvyahe vā bhoktetyatra dravyasya devadattarūpakārakasyai katvādbhedanibandhano madhyabhāvo nāstīti cet| na, vārtikarītyā kriyāmadhye iti nyāsenaivopapatteḥ| bhāṣyakṛtastu śakteḥ kārakatvasya pūrvamuktatvāt adyatanabhojanakriyānirūpitakartṛtvādvyahottarakālīnabhojanakriyānirūpitakartṛtvasya bhedāt kārakamadhyatvamastyevetyāhuḥ| vastutaḥ kriyābhedena śaktibhedo natu kālabhedena| anavasthāpattermānābhāvācca| kriyābhedaśca kriyāvibhājakopādhyavicchinnapratiyogitākaḥ saca nādyatanadvyahakālīnabhujikriyayoḥ ato vārtikamāvaśyakaṃ lāghavācceti vibhāvanīyam| adhikaraṇatvaṃ vibhaktyarthaḥ| pañcamyartho vidhiḥ| atra madhyebhojanābhāvo vivakṣitaḥ| madhyasya nirūpakānadhikaraṇatvaniyamāt| etaddināvyavahitottaradinavṛttyabhāvapratiyogibhojanakartotidhīḥ| dvyahe bhojanābhātre'pyuktaprayogāt| krośodāharaṇe tu etaddeśavṛttereva krośavṛttilakṣyavedhasāmartyaṃ pratipādyam| natu sannihitalakṣyavedhābhāvo'pakarṣaparyavasānātkaimutikatvācca| karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā || 8 || karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāḥ prāguktāḥ tadyoge dvitīyā syāt| japamanu prāvarṣat| hetubhūtajapopalakṣitaṃ varṣaṇamiti dhīḥ| atha sāmānyato lakṣaṇapraṇayane vṛkṣaṃ pari vidyotate ityatrāpi viśeṣavihitatvāt `pañcamyapāṅ‌pārabhi'riti pañcamī syāt| sādhu devadatto mātaraṃ pratītyatra paratvāta`sādhunipuṇābhyāmarccāyā'miti saptamī syāt| apraterityasyopāttatve'pi tatraiva gauravāt| iti cet| atra vārtikam| pratyādibhiśca lakṣaṇādiṣviti vaktavyamiti| tataśca tadarthapuraskāreṇaiva dvitīyāvidhānānnoktadoṣa iti bhāvaḥ| apraterityasyoktatvānna saptamī| varjanārthakāpaśabdasāhacaryeṇa parerapi tādṛśasyaiva grahaṇānna pañcamyapīti bhāṣyam| yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ tatra saptamī || 9 || yadapekṣayādhikyaṃ karmapravacanīyadyotyaṃ tasmāt, aiśvaryadyotakakarmapravacanīyayuktācca saptamī syāt| upa parārdhe harerguṇāḥ| tato'pyadhikāḥ| skasvāmimyāṃ paryāyeṇa| yasyeti ṣaṣṭhyā nirūpyatvavṛttitbobhayaparatvāmāśritya yacchadbasyobhayaparatvāt| adhibhuvi rāmo bhūvṛttisvatvamapratiyogī| adhirāme bhūḥ| rāmanirūpyasvatvāśrayaḥ| adhikayoge pañcamīsaptamyau| `yasmādadhikaṃ' `tadasminnadhika'miti ca mautranirdeśāt| adhiko lokāt loke vāhariḥ| svatvādisambandhasya vṛttyaniyāmakatvātsūtrārambhaḥ|| bhāṣye tu svasvāminorādhikaraṇatvavivakṣayā paryāyeṇa saptamīsiddheryasyacetyaṃśaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ| adhirīśvare iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāpi na kāryā| aiśvaryaviṣayasya adheḥ kriyāyogābhāvādeva gatyupasargasaṃjñayoraprasaṅgāt| pañcamyapāṅaparibhiḥ || 10 || karmapravacanīyairetairyoge pañcamī| apaviṣṇoḥ pariviṣṇoḥ saṃsāraḥ| viṣṇuniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogītyarthaḥ| parirvarjanārtha evātreti prāguktam|| āṅ maryādāvacane || āpāṭaliputrāt vṛṣṭo devaḥ| tadvarjayitvetyarthaḥ|| pratinidhipratidāneca yasmāt || 11 || tatra karmapravacanīyayukte pañcamī| pradyumnaḥ kṛṣṇātmati| tilebhyaḥ pratiyacchati māṣān| `yasmādi'tyanenaiva pañcamī| gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau ceṣṭāyāmanadhvani || 12 || adhvanyarthagrahaṇam| tena paryāyāṇāmapi paryudāsaḥ| āsthitapratiṣedhaśca vaktavyaḥ| bhedapratīyogī adhvā gantradhiṣṭhitatvena viśeṣaṇīyaḥ| tathāca gantradhiṣṭhitādhvabhinne gatyarthānāṃ karmaṇi ete staḥ ceṣṭāyāṃ satyām| grāmaṃ grāmāya vā gacchati| adhvabhinne kim, panthānaṃ gacchati| adhvano gantradhiṣṭhitatvena viśeṣaṇaṃ kim, utpathātpatha ākramitumiṣyamāṇatve caturthī yathā syāt| utpathena pathe gacchati| gatyartheti kim| odanaṃ pacati| karmaṇi kim, aśvena vrajati| ceṣṭāyāṃ kim, manasā hiraṃ vrajati| andhavanītyasya sthāne'saṃprāpte iti vaktavyam| asamprāptaṃ vastu gamanena yatsaṃprekṣyate tatra karmaṇītyarthaḥ| tena striyaṃ gacchatītyatra na caturthī| samprāptatvāt| nanu asamprāptatvaṃ kena sambandhena| svasvāmibhāvasambandhena striyāḥ samprāptatve'pi dhātvarthatāva cchedakasambandhenāsaṃprāpteḥ| yatkiñcitsambandhena
