grāmāderapi prāptatvāt| maivam| tatsākṣātsambandhābhāvaviśiṣṭasaṃyogādinā'saṃprāptervivakṣitatvāt| ata evājāṃ nayatītyajāyāṃ na caturthī| kecittu nayatirna gatyarthaḥ| ākṣepādeva tatra gatipratīterityāhuḥ| atra bhāṣyakārāḥ gamanakriyayā grāmasyopsitatamatvātakriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti vārtikena gatārthamidaṃ sūtramiti| atra kaiyaṭādayaḥ| yadyapīdaṃ vārtikaṃ karmaṇā yamabhipraitītyatra bhāṣyakṛtā pratyākhyātam| tathāpi tatratyanyāyasmaraṇārthamidamuktam| sarvāpi kriyā jñānecchādikriyā(karma)tadvyatirekeṇacetanasādhyakriyānutpatteḥ| taduktam-pūrvaṃ hi sampaśyatyadhyavasyatītyādi| tatra yadā gamanasya saṃdarśanādīnāṃ ca bhedavivakṣā tadā sandarśanādikriyābhirāpyamānatvāt karmaṇā gamanenābhipeyamāṇasya grāmasya sampradānatvāccaturthī| yadā tvabhedavivakṣā tadā gamanasya karmatvābhāvā dgrāmaḥ karmaiva bhavati iti dvitīyā| bhedābhedavivakṣā ca laukikaprayogānusāreṇa, niyataviṣaye tvārambhapratyākhyānayornāsti phalabheda iti| atra navyamīmāṃsakāḥ| naitadyuktam| pacyādibhyo jñānādyanubhavābhāvāt| niyamenārope'pi pramāmābhāvāt| vidhyabhāve kāraṇābhāvena prayogagatasādhutvajñānābhāvāttena bhedābhedavyavasyāpratītyanupapatteśca| ata evātra sūtre bhāṣyakṛtāpi tadvārtikasya vidhitvamāśritam| nacaivaṃ gatyarthakarmaṇītyādisūtrapratyākhyānānupapattiḥ| dhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalaśālitvarūpe tatsamaniyate'khaṇḍopādhauca vivakṣite dvitīyā| tadanavacchedakakriyājanyaphalaśālitve vivakṣite caturthītyabhiprāyāt| gamanajanyasvāsthyādyāśrayatvena grāmāya gacchatītyasyopapatteḥ| nacaivamadhvādirūpāpavādaviṣaye'pi prayogadvayāpattiḥ| tadaṃśe'pratyākhyānasya bhāṣyābhimatatvāt| bhāṣyakāro hi-adhvādīnāṃ na svarūpeṇāpavādaviṣayatvaṃ| striyaṅgacachatītyatra dvitīyāniyamānāpatteḥ| api tu saṃprāptatvena, prāpta eva panthāḥ strīca| tatra panthānaṃ gacchati striyaṃ gacchatīti dvitīyāniyama iti pratipādayanna saṃyukte karmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau bhavata ityāha| ato vārtikapratyākhyāne na bhāṣyatātparyamityāhuḥ| ata eva vṛttikāreṇātra dvitīyopādānaṃ apavādaviṣaye'pi dvitīyāvidhānārtham| anyathā caturthīvikalpameva kuryāt| tenaitatsūtraviṣaye kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛtītvasya na pravṛttiḥ| ato grāmaṃ ganteti tṛjante dvitīyaivetyuktam| sarvātmanaitatsūtrapratyākhyāne tu tatra paṣṭhyā eva bhāṣyasammatatvāpattyā vṛttigranthānupapatteḥ| yattu dvitīyeti sūtre grāmaṃ gāmītyatrāvaśyake ṇinau dvitīyaveti vṛttimataṃ kaiyaṭādau etatmatyākhyānodbhāvanena hūṣitaṃ, tadapi svamatopaṣṭambhamātreṇeti draṣṭavyam| caturthī sampradāne || 13 || viprāya gāṃ dadāti| tādarthye upasaṃkhyānam| tatpadaṃ kāryaparam| tasmai idaṃ tadarthamitikāryaviśiṣṭakāraṇalābhaḥ| taduttarabhāvapratyayātkāryakāraṇabhāvasambandhalābhaḥ| kṛttiddhitasamāsebhyaḥ sambandhābhidhānamitinyāyāt| tasyobhayavṛttitve'pi rājñaḥ puruṣa ityādau ṣaṣṭhīva yūpāya dārviti caturthī viśeṣaṇādeva| ata eva hetutṛtīyāpi dāruśabde na pravartate| prakṛtyaiva hetutvasya pratipāditatvāt| hetutvasya prakṛtyarthānantarbhāve eva tadvidhānāt| tadāhuḥ| tasmādityupakāryaṃ hi kāryaṃ pratyavamṛśyate| tadarthaśabdātsambandhe bhāvapratyaya iṣyate|| gamyamānavibhaktitvāccaturthī kāryavācinī| guṇe kṛtāspadā tasmātkāraṇaṃ nāvagāhate|| nacopasaṃkhyānena sūtraṃ gatārtham| haraye rocate bhaktirityādyarthaṃ tadārambhāt| upakārāpakārasādhārāṇaṃ tādarthyam| maśakebhyo dhūmaḥ| etena- gonāsāya niyojitā gadarajāḥ sarpāya baddhauṣadhiḥ| kaṇṭhasthāya viṣāya vīryamahataḥ pāṇau maṇīn bibhratī| bharturbhūtagaṇāya gotrajaratī nirdiṣṭamantrākṣarā| rakṣatvadrisutā vivāhasamaye prītā ca bhītā ca vaḥ|| iti kavirājaśeṣaprayogā vyākhyātāḥ| `klṛpi sampadyamāne ca vikāravācakāccaturthī'| sampadyate prādurbhavatītyarthāt| bhaktirjñānāya kalpate| prakṛtivikṛtyorabhedavivakṣāyāṃ bhaktirjñānaṃ kalpate iti prathamaiveti na caturthītyanye| apādānatvavikṣāyāṃ bhakterjñānaṃ kalpate iti pañcamīti kecit| anyetu tatrāpi virodhābhāvāccaturthītyāhuḥ| `utpātena jñāpite ca'| śubhāśubhasūcako vikāra utpātaḥ| tajjñāpye svottarakālabhāvitvena bodhye caturthī| vātāya kapilā vidyut, ātapāyātilohinī| māṃsaudanāya vyāharati mṛgaḥ| hitayoge caturthī tatsamāsavidhānajñāpyā| brāhmaṇāya hitam sambandhitvaṃ caturthyarthaḥ| kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇisthāninaḥ|| 14 || pāribhāṣikopapadasya kriyārthakriyārūpasya tumun‌ṇvul‌nirūpitabhinnasyāsambhavāt sāmarthyāttayoreva viśeṣyatvam| sthānipadaṃ yadyapyādeśaprayojyanivṛttipratiyogitvena prasiddhaṃ, tathāpyaprayujyamānatvamatra tadarthaḥ| phalebhyo yāti| phalānyāhartuṃ phalānyāhārako vā yātītyarthaḥ| gamyamānāharaṇakriyānirūpitaṃ karmatvaṃ caturthyarthaḥ|| tumarthācca bhāvacanāt || 15 || bhāvavacanāśceti sūtreṇa tumarthe vihitā ye ghañādayastadantācca caturthī| yāgāya yāti| pākāya pacanāya paktaye| naca tādarthyena gatārthatvam| tumuneva ghañādibhireva tādarthyasya dyotitatvāt prathamāyā eva prasaktestadbādhārthatvāt| naca tarhi bhānavacanāśceti sūtrameva vyarthaṃ śuddhabhāve ghaña vyutpādya tādarthyacaturthyaiva nirvāhāditi vācyam| kriyārthāyāṃ kriyāyāmupapade viśeṣavihitena tumunā ghaño bādhāpatteḥ| namaḥ svastisvāhāsvadhālaṃvaṣaḍ‌yogācca || 16 || ebhiryoge caturthī syāt| haraye namaḥ| svāpakarṣabodhānukūlo vyāpāro namaskāraḥ| avadhitvaṃ caturthyarthaḥ| haryavadhikasvāpakarṣabodhanamityarthaḥ| svasti jālmāya| atra svarūpakathanaṃ jālmatvādāśīlavivakṣā| svāhāvaṣaṭ‌śadbau devabhyaḥ, svadheti pitṛbhyo havirdāne| `tasyā dvau stanau devā upajīvanti svāhākaraṃ vaṣaṭkāraṃ ca, hantakāraṃ manuṣyāḥ, svadhākāraṃ pitara'iti śruteḥ| `srajā namaskṛtya tayaiva śakra'ityādau kṛñaeva namaskāro'rthaḥ, namaḥ śabdastātparyagrāhakaḥ| ato dvitīyā| upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasīti nyāyāt| namaskurmo nṛrsihāya, rāvaṇāya namaskuryādityādau `kriyārthopapadasye'ti caturthī| nṛsiṃha manukūlayitumityarthaḥ| alamiti paryāptyarthagrahaṇam| alaṃ mallo mallāya| daityebhyo hariḥ prabhuḥ samathai ityādi| `prabhurbubhūṣurbhuvanatrayasya ya'ityādau aiśvaryamarthaḥ| paryāptestadabhibhavasāmarthyarūpatvāt| cakāraḥ punarvidhānārthaḥ| tenāśīṃrvivakṣāyāmapi ṣaṣṭhīṃ bādhitvā caturthī| svasti gobhyo bhūyāt| anyathā pūrvokte sāvakāśāyāścaturthyāḥ svastibhinnakuśalārtheṣu sāvakāśayā ṣaṣṭhyā pakṣe paratvādbādhaḥ syāt| manyakarmaṇyanādare vibhāṣā'praṇiṣu || 17 || aprāṇiṣvityapanīya naukākānnaśukaśṛgālabhinneṣviti vaktavyam| etatsphoraṇārthameva bhedāśrayanvayino'pi bahutvasya pratiyogitāvacchedakabahutvasūcanāya nirdeśaḥ| manyeti śyanūprayogastanādinivṛttyarthaḥ| natu tadviśiṣṭayoga eva caturthītyetadarthaḥ| `tṛṇāya matvā raghunandano the'tyādiprayogavirodhāt| naca yak‌nirdeśa eva syāditi vācyam| anabhihitādhikārāt| anādara ityetaduttaraṃ `umamāne'ityadhikamāpiśalisūtram| tathāca yatpratiyogikasādṛśyāśrayatvena tadābhāvāśrayatvena vā prakṛtasya tiraskāravivakṣā tadvācakāccaturthī syāt| ādye tṛṇāya matvetyādi | dvitīye na tvāṃ tṛṇāya manye| evaṃ natvāṃ śune manye ityādi| prakṛṣya kutsitagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti vārtikam| sāmyābhāvavivakṣāyāmeva caturthī natu sāmyavivakṣāyām| pratikṛṣyeti pāṭhe'pyayamevārthaḥ| iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau dvitīyādhyāyasya tṛtīye pāde prathamamāhnikam| tṛtīyapāde dvitīyamāhnikam kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā || 18 || rāmeṇa bāṇena hato vālī| prakṛtyādibhya upasaṃkhyānam| prakṛtyābhirūpaḥ| kriyāpadāśravaṇāt kartṛkaraṇayorabhāvāt ṣaṣṭhī prāptā| sāhajikaṃ prakṛtipadasya, abhedastṛtīyāyāḥ, ramaṇīyatvavānabhirūpapadasyārthaḥ| sāhajikābhinnaramaṇīyatvavānityarthaḥ| prāyeṇa yājñikāḥ bahavo yājñikā ityarthaḥ| avacchedakatvābhāvaviśiṣṭe bāhulye prāyaśabdaḥ| prāyeṇa yājñika itica yājñikatvasamānādhikaraṇadharmaliṅgakānumitiviṣayayājñikatvavati prayogaḥ| tathā ca sambhāvitayājñikatvāśraya iti dhīḥ| kecittu tṛtīyāyā avacchinnatvamarthaḥ| tathā ca kiñcinnyūnabāhulyāvaccinnayajñavidyāsabandhavāniti dhīrityāhuḥ| gotreṇa gārgya ityatra gotratvāvacchinnagargasambandhavān| gotrābhinnasambandhavāniti vārthaḥ| samāvāyena rūpavānityādāvapi samavāyābhinnarūpasambandhavāniti dhīreti kecit| samena viṣameṇa yāti| samādideśāvacchinnaṃ gamanamityarthaḥ| dvidroṇena dhānyaṃ krīṇāti, pañcakena paśūn krīṇāti| droṇadvayaparimitaṃ dhānyaṃ, pañcaghaṭitasamudāyāvacchinnān paśūn krīṇātītyarthaḥ| bhāṣyakṛtastvāhuḥ| prakṛtyābhirūpaḥ kṛto, na tvalaṅkārādineti gamyamānakriyāyāṃ karamatvātsiddham| saṃghībhūya yajñamadhīyate ityarthādadhyayanaṃ prati bāhulyaṃ karaṇameva| adhyavasāṃyasthale'pi jñānaṃ prati tat| ācaraṇādibāhulyenānyeṣām yājñikatvaprakārakatadviśeṣyakapratītyutpatteḥ| prāyeṇa sāmagryavidhau guṇānāmityādidarśanādvibhaktipratirūpakaḥ prāyeṇeti nipāta ityeke| gotreṇa gārgya ityatrāpi anenāhaṃ jñāye ityarthaḥ| samenetyatra yathetyadhyāhāraḥ| dvidroṇenetyatra tadarthamūlyalakṣaṇayā siddhamiti| sahayukte'pradhāne || 19 || sahārthena yukte'pradhāne tṛtīyā| putreṇa sahāgataḥ pitā| piturāgamanānvayaḥ śābdo'nyasya tvārthaḥ| bhinnavibhaktyantatvāt| yuktagrahaṇaṃ sahārthe gamyamāne'pi tṛtīyārtham| vṛddho yūnetyādidarśanāt| tena `tulāṃ yadārohati dantavāsase'tyādi siddham| apradhānagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum| prātipadikamātrapekṣatvādantaraṅgatvena pitetyatra prathamāsiddheḥ| evaṃcāpradhānatvaprakārakabodhārthaṃ taditi kalpanābhāso nirmūlaḥ| bhāṣyakārādisarvābhiyuktānubhavavirodhāt pitrā saha putra āgata ityāderapi darśanena vāstavāprādhānyasyāprayojakatvāt| sahaiva daśabhiḥ putrairbhāraṃ vahati gargabhītyādau vahanakriyānvayābhāve'pi vidyamānetyadhyāhārāttadaṃśe sāhityāttṛtīyā| putrakartṛkāgamanaviśiṣṭāgamanakartetyanvayaḥ| vaiśiṣṭhyaṃ tvekadeśakālāvacchainnatvam| śiṣyeṇa saha gururbrāhmaṇaḥ,putreṇa saha pitā sundara ityatra vṛttitvaṃ tṛtīyārtho brāhmaṇapadārthatāvacchedakabrāhmaṇatvānvayī, śiṣyavṛttibrāhmaṇatvāśrayo guruḥ| putravṛttisaundaryāśrayaḥ piteti dhīḥ| yadvā tṛtīyārtho vṛttiḥ sahityaṃ ekadharmānvayitvaṃ śiṣyasāhityavān gururbrāhmaṇa ityādirarthaḥ|| yenāṅgavikāraḥ || 20 || vikāro hānirādhikyaṃ vā| yenāṅgena vikṛtenāṅgino vikāro lakṣyate tasmāttṛtīyā| akṣṇā kāṇaḥ| pādena khañjaḥ| pāṇinā kuṇiḥ| `sa bāla āsīdvapuṣā caturbhujo mukhena pūrṇenduḥ nibhastrilocanaḥ'| atrākṣṇetyukte nirūpayatītyaḥ kāṅkṣodayāt| karaṇe ityasya nādhikyamiti kecit| anyetu yadyapi cakṣuṣmatve sati cakṣuṣmadgolakadvayaśūnyatvaṃ kāṇa padārthaḥ| tathāpyatra cakṣuṣmattvamakṣṇetyasyārthaḥ| vaiśiṣṭhyasya tṛtīyārthatvāt| yenāṅgena vikārastajjātīyavācakapadāttṛtiyeti| anye tu akṣipadaṃ golakaparam| abhede tṛtīyā| kāṇapadārthaikadeśe cakṣuḥśūnye tadanvayaḥ| golākabhinnaṃ yaccakṣuḥśūnyaṃ tadvānityarthaḥ| yasya golakamapi nāsti tatroktaprayogo gauṇaḥ| sūtrārthasahgatirapyevamityāhuḥ| kha़ñjaḥ saṃsthānaviśeṣaśūnyapādavān| pādavṛtti yaduktaśūnyatvaṃ tadāśrayapādavān pādābhinno ya uktaśūnyastadvānvā ityādi| mukhavṛttilocanatrayavāniti vikāralābho'rthāt| yadvā vṛttiviṣaye tripadaṃ pūramārthaparaṃ tṛtīyaṃ locanaṃ yasya trilocanaḥ| mukhāvacchedena yattṛtīyaṃ locanaṃ tadvānityarthaḥ| itthaṃbhūtalakṣame || 21 || tṛtīyā| itarasmādvyāvartakaṃ dharmaṃ prāpta itthaṃbhūtaḥ| itaratvaṃ ca samabhivyāhṛtapadārthatāvacchedakāvacchinnapratiyogitākaṃ tasya lakṣaṇamuktadharmastatra tṛtīyā| jaṭābhistāpasaḥ| atāpasavyāvṛttidhījanako dharmo jaṭā bhavatyeva| tāpasatvasāmānādhikaraṇyamātreṇa sattvāt| kintu tāpasabhinne'pi sattvādatāpasavyāvṛttau nāvacchedikā| tathā ca pratyāyyavyāvṛttyanavacchedakatve sati tadvyāvṛttisamānādhikaraṇatvarūpe upalakṣaṇatve tṛtīyetyarthaḥ| ataeva śaityena jalaṃ, śamādinā tāpasa ityādirna prayogaḥ etena `latāpratānodgrathitaiḥ sa keśai'rityādi vyākhyātam| ata eva tatra kaiśairupalakṣita iti vyākhyātam| yadi viśeṣaṇe'pi tṛtīyā dṛśyate tadā tatsādhāraṇaṃ vaiśiṣṭyaṃ tṛtīyārtha ityāhuḥ|| saṃjño'nyatarasyāṃ karmaṇi || 22 || saṃpūrvasya jānāteḥ karmaṇi tṛtīyā vā syāt| mātrā mātare vā saṃjānīte| `sampratibhyāmanādhyāne'iti taṅ| mātuḥ saṃjñātetyatrapūrvavipratiṣedhena ṣaṣṭhī `saṃjñaḥ kṛtprayoge ṣaṣṭhī vipratiṣedhena'iti vārtikāt| `upaṇdavibhakteścopapadavibhaktiḥ'anyārādityādeḥ svāmīśvaretyādeścānyo devadattādityādau goṣu gavāṃ vā svāmītyādauca sāvakāśatvāt anyo goṣu svāmītyatra svāmiśvaretyādereva pravṛttiḥ| nanvatra pūrvasvāmyapekṣamanyatvaṃ pratipādyaṃ, natu gavāpekṣam| nirjñātatvāt| vivakṣāyāṃ ca pañcamyā iṣṭatvāt| satyam| tulyo gobhiḥ svāmītyudāharaṇam| gosvāmini jāḍyādipravuktagosādṛśyavivakṣāyāṃ padadvayārthayogasya gavāṃ sattvāt| hetau || 23 || tadarthe tṛtīyā syāt| dhanena kulam| vidyayā yaśaḥ| yoganayatāmātraprayukto'nāśritavyāpāro'rtho dravyaguṇakriyāviṣayo hetuḥ| karaṇaṃ tu vyāpāraniyataṃ kriyāmātraviṣaṃ ceti bhedaḥ| taduktam- dravyādiniyato hetuḥ kārakaṃ niyatakriyamiti| anāśrite tu vyāpāre nimittaṃ heturucyate|| itica || adhyayanena vasati| vāsapravartakecchājanakecchaviṣayatayā hetutvaṃ, phalecchayā upāyeccheti tato vāsaḥ| ayamapyasya sūtrasya veśeṣaḥ| `nimittakāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃprāyadarśanam'| prāyagrahaṇātsarvanāmnaḥ prathamā dvitīyayorabhāvaḥ anyāsāṃ yathādarśanaṃ prayogaḥ| paryāyagrahaṇaṃ anyanivṛttyarthamiti kecit| upalakṣaṇatvātprapañcārthamityanye| annena hetunā vasatītyādi| akartaryṛṇe pañcamī || 24 || kartṛbhinnaṃ yadṛṇaṃ hetubhūtaṃ tataḥ pañcamī syāt| tṛtīyāpavādaḥ| śatadbaddhaḥ| akartari kim| śatena bandhitaḥ| ṛṇatvaṃ śatasya prasiddham| tatprayojako hetuś‌ceti cakāratkartṛsaṃjñaṃ ca| pūrvasūtre śāstrīyasādhāraṇahetugrahaṇe bādhakābhāvāt| kartṛkaraṇayoriti tṛtīyāyāstatra prābalyātsiddheḥ| vibhāṣā guṇe'striyām || 25 || guṇe hetāvastrīliṅge pañcamī vā syāt| jāḍyājjāḍyena vā baddhaḥ| pāṇḍityātpāṇḍityena vā muktaḥ| guṇeti kim| dhanena kulam| āstriyāṃ kim| buddhyā muktaḥ| guṇapadaṃ paratantramātraparam| yasya guṇasya bhāvācchadbe niveśa itivat| tena vahnimān‌dhūmādityādau pañcamīti kecit| nāsti ghaṭo'nupalabdherityādau tu bāhulakaṃ prakṛtestanudṛṣṭeritivārtikaprayogāt| anyetu vibhāṣeti yogavibhāgādubhayatrāpi siddhamityāhuḥ| ṣaṣṭhīhetuprayoge || 26 || hetuśabdaprayoge hetutve dyotye ṣaṣṭhī| annasya hetorvasati| sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca|| 27 || pūrvaviṣaye tṛtīyā ṣaṣṭhī ca| kena hetunā vasati| kasya hetorvā| apādāne pañcamī || 28 || grāmādāgacchati| `lyablope karmaṇyadhikaraṇe copasaṃkhyānam'| prāsādādāsanātprekṣate| prāsādamāruhyāsane upaviśyetyarthaḥ| lyabantaprayoge'pi yatra tadarthapratītistadviṣayakamiti kecit| dvetīyāsaptamyorapavādaḥ| ``praśnākhyānayoścakuto bhavān| pāṭaliputrāt| gamyamānakriyāmādāya siddhārthakathanametat| ``yataścādhvakālīnarmāṇaṃ tatra pañcamī tadyuktādadhvanaḥ prathamāsaptamyau, kālātsaptamīca vaktavyā| nirmāṇaṃ paricchedaḥ| tadyogaścārthadvārakaḥ| gavīdhumataḥ sāṃkāśyaṃ catvārī yojanāni caturṣu yojaneṣu vā| kārtikyā āgrahāyaṇīmāse| ubhayatra daiśikakālike paratve yathākramaṃ prathamāsaptamyoḥ saptamyāścārthaḥ| tatrāvaccinnatvasabandhena prakṛtyartho viśeṣaṇam| tasyāśrayatvasabandhena sāṃkāśye āgrahāyaṇyāṃ cānvayaḥ gavīdhumadavadhikayojanatvasabandhena sāṃkāśye āgrahāyaṇyāṃ cānvayaḥ gavīdhumadavadhikayojanacatuṣṭayāvacchinnaparatvāśrayaḥ| kārtikyavadhikamāsāvacchinnaparatvāśrayaścetyanvayadhīḥ| atrabhāṣyam-gavīdhumato niḥ sṛtya yadā catvāri yojanāni gatāni bhavanti tataḥ sāṃkāśyam| yadvā caturṣu yojaneṣu gateṣu tataḥ sāṅkāśyam| kārtikyāḥ prabhṛtyāgrahāyaṇī māse| tathāca gamyamānakriyāmādāyaiva siddhyā vārtikaṃ nārabhyamiti| bhāṣyaprayogātprabhṛtiyoge pañcamī| tatrārthagrahaṇācca tata ārabhyeti tadvyākhyāparakaiyaṭaḥ| tena`iti sa cikurādārabhyaināṃ nakhāvi varṇaya'nnityādi siddham| ttarapadājāhiyukte || 29 || etairyoro pañcamī syāt| anyetyarthaparam| itaragrahaṇaṃ prapañcārtham| nīcārthayoge `pañcamī vibhakta'ityeva siddheḥ| ghaṭādanyo bhinno vetyādi| atra pratiyogitvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ| tasya padārthaikadeśe'nyonyābhāve'nvayaḥ| nanvevaṃ ghaṭaḥ paṭo netyatrātiprasaṅgaḥ| naca tasyānyonyābhāvabodhakatvānna doṣaḥ tadāśrayavācakapadayoge pañcamīvidhānāditi vācyam| bhinna ityādau tadasiddheriti cedatrāhuḥ-naño dyotakatvānna doṣa iti| anye tu evamapi ghaṭasyānyonyā bhāvastādātmyāvacchinnapratiyogitākābhāva ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ| ato'nyonyābhāvādipadānāṃ anyonyapadavācyatādātmyādyabhāvattvena bodho natu bhedatvena| naño'pyubhayasādhāraṇamabhāvatvameva śakyatāvacchedakamato na doṣaḥ| naca nañ‌yoge ṣaṣṭhī tathāpi durvārā| niyataprayogā hi kecidavyayā iti neyaṃ vibhāṣetyādi bhāṣyaprayogāccetyāhuḥ| tanna| anyonyābhāvatvātyantā bhāvatvayoreva nañ‌padaśakyatāvacchedakatāyā dīdhitikārādibhiruktatvāt| anyathā tattatprakārakasandehanivṛttyanupapatteḥ| tasmādanyavācakasatvārthakapadānāmeva yoge pañcami| atra cetarapadaṃ tātparyagrahakamiti bodhyam| guṇarahasye tu-anye tu evamapi ghaṭasyānyonyābhāvastādātmyasambadhavicchinnapratiyogitākābhāva ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ| ato'nyonyābhāvādipadānāmanyonyapadavācyatādātmyādyabhāvatvena bodho natu bhedatvena| naño'pyubhayasādhāraṇamabhāvattvameva śakya tāvacchedakamato na doṣaḥ| naca nañ‌yoge ṣaṣṭhī tathāpi durvārā niyataprayogā hi kecidavyayā iti neyaṃ vibhāṣetyādi bhāṣyaprayogāccetyāhuḥ| tanna| anyonyābhāvapadasyāpi bhedapadavadbhedatvenaiva bodhakatvāt| tādātmyābhāvatvena bodho hi tādātmyasya pratiyogitvāvagāhī pratiyogitāvacchedakatvāvagāhī vā| nādyaḥ| ghaṭādereva pratiyogitvānubhavāt| nāntyaḥ| tādātmyasambandhāvacchinnapratiyogitākābhāvatvasya bhedatve saṃyogādyavacchinnapratiyogitākātyantābhāve'tivyāpteḥ| saṃyogasya saṃyogitādātmyarūpatvāt| bhedapratiyogitāyāḥ sambandhāvacchinnatvasya navyairanaṅgīkārācca| akhaṇḍopādhirūpatāyā eva svīkārācca| atyantābhāvatvānyonyābhāvatvayoḥ pṛthageva nañ‌padaśakyatāvacchedakatāyādīdhitikārādibhiruktatvāt| anyathā tattatprakārakasaṃndehanivṛttyanupapatteḥ| tasmādanyavācakasattvārthakapadayoge eva pañcamī tatra cetarapadopādānaṃ tātparyagrāhakaṃ ato nañ‌yoge na prasaṅgaḥ| anye tu yatra pratiyogitvasambandhena pratiyogino'nyo'nyābhāvānvayo na vyutpannastatra ṣaṣṭhyāḥ pañcamyā vā pratiyogivācakapadottaramapekṣā| yathā ghaṭasyābhāvo ghaṭādanya ityādau| nipātātiriktanāmārthayorbhedānvayānarhatvāt nañ‌rthe tu pratiyogitvasambandhena paṭādedanvayasya vyutpannatvātṣaṣṭhyā iva pañcamyā api nākāṅkṣā ityāhuḥ| ārād‌dūrasamīpayoḥ| ārāddevadattāt| dūrāntikārthaiḥ ṣaṣṭhyantarasyāmiti prāptam| ṛte kṛśānorna hi mantrapūtam| dvitīyāpīti prāguktam| srak‌ pārijātasya ṛte na śālām| diśi dṛṣṭa śabdo dik‌śabdaḥ| tatsamabhivyāhāre digvācakatvābhāve'pi yadākadāciddik‌para ityarthaḥ| grāmātpūrvo deśaḥ| caitrātpūrvaḥ phālgunaḥ| avayavinā yoge ṣaṣṭhyeva| pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti prāguktam| añcuttarapadasya dik‌śabdatve'pi`ṣaṣṭyatasarthapratyayene'tyasya bādhārthaṃ pṛthagupādānam| naca tena sadhryaṅ ityādau pañcamyarthaṃ taditi vācyam| sāhacaryāddik‌śabdasyaivāñcūttarapadasya grahaṇāt prākgrāmāt pratyagnā| dakṣimāgrāmāt| dakṣiṇādāc‌| dakṣiṇāhi uttarāhi vā grāmāt| āhi ca dūre, uttarāccetyāhiḥ| ṣaṣṭhyatasarthapratyayena || 30 || dakṣiṇata uttarato vā grāmasya| dakṣiṇottarābhyāmatasuc‌| evaṃ puraḥ purastāduparyyapariṣṭāt| `vindhyāddakṣiṇato'khilairapi buvaiḥ kuṣṇādiko neṣyate' iti tu tataḥ paścātsraṃsyate iti bhāṣyaprayogasya sāmānyāpekṣajñāpakatvāditi kecit| anye tu pramāda evāyam| jñāpakasya paścādyogamātraviṣayakatvādityāhuḥ| śrutasyaiva cātrātasuc‌pratyayasya nimittatā na tu luptasya| prāk‌grāmādityādau pratyayalope ṣaṣṭhyabhāvasya kaiyaṭasiddhatvāt| enapādvitīyā || 31 || yogavibhāgātṣaṣṭhīca| dakṣiṇena grāmam grāmasya vā| uttareṇa| `tatrāgāraṃ dhanapatigṛhāduttareṇāsmadīya'miti tu pramāda ityeke| uttareṇeti tṛtīyaikavacanāntam| `dūrāllakṣyaṃ surapatidhanuścāruṇā toraṇene'ti tṛtīyāntenābhedānvayītyapare| gṛhāniti dvitīyāntamityanye| pṛthagvinānānābhistṛtīyānyatarasyām || 32 || anyatarasyāmiti samuccayārtham| maṇḍūkaplutyā pañcamyanuvṛttiḥ| ebhiryoge tṛtīyāpañcamyau staḥ| ghaṭātpṛthak ghaṭena vā| hiruṅ‌ nānāca varjane ityamaraḥ| `nānā nārīṃ niḥ phalā lokayātre'ti kṣīrasvāmī| yogavibhāgād‌dvitīyāpīti vṛttiḥ| nānāviṣṇuṃ mokṣado nānyadevaḥ| karaṇe ca stokālpakṛcchrakatipayasyāsattvavacanasya || 33 || adravyārthebhya ebhyaḥ karaṇe tṛtīyāpañcamyau staḥ| stokena stokādvā muktaḥ| asatveti kim| stokena viṣeṇa hataḥ| dūrāntikārthaiḥṣaṣṭhyanyatarasyām || 34 || pañcamyā saha vikalpaḥ| dūramantike grāmasya grāmādvā| dūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca || 35 || cakārātpañcamītṛtīye| prātipadikārthe vidhirayam| natvatra vibhaktyarthaḥ kaścit| grāmasya dūraṃ d‌rād dūreṇa vā| evamantike'pi| `tadyuktātpañcamīpratiṣedho navā tatrāpi darśanā'diti vārtikam| yadapekṣayā dūratvaṃ tatra pañcamī na syāt| atha vā tatrāpi darśanādavācyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| `dūrādāvamathānmūtraṃ dūrātpādāvanejanam| dūrācca bhāvyaṃ dasyubhyo dūrācca kupitādguroḥ'| atra yadā dūrapadaṃ dharmamātraparaṃ tadaiva asatvavacanetyanuvṛttiḥ| yadā tu dharmiparaṃ tadā sāmānādhikaraṇyādviśeṣyasamānavibhaktikatvam| dūraḥ panthāḥ `adavīyānayaṃ panthāḥ svarlokamupatiṣṭhate' iti murāriḥ| saptamyadhikaraṇe ca || 36 || cakāro dūrāntikasamuccayārthaḥ| kaṭe āste| dūre grāmāt| pūrvoktavibhaktitrayeṇa sahaitadvākyavihitasaptamyāḥ samuccayāt dūrantikārthebhyaścatasro vibhaktayaḥ siddhāḥ| `ktasye nveṣayasya karmaṇyupasaṃkhyānam'| innantasyetyarthaḥ| adhīti vyākaraṇe| adhītamanenetikarmaktapratyayāntādadhītaśabdāt `iṣṭādibhyaśce'ti kartari iniḥ| karmaṇi dvitīyā kṛtapūrvī kaṭamitivatprāptā tadapavādo'yam| adhikaraṇavivakṣāyāṃ saptamīsiddhāvapi karmavivakṣāyāṃ dvitīyāyā durvāratvāt| māsamadhītī vyākaraṇe| ityatra māse na saptamī| kālasya bahiraṅgakarmatvāt| naca ktapratyayena karmaṇo'bhidhānātkathaṃ dvitīyāpattiḥ| taddhitārthena sahaikārthībhūtasya ktāntasya pṛthagvyākaraṇena sambandhābhāvāt| guṇabhūtakriyayāpi karmaṇaḥ sambandhasambhavāt| sahādhītavān vyākaraṇamityādivat agre vistaraḥ| `sādhvasādhupayoge ca' sādhuḥ kṛṣṇo mātari| asādhurmātule| kriyāvirahādadhikaraṇe saptamyaprāptau vacanam| kecittu vaiṣayikādhikaraṇatvena tatsiddhāvapi ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhārthāmityāhuḥ| `sādhunipuṇābhyāmarcāyā'mityanena siddhe'pi anarcārthamatra sādhugrahaṇam| tena tattvakathane'pi sādhuyoge saptamī| tatrārcāpadaṃ tu nipuṇasyaiva viśeṣaṇam| sādhurbhṛtyo rājña iti tu bhṛtyāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī natu sādhvapekṣeyeti sampradāyaḥ| vārtikena sūtravaiyarthyābhāvāttatsūtre sādhuśabdopādānamityapyāhuḥ| `arhāṇāṃ kartṛtke'narhāṇāmakartṛtve tadvaiparītye ca'| ṛddheṣu bhuñjāneṣu daridrā āsate| brāhmaṇeṣu taratsu vṛṣalā āsate| ṛddhādīnāṃ bhojanārhatvaṃ| mūrkheṣvāsīneṣu ṛddhā bhuñjate| vṛṣaleṣvāsīneṣu brāhmaṇāstaranti| mūrkhāṇāṃ bhojanādyanarhatvam| kārakārhāṇāmakārakatvam, akārakatvārhaṇāñca kārakatvaṃ viparyāsaḥ| ṛddheṣvāsīneṣu mūrkhā bhuñjate| brāhmaṇeṣvāsīneṣu vṛṣalāstaranti idaṃ ca lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvāvivakṣāyāṃ saptamīvidhyartham| anyathottarasūtreṇa siddheriti kaiyaṭādayaḥ| kecittu āsate ityanena bhojanābhāvo lakṣyate, ṛddhadaridrādipadaiśca kriyārhatvānarhatve vyaṅye| aucityamanaucityañca vyaṅyo vākyārthaḥ| etādṛśalakṣyalakṣaṇabhāva uttarasūtrīyāttasmādvyāvṛtta eveti na vārtikavaiyarthyamityāhuḥ| `nimittātkarmayoge' pravṛttihetujñānaviṣayatvena nimittapadaṃ phalaparam| hetutṛtīyāpavādaḥ| karmaṇā yogo vāstavaḥ saṃyogasamavāyānyataraḥ| natuśābdaviṣayatvaniyamaḥ| kriyākarmaṇā saha sambandhaśālinaḥ phalātspatamīti vārtikārthaḥ| carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hanti dantayorhānti kuñjaram| keśeṣu camarīṃ hanti sīmni pupkalako hataḥ|| puṣkalakaḥ śaṅkuḥ| sīmni samijñānārtha nikhāta iti kecit| puṣkalako gandhamṛgaḥ| sīmā aṇḍakośaḥ| tadarthaṃ hata ityanye| carmaṇītyatra carmadvipinoḥ samavāyaḥ| trayāṇāṃ saṃyogaḥ| dantakeśādīnāṃ śarīrāvayavatvābhāvāt| gandhamṛgārthatve'pi samavāya iti viśeṣaḥ| karmayoge kim| vetanena dhānyaṃ lunāti| atra naiyāyikāḥ| atra janakatvaṃ janyatvaṃ vā saptamyarthaḥ| carmapadaṃ tadīyayatheṣṭaviniyogaparam| carmayatheṣṭaviniyogajanakadvīpihananānukūlakṛtimān| yadvā nimittatvam-yatheṣṭaviniyogaviṣayatvenecchāviṣayatvam| tādṛśecchāviṣayatvasya saptamyarthasya janyatvasambandhena hananānvayaḥ, yatkiñcitkarmaprakārakabodhajanakadhātuyogaścātra vivakṣitaḥ, tajjanakatvaṃ sakarmadhātoḥ karmabodhakapadayogena carmaṇītyādau, akarmasya tu karmaviśiṣṭasvārthaśaktyā, avidyārajanīkṣaye yadudetīti darśanāt| udayagiriśikharamārohatītyarthāt| rajanīkṣayasya sūryodayājanyatve'pi jñānaviṣayatvenoddeśyatayā nimittatvam| sīmni puṣkalako hata itivat| tena lokānāṃ rajanīkṣayajñānārthaṃ yadudetītyarthaḥ| kecittu etad‌ dvīpavartiyāvadraviraśmisaṃsargabhāvaviśiṣṭaḥ kālo rātriḥ| yāvaditisaṃsargābhāvaviśeṣaṇam| tadraśmyutpattau tatprāgabhāvanāśe viśiṣṭakālanāśādrajanīkṣayaprayojakatvaṃ sūryodaye sulabhamityāhuḥ| yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam || 37 || yasya kriyayā kriyāntaraṃ paricchidyate tataḥ saptamī syāt| nirjñātakālayā kriyayā anirjñātakālāyāstasyāḥ paricchedāt| goṣu duhyamānāsvāgataḥ| duhyamāneti goviśeṣaṇam| tathaivānubhavāt| kālikasāmānādhaikaraṇyaṃ saptamyarthaḥ| tasyāgamanakriyāyāmanvayaḥ duhyamānatvaviśiṣṭagavādhikaraṇakālavṛtti yadatīnamāgamanaṃ tadāśrayaḥ| dohaviśiṣṭānāṃ ca gavāṃ kālāntare viśeṣaṇabhāvanibandhanādabhāvāt dohasamānakālīnatvamāgamane paryavasyatītyato bhāvalakṣamatvamavyāhatam| dugdhāsvāgata ityatrātītadohanakālīnatvasyāgamane bādhāt dohanadhvaṃsaviśiṣṭe lakṣaṇā| tathāca vidyamānadhvaṃsapratiyogidohanakarmasu goṣu ityarthaḥ|cha dohana viśeṣaṇatāpannaṃ yatpratiyogitvaṃ tadviśeṣaṇībhūtasya dhvaṃsasya samānakālīnatvamāgamane bhāti| tathāca gokarmakadohanapratiyogikavidyamānadhvaṃsādhikaraṇakālavṛtti yadāgamanaṃ ityādiḥ| dhokṣyamāṇāsvityatrāpi vidyamānadhvaṃsapratiyogī yo dohanaprāgabhāvaḥ tadadhikaraṇetyādi yojyam| guṇakarmānyatve sati sattvādityabhiyuktaprayogāt| yatra paradharmeṇa dharmāntaraṃ svasāmānādhikaraṇyena pratipādyate tatra spamīti sūtrārthaḥ| tena viśeṣaṇatāsamavāyobhayaghaṭitadaiśikasāmānādhikaraṇyena dravyatvādeḥ pratipādane'pyadoṣa iti tārkikāḥ| ṣaṣṭhī cānādare || 38 || anādarādhike bhāvalakṣaṇe ṣaṣṭhī saptamī ca syāt| sudati rudato vā prāvrājīt| rudantaṃ putrādikamanādṛśya sanyastavānityarthaḥ| atra pravrajanahetubhūtāvapratiyogirāgaviṣayatvena putrādeḥ pravrajanapratikūlatvāttadanādaraḥ| anyādṛśasthale tadapratyayāt| svamīśvarādhipatidāyādasākṣipratibhūprasūtaiśca || 39 || etaiḥ saptamiryoge ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau staḥ| pākṣikasaptamyarthaṃ vacanam| ṣaṣṭhyāsvabhyanujñānamātram| gavāṃ goṣu vā svāmī| dāyaṃ bhāgaṃ ādatte dāyādaḥ| nipātanātsopasargādapi kaḥ| gopadārthasyābhedena dāye'nvayaḥ| gavātmakasyāṃśasyādātetyarthaḥ| gavāṃ prasūtaḥ| gā evānubhavituṃ jāta ityarthaḥ| āyuktakuśalābhyāṃ cāsevāyām || 40 || āsevā tadekaparatvam| tadarthe ābhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau| haribhajanasya haribhajane vā āyuktaḥ kuśalo vā| āseveti kim| āyukto gauḥ śakaṭe| īṣadyukta ityarthaḥ| yataśca nirddhāraṇam || 41 || jātiguṇakriyāsaṃjñābhiḥ samudāyādekadeśasya pṛthakkaraṇaṃ nirdhāraṇaṃ tadyasmāttataḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamapmyau| nṛṇāṃ nṛṣu vā dvijaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ| gavāṃ goṣu vā kṛṣṇā bahukṣīrā| gacchatāṃ gacchatsu vā dhāvan śīghraḥ| chātrāṇāṃ chātreṣu vā maitraḥ paṭuḥ| atra vibhakteranyonyābhāvo'tyantābhāvaḥ pratiyogī cārthaḥ| anyonyābhāve kṛṣṇābhinnagavyāḥ sāmānādhaikaraṇyena kṛṣṇatvaviśiṣṭagotvāvacchinnapratiyogitāsambandhenānvayaḥ| tasyānuyogitayā gopadārthe, tasya vṛttitvenātyantābhāve, tasya pratiyogini, tasyābhedena nirdhāraṇanimitte guṇa bahukṣīratvādau, tasya kṛṣṇābhinnāyāṃ gavi tataśca kṛṣṇagavībhinnagovṛttyatyantābhāvapratiyogivahukṣīratvavadabhinnā kṛṣṇagavītyanvayadhīḥ| evaṃ ca nirdhāraṇapratiyogini atyantābhāvapratiyogitvena bahukṣīratvādeḥ pratītau nirdhāraṇanimittatvamapi saṅgacchate| yattu bhedo'bhedaśca vibhaktyarthaḥ kṛṣṇakṣīrapadārthayoḥ pratiyogitayā gopadārthasyāśrayatvenānvayaḥ| abhede ca gopadārthasya pratiyogitayā kṛṣṇapadārthasyādhikaraṇatayānvayaḥ| tathāca kṛṣaaṇabhinnā gaurna sampannakṣīratamā, gavābhinnā kṛṣṇā sampannakṣīratametidhīriti| tadasat| ekavākyatvānubhavavirodhāt| kṛṣṇagopadārthayoḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavaiparītyena vāradvayamanvayācca| yadapi vibhaktyarthaḥ pūrvavat| kṛṣṇārthasya bhede, tasyāśrayatayā gavi, tasyāḥ pratiyogitvena bhede, tasyāśrayatayā sampannakṣīratamāyāṃ, goḥ pratiyogitvena bhede, tasyāśrayatvena kṛṣṇāyāṃ, tatra sampannakṣīratamāyā abhedenānvayaḥ| tathāca gavābhinnakṛṣṇā kṛṣaaṇabhinnagobhinnasampannakṣīratamābhinneti dhīḥ| yadvā sampannakṣīratamā kṛṣṇabhinnagobhinnā gavābhinnakṛṣṇā sampannakṣīratamā'bhinnetibhinnaviśeṣyako bodha iti| tadapyasat| anvayabāhulyāt| kṛṣṇā gauḥ sampannakṣīratamābhinnetisaṃśayanivṛttyanupapatteśca| kṛṣṇavata eva bhede pratiyogitvenānvaye gauravācca| kecittu abhedo vibhaktyarthaḥ| tatra goḥ pratiyogitvenānvayaḥ| gavābhedasya kṛṣṇāyāṃ sampannakṣīratamāyāṃ cānvayaḥ| gavābhainnasaṃpannakṣīratamāyāścābhedena sambandhena gavābhinnakṛṣṇāyāṃ tataśca gavābhinnakṛṣṇā gavābhinnasampannakṣīratamābhinneti dhīḥ| naca gavāntare sapannakṣīratamatvābhāvapratyayāsiddhiḥ| vyāpakatvaviśiṣṭābhedasaṃmargatvādityāhuḥ| tadapi cintyam| gavābhedasya kṛṣṇāyāṃ saṃpannakṣīratamāyāṃ cānvaye gauravāt| kṛṣṇābhinnagoviśeṣyakasampannakṣīratamatvasaṃśayanivṛttyamupapatteśca| pañcamī vibhakte || 42 || nirdhāraṇapratiyogitāvacchedakadharmo yatra nirdhāraṇaviṣaye nāsti tatra nirdhariṇapratiyoginaḥ pañcamī syāt| māthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya āḍhyatarāḥ| pāṭaliputrakaniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogi yadāḍhayataratvaṃ tadvanto māthurāḥ| abhāvaḥ pañcamyarthaḥ| tatra prakṛtyarthasya vṛttitvenātyantābhāve, tasya ca pratiyogitayā āḍhyataratvādau nirdhāraṇanimitte'nvayaḥ| sādhunipuṇābhyāmarcāyāṃ saptamyaprateḥ || 43 || praśaṃsātātparye ābhyāṃ yoge pañcamī syāt| natu prateḥ prayoge| sādhurmātari nipuṇo vā| arcāyāṃ kim| sādhurbhṛtyo rājñaḥ| svarūpakathane tātparyam| sādhuśabdayoge'narcāyāmapi saptamīti prāguktam| `apratyādibhiriti vaktvayam'| sādhurnipuṇo vā mātaraṃ prati paryanu vā| prasitotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīyā ca|| 44 | cātsaptamī| tatpare prasitāsaktaviṣṭārtharthodyukta utsukaḥ| ityamaraḥ| tena prakarṣeṇa sitaḥ śuklo vetyatraitadabhāvaḥ| prasita utsukovā harimā harau vā| viṣayatvaṃ vibhaktyarthaḥ| `svaprāṇeśvaranarmaharmyakaṭakātithyagrahāyotsukamaṃ' ityatra tumartācceti caturthī| `paryu tsuko nijamahotsavadarśanāye'ti ratnāvalyām| nakṣatre ca lupi || 45 || lupsaṃjñāprayojyalopapratiyoginaḥ pratyayasyārthe vartamānānnakṣatrātprakṛtiśabdātkālikādhikaraṇe tṛtīyāsaptamyau staḥ| `mūlenāvāhayeddevīṃ śravaṇena visarjapet'| mūle śravaṇe iti vā| puṣye pāyasamaśnīyāt maghābhiḥ palalaudanam| `nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kāla'ityaṇ| `luvaviśeṣa'iti tasya lopaḥ| rātryavacchedena dināvacchedena vā mūlayoga iti viśeṣasyānavagamyamānatvāt| adhikaraṇe kim| puṣye śaniḥ| adya puṣyaḥ| iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau dvitīyādhyāyasya tṛtīye pāde dvitīyamāhnikam| tṛtīyapāde tṛtīyamāhnikam pratipadikārthaliṅgaparimāṇavacanamātre prathamā || 46 || mātraśabdo'vadhāraṇārtho dvandvānte śrutatvātpratyekānvayī| prātipadikasyeti ṣaṣṭhyarthajanyatvasyārthapadārthaikadeśe jñāne'nvayaḥ| viśeṣyatvaṃ than pratyayārthaḥ| prātipadikajanyajñānaviśeṣyamātre liṅgamātre parimāṇamātre maṃkhyāmātreprathamā syāt| vacanapadasya saṃkhyāparatvāt| prātipadikārthastu tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyiśābdapratyayārthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratānāśrayatvena vivakṣāyāṃ prathamā| tenaikatvādāvanubhave'pi na kṣatiḥ| pratyayaśca svaprakṛtikaḥ tenākhyātārthe kartari tadanvaye'pi na doṣaḥ| tare'nvayāt pratyayārtheti| evañca candra iva mukhamityādau pratiyogitayā sādṛśyādyanvaye'pitaravibhakterabhedārthatvapakṣe doṣatādavasthyam| sāmānādhikaraṇyādvibhaktirityāśrayaṇāt| svatantraprathamāyāmevāsya niyāmakatvādvā| vibhakteḥ pratiyogyādyarthaparatvamityādeścaikadeśimātreṇābhyupagamāt| etena vīraḥ puruṣa ityādau prātipadikārthatvābhāvamāśaṅkya saṃsargasya vākyārthatvena bahiraṅgatvātsvārthamātranimittakaprathamapravṛttavapadasaṃskārabādhānupapattiḥ| anyathā sarvatraiva prathamāyāḥ pūrvaṃ pravṛttau dvitīyādiprakaraṇaṃ nirviṣayaṃ syāt| abhedānvayasya karmādivirahe sārvatrikatvādvacanasāmarthyātprathamā| ghaṭa ityādāvapyastyādyadhyāhārasyāvaśryakatvāt| mātragrahaṇe sambodhane cetyasyārambheṇa ca vibhaktivācyādhikyasya vyavacchedācca| rāhoḥ śira ityādāvapi aupādhikabhedena ṣaṣṭhīpravṛttyā abhedasya ṣaṣṭhyarthatvābhāvācceti kleśaḥ parāstaḥ| avyayeṣu prathamāvibhakteḥ sāvakāśatvāt| naca saṃkhyāśāstraikavākyatayāsyapravṛttestatra kathaṃ pravṛttiriti vācyam| arthe prathametyuktaṃ'pi kasyārthe ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ ṅyāppratipadikādityanena prakṛtisamyemāṇāt yasmādvihitāstasyeti sambhavāt prātipadikagrahamasyādhikyātsaṃkhyārahite'pyavyayārthe prathametyarthasyākarasiddhatvāt| etadudāharaṇatayā uccairtīcairityasya likhitatvācca| ṣaṣṭhyaiva padatvasiddhāvapi grāma uccaistava svaṃ grāma uccaiste svaṃ ityatra sapūrvāyāḥ prathamāyā vibhāṣetye tatpravṛttyarthaṃ prathamāyā apekṣitatvāt| naca tatrāpyabhedānvayasya grāmādau sattvāt niravakāśatvamaviśiṣṭamiti vācyam|vijayate ityādau dyotakeṣu upasargeṣu sāvakāśatvānapāyāt| naca tatra prathamotpattau prayojanābhāvaḥ| āte pitarmarutāṃ sumnametu, pratitvā duhitardiva ityādau padottaraṃ vihitānāṃ yuṣmadasmadādeśānāṃ tiṅ‌ṅatiṅ‌iti nighātasya ca tathātvāt| nipātasyānarthakasya prātipadikasaṃjñe'ti vārtikāt| dyotyārthenaivārthavattvādvā| jayatyādeḥ prakṛṣṭajayaparatve'pi prakarṣe praśabdānvayavyātirekānuvidhānamattvāt| api ca svaḥ paśyetyādau avyayottaraṃ prathamāyā eva svīkārāt svarādeḥ karmatvasaṃsargeṇa dhātvarthānvayaḥ prathamāyāḥ karmatve lakṣaṇā vetyavaśyaṃ vācyam| tathāca tatrāpi prathamāvidheḥ sāvakāśatvaṃ sulabhameva| kiñca caitraḥ pacatītyatraiva tadavakāśaḥ| naca tiṅrthe kartaryabhaṃdena sambandhena tadanvayānna tatheti vācyam| naiyāyikaiḥ kṛtereva tatrānvayasvīkārān| etadanurodhena prathamāntamukhyaviśeṣaayakabodhasya sūtrakārābhimatatvakalpanasyāpi sambhavācca| dhānyena dhanītyādau abhedasyāpi vibhaktyarthatvācca| ṣaṣṭhyāḥ śeṣārthatvenābhedasya tadarthatāyā durvāratvāt| kālādau sarveṣāṃ svarūpasaṃbandhatvena ṣaṣṭhīvācyatāvacchedakasaṃbandhatvāvacchinnatvasya padārthamātre sattvādvibhaktivācyādhikyavyavacchedāsambhavācca| etena `navā vākyārthatvāt'iti vārtikaṃ vyākhyātam| yattu prātipadikārtheti vākye liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣāyāḥ saṃbandho'sti navā nādyaḥ yasmātsvādividhistasmādityarthaparyavasāne prātipadikagrahaṇavaiyarthyāt| nāntyaḥ mṛḍānī himānītyādau prathamānāpatteḥ arthe prathametinyāse tu yasmātsvādividhistasyeti lābhena svādīnāṃ ca pratipadikālliṅgabodhakapratyayaviśiṣṭācca vihitatvānnayatopasthaitikatvasya tadarthatayā puṃyogamahattvāderapi tathātvāttatsiddheḥ iti| tattuccham| pratipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpīti paribhāṣāyāḥ prātipadikoddeśena yatkāryaṃ vidhīyate tanmātraparatvāt| dharmigrāhakamānena tathaiva labdhatvācca| ihaca na prātipadikoddeśena prathamāvidhānaṃ kintu prātipadikārthe vācye prathameti| ṅyāpprātipadikādityasyaiva prātipadikoddeśena svādividhāyakatayā tatra paribhāṣāpravṛtteḥ sarvasaṃmatatvācca| nacoktadoṣaḥ liṅgagrahaṇena tatsiddheḥ| naca puṃyogāderadhikārthasya pratītyā na tatheti vācyam| liṅgabodhakapratyayārthātiriktārthasyaiva vyavacchedyatvāt| puṃyogamahattvādeśca ṅyādibodhyatvāt| etena mṛṇālyādayo vyākhyātāḥ| strīsyātkācinmṛṇālyādi vivakṣāpacaye yadītyamaraḥ| yattu arthe prathameti nyāsenopapattiriti tanna| kasyeti viśeṣākāṅkṣāpekṣayā kasminnarthe ityasyāākāṅkṣāyāḥ svarūpaviṣayakatvenāntaraṅgatvāt| karmādāvarthe prathametyasyāpi prasaṅgāt| karmādīnāṃ senihitatvāta pūrvopasthitvāt arthatvasya karmatvakaraṇatvādirūpaśakyatāvacchedakānugamamātraparatayā karmatvādereva śābde lābhopapatteḥ| sarvanāmnāṃ vuddhisthatvādivat śakyatāvacchedakaikyasyāpi śaktyaikyasaṃpādakatvāt| tataśca kasyetyākāṅkṣāviraheṇaṅyāppratipadikānāṃ pratiyogitvena lābhānupapattau sarvaviplavaprasaṅgāt| anabhihite karmādau dvitīyādi, prathamā tvabhihitānabhihitasādhāraṇyeneti anabhihitasthale dvitīyādibhiḥ saha vaikalpikatvena prathamāyāḥ samāveśasambhavāt| etena sambodhaneceti jñāpakena mātragrahaṇasya pratyākhyānamapi nirastam| uktavidhayā tasyā apūrvavidhitvenaivopapattiprasaṅgāt| prātipadikapadopādāne tu antaraṅgatayā sambandhinyeva sākāṅkṣatayā tadanvayenaivākāṅkṣāśāntau karmādīnāṃ nānvaya iti vaiṣamyam| evaṃca tvadrītyā sūtrasyaiva vaiyarthyāpattiḥ| svaujasamauṭityādinaiva prathamāyā vidhānāt| karmaṇi dvitīyaivetyādyarthaniyamapakṣe prātipadikārthamātre dvitīyādīnāṃ, karmaṇyeva dvitīyetyādipratyayaniyamapakṣe karmādau prathamāyāśca vyāvṛttyarthaṃ niyamadvayasampādakatvena sūtramārthakyamiṣṭam| tacca karmādāveva prathāmāyā vidhānaprasaṅgena dūrāṣāstaṃ syāt| nanu pratyayaniyamapakṣe karmādau prathamāyāḥ svayameva prāptatvāt| sūtravaiyarthyabhītyā karmādau prathamāvidhāne sūtratātparyaṃ nakalpayiṣyate kintu ṅyāp‌prātipadikārthe ityatraiveti cenna| śāstratātparyānusāreṇaiva niyamasya kalpyatvāt| prātipadikārthamātra prathamāvidhānasyaivānupapattau yathoktaniyamasyaiva śaśaviṣāṇāyamānatvāt| dvitīyādīnāṃ parasparātiriktārthe parasparavyavacchedaparatayaiva karmaṇi dvitīyetyādiśāstrāṇāṃ tātparyaprasaṅgāt| dvitīyā karmaṇyeva tṛtīyā kartṛkaramayorevatyādibhireva niyamasvarūpāpatteḥ| tṛtīyādivyavacchedaśca tatphalamityasya sambhavāt| prathamāyāḥ karmādāveva vihitatve tadvyavacchedasyāśakyatvāt| tataśca prātipadikārthamātre prathamāvidhānasiddhau pratyayaniyamasya prathamāvyavacchedārthatvaṃ, tatsiddhauca prathamāyāḥ prātipadikārthamātre vidhānaṃ iti doṣo durvāraḥ| anyathā'rthe prathamoti nyāse prātipadikasyārthopari pratiyogitvenānvayalākṣānupapatteruktatvāditi tiṣṭhatu tāvat| evaṃ parimāṇagrahaṇamapyāvaśyakam| prakṛtyarthasyābhedena prathamārthe parimāṇe tasya ca paricchannatvasambandhena vrīhāvanvaye yādṛśo bodhastasyāsiddheḥ| nacoktabodho'siddha eva| liṅgādisāhacaryeṇa nyāyaprāptārthānuvādakatvamyaiva parimāṇāṃśe svīkāreṇa parimāṇasya vācyatvakalpanāditi vācyam| anantasthale droṇādiśabdānāṃ tatparimitalakṣaṇamapekṣya prathamāyā vācyatvasyaiva kalpayitumucitatvāta| naca droṇaṃ vrīhimānayetyādau lakṣaṇāvaśyakatvātprathamāsthale'pi tatheti vācyam| tathāpi lakṣaṇāyā nirūḍhatvasampādanāya parimāṇagrahaṇasyāvaśyakatvāt| `guṇavacanebhyo matupo lugiṣṭa'ityādivat| vacanagrahaṇaṃ tūkteṣvapyekatvādiṣu yathā syāt| ekaḥ dvau bahavaḥ| anyathānabhihitādhikārādbahuṣu bahuvacanamityādināsya prakaraṇasyaikavākyatvātparigaṇanasya ca pratyākhyātatvātprakṛtyaivekatvādīnāmabhihitatvāt| anabhihitādhikārapratyākhyāne'pi uktārthatvādeva prathamā na syāt| yattu na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā na kelavaḥ pratyayaḥ iti vacanādeva ekādibhyaḥ prathamā bhaviṣyati| anyathā ekaṃ paśya, ekena kṛtamityādau gatyantarābhāvāditi tanna| tatra karmatvādīnāmanuktatvena dvitīyādeḥ sambhavāt| naca prātipadikārthasyānuktatvātsathameti tulyam| tasya prātipadikenaivoktatvāt| nacaivaṃ prathamāvidhāyakasyaiva nirviṣayatvānupapattiḥ| tatra vacanabalātprathamāpravṛttāvapi eka ityādau vacanavyatyayasya durvāratvāt| yattu ekatve ekavacanamityādyarthaniyamairdvivacanādīnāṃ vyāvartane'pi ekatvādāvekavacanādīnāṃ vidhānābhāvāduktārthānāmaprayoga iti nyāyāpravṛttiḥ| ekatve ekavacanamiti pratyayaniyamapakṣe'pi sajātīyāpekṣatayā saṃkhyāntare ekavacanādīnāṃ vyāvartane'pi saṃkhyārahite ekavacanādīnāmavyāvartanāt| eka ityādau ekatvādipratyayaḥ supaiva natu prakṛtyetyatra niyāmakābhāvāt| upasthitāḥ nāmarthānāmatyantatyāge mānābhāvācca| saṃkhyāntarambhave eva niyamapravṛtteḥ| ekaśabdādau ca dvivacanādīnāṃ yathāyathamasambhavādityādi| tadapi cintyam| śāstratātparyāviṣayatve'rthānāṃ tyāge'pi kṣativirahāt| upasthitimātrasyāprayojakatvāt| etenānanvitārthakaprayogāpekṣayānuvādamātraprayogasya nyāyyatvāditi nirastam| prathamopastitve dvau bahava ityatraikavacanāpatterdurvāratvāt ca| yadapi sambodhaneceti jñāpakena karmādyādhikye prathamāyā apravṛttermātragrahaṇaṃ vyarthamiti| tatrāpyāhuḥ-tadabhāve śeṣe ṣaṣṭhyāpattau tadbādhanārthaṃ sūtrasyāvaśyakatvātkathaṃ niyamārthatvamiti| yattvevaṃ karmaṇi dvitīyetyādīnāmapi niyamatvaṃ na syāt| ataḥ motsargaṃ sāpavādaṃ ca prakaraṇaṃ tadeva lakṣyasaṃskārakaṃ evañca karmaṇi dvitīyetyasyābhāve śeṣeṣaṣṭhītyasyāpyabhāvāddvitīyāyā āpa prāptatvena niyamatvaṃ yuktameveti| tatredaṃ vaktavyam-vārttikakārastvāha abhihete prathameti| tiṅādibhirabhihite kartrādau prathamā bhavatītyarthaḥ| vṛkṣa ityādauastikriyādhyāhārāt udāharaṇāni| evañca vīraḥ puruṣa ityādau viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasyādhikye'pi abhihitatvātprathamā sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ| etacca nirastam| abhihitānabhihite hi prathamābhāva iti| asyārthaḥ| prāsāde āste ityatra kriyādvayānirūpitamadhikaraṇaṃ prāsādākhyaṃ, tacca sadiprakṛtikena ghañābhihitaṃ āserlaṭānabhihitaṃ tatraikasyāḥ śakterabhihitatvāttānnabandhanā prathamā paratvātsaptamīṃ bādhitvā syāt| atha tiṅ‌samānāidakaraṇe prathameti vaktavyam| uktasthale tu vaiyadhikaraṇyātprathamāyā abhavāḥ| tiṅ‌sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ hi tatpratipādyapratipādakatvam| tacca caitraḥ pacatītyādāvasti| kartṛtvarūpeṇākhyātena prātisvikarūpeṇa ca prātipadikena caitrasya pratipādanāt| prāsāde āste ityatra tvākhyātoktakartṛviśeṣapratipādakatvavirahāt| prāsādaśabde na prathameti cet| maivam| laṭi tiṅāmaprasiddhiprasaṅgāt| tathāhi-devadatta pac‌ laṭ‌ iti sthite tiṅutpatteḥ pūrvaṃ tiṅ‌samānādhikaraṇatvābhāvena prathamaivoti niyamasyābhāvāt| devadattaśabdādaviśeṣavihitāḥ sarve svādayaḥ sambhavantyevetyaprathamāsāmānādhikaraṇyasattvācchatṛśānacāveva syātām| naceṣṭāpattiḥ| devadattaḥ pacatīti vākyavilopāpatteḥ| naca karmaṇyeva dvitīyetyādivibhaktiniyamāśrayaṇānna dvitīyādikamapīti vācyam| karmaṇi dvitīyaivetyarthaniyamapakṣe tadāpatteḥ| śeṣatvena ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sambhavācca| naca tiṅ‌vidhisāmarthyāttibādayo bhaviṣyantīti vācyam laṅādau tiṅ‌vidheḥ sāvakāśatvāt| ata eva prathamāvidherapi na sāmarthyam| laḍ‌bhinnalakārasthale eva sāvakāśatvāt| nacāprathamāsāmānādhikaraṇe ityasya prasajyapratiṣedhatvamāśritya prathamāsāmānādhikaraṇye śatṛśānacorniṣiddhatvādatra ca tasyāpi sattvānna śatṛśānacorāpattiriti vācyam| asamarthasamāsasya vākyabhedasya cāśrayaṇe gauravāt| bhāṣye tu paryudāsapakṣe'pi vibhaktiniyame doṣo netyuktam| tacvintyamiti dīkṣitāḥ| dvitīyā karmaṇyevetyādivibhaktiniyame dvitīyāderanutpattāvapi ṣaṣṭhyā durvāratvāt| ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe eveti niyatatvāt| vibhaktyantaraniyamo yatra na pravṛttaḥ tasyaiva śeṣatvāt tathāca prathamābhinnavibhaktisāmānādhikaraṇyasattvād‌durvārau śatuśānacāviti| sambodhane ca || 47 || prathamā syāt| caitra maitra āgacchati| sabodhanaṃ ca ayametadvākyārthabodhavānbhavatvitīcchā| tatra vivakṣitavivekenecchā prathamārthaḥ| viśeṣyatāsambandhena prakṛtyarthasyecchāyāṃ tasyāśca svaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaviṣathitāsambandhāvacchinnaprakāratāśālibodhanīṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaviṣayitāsambandhena kriyāyāmanvayaḥ| maitrakartṛkagamanakriyābodho'sya jāyatāmityākārakecchāyāṃ tathaiva sambhavāt| caitraviṣayikā yā icchā tasyāṃ viṣayitvena viśeṣaṇībhūto yo bodhaḥ tasmin viṣayitāsambandhena prakāratāpannā maitrakartṛkāgamanakriyenvayadhīḥ| etenācena'pi sambodhanaṃ vyākhyātam| uktecchāyāstatrāpi sambhavāt| tenaikavākyatayā vrajāni devadattetyādī nighātaḥ| taduktaṃ hariṇā- sambodhanapadaṃ yacca tatkriyāyāṃ viśeṣaṇam| vrajāni devadatteti nighāto'tra tathā satīti|| sāmantritam || 48 || uktaprathamāntamāmantritasaṃjñaṃ syāt| mahāsaṃjñākaraṇasāmārthyāttadantagrahaṇam| saṃjñāpradeśā `āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānava'dityādayaḥ| seti kim he pacan he pacamānetyādau śatrādeḥ sambodhana eva vihitatvātprātipadikārtha eva tadantarbhāvātpūrvasūtreṇaiva prathamāyāmapi uktasaṃjñā yathā syāt| yadā tu uktaśatrāderapi kartṛbodhakatvameva loṭa iva dvirvacanarahitasya tadā `sambodhanece'tyeva prathamā| anantarasya vidhirveti tasyā evaṃ saṃjñāpravṛttāvapi rūpasiddheḥ seti na kartavyam| ekavacanaṃ sambuddhiḥ || 49 || āmantritaprathamāyā ekavacanaṃ sambuddhisaṃjñaṃ syāt| saṃjñāpradeśā `eṅ‌hasvātsaṃbuddhe'rityādayaḥ| suḥ sambuddhiriti vaktavye ekavacanagrahaṇaṃ pratyayamātrasya saṃjñā yathā syāt| prakramāttadantasya mābhūt| ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe || 50 || śeṣaśabdo'nyārthaḥ, tatra pūrvoktānāṃ karmādīnāṃ pratiyogitvenānvaye karmādikārakebhyo'nye'rthāḥ śeṣa ityucyante| yadyapi vāstavaḥ kriyākārakabhāvaḥ sarvatrāsti rājñaḥ puruṣa ityatra rājā puruṣāya dadātīti pratyayāt kartṛsampradānabhāvaḥ| vṛkṣasya śākheti lokaprasidhyā vṛkṣasya, vaiśoṣikarītyā tu śākhāyā adhikaraṇatvaṃ, krayāpahārayāñcāvinimayānāṃ svatvopāyānāṃ kriyātmakatvācca| apahārasya svatvahetutāyāḥ śāstrānabhihitatve'pi yatheṣṭaviniyogātmakatādyupāyatvāt| tathāpi svasvāmibhāvādimātrasabandhavikṣāyāṃ kriyākārakasambandhasya vastusato'pyavikṣaivaśeṣaḥ| taduktam| sambandhaḥ kārakebhyo'nyaḥ kriyākārakapūrvakaḥ| śrutāyāmaśrutāyāṃ vā kriyāyāṃ so'bhidhīyate iti| aśrutāyāṃ rājñaḥ puruṣa ityādau| śrutāyāṃ mātuḥ smaratītyādau| mātuḥ sambandhi smaraṇamityarthaḥ| iha pratyayaniyamapakṣeśeṣa eva ṣaṣṭhītyavadhāraṇārthaṃ śeṣagrahaṇam| arthaniyamapakṣe tu ṣaṣṭhītyeva vācyam| ṣaṣṭhyāstadanyasyāśca prāptau ṣaṣṭhyeveti| nanu pratisambandhini ṣaṣṭhīnivṛttyarthaṃ śeṣagrahaṇamastu| sambandhasya dviṣṭhatayā tasmādapi tatprasakteḥ| naca prātipadikārthomātre'ntaraṅgatvātprathameti vācyam| sambandhasyādhikasya pratyayāditicenna| tasya vākyārthatayā paścātpratītirityasya prāgevoktatvāt| puruṣaityukte prātipadikārthamātrapratīteḥ| rājña ityetāvanmātroktāvapi pratiyogiviśeṣānavacchinnasya svāmitvasya pratiteścetyanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ rājapuruṣayorguṇapradhānabhāvavyavasthayā ṣaṣṭhiniyamopapatteḥ taduktam- dviṣṭho'pyasau parārthatvādguṇeṣu vyatiricyate| tatrābhidhīyamānastu pradhāneṣu prayujyate|| sambandhasyobhayaniṣṭhasya guṇottaraṣaṣṭhyaiva pratyāyitatvānnapratisambandhini pradhāne ṣaṣṭhītyarthaḥ| tathāhi-kriyāpekṣāḥ kārakaśaktayaḥ prātipadikārtheṣu kalpyante yadā prātipadikārthasya kriyāveśavivakṣāyāṃ śaktilakṣaṇārthātireko bhavati tadā śaktayaḥ prātipadikārthatāṃ na pratipadyante| dātreṇa lunātītyeva tadā prayogo natu dātraṃ karamamiti| kriyāyogavivakṣāyāṃ karaṇādiśabdaiḥ śaktayo na pratipādyante apitu vibhaktibhireva| niṣkṛṣṭaśaktyabhidhānasya tadekasādhyatvāt| vivecitaṃ caitatprāk| yadā tu yogyatāmātravivakṣā tadā dātraṃ karaṇamiti| tadāca vibhaktyutpattau saṃjñānāmanimittatvam| taduktam| svaśabdairabhidhāne tu sa dharmo nābhidhīyate| vibhaktyādibhirevāsāvupakāraḥ pratīyate|| iti| vibhaktipadaṃ suptaṅubhayaparam| ādipadaṃ kārakārthakakṛttaddhitaparam| tathāsvaviśeṣasambandhavivakṣāyāṃ rājñaḥ puruṣa iti| svāmitvamātrābhiprāye tu rājā svāmītibhāvaḥ| yadā tu puruṣaniṣṭhasvatvanirūpitaṃ rājñaḥ svāmitvaṃ vivakṣyate tadā puruṣasya rājeti| rājñaḥ puruṣasya dhanaṃ ityatra tu puruṣadhanayoryaḥ sambandhastasya rājapadottaraṣaṣṭhyānabhihitatvāttatpratipādanārthaṃ ṣaṣṭhīti bodhyam| jño'vidarthasya karaṇe || 51 || jñānabhinnārthakatvena vivakṣitasya jānāteḥ karaṇe śeṣatvena vivakṣite ṣaṣṭhī| sarpiṣo jñānam| vastutaḥ karaṇībhūtaṃ yatsarpistatsambandhinī pravṛttiḥ jñānapadaṃ tarpūvakatvasambandhena pravṛttiparam etatprakaraṇaṃ samāsanivṛtyarthamiti pūrvaṃ vyākhyātam| yattu tiṅantodāharaṇaṃ grantheṣu tadupalakṣaṇaṃ kṛdantatattaddhātūnāmiti prāmāṇikāḥ| adhigarthadayośāṃ karmaṇi || 52 || śeṣatvena vivakṣite ṣaṣṭhī| ik‌smaraṇe| kakāra ihaiva viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| sopasargagrahaṇaṃ tu ekadeśānumatidvārā `iṅikāvadhyupasargato na vyabhicarata'iti sūcanārtham| ataeva smṛtyartheti noktam| tathāpi iṇvadikaityatra kaṭī ityatrapraśliṣṭasyāyatervāraṇāya kitvadhrauvyācca| māturadhyayā pituḥ smaraṇamityādi| kṛñaḥ pratiyatne || 53 || pratiyatno guṇādhānam| edho dakasyopaskaraṇam| (jātiraprāṇināmityekavadbhāvaḥ)| rujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānāmajvareḥ || 54 || ajvarisaṃtāpyoritivaktavyam| bhedapratiyogikoṭau saṃtāpirapi niveśya ityarthaḥ| ubhayabhinnānāṃ bhāvakartṛkāṇāṃ rujārthānāṃ karmaṇi śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī| caurasya rogasya rujā| vacanetyatra dhātorlyuṭaḥ sādhutvamātrārthamupādānāttadarthasyāvivakṣitatvātpratyayārthasya kartureva vivakṣitatvādbhāvakartṛko'rthaḥ saṃpannaḥ| kecittu bhāve vacanaṃ yeṣāṃ te bhāvavacanāḥ santi bhāve kartariyeṣāṃ vacanamuccāraṇaṃ bhāvakartṛkadhātvarthapratipādanāya yeṣāmabhidhānamiti yāvaddityāhuḥ| ajvarītyādi kim| rogasya corajvaraḥ corasaṃtāpo vā ityatra karmaṣaṣṭhyeva yathā syāt| tena samāsasiddhiḥ khare ca viśeṣa iti prāguktam| āśiṣi nāthaḥ || 55 || sarpiṣo nāthanam| tatsaṃbandhinī icchetyarthaḥ| āśiṣi kim| māṇavakasya nāthanam| yāñcātra nāthatyarthaḥ| atra samāso'pi| jāsiniprahaṇanāṭakrāthapiṣāṃ hiṃsāyām || 56 || caurasyojjāsanam| jasuhiṃsāyām| niprau saṃhatau viparyastau vyastau ca| corasya niprahaṇanam| praṇihananam| nihananaṃ prahaṇanaṃ vā| naṭa syandane curādiḥ| naṭanṛttāvityasya ghaṭāderna grahaṇam| dīrdhanirdeśāt| caurasyonnāṭanam| kratha rhisāyāmiti ghaṭādiḥ| tasya mittve'pyatra nipātanādvṛddhiriti vṛttiḥ| ataeva yujādau kratheḥ pāṭhaḥ prāmādika iti saṃpradāyaḥ| naca ghaṭādipāṭhavaiyarthyam| akrathi akrāthi, krathaṃ krathaṃ, krāthaṃkrāthamityatra `ciṇṇamulordīrgho'nyatarasyā'miti vikalpena caritārthatvāt| yattu nyāsakṛtoktam| dīrghanirdeśānmitve'pi vṛddhiḥ ṣaṣṭhyapi tatraiva| caṅanteṣu tu vṛdhyabhāvāddvitīyaiva| coramacakrathaditi| tatrāhuḥ-tiṅantānāmetatprakaraṇe udāharaṇatvaṃ naca krāthereva ṣaṣṭhī natu hrasvasyeti vyākhyānātprakaraṇaṃ bhitvā tiṅantodāharaṇatvaprastviti vācyam| mānābhāvāt| tathāpi dvitīyāyā durvāratvācceti| etenātideśikaṣittvena ṣidbhidādibhya ityaṅartho ghaṭādipāṭha iti haradattoktamapi parāstam| ghaṭādayaḥ ṣita ityasya ghaṭādigaṇāntarāle pāṭhāt ṣitvātideśavacanottaraṃ paṭhyamānasya kratheḥṣitvāyogāditi| vṛṣalasya peṣaṇam| hiṃsāyāṃ kim| dhānāpeṣaṇam| acetanānāṃ mukhyahiṃsāvirahaḥ| vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ || 57 || dyūte krayavikrayavyavahāre cānayostulyārthatvam| śatasya vyavaharaṇaṃ paṇanaṃ vā| śatasambandhi krayavikrayarūpema viniyogo devanaṃ vetyarthaḥ| ekārthayoḥ kim| śalākāvyavahāraḥ gaṇanetyarthaḥ brāhmaṇapaṇanaṃ stutirityarthaḥ| divastadarthasya || 58 || iha śeṣa ityasya nānvayaḥ| uttarasūtradvayārambhāt| anyathā tatra karmaṇi dvitīyāvidhānānupayogāt| ataeva pūrvasūtre divirna nirdiṣṭaḥ| tatra śeṣasambandhāt| paṇādisamānārthakasya divaḥ karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| atra diṅantamapyudāharaṇam| karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyā aprāptāyā eva vidhānātsamāsanivṛttau tātparyābhāvāt| śatasya dīvyati| tadarthasya kim| brāhmaṇaṃ dīvyati stautītyarthaḥ| vibhāṣopasarge || 59 || śatasya śataṃvā pradīvyati| dvitīyā brāhṇaṇe || 60 || mantrabhinno vedo brāhmaṇam| `śeṣe brāhmaṇa śabda'iti jaiminisūtrāt| tadviṣaye prayoge pūrvoktārthasya divaḥ karmaṇi dvitīyā| ṣaṣṭyapavādaḥ naca gāṃ ghnanti, gāṃ pradīvyanti ityatra vyavasthitavibhāṣayā pūrveṇaiva siddhamiti vācyam| gāmasya tadahaḥ sabhāyāṃ dīvyeyuḥ ityanupasargārthaṃ etadārambhāt| preṣyabruvorhaviṣo devatāsaṃpradāne || 61 || iṣa gatāviti daivādikasya loṭi madhyamaikavacanaṃ preṣyeti| sāhacāryāṭ bruvirapi loṇmadhyamaikavacanānta evātra gṛhyate| devatāsaṃpradānaṃ yasyārthasya tadvṛttyoḥ devatodeśyakatyāgārthayoriti yāvat| preṣyabrūhīti śabdayoḥ karmaṇo havirviśeṣavācakācchabdātṣaṣṭhī| agnaye chāgasya haviṣo vapāyā medasaḥ preṣya anubrūhi vā| preṣyetyādi kim| agnaye gomayāni preṣya| devatīti kim| māṇavakāya puroḍāśānpreṣya| haviṣo'prasthitasyeti vaktavyam| prasthitatbena havirviśeṣaṇe ṣaṣṭhī na bhavatītyarthaḥ| indrāgnibhyāṃ chāgaṃ havirvapāṃ medaḥ prasthitaṃ preṣyeti| iha śeṣasya nānvayaḥ| tiṅantayorevānukaraṇena samāsānāpatteḥ uttaratra cchandograhaṇādbhāṣāyāmapīdam| caturthyarthe bahulaṃ chandasi || 62 || ṣaṣṭhī syāt| puruṣamṛgaścandramase godhākālakādārvāghāstaṭe vanaspatīnām| ṣaṣṭhyarthe caturthītyapi vaktavyam| yā kharveṇa pibati tasyai kharvaḥ| yadvā caturthītyeko yogaḥ| prakaraṇāt ṣaṣṭhyarthe ityasya lābhaḥ| arthe ityaparaḥ| caturthyarthe ṣaṣṭhīti tadarthaḥ| vyatyayavacanādvā siddham| yajeśca karaṇe || 63 || chandasi karaṇe bahulaṃ ṣaṣṭhī, ghṛtasya ghṛtena vā yajate| kṛtvorthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe || 64 || atra prāñcaḥ| śeṣagrahaṇamanuvartate uttarasūtre karmagrahaṇāt| anyathā kartari cetyavakṣyat| śeṣasaṃbaddhaṃ karmagrahaṇaṃ mānuvṛtadityarthameva karmaṇastatra pṛthagupādānāditi| anye tu sannihitatarasya prakṛtasūtrasthādhikaraṇasyaiva nivṛttyarthe karmagrahaṇasambhavādvyākhyānameva śeṣānuvṛttau mānamityāhuḥ| pañcakṛtvo'hno bhojanam| dvirahno bhojanam| śeṣe kim| dvirahanyadhīte iti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyā bādho mābhūt| kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti || 65 || śeṣa iti nivṛttam| kṛdyoge kartari karmaṇi ca ṣaṣṭhī syāt| bhavataḥ śāyikā| apāṃ sraṣṭā| kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kim| śāstreṇa bhettā| nanu kṛtīti vyartham| dhātorhi dvaye pratyayā vidhīyante tiṅaḥ kṛtaśca| tatra tiṅ‌prayoge na loketi ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhātkṛdyoga eva ṣaṣṭhīparyavasānaṃ sulabhaṃ nacāvyayaprayoge vakṣyamāṇaḥ ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhaḥ kṛto'vyayasya ye kartṛkarmaṇī tatraiva pravartatāṃ natu uccaiḥ kaṭānāṃ sraṣṭetyatrākṛto'vyayasya ye kartṛkarmaṇī tatra mābhūdityuktarārthaṃ taditi vācyam| uccaiḥsthānasthitānāṃ kaṭānāṃ sraṣṭetyarthāt kṛdantasyaiva te kartṛkarmaṇī natvakriyāvācina uccaiḥ śabdasyeti| sāmarthyādeva tatra kṛdgrahaṇalābhāt| nacobhayaprāptāviti vakṣyamāṇe kṛtīti śabdopātte viśeṣye ubhayaprāptāvityasya bahuvrīhitvasiddheḥ| anyathāntaraṅgatvāttatpuruṣaḥ syāt| tataśca dvayoḥ kṛtorthe kartṛkarmaṇī tatra niṣedho mābhūt| āścaryamidaṃ vṛttam odanasya ca nāma pāko brāhmaṇānāṃ ca prādurbhāva iti vācyam| tathāpyatra tadgrahaṇe prayojanābhāvāt| tatrāpi vyākhyānena bahuvrīhinirṇayasambhavācceti cet| atrabhāṣyakṛtaḥ taddhitasya ye kartṛkarmaṇī tatra mābhūditi kṛdgrahaṇam| kṛtapūrvī kaṭam| bhuktapūrvī odanamiti| kṛtaṃ pūrvamaneneti supsupeti samāsaḥ| sapūrvācceti iniḥ| kartātra taddhitenokta iti tataḥ ṣaṣṭhyā aprasaktāvapi kaṭāt karmaṇaḥ ṣaṣṭhī mābhūt| syādetat| kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ pūrvamanenetyasmin vigrahe ktapratyayena karmaṇo'bihatatvāddvitīyayā na bhāvyam| sutarāṃ tadapavādena ṣaṣṭhyā ihāpyanabhihitādhikārāt| evaṃ kṛtaśabdasya kaṭena sāpekṣatvātsamāsataddhitāvanupapannāviti cet| atrāhuḥ- viśeṣakarmasaṃbandhanirmukte'pi kaṭādibhiḥ| viśeṣanirapekṣo'nyaḥ kṛtaśabdaḥ pravartate|| akarmakatve satyevaṃ ktānte bhāvābhighāyini| tataḥ kriyāvatā kartrā yogo bhavati karmaṇām|| avigrahā gatādisthā yathā grāmādikarmabhiḥ| kriyā saṃbadhyate tadvatkṛtapūrvyādiṣu sthiteti|| asyārthaḥ-kṛtaḥ kaṭo'neneti vākye kṛtakaṭayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ asmiṃścārthaviśeṣe na bhāvyameva vṛttyā| tasyāḥ sāmānyaviṣayatvāt| tathāhi-karmasāmānye bhāve vā ktapratyaye sati kaṭarūpakarmaviśeṣānvayamapratipadyamāna eva kṛtaśabdaḥ pūrvaśabdena samasyate| naca karmasāmānyeti pakṣe kaṭasyābhidhānaṃ durvāraṃ śakyaṃ ca kṣudupahantu mityādivaditi vācyam| taddhitavṛttāvekārthīrbhūtasya kṛtaśabdārthasya pṛthak‌kaṭena saṃbandhābhāvāt| iti prathamaślokārthaḥ| nanvevaṃ kaṭaśadvasyāpi kriyāyogābhāve dvitīyā nasyāditi cenna| grāmaṃ kṛtavānityādau guṇabhūtayā'pi kriyayā kārakāṇāṃ saṃbandhadarśanāt| tadāhaḥ avigraheti| prādhānyenāgṛhyamāṇāpītyarthaḥ| pūrvaṃ kṛtamanenetyarthe vputpāditasya kṛtapūrvītyasya pūrvaṃ kṛtavānityarthasaṃpattyā karotikriyāpekṣakarmatvānapāyāt| iti atra navyamīmāṃsakāḥ| evaṃ sati rājapadasyāpi ṛddhapadānapekṣasya puruṣapadena samāse kṛte paścādṛddhapadānvayāpattiḥ| odanaḥ pacyatetamāṃ, gururdharitrī kriyatetarāṃ tvayetyādāvapi dvitīyāpattiśca| uktayukteḥ guṇībhūtena lakārārthena karmaṇā odanādīnāṃ yogaityuktau ca ktapratyayārthenāpi tadāpatteḥ| kriyāyāḥ kārakeṣviva śakterapi śaktimatyutthitākāṅkṣatvāt, vaiṣambhe bījābhāvāt| odanaṃ pacyate iti bhāvākhyāte'pi dvitīyāpattiśca| tasmānna dhātvarthe karmānvayaḥ| mīmāṃsakamate dhātvarthānvayasya kārakāṇāmavyutyapitu taddhitārtha eva| kartṛtvasyātra taddhitārthatayā pācakādivadviśeṣaṇatayā lakṣaṇayā svātantryeṇa vā kṛterapi taddhitārthatvā tasyāṃ9 ca liṅgānvayinyāṃ viśeṣyavācakapadopasthāpyāyāṃ cānvaye odanasya pācaka itivanna samāsabhaṅgaḥ| tadvācakapadena karmatvānuktyā prathamānāpattiśca| pacyatetamāmityādau tu atiśayamātrasya taddhitārthatvānna kṛtyabhidhānam| tatra lakārārthakṛtāviva tadanvayāttenaiva tadanvayāttenaiva karmatvasyoktatvānna dvitīyā| tarapratyayasya tātparyagrāhakatvāṅgīkāreṇa tarāmityasyānarthakatvena viśeṣaṇasāpekṣasyāpi tena saha vyutpatteśca| evamodanasya pācakatama ityādau yojyam| vyākaraṇaṃ prājña ityatrāpi svārthikataddhitena kṛdarthakṛterapyupādānena tatra karmānvayo draṣṭavyaḥ| nacaivaṃ odanasya pācakaḥ, kṛṣṇasya kṛtīrityatra kārakānvayo na syāt| dhātvarthe tvayānabhyupagamāt| ghañarthasya ca liṅgānvayitvāt| tādṛśe'pyanvayopagame ca vastupadābhidheyāyāmapi tatprasaṅgāditi vācyam| tatrāpi paktetyādivat kṛtiviśiṣṭapākasya kṛtilakṣaṇābhyāṃ pṛthak‌kṛtipākayorvābhidānena kṛtau kārakānvayopapatteḥ| pākānukūlakṛtisādhyaḥ pāka ityanvayasaṃbhavāt| yadvā tatra śeṣaṣaṣṭhyeva| tasyā api adhyāhṛtāstyādikriyāyāṃ paramparānvayaḥ naca kṛdyoge ṣaṣṭhīvidhivaiyarthyam| kartrādivācakatṛjādiparatvamātreṇa tadupapatteḥ| tatsiddhaṃ kṛdyoga eva kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhī| natu sārthakataddhitayoge kārakavācitaddhitayoge vetyetadarthaṃ kṛd‌grahaṇaṃ taddhitayoge kārakāṇāṃ kṛtāvanvaya ityevaṃ jñāpakatvāditi| tatredaṃ vaktavyam| atiprasaṅganirāsaḥ prayogānusārādeva sulabhaḥ| anyathā kuto bhavān pāṭaliputraka ityādāvasamarthasamāsasya bhāṣyasiddhatvātsarvasaṃmatatayā tenāpyatiprasaṅgāpattiḥ syāt| kiñcātra kṛtaśabdādbhāve pratyayaḥ karmaṇi vā nādyaḥ| taddhitasya kṛti lakṣaṇāyāṃ mānābhāvaprasaṅgāt| anyathā śayyate ityādāvapi tatprasaṅgāt| nāntyaḥ| sahī sāmānye, viśeṣarūpe vā| nādyaḥ tvaduktadoṣāpatteḥ| nāntyaḥ| ananvitatvaṃ kaṭābhidhānaṃcetyanyatarasya durvāratvāt| kiñca pūrvīti taddhitasya liṅgānvayitvātkathaṃ tadarthakṛtau kārakānvayaḥ| kartaiva tatra liṅgānvayīti cet| na| kṛteḥ pṛthakghañarthatve kṛterna liṅgānvaya ityasya vinigantumasakyatvāt| pākānukūlakṛtisādhyaḥ pāka ityapyuktam| ghañādibhiḥ siddhabhāvāpannabhāvaḥ pratyāyyate iti siddhāntavirodhāt| nāpi tṛjadimātraviṣayakatvena sūtrasārdhakyam| harismaraṇamityādau karmaṣaṣṭhyā samāse kārakapūrvatayā kṛduttaraprakṛtisvara ityasya samāsasya ca sarvābhiyuktasaṃmatasyāsiddhiprasaṅgāt| mānuḥsmṛtamityāderasiddheśca| kṛdyogaṣaṣṭhyāstatrāpravṛttau śeṣaśaṣṭhyā eva naloketi sūtre niṣṭhāprayoge niṣedha iti tvayā vācyatvāt ityāstāṃ vistaraḥ| prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ| atra pratyavatiṣṭhante| astu ktārthaparityāgena kathañcid‌vṛttiḥ māsajātādau vṛttivākyayorupastitatyāgasyāpi darśanāt| evamapi kṛd‌grahaṇaṃ vyartham| naloketi niṣṭhāyoge ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhasiddheḥ| niṣṭhāntadhātūpātta kriyayoge tanniṣedhāt| grāmaṃ gatavānityādāvapi kārakāṇāṃ kriyayaivānvayāt| naca pācayati caitro maitreṇetyādau ṇicprakṛtyarthakriyākartuḥ prayojyātṣaṣṭhī mābūdityarthaṃ taditivācyam| layoge netyeva niṣedhopapatteḥ| naca ṇijantopastāpyakriyāyoga eva natu lakārāntīpasthāpyakriyayā ṇica eva lakārāntaratvāditi vācyam| laprakṛtyā lāntapadena vā yā kriyopāttā tadyoge netyarthasya guṇakriyāsādhāraṇyāt| lakṣyānurodhena gauṇamukhyanyāyāpravṛtteḥ| anyathā tatra tṛtīyāpi na syāt| bhedikā devadattasya yajñadattasya kāṣṭhānāmityubhayatra ṣaṣṭhyā apīṣṭhatvāditi| atrāhuḥ-taddhitādhikyavyavacchedārthaṃ kṛdgrahaṇaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ prājña iti prajñādibhyaśceti svārthe'ṇ iti sāṃpradāyikāḥ| evaṃ ca odanasya pācakatam ityatra ṣaṣṭhī neti granthakṛtāmāśayaḥ| kartavyapūrvī kaṭamityatra tavyayoge mābhūditi kṛdgrahaṇavyāvartyamapi saṃbhavatyeva| bhāṣyasyātrodāsīnatayābhiyuktaprayogadarśanādanyatarannirṇeyamiti dīkṣitāḥ| yathā lakṣaṇamaprayukte iti nyāyena kartavyapūrvī kaṭamityeva yuktamiti rahasyam| atra pakṣadharamiśrāḥ| devadatta odanamityatra pacatīti śabdasyānadhyāhāre karturanabhidhānāttṛtīyā syāditi doṣastadadhyāhāre'pi samānaḥ| nyāyādimate ākhyātena karturanabhidhānāt| kartṛsaṃkhyābhihiteti cet devadattasya pāka ityatrāpi tṛtīyāpattiḥ| kṛtpratyayena saṃkhyānabhidhānāditimaṇikāraphakkikāyāṃ vyācakhyuḥ| nanvatra kṛdyoge ṣaṣṭhayevāpavādikā anyathā tṛtīyāprasaktau tatsūtrapraṇayanānupapattiriti| maivam| kṛdyoge'pi ṣaṣṭhī na kartṛtvaprakāreṇa bodhayati kintu sambandhatvena| sambandhastu kartṛtvamevetyanyadetat| tathā ca kartṛsaṃkhyānabhidhāne kartṛtvaprakārakānvayabodhārthaṃ tṛtīyāniyame prakṛte'pi tathā syādityartha iti| nanvevaṃ sūtravaiyarthyam| sambandhatvaprakārakabodhajanikāyāḥ śeṣavacanādeva siddheḥ| evaṃ caitrasya gata ityādau śeṣaṣaṣṭhītyasyānupapattiḥ| na loketisūtreṇa śeṣaṣaṣṭhīniṣedhasyaivaitanmate vācyatvāt| harismaraṇamityādau karmaṣaṣṭhyā samāse kṛduttaraprakṛtisvarānupapattiśca| tṛtīyādeḥ kartṛtvaprakārakabodhajanakatayā tadapavādasyāpi ṣaṣṭhayāstathaucityācceti| ucyate| sambandhatvena kartṛtvakarmatvabodhikā ṣaṣṭhī niṣṭhāyoge na sādhurityatra naloketyādisūtrasya tātparyātsambandhāntarabodhikāyāḥ sādhutvameveti ṭīkākṛtaḥ| nacaitadapyayuktam| śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāpi sambandhatvarūpeṇa kartṛtvādereva bodhanāt| ata evādhīgarthetisūtre mātṛsmaraṇayorasthānādikriyānimittaḥ sambandho yadvāsmaraṇakriyārūpatayā svata eva saṃbodhanākriyāntarakṛtaḥ yathā jatu kāṣṭhayoḥ saṃśleṣo jatukṛtaḥ, jatunastu svainaiva natu jatvantareṇeti matadvaye kaiyaṭenoktam| anyathā śeṣaṣṭhyāpi sambandhatvena viṣayasyaiva bodhe mātaraṃ smaratītyādivat śaṅkānuttānāt| sambandhatvaṃtu kartṛtvameveti| miśrokterapi kṛdyogaṣaṣṭhīparatvāt| vastutastu ubhayatrāpyastu sambandhatvaprakārakakartṛtvaviśeṣyaka eva bodhaḥ tathāpi na sūtravaiyarthyam| nalokādisūtre niṣedhapratiyogitvenaitatsūtroktaṣaṣṭhyā'nvayārthatayā sārthakyāt| etena svaro'pi vyākhyātaḥ| naca kṛdyoge'pi śeṣavacanādeva ṣaṣṭhīprāptau asyārambhāt| jño'vidarthasyetyādyaṣṭasūtrīvatsamāsanivṛttyarthatvameva syāditi vācyam| karmaṇiceti samāsaniṣedhasūtrasya vaiyarthyāt| tasya kartṛkarmaṇorityetatsūtrīyaṣaṣṭhīgrahaṇavyāvṛttimātrārthatvāt| ubhayaprāptāviti sūtrasyaitadbodhyaṣaṣṭhīniyamamātraparatvācca| adhīgarthetyādīnāṃ karmaṇi śeṣaṣaṣṭhīvidāyakānāṃ vaiyarthyācca| taiṣāṃ kṛnmātraviṣayakatvasya siddhāntitatvāt| tatraitatsūtreṇaiva tvadrītyā samāsanivṛttisiddheḥ| idaṃca vastugatyoktam| kṛdyoge tṛtīyādvitīyayorasādhutvajñāpanārthatvenaivopapatteḥ| caitreṇa hata ityādau ca niṣṭhāyoge ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt| ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi || 66 || ubhayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇoḥ prāptiryatra tasmin kṛti karmaṇyeva ṣaṣṭhī syāt| niyamārthamidam| āścaryaṃ gavāṃ doho'gopena| `akākārayoḥ prayoge pratiṣedho na' iti vaktavyam| uktaniyamo na pravartate ityarthaḥ| bhedikā devadattasya kāṣṭhānām| cikīrṣā viṣṇumitrasya kaṭasya| ubhayatra ṣaṣṭhī| naca ktinā bādhā na bhavati suṭā sīyuṭo bādhā netica vṛttirasaṅgateti vācyam| apratyayādityakārasyaiva prāthamyena grahaṇāt| gurośca hala ityakārasya prakṛte'nupādānāt iti kecit| karaṇatvavivakṣayeti kecit| `śeṣe vibhāṣā'iti vaktavyam| strīpratyayaviṣayamevedamiti kecit| vicitrā khalu pāṇineḥ sūtrasya kṛtiḥ pāṇininā vā| anyetu ubhayabhinne pratyayamātre vikalpaḥ| nañivayuktanyāyasyānityatvādityāhuḥ| śabdānāmanuśāsanamācāryasyācāryeṇa vā| ktasya ca vartamāne || 67 || naloketi vakṣyamāṇaniṣedhasyāpavādaḥ| vartamānārthakaktasya yoge ṣaṣṭhī| rājñāṃ mato buddhaḥ pūjito vā| `napuṃsake bhāve upasaṃkhyānam'| chātrasya hasitam| śeṣavacanādvā siddham| kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ tṛtīyā| chātreṇa hasitam| adhikaraṇavācinaśca || 68 || ktasya yoge ṣaṣṭhī| idameṣāṃ śayitam| akarmakebhyastūbhapatrāpi| idameṣāṃ bhuktamodanasya| nacobhayaprāptau karmaṇītyasya prāptiḥ| kartṛkarmaṇoḥkṛtītyetanmātraparatvāt| evaṃca gatyartheṣu cātuśaśabdyam| ihāhinā sṛptamiti bhāve| ihāhiḥ sṛpta, idamahiḥ sṛpta iti kartari| ihāheḥ sṛptaṃ grāmasya pārśve iti| pārśva ityadhikaraṇaprayogo nāyamadhikaraṇe ktaḥ kintu bhāve iti sūcanārthaḥ| nalokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnām || 69 || tṛnāmityatra pratyayasvarūpatirobhāvāpattyā ṇatvaṃ na prayuktamitikecit| sautratvāditi kaiyaṭānusārimaḥ| eṣāṃ yoge ṣaṣṭhīna syāt| kartṛkarmaṇorityasyāpavādaḥ| lādeśaḥ| odanaṃ pacan pacamānaḥ pecānaḥ pacivān| `lādeśe salliṭ‌ grahaṇaṃ kikinoḥ pratiṣedhārtham'| lagrahaṇamapanīya salliḍiti vaktavyam| saditi śatṛśānacorgrahaṇam| liṭ‌padena kānac‌kvasoḥ liṭ‌saṃjñāvidhānāt kikinośca| yathānyāse tu kikinorlādeśatvābhāvāt papiḥ somaṃ dadirgā ityatra niṣedho na syāt| bhāṣye tu kikinau liṭ‌ceti liṭ‌kāryātideśaḥ| natu liṭ‌saṃjñā| viśeṣātideśe ca sāmānyamapyatidiśyate| avyabhicārāt| tena lamātranibandhanaḥ ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedha ityuktam| uḥkaṭaṃ cikīrṣuḥ| kanyāmalaṅkariṣṇuḥ| ukārāntaprayoge ityarthāt| vyapadeśivadbhāvena kevalenāpi niṣedhasaulabhyāt| ukena saha dvandvaṃ kṛtvā paścāllakāreṇa samāsaḥ tena sahaiva dvandve tu yuṇāvādeśau syātām| ukaḥ kāśīmāgāmukaḥ| kamerbhāṣāyāmaniṣedhaḥ| lakṣmyāḥ kāmukaḥ| avyayaṃ kaṭaṃ kṛtvā| tosunkasunorapratiṣedhaḥ| purā sūryasyodetorādheyaḥ| purākrūrasya visṛpo virapśin| niṣṭhā devadattena kṛtam| odanaṃ bhuktavān| khalarthaḥ tvayā sukaram| ikṣvākūṇāṃ durāpe'rthe itiśeṣaṣaṣṭhī| siddhaya ityatra vānvayaḥ| īṣajjayaḥ sphuṭamanena deśānano'pīti surāriḥ| `śānam̐ścānaś śatṝṇāmupasaṃkhyānam' tṛnniti śatṛśānacāvityārabhya tṛno nakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ| tena śānanprabhṛtīnāmapi grahaṇam| somaṃ pavamānaḥ| pūṅyajoḥ śānan| naḍamāghrāṇaḥ| tācchīlyādau cānaś| adhīyan pārāyaṇam| iṅ‌dhāryoriti śatṛpratyayaḥ| tṛn| pātā sutamindro amnu somam| sa sarvasvaṃ dātā tṛṇamiva sureśaṃ vijayate iti subandhuḥ| `dviṣaḥśaturveti vaktavyam'| murasya muraṃ vā dviṣan| etacca pratyayagrahaṇe pratiṣedhārtham| pratyāhāragrahaṇe vidhyarthamiti viśeṣaḥ| akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ || 70 || yathāsaṃkhyavāraṇāya yogavibhāgaḥ| akasya bhaviṣyati| ina ādhamarṇye ca| cakārema bhaviṣyatītyanuvṛttiḥ| ṣaṣṭhī na syāt| edhānāhārako vrajati| vrajaṃ gāmī| ādhamarṇye śataṃ dāyī| bhaviṣyadityasya svaritatvam| pratijñāsvaritāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ| tena bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasyaivākasya grahaṇānneha varṣaśatasya pūrakaḥ| ṇvul‌tṛcāviti sāmānyato vihito'yaṃ natu bhaviṣyadadhikārasthaḥ| kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā || 71 || ṣaṣṭhī vā syāt| kartavyamidaṃ kṛṣṇasya kṛṣṇena vā| nacakṛtyānāṃ bhāvakarmaṇoreva vidhānātkartṛgrahaṇaṃ vyartham| karmaṇo'bhidhānāvaśyakatvena tatra ṣaṣṭhyāḥ prasaktyabhāvāditi vācyam| geyo māṇavakaḥ sāmnāmityatra tatsambhavāt| bhavyageyetyādinā kartari yadvidhānena karmaṇo'nabhidhānāt| naca ākraṣṭavyā grāmaṃ śākhetyatra doṣavāraṇārthamapi tat| kṛṣerdvikarmakatvātpradhānakarmaṇaḥ śākhāyāḥ kṛtyenābidhānāt| gauṇakarmaṇo grāmasyānabhidhānāditi vācyam| yogavibhāgenaiva tadvāraṇāt| kṛtyānāmubhayaprāptau netyanuvartate ataḥ kartaryapi na ṣaṣṭhī kintu tṛtīyaiva| netavyā vrajaṃ gāvaḥ kṛṣṇena| kartari vā| sarvaṃ nivṛttam| arthaḥ pūrvavat| tulyārthairatulopamābhyāṃ tṛtīyānyatarasyām || 72 || tulyārthayoge tṛtīyā vā syāccheṣe pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī| kṛṣṇena kṛṣṇasya vā tulyaḥ samo vā| atuleti kim| kṛṣṇasya tulopamā vā nāsti| atha kathaṃ tulāṃ yadārohati dantavāsasā, sphuṭopamaṃ bhūtisitena śaṃbhunetyādi| atrāhuḥ-tolanaṃ tulā atraiva nipātanādaṅ‌ṇilopau| upamitirupamā dhātvarthaṃ prati karaṇāttṛtīyā| tenopamīyena tamālanīlamityādivat| prakṛtasūtrasya tu śeṣaṣaṣṭhyapavādatvena tṛtīyāvidhāyakasya neha pravṛttiriti| anyetu `svabālabhārasya taduttamāṅgajaiḥ samaṃ camaryyeva tulābhilāṣiṇaḥ' ityādivatsahayoge tṛtīyā| sahārtho'tra gamyamāna iti paraṃ viśeṣa ityāhuḥ| tattvaṃ tu bhedānuyogipadānāṃ dharmisamarpakatayā bhedapratiyogitvamapi tādṛśayoreva tulopamāśabdayoḥ kṛṣṇasya tulopamā vā nāsti ityatra tulopamāśadbayostadvatparatvāṅgīkārāt| tulāṃ yadārohatītyādo tu sādṛśyamātraparatvānneyaṃ tṛtīyā| ata eva ivādiprayoge na tṛtīyāprasaktiḥ| tatra śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā apyaprasakteśca| veti vartamāne'pyanyatarasyāṃ grahaṇaṃ uttaratra cakārema svasyānukarṣaṇārtham| anyathā saṃnihitāyāstṛtīyāyā evānukarṣaprasaṅgāt| caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣyamadrabhadrakuśalasukhārthahitaiḥ || 73 || etairyoge caturthīṣaṣṭhyau sta āśiṣi gamyāyām| sukhaparyantānāṃ dvandvaṃ kṛtvā'rthaśabdena bahuvrīhiḥ| madrabhadrayoranyataro na paṭhanīya iti kecit| arthaśadbro'pi pṛthageva nimittam| vyākhyānāttu sarvaśabdānāmatrārthaparatvamityanye| āyuṣyaṃ cirajīvitaṃ vā caitrasya caitrāyā vā bhūyāt|ṣa evaṃ madraṃ bhadraṃ kuśalaṃ nirāmayaṃ sukhaṃ arthaḥ prayojanaṃ hitaṃ pathyamityādi| hitayoge caturthyā anāśiṣi sāvakāśatvādāśiṣyanena vikalpaḥ| āśiṣi kim| caitrasyāyuṣyamasti| tatvakathanametat| śrīḥ iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau dvitīyādhyāyasya tṛtīye pāde tṛtīyamāhnikam| pādaścāyaṃ samāptaḥ| <2.4> atha caturthaḥ pādaḥ| dvigurekavacanam || 1 || bāhulakātkartāri lyuṭ| sāmānye napuṃsakam| samāhāre dvigurekārthapratipādakaḥ syāt| taddhitārtheti sūtre samāhāraśabdo bhāvasādhana iti sthitam tathācaikatvaṃ nyāyasiddham| taduktaṃ vārkikakṛtā `navā samāhāraikatvā'diti tataśca karmasādhanatvabhramanirāsārthaṃ sūtram| sa napuṃsakamityasya pravṛttyarthaṃ ca| nacottarapadanimitte dvigau ekatvavidhānārthamastviti vācyam| tadarthasyottarapadārthe guṇabhāvātpratipadikatvasadbhāve'pi vibhaktyanutpatteḥ| taddhitārthe dvigāvapi pañcakapālaśabdaṃ saṃskṛtapratyayāntaṃ kṛtvaikaśeṣe kriyamāṇe dvigvarthasamudāyasya dvigvarthatvābhāvādbahiraṅgatvātprathamakalpike'ntaraṅge dvigau caritārthatvāccaikavadbhāvo vacanasattve'pi na pravartate sutarāṃ nyāyasiddhaḥ| yadā tu pa़ñcasukapāleṣu saṃskṛtā iti prathamameva bahutvacchinnā arthā vivakṣitāstadā samāhārarūpatvameva nāstīti na doṣaḥ| dvandvaśca prāṇitūryasenāṅgānām || 2 || aṅgaśadbasya pratyekamanvayaḥ| dvandvaghaṭakayāvatpadānāṃ uktatrayānyatamamātrāṅgavācitve ekavadbhāvaḥ| pāṇipādam| mārdaṅgikapāṇavikam| rathikāśvāroham| neha mārdaṅgikāśvārohāḥ| prāṇināmaṅgamavayavaḥ| tūryāṇāmupakārakam| senāyā apekṣābuddhiviśeṣaviṣayaḥ iti boddham| pāṇipādamityādau jātiraprāṇināmityeva siddhe vyatikaranirāsārthaṃ vacanam| rathavājipattikariṇīsamākulamityādau senāṅgavācipadānāṃ antyavarjaṃ dvandvaṃ kṛtvā antyena madhyamapadalopo vyākhyeyaḥ| pātitai rathanāgāśvairityādau kṛtadvandvānāmekaśeṣeṇāpi samādheyam| etena itthaṃ ratāśvebhaniṣādināṃ prage iti māgho'pi vyākhyātaḥ| yadyapi samāhāradvandve'pi cārthe dvandva ityanena ekavadbhāvaśca nyāyena siddhastathāpi niyamārthamidam| eteṣāṃ samāhāra eva dvandvo netaretarayoga iti| nava samāhāre eṣāmeva dvandva iti viparītaniyamo'stviti vācyam| tiṣyapunarvasvoriti sūtre bahuvacanagrahaṇāt tiṣyapunarvasvidamiti samāhāraikavacanavyāvṛttestadarthatvāt| anuvāde caraṇānām || 3 || caraṇaśabdaḥ kaṭhakalāpādiparaḥ| kaṭhādiśabdaśca śākhābhedeṣu mukhyo adhyetṛṣu gauṇaḥ| sphuṭaṃ cedaṃ śākhāntarādhikaraṇe| gotraṃca caraṇaiḥ sahetyeṣāṃ jātisaṃjñā| tatra jātiraprāṇināmityeva śākhābhedavācināmekavadbhāvaḥ siddhaḥ| puruṣabhedānāmekavadbhāvārthamārambhaḥ| udagātkaṭhakālāpam| pratyaṣṭhātkaṭhakauthumam| udagātkaumodapaippalādam| kaṭhakalāpeṣu uditeṣu pratiṣṭhiteṣu vā tatra gantavyamiti pūrvoktaṃ vismṛtyāsīnaṃ pratyuktau bhavatyanuvādaḥ| `stheṇoradyatanyāṃ ceti vaktavyam'| neha nandantu kaṭhakālāpā varddhantāṃ kaṭhakauthumāḥ| adyatanyāṃ kim| udyanti kaṭhakālāpāḥ| adhvaryukraturanapuṃsakam || 4 || adhyaryūd‌gātṛhotāro yajuḥsāmargvidaḥ kramāt| ityamaraḥ| atrādhvaryuśabdo yajurvedaparaḥ| tatrotpannasya viniyuktasya vā kratorvācakānāmaklībānāṃ dvandva ekavat| arkāśvamedham| sāhnātirātram| adhvaryupadaṃ kim| iṣuvajrau| udbhidbalabhidau| sāmaveda eṣāṃ vidhānam| kratuśabdasya somayāgeṣu rūḍhatvāddarśapaurṇamāsāvityādau neti vṛttiḥ| anapuṃsakaṃ kiṃ rājasūyavājapeye| ardharcādipāṭhātklībatvapakṣe pratyudāharaṇam| adhyayanato'viprakṛṣṭākhyānām || 5 || adhyayanena nimittena yeṣāmaviprakṛṣṭā saṃnihitā ākhyā teṣāṃ dvandva ekavat| padakakramakam| kramakavārtikam| padaṃ kramaṃ vādhīte iti kramādibhyo vun| vṛttiṃ saṃhitāmadhīte vārtikaḥ| ukthyāditvāṭhṭhak padādhyayanottaraṃ kramādhyayanaṃ iti paurvāparyaṃ sannidhiḥ antye tu kramādhyayanasya saṃhitādhyayanavyatirekaprayuktavyatirekapratiyogitvameva tatheti bodhyam| adhyayanataḥ kim| pitāputrau| aviprakṛṣṭeti kim| yājñikavaiyākaraṇau| jātiraprāṇinām || 6 || prāṇibhinnavṛttiryā jātiḥ tadvācināṃ dvandva ekavat| ārāśastri| jātiḥ kim| nandakapāñcajanyau ekavyaktikatvānna jātitvam| aprāṇīti kim| brāhmaṇakṣātriyaviṭ‌śūdrāḥ| nañivayuktanyāyena dravyavṛttijātereva grahaḥ| neha rūparasau| gamanākuñcane| pṛthivyaptejovāyūnāmityādau tu dravyaprādhānyaṃ vivakṣitam| badarāmalakānītyāderiṣṭatvāt| rañjitā nu vividhāstaruśailā ityādau madhyamapadalopaḥ| viśiṣṭaliṅgo nadīdeśo'grāmāḥ || 7 || agrāmā iti bahuvacanaṃ sautram| bhinnaliṅgānāṃ nadīvācināṃ deśavācināṃ ca grāmabhinnānāṃ dvandva ekavat| udhdyaścerāvatī ca udhdyerāvati| kuravaśca surukṣetraṃ ca kurukurukṣetram| bhinnaliṅgaḥ kim| gaṅgāyamune| madrakekayāḥ| nadīdeśa iti kim| kukkuṭamayūryau `agrāmā ityatra nagarāṇāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ' abhakṣyo grāmakukkuṭa ityādau nagarasyāpi grāmaśabdena grahaṇādārambhaḥ| nagarāṇāṃ nāyaṃ paryudāsa ityarthaḥ| mathurāpāṭaliputram| `ubhayataśca grāmāṇāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ'| grāmanagarayordvandve grāmanimittaḥ pratiṣedha eva pravartate ityarthaḥ| śauryaṃ nagaram| ketavatā grāmaḥ śauryaketavate| agrāmāḥ kim| jāmbavaṃ nagaram| śālūkinī grāmaḥ| jāmbavaśālūkinyau| deśa iha janapadaḥ tena parvātanāṃ na kailāsagandhamādane| kṣudrajantavaḥ || 8 || eṣāṃ dvandva ekavat| yūkālikṣam| kṣudrajanturanasthi syādathavā kṣudra eva saḥ| śataṃ vā prasṛtau yeṣāṃ kecidānakulādapi|| paścādupanyasta eva pakṣovyāpitvādgrāhya iti granthakṛtaḥ| yeṣāṃcavirodhaḥ śāśvatikaḥ || 9 || virodho vairam| natu sahānavasthānādi| pratiyogyabhāvayorityādāvatiprasaṅgāt| śāśvatikaḥ sārvādikaḥ| nipātanādikādeśaḥ tatvaṃ cātra ekārthabiniveśaprayuktatvābhāvaḥ| govyāghram| gajasiṃham| śāśvatikaḥ kim| devāsurairamṛtamambunidhirmamanthe| etena teṣaāṃ na nityo virodho mathanapravṛttikāle tadabhāvādīti nirastam| kālānavacchinnatvena vairavivakṣāyāṃ govyāgramityādāvavyāpteḥ| viṣayāntarasaṃcārasuṣuptyādau tadvicchedasyāvaśyakatvāt| iha paśuśakunidvandvaikavabhdāvavikalpasyāvakāśo mahājorabhraṃ mahājorabhrāḥ| haṃsacakravākam| haṃsacakravākāḥ| yeṣāṃcetyasya śramaṇabrāhmaṇam| mārjāramūṣakam| aśvamahiṣam| kākolūkamityatra paratvādvibhāṣā prāptā cakārasya nirdhāraṇārthatayā tāṃ bādhitvā ekavabhdāva eva| tena paśuśakunidvandve virodhināṃ pūrvavipratiṣedha iti nārabhyam| śūdrāṇāmaniravasitānām|| 10 || abahiḥ kṛtānāṃ śudrāṇāṃ dvandva ekavat| takṣāyaskāram| rajakatantuvāyam| niravasānaṃ bahiḥkāraḥ| taccāryāvartāt sa ca prāgādarśātpratyak‌kālikavacanāt| dakṣiṇena himavantaṃ uttareṇa pāriyātramiti bhāṣyam| ādarśādayaḥ parvataviśeṣā iti kaiyaṭaḥ| evaṃ tu kiṣkikagāndhikaṃ śakayavanam| śauryakrauñcīmati na sidhyet| grāmaghoṣanagarādibhyo bahirbhāvavivakṣāyāṃ caṇḍālamṛtapā ityādāvyāptiḥ| yajñātkarmaṇastaduktau takṣāyaskāramitina syāt| tasmātpātrādabahiḥ kṛtānāmityevārthaḥ| gavāśvaprabhṛtīni ca || 11 || etāni kṛtaikavadbhāvāni nipātyante| gavāśvam| gavāvikam| gavaiḍakam| ajāvikam| ajaiḍakam | eṣāṃ paśudvandvavikalpaḥ prāptaḥ| kubjavāmanam| kubjakairātam pūtrapautram| śvacaṇḍālam| strīkumāram| dāsīmāṇavakam| uṣṭrakharam| śāṭīpracchadam| prāṇijātyarthānāṃ vidhyarthaḥ| aprāṇijātīnāmabahuprakṛtyarthaḥ| pāṭhaḥ| uṣṭraśaśam| mūtraśakṛta| mūtrapurīṣam| yakṛnmedaḥ| māṃsaśoṇitam| darbhapūtīkam| arjunapuruṣam| tṛṇolapam| dāsīdāsam| atra pumān‌striyetyekaśeṣābhāvaḥ| kuṭīkuṭam| bhāgavatībhāgavatam| atravārtikam| `gavāśvaprabhṛtiṣu yathoccāritaṃ dvandvavṛttaṃ, yadrūpa viśiṣṭamuccāritaṃ tatraivaikavadbhāva ityarthaḥ| tenāvaṅādeśābhāvapakṣe na| `apaśavo vā anye go aśvebhyaḥ paśavo goaśvāḥ||' vibhāṣāvṛkṣamṛgatṛṇadhānyavyañjanapaśuśakunyaśvavaḍavapūrvāparādharottarāṇām|| 12 || śakunyantānāṃ dvandvaḥ anyatkaṇṭhoktaṃ dvandvatrayaṃ caiṃkavadvā| vṛkṣādau viśeṣagrahaṇam| ekapadasya dvandvābhāvātpadadvayaikaśeṣāt paryāyadvayasyāpi virūpāṇāmapi samānārthānāmityekaśeṣāt| sāmānyaviśeṣayośca dvandvaniṣedhasya vācanikatvāt| prācyabharateṣviti nirdeśādanityatve'pi prakṛte niṣedhasyaiva pravṛtteḥ| plakṣanyagrodham plakṣanyagrodhāḥ| rurupṛṣatam| rurupṛṣatāḥ| kuśakāśam| kuśakāśāḥ| vrīhiyavam| vrīhiyavāḥ| dadhidhṛtaṃ dadhidhṛte| gomahiṣam| gomahiṣāḥ| tittirikapiñjalam| tittirikapiñjalāḥ| aśvavaḍavam| aśvavaḍavau| pūrvāparam| pūrvāpare| adharottaram adharottare| atravārtikam-`bahuprakṛtiḥ phalesanāvanaspatimṛgaśakunikṣudrajantudhānyatṛṇānām'|| samasthamānapadānāṃ bahuvacanāntatve satyevaiṣāṃ dvandvaḥ ekavadbhavati nānyathetyarthaḥ| anena prakaraṇavihata evaika vadbhāvo niyataviṣayatvena vyavasthāpyate natvetatsūtravihita eva| plakṣanyagrodhāvityatra jātiraprāṇināmiti nityaikavadbhāvaprasaṅgāt| vadarāmlakam| badarāmalakānīti bhāṣyam| tatra vadarāmalakānīti prāpte jātiraprāṇināmiti nitya ekavadbhāva iti vyācaṣṭa kaiyaṭaḥ| kecittu nitya ekavadbhāve prāpte vikalpo'nena kriyate ityāhuḥ| anye tu asya bahuprakṛtike vikalpavidhiparatvenyatra nityaikavadbhāvāpattyā badarāmalake tiṣṭhata iti bhāṣyavirodhānnedaṃ yuktamityāhuḥ| atrāyaṃ vākyārthaḥ| phalādīnāṃ dvandvo'nena lakṣaṇāntareṇa vā ekavadbhavan bahuprakṛtireva| tena plakṣanyagrodhau, vrīhiyavau, kuśakāśau ityādau prakṛtavikalpo jātiraprāṇināmiti niṣedhaśca na| etatsūtropāttānāṃ tu viṣayavibhāgaḥ pradarśyate| aprāṇināṃ nityaṃ prāpte vikalpo vidhīyate sacaikajātivyāpyānāṃ jātīnāṃ-padārthavibhājakopādhisākṣāvdyāpyajativyāpyānāmiti yāvat| vijātīyānāṃ tu yathāprāptaṃ| vrīhikuśaplakṣamityatra jātiraprāṇināmiti nityaḥ plakṣaśabdasparśam| plakṣaśabdasparśāḥṣa ityatra cārthe dvandva ityubhayam| adravyavṛttijātitayā śabdatvāderjātiraprāṇināmityasyāpravṛtteḥ| hastyaśvādiṣu senāṅgatvānnityaṃ prāpto vikalpaḥ| mṛgaśakunyaṃśe tu yo vibhāṣā prāpta ekavacano dvandvaḥ sa mṛgaviśeṣāṇāṃ tairave saha nānyairiti| itaraiḥ saha tvitaretarayoga eveti phalito'rthaḥ| tena pūrvāparam, adharottaramiti vyākhyātam| aśvavaḍavagrahaṇaṃ paśudvandvatvādeva siddheḥ pratipadavidhānārtham| tenaikavadbhāvapakṣe pūrvavadaśvavaḍavāvityetadbādhitvā sanapuṃsakamityasya pravṛttiḥ| tacchabdenaikavadbhāvaviśiṣṭaparāmarśāt| pūrvavaditi tu ekavadbhāvābhāvapakṣe pravartate iti|| vipratiṣiddhaṃ cānadhikaraṇa vāci || 13 || niyamārthamidam| ekavadbhāvaviśiṣṭo yo dvandvo vikalpena prāptaḥsa viruddhavacanānāṃ yadi bhavati tadā adravyavācināmeveti| tena viruddhadravyārthānāmitaretarayoga eva| śītoṣṇe udake staḥ| atra viruddhatvaṃ parasparātyantābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ paramparayā jalaviruddhatvaṃ parasparātyantābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ paramparayā jalasyoṣṇatvaṃ taddvārako gumadvayaviśiṣṭajalayorvirodhaḥ| vipratiṣiddhaṃ kim| nandakapāñcajanyam| pākṣikaḥ samāhāradvandvaḥ| kāmakrodhāviti pratyudāhṛtaṃ vṛttau| tatrāhuḥ-śotoṣṇaṃ sukhaduḥkhamityādivatpākṣikaikavadbhāvo durvāraḥ| prakṛtasūtrasya niyamārthatvāt| nacādravyavācināṃ yadi bhavati tadā vipratiṣiddhānāmeveti tadabhiprāyaḥ| śītoṣṇe udake ityasyānadhikaraṇavācītyetat-pratyudāharaṇatayā tatraiva likhitatvāt, uktarītyā tatrāpi pākṣikaikacadbhāvāpatteḥ| na dadhīpaya ādīni || 14 || etāni naikavatsayuḥ| dadhipayasī, madhusarpiṣīṣa sapirmadhunī| anyathā vyañjanatvādvikalpaḥ syāt| brahmaprajāpatī| śivavaiśravaṇau| skandaviśākhau| skandaścaiva viśākhaśca dvau sutau saṃbabhūvatuḥ|| iti bhāratam| parivrāṭ‌kauśikau| pravargyopasadau| śuklavṛkṣe| idhmārbihiṣī| nipātanādātvam| dīkṣātapasī| śraddhāmedhe| medhātapasī adhyayanatapasī ulūkhalamusale| udūkhalamusale| ādyavasāne| śraddhāmedhe| ṛk‌sāme| vāṅbhanase| nacātra dadhipayasītyādau vyaṃñjanatvaprayuktavikalpaniṣedhe'pi jātilakṣaṇo nitya ekavadbāvo'stīti śaṅkanīyam| lakṣaṇaviśeṣaprāpteḥ pratiyogitvenānupādānāniṣedhaḥ| tathāca tenetaretarayoge prakṛtasūtreṇa ca samāhāre dvandvaniṣedhāt eṣāṃ dvandva eva na syāditi vācyam| niyamavākyānāṃ vidhirūpeṇa pravṛttiriti pakṣe jātiraprāṇināmityādibhirvihitasyaikadbhāvasyānena niṣedhāt|| adhikaraṇaitāvattve ca || 15 || dravyasaṃkhyāpratītau naitatsyāt| daśa dantoṣṭhāḥ| ayaṃca prāṇyaṅgānāṃ samāhāra eva dvandva iti niṣedho na samāhāradvandvasya| vaiyarthyāt pradhānabhūte samāhāre eva daśatvasaṃkhyānvayāpatteḥ| daśapañcapūlyetivat| tathāca vartipadārthānāṃ saṃkhyāviśeṣabodhanatātparye itaretarayogasya nyāyata eva prāpteḥ| tena `pañcasvihāsyāṃghrikareṣvabhiṣyābhikṣādhunā mādhukarī sadṛkṣe'tyādiśiddham| nacaivaṃ daśabrāhmaṇakṣatriyā ityāderanupapattiḥ| uktanyāyenaiva tadvāraṇāt| tattvaṃ tu noktanyāyena tadvāraṇaṃ suśakam| uttarasūtravakṣyamāṇarītyā'vayaveṣveva saṃkhyānvayasaṃbhavāt| dṛṣṭānte tu samāhāriṇāṃ bhinnasaṃkhyāvaruddhatvena vaiṣamyāt|| vibhāṣā samīpe || 16 || śabdopāttasaṃkhyāsāmīpyāvacchinnasaṃkhyayā| dravyaviśeṣaṇe samāhāra evetyevarūpo niyamo vā syāt| upadaśam‌ pāṇipādam| upadaśāḥ pāṇipādāḥ| navaikādaśa vetyarthaḥ| tatropadaśamiti sāmīpyaprādhānye'vyayībhāvaḥ| samīpaprādhānye bahuvrīhirityuktam ekavadbhāvapakṣe'vyayībhāvasya anyadā bahuvrīheḥ prayogaḥ| samānasaṃkhyāvagatyanurodhāt|yadyapyavyayībhāvo niḥsaṃkhyastathāpyabhedaikatvasaṃkhyābhiprāyamiti saṃpradāyaḥ| sāmīpyatadvatorabhedopacārātsāmānādhikaraṇyam| naca saṃkhyāyāḥ samāhāra evānvayopapattau dvandvavartipadārthānāṃ tatparicchedyatvānupapātteḥ| samāhārasamāhāriṇorapyabhedopacārāt| ekavattvābhāvapakṣe bahuvrīhiḥ| samānavacanāntatvāt| avyībhāve bahuvacanānupapatteḥ| saṃbhave'pyambhāvāpatteśca| ekavadbhāvapakṣe'pi bahuvrīheranuprayoge tu ṣaṣṭhyāmupadaśasya pāṇipādasyeti syāt| iṣyate tu upadaśaṃ pāṇipādasyetyevamākaraḥ| sa napuṃsakam || 17 || samāhāre dvigurdvandvaśca napuṃsakaṃ syāt| paravalliṅgāpavādaḥ| pañcagavam| dantoṣṭham| prakaraṇādanuvādyalābhe'pi sagrahaṇametatprakaraṇabahirbhūtasyāpi samāhāradvandvasya parigrahārtham| ataeva yuvoranākāvityādau samāhāradvandve napuṃsakatā syāditi vadanti| etena janmādyasya yata iti sūtre janmādīti sautranapuṃsakatvānurodhena janmasthitibhaṅgamiti śāṅkarabhāṣyaṃ vyākhyātam| akārāntottarapado dviguḥ striyāmiṣṭaḥ| pañcapūlī| ataityadhikāre dvigoriti ṅīp‌vidhānaṃ ceha liṅgam| `vābantaḥ' ābantodviguḥ striyāṃ vā| pa़ñcakhaṭvam| pañcakaṭvī| strītvapakṣe upasarjanahasva iti pūrvaṃ vyākhyātam| `ano nalopaśca, vā ca dviguḥ striyām'| pañcatakṣam| pañcatakṣī| nacāntarvartivibhaktyā padatvānnalopasiddhiriti vācyam| uttarapadatve cāpadādividhāviti pratyayalakṣaṇaniṣedhāt| `pātrādyantastha pratiṣedhaḥ'| pañcapātram| tribhuvanam| caturyugam| dvimāsam| pātrādirākṛtigaṇaḥ| avyayībhāvaśca || 18 || napuṃsakaṃ syāt| adhistri unmattagaṅgam| pūrvapadārthaprādhānye liṅgābhāve, anyapadārthaprādhānye viśeṣyaliṅge prāpte'yamārambhaḥ| cakārātpuṇyāham| sudināham| `puṇyasudinābhyāmahnaḥklībatvam'| karmadhāraye rājāhaḥsakhibhyaitiṭac| rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsītyapavādaḥ| sudinaśabdaḥ praśastārthaḥ| `sudināsu sabhāsu kāryametatpravicinvīta viśeṣataḥ svayaṃve'tidarśanāt| `pathaḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ'| trayāṇāṃ panthāḥ tripatham| virūpaḥ panthāḥ vipatham| samāsāntāvyabhicārisaṃkhyādipathaśabdasāhacaryādavyayāderapi kṛtasamāsāntasyaivedam| neha| atipanthāḥ supanthāśceti| napūjanāditi samāsāntaniṣedhaḥ| svatībhyāmeveti parigaṇanātsatpathaścārcite'dhyavanīti siddham| vyadhvo duradhvo vipathaḥ kadadhvā kāpathaḥ samāḥ| ityatra vipathaṃ kāpathamityevapāṭha iti kṣīrasvāmyādayaḥ| kecittu vāraḥ pathaśca mārgaśceti trikāṇḍaśeṣātpathegatāvityasmādaci pathate vyāpnotīti pathaśabdo'kārāntaḥ| nacaivaṃ vipatha ityādi rūpasiddhāvapi kāpatha ityasyānupapattiḥ| kāśabdasya pathiśabde eva vidhānāditi vācyam| īṣadarthe kādeśe kutsāyāmarthataḥ paryavasānādityāhuḥ| anye tvevaṃ sati pathovibhāṣeti sūtravaiyarthyaṃ syāt| apathamityasya pathaśabdādevāparya napuṃsakamityanenāpanthā ityasya ca pathiśabdanaiva siddherityāhuḥ| apare tu apathaṃ napuṃsakamiti kṛtasamāsāntanirdeśasāmarthyātpathiśabde nañastatpuruṣāditi samāsāntaniṣedhasya asakhetyādau caritārthasya nityaṃ bādhaḥ prāptaḥ ato'panthā ityasya
