anyonyasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārānāśrayāviti bodhāt| saṃyogamādāya karmatvaṃ gamanādikriyāmādāya ca kartṛtvamiti na kiyaikyamiti| atrāhuḥ-ajā grāmaṃ nayatītyatrājāyāḥ kartṛtvavivakṣāyāmapi grāmarūpeṇa karmaṇā sakarmakatvāttadvāraṇāyoktavārtikamiti| tathāhyajā grāmaṃ nayati ityatra grāmasaṃyogānukūlājāniṣṭhavyāpārānukūlavyāpāravāniti bodhāt| grāmasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārarūpāṃ kriyāmādāyājāyāḥ karmatvaṃ tadāśrayatvādeva coktasthale kartṛtvamiti| atra bhāṣyakṛtaḥ-naitadvārtikamārabhyam| tapastapaḥ karmakasyaivetyatra tapa iti yogavibhāgena tapereva sakarmakasya kartā karmavadbhavatīti niyamavyākhyānāt| syādetat upavāsādirūpasya tapasaḥ sartṛtve tapeḥ duḥkhārthatvam| tapastāpasaṃ tapati duḥkhayatīti pratīteḥ| tāpasasya tu kartṛtve jñānaṃ tathā| tapyate tapastāpasaḥ| tapo jānātīti bodhāt| tathāca karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriyatvaṃ nāsti karturiti karmavadbhāvo na prāpta iti vidhdyarthametaditi vṛttikāraḥ| tatkathaṃ niyamārthatvamiti| atra kaiyaṭaḥ-śarīrasaṃtāpalakṣaṇā kriyā'vasthādvaye'pi tulyā| śarīrasaṃtāpalakṣaṇamevārjanaṃ tāpasasya yato vyāpāra iti| tathā cānyasya sakarmakadhātoḥ kartā na karmavat| nacaivaṃ taperakarmakasyāpi karmavadbhāvāpattiḥ, tapaḥ karmakasyaiveti niyamāntareṇa tad‌vyāvṛtteriti| `duhipacyorbahulaṃ sakarmakayoriti vācyam'| dugdhe gauḥ payaḥ| na duheti vakṣyamāṇena niṣedhaḥ| udumbaraḥ pacyate phalam| gaurdugdheti paya iti bodhaḥ| duhadviṃkarmakatvātkarmasthakriyayā tulyakriyatve'pi sakarmakatvādaprāptau pacyata ityatra vṛkṣya kartṛtvavivakṣāyāmatyantamaprāptāvārambhaḥ| kecittu paciratra dvikarmakaḥ vṛkṣasya pākamantareṇa phalapākāsaṃbhavāt| vṛkṣo'kathikarma| tasyaiva yadā kartṛtvavivakṣā tadāyaṃ karmavadbhāvaḥ| odanaṃ pacatītyādau tvanabhidhānānnetyāhuḥ| tathāca phalapākānukūlodumbaraniṣṭhapākānukūlavyāpāravāniti udumbaraḥ phalaṃ pacatītyatra dvikarmakadaśāyāṃ bodhaḥ| udumbarapākalakṣaṇā kriyā karmāvasthāyāṃ| saiva kartṛdaśāyāmudumbaraniṣṭhā phalapākānukūlavyāpāravānudumbara iti bodhāt| tasya ca pākarūpatvāt| `sṛjīyajyoḥ śyaṃstu'| anayoḥ sakarmakayoḥ kartā bahulaṃ karmavat yagapavādaśca śyanvācya ityarthaḥ| `sṛjeḥ śraddhopapanne kartaryeveti vācyam'| sṛjyate srajaṃ bhaktaḥ| devādyarthaṃ śraddhayā mālāṃ saṃpādayatītyarthaḥ| śraddhāyukteti kim| `srajaṃ sṛjantyā tadaśādhi sādhu'| upabhogārthamevātra srajo nirmāṇam| śyanā ca yageva bādhyate| natu ciṇ| ciṇātmanepadārtha iti bhāṣyokteḥ| asarji mālām| yujyate brahmacārī yogam| yogo brahmacāriṇaṃ yunakti ityasya saṃbadhnātītyarthaḥ| tato brahmacāriṇaḥ kartṛtvavivakṣāyāmetat| `karaṇena tulyakriyaḥ kartā bahulaṃ karmavaditi vaktavyam'| parivārayante kaṇṭakā vṛkṣam kaṇṭakaiḥ parivārayati vṛkṣa ityatra upaghātakadravyasaṃyogapratibandho vāraṇam| kaṇṭakavyāpāraḥ saṃmantātsaṃyogaḥ| kaṇṭakānāṃ kartṛtve tu saṃyoga eva dhātvarthaḥ| saṃmantādavacchinnasvasaṃyogavantaṃ kurvantītyarthaḥ| bahulagrahaṇātsādhvasiḥ cchinattītyādau na doṣaḥ| `sravatyādīnāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ'| sravati kuṇḍikāṃ udakam| sravanti valmīkānyudakam| niṣkrāmadudakaṃ niṣkrāmayatyarthekriyāsāmyātprāptiḥ| bhāṣyakṛtastu sravanti valmīkānyudakamityatra visṛjantītyarthāvagamāt| kṛpaṇo sau nakiṃcitsravatīti loke ca visargapadasya dānārthatvadarśanāt| bhinnakriyatvādevātra na karmavadbhāva ityāhuḥ| `bhūṣākarmakirādisanāṃ cānyatrātmanepadāt| eṣāṃ yak‌ciṇau ciṇvadiṭ‌ca na bhavati kintvātmanepadamātra mityarthaḥ| bhūṣāphalaṃ śobhākhyaṃ karmaṇi dṛśyate iti karmasthakriyatvam| aṇyantārthaṃ bhūṣāgrahaṇam| alaṅkurute svayameva kanyā| alamakṛta| ṇyantatve tu vakṣyamāṇavārtikenaiva tanniṣedhasiddheḥ| avakirate hastī svayameva| avākīrṣṭa| hastinaṃ kaścitpāṃśvādinā'vakirati tatra saukaryavivakṣāyāṃ hastinaḥ kartṛtvam| cikīrṣate kaṭaḥ svayamave| acikīrṣiṣṭa| nanu pratyayārthatvātsannante icchāyāmeva prādhānyam| sāca kartṛsthaiveti nātra karmavadbhāvaprāptiḥ| atrāhuḥ-karotikriyāmapekṣyeha karmasthakriyatvam ārthaṃ ca karoteḥ prādhānyaṃ tadarthatvādicchāyā iti| kirādistudādyantargaṇaḥ| girate| agīrṣṭa| ādriyate ādṛta| ādaraviṣayo bhavatītyarthaḥ| tapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva || 88 || tapaḥ karmakasyaiva tapeḥ kartā karmavatsyāt kriyābhedādapūrvavidhirayamiti vṛttiḥ| niyamārthamiti bhāṣyam| tacca pūrvatra vyākhyātam| tapyate tapastāpasaḥ| kartuḥ karmavadbhāve tasyāpyabhidhānādubhayatrāpi prathamāntatvam| syādetat| tapa ityauṇādikamasunnantaṃ bhāvārtham| tāpasena tapastapyate iti karmaṇi lakāre prakṛtyarthakriyāyā eva karmapratyayārthatvaṃ dṛśyate| kriyākarmaṇośca sādhyasādhanabhāvādbhedena bhāvyam| iha tu bhedābhāvātprakṛtipratyayārthatvānupapattiḥ| rkica tapaḥ karma kasyaiveti vacanātprakṛtyarthasyaiva karmatvamāśritaṃ viruddhamiti| atra bhāṣyam-`sāmānyatape ravayavatapaḥ karmeti'| asyārthaḥ jñānarūpatapoviśeṣaḥ karmeti| avayavapadasya viśeṣaparatayā vyākhyānāt| tapaḥ karmaketi kim| uttapati suvarṇaṃ suvarṇakāraḥ|| naduhasnunamāṃ cakciṇau || 89 || eṣāṃ karmakartari yakciṇau nastaḥ| karmavadbhāvātideśātprasaktiḥ| `svayaṃ pradugdhe'sya guṇairupasnutā'iti bhāraviḥ| `svayaṃ praṇamate'lpe'pi'iti māghaḥ| duherayaṃyako'pi niṣedhaḥ| ciṇastu vacanāntareṇaṃ vikalpaḥ| dugdhe gauḥ svayameva| adugdha gauḥ svayameva| lugvā duheti ksasya luk ciṇ‌pakṣe adohi| prasnute gauḥ svayameva| prāsnoṣṭa prāsnāviṣṭa| nanvayaṃ ciṇa iva ciṇvadiṭo'pi niṣedhaḥ| ciṇvadītyatra tṛtīyāntādvatervijñānāt| ciṇ‌niṣedhasyāpi ciṇ‌kāryatvāditicet| maivam| saptamyantādeva tatra vatervyākhyānāt| ciṇipare yatkāryaṃ tasyaivātideśāt| ciṇ‌niṣedhena tadatideśasya niṣedhdumaśakyatvāt| yattu ciṇniṣedhasya ciṇi pare vihitatvābhāvāttasmin kartavye nāstyatideśa iti| tatrāhuḥ atideśo na virudhyate iti vaktavye niṣedho nātidiśyata iti ukteranaucityamiti| vastutastu tasmin| ciṇ‌niṣedhe kartavye vidheye atideśo nāstītyatra pratiyogitāvacchedakasaṃbandhaḥ pratiyogitvameva vivakṣitaṃ tathāca ciṇ‌ niṣedhaḥ pratiyogitayā ciṇvadbhāve na viṣayīkaroti ciṇvadbhāvapratiyogiko na bhavatīti yāvat| `yak‌ciṇoḥ pratiṣedhe hetumaṇṇiśribrūñāmupasakhyānam'| bhāradvājīyāstu `ṇiśranthigranthibrūñātmanepadākarmakāṇāṃ miti paṭhanti| kārayate| acīkarata| ucchrayate daṇḍaḥ| udaśiśriyata| vacanasya śabdaprakāśanaphalatvātkarmasthatvam| śrathnāti granthaṃ devadattaḥ| śrathnīte granthaḥ svayameva| aśranthiṣṭa granthaḥ| grathnāti ślokaṃ devadattaḥ| grathnīte ślokaḥ svayameva| agranthiṣṭa ślokaḥ| caurādikāvapyatra śranthignanthī gṛhyete| naca ṇigrahaṇādeva gatārthatvam| ādhṛṣīyatvāṇṇijabhāvapakṣe sārthakyāt| granthate| śranthate| luṅi prāgvat| brūte kathā svayameva| avocata kathā svayameva| ye dhātava ātmanepadavidhāvakarmakā nirdiṣṭāsteṣāmantarbhāvitaṇyarthatāyāṃ sakarmakadaśāyāṃ karmavadbhāvātprāptau yak‌ciṇau niṣidhyete| vikurvate saindhavāḥ| valgantītyarthaḥ| tān yadānyo valgayati tadā teṣāṃ karmatvam| punaḥ saukaryātiśayavivakṣāyāṃ vikurvate saindhavāḥ svayameva| vyakṛṣata| utpucchayate gauḥ| antarbhāvitaṇyarthatvātkarmavadbhāvātpratiyogiprasaktiḥ| tathāhi-pucchamudasyati utpucchayate gauḥ| antarbhāvitaṇyarthatvātkarmavadbhāvātpratiyogiprasaktiḥ| tathāhi-pucchamudasyati utpucchayate gauḥ ṇyarthāntarbhāve utpucchayate gām| punaḥ kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ yathoktaṃ rūpam| udapupucchata| yak‌ciṇoḥ pratiṣedhācchapacaṅau| kuṣirajoḥ prācāṃ śyan parasmaipadaṃ ca || 90 || kuṣa niṣkarṣe| rañja rāge| anayoḥ karmakartari na yak kintu śyan parasmaipadaṃ ca syāt| yagātmanepadayoryathākramamapavādau| kuṣyati kuṣyate vā pādaḥ| rajyati rajyate vā vastram| nityatumarthaṃ svarārthaṃca śyano vidhānam| tena kuṣyantī jaṅgheti śap‌śyanornityamiti num| ñnityādirityādyudāttatvam| yaki tu lasārva dhātukānudāttve yaka udāttatvaśravaṇaṃ syāt| idaṃca yag‌viṣaya eva pravartateḥ niṣedhasya prasaktipūrvakatvāt| tena liṅāśīrliṅoḥ syādīnāṃ viṣaye nāsya pravṛtiḥ| dhātoḥ || 91 || adhikāro'yam| tṛtīyādhyāyaparyantam| nacaivaṃ lādeśeṣu doṣaḥ syāt| tathāhi tatra dhātorityupasthāne tasmādityuttarasyeti paribhāṣayā dhātoravyavahitaparasya lasya tibādayo bhavantītyarthaḥ syāt| tathāca vikaraṇavyavadhāne tibādīnāmasiddhiḥ| syādīnāṃ lāvasthāyāmeva pravṛtteḥ| sārvadhātuka iti viṣayasaptamīpakṣe śabādīnāmapi tathātvāt| naca paratvādvikaraṇebhyaḥ pūrvameva lādeśapravṛttiḥ| kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena vikaraṇānāṃ nityatvāt| nacādeśānāṃ niravakāśatvam| luk‌śluvikaraṇeṣu vikaraṇalopena liṅ‌liṭośca vikaraṇānutpattyā tatra sāvakāśatvāt| evaṃ dhātoḥ parasya tasya etvavidhāne ādeḥ parasyeti takāramātrasya ekārādeśāpattau sarvādeśārthaṃ tasya śitvaṃ kartavyamiti gauravam| prāglādeśebhya iti pakṣe tūktaparibhāṣānupasthāne vidhānasāmarthyādvināpi śittvaṃ tatsiddhiḥ| nacālontyaparibhāṣayā antyādeśatvāpattiḥ| ekārasya ekāravidhāne prayojanābhāvāt| evaṃ loṭo laṅ‌vat, eruḥ, serhyapiccanityaṃṅitaḥ, itaśca, tasthasthamipāṃ tāṃ taṃ tāmaḥ, liṅaḥ sīyuṭ, yāsuṭ parasmaipadeṣvityāvapi bodhyam| dhātoḥ paratvena tadviśeṣaṇāpattyā vikaraṇavyavadhāne tadapravṛtteḥ| ucyate tathācārddhadhātukasaṃjñāyāṃ dhātugrahaṇasyāvaśyakatvāt| anyathā vṛkṣatvamityādāvativyāpteḥ| parasmaipadānāmiti madhyamapuruṣathakārasthāne akārādeśe śittvasya kartavyatvāpatteśaaca| siddhānte tu dhātoḥ parasya thasyeti vyākhyāne thakāramātrasya akārādeśeato guṇa iti pararūpe ca siddhamiṣṭam| naca tatrāpyalontyaparibhāṣayā akārasyākārādeśavidhānavaiyarthyātsāmarthyādeva sarvādeśatvasiddhiḥ| ṇalādīnāṃ yathāsaṃkhyasaṃpādanena caritārthatvāt| naca paratvādiṭ‌prasaṅgaḥ| kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena akārādeśasya nityatvāt| tatra kṛte valāditvābhāveneṭo'prāpteḥ| naca śabdāntaraprāptyā akārādeśasyāpyanityatvam| sahi iṭi kṛte ikārasya prāpnoti akṛte tu ṇakārasyeti vācyam| tasya prāyikatvāt nacoktadoṣāṇāmāpattiḥ| śabādīnāṃ sārvadhātuke parata eva vidhānāt| syādisthale'pi dhāto rvihitasya lasyeti vihita viśeṣaṇāśrayaṇāt| nanu vindatītyādāvapi ṇalādīnāmāpattiḥ dhātorvihitasya vetteranantarasyeti vyākhyānāt| nacājakṣiṣyannajapāriṣyannityādau adabhyastājjhorjus‌prasaṅgaḥ| dhātorvirhitasyābhyastādanantarasyeti vyākhyānāt| āta ityatra tu dhātorvihitasyākārādantarasyeti vyākhyeyam| ākārāntādvihitasyeti vyākhyāne'pibannityādāvatiprasaṅgāt| tasmādādātṛtīyādhyāyāddhātvadhikāra iti sthitam| prayojanāni| prātipadikāttavyādyanutpattiḥ| aṅgasaṃjñā kṛdupapadasaṃjñāceti| tatra nādyaḥ| tayoreveti bhāvakarmaṇoḥ kṛtyavidhānāt| kṛtāñṭakartari tiṅāṃ ca bhāvakarmakartṛṣu vidhānāt| kartrādirūpasādhanābhāvādeva prātipadikebhyasvadanutpatteḥ| nacaivaṃkarmādau vidhīyamānā dvitīyādayo'pi prātipadikānna syu riti vācyam| vacanasāmarthyācchabdāntaravācyakriyāpekṣasādhana eva tatpravṛtteḥ| prakṛte tu prakṛtī vācyāntaraṅgakriyāpekṣasādhanasambhave śabdāntaravācyabahiraṅgakriyāsādhanānāśrayaṇāt| na dvitīyaḥ yaṅ‌vidhereva dhātugrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| tena prāsthitetyādau sopasargasya gamanārthatve'pi dhātorevāṅgasaṃjñā natudhātūpamargasamudāyasya| tenāḍādivyavasthā| anyathā syādiṣu tadananuvṛttau kariṣyatītyādāvaṅgasaṃjñā na syāt| naca cūrṇacurādibhyo ṇic dhātoścetidhātumātrāṇṇijāpattiḥ| hetumaticetyasya tadabhāvajñāpakatvāt| anyathākarotyarthe karaṇe vihitasya hetumatyapi karaṇe siddhatvāt| nanu curādigrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam| prātipadikāddhātvarthe ityādyarthatayānyathāsiddheḥ| kaṇḍ‌vādibhya ityatrāpi na dhātumātrādyagāpattiḥ| kaṇḍ‌vādigrahaṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ| yakaḥ kitvena teṣāṃ dhātutvasiddheḥ pūrvamuktatvāt| dhātorityataeva siddhiprasaṅgāt| kaṇḍ‌vādibhyo dhātubhya iti sāmānādhikaṇyenānvayasambhave samuccayānaucityācca| na tṛtīyaḥ| kṛdupapadasaṃjñayorevādhikāratvenopapatteḥ| tatra svaritatbamātrakalpane lādhavāt| nāpyārdhadhātukasaṃjñārthoṃyaṃ dhātvadhikāraḥ| vastuto dhātorvihitasyeti vyākhyāne jugupsate lūbhyāmityādāvativyāpte riti vācyam| yaṅ‌vidheranuvṛttasyaiva dhātorvihitasyeti vihitaviśeṣaṇāśrayeṇa siddheḥ| yadi dvitīyadhātugrahaṇaṃ vinā śabdavyāpāro na labhyate ityāgrahastadā śamidhātorityato dvitīyadhātugrahaṇamanuvarttyamiti| tatropapadaṃ saptamīstham || 92 || asmin dhātvadhikāre pratyayavidhau saptamīnirdiṣṭa mupapadasaṃjñam| yathā karmaṇyaṇityādau karmaṇīti| tena kumbhakāra ityādau kumbhādīnāmupadasaṃjñā| karmapadena teṣāmevopādānāt| aśabdasaṃjñeti svarūpagrahaṇānupapatteḥ| naca sthagrahaṇaṃ vyartham| saptamītyata eva tannirddiṣṭagrahaṇasiddheriti vācyam| stambe ramaḥ, karṇejapaḥ, ityādeḥ śrūyamāṇasaptamīkasya saptamyāṃ janerḍaiti saptamīśabdanirdiṣṭasyaiva vāsaṃjñāprasaṅgāt| tathāca saptamyā eva saṃjñā syānnatu tadantasya saṃjñāvidhitvāt| samāsastu samarthaparibhāṣayā tadanatasyaiva siddhaḥ kevalasaptamyā sāmartyābhāvāt| sthagrahaṇeti saptamyupalakṣitasya saṃjñāvidhānātkumbhakārādāvapi siddhiḥ| tatragrahaṇaṃ viṣayanirdeśārtham| tatraitasmindhātvadhikāre iti| anyathā pratisūtramadhikārāśrayaṇe gauravāt| āhara kumbham| karoti kaṭam| ityādau tu kumbhasya nopapadasaṃjñā asāmartyati| naca mahāntaṃ kumbhaṃ karoti ityatrātiprasaṅgaḥ| mahākumbhaṃ karotīti mahākumbhakāra ityasyeṣṭatvāt| naca mahāntaṃ kumbhakāra ityasyāpattiḥ| upapadasaṃjñāyā anvarthatvāt| upoccāritaṃ padamupapadamiti| padavidhitvena samarthaparibhāṣopasthiteśca| mahatpadārthāpekṣasya kumbhasya aṇantena samamekārthībhāvānupapatteḥ|| kṛdatiṅ || 93 || atrādhikāre tiṅ‌bhinnaḥ pratyayaḥ kṛtsaṃjñaḥ tathācaitaddhātvadhikāravihitatve sati tiṅ‌bhinnapratyayatvaṃ lakṣaṇam| atiṅ kim| karoti| tibādermābhūt na ca prāglādeśebhyo dhātvadhikāra itipakṣe dhātoḥ parasya pratyayasya kṛtsaṃjñāvidhāne'pi tiṅ‌ṣu nātiprasaṅgo vikaraṇavyavadhānāditi vācyam| lugvikaraṇādau tathā pyatiprasaṅgāt| vikaraṇānāṃ sārvadhātuke parata utpatyā lakārasya kṛtsaṃjñāyāṃ stānivadbhāvena tiṅ‌ṣu doṣācca| nacaivamatiṅ‌grahaṇe'pi doṣatādavasthyam| paryudāsasāmarthyā tsthānivadbhāvāpravṛtteḥ| tiṅ‌bhāvino lakārasyaiva bhedapratiyogitayā niveśāt| ataeva kārayāṃcakāretyādau āmantasya kṛtsaṃjñā| tatra lakārasyaiva lopena tasya tiṅ‌bhāvitvābhāvāt| nanvastu tiṅāṃ kṛtsaṃjñā| naca kṛttaddhiteti prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ svādiprasaṅgaḥ| ekatvādestiṅaivoktatvena tadanāpatteḥ| nacāṇādiprasaṅgaḥ| apatyādyarthayogābhāvāt| atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau tiṅaśceti pṛthak‌tiṅ‌grahaṇasāmarthyācca| nacapacatītyādau hasvasya piti kṛtīti tuk‌prasaṅgaḥ| tatra dhātorityanuvṛtteḥ| śabantasya ca dhātutvāditi vācyam| tatrāpi śapā vyavadhānāt| ekādeśe kṛte'pi pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāvena vyavadhānasadbhāvāt| satyam| anupādeyatvādevātiṅityasyeti tatvam| iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau tṛtīyasya prathamapāde pañcamāhnikam| vā'sarūpo'striyām || 94 || atrāsarūpo'pavādapratyaya utsargasya bādhako vā syāt stryadhikāroktaṃ vinā tatra nityameva bādhaḥ| strīśabdasya svaritatvādadhikāralābhaḥ| striyo'bhidheyatve ityarthe tu labyetyeva yatā bādhitatvāt lavitavyeti tavyapratyayo na syāt| apavādenotsargasya nityabādhe prāpte pākṣikotsargapravṛttyarthamārambhaḥ| taduktam| `asarūpavāvacanamutsargasya bādhakaviṣaye pravṛttyarthe'miti| syādetat| na tāvattavyādayo'syodāharaṇam| dvividhā eva hi dhātavaḥ| ajantā halantāśca| tatrācoyat haloṇyat| tābhyāmeva sarvaviṣayā'varodhe vidhīyamānānāṃ tavyadādīnāṃ ārambhasāmarthyādeva samāveśasiddheḥ| nāpi pacādyaco viṣaye ṇvul‌tṛcau sarvadhātubhyoc‌pratyayavidhānena tayorapi sāmarthyādeva siddheḥ| ucyate| igupadhetyādeḥ kasya viṣaye ṇbul‌tṛcoḥ samāveśārthatvāt| asarūpaḥ kim| āto'nupasarge ko nityameva karmaṇyaṇo bādhako yathā syāt| nānubandhakṛtamasārūpyam| tathācānubandhavinirmuktapratyayavyaktyoḥ sādṛśyaṃ bodhyam| astriyāṃ kim apratyayaḥ nityameva striyāṃ ktino bādhako yatā syāt| atrotsargāpavādayordvayorapi stryadhikārasthatve evāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ pravartate iti vṛttyanusāriṇaḥ| apavādamātrasya stryadhikāratve'pi iti dīkṣitādayaḥ| kṛtyāḥ || 95 || `prāṅ ṇvula iti vaktavyam'| ṇvul‌tṛcāvityataḥ prāk‌ vakṣyamāṇāḥ pratyayāḥ kṛtyasaṃjñāḥ| kṛtsaṃjñāvyāpyeyaṃ saṃjñā| prāgitikim ṇvulaḥ kṛtyasaṃjñā mābhūt| anyathā tayorevakṛtyeti bhāvakarmaṇostadāpatteḥ| evaṃtu kartari kṛditi kartaryeva saḥ| vastutastvarhe kṛtyatṛcaścetyatra tṛj‌grahaṇameva yogāpekṣaṃ jñāpakam| ṇvulaḥ prāgeva kṛtyādhikāra iti| anyathā tṛco'pi kṛtyapadenaiva saṃgrahāpatteḥ| tena ṇvulaḥ kṛtyasaṃjñānāpattiḥ vṛttikāreṇatura| tavyattavyānīyaraḥ || 96 || dhātorete syuḥ| tittvaṃ sbarītārtham| ritvamupottamaṃ ritīte madhyodāttārtham| ridantasyopottamamudāttam| karaṇīyam| īkāra udāttaḥ| sauvaryaḥsaptamyastadantasaptamya iti siddhāntāt `kelimara upasaṃkhyānam'| pacetimā māṣāḥ| bhidelimāḥ saralāḥ| paktavyāḥ bhettavya ityrathaḥ| kakāro guṇavṛddhiniṣedhārthaḥ rephaḥ svarārthaḥ| karmakartaryayamitivṛttistvayuktā| bhāṣye karmaṇyevoktatvāt| `vaseḥ stavyaḥ kartari ṇicca'| ṇitvāddhṛddhiḥ| vasatīti vāstavyaḥ| vāstuni bhavo vāstavyaḥ| digāditvādyaditi bhāṣaayam| yathākathañcidanvākhyeyatvāt| taduktam-- upādāyāpi ye heyāstānupāyān pracakṣate| upāyānāṃ hi niyamo nāvasyamavatiṣṭhate|| naca svare bhedaḥ| tavyāntatve kṛtyokeṣṇujiti antodāttatvam| yati tu yayatoścātadarthe ityanenetyaviśeṣāt| aco yat || 97 || ajantādyatsyāt| ceyam| jeyam| sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoriti guṇaḥ| halantāṇṇyato vakṣyamāṇatvāt ajantaviṣayatve'sya saṃbhavatyapi| aj‌grahaṇaṃ kim| ajantabhūtapūrvādapi yathā syāt| ditsyam| dhitsyam| ārdhadhātukavivakṣāyāmevātolopāpattyā pratyayotpattivelāyāmajantatvābhāve'pi yathā syāt| nirūpitaṃ cedaṃ na padāntasūtre| ataeva parasaptamīpakṣe'j‌grahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārthameveti nyāsakāraḥ| tena gaṇayatītyādau atolopasya paranimittakatayā sthānivatvānnopadhāvṛddhirityabhiprāyaḥ| `takiśasicatiyatijanīnā mupasaṃkhyānam'| ṇyato bādhanārthamārambhaḥ| śaṃsīti sānusvārapāṭho heyaḥ| īḍavandavṛśaṃsaduhāṃṇyata iti sūtravirodhāt| takyam| śasyam| catyam| yatyam| janyam| naca janerṇyati janivadhyośceti vṛddhipratiṣedhājjanyamiti rūpasāmyādupasaṃkhyānavaiyarthyam| yato nāva ityetadarthatvāt| `hantervā yadvaktavyaḥ'| vadhyaḥ ghātyaḥ| vadhamarhatīti daṇḍādibhya iti yataiva sādhyam| nacaasivadhya ityādyanupapattiḥ samāsavidhāyakābhāvāditi vācyam| pādahārakādyarthamiti tatsiddheḥ| maivam| svare doṣaprasaṅgāt| asivadhaśabdādyati titsvaritamityāpatteḥ| kṛdantena samāse tu gatikārakopapadāditi kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa vadhyaśabde ādyudāttasiddhiḥ| vastuto'sivadhaśabdādyadeva durlabhaḥ| daṇḍādiṣu kevalasyaiva vadhaśabdasya pāṭhāt| pratyayavidhau ca tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt|| poradupadhāt || 98 || adupadhātpavargāntāddhātoryat| ṇyato'pavādaḥ| śapyam| labhyam| naca vairūpyāt ṇyadapi vāsarūpanyāyena syāditi vācyam| nānubandhakṛtamasārūpyamiti siddhāntāt|| śakihośca || 99 || śakyam| sahyam|| gadamadacarayamaścānupasarge || 100 || pañcamyarthe saptamī| anupasargebhya ebhyo yat| athavā ebhyo yatsyānnatūpasargayoge| gadyam| madyam| caryam| `carerāṅicāgurāvitivaktavyam'| ācaryodeśaḥ| agurau kim| ācāryaityatra ṇyadeva syāt| naca yameḥ poradupadhādityeva siddhamiti vācyam| sopasargānmābhūdityeva niyamārthatvāt| tena prayāmyamiti ṇyadeva| nacaivamaniyamyasya nāyuktiḥ| tvayā niyamyā nanu divyacakṣuṣetyādīnāmanupapattiḥ| `tena na tatra bhavedviniyamya'mitivārtikaprayogānnipūrvādapi yadanumānāt| yattu yamaḥ samupaniṣucetivaikalpike'ppratyaye niyamaśabdaḥ tatrasādhurita yatpratyaye niyamyaśabdaḥ sādhyaḥ| nacaivaṃkṛdyogaṣaṣṭhyāpattau teneti tvayetica kartari tṛtīyā durlabhā| apaḥ kṛtyasaṃjñāviraheṇakṛtyānāṃ kartarītyasyāpravṛtteriti vācyam| karaṇe tṛtīyopapatteḥ| yadvā paryavasitaṃ niyamayannityādāviva yamo'pariveṣaṇe miditi matamāśritya ṇyanatādyadbodhyaḥ| athavā ṇyatyeva saṃjñāpūrvakatvānna vṛddhiriti taccintyam| kliṣṭatvāt| tvayeti karaṇatve karturadhyāhārāpatteḥ| ṇyarthasyāvivakṣitatvakalpanāt| saṃjñāpūrvaka ityasyāpyagatikagatitvāt| avadyapaṇyavaryā garhyapaṇitavyanirodheṣu || 101 || yathākramamarthatraye nipātyante| nañyupapade vadaḥ supīti yatkyapoḥ prāptau yadeva sa ca garhāyāmeveti niyamadvayārthaṃ nipātanam| avadyaṃ pāpam| garhoti kim| anudyaṃ gurunām| atra kyabeva| agarhyatve'pi vadanānarhatvāt| ātmanām gurornāmeti smṛtyā taduccāraṇaniṣedhāt paṇyā gauḥ| vyavahartavyetyarthaḥ| pāṇyamanyat| styutyarṅamityarthaḥ| naca paṇitavyaśabdasyobhayasādhāraṇyātkathaṃ stutyarthasya bahirbhāva iti vācyam| rūḍhyārthaniyamalābhāt| dhātusādhanakālānāṃ prāptyarthaṃ niyamasya ca| anubandhavikārāṇāṃ rūḍhyarthaṃca nipātanam|| ityukteḥ| śatena varyā kanyā varayitṝṇāṃ niyamābhāvāt| vṛṅoyat| anirodharūpārthasya saṃbhaktivācinyeva sauṣṭhavāditi saṃpradāyaḥ| vṛṅastu vṛtyeti vakṣyate| atravaryetyante nirvibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ| natu dvandvaḥ| tena varyeti nipātaḥ striyāmeva| āstriyāṃ tu ṇyat| vāryā ṛtvija iti vṛttiḥ| kecittu dvandvaeva| sugrīvo mama varyo'sāviti bhaṭṭiprayogādityāhuḥ| vahyaṃ karaṇam || 102 || vahantyanena vahyaṃ śakaṭam| karmaṇi tu vāhyam| halantatvāṇṇyat| voḍhvayamityarthaḥ| aryaḥ svāmivaiśyayoḥ || 103 || ṛdantatvātprāptasya ṇyato'pavādaḥ| `svāminyantodāttatvaṃ vaktavyam' svāmīti kim| āryo brāhmaṇaḥ| prāptavya ityarthaḥ| upasaryā kālyā prajane || 104 || prajane garbhograhaṇe kālyā prāptakālā cedityarthaḥ| tadasya prāptamityanuvṛttau vartamāne kālādyat| upasaryā gauḥ| garbhādhānārthaṃ vṛṣabheṇa gantuṃ yogyā| prajanetyādi kim| upasāryā kāśī| prāptumarhetyarthaḥ| ajaryaṃ saṃgatam || 105 || nañ‌pūrvājjīryateḥ kartari yat saṃgatasya viśeṣyatve| tena saṅgataprayogo'pyapekṣaṇīyaḥ| tena saṅgatamāryeṇa rāmārmajaryaṃ kuru drutamiti bhaṭṭiḥ| mṛgairajaryaṃ jarasopadiṣṭamiti kālidāsaprayoge tu tadadhyāhāryam| kecittu jaraṇābhāvaviśeṣyasaṅgate'jaryapadasyājahallakṣaṇetyāhuḥ| tanna| saṅgatasyājaryapadabhinnapadajanyadhīviśeṣya tvasya sūtrārthato lābhāt| anyathā yogarūḍhereva durvāratvāt| naca bhaṭṭiprayoge paunarūktyāpattistadbādhikā| tatra viśeṣaṇamātraparatāyāḥ sambhavāt| vadaḥ supi kyap ca || 106 || anupasarga iti vartate| uttarasūtrādbhāvapadāpakarṣaḥ| vaderbhāve kyamap syāt cādyat| upasargabhinne supyupapade| brahmodyam| kitvātsaṃprasāraṇam| yati brahmavadyam| brahmaṇo vedasya vadanamityarthaḥ| karmaṇyayamityanye| bhāvagrahaṇamuttarārthāmityuttarasūtrabhāṣyasvārasyāt| upasargetu anuvādyam| apavādyam| anūdyeti kyap‌prayo gastu kvācitko'sādhuḥ| bhuvo bhāve || 107 || kyap syāt| brahmaṇo bhāvo brahmabhūyam| bhāva ityuttarārtham| bhuvo'karmakatvena vyāvartyābhāvāditi bhāṣyam| prāptyarthasya sakarmakatve'pi prathamamanupasthitatvāt| kālādikarmaṇi tvanabhidhānāditi kaiyaṭaḥ| hanastaca || 108 || kyap syādupasargabhinne supi upapade takāraścāntādeśaḥ `striyāṃ ciditi vaktavyam'| cittvādantodāttatvam| brahmaṇo hananaṃ brahmahatyā| strītvaṃ liṅgasya lokāśrayatvāt| dasyuhatyāyeti bhāṣyodāhṛtaśrautaprayoge tu klībatvaṃ chāndasamiti kaiyaṭaḥ| etistuśāsvṛdṛjuṣaḥ kyap || 109 || ityaḥ stutyaḥ vṛttyaḥ| vṛiti vṛño grahaṇaṃ natu vṛṅaḥ| īḍavandavṛśaṃsaduhāṃ ṇyata ātmanepadibhyāṃ īḍavandibhyāṃ sāhacaryaṇa vṛṅa evopādānāt| vṛṅastu vāryā ṛtvijaḥ| ādṛśaayaḥ| dṛdhātorāṅ‌ pūrvasyaiva prayogāt| sarvatra hrasvasya piti kṛtīti tuk| śiṣyaḥ| śāsaidaṅ‌haloritītvam| śāsivasīti ṣatvam| juṣyaḥ| kyapi prakaॉte punaḥ kyap‌grahaṇaṃ pūrvasmādasya vailakṣaṇyasūcanārtham| tena pūrvaśchandasistriyāṃ cidbhavatīti siddham| na caivamavaśyastutya ityatra orāvaśyake iti ṇyadāpattiḥ| pūrvavipratiṣedhavacanena kyap‌siddheḥ| yadi tu punaḥ kyab‌grahaṇasyedamevaprayojanaṃ tarhi cittvaṃ vācanikaṃ bodhyam| `āṅ‌pūrvādañjeḥ saṃjñāyāmupasaṃkhyānam'| añjū vyaktyādau| bāhulakātkaraṇe kyap| aniditāmiti nalopaḥ| añjatyanenetyājyam| naca dīrghānupapattiḥ| āṅ‌pūrvatvāt| ṇyati tu upadhālopo na syāt| nacāṅaḥ padatvādavagrahaprasaṅgaḥ| na lakṣaṇena padakārā anuvarttyāḥ padakārairnāma lakṣaṇamanuvarttyamitīṣṭāpatteḥ saṃhitaiva hyapauruṣeyī| padacchedastu pauruṣeyaḥ| ataeva yatrārthaniścayo nāsti tatra nāvagrahaḥ| taduktam| haridruranavagṛhya iti| hariśabdo haricchabdo veti sedehāt| ṛdupadhāccāklṛpicṛteḥ || 110 || klṛpicṛtivyatiriktādṛdupadhātkyap| vṛtyam| vṛdhyam| kitpānna guṇaḥ| aklṛpīti kim| kalpyam| cartyam| ṇyadguṇau| taparaḥ kim| kīrtyam| ṇijabhāvapakṣe ṇayat| ṇici tu acoyat| īca khanaḥ || 111 || ca tkpap| kheyam| atra bhāṣyam| ikāro hrasva eva vidheyaḥ| ādguṇena rūpasiddheraviśeṣāt| naca ṣatvatukorityekādeśasyāsiddhatvādadhītyetyādāviva tuk‌ prasaṅgaḥ padāntapadādyorekādeśasyaivāsiddhatvasvakirāt| anyathā vṛkṣechatramityatra hrasvāśrayasya nityasya tukaḥ prasaṅgat| dīrghātpadāntādveti vaikalpikasyeṣṭatvāt| kecittu praśleṣanirdeśena dvitīya ikāro ye vibhāṣetyātvasya pakṣe paratvātprāptasya bādhāya vidhīyate| yevibhāṣetyātvasyāvakāśaḥ khāyate| itvasyāvakāśaātvābhāvapakṣe| ātvapakṣe tūbhayaprasaṅge paratvādātvameva syāditi kalpayanti| tanna| kyap saṃniyogaśiṣṭatvenetvasyāntaraṅgatvāt| yakārādau pratyaye pare vidhīyamānasyātvasya bahiraṅgatvāt| antaraṅgabahiraṅgayośca vipratiṣedhāyogāt| naca ye iti viṣayasaptamyāśrayaṇādātvasyaiva paranimittatvābhāvādantaraṅgatvamiti vācyam| parasaptamyā eva tatra yuktatvāt iti kaiyaṭaḥ| bhṛño'saṃjñāyām || 112 || bhṛtyāḥ karmakarāḥ| bharaṇīyā ityarthaḥ| `samaśca bahulam'| saṃbhṛtyāḥ| pakṣe sambhāryāḥ| nacasaṃjñāyāmiti pratiṣedhasya saṃnidhānādetatsūtraprāptimātraviṣayatvātsaṃjñāyāṃ samajaniṣedatyādinā kyapo durvāratvam| tathāca bhāryāśabdo na sidhyet| tathācaitatpratiṣedhasāmarthyāllakṣaṇāntaraprāptasyāpi kyapo'yaṃ niṣedha iti vācyam| astrīsaṃjñāniṣedhatvenopapatteḥ| bhāryo nāma kṣatriyaḥ| karmavyutpattyā saṃjñāpadasya saṃjñiparatvāt| nanu saṃjñāyāṃ samajetyasmādanantaraṃ `na striyā'miti pāṭhyam| tathāca striyāmityadhikārādvidhau śāstrīyastrīgrahaṇād‌bhṛtyeti kyap| niṣedhe tu stanakeśavatīti laukikastrīgrahaṇātkyapo niṣedhe ṇyatpratyaye bhāryeticet| maivam| sūtrabhedāpatteḥ| ucyate saṃjñāyāmiti sūtre vrajayajorbhāve kyabityasmādbhāvapadānuvṛtteḥ| bhāryāśabdasya tu karmasādhanatvānna tatra kyap‌prasaṅgaḥ| athavā vidhipradeśeṣu saṃjñāśabdo na karmasādhanaḥ kiṃtu bhāvasādhanaḥ| tena pratyayāntena yadi rūḍhirgamyate tataḥ pratyayaḥ| bhṛtyāśabdena ca gṛhiṇyanabhidhānānna kyap| tathāca vārtikam| saṃjñāyāṃ puṃsi dṛṣaaṭatvānna te bhāryā prasidhyati| striyāṃ bhāvādhikāro'sti tena bhāryā prasidhyati| yadvā bāhulakāṇṇyat| tathācoktam| athavā bahulaṃ kṛtyāḥ saṃjñāyāmiti cetsmṛtam|| yathā yat yathā bhitti stathaiva sā| yathā ajantādvihito yat bāhulakātkvaciddhalantādipa| yathā vā bhittirityaṅ‌viṣaye ktinnityarthaḥ| kecittu bibhartterbhṝ iti dīrghāntāt kryodarvāṇyat| kyap tubharatestaidādikādeva| tadanubandhakagrahaṇe nātadanubandakasyetyāhuḥ| mṛjorvibhāṣā || 113 || kyap‌ mṛjayaḥ| pakṣe ṇyat| mārgyaḥ| mṛjervṛddhiḥ| cajoritikutvam| rājasūryasūyamṛṣodyarucyakupyakṛṣṭapacyāvyathyāḥ || 114 || ete nipātyante| rājñā sotavyo'bhiṣavadvārā niṣpādayitavyaḥ| rājānaṃ krīṇātītyādidarśanāllatātmakaḥ somaḥ sūyate kaṇḍyate'tretyadhikaraṇo kyap| nipātanāddīrghaḥ| rājasūyasya paśivaṣṭisomātmakaṣoḍaśapradhānarūpatve'pi ekadeśasaṃbandhasyāpi pravṛttinimittatvam| vaiśvadevena yajetetyādāvekadeśavartināpi viśvadevasaṃbandhena vaiśvadevapadasya yāgāṣṭakaparatvadarśanāt| sūryarucyāvyathyāḥ kartari| saratīti sūryaḥ nipātanādutvam| yadvā ṣū prereṇe tudādiḥ| suvati karmaṇi prerayati lokān| kyapo ruṭ‌ nipātanāt| mṛṣetyupapadādeva vadeḥ karmaṇi nityaṃ kyap| tena yat na| viśeṣyaliṅgo'yam| kṣīre payasyā'pi peda dvayavācibhūyaṃ nānārthakeṣaviṣayo'dya mṛṣodyamastu| arthadvayavācitvaṃ mṛṣodyaṃ mṛṣeti vaktavyamastvityanvayaḥ| ucchrāyasaundaryaguṇā mṛṣodyāḥ| rocate rucyaḥ| sundaraṃ rucyamityamaraḥ| kupyaṃ saṃjñāyām| svarṇarajatābhyāmanyatkupyam| guperādeḥ kutvam| kṛṣṭapacyasyāntodāttatvaṃ karmakartari ca| kṛṣṭe svayameva pacyante kṛṣṭapacyāḥ| kṛṣṭapacyāśca me'kṛṣṭapacyāśca me| śuddhe kartari kṛṣṭapākyāḥ| na vyathate'vyathyaḥ|| bhidyaudhyau nade || 115 || bhiderujjheśca kyap| ujjherdhatvaṃca| bhinatti kūlaṃ bhidyaḥ| ujjhatyudakaṃ udhyaḥ| ajādyadantamityasyānityatvāt bhidyapadasya pūrvanipātaḥ| nade kim| bhettā ujjhitāḥ|| puṣyasidhyau nakṣatre || 116 || puṣyati sidhyatibhyāmadhikaraṇe kyap| puṣyanti sidhyantivāsminnarthāḥ pūṣpaḥ sidhyaḥ|| vipūyavinīyajityā muñjakalka haliṣu || 117 || pūj‌nīñ‌jibhyaḥ kyap| vipūyo muñjaḥ| rajvādikaraṇāya śodhanīyaḥ vinīyaḥ kalkaḥ| piṣṭa auṣadhiviśeṣaḥ pāpaṃ vā tapo na kalko'dhyayanaṃ na kalka ityupakramya tānyeva bhāvopahatāni kalkaḥ iti bhāratāt| kalkaḥ pāpāśaye pāpaṃ iti koṣācca| jityo hāleḥ| balena kraṣṭavyaḥ| kṛṣṭasamīkaraṇārthaṃ stūlakāṣṭham| eṣu kim| anyatra yadeva| vipavyam| vineyam| jeyam|| pratyapibhyāṃ graheḥ || 118 || `kyap chandasīti vaktavyam'| mattasya na pratigṛhyam| anyatra pratigrāhyam| apigrāhyam| padāsvairibāhyapakṣyeṣu ca|| 119 || avagṛhyaṃ pragṛhyaṃ padam| gṛhyo'svairī paratantra ityarthaḥ| gṛhāsaktāḥ pakṣimṛgāḥ chekāste gṛhyakāśca te|| ityamaraḥ| grāmagṛhya senā| || 120 || kṛtyam| vṛṣyam| pakṣe ṇyat| kāryam| varṣyam|| yugyaṃ ca patre || 121 || patraṃ vāhanam yujeḥ kyap kutvaṃ ca| ṇyadvyāvṛttaye sūtram| tadvahatirathayugeti taddhitenāpi siddheḥ|| kakāratakārayorvyatyāsaḥ| upasargasakārasya ṣatvaṃca| niṣṭarkyaṃ cinvati paśukāmaḥ| devahūyādicatuṣṭaye caturbhyaḥ kyap| kitvānna guṇaḥ| upasargabhedānnayaterbhedaḥ| maryādicatuṣṭaye yat| yatonāva ityādyudāttatvam| khānya iti ṇyat| devayajyeti yakāraḥ| āpṛcchetyādi dvaye kyap| kitvātsaṃprasāraṇagumābhāvau| brahmavādyādicatuṣṭaye ṇyat| caturiti sujantam| caturo vārān yadvidhīyate ityarthaḥ| upacāyyeti pṛḍaśabdeuttarapade nipātaḥ| `hiraṇya iti vaktavyam' upaceyapṛḍamanyat mṛḍa mukhane pṛḍa cetyasmādigupadhatvātkaḥ|| ṛhalorṇyat || 124 || ṣaṣṭhī pañcamyarthe| ṛdantāddhalantācca ṇyat| naca ṛ gatāvityasyaiva grahaṇamastviti vācyam| hal‌sāhacaryeṇa barṇagrahaṇāt| paraṃ kāryamiti nirdeśāt| īḍavandetyādi liṅgācca| anyathā vṛdhātūttarasya ṇyato'prasiddheḥ| kāryam| varṣyam| `pāṇau sṛjerṇyadvācyaḥ'ṛdupadhāditi prāptasya kyapo'pavādaḥ| pāṇibhyāṃ sṛjyate iti pāṇisargyā rajjuḥ| `samavapūrvācca'samavasargyā| `lapidibhibhyāṃ cetivaktavyam'| poradupadhāditiyato'pavādaḥ| apalāpyam apadābhyam| dabhirvārtikabalāllabdhadhātubhāvaḥ| viṣṇurgopā adābhyaḥ| na mā naśanti na dabhāti taskara ityādiprayogāt| vṛtikārastu āsuyu ityādisūtre raperuttaraṃ larpi paṭhitvā cakāreṇa dabheḥ ityasmāt| āsāvyaḥ| yu miśraṇe| yāvyaḥ| yuñ bandhane ityasya tu na grahaṇam| sānubandhakatvāt| upādīnāṃ caturṇāmupādānaṃ poradupadhāditi yato bādhanārtham| vāpyam| rāpyam| trāpyam| cāmyam| ānāyyo'nitye || 127 || atra vārtikam| ānāyyo'nitya iti ceddakṣiṇāgnau kṛtaṃ bhavet| ekayonau tu taṃ vidyādāneyo hyanyathā bhavet| anityamātre uktanipātane ghaṭādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ| ato dakṣiṇāgnāviti vaktavyam| tatrāpi ekayonāviti vācyam āhavanīyena saha yo gārhapatyādānīyate sa ekayonirdakṣiṇāgniḥ| anityatvaṃ ca tasya satatamaprajvalanāt| yastu vaiśyakulāderānīyate tatra nāyaṃ nipāta ityarthaḥ| `vaiśyakulādvittavato bhrāṣṭrādvā gārhapatyādveti dakṣiṇāgneryonivikalpaśravaṇāt| yo gārhapatyādānīya dakṣiṇāgniḥ praṇīyate| tasminnānāyya ityamaraḥ|| praṇāyyo'saṃmatau || 128 || saṃmatiḥ prītiviṣayatvam| praṇāyyaścauraḥ| prītyanarhatvāt| bhogecchāpi saṃmatiḥ| praṇāyyo'ntevāsī| virakta ityarthaḥ| praṇeyo'nyaḥ| pāyyasāṃnāyyanikāyyadhāyyāmānahavirnivāsasāmidhenīṣu || 129 || mīyate'neneti pāyyaṃ mānam| karaṇe ṇyat| masya patvam| āto yuk| samyak nīyate homārthamagniṃ pratiti sānnāyyaṃ haviḥ| darśe'gniṣomīyayāge ṇyadāyādeśau samo dīrghaśca| nicīyate dhānyādikamatreti nikāyyo nivāsaḥ ṇyadāyādeśau dhātvādeścakatvam| dhīyate'nayā samiditi dhāyyā ṛk| prakṛtau pañcadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ śrūyante| sāptadaśyasya mitravindādivikṛtiviśeṣaviṣayakatvāt| `ekaviṃśatimanubrūyā'dityādau vikūtiviśeṣe sāmidhenivivṛddhiśrutau āgamyamānānāmṛcāṃ kutra deśe niveśa iti saṃdeha iyaṃ vai samidhyamānavatī asau samiddhavatī yadantayā taddhāyyā iti dyāvāpṛthivītvena kalpitayoḥ samidhyamānasamidhaayavattyormadhye dhāyyānāmākāśatvena saṃstavāt pūrvāsāṃ cāgantūnāmṛcāṃ dhīyamānatayā dhāyyatvāt| tanmadhye niveśa iti pūrvapakṣaḥ| dhīyamānatvaṃ na dhāyyāśabdapravṛttinimittam stobhādividhau stutaśastrārthatayā dhīyamānāsu tacchabdaprayogābhāvāt| kintu pṛthupājavatyau dhāyye ityādivedaprayogo yatra dhāyyāpadavācyānāmeva samiddhyamānasamiddhasmādatra samidhenīpadaṃ tadviśeṣaparaṃ bodhyam| mānetyādi kim| anyatra meyam| niceyam| saṃneyam| dheyam| kratau kuṇḍapāyyasaṃcāyyau || 130 || kuṇḍena pīyate somo'smin kuṇḍapāyyaḥ kratuḥ| adhikaraṇe yat| natu vyat| nitsvarāpatteḥ| yatonāva ityādyudāttaḥ pāyyaśabdaḥ| samāse kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| tathāca vārtikam| `kuṇḍapāyye yadvidhi'riti| saṃcīyate'sau saṃcāyyaḥ| karmaṇi ṇyat| āyādeśaḥ kratau kim| kuṇḍapānaṃ saṃceyaḥ| agnauparicāyyopacāyyasamūhyāḥ || 131 || agnipadena taddhāraṇārthamiṣṭakānirmitasthalaṃ grāhyam iṣṭakābhiragniṃ cinute ityādidarśanāt| paryyupūrvāccinoterṇyadāyādeśau| saṃpṛrvasya brāhmaṇaprayogādityuktam|| cityāgnicitye ca|| 132 || agnipadamanuvartate| taccādyasyaiva viśeṣaṇam| na dvitīyasya tasya bhāvārthatvena agnivācakatvāyogāt cīyate'sau cityo'gniḥ| karmaṇi kyap| ca | 147 || gāyanaḥ| ṭitvādgāyanī|| haśca vrīhikālayoḥ || 148 || hāṅ‌ hākorṇyuṭ vā vrīhau kāleca vācye| jahātyudakamiti hāyane vrīhiḥ| prarohārthadattodatād‌rdhvagamanena jalatyāgaḥ| jahāti jihīte vā
