samāsaitikecit| taccintyam| karmopapadābhāve karmaṇyaṇo'nupapattyā tadutpatteḥ prāk kṛdyogābhāvena dvitīyotpatterāvaśyakatvāttasyā eva parityāge mānābhāvādalaukike samāsivigrahavākye'pyanupraveśaucityāt| anyathā kṛdyoge'pi ṣaṣṭhī tasyāṃca kṛdyoga ityanyonyāśrayāpatteḥ| karmasamarpakaprātipadikamātrāpekṣāyāṃ ca ṣaṣṭhyā api vigrahāntarbhāvasya durvāratvāt| samarthaparibhāṣānupasthitpāpatteśca| ataeva mahāntaṃ kumbhakāra ityādyāpādyavākye viśeṣaṇe dvitīyaiva bhāṣyādau dṛśyate| samāsāntargatasya kumbhasya ṣaṣṭyantatve tadviśeṣaṇe mahacchabde'pi tasyā eva prasaṅgāt| ataeva yugapadadhikaraṇavacane dvandva iti pakṣe'pi prathamapravṛttaikavacanasyaivālaukake vigrahavākye praveśa iti pūrvaṃ svayamevoktam| kumbhasya kartetyādau karmayogasyānupajīvyatvātkartrādau tatpratyayotpattau paścāttadyoge dvitīyādyapavādena ṣaṣṭhīti vaiṣamyamiti dik| `akārānupapadātkarmopapado vipratiṣedhana'| yadyapi sarvadhādhātubhyo'jitipakṣe pacādyacā nirmuktaḥ karmaṇyaṇo'vakāśo na labhyate iti yenanāprāptinyāyenāṇastadbādhakatvādvipratiṣedho nāsti| utsargāpavādayoratulyabalatvāt| tathāpi kāṣṭhabheda ityatra kāṇorvipratiṣedho bodhyaḥ| ajapavādayostayorvipratiṣedhādaṇ‌pravṛtteḥ| odanapāka iti bhāṣyaṃ tu gaṇapaṭhitadhātuviṣayo'c‌pratyaya ityāśena neyam| `śīlikāmibhakṣyācaribhyo ṇaḥ pūrvapadasvaratvaṃca'`īkṣikṣamibhyāṃ ceti vaktavyam' māṃsaśīlā māṃsakāmā māṃsabhakṣā| kalyāṇācārā| māṃsaśabdaḥ sapratyayāntatvādantodāttaḥ| kalyāṇaśabdolaghāvante dvayośca bahuṣogururiti madhyodāttaḥ| tatra kṛduttaraprakṛtisvabādhārthaṃ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarārambhaḥ| nanu bhakṣayaterac| erajaṇyantacānāmityasya munitrayeṇānuktatvāt| māsaṃ bhakṣo'syeti bahuvrīhiṇaivoktasvarasiddhiḥ| naca bahavo bhakṣā asyetyatra bahvornañ‌vaduttarapadabhūmnīti antodāttaprasaṅgāduktavārtikadhrauvyamiti vācyam| bhāve bhakṣapadaṃ vyutpādya bahuṣu bhakṣo'syeti vyadhikaraṇabahuvrīhau uttarapadatvābhāvena tadapravṛttau bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadamityasyaiva pravṛtteḥ| nacārthasāmye bahuvrīhikarmopapadayorarthasāmye bahuvrīhirnabhavatīti vārtikena jñāpyam| kāṇḍalāvo māṃnasakāma ityādibahuvrīherapīṣṭatvāt| ambhobhigama ityatrānabhidhānādvahuvrīhikarmopapadayorabhāvadambhobhigāmītyatyaiveṣṭatvāt| satyam| aṇ‌bādhanārthamevataidārambhāt|| hvāvāmaśca || 2 || māṅ‌ meṅāviha gṛhyete natu māmāne ityakarmakatvāt| svargahvāyaḥ tantuvāyaḥ| dhānyamāyaḥ| karmaṇyaṇiti siddhe vakṣyamāmakāpavārdāthamārambhaḥ| tenānyatrāpyādantādvihitaḥ pratyayaḥ ejantātsiddhiḥ| tathāca kaiyaṭaḥ| ātvabhāvina ejantādādanttvanibandhanaḥ| pratyayo jñāpyate sarvo hvāvāmaścetyaṇā punaḥ|| āto'nupasarge kaḥ || 3 || anupasargādādantāddhātoḥ karmaṇi upapadeḥ kaḥ syāt| aṇo'pavādaḥ| yevā divi dakṣiṇāvanto asthurye aśvadāḥ sahate sūryeṇa hiraṇyadā amṛtatvaṃ bhajante vāsodāḥ somapratiranta āyuḥ| sopasargāttvaṇ gosaṃdāyaḥ| `kavidhausarvatra saṃprasāraṇibhyoḍaḥ'| brahma jināti brahmajyaḥ| sarvatretyukterātaścopasarge ityasyāpi viṣaye| āhaḥ| prahvaḥ| atravārtikam| nityaṃ saṃprasāraṇaṃ hvo yaṇ vārṇādāṅgaṃ na pūrvatvaṃ hi| yo'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvastakārye sthānivatvaṃ hi| provāca bhagavān kātyastenāsiddhiryaṇastute| ātaḥ koliṇ naiṅaḥ pūrvaḥ| siddhaāhvastathāsati| asyārthaḥ-kapratyayenaiva āhva ityādi siddham| āhvāḍaityatrasaṃprasāraṇātolopayaṇādeśeṣu asya susādhatvāt| naca uvaṅprasaṅgaḥ| ātolopasya stānivadbhāvāt| naca paramapyātolopaṃ vādhitvāntaraṅgatvātpūrvarūpāpattiḥ| vārṇādāṅgasya balavattvāt| samānāśraye eva tadaṅgīkāre tu hvāaityavasthāyāṃ saṃprasārāṇaṃ bādhitvātolopaḥ| tataḥ saṃprasāraṇam| ātolopasya sthānivavattvānnovaṅ| naca kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvātsaṃprasāraṇaṃ nityam| ātolopasyāpi tathātvāt naca saṃprasāraṇepūrvarūpe ca kṛte ātolopasya na prasaṅga iti kathaṃ sa nitya iti vācyam| yasya lakṣaṇāntareṇa nimittaṃ vihanyate na tadanityamiti svīkārāt| pūrvarūpeṇālopasya nimittāpahāre'pi saṃprasāraṇena tadabhāvāt| nanu tathāpyakārasyānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvatvābhāvāduvaṅi kartvaye kathaṃ sthaānivadbhāvaḥ| naca sthānidvārakaṃ tat| ukārasthānino vasyāto lopātpūrvasattvāditi vācyam| tasyācaḥ parasminnityatra dūṣitatvāt| ata uvaṅ‌ durvāra iticet| na, tathāsiddhavadatrābhādityātolopasyāsiddhatvena tadvāraṇāt| ubhayatrāpyajādipratyayasya nimittattvena samānāśrayatvāt| nanvevaṃ juhuvaturityāderasiddhiḥ| tatrāśitīti paryudāsapakṣe bādhitvā paratvādātvapravṛttau tadārnī pūrvarūpaprasaktyabhāvādāto lopa iticetsatyam| eṅaḥ padāntādityatra eṅa iti vibhajya saṃprasāraṇādityanuvartya saṃprasāraṇātparasya eṅaḥ pūrvarūpaṃ syāditi vyākhyānāt| arthātpūrvatvavidhānenātvabādhāt| nacaprakṛte'pi tadāpattiḥ| ādantatvakṣaṇe ātvasyopajīvyatvāt| liṭastu dhātumātrādvihitatvena vaiṣamyād|| supi sthaḥ || 4 || supīti vibhajyate| ādantātsupyupapade kaḥ| kacchena pibati kacchapaḥ| dvābhaayāṃ pibati dvipaḥ| kecittu kacchaṃ pibati iti karmopapadakapratyaya eva kāryo rūḍhatvenāvayavārthānanvaye'pi kṣativirahādityāhuḥ| satisaṃbhave rūḍhānāmapyasadarthāśrayeṇānvākhyānānaucityam| tailapāyikādau tvagatyā'sadarthāśrayaṇamiti kaiyaṭaḥ| stha ityatra supītyanuvartate| kartari pūrveṇaiva siddhe rayaṃ bhāve| anirdiṣṭārthā iti nyāyāt| nabādhāpattyā samastho viṣamastha ityādi na sidhyediti vācyam| bhāvaityasya paryavasāne'pi sākṣādbhāvaśabdasyānupādānāt| kecittu ghañarthe kavidhānamiti vārtikādeva tiṣṭhateḥ kapratyayasiddhirityāhuḥ| tanna upapadamatiṅiti nityasamāsārthaṃ upapadātkapratyayasyātra vidhānāt| tadvārtike sthagrahaṇasya tvakartari kārake caritārthatvāt| ākhūnāmutthānāmākhūtthaḥ| śyenotthaḥ| śalabhotthaḥ| napuṃsakodāharaṇaṃ tu ākaraviruddham| luyaḥ kartarīmanij bhāve ko ghoḥ kiṃ prādito'nyata ityamareṇa bhāva kasya puṃstvokteḥ| tundaśokayoḥ parimṛjāpanudoḥ || 5 || yathākramaṃ kaḥ| `ālasyasukhāharaṇayoriti vācyam'| tundaparimṛjo'lasaḥ| śokāpanudaḥ sukhasyāhartā| anyatra tundaparimārjaḥ| śokāpanodaḥ| saṃsārānityatodbhāvanena śokanivṛttikṛdityarthaḥ| `kaprakaraṇe mūlavibhujādibhya upasaṃkhyānam'| mūlavibhujo rathaḥ| mahīdhraḥ| kudhraḥ| saroruham|| pre dājñaḥ || 6 || propasargaviśiṣṭāddārūpājjānāteśca karmaṇyupapadeḥ kaḥ syāt| aṇo'pavādaḥ| sarvapradaḥ pathi prajñaḥ| upasargāntarayoge tuna| anupamarga iti niṣedhāt| praśabdamātre uktavidhinā tadbādhe'pyanyatra bādhābhāvāt| gosaṃpradāyaḥ| samikhyaḥ || 7 || gāḥ saṃcaṣṭe gosaṃkhyaḥ| saṃpūrvasya khyāteḥ prayogo neti nyāsakāraḥ| khyāteḥ sārvadhātukamātraviṣayatvaṃ tu prāgeva nirastam|| gāpoṣṭak || 8 || anupasargābhaayāmābhyāṃ karmaṇyupapade ṭak| gāyaterevātra grahonatu gāgānoranabhidhānāt| sāmagaḥ| sāmagī| pā pāne| lugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇayoralugvikaraṇasyaiva grahaṇāt| `pibateḥ surāsīdhvoriti vaktavyam'| surāpī| sīdhupī| yā tu surāṃ rakṣati sā surāpā| upapadaniyamānneha| kṣīraṃ pibati kṣīrapā| `bahulaṃ saṃjñāchandasoḥ'| brāhmaṇī bhavati yā surāpī naināṃ devāḥ patilokaṃ nayanti| surāpā vā|| harateranudyamane'c || 9 || aṃśaharaḥ| grahaṇamatra haraterthaḥ| udyamane tu bhārahāraḥ| `acprakaraṇe śaktilāṅgalāṅkurā yaṣṭitomaraghaṭaghaṭīdhanuḥṣu graherupasaṃkhyānam'| śaktigrahaḥ| lāṅgalagrahaḥ ityādi| ghaṭīśabdagrahaṇaṃ liṅgaviśiṣṭagrahaṇaparibhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanārtham'| `sutre ca dharye'rthe' sūtragrahaḥ| yastu sutrasya saṃgrahamātraṃ karoti natu dhārayati tatra sūtragrāha eva|| vayasi ca || 10 || kālikaśarīrāvastāviśeṣo vayaḥ tatra dyotye haraterac| kavacaharaḥ kumāraḥ| udyamanārthamārambhaḥ| kavacodyamane tadabhāve vā vayoviśeṣamātraṃ gamyam| kavacopādānayogya ityarthaḥ| phalopadhāne'pi yogyatānapāyāt|| āṅi tācchīlye || 11 || karmaṇyupapade āṅ pūrvāddharaterac tācchīlye| puṣpāṇyāharati tacchīlaḥ puṣpāharaḥ| tācchīlyamautsargikī pravṛttiḥ| anyatra bhārāhāraḥ|| arhaḥ || 12 || karmaṇyupapade'rhaterac aṇapavādaḥ| pūjārhā brāhmaṇī || stambakarṇayoramijapoḥ || 13 || `hastisūcakayoriti vaktavyam'| haladantādityaluk| stamberamo hastī| karṇejapaḥ sūcakaḥ| anyatra stambe rantā| karṇejapitā|| śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyām || 14 || `śami upapade dhātumātrādac saṃjñāyām'| śebhavaḥ| śaṃvadaḥ| dhātugrahaṇaṃ kṛño hetvādiṣu pratiṣedhārtham| aco'vakāśa uktaḥ| ṭasyāvakāśaḥ śraddhakaraḥ| śaṃkarā nāma parivrājikā tacchīlā tatra paratvāṭṭaḥ syāt| dhātugrahaṇasāmarthyādajeva| kuṇaravāḍavastvāha gṛṇāteḥ śaṃgarāśabdaṃ vyutpādya pṛṣodarāditvādgakārasya kakāra iti śaṃkarāśabdasiddheḥ| tathāca dhātugrahaṇaṃ na kāryamiti bhāṣyam|| adhikaraṇe śeteḥ || 15 || khe śete khaśayaḥ| `pārśvādiṣūpasaṃkhyānam'| pārśvābhyāṃ śete pārśvaśayaḥ| pṛṣṭhaśayaḥ| udaraśayaḥ| `digdhasahapūrvācceti vaktavyam'| digdhasahitaṃ upapadaṃ natu pratyekam| digdhena saha śete digdhasahaśayaḥ| mayūkhyaṃsakāditvātsamāsa iti kaiyaṭaḥ| `uttānādiṣu kartṛṣviti vaktavyam'| uttānaḥ śete uttānaśayaḥ| avamūrdhaśayaḥ avanato mūrdhā yasya tādṛgadhomukhaḥ śete iti yāvat| `girau ḍaḥchandasīti vaktavyam' girau śete giriśaḥ| yadvā girirasyāsti lomāditvāt śapatyayaḥ| yadvā sekhyaikavacanācceti śas| rūḍhānāṃ kathañcivdyutpādyatvāt|| vairavāsiṣṭagiriśāsthaikāgārikādayaḥ| kaiścitkathañcidākhyātā nimittāvadhisaṃkaraiḥ|| etena giriśamupacacāra pratyahaṃ sā sukeśīti vyākhyātam| yattu chandasīti vacanādbhāṣāyāṃ giriśaśabdasyāsādhutvamāhuriti kaiyaṭenoktaṃ tatrāhurityakharasaḥ| tabdījaṃtu prakārāntareṇa tatsiddheruktatvānna sādhutvamiti|| careṣṭaḥ || 16 || adhikaraṇe upapade| kurucaraḥ| kurucarī| adhikaraṇe kim| kurūṃścaratītyatrāṇeva| yasya kurava eva prāpyāḥ sa kurucāraḥ| yastu kuruṣu bhramati sa kurucaraḥ| atra kurupadaṃ tadekadeśaparam|| bhikṣāsenādāyeṣu ca || 17 || bhikṣā carati bhikṣācaraḥ| caraṇopasarjanamarjanamiha caratyarthaḥ| caraṇena bhikṣāmarjayatītyarthaḥ| senācaraḥ atra praveśo'rthaḥ| ādāyeti lyabantānukaraṇam| karmākāṅkṣatve'pi vacanātsamāsaḥ| ādāyacaraḥ| ādānottarakālīnacaraṇāśraya ityarthaḥ| sahacarityādikaṃ tu pacādiṣu caraḍiti pāṭhāt| ṭavidhānaṃ tu nityasamāsārtham|| puro'grato'greṣu sarteḥ || 18 || puraḥ saraḥ| agrataḥ saraḥ| agramagreṇāgre vā saratyagresaraḥ| nipātanādetvam| agrasaraśabdo bāhukāditi haradattaḥ|| pūrve kartari || 19 || pūrvaḥ sarati pūrvasaraḥ| kartari kim| pūrvaṃdeśaṃ sarati pūrvasāraḥ|| kṛño hetutācchīlyānulomyeṣu || 20 || heturaikāntikaṃ kāraṇam| yaśaskarī vidyā| ataḥ kṛkamīti satvam| kīrtyayogavyavacchinnetyarthaḥ| śrāddhakaraḥ| ānulomyamanukūlatvam| vacanakaraḥ| ānulomyaṃ dyotyam|| divāvibhāniśāprabhābhāskarāntānantādibahunāndīkiṃlipilibibilibibalibhaktikartṛcitrakṣetrasaṃkhyājaṅghābāhvaharyattaddhanuraruḥṣu || 21 || ahetvādyartha ārambhaḥ| eṣu kṛñṣṭaḥ syāt| divākara ityādi| bhāskaraḥ| kaskāditvātsaḥ| bahuśabdo vaipulyārthaḥ| saṃkhyāyāḥ pṛthagupādānāt| lipilibiśabdau paryāyau| ekakaraḥ| dvikaraḥ| ahaskaraḥ| kaskādiḥ| dhanuṣkaraḥ| nityaṃsamāse'nuttarapadasthasyeti ṣatvam| kiṃyattadbahuṣukṛñojvidhānam| vārttikomataditi kaiyaṭaharadattādayaḥ| iṣṭiriti mādhavādayaḥ| kiṃkaraśabde'cā ṭasya bādhātavāsmi kiṃkarītyasādhuriti kaiyaṭaharadattādayaḥ| `huṃtyaja tyaja tavāsmi kiṃkareti śrīharyaḥ| nayāsakārāstu haitvādau pūrvasūtreṇa ca eva| tena kiṃkarītyupapannamityāha| tasyāyamāśayaḥ| ahetvarthaṃ divetyādisūtramiti sarvasiddham| tadapavādasya kiṃyaditi vārtikasya sa eva viṣayaḥ| etenājvidhau hetvādyabhāva iti viśeṣaṇaṃ munitrayeṇa na dattamiti nirastam| tathāca hetuvivakṣāyāṃ ṭa upapanna eva| etena pūrvavipratiṣedhasya nirmṛlatvāditi tad‌dūpaṇamapāstam| uktamiprāyeṇaiva tatpravṛtteḥ| ataevoktiṃ vārtikameveti paṭhanti prāñcaḥ| naca pakṣekarmaṇyaṇ prasaṅgaḥ| ajabhāve divāvibheti ṭasyaiva pravṛtteḥ| naca sūtre kimādigrahaṇāpanayanasya haradattādibhiruktatvātkatha taditi vācyam uktaprayojanasaṃbhave tadapanayasya durniścayatvāt| anye tu iha kimādigrahaṇamapanīya pacādiṣveva `kiṃyattadbahuṣu kṛña' ityeva pāṭham| vārtikasyāpyayemavāśayaḥ| tathāca karmaṇyaṇo bādhāccaritārthamuktavārtikam| hetvādivivakṣāyāṃ paratvāṭṭena bādhyate tena puṃyogaṃ vināpi kiṃkarīti syādevetyāhuḥ|| karmaṇi bhṛtau || 22 || karmaśabde upapade kṛñaṣṭo bhṛtau gamyāyām| karmakaro bhṛtakaḥ| naca kṛtrimākṛtrimayorityarthagrahaṇāpattiḥ| punaḥ karmapadopādānasāmarthyāt| anyatra karmakāraḥ|| na śabdaślokakalahagāthāvairacāṭusūtramantrapadeṣu || 23 || hetvādiṣu prāptasya ṭasya pratiṣedho'yam| śabdakāra ityādi || stambaśakṛtorin || 24 || `vrīhivatsayoriti vaktavyam'| na śāle stambakaritā vapturguṇamapekṣate| iti mudrārākṣasam| śakṛtkarirvatsaḥ| anyatra stambakāraḥ| śakṛtkāraḥ|| haraterdṛtināthayoḥ paśauṃ || 25 || etayoḥ karmaṇorupapadayorharaterin paśau kartari| dṛtiharirnāthahariḥ paśuḥ| dṛtiścarmakoṣaḥ nātho nāsārajjuḥ|| phalegrahirātmambhariśca || 26 || ādye upapadasyaidantatvamin pratyayaśca nipātyate| phalāni gṛṇhāti phalegrahiḥ| dvitīye mumāgama in‌ca| ātmambhariḥ| cātkukṣimbharirudarambhariśca| `ātmodarakukṣiṣviti cāndrapāṭhāt| mṛdutarakarākārai stālotkarairudarambhariritiśrīharṣaḥ| chandasi vanasanarakṣimathām || 27 || ebhyaḥ karmaṇyupapade in| brahmavarni tvā kṣatravanim| brahma vanati kṣatraṃ vanatīti vigrahaḥ| vājasarni rayi masme suvīram| ye pathāṃ pathirakṣayaḥ| havirmathīnāmabhi| ejeḥ khaś || 28 || ṇyantasyekā nirdeśo na śuddhasya vyākhyānāt| śittvācchavādi| arurdviṣaditi mum| janamejayati janamejayaḥ| yattu bhaviṣye- janmanaivātiśuddhena ripūnejitavān yataḥ| ejiśca kampane dhāturjanmejaya iti smṛtaḥ|| ityuktam| tatrocchadvābhāve'pi ucchabdayogaṃ vināpi anupasargāllimpavindetyādinā śapratyayaḥ| chāndasatvānnairuktavyutpattervābodhyaḥ| `khaś‌prakaraṇevātaśunītilaśarddheṣvajadheṭ‌tudajahātibhya upasaṃkhyānam'| vātamajā mṛgāḥ śunindhayaḥ| khityanavyayasyetihrasvaḥ| tilaṃtudaḥ| śardhaṃjahā māṣāḥ| śarddho'pānaśabdaḥ| taṃ jahatītyanatarbhāvitaṇyartha iti mādhavādayaḥ| garddheti pāṭhastu bhāṣyavṛttyādiviruddhaḥ| sarvatrārurdviṣaditi mum| nāsikāstanayo dharmādheṭoḥ || 29 || atra yathāsaṃkhyabādhanārthaṃ vārtikam| `stane gheṭo nāsikāyāṃ dhmaśceti vaktavyam'| stanandhayo bālaḥ| dheṭaṣṭitvasyāvayave'caritārthatvān ṅīp| stanandhatī| pratyāyāntare tu ṅīp neṣyate iti vardhamāna kṣīrasvāmi haradattādayaḥ| tena śapratyaye kapratyaye ca ṭābeveti saṃpradāyaḥ| nāsikaṃdhamaḥ| nāsikaṃdhayaḥ| `dhaṭīkhārīkharīṣūpasaṃkhyānam' ghaṭindhamaḥ| dhaṭindhaya ityādi| nāḍīmuṣṭyośca || 30 || dhmādheṭorityanuvartate| yathāsaṃkhyenoti bhāṣyavṛttyādayaḥ| ubhayatrāpi pūrvanipātavyatyayo yathāsaṃkhyābhāvajñāpaka ityāhuḥ| yathāsaṃkhyasūtre nāḍīmuṣṭyośceti bhāṣyaṃ tu prāptimātrābhiprāyam| nārḍidhamaḥ| nārḍidhayaḥ| udi kūle rujivahoḥ || 31 || utpūrvābhyāṃ rujivahibhyāṃ kūle karmaṇyupapade khaś‌rujobhaṅge vahaprāpaṇe| kūlamudrujaḥ| kūlamudvahaḥ| uditi pañcamyarthe saptamī| vahoriti pañcamyarthe ṣaṣṭhī| tato na yathāsaṃkhyamiti kaiyaṭaḥ| asatvavācinyucchabde karmaṇītyasyānvayāsaṃbhavācceti dīkṣitāḥ| tena prāgdhātoriti sūtre `upasarjana saṃnipāta' iti vārtikaṃ tu dvayorupapadatvabhramavatpuruṣābhiprāyamiti kaiyaṭe eva spaṣṭam| vahābhre lihaḥ || 32 || vahaṃ skandhaṃ leḍhi vahaṃliho gauḥ| abhraṃliho vāyuḥ| abhraṃlihāḥ parvatā ityādau saṃyogo liherarthaḥ| sārvadhātukamapiditi khaśo ṅitvānna guṇaḥ| parimāṇe pacaḥ || 33 || prasthaṃpacā sthālī khāriṃpacaḥ kaṭāhaḥ| mitanakhe ca || 34 || `kadarye kṛpaṇakṣudrakiṃpacanamitaṃpacāḥ'| nakhaṃpacā yavāgūḥ| paciratra kleśārthaḥ| kucabhāro na nakhaṃpacaḥ priyasyeti māghaḥ| vidhvaruṣostudaḥ || 35 || vidhutudaḥ| aruntudaḥ mumi kṛte saṃyogāntasyeti salopaḥ| aruntudastu marmaspṛgityamaraḥ| arurvraṇaṃ tudatīti| vraṇavedhasya vyathātiśaye hetutvāt| vraṇostriyīmīrmarurityamaraḥ| asūryalalāṭayordṛśitapoḥ || 36 || sūryaṃ na paśyantītyasūryaṃ paśyā rājadārāḥ| naño dṛśianvayātsūryaśabdena samamasāmarthye'pi samāso vacanasāmarthyāt| guptiviśeṣecātra tātparyam| na sūryadarśanābhāve| sūryabhinnadarśane vā| tatra tu na khaś| anabhidhānāditi vadanti| tanna| śrṛṇuta śrṛṇutāsūryaṃpaśyā na sā kila bhāvinīti śrīharṣeṇāsūryaṃ paśyānāmavadhigiri pāścātyadṛṣadāmiti vidyānāthena ca prayuktatvāt| ugraṃpaśyerammadapāṇiṃdhamāśca || 37 || ete nipātyante| ugraṃ yathā syāttathā paśyati ityugraṃpaśyaḥ| irayā udakena mādyati jvalati irammado medhajyotiḥ| tipātanānna śyan| pāṇayo dhmāyante'tra pāṇindhamo'ndhakārādyāvṛto'dhvā| tatra sarpādiśaṃkayā tadapanodāya pāṇiśabdakaraṇāt| durgamatvamātre tātparyam| śastrāśastrikayaiva kānanabhavagdīvārṇapāṇindhamāḥ panthāno divi saṃkucanti vandhyā na sūte bhaṭāniti murāriḥ| priyavaśe vadaḥ khac || 38 || priyaṃvadaḥ| aniṣṭhuroktiḥ| vadasthairye ityasmādvaśavado bodhyaḥ| vaśe vadati vartate iti vyutpattiḥ| khaśā rūpanirvāhe'pi prtayayāntaramuttarārtham| tatrāpi prayojanaṃ tu vakṣyate| iha karaṇaṃ tvanyato'pi khajiti jñāpanārtham| tadeva vārtikenoktam- `gameḥ supyupasaṃkhyānam| naceha gamaśceti sūtreṇa siddhiḥ| tasya saṃjñāyāme pravṛtteḥ| mitaṃgamā hastinī| `vihāyaso vihaḥ khac‌ca vibhāṣā ḍidvaktavyaḥ'| vihaṃgamaḥ| ḍitvapakṣe ṭilopaḥ| khaśi tu ārdhadhātukatvānupapattyā idaṃ na syāt| sārvadhātukatvena śap ca syāt| dviṣatparayostāpeḥ 39 || dviṣantaṃ tāpayati dviṣantapaḥ| paraṃtapaḥ| dviṣatītāpa ityatra na| liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣāyā anityatvāt| vāci yamo vrate || 40 || vākśabde upapade yameḥ khac vrate gamye| vācaṃyamo maunavratī| aśaktyādinā maunavrate tu karmaṇyaṇ| vāgyāmaḥ|| pūḥ sarvayordārisahoḥ || 41 || puraṃdaraḥ| vācaṃyamapuraṃdarauceti amantatvam| sarvaṃsahaḥ| atra haradattaḥ| vāci yama iti sūtrasya| puridāretyaṃśasyaca vaiyarthyam| vācaṃyamapuraṃdarau cetyanenaiva khac pratyayasyāpi saṃmbhavāt| vrataviṣayatvasyāpi nipātanabalādeva lābhāt| tathācātra sarve saha ityeva sūtraṃ yuktamiti| dārīti dṝvidāraṇe eva gṛhyate natudṝbhaye dṛṅ‌ādare iti saṃpradāyaḥ| sahigrahaṇamasaṃjñārtham| saṃjñāyāṃ vakṣyamāṇatvāt| sarvakūlābhrakarīṣeṣu kaṣaḥ || 42 || sarvaṃkaṣaḥ khalaḥ| kūlaṃkaṣā nadī| abhraṃkaṣo vāyuḥ| karīṣaṃkaṣā vātyā| doḥ saṃdohavaśīkṛtatribhuvanaśrīgarvasarvaṃkaṣa iti murāriḥ| meghartibhayeṣu kṛñaḥ || 43 || medhaṃkaraḥ| khatiṃkaraḥ| bhayaṃkaraḥ| tadantavidhinā abhayaṃkaraḥ| kṣemapriyamadre'ṇ ca || 44 || cātkhac| kṣemaṃkaraḥ| kṣemakāra ityādi| vetyapahāyāṇ‌grahaṇaṃ detvādau ṭapratyayābhāvārtham| alpārambhāḥ kṣemakarā iti karmaṇaḥ śeṣatvavivakṣāyām| aśite bhuvaḥ karamabhāvayoḥ || 45 || āśito bhavatyanenāśitaṃbhava odanaḥ| atithyādibhojanaparyāpta ityarthaḥ| āśitasya bhavanaṃ āśitaṃbhavaḥ| vāsarūpavidhinā lyuḍapi| āśitabhavanaḥ| āśitabhavanam| ghañ‌tu sarūpatvādbādhyate iti vṛttikārādayaḥ| yattu ktalyuṭtumun khalartheṣu vāsarūpavidherabhāvādayukta eva lyuḍiti tanna| tasya yatra ktādīnāṃ ghañādibādhakatvena prasaktistanmātraparatvāt| atra tu lyuṭo'pavādaḥ khac| na tu khaco lyuḍiti vāsarūpavidherdurvāratvāt| ktādīnāṃ bādhakatvasthale na vā sarūpanyāyo, bādhyatvasthale tvastyeveti paryavasānāditi dīkṣitāḥ|| saṃjñāyāṃ bhṛtṝvṛjidhārisahitapidamaḥ || 46 || viśvaṃbharā bhūḥ| rathana tarati rathantaram| sāmani kevalaṃ rūḍhametat| pyutpattiphalaṃ tu rathantaramājabhāvā vasiṣṭha ityādau kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodāttatvamavagrahaśca| akhaṇḍatve nab‌viṣayasyetyādyudāttanikhagrahatvayoḥ prasaṅgāt| patiṃvarā kanyā| śatruṃjayo hastī| yugandharaḥ parvataviśeṣaḥ| yugandhare dadhi prāśyeti bhāratam| śatruṃ sahaḥ| śatruṃtapaḥ| ariṃdamaḥ| śamanārthatvātsakarmakatvam| ṇyarthāntarbhāvo vā|| gamaśca || 47 || sutaṃgamaḥ || antātyantādhvedūrapārasarvānanteṣu ḍaḥ || 48 || saṃjñāyāmiti nivṛttam| antaṃ gacchatītyantagaḥ ityādi| ` sarvatrapannayorupasaṃkhyānam'| sarvatragaḥ| pad‌bhyāṃ gacchati pannagaḥ| `uraso lopaśca'| uragaḥ| `suduroradhikaraṇe' sukhena gamyate'tra sugaḥ| duḥkhena durgaḥ| `niso deśe'nirgamyate yasmānnirgaḥ| vastutastu `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate'iti vaktavyam| grāmagaḥ gurutalpaga ityādi|| āśiṣi hanaḥ || 49 || ḍaḥ syāt| śatruṃ vadhyāt śatruhaḥ| śatruhananāśrayaprakārakecchāviśeṣaaya ityarthaḥ| āśiṣi kim| śatruṃ hanti śatrughātaḥ| `dārāvāhano'ṇantasya ca ṭaḥ saṃjñāyām' dārvāghāṭaste vanaspatīnām| `cārauve'ti vācyam| cārvādhāṭaḥ| cārvāghātaḥ `karmaṇasamica'| varṇān saṃhanti varṇasaṃghāṭaḥ varṇasaṃghāṭaḥ| padasaṃghātaḥ| padasaṃghātaḥ| ape kleśatamasoḥ || 50 || apapūrvāddhanteretayorupapadayorḍaḥ| anāśīrartha ārambhaḥ| kleśāpahaḥ putraḥ tamopahaḥ sūryādiḥ| kumāraśīrṣayorṇiniḥ || 51 || kumāraghātī| śirasaḥ śīrṣabhāvo nipātanāt| śīrṣaghātī| lakṣaṇe jāyāpatyoṣṭak || 52 || lakṣaṇeti kartṛviśeṣaṇam| lakṣaṇavati kartari anayoruvapapadayorhanateṣṭak| jāyāghno manuṣyaḥ| patighrī strī| tatsūcakalakṣaṇāśraya ityarthaḥ|| amunuṣyakartṛke ca || 53 || jāyāghnaḥ tilakaḥ| patighnī pāṇirekhā| tatsūcakatvamarthaḥ| pittaghnaṃ ghṛtam| amanuṣyeti kim| ākhudhātaḥ śudraḥ| pralambadhnaśatrukṛtaghnādayo mūlavibhujāditvāt| coradhāto nagaraghāto hastītyādayo bāhulakāt| śaktau hastikapāṭayoḥ || 54 || śaktau dyotyāyāṃ hanteṣṭak| manuṣyakartṛkārthamārambhaḥ| hastighno nā| kapāṭaghnaścauraḥ| kavāṭetipāṭhe yavāditvādvatvamiti svāmī| kutsitamaṭati kavāṭam| aṭateḥ paṭādyac| kavaṃcoṣṇa iti yogavibhāgātkavādeśa iti haradattaḥ| svabalena hantuṃ sāmarthyaṃ śaktipadārthaḥ| pāṇighatāḍaghau śilpini || 55 || hanteṣṭak‌ ṭilopaghatvāni nipātyante| śilpini kim| pāṇighāta ityādi| `rājadhasyopasaṃkhyānam'| rarāja nīrājanayā sa rājaghaḥ| ndhapriyeṣucvyartheṣvacvau kṛñaḥ karaṇe khyun || 56 || cvyartheṣvacvyanteṣu āḍhyādiṣūpapadeṣu kṛñaḥ khyun syāt| anāḍhamāḍhyaṃ kurvantyanena āḍhyaṃkaraṇam| acvau kim| āḍhyīkaraṇam| atra lyuḍeva| nanu cvāvapi ravyuni doṣābhāvāda cvāviti vyartham| rūpasvarayoraviśeṣāt| ṅī paścanañ‌snañīkak‌khyuṃstarūṇatalunānāmiti khyuno'pi vidheyatvāt| khyuni upapadasamāsasyeva lyuṭi gatisamāsasyāpi nityatvāt| litsvareṇa nitsvareṇa vā kṛña ādyudāttasāmyāt| mumūhrasvayoścānavyayasyeti paryudāsāt| cvyantasyāvyayatvāt| atrabhāṣyam| uttarārthaṃ taditi| tathāca kevalottarārthatve bhāṣyavārtikaprāmāṇyānnīrṇīte cvau lyuḍ‌bhavatyeva| vṛttikārāstu uttaratraiva grahaṇāpattyā ihakiṃcittrapo iti nyāyenātragrahaṇasāmarthyāllyuḍapi netyāhuḥ| taccintyam| kartari bhuvaḥ khiṣṇuc‌khukañau || 57 || pūrvaviṣaye kartari bhavatereto staḥ| anāḍhyaāḍhyo bhavatyā ḍhayaṃbhāvukaḥ| āḍhyaṃ bhaviṣṇuḥ| nārācauḥ kṛtavīryanandanavadhūbāṣpapriyaṃbhāvukairiti munarāriḥ| kartṛgrahaṇaṃkaraṇānuvṛttibhramanirāsārthamuttarārthaṃceti saṃpradāyaḥ| nacāsvaritatvādevānanuvṛttisiddhiḥ| agatikagatitvāt| atravartikam| iṣṇucaikārāditvamudāttatvātkṛtaṃ bhuvaḥ| nañastu svarasidhyarthamikārāditvamiṣṇucaḥ|| asyārthaḥ-bhuvaḥ seṭ‌tvādvalādilakṣaṇeneṭaiva siddhau khūṇṇujeva vidheyo natviṣṇuc| naca khakārasya carttve kṛte k‌ṣṇurityatra katvaṃ śatvaṃveti sandehāpattiḥ| vyākhyānato viśeṣapratipatteḥ| ityākṣepaḥ| nañ‌samāse'nāḍhyaṃbhaviṣṇurityatra kṛtyokeṣaaṇuccārvādayaśceti antodāttārthamiti samādhānam| anyathā tatrālaṃkṛñityādinā vihatasya pratipadoktasyai veṣṇuco grahaṇaṃ syāt| snupratyaye ṣatvaṇatvayorasiddhatayā ṣṇuiti rūpābhāvācca| nanu cakārānubandhamātreṇāpyetatsiddham| naca svarārthatayā tadanyathāsiddhiḥ| pratyayasvareṇāntodāttasiddheḥ| pratyayasvare āgamānāmavidyamānavadbhāvasyoktatvāt| yattu haradattaḥ| ṣatvaṇatvayoḥ sāmarthyādasya grahaṇamiti tadrahitapratyayāpekṣayā tatsahitapratyayavidhāne prakriyālāghavena sāmarthyopakṣayāt| sarvathāpi tvikāro vyartha eveti| maivam| tadanubandhakagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tatrakhiṣṇuconupādānāpatteḥ| ikārīccāraṇasāmarthyāttu tadbādhāt| nacacakārasāmarthyam| vinigamakābhāvāt| spṛśo'nudake kvin || 58 || udakabhinne supyupapade kartari spṛśeḥ kin| dhṛtaspṛk| karmaṇīti nivṛttam| yadyapi spṛśeḥ sakarmakatvātkarmaṇītyasyānuvṛttiryuktā tathāpi pūrvasūtre kṛrtṛgraṇasyaitadarthatvāttadvaiyarthaayaparihārāya karmaṇyupapade ekaḥ kartā karaṇādau cānya iti kartṛpratyayārtharāya karmaṇyupapade ekaḥ kartā karaṇādau cānya iti kartṛpratyayārthatvāt ubhayatra siddhiḥ| supyupapade ityasya paryaksānāditi prāñcaḥ| dīkṣitāstu mantraspṛgiti kvipaiva siddham| kvin‌pratyayo yasmādityarthāśrayaṇenānyatrāpi kutvavidhānātyāhuḥ| atra nakāro na nitsvarārthaḥ ekāca evaitadvidhānena viśeṣābhāvāt| dadhṛgityatra cāntodāttasya nipātayiṣyamāṇatvāt| kvinpratyayasyetyatra kvipratyayasyeti pāṭhādeva siddheḥ| ekapakārako dvipakārako vā nirdeśa iti saṃdehasya vyākhyānānnivṛtteḥ| tadanubandhakaparibhāṣayā ca kvipo'nupādānāt| ṛtvig‌dadhṛg‌sradgiguṣṇigañcuyujikṛñcāṃ ca || 59 || ādyāḥ pañca kvinnantā nipātyante| tribhyaḥ kvin vidhīyate| alākṣaṇikamapi kiñcitkāryaṃ nipātanalabhyam| ṛtāvupapade yajeḥ kvin| dhṛṣordvitvamantodātttvaṃ ca| sṛjeḥ karmaṇi kvin| ramāgamaśca| diśeḥ karmaṇi| utpūrvāt sniheḥ kvin upasargatakārasya lopaḥ ṣatvaṃ ca| añceḥ supyupapade kvin| yujerapi| kruñcernalopābhāvaśca| tyadādiṣu dṛśo'nālocane kañca || 60 || cātkvin| tādṛśaḥ tādṛk| ā sarvanāmna ityātvam| evaṃ yādṛśa ityādi| ñakāra ādyudāttārthaḥ| nakārema tatsiddhāvapi kañ‌kvarabityatra viśeṣaṇārthatvāt| tatra kan ityuktau apamityayācitābhyāṃ kakvanāviti vihite kanyatiprasaṅgāt| `samānānyayorupasaṃkhyānam' dṛgdṛśeti sādeśaḥ| sadṛśaḥ sadṛk| nanu kartaryayaṃ prāpnoti karmaṇi| karmaṇa eva saukaryātkartṛtvavivakṣaṇāt| tamivemaṃ janāḥ paśyanti soyaṃ saiva dṛśyamānastamivātmānaṃ paśyatītyarthaḥ| rūḍhyarthānukūlyamātreṇa cedamuktam| vastutaḥ sādṛśyamātrapratīteḥ| satsūdviṣadruhaduhayujavidabhidacchidajinīrājāmupasarge'pi kvip || 61 || supyupapade ebhyaḥ kvip| upasarge satyasati vā| supītyanuvṛttāvapi upasargagrahaṇamanyatra subgrahaṇe upasargagrahaṇaṃ neti jñāpanārtham| tena vadaḥ supītyatrānupasargagrahaṇamanārabhyam| dusadityatra tu na chandasītyanuvṛtteḥ| diviṣada ityatra tu suṣāmāditvātṣatvamiti mādhavādayaḥ| sadādiṣu keṣāñcit sakarmakatve'pi na karmaṇītyasyaiva tatrānvayaḥ| kintu summātrasya| hotā vediṣadatithirduroṇamat| vedyāṃ sīdatīti vediṣat| pūrvapadāditi ṣatvam| duroṇe gṛhe sīdatīti duroṇasat| upanipūrvātsade rviśaraṇārthātkvipi upaniṣatpadaṃ vyutpāditam| upanīyādvayaṃ brahma savāsanāmavidyāṃ hinastīti brahmavidyāmāha| taddhetutvādvedāntā adādinā dviṣā sāhacaryāt| na tudādidivādyoḥ suvati sūyatyoḥ| dviṣaaprītau| druha jighāṃsāyām| duha prapūraṇe| yujasamādhau| yujijiryoge iti dvayorapyupādānam| videtyakārānubandhasya vivakṣitatvādvidajñāne vidavicāraṇe vidamattāyāmityete gṛhyante| natu vid‌lṛiti| bhid‌lṛvidāraṇe| chidir dvaidhīkaraṇe ṇīñ‌ prāpaṇe rājṛdīptau| aṇḍasūḥ| prasūrityādi| agragrāmābhyāṃ nayaterṇo vācyaḥ| sa eṣāṃ grāmaṇīriti nirdeśāt| sarvalopi pratyayaviṣayañcedaṃ dharmigrāhakapramāṇāt| tena grāmanāya ityādau na| bhajo ṇviḥ || 62 || aṃśabhāk| prabhāk| ṇitvādvṛddhiḥ| chandasi sahaḥ || 63 || ṇivaḥ syāt| duścayavanaḥ pṛtanāṣāḍayudhyaḥ| sahiratrābhivārthaḥ| vahaśca || 64 || dityavāṭ ca me dityauhi ca me| yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ|| kavyapuriṣapurīṣyeṣuñyuṭ || 65 || kavyavāhanaḥ purīṣavāhanaḥ purīṣyavāhanaḥ| havye'nantaḥ pādam || 66 || havyaśabde upapade vahecchandasi ñyucaṭ pādānte| anantaḥ pādamityanena pratyayāntasya caraṇottarapādāvayavānantargatatvokteḥ| agniśaaca havyavāhanaḥ| pādānte kim| kavyavāḍagnirajaraḥ pitā naḥ| janasanakhanakramagamo viṭ || 67 || jana janane janī prādurbhāve ṣaṇa dāne ṣaṇu sambhaktau dvayorgrahaṇamiti saṃpradāyaḥ| viḍ‌vanorityanunāsikasyātvam| abjā gojāḥ| goṣā indro asi| sanoterana iti ṣatvam| iyaṃ śuṣmebhirvisakhā ivārujat| ādidhikrāḥ| śavase pañca kṛṣṭīḥ| vāyuragregā yajñaprīḥ| ado'nanne || 68 || chandasīti nivṛttam| annaśabde upapade ado viṭ| grāmāt sasyāt| ananne kim| annādaḥ| kravyeca || 69 || kravyāt| āmamāṃsabhoktetyarthaḥ| pūrveṇa siddhe'ṇ‌bādhārthamārambhaḥ| kravyāda iti tu pakvamāṃsaśabdādaṇ| pṛṣodarāditvādupapadasya kravyādeśaśca| kravyāda ityaṇ na bhavatītyākarasya tu āmamāṃsabhakṣaka ityarthavivakṣāyāmityarthaḥ| duhaḥ kab‌ ghaśca || 70 || kāmaṃ kāmadughe dhukṣva| avehi māṃ kāmadughāṃ prasannām| mantreśvetavahokthaśaspuroḍāśoṇvin || 71 || ? śvetādāvupapade vahādibhyo ṇvin| alākṣaṇikakāryārthaṃ nipātanam| śvetā evaṃ vahanti śvetavā indraḥ| kartṛvācini śvetaśabde vaheḥ karmaṇi pratyayaḥ| ukthāni uktairvā śaṃsatyukthaśā yajamānaḥ| ukthe karmaṇi karaṇe vā śaṃsernalopaśca| puro dāśanta etamiti puroḍāḥ| puraḥ śabde dāśṛdāne ityasmātkarmaṇi pratyayo dasyaḍatvaṃ ca| `śvetavahādīnāṃ haspadasyeti vaktavyam' yatra ḍasantasya padatvaṃ bhaviṣyati tatra ḍhaspratyayo'nyatra ṇvinnevetyarthaḥ| ayaṃcāve yaja ityetadvihitasyāpi ṇvino'pavādaḥ| śvetavā indraḥ| śvetavobhyāṃ śvetavobhiḥ| padasya kim| śvetavāhau śvetavāhaḥ| nacaivamavayāḥ śvetavā iti nipātanavaiyarthyam| atvasantasyetyeva dīrghasiddheriti vācyam| he śvetavā iti sambudhyarthatvāt| naca ḍas vaiyarthyam| śvetavobhyā mityādyarthatvāt| naca rutvanipātanasya padamātraviṣayakatvamiti vācyam| ākārātparasya utvābhāve rūpāsiddhitādavasthyāt| ukśaśā iti sambuvyarthaṃ nipātanaṃ kartavyaṃ yadi mantre darśanamastīti kaiyaṭādayaḥ| ave yajaḥ || 72 || avaśabde upapade yajerṇviḥ syānmantre| tvaṃ yajñe varuṇasyāvayā asi| avayajata ityavayāḥ| avayājauavayājaḥ| avayobhyāmityādi| yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ| vijupe chandasi || 73 || upetyupapade yajervicchandasi| upayaṭ ḍapayajau upayajaḥ| upayaḍibharūrdhvaṃ yajanti tadupayajāmupayaṭ‌tvam| nacānyebhyo'pi dṛśyate iti siddhiḥ| upayajaḥ chandasyeveti niyamārthatvāt| citkaraṇaṃ verapṛktasyeti sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārtham|| āto manin kvanib‌vanipaśca || 74 || supi upasarge upapade ādantāddhātorete trayaḥ syuḥ chandasi| cādvic| sudāmā sudhīvā| supīvā bhūridāvā| ghṛtaṃ ghṛtapāvānaḥ| kīlālaye somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase| aśva iva tiṣṭhatyaśvatthāmā| anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante || 75 || chandasīti nivṛttam| catvāraḥ pratyayā dhātvantarādapi syuḥ| suṣṭu śṛṇoti suśarmā| neḍ‌vaśīti neṭ| prātareti prātaritvā| pittvāttuk| vijāyate| vijāvā| viṅ‌vanorityātvam| oṇṛ apanayane| avāvā| ṇasyātve avādeśāḥ| roṭ‌ reṭ‌ sugaṇ| dṛśigrahaṇaṃ prayogānusārārtham| kvipca || 76 || ayamapi prāgvat| satsūdviṣetyasyaiva prapañcaḥ| apiśabdānuvṛtyā sarvadhātubhyaḥ chandasi bhāṣāyāṃ cetyarthaḥ| ukhāyāḥ sraṃsate ukhāsrat| parṇād dhvaṃsate parṇadhvat| vasusraṃsviti datvam| vāhāt‌bhraśyati vāhabhraṭ| vraśceti ṣaḥ| vahābhraḍiti vṛttiḥ| vahaḥ skandhaḥ| anyeṣāmapīti upapadāntasya dīrgha iti haradattaḥ| sthaḥ ka ca || 77 || cātkvip‌| pūrvoktena kvipā supi stha iti ca kasya siddhau śamidhātorityaco vādhārthamārambhaḥ| śesthaḥ| śaṃsthāḥ ītvamavakārādāviti vacanādbhāvaṣyaprayogādvā pratyayalakṣaṇenetvābhāva iti kaiyaṭaḥ| idaṃca pratyayaprādhānye'l‌vidhyarthaṃ pratyayalakṣaṇasūtramitipakṣe| niyamārthamiti pakṣe tu analvidhāviti niṣedhānna sthānivattvamiti dīkṣitāḥ|| nanu śamidhātorityetaduttarameva sthaḥ kaceti sūtryatām| cakāro'csamuccayārthaḥ| savarmadīrghe sesthā iti siddham| evaṃcotsargapavādayoḥ samānadeśatvamītvasyāprasaktiśceti lāghavam| atrāhuḥ| evaṃ satyasaṃsthā ityatra ackāvaśaktāviti uttarapadāntodāttatvaṃ syāt| kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā saṃsthāśabdasyājantatvāt| kvibantena nañsamāse tu avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇād‌yudāttateti|| supyajātauṇinistācchīlye || 78 || ajātyarthe supyupapade tācchīlye dyotye ṇiniḥ syāt| supīti vartamāne sub‌grahaṇamanupasarga ityasya nivṛttyarthaṃ summātre yathā syāt| udāsariṇyaḥ pratyāsāriṇyaḥ| iti bhāṣyam| yattu sub‌grahaṇamupasarganivṛtyartham| `utpratibhyā māṅi sarterupasaṃkhyāna' miti jayāditya haradattamādhavādayaḥ| tadbhāṣyaviruddhamiti spaṣṭameva| ataeva `liṅgaśeṣavidhirvyāpī' `sa babhūvopajīvinā' mityādiprayogāḥ| ajātau kim| brāhmaṇānāmantrayitā| tṛnā tācchīlyadyotanam| tācchīlye kim| kadāciduṣṇaṃ bhuṅkte| `sādhukāriṇyusekhyānam' sādhukārī| sādhudāyī| brahmaṇi badaḥ|' brahmavādino vadanti| saugatabrahmavādinorayaṃ viśeṣaḥ| tattācchīlyārthaṃ vacanadvayamiti kaiyaṭaharadattādayaḥ| nanvevaṃ brahmavādiśabdasya tacchīlataddharmatatsādhukāriparatayā bhaṭṭavārtikavyākhyānamasaṃgataṃ syāditi cet| atrāhuḥ-supyajātāviti tācchīlye upasaṃkhyānena sādhukāriṇi āvaśyakādhamarṇyayoriti ṇinistaddharme paryavasannaḥ| evaṃcoktavārtikena tācchīlyādivirahe ṇinerumasaṃkhyāne'pi tacchīlādāvapi tasya sulabhatvāt| ākverityadhikāre ṇinividhāyakaṃ vārtikamastīti kalpanaṃ tu nirmūlameveti| kartaryupamāne || 79 || atācchīlyārthaṃ jātyarthaṃ sādṛśyārthaṃ ca sūtram| upapadārthaḥ prtayayārthasya karturupamānam| uṣṭrakrośī dhvāṃkṣarāvī| yadyapi uṣṭrasadṛśakrośanāśraya iti bodhaḥ| tatropapadārthapratyayārthayorabhedānvayasyānyatrādṛṣṭatvāt| etenoṣṭrasya sādṛśyārthatayā tasyāśrayatvena pratyayānvayopyanāśaṅkyaḥ| tathāpi sādṛśyaṃ ṇinyarthaḥ| tatra pratiyogitayā upapadārthasyānvayaḥ| sādṛśyasya ca prayojakatayā dhātvarthe tasya svarūpasaṃbandhena pratyayārthāntare āśraye tasyābhedena devadattādau uṣṭrasādṛśyaprayojakakrośanāśrayābhinno devadatta itibodhaḥ| prakṛtyarthānvayātpūrvamapi pratyayārthe padāntarānvayasya vyutpannatvāt| kartarī kim| apūpāniva bhakṣayati māṣān| upamāne kim| uṣṭraḥ krośati|| vrate || 80 || ṇiniḥ syāt| sthaṇḍilaśāyī| yaḥ sthaṇḍile vratavaśāt śete sthaṇḍilaśāyyasāvityamaraḥ| ayācitāśī| aśrāddhabhojī| nacātra śrāddhabhojīśabdasya vrataviṣayatvābhāve'pi na śrāddhabhojīti alokikavigrahavākye ṇinyantena saha nañsamāsena siddhiḥ| ādyudāttāpatteḥ kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodāttasyeṣṭatvāt nacaṇinītyanena pūrvapadādyudāttasiddhiḥ| tatra saṃjñāyāmityanuvṛttipakṣe doṣaprasaṅgāt| atra na śrāddhasya bhojīti na vigrahaḥ| subupapade vinā bhojītyasyā sādhutvāt kintu śrāddhaṃ bhuṅkte iti vākyaṃ kṛtvā nañaḥ śrāddhena saha asamarthasamāsaṃ kṛtvā aśrāddhaśabde upapade ṇinirvācyaḥ| nanu śrāddhīyatadbhinnayo rāgādbhojanaprasaktau śrāddhabhojananiṣedhamātraṃ vidhyartho natvaśrāddhīyaṃ bhojanamapi peca paṃñca nakhā bhakṣyā itivat| tatkathaṃ yadā aśrāddhaṃ nabhuṅkte tadāsya vratalopaḥ syāditi bhāṣyaṃ saṃgacchate iticet atra kaiyaṭaḥ| aśrāddhaṃmayā bhoktavyameveti yena saṃkalpaḥ kṛtaḥ sa yadā bubhukṣāyāṃ satyāṃ yasminnahanyaśrāddhaṃ na bhuṅkte tasya syādeva vratalopa iti| bahulamābhīkṣṇe || 81 || suppupapade ṇiniḥ paunaḥ punye dyotye| kṣīrapāyiṇa uśīnarāḥ| kaṣāyapāyino gāndhāyāḥ| sāmarthyecchayā pānāntarābhāvādvā kaṣāyapānaṃ natu tācchīlyāt| manaḥ || 82 || manajñāne iti daivādikasya grahaṇaṃ natu manu avabodhane ityasya uttarasūtre khaśi śyano'nupapattiprasaṅgāt| supi manyaterṇiniḥ syāt| darśanīyamānī| ātmamāne khaśca || 83 || khasyaiva manyarthakarmatve khaś cāṇiṇniḥ| naca vāsarūpavidhinaiva siddhiri vācyam| karaṇe yajaityādau ṇinerevānuvṛtyarthaṃ tadavacchedāya samūccayokteḥ| paṇḍitamātmānaṃ manyate paṇḍitemanyaḥ| paṇḍitamānī| māna iti ghañ| ātmana iti karmaṣaṣṭyantena samāsaḥ| mati śabda iha lakṣaṇayā ātmaviśeṣyakabhramaparaḥ| paṇḍitapadaṃ paṇḍitābhedaprakārakaparam| tasyābhedasaṃsargeṇa bhramānvayaḥ| āśrayaḥ kṛtpratyayārthaḥ| tathāca paṇḍitābhedaprakārakātmaviśeṣyakabhramāśrayaḥ ityarthaḥ| bhūte || 84 || adhikāro'yam| vartamāne laḍityetatparyantam| ghātvarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ cedam| dhātorityadhikārāt| naca bhūtakriyārthakādbhavateḥ ktapratyayo vidheyaḥ| tasmiṃśca bhūtaśabdasya bhūtakriyāviṣayatvalābha ityadhikārāśrayo niṣṭāpratyayastadāśrayaścādhikāra ityadhikārāśrayo niṣṭhādhikārāt| vastuto bhūtaśabdārthabodhe niṣṭhādividhivākyabodhasyānapikṣitatvānna doṣaḥ| atha prayojanāni| kumāraśīrṣayorṇinirityanena takrakoṇḍinyanyāyena bhūte ṇiniṃ bādhitvā bhaviṣyadvartamānayorṇinirvidhīyate| asati bhūtādhikāre dvayorapi sāmānye vidhānaṃ syāt| pūnarvidhervāsarūpanivṛttyarthatayāpyupapatteḥ| evaṃ brahmādiṣveva hanterbhūte kvibiti niyamena bhūtārtheupapadāntarāddhanteḥ| kpip nivartate| tevākhuhetyādau kālāntare bhavatyeva| eve suño vartamāne bhūte ca vihitayoḥ śatṛṅ‌vanipoḥ viṣayabhedānna bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ| bhūtavartamānobhayādhikārānārambhe tu yajñasaṃyoge viśeṣe vidhīyamānaḥ śatṛpratyayaḥ kālatraye'pi ṅ‌vanipaṃ bādheta| tataśca bhūte yajñasaṃyoge sutveti na syāt| naca vāsarūpanyāyena ṅ‌vanip‌siddhiḥ| sutvā sutvannityatra kālabhedaniyamo na syāt| evaṃ svaperbhūte liṭ| vartamāne najiṅitiṃ siddhiḥ| ubhayādhikārābhāve svapo viśeṣavihitena najiṅā liṭo bādhāpatteḥ| evamanehetyatra nañyāhana ehacetyasipratyayo vartamānakāle eva nṛnaṃ bādheta| asatyasmin kālāntare'pi bādhena| evaṃ bhūte kānac vartamāne cānaśiti cānaś‌ kānaco bādhako na bhavati| yadyapyabhyastānāmādirityasya lādeśasārvadhātukamātraviviṣayatvā ccānaśyapi tadapravṛtternaviśeṣaḥ tathāpi kānajātmanepaditvātkartrabhiprāye eva| cānaś tu aviśeṣeṇeti viśeṣo bodhyaḥ|| karaṇe yajaḥ || 85 || karaṇe upapade bhūtārthādyajeḥ kartari ṇiniḥ syāt| agniṣṭomeneṣṭavānagniṣṭomayājī| agniṣṭomena karaṇena svargaṃ bhāvitavāniti vṛttinyāsaharadattādayaḥ| teṣāṃ cāyamāśayaḥ| svargotpādanarūpe sāmānyavyāpāre| viśeṣyavyāpāre agniṣaaṭomākhye yāgaḥ karaṇaṃ yadyapi svayamasiddhaḥ sādhanatvāpatyanarhatayā anuṣṭhīyamānatvātkarma tathāpi śaktibhedātkaraṇatvamapyupapannam| nipīyamānena madhunā mattaḥ kokila iti pānakarmaṇo madhuno mādanakriyāyāṃ karaṇatvadarśanāt| yajyādau dve rūpe dhātutvaṃ sāmānyaṃ yajitvādiśca viśeṣaḥ| tatra dātutvena dhātupāttāṃ bhāvanāṃ prati yajitvādinā rūpeṇopasthāpitasya aṃśāntarasya karaṇatvenānvayaḥ| ataeva bhāvanā tiṅartha iti mīmāṃsakamatamupekṣyamiti| idaṃ tviha vaktavyam| vidhivākye yathā tathāstu| idaṃ tvanuvādavākyam| atraca bhāvanāyā aṃśatrayasākāṅkṣatvaṃ nāstyeva phalāśasya sāmānyataḥ svargāditvādinā vā rūpeṇānanubhavāt| ato'tra yāgasvarūpameva yajinopasthāpyate tṛtīyayā tu vidhivākyaprāptakaraṇatvasyaivānuvādaḥ| same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajetetyādivat| vidhāne cānuvādeca yāgaḥ karaṇamiṣyate| tatsamīpe tṛtīyāntastadvācitvaṃ na muñcati|| iti vārtikakṛtokteḥ vidhivākye ākṣepeṇa pratītasya sādhyatvasyānuvādavākyeṣu nānuvādo'pitu tatra pratītasya karaṇatvasyaiveti tadarthāt| ato vaiyākaraṇamate'pi jyotiṣṭomābhinnayāgakaraṇakabhāvanādhvaṃsāśraya ityeva dhīryuktā| mīmāṃsakamate tu bhāvanāyāstiṅarthatvādākṣepe cātra mānābhāvāt| jyotiṣṭomākhyayāgadhvaṃsāśraya ityeveti dik| karmaṇi hanaḥ || 86 || sahecetyetatparyantaṃ karmaṇītyadhikāraḥ| pitṛvyaṃ hatavān pitṛvyaghātī| atravṛttiḥ| `kutsitagrahaṇaṃ kartvyam'| iha na coraṃ hatavāniti| idaṃcakarmaṇīniriti sūtre vakṣyamāṇasya kutsitagrahaṇasyehāpakarṣalabhyam| pitṛvyavadhādikāṃ prati siddhakriyāṃ kurvāṇo yaḥ kartā kutsyate tatra bhavati nānyatreti nyāsakāraḥ| anye tu bhāṣyānumapi śabdaśaktibalāllabhyata ityāhuḥ| brahmabhrṛṇavṛtreṣu kvip || 87 || hano bhūte eṣu kpip| brahmahā bhrṛṇahā vṛtrahā| niyamārthaṃ sūtram| saca dhātūpapadakālapratyayānāṃ caturṇāmiti vṛttiḥ| dhātukālayoreveti bhāṣyam| tatra vṛtterayamabhiprāyaḥ| tathāca yatraivapapadeṣu hanterbhūte kvibiti atra vākyasya rūpam| tathāca yatraivapapadeṣu hanterbhūte kvibiti atra vākyasya rūpam| tathāca yatraivakāro tato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti nyāyāt brahmādiṣvevetyavadhāraṇasyānantaryāddhantiviṣayaṃ bhavati brahmādibhinnopapadasaṃnbandhanivṛttiphalako dhātuniyamaḥ| atraca bhūta ityaśrayaṇāt kālāntare'nyopapadādapi kpip bhavatyeva| puruṣaṃ hanti haniṣyati vā puruṣaheti| brahmādiṣu hantereva bhūte ityatra tu ānantaryasāmye'pi prāthamyādupapadaniyamaḥ| atrāpi bhūta ityāśrayaṇātkālāntare'nyasmādapi dhātorbhavatyeva| vṛtraṃ jayati jeṣyativā vṛtrājiditi| brahmādiṣu hanterbhūte eva kviviti prakṛtipratyayayorānantaryataulye'pi prādhānyātpratyayaniyamaḥ| atra brahmādiṣvityāśrayaṇāt puruṣaheti prāgvatsiddham| brahmādiṣu hanterbhūte kvibeveti kālaniyamaḥ| atrāpyupapadāntare bhūte'pi pratyayāntaraṃ bhaviṣyatyeva| pitṛvyaghātīti| niyamasya sopapadamātraviṣayakatvāt madhyepavādanyāyācca vṛtraṃ hatavāniti niṣṭhā bhavatyeva| tasmādvinigamakābhāvāccaturvidho'tra niyama iti siddham| etacca bhāṣyavirodhādupekṣyam| brahmādiṣveva hanterbhūte kpap nopapadāntare iti dhātuniyamaḥ| tena puruṣaṃ hatavānityatra nakvip| brahmādiṣu hanterbhūte kvibeva bhavati na pratyayāntaramiti kvipi bhūtakālo niyamyate iti kālaniyamaḥ| tena brahmādāvupapadehantermūte karmaṇi hana iti ṇinirna bhavati| ataevopapadāntare bhūte'pi kvip‌sidhyartha uttarasūtraṃ saṃgacchate| tathāca brahmādiṣu hantereva bhūte kvibityupapadaniyamo brahmādiṣu hanteḥ kvip bhūte eveti pratyayaniyamaśceti dvayaṃ bhāṣyānārūḍhatvādupekṣyamiti kaiyaṭaḥ| tenānyopapadāddhanterbhūte kvip brahmādyupapadāddhanterapi kālāntare bhavatyeva| puruṣaṃ hatavān puruṣahā| brahma karoti brahmakṛditi bodhyam| dhātukālaniyamāśrayaṇe ca lakṣyānurodha eva bījam| tena vinigamakābhāvo nirastaḥ| bhāṣyānusāreṇaiva lakṣyavyavasthitisiddheḥ| yattu atra vījamuktam| dhātukālayoḥ prakaraṇalakṣaṇajadhanya pramāṇena, upapadapratyayau tu śrutyopasthitau| ataḥ prakaraṇopasthitaviṣaya eva niyamo yukta iti| tanna| dhātukālānvayavyatireke vākyārthaniṣpatteścaturṇā mapi sāmyāt| prakaraṇopasthitistu śrutivirodha eva durbalā| nahyatra śrutyā tadbādho virodhābhāvāt| kintu kalpanīyavākyāntareṇeti bodhyam|| bahulaṃ chandasi || 88 || upapadāntare'pi hanterbahulaṃ kvip syāt| yo mātṛhā pitṛhā| mātṛghātaḥ| sukarmapāpamantrapuṇyeṣukṛñaḥ || 89|| sau karmādiṣu ca kṛñaḥ kvip| karmaṇītyanuvṛttasyāpi suśabdena samaṃ nānvayo'vyayatvena karmatvānupapatteḥ| kālopapadapratyayaviṣayastrividho niyama iti vṛttiḥ| bahulagrahaṇalabhyecaitaditinyāsakāraḥ| sukṛt karmakṛdityādi| bhūte eveti niyamānmantraṃ karoti kariṣyati veti vivakṣāyāṃ nakvipi| svādiṣu kṛña eveti niyamāt mantramadhitavānmantrādhyā ityatra nakvip| svādiṣu kuñaevetiniyamātkarmakṛtavānityatra nāṇ| svādiṣveva kṛña eveti niyamābhāvādupapadāntare'pi kvip| śāstrakṛt bhāṣyakṛt| some suñaḥ || 90 || somaṃ sutavān somasut| agnau caḥ || 91 || citavānagnimagnicit| ubhayatra caturvidho niyama iti vṛttiḥ| karmaṇyagnyākhyāyām || 92 || karmaṇyupapade tatraiva kārake ciñaḥ kvip| agnyādhānasthalaviśeṣākhyāyām| śyena iva śyenacit| iṣṭakābhiścayanena śyenākāratayā saṃpādita ityarthaḥ| karmaṇīnirvikriyaḥ || 93 || vipūrvātkrīṇāteḥ karmaṇyupapade iniḥ syāt| `kutsitagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam'| idaṃca punaḥ karmagrahaṇalabhyam| somavikrayī| ghṛtavikrayī| tasya pratyavāyajanakatvāttatkartuḥ kutsitatvam kutsite kim| dhānavikrāyaḥ| dṛśeḥ kvanip || 94 || anyebhyo pi dṛsyate iti siddhe niyamārtham| tena manināderaṇādeśca nivṛttiḥ| niṣṭhā tu bhavtayeva| pāraṃ dṛṣṭavāniti| pāraṃ dṛṣṭavān paśyati vā paradṛśvā| pratyayāntaranivṛtyarthatāyā vṛttikārādibhiruktatve'pi kālāntaranivṛttyarthatāyā anuktatvāt| rājani yudhikṛñaḥ || 95 || kvanip syāt| yudhirantarbhūtaṇijarthaḥ| rājānaṃ yodhitavān rājayudhvā rājakṛtvā| sahe ca || 96 || karmaṇīti nivṛttam| sahaśabdasyāsattvārthatvāt| kathayati pariśrāntiṃ rātrī tamaḥ sahayudhvanābhiti śrīharṣaḥ| sutrāmṇo vijayasahakṛtvā daśagtha iti murāriḥ| saptamyāṃ janerḍaḥ || 97 || sarasijam| sphuradurasijabhārabhaṅgurāṃgī| haladantādityaluk| mandurāyāṃ jāto mandurajaḥ| ṅyāporiti hrasvaḥ| pañcamyāmajātau || 98 || jātiśabdabhinne pañcamyante upapade janerḍaḥ| saṃskārajaḥ| adṛṣṭajaḥ|saṃskāratvamadṛṣṭatvaṃca najātirvyavasthāpakābhāvāditi vaiśeṣikāḥ| upasarge ca saṃjñāyām || 99 || prajāyate iti prajā| prajā syātsaṃtatau jane dhātūpapadapratyaya samudāyena saṃjñāyāṃ gamyāyāṃ| anau karmaṇi || 100 || anupūrvājja neḥ karmaṇyupapade ḍaḥ| pumāṃsamanurudhya jātā pumanujā| stryanujaḥ anurodhaviśiṣṭaṃ jananaṃ janerarthaḥ| tadekadeśānurodhāpekṣayā karmatvam| anyeṣvapi dṛśyate || 101 || upapadāntare'pi janerḍaḥ| ajaḥ brāhmaṇajaḥ| saptamīnirdeśādupapadāntarameva labdham| ato dhātvantaralābhārthamanyebhyo'pi dṛśyate ityapi vaktavyam| tena kvicitkārakāntareṣvapi dhātvantarādapi| paritaḥ khātā parikhā | yattu antātyanteti sūtre'nyatrāpi dṛśyate iti vārtikam| tadbhatakālavyatireke'pi tadartham| vastutastu prakṛtasūtre'piśabdasya sarvopādhivyabhicārārthatvāttadetacceti vārtikadvayamapyanārabhyam| ikoguṇeti sūtre gamerapyayaṃ ḍo vaktavya iti bhāṣyasvārasyāt| niṣṭhā || 102 || bhūtārthavṛtterdhātoḥ ktaktavat staḥ| ādyo bhāvakarmaṇi antyaḥ kartarīti vivekaḥ| nanu ihaiva ktaktavatū niṣṭheti saṃjñā kāryā| yau bhūte ktaktavatū(tau)niṣṭhāsaṃjño| viśiṣṭānuvādasāmarthyād‌bhūte tayorvidhānamanumeyam| anyathā vihitayoḥ saṃjñā saṃjñayā ca vidhānamityanyonyāśrayaḥ| naca siddhaṃ tu nityaśabdatvādityayaṃ parihāraḥ| mṛjervṛddhirityādinā hi prayogasamavetānāmākārādīnāṃ sādhutvamanvākhyāyate ktaktamānārthakayoḥ saṃjñānupapatteḥ| nacānyonyāśrayaḥ| niṣṭhetyukte saṃjñāvākyasmaraṇātsāmarthyāttadvidhānopapatteḥ| `ādikarmaṇi niṣṭhā vaktavyā'karmaśabdo'tra kriyāparaḥ| samudāyaghaṭakayatkiñcid‌vyāpāravyaktiṣvatītāsu samudāyarūpakriyāyā bhūtatvābhāvānsūtreṇāprāptāvārambhaḥ| ādyakarmaṇo yatkiñcidvyāpārasya bhūtatve niṣṭhoti vārtikārthaḥ| ayaṃca kartaryyapīti vakṣyate| naca tadanuvādasāmarthyā devādikarmaṇi niṣṭhāsiddhiḥ| vartamānārthakaniṣṭhāparatayāpi tadupapatteḥ| bhaṣyakārāstvāhuḥ| yasyā vyāpāra vyaktoratītatvaṃ tadvivakṣayā sūtreṇaiva siddham| ata eva prakṛtaḥ kaṭaṃ devadattaḥ prakaroti kaṭe devadattaḥ iti laṭa iva prākarṣitkaṭaṃ devadatta iti luṅo'piprayogasyeṣṭatvāt| tasya cādyavyāpāravivakṣāvyatirekeṇa durupapādatvāt| uktaṃca hariṇā- samūhaḥ sa tathābhūtaḥ pratibhedaṃ samūhiṣu| samāpyate tato bhede kālabhedasya sambhavaḥ|| samudāyābhiprāyeṇa tu kaṭaṃ prakarotītyeva siddhamiṣṭam| suyajoṅarvanip || 103 || sutvā sutvānau| yajvā tu vidhineṣṭavān| jīryateratṛn || 104 || jaran jarantau| vāsarūpavidhinā jīrṇo jīrṇavāt| chandasi liṭa || 105 || bhūtasāmānye| ahaṃ sūryamubhayato dadarśa| ahaṃ dyāvāpṛthīvi ātatāna| liṭaḥ kānajvā || 106 || cakrāṇā vṛṣṭim| kvasuśca || 107 || yono agne ararivām̐ aghāyuḥ| rādāne| ādantatvādvasvekājitaṭi| nañ samāse pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| dīrghādaṭīti nasya rutvam| ātoṭi nityamiti anunāsikaḥ| nanu vāvacanaṃ vyartham| naca lādeśeṣu nāsarūpavidherabhāvātpakṣe liḍādeśaśravaṇārtham| chandasi luṅ liṭa ityeva siddheḥ| maivam| uttarārthatvāt| athobhayorapi kittvaṃ kimartham| asaṃyogālliṭ kidityeva siddheḥ| naca vadbradhānetyatra badhabandhane ityasmātkānaci chāndasatvāddhalādiḥ śeṣābhāve kittvenānunāsikalopārthaṃ tat| saṃyogāntatvādasaṃyogādityasyānavakāśāt| maivam| añjeḥ kvasau ājivānityatra nalopārthaṃ ceti vācyam| chandasyubhayatheti sārvadhātukatvātsārvadhātukamapiditi ṅittvenaiva nalopasiddheḥ| satyam| ṛkārāntaguṇapratiṣedhārthaṃ anyathā teraturityādāvika titirāṇa ityādau ṛcchatyṝtāmiti guṇāpatteḥ| nahyetanṅitvanaiva vāryam| pratiṣedhaviṣaye eva vidhānāt| kittvasāmarthyāttu tadbrādhāt| etena kitkaraṇasāmarthyādbhāṣāyāmapyanayoḥ sādhutvakalpanamapāstam| bhāṣāyāṃ sadavasaśruvaḥ || 108 || ebhyo bhṛtasāmānye vā liṭ tasya ca nityaṃ kvasuḥ| tathāhi `bhāṣāyāṃ sadādibhyo vā liṭ' iti vārtikam| anyathādeśavidhānasāmarthyātsadādibhyo bhṛtasāmānye'numīyamāno liṭ luṅo bādhakaḥ syāt| luṅo hyapavādatrayam| etatsūtrānumiti liṭ| anadyatane laṅ| parokṣe liṭ ca| yatrāpavādavipratiṣedhāllaṅ liṭāveva syātām| bhūtasāmānyasyāvakāśatvāt pokṣe liḍityasyātrāprakṛtatvena tasya kvasvādeśavidhyasvabhāvāt| `anadyatanaparokṣayośca vā liḍ vaktavyaḥ'| upasedivān kautsaḥ| upāsadat| upāsīdat| upasasāda| `tasya kvasuraparokṣevaṇārthaṃ aparokṣeti| anadyatanepi vārtikena vā vihitasya liṭo'pravṛttau laṅ liṭau bhavataḥ| parokṣe liḍityasya tu kvasvabhāvāttiṅādeśāḥ| bhāṣyakārāsttvāhuḥ-atra vetyanuvṛttaṃ liṭā sambadhyate na kvasunā| liḍabhāvapakṣeluṅ| tato laṅ‌liṭorvidhāvapyetatsūtrānuvṛttyā anadyatanaparokṣayorapi sadādibhyo vā liḍ‌bhavatīti siddham| upeyivānanāśvānanūcānaśca || 109 || ete nipātyante| upetyatantram| upeyivān| īyivātan| samīyivān| bhūtasāmānye vā liṭ kvasuśceti| samiti prāgvat| aṭadbhiruccairaṭavītvamīyuṣī| nañ pūrvādaśrāteḥ kvasuriḍabhāvaśca| anupūrvādvaceḥ kartari kānac| anucānaḥ pravacane sāṅge'dhīti gurostu yaḥ| īyivānityatreṇo liṭ kvasuḥ| iḍāgamātpūrvaṃ nityatvādidūrvacanaṃ dīrgha iṇaḥ kitītyabhyāsadīrghaḥ| tatsāmarthyānnaikādeśaḥ| naceyaturityādirdīrghāvakāśaḥ| tatrāpi yaṇādeśasya sthānivadbhāvenaikādeśaprasaṅgāt| pūrvaparobhayavidherapi pūrvavidhitvāt| tataśca valādilakṣaṇeṭo `neḍ‌vaśi kṛtī'ti niṣedhe, krādiniyamātprāptau vasvekājāddhasāmiti ebhya eva vasoriṭ nānyeṣāmiti niyamena niṣidhyate| uktarītyā ekāctvābhāvād| tathāca pūrvaeva iḍatranipātyate iti svīkāre viśeṣānupādānātsaṃprasāraṇasthale'pi iḍāpattiḥ| tasmādvasvekājiti niṣiddhasya pratiprasavamātraṃ kriyate iti valādāveveṭ natvajādāviti nadoṣaḥ| tasmāddvirvacane'bhyāsadīrgha caikādeśaḥ| tasyeyādeśo nipātyate| iyādeśasya nipātanetu īyivānityādi na syāt| naca dīrgha ekādeśabādhakaḥ| iṇo yaṇityasyaiva tathātvāt| atraca tannimittatvābhāvena ekādeśasyasusthatvāt| nacābhyāsadīrghottaraṃ vārṇādāṅgamiti nyāyena ekādeśaṃ bādhitvā haṇoyaṇādeśe tasya sthānivadbhāvādekādeśaprāpteruktatvāt| abhyāsadīrghatvamekādeśabādhakamiti kathametaditi vācyam| rūpānatideśādikārasvarūpāśrayasyaivakādeśasya yakāre prāptyabhāvāt| pūrvaṃ vādhitasyaikādeśasya sthānivadbhāve'pi bādhitatvācca| pūrvaparayorvidhau sthānivadbhāvābhāvācca| yadvā abhyāsadīrghe kṛte tadūttarasya ikārasyāprāpta eva yaṇādeśo halādau nipātyate tato vasvekājityanenaiva iḍ bhavatīti nājādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ| apara āha- nopeyivānnipātyo dvirvacanādiḍ‌bhavati paratvāt| anyeṣāmekācāṃ dvirvacanaṃ nityamityāhuḥ| asya punariṭ ca nityo dvirvacanaṃ naca vihanyate hyasya| dvirvacanaṃ caikāctvāttasmādiḍh bādhate dvitvam| asyārthaḥ-iṇo bhāṣāyāṃ bhūtasāmānye liḍeva vibhāṣā vidheyaḥ| tasyaca nityaṃ kvasvādeśaḥ| dvirvacanaṃ bādhitvā paratvādiṭaḥ pūrvaṃ pravṛtteḥ| naca bibhidvān cicchidvān ityādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ tasya dvirvacanasya nityatvāt tato'nekāctvādiṭo vighātābhāvāt| tathāca paratvānnityatvācca iṭ‌siddha eveti na kviñcinnipātyamiti| luṅ || 110 || bhūtasāmānye dhātorluṅ| apākṣīt| sāmānyavivakṣāyāṃ luṅ viśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ vakṣyaprāṇau laṅ‌liṭāviti vivekaḥ| `vaserluṅarātriśeṣe'nadyatena jāgaraṇasaṃtatāviti vācyam'| rātrerādyayāpatrayaṃ jāgaritvā caturthe yāme yadā'mutrāvātsamiti prayuṅkte tadātikrāntarātripraharatrayavāsasyānadyatanatvāllaṅ‌prasaṅge luṅ vidhīyate| jāgareti kim| yadā praharatrayamadhye kiñcidapi jāgaritvā caturthe prayuṅkte'mutrāvasamiti laṅeva yathā syāt| anadyatane laṅ || 111 || bhūtānadyatanakriyāvṛtterdhātorlaṅ| saṃpūrṇo divasastutpūrvottaravartinyo rātryoścaramaprathamayāmau cetyetāvānsamayo'dyatanastadbhinno'nadya tana iti saṃpradāyaḥ| divasaśca śabdaprayogādhikaraṇaṃ grāhyo natu śābdabodhādhikaraṇam| prayogādhikaraṇādinā'tītasyāpi bhāvidinavṛttiśābdabodhāpekṣayānadyatanatvena laṅ prayogāpatteḥ| apacat| na vidyate'dyatano yasminso'nadyatanaḥ tena dvayorviṣaye luṅeva| adya hyaścābhuṃjmahi| nacaivamadyatane'pyadyatanābhāvena laṅāpattirādhārādheyabhāvasya bhedanibandhanatvāditi vācyam| samudāyāvayavayorbhedamāśritya samudāye'dyatane avayavā adyatanāḥ santītyupapatteḥ| tadāha hariḥ| kālasyāpyaparaṃ kālaṃ nirdiśantyeva laukikāḥ|| naca nirdeśamātreṇa vyatireko'nugamyate| adyatanakālopādhīnāṃ bhūyastvāt ekasminnaparasya vṛttiḥ sambhavatyeva| parantu naikena rūpeṇa idānīmidānīmiti pratyayābhāvāt| bhinnarūpeṇa tu bhavatyeva| `parokṣe vijñāte prayokturdarśanāviṣaye laṅ‌vaktavyaḥ'| aruṇadyavanaḥ sāketam| prayoktṛmamānakālīnatayā || 112 || abhijñā smṛtiḥ yattu yāṃ kāñcitbrāhmaṇavatīmiṣṭakāmabhijānīyāttāṃ madhyamāyāṃ citāvityatra `vacanānmadhyamāyāṃ syuḥ| pratyakṣabrāhmaṇoditāḥ'| jānātirabhipūrvo'yaṃ pratyakṣe vartate iti mīmāsakairuktam| tatprāyikam| smṛtivācakatvaṃ ca na smṛtitvāvacchinnaśakyatākatvaṃ kintu smṛtitātparyeṇa prayuktatvaṃ tena budhyādīnāṃ jñānārthānāṃ ca saṃgrahaḥ| smṛtivācinyupapade bhūtānadyatane'rthe dhātorlṛṭ| laṅo'pavādaḥ| abhijānāsi kāśmīreṣu vatsyāmaḥ| na yadi || 113 || yadyoge uktaṃ na| smarasi devadatta yatkāśmīreṣu avasāma| vibhāṣā sākāṅkṣe || 114 || dhātvarthasya lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvena || 115 || bhūtānadyatanaparokṣārthakriyāvṛtterdhātorliṭ| atra vārtikam| parabhāvaḥ parasyākṣe parokṣe liṭi dṛśyate| utvaṃ pādeḥ parādakṣṇaḥ siddhaṃ vā syānnipātanāt| asyārthaḥ| parokṣe pratyekamaparokṣatvāt| piṇḍībhūtā naśakyā nidarśayitumiti bhāṣyasvārasyāt| dhātupadasya kriyāparatve svavācyatvaṃ sambandhaḥ| sādhanaparatve svārthasādhanatvamiti lakṣyatāvacchedakasambandhalāghavasyaiva vinagamakatvāt| pratyekaṃ kriyātvābhāve'pi dhātvarthatvānapāyādityāhuḥ| taccintyam| tsamudāyaghaṭakasarvavyāpārāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ pratyakṣasthale'pi liḍāpatteḥ| samudāyasya parokṣatāyāstatrāpi susthatvāt| tathāca parokṣaviśeṣaṇameva niṣprayojanaṃ syāt| nanvavayavānāmeveha pārokṣyaṃ vivakṣitamiticet katipayānāṃ, yāvatāṃ vā, nāntyaḥ| vaiyarthyatādavasthyāt| nādyaḥ| apasiddhāntāt| vyapāraikadeśasākṣātkāre'pi liṭ‌prayogasyāniṣṭatvāt| anyathāyadātena sthālyāṃ taṇḍulodakaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tadā sādhanaparokṣevyāpāraparokṣe vā sūtrārthepapāceti bhavatyeveti syāt| avayavasya parokṣānvayitāvacchedakatve tasyaiva bhūtānvayitāvacchedakatvāt| tathā ca hyaḥ papāceti prayoge prakṛtapākānukūlavyāpāratvāvacchedena bhūtānvaye bodhānupapattiriti dik| `suptamattayoruttama iti vaktvayam'| supte'haṃ kila vilalalāpa| bahu jagada purastāttasya mattā kilāham| idaṃ ca cittavikṣepanimittamātropalakṣaṇam| idaṃca nyāyalakṣyam| svavyāpārasyāpi vyāsaṃṅgādinā svayamapratisaṃdhānasaṃbhavāt| `atyantāpahnave cetivaktavyam'| no khaṇḍikāṃjagāma no kaliṅgān jagāma| niṣiddhadeśeṣu ciraṃ tvayoṣitamityukte cira vāsaniṣedhārthaṃ taddeśagamanasyāpanhavaḥ| `nakāri (na)prapapau nadādhajasya pratijagrāha ko me manuṣyaḥ praharedvadhāya'| apahnavatvaṃ svarūpasadeva niyāmakam| natuśābdadhīviṣayaḥ apahnavatvavyāghātāt| kārī ṛtvigbhūtvā somaṃ na papāvapiti yajamāna eva bhūtvā ayājyayājanamapratiṣidhya ṛtviktvamevāpahūnutam| dādhā janapadaviśeṣaḥ| tatra jātasya nāhaṃ pratijagraheti sarvathā pratigrahāpahnave niṣiddhapratigrahasya sutarāmeva nihnavaḥ| komanuṣyomamāsatyāropaṇena praharedityarthaḥ| vyāpyaniṣedhābiprāyeṇa tadvyāpakaniṣedho'tyantāpahnava iti bodhyam| atha kathaṃ vyātene kiraṇāvalīmudayana iti| yattu āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacceti liṭ kartumicchatītyarthāditi tanna| tatra luṅa evātideśa iti siddhāntāt|? yadpayāhuḥ| yadyapi uttamapuruṣatrayādeśavidhānaṃ yathāsaṃkhyasaṃpādanena caritārthaṃ tathāpi ṇaluttamo veti jñāpakādaparokṣe'pi liṭ sādhuriti tanna suptādiviṣaye caritārthatvāt| yattvatrāpi granthakaraṇarabhasavaśāccittavikṣepa iti tanna| bahutaramanaḥ praṇidhānasādhya śāstrārthanirṇayajanakaśabdaracanānmake granthe'nadyatanatvātītatvayośca vistārakriyāyāmasaṃbhavāt| satyam| tiṅantapratirūpakanipātaiti kecit| śiṣyalokoyamityanye| idaṃca vardhamānatadvivaraṇādau spaṣṭam| haśaśvatorlaṅaca || 116 || anayoryoge liṭo viṣaye laṅ cālliṭ iti hākarot śaśavadakarot| cakāraca| praśne cāsannakāle || 117 || sannihitasamaye pṛcchayamāne'rthe pūrvavat| pañcavarṣābhyantaramāsannam| taduttaramanāsannamiti saṃpradāyaḥ agacchatkim| jagāma kim| anāsanne tu kaṃsaṃ jaghāna kim|| laṭ sme || 118 || smaśabdayoge laṭ| liṭo'pavādaḥ| dharmeṇa sma kuravo yudhyante| `smapurā bhūtamātre, na smapurādyatena iti vaktavyam'| smapuretiśabdena ādyantānukaraṇadvārā pañcasūtrī gṛhyate| tatra bhūtamātre pratyayaḥ| smapurāśabdavatsūtratrayalakṣamastu pratyayo'dyatane na bhavatīti vārtikadvayārthaḥ| tathāca laṭ‌sme aparokṣeca puriluṅ‌cāsme itisūtratrayeṇānadyatanabhūtapratyayaḥ| nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane `nanvorvibhāṣā'ityetābhyāṃ bhūtasāmānye iti paryavasannam| atra bhāṣyam-smādividhiḥ purānto yadya viśeṣeṇa kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati|| nasma purādyanatana iti bruvatā kātyāyaneneha|| anuvṛttiranadyatanasya laṭsma ityatra nāsti nañkāryam|| aparokṣānadyatanau nanau vibhāṣā cahi nivṛttau|| napurānadyatana itibhavedetadvākyaṃ tatracāpiluṅ‌grahaṇam|| aviśeṣeṇa smapurā hetū iti tatracāpi śṛṇubhūyaḥ|| aparokṣecetyeṣa prāk puriśabdāditi nivṛttaḥ|| sarvatrānadyatanastathāsati nañā kimiha kāryam|| smādāvaparokṣecetyakāryamapi śakyametaditi|| śakyaṃhi nivartayitu parokṣe iti laṭsma itya.tra|| syādeṣā tava buddhiḥ smalakṣaṇetyevameva siddhamapi|| laṭsma iti bhavennārthaḥ tasmā dvācyaṃ parārthaṃ tu|| ayamarthaḥ-uktasūtratraye'nadyatanagrahaṇānuvattyaiva siddheḥ dvitīyāṃ vārtikaṃ nakartavyam| nanāvityādisūtradvayaṃ ca tadanuvṛttyabhāvena tatpravṛttisiddheḥ| nacaivaṃ puriluṅcāsme ityatra tadanuvṛttirnasyāditivācyam| tasya bhūtasāmānyaviṣayakatvalābhārthaṃ napurādhrauvyamiti vācyam| luṅgrahaṇasāmarthyādeva tatrānadyatanagrahaṇānuvṛttyanumānāt| asyabhūtasāmānyaparatvevibhāṣānuvṛttyā viklapena laḍ‌vidhānādeva pakṣe laḍaḥsiddheḥ| anadyatānānuvṛttau tu luṅgrahaṇaṃ vinā luṅ durlabhaḥ| vikalpavidhāne laḍabhāvapakṣe laṅa evaprasaṅgāditi viśiṣya tadupādanasārthakyam| aparokṣe ca || 119 || bhūtānadyatane laṭ smayoge | evaṃ pitā bravīti|| nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane || 120 || anadyatanaparokṣetyubhayaṃ nivṛttam| nanuyoge bhūte laṭ uttara vākye| naca prativacanasya praśnapūrvakatvātpraśnapadaṃ vyartham| viruddhavacanābhimukhyatadbījānāmapi vācyatvāt| apākṣīḥ kim| nanu pacāmi bhoḥ| `nanau pṛṣṭaprativacana ityaśiṣyam'| kriyāṃsamāptivivakṣitatvāt| asyārthaḥ| pākādikriyānivṛttāvapi tatkāryasya śramāderanuvṛttestasyā evāsamāptivivakṣāyāṃ vartamāne laḍityeva siddham| etādṛśavartamānānupādāne nanu māṃ kurvantaṃ paśya, nanu māṃ kurvāṇaṃ paśyeti vartamānalaḍādeśayoḥ śatṛśānacorasidhyāpatteḥ| nanvorvibhāṣā || 121 anayoryoge vā laṭ| pakṣe laṅ pūrvaviṣaye| apākṣīḥ| kim| na pacāmi| nāpākṣam| ahaṃ nu pacāmi| ahaṃ nvapākṣamaṃ| puri luṅ cāsme || 122 || anadyatanetyanuvartate| bhūtānadyatane purāyoge vibhāṣā luṅ cālliṭ natu sma yoge| pakṣe liṭ| rathenāyaṃ purā yāti| rathenāyaṃ purāyāsīt| āyāt yayau vā| smayogetu yāti sma purā| `haśaśvad‌bhyāṃ purālakṣaṇo vipratiṣedhena'rathena hapurā śaśvadyāti| ayāsīdityādi| smaḥ sarvebhyo vipratiṣedhena parapūrvavipratiṣedhābhyāmityarthaḥ| tathācāsmegrahaṇaṃ nakartavya mityāśayaḥ| yanaha smāve śaśvat purāgniraparaśuvṛkṇaṃ dahati| vartamāne laṭ || 123 || prārabdhāparisamāptakriyopalakṣite kāledhātorlaṭ| pacati| karoti| `pravṛttasyāvirāme nityapravṛtte ca śāsitavyā bhavantyavartamānatvāt'| bhavantīti laṭ saṃjñā prācām| ihādhīmahe| madhye bhojanādikriyāvyavadhānādaprāptiḥ| tiṣṭhanti parvatāḥ| sravanti nadyaḥ| sthānādeḥ sārvadikatvātsādhyatvābhāve kriyātvābhāvātkriyādharmasya vartamānatvasyāpyabhāva iti vacanārambhaḥ| janyasya prāgabhāvadhaavaṃsāvaśyakatvādadvartamānatvasya ca tatpratidvindvitvānnityapravṛttasya ca bhūtabhaviṣyatvābhāvena vartamānatvaṃ kriyātvaṃ ca nāstītyabhiprāyaḥ| parvatādipadaṃ cātmākāśādornityasyopalakṣaṇam| pūrvatādisthiteranityatvāt| atra siddhāntaḥ| nyāyyaṃ tvanapavargāt| adhyayanapravṛttyanantarakālīnatatsamāptipūrvakālīnabhojanādernāntarīyakatayā vyavadhāyakatvābhāvāttadavayavatvādvā sūtreṇaiva siddham| anyathā bhuṅkte ityādāvapi jalapānādinā vyavadhānāpatteḥ| taduktaṃ hariṇā- vyavadhānamivopaiti vicchinnamiva dṛśyate| kriyāsamūhe bhujyādirantarālapravṛttibhiḥ|| naca vicchinnarūpāpi sāvirāmānnivartate| sarvaivaṃ hi kriyānyena sakīrṇevopalabhyate|| tadantarāhaladṛṣṭā vā sarvaivāvayavakriyā| sādṛśyātsati bhede tu tadaṅgatvena gṛhyate|| parvatāstiṣṭhantītyādauca bhūtabhāviṣyadvartamānānāṃ rājñāṃ yāḥ kriyāḥ tā bhūtādibhedabhinnāḥ parvatādisthityāderbhedikā ityupapāda nīyam| tadāha hariḥ- parato bhidyate sarvamātmā tu na vikalpyate| parvatādisthitittasmātpararūpeṇa bhidyate|| prasiddhabhedā vyāpārā virūpāvayavakriyāḥ| sāhacaryeṇa bhidyante sarūpāvayavakriyāḥ| prasiddhaparimāṇānāṃ tatkriyāṇāmeva kriyāntaraparicchedakatayā kālarūpatvātkālasya ca kriyākāraṇatvādityarthaḥ| syādetat| niṣpannasyārthasya bhṛtatvādaniṣpannasya ca bhāvitvātprakārāntarābhāvādvartamānakālo durvacaḥ| tadāhuḥ- navartate cakramiṣurna pātyate na syāndante saritaḥ sāgarāya| kūṭastho loko naviceṣṭitāsti yo hyevaṃ paśyati sopajanaṃ vaḥ| mīmāṃsako manyamāno yuvā medhāvisaṃmataḥ| kākaṃ svohānuyacchati kiṃ te patitalakṣaṇam| anāgatena patati atikrānte ca kārakaḥ| yadi saṃprati patasi sarvo lokaḥ patatyayaḥ| himavānapi gacchati| anāgatamatikrāntaṃ vartamānamiti trayam|| sarvatraca gatirnāsti gacchatīti kimucyate| ayamarthaḥ-parivartanakriyāyāanekakṣaṇavṛttitayā kṣaṇānāṃ ca yaugapadyābhāvātkathaṃ tasyā vartamānatvam| sthūlakālopādhimādāyaikyoktau tu yugādirūpopādhimādāya tadvṛttidhvaṃsaprāgabhāvadaśāyāṃ pratiyogināmapi vartamānatvavyavahārāpatteḥ| naca yatkālāvacchedena yasya satvantasya sa eva vartamānakāla itivācyam| sarvasya vartamānarūpatayātmāśrayāpatteḥ| naca satvaṃ sambandhamātraṃ taddhaṭitatvamātrasya tadīyatve tad‌dhvesaprāgabhāvasambandhasyātiprasaktatvāt| naca yasya tattpratiyogikadhvesādivṛttipratiyogitākatve'pi vivakṣitasya tadvṛttipratiyogitākatvasyāsyābhāvānna doṣa iti vācyam| tatpratiyogikadhvaṃsādyadhikaraṇatvasambandhena tatsambandhasyāpi dhvaṃsādikāle sattvāt| naca yatra samaye yadatyantābhāvo nāsti sa tasya vartamānakāla iti vācyam| aprasiddheḥ| ghaṭādhikaraṇakāle'pi ghaṭātyantābhāvasattvāt| naca pratiyogivyadhikaraṇatvenābhāvo viśeṣaṇīyaḥ| pūrvāparakāle vartamānatvābhimatakāle'pi tadatyantābhāvasattvāt| naca prāk‌kālāvacchedena saṃyogasamavāyāntayatarasambandhena pratiyogyadhikaraṇe yadatyantabhāvo nāstīti vācyam| vyadhikaraṇa sambandhena dharmeṇavāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvasya ghaṭābhāvasya tadāpi bhūtalakapālādau sattvāt| ghaṭadhvaṃsaprāgabhāvakālīnapadārthātyantābhāvavṛttighaṭātyantābhāvasyādhikaraṇasvarūpatayā tādṛśapadārthātyantā bhāvasya ghaṭavatyapi sattvācca| naca bhūtabhaviṣyadbhinnatvaṃ tat| bhūtatvāderapi bhaviṣyadvartamānabhinnatvādinā nirvācyatvāt| atrocyate| kriyāpravṛttau yo hetustadarthaṃ yadviceṣṭitam| tadanviṣya prayuñjīta gacchatītyavicārayan| hetuḥ prayojanaṃ gamanasya deśāntaraprāptiḥ tadarthaṃ phalārtha| iha pratyabhijñānāt| kṣaṇabhaṅganirāse devad‌ttasya deśāntaraprāptirnirhetukā na sambhavati iti gamanakriyaiva tasyā nimittam| tadālambanaśca gacchatīti pratyayo'bādhita utpadyate iti sattva tāvadavaramyate| kriyāyāḥ vartamānatvābhāve ca bhūtabhaviṣyatorapyabhāvaprasaṅgaḥ vartamāne hibhūtatvaṃ bhaviṣyatvaṃ ca pratipadyate tatrānekakṣamasamūhātmakaṃ kriyāprabandharūyaṃ budhyā saṃkalpya gacchatītyādi prayuṅkte iti kaiyaṭaḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-vidyamānaprāgabhāvapratiyogī bhaviṣyan tadupalakṣitaḥ kālo'pi tathā| dhvaṃsapratiyogitvādi mātrasyātītāditve sarvadā tatpratītyāpatteḥ| nanu svadhvaṃsādighaṭitasyāsya parvatāstiṣṭhantītyādāvanupapattiḥ| etatprayogakāle parvatādisthiteratītvādyabhāvāt| dhvaṃsaprāgabhāvānavacchinnasamaya sambandhasya sthititvāt `tama āsīttamasā gūḍhamagre tucchenābhvapihitaṃ yadāsīt ātmaivedamagraāsīdityādau tu sutarāmiticet satyam| dharmisattāyā evātra vartamānatvamiti siddhāntāt| vedāntināṃ tvasti brahmetyatra lakārasya prayogamātrasādhutvāṅgīkārāt| nahi sthitikriyāyāṃ brahmaṇaḥ svātantryarūpakartṛtvasambhavaḥ| nityatvāt| nāpikṣemasādhāraṇīsiteḥ sādhyatā| svasvavyāpyetarāsu yāvatīṣu vyaktiṣu satīṣu|| laṭaḥ śatṛśānacāvaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe || 124 || prathamābhinnavibhaktyantena sāmānādhikaraṇye laṭa etau staḥ| pacantaṃ pacamānaṃ vā paśya| śakāraḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ| ṛkāra ugitkāryārthaḥ| cākaraḥ kurvāṇa ityādāvantodāttārthaḥ| yadyapi kriyāntarayoganimittakaṃ aprathamāsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ pācakaṃ devadattaṃ paśyetyādau kṛdantapadasyopasarjanakartṛpratipādakatayā tasya darśanādikriyāpekṣakarmatvādyupapatteḥ| lakārastu kartṛkarmaṇorvihito'pi kartṛkarmopasarjanakriyāpratipādakaḥ| pacatyodanaṃ devadattaḥ pacyate odano devadattenetyādau kriyāprādhānyavyavasthāpanāt| kriyāyāśca kriyāntarayogābhāvātkarmādiśaktyāveśānupapattiḥ| anyathā apacadodanaṃ devadattaṃ paśyetyāderdurvāratvāt| laḍvācyāyāḥ śaktyantarayogo natu laṅādivācyāyā ityasya durghaṭatvāt| tathāpi tiṅ‌bhāvino lakārasya kriyāyāṃ guṇabhūte kartrādau, śatrādi viṣayasyatu kriyāṃ prati viśeṣyabhūte tatra śaktiḥ| pacantaṃ devadattaṃ paśyetyādau ādeśe vibhaktyantarasāmānādhikaraṇyadarśanātsthāninyapi tadanumānāt| naca laṭaḥ prayogasamavāyābhāvādaprathamāsāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvapratyakṣeṇa sāmānyato dṛṣṭānumānabādhaḥ| lakārāprayoganibandhanatvena tadabhāvapratyakṣasyānyathāsiddheḥ| ādeśe'prathamāsāmānādhikaraṇyānyathānupapattimūlakānumānasyānyathāsiddhatayā balavattvāt| ataevālātacakrapatyakṣaṃ sarvadagavacchedena rūpānubhave'pi tatsahacaritasparsānupalambhabhramaḥ| taduktaṃ hariṇā- sparśaprabandho hastena yathā cakramya saṃmataḥ| na tathālācakrasya vicchinnaṃ spṛśyate hi tat || ataeva jvālaukyabuddherapīyameva gatiriti siddhāntaḥ| atha paryudāso'yaṃ pratiṣedho vā?|| nādyaḥ| pratyayottarapadayo stadasiddheḥ| kurvato'patyaṃ kaurvata ityādau śatrantasya devadattādisāpekṣatāyāmasāmarthyāttaddhitānupapatteḥ| padāntaranairapekṣyeca tatsāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvācchatrāderanupapatteḥ| kurvatobhaktiḥ kurvabhdaktiḥ| pūrvapadyojyam| nāntyaḥ| kurvatī cāsau bhaktiścetyāderanupapatteḥ| evaṃ kurvattara kurvadrupaḥ| kurvatkalpa ityādīnāṃ samānādhikaraṇavṛttitaddhitānāmapyanupapattirbodhyā| devadattādipadāntarasāmānādhikaraṇyāt| nanu pratyayottarapadayośceti vacanāntaramārambhaṇīyam| pṛthaguttarapadagrahaṇaṃ antaṅgānapīti nyāyena luki kṛte pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhāt pratyaye parataḥ śatrādeśavidhestatrāpravṛtteḥ| ato noktadoṣaḥ| maivam| taduktam| `pratyayottarapadayornimittatvāderaprasiddhi'riti| pratyayādeśayoḥ paraspara nimittatvāt| satyuttarapade śatṛśānacau tayośca kṛtsaṃjñāyāṃ subutpattiḥ| subnimitaḥ samāsaḥ tannimittaṃ copapadamiti itaretarāśrayasya spaṣṭatvāt| atra siddhāntaḥ| `navā lakārasya kṛttvā'diti| ayamarthaḥ-tadbhinnapratyayatvena lakārasyāpi kṛtsaṃjñayā tadantasya prātipadika saṃjñāyāṃ tadāśrayasubutpattyā aṇāditarabādīnāmutpattau teṣu pareṣu śatrādyādeśavidhānānna doṣaḥ uttarapadasthale'pi tiṅādeśaṃ bādhitvā paratvātsubutpatteḥ| naca pacatītyādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ| kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena tatra tiṅādeśasya nityatvāt| naca prakṛte'pi tathāpattiḥ| śatṛśānacostiṅapavādatayā tadviṣaye tatpravṛtyanaucityāt| nacaivamapi vaikṣyamāṇirityādau śānacaṃ vinākārāntatvavirahādiñ na syāt| pacatitarāṃ pacatirūpaṃ ityādau ca śatrāderāpattiḥ| tiṅaścetyātrāpacattarāmiti laṅādiviṣaye sāvakāśatvāt| evaṃ pacati paṭhatītyādāvapi lasya kṛtvātsubutpattau pratyaye vihitaḥ śatrādyādeśaḥ syāt| liḍādau tiṅāṃ sāvakāśatvāt| satyam| nanvorityato vibhāṣānuvṛttyā vyavasthitabikalpavijñānācceṣṭavyavasthāsiddheḥ| nacaivamametyādivaiyarthyam| vyavasthitavibhāṣayaiva nityayorādeśayoḥ siddheriti vācyam| śatṛśānacāvityekāsmin yoge vibhāṣānuvṛttiḥ| `aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe'dvitīyo yogo niyamārthaḥ| vyavasthitavibhāṣayā vispaṣṭapratipattyabhāvāt| tathāca vikalpasya prathamāsāmānādhikaṇyaṃ viṣayaḥ| pacan pacamānaḥ pacati vā devadattaḥ pacati devadattaṃ paśyetyasya ca nāpattiḥ| dvitīyasya vidhernityatvāt| etena laṭa iti vartamāne laḍ‌grahaṇaṃ kvacitprathamāsāmānādhikaraṇye aprathamāsāmānādhaikaraṇye ca vidhyartham| tena pacannityādau pratyayottarapadayośca tadādeśasiddhiriti nirastam| bhāṣyavirodhāt| tasya śatṛśānacāviti sūtrāpekṣayā laṭa ityasyopādāne gauravābhāvāt| saṃbodhane ca || 125 || he pacan| he pacamāna| saṃbodhanavibhaktyantārthasya kriyāntaranirūpitakarmatvādiśaktyanāveśātkriyānvayitvena ca prathamāsāmānādhaikaraṇyasyāpyabhāvādaprāptāvārambhaḥ| lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ || 126 || kriyāyāḥ paricāyakahetau vartamānāddhātoḥ laṭa etau staḥ| hetupadaṃ phalakāraṇobhayaparam| tiṣṭhan mūtrayati| gacchan mūtrayati sthānādikriyayā mūtrādikriyā lakṣyate| atra vārtikāni| `guṇaupasaṃkhyānam' bahuṣu mūtrayatsu ko devadatta ityukte yasmiṣṭhan mūtrayatītyuttare ca devadatto lakṣyate| aśaucādiguṇo vā gṛhyate| tatra dravyaguṇayoreva lakṣyatvātsūtreṇāsiddhāvārambhaḥ| `kartṛlakṣaṇayoḥ paryāyeṇācayoge iti vaktavyam'| yo'dīyāna āste sa devadattaḥ| yaāsīno'dhīta iti vā| pūrvavākye guṇapadasya sādhanaparatve tata evasiddhāvidaṃ paryāyārtham| aśaucādigrahaṇe tu vidhyartham| acayoge kim| ya āste cādhīte ca sa caitra iti cakārayoge mābhūt| `tatvākhyāne ca'| śayānā varddhate dūrvā| asīnaṃ vardhate bisam| svabhāvākhyānametat| natvāsanavṛdhyorlakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ| `sadāca yaśca bahulam'| san brāhmaṇaḥ| asti brāhmaṇaḥ| `iṅ juhotyorvā'| adhīte adhīyānaḥ| juhoti juvhāna iti| bhāṣyetu tiṣṭhatikriyā mūtrayatikriyāyā eva lakṣaṇaṃ sā tu devadattāderiti sūtreṇaiva siddheḥ| yo'dhīte ityādāvapi| adhyayanāsikriyayoḥ parasparaṃ lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvatparyāyasiddheḥ| cakārayoge ca samuccitakriyādvitayasya kartṛlakṣaṇatvena kriyayo ranyonya lakṣyalakṣaka bhāvābhāvenā na tiprasaṅgāt| caitanyalakṣaṇaḥ puruṣaityādau tatvākhyānasyāpi lakṣaṇatvena śayānetyādeḥ siddhatvādityuktam| `māṅyākrāśe iti vācyam| mā pacan| mā pacamānaḥ| luṅo bādha etatprāmāṇyāt| tau sat || 127 || tau śatṛśānacau satsaṃjñau| tāviti saṃjñāvidhānārtham| anyathā pratyayavidhānāpatteḥ| tenaca tacchabdena śatūśānacoḥ svarūpamātraparāmarśena sthāniviśeṣa parāmarśavirahāllakārāntarasthānikayorapi saṃjñāsiddhiḥ| naca pūrvoktaviśeṣanivṛttyāsiddhiḥ uttaratra vartamānagrahaṇānuvṛtterāvaśyakatvāt| tena vartamāna sāmipyārthakalaḍādeśayorlṛḍādeśayośca saṃjñā| naca vartamānāditi nirdeśāt lṛṭaḥ sadveti vacanācca siddhiḥ pūraṇagumetyatra sacchabdena tadupādānānupapatteḥ| vartamānavadityatra pratyayādhikāreṇa saṃjñānatideśāt| lṛṭa ityatrāpi| piṣṭapiṇḍāḥ siṃhāḥ kriyantāmityādibat satsaṃjñakapratirūpakayo rvidhāne'pi vihitayostatsaṃjñānibandhanakāryānapāyāt| syādetat| tacchabdasya saṃnihitaparāmarśakatayā lakārāntādeśayorgrahaṇaṃ durlabham| nacaivaṃ tāvityasya vaiyarthyam anuvṛttyaiva prakṛtayorlābhāditi vācyam| prayojanasya pramāṇānusāritvāt| maivam| tāviti yogaṃ vibhajya dhātumātrādvihitasya pratyayasya śatṛśānacau sta iti vyākhyāya saditi yogena śatṛśānac‌mātrasya satsaṃjñāvidhānāśrayaṇāt atha pūrvasūtre tayorādeśatvādihāpi tathātve sthānyākāṅkṣāyāṃ tṛjādināṃ svarūpeṇa kvibādīnāṃ ca lopasya vidhānasāmarthyādetadādeśābhāve pariśeṣāt ādeśanivṛttiprayojyapratiyoginaḥ pratyayasyāpavādatayā tayorvidhānamiti ṇvulo yucaśca śatṛsānacau syātāmiti kārake nandanetyāderasiddhiḥ| yuvoranākāvityasya taddhite sāvakāśatvāditi cenna| lṛṭaḥ sadvetyasya niyamārthatvān yadi dhātumātratparasya tadā lṛṭa eveti| naca vikalpavidhāyakatayā tasya niyamatvānupapattiḥ| lṛṭaḥ sadityasya tathātvāt| tāvityanena śatṛśānacau aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe ityāderananuvṛttyā viśeṣavihitayoḥ śatṛśānacoḥ lṛṭaḥ saditi sūtreṇa niyamaḥ| betyanena tu samānādhikaraṇādau laṭa iva tau vikalpena vidhīyete| evaṃca nityamaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe ityapi na vaktavyamiti lāghavam|| pūṅ yajoḥ śānan || 128 || pavamāno yajamānaḥ|| tācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaśa || 129 || eṣvartheṣu dyotyeṣu| bhogaṃ bhuñjānaḥ| kavacaṃ bibhrāṇaḥ śatrūnnighnānaḥ| iṅ‌dhāryoḥ śatrakṛcchiṇi || 130 || ābhyāṃ śatṛsyāt anāyāse kartṛniṣṭhe dyotye| adhīyan| dhārayan anāyāsenādhīyāna ityarthaḥ| neha kṛcchreṇādhīte| syādetat| ete trayaḥ pratyayāḥ svatantrā lādeśā vā| laṭo'nuvṛttyananuvṛttibhyāṃ ubhayasaṃbandhena saṃdehāt| nādyaḥ| pacate yajate adhīte ityādyarthaṃ vācyatvāpatteḥ| lādeśeṣuvāsaruvapidherabhāvāt| bhāvakarmaṇorapyetadāpatteśca| kartaryeva caiṣāmiṣṭatvāt| lādeśasārvadhātukatvena pavamāna ityādau tāsyanudāttedityanudāttaprasaṅgācca| citkaraṇasya nighnānā ityādau sāvakāśatvāt| nighnānā ityādyarthamātmanepadasaṃjñāpratiṣedhārambhāpatteśca| na dvitīyaḥ| somaṃ pavamānaityādau naloketiṣaṣṭhīniṣedhānupapatteḥ| maivam| tṛnnitipratyāhāragrahaṇenaiva etadyoge ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhopapatteḥ| naca dviṣayoge'pi tadāpattiḥ| dviṣaḥ śaturvetyasya tṛpratyayagrahaṇe pratiṣedhārthasya pratyāhāragrahaṇe vidhyarthatayopapatteḥ| dviṣo'mitre || 131 || śatṛsyāt| dviṣan śatruḥ| amitraśabdaḥ puṃsi| naño'ja ramarasṛtāḥ itiliṅgānuśāsanasūtrāt|| suño yajñasaṃyoge || 132 || śatṛsyāt| yaḥ sunvantamavati| sarve sunvantaḥ| yajñe kim| surāṃ sunotītyatra mābhūt| nanu suñoyajña ityukte'pi sunotyarthasya yajñaviṣayakatve iti vyākhyayā tadvāraṇasaṃbhavātsaṃyogapadavaiyarthyāmiti| || 135 || kartā kaṭān| `ṛtvikṣu vānupasargasyeti vaktavyam'| atācchīlyādyarthamārambhaḥ| hotā potā| anupasarge kim| praśāstā| pratihartā| atra tṛjeva| tena kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| tṛni tu tādauca niti kṛtyatāviti gateḥ prakṛtisvarādyudāttattvaṃ syāt| `nayateḥ ṣuk ca vaktavyaḥ'| navā dhātvantaratvāt| indrovastena neṣatu| ityādau neṣateḥ| prakṛtyantaratvāt| ṣuki tu guṇo na syāt| `tviṣerdevatāyāmakāraścopadhāyā aniṭ‌tvaṃ ca vaktavyam'| tvaṣṭā| aniṭūtvaṃ coktavakṣyamāṇopasaṃkhyānasādhāraṇam| tviṣeḥ svata evāniṭ‌tvātga| tena praśāstā neṣṭā kṣattā ityādisiddham| `kṣadeścāyukte tṛn vaktavyaḥ'| kṣattā `chandasi tṛjvaktavyaḥ'| namaḥ kṣatṛbhyaḥ saṃgṛhītṛbhyaḥ| cittvādantodāttaḥ| alaṃkṛñ‌nirākṛñ‌prajanotpacotpatonmadarucyapatrapavṛtuvṛdhusahacara iṣṇuc || 136 || upasargaviśeṣoktiranyanivṛttyarthā| kṛñatra karotiḥ prasiddhatvāta| natu hiṃsārthaḥ| patapacamadāmucchabdasya tantreṇa pāṭhasya yuktteve'pi pratyekoccāraṇamupasargāntaranivṛtyartam| tena samutpatiṣṇurityādau neti sampradāyaḥ| utpatiṣṇucariṣṇuceti bhaṭṭiḥ| kocittu tatsthāne padeti paṭhitvā utpatiṣṇurityāhuḥ| evaṃ rociṣṇurityādi| ṇecchandasi || 137 || vīrudhaḥ pārayiṣṇavaḥ|
