mṛṇālatantuchidurā satī sthitirityāderapi darśanāt| iṇ‌naśajisartibhyaḥ kvarap‌ || 163 || itvaro'bhavaditi harṣacaritam| asatītvarītyamaraḥ| naśvaraḥ jitvaraḥ sṛtvaraḥ| gatvaraśca || 164 || anunāsikalopasyāpi nipātaḥ| jāgurūkaḥ || 165 || jāguriti anukāryānukaraṇayorbhedavivakṣāyāṃ prātipadikatve pañcamyantam| jāgarterūkaḥ syāt| jāgarūka iti nipātetu uttaratra ūkānuvṛttirna syāt| yajajapadaśāṃ yaṅaḥ || 166 || ebhyo yaṅantemyaḥ ukaḥ| daśeti bhāvinalopābhiprāyam| yāyajūkaḥ| jañjapūko'kṣamālāvāniti bhāṭṭiḥ| dandaśūko bileśayaḥ| vāvadūkaśabdastūlūkādiḥ| kurvādigaṇe pāṭhātsiddha ityanye|| namikampismyajasakamahiṃsadīpo raḥ || 167 || namraḥ| kampraḥ smeraḥ| nañ‌pūrvo jasiḥ sātatyārthaḥ| ajasram| kamraḥ| rhistraḥ| dīpraḥ| nasāśaṃsabhikṣa uḥ || 168 || cikīrṣuḥ| sanadhātorneha grahaḥ| gargādau jigīṣuśabdapāṭhāt| avyutpannatatkalpane gauravāt| āṅ‌ pūrvaḥ śaṃsuricchāyām| āśaṃsuḥ bhikṣuḥ| vinduricchuḥ || 169 || vetternum iṣeḥ chatvaṃ ceha nipātyam| vettibhinnānāṃ vidāṃ iṣṇātīṣyatyośca nedaṃ nipātanamanabhidhānāt| kyācchandasi || 170 || devān jigātiṃ sumnayuḥ| nachandasyaputrasyeti ītvadīrghābhāvaḥ| iha kyeti nākhaṇḍasya grahaṇam| kintu kiccāsau yaśceti karmadhārayaḥ| tena kaṇḍ‌vādiyako'pi grahaḥ| tena turaṇyavaḥ bhuraṇyurityādi| gṛṇhanti hyanasūyava iti mṛgayvāditvāt| ādṛgamahanajanaḥ kikinau liṭ‌ca || 171 || ādantādṛkārāntādgamādibhyaśca kikinau staḥ chandasi tauca liḍ‌vat| āditi dakāraḥ| takāre tu ṛityasya tātparatvena dīrghaṛkārāntānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt| dadirgāḥ| babhrirvajram| taturiḥ jaguriḥ| bahulaṃ chandasi ityutvam| śubhaṃ bhāvāno vidatheṣu jagmayaḥ| jaghnirvṛtramamitriyam| jajñiḥ| taturirityādau ṛcchatyṝtāmiti guṇaniṣedhārthaṃ kitvaṃ| naca parasmaipadasaṃjñā syāditi vācyam| ādeśānāmeva tatsaṃjñatvāt| kartari kṛditi kartari kikinorutpattau paścātpravartamānenātideśena bhāvakarmaṇorapi naitadāpattiḥ utpattiśiṣṭārthāvirodhe utpannaśiṣṭārthānanvayāt| bhūtakālasyāpi nātideśo vartamānādhikārāt| nāpi tiṅādeśānāṃ kasukānacoścāpattiḥ| svarūpabādhaprasaṅgāt| atravārtikam| `utsargaḥ chandasi sadādibhyo darśanā' diti| sedirnomirityādi| ata ekahal‌madhye iti etvābhyāsalopau| `bhāṣāyāṃ dhāñ‌kṛsṛgamijaninamibhyaḥ| dadhiḥ| cakriḥ| sasrirityādi| `sāsādi vāvahi cācalipāpatīnāmupasaṃkyānam'| paternīgabhāvo'pi nipātanāt| sahivahicalipatibhyoyaṅitivacanārambhapakṣe tu bhāṣyaprāmāṇyāt| svapitṛṣornajiṅ‌ || 172 || svapnak tṛṣṇak| svap‌najau tṛṣṇajāvityādi| dhṛṣeśceti vṛttiḥ| ghṛṣṇak| śṝvandyorāruḥ || 173 || śarārurghātuko hiṃsraḥ| vandārurabhivādake|| bhiñaḥ kruklukanau || 174 || bhīruḥ| bhīlukaḥ| `krukannapi vaktavyaḥ'| bhīrukaḥ| stheśabhāsapisakaso vrarac‌ || 175 || sthāvaraḥ īśvara| bhāsvaraḥ yesvaraḥ kasvaraḥ| yaśca yaṅaḥ || 176 || yaṅantādyātervarac| yāyāvaraḥ| nirūpito'yaṃ padāntasūtre| tācchīlikāḥ samāptaḥ| bhrajabhāsadhurvidyutorjipṝjugrāvastuvaḥ kvip || 177 || vibhrāṭ bhāḥ bhāsau dhūḥ vidyut| ūrk‌ pūḥ jūḥ juvau nipātanād‌grāvaśabdasya dhātunā samāsaḥ| grāvastut ṛtvigviśeṣaḥ| anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate || 178 || anupasargārtha ārambhaḥ kvip‌cetyatra supītyupasarge iti cānuvṛtteḥ| bhid‌ chid| naca pūrvasūtre grāvopapadāt stoḥ kvividhānavaiyarthyam| prāk‌kveriti pāṭhe tācchīlyādau kvipo vidheyatvāt| nacaitatsūtravihitasyaiva tacchīlādyarthatvam| tṛnā bādhāpatteḥ| tācchīlikānāṃ tairvāsarūpavidhirnetyuktattvāt| dṛśigrahaṇaṃ dīrghasaṃprasāraṇatadabhāvahasvānāmapi vidhānārtham| `vacipracchyāyatastukaṭaprujuśrīṇāṃ kvip‌dīrgho vacisvapporasaṃprasāraṇaṃ ca' `dyutigamijuhotīnāṃ dveca'ti vaktavyamiti vārtikadarśanāt| kvib‌vacītyādyuṇādisūtreṇa keṣāṃcitsiddhe tacchīlādau tṛnā bādho mā bhūditi punarupādānam| vakti anayā vāk| pṛcchatīti prāṭ| sa cāsau vivākaśca prāḍvivākaḥ| āyataḥ stauti āyatastūḥ| kaṭaṃ pravate kaṭaprūḥ| jūḥ pūrvoktaḥ| śruyantyenāṃ śrīḥ| didyut jagat| krameṇa dyutisvāpyoḥ, gamaḥ kvāvityabhyāsa saṃprasāraṇalopau| juhotyanayā juhūḥ| naca dyutyādīnāmapi dīrdhāpattiḥ| dīrdhasamuccayavelāyāmacaścetyupasthānāt tadantavidhinā'jantasyeti paryavasāne arthāddīrghisya juhotimātraparatvāt| dīryati darat| dṝbhaye hasvaḥ| dhyāyaterdhīḥ| dṛśigrahaṇātkvacitkartrarthavyabhicāraḥ karaṇasya kartṛtvopacārāpekṣayā'vayavārthānugamāya ca karaṇādāvevotpattervācyatvāt| bhuvaḥ saṃjñāntarayoḥ || 179 || mitrabhūsaṃjñaḥ kaścit| uttamādharṇayorviśvāsaghaṭakaḥ pratibhūḥ| dṛśigrahaṇānuvṛttilabhyaṃ cedam| naca saṃjñātvādeva siddhiḥ| pratidānapūrvakālamātravṛttivyavahāraviṣayatvāt| saṃjñāyāśca yāvad‌dravyabhāvitvāt| viprasaṃbhyo ḍ‌vasaṃjñāyām || 180 || ḍu ityavibhaktiko nirdeśaḥ| vibhuḥ prabhuḥ saṃbhuḥ| vyāpakatvaiśvaryajananānyatra nimittam| saṃjñāyāṃ tu vibhūḥ kaścit| `mitadvrādibhya upasaṃkhyānam'| mitaṃ dravatīti mitadruḥ| śaṃmbhavati bhāvayati vā śaṃbhuḥ| dhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭran || 182 || dhāñ‌dheṭorgrahaṇam| svarūpeṇaiva nirdeśāt| dhātrījananyāmalakīvasumatyupamātṛṣu | dāmnīśasayuyujastutudasisicāmihapatadaśanahaḥkaraṇe || 182 || ṣṭran syāt| dāntyanena dātram| dā cchedane| netram| śastram| yotram| yoktram| totram| sotram, sinvanti badhntyanena setram| sektram| meḍh‌ma patram daśoti nirdeśo akṅityāpi kvacinnalopārthaḥ| tena daśanoti siddham| naca prakṛte'pyāpattiḥ| śuno dantadaṃṣṭretyādi nirdeśāt| halasūkarayoḥ puvaḥ || 183 || pūṅ‌ pūñoḥ karaṇe ṣṭran| karaṇasya halasūkarādyavayavatve| etena tayorupapadatvābhidheyatvayornirāsaḥ| potram| toyarmukhamityarthaḥ| sarvatra titutreti iṇ‌niṣedhaḥ| artilūdhūsūkhanasahacaraitraḥ || 184 || aritram| lavitram| dhūiti niranubandhakasya kuṭādereva grahaṇam| ṅitvādguṇaniṣedhe uvaṅ| dhavitram| savitram| khanitram| sahitram| caritram| puvaḥ saṃjñāyām || 185 || pavitram| ājyotpanasādhanaṃ darbhamayamanāmikāveṣṭanaṃ vā| kartari carṣidevatayoḥ || 186 || puvaitraḥ ṛṣervedamantrasya karaṇatve devatāyāśca kartṛtve| pūyate'nena pavitram| agniḥ pavitraṃ samā punātu| ñītaḥ ktaḥ || 187 || vartamāne| svinnaḥ| iddhaḥ| kṣviṇṇaḥ| vartamānasvedādyāśraya ityarthaḥ| matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca || 188 || matiricchā buddheḥ pṛthagupādānāt| rājñāṃ mato buddhaḥ pūjito vā karmaṇyayaṃ sakarmakatvāt| matyādiprakṛtikasya ktasya bhūtaviṣayatvamanena bādhyate| takrakauṇḍinyanyāyāt| jñātīmatyetattu bhūte'pi tenetyadhikāre `upajñāta'miti sūtraprayogāt anyathā ktasyaca vartamāna iti ṣaṣṭhyāpatteḥ| cakāronuktamuccayārthaḥ| tathāca bhāṣyam| śīlito rakṣitaḥ kṣānta ākruṣco juṣca ityapi| ruṣṭaścarucitaścobhāvabhivyāhṛta ityapi|| hṛṣṭhajuṣṭau tathākrāntastathobhau saṃyatodyatau| kaṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāhuramṛtāḥ pūrvavatsmūtāḥ|| iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau tṛtīyasya dvitīyapāde tṛtīyamāhnikam| pādaścāyaṃ samāptaḥ| <3.3> tṛtīyapāde prathamamāhnikam|| 1 || uṇādayo bahulam || 1 || prayeṇaiṣāṃ rūḍhatayā prakṛtipratyayārthānanugamādviśiṣya na vyutpādyante kintu śāstrāntaravyutpāditānāṃ sādhutvamātramanenābhyanujñāyate| atra vārtikam| vāhulakaṃ natudṛṣṭeḥ naigamarūḍhibhavaṃ hi susādhu| nāma ca dhātumāha nirukte vyākaraṇe śakaṭasya ca tokam| asyārthaḥ-nanvatra bahulagrahaṇaṃ vyartham| uṇādaya ityetāvataiva sādhutvābhyanujñāsiddheḥ ityāśaṅkyāha-tanudṛṣṭeriti| prakṛteritijātyabhiprāyamekatvam| tanuśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ prakṛtīnāmalpatvadarśanāt| bahulaśabdārtho bahvarthādānam| tathāca tatrāpaṭhitātābhyo'pi prakṛtibhyo uṇādayo vidhīyante| tena hṛṣerulac| śaṃkerapi bhavati śaṃkuleti| evaṃ bahuvacanāttatrāvihitā api pratyayāḥ tenārteḥ piḍapiḍḍau| ṛpiḍaḥ ṛpiḍḍu iti| evaṃ kāryāṇyapi| yathā ṣaṇḍa ityatra satvābhāvaḥ| ṣatvaṃ vā nanvevaṃ sarvebhyodhātubhyaḥ sarve pratyayā syurataāha naigameti| nigame chandasi bhavāḥ| aṇṛgayanādibhya ityaṇ| rūḍhiḥ prasiddhiḥ| prayogasya niyāmakatvānnātiprasaṅga ityarthaḥ| prakṛtyādivibhāge na vyutpādane ācāryāntarasaṃmatirāha-nāmaceti| niruktaṃ ca bhūvādisūtra upanyastam| śakaṭasya tokamapatyaṃ śākaṭāyana ityarthaḥ| saṃjñāsu dhāturūpāṇi pratyayāśca tataḥ pare| kāryādvidyādanūbandhametacchāstramuṇādiṣu|| vyokhyātam| bhūte'pi dṛśyante || 2 || naca vartamānādhikārinivṛttyaivaitaduttarasūtradvayasyānyathāsiddhiḥ| utsargato vartamāne, kvacideva kālāntare ityarthāt| bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ || 3 || grāmaṃ gamī gāmī vā| bhaviṣyatsāmānyaviṣayāścaite| viśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ tvapavāda vipratiṣedhālluṭ| śvo gantā grāmam| vāsarūpavidhinā lṛḍapi| gamiṣyati| bhaviṣyati ityādi| bhaviṣyadadhikāro yāvatpurāśabdayoge bhaviṣyatyeva laṭaḥ sādhutvārthaḥ| bhaviṣyatkālena vartamānasya bādhāt| śabdopāttakālaviśeṣavidhyabhāve ca tadaprayogāt| asati tvasmin bhūte'pi laṭaḥ sādhutvaṃ syāt| yāvatpurānipātayorlaṭ || 4 || yāvabhduṅkte| purābhuṅkte| niścayārthau nipātau| samānantaraṃ bhokṣyate ityarthaḥ| nipātagrahaṇaṃ lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanārtham| yāvabhduṅkte ityatra pūrvavipratiṣedhena luṭ‌ tatparyantaṃyāvatpurotyanuvartanādvā| vibhāṣā kadākarhyoḥ || 5 || bhaviṣyati vā laṭ syāt| pakṣe luṭ‌ca| kadākarhi vā bhuṅkte bhokṣyate bhoktāvā| naca karhiśabdasyānadyatanaviṣayatvāttadyogela़ḍayuktaḥ bhaviṣyatsāmānye bhokṣyate iti vyutpādya karhiyogavyākhyānāt| naca bhaviṣyatsāmānyavihita lṛṭo viśeṣavihitena luṭā svaviṣaye bādhaḥ| tatraiva tadanuvṛtteruktatvāt| kiṃvṛtte lipsāyām || 6 || laṅvā syāt| kaṃ kataraṃ katamaṃ vā tvaṃ bhojayasi bhojayiṣya sibhojayitāsi vā| vakturbhonecchātra gamyā| lipsyamāna siddhau ca || 7 || lipsyamānenānnādinā svargādeḥ siddhau gamyāyāṃ laḍ‌vā| arkivṛttārthaārambhaḥ| yo bhavatāmannaṃ dadāti sa svargaṃ gacchati| yo dāsyati dātā vā sa svargaṃ yāsyati yātā vā| pūrvasūtre kiṃvṛttagrahaṇe tu sipsyamānarahitāyāṃ lipyāsāyāṃ akiṃvṛtte laṭo nivṛttyarthamiti kaiyaṭaḥ| loḍarthalakṣaṇeca || 8 || preṣādeḥ paricāyake'rthe vartamānāddhātoḥ bhaviṣyati vā laṭ| kṛṣṇaśced‌bhuṅkte tvaṃ gāścāraya bhokṣyate bhoktā vā|| liṅ‌caurdhvamauhūrtike || 9 || nipātanātsamāsottarapadavṛddhī| muhūrtānantaraṃ bhaviṣyatyuktaparicāyake vartamānāddhātoḥ liṅ‌laṭau pakṣe lṛḍ‌luṭau| muhūrtādupari upādhyāyaścedāgacchedāgacchati āgamiṣyatyāgantā vā athatvaṃ chando'dhīṣva| tumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām || 10 || kriyārthāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ tadvācake dhātāvupapade bhaviṣyatyarthe dhātoretau staḥ| kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ yāti| kṛṣṇaṃ darśako yāti| iha gamanakriyā darśanārthā| atodṛśestumunādi| nanvaviśeṣeṇa vihito ṇvul etadviṣaye'pi siddha eva| nacākenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoriti bhaviṣyatkālānuvādena ṣaṣṭhīnaṣedhārthaṃ tadvidhānam| sāmānyavihitasyaiva bhaviṣyadarthakatāyāṃ tadupapatteḥ| naca bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitatvasya tanniṣedhapratiyogitāvacchedakatvalābhārtham| bhaviṣyadarthasyaiva tathātve aṅga yajatāṃ lapsyante'sya yājakā ityatra ya enaṃ yājayiṣyantīti vivaraṇādbhaviṣyadarthasyāpyakasya yoge ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhāpatteriti vācyam| bhūtārthasyaiva yājakapadasya lapsyanta iti padasamabhivyāhāreṇa bhaviṣyattābodhakatvāt| naca ime'sya yājakā ityādau tadaniṣedhārthaṃ śabdaśaktisvābhāvyeva yājakapadasya bhūtaviṣayatvāt| bhāviyājakatvāropeṇa tadvyavahārāt| naca viśeṣavihitena tumunā ṇvulo'napavādārthaṃ tumuno bhāvārthatayākarthakaṇvulaṃ pratyabādhakatvāta| vāsarūpavidhinā ṇvulopyupapatteśca| ucyate tṛjādibādhāya ṇvulo vidhānam| anyathā vāsarūpavidhinā te'pi prasajyeran| tena kartuṃ brajatītyādyarthe kartāvrajati vikṣipo vrajati ityādayo na prayujyanta ityākaraḥ| kriyāyāṃ kim| dravye upapade mābhūt| bhikṣiṣye ityasya jaṭāḥ| bhikṣituṃ jaṭā ityatra tu dhārayatītyadhyāhāryam| kriyārthāyāṃ kim| dhāvataste patiṣaayati daṇḍaḥ| dhāvanakriyāyā daṇḍapātahetutve'pi tadarthatvābhāvāt| taduddeśena kriyamāṇmyaiva tadarthatvāt| kṛṣṇamityatra viṣayatvaṃ dvitīyārthaḥ| tacca darśanānvayi udeśyatvasaṃmbandhena darśanasya yānakriyānvayaḥ| kṛṣṇaviṣayakadarśanoddeśyakaṃ caitrakartṛkaṃ yānamiti bodhaḥ| bhaviṣyatvaṃ tu na śābdaviṣayaḥ| icchāyā asiddhaviṣayatvasvābhāvyādeva lābhāt| darśaka ityatra tu darśanasya svaviṣayakecchāvattvasambandhena ṇvularthāśrayānvayaḥ| tathāca kṛṣṇaviṣayakadarśanāśrayakartṛkaṃ yānamiti dhīḥ| yānakartari darśanasya svaviṣayakecchāvattvasaṃmbandhenānvaye yāne darśanoddeśyakatvamarthādbhavati| yattu kṛṣṇakarmakabhaviṣyaddarśanārthaṃ tādṛśabhaviṣyaddarśanakartṛkartṛkaṃtvaduddeśyakaṃ ca yānamityubhayatrārtha iti tanna| samānakartṛkatvamabhidānabalalabhyaḥ prayogopādhiriti svagranthavirodhāt| prayogopādheḥ śabdaviṣayatvānupapatteḥ| tasyoktarītyānyalabhyatvācca| etena sāmānādhikaraṇyasya kartari janitānvayabodhatve yātītyatrānvayānupapatteśca| yadapi darśanajanikā yānakriyeti tadapyasat| darśanānupadhāne'pi uktaprayogāt| svarūpayogyatāvivakṣāyāmapi yatrānyārthakṛtayonana darśanaṃ tatrāpyuktaprayogāpatteḥ| uddeśyatvasyāpi saṃsargatāṅgīkāre tu janakatvasya tatkalpane prayojanābhāvāt| bhāvavacanāśca || 11 || bhāvādhikāre vakṣyamāṇā ghañādayaḥ kriyārthakriyāyāmupapade bhaviṣyadarthe syuḥ| idaṃca bhāvavacanānāṃ yathāvihitānāṃ pratipadavidhyartham| yathetyasamastam| yathāvihitaṃ vidhānaṃ yeṣāmitica bahuvrīhirvā| ayamarthaḥ kriyārthakriyopapade viśeṣavihitena tumunā svaviṣaye ghañādīnāṃ bādhaprasaṅgāt yasminnupādhiviśeṣe prakṛtiviśeṣebhyo ghañādividhānaṃ tādṛgevoktasthale'pi bhavatītyetadarthaṃ vacana padopādānam| anyathāvyatikarāpatteḥ| yāgāya yāti| tumarthācceti caturthī| yāgoddiśyakaṃ yānamityarthaḥ| aṇ‌karmaṇi ca|| 12 || kāṇḍalāvo vrajati| kāṇḍalavanārthaṃ vrajanamityarthaḥ| nanu karmaṇi sāmānyavihito'ṇ uktaviśeṣe'pi siddhaḥ satyam| punarvacanamapavādabiṣaye'nivṛtyartham| nanvapūrva vidhyapekṣayā pratiprasavasya laghutvādutsargaviṣaye'pi lābhārthametatsyāt| anyathā ṇvulo vidhānena tṛjādivadaṇo'pi durlabhatvāt| tatkathamapavādaviṣaye'pi karmaṇyaṇaḥ siddhiḥ| maivam| vacanagrahaṇānuvṛttimātreṇa karmaṇi tadupapatteḥ| punaḥ karmagrahaṇasya karmamātropasaṅgrahārthatayā'pavādaviṣaye'pavādaviṣaye'pyaṇ‌siddheḥ| tathāca kambaladāyaityādi siddham| paratvādanena kapratyayabādhāt| nanvevamapi kadācitkarmaṇyupapade syāt kadācit| kriyāyām| bhaviṣyatyapavādabādhanārthatayā vacanasārthakyāt| yo'yamanabhiyuktaḥ| naca ganteva gantā ityupamānena nirvāhaḥ| tiṅante tadabhāvāt| yadvā anadyatane ivānadyatane iti sūtra evopamānamāśretya nirvāhyam| prayogavaśādgauṇepyanadyatane pratyayotpatteriti liṅgama| sṛdhātoḥ| sthire kartari ghañ sāraḥ sarati kālāntaramiti vyutpatteḥ| utpatyanantaranāśinaścārthasya gatikartṛtvānupapatteḥ| nacaivaṃ sthirapadavaiyarthyam| prakarṣavijñānārthatvāt tena| bhāvaśabdaścātra puṃlliṅga ekavacanāntaśca nirdiṣṭaḥ| tasya striyāmityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāsaṃbhavāt| bhāve striyāṃ ktinna syāt| kintu striyāmakartari kārake eva bhāve puṃsi syāt| napuṃsakebhāve prasaṅgāt| maivam nāntarīyakatayā liṅgavacanayorupādāne'pi tayoravivakṣitatvāt| bhāvapratipadikārthasāmānyasyaiva pratyayanimittatvāt| yadvā pākādiṣu kriyāviśeṣeṣu liṅgasaṃkhyāviśapasthale'pi bhāvaśabdavācyaṃ sāmānyaṃ gotvamiva goṣvasti taccaikaṃ puṃstvānugataṃ ceti tamāśritya pratyayavidhiḥ bhāvasya sāmānyatvātpacādeśca viśeṣatvāt| bhūtirbhavanamityapi pākādivatkartrādibhedādbhāvaviśeṣa eva bhāvasāmānyānunama iti kaiyaṭaḥ| sabandhibhedenaikasya mātulatvopādhyāyatvādivatpākādiṣu viśeṣarūpatā bhāvaśabdavācyasāmānyayoḥ parasparābādhena sattvāt| uktaṃca hariṇā- ācāryo mātulaśceti yathaiko vyapadiśyate| saṃbandhibhedādarthātmā sa vidhiḥ paktibhāvayoḥ|| tathāca pratyekadhaātuvācyaviśeṣamavetasya bhāvasāmānyasyātrapratyayārthatayā nirdeśa iti siddham| atra bhāvasya siddhāvasthādikaṃ prāgeva vyutpāditam| akartaricakārake saṃjñāyām || 19 || kartṛbhinne upapade ghañ| rajyate'nena rāgaḥ| prāsyate iti prāsaḥ| kvacidasaṃjñāyāmapi| ko bhavatā lābho labdhaḥ| kastvayā dāyo dattaḥ| akartari kārake bhāve ityetadubhayasyātaḥ paramanuvṛttiḥ| kṛtyalyuṭo bahulamiti yāvat| atra bhāṣyam| akartarīti paryudāse kārakagrahaṇaṃ nañivayuktanyāyādeva labhyam| matiṣedhapakṣe'pi saṃjñāyāṃ ghañaḥ kartari tanniṣedhasya ca vākyabhedena vidhāne dhātvarthasaṃbandhini kāraka eva bhaviṣyati| bhāve pūrvasūtreṇaiva vihitatvāt| naca bhāve saṃjñāyāṃ ghañ‌vidhārnāthatayānyathāsiddhiḥ| bhāve saṃjñāyāmityekayogāpatteḥ| nāpiparimāṇākhyāyāmityatra kārakagrahaṇānuvṛttyā ekā tilocchritirdve sṛtī ityādau ghañbhāvārthaṃ| akartarītyasyānuvṛtyāpi siddheḥ| sejñāgrahaṇamapi vyartham| asaṃjñāyāmapi darśanāt| naca kṛtaḥ kaṭa ityādau kāraka ityādiprasaṅgaḥ| abhivānalakṣaṇāḥ kṛtaddhitasamāsā ityatiprasaṅbhaṅgāt| parimāṇākhyāyāṃ sarvebhyaḥ || 20 || ghañ| ekamtaṇḍulaniścāyaḥ| dvau śūryaniṣpāvau| grahavṛdṛniścigamaścetighaña ṛdorapaścāpavādaḥ| nacānte nirabhyoḥ pūlvorityeva ghañ‌siddhiḥ sarvāpavādabādhanārthaṃ sarvebhya upādānādanenāpi bhavitumarhatvāt| nanu sarvebhya iti kimartham| naca purastādapavādanyāyenāyaṃ ghañacāveva bādhena natvapamatastasyāpi vādhārthamiti vācyam| vādhyasāmānyacintāyāntasyāpi bādhopapatteḥ| nacaikaḥ| pāka ityatra karmaṇi ghañarthaṃ akartaricetyeva siddheḥ saṃjñāyāmityasya tatra nirāsāt| ajaporapi saṃjñāviṣayakatvāpattyā prakṛte tadanāpatteśca| apavādasyotsargasamānaviṣayakatvāt| dhātusāmānādikaraṇyāpannasarvebhya iti pañcamīnirdeśādīdṛśārthalābhāt asatyasmin arthāśrayasyāpi apavādasyāyamapavādaḥ| tathācaikātilocchritirityādi na sidhyet| sarvebhya ityupādāne tu striyāmityarthaṃ nirdiśya ktino vidhānādarthāśrayasya hrasva iti hrasvāpatteḥ| ṇijāśrayavṛddherdurlabhatvāt| ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvena ghañāśrayāyā api tathātvāt| naca suddhābhyāmeva karaṇe ghañā siddhiḥ| apo durvāratvāt| yadvā śuddhābhyāmeva karaṇe 34 || stra ityasyānuvṛttiḥ śabdaviṣayatvādaprāptāvārambhaḥ| vistīryante'sminnakṣarāṇi viṣṭāra ityadhikaraṇe ghañ| tataḥ paṅaktiśabdena karmadhārayaḥ viṣṭārapaṅktiḥ chandaḥ| vāvitvasyānanuvṛttyā prastārapaṅaktirityādi| udi grahaḥ || 35 || grahavṛityādiprāptasyāpo'pavādo ghañ udgrāhaḥ| sami muṣṭau || 36 || yadyapi muṣṭiśabdasya parimāṇārthatve parimāṇākhyāyāmityeva siddhaṃ tathāpi aṅgulisanniveśaviśeṣārthamuṣṭiśabdārthamārambhaḥ| mallasya saṃgrāhaḥ| muṣṭau kim| padārthasaṃgrahaḥ| `udgrābhanigrābhau ca chandasi' srugudyamananipātana yoriti vaktavyam| udgrābhaṃ ca nigrābhaṃ brahmadevā avīvṛdhan ca| juhūpabhṛtorevātra grahaṇām| udgrābhaṃ ceti juhūmudyacchati| udgrābhaṃceti upabhṛtaṃ niyacchatītyukteḥ| parinyornīṇordyūtābhreṣayoḥ || 37 || paripūrvānnayatornipūrvādiṇaśca krameṇa dyūte aucitye ca viṣaye ghañ| pariṇayena śārān hanti| samantānnayanenetyarthaḥ| eṣa nyāyaḥ| ucitamityarthaḥ| anyatra pariṇayo vivāhaḥ| nyayo nāśaḥ| kramaprāptasyānullaṅghanamanupātyayaḥ| tatra paryāyaḥ| anyatra parāvanupātyayaiṇaḥ || 38 || kālaparyayaḥ| atipāta ityarthaḥ| atra vadanti| parau niyo dyūte iṇo'nupātyaye nāvabhreṣa ityeva sūtraṇīyam| parīṇoḥ sakṛdupādāne lāghavāditi| vyupayoḥ śeteḥ paryāye || 39 || tava viśāyaḥ| rājopaśāyaḥ| paryāyekim| viśayaḥ| saṃśayaḥ| viśaye prāyadarśanāditi jaiminisūtram| upaśayaḥ samīpa śayanam| nācānūpātyayapadānuvṛttyaiva siddhiḥ| paryāyaśabdasyāpi tatsamānārthatvāditi paryāyeti vyarthamiti vācyam| punarvidhānārthatvāt| tenābhividhivibakṣāyāṃ paramapīnuṇaṃ bādhitvā'yameveti vyākhyātāraḥ| hastādāne cerasteye || 40 || hastādānapadasya upādeyapratyāsattau tātyaryam| puṣpapracāyaḥ| anyatra yūyaṃ kusumāvacāyam| hasteti kim| pracayaḥ| vṛkṣagravartināṃ phalānāṃ yaṣṭyā grahaṇamityarthaḥ| asteye kim| puṣpapracayaścauryeṇa atha kathaṃ kusumāvacayaṃ nāṭayan‌tyāviti kālidāsaḥ| puṣpasyāvacayāya namravadanāmakāṃ samāyojayat| ityādi| satyam| pramādaevāyamityabhiyuktāḥ| yattu āruhya hastādāne'pi ādeyapratyāsatyabhāvāddhañabhāva iti śakuntalāṭīkāyāṃ taccintyam| haṃsamukhākhyahastasya niyoge aucityāt| cyutasaṃyuktaṃ kusumāvacayādiṣu iti tadudāhṛtaprayogasyaivānupapatteḥ| āruhya puṣpagrahe'pi taddhastasya viniyogāt| yaṣṭyādinā grahaṇe ca hastānupayogāt|| nivāsacitiśarīropasamādhāneṣvādeśca kaḥ || 41 || eṣu ciño ghañ casya kutvaṃca| nikāyo gṛham| ākāya magniṃ cinvīta| adhikaraṇe ghañ| agniṃ tadādhārasthalaviśeṣaṃ cayanena niṣpādayedityarthaḥ| kāyaḥ śarīram| gomayanikāyaḥ| upasamādhānaṃ rāśīkaraṇam| samūha iti yāvat ayaṃ dhātvarthaḥ| anye pratyayārthopādhayaḥ| casya ka ityeva vaktavye ādigrahaṇaṃ yaṅaluki abhyāsyaiva katvaṃ yathā syāt| anyathā dvayostadāpatteḥ| gomayānāṃ nikecāya ityāhuḥ| saṃghe cānauttarādharye || 42 || pūrvavat| bhikṣunikāyaḥ| prāṇisamūhaḥ saṃghaḥ| auttarādharyetu sūkaranicayaḥ| stanapānādidaśāyāmuparyadhobhāvenāvasthānamauttarādharyam| bhikṣuvatpṛthagevāvasthāne tu sūkaranikāya ityeva| saṃghekim| jñānakarmasamuccayaḥ| karmavyatihāre ṇac striyām || 43 || bhāve iti vartate strīgrahaṇaṃ vyatipāka ityatra mābhūt| naca ktin‌prakaraṇe evāyaṃ vidhīyatām| striyāmityata eva lābhāditi vācyam| ktinbandhakānāmapi bādhārthaṃ prakaraṇotkarṣāt| tena ṇyāsaśrantheti yuco bādhe vyāvacorī vyāvavarṣītyādi siddham nanvevaṃ vyatīkṣā vyatīhetyāderasiddhirakārapratyayasyāpi bādhāpatteriticetsatyam| ktinprakaraṇe evāsya pāṭhyatvāt| nacaivaṃ vyāvakruṣṭiriti vyātyukṣīti ca na syāt stryadhikāre vāsarūpavidherabhāvāt| satyaṃ bahulagrahaṇena yatheṣṭalābhādityākaraḥ|| abhividhau bhāvainuṇ || 44 || saṃkūṭinam| sāṃrāviṇaṃ vartate| abhividhirabhivyāptiḥ| aṇādivacanāntareṇātra kāryam| `iṣeranicchārthasyeti vācyam' anviṣyateḥ anveṣaṇā| vittaiṣaṇāyāśca sutaiṣaṇāyāśca lokaiṣaṇāyāśceti chāndasam| parerveti vaktavyam| parīṣṭiḥ paryeṣaṇā| rogākhyāyāṃ ṇvula bahulam || 108 || charda artiśabdastu pīḍāviśeṣavācī taddhetutvenātra prayuktaḥ| rogatvavyāpyadharmasyātra śakyatānavacchedakatvāt| `dhātvarthanirdeśe'pivaktavyaṃ' kānāmāsikā anyeṣvīhamāneṣu| kānāmasāyikā anyeṣvadhīyamāneṣu suvacatvāt| etadabhiprāyeṇaiva kaiyaṭaharadattanyāsakārādibhiḥ śitkaraṇasāmarthaayādityevābhihitatvātma| tasmādāṃśika ākaravirodhastaduktāvapi durvāra iti bodhyam| etena śitkaraṇetyatra bahuvrīhiṇā bhavateriti nirdeśācchabityevanyāsakārādyabhiprāyaiti sīradevoktamapāstam| anunyāsādayastu śtipi dvitīyo'pi śakāraḥ praśliṣyate tatsāmarthyācchabityāhuḥ| `varṇātkāraḥ'| nirdeśa ityeva| akāraḥ kakāraḥ| nyāsakṛt| nacākāra ityādāvāpyevam| akārakaraṇamityādyanupapatteḥ| nacakakārasyetsaṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ| prayojanābhāvāt| `rādiphaḥ' rephaḥ| vāsarūpavidhinā kāro'pi kārapratyayasya dhātuprakṛtikatvābhāve'pi adhikāravaśātkṛtsaṃjñā| tatastadantasya prātipadikatve svādyutpattiriti kaiyaṭaḥ| evamutaratra bodhyam| ārddhadhātukatvābhāvādiḍabhāvaḥ| `satvarthāccho vaktavyaḥ'| matvarthīyaḥ| śabdasvarūpamatantram| śaiṣikānmatubarthīṃyāditiprayogāt| bhasaṃjñāvirahe'pi bhāṣyaprayogādvahuloktervā akāralopaḥ| kecittu matubarthe bhava iti gahāditvāccha iti taddhitāntamevetyāhuḥ| `iṇajādibhya iti vācyam'| dhātvarthanirdeśe ṇvulo'yamapavādaḥ| evamagre'pi| ājiḥ| bāhulakānna vībhāvaḥ| ātiḥ| saṃjñāśabdā ete itinyāsakṛt| `iñavapādibhya iti vācyam'| vṛddhisāmye'pi svarārthamārambhaḥ| vāpiḥ| vāsiḥ| `ik‌kṛṣyādibhyo vaktavyaḥ'| kitvaṃ guṇābhāvārtham| kṛṣiḥ| giriḥ| `saṃpadādibhyaḥ kvip vaktavyaḥ'| sampat vipat āpat sampattirityādibahulokteḥ| saṃjñāyām || 109 || adhikaraṇe ṇvalarthaṃ sūtram| uddālakapuṣpāṇi bhajyante'syā uddālakapuṣpabhañjikā krīḍāviśeṣaḥ| kṛdyoge ṣaṣṭhī| nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoriti samāsaḥ| vibhāṣākhyānaparipraśnayoriñca || 110 || pariṃpraśne uttareca gamye iñ syācchāṇṇvul| vibhāṣokte ryathāprāptamanyepi| yadyapīha alpāc‌tvādākhyānapadasya pūrvanipātaḥ śrūyate tathāpi uttarasya praśnapūrvakatvānatkramollaṃghaneca prayojanābhāvādvṛttāvudāharaṇe ca praśnasyaiva prāthamyamiti sampradāyaḥ| kāṃtvaṃ kāriṃ kārikāṃ kriyāṃ kṛtyāṃ kṛrti vā akārṣīḥ| sarvāṃ kārimityādike'nyatamamukttvā'kārṣamiti yojyam| paryāyārharṇoptattiṣu ṇvuc || 111 || bhavata āsikā śāyikā| agragāmikā paryāyaḥ kramaḥ| śayanādivāra ityarthaḥ| bhavānikṣubhakṣikāmarhati| ṛṇe ikṣu bhakṣikāṃ me dhārayasi| utpattau ikṣubhakṣikā udapādi| ākrośe nañyaniḥ || 112 || vibhāṣeti nivṛttam| nañi upapade aniḥ syādākrośe| ajīvaniste śaṭha bhūyāt| tasyājananirevāstu| kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam || 113 || yathoktasādhanaprakṛtyādibinnasthale'pi bhavantītyarthaḥ| snāntyaneneti snānīyaṃ cūrṇam| dīyate'smai dānīyo vipraḥ| avasicyate taditi avesacanam| nacaivaṃ tayoreva kṛtyetyartanirdeśānarthakyam| utsargatasteṣāmeva gamyasānatvāt| `kṛt‌tayarthanirdeśānarthakyam| utsargatasyeṣāmeva gamyamānatvāt| `kṛt‌tyuṭo bahulamiti vaktavyam'| kṛtyagrahaṇamapanīya kṛdgrahaṇameva vyāpakatvātkartavyam| tathācalyuṭo'pi saṅgrahe pṛthak grahaṇaṃ nakāryamiti tātparyam| pādābhyāṃ hriyate pādahārakaḥ| gale copyate galecopakaḥ| iha karmaṇi ṇvul| śvo'gninādhāsyamānena| śvaḥ somena yakṣyamāṇena| anadyatane'pi lṛṭ| napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ || 114 || klībatviśiṣṭe bhāve'rthedhātoḥ ktaḥ syāt| isitaṃ śayitamityādi| syādetat| tarorevakṛtyaktakhalarthā ityeva bhāvārthatvaṃ ktasya siddham| maivam| tatra bhūtādhikārīyaniṣṭhetivihitasya ktapratyayasyaiva grahaṇāt| idaṃ tu kālasāmānye ktasya vidhānam| ataevāsya paratvātsvaviṣaye ghañajaṣāṃ bādhakatayā teṣāṃ puṃviṣayatvamiti siddhāntaḥ| atha karmaṇyapyayaṃ syāt| bhāvecākarmakebhya ityasyāsannidhānāt| satyam| gataṃ tiraścīnamityādiprayogādiṣṭāpatteḥ| naca tadyogedvitīyāpattirnaloketi ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhāditi vācyam| ktasyaca vartamāne itisūtre napuṃsakabhāvaktasya ṣaṣṭhyā upasaṃkhyānāt| śeṣavivakṣayā tatpratyākhyānapakṣe'pi tadbhāṣyaprāmāṇyāttatra śeṣavivakṣaiveti kalpanāt| bhrāntaṃ deśamanekadurgaviṣamaṃ iti kvacidvitīyādarśanācceti kecit| anyetvakarmakebhya evāyam| tayoreveti| sūtre'nuvṛttasya bhāvecākarmakebhya ityasya vākyabhedena vyākhyānāt| tattatsūtravihitakṛtyādyanuvādena bhāvakarmaṇorevetyarthavidhāyakamekaṃ vākyam| tena niṣṭheti vihitasya ktasya bhāvo'pyarthaḥ siddhaḥ| bhāvecākarmakebhya ityatra tubhāvecetyatra ktaityanuvṛttyā bhāvārthakaktapratyayānuvādenākarmakebhya iti viṣayo niyamyate tatrāviśeṣeṇa ktadvayasyāpyupādānādasyāpi akarmakāmātraparatvam| gataṃ bhuktamityādikaṃ tvavivakṣitakarmatvenākarmakatvasadbhāvādityāhuḥ| lyuṭ‌ca || 115 || napuṃsake bhāve lyuḍapi syāt| śayanaṃ hasanaṃ yogavibhāga uttaratra ktānanuvṛttyarthaḥ| karmaṇi ca yena saṃsparśātkartuḥ śarīrasukham || 116 || sparśa iti bhāve ghaj| karturiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| ubhayaprāptau karmaṇīti niyamādyeneti kartari tṛtīyā| kartṛtvaṃca yatkriyānirūpitamanyasya karmatvaṃ tatkriyānirūīpitaṃ grāhyam| tathāca yena spṛśyamānasya kartuḥ śarīrasukhamutpadyate tatra karmaṇyupapade napuṃsake bāve lyuṭ| upapadamiti nityasamāsārtha ārambhaḥ| payaḥ pānaṃ sukham| yadyapi bhakṣaṇādeva sukhamutpadyate tathāpi sparśapadaṃ tadādyupalakṣakameva| karmaṇi kim| tūlikāyā utthānaṃ sukham| atrāpādānena spṛsyamānasya kartuḥ sukhaṃ natu karmaṇeti pūrveṇaiva lyuṭ| kartuḥ kim| guroḥ snāpanaṃ sukham| sukhāpekṣayā guroḥ kartṛtve'pi snāpanakriyākartṛtvābhāvāt| ṇijarthakriyāyāṃ śiṣyasyaiva kartṛtvāt| gatibuddhityādināguroḥ karmatvaṃ snapayatītyasya aṇyantadaśāyāmakarmakatvāt śarīrapadaṃcātra śarīrasaṃyoganimittakāraṇakatvasya sukhe lābhārtham| tena danasyāsādanaṃ sukhamityādau na| svasvāmibhāvenaiva tatra sukhotpatteḥ| karaṇādhikaraṇayośca || 117 || anayorarthayo laryuṭ| nacopapadatvamevānayorasti natu pratyayārthatvamiti vācyam| karaṇetyādiprayogādeva tadabhāvāt| idhmavraścanaḥ| palāśaśātanaḥ| godohanena paśukāmasya praṇayet| vāridhānī| ghañapavādo'yam| yena nāprāptinyāyāt| ajapoḥ strīpratyayānāṃ ca paratvādbādhakaḥ yadvakṣyati ajabhyāmiti| puṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa || 118 || karaṇādhikaraṇayoḥ puṃsi prāyeṇa ghaḥ syātsaṃjñāyāya viṣaye| dantāḥ chādyante'nena dantacchadaḥ chādergheiti hrasvaḥ| ākurvantyasminnākaraḥ| patya vyavahāraṃ kurvantīti yāvat| prāyeṇa kim| prasādhanam| gocarasaṃcaravahava3javyajāpaṇanigamāśca || 119 || pūrvayorevārthayorghāntā nipātyante| halaśceti ghañapavādaḥ| gāvaścarantyatra gocaro viṣayo deśaśca| saṃcarante'neneti saṃcarī mārgaḥ| vahantyanena bahaḥskandhaḥ| vrajantyatra vrajo ghoṣaḥ| vyajastālavṛntam| nipātanānna vībhāvaḥ| gocarādināmavacanaṃ prāyavacanāt| halaścetyatra prāyagrahaṇānuvartanāddhañaḥ kvacidabhāvāddhaeva bhavatīti kaiyaṭaḥ| anyathā kaṣo nikaṣa ityasiddheḥ| ave vyādhiranenetyapāmārgaḥ| vimaॉjyate'vakaro'neneti vimārgaḥ samūhanī| adhyāyanyāyodyāvasaṃhārāśca || 122 || adhīyate'sminnadhaayāyaḥ| niyantyanena nyāyaḥ| udyuvanyanenetyādi| `avahārādhārāvāyānāmupasaṃkhyānam'| adhikaraṇārthāścaite iti bhāṣyam| vṛttikārastu vārtikasthāvādhārāvāyaśabdau sūtre prakṣipya cakāradāvahāraśabdasaṃgraha ityāha| spaṣṭa cedaṃ kaiyaṭādau| yadyapi ghaño ghāpavādatvāddhañabhāve gha eva yuktaḥ tathāpi ghañ‌pratiṣedhasāmarthyāddhasyāpyabhāvaḥ| rūpasāmyāt| ghe kūdūttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa ghañyapi thāthādisvareṇāntodāttasāmyācca| `anudakagrahaṇānarthakyaṃ prāyavacanāt'| udakodañaacana ityatra prāyoktyaiva ghābhāvāttsūtramanārabhyamityarthaḥ| jālamānāyaḥ || 124 || jaladhānye jvalitikasantebhyoṇa iti jālaśabde siddhe ānāyaśabda eveha nipātyaḥ| ānīyante matsyādayo'nenetyānāyaḥ| jālaṃ kim ānayaḥ| khano ghaca || 125 || cāddhañ| ākhanaḥ| khanaḥ| cajo riti kutvārhāvayavābhāvāddhitkaraṇānupayoge tatsāmarthyādanyato'pyayam| tena bhagamiti siddham| `khanerḍaḍaraikaikavakāvācyāḥ'| ākhaḥ| ākharaḥ| ḍitvāṭṭilopaḥ| ākhanikaḥ| ākhanikavakaḥ| ākhanādayaḥ ṣaṭ khanitrārthāḥ| atra vartikam| `ajabhyāṃ strīkhalanāḥ striyāḥ khalano vipratiṣedhena'| cayo lavaḥ kṛtirdṛtirityādau ubhayoḥ sāvakāśatve citiḥ śrutirityatra paratvāktin| evamuttaradvaye'pi cayaityādiravakāśo darśanīyaḥ īṣadbhedamityādau khalo'vakāśaḥ| īṣaccayaṃ duścayamīṣallavaṃ durlavaṃ sulavāmityatra khal| idhmavraścana ityatra anasyāvakāśe palāśacayana ityādau ana eva| evaṃ kṛtirityādistrīpratyayasya īṣadbhedamityādiḥ khalo'vakāśaḥ| īṣadbhedā durbhedetyādau khal| eva saktudhānī tailapīḍanītyādau strīpratyayaṃ bādhitvā ano bodhyaḥ| iṣad‌duḥ suṣu kṛcchrākṛcchrārtheṣu khal || 126 || eṣu duḥ khasukhārtheṣūpapadeṣu bhāvakarmaṇoḥ khal syāt| tayorevetyukteḥ karaṇādhikaraṇayoriti nivṛttam| atradurityasya kṛchrārthatve itarayorakṛchrārthatve iti vibhāgo yogyatāgamyaḥ| duṣkaraḥ kaṭo bhavatā| īṣatkaraḥ sukaro vā| iha karmaṇo'bhidhānātkaṭa iti prathamā| naloketi ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhātkartari tṛtīyā| laḥ svarārthaḥ| khitvaṃ tu yadyapi na mumādyartham| anavyayasyeti vacanāt| tathāpi uttaratra tadartham| kartṛkarmaṇośca bhūkṛñoḥ || 127 || iha kartṛkarmaṇorna pratyayārthatvaṃ kintvīṣadādīnāmivopapadatvameva anyathākhitakaraṇavaiyarthyāpatteḥ| anavyayasyetīṣadādīnāṃ tadayogāt| naceṣadādīnāmupapadatve mānābhāvaḥ| cakāreṇa tadbhāvāt taduktaṃ `kartṛkarma grahaṇaṃ copapadārthamiti| yathāsaṃkhyaṃ tu nāstīti pāguktam| `cvyarthayoriti vaktavyam'| tenābhūtatadbhāvādanyatra nāyam| anāḍhyena bhavatā īṣadāḍhyena śakyaṃ bhavituṃ īṣadāḍhyaṃ bhavam| durāḍhyambhavam| anāḍhyo yamīṣadāḍhyaḥ śakyaḥ kartum| īṣadāḍhyaṃkaraḥ| akṛchrāṭhyaḥ kriyate bhavatetyarthaḥ| durāḍhyaṃkaraḥ svāḍhyaṅkaraḥ| atra suśabdasya gatitvā ddhātoḥ prāk prayogaḥ| kartṛkarmaṇostu khitkaraṇasāmarthyāddhā tvavyavadhāneti prāguktam| īṣedityādi kim| īṣatkṛchram| sukhaṃ vā kāryam| alpamityādirthaḥ| īṣadityādi kim| manāgāḍhyena bhūyate| cvyarthayoḥ kim| āḍhyena subhūyate| āto yuc || 128 || ādantāddhātoruktaviṣaye yuc| khalapavādaḥ īṣatpānaḥ somobhavatā duḥpānaḥ supānaḥ| chandasi gatyarthebhyaḥ || 129 || khal‌viṣayeyuc sūpasadano'gniḥ susenopasattuṃ śakya ityarthaḥ| anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate || 130 || sudohanaḥ| `bhāṣāyāṃ śāsiyudhidṛśidhṛṣimṛṣibhyo yujvaktavyaḥ'| duḥśāsanaḥ| duryodhanaḥ| durdarśanaḥ| durdharṣaṇaḥ| durmaṣaṃṇaḥ| iti śrīsiddhāntasudhānidhau tṛtīyādhyāyasya tṛtīye pāde prathamamāhnikam| tṛtīyādhyāye tṛtīyapāde dvitīyamāhnikam || 2 || vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadvā || 131 || sāmīpyamiti svārthe ṣyañiti kecit| bhāva ityanye| nacātideśyapratyayārthānāmeva sāmīpyasambandho natu varttamānasyeti samāsānupapattiḥ| paramparayopapatteriti kaiyaṭaḥ| etena bhāvārthe vartamānaśabdena samāso na syāt| nahi sāmīpyasya vartumānena sambandhaḥ| apitu samīpena tasya tad‌guṇatvāditi nyāsakāro ktamapāstam| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaniṣedho rūpādīnāmevetyeke anitya ityanye| guṇākṣiptasya guṇina eva niṣedhaḥ| naca vartamānaḥsāmīpyasya guṇī kiṃ tu bhūtabhaviṣyantāvityapare| vatkaraṇaṃ prakṛtyādivyavasthārtham| anyathā yasmāddātorvartamāne yasya pratyayasya vidhānaṃ sa viśeṣānupādānādasmādatideśāddhātvantarādapi syāt| yābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyo yenopādhinā prakṛtyupapadābhidheyarūpeṇa ye pratyayā vihitāstābhya eva prakṛtibhyastasminnevopādhau te vartamānasamīpe bhūte bhaviṣyati ca bhavantītyarthavijñānāt| tena pūṅ‌yajorvihitaḥ śānan vartamānasamīpe'pi tābhyāmeva nānyasmāt| tacchīlādau kartari alaṃkṛñityādinā iṣṇujuktaḥ sa tādṛśa eva kartaryupādhau nānyādṛśa ityādi| anyathā vartamānavadityatideśāvirodhāt| kālamātravyabhicārasyaitadarthatvāt| kadāāgato'syayamāgacchāmi| āgamaṃ vā| kadā gamiṣyasi yava gacchāmi gamiṣyāmi vā| praśnavākye bhūtabhaviṣyatkālanirdeśa udāharaṇavākye tadabhivyaktyarthaḥ ayamityādipadasyāgamanādervartamānasāmīpyaṃ dyotyam| gamanāgamanāvinābhūtaprasvedaparikarabandhādiviśiṣṭaparāmarṣāt| nanu laḍevātrodāhriyate| tatra bālaḍityeva sūtraṃ yuktamiti cenna| eṣo'smi pacan eṣo'smi pacamāna ityādyarthatvāt| pūṅ‌ yajoḥ śānan, tācchīlya vayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaś‌, iṅ‌dhāryādibhyaḥ śatṛpratyayaśca bodhyaḥ| laṭaḥ śataśānacāvityatra vartamānavihitasyopādānāt| anyathā laṭ‌sme ityādivihitasyādeśasya tadādeśaprasaṅgāt| idamāropeṇopapattyā pratyākhyātam| āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca || 132 || āśaṃsā abhimatārthavāñchā| sā svarūpato vartamānāpi viṣayasya bhaviṣyatvāttādṛśyucyate| atideśasya viṣayabhūtā ca| āṃśasāyāṃ viṣaye āśesyamānakriyāvacanāddhātorbhaviṣyati kāle bhūtavadvartamānavacca pratyayā bhavanti ityarthaḥ| devaścedavarṣīdvarṣati vāyamatideśo bhūtasāmānyārthatvāt natu laṅ‌liṭoḥ sāmānyātideśe viśeṣānatideśa itinyāyāt| kṣipravacane lṛṭ || 133 || vacanagrahaṇaṃ svarūpamātranirāsārtham| pūrvaviṣaye lṛṭ| vṛṣṭiścotkṣipramāśu vā yāsyati śīghraṃ vapsyāmaḥ| anāśaṃsārtha ārambhaḥ| niṣedhamapahāya lṛṭo grahaṇaṃ luṭo viṣaye'pi lṛḍartham| śvaḥ śīghraṃ vapsyāmaḥ| āśaṃsāvacane liṅ || 134 || āśaṃsārthe upapade bhaviṣyati liṅ| bhūtavaccetyasyāyamapavādaḥ guruścedupeyādāśaṃse'dhīyīya| āśaṃse kṣipramadhīyīya| nānadyatanavatkriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoḥ || 135 || kriyāyāḥ sātatye sāmīpyeca laṅ‌luṭau na| anadyatane tayorvidhānānniṣedhasyāpi prasaktisāpekṣasya tadviṣayakatvāt| yāvajjīvamannamadāt dāsyati vā| sāmīpyaṃ sajātīyenāvyavadhānam| yeyaṃ paurṇamāsyatikrāntā tasyāmagnīnādadhīta somenāyaṣṭa| yeyamamāvāsyāgāminī tasyāmagnīnādhāsyate somena yakṣyate| tithyantareṇa vyavadhāne'pi paurṇamāsyantareṇāmāvāsyāntareṇacāvyavādhānānna doṣaḥ| syādetat| anadyatanavadityādyeva sūtryatām| niṣedhāpekṣayā lāghavāt| maivam| apūrvavidhitvāpattau luṅ‌lṛṭoranyonyaviṣaye saṃkaraprasaṅgāt| naca vatkaraṇasāmarthyam. bhūtabhaviṣyacchadbopādānena luṅ‌lṛṭorvidhāne'pi anadyatane dṛṣṭatvamastīti tanmātreṇa svakālātiriktakālepi tatprasaṅgasya durvāratvāt| vadityasya dṛṣṭārthatayāpyupapatteḥ| yathānyāse tu vatkaraṇamanadyatanaviśeṣavihitānāmapi niṣedhārthama| prayojanāntarābhāvāt| nānadyatana ityeva siddheḥ| tena parokṣe liṭ haśaśvatorlaṅ‌ca laṭ‌mme puriluṅ‌cāsme ityetatsūtravihitānāmayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| anadyatanapratyayapratiṣedhena maulaireva vidhivākyairapavādaviṣayamapahāya yathāsvaṃ pratyayā vidhīyante iti na ko'pi doṣaḥ| bhaviṣyati maryādāvacane'varasmin || 136 || akriyāprabandhārtho'sāmīpyārthaścārambhaḥ| vacanasāmarthyācca tayornivṛttaḥ bhaviṣyati kāle maryādoktāvarvāgbhāge'nadyatanavanna| yo'yamadhvā gantavyaḥ pāṭaliputrāttasya yadavaraṃ kauśāmbyāḥ tatra saktūn pāsyāmaḥ| kālavibhāge cānahorātrāṇām || 137 || pūrvasya sarvānuvṛttiḥ yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ| anahorātrāṇāmiti saṃbandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī| tena yadāhorātrāṇāmanyena kālena vibhāgaḥ, anyasya vāhorātraiḥ| ahorātrāṇaāṃ vāhorātraiḥ tatra sarvatra pratiṣedha iti bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ spaṣṭam| yo'yaṃ savatsara āgamī tasya yadavaramāgrahāyaṇyāstatra yuktā adhyeṣyāmahe| anahorātrāṇāṃ kim| yo'yaṃ māsa āgāmī tasya yadavaraḥ pañcadaśarātraḥ tatrādhyetāsmahe| atra māsasya pūrvapañcadaśarātreṇāvaccheda evavibhāgaḥ| parasmin vibhāṣā || 138 || pūrvasūtradvayasyānuvṛtti rnatvavarasminnityasya| parasminniti viśeṣyopādānāt| aprāptavibhāṣeyam| yoyaṃ saṃvatsara āgāmī tasya yatparamāgrahāyavyāstatrādhyeṣyāmahe| adhyetāsmahe vā| nanu deśavibhāge'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ syāditi cenna| bhaviṣyati maryādāvacane'varasminnanahorātrāṇāmityekayoge kartavye pṛthagyogakaraṇenaparasminniti sūtre kālavibhāgamātrasabandhasya jñāpitatvāt| tena yo'yamadhvā gantavya āpāṭaliputrāttasya yatparaṃ kauśambyāstatra saktūn pātāsma iti luṭ| liṅ‌nimittelṛṅ‌kriyātipattau || 139 || liṅo nimittaṃ hetuhetumadbhāvādi tatra lṛṅ‌ kriyāyā aniṣpattau gamyamānāyām| atra lṛṅo bhaviṣyatvaṃ hetuhetumadbhāvo'tipattiścārthaḥ| yasmin deśe kālevā yasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ saṃbhavastadanyatra tatkriyāyāḥ prasañjanaṃ atipattiḥ| tatra bhaviṣyatvaṃ kṛtyarthakākhyātasthale kṛtau āśrayatvārthakasthaleca dhātvarthe'nveti| hetuhetumadbhāvaśca kriyāyāṃ, dhātvarthaḥ prasaṃjane prakāratayā, prathamāntarthaśca viśeṣyatayānveti| yadi varṣasahasramajīviṣyaṃ tadā putraśatamajanayiṣyam| ityatra yadiśabdasya kriyānvitamanirddhāraṇaṃ kālaviśeṣaścārthaḥ| dvitīyāyāvyāpakatvanirūḍhalakṣaṇayā'lyantasaṃyogorthaḥ| tathāca nirdhāritakālaviśeṣavṛttibhaviṣyaddhetusahasravarṣavyāpakajīvanaprakārakasambhāvanāviśeṣyohaṃ tatkālīna bhaviṣyatkārthaśataputrakarmakotpatyanukūlavyāpāraprakārakasambhavanāviśeṣya iti bodhaḥ| ihavartasahasa3jīvitvasya svasmin bādhadaśāyāṃ prasaktireva sambhāvanā| tadasatve saṃśaya eveti kecit| anyetu tatrayogyatāniścayasattve'pi āhāryaṃ śābdam| anirdhāritakālaviśeṣavṛttibhaviṣyaddhetubhūtavarṣasahasrajīvitvavānaham| tatkālīnabhaviṣyatkāryabhūtapūtraśatotpattyanukūlavyāpāravān iti bodhaḥ| yadvā etādṛśasthale padārthepasthimātrejāte tadbalādvyāptyādipratisandhāne mānasa eva saṃśayātmakabodhaḥ| prācīnamate śabdo nityo navetyādivat| sūtrasya tu tādṛśātipattisthale liṅo'sādhutve tātparyamityāhuḥ| apare tvanāgatakālīnavarṣasahasrajīvitvābhāvaprayukto mama putraśatotpādakatvābhāva ityāhuḥ| nanu yadi māṃsamalapsyata tadā'bhokṣyata ityādau sādhanasya māṃsāderatipattāvapi sādhanāntareṇa bhojanakriyāniṣpatteḥ kathaṃ lṛḍiticedatra bhāṣyam| karaṇabhedena kriyābhedānmāṃsātipattau māṃsabhojanakriyātipattireveti| etatsvārasyāccecchabdasyābhāvo'rthaḥ tatra bhaviṣyatkālasambandhitvaṃ cecchabdasamabhivyāhṛtadhātvarthaśca viśeṣaṇam| abhāvaśca prayuktatvasambandhena bhaviṣyatkālasambandhyabhāve tasya pratiyogitayākriyāntare'nvayaḥ| dhātvantarokteralṛṅarthabhabhiṣyakālasambandhitvasya bhāve punaranvayasvīkārāt| tathāca bhaviṣyatkālasambandhī yo māṃsakarmakalābhābhāvastatprayuktābhāvapratiyoginī māṃsabhakṣaṇakriyoti bodhaḥ| evamanyatrāpyūhyam| bhīteca || 140 || prathamasūtrasya sarvānuvṛttiḥ| udāharaṇāni| utāpyoḥ samartayorityārabhya vakṣyante tataḥ prāgvikalpokteḥ| votāpyoḥ || 141 || otāpyoriti cchedaḥ| tatrāpyā utāpyoriti samāsaḥ| vibhaktyantamevānukṛtyāṅā samāso'vyayatvādvibhakterluk| utāpyoḥ samarthayorityataḥ prāk‌ bhūte liṅ‌nimitte lṛṅ‌vetyadhikṛtaṃ bodhyam| āṅ‌cātra maryādāyām| garhāyāṃ laḍapijātvorityasya laḍvidhāyakatvena liṅ‌nimittābhāvāt| vibhāṣākathamityabhivyāpya utāpyoḥ samarthayorityataḥ prāk liṅo vidhānaṃ tatrabhūte liṅ‌vikalpo bhaviṣyati tu nityamiti phalitārthaḥ| gārhāyāṃ laḍapi jātvoḥ || 142 || ābhyāṃ yoge laṭ kālatraye garhāyām| luṅādīnāṃ paratvādbādhako'yam| api jā yāṃ tyajasi gaṇikāmādatse garhitametat| garhitapadaṃ tātparyadyotanārtham| garhādiviśiṣṭe prakṛtyarthe iti kaiyaṭokteḥ| vibhāṣā kathamiliṅ‌ca || 143 || garhāyāṃ kālatraye liṅ cāllaṭ| kathaṃ dharmaṃtyajeḥ| tyajasi vā| liṅ‌vikalpātpakṣe kālatraye lakārāḥ kathaṃ nāmātrabhavān dharmamatyakṣyat| kiṃ vṛttelṛṅ‌lṛṭau || 144 || garhāyāṃ vibhāṣāyā nānuvṛttiḥ| kaḥ kataraḥ katamo vā hariṃ nindet| nindiṣyati vā| lṛṅ prāgvat| anaklaॉptyamarṣayorakiṃvṛtte'pi || 145 || garhāyāmiti nivṛttam| anavaklṛptirasambhāvanā| amārṣo'kṣamā| idaṃ dvayamanuvartate garhāyāñceti yāvat| nasambhāvayāmi na marṣaye vā bhavān hariṃ nindet| nindiṣyati vā| kaḥ katara ityādi prāgvat| asya lṛṭaḥ kālatraye vidhānādbhaviṣyadarthayoge'pi bhaviṣyadīkāravihitatvābhāvāt| lṛṭaḥ sadvetyādeśo nabhavatīti bodhyam| kiṃ kilāstyartheṣu lṛṭ || 146 || nipātasamudāyo'yaṃ krodhārthaḥ| astyarthā astibhavatividyatayaḥ| ubhayaṃ ca vikalpenopapadam| liṅo'pavādaḥ| na śraddadhe namarṣayāmi vā kiṃ kila tvaṃ śūdrānnaṃ bhokṣyase| asti bhavati vidyate vā śūdrīṃ gamiṣyasi| jātuyadorliṅ‌ || 147 || `yadai yadyorupasaṃkhyānam' lṛḍapavādaḥ| jātu yat yadā padi vā tvādṛśo hariṃ nidet nāvakalpayāmi na marṣayāmi|| yacca yatrayoḥ || 148 || yacca yatra vā tvamevaṃ kuryāḥ naśraddadhe namarṣayāmi| yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ| garhāyāṃ ca || 149 || anavaklṛptyamarṣayoriti vācyam| yacca yatrayoge liṅevasyāt| yacca yatra vā tvaṃ śūdraṃ yājayeḥ| anyāyyaṃ tat| citrīkaraṇe ca || 150 || yacca yatra vā tvaṃ śudraṃ yājayorāścaryametat| śeṣelṛḍayadau || 151 || yaccayatrābhyāmanyasmin upapade āścarye gamye lṛṭ| āścaryamandho nāma kṛṣṇaṃ drakṣyati| ayadau kim| āścaryaṃ yadi sa bhuñjīta atra yadi śabdasya saṃbhāvane prayogāttatra tātparya pratītyā sambhāvane'valamiti cedityanenaiva liṅiti bhāṣyam| utāpyoḥ samarthayorliṅ || 152 || bāḍhamityarthe'nayorarthasāmyaṃ uta api vā hanyādaghaṃ hariḥ| samarthayoḥ kim| uta daṇḍaḥ patiṣyati| apidhāsyati dvāram| praśna ācchādanaṃ cārthaḥ| itaḥ prabhṛti liṅ‌nimitte kriyātipattau bhūte'pi nityo lṛṅ‌| kāmapravedane'kacciti || 153 || kaccicchabdādanyana svecchāyāṃ prakāśyamānāyāṃ liṅ‌| kāmo me bhuñjīta bhavān| bhavatkartṛkabhojanaṃ madicchāviṣaya ityarthaḥ| akicciti kim| kaccijjīvati| atrapraśno'pi kaccitpadasyārthaḥ| tathāca madicchāviṣayo jīvanaṃ jijñāsāviṣaya ityarthaḥ| sambhāvane'lamiticetsiddhāprayoge || 154 || alamartho'tra prauḍhiḥ| tatprakārake sambhāvane gamye lṛṭ alaṃśabdaḥ siddhāprayogaścet| vibhaktivyatyayalakṣyo'yamarthaḥ| yatprayogavyatireke'pi sortho gamyate sa siddāprayogaḥ| api giriṃ śirasā bhindyāt| siddhetikim| alaṃ kṛṣṇo hastinaṃ haniṣyati| vibhāṣādhātau sambhāvanavacane'yadi || 155 || sambhāvane'rthe dhātāvupapade liṅ‌vā natu yadyoge| vikalpārtha ārambhaḥ| sambhāvayāmi bhuñjīta bhavān bhokṣyate vā| ayadīti kim| sambhāvayāmi yad‌bhuñjīthāstvam| hetuhetumatorliṅ || 156 || vibhāṣā syāt kṛṣṇaṃ nameccet sukhaṃ yāyāt| kṛṣṇaṃ naṃsyati cet sukhaṃ yāsyati| bhaviṣyatyeveṣyate| neha| hantīti palāyate| iha lakṣaṇa hetvoriti śatrādeśo netyeveti siddhāntaḥ| tathāca vārtikam| devatrāto garo grāha itiyogeca sadvidhiḥ mitho naiva vikalpyante gavākṣaḥ śaṃsitavrataḥ iti| eṣu natvalatvābhāvau ṇaḥ sadādeśābhāva avaṅ‌ itvaṃca nityameva pravartante vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu tiṅantavācyakriyāyāḥ kriyāntare sādhanatvenānvayasya bhāṣyasiddhatvāt| atrakathaṃ tayoḥ parasparānvaya iticet| atrakecit| ākāṅkṣārūpānvaye bhāṣyatātparyam| samabhivyāhāraviśeṣasya niyāmakatvāt| atraca yacchabdādisamabhivyāhāreṇa kriyāyāḥ kriyāntarākāṅkṣotthāpanam| natu kṛṣṇaṃ namedityādau ato nadoṣa ityāhuḥ| miśrāstu yo brāhmaṇāyāvagurettaṃ śatena yātayādityatra hetuhetumatorliṅityanuśāsanādyo brāhmaṇavadhodyamaprāgabhāvavān sa ta duttaravartiśatayātanāvāniti bodhyate| hetutve-pūrvavartitve| hetumattve uttaravartitve liṅanuśāsanāt| niyamaśca(yadyogaḥ prāthamya)mutpattibalalabhya ityāhuḥ| anyetu niyamāṃśe'pi śaktau nadoṣaḥ| niyatapaurvāparyaṃ bodhyate itimūlasvārasyādityāhuḥ| evaṃcātrāpi niyatapūrvavṛttiryā kṛṣṇanamanakriyā sāmānādhikaraṇyena tadviśiṣṭā uttaravṛttisukhaprāptikriyeti liṅarthaviśiṣṭayoḥ kriyayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyenaivānvayaḥ| natu sādhanatveneti nadoṣa iti kaiyaṭasvārasyānusāriṇaḥ| icchārtheṣu liṅ‌loṭau || 157 || praiṣātisargaprāptakāleṣukṛtyāśca || 158 || prāptaviṣaye preraṇaṃ praiṣaḥ| atisargaḥ kāmacārānujñā| svādhyāyo'dhyetavya ityādau tvaprāptatvādviśeṣyamātraparatvam| bhavatā yaṣṭavyam| bhavān yajatām| cakāraḥ prāptakāle loṭo bādhāpattyā tadabhāvārthaḥ| liṅ‌cordhvamauhūrtiko || 159 || praiṣādīnāṃ gamyatve kṛtyā liṅ‌casyuḥ| ūrdhvaṃ muhūrtādyajeta| yajatām| tvayā yaṣṭavyam| sme loṭ || 160 || smaśabde upapade loṭ pūrvaviṣaye| ūrdhvaṃmuhūrtādyajatāṃ sma| liṅaḥ kṛtyānāṃ cāpavādaḥ| adhīṣṭeca || 161 || atra gamye sme upapade loṭ| tvaṃ smādhyāpaya| kālasamayavelāsutumun || 162 || kālo bhoktum| samayo velā vā| liṅ‌ yadi || 163 || yacchabde kālādiṣu copapadeṣu liṅ| kālo yad‌bhuñjīta bhavān| sayayo velā vā yacchadbaḥ kālādyanyataraccetyupapadadvayamatra bodhyam| arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca || 164 || tadyoge kartari gamye liṅca kṛtyatṛcaḥ syuḥ| tvaṃ kanyāṃ vaheḥ| boḍhumarho'sītyarthaḥ| kreyaṃ krayaṇārhamityarthaḥ| stutimarhaḥ stotā| liṅā bādho mābhūditi kṛtyatṛjvidhānam| āvaśyakādhamarṇyayorṇiniḥ || 165 || grāmaṃ gamī| śatamṛṇaṃ dāyī| akenorbhaviṣpadādhamarṇya yoriti ṣaṣṭhī niṣedhaḥ| kṛtyāśca || 166 || uktayorarthayoḥ syuḥ| yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ| śaki liṅ‌ca || 167 || śaktau liṅ cātkṛtyāḥ| tvaṃbhāraṃ vaheḥ| bhāravahane śaktosītyarthaḥ| vohuṃ śakyo voḍhavyo vahanīyo vāhyaḥ| liṅā bādhā mābhūditi kṛtyoktiḥ| naca vāsarūpavidhinā siddhiḥ| stryadhikārādūrdhvaṃ vāsarūpavidhirnāstītyasya jñāpyatvāt| yadyapi praiṣetisūtre kṛtyāścetyanenāpi tajjñāpayituṃ śakyam| tathāpyatra cakāramātreṇa jñāpayituṃ śakyam| tatra tu kṛtyagrahaṇena kṛtyatṛjgrahaṇenaceti gauravādasyaiva jñāpakatvaṃ yuktamityāhuḥ| paribhāṣā prayojanānyucyante| chātrasya hasitam hasanaṃ veti kṛtyalyuṭo viṣaye napuṃsake bhāve ghañ‌na| icchati bhoktumityatrāśiṣi loṭ‌na| liṅ‌tu liṅ‌cetiviśiṣyadarśanāt| īṣatpānaityāto yuco viṣaye khal‌neti saṃkṣepaḥ| kāmapravedane iti vaktavyam| neha icchan karoti kāmapravedanaṃ svavṛttīcchāyā jñāpanam| ihatu kṛtiheturicchānyavṛttiḥ| tathāca liṅuccārayituricchāyāṃ icchāpadasya tātparye liṅityarthaḥ| nanvevaṃ kāmapravedane akaccitīti sūtraveyarthyam| yatrārthaprakaraṇādināpi kāmapravedanaṃ gamyate tadarthatvāt| nacaivamapyasya vaiyarthyam loḍarthatvāt| viśeṣavihitena tena liṅo bādho mābhūditi liṅāpyukteḥ| naca loṭ‌ cetyeva nirvāhaḥ| cakāreṇa liṅo'nukarṣe tatsaṃbaddhavibhāṣāgrahaṇasyāpi tadāpatteḥ| mīmāṃsakāstu uktarītyā tatsūtrasārthakyaṃ niryuktikam| ato'nena sūtreṇa icchāyāmarthe liṅ vidhīyate natu icchārthadhātuyoge| tena yadi rathantarasāmā somaḥ syādaindravāyavāgrān gṛhṇīyāt ityādau grahītumicchedityartha ityāhuḥ| liṅ‌ ca || 168 || samānakarkṛkeṣu icchārtheṣu upapadeṣu liṅ| bhuñjīyatīcchati| samānakartṛkeṣu tumun‌vakṣyate| sa yathā pūrvasūtreṇa prāptaṃ loṭaṃ bādhate evaṃ liṅamapi bādheteti liṅrthaṃ ārambhaḥ| naceha vāsarūpanyāyaḥ| ktalyuṭ‌tumun‌khalartheṣu tanniṣedhāt| icchārthebhyovibāṣāvartamāne || 169 || pakṣe laṭ| icchet| icchati| kāmayeta kāmayate| etena pāṇipīḍanamahaṃ damayantyāḥ kāmaye mahimahīmihikāṃśo itinaiṣadhaṃ vyākhyātam| vidhinimantraṇāmantraṇādhīṣṭasampraśnaprārthaneṣu liṅ || 170 || vidhau svargakāmo yajeta| nimantraṇe iha bhuñjīta bhavān| āvaśyake śrāddhabhojanādau dauhitrādeḥ pravartanaṃ tat| tadatikramaṇe ca nimantraṇīyasya pratyavāyaḥ| āmantraṇaṃ kāmacārānujñā| yadakaraṇe'pi na pratyavāyaḥ| nivāraṇābhāvavyaṃjakeccheti yāvat| ihāsīta nyāyavyutpādanārthaṃ vā prapañcārthamathāpi vā| vidhyādīnāmupādānaṃ caturṇāmāditaḥ kṛtam|| astipravartanārūpamanusyūtaṃ caturṣvapi|| tatraiva liṅ vidhātavyaḥ kiṃbhedasya vivakṣayā| abhidhānaprayojikā jijñāsā praśnaḥ| kiṃbho vedamadhīyīya| utta tarkam| lābhecchā prārthanā| bhojanaṃ labheya| atra vidhyādayo'rthāḥ dyotyā ityekaḥ pakṣaḥ| anyathā nāprāpteṣu kartrādiṣu vidhyādayo nirdiśyamānāsteṣāṃ bādhāpatteḥ| tataśca karturanabhidhānaprasaṅgādvivacanabahuvacanānupapatteśca| tadarthasya dvitvādeḥ kartṛkarmānyataramātrānvayitvāt| śabādīnāmanupapatteśca| siddhāntastu vācyā evaite vidhyādibhirvirodhābhāvāt| laḥ karmāṇacetyatra sarvasaṃgrahārthāt bahuvacananirdeśādvobhayānugrahācca kartrādayo na bādhyante iti kartṛkarmagatadvibahutvanibandhanānāṃ dvivacanabahuvacanānā mupapatteḥ| laḍādāvapi vartamānatvāderarthaviśeṣasya sarvatra sattvena tasya kartrādyarthabādhakatvāpattyā kartrādīnāmapi niravakāśatvāccetyākarasiddhiḥ panthāḥ| iti tṛtīyasya dvitīyamāhnikam| iti tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ| <3.4> tṛtīyādhyāye caturthapāde prathamamāhnikam| atha caturthaḥ pādaḥ|| dhātusambandhe pratyayāḥ || 1 || ihavṛttābekatvasyautsargikatve'pi sāmarthyāhvitvāvagatiḥ| sambandhasya sambandhibhedaniyatatvāt| dhātoḥ sambandho sambandho dhātusambandhaḥ| dhātupadaṃca tadarthaparam| tatra biśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvalakṣaṇasambandhopapatteḥ| dhātoḥ svārthopasthāpakatayaivopayogena vākyārthānanvayāt| śabdopahitārthabhānapakṣe'pi svārtha eva viśeṣaṇatvāt| parasparaṃ viśeṣaṇatvānupatteḥ| naca san‌vidhau karmatvasamānakartṛtvayoryathārthadvārakaṃ viśeṣaṇatvaṃ tathehapi dhātorarthadvārakasambandho'stviti vācyam| parasparānvitārthabodhakānekadhātuprayoge pratyayā ityarthāpattyā gomānāsīdityāderasiddheḥ| atra vartamānakāle'steraprayogāt| aprayujyamānasya ca sambandhānupapatteḥ| tathāca dhātvarthayoḥ sambandhe kālāntaravihitānāṃ pratyayānāṃ kālāntare'pi sādhutvābyanujñānārthaṃ sūtram| dhātvarthasambandhe yatra kāle pratyayā uktāste tadbhinnakāle'pi syuriti vākyārthaḥ| prakṛtipratyayopapadāni tānyeva kālamātre tu vaiṣamyamato na sāṃkaryam| naca vinigamakābhāvaḥ| vartamānasāmipye ityādau kālavipartayasyaiva pratipādyatvāt| vasan dadarśa bhūte laṭ| agniṣṭomayājyasya putro bhavitā| bhaviṣyati ṇiniḥ| somena yakṣyamāṇo yaḥ putrastatkartṛkā vartamānaprāgabhāvapratiyoginyutpattirityarthaḥ| pratyayagrahaṇe'nuvartamāne'pi pratyayagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtyantaravihitānāmapi pratyayānāṃ parigrahārtham| tena gomānāsīdityādau vartamānasattāviśiṣṭaprakṛtyarthayuktārthavṛttimatuppratyayaprakṛtyarthasya bhūtabhaviṣyatve'pi sādhutvam| nanuviśeṣaṇa viśeṣyabhūtayoḥ kriyayoḥ viruddhakālavaruddhatvādananvayāpattau taduddhārārthamayamārambhaḥ| sacānyataratra kālavaiparītyenopapādyaḥ| nanutiṅantakālavaiyarītyenāpi saṃbhavatīti suvantārthakālavādha eva kiṃ niyāmakamiticet| atrāhuḥ tiṅantavacyikriyāyā viśeṣyatvāttadbādhāpekṣayā guṇabhūtakriyāvāciprakṛtipratyayārthasyaiva kālasya bādhaḥ guṇānurodhena pradhānānurodhasyāyuktatvāt| guṇe tvanyāyyakalpaneti nyāyāt| syādetat| prathamāntārthamukhyaviśeṣyakabodhavādināṃ naiyāyikānāṃ kathamiyaṃ vyavasthā kriyādvayasyāpi viśeṣaṇatvāditi cet maivam| śābde tasya prādhānye'pi agniṣṭomayājitvaviśiṣṭaputrotpattervidheyatayā tadupapatteḥ| nacaviśiṣṭavidhitvādviśeṣaṇasyāpi vidheyatvamitivācyam| viśiṣṭavidyanyathānupapattyā viśeṣaṇavidheḥ kalpanādupajīvyatvena bhavitetyasyaiva prādhānyāt| nanu śābdānvaye śabdasyaiva prādhānyasya niyāmakatvaṃ tathā cāprathamāntārthayoranvayasyāntaraṅgatayā jyotiṣṭomayājitvaviśiṣṭe putre bhavitetyasyānvayo'traya prathamopasthitakālabādhāpekṣayā bhavitetyasya kālabādha eva syāditicenna| jyotiṣṭhomānukūlakṛtiviśiṣṭe putre vartamānaprāgabhāvapratiyogyutpattivaiśiṣṭhyabodhasya bādhitatayā hyatra kālāvarodhaḥ| bhavatica atītotpattiko'syaputro'tītoktakṛtimāniti bodho bādhitaḥ| jyotiṣṭomānūkūla bhaviṣyatkṛtimānasya putro bhaviṣyan iti tvabādhita ityasyaiva vinigamakatvāditi dik| bhāṣyakārāstu viśeṣyabhūtakriyāyāḥ svakāla evāvasānaṃ viśeṣaṇabhūtāyāstūpalakṣaṇa bhāvenopādānāt| bhāvibhūtavyapadeśaḥ| tathāca padasaṃskāravelāyāṃ bhūta eva ṇininā vyutpanne vijiśabdo bhavitetyetatsamibhivyāhāradaśāyāṃ kālāntarārthaḥ saṃpadyate iti kālāntarapratītirbahiraṅgā| sācāntaraṅgapadasaṃskāre bādhitumakṣamaiveti sūtrametadanārabhyam| avaśyaṃca svakālaeva pratyayavidhireṣṭavyaḥ| bhāvikṛtyamāsīdityatra bhāviśabdasya bhūtakālatve bhāvyāsīcchabdayoḥ paryāyatvādyugapat prayogānāpatterityāhuḥ| kriyāsamabhihāre loṭ loṭo hisvau vā ca tadhvamoḥ || 2 || kriyāsamabhihāraḥ paunaḥ punyaṃ bhṛśārthaśca| tacca prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ natūpapadaṃ kevalānāṃ tadanāpatteḥ| iha dvau pakṣau saṃbhāvyete| hisvau tiṅādeśau vā lakārādeśo vā| nacaloṭa iti sthāninirdeśasya pratyakṣatvādādyapakṣaśaṅkānupapattiḥ| svādeśasthānikatvenāpi tadupapatteḥ| tatrādye itthamupapattiḥ| sāmānyavihitānāṃ tiṅāṃ śatṛśānacāviva hisvāvapi bādhakau syātā matastiṅādeśāḥ
